papers.title: Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning from Point Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D part decomposition methods do not necessarily partition the original shape into non-overlapping parts that collectively cover the entire shape, allowing overlaps or gaps that hinder downstream part-level applications. We instead formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape, where the predicted parts are non-overlapping and jointly recover the entire shape. Our key insight is that part decomposition should consider all desired parts jointly, rather than modeling each part independently. To this end, we develop a promptable model for 3D part decomposition from images or meshes. Users can specify desired parts through 3D point prompts for controllable decomposition. Given one point prompt per desired part, our model produces the corresponding parts as a complete partition of the entire shape. We build on a pretrained 3D generation model and first obtain a shape latent from either an input image or mesh. We then introduce a prompt encoder that maps each 3D point prompt to a part token while attending to the shape latent. To decode the desired parts, we propose a novel part decoder jointly scoring the entire shape against all part tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, assigning every position within the shape volume to exactly one part. We perform part decomposition in this shared shape latent space, enabling a unified model for image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation. Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods. Code and models will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Point2Part 把 3D 部件分解重构为对整形状的联合划分：每个 3D 点提示经 prompt encoder 变成 part token，part decoder 在共享 shape latent 中由粗到细对全形状联合打分，把体积内每个位置唯一指派给一个部件，保证部件互不重叠且合起来覆盖整个形状。在 image-to-part、mesh-to-part、part segmentation 三项任务上，部件质量指标全部超过已有方法，部件间兼容性比此前 SOTA 提升一个数量级。
Motivation: 现有 3D 部件分解方法允许部件重叠或留空隙，无法保证非重叠且完整覆盖原形状，损害下游部件级应用。
Method: 基于预训练 3D 生成模型，先从输入图像或 mesh 取得 shape latent；prompt encoder 将每个 3D 点提示映射为 part token 并对 shape latent 注意；新提出的 part decoder 以 coarse-to-fine 方式对全形状与所有 part token 联合打分，把形状体积内每个位置恰好指派给一个部件，分解在共享 shape latent 空间完成，统一支持 image-to-part、mesh-to-part 与 part segmentation。
Result: 在 image-to-part、mesh-to-part、part segmentation 三项任务的所有部件质量指标上均超过已有方法；部件间兼容性 (compatibility among parts) 相比此前 SOTA 提升一个数量级。
Conclusion: 部件分解应联合考虑所有目标部件而非逐个独立建模，联合划分能同时保证非重叠、全覆盖与部件兼容性；代码与模型将发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Robots deployed in the physical world must be able to improve beyond their initial training as they encounter new situations and failures. For this improvement to scale across tasks, it must make effective use of experience without requiring human demonstration of each correction. Recent agentic systems offer a way to reduce this reliance on human effort by using foundation models to autonomously compose learned behaviors to complete tasks. Yet completing tasks this way does not itself teach a task policy to overcome its own failures; that requires turning these behaviors into learnable corrections for the policy. Our insight is that many such corrections are familiar short behaviors, or skills: they recur across tasks and describe actions that foundation models can reason about from a scene. We introduce skill-space shooting, which uses foundation model guidance to explore corrections through these reusable skills and turn successful trials into policy improvement. Real-world experiments show repeated improvement in policies acting autonomously, while skills can also be shared to reduce the teaching needed to improve on new tasks. By making reusable skills a source of corrective supervision, skill-space shooting enables scalable and generalizable policy improvement within and across tasks. Additional results and videos at https://skill-space-shooting.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 skill-space shooting：用基础模型在可复用技能 (skills) 构成的空间里自主探索纠正行为，把成功的试次转成策略的纠正监督，从而让机器人策略在部署后持续自我改进。真实世界实验显示策略在自主行动中被反复改进，且技能可跨任务共享以减少新任务所需的示教量。
Motivation: 机器人部署后会遇到训练时没见过的失败，但逐个失败都靠人工示教纠正无法规模化；agentic 系统能用基础模型组合已有行为完成任务，却不会把这些行为变成策略可学的纠正。
Method: skill-space shooting 把常见短行为抽象为可复用技能，由基础模型结合场景推理并在技能空间中探索纠正，将成功的试次转化为对任务策略的纠正监督；技能可在任务间共享复用。
Result: 真实世界实验中，作用于自主行动的策略获得反复改进；共享技能减少了在新任务上改进所需的示教量。
Conclusion: 把可复用技能当作纠正监督的来源，可以在任务内与任务间实现可扩展、可泛化的策略改进，而不必为每次纠正采集人工示教。

papers.title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Imagine3D-LLM 在图像 token 后追加少量可学习 summary token，将其解码为紧凑 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示并用光度重建损失监督，与 next-token prediction 联合训练，让 MLLM 先在内部“想象”3D 场景再作答。该重建目标虽只直接监督 summary token，却同时增强了底层图像特征的跨帧对应，在多个空间推理与 3D 理解基准上一致超过先前注入 3D 感知的方法。
Motivation: MLLM 能处理单图，但难以把多视角证据整合成连贯的 3D 理解；现有注入 3D 感知的做法（像素级跨视角对应或融合 3D 几何基础模型特征）与人类推理仍有明显差距。
Method: 在图像 token 后追加一组可学习 summary token，解码为紧凑 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景表示，用光度重建损失 (photometric reconstruction loss) 监督，并与标准 next-token prediction 目标联合训练；思路借鉴人类空间推理——粗略对齐跨视角物体、推断视角间相对几何、组装粗 3D 布局。
Result: 在多个空间推理与 3D 理解基准上一致优于先前方法；仅 summary token 接收重建监督，却在 LLM 底层图像特征中诱导出更强的跨帧对应，说明重建学习把 3D 感知信号传播到整个模型。
Conclusion: 让模型先生成紧凑 3D 表示再作答，比直接喂入像素级几何信息更有效；重建目标可作为副产品在无显式几何监督处传播 3D 对应。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation
papers.abstract_en: The dynamics of generative models exhibit two apparently distinct temporal windows: a speciation window, in which a sample commits to a semantic class, and a nonlocality window, in which local context windows become insufficient for generation. Motivated by evidence of their near-concurrence in a variety of frontier models, we investigate their relationship through the spatial distribution of semantic information. Under a "common cause" hypothesis, we prove that the nonlocality window must lie in the speciation window. This hypothesis postulates that semantic labels explain a fraction of the correlations between distant tokens, a condition that is natural for many real datasets. We further give conditions under which both windows shrink to a single limiting time as system size grows, defining a "phase transition", and verify this behavior analytically in Gaussian mixtures. Together, these results identify conditions under which semantic information explains the concurrence of speciation and nonlocality, connecting two complementary perspectives on the emergence of semantic structure in generative modeling.
papers.comment: 9 pages main, 13 pages appendix, 4 figures. Comments very welcome
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在生成模型动力学中提出「共同原因」假设：语义标签解释了远距离 token 之间的一部分相关性，据此证明非局部性窗口必然落在物种形成窗口 (speciation window) 之内，并给出两窗口随系统尺寸增大收缩为同一极限时间（即「相变」）的条件，且在 Gaussian mixture 上给出解析验证。
Motivation: 生成模型表现出两个看似独立的时间窗口——样本确定语义类别的 speciation 窗口与局部上下文窗口不足以继续生成的 nonlocality 窗口——而前沿模型中二者近乎同时出现，其关系缺少统一解释。
Method: 从语义信息的空间分布入手，在「共同原因」假设（语义标签解释远距离 token 相关性的一部分，对真实数据集自然成立）下证明包含关系；再给出系统尺寸增长时两窗口收缩为单一极限时间的条件，并在 Gaussian mixture 中做解析验证。
Result: 证明 nonlocality 窗口必位于 speciation 窗口之内；给出两窗口随系统尺寸增长收缩为同一极限时间（定义为「相变」）的条件，并在 Gaussian mixture 中解析验证该行为。
Conclusion: 在「共同原因」假设成立的条件下，语义信息足以解释 speciation 与 nonlocality 两窗口的近乎同时出现，把生成模型中语义结构涌现的两种视角联系起来。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Teaching humanoids loco-manipulation skills, such as carrying diverse objects, via visual imitation is a promising path toward generalist robots. However, collecting diverse, high-quality interaction videos, such as clips that clearly show a person's full body and unoccluded interactions with objects, poses a practical barrier to scaling this approach. We propose PRISM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that overcomes this limitation by amplifying a handful of real videos into a large, diverse training set. PRISM first generates hundreds of diverse "counterfactual" human-object interaction videos via video-to-video (V2V) generation from a few exemplar real videos. Our contact-anchored real-to-sim pipeline then reconstructs both human and object motions, retargeting this imperfect video data into physically plausible trajectories. The intra-class variability across these counterfactual videos lets us train a single policy that generalizes to unseen objects within each category. We demonstrate the full pipeline by deploying this policy on a real robot without any real-world fine-tuning. Using only onboard depth observations, our humanoid picks up, carries, and drops objects, including boxes, barrels, bins, and balls, across novel instances, sizes, and initial configurations.
papers.comment: published at CoRL 2026. Project page: https://prism-real2sim2real.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 用 video-to-video 生成把少量真实人-物交互视频放大成数百条“反事实”视频，再经 contact-anchored real-to-sim 重建人与物运动并重定向为物理可行轨迹，训练单一策略。类内多样性使策略能泛化到未见物体，实机零微调下仅凭机载深度完成抓取、搬运与放下 boxes、barrels、bins、balls 等新实例。
Motivation: 视觉模仿通向通用人形机器人需要大量高质量交互视频，但能看清全身且不被遮挡的视频难以采集，成为规模化的主要瓶颈。
Method: PRISM 是 real-to-sim-to-real 框架：先用 V2V 生成从少量范例视频扩出数百条反事实人-物交互视频，再用 contact-anchored real-to-sim 管线重建人体与物体运动，把不完美的视频数据重定向为物理可行轨迹，最后训练单一策略。
Result: 生成数百条反事实视频；训练出的策略在真实机器人上无需任何真实世界微调，仅用 onboard depth 观测即可拾取、搬运并放下 boxes、barrels、bins、balls，覆盖未见实例、尺寸与初始配置。
Conclusion: 少量真实视频经反事实生成与物理重建放大后，类内变异性足以支撑单一策略对同类未见物体的 real-to-sim-to-real 泛化。

papers.title: Adversarial Training for Pixel Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Pixel diffusion models generate RGB images directly, avoiding the bottleneck of an autoencoder, yet their outputs still systematically underrepresent fine-scale natural-image statistics. We show that adversarial learning provides an effective post-training correction for this deficiency. Starting from a pretrained model, we retain its original diffusion or flow-matching objective and add an adversarial loss to the predicted output at non-high-noise timesteps, leaving the model architecture and sampling procedure unchanged. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of adversarial post-training for pixel diffusion. Across two pixel backbones, the method jointly improves distribution fidelity, coverage, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality. We further investigate why it works. Frequency-band and power-law analyses show that the original models systematically underproduce natural-image high-frequency content, while adversarial post-training restores this missing spectral power. In contrast, perceptual loss also increases high-frequency content but sacrifices distribution fidelity and prompt alignment. Nearest-neighbor, recall, and matched no-GAN SFT controls further rule out memorization, mode dropping, and additional optimization as simple explanations. Finally, we examine the boundary of this effect. Under the tested latent diffusion configurations, the same procedure does not produce comparable joint gains and adds almost no decoded high-frequency power. These results identify direct output access to the image statistics being corrected as a key factor governing when adversarial post-training succeeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在像素级扩散模型的预训练权重上，仅对非高噪声时间步的预测输出加对抗损失（保留原 diffusion/flow-matching 目标、架构与采样不变），可在两个 pixel backbone 上同时提升分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐与感知质量。频带与幂律分析显示原模型系统性缺失高频功率，对抗后训练补回这部分谱功率；而感知损失虽也增加高频，却牺牲分布保真与提示对齐。同一流程在所测 latent diffusion 配置上几乎不增加解码后高频功率，说明能否直接访问被修正的图像统计量是成败关键。
Motivation: 像素级扩散绕开 autoencoder 瓶颈，但输出系统性低估自然图像的细尺度统计；需要一种不改架构与采样流程的后训练修正手段，并厘清它何时失效。
Method: 从预训练模型出发，保留原 diffusion 或 flow-matching 目标，在非高噪声 (non-high-noise) 时间步对预测输出追加对抗损失 (adversarial loss)，模型架构与采样流程不变；用频带与幂律分析定位缺失的高频功率，并以 nearest-neighbor、recall 与 matched no-GAN SFT 对照排除记忆化、模式丢弃和额外优化这几种解释。
Result: 在两个 pixel backbone 上，对抗后训练同时改善分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐与感知质量；原模型系统性欠产自然图像高频内容，对抗后训练补回该谱功率，而感知损失同样增加高频却牺牲分布保真与提示 alignment。在所测试的 latent diffusion 配置下，同一流程不产生可比的联合增益，且几乎不增加解码后的高频功率。
Conclusion: 对抗后训练能否成功，取决于能否直接访问被修正的图像统计量；对 latent diffusion 这类无法直接访问输出像素的配置，该流程不奏效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding steps; spatially, errors in different key rows affect model outputs differently, while state magnitudes vary substantially along both rows and columns. Motivated by these observations, we propose STEPQuant, a spatial-temporal post-training quantization framework for Delta-rule recurrent states. STEPQuant allocates precision according to error magnitude and memory lifetime, and jointly fits key-row and value-column scales based on state distributions and key-row impact on output error. Experiments on Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct across both long- and short-generation benchmarks show that STEPQuant closely matches FP32-state accuracy under a nominal 6-bit budget and outperforms uniform INT8 in its 4-bit configuration. Integrated into SGLang with optimized GPU kernels, 6-bit STEPQuant achieves over 5x recurrent-state compression and reduces total serving memory by up to 68.7%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STEPQuant 针对线性注意力 Delta-rule 递归状态的 PTQ，按误差大小与记忆存活时长分配精度，并联合拟合 key 行与 value 列的 scale。在 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct 上，6-bit 预算下精度接近 FP32 状态且优于 4-bit 均匀 INT8；接入 SGLang 后 6-bit 实现 5 倍以上递归状态压缩，总服务内存最多降 68.7%。
Motivation: 线性注意力用固定大小递归状态替代不断增长的 KV cache，但并发服务下该状态成为内存瓶颈；直接低精度量化会因误差在连续状态更新中传播而导致精度严重下降。
Method: 提出空间-时间后训练量化 (spatial-temporal post-training quantization) 框架 STEPQuant：时间维度按记忆存活时长、空间维度按不同 key 行对输出误差的影响分配精度；依据状态分布与 key 行对输出误差的影响，联合拟合 key 行与 value 列的 scale；并配合优化的 GPU kernel 集成进 SGLang。
Result: 在 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct 的长、短生成基准上，6-bit STEPQuant 精度接近 FP32 状态，并在 4-bit 配置下优于均匀 INT8；集成 SGLang 后 6-bit 实现超过 5 倍递归状态压缩，总服务内存最多减少 68.7%。
Conclusion: 递归状态的量化误差应同时按时间存活与空间影响两个维度分配精度，可在 6-bit 预算下保住 FP32 级精度并显著降低并发服务内存。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid designs that replace standard attention with linear attention, such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Although they compress the context into a fixed-size recurrent state and substantially reduce the cost of long-context processing, repeatedly reading and updating that state remains a major inference bottleneck. Quantization offers a natural way to reduce this cost, but can significantly degrade model quality, due to the accumulation of rounding errors and the presence of outlier rows and columns in the state. To address these challenges, we propose LeapQuant, a training-free method that achieves near-lossless performance under 8-bit recurrent-state quantization. First, to mitigate error accumulation, we propose per-window quantization, which leaps over a window of tokens and quantizes the state only once at its end. Within a window, outputs are computed from the fixed low-bit state together with high-precision buffered updates. Second, to reduce the error introduced by each quantization, LeapQuant retains the state's largest outliers as a few high-precision Compensator Tokens, which share the update path of real tokens. We then smooth the remaining residual before quantization to further reduce the error. Comprehensive experiments across the Qwen, Kimi, and GLM model families show that LeapQuant substantially reduces memory and compute costs during inference. With accuracy comparable to the FP32 baseline, it achieves average speedups of 2.05--3.70$\times$ at the kernel level and 1.47$\times$ for end-to-end inference on NVIDIA B200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090 GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeapQuant 是免训练的线性注意力循环态 8-bit 量化方法：按窗口只在窗口末尾量化一次态，窗口内用高精度缓冲更新算输出，再把态中最大的离群行/列保留为少量高精度 Compensator Tokens 并对残差做平滑。在 Qwen、Kimi、GLM 系列上达到与 FP32 基线相当的精度，kernel 级平均加速 2.05–3.70×，端到端推理加速 1.47×（NVIDIA B200、RTX PRO 6000、RTX 5090）。
Motivation: 混合线性注意力 LLM（Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention）把上下文压进定长循环态，但反复读写该态成为推理瓶颈；直接量化会因舍入误差累积以及态中离群行/列而明显掉点。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 三件套：per-window quantization 跳过一个 token 窗口、仅在窗口末尾量化一次态，窗口内输出由固定低比特态加高精度缓冲更新得到；保留态中最大的离群值作为少量 Compensator Tokens，与真实 token 共享更新路径；再对剩余残差做平滑后量化。
Result: 在 Qwen、Kimi、GLM 模型家族上，8-bit 循环态量化达到与 FP32 基线相当的精度；kernel 级平均加速 2.05–3.70×，端到端推理加速 1.47×，测试硬件为 NVIDIA B200、RTX PRO 6000 与 RTX 5090。
Conclusion: 循环态量化的主要误差来自逐 token 的舍入累积与离群行/列，按窗口量化加离群补偿即可在 8-bit 下把线性注意力推理的显存与算力成本压下来而基本不掉精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data
papers.abstract_en: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation (PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. We validate our architecture with an in-depth ablation study, and analyse the performance of our model against state-of-the-art crop segmentation models on multiple tile-size variants of the popular PASTIS and MTLCC datasets. Our findings show our model to outperform all others in the task of crop class segmentation, verified across multiple important segmentation metrics, with especially strong performance against compared models seen in the often under-reported parcel delineation quality, for which we use the Boundary IoU metric. We also find that flawed class groupings within datasets can have a significant negative impact on model performance, and report that alternate tile-size variants of crop segmentation datasets produce results incomparable to one-another, invalidating fair comparison between model performance when trained on different tile-sizes. Based on these findings, we suggest further work is required to standardise best practices when constructing SITS crop segmentation datasets, and to enable future dynamic-tile-sizing for ideal model performance.
papers.comment: Main body: 19 pages, 7 figures; Appendices: 15 pages, 16 figures. All code and models associated with this work are available at https://github.com/JoeMetc/CroplandPAtteRNS , along with preparation guides for the two publicly available crop segmentation datasets used in this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合 transformer-卷积模型 PAtteRNS，首次对 Sentinel-2 多光谱 SITS 的时间、光谱、空间三个维度分别做 self-attention，并用并行 transformer 结构大幅降低三重分解注意力的计算复杂度。在 PASTIS 与 MTLCC 的多种 tile-size 变体上，其作物类别分割全面胜过对比的 SOTA 模型，尤其在 Boundary IoU 衡量的地块边界勾画上优势明显；同时发现数据集内有缺陷的类别分组会显著拉低性能，且不同 tile-size 变体的结果互不可比。
Motivation: 卫星影像时间序列 (SITS) 作物分割数据集与架构都在膨胀，但追求最新颖结构或最大数据集使细节被忽略：类别分组缺陷与 tile-size 差异会破坏模型间的公平比较。
Method: PAtteRNS 为混合 transformer-卷积模型，对 Sentinel-2 多光谱 SITS 的时间、光谱、空间三个维度分别施加 self-attention，实现 fully-factorised attention；用新的并行 transformer 架构降低三重分解 self-attention 的计算复杂度，并配合消融研究验证架构设计。
Result: 在 PASTIS 与 MTLCC 的多个 tile-size 变体上，作物类别分割全面优于对比的 SOTA 模型，覆盖多项分割指标，其中 Boundary IoU 度量的地块 delineation 质量优势尤其突出；数据集中有缺陷的类别分组对模型性能有显著负面影响，不同 tile-size 变体产生的结果互不可比，使跨 tile-size 的模型比较失效。
Conclusion: SITS 作物分割数据集的构建需要标准化最佳实践（类别分组与 tile-size 规范），并支持未来的 dynamic-tile-sizing 以获得理想模型性能。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReWAM 用 DINO 预训练特征加 Feature Calibration 与 Temporal Representation Bottleneck 构造紧凑世界状态，再用 Action-Grounded Representation Shaping 只把动作损失梯度送进瓶颈，让策略决定表征编码什么、世界模型学习其如何演化。不做生成式视频预训练，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 93.6% 成功率，RoboDojo 平均分 12.29、成功率 8.28%（约 600 小时具身预训练数据）。
Motivation: 世界-动作模型里表征空间是控制与预测的共同接口，但受控比较显示重建保真度或单纯的预训练感知特征都不足以保证策略学好，需要弄清该空间该怎么设计。
Method: 以预训练 DINO 特征为基底，用 Feature Calibration 和 Temporal Representation Bottleneck 把它们组织成适合动力学建模的紧凑世界状态；Action-Grounded Representation Shaping 只将动作损失的梯度路由到瓶颈，使策略塑造表征内容而世界模型学习其演化；不使用生成式视频预训练。
Result: RoboTwin 2.0 成功率 93.6%；RoboDojo 平均分 12.29、成功率 8.28%，使用约 600 小时具身预训练数据。受控比较的定性结论是重建保真度与预训练感知特征单独都不足以支撑有效策略学习。
Conclusion: 把表征当作控制与预测的接口来设计——用动作损失梯度单独塑形瓶颈——可以在不做生成式视频预训练的条件下学到可用的机器人策略。

papers.title: A Spectral Theory of Distortion in LLM Graph Reconstruction: Sharp Bounds and Empirical Characterization
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of graph reconstruction by language models typically report a single aggregate distance between the original and the reconstructed graph. We prove that for the Wasserstein distance between Laplacian spectra such a summary is bracketed by two edge counts, the net change in edge number from below and the symmetric difference from above, each scaled by $2/n$ where $n$ is the number of vertices. The bracket is sharp: its two ends coincide exactly when the reconstruction only adds edges or only deletes them, and on that class the distance is a rescaled edge count that says nothing about which edges changed. When the ends differ, the residual between the distance and the lower end is positive only if the reconstruction both invented and lost edges, which turns it into a certificate of mixed editing computable from the reported summaries alone. We characterize these regimes in 135 reconstructions produced by three open-weight models over 45 synthetic graphs. Seventy-seven outputs are one-sided and 29 mixed outputs have $X > 0$, including cases where edge count is exactly preserved while nineteen edges were simultaneously invented and lost. The three models differ in editing policy, ranging from copying the input to attempting completion at the cost of large hallucination volume, a distinction that aggregate distortion does not reveal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明图重建的 Laplacian 谱 Wasserstein 距离被两个边数夹住：下界为净边数变化、上界为对称差，各乘 2/n，且夹逼是紧的——只增边或只删边时两端重合，此时距离只是重标度的边数，完全不反映哪些边变了。两端不等时，距离减下界的残差 X>0 当且仅当重建同时发明并丢失边，可仅凭已报告摘要量算出混合编辑证书。在三个开源模型对 45 张合成图的 135 次重建中，77 个输出是单侧编辑，29 个混合输出 X>0，包括边数恰好不变但同时发明并丢失 19 条边的案例。
Motivation: 图重建评测通常只报一个聚合距离，掩盖了编辑结构：单侧增删与混合编辑在该距离下可能无法区分，模型的编辑策略差异被抹平。
Method: 对 Laplacian 谱的 Wasserstein 距离给出夹逼定理（下界净边数变化、上界对称差，均乘 2/n），证明紧性并刻画两端重合的单侧编辑类；再定义残差 X 作为混合编辑证书，并在 45 张合成图上用三个开源模型的 135 次重建刻画各区间。
Result: 夹逼为 2/n·|净边数变化| ≤ 距离 ≤ 2/n·对称差且是紧的；135 次重建中 77 个单侧、29 个混合输出 X>0，含边数恰好保持但同时发明并丢失 19 条边的案例；三个模型编辑策略从照抄输入到以大量幻觉为代价尝试补全。
Conclusion: 单一聚合失真度不足以揭示编辑策略：单侧编辑下谱距离退化为边数的重标度，只有残差 X>0 才能从已报告摘要量中认证混合编辑。

papers.title: DMA$^2$: Pixel-space Distribution Matching with Adversarial and Anchor Losses
papers.abstract_en: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) provides a general framework for few-step diffusion generation, but its modern text-to-image instantiations have been developed primarily around latent diffusion. It therefore overlooks key properties and design opportunities of native RGB. We revisit two DMD interfaces for pixel-space teachers. On the teacher-matching side, diagnostics show low-noise RGB matching is dominated by a local-texture cue, motivating a fixed high-noise matching band. On the real-data side, native clean-RGB outputs allow guidance from an external visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the heavy fake-score critic. DINO-Adv removes this critic from the adversarial gradient path and supplies local parametric patch guidance. For distribution-level guidance, we introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It operates on detached rolling real and generated supports in the shared DINOv2 space while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision. AF-Loss adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. Together these designs form DMA$^2$. Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, the four-step DMA$^2$ student performs better than the 25-step teacher and evaluated few-step distillers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DMA² 把分布匹配蒸馏 (DMD) 从 latent diffusion 移到像素空间 RGB 教师，诊断出低噪声 RGB 匹配被局部纹理线索主导，因而固定高噪声匹配带；并用 DINO-Adv 把对抗梯度路径中的 fake-score critic 移除、改由 DINOv2 提供局部 patch 引导，再加无参数的 AF-Loss 在共享 DINOv2 空间对 detached rolling 真实与生成支撑做语义分布场匹配。四步 DMA² 学生在 DPG-Bench、GenEval、VQAScore 与 COCO30K 上优于 25 步教师与被评测的少步蒸馏方法。
Motivation: DMD 的现代文生图实现几乎都围绕 latent diffusion 构建，忽略了原生 RGB 输出带来的设计空间：低噪声匹配的信号来源不清，且对抗训练必须经过 decoder 并共享沉重的 fake-score critic。
Method: 两条接口改造：教师匹配侧诊断出低噪声 RGB 匹配由局部纹理线索主导，改为固定高噪声匹配带；真实数据侧用原生 clean-RGB 输出引入外部视觉表征，DINO-Adv 将 fake-score critic 从对抗梯度路径中移除，提供局部参数化 patch 引导。分布级引导用 AF-Loss：在共享 DINOv2 空间上对 detached 的 rolling 真实与生成支撑做无参数辅助语义分布场目标，同时保留 prompt 条件的教师监督，不引入可学习参数也不增加推理时计算。
Result: 四步 DMA² 学生在 DPG-Bench、GenEval、VQAScore 和 COCO30K 上优于 25 步教师，也优于被评测的少步蒸馏方法；AF-Loss 不增加可学习参数与推理时计算。
Conclusion: 像素空间教师的 DMD 应避开被局部纹理主导的低噪声匹配、改用高噪声带，并把外部 DINOv2 表征同时接进对抗路径与分布级目标，即可让四步学生胜过 25 步教师。

papers.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
papers.abstract_en: Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days. Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events. Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the "biography" of the particular entity a question concerns. To address this, we introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that groups visually grounded observations of the same physical instance across clips into retrievable biographies while preserving the context of each moment. During question answering, the biography is retrieved alongside episodic evidence, allowing the model to follow an entity through events using identity links established during memory construction. Evaluations across four benchmarks, including day-long and week-long recordings, demonstrate improvements over prior memory frameworks in both multiple-choice and open-ended question answering. On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0% accuracy, 4.4 percentage points above the best published result. Ablations show that grounded identity association and biography reading both contribute to the gains, which additional descriptions alone do not fully recover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEB 把长视频中同一物理实例的视觉观测跨片段聚成可检索的 entity biography，问答时与 episodic 证据一起检索，让模型沿身份链接追踪实体。在含天级、周级录像的四个基准上，EgoLifeQA 准确率 72.0%，比已发表最佳结果高 4.4 个百分点，选择题与开放式问答均提升。
Motivation: 长视频问答需跨数小时乃至数天连接同一物体的事件，但时间线描述与文本实体无法解决物理身份歧义：不同物体可能共享描述，同一物体的观测在事件间彼此断开，检索到相关事件并不等于拿到该实体的完整经历。
Method: 提出 Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB) 长视频记忆框架：在记忆构建阶段把跨片段的视觉接地观测按物理实例分组，形成保留每个时刻上下文的 biography，并建立身份链接；问答时 biography 与 episodic 证据并行检索。
Result: 在四个基准（含 day-long 与 week-long 录像）上，选择题与开放式问答均优于既有记忆框架；EgoLifeQA 准确率 72.0%，高出已发表最佳结果 4.4 个百分点；消融显示 grounded identity association 与 biography reading 均对增益有贡献，而仅增加描述无法完全复现。
Conclusion: 跨事件的物理身份链接是长视频记忆的关键，单靠更长的时间线描述或文本实体不足以恢复实体经历；接地身份关联与 biography 阅读需同时具备。

papers.title: LongLive-Plug: Once-for-All Distillation for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models are increasingly developed into specialized models for diverse downstream tasks, and this development often includes a distillation stage, for example to accelerate sampling or to improve long-video generation. This stage is typically repeated for every specialized model. We introduce LongLive-Plug, a once-for-all distillation framework that learns reusable capabilities as LoRAs on a base model for training-free, plug-and-play deployment to compatible downstream models. These capabilities include single-pass classifier-free guidance, few-step sampling, and long-context error correction for autoregressive generation. The adapters remain reusable even when downstream models add conditioning branches, expand output channels. Despite training at a fixed guidance scale, our dedicated CFG LoRA provides text guidance control through its inference weight. Combining it with a few-step LoRA simultaneously preserves few-step generation and CFG controllability on downstream tasks. We verify training-free deployment on 54 downstream models across three backbone families and eight task categories, including world modeling, robotics, editing, and multimodal generation. The approach may support additional compatible models. Each capability can thus be distilled once per backbone family and reused without per-target retraining.
papers.comment: Code and models are available at https://github.com/NVlabs/LongLive
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LongLive-Plug 把视频扩散模型的蒸馏做成 once-for-all：在基座模型上学出可复用的 LoRA 能力（单次前向 CFG、少步采样、自回归长视频的长上下文纠错），下游模型免训练即插即用。在三个 backbone 家族、八类任务共 54 个下游模型上验证了免训练部署，且在固定 guidance scale 下训练的 CFG LoRA 仍可通过推理权重控制文本引导强度。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型为不同下游任务反复做蒸馏（加速采样、长视频生成），每个专用模型都要重训一次，成本高且能力不可迁移。
Method: 在基座模型上以 LoRA 形式蒸馏三类可复用能力：single-pass classifier-free guidance、few-step sampling、面向自回归生成的 long-context error correction；CFG LoRA 虽在固定 guidance scale 下训练，但用推理权重提供文本引导控制，与 few-step LoRA 叠加使用。适配器在下游模型新增条件分支、扩展输出通道后仍可复用。
Result: 在三个 backbone 家族、八个任务类别（含 world modeling、robotics、editing、mult模态生成）共 54 个下游模型上验证了 training-free 部署；CFG LoRA 与 few-step LoRA 组合后在下游任务上同时保持少步生成与 CFG 可控性。
Conclusion: 每个能力可按 backbone 家族蒸馏一次并跨兼容下游模型复用，无需逐目标重训；作者称该方法可能支持更多兼容模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PowerSim: Differentiable Physics Simulation and Rendering with Power Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PowerSim, a method to bring physically grounded, differentiable dynamics to PowerFoam's power diagram based 3D representation. PowerSim directly couples a pre-trained PowerFoam scene to the Material Point Method (MPM) by exploiting a natural alignment between the two: the geometric and appearance properties of each primitive correspond closely to the quantities MPM already tracks as an object deforms. Consequently, simulated motion can drive the scene's geometry and appearance directly, without an auxiliary representation in between. Built on this framework, we enable a range of applications on real and synthetic scenes: (1) simulating a static scene under user interaction, (2) recovering spatially varying material fields, (3) compositing primitives from independently captured scenes into a single simulation-ready scene and (4) ray-tracing reflections that update consistently as the object deforms. Our results suggest that PowerSim excels over previous frameworks for physically grounded dynamics, while unlocking unique advantages-such as secondary ray lighting effects on dynamic scenes. Results are best viewed on our project website: https://power-sim.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PowerSim 把预训练的 PowerFoam power diagram 3D 表示直接耦合到 Material Point Method (MPM)，让每个图元的几何与外观属性直接对应 MPM 跟踪的物理量，模拟形变可同时驱动几何与外观，无需中间辅助表示。基于该框架支持交互式静态场景模拟、空间变化材料场恢复、跨场景图元合成，以及随形变一致更新的光线追踪反射。
Motivation: 可微物理模拟与 3D 表示之间通常需要额外的中间表示来桥接几何、外观与动力学量，导致物理接地的动态模拟难以直接作用于预训练场景表示。
Method: 利用 PowerFoam 的 power diagram 图元属性与 MPM 所跟踪量之间的自然对应，将预训练场景直接耦合到可微 MPM；在此框架上实现四类应用：用户交互下的静态场景模拟、空间变化材料场恢复、独立拍摄场景的图元合成、随物体形变一致更新的光线追踪反射。
Result: 在真实与合成场景上展示四类应用；作者称 PowerSim 在物理接地动力学上优于此前框架，并带来动态场景的二次光线照明效果等独特优势。
Conclusion: power diagram 表示与 MPM 的直接耦合可免去中间表示，同时实现物理接地的可微动态模拟与一致的外观更新。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FracGen: Learning How Objects Stretch and Tear with Physics-Informed Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FracGen, a fracture-aware video generation model that produces plausible, controllable fracture dynamics from a single image of an intact object, conditioned on physics signals. To train FracGen, we build FracSim, a fracture-aware simulation framework that augments material point method (MPM) simulation with a continuum damage model, producing paired fracture videos and dense, pixel-aligned physical fields at no additional cost beyond standard rendering. FracGen leverages these maps in two ways: it is trained to jointly predict them alongside RGB video, encouraging the model to capture physical state rather than surface appearance; and it is supervised with physics-informed losses that encourage consistency among the predicted maps. As a result, FracGen captures distinct material-specific fracture behavior without expensive test-time simulation or per-scene tuning, while offering fine-grained control over where an object tears, how fast the crack propagates, and how much deformation precedes failure. We further introduce a benchmark for evaluating the physical plausibility of generated fracture video, and show through extensive experiments that FracGen outperforms existing video generation baselines in both physical and visual fidelity. Results are best viewed in our project website: https://fracgen.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FracGen 是一个断裂感知的视频生成模型，从单张完整物体图像出发，在物理信号条件下生成可控的断裂过程。训练数据由 FracSim 提供：在 material point method (MPM) 仿真上加连续介质损伤模型，产出配对断裂视频与逐像素对齐的物理场；模型同时预测 RGB 与这些物理场，并用物理信息损失约束各场之间的一致性。结果是在无需测试时仿真或逐场景调参的情况下捕捉材料特有的断裂行为，并可控制撕裂位置、裂纹扩展速度与失效前变形量，在物理与视觉保真度上超过已有视频生成基线。
Motivation: 从单张图像生成物体断裂视频时，模型容易只学表面外观而丢失材料真实的力学行为，且缺少衡量生成断裂视频物理合理性的评测手段。
Method: 构建 FracSim：在 MPM 仿真上叠加连续介质损伤模型，以标准渲染的额外零成本产出配对断裂视频与逐像素物理场。FracGen 联合预测 RGB 视频与这些物理场，并用 physics-informed losses 约束各预测场之间的一致性；推理时由物理信号条件控制撕裂位置、裂纹扩展速度与失效前变形量，不做测试时仿真或逐场景调参。
Result: 在作者提出的断裂视频物理合理性 benchmark 上，FracGen 在物理保真度与视觉保真度两方面均超过已有视频生成基线；并能区分材料特有的断裂行为，无需昂贵的测试时仿真或逐场景调参。
Conclusion: 把逐像素物理场作为联合预测目标加物理信息损失，能让视频生成模型学到材料层面的断裂规律，从而在单图条件下同时获得可控性与物理合理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 agentic meta-reasoning：把 agent 执行中的控制决策（基于哪份部分结果、何时重启、何时停止）变成显式的元推理过程，由 controller 在持久记忆与压缩运行摘要上评估各选项在剩余预算下的价值再派发 worker。在 ProgramBench 程序重建上 GPT-5.5 达 71.5%（Codex 58.0%）、Opus 4.8 达 67.2%（Claude Code 65.5%），其余抽象推理、多领域长程推理与证明生成基准上较 direct control 平均高 3.6–4.2 点。
Motivation: agent 处理长程复杂任务时，执行控制本身成为难题：每一步都要在多份部分成果、重启与停止之间做选择，而直接控制在预算增长时会较早进入平台期。
Method: inference-time harness 分两层：worker 承担任务级计算，controller 持久记忆中取上下文、整合已确立的运行状态、探索下一步选项、按剩余预算评估各选项价值并派发所选工作；决策之间只保留压缩的运行摘要而非完整历史。基线包括生产级 coding agent、research harnesses，以及同 worker 与同计算预算的 Direct Control Agent。
Result: ProgramBench（程序重建的长程 agentic 基准）：GPT-5.5 上 meta-reasoning 71.5% 对 Codex 58.0%，Opus 4.8 上 67.2% 对 Claude Code 65.5%。其余基准（抽象推理、多领域长程推理、证明生成）上相对 direct control 提升 3.6–4.2 点，为三个 frontier model 的平均。在测试预算区间内持续改进而 direct control 已平台化，但小预算下开销会拖累表现。artifact-graph 分析显示更多复用早期工作、多数设置下正确解覆盖更高、最终选择上的收益不均匀。
Conclusion: 把计算花在结构化控制上随 agent 运行变长而愈发关键；代价是小预算下 controller 开销可能得不偿失。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: LIFT: Layout-In-Future Video Generation under Large Viewpoint Change via On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LIFT, a unified image-to-video generation framework that complements camera control with Layout-In-FuTure control, enabling users to specify what should appear in a future view and where it should appear. This addresses a practical need in controllable video generation: given an initial image, users often care not only about how the camera moves, but also about what the scene should look like at key future moments, especially the final frame. Existing camera controls specify viewpoint trajectories, while text prompts provide only coarse semantic guidance; neither precisely determines the content and spatial layout of future views. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced under large viewpoint changes, where the camera reveals regions that are not visible in the first frame. LIFT therefore uses the last-frame layout as an explicit control signal for the desired future scene. Since learning from such sparse layout guidance is substantially more challenging than conditioning on dense per-frame layouts, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) to transfer the control capability of a dense-layout teacher to a last-frame-layout student. We further curate LIFT-Vista, a dataset featuring large viewpoint changes with camera and temporally consistent layout annotations. Experiments show that LIFT improves video quality, future-layout controllability, and camera controllability over other methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIFT 把最后一帧的布局 (layout) 作为显式控制信号，在相机轨迹之外指定未来视图里应出现什么、出现在哪，从而在大视角变化下补上相机控制与文本提示都无法确定的未来画面内容。用 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 把稠密逐帧布局教师的控制能力迁移到只看末帧布局的学生，并配套构建了带相机与时序一致布局标注的大视角变化数据集 LIFT-Vista。实验显示该框架在视频质量、未来布局可控性与相机可控性上均优于其他方法。
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成中，相机控制只给视角轨迹、文本提示只给粗粒度语义，都无法确定未来视图的内容与空间布局；大视角变化时镜头会揭示首帧不可见的区域，这一缺口尤其突出。
Method: LIFT 是统一的 image-to-video 生成框架，以末帧布局作为未来场景的显式控制信号；由于稀疏末帧布局比稠密逐帧布局难学，引入 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)，把稠密布局教师的控制能力蒸馏给末帧布局学生；同时整理 LIFT-Vista 数据集，含大视角变化及相机、时序一致的布局标注。
Result: 实验表明 LIFT 在视频质量、未来布局可控性与相机可控性三方面均优于其他方法；配套数据集 LIFT-Vista 提供大视角变化与相机、时序一致的布局标注。
Conclusion: 末帧布局配合 on-policy 自蒸馏，是在大视角变化下同时拿到内容可控与相机可控的可行路径，稠密布局教师可用来弥补稀疏布局监督的不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
papers.abstract_en: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在权重全冻结的 test-time AI4AI 设定下，Builder 从 Target 在开发集上的执行反馈中提炼出 Meta-Skill 原则（何时需要支持、提供什么资源），存入冻结的 skill bank，再据此为未见任务构造执行 harness。在 Harness-Bench 与 NewtonBench 上，完整 skill bank 使宏平均性能比无 skill 构造高 8.95 个百分点，比把同一 bank 直接交给 Target 高 12.02 个百分点。
Motivation: Agent 表现同时取决于推理能力和所处执行环境，但当两个模型权重都固定时，如何让 Builder 学会为目标构造更好的执行环境、并把这种经验迁移到未见任务，缺少可复用的机制。
Method: 提出 Meta-Skill：从 Target 在开发集上的执行反馈中学习“何时需要支持、提供何种资源”的原则，形成冻结的 skill bank；Builder 用该 bank 为未见任务构造 harness，Target 与 Builder 权重均不更新，评测在 Harness-Bench 与 NewtonBench 上进行。
Result: 在 Harness-Bench 与 NewtonBench 上，full-bank meta-skill 相比 no-skill 构造使宏平均性能提升 8.95 个百分点；相比把同一 skill bank 直接交付给 Target 提升 12.02 个百分点；同一模型兼任两角色时也有增益。
Conclusion: 把执行经验翻译成可执行的支持原则（而非直接传递资源本身）更能提升固定权重 Agent 在未见任务上的表现，并暗示了通过学习构造更好环境实现系统级自我改进的路径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 Harness-Bench 与 NewtonBench 上，full-bank meta-skill 相比 no-skill 构造使宏平均性能提升 8.95 个百分点；相比把同一 skill bank 直接交付给 Target 提升 12.02 个百分点；同一模型兼任两角色时也有增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把执行经验翻译成可执行的支持原则（而非直接传递资源本身）更能提升固定权重 Agent 在未见任务上的表现，并暗示了通过学习构造更好环境实现系统级自我改进的路径。

papers.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdviSD 用「按影响选择性自蒸馏」训练小型 advisor 去引导冻结的 LLM executor：只有当 advisor 对同一响应在有无建议下的打分差足够大时，才把该轮反思修正用于自蒸馏。Qwen3-8B advisor 上，该方法在 BFCL-v3 比 advisor-GRPO 高 4.2–6.4 个百分点，在 EnvScaler 高 3.9–5.1 分，并胜过等量随机选择。
Motivation: 反思给出的修正看似合理却未必改变执行结果，而在共享参数模型中，从这类弱目标修正学习会拖累模型在其他情境的决策；作者证明按低于其他修正的频率保留它们反而提升最终性能。
Method: AdviSD 将基于结果的强化学习（advisor-GRPO 式）与自蒸馏配对：Reflection 提出修正，advisor 对同一条已记录的 executor 响应分别在带建议与不带建议下打分，用两者差值的幅度挑选进入监督的决策；不需要 executor likelihood，也不需要额外 executor rollout。
Result: Qwen3-8B advisor 引导 Gemini 与 Claude 时，AdviSD 在 BFCL-v3 上比 advisor-GRPO 高 4.2–6.4 个百分点，在 EnvScaler 上高 3.9–5.1 分；相对等数量随机选择同样占优，且训练出的 advisor 能泛化到 out-of-domain 任务、跨 executor 版本与模型家族迁移。
Conclusion: 选择性自蒸馏（按建议对执行的实际影响筛选修正）比对全部修正学习更有效，且该选择规则本身是收益来源；advisor 无需 executor 内部信号即可跨执行器版本与家族迁移。

papers.title: Breaking the Uniformity Trap: Scaling Video Diffusion Model via SplitMoE
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), popularized by large language models, is a promising paradigm for scaling visual generative models. However, conventional token-wise MoE routes tokens independently within a homogeneous expert pool and regularizes expert usage toward uniformity, making it poorly matched to video data that is spatiotemporally redundant and semantically long-tailed. We show that existing visual MoEs fall into a uniformity trap: semantically under-organized routing, compounded by uniform expert-usage regularization, scatters coherent patches across disparate experts, causing routing fragmentation and structural distortion. To address this, we propose SplitMoE, a split-role sparse architecture that breaks the shackles of uniformity. To accommodate the inherent semantic imbalance, we explicitly bifurcate the expert pool into semantic experts and generic experts, with semantic experts capturing high-level semantic abstraction and generic experts preserving residual visual information and flexible generative capacity. Leveraging prototype-guided routing and pull-push regularization, SplitMoE enables tokens to cluster naturally by semantic attributes rather than arbitrary balancing constraints. Extensive results show that under an equivalent activated-parameter budget, SplitMoE outperforms traditional load-balanced MoEs in convergence speed, routing coherence, and video generation quality across standard benchmarks. By revealing an emergent coarse-to-fine denoising logic, SplitMoE provides the community with a modality-aware scaling path, serving as a critical reference for building large-scale video world models.
papers.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight paper at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://yuci-gpt.github.io/SplitMoE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SplitMoE 把视频扩散模型的专家池显式拆成语义专家与通用专家，用 prototype-guided routing 加 pull-push 正则让 token 按语义属性自然聚类，而非被均匀负载均衡打散。在等激活参数预算下，它在收敛速度、路由一致性与标准视频生成基准的生成质量上都优于传统负载均衡 MoE。
Motivation: token-wise MoE 在同质专家池内独立路由并强制专家使用均匀，与视频时空冗余、语义长尾的特性不匹配：语义组织不足加上均匀正则会把连贯 patch 打散到不同专家，造成路由碎片化与结构失真（uniformity trap）。
Method: 提出 split-role 稀疏架构 SplitMoE：把专家池二分为负责高层语义抽象的 semantic experts 与保留残差视觉信息、提供生成灵活性的 generic experts；路由用 prototype-guided routing，正则用 pull-push regularization 替代均匀负载约束，使 token 按语义聚类。
Result: 在等激活参数预算下，SplitMoE 在收敛速度、路由一致性与视频生成质量三方面超过传统 load-balanced MoE，并覆盖标准视频生成基准；摘要另指出其呈现 emergent coarse-to-fine denoising logic。
Conclusion: 均匀负载均衡是视频 MoE 的错误约束，按语义分工的 split-role 稀疏结构是一条 modality-aware 的扩展路径，可作为构建大规模 video world models 的参考。

papers.title: CLeaR: A Unified Framework for Resolving the Leakage-Degradation Dilemma in Style Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Style transfer aims to render target content in the style of a reference image, but existing methods often suffer from content leakage, where objects, layouts, or semantics from the style reference appear in the generated output. Although prior data-driven and training-free methods can reduce leakage, they often face a leakage-degradation dilemma: stronger content suppression may weaken style fidelity, while richer style preservation may reintroduce unwanted reference content. We identify this dilemma across the full style-transfer pipeline, including feature separation, feature-space grounding, and diffusion generation. To address these issues, we propose CLeaR, a training-free framework for content-leakage-resistant style transfer. CLeaR first uses Orthogonal Subspace Projection to define content-reduced style targets in each vision foundation model (VFM) feature space. It then performs Ensemble Inversion, which optimizes a shared pixel-space style anchor satisfying style constraints across multiple VFMs. Finally, Energy-Guided Calibration maintains style alignment during diffusion sampling by steering the denoising trajectory toward the ensemble-defined style manifold. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the style-anchor estimation error decreases with the number of VFMs. Experiments on StyleBench demonstrate that CLeaR improves style alignment, reduces content leakage, and achieves better LLM-as-Judge evaluation compared with existing methods. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLeaR 是一个免训练的抗内容泄漏风格迁移框架：用正交子空间投影 (Orthogonal Subspace Projection) 在各视觉基础模型 (VFM) 特征空间中定义内容削减后的风格目标，再用 Ensemble Inversion 优化共享像素空间风格锚点，采样阶段用 Energy-Guided Calibration 把去噪轨迹拉向集成定义的风格流形。理论上风格锚点估计误差随 VFM 数量增加而下降；在 StyleBench 上相较现有方法提升风格对齐、降低内容泄漏，并取得更好的 LLM-as-Judge 评分。
Motivation: 风格迁移中存在泄漏-退化两难：抑制风格参考图中的物体、布局、语义越强，风格保真度越弱；保留风格越多，参考内容又重新混入输出。该困境贯穿特征分离、特征空间 grounding 与扩散生成整条流水线。
Method: 免训练三段式：先在每个 VFM 特征空间用 Orthogonal Subspace Projection 得到内容削减的风格目标；再用 Ensemble Inversion 跨多个 VFM 优化一个满足风格约束的共享像素空间风格锚点；扩散采样时用 Energy-Guided Calibration 引导去噪轨迹朝集成定义的风格流形。另给出风格锚点估计误差随 VFM 数量下降的理论分析。
Result: 在 StyleBench 上，CLeaR 相比现有方法提升风格对齐、减少内容泄漏，并取得更好的 LLM-as-Judge 评估结果；理论分析表明风格锚点估计误差随 VFM 数量增加而减小。
Conclusion: 泄漏-退化两难可通过跨 VFM 集成的风格锚点与采样期能量引导校准同时缓解，而不必在内容抑制与风格保真之间二选一；该框架是免训练的，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. However, its expressivity does not, in general, come with formal guarantees that the generated objects satisfy hard constraints or requirements. In multi-agent generation, this problem becomes more challenging because a hard requirement can depend on multiple agents, while each agent may need to determine its own guidance input without relying on the simultaneously computed guidance inputs of other agents. To this end, we introduce DeGG-Flow, a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance. By representing the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, we develop guidance conditions for two classes of coupled requirements: shared requirements whose satisfaction depends on multiple agents together, and private requirements associated with each individual agent dependent on its neighbors. For both classes, we establish feasibility conditions and finite-horizon convergence guarantees. We further derive a Wasserstein bound that characterizes the distributional deviation induced by the guidance. We demonstrate DeGG-Flow on multi-robot collaboration for crossing a spatial gap by reconfiguring the environment, and on multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements. Across both applications, DeGG-Flow directly generates objects that satisfy all corresponding hard requirements, including at team sizes unseen during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeGG-Flow 把多智能体生成过程写成 control-affine 动力系统，在 flow matching 上加解耦的生成引导，使每个智能体无需等待他人引导输入即可满足共享与私有两类硬约束。给出可行性条件、有限时域收敛保证与 Wasserstein 偏差界；在跨空间缺口的多机器人协作和带 affordance 要求的多物体场景生成中，直接生成满足全部硬要求的物体，且团队规模在训练中未见过时仍成立。
Motivation: 生成模型的表达力一般不附带硬约束满足的形式化保证；多智能体场景下硬要求还可能依赖多个智能体，而各智能体无法依赖同时计算的他人引导输入。
Method: 提出 DeGG-Flow 框架：将生成过程表示为 control-affine 动力系统，针对共享要求（依赖多个智能体共同满足）与私有要求（依赖邻居的个体要求）推导引导条件，并建立可行性条件、有限时域收敛保证与刻画引导引起分布偏差的 Wasserstein 界。
Result: 在两项应用上验证：跨空间缺口的多机器人协作（通过重构环境）与带 affordance 要求的多物体场景生成；两者中 DeGG-Flow 直接生成满足全部相应硬要求的物体，包括在训练期间未见过的团队规模下。
Conclusion: 把硬约束写进 control-affine 引导条件后，多智能体 flow matching 可在无需协调他人引导输入的前提下满足共享与私有要求，并对分布偏差给出 Wasserstein 界。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Achieving an $O(1/N)$ Optimality Gap in Average-Reward Weakly-Coupled MDPs
papers.abstract_en: We study average-reward weakly-coupled Markov decision processes (WCMDPs), where a WCMDP consists of $N$ smaller MDPs, called arms, that share multiple per-step budget constraints. We consider the setting where the arms have identical model parameters, multiple actions, and state- and action-dependent costs. For restless bandits (RBs), a well-studied special case of WCMDPs, prior work has developed policies that achieve an $O(1/\sqrt{N})$ optimality gap under general conditions, and has further identified conditions under which policies can achieve a better-than-$1/\sqrt{N}$ optimality gap. However, for general WCMDPs, no prior result achieves an optimality gap better than $1/\sqrt{N}$. In this paper, we identify conditions analogous to those for RBs under which a better-than-$1/\sqrt{N}$ optimality gap is achievable, and design a policy that attains an $O(1/N)$ optimality gap. Notably, unlike prior approaches based on generalizing priority orderings, our policy is not priority-based but rather is designed to induce locally linear mean-field dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对一般 weakly-coupled MDP（WCMDP）此前没有优于 1/√N 的最优性间隙结果，本文在与 restless bandit 类比的条件下设计出非优先级策略，使平均奖励最优性间隙达到 O(1/N)。该策略不依赖推广优先序，而是通过构造诱导局部线性 mean-field 动力学来实现。
Motivation: restless bandit 已有在一般条件下 O(1/√N) 间隙及更优条件的结果，但一般 WCMDP 此前没有任何优于 1/√N 的最优性间隙界，多臂共享逐步预算约束的平均奖励控制缺少更紧的理论保证。
Method: 研究臂参数相同、多动作、状态与动作相关代价的 WCMDP；识别与 restless bandit 类比的可超越 1/√N 的条件，设计非优先级策略，通过诱导局部线性 mean-field 动力学来逼近平均奖励最优。

papers.title: Atmospheric dynamics and variability of periodically irradiated tidally locked planets
papers.abstract_en: Time-variable stellar heating may create new climate states, such as permanently hot or cold hemispheres, on asynchronous planets. Planets on eccentric orbits, circumbinary planets and planets on polar orbits around gravity-darkened stars all receive variable irradiation, yet variably irradiated planets (VIPs) have not been studied from a fundamental dynamical perspective. We present the first generalized study of the atmospheric response of variably irradiated tidally locked planets, using a 1.5-layer shallow-water model forced towards a time-dependent radiative equilibrium. We derive linearized analytic expressions for the mean, amplitude and phase lag of the response, which is that of a forced damped harmonic oscillator, and recover the established trends of tidally locked planets in the limit of steady forcing. When the instellation variation and wave timescales match and the damping is weak, a resonance occurs because waves propagate and interfere freely. The resonance produces a global standing wave mode and consequently a temporarily warmer nightside. Linear and nonlinear simulations reproduce these results and show that the hotspot oscillates longitudinally at the forcing frequency and reaches the antistellar point at resonance. The oscillation is eastward or westward of the substellar longitude depending on the rotation rate and the nonlinearity of the system. Synthetic phase curves carry signatures of this variability and invert in shape at resonance because of nightside warming. Among observed systems, we find 11 planets with at least 10% phase curve modulation from variable irradiation. Eccentric, pseudo-synchronous giants are the most promising targets, with HAT-P-2b having the largest predicted modulation.
papers.comment: Submitted to MNRAS; comments are welcome
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 1.5 层浅水模型加时变辐射平衡强迫，首次系统研究变辐照潮汐锁定行星 (VIPs) 的大气响应：当辐照变化周期与波动时间尺度匹配且阻尼弱时发生共振，产生全球驻波并使夜面暂时变暖，热点在共振时摆到反恒星点。合成相位曲线在共振处形状反转，已观测系统中有 11 颗行星的相位曲线调制幅度至少 10%，HAT-P-2b 预测调制最大。
Motivation: 偏心轨道、双星环行星和极轨道行星都接受时变辐照，但此前没有从基本动力学角度研究过变辐照行星的大气响应，缺少解析框架来判断何时出现新气候态。
Method: 用 1.5 层浅水模型 (1.5-layer shallow-water model) 向时变辐射平衡强迫，推导响应的平均值、振幅与相位滞后的线性化解析表达式（受迫阻尼谐振子形式），再用线性与非线性模拟及合成相位曲线检验。
Result: 稳强迫极限下恢复潮汐锁定行星的既有趋势；辐照变化与波时间尺度匹配且阻尼弱时出现共振，产生全球驻波、夜面暂时变暖，热点按强迫频率纵向摆动并在共振处到达反恒星点，摆动方向（东/西）取决于自转率与系统非线性；共振时合成相位曲线因夜面增暖而形状反转；在已观测系统中找到 11 颗行星因变辐照产生至少 10% 的相位曲线调制，偏心、伪同步巨行星最有前景，HAT-P-2b 预测调制最大。
Conclusion: 变辐照下的大气响应本质上是受迫阻尼谐振子，共振是可从相位曲线形状反转中观测到的判据，偏心伪同步巨行星是检验该效应的首选目标。

papers.title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model
papers.abstract_en: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HelixWorld 是实时交互式视听世界模型：视觉场景与相机绑定的空间立体声在用户交互下共同演化，把双向教师蒸馏成少步流式学生，单卡上以 24 FPS 做无漂移的音视频联合滚动。在视觉保真与响应性上匹配 SOTA 无声世界模型，在相机对齐的空间声学沉浸上显著超越现有基线。
Motivation: 现有交互式世界模型只做视觉渲染与控制而完全无声，缺少与视角运动同步的声学维度，多感官实时模拟因此不完整。
Method: 构建含真实立体声与度量相机位姿的高保真视听数据集，预训练以 6-DoF 相机轨迹和用户动作为条件的双向教师；再用在线轨迹蒸馏损失 (online trajectory distillation loss) 把教师蒸馏为少步流式学生以实现低延迟因果交互；并形式化空间声学一致性、提出 HelixBench 评测合成声场是否跟随动态视角运动。
Result: 单卡上维持 24 FPS 的无漂移音视频联合滚动；实验显示视觉保真与响应性匹配 SOTA 无声世界模型，在相机对齐的空间声学沉浸上显著超越现有基线。
Conclusion: 交互式世界模型可以同时做到实时低延迟与视角一致的空间声学，声学维度不必以牺牲视觉质量为代价。

papers.title: WUSH-KV: KV Cache Quantization with Data-Adaptive Transforms
papers.abstract_en: KV cache memory and bandwidth costs grow with context length and batch size, which limits efficient long-context inference. To address this bottleneck, we introduce WUSH-KV for low-bit KV-cache quantization. It adapts WUSH, which constructs a data-aware transform from the second-order statistics of both factors in a matrix product to reduce quantization error. WUSH-KV uses calibration data to construct separate key and value transforms, with the value transform folded into the model weights and the key transform applied after RoPE. The transforms can be paired with clipped quantizers. For one such quantizer, QuEST INT, we show that, under mild assumptions, the WUSH transform is near-optimal. With this quantizer, WUSH-KV reduces layerwise reconstruction error and achieves the lowest end-to-end perplexity among other tested transforms. For end-to-end evaluation, we integrate WUSH-KV into SGLang using OSCAR-style percentile-clipped affine quantization. At 2-bit, WUSH-KV performs comparably to or outperforms the OSCAR transform across all evaluated models and downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WUSH-KV 把 WUSH 的数据感知变换用于低比特 KV cache 量化：用校准数据分别构造 key/value 变换，value 变换折叠进模型权重，key 变换作用在 RoPE 之后，并可与截断量化器（如 QuEST INT）配对。在温和假设下该变换对 QuEST INT 近似最优；2-bit 下集成进 SGLang 后，在所有评测模型与下游任务上表现与 OSCAR 变换相当或更优。
Motivation: KV cache 的显存与带宽开销随上下文长度和 batch size 增长，限制长上下文推理效率，需要低比特量化来压缩。
Method: 从矩阵乘两个因子的二阶统计构造数据感知变换，用校准数据分别生成 key 与 value 变换；value 变换折叠进权重，key 变换在 RoPE 后应用，并与截断量化器配对。端到端集成进 SGLang，采用 OSCAR 式 percentile 截断 affine 量化。
Result: 对 QuEST INT 在温和假设下证明 WUSH 变换近似最优；该量化器下逐层重构误差降低，并在所测变换中取得最低端到端 perplexity。2-bit 时在全部评测模型与下游任务上与 OSCAR 变换相当或更优。
Conclusion: 基于二阶统计的数据感知变换配合截断量化器，可在 2-bit KV cache 上把重构误差和端到端困惑度做到所测变换中最优水平。

papers.title: Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems
papers.abstract_en: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用带物理接地隐变量 (physically grounded latents) 的随机 world model 替代 GAN 作为视觉神经反馈系统的感知代理，隐变量由标准验证器可定界的运算构成，使闭环验证可行。在紧急制动基准上，配套的证伪+自适应细化+符号+反向分析流程在 GAN 代理下解出全部状态空间，其中 38% 是 SOTA 验证器未解出的；RGB 版本上用 world model 代理解出 80% 以上状态空间，且复现留出帧比参数量最多多 130 倍的 GAN 代理更忠实。
Motivation: 验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统需要一个既能刻画传感器观测变化、又对闭环分析足够 tractable 的观测模型；现有 GAN 感知代理参数量大、难以复现复杂场景且难以验证。
Method: 训练以物理接地隐变量为瓶颈的随机 world model，隐变量取自标准验证器可定界的运算；配套验证流程结合 falsification、adaptive refinement、symbolic analysis 与 backward analysis，用于解出闭环状态空间。
Result: world model 复现留出帧比参数量最多达其 130 倍的 GAN 代理更忠实；在带 GAN 代理的紧急制动基准上，该流程解出整个状态空间，其中 38% 被 SOTA 验证器留为未解；在 RGB 版本基准（此前无验证结果）上，用 world model 代理解出 80% 以上状态空间。
Conclusion: 随机 world model 加上组合式验证流程，可以把视觉神经反馈系统的验证从 GAN 代理的不可验证困境推进到可解出大比例乃至全部状态空间，RGB 场景也首次给出验证结果。

papers.title: VideoLoop: Looped Working Memory Against Semantic Thrashing in Long-Form Video Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video understanding requires multimodal agents to iteratively gather evidence over many reasoning steps. However, most existing agentic methods suffer from semantic thrashing: as append-only working memory grows, attention to key evidence collapses, and the agent loses access to what it has already found. First, we provide a structural argument showing that append-only memory can incorporate newly observed target evidence, but cannot remove accumulated noise or prevent ordered context growth without a rewrite operator. Second, motivated by this analysis, we propose VideoLoop, a multimodal agent with two coupled loops. The outer loop reasons over the video and the inner loop, after each step, retrieves artifacts from an unbounded filesystem of past observations and intermediate analysis, and rewrites a bounded working memory. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoLoop, which improves four popular LVLM backbones in a plug-and-play manner, with an average gain of 4.2% points over baseline on VideoMME (long). Further analysis of working memory suggests that VideoLoop mitigates semantic thrashing: on the hardest quarter of VideoMME (long) questions, a blind judge that reads only the agent's context answers 81.1% correctly, versus 60.9% for the append-only agent. With Gemini 3.1 Pro, VideoLoop reaches 88.3% on VideoMME (long), 88.8% on VideoMMMU, and 80.9% on LongVideoBench (long).

papers.title: GA-EIRFS: A Geometry-Augmented Repeat-Factor Sampling Method for Long-Tailed LiDAR 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Long-tailed 3D object detection is treated as a class-frequency problem, but LiDAR supervision quality depends on object observability: similar frequencies can hide different geometric evidence. We introduce Geometry-Augmented Exponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling (GA-EIRFS), a detector-agnostic method that modulates a frequency-based repeat factor with a fixed geometry score combining point count, surface-normal entropy, and surface coverage. GA-EIRFS changes only frame-sampling probabilities, leaving the detector and inference unchanged. On nuScenes it improves mean average precision (mAP) and the nuScenes detection score (NDS) in four converged experiments with CenterPoint and PointPillars over two seeds; for CenterPoint at seed 666, mAP rises from 0.552 to 0.563 and bicycle AP from 0.306 to 0.359. Per-class gains correlate with the class sampling-weight increase (Spearman rho=0.70, p=0.025) but not with geometry score alone (rho=0.32, p=0.37), so geometry amplifies frequency-driven need. KITTI results vary across seeds, most for the rarest class. Code: https://github.com/Multimodal-Sensing-Lab/GA-EIRFS.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GA-EIRFS 把长尾 LiDAR 3D 检测的重复采样因子 (repeat factor sampling) 乘上一个固定几何分数（点数、表面法向熵、表面覆盖），只改帧采样概率、不动检测器与推理。在 nuScenes 上 CenterPoint seed 666 的 mAP 从 0.552 升到 0.563、bicycle AP 从 0.306 升到 0.359；逐类增益与类采样权重增幅相关 (Spearman rho=0.70, p=0.025)，与几何分数本身不相关 (rho=0.32, p=0.37)，说明几何只是放大频率驱动的需求。
Motivation: 长尾 3D 检测被当作类频率问题处理，但 LiDAR 监督质量取决于目标可观测性：频率相近的类可能几何证据差异很大，单靠频率无法刻画采样需求。
Method: 提出 Geometry-Augmented Exponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling (GA-EIRFS)，检测器无关：在指数加权的实例感知重复因子上乘以固定几何分数（点数、表面法向熵、表面覆盖的组合），仅调制帧采样概率，检测器与推理流程保持不变；在 CenterPoint 与 PointPillars 上以两个 seed 做四个收敛实验。
Result: nuScenes 上四个收敛实验均提升 mAP 与 NDS：CenterPoint seed 666 的 mAP 0.552 → 0.563，bicycle AP 0.306 → 0.359。逐类增益与类采样权重增幅 Spearman rho=0.70 (p=0.025)，与几何分数单独 rho=0.32 (p=0.37)。KITTI 结果随 seed 波动，最稀有类波动最大。
Conclusion: 几何分数的作用是放大频率驱动的采样需求，而非独立决定增益；方法只改采样即可在 nuScenes 上稳定提升，但 KITTI 上跨 seed 不稳定、最稀有类尤甚。

papers.title: Self-Aligned Forcing: Streaming Video Diffusion with Differentiable Noisy History
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion enables interactive streaming generation, but suffers from error accumulation over long rollouts. Self-rollout training reduces exposure bias, yet finite rollouts leave long-range drift unresolved. We observe that the noise level of the history key-value (K/V) representations trades visual quality against motion, and that restoring gradients through the history aligns causal training far more closely with bidirectional training. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF), a training scheme that aligns the history of each block with the noise level of the block being denoised. Specifically, the history is the K/V produced by preceding blocks at the same denoising stage, so all blocks at a stage can be denoised in a single forward pass under a causal mask. This keeps the noisy history differentiable, allowing future losses to optimize how it is encoded. SAF therefore avoids a separate no-gradient rollout and per-block timestep-zero recaching, training up to 1.8x faster than prior methods with lower memory. At inference, SAF achieves the highest single-GPU throughput among existing methods and keeps one history bank per stage for a multi-GPU pipeline, reaching 49.1 FPS on 4 GPUs. Experiments show superior long-horizon generation with a better balance between visual quality and motion. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/self-aligned-forcing/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF) 把自回归视频扩散的历史 K/V 噪声水平对齐到当前去噪块的噪声水平，并让历史在因果掩码下单次前向可微，从而用未来损失直接优化历史编码。训练比先前方法快至多 1.8 倍且显存更低，4 GPU 流水线推理达 49.1 FPS，长时程生成在视觉质量与运动之间取得更好平衡。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散在长 rollout 中误差累积，self-rollout 训练虽减轻 exposure bias，但有限 rollout 仍留有长程漂移；历史 K/V 的噪声水平会在视觉质量与运动之间取舍，且无梯度 rollout 使因果训练偏离双向训练。
Method: SAF 训练方案将每个 block 的历史对齐到正在去噪的 block 的噪声水平：历史取自同一去噪阶段前序 block 产生的 K/V，使该阶段所有 block 可在因果掩码下用一次前向完成去噪。历史因此保持可微，未来损失可优化其编码，无需独立的无梯度 rollout 与逐 block 的 timestep-zero 重缓存。
Result: 训练速度比先前方法快至多 1.8 倍且显存更低；推理在现有方法中取得最高单 GPU 吞吐，每阶段保留一个 history bank 支持多 GPU 流水线，在 4 GPU 上达到 49.1 FPS；实验显示长时程生成更优，视觉质量与运动的平衡更好。
Conclusion: 让历史 K/V 与当前去噪噪声水平对齐并保持可微，是缓解自回归视频扩散长程漂移、同时提速降显存的可行训练路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ReCIRC: Rectified Conformal Risk Control
papers.abstract_en: Many applications of black-box predictive models require controlling task-relevant error rates, such as missed lesion pixels in segmentation or missed labels in multilabel classification. Conformal risk control (CRC; Angelopoulos et al., arXiv:2208.02814) gives distribution-free guarantees for such losses, but it calibrates a single threshold shared by all inputs. Because conditional risk varies with the input, this marginal guarantee often overprotects easy cases and underprotects hard ones. We propose ReCIRC (Rectified Conformal Risk Control), which inverts each input's estimated local risk curve to reparameterize the calibrated threshold as a risk budget $a$ representing a common target conditional risk, and then applies CRC unchanged to the resulting family. ReCIRC retains CRC's finite-sample marginal guarantee regardless of the accuracy of the estimated curves, while accurate curves yield approximate conditional risk control and, under additional conditions, asymptotically exact conditional risk control; they also support a risk-calibration diagnostic. Across three synthetic and five real-data settings spanning segmentation, multilabel and multiclass classification, and regression, ReCIRC attained the lowest average worst-group risk and mean positive group excess in every setting, while maintaining marginal risk close to the target, whereas changes in prediction size were application-dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCIRC 把每个输入估计的局部风险曲线求逆，将 CRC 的单一阈值重参数化为统一的条件风险预算 a，再对新阈值族原样套用 CRC。它在估计曲线不准时仍保留 CRC 的有限样本边际保证，曲线准时则得到近似条件风险控制、在附加条件下渐近精确。在 3 个合成与 5 个真实数据设定（分割、多标签/多分类、回归）中，ReCIRC 在每个设定都取得最低的平均最差组风险与平均正组超额，同时边际风险贴近目标。
Motivation: CRC 只能给所有输入共用一个阈值，其边际保证在条件风险随输入变化时会过度保护易样本、保护不足难样本。
Method: 对每个输入估计局部风险曲线并求逆，把 CRC 校准的阈值重写为表示共同目标条件风险的风险预算 a；随后对这一阈值族不加改动地应用 CRC，并用曲线支持风险校准诊断。
Result: 在 3 个合成与 5 个真实数据设定（覆盖分割、多标签与多分类分类、回归）中，ReCIRC 在每个设定都取得最低的平均最差组风险 (average worst-group risk) 和最低的平均正组超额 (mean positive group excess)，同时边际风险贴近目标；预测大小 (prediction size) 的变化则依应用而异。
Conclusion: 用局部风险曲线重参数化阈值可以在不牺牲 CRC 有限样本边际保证的前提下换取条件风险控制，且准确曲线带来渐近精确的条件控制。

papers.title: From Routing Signals to Selective Review: Visual regrounding in MoE VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) may accept false visual premises, answering questions about a target object's color, count, location, or state even when it is absent. We call this reliability-critical behavior a target-absence grounding failure. Existing visual-grounding detectors primarily rely on generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures. We present the first framework to leverage internal routing decisions in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs to detect target absence before generation and guide selective correction. We extract target-token routing probabilities from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, train a separate L2-regularized linear detector for each model, and use its predictions to selectively invoke a target-aware review prompt. Using routing alone, the Qwen and Gemma detectors achieve ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956 on GQA-Inpaint and retain 0.8095 and 0.7781 on the external OBER dataset, respectively. The resulting routing-gated policy improves end-to-end accuracy on GQA-Inpaint and OBER by +22.25% and +12.17% for Qwen, and by +13.42% and +1.39% for Gemma, without modifying model weights. Further analysis shows that the signal is localized to the target-object token, emerges in early MoE layers, and is distributed across partially substitutable experts. Although cross-dataset threshold shifts require recalibration, false-positive review causes limited harm overall, suggesting that intervention risk can be controlled through joint selection of the detector threshold and review prompt. Overall, we show that routing probabilities alone preserve actionable information about visual perception, allowing computation already produced by an MoE VLM to support low-cost detection and selective visual regrounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoE VLM 在目标物体不存在时仍会顺着假视觉前提作答，本文发现这类 target-absence grounding failure 在生成之前就已写进专家路由：从 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 与 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 的目标 token 路由概率训练 L2 正则线性探测器，据此门控是否插入 target-aware review prompt。GQA-Inpaint 上 ROC-AUC 达 0.9988/0.9956，端到端准确率 Qwen 提升 +22.25%、Gemma +13.42%，且不改模型权重。
Motivation: VLM 会对画面中并不存在的目标物体回答颜色、数量、位置、状态，现有 grounding 检测器依赖生成响应、隐状态或不确定性，都要先生成才判断，缺少生成前的低成本信号。
Method: 提取 MoE VLM 中目标 token 的路由概率，为每个模型单独训练一个 L2 正则线性探测器；探测器预测为正时才调用 target-aware review prompt，形成 routing-gated selective correction 策略，全程不修改模型权重。
Result: 仅用路由信号，Qwen 与 Gemma 探测器在 GQA-Inpaint 上 ROC-AUC 分别为 0.9988 与 0.9956，在外部 OBER 数据集上保持 0.8095 与 0.7781；端到端准确率提升 Qwen 为 GQA-Inpaint +22.25%、OBER +12.17%，Gemma 为 +13.42% 与 +1.39%。信号定位在目标物体 token、在早期 MoE 层即出现、分布在部分可替代的专家上；跨数据集阈值偏移需重新校准，误报式 review 总体危害有限。
Conclusion: 路由概率本身保留了关于视觉感知的可操作信息，可直接复用 MoE 已有计算做低成本的目标缺失检测与选择性视觉重锚定；干预风险可通过联合选择探测阈值与 review prompt 来控制。

summary_sections.result: 仅用路由信号，Qwen 与 Gemma 探测器在 GQA-Inpaint 上 ROC-AUC 分别为 0.9988 与 0.9956，在外部 OBER 数据集上保持 0.8095 与 0.7781；端到端准确率提升 Qwen 为 GQA-Inpaint +22.25%、OBER +12.17%，Gemma 为 +13.42% 与 +1.39%。信号定位在目标物体 token、在早期 MoE 层即出现、分布在部分可替代的专家上；跨数据集阈值偏移需重新校准，误报式 review 总体危害有限。
summary_sections.conclusion: 路由概率本身保留了关于视觉感知的可操作信息，可直接复用 MoE 已有计算做低成本的目标缺失检测与选择性视觉重锚定；干预风险可通过联合选择探测阈值与 review prompt 来控制。

papers.title: How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention
papers.abstract_en: The attention operation is naively position invariant. However, positional information is fundamental to natural language, and therefore a variety of explicit position encodings have been developed in transformer-based models, such as rotary position encoding (RoPE). Although explicit position encodings have long been assumed to be required, recent methods that interleave local mixing layers, such as sliding window attention (SWA) and gated linear attention, while not encoding position (NoPE) in global attention layers has recently been shown to be successful at scale. How and why this approach works is not well-understood. In this paper, we develop an explanation of how hybrid models of this sort can implicitly encode position at global NoPE layers. Supported by both theoretical and empirical evidence, our central argument is that SWA and gated linear attention induce a recency bias in the residual stream that propagates to, and is selected by, the global attention logits. Moreover, in contrast to the implicit position encodings found in models with only global NoPE attention, in which positional information arises solely from the causal mask, the recency bias in hybrid models can be maintained across long sequences. In addition to deepening our understanding of how hybrid models encode position, these findings may provide insights for how to encode position in a way that can extrapolate to longer sequence lengths indefinitely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 解释混合 Transformer（滑动窗口注意力 SWA 或 gated linear attention + 全局 NoPE 层）为何不需要显式位置编码：局部混合层在残差流中诱导 recency bias，该偏置传播到全局注意力 logits 并被其选择，从而隐式编码相对位置。与纯全局 NoPE 模型中位置信息只来自 causal mask 不同，混合模型的 recency bias 能在长序列上维持，作者据此提出可外推到更长序列长度的位置编码思路。
Motivation: 显式位置编码（如 RoPE）长期被视为必需，但混入局部混合层、全局层不编码位置 (NoPE) 的模型在大规模训练中已显示有效，其为何工作缺乏解释。
Method: 结合理论与实证证据论证：SWA 与 gated linear attention 在残差流中诱导 recency bias，该偏置传播至全局注意力 logits 并被选择；并对比纯全局 NoPE 模型中位置仅由 causal mask 产生的机制。
Result: 给出混合模型隐式编码相对位置的理论解释并有实证支持；指出混合模型的 recency bias 可在长序列上维持，而纯全局 NoPE 模型的位置信息仅来自 causal mask。
Conclusion: 混合架构中的局部混合层足以替代显式位置编码，且这种隐式位置机制为设计能无限外推到更长序列的位置编码提供线索。
