papers.title: Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High's published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.
papers.comment: Technical report, 14 pages. Evidence repository (reader outputs, judge verdicts, control records, judge harness): https://github.com/cjchanh/longmemeval-evidence (MIT). Re-scoring any run under the official judge costs about $1.28
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LongMemEval-S 500 题上评测一条可审计的长期记忆检索链：混合候选检索、cross-encoder 重排、coverage-first 打包与确定性推理脚手架，LLM 仅作可替换的最终 reader。Claude Opus reader 两次跑分 479/500 与 475/500（GPT-4o 评审），跨在 Chronos High 已发表的 478/500 两侧，作者据此判定既不优于也不等同于该系统。
Motivation: 长时记忆系统的分数常由 reader 生成、评分 prompt 与评审噪声共同决定，单次跑分无法区分真实能力差异与系统内方差，也缺少可复核的证据链。
Method: 检索链为 hybrid candidate retrieval + cross-encoder reranking + coverage-first packet compilation + 确定性 reasoning scaffolds，LLM 仅作可替换 final reader；用 Claude Opus（unpinned CLI alias）跑两遍 500 题，GPT-4o 作 judge，并加第二 judge、字节相同答案重评、以及一个修复/破坏草稿的 verifier 负控。
Result: 候选池含全部 gold session 的可答题 468/470，gold-complete packet 462/470；两遍 479/500 与 475/500，跨 Chronos High 的 478/500；grok-4.6-high reader 同包 476/474，maximum-reasoning-effort agentic 变体回退到 461/465；两遍 headline 在 8 个 verdict-flip 行上不同；第二 judge 与主 judge 每遍一致 493/500（98.6%）并给两遍均 472/500，官方 judge 对字节相同的 pass-1 答案重评仍翻转 3 个 verdict；负控显示该 verifier 修好 3 个错草稿却破坏 11 个对草稿；72 行 knowledge-update 用了实质修改的评分 prompt。
Conclusion: 确定性检索链能把 gold 证据稳定送进 reader，但 479/475 与 478 的差距落在评审与跑分噪声内，不构成优越或等同的证据；全部组件在同一 500 题上开发、无人工独立裁决，结论需靠发布的 packets、scaffolds、verdicts 与控制记录复核。

papers.title: Beyond Lip Sync: Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement for Audio-Driven Portrait Animation
papers.abstract_en: We present RGOR (Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement), an audio-driven lip-sync framework that renders the mouth of the specific person being dubbed rather than a generic one. Existing lip-sync systems follow the audio closely and keep the face recognizable, yet the mouth they render is an average mouth: the shape and texture of the lips, the arrangement of the teeth, and how much of them shows as the mouth opens are not that person's. The problem persists because nothing in current training or evaluation asks for the person's own mouth: perceptual losses accept any plausible mouth, face identity is carried mostly by the skin around it, and the released inference code of inpainting systems uses the unmasked target frame as the reference, which hides the gap. To address this, RGOR conditions every generated frame on frames from separate enrollment recordings of the same person and on HD patches of the mouth that bypass the VAE, and trains the generator against a paired judge that compares each rendered mouth with the person's reference and learns to reject a realistic mouth of someone else. We further build an evaluation protocol and use it to compare open-source and commercial lip-sync systems on held-out identities. Experiments show that RGOR achieves the best or second-best result on most metrics, and preserves the person's own lip and dental detail while keeping synchronization and the rest of the face intact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RGOR 用同一人的独立注册录音帧和绕过 VAE 的嘴部高清 patch 作为条件，并用会拒绝他人真实嘴部的配对判别器训练，使口型同步系统渲染出被配音者本人的嘴唇与牙齿细节而非平均嘴。在留出身份上自建评测协议比较开源与商业系统，RGOR 在多数指标上取得最好或次好结果，同时保持同步与面部其余部分。
Motivation: 现有 lip-sync 系统只保证跟随音频与身份可辨，渲染的却是平均化的嘴；感知损失接受任何合理嘴型，身份主要由嘴周皮肤承载，而 inpainting 系统发布代码用未遮挡目标帧做参考，掩盖了这一缺陷。
Method: RGOR 以同一人独立注册录音的帧为条件，并注入绕过 VAE 的嘴部 HD patch；训练时用配对判别器逐帧比较渲染嘴与该人参考嘴，并学会拒绝他人的真实嘴。另自建评测协议，在留出身份上比较开源与商业 lip-sync 系统。
Result: 在留出身份的评测协议下，RGOR 在多数指标上取得最好或次好结果，并在保持口型同步与面部其余部分完好的同时保留本人的嘴唇与牙齿细节。
Conclusion: 要渲染特定人的嘴，训练目标必须显式要求该人的嘴部细节，评测也必须按此设计；仅靠感知损失与面部身份损失无法做到。

papers.title: Prompts Live on an Arc: Gaussian Curricula in Fisher--Rao Coordinates for Rollout-Efficient GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) learns only from prompts whose sampled responses disagree: a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has zero reward variance, contributes no gradient, and still consumes its rollouts. Prompt-selection methods reduce this waste by steering sampling toward intermediate pass rates, but they choose the target, its width, and the uncertainty model heuristically, in raw pass-rate or logit coordinates. We show that GRPO comes with a natural coordinate for pass rates: the arc length $ψ=\arcsin\sqrt{p}$ on the Bernoulli Fisher--Rao manifold. In arc length, the expected GRPO update is uniform up to two boundary ramps; the probability of a zero-variance group is bounded by two Gaussian boundary layers of width $1/\sqrt{2G}$; pass-rate evidence has constant noise; and the gradients of the pass@$k$ and pass$^k$ objectives are Gaussians whose center and width follow from $k$ in closed form. A prompt curriculum for GRPO is therefore a Gaussian in arc length, and choosing its center amounts to choosing the objective. We turn this observation into ARCUS, a drop-in sampler that tracks every prompt with a Kalman filter in arc length, scores prompts by an objective-matched Gaussian kernel times the predicted probability of an informative group, keeps only informative groups for the unchanged GRPO update, and paces the target toward the hardest objective whose predicted yield stays within a small slack of the best. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three backbones, ARCUS improves the average accuracy of GRPO by 2.8--2.9 points and that of dynamic sampling by 1.1--1.2 points, while generating 48--57\% fewer rollouts than dynamic sampling.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy
papers.abstract_en: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. The above drawback tightly couples the imposed constraints to the training scenarios, leaving the AD policy hard to handle different interaction scenarios, due to the improper state-level action-cost and the static projection boundary. Consequently, in this paper, we propose Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints. By perceiving the current vehicle-interaction scene, Brain-SAD generates dynamic fear signal as fear reaction to online decide long-term policy for regular interaction or short-term policy for urgent-collision defense. In such two policy, the above fear-reaction will be constructed as the dynamic fear constraints, respectively reflecting the overall fear cost directly coupled with action-impact, and the dynamic fear boundary of the feasible region derived from different risky neighbors, both of which will in turn serve for the online policy optimization. Experimental results show that Brain-SAD outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rate in shorter task-completion and collision-recovery time, and exhibits stronger reliability across continuous intersections of fluctuating complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Brain-SAD 针对安全自动驾驶中约束静态的问题，用在线感知车辆交互场景生成动态 fear 信号，据此在线切换长期常规交互策略与短期紧急避撞策略，并把 fear 反应构造成随动作影响耦合的动态 fear cost 与随风险邻居变化的可行域动态 fear 边界，用于在线策略优化。实验显示其成功率更高、任务完成与碰撞恢复时间更短，在连续变化复杂度的交叉口场景中可靠性更强。
Motivation: 现有 Constrained RL 的动作代价多为静态状态到代价映射，硬约束方法的可行域边界也由离线演示静态估计，导致约束与训练场景强耦合，策略难以应对不同的交互场景。
Method: Brain-SAD 是脑启发的安全自动驾驶控制框架：感知当前车辆交互场景后生成动态 fear 信号，在线决定采用长期常规交互策略还是短期紧急避撞策略；两种策略下将 fear 反应分别构造为与动作影响直接耦合的整体 fear cost，以及由不同风险邻居导出的可行域动态 fear 边界，二者共同用于在线策略优化。
Result: 实验结果表明 Brain-SAD 优于现有方法：取得更高的成功率，任务完成时间和碰撞恢复时间更短，并在复杂度连续波动的交叉口场景中表现出更强的可靠性。
Conclusion: 把安全约束从静态状态代价与固定投影边界改为随场景动态生成的 fear cost 与 fear 边界，可使自动驾驶策略在多变交互场景下同时保持安全与效率。

papers.title: When do data mixtures improve scaling laws? Insights from high-dimensional regression
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning systems are trained on mixtures of data from different domains, and choosing the right mixture can substantially improve downstream performance. Despite an extensive literature on data mixing and reweighting, existing work is largely empirical and it remains unclear when auxiliary data genuinely improves scaling laws rather than merely providing more samples. To gain insight into this question, we study a high-dimensional mixed-data regression model with a shared regression function, heterogeneous covariances and noise levels, and dataset sizes that may grow at different rates. We establish the minimax risk under an ellipsoidal parameter constraint for the general covariance structure and derive deterministic equivalents for the test error of ridge regression under commutative covariances. We then specialize to a target domain and an auxiliary domain with aligned power-law covariance spectra, where the theory yields explicit scaling laws in terms of spectral decay, target regularity, and the relative growth of the two datasets. These laws identify regimes in which combining data mixtures provably yields a faster scaling rate than using either dataset alone. In particular, improving the scaling law requires a specific interplay between spectra and relative sample sizes of the domains. Our numerical experiments on language models exhibit the same qualitative phenomenon: appropriate data mixtures yield a faster decrease in target-domain test loss than training on either domain alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享回归函数、异构协方差与噪声的高维混合数据回归模型中，当目标域与辅助域的幂律谱对齐且两域样本量按特定比例增长时，混合数据可证明给出比任一单域更快的 scaling law。理论把改进条件归结为谱衰减、目标正则性与两域样本相对增长速度三者的耦合；语言模型实验呈现同样定性现象：合适混合使目标域测试损失下降快于单域训练。
Motivation: 数据混合与重加权研究多为经验性，尚不清楚辅助数据何时真正改善 scaling law，而非仅仅增加样本量。
Method: 研究带共享回归函数、异构协方差与噪声水平、数据集规模可按不同速率增长的高维混合数据回归模型：在椭球参数约束下给出一般协方差结构的 minimax risk，并为交换 (commutative) 协方差推导 ridge 回归测试误差的 deterministic equivalents；再特化到幂律谱对齐的目标域与辅助域，得到以谱衰减、目标正则性和两域样本相对增长表示的显式 scaling law。
Result: 理论给出的 scaling law 划分出混合数据比任一单域更快的 regime，且改进需要谱与两域相对样本量的特定配合；在语言模型上的数值实验显示，合适的数据混合使目标域测试损失下降快于任一单域训练，与理论定性一致。
Conclusion: 数据混合能否改善 scaling law 取决于谱对齐与样本量相对增长的特定组合，而非单纯堆叠辅助样本；该结论由高维回归理论与语言模型实验共同支持。

papers.title: From Unity Simulation to Diffusion-Based Augmentation: Quantifying Dataset Balance for Robust Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Modern computer vision models achieve high accuracy when trained on large-scale annotated datasets. In critical domains such as construction safety monitoring, data collection is costly, hazardous, and ethically constrained. This paper presents a systematic study comparing two complementary data generation paradigms, (1) Unity Simulation-based rendering and (2) Controllable Diffusion-based generation (CIA), for object detection under real data-scarce conditions. A unified experimental framework enables controlled dataset mixing across real, simulated, and generative sources, while maintaining identical model and training settings. Quantitative evaluation using Precision, Recall, mAP, and custom $Δ$-metrics, reveals that neither simulation nor generative augmentation alone achieves optimal transferability. Unity-only training yields an mAP@0.5 drop of $-50\%$ relative to real data, while CIA-only training shows a milder $-16.5\%$ degradation. Hybrid compositions significantly improve performance, with the 90\% real + 10\% Unity configuration achieving the best overall mAP@0.5 of $62.68\%$ ($+7.64\%$ over baseline), and the 90\% real + 10\% CIA configuration maximizing precision at $74.45\%$. Results demonstrate that limited synthetic inclusion enhances generalization, while excessive substitution induces domain drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在施工安全监测这类真实标注稀缺的目标检测任务上，Unity 仿真渲染与可控扩散生成 (CIA) 单独使用都会掉点：Unity-only 相对真实数据 mAP@0.5 下降 50%，CIA-only 下降 16.5%。混合配比才有效，90% 真实 + 10% Unity 拿到最佳 mAP@0.5 62.68%（较基线 +7.64%），90% 真实 + 10% CIA 精度最高 74.45%。结论是少量合成数据提升泛化，过度替代会引入 domain drift。
Motivation: 施工安全监测等关键场景的数据采集昂贵、危险且受伦理约束，真实标注稀缺；需要弄清仿真渲染与生成式增强这两种数据生成范式各自能补多少、混多少才不伤迁移。
Method: 在统一实验框架下对比两种数据生成范式：Unity Simulation 渲染与可控扩散生成 (CIA)，在真实、仿真、生成三类来源之间做受控的数据集配比混合，保持模型与训练设置完全一致，用 Precision、Recall、mAP 及自定义 Δ-metrics 评估。
Result: Unity-only 训练 mAP@0.5 相对真实数据下降 50%，CIA-only 下降 16.5%；90% 真实 + 10% Unity 配置取得最佳 mAP@0.5 62.68%，较基线提升 7.64%；90% 真实 + 10% CIA 配置精度最高，达 74.45%。
Conclusion: 仿真与生成增强都不能单独替代真实数据，少量合成数据混入（约 10%）即可提升泛化，过度替代会引发 domain drift。

papers.title: HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer use agents (CUAs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in completing digital tasks. However, existing CUAs either rely solely on graphical user interface (GUI) interactions, which are often inefficient and error prone, or augment GUI interactions with application specific APIs or tools, which require substantial engineering effort and are difficult to scale across applications. We argue that the next generation of CUAs should combine GUI interactions with the command line interface (CLI), leveraging the generality of the GUI and the efficiency of shell commands. A critical challenge, however, is that current models do not know when or how to use the CLI during task execution. To address this challenge, we develop a data construction pipeline that produces three types of trajectories: GUI only, CLI only, and interleaved GUI and CLI trajectories. This pipeline results in HybridCUA-8K, containing 5K hybrid trajectories and 3K verified RLVR tasks. Building on these data, we propose a training framework with two stages: supervised fine tuning on the constructed trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning with our CLI aware rewards that encourages agents to use the CLI selectively and reliably. Experiments show that HybridCUA-9B achieves 53.6% accuracy on OSWorld, improving over the base model by 14.8 percentage points, and improves performance on WindowsAgentArena by 4.0 percentage points. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and cross platform generalizability of the hybrid GUI and CLI paradigm for computer use agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HybridCUA 把 GUI 与 CLI 混合编排引入 computer-use agent：先用数据管线构造 GUI-only、CLI-only 与交错轨迹，得到 HybridCUA-8K（5K 混合轨迹 + 3K 经验证的 RLVR 任务），再做 SFT 加 CLI-aware 奖励的两阶段训练。HybridCUA-9B 在 OSWorld 上达到 53.6% 准确率，比基座模型高 14.8 个百分点，WindowsAgentArena 提升 4.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 CUA 要么只用 GUI，效率低且易错，要么依赖应用专用 API/工具，工程量大、难以跨应用扩展；核心缺口是模型不知道何时、如何在任务执行中使用 CLI。
Method: 构建数据管线产出三类轨迹（GUI only、CLI only、交错 GUI+CLI），形成 HybridCUA-8K（5K 混合轨迹、3K 经验证的 RLVR 任务）；训练分两阶段：在构造轨迹上做监督微调 (SFT)，再用 CLI-aware rewards 做强化学习，奖励鼓励选择性且可靠地使用 CLI。
Result: HybridCUA-9B 在 OSWorld 上准确率 53.6%，较基座模型提升 14.8 个百分点；在 WindowsAgentArena 上提升 4.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 混合 GUI+CLI 范式对 computer-use agent 有效且具备跨平台泛化性，关键在于用针对性数据与 CLI-aware 奖励教会模型何时用 CLI。

papers.title: HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency, so it must decide which queries are worth the extra computation (efficiency). Second, some queries are beyond the local model, and delivering a wrong answer is worse than deferring the query to a human in the loop, so it must decide which answers are safe to deliver (safety). We show that both decisions can be made from the model's own hidden states. The prefill state, computed before any token is generated, predicts whether the model will answer correctly, and the answer state, at the end of the generated answer, predicts whether that answer is correct. HARISSA fine-tunes the model so that both states predict correctness, then makes both decisions with one policy that cascades through the ways of answering from cheapest to most expensive, skipping a way the prefill state predicts will fail and deferring the query when the answer it stops with is predicted wrong. On a device running a single model, HARISSA is within one accuracy point of chain-of-thought at 2.7 times lower latency. On a server holding four sizes of one model, HARISSA is more accurate than the FrugalGPT and Self-REF cascades at the same latency, and at the same deferral rate the answer state leaves fewer wrong answers than the standard confidence signals in five of six task and setting pairs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HARISSA 让本地语言模型用自身 hidden states 同时做两个决策：prefill state 判断该不该多花算力推理，answer state 判断答案能否安全交付，否则转人工。单模型设备上它比 chain-of-thought 低一个准确率点以内、延迟低 2.7 倍；四模型服务器上同延迟比 FrugalGPT 与 Self-REF 级联更准，同转介率下 answer state 在六组任务-设置中的五组留下更少错误答案。
Motivation: 本地小模型能力不足，把难题上抛云端会丢掉隐私与成本优势；留在本地则要同时决定哪些查询值得追加推理开销、哪些答案不该交付。
Method: 微调模型使 prefill state（生成任何 token 前）与 answer state（答案末尾）都预测正确性，再用单一策略按代价从低到高级联各种作答方式：prefill 预测会失败就跳过该方式，最终答案被预测为错则把查询 defer 给 human in the loop。
Result: 单模型设备上 HARISSA 与 chain-of-thought 的准确率差距在一个点以内，延迟低 2.7 倍；服务器上四个同系列模型规模的设置中，同延迟下比 FrugalGPT 与 Self-REF 级联更准；同转介率下，answer state 在六组任务与设置中的五组比标准置信信号留下更少错误答案。
Conclusion: 效率与安全这两个部署决策都能从模型自己的 hidden states 得到，无需把查询交给云端模型。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把 LLM 决策损失分解为「从证据形成准确信念」与「把信念转成效用最优行动」两部分的决策论框架，在有已知真值的合成基准上刻画前沿与开源模型的概率推理，并用 RL 分别针对信念、决策或两者做干预。发现只针对一个分量会重新分配决策损失：目标分量改善但不迁移到另一分量；联合针对两者能同时改善，但依赖训练与评估的格式匹配。
Motivation: LLM 被当作需在显式决策成本下做概率推理的决策助手，但其决策损失来自信念形成与行动选择两个不同环节，混在一起无法判断 RL 干预到底改善了哪一环、能否迁移。
Method: 构建决策论分解框架，把决策损失拆成信念形成与效用最大化行动两部分；在有已知真值的合成基准上评估前沿与开源模型，并设计针对信念、决策或两者的 RL 干预，跨三个领域检验分量间与不同 elicitation 格式间的迁移。
Result: 针对单一组件的 RL 会重新分配决策损失：目标组件改善但不必然迁移到其他组件；同时针对信念形成与决策的联合干预改善两者，但效果取决于训练与评估格式匹配；框架还能识别决策表现在信念未改善的情况下提升的情形。
Conclusion: 概率推理的两个分量要分开诊断与干预，联合训练有效但对训练/评估格式一致性敏感；决策表现提升不等同于信念变准。

papers.title: No Scale Left Behind: Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Bi-directional Attention for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) plays a crucial role in healthcare, finance, industrial monitoring, and other sectors. Within and between these settings, anomalies span vastly different temporal scales, from sub-second point spikes to multi-hour drift patterns. However, most existing TSAD methods commit to a single temporal granularity, and multi-scale designs either analyze different scales in isolation or are constrained to a predefined coarse-to-fine hierarchy, both failing to sufficiently capture multi-scale interactions. To resolve this limitation, we propose Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Cross-Scale Attention for TSAD (MSCAD), a simple yet powerful semi-supervised TSAD framework founded on parallel autoencoder branches corresponding to different patch sizes. A stack of symmetric bidirectional cross-scale attention blocks enables every pair of scales to exchange information before reconstruction without allowing any single scale to be privileged. On the comprehensive TSB-AD benchmark (40 datasets, 530 series), MSCAD achieves large performance gains against 50 baselines across multiple metrics, with VUS-PR of 0.57(+9.6%) on the univariate split and 0.47(+9.3%) on the multivariate split compared to the state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSCAD 用不同 patch size 的并行 autoencoder 分支对齐多时间尺度，再用对称堆叠的双向 cross-scale attention 让任意两个尺度在重构前互换信息、不让任一尺度占优。在 TSB-AD 基准（40 个数据集、530 条序列）上对 50 个基线取得明显提升，VUS-PR 单变量 0.57（+9.6%）、多变量 0.47（+9.3%）。
Motivation: 异常在时间尺度上跨度极大，从亚秒级点尖峰到多小时漂移；现有 TSAD 方法多绑定单一时间粒度，多尺度设计要么各尺度孤立分析、要么被预定义的由粗到细层级限制，无法充分捕捉跨尺度交互。
Method: 提出半监督框架 MSCAD：按不同 patch size 建立并行 autoencoder 分支，堆叠对称的双向 cross-scale attention 块，使每对尺度在重构前交换信息且无单一尺度被特权化。
Result: 在 TSB-AD 基准（40 个数据集、530 条序列）上对比 50 个基线、跨多个指标取得大幅提升：VUS-PR 单变量 split 0.57（较 SOTA +9.6%），多变量 split 0.47（+9.3%）。
Conclusion: 让各尺度分支在重构前通过双向 cross-scale attention 平等交互，比单尺度或固定层级的多尺度设计更能覆盖跨尺度异常，且在单变量与多变量设置上同时成立。

papers.title: Mutual Information Constrained Chernoff Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: The classical information bottleneck (IB) measures the relevance of a representation $U$ of $X$ to a target $Y$ by $I(U;Y)$, which does not directly characterize the error of downstream decisions. For a binary hypothesis $Y$ inferred from many separately encoded observations, the optimal error exponent is the Chernoff information between the two conditional distributions of $U$ given $Y$. We study the mutual information constrained Chernoff bottleneck, which seeks an encoder that maximizes this Chernoff information subject to a rate constraint $I(U;X) \leq R$. We show that its optimal value $C(R)$ increases strictly up to $R = H(V)$, where $V$ merges the symbols of $X$ with equal likelihood ratio, remains at the uncompressed exponent beyond, and, unlike the IB curve, need not be concave. We further show that $k+1$ outputs suffice to attain $C(R)$, where $k$ is the cardinality of $V$. We propose an alternating algorithm that updates the encoder via a generalized Blahut--Arimoto algorithm and the Chernoff parameter $s$ via a nonlinear equation, and prove that its iterates remain feasible, with nondecreasing and convergent Chernoff information. Numerical experiments confirm the theory, and on real topic-detection data from the 20 Newsgroups corpus, compressing each word to only $17\%$ of its entropy retains $90\%$ of the error exponent and nearly the accuracy of the uncompressed classifier.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Feedback and comments are welcome
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出互信息约束下的 Chernoff 瓶颈 (mutual information constrained Chernoff bottleneck)：在速率约束 I(U;X)≤R 下最大化二元假设检验的误差指数（Chernoff information），而非经典 IB 的 I(U;Y)。最优值 C(R) 在 R=H(V) 前严格递增、之后保持未压缩指数且不必凹；k+1 个输出即可达到 C(R)。在 20 Newsgroups 话题检测上，把每个词压到其熵的 17% 仍保留 90% 的误差指数与接近未压缩分类器的准确率。
Motivation: 经典信息瓶颈用 I(U;Y) 度量表征与目标的相关性，但该量不能直接刻画下游判决错误；对由多个独立编码观测推断的二元假设 Y，真正的判决性能由 Chernoff information 给出的误差指数决定。
Method: 定义在速率约束 I(U;X)≤R 下最大化 Chernoff information 的瓶颈问题；证明最优编码器结构（V 合并等似然比符号）、C(R) 的分段行为与 k+1 输出的基数界；求解用交替算法——广义 Blahut--Arimoto 更新编码器，非线性方程更新 Chernoff 参数 s。
Result: C(R) 在 R=H(V) 前严格递增，之后保持未压缩误差指数，且与 IB 曲线不同不必为凹；k+1 个输出足以达到 C(R)（k 为 V 的基数）。算法迭代保持可行、Chernoff information 单调不减并收敛，数值实验验证理论。在 20 Newsgroups 真实话题检测数据上，将每个词压缩到其熵的 17% 仍保留 90% 的误差指数，准确率接近未压缩分类器。
Conclusion: 以误差指数为目标的速率约束瓶颈在结构与曲线上都不同于经典 IB：最优值在 H(V) 处饱和且可非凹，且只需 k+1 个输出即可实现，压缩表征可在极低速率下保住判决性能。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
papers.abstract_en: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.
papers.comment: 8 pages. Participant paper for the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BITEM 用单一 agentic RAG 管线参加 NTCIR-19 R2C2：编排器 (orchestrator) 持有记录、经 entailment 级联校验后才提交答案，置信度由运行残留信号算出而非让模型自评。检索跑出 22 队中第 4、5 名，池化多趟值 0.0709 nDCG@20；答案准确率 0.9219（25 队第 6），HMR 0.4915（第 13），再套一组手写规则后准确率 0.9375、HMR 0.6985。作者据此提出 accHMR＝准确率×HMR，修订规则在该指标上得 0.6549（第 5）。
Motivation: R2C2 要求系统在答对时给高置信、答错时给低置信，但让模型自评置信度不可靠；且单看 HMR 排名会奖励“答错但低置信”的系统，需要一个能同时反映准确率的奖励口径。
Method: 单一 agentic 管线：模型在电影语料上搜索、阅读并记录证据，编排器持有记录并裁决可提交内容；claim 须先通过针对所引段落的 entailment 级联，证据足够才放行答案。每题跑三到四趟，每趟检索时剔除前几趟已见过的内容；置信度由编排器根据运行残留信号计算，不询问模型。另在同一批记录信号上手写少量规则（不再调用模型、不再检索）调整置信度，并提出 accHMR＝accuracy×HMR。
Result: 两次检索跑分列 22 队第 4、第 5，池化各趟值得 0.0709 nDCG@20，增益在多跳与后处理繁重的题上最大，组织方把池化跑排为全场第一；25 个答案跑中有 16 个建立在这两个跑提供的段落上，其中 12 个来自其他队。答案准确率 0.9219（25 队第 6），所报置信度的 HMR 为 0.4915（第 13）；套用手写规则后准确率 0.9375（第 5）、HMR 0.6985（第 9），accHMR 0.6549（第 5）。
Conclusion: 置信度应由管线运行信号而非模型自评产生，且奖励指标要与准确率绑定：作者提出用 accHMR 替代单看 HMR，并认为下一步是在管线已产出的数字上拟合模型，取代手写规则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute
papers.abstract_en: Brain-AI alignment is often interpreted as a sign that model and brain perform similar computations. Whether the aligned units are causally involved in model computation is rarely checked. On an abstract pattern-completion task (AAABAAA $\rightarrow$ B), we compare LLM attention-head representations with human EEG and test how ablating those heads affects task performance. Alignment and causation dissociate: brain-aligned heads contribute to performance, but their removal is substantially less disruptive than removal of heads selected via attribution patching. We compare two head sets that prior interpretability work defines without reference to the brain: concept vectors (CVs), which represent abstract patterns across formats, and function vectors (FVs), selected for their contribution to correct-answer prediction. Brain alignment shows little association with FV scores, while its association with CV scores varies across models. Among brain-aligned heads, we find recurring attention profiles: one emphasizes distinctive elements (novelty heads), the other repeating elements (repetition heads). The novelty family tracks salience and attends to the same elements that humans look at, yet its removal is less damaging than random ablation on average. Repetition heads contribute modestly to performance and are associated with abstract-pattern representation (CVs). Across 17 models spanning 3B-72B parameters, FV-ranked removal is substantially more disruptive than brain-ranked removal. Brain alignment thus captures how the model reads the stimulus, and only faintly captures how it represents the pattern and solves the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在抽象补全任务 AAABAAA→B 上，脑对齐 (brain alignment) 的注意力头被消融后对性能的破坏显著小于按 attribution patching 选出的头：脑对齐捕捉的是模型如何读取刺激，而非如何表征模式与解题。跨 17 个 3B–72B 模型，按 function vector 排序移除头的破坏性远大于按脑对齐排序。
Motivation: 脑-AI 对齐常被当作模型与脑执行相似计算的证据，但被对齐的单元是否真正参与模型计算很少被因果检验。
Method: 在 AAABAAA→B 抽象模式补全任务上比较 LLM 注意力头表征与人类 EEG，再对选出的头做消融看性能变化；对照两组不依赖脑的头集合——concept vectors (CVs) 与 function vectors (FVs)，并按脑对齐排序与 attribution patching 排序分别移除。
Result: 跨 17 个模型（3B–72B 参数），FV 排序移除比脑排序移除破坏性大得多；脑对齐头移除的破坏显著小于 attribution patching 选出的头，novelty 头移除平均而言比随机消融还轻；脑对齐与 FV 分数关联很弱，与 CV 分数的关联随模型变化。脑对齐头中反复出现两类注意轮廓：novelty 头追踪显著性并注视与人类相同的元素，repetition 头对性能贡献不大但与抽象模式表征 (CVs) 相关。
Conclusion: 脑对齐刻画的是模型读取刺激的方式，只微弱地反映其表征模式与解题的机制，因此不能直接当作计算相似性的证据。

papers.title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models achieve strong zero-shot accuracy on structured data by pretraining on synthetic tables, but they ignore the column names, task descriptions, and auxiliary files that carry dataset semantics. Meanwhile, self-evolving machine learning engineering (MLE) agents train models from scratch on each dataset, yet jointly searching over features, architectures, and hyperparameters is noisy and prone to overfitting. We introduce TabFM-Auto, which pairs a tabular foundation model, TabFM, with a language model agent that evolves the data pipeline around it. Guided by dataset metadata and validation feedback, TabFM-Auto iteratively refines data cleaning, feature engineering, context selection, and post-processing to reduce TabFM's error. Across all 51 datasets of the TabArena benchmark, five TabFM-Auto configurations with different agents and language models take the top five overall positions, and the best raises TabFM from 1785 to 2013 Elo. The discovered pipelines also transfer to other frozen tabular foundation models (+69 to +143 Elo) with no further search. On the 8 tabular competitions of MLE-Bench, TabFM-Auto ranks first overall among MLE agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabFM-Auto 把表格基础模型 TabFM 与语言模型 agent 配对，由数据集元数据和验证反馈驱动，迭代改进数据清洗、特征工程、上下文选择与后处理以降低 TabFM 误差。在 TabArena 全部 51 个数据集上，五种 agent/LLM 配置包揽总榜前五，最佳配置把 TabFM 的 Elo 从 1785 提到 2013；发现的 pipeline 迁移到其他冻结表格基础模型可再加 69 至 143 Elo，且在 MLE-Bench 的 8 个表格竞赛中总排名居首。
Motivation: 表格基础模型零样本预训练时忽略列名、任务描述和辅助文件里的数据集语义；而自演化 MLE agent 从头训练，联合搜索特征、架构与超参数噪声大、易过拟合。
Method: 以 TabFM 为底座，语言模型 agent 依据数据集元数据与验证反馈，围绕它迭代改进数据清洗、特征工程、上下文选择 (context selection) 和后处理；对比五种不同 agent 与语言模型的配置。
Result: 在 TabArena 全部 51 个数据集上，五种 TabFM-Auto 配置占据总榜前五名，最佳配置将 TabFM 的 Elo 从 1785 提升到 2013；发现的 pipeline 无需再搜索即可迁移到其他冻结表格基础模型，带来 +69 至 +143 Elo；在 MLE-Bench 的 8 个表格竞赛中，TabFM-Auto 在所有 MLE agent 中总排名第一。
Conclusion: 围绕冻结表格基础模型演化数据 pipeline，比让 agent 从头训练更有效，且学到的 pipeline 对其他表格基础模型可直接迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices
papers.abstract_en: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). We call the resulting method KV-Kaizen, for the many small per-layer choices it compounds. We observe that these interventions taken independently and uniformly over all layers limit achievable compression because they degrade accuracy. Crucially, composing them locally and adaptively to the context can instead preserve accuracy while achieving large memory savings. At inference, the selector runs once, before pre-fill. In evaluations on instruction following and reasoning tasks, our selectors reach the Pareto frontier of accuracy against cache size, against learning-free and post-hoc baselines. On long-context tasks, KV-Kaizen improves on eviction and can be composed with it, reaching a 32x smaller decode-time cache on a 14B model while preserving accuracy. A 4x cache size reduction incurs no accuracy degradation from 7B parameters up, and a compressed model is more accurate than a smaller uncompressed one with the same cache size. Together, these findings support pre-training large models and compressing them only afterwards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KV-Kaizen 学一个按上下文选 KV cache 配置的选择器，在 depth（跨层共享 cache）、precision（低位宽缓存）、rank（截断低秩隐变量）三个轴上做逐层组合，而非一次性丢弃 token。在指令跟随与推理任务上达到精度-缓存大小的 Pareto 前沿；14B 模型上可把解码期 cache 压到 1/32 且保持精度，7B 起 4 倍压缩不掉点，作者据此主张先预训练大模型再压缩。
Motivation: 长上下文下 KV cache 会超过模型权重占用，解码是 memory-bound，decode 成本随 cache 增长；现有 eviction 一次性丢 token 可能事后有害，而各层统一地独立使用压缩手段会因精度下降限制可压缩率。
Method: 训练一个 selector，基于上下文在 pre-fill 之前运行一次，输出逐层 cache 配置以满足整体压缩预算；三个可组合的轴是跨层共享 cache（depth）、降低缓存位宽（precision）、截断低秩 latent cache 表示（rank），可与 eviction 组合。
Result: 在指令跟随与推理任务上，selector 相对 learning-free 与 post-hoc 基线达到精度对 cache 大小的 Pareto 前沿；长上下文任务上优于 eviction 且可与之组合，14B 模型达到 32 倍更小的解码期 cache 并保持精度；7B 参数及以上时 4 倍 cache 缩减不带来精度下降；同等 cache 大小下压缩模型比更小的未压缩模型更准。
Conclusion: 逐层、随上下文自适应地组合 depth/precision/rank 才能既省显存又保精度，统一均匀地单独使用这些手段会掉点；这些结果支持先预训练大模型、事后压缩的路线。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ORMA: Optimization-based Monocular 4D Reconstruction of Articulated Animals
papers.abstract_en: Recovering articulated 4D representations of animals from monocular videos remains challenging due to the large diversity of quadruped morphologies and lack of animal 4D supervision data. Existing learning-based reconstruction methods operate on individual images and rely on synthetic or model-fitted 3D supervision, which inherits the constraints of strong parametric priors and limits generalization to out-of-distribution species. When applied to out-of-distribution animals, they often recover a plausible pose while producing inaccurate geometry because the underlying shape model cannot faithfully represent the observed instance. We present ORMA, a training-free reconstruction framework that decouples articulation from shape, using the predicted pose as reference for optimization while leveraging generative 3D priors for accurate shape reconstruction. Given a reference image, we reconstruct the animal geometry and register it to the parametric model SMAL+, yielding an articulated shape adapted to the observed instance. We then combine per-frame articulated pose estimates with globally consistent camera poses to recover animal motion in a shared world coordinate frame, and further refine the reconstruction using self-supervised DINO correspondences and temporal consistency. To enable quantitative evaluation, we introduce PAW4D, a synthetic multi-species benchmark with ground-truth 3D geometry and camera motion. Experiments on PAW4D, PFERD, and challenging in-the-wild videos demonstrate that ORMA improves reconstruction accuracy while recovering globally consistend animal motion across diverse quadruped species.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORMA 是免训练的单目四足动物 4D 重建框架：把关节化姿态与形状解耦，用生成式 3D 先验重建形状并配准到 SMAL+，再结合逐帧姿态与全局一致相机位姿恢复世界坐标系下的动物运动。在新提出的合成多物种基准 PAW4D 以及 PFERD 和野外视频上，重建精度提升且跨四足物种的运动全局一致。
Motivation: 单目动物 4D 重建缺少监督数据，现有学习方法依赖合成或模型拟合的 3D 监督与强参数先验，遇到分布外物种时姿态看似合理但几何不准，因为底层形状模型无法忠实表示观测实例。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 流程：由参考图像重建几何并配准到参数模型 SMAL+，得到适配该实例的关节化形状；以预测姿态为参考做优化，同时用生成式 3D 先验保证形状精度；逐帧关节姿态与全局一致相机位姿结合，在共享世界坐标系恢复运动，并用自监督 DINO 对应与时序一致性进一步精化。另提出带真实 3D 几何与相机运动真值的合成多物种基准 PAW4D。
Result: 在 PAW4D、PFERD 及有挑战的野外视频上，ORMA 提升重建精度并跨多样四足物种恢复全局一致的动物运动；PAW4D 提供真值 3D 几何与相机运动以支持定量评估。
Conclusion: 把关节化姿态与形状解耦、让生成式先验负责形状，可在无动物 4D 监督的条件下改善分布外物种的单目 4D 重建与全局一致运动恢复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
papers.abstract_en: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ($S^3$), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate $S^3$ on 2B-30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains. $S^3$ establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S³ 把 Thinking 检查点中落在 Non-thinking 模型主奇异方向零空间 (null space) 之外的权重成分换掉，保留 Non-thinking 模型自身主子空间，实现免训练的成对检查点组合。在 2B–30B 稠密与 MoE 模型、28 个数学/多模态/音频推理环境上，相比完整 Thinking 模型平均减少 27.4% 推理 token 开销，同时整体准确率再升 1.0 个百分点，HMMT25 上 +8.3% 准确率并带来 33.0% token 加速。
Motivation: Chain-of-thought 后训练的 Thinking 模型推理能力提升但 token 开销过大；已有压缩工作多在主子空间内操作，零空间的作用未被利用。
Method: 提出 Spectral Null-Space Swap (S³)：对配对的 Non-thinking 与 Thinking 检查点做免训练组合，保留 Non-thinking 模型在其自身主子空间内的成分、取用 Thinking 检查点在该子空间之外的成分；用 attention entropy 解释保留成分带来更集中的注意力，并以简化优化解析模型说明零空间为何能降低 attention entropy。
Result: 在 2B–30B 稠密与 MoE 架构、覆盖数学、多模态、音频的 28 个评测环境上：相比完整 Thinking 模型平均减少 27.4% 推理 token 开销，整体任务准确率同时提高 1.0 个百分点；HMMT25 上准确率 +8.3% 且 token 加速 33.0%。

papers.title: On Trajectory-Aware Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions. The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model's own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed. Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact. We introduce PUMBA, a unified framework for trajectory-aware training that trains the denoiser on consecutive steps of policy-induced trajectories, passes information between steps, and optimizes them jointly by backpropagation through time. A controlled study of this design space shows that i) exact train--inference alignment fails due to local overfitting, whereas a looser alignment still brings training masks closer to those seen at inference; ii) passing continuous information outperforms discrete gradient estimators through the commitment at each step; and iii) performance improves as backpropagation through time spans more steps, which we support theoretically. Combined, these components match the best checkpoint of a same-size autoregressive model. Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B, where it improves the trade-off between performance and number of function evaluations (NFEs) in both full-canvas and block diffusion generation. At matched performance, it needs up to 22% fewer NFEs than standard fine-tuning with twice the budget in full-canvas generation, and up to 26% fewer than standard fine-tuning for the same number of steps in block diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PUMBA：在策略诱导的轨迹上对掩码扩散语言模型 (MDM) 去噪器做轨迹感知训练，逐步传递连续信息并用 BPTT 联合优化。精确的训练-推理对齐因局部过拟合而失败，宽松对齐反而更好；在 LLaDA-8B 微调上，同等性能时 full-canvas 生成最多省 22% NFE，block diffusion 最多省 26%。
Motivation: MDM 训练用随机掩码序列、推理却沿模型自身预测的轨迹进行，且每一步看不到上一步的计算结果；已有方法各自从单一角度缓解，这些设计如何相互作用尚不清楚。
Method: PUMBA 统一框架：在策略诱导轨迹的连续步上训练去噪器，步间传递连续信息（优于离散梯度估计器），并用时间反向传播 (BPTT) 联合优化多步；随后用于 LLaDA-8B 的监督微调，覆盖 full-canvas 与 block diffusion 两种生成方式。
Result: 受控设计空间研究给出三点：精确 train-inference 对齐因局部过拟合失败而宽松对齐更优；连续信息传递胜过离散梯度估计器；BPTT 跨步数越多性能越好，并有理论支持。组合后匹配同规模自回归模型的最佳 checkpoint。LLaDA-8B 上，full-canvas 生成在同等性能时比预算翻倍的标准微调最多省 22% NFE，block diffusion 在相同步数下比标准微调最多省 26%。
Conclusion: 轨迹感知训练的正确形态是宽松对齐加连续步间信息与多步 BPTT，而非精确对齐；这能改善 MDM 性能与 NFE 的权衡，使其匹配同规模自回归模型。

papers.title: Dagger: Decoupling-based Model Stealing Attack against Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: As Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely deployed as Machine Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS) APIs, model stealing attacks have emerged as a critical security threat. By querying a victim model's black-box API, an adversary can construct a functionally equivalent surrogate model, compromising proprietary intellectual property and downstream security. Existing GNN stealing attacks, however, rely on overly permissive assumptions, such as soft-label outputs, large query budgets, full-graph query access, and prior knowledge of victim backbones that rarely hold in real-world deployments. In this work, we formalize a strictly constrained black-box, hard-label and backbone-agnostic threat model for GNN stealing attacks under a tight query budget. Given these realistic restrictions, we identify four fundamental challenges: sparse local structures and isolated nodes that degrade victim label quality, insufficient supervision signals, systematic imbalance with incomplete class coverage, and backbone mismatch. To address these interlocking barriers, we propose Dagger, a novel two-phase decoupling-based attack framework. Specifically, in Phase 1, Dagger pre-trains a surrogate using decoupled information propagation to preserve structural context over sparse local subgraphs while handling isolated nodes, combined with manifold-level node mixup to synthesize continuous supervision signals and smooth decision boundaries. In Phase 2, Dagger freezes the encoder and fine-tunes the classifier head via class-balanced sampling paired with logit adjustment to rectify severe query imbalance without requiring extra victim queries. Extensive experiments across four benchmark graphs and four GNN backbones demonstrate that Dagger consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GNN stealing attacks, achieving up to 18.16\% higher fidelity while only utilizing 12.23$\times$ fewer queries than the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dagger 在严格受限的黑盒、硬标签、backbone 无关且查询预算极小的威胁模型下做 GNN 模型窃取：Phase 1 用解耦信息传播与流形级 node mixup 预训练 surrogate，Phase 2 冻结编码器、用类平衡采样加 logit adjustment 微调分类头。在四个基准图与四种 GNN backbone 上，fidelity 最高比最强基线高 18.16%，同时查询量少 12.23 倍。
Motivation: 现有 GNN 窃取攻击依赖软标签输出、大查询预算、全图访问和已知 victim backbone 等在真实 MLaaS 部署中几乎不成立的宽松假设，导致攻击可行性被高估。
Method: 两阶段框架：Phase 1 用 decoupled information propagation 在稀疏局部子图上保留结构上下文并处理孤立节点，配合 manifold-level node mixup 合成连续监督信号、平滑决策边界；Phase 2 冻结 encoder，用 class-balanced sampling 加 logit adjustment 微调 classifier head，纠正查询类别失衡且不额外查询 victim。
Result: 在四个 benchmark graphs 与四个 GNN backbones 上，Dagger 相比 SOTA GNN stealing attacks 最高获得 18.16% 更高的 fidelity，同时只用比最强基线少 12.23 倍的查询。
Conclusion: 在硬标签、backbone 无关、查询预算紧张的现实约束下，解耦传播加合成监督与类平衡微调的组合能同时提升 surrogate fidelity 并大幅压缩查询开销。

papers.title: PhysWAM: Physically Consistent World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) jointly predict how a scene will evolve and how an agent should act, however joint generation alone does not necessarily impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions. We present PhysWAM, a unified world-action model for autonomous driving that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single flow-matching transformer. To ground world and action generation in measured scene geometry, we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP) that unprojects the generated depth into 3D points, transforms them using the generated $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ ego motion, and minimizes their distance to LiDAR points transformed using the recorded ego motion. This geometric constraint promotes physical consistency with the measured scene by jointly supervising generated depth and motion alongside their standard flow-matching objectives. At inference, trajectory selection relies only on a simple label-free consensus rule, with no learned scorer or simulator feedback. We evaluate PhysWAM across NAVSIM v1 and v2 planning, zero-shot closed-loop transfer, and future video and metric-depth prediction. Despite PhysWAM's simple selection procedure, it achieves strong planning performance and transfers zero-shot to unseen driving environments. It also generates accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video, with CPP improving both planning and depth prediction. Together, these results demonstrate that the geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion provides a direct way to couple world and action generation within a simple unified model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysWAM 在单个 flow-matching transformer 中联合去噪多视角视频、metric depth 与 ego motion，并用 Coupled Point Projection (CPP) 把生成深度反投影为 3D 点、按生成的 SE(3) 自车位姿变换后与 LiDAR 点对齐，从而把世界生成和动作生成绑在同一套几何约束上。在 NAVSIM v1/v2 规划、零样本闭环迁移以及未来视频与深度预测上均取得强规划表现，CPP 同时改善规划与深度预测。
Motivation: 现有 world-action model 只做联合生成，不强制世界预测与动作预测共享几何约束，导致生成的场景演化与自车动作可能彼此不一致。
Method: 单个 flow-matching transformer 联合去噪多视角视频、metric depth 和 ego motion；新增 Coupled Point Projection (CPP) 将生成深度反投影为 3D 点，用生成的 SE(3) 自车运动变换，最小化其与按记录自车位姿变换后的 LiDAR 点的距离，该几何约束与标准 flow-matching 目标一起监督深度与运动；推理时轨迹选择只用无标签 consensus 规则，不需学习式打分器或仿真器反馈。
Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 与 v2 规划、零样本闭环迁移到未见驾驶环境、以及未来视频与 metric depth 预测上评估：尽管选择规则简单仍取得强规划性能并实现零样本迁移，生成的 metric depth 准确、视频时间连贯，CPP 同时提升规划与深度预测。
Conclusion: 场景深度与自车运动之间的几何关系可以直接把世界生成和动作生成耦合进一个简单统一模型，无需学习式打分器或仿真反馈。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: SoL-Refiner: Speed-of-Light One-Step Refinement for High-Resolution Video
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution video generation is expensive, as its cost grows rapidly with the number of spatiotemporal tokens. A practical alternative first generates a lower-resolution video and then applies a refiner, but conventional multi-step refinement introduces a second sampling bottleneck. We present SoL-Refiner, a one-step video refiner that transforms low-resolution model outputs into 4K videos with a single denoising step. Our three-stage recipe combines high-resolution continual training, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, and a final one-step distillation. We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners at approximately 2K output resolution. At 2K, the one-step SoL-Refiner outperforms all external refiners on the VBench and UniPercept averages, while at $3840\!\times\!2176$ it improves both metrics over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner. With the complete acceleration stack, SoL-Refiner achieves an $8.91\times$ speedup in refinement latency over the same baseline in our 2K latency setting.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SelfSearch 让 LLM agent 用先前自我改进记录（推理、工具动作与结果）修改自身，搜索阶段完全不用下游奖励信号。在六个模型-基准设置上群体平均成功率均高于初始 agent，单个 agent 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上最多提升 11.2 个百分点；仅花 4.03 美元搜索成本产出的 harness 在 DeepSeek V4 Flash 下解决 82.0% 的 Terminal-Bench 2.1 任务，追平最高分 Codex。
Motivation: 现有 agent 自改进方法靠反复下游评估搜索改进方案，成本高且搜索被绑定到被评估的具体任务上。
Method: SelfSearch 是无奖励 (reward-free) 搜索过程：agent 读取先前自我改进 episode 的记录（包含推理、工具动作与修改尝试的结果），据此修改自身的指令、工具与执行流程，用这些具体经验同时改进任务求解与自我修改能力；搜索期间不使用下游奖励信号。
Result: 六个模型-基准设置上群体平均成功率全部高于初始 agent，单个 agent 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 最多提升 11.2 个百分点；SWE-bench Multilingual 上某 agent 在两个版本都解出的任务上成功率 +5.0 个百分点且执行成本降 38.5%；搜索成本 4.03 美元产出的 harness 在公开九-harness 对比设置下用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 解决 Terminal-Bench 2.1 的 82.0% 任务，追平最高分 Codex；任务成功率与评估引导搜索基线相当而搜索成本更低。
Conclusion: 自我修改过程中积累的经验本身足以提升 agent 的下游能力与效率，无需在搜索阶段依赖下游奖励信号，且成本低于评估引导的搜索基线。

papers.title: TabFM: A Zero-Shot Foundation Model for Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Tabular machine learning typically relies on per-dataset workflows, fitting tree ensembles or running AutoML searches from scratch for every task. We present TabFM, a 400M-parameter tabular foundation model that formulates supervised tabular prediction as in-context learning. TabFM produces calibrated zero-shot predictions in a single forward pass without task-specific tuning. Trained entirely on synthetic tables generated from structural causal models, TabFM learns general tabular representations that transfer zero-shot to real-world tasks. Across all 51 benchmark datasets in TabArena (38 classification and 13 regression), zero-shot TabFM ranks first among default tabular foundation models and outperforms tuned AutoML pipelines. Two extensions over the same frozen weights improve performance further on both tracks: multi-view feature expansion with ensembling and post-hoc calibration (TabFM+), and LLM-guided, dataset-specific data processing and feature engineering (TabFM-Auto).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabFM 是 400M 参数的表格基础模型，把有监督表格预测改写成 in-context learning，仅用结构因果模型 (SCM) 生成的合成表训练，单次前向即给出校准的零样本预测。在 TabArena 全部 51 个基准数据集（38 分类、13 回归）上，零样本 TabFM 在默认表格基础模型中排名第一，并超过调过参的 AutoML 流水线。
Motivation: 表格机器学习长期依赖逐数据集流程：每个任务都要从头拟合树集成或重跑 AutoML 搜索，成本高且无法直接迁移。
Method: TabFM 以 400M 参数把监督表格预测表述为 in-context learning，训练数据全部来自结构因果模型生成的合成表，从而学到可零样本迁移到真实任务的通用表格表示；两个扩展在同一份冻结权重上工作：TabFM+ 加多视图特征扩展 (multi-view feature expansion)、集成与事后校准 (post-hoc calibration)，TabFM-Auto 用 LLM 做数据集特定的数据处理与特征工程。
Result: 在 TabArena 全部 51 个基准数据集（38 个分类、13 个回归）上，零样本 TabFM 在默认表格基础模型中排名第一，并优于调过参的 AutoML 流水线；TabFM+ 与 TabFM-Auto 在两条任务轨上都于同一冻结权重之上进一步提升性能。
Conclusion: 只用 SCM 合成表训练的表格基础模型可以零样本给出校准预测并胜过逐任务调参的 AutoML，而多视图扩展、事后校准与 LLM 驱动的特征工程还能在不改权重的前提下继续加成。

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier Systems as Universal Approximators
papers.abstract_en: As the input dimension $n$ grows, rule-based machine learning, such as Learning Classifier Systems (LCSs), faces a fundamental scalability bottleneck for function approximation: both rule count and parameter count grow exponentially with $n$. Traditional LCSs partition the $n$-dimensional input space directly, requiring $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ rules for adequate coverage, where $m$ is the per-variable resolution. This article breaks from this paradigm by reorganizing rules dimension-wise, guided by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem: any continuous $n$-dimensional function can be expressed as a finite superposition of one-dimensional functions. The proposed Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier System (KACS) decomposes the target function into one-dimensional subproblems and assigns a dedicated ruleset to each, reducing the worst-case rule count from $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn^2)$ and replacing $n$-dimensional local models with one-dimensional models requiring only two parameters per rule, independent of $n$. We also provide the first constructive proof that an LCS, namely KACS, is a universal approximator for continuous functions on compact domains. Evaluated against a direct $n$-dimensional input space partitioning approach under otherwise identical conditions, KACS achieves competitive accuracy in many settings while using only 2\% to 40\% of the parameters. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YNU-NakataLab/KACS.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Evolutionary Computation (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier System (KACS)：按 Kolmogorov-Arnold 表示定理把 n 维目标函数拆成一维子问题、每个变量配专属规则集，最坏规则数从 O(m^n) 降到 O(mn²)，每条规则只需两个与 n 无关的参数。在与直接 n 维输入空间划分方法的同条件对比中，KACS 在多数设置下精度相当而只用 2%–40% 的参数，并给出 LCS 作为紧集上连续函数通用逼近器的首个构造性证明。
Motivation: 规则型机器学习（如 Learning Classifier Systems）在输入维度 n 增大时遭遇可扩展性瓶颈：直接划分 n 维输入空间需要 O(m^n) 条规则，规则数与参数数随 n 指数增长。
Method: KACS 借助 Kolmogorov-Arnold 表示定理（任意连续 n 维函数可表为一维函数的有限复合）将目标函数分解为一维子问题，为每个维度分配专属 ruleset，用一维局部模型替代 n 维局部模型，每条规则仅两个参数；并给出 KACS 作为紧集上连续函数通用逼近器的构造性证明。
Result: 最坏规则数由 O(m^n) 降为 O(mn²)，每规则参数量与 n 无关；在与直接 n 维输入空间划分方法、其余条件完全相同的评测中，KACS 在多数设置下精度具有竞争力，参数量仅为对照方法的 2% 到 40%。
Conclusion: 按维度重组规则（而非按空间划分）能让规则型学习在维数增长时保持可扩展的参数规模，同时仍具备通用逼近保证。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
papers.abstract_en: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BrainNet Studio 把静态与动态脑网络分析整合成一条统一流水线：网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、候选生物标志物识别、可视化与辅助解释，内置 27 种算法（深度学习、图神经网络、时空序列模型）做分类并定位判别性脑区与连接，另用 LLM 生成可被研究者核验的功能连接、结构连接与结构-功能耦合摘要。用户可在同一计算框架内配置任务、比较方法、检查输出并扩展功能，无需反复拼装专用 pipeline。
Motivation: 现有工具多面向静态 connectome，动态网络建模与现代图学习、序列学习方法的集成不足，而脑网络拓扑随时间变化且存在高阶时空依赖，静态表示难以刻画。
Method: 提供统一工作流，覆盖网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、候选生物标志物识别、可视化与辅助解释；集成 27 种算法，含深度学习、图神经网络 (GNN) 与时空序列模型，用于分类及判别性脑区、脑连接识别；LLM 模块在个体与群体层面生成功能连接、结构连接和结构-功能耦合的可核验摘要。
Result: 工具集成 27 种算法，覆盖分类与判别性脑区/连接识别；LLM 输出个体与群体层面的功能连接、结构连接及结构-功能耦合摘要，且可由研究者核验；代码公开于 github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio。
Conclusion: 把动态脑网络建模与图/序列学习放进同一可扩展框架，可让认知神经科学、脑疾病探索和脑机接口研究者在不重复搭 pipeline 的前提下配置、比较与扩展分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, TOCOMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, TOCOMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TOCOMAS 把任务图锚定到工具接口，用责任域、依赖诱导的协作与边界调控的记忆可见性约束多智能体结构，并在在线自演化中只保留满足结构约束且提升奖励的耦合改动。在 BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified 与 CoMemBench 上，任务成功率相对基线在多种 backbone 上均提升，CoMemBench 上相对自演化基线在 verified progress、handoffs 与 memory isolation 上也有增益。
Motivation: 现有方法能联合优化智能体与通信结构，但不保证责任、交接与记忆边界与任务依赖保持一致，导致自演化时结构漂移。
Method: TOCOMAS 将任务图落到工具接口，把相容任务节点组织为可复用责任域，由依赖与 profile 推导协作关系并按边界调控记忆可见性；在线自演化阶段对智能体、协作与记忆策略提出耦合改动，只保留满足结构约束且提升评估奖励的候选。
Result: 在 BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified、CoMemBench 四个基准上，任务成功率相对基线在多种 backbone 上均提升；CoMemBench 上相对自演化基线在 verified progress、handoffs、memory isolation 三项指标上也取得增益。
Conclusion: 让责任、交接与记忆边界始终与任务依赖对齐（topological coherence），是自演化多智能体系统持续改进任务成功率与记忆隔离的前提。

papers.title: Scene-Consistent Illumination Transfer for Inserted Advertising Graphics
papers.abstract_en: Replacing a visible advertisement in a broadcast frame is geometrically straightforward but photometrically delicate. A pasted graphic can have the correct perspective and still appear detached when its brightness, shading, or shadow disagrees with the surface beneath it. This paper presents Ad-Relight, an inference-only procedure for transferring scene illumination to a supplied advertising graphic without collecting a banner-specific training set. The procedure first separates slowly varying shade from graphic structure, then probes a pretrained diffusion relighter with two nearly identical backgrounds to isolate the contribution of the target region. A final pass combines this residual with a smoothed luminance field and a soft attenuation mask. Across 560 generated placements, the approach improves structural similarity, perceptual distance, and illumination agreement over geometric compositing and direct relighting baselines. Human judgments and an automated preference study show the clearest gains on floor-mounted graphics with nonuniform lighting. The current study is image based; temporal stabilization remains an open extension.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, and 3 tables; conference-style computer vision manuscript focused on single-frame advertising-banner relighting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ad-Relight 是一套仅推理的单帧广告图重光照流程：先分离缓变阴影与图形结构，再用两张几乎相同的背景探测预训练 diffusion relighter 以提取目标区域的光照残差，最后把残差与平滑亮度场、软衰减掩码合成。在 560 个生成的插入位点上，其结构相似性、感知距离与光照一致性均优于几何合成与直接重光照基线，增益在非均匀光照的地面广告上最明显。
Motivation: 广播画面里替换广告时，透视正确但亮度、阴影与底面不一致会让贴图显得浮在表面；现有做法要么纯几何合成，要么直接重光照，缺少不需广告位专属训练集的光照迁移手段。
Method: Ad-Relight 为 inference-only 流程：先将缓慢变化的阴影与图形结构分离，再对预训练 diffusion relighter 输入两张几乎相同的背景以隔离目标区域的贡献，最后把该残差与平滑亮度场 (luminance field) 及软衰减掩码 (soft attenuation mask) 结合完成合成，全程无需收集 banner 专属训练集。
Result: 在 560 个生成的广告插入位点上，该方法在结构相似性 (SSIM)、感知距离与光照一致性三项指标上均优于几何合成 (geometric compositing) 与直接重光照 (direct relighting) 基线；人工评判与自动化偏好研究显示，增益在光照非均匀的地面放置广告 (floor-mounted graphics) 上最突出。
Conclusion: 不采集特定训练集、仅靠探测式残差提取即可把场景光照迁移到插入广告图形；当前结论限于单帧图像，时序稳定 (temporal stabilization) 被作者列为待扩展方向。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video-RSI 让视频理解 agent 用自己的语言模型改写采集证据的 harness：通过主动回看原始训练视频、用额外观测检验竞争性失败解释，再把诊断转成可复用修订，并按答案准确率与视觉成本共同决定保留哪些修订。在视频理解 benchmark 的评测设置下，演化后的 agent 提升准确率同时处理更少帧，取得有竞争力的准确率-效率权衡。
Motivation: 执行轨迹只包含当前 harness 采集到的证据，失败的竞争性解释无法被区分，自我改进缺少可靠依据。
Method: 框架包含三步：主动视频调查 (active video investigation) 回到原始训练视频用新观测检验竞争性失败解释；cost-aware harness evolution 把诊断转为可复用的 harness 修订；保留决策同时考虑答案准确率与视觉成本。修订由 agent 自身的语言模型生成。
Result: 在视频理解 benchmark 的评测设置下，演化后的 agent 提升准确率且处理更少的帧，相对已有视频理解 agent 达到有竞争力的准确率-效率权衡；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 视频理解 agent 可以通过 harness 演化改进自身的证据采集与使用，且改进不必以更多视觉输入为代价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A shape-similarity latent space for fluid interfaces: invertible reduced-order modelling of droplet morphology
papers.abstract_en: A droplet breaks up in tens of microseconds, and a recording captures perhaps a dozen frames. The states in between cannot be recovered without repeating the experiment, and simulating them is too costly to sweep an operating envelope. Yet they are present in the corpus as a whole: a campaign spanning a device's actuation range produces morphologies resembling those any single recording missed. Exploiting that requires a representation that is low-dimensional, invertible, and faithful to shape rather than to sampling. Proper orthogonal decomposition supplies the first two but measures distance in sampled coordinates; manifold learning supplies the third but no map back to a shape; elastic shape analysis supplies a shape metric but no reduced coordinates. SHROM composes all three. Interfaces are represented by their square-root velocity functions, a neighbour graph is built over that shape space, and an autoencoder is trained to reconstruct while penalising latents in which graph neighbours are not latent neighbours. The demonstration uses 301,539 inkjet droplet contours and four filmed break-up sequences. The graph term does not improve reconstruction. It determines whether position in the latent carries meaning: clustering the latent of an otherwise identical model recovers the shape-space partition at chance level (ARI = 0.063 +/- 0.059), and at 0.781 +/- 0.049 with the term active. Waveform parameters predict the full contour at R^2 = 0.878 +/- 0.026. Negative results are reported in the same terms. The graph metric proved immaterial across five choices, and interpolation error saturates at the reconstruction limit, so a plain autoencoder leads that task. The main limitation is interpolation across a topology change: no component of the regularised latent holds both a single-component and a post-break-up shape, whereas an unregularised autoencoder mixes them freely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHROM 把液滴界面的平方根速度函数 (square-root velocity function)、形状空间邻域图与自编码器组合成可逆降阶模型，用图正则强制潜空间位置对应形状邻域。图项不改善重建，但决定潜变量是否有语义：关掉时潜空间聚类恢复形状分区的 ARI 为 0.063±0.059（随机水平），开启后升到 0.781±0.049；波形参数预测完整轮廓达 R²=0.878±0.026。作者同时报告负结果：图度量在五种选择下无差别，插值误差在重建极限处饱和，且正则潜空间无法同时容纳断裂前后的拓扑。
Motivation: 液滴破裂发生在几十微秒内、单次录制只有约十几帧，中间状态无法恢复，仿真又贵到扫不动工况包络；而 POD 度量的是采样坐标、流形学习没有回到形状的映射、elastic shape analysis 没有降阶坐标，三者各缺一角。
Method: SHROM：界面用平方根速度函数表示，在该形状空间上建邻域图，训练自编码器重建的同时惩罚“图邻居不是潜邻居”的潜变量，从而把形状度量注入潜空间。演示用 301,539 条喷墨液滴轮廓与四段拍摄的破裂序列。
Result: 图项对重建无改善；潜空间聚类恢复形状分区的 ARI 从 0.063±0.059（图项关闭，随机水平）升到 0.781±0.049（图项开启）。波形参数预测完整轮廓 R²=0.878±0.026。负结果：图度量在五种选择下均无实质差别，插值误差在重建极限处饱和，普通自编码器在该任务上领先。
Conclusion: 图正则的价值不在重建而在潜空间语义——它让潜坐标携带形状分区信息；但插值任务上它无增益，且正则潜空间无法跨越拓扑变化同时表示单组分与破裂后形状，这是作者点名的主要局限。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Identifiability Guarantees for Drivers and Dynamics of Delayed Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: A wide range of methods have been proposed, including physics-informed neural networks, which are powerful but do not guarantee identifiability of the dynamics, symbolic regression, which requires a set of precomputed operations, and causal discovery, which is more principled but usually relies on strong assumptions that physical systems may violate. In this work, we develop a theory-grounded method and prove that under a set of permissive assumptions, the structural drivers and drift of stochastic delayed differential equations are identifiable. Our method outperforms others on a benchmark for driver identifiability, and on a second benchmark to evaluate physical consistency of the learned dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对含时滞的随机物理系统，提出一种有理论保证的辨识方法，在一组宽松假设下证明随机时滞微分方程 (stochastic delayed differential equations) 的结构驱动项与漂移项 (drift) 可辨识。在驱动项辨识基准上优于对照方法，并在第二个评估学习动力学物理一致性的基准上同样更优。
Motivation: PINN 强大但不保证动力学可辨识，符号回归依赖预先给定的运算集合，因果发现依赖物理系统可能违反的强假设；含时滞的随机系统缺少有理论保证的驱动与动力辨识手段。
Method: 提出理论驱动的辨识方法，在一组宽松假设下对随机时滞微分方程的结构驱动项与漂移项给出可辨识性证明，并在两个基准上与既有方法对比：一个测驱动项辨识，一个测学习动力学的物理一致性。
Result: 在驱动项辨识基准上优于其他方法；在第二个评估学习动力学物理一致性的基准上也表现更优。
Conclusion: 在宽松假设下，随机时滞微分方程的结构驱动与漂移可被理论保证地辨识，且该方法在驱动辨识与物理一致性两类基准上均胜过对照方法。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: An Efficient Machine Learning Approach for Degradation Forecasting in AEM Water Electrolysis
papers.abstract_en: This study provides a data-driven analysis of a novel dataset of single-cell Anion Exchange Membrane water electrolyzers (AEMWE), operated under constant current load across multiple heterogeneous experimental campaigns. We train and evaluate a range of machine learning models with different complexity, including linear baselines, LSTMs and CNNs, to perform medium-term forecasting of the cell voltage degradation curve. The models are assessed within a rigorous training and evaluation framework specifically designed for heterogeneous industrial data.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Does Local Video Understanding Transfer Across Encounters? The EgoGears Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Embodied systems must make knowledge acquired during one encounter usable in another despite changes in viewpoint, motion, and illumination. Yet aggregate cross-video accuracy conflates failures of local perception with failures to preserve observation identity, establish correspondence, and compose evidence, obscuring whether local video understanding actually transfers. We introduce EgoGears, a complementary single- and multi-video benchmark designed to diagnose this transition. It contains 567 single-video and 1,487 multi-video questions derived from 126 human-collected egocentric recordings covering 39 outdoor routes. Repeated traversals across movement speeds and lighting conditions ground comparisons in shared physical environments; 531 questions require alignment across independent recordings. Single-video questions measure the local visual, spatial, and motion evidence available to a model, while multi-video questions test whether evidence remains bound to the correct observation and can be composed into consistent route relationships. We report 29 single-video and 31 multi-video MLLM configurations across six model families in the main leaderboard. Among the 20 configurations evaluated comparably on both splits, every model performs worse on multi-video questions, with a mean decrease of 22.5 percentage points, and the gap persists when answer format and scoring are held fixed. The gap is not explained simply by additional videos or recording boundaries. The central bottlenecks are observation--evidence binding and ordered route-state tracking. The code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/lei-qi-233/EgoGears.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoGears 是一个单视频与多视频对照的具身视觉基准，用 126 段第一视角重复穿越录像诊断局部视频理解能否跨次遭遇迁移。在 20 个可比配置上，所有模型的多视频题都比单视频题更差，平均下降 22.5 个百分点，且瓶颈被定位为观测-证据绑定与有序路线状态跟踪，而非视频数量或录制边界。
Motivation: 跨视频总体准确率把局部感知失败与身份保持、对应建立、证据组合的失败混在一起，无法判断局部视频理解是否真的跨遭遇迁移。
Method: 构建 EgoGears：567 道单视频题与 1,487 道多视频题，源自 126 段人工采集第一视角录像、覆盖 39 条户外路线，重复穿越不同移动速度与光照条件，其中 531 题要求跨独立录像对齐；主榜报告六个模型家族的 29 个单视频与 31 个多视频 MLLM 配置。
Result: 在两个划分上可比评估的 20 个配置中，每个模型在多视频题上都更差，平均下降 22.5 个百分点；固定答案格式与评分后差距仍在，且差距不能简单归因于视频数量增加或录制边界。
Conclusion: 跨遭遇迁移的主要瓶颈是观测-证据绑定与有序路线状态跟踪，而不是局部视觉证据不足；代码与基准已公开。

papers.title: Look Closer: Patch-wise Supervision for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: How much of an image does a detector need to see? Small RGB regions can retain useful evidence of image synthesis even when they reveal little of the full scene. Motivated by single-patch detection, we study patch-wise supervision: a shared backbone classifies explicit crops, each crop receives its own loss, and patch probabilities are averaged only at inference. The procedure requires neither handcrafted residual filtering nor a learned image-level fusion module. Experiments span single-patch selection, multiple generator collections, and four CNN and Transformer backbones. On GenImage, the reported patch-wise variants improve average accuracy over their whole-image counterparts across all four backbones. Comparisons of supervision granularity, source resolution, crop size, and inference coverage further characterize the approach, while post-processing tests and difficult-image evaluation reveal its limitations. The historical experiments include evaluation-based model selection, so their scores are not presented as a uniformly selected leaderboard comparison. Overall, the study identifies explicit local input and patch-level supervision as a simple, useful combination for investigating generalizable AI-generated image detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI 生成图像检测中，用共享 backbone 对显式裁剪出的图像块逐一分类、每块各自计损失、推理时才平均块概率，可在不加手工残差滤波与图像级融合模块的前提下提升检测精度。在 GenImage 上，该 patch-wise 变体在全部四个 CNN 与 Transformer backbone 上的平均准确率均高于对应的整图训练版本。
Motivation: 单块检测 (single-patch detection) 表明小 RGB 区域已保留合成痕迹，但缺少系统化的块级监督方案，且整图训练可能浪费局部证据。
Method: 共享 backbone 对显式裁剪的图像块逐一分类，每个 crop 有独立损失，推理时平均块概率；无需手工残差滤波或学习式图像级融合模块。实验覆盖单块选择、多个生成器集合与四个 CNN/Transformer backbone，并考察监督粒度、源分辨率、裁剪尺寸与推理覆盖度。
Result: 在 GenImage 上，patch-wise 变体在全部四个 backbone 上的平均准确率均高于整图对应版本；另通过后处理测试与困难图像评估刻画方法边界。作者说明历史实验含基于评估的模型选择，其分数不作为统一选型的 leaderboard 对比。
Conclusion: 显式局部输入加 patch 级监督是研究可泛化 AI 生成图像检测的简单有效组合，但其表现受后处理与困难图像影响。

papers.title: Post-Anomaly Detection Inference for Deep SVDD
papers.abstract_en: Deep Support Vector Data Description (Deep SVDD) has become a prominent framework for unsupervised anomaly detection by learning latent representations that compactly characterize normal data around a center. Despite its empirical success, anomaly decisions produced by Deep SVDD are typically made solely based on anomaly scores without rigorous statistical guarantees, thereby limiting their reliability in safety-critical and high-stakes applications where false positives must be strictly controlled. In this paper, we propose PADI (Post-Anomaly Detection Inference), a novel framework that equips a trained and frozen Deep SVDD detector with statistically valid inference by leveraging the Selective Inference framework. Specifically, PADI performs inference conditional on the event that a test instance is identified as anomalous by Deep SVDD, thereby enabling rigorous statistical assessment of anomaly decisions. Based on this formulation, we derive valid selective p-values that quantify the statistical significance of the detected anomaly. Using these p-values, we theoretically establish control of the false positive rate (FPR) at a user-specified significance level $α$ (e.g., $α=0.05$). Furthermore, we extend the proposed framework to Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (Deep SAD), providing a principled approach for statistically reliable inference in semi-supervised anomaly detection settings. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets robustly support the theoretical findings. The results demonstrate that PADI consistently achieves proper FPR control while attaining superior true positive rates compared with existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PADI 用 selective inference 给已训练冻结的 Deep SVDD 检测器补上统计推断：条件于该样本被判为异常这一事件，构造 selective p-value，并在用户指定显著性水平 α（如 α=0.05）下理论保证假阳性率 (FPR) 受控。合成与真实基准实验显示 FPR 得到正确控制，同时真阳性率优于现有方法；框架还可扩展到 Deep SAD 半监督设定。
Motivation: Deep SVDD 只按异常分数下判定，缺少严格统计保证，在必须严格控制假阳性的安全关键场景中可靠性不足。
Method: 提出 PADI (Post-Anomaly Detection Inference)，基于 Selective Inference 框架，对训练好且冻结的 Deep SVDD 检测器条件于“该测试样本被判定为异常”的事件做推导，得到 selective p-value，并把该流程扩展到 Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (Deep SAD)。
Result: 理论上在用户指定显著性水平 α（如 α=0.05）下建立 FPR 受控；在合成与真实基准数据集上的大量实验支持理论结论，PADI 持续实现正确的 FPR 控制，同时相比现有方法取得更优的真阳性率 (TPR)。
Conclusion: 对冻结的 Deep SVDD 检测器做事后 selective inference，可以在不重训的前提下给出带显著性水平的异常判定，并同时保住 TPR；该原则同样适用于半监督的 Deep SAD。

papers.title: GRFBrain: Graph-Structured Rectified Flows for EEG Dynamic Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting time-varying functional connectivity from electroencephalography (EEG) requires modeling both history-dependent trends and structured variability across channels. Conditional flow matching provides a framework for distributional forecasting, yet it remains unclear whether graph-informed source distributions offer practical advantages over isotropic noise and strong deterministic predictors. We introduce a graph-structured residual flow framework that separates conditional mean prediction from stochastic residual transport. A history-only predictor estimates the future connectivity graph, while a graph Gaussian source encodes dependencies derived from past connectivity through a Laplacian-based covariance. A conditional velocity field transports source samples to future graph residuals, with transport time explicitly distinguished from physical EEG time. Our study identifies the conditions and controls needed to distinguish useful residual transport from improvements attributable to deterministic prediction, learned representations, and sampling effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRFBrain 把 EEG 功能连接图的预测拆成两路：历史条件预测器给出未来连接图的条件均值，图结构高斯源（Laplacian 协方差编码历史连接依赖）经条件速度场做随机残差传输，且传输时间与物理 EEG 时间显式分离。论文的核心主张是给出一套条件与对照，用来区分残差传输的真实收益与确定性预测、学到的表示、采样效应带来的提升。
Motivation: EEG 时变功能连接预报要同时刻画历史趋势与跨通道结构化变异；条件流匹配虽提供分布预报框架，但图信息源分布相对各向同性噪声和强确定性预测器是否真有实际优势仍不清楚。
Method: 图结构残差流 (graph-structured residual flow)：history-only 预测器估计未来连接图，图高斯源用基于 Laplacian 的协方差编码历史连接依赖，条件速度场把源样本输运到未来图残差；研究设计强调区分传输时间与物理 EEG 时间，并设置对照以剥离确定性预测、表示学习与采样效应。
Result: 摘要给出的是研究设计与主张：识别出区分有效残差传输与确定性预测、学到的表示、采样效应所致改善所需的条件和对照；未列出数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 评估图信息残差传输的增益必须配对照，把其与确定性预测和采样效应分开，否则无法归因。
