papers.title: Learning When to Update: A Near-Optimal Timing Bandit Approach
papers.abstract_en: Systems operating in dynamic environments require timely updates to sustain performance. For resource-intensive systems such as machine learning models and digital twins, strategically timing updates is essential. Updating too frequently wastes resources, while updating too infrequently leads to costly performance degradation. The problem is particularly challenging when the system's degradation pattern is unknown a priori, as is common in new operating environments. We formalize this challenge as a novel \emph{timing bandit} problem, where each arm represents a candidate update interval with a fixed update cost and an unknown, stochastic degradation cost. Three structural properties distinguish this setting from standard multi-armed bandits: selecting an interval commits the learner to multiple time slots before the next update; arm costs are composed of per-step degradation costs and a fixed update cost; and selecting a longer interval naturally reveals degradation at every intermediate step, providing consecutive feedback relevant to shorter intervals. By exploiting these structures, we develop Balanced Consecutive Arm Elimination (BCAE). BCAE achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret, improving upon the $\tildeΩ(K\sqrt{T})$ regret of standard bandit algorithms in this setting, where $K$ is the number of candidate update intervals. We further propose an Optimism-Enhanced variant (OE-BCAE) that integrates lower-confidence-bound principles to improve empirical adaptivity while preserving the same regret order. Moreover, the regret bound achieved by our algorithms matches the theoretical lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Simulation results demonstrate that our algorithms achieve low regret and remain stable as both the number of arms and the update cost vary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「何时更新模型/数字孪生」形式化为 timing bandit：每条臂是一个候选更新间隔，代价由每步性能退化加固定更新成本构成，选长间隔会在中间各步连续暴露退化信息。据此提出 Balanced Consecutive Arm Elimination (BCAE)，得 Õ(√T) regret，优于该设定下标准 bandit 算法的 Õ(K√T)；OE-BCAE 用 LCB 原则增强经验自适应性并保持同阶 regret，且与理论下界只差对数因子。仿真中算法在臂数与更新成本变化时保持低 regret 与稳定。
Motivation: ML 模型与数字孪生等资源密集系统在新运行环境中退化模式先验未知，更新太频繁浪费资源、太稀疏则性能退化代价高，而标准多臂 bandit 无法刻画间隔承诺与连续反馈这两个结构。
Method: 定义 timing bandit：臂为候选更新间隔，代价为逐步退化成本加固定更新成本，选择间隔后承诺多个时间槽，且长间隔选择会逐步揭示对短间隔有用的连续退化反馈。提出 BCAE（平衡的连续臂消除），以及集成 lower-confidence-bound 原则的 Optimism-Enhanced 变体 OE-BCAE。
Result: BCAE 达到 Õ(√T) regret，改进该设定下标准 bandit 算法的 Õ(K√T)（K 为候选更新间隔数）；OE-BCAE 保持同阶 regret。算法 regret 上界与理论下界只差对数因子。仿真显示两算法 regret 低，且在臂数与更新成本变化时保持稳定。
Conclusion: 利用间隔承诺与连续退化反馈这两个结构，可以把更新时机问题的 regret 从 K√T 量级降到 √T 量级并匹配下界；OE-BCAE 在不改变阶数的前提下提升经验自适应性。

papers.title: Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Persistent textual memory allows language models to carry information across long interactions, but learning what to remember is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. A memory rewrite may only become useful many steps later, while much of the observed utility may be inherited from information already stored before the rewrite. We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which isolates the incremental value of each memory rewrite by crediting it for its marginal contribution to current and future downstream utility. This turns delayed memory utility into a direct learning signal for optimizing what information should persist. We study MGPO on document-level information extraction, where structured supervision makes the effects of individual memory updates directly measurable. MGPO improves extraction while reducing average memory length by nearly 80% relative to the initial memory policy before optimization. The learned memory policy also supports reuse and transfer across domains, downstream models without further training. These results show that effective memory learning depends not only on preserving useful information, but on identifying which memory updates create lasting incremental value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对语言模型持久记忆改写的信用分配问题，提出 Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO)，把每次记忆改写对未来下游效用的边际贡献单独归因，作为优化「该记什么」的直接学习信号。在文档级信息抽取任务上，MGPO 在把平均记忆长度相对初始记忆策略压缩近 80% 的同时提升抽取效果，学到的策略还能跨域复用并直接支撑未经再训练的下游模型。
Motivation: 记忆改写的收益往往要很多步之后才显现，且常与改写前已存信息带来的效用混在一起，导致「该记什么」难以用强化学习信用分配来学。
Method: MGPO 为每次记忆改写单独计算其对当前及未来下游效用的边际贡献并据此归因，把延迟的记忆效用转成直接的学习信号；实验设定为文档级信息抽取，用结构化监督使单次记忆更新的效果可直接度量。
Result: 在文档级信息抽取上，MGPO 提升抽取表现，同时把平均记忆长度相对优化前的初始记忆策略减少近 80%；学到的记忆策略可跨域复用，并支撑无需进一步训练的下游模型。
Conclusion: 有效记忆学习的关键不只是保留有用信息，而是识别哪些记忆更新能产生持久的增量价值；MGPO 用边际贡献归因即可同时缩短记忆并保持下游可用性。

papers.title: Rollout-Marginal Distillation for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables low-latency, streamable video generation, but prediction errors often accumulate over long rollouts. Training the generator on its own rollouts exposes it to these imperfect histories. However, existing video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) scores the whole rollout jointly. Because a chunk is evaluated together with its past and future, its correction can favor matching artifacts in the surrounding context merely to preserve temporal consistency. To provide a clearer visual-quality signal, we introduce Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD). RMD retains the generated history for AR prediction but scores each chunk independently against a chunk teacher, ensuring its quality correction is not compromised by an imperfect temporal context. To compensate for the lack of temporal context in independent chunk scoring, RMD subsequently applies video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RMD maintains high visual quality far beyond its training horizon and outperforms video-level DMD baselines. Code and video results are available at https://cjeen.github.io/RMD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自回归视频扩散在长 rollout 中误差累积，而视频级分布匹配蒸馏 (DMD) 把整段 rollout 一起打分，导致单个 chunk 的修正会为了时间一致而迎合周边上下文里的伪影。Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD) 保留生成历史做自回归预测，但每个 chunk 独立对着 chunk teacher 打分，再补一次视频级 DMD 恢复时间连贯；实验显示它在远超训练时域的 rollout 上仍保持高视觉质量并超过视频级 DMD 基线。
Motivation: 自回归视频生成在长 rollout 上误差累积，而现有视频级 DMD 联合打分整段，使 chunk 的质量修正被不完美的时间上下文牵制，视觉质量信号不干净。
Method: RMD 分两步：保留生成历史供自回归预测，但每个 chunk 独立对一个 chunk teacher 做分布匹配打分，隔离上下文伪影；随后再施加视频级 DMD 以补回时间连贯性。
Result: 实验显示 RMD 在远超其训练时域的 rollout 上仍保持高视觉质量，并在对比中胜过视频级 DMD 基线；摘要给出代码与视频结果页面。
Conclusion: 把质量修正与时间连贯拆成独立打分加视频级补偿两步，可以在长时域自回归视频生成中同时守住视觉质量与连贯性。

papers.title: Time-Anchored Diffusion Language Models: Latent-Space Caching for Fast Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on anchored diffusion language models improves denoising by shaping an intermediate latent space with supervised important-token targets. In this work, we introduce time-based (self-supervised) anchoring, which learns and reuses latent anchors without requiring such targets. Our key observation is that anchors encode persistent properties of the clean sequence, such as its semantic intent, global structure, or intermediate plan. Although their hidden representations become stale as the token canvas evolves, their semantic content remains useful across nearby diffusion times. This is implemented through a two-stage architecture consisting of a relatively expensive anchor network that generates the latent cache state and a lightweight denoising network that intelligently combines the cached latent state with the current state at each reverse step using a fusion module. This gives anchoring a latent-space caching interpretation: the anchor network is evaluated periodically, while its cached representation is reused across multiple reverse steps. We instantiate this framework as TADM:Post-train, which time-anchorizes pretrained DLMs, and TADM:Pretraining, which learns time-based anchors during pretraining. Applied to DiffusionGemma-26B, TADM:Post-train improves throughput by approximately 49% to 79% on several math, code, and STEM benchmarks (GSM8K, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench-v6, HumanEval, MMLU-Pro). TADM:Pretraining reduces Transformer-layer computation by up to 38% relative to a standard single-stage DLM, achieves up to 73% higher measured throughput than ADLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TADM 把 anchored diffusion language model 的监督重要 token 目标换成自监督的 time-based anchoring：昂贵的 anchor 网络周期性生成 latent cache，轻量去噪网络在每个 reverse step 用 fusion module 融合缓存与当前状态。在 DiffusionGemma-26B 上，TADM:Post-train 在 GSM8K、AIME26、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6、HumanEval、MMLU-Pro 等基准上吞吐提升约 49%–79%，TADM:Pretraining 最多减少 38% 的 Transformer 层计算、比 ADLM 吞吐最高高 73%。
Motivation: anchored DLM 依赖监督的重要 token 目标来塑造中间 latent 空间，这类目标难以获得；同时每步都跑完整 anchor 计算代价高。
Method: 两阶段架构：较贵的 anchor 网络生成 latent cache state，轻量去噪网络在每个 reverse step 用 fusion module 把缓存 latent 与当前状态结合；anchor 网络周期性求值、其表示跨多个 reverse step 复用，即 latent-space caching。实例化为 TADM:Post-train（对预训练 DLM 后训练）与 TADM:Pretraining（预训练中学 time-based anchors），应用于 DiffusionGemma-26B。
Result: TADM:Post-train 在 GSM8K、AIME26、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6、HumanEval、MMLU-Pro 等数学、代码与 STEM 基准上吞吐提升约 49% 到 79%；TADM:Pretraining 相对标准单阶段 DLM 最多减少 38% 的 Transformer 层计算，实测吞吐比 ADLM 最高高 73%。
Conclusion: 锚点编码的是 clean 序列的持久语义属性，其 hidden representation 虽随 token canvas 变化而过期，语义内容在邻近 diffusion time 间仍可用，因此可周期性重算 anchor、复用缓存来加速生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EpiCon: Collective Agent Learning through Co-Evolving Multimodal Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agents can learn from past executions, but enabling different agents to reuse and build on one another's experience remains challenging. We introduce EpiCon, a shared multimodal memory framework for agent collective learning without updating host model parameters. EpiCon links question-level memory evolution to a persistent experience bank through two independently trained 2B models: a memory controller and a tree self-organizer. The controller jointly refines textual guidance and visual evidence across attempts and selectively includes visual memory. The self-organizer consolidates lessons hierarchically and retrieves experience and rules for new problems. We evaluate EpiCon on eleven benchmarks spanning four multimodal task domains, using two harnesses and multiple backbones. A frozen bank improves other systems even with a single solving attempt. A second harness raises the original system's macro-average score by 2.6 points across eleven benchmarks. Across four host configurations, EpiCon improves macro-average scores by 1.7 to 4.9 points over No Memory and reduces memory-operation time by 67\% to 74\% relative to backbone-sized memory models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EpiCon 用两个独立训练的 2B 模型（memory controller 与 tree self-organizer）把多模态任务经验沉淀为共享经验库，让不同 agent 在不更新宿主模型参数的前提下复用彼此经验。在十一个跨四领域的多模态基准上，冻结经验库单次尝试即可提升其他系统，第二个 harness 把原系统宏平均分提高 2.6 分，四种宿主配置下较 No Memory 提升 1.7–4.9 分，记忆操作耗时比 backbone 级记忆模型减少 67%–74%。
Motivation: agent 能从自身历史执行中学习，但不同 agent 之间难以复用和叠加彼此经验；已有记忆方案往往要改宿主模型参数或按 backbone 规模付出高昂记忆操作开销。
Method: 提出共享多模态记忆框架 EpiCon：一个 2B memory controller 在多次尝试间联合精炼文本指引与视觉证据并选择性纳入视觉记忆，另一个 2B tree self-organizer 层级化整理 lessons 并为新问题检索经验与规则；两者独立训练，宿主模型参数保持冻结，经验存入持久 experience bank。
Result: 在十一个基准、四个多模态任务域、两种 harness 与多个 backbone 上评测：冻结经验库即使只有一次解题尝试也能提升其他系统；第二个 harness 使原系统在十一个基准上的宏平均分提高 2.6 分；四种宿主配置下 EpiCon 较 No Memory 宏平均分提升 1.7 至 4.9 分，记忆操作耗时相对 backbone 规模的记忆模型减少 67% 至 74%。
Conclusion: 把问题级记忆演化与持久经验库解耦、用专职小模型管理记忆，可以在不微调宿主的前提下让集体经验跨系统迁移，同时显著压低记忆操作的时间开销。

summary_sections.motivation: agent 能从自身历史执行中学习，但不同 agent 之间难以复用和叠加彼此经验；已有记忆方案往往要改宿主模型参数或按 backbone 规模付出高昂记忆操作开销。
summary_sections.method: 提出共享多模态记忆框架 EpiCon：一个 2B memory controller 在多次尝试间联合精炼文本指引与视觉证据并选择性纳入视觉记忆，另一个 2B tree self-organizer 层级化整理 lessons 并为新问题检索经验与规则；两者独立训练，宿主模型参数保持冻结，经验存入持久 experience bank。
summary_sections.result: 在十一个基准、四个多模态任务域、两种 harness 与多个 backbone 上评测：冻结经验库即使只有一次解题尝试也能提升其他系统；第二个 harness 使原系统在十一个基准上的宏平均分提高 2.6 分；四种宿主配置下 EpiCon 较 No Memory 宏平均分提升 1.7 至 4.9 分，记忆操作耗时相对 backbone 规模的记忆模型减少 67% 至 74%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把问题级记忆演化与持久经验库解耦、用专职小模型管理记忆，可以在不微调宿主的前提下让集体经验跨系统迁移，同时显著压低记忆操作的时间开销。

papers.title: Pattern Formation in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: What are the inductive biases of a Transformer architecture? Existing theory on how the forward pass shapes representations either considers whether Transformers escape from rank collapse or demonstrates that self-attention drives tokens toward cluster patterns. The latter view arises from an elegant dynamical systems perspective, but relies on simplified architectural assumptions, and does not explain the rich structures observed in practice. This leaves a major open question: when a full Transformer escapes rank collapse, how does it structure token representations? Using pattern-formation theory, we show that the dynamical view of Transformers can account for Positional Encoding, Multi-Head Attention, and Output-Value geometry. We demonstrate that a full Transformer architecture imposes an inductive prior by selectively amplifying a rich set of previously unreported patterns, including traveling or rotating waves among others. We characterize the role of each architectural component in controlling which pattern is amplified, which ones stabilize, compete, or coexist. Finally, we show that these structures can act as a controllable dynamical prior that facilitates learning. By choosing both task-aligned positional encoding and weight initialization, we demonstrate improved data efficiency and accelerated optimization on controlled sequence tasks and with ConViT on CIFAR-10.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用模式形成理论 (pattern-formation theory) 分析完整 Transformer 的动力学，证明其在逃离 rank collapse 后会通过选择性放大此前未报告的模式（行波、旋转波等）形成归纳先验，且每个架构组件决定哪种模式被放大、稳定、竞争或共存。通过同时选择任务对齐的位置编码与权重初始化，可在受控序列任务和 CIFAR-10 上的 ConViT 中提升数据效率并加速优化。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 前向传播理论要么只讨论是否逃离 rank collapse，要么在简化架构假设下用动力系统视角解释自注意力把 token 推向聚类，无法说明实践中观察到的丰富结构。
Method: 以模式形成理论刻画完整 Transformer 的动力学，纳入 Positional Encoding、Multi-Head Attention 与 Output-Value 几何；逐个组件分析其对模式放大、稳定、竞争与共存的控制，并把结构用作可控动力学先验，通过选择任务对齐的位置编码与权重初始化来影响学习。
Result: 完整架构选择性放大一组此前未报告的模式，包括行波与旋转波；在受控序列任务以及 CIFAR-10 上的 ConViT 中，配合任务对齐的位置编码与权重初始化，获得更好的数据效率和更快的优化。
Conclusion: Transformer 的归纳偏置可由被选择性放大的模式形成来解释，且这些结构是可控的动力学先验，架构组件与初始化、位置编码的搭配直接决定学习效率。

papers.title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning across videos requires aligning events, matching identities, comparing motion, and integrating partial observations. Evaluating these capabilities and testing how to improve them requires both reliable labels and targeted supervision. We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that connects these two needs through shared task generators. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from environment state and provides 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 training questions over disjoint videos, spanning eight cross-video reasoning tasks. Visual ablations and human evaluation assess dependence on the supplied evidence and answer recoverability. Evaluation of 22 multimodal large language models reveals persistent difficulties in physical comparison and scene integration that increasing model size does not consistently resolve. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3-VL-8B's average SYNCR accuracy from 32.6% to 61.6%, with gains extending to task configurations and video sources absent from training for those tasks. Transfer to real footage is most consistent for temporal ordering: accuracy improves by 9.0-20.5 percentage points on constructed Assembly101 and Panoptic ordering sets across three checkpoints spanning two model families and two model sizes, with additional gains on existing temporal reasoning benchmarks. These results establish SYNCR as a controlled setting for diagnosing cross-video reasoning failures, testing their learnability, and identifying where synthetic supervision transfers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SYNCR 是基于 Habitat、Kubric、CLEVRER 的仿真驱动跨视频推理诊断与训练框架，用共享任务生成器从环境状态直接产出答案，覆盖 8 类跨视频推理任务、4,000 道评测题与 15,960 道训练题。对 22 个多模态大模型的评测显示物理比较与场景整合持续困难且加大模型规模并不稳定解决；监督微调把 Qwen3-VL-8B 平均准确率从 32.6% 提到 61.6%，迁移到真实素材时时间排序最稳，Assembly101 与 Panoptic 构造集上提升 9.0–20.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 跨视频推理需要对齐事件、匹配身份、比较运动并整合部分观测，但缺少可靠标签与针对性监督，难以区分模型是能力不足还是评测证据不足。
Method: 在 Habitat、Kubric、CLEVRER 上构建共享任务生成器，答案直接由环境状态导出，产出 4,000 道评测题与 15,960 道训练题（视频互不重叠），覆盖 8 类跨视频推理任务；用视觉消融与人工评测检验模型对给定证据的依赖和答案可恢复性，并对 22 个多模态大模型做评测与监督微调。
Result: 22 个多模态大模型在物理比较与场景整合上持续失败，模型规模增大并不稳定改善；监督微调使 Qwen3-VL-8B 平均 SYNCR 准确率从 32.6% 升至 61.6%，且增益扩展到训练中未出现的任务配置与视频来源；迁移到真实素材时时间排序最一致，在构造的 Assembly101 与 Panoptic 排序集上跨两个模型家族、两个规模的三个 checkpoint 提升 9.0–20.5 个百分点，既有时间推理基准上也有额外增益。
Conclusion: SYNCR 可作为受控环境诊断跨视频推理失败、检验其可学习性并定位合成监督在何处能迁移的平台；合成监督对时间排序类能力向真实素材迁移最有效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Search Dimension in Unlabeled Projection Pursuit: A Scaling Law for Subspace Restriction
papers.abstract_en: Projection pursuit searches for a direction along which the data look least Gaussian. When the observation space contains a large Gaussian complement, the empirical objective can be minimized by a direction that carries no signal, with empirical kurtosis as low as at the truth. Sample splitting exposes rather than repairs this failure. Appending coordinates independent of the latent regime degrades the search while leaving Bayes recoverability unchanged. Restricting the search to the column space of a known forward operator removes the failure exactly on the negative-kurtosis branch. Estimating a principal subspace from the data is the alternative. In a controlled two-component model, the leading sufficient scalings differ in the gain with which the operator transmits the discriminant: $ς^{-4}$ for covariance-spike estimation and $ς^{-8}$ for fourth-moment search. At fixed search dimension, the measured threshold ratio collapses onto $n/p^2$ with exponent $0.156$, close to the predicted $1/8$. This is an empirically supported scaling motivated by sufficient bounds, not a proved asymptotically tight law. When the search dimension is varied, the measured exponent is $0.325$, substantially larger than $1/8$, and the tested range does not identify its functional form. The crossing location also depends on calibration and model configuration. Under a downstream excess-error criterion, the scaling largely disappears.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 投影 pursuit 在观测空间含大高斯补空间时会被无信号方向骗过：经验峰度可低到与真方向相同，样本分割只能暴露而非修复该失败。把搜索限制到已知前向算子的列空间可在负峰度分支上精确消除失败；受控双成分模型中协方差尖峰估计的充分增益标度为 ς^{-4}、四阶矩搜索为 ς^{-8}，固定搜索维数下实测阈值比按 n/p^2 塌缩、指数 0.156（接近预测的 1/8）。
Motivation: 观测空间加入与隐变量独立的坐标会劣化投影搜索，而 Bayes 可恢复性不变，即经验目标的失败与信息本身无关；需要判定搜索维数与算子增益如何标度才能避开这一退化。
Method: 在受控两成分模型中比较三种搜索设置：全空间经验峰度搜索、限制到已知前向算子列空间、以及从数据估计主子空间；用样本分割诊断失败，并以充分界 (sufficient bounds) 推导增益 ς 下的标度，再实测阈值比与指数。
Result: 协方差尖峰估计的充分标度为 ς^{-4}，四阶矩搜索为 ς^{-8}；固定搜索维数时实测阈值比塌缩到 n/p^2、指数 0.156，接近预测的 1/8；改变搜索维数时实测指数为 0.325，明显大于 1/8，且测试范围无法确定其函数形式，交叉位置还依赖校准与模型配置；在下游超额误差准则下该标度基本消失。
Conclusion: 作者明确把结果定位为受充分界启发、有实证支持的标度而非已证明的渐近紧律：n/p^2 塌缩只在固定搜索维数与特定准则下成立，换准则或变维数后标度即失效。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RLX: A Unified Multi-Backend Tensor Compiler and Distributed Runtime in Rust
papers.abstract_en: Production machine learning (ML) stacks often split graph compilation and kernel execution across different layers and languages, making backend behavior, deployment guarantees, and performance fallbacks hard to reason about end-to-end. RLX addresses this gap with a single Rust codebase that combines compiler and runtime roles around one primitive-level, three-level intermediate representation (IR), plus a transparent dispatch contract that resolves each operator to native, common-IR, or rewritten lowering and fails compilation when legalization is not possible. The same IR targets fourteen runtime devices (cpu, metal, mlx, ane, cuda, rocm, oneapi, tpu, hexagon, gpu, vulkan, opengl, directx, webgpu) and two specialty codegen paths (Cortex-M INT8 and FPGA), ingests safetensors, GGUF, ONNX, and rten formats, supports F16/BF16/F64/C64 and quantized INT4/INT8 flows with AMP/PTQ/QAT, and scales via tensor-/pipeline-parallel collectives over TCP and RDMA transports. Beyond neural workloads, RLX also extends to scientific/physics-style domains through sparse and dense linear algebra extensions (e.g., CSR LU/CG/matvec and LAPACK- backed factorizations) and 3D Gaussian splatting operators. We evaluate RLX against PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, candle, burn, tch, rten, MLX, CoreML, IREE, Glow, TensorRT, and tinygrad under identical input generation and p50 measurement methodology on one host. On all-MiniLM-L6-v2, RLX-Metal is fastest at every batch (e.g., 16.6 ms at batch 32 vs. PyTorch-MPS 26.7 ms). In the MNIST training table, RLX also has the top-throughput entry (graph-fused MLP: 946,487 img/s), above NumPy+BLAS (787,349 img/s), while retaining 100% top-1 parity on reference checks (e.g., Qwen3).
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, peer-reviewed and presented at 2026 IEEE High Performance Extreme Computing Conference (HPEC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLX 用单一 Rust 代码库把图编译与内核执行合到一个 primitive 级三层 IR 上，配透明 dispatch 契约：每个算子解析到 native、common-IR 或 rewritten lowering，无法 legalization 就直接编译失败。同一 IR 覆盖 14 种运行时设备与 Cortex-M INT8、FPGA 两条专用 codegen 路径。在单机 p50 同输入对比中，RLX-Metal 在 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 各 batch 均最快（batch 32 为 16.6 ms，PyTorch-MPS 26.7 ms），MNIST 训练吞吐 946,487 img/s 居首。
Motivation: 生产 ML 栈把图编译与内核执行拆在不同层和语言里，后端行为、部署保证与性能回退难以端到端推理。
Method: 单一 Rust 代码库统一编译器与运行时角色，围绕一个 primitive 级三层 IR 与透明 dispatch 契约；同一 IR 面向 14 种 runtime device 与两条 specialty codegen，支持 safetensors/GGUF/ONNX/rten 摄入、F16/BF16/F64/C64 与 INT4/INT8 量化（AMP/PTQ/QAT），并经 TCP 与 RDMA 做 tensor-/pipeline-parallel collectives；另加 CSR LU/CG/matvec、LAPACK 分解与 3D Gaussian splatting 算子扩展到科学计算域。
Result: 在相同输入生成与单主机 p50 方法下对比 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX、candle、burn、tch、rten、MLX、CoreML、IREE、Glow、TensorRT、tinygrad：all-MiniLM-L6-v2 上 RLX-Metal 每个 batch 都最快，batch 32 为 16.6 ms（PyTorch-MPS 26.7 ms）；MNIST 训练表 RLX 图融合 MLP 吞吐 946,487 img/s，高于 NumPy+BLAS 的 787,349 img/s；参考校验（如 Qwen3）保持 100% top-1 parity。
Conclusion: 把编译与运行时收敛到单一 IR 加显式 dispatch 契约，可在保持参考校验 100% top-1 一致的同时，在 Metal 与 MNIST 训练上取得所测基线中最快的延迟与最高吞吐。

summary_sections.method: 单一 Rust 代码库统一编译器与运行时角色，围绕一个 primitive 级三层 IR 与透明 dispatch 契约；同一 IR 面向 14 种 runtime device 与两条 specialty codegen，支持 safetensors/GGUF/ONNX/rten 摄入、F16/BF16/F64/C64 与 INT4/INT8 量化（AMP/PTQ/QAT），并经 TCP 与 RDMA 做 tensor-/pipeline-parallel collectives；另加 CSR LU/CG/matvec、LAPACK 分解与 3D Gaussian splatting 算子扩展到科学计算域。
summary_sections.result: 在相同输入生成与单主机 p50 方法下对比 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX、candle、burn、tch、rten、MLX、CoreML、IREE、Glow、TensorRT、tinygrad：all-MiniLM-L6-v2 上 RLX-Metal 每个 batch 都最快，batch 32 为 16.6 ms（PyTorch-MPS 26.7 ms）；MNIST 训练表 RLX 图融合 MLP 吞吐 946,487 img/s，高于 NumPy+BLAS 的 787,349 img/s；参考校验（如 Qwen3）保持 100% top-1 parity。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把编译与运行时收敛到单一 IR 加显式 dispatch 契约，可在保持参考校验 100% top-1 一致的同时，在 Metal 与 MNIST 训练上取得所测基线中最快的延迟与最高吞吐。

papers.title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student to match a privileged teacher distribution along its own sampled trajectory. Standard OPSD applies this supervision to unverified student rollouts while conditioning the teacher on privileged context, typically a reference solution. We separate these roles in a factorial analysis and find that scaffold correctness has a stronger effect on downstream accuracy than context correctness. Unverified scaffolds create an imitation gap because the teacher can use information unavailable to the student. This gap shrinks with model scale, yet OPSD continues to supervise mostly unverified trajectories. In contrast, verified scaffolds remain effective even when the teacher is conditioned on the student's own unsuccessful rollout. Based on this finding, we introduce OASIS, which retains the OPSD objective but supervises mostly verified by label on-policy trajectories and replaces written solutions with unverified model-generated attempts as the teacher context. OASIS therefore requires only final-answer labels. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025, OASIS improves over the base model by 3.2--3.8 points on average, while OPSD's gain falls from 3.05 points at 1.7B to 0.14 at 8B. At 8B, OASIS improves over OPSD by 3.05 points, showing that verified on-policy scaffolds preserve the effectiveness of self-distillation as models scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 中，脚手架 (scaffold) 是否经验证比教师上下文是否正确更能决定下游准确率；未验证脚手架让教师用到学生拿不到的信息，形成 imitation gap。据此提出 OASIS：只在按标签验证过的 on-policy 轨迹上蒸馏，并把教师上下文从书面参考解换成学生自己未验证的尝试，因此只需最终答案标签。在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 上，OASIS 相对基座平均提升 3.2–3.8 点，而 OPSD 的增益从 1.7B 的 3.05 点掉到 8B 的 0.14 点。
Motivation: 标准 OPSD 把特权教师监督加在未验证的学生 rollout 上，随模型变大增益迅速衰减，自蒸馏在规模化后失效。
Method: 先做因子分析，把 scaffold 正确性与 context 正确性分开；再提出 OASIS，保留 OPSD 目标，但只在按标签验证的 on-policy 轨迹上施加监督，教师上下文改用学生自己未验证的模型生成尝试，只需最终答案标签。
Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 上，AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025 上 OASIS 相对基座平均提升 3.2–3.8 点；OPSD 增益从 1.7B 的 3.05 点降至 8B 的 0.14 点；8B 上 OASIS 比 OPSD 高 3.05 点。因子分析显示 scaffold 正确性对下游准确率的影响强于 context 正确性，imitation gap 随模型规模缩小。
Conclusion: 验证过的 on-policy scaffold 能让自蒸馏随规模扩大继续有效，且监督只需最终答案标签，无需书面参考解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or 'evil' persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether different models are equally affected by the same fine-tuning examples. In this work, we use training data attribution to quantitatively estimate how much each harmful example contributes to EM. We benchmark the quality of the attribution via retraining -- a sound attribution score should enable us to enhance or attenuate EM by filtering data on that score. Score-based filtering can substantially enhance or attenuate EM; we find that both data-attribution scores and a black-box harmfulness score can identify consequential examples. All models we test become misaligned when trained on the same dataset, and influence scores perform best when filtering data from the same model that computed them. We find cross-model generalization of influence scores from scores derived from the three model families we tested, but this generalization does not recover same model filtering performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用训练数据归因 (training data attribution) 逐例量化有害样本对涌现失准 (emergent misalignment, EM) 的贡献，并以归因分数过滤微调数据来增强或削弱 EM。按分数过滤可显著改变 EM；归因分数与黑盒有害性分数都能挑出关键样本，且同模型算出的 influence score 过滤效果最好。
Motivation: 窄域有害任务微调会破坏后训练对齐并诱发新的失准行为，但尚不清楚是所有有害样本等量贡献，还是少数关键样本起作用，以及同一微调样本对不同模型的影响是否一致。
Method: 用 training data attribution 估计每个有害样本对 EM 的贡献量；以重训练 (retraining) 为基准检验归因质量——合格的归因分数应能通过按分数过滤数据来增强或削弱 EM；同时对比黑盒有害性分数，并在三个模型族上测试 influence score 的跨模型迁移。
Result: 按分数过滤可显著增强或削弱 EM；数据归因分数与黑盒有害性分数都能识别出有实质影响的样本；所有受测模型在同一数据集上训练后都会失准；influence score 过滤同源模型数据时表现最佳，从三个模型族导出的分数存在跨模型泛化，但泛化后达不到同模型过滤的性能。
Conclusion: EM 并非由有害样本均匀贡献，归因分数可用来定向调节失准程度；归因分数具有跨模型迁移性但存在同模型优势，因此过滤数据应使用目标模型自身算出的 influence score。

papers.title: Generated Query Expansion Still Helps Strong Sparse Retrieval: A Controlled Study with SPLADE-v3
papers.abstract_en: Scientific queries are often brief, while relevant papers use specialized vocabulary. Generated query expansion can bridge this mismatch, but earlier work suggests that its value shrinks as the underlying retriever becomes stronger. We test the four generated formats of term lists, a pseudo-document, multiple pseudo-references, and corpus-steered text all together with SPLADE-v3 on NFCorpus, TREC-COVID, and SciDocs. Every condition searches the same frozen document index and follows the same query-side integration rule and 256-dimension budget, isolating the effect of the added content. All twelve method-collection comparisons improve aggregate nDCG@10, with best relative gains of 4.81%, 8.92%, and 9.47%. Eleven remain significant after Holm correction. The gain persists in 103 of 114 interpolation settings, including every setting that assigns at least 30% of the mixture weight to the original query. Shuffled-text and non-contextual lexical-bag controls also remain above baseline in all 24 aggregate comparisons, showing that the added vocabulary carries most of the benefit. A corpus-induced typed concept graph, by contrast, produces no consistent gain, and its relation, depth, validation, random, and gating controls do not rescue it. Generated vocabulary can therefore complement a strong learned sparse retriever, provided that the original query remains strongly represented.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在强稀疏检索器 SPLADE-v3 上，生成式查询扩展 (generated query expansion) 仍然有效：四种生成格式在 NFCorpus、TREC-COVID、SciDocs 上全部提升 nDCG@10，最佳相对增益 4.81%、8.92%、9.47%，且收益主要来自新增词汇而非语义结构。前提是原查询在混合权重中至少占 30%。
Motivation: 科学查询往往很短而论文用专门术语，生成式查询扩展本可弥合词汇错配，但既有工作认为检索器越强扩展收益越小，需要在强检索器上受控验证其残余价值。
Method: 将四种生成格式（term list、pseudo-document、multiple pseudo-references、corpus-steered text）统一接到 SPLADE-v3，全部条件共用同一冻结文档索引、同一查询侧融合规则与 256 维预算，以隔离新增内容本身的作用；另设 shuffled-text 与 non-contextual lexical-bag 对照，以及语料诱导的 typed concept graph 及其 relation、depth、validation、random、gating 对照。
Result: 12 组方法-集合对比全部提升聚合 nDCG@10，最佳相对增益分别为 4.81%、8.92%、9.47%；其中 11 组经 Holm 校正后仍显著。增益在 114 个插值设置中的 103 个成立，包括所有原查询混合权重不低于 30% 的设置。shuffled-text 与 lexical-bag 对照在全部 24 个聚合对比中仍高于基线；typed concept graph 无一致增益，其各类对照也未能挽救。
Conclusion: 生成词汇可以补足强学习型稀疏检索器，收益主要由新增词汇承载而非结构化语义图，条件是原查询在混合中保持强占比。

papers.title: Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied agents.Abundant online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training. Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames. Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on $\sim$1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures. We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM's outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as $F_1^{macro}$. Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics. The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics. Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Multimodal Digital Agents (ECCV 2026): https://mda-workshop.allen.ai/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数据受限条件下研究游戏逆动力学模型 (IDM)：从视频帧反推玩家按键，系统比较空间运动特征、模型架构与训练目标，并改用 per-key 与 F1^macro 这类均衡指标评估。Trackmania 上架构选择与预处理中的 motion flow 提取是关键因素，且暴露了不平衡指标掩盖失败的问题；同一架构与训练配方迁移到 Cyberpunk 2077 后各游戏机制表现不均。
Motivation: 海量游戏视频缺少玩家输入，IDM 是获取示范的关键路径，但现有大模型（最高 1B 参数、约 1K–2K 小时数据）只报聚合准确率，会掩盖罕见动作失败，且未厘清恢复单个动作的核心要素。
Method: 在数据受限设定下，控制变量地改变空间运动特征、模型架构与训练目标训练 IDM，并在 Trackmania 上实验，再把同一架构与训练配方直接应用到 Cyberpunk 2077；评估改用 per-key 指标与 F1^macro，并做逐动作失败分析。
Result: Trackmania 实验显示模型架构与预处理中的 motion flow 提取对结果重要，同时表明不平衡指标会掩盖评估缺陷；同一架构与配方在 Cyberpunk 2077 上跨游戏机制表现不均。失败分析定位出三类歧义来源：相机运动、动作延迟效应、按键频率不平衡。
Conclusion: 未来 IDM 需显式建模 3D 场景结构与长期状态，并采用更合适的损失；仅靠聚合准确率与不平衡指标不足以判断模型是否真正恢复了单个动作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Interaction Capacity: Estimator Scaling with Recursive Models for CTR Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Click-Through Rate prediction, a core task in recommendation and advertising systems, relies on modeling interactions among sparse categorical features. Explicit cross networks are a central paradigm for CTR prediction, and recent progress has largely come from increasing the interaction capacity of a single predictor through deeper cross networks and more expressive cross operators. We revisit whether continually increasing interaction capacity remains the most effective way to improve predictive performance, and find that its benefits quickly exhibit diminishing returns even as capacity continues to grow. This motivates a complementary scaling direction that we call estimator scaling, where additional resources are used to incorporate multiple related estimators rather than only enlarging a single predictor. Through theoretical analysis, we show that the gains from estimator scaling are governed by the amount of non-shared predictive variation available across estimators. However, exploiting this variation naively can be expensive: independently trained models provide substantial estimator diversity but require deployment cost to grow with ensemble size. This motivates a parameter-efficient realization of estimator scaling that can incorporate diversity from multiple estimator sources without maintaining multiple full models. Building on this view, we introduce RECursive Averaged Predictor (RECAP), a parameter-efficient recursive CTR model that operationalizes estimator scaling at three levels: distillation across independently trained models, exponential moving averaging over training trajectories, and aggregation over inference-time routes within a weight-shared recursive backbone. Experiments across multiple benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art predictive performance on standard benchmarks, while placing the RECAP on a favorable performance-parameter Pareto frontier.

papers.title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. We formulate same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem. A simple measured-map policy routes to the cheapest provider that is both quality-equivalent and healthy, yielding matched-quality savings while avoiding degraded endpoints. Because the map drifts, we introduce FACET, an online provider router that certifies per-(provider x task) feasibility facets and fails safe to an anchor before serving uncertified arms. Across relaxed deployment assumptions, FACET tolerates imperfect task assignment and sparse feedback, while systematic evaluator bias exposes a quality-signal trust boundary that can be mitigated with ground-truth probes or audits. Live provider runs further confirm that certification can move real traffic from a premium anchor to a substantially cheaper certified endpoint. Our results suggest that market-aware LLM routing must measure not only which model to use, but also who serves it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开放权重 LLM 推理市场里，同一模型在不同 provider 上的质量、延迟、可用性和价格差异极大，价格表无法预测质量与可用性。提出 FACET：在线认证每个 (provider × task) 可行性面，先走质量等价且健康的最便宜 provider，未认证时回退到 anchor；实测能把真实流量从高价 anchor 迁到更便宜的已认证端点。
Motivation: 现有 LLM router 只按静态的每模型成本选模型，忽略了选完模型后还要选 provider 这一决策轴，而价格表无法推断 provider 的质量与可用性。
Method: 先对 [nummodels] 个开放模型、多个竞争 provider、多类任务做三轮实测，构建 measured-map 策略（路由到质量等价且健康的最便宜 provider）；再提出 FACET 在线 provider router，认证 (provider × task) 可行性面并在服务未认证臂前 fail-safe 回退到 anchor，容忍不完美的任务分配与稀疏反馈。
Result: 跨 [nummodels] 个开放模型、多个 provider、多任务类型与三轮测量发现：同一模型跨 provider 的质量、延迟、可用性、价格差异显著；高价 provider 一贯更快，但价格不能可靠预测质量或可用性；某部署在知识任务上近乎正常、在多步推理上灾难性退化。measured-map 在质量匹配下省钱并避开退化端点；实测中 FACET 认证把真实流量从 premium anchor 迁到显著更便宜的已认证端点；评估器系统性偏差会破坏质量信号，可用 ground-truth probes 或审计缓解。
Conclusion: 市场感知的 LLM 路由必须同时度量用哪个模型和由谁提供服务；provider 可行性按任务选择且随时间漂移，需要在线认证加安全回退。

papers.title: Scaling Zero-Order Pretraining through Model Sharding
papers.abstract_en: Zero-order optimization (ZO) trains without backpropagation, making it relevant to forward-only hardware and non-differentiable loss, but its gradient variance grows with perturbed dimension, inhibiting large-model training. Sharded Optimization Mixture of Assemblies (SOMA) trains LSTM experts independently on $N$ data clusters using simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA), without exchanging gradients, activations or optimizer state. Its separable loss removes cross-expert perturbation noise at the cost of jointly learned representations across domains. Using 80,000 estimated RTX 5090 GPU-hours, we show modest sharding improves training compute efficiency over all tested monolithic ZO controls. At 8.44M parameters and 150 aggregate GPU-hours, SOMA $N=2$ with 64 perturbations reaches 1.76 test nats/byte, versus 2.00--2.11 for monolithic SPSA at 64, 256 or 1,024 perturbations and 2.21 for EGGROLL. On WikiText-103, these frozen checkpoints reach 2.07, 2.25--2.36 and 2.49, respectively. On a fixed separable objective with equal-size blocks, we prove independent losses reduce relative gradient variance to approximately $1/N$ of a shared-loss estimator's. Holding starting weights, data, perturbations and compute fixed, independent rather than summed losses lower SOMA $N=4$ test loss by 0.035 nats/byte after 1,000 updates across three seeds. Larger ensembles offer a separate inference benefit: at similar model size with top-$k$ routing ($k=4$), SOMA $N=256$ achieves 2.36M tokens/s versus 257k for SOMA $N=8$ ($9.19\times$, including routing), at lower test loss (1.68 versus 1.71), albeit using $59.9\times$ as much aggregate training compute. We release all training and evaluation code and checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分片零阶预训练方法 SOMA (Sharded Optimization Mixture of Assemblies)：把 LSTM 专家在 N 个数据簇上用 SPSA 独立训练、不交换梯度与优化器状态，可分离损失把相对梯度方差压到共享损失估计的约 1/N。在 8.44M 参数、150 GPU-hours 下 SOMA N=2（64 次扰动）测试 1.76 nats/byte，弱于单体 SPSA 的 2.00–2.11 与 EGGROLL 的 2.21；但 N=256 配 top-k 路由 (k=4) 达 2.36M tokens/s，是 N=8 的 9.19 倍且测试损失更低 (1.68 vs 1.71)。
Motivation: 零阶优化无需反向传播，适用于前向-only 硬件与不可微损失，但其梯度方差随扰动维度增长，阻碍大模型训练；单体 ZO 训练在算力效率上受限。
Method: SOMA 将 LSTM 专家分配到 N 个数据簇上，用 simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) 独立训练，不交换梯度、激活或优化器状态；采用可分离损失 (separable loss) 去除跨专家扰动噪声，代价是跨域表征不再联合学习。共使用 80,000 估算的 RTX 5090 GPU-hours，并在固定可分离目标、等大小块下证明独立损失的相对梯度方差约为共享损失估计的 1/N。
Result: 8.44M 参数、150 聚合 GPU-hours 下，SOMA N=2（64 扰动）测试 1.76 nats/byte，单体 SPSA（64/256/1,024 扰动）为 2.00–2.11，EGGROLL 为 2.21；WikiText-103 冻结检查点上分别为 2.07、2.25–2.36、2.49。固定起点权重、数据、扰动与算力时，独立损失使 SOMA N=4 在 1,000 次更新后测试损失比求和损失低 0.035 nats/byte（三个种子）。推理侧，相似模型规模下 SOMA N=256 (top-k, k=4) 达 2.36M tokens/s，对比 N=8 的 257k（9.19 倍，含路由），测试损失 1.68 vs 1.71，但聚合训练算力为其 59.9 倍。
Conclusion: 适度分片在所测单体 ZO 对照上提升训练算力效率，独立损失可把相对梯度方差降到约 1/N；更大集成带来独立的推理加速收益，但需付出数十倍聚合训练算力，且可分离损失牺牲跨域联合表征。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which augments the student's RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher's reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对稀疏结果奖励下长程 agent RL 的冷启动问题，提出 Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS)：用 on-policy distillation (OPD) 在学生自身 rollout 上给 token 级指导，并让 OPD 项权重随师生性能差距自适应衰减，学生接近教师参考水平后逐步撤除指导。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三套 Qwen2.5 师生配置下，GATS 平均成功率在全部三种配置中最高，相对仅用奖励的 GRPO 在匹配学生 rollout 预算下提升 4.37%–11.87%。
Motivation: 长程 agent 的稀疏结果奖励导致冷启动：早期策略几乎解不出采样任务，几乎得不到有用奖励信号，RL 难以起步。
Method: 用 on-policy distillation (OPD) 在学生自己的 rollout 上提供 token 级教师指导；提出 GATS，在学生 RL 目标上加一个权重随师生性能差距自适应的 OPD 项，学生接近教师参考表现时逐步降低权重、达到后完全撤除，从而可使用比学生更小的任务训练教师。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上、三种 Qwen2.5 师生配置下，GATS 的平均成功率在全部三种配置中均为所比较方法最高；在匹配学生 rollout 预算下相对 reward-only GRPO 提升 4.37%–11.87%。定性发现：师生差距大时蒸馏有帮助，差距缩小并反转后继续蒸馏收益下降甚至妨碍进一步提升。
Conclusion: 教师指导只在训练早期真正需要，按师生性能差距调度并最终撤除蒸馏，比持续蒸馏更能提升稀疏奖励 agent RL 的成功率，且允许使用更小的任务训练教师。

papers.title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current pre-training datasets are derived from web crawls, with all their issues, and were not designed to support mid- and post-training pipelines--for instance, they contain little explicit reasoning. Thus, many frontier labs have begun to develop their own internal datasets, starting from state-of-the-art models, to augment their pre-training data mix, eg, with reasoning traces to address cold-start problems. While demonstratively effective, none of these datasets are public, and the effect of this so-called synthetic data on knowledge and skill acquisition of language models, including small ones, remains poorly understood. We present SYNTH, the first open-source synthetic corpus derived from 58,698 Wikipedia articles that collapses pre-, mid-, and post-training into a single training stage via structured amplification of curated encyclopedic seeds. We evaluate SYNTH by training a suite of models: a 56M tiny model (Monad), 0.3B-0.6B dense models (Baguettotron), and a 13B / 1B-active MoE. At iso-compute, SYNTH outperforms filtered web data, and our models remain competitive with similarly-sized open-weight baselines. Because SYNTH is back-translated from grounded passages, SYNTH-trained models achieve high factual precision despite 10-140x fewer training tokens, with memorization targeted by the seed corpus. These results show that synthetic datasets, including our SYNTH dataset, are capable of producing competitive generalist models from a fraction of the training data, enabling rapid iteration as the frontier advances. These findings open up possibilities for both generalist models with significantly increased data efficiency, as well as domain-specific models where no instruction or conversational data is available. Finally, we publicly release our SYNTH dataset and the suite of Baguettotron models under a permissive license, thus supporting open-source language model development.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 9 figures. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PleIAs/SYNTH
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SYNTH 是首个开源合成语料，从 58,698 篇 Wikipedia 文章经结构化扩增 (structured amplification) 生成，把预训练、中训练、后训练合并为单一训练阶段。在 iso-compute 下 SYNTH 胜过过滤后的网页数据，且因从有据段落回译，模型在少 10–140 倍训练 token 的情况下仍保持高事实精度。
Motivation: 现有预训练数据来自网页抓取，缺乏显式推理内容，也不适配中/后训练流程；各前沿实验室自建的合成数据集均不公开，合成数据对语言模型（尤其是小模型）知识与技能获取的影响尚不清楚。
Method: 以精选百科种子为起点做结构化扩增，生成回译自 grounded passages 的 SYNTH 语料，将 pre-/mid-/post-training 压成单阶段训练；用该语料训练 56M 的 Monad、0.3B–0.6B 稠密模型 Baguettotron，以及 13B 总参/1B 激活的 MoE，并与过滤网页数据在 iso-compute 下对比。
Result: iso-compute 下 SYNTH 优于过滤网页数据，模型与同规模开源权重基线相当；SYNTH 训练模型用少 10–140 倍的训练 token 达到高事实精度，记忆被种子语料限定。语料源自 58,698 篇 Wikipedia 文章，模型规模覆盖 56M、0.3B–0.6B、13B/1B-active MoE。
Conclusion: 合成数据集能用一小部分训练数据产出有竞争力的通用模型，支持随前沿快速迭代；同一配方也适用于没有指令或对话数据的领域专用模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ReCAP: Retrieval-Guided Capability Reuse for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal continual instruction tuning (MCIT) aims to enable multimodal large language models to acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks while preserving previously learned knowledge. Existing methods primarily mitigate catastrophic forgetting by constraining parameter updates or separating task-specific adaptations. However, continual adaptation can also benefit from external knowledge that provides domain-specific information and reusable reasoning patterns for solving diverse instructions. For example, to answer "How many red cubes are to the left of the sphere?", domain knowledge can provide relevant concepts about objects and spatial relations, while reasoning knowledge can specify ordered operations such as object recognition, spatial filtering, and counting. Despite this potential, how to leverage external knowledge for continual adaptation remains largely unexplored in existing MCIT methods. To this end, we propose ReCAP, a retrieval-guided framework that leverages external knowledge to guide capability reuse during continual adaptation. At each continual stage, ReCAP uses external search and an LLM to incrementally build a knowledge base of domain, reasoning, and format knowledge based on the current-stage training data. For each instruction, retrieved domain knowledge guides generation, while retrieved reasoning knowledge selects and orders capability modules to form an instance-specific capability path. As these capability modules are reused across stages, subsequent adaptation can overwrite previously learned parameters. To enable stable cross-stage reuse, ReCAP introduces adaptive subspace recycling, which parameterizes reusable capability modules with shared bases and stage-specific cores, protects historically important directions while recycling residual capacity. Extensive experiments on MCIT benchmarks show that ReCAP achieves SOTA performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCAP 针对多模态持续指令微调 (MCIT) 提出检索引导的能力复用框架：每个持续阶段用外部检索与 LLM 增量构建领域、推理、格式三类知识库，检索到的领域知识引导生成，推理知识选择并排序能力模块形成实例级能力路径；再用自适应子空间回收（共享基 + 阶段核心，保护历史重要方向并回收残余容量）实现跨阶段稳定复用。在 MCIT benchmark 上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有 MCIT 方法主要靠约束参数更新或分离任务特定适配来缓解灾难性遗忘，而持续适配如何利用外部知识提供的领域信息与可复用推理模式基本未被探索。
Method: 每个持续阶段用外部搜索加 LLM 基于当前阶段训练数据增量构建领域/推理/格式知识库；推理时领域知识引导生成，推理知识选择并排序能力模块组成实例特定能力路径；自适应子空间回收把可复用模块参数化为共享基与阶段特定核心，保护历史重要方向并回收残余容量。
Result: 在 MCIT benchmark 上取得 SOTA 性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把外部知识检索与跨阶段复用的能力模块结合，并用子空间回收稳定参数更新，可在多模态持续指令微调中同时获得新能力与既有知识保持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visual Branch is What You Need for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) requires models to recognize new classes over time without forgetting previously learned ones. With the rise of vision-language pre-training, CLIP has become a strong foundation for CIL. A common design in CLIP-based CIL is to construct textual classifier weights by encoding class-name templates with the CLIP text encoder, and then classify visual features by image-text cosine similarity. This design is appealing: since CLIP aligns images and text in a shared embedding space, textual weights appear to provide an off-the-shelf classifier for incremental classes. However, we show that this seemingly natural design is not always beneficial, as a modality gap can still separate the two modalities and make textual classifier weights deviate from visual class distributions. Empirically, under identical task-wise CIL training, initializing the cosine classifier with visual class centers yields lower loss and better incremental accuracy than using CLIP textual features.Motivated by these observations, we propose VIS, a visual-only method for CLIP-based CIL that removes the deployed textual branch and constructs the incremental classifier entirely in the visual space. To obtain stronger task-adaptive visual representations, VISuses only base-session data to enhance CLIP's final visual representation with informative visual-layer features. Built on the enhanced visual representation, VISemploys a simple kernelized incremental least-squares SVM, whose classifier weights are solved in closed form from additive sufficient statistics. When new classes arrive, VISaccumulates their sufficient statistics and recomputes the classifier weights for all seen classes, enabling efficient incremental updates while preserving historical class knowledge. Extensive experiments show that VISachieves state-of-the-art performance without a textual branch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIP 类增量学习 (CIL) 中用文本编码类名模板构造分类器权重会因 modality gap 偏离视觉类分布；VIS 去掉文本分支，只用 base-session 数据增强 CLIP 最后一层视觉表征，再用闭式求解的核化增量最小二乘 SVM 在视觉空间重建分类器。同任务训练下用视觉类中心初始化余弦分类器比用 CLIP 文本特征损失更低、增量准确率更高，VIS 在无文本分支下达到 SOTA。
Motivation: CLIP-based CIL 的通行做法是把类名模板经文本编码器当分类器权重，看似可直接复用，但 modality gap 使文本权重与视觉类分布错位，增量阶段分类不准。
Method: VIS 是纯视觉方法：移除部署时的文本分支；仅用 base-session 数据融合视觉层特征以增强 CLIP 最终视觉表征；在其上用核化增量 least-squares SVM，分类器权重由可加充分统计量闭式求解，新类到达时累加统计量并重算全部已见类权重。
Result: 在相同 task-wise CIL 训练下，用视觉类中心初始化余弦分类器比用 CLIP 文本特征得到更低 loss 与更高增量准确率；VIS 在无文本分支下取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: CLIP 的文本分支在 CIL 中并非必要，视觉空间内的闭式增量分类器既能保留历史类知识又能高效更新，是 CLIP-based CIL 的更优构造方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Behavioral Capacity Certificates for Quantized Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Activation and key-value cache precision change what a quantized language model computes without altering its stored weights. Direct weight-code bounds, however, assign identical complexity to deployments that behave differently and charge separately for weight codes that behave identically. Behavioral Capacity Certificates (BCC) charge for behavior using the aggregate prior mass of complete implementations---weights, scales, activation and cache rules---that induce the same bounded loss. When quantization merges implementations, this shared mass lowers the complexity penalty, and a break-even law determines when the saving survives the cost of validating it. BCC supports a three-step deployment workflow, and our experiments verify each step. First, a forward-only screen shortlists per-layer bit-widths by how often candidate perturbations preserve the reference predictions, with quality comparable to Hessian-guided selection at lower preprocessing cost. Second, margin-certified cells identify weights that can be pruned or sign-flipped without changing the deployed behavior: every permitted combination preserves all declared predictions, and on OLMoE-1B-7B and SmolLM2-1.7B, independent probes bound the probability that any permitted combination changes a prediction on new text. Third, BCC bounds the population loss of the deployed model, nonvacuously for complete decoders and more tightly than the compressed-code route. At equal cache memory, giving keys higher precision than values yields lower NLL and higher prediction agreement on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and SmolLM2, together with a tighter complexity bound in the GPT-2 audit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出行为容量证书 (Behavioral Capacity Certificates, BCC)，用诱导相同有界损失的完整实现（权重、scale、激活与 KV cache 规则）的先验质量总量来计费，量化合并实现时复杂度惩罚下降，并给出盈亏平衡定律判定节省是否覆盖验证成本。三步部署流程在 OLMoE-1B-7B、SmolLM2-1.7B、GPT-2、Qwen2.5 上验证：等 cache 显存下 key 比 value 给更高精度得到更低 NLL 与更高预测一致性。
Motivation: 直接的权重码复杂度界把行为不同的部署算成相同复杂度，又对行为相同的权重码重复计费，无法反映激活与 KV cache 精度对量化模型实际计算的改变。
Method: BCC 按完整实现集合的先验质量总量计费；三步流程为：前向筛选按候选扰动保持参考预测的频率挑选每层 bit-width；margin-certified cells 标出可剪枝或翻符号而不改变部署行为的权重；最后给出部署模型的总体损失界。实验用独立探针检验允许组合在新文本上改变预测的概率。
Result: 前向筛选的模型质量与 Hessian-guided 选择相当而预处理成本更低；在 OLMoE-1B-7B 与 SmolLM2-1.7B 上，margin-certified cells 的每个允许组合保持全部声明预测，独立探针给出任一组合在新文本上改变预测的概率上界；BCC 对完整 decoder 非空地界定总体损失，且比压缩码路线更紧。等 cache 显存下 key 高于 value 精度在 GPT-2、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2 上得到更低 NLL 与更高预测一致性，并在 GPT-2 审计中给出更紧的复杂度界。
Conclusion: 量化部署的复杂度应按行为而非权重码计费：合并实现可降低惩罚，而 key/value 精度不对称是等显存下更优的 cache 分配方式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Boids of a Feather Flock Together - Evolving Prey Behaviours Under Different Predator Attack Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Flocking and schooling are thought to have evolved partly as defences against predation, but how prey should balance social and escape tendencies may depend on the predator's hunting strategy. We extend the predator-prey boids model of Ojo et al. (2023), itself based on Reynolds' boids, by combining six prey movement tendencies (alignment, cohesion, separation, dodge, repel and wiggle) into a single weighted acceleration update, and by reformulating wiggle as a sinusoidal manoeuvre. We then use an evolutionary strategy to optimise the six behaviour coefficients for collective prey survival against four predator hunting strategies: attack-centroid, attack-nearest, attack-random and attack-peripheral. Across five independent trials per strategy, coefficients converged within trials and mean fitness remained stable or increased, although trials often settled in different local optima. Prey survival was highest under attack-centroid and lowest under attack-nearest, in line with our hypotheses. Against attack-centroid, prey evolved individualistic predator avoidance with high escape coefficients, whereas against the other three strategies they largely kept their flock formation. Across all strategies, evolution favoured a low repel coefficient and relatively high dodge and wiggle coefficients. Our results suggest that optimal anti-predator behaviour depends on the interplay between escape tendencies and the predator's hunting strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在扩展的捕食者-猎物 boids 模型中，用进化策略优化猎物六项运动倾向（alignment、cohesion、separation、dodge、repel、wiggle）的权重，检验最优反捕食行为如何随捕食者狩猎策略变化。五次独立试验下，attack-centroid 时猎物存活率最高、attack-nearest 最低；面对 attack-centroid 猎物演化出高逃逸系数的个体化躲避，面对其余三种策略则基本保持群体队形，且所有策略一致偏好低 repel、较高 dodge 与 wiggle。
Motivation: 群游作为反捕食防御的最优社会-逃逸权衡是否随捕食者狩猎策略而变，缺少可量化的机制刻画；已有 boids 模型未把六项倾向放进统一权重框架做进化优化。
Method: 扩展 Ojo et al. (2023) 的捕食者-猎物 boids 模型（基于 Reynolds' boids），把六项猎物运动倾向合成单一加权加速度更新，并将 wiggle 重写为正弦机动；用进化策略 (evolutional strategy) 针对四种捕食者狩猎策略（attack-centroid、attack-nearest、attack-random、attack-peripheral）优化六个行为系数以最大化群体存活适应度，每种策略跑五次独立试验。
Result: 每种策略五次独立试验中系数在试验内收敛，平均适应度保持稳定或上升，但不同试验常落入不同局部最优。猎物存活率在 attack-centroid 下最高、attack-nearest 下最低，与假设一致；attack-centroid 下演化出高逃逸系数的个体化躲避，其余三种策略下基本保留群体队形；跨全部策略进化都偏好低 repel 系数与相对较高的 dodge、wiggle 系数。
Conclusion: 最优反捕食行为取决于逃逸倾向与捕食者狩猎策略的交互：不同狩猎策略会把进化推向个体化逃逸或维持群游两种解，且 dodge/wiggle 比 repel 更普适有效。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在扩展的捕食者-猎物 boids 模型中，用进化策略优化猎物六项运动倾向（alignment、cohesion、separation、dodge、repel、wiggle）的权重，检验最优反捕食行为如何随捕食者狩猎策略变化。五次独立试验下，attack-centroid 时猎物存活率最高、attack-nearest 最低；面对 attack-centroid 猎物演化出高逃逸系数的个体化躲避，面对其余三种策略则基本保持群体队形，且所有策略一致偏好低 repel、较高 dodge 与 wiggle。
summary_sections.motivation: 群游作为反捕食防御的最优社会-逃逸权衡是否随捕食者狩猎策略而变，缺少可量化的机制刻画；已有 boids 模型未把六项倾向放进统一权重框架做进化优化。
summary_sections.method: 扩展 Ojo et al. (2023) 的捕食者-猎物 boids 模型（基于 Reynolds' boids），把六项猎物运动倾向合成单一加权加速度更新，并将 wiggle 重写为正弦机动；用进化策略 (evolutional strategy) 针对四种捕食者狩猎策略（attack-centroid、attack-nearest、attack-random、attack-peripheral）优化六个行为系数以最大化群体存活适应度，每种策略跑五次独立试验。
summary_sections.result: 每种策略五次独立试验中系数在试验内收敛，平均适应度保持稳定或上升，但不同试验常落入不同局部最优。猎物存活率在 attack-centroid 下最高、attack-nearest 下最低，与假设一致；attack-centroid 下演化出高逃逸系数的个体化躲避，其余三种策略下基本保留群体队形；跨全部策略进化都偏好低 repel 系数与相对较高的 dodge、wiggle 系数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 最优反捕食行为取决于逃逸倾向与捕食者狩猎策略的交互：不同狩猎策略会把进化推向个体化逃逸或维持群游两种解，且 dodge/wiggle 比 repel 更普适有效。

papers.title: TopoEmbedX: A General Framework for Representation Learning on Topological Domains
papers.abstract_en: Topological structures such as simplicial complexes, hypergraphs, and cell complexes extend standard graph models by modeling higher-order relationships. These structures appear in many modern datasets and require specialized methods for generating meaningful embeddings. In this paper, we introduce TopoEmbedX, a unified framework for embedding a wide range of topological domains into Euclidean spaces. The package brings together several existing topological embedding algorithms---DeepCell, Cell2Vec, CellDiff2Vec, HOLE, and HOGLEE---and introduces five new algorithms: ComplexNetMF, ComplexRep, ComplexRandNE, ComplexWalklets, and ComplexHeat. These algorithms extend well-known graph embedding techniques to higher-order settings using the augmented Hasse graph of a topological domain. TopoEmbedX provides a clear, consistent, and easy-to-use framework for topological representation learning. Experiments show that the embeddings generated by TopoEmbedX support tasks such as classification and regression across multidimensional data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoEmbedX 把单纯复、超图、胞复形等拓扑域统一嵌入欧氏空间，打包 5 个已有算法并新增 5 个基于增广 Hasse 图 (augmented Hasse graph) 的算法。实验显示其嵌入可支撑多维数据上的分类与回归任务。
Motivation: 单纯复、超图、胞复形等高阶结构超出标准图模型表达能力，现有嵌入算法彼此割裂、缺少统一接口，难以在同类任务上横向比较与复用。
Method: 统一框架 TopoEmbedX 收录 DeepCell、Cell2Vec、CellDiff2Vec、HOLE、HOGLEE 五个已有算法，并新增 ComplexNetMF、ComplexRep、ComplexRandNE、ComplexWalklets、ComplexHeat 五个算法；新算法把已知图嵌入技术经由拓扑域的增广 Hasse 图推广到高阶设定。
Result: 实验表明 TopoEmbedX 生成的嵌入可支撑多维数据上的分类与回归任务；摘要给出的算法清单为 5 个已有加 5 个新增，共 10 个。
Conclusion: 高阶图嵌入技术经增广 Hasse 图可系统迁移到各类拓扑域，统一框架使这些嵌入在分类与回归上可用。

papers.title: How Many Labels Does a Language Need? Annotation Budgets and Cross-Lingual Pooling for African-Language Text Classification
papers.abstract_en: Every text classifier for an African language begins with a budgeting question: how many labelled examples are needed, and can labels from other African languages stand in for them? We answer both questions empirically for 28 language-task pairs, news topic classification in 16 languages (MasakhaNEWS) and tweet sentiment in 12 languages (AfriSenti), using a character n-gram linear model that trains in seconds on two CPU cores with no pretrained weights and no accelerator. Monolingual learning curves at budgets from 25 to several thousand labels show that topic classification reaches 90\% of its full-data macro-F1 with about 400 labels in the median language, while sentiment is still improving at the full training size in 11 of 12 languages and needs thousands of labels. Pooling the full training data of the other languages in the benchmark is worth a great deal at small budgets and nothing at large ones: at 25 target labels it adds 0.20 macro-F1 on average for news (up to 0.43 for Lingala) and 0.08 for sentiment, the gain decays to zero by 800 labels, and at full size pooling hurts in 9 of 16 and 8 of 12 languages. Twenty-five target labels plus pooled data match what 100 to 400 monolingual labels achieve for most news languages. A complete zero-shot transfer matrix shows that transfer without any target labels recovers a median of only 13\% (news) and 4\% (sentiment) of the gap between a majority-class predictor and the in-language model, with the exceptions explained by shared script (Amharic and Tigrinya), shared lexicon (English and Nigerian Pidgin, the Arabic dialects), or a shared label prior rather than by language family. We release code that regenerates every number from the public benchmark files and translate the results into concrete annotation guidance for teams building African-language classifiers without GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 28 个非洲语言-任务对上系统测出标注预算与跨语言数据池化的收益曲线：新闻主题分类中位语言约 400 个标签即达全量数据 macro-F1 的 90%，而情感分类在 12 种语言中有 11 种到全量仍在提升。25 个目标标签加跨语言池化可抵 100–400 个单语标签，但池化收益随标签数衰减、到 800 个标签归零，全量时反而在 9/16（新闻）和 8/12（情感）语言上造成损失。
Motivation: 为非洲语言构建文本分类器时，团队要先回答标注多少、能否借用其他语言标签两个预算问题，而现有基准缺少跨语言-预算维度的系统实证。
Method: 在 MasakhaNEWS（16 语新闻主题）与 AfriSenti（12 语推文情感）共 28 个语言-任务对上，用字符 n-gram 线性模型（双核 CPU 数秒可训、无预训练权重与加速器）绘制 25 到数千标签的单语学习曲线，并做跨语言全量池化与完整零样本迁移矩阵。
Result: 新闻分类中位语言约 400 标签达到全量 macro-F1 的 90%；情感在 12 语中 11 语到全量仍在提升。25 个目标标签时池化平均加 0.20 macro-F1（新闻，Lingala 最高 0.43）、情感加 0.08，收益到 800 标签衰减为零，全量时在 9/16 与 8/12 语言上反而有害。零样本迁移仅补回多数类与语内模型差距的中位 13%（新闻）与 4%（情感），例外由共享文字（Amharic/Tigrinya）、共享词表（English/Nigerian Pidgin、阿拉伯语方言）或共享标签先验解释，而非语系。
Conclusion: 小预算下跨语言池化可替代 100–400 个单语标签，大预算下应停用池化；零样本迁移整体不足以替代目标语言标注，决定迁移效果的是文字、词表与标签先验而非语系。

papers.title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition
papers.abstract_en: How many tokens from its context does a language model actually use, and what determines that number? We study this question through self-attention. Without retraining, we retain only the tokens with the highest attention weights at each head, layer, and query, keeping their original weights unchanged. By varying the selected set size and measuring the increase in negative log-likelihood (NLL), we estimate the effective attention set size needed to stay within a chosen loss tolerance. Relatively small selected sets can keep NLL close to the full-attention baseline, although the required size varies across models. Attention-based selection substantially outperforms random selection. Selected sets exhibit geometric structure, although geometric separation alone does not establish that model loss is preserved. Extending context while evaluating the same prediction targets increases the required set size, while its fraction of context decreases over the tested range. Experiments with a fixed supporting fact show that additional background pushes its tokens down the attention ranking and reduces their attention mass. Renormalizing the retained weights can substantially reduce the required set size, showing that it also depends on how selected representations are combined. Conditional theoretical models explain how competition and attention-mass retention can produce growing set sizes without more distinct information to retrieve. These results provide a way to measure effective attention set size in language models and investigate its dependence on context, competition, and aggregation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 不重训模型，只保留每个 head/layer/query 上注意力权重最高的 token 并保持原权重，通过改变保留集大小测 NLL 上升，估计维持给定损失容忍度所需的有效注意力集大小。小保留集即可让 NLL 接近全注意力基线，注意力选择显著优于随机选择；延长上下文会推高所需集大小但其占上下文比例下降，重归一化保留权重可明显降低所需集大小。
Motivation: 语言模型实际用了上下文中的多少 token、由什么决定这一数量并不清楚，需要一种不重训即可测量有效注意力集大小的手段。
Method: 在每个 head、layer、query 上按注意力权重保留 top token 且不改权重，扫描保留集大小并测负对数似然 (NLL) 增量，反推落在给定损失容忍度内的有效集大小；对比注意力选择与随机选择，并用固定 supporting fact 加背景干扰的实验观察排名与注意力质量变化，辅以条件理论模型解释竞争与质量保留。
Result: 相对小的保留集即可让 NLL 接近全注意力基线，但所需大小因模型而异；注意力选择显著优于随机选择；延长上下文且评估相同预测目标时所需集大小上升、其占上下文比例在测试区间内下降；加入背景会把 supporting fact token 的排名与注意力质量压低；重归一化保留权重可大幅降低所需集大小。
Conclusion: 有效注意力集大小是可测量的量，同时取决于上下文竞争与所选表示的聚合方式；几何分离本身不足以说明损失被保持。

papers.title: Co-PiLOT: Constrained Physics-Informed Latent Optimization for Target-Driven Inverse Design
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce MERIDIAN, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, failure-aware feasibility prediction, manifold-aware trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within a budget of $160$ simulations, the ViT-FMDiT and MERIDIAN combination yields the best target-driven objective score, reducing the relative target error by $3$--$22\%$ against seven baselines (DANTE, TuRBO, BAxUS, CMA-ES, DDOM, SEIKO, DDPO) on the same decoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Co-PiLOT 把物理逆向设计放进生成模型的潜空间：编码器-解码器把候选映射到低维瓶颈 z，解码器充当有效性先验，再用物理信息黑盒优化器 MERIDIAN 在潜空间中搜索。在镁合金微结构/织构逆向设计上，ViT-FMDiT（z=768）以 FID 27.86、MS-SSIM 0.178 重建高保真 EBSD 图像，160 次晶体塑性模拟预算内相对目标误差比七个基线低 3–22%。
Motivation: 分子、器件、微结构的逆向设计要在非欧氏高维空间里对昂贵黑盒模拟器做优化，直接搜索难以编码可行性且每次评估代价高。
Method: 候选经生成编码器-解码器映射，解码器作为学习到的有效性先验；ViT 编码器配 latent diffusion、diffusion transformer、rectified-flow transformer 解码器，在约 80,000 张 EBSD 微结构数据集上学最小瓶颈 z；自分割取向编解码器把重建图转成晶体塑性求解器输入网格；MERIDIAN 用 deep-kernel 高斯过程不确定性、失效感知可行性预测、流形感知 trust region 与目标感知采集函数做主动潜空间优化。
Result: ViT-FMDiT（z=768）重建 FID 27.86、MS-SSIM 0.178；在 160 次模拟预算内，ViT-FMDiT 与 MERIDIAN 组合取得最佳目标驱动目标分数，相对目标误差比 DANTE、TuRBO、BAxUS、CMA-ES、DDOM、SEIKO、DDPO 七个基线低 3–22%（同一解码器上比较）。
Conclusion: 把可行性先验放进解码器、把搜索限制在潜空间 trust region 内，可在极小模拟预算下完成镁合金微结构的靶向逆向设计。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: EndoPrior-GS: Dynamic Endoscopic Reconstruction with a Joint Texture Prior
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic endoscopic reconstruction is fundamental to robotic surgery and computer-assisted interventions. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) realises real-time rendering, its application to deformable intraoperative environments remains constrained by spurious geometry and varying illuminations. To address these limitations, we introduce EndoPrior-GS, a novel pipeline that explicitly couples frame-extracted vision heuristics and estimated depth maps. EndoPrior-GS derives a joint texture prior from a tool-filtered valid tissue mask, a non-specular photometric filter, and anatomical structural salience, yielding a probability map that guides primitive initialisation and subsequent density control. The prior is further extended to the temporal domain through a texture-aware term that dynamically weighs pairwise primitive contributions during training. We conduct extensive experiments on benchmark datasets EndoNeRF and SCARED, and the obtained results show that our method EndoPrior-GS reduces Flow Error by 27.7% and 25.8% over the representative approaches while preserving competitive rendering quality and real-time rendering speed. Our project website is available at https://jiaqi-huang-77.github.io/EndoPrior-GS/.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: EndoPrior-GS 管线显式耦合逐帧提取的视觉启发式与估计深度图：由工具过滤的有效组织掩膜、非镜面光度滤波和解剖结构显著性合成联合纹理先验，输出概率图指导图元初始化与后续密度控制；再通过 texture-aware 项把先验扩展到时域，训练中动态加权成对图元贡献。
Result: 在 EndoNeRF 与 SCARED 基准上，Flow Error 相对代表性方法分别降低 27.7% 与 25.8%，并保持有竞争力的渲染质量与实时渲染速度。
Conclusion: 以纹理先验同时约束空间初始化与时间图元加权，可在可变形术中环境中抑制伪影几何与光照变化带来的误差，且不牺牲实时性。

papers.title: ExceptionDrive: A Planning-Oriented Counterfactual Corner-Case Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Average performance on routine driving benchmarks does not establish planner reliability under rare, safety-critical hazards. We proposed ExceptionDrive, a counterfactual planning benchmark that uses VLM-assisted screening, localized multi-view editing, and quality auditing to insert hazards into real nuScenes scenes while preserving their context. Its 21 tasks span six safety families and define hazard or conflict regions, local safety constraints, and acceptable responses. Because hazard insertion can invalidate the recorded human trajectory, our reference-free protocol evaluates edited predictions using Unsafe Rate (UR), Hazard Clearance Compliance (HCC), Hazard Proximity Response (HPR), and Counterfactual Trajectory Shift (CTS), which measure core-region intrusion, clearance compliance, clearance relative to a prescribed margin, and counterfactual trajectory change. Seven representative planners frequently intrude into hazard regions or provide insufficient clearance. We also develop a Reminder Agent that, without sample-specific task labels, converts visual evidence and the shared taxonomy into structured records of hazard presence, type, and a recommended high-level strategy. The agent neither predicts trajectories nor controls the vehicle; its records guide a VLM-based decision agent. In zero-shot experiments, the reminders improve strategy accuracy and reduce under-warning.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables; supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExceptionDrive 是一个面向规划的反事实 corner-case 自动驾驶基准：用 VLM 筛选、多视角局部编辑与质量审计把危险目标插入真实 nuScenes 场景并保留上下文，21 个任务覆盖六类安全族。在无参考协议下用 UR、HCC、HPR、CTS 四个指标评测，七个代表性规划器频繁侵入危险区或余量不足；零样本 Reminder Agent 生成的结构化提醒能提高策略准确率并减少漏报。
Motivation: 常规驾驶基准上的平均表现无法说明规划器在罕见、安全关键危险下的可靠性，而直接插入危险又会破坏已记录的人类轨迹，使参考轨迹失效。
Method: 以 VLM 辅助筛选加多视角局部编辑 (localized multi-view editing) 和质量审计，把危险插入真实 nuScenes 场景；21 个任务定义危险/冲突区域、局部安全约束与可接受响应。因参考轨迹失效，采用 reference-free 协议，用 Unsafe Rate、Hazard Clearance Compliance、Hazard Proximity Response、Counterfactual Trajectory Shift 度量核心区域侵入、余量合规、相对规定余量的接近度与反事实轨迹变化；另训 Reminder Agent，零样本把视觉证据与共享 taxonomy 转成危险存在、类型与高层策略的结构化记录，供 VLM 决策 agent 使用。
Result: 七个代表性规划器在该基准上频繁侵入危险区域或给出不足余量；零样本实验中 Reminder Agent 的提醒提高了策略准确率并降低了 under-warning。评测指标为 UR、HCC、HPR、CTS 四项。
Conclusion: 平均分不能替代 corner-case 下的规划可靠性检验，而无需样本级任务标签的提醒记录即可改善 VLM 决策 agent 的策略选择与预警充分性；Reminder Agent 本身不预测轨迹也不控制车辆。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Learning from synthetic photorealistic raindrop for single image raindrop removal
papers.abstract_en: Raindrops adhered to camera lens or windshield are inevitable in rainy scenes and can become an issue for many computer vision systems such as autonomous driving. Because raindrop appearance is affected by too many parameters, therefore it is unlikely to find an effective model based solution. Learning based methods are also problematic, because traditional learning method cannot properly model the complex appearance. Whereas deep learning method lacks sufficiently large and realistic training data. To solve it, in our work, we propose the first photo-realistic dataset of synthetic adherent raindrops for training. The rendering is physics based with consideration of the water dynamic, geometric and photometry. The dataset contains various types of rainy scenes and particularly the rainy driving scenes. Based on the modeling of raindrop imagery, we introduce a detection network which has the awareness of the raindrop refraction as well as its blurring. Based on that, we propose the removal network that can well recover the image structure. Rigorous experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our proposed framework.
papers.comment: 2019 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshop (ICCVW)
papers.journal_ref: 2019 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshop (ICCVW), pp. 4340-4349
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个基于物理渲染的合成附着雨滴数据集（含水动力、几何与光度建模），并据此训练一个感知雨滴折射与模糊的检测网络，再由去除网络恢复图像结构。在含雨驾驶场景等图像上，该框架经严格实验达到 state-of-the-art 的单图雨滴去除性能。
Motivation: 附着在镜头或挡风玻璃上的雨滴受过多参数影响，难以用解析模型求解；深度学习又缺少足够大且真实的训练数据，导致自动驾驶等视觉系统在雨天退化。
Method: 先做物理基（water dynamic、geometric、photometry）的合成附着雨滴渲染，得到首个 photo-realistic 训练数据集，覆盖多种雨景尤其驾驶场景；再训练带折射与模糊感知的雨滴检测网络，检测结果驱动去除网络恢复图像结构。
Result: 构建首个合成附着雨滴 photo-realistic 数据集；所提检测加去除框架在严格实验中达到 state-of-the-art 的单图雨滴去除表现。
Conclusion: 用物理渲染的合成雨滴数据配合折射感知检测，可以绕开真实训练数据不足的问题，把单图雨滴去除推到 state-of-the-art。

papers.title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO rely on successful self-generated trajectories, but finite rollout budgets can produce all-fail groups with no reward-based policy-gradient signal. While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model's rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportunities for mutual learning without a designated stronger teacher. To exploit this complementarity, we propose GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories), an off-policy-aware framework that replaces all-fail groups with informative peer groups. GRAFT transfers both successful and unsuccessful peer responses with peer-computed advantages, while controlling cross-model mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance ratio clipping. Across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, gaining 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance. Stored peer trajectories preserve most of the gains, improving over GRPO by 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRAFT 在 RLVR 中把某模型全失败 (all-fail) 的 rollout 组替换为同伴模型的轨迹，用同伴侧 advantage 加序列级兼容性加权与 token 级重要性比裁剪控制跨模型 off-policy 失配。在三对异构模型、五个数学推理基准上，同 rollout 预算下比 GRPO 平均高 2.1 分、最高 4.5 分；仅用存储的同伴轨迹仍平均高 1.8 分。
Motivation: GRPO 依赖自身成功轨迹产生策略梯度，有限 rollout 预算下会出现整组全失败、没有 reward 信号；继续加 rollout 成本高，而其他模型可能已在互补 prompt 上找到成功解。
Method: GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories)：检测全失败组后用同伴组替换，转移成功与失败两类同伴响应并使用同伴侧计算的 advantage；以序列级兼容性加权 (compatibility weighting) 和 token 级重要性比裁剪 (importance ratio clipping) 约束跨模型失配，支持异构模型对协同训练或离线存储轨迹复用。
Result: 在三对异构模型与五个数学推理基准上，同 per-model rollout 预算下 GRAFT 对两个模型均稳定优于 GRPO，模型级平均性能平均提升 2.1 分、最高提升 4.5 分；用存储的同伴轨迹（无需同时协同训练）仍平均提升 1.8 分。
Conclusion: 异构模型在 prompt 上的成功互补可以在没有指定强教师的情况下互相利用，且大部分收益可由离线存储的同伴轨迹保留。

papers.title: Strict-Saddle Landscapes and Multi-Rank Geometry in Low-Tubal-Rank Tensor Sensing
papers.abstract_en: We study the optimization landscape of low-tubal-rank tensor sensing through a balanced factorization. Under a tubal restricted isometry condition, we establish a quantitative strict-saddle landscape with no spurious local minima for arbitrary Fourier multi-rank profiles. We further show that the local geometry depends on the Fourier-slice ranks rather than the tubal rank alone. Uniform ranks yield quadratic growth transverse to the solution orbit, whereas nonuniform ranks produce quartically flat directions through hidden frequency-wise overparameterization, even when the factor width equals the exact tubal rank. Numerical experiments illustrate the global optimization behavior and the contrasting local geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 tubal restricted isometry 条件下，低 tubal 秩张量感知的 balanced factorization 具备定量 strict-saddle 性质且无伪局部极小，适用于任意 Fourier multi-rank 配置。局部几何由 Fourier-slice ranks 而非 tubal rank 单独决定：均匀秩在解轨道横截方向呈二次增长，非均匀秩因隐藏的逐频率过参数化出现四次平坦方向，即使因子宽度等于精确 tubal 秩。数值实验展示了全局优化行为与这两种局部几何的对比。
Motivation: 低 tubal 秩张量感知的非凸 landscape 分析通常只按 tubal 秩刻画，无法解释 Fourier 各频率秩不均时优化变慢、局部几何变差的现象。
Method: 对 balanced factorization 在 tubal restricted isometry 条件下推导定量 strict-saddle landscape，按任意 Fourier multi-rank 配置分析；再比较均匀与非均匀 Fourier-slice ranks 下解轨道横截方向的增长阶，并配数值实验展示全局优化行为。
Result: 证明无伪局部极小且 strict-saddle 常数可量化，覆盖任意 Fourier multi-rank；均匀秩给出解轨道横截方向的二次增长，非均匀秩产生四次平坦方向（即使因子宽度等于精确 tubal 秩）；数值实验说明全局优化行为与两种局部几何的对比。
Conclusion: 判断该优化问题的局部几何与可解性要看 Fourier-slice ranks 的均匀性，仅用 tubal 秩与因子宽度不足以预测平坦方向。

papers.title: AgentBug-Smith: Automatically Reproducing Real-World Harness Bugs in Agentic Systems
authors: Yiling Lou (5) ((1) The University of Chicago
papers.abstract_en: Agent harness bugs exhibit unique characteristics and remain challenging for state-of-the-art software agents to repair. Progress in this area is further hindered by existing benchmarks, which contain only a small and fixed number of executable harness bugs while requiring hundreds of human hours to construct. This work presents AgentBug-Smith, an automated harness bug reproduction approach that continuously discovers and reproduces real-world harness bugs from open-source agentic systems. Across different backbone LLMs, AgentBug-Smith consistently outperforms existing bug reproduction techniques designed for general software, achieving 10.67% - 27.56% higher success rates of reproducing harness bugs. By applying AgentBug-Smith to open-source agentic systems in the wild, we construct Live-Harness-Bench, a live and extensible benchmark that currently contains 200 reproducible harness bugs. We further demonstrate the utility of Live-Harness-Bench through two downstream applications. First, we use Live-Harness-Bench as the evaluation benchmark to systematically evaluate state-of-the-art software agents, revealing their limited capabilities in repairing real-world harness bugs. papers.title: It's Not What the Image Shows: Irrelevant Context Destabilises VLM Judges Without Informing Them
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of human annotators, making it important that substitutability tests reflect the model rather than incidental evaluation conditions. We introduce MIST, the Misleading-Image Stress Test: 200 English sentences, each built around a phrase readable either figuratively or literally and shown with an aligned image depicting its reading, a misleading image depicting the opposite, or no image at all. The guidelines require the label to be decided from the sentence alone, so no image should change any answer. We expected each image to pull a judge's labels toward the sense it depicts, and neither kind did. Across thirteen VLM judges, an aligned image changed 20.5% of labels and a misleading one 19.4%, close for every judge and both above the 11.6% produced by deleting the ignore-the-image instruction with the image left in place. Yet only 37% of the labels that differ between the two images moved toward the sense shown, and agreement with our human annotators is unchanged whether the image is absent, aligned or misleading. The effect is smaller in the seven judges that pass the alt-test than in the six that never do, but present in all of them: what moves a judge is that an image is there, not which of the two it is, so a substitutability verdict describes a configuration as much as a model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIST 用 200 个可歧义解读的英文句子配对齐图、误导图或无图，检验 VLM 评审是否被图像内容带偏。13 个 VLM 评审中，对齐图改变 20.5% 标签、误导图 19.4%，均高于仅删除“忽略图像”指令的 11.6%；但两图间差异标签只有 37% 朝所画语义移动，与人工标注的一致度在无图/对齐/误导三种条件下不变。作者结论是：真正左右评审的是“有没有图”，而不是图是哪一张，因此可替代性判定描述的是配置而非模型。
Motivation: VLM 正在替代人类标注员，但可替代性测试可能混入评测条件的偶然效应，而非模型本身的能力；需要区分评审是被图像内容牵引，还是仅被图像存在与否扰动。
Method: 提出 MIST（Misleading-Image Stress Test）：200 个英文句子，每句围绕可作比喻或字面解读的短语构造，分别配对齐图（画出该解读）、误导图（画相反解读）或无图；标注规则要求仅凭句子判定，故任何图像都不应改变答案。在 13 个 VLM 评审上比较三种图像条件，并对照删除“忽略图像”指令但保留图像的设置。
Result: 13 个 VLM 评审中，对齐图改变 20.5% 的标签，误导图改变 19.4%，各评审与两种图之间都接近，均高于删除 ignore-the-image 指令而保留图像的 11.6%。两图之间存在差异的标签中仅 37% 朝图像所画语义移动；与人工标注员的一致度在无图、对齐图、误导图三种条件下不变。通过 alt-test 的 7 个评审效应小于从未通过的 6 个，但所有评审都存在该效应。
Conclusion: 驱动 VLM 评审标签变化的是图像存在本身而非图像内容，因此可替代性结论同时描述模型与评测配置，测试须把图像存在与图像内容分开控制。
Relevance: 1
