papers.title: One Threshold Does Not Fit All Languages: Language-Conditional Deferral for Reliable and Efficient Low-Resource Text Classification
papers.abstract_en: In the Global South, the lower-income countries of Africa, Asia, and Latin America where most of the world's languages are spoken, a deployed text classifier usually runs on ordinary CPUs, serves many languages with a single model, has few labeled examples in any of them, and relies on people to catch its mistakes. Such a system is only useful if it can promise how often it will be wrong: at most a fixed fraction of the labels it assigns on its own may be incorrect, and everything else must go to a person. Split conformal prediction delivers this promise through a single confidence threshold, normally estimated on validation data pooled across languages. We ask whether the promise reaches every language, and it does not. On MasakhaNEWS (16 African languages) and AfriSenti (12 languages plus two never seen in training), a pooled threshold meets the 90% target on average but covers Somali at 77.5%, Tigrinya at 83.7%, and the two unseen languages at 77.5% and 81.2%. Estimating one threshold per language brings every language to between 89.1% and 91.0% without retraining, and it shows how unequal the cost of the promise is: keeping it means sending 43% of Somali news and over 80% of Amharic and Xitsonga tweets to a person, against under 8% of Nigerian Pidgin news. One or two hundred labels per language are enough and the models train in minutes on one CPU core, so the fix is affordable: calibrate, report, and budget human review one language at a time.
papers.comment: Got accepted and published in NeurIPS 2026 GlobalSouthAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多语言低资源文本分类上，全局共享的 split conformal prediction 阈值只在平均意义上满足 90% 覆盖承诺，对 Somali 只有 77.5%、Tigrinya 83.7%、两个训练未见语言 77.5% 与 81.2%。改为按语言分别估计阈值后，所有语言覆盖落到 89.1%–91.0%，代价是 Somali 新闻 43%、Amharic 与 Xitsonga 推文超过 80% 需转人工，而 Nigerian Pidgin 新闻不到 8%。作者的结论是逐语言校准、报告与预算人工复核。
Motivation: 单一模型服务多语言、标注极少的部署场景里，用混合语言验证集估一个全局置信阈值，会让低资源语言系统性达不到承诺的错误率上限，而人工兜底成本在语言间极不均衡。
Method: 用 split conformal prediction 给每个标签设置信阈值，比较两种校准方式：在混合语言验证数据上估一个 pooled 阈值，或按语言分别估计阈值；在 MasakhaNEWS（16 种非洲语言新闻）与 AfriSenti（12 种语言加两种训练未见语言）上检验，目标覆盖 90%，模型在单 CPU 核上训练。
Result: pooled 阈值平均达到 90% 目标，但 Somali 覆盖 77.5%、Tigrinya 83.7%、两个未见语言 77.5% 与 81.2%；逐语言阈值把所有语言拉到 89.1%–91.0% 且无需重训。维持承诺需转人工的比例：Somali 新闻 43%，Amharic 与 Xitsonga 推文超过 80%，Nigerian Pidgin 新闻低于 8%。每语言 100–200 个标签即可，模型在单 CPU 核上几分钟内训完。
Conclusion: 全局阈值的可靠性承诺在语言间不成立，应逐语言校准、报告覆盖并预算人工复核；这一修复的标签与算力成本很低，但人工复核负担在语言间高度不均。

papers.title: Storage Is Not Strategy: State-Conditioned Support Control for LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981, yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35/36. We introduce Intervention Score, which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline (Static-IV). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from +0.431 to +0.848, and SimNPO margins range from +0.503 to +0.571. The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV, the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of +0.165 and +0.0025. The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 遗忘 (unlearning) 中「定位到的参数就是该更新的参数」这一假设被推翻：存储定位分数 AUROC 达 0.981，却只在 36 个目标中的 17 个上选中更优干预，而 LoRA 在 35/36 上获胜。作者提出按实际遗忘更新的预测效果并计入副作用来排序的 Intervention Score，以及仅在校准探针给出理由时才重排子集的 DIR-R；在 LACUNA 上 NPO 边际 +0.431 至 +0.848、SimNPO +0.503 至 +0.571。
Motivation: 局部化 LLM 遗忘方法从定位信号选出一小撮参数并全程固定，但与目标关联最强的参数未必是最适合更新的，且候选干预的价值会随优化推进而变化。
Method: 提出 Intervention Score，按实际遗忘更新的预测效果对可编辑参数组排序并计入 collateral damage，构成静态基线 Static-IV；再提出 selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R)，仅当校准探针 (calibrated probe) 支持比较时才重访该子集。评测用 Natural-TOFU 与 LACUNA 定位精度基准，覆盖 NPO、SimNPO、GradDiff 目标。
Result: 存储定位分数 AUROC 0.981，但存储身份仅在 36 个目标中的 17 个上与更优干预一致，LoRA 在 35/36 上获胜。Natural-TOFU 上方法与目标两两比较 20 组中 19 组描述性边际为正，若干接近零。LACUNA 上六组 NPO 与 SimNPO 比较的平均终端效用全部更高：NPO 边际 +0.431 到 +0.848，SimNPO +0.503 到 +0.571。GradDiff 相对 Static-IV 的四字段主评测为六胜六平零负，配对增益均值 +0.165、中位数 +0.0025，且存在明显字段依赖。
Conclusion: 定位、初始干预选择、以及随 checkpoint 变化的支持集修订应当分开处理；高定位精度不等于选对了可更新参数，动态重排只在校准探针给出理由时才值得做。

papers.title: Active Budget Can Kill Sensitivity: Diagnosing and Repairing TopK Sparse Autoencoder Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly scaled to wider dictionaries to recover fine-grained structure from large language model activations. However, a feature is useful for interpretation only if it remains a stable unit of analysis when the same meaning is expressed in different surface forms. We study this reliability question for TopK SAEs via feature sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that scaling selectively reduces the sensitivity of rare features, while common features remain comparatively stable. A controlled width\(\times k\) factorial experiment identifies the active budget k as the root cause: the degradation arises from the selection boundary rather than dictionary width alone. We attribute this failure to the geometry of TopK selection. The active margin, the distance to the cutoff, predicts feature loss without thresholds. Guided by this margin diagnosis, we introduce pairwise rank stabilization. Our method targets ordering failures at the cutoff and improves rare-feature sensitivity by \(8.83\) percentage points, while keeping reconstruction and alive-feature coverage near the baseline. Overall, our results suggest that wide TopK SAEs should be evaluated not only by reconstruction, sparsity, and feature count, but also by feature reliability under semantic variation and boundary geometry for stable interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopK SAE 扩宽字典会降低稀有特征对同义改写的敏感度，受控 width×k 因子实验把根因定位到 active budget k 的选择边界而非字典宽度本身。用不设阈值的 active margin（到截断点的距离）诊断后施加 pairwise rank stabilization，稀有特征敏感度提升 8.83 个百分点，重建与 alive 特征覆盖基本保持基线水平。
Motivation: SAE 特征只有在同义不同表述下仍是稳定分析单元时才可用于可解释性，而 TopK SAE 扩宽字典后稀有特征的这种可靠性会退化，现有评估只看重建、稀疏度和特征数，抓不到这一失效。
Method: 以 feature sensitivity 度量特征对语义变体的稳定性，做受控的 width×k 因子实验分离字典宽度与 active budget 的作用，并归因到 TopK 选择的几何；提出 pairwise rank stabilization，直接针对截断点处的排序失效，用 active margin 作为无需阈值的特征丢失预测量。
Result: 扩宽字典选择性降低稀有特征敏感度，常见特征相对稳定；width×k 因子实验把退化归因于 active budget k 的选择边界而非字典宽度；pairwise rank stabilization 使稀有特征敏感度提升 8.83 个百分点，同时重建与 alive 特征覆盖接近基线。
Conclusion: 宽 TopK SAE 的评估应加入语义变体下的特征可靠性与边界几何，而不只看重建、稀疏度和特征数；失效根源在截断边界而非宽度本身。

papers.title: HandAnthro: Automated Hand Anthropometry from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: Hand anthropometry supports protective-glove design, but existing measurement methods often require trained operators, specialized hardware, or manual landmarking. We present HandAnthro, which estimates 44 projected hand dimensions from a smartphone photograph of a palm-up hand on US letter-size paper. The pipeline reconstructs wrist-occluded paper boundaries for rectification, whitens non-hand pixels, and refines 41 anthropometry-specific landmarks from a fine-tuned You Only Look Once (YOLO) pose model using image-specific geometry and contours. Controlled evaluation comprised 720 captures from 45 held-out participants, each contributing 16 images across two smartphones, two backgrounds, two angles, and two nominal illumination settings. HandAnthro produced complete outputs for 704 captures (97.8%); among these, mean absolute error (MAE) was 3.80 mm per dimension against two trained operators' caliper measurements. Regional MAEs were 2.48 mm for non-thumb fingers, 6.04 mm for thumbs, and 6.17 mm for palm and wrist. In a researcher-assisted mobile-app pilot, automated batch processing returned all 44 dimensions for 260 of 268 retained, researcher-screened firefighter images (97.0%). A descriptive, unpaired comparison with an independent national firefighter reference yielded a mean absolute difference of 2.40 mm across 28 sex-by-dimension group-mean contrasts. These results characterize controlled measurement performance and researcher-assisted field feasibility for future distributed hand-anthropometry studies.
papers.comment: 21 pages, including 7 pages of main text and references and 14 pages of supplementary material

TL;DR: HandAnthro 用单张掌心朝上手机照片自动测出 44 项手部尺寸：先重建被手腕遮挡的纸张边界做校正、白化非手部像素，再用微调的 YOLO 姿态模型加图像几何与轮廓精修 41 个测量点。在 45 名留出受试者 720 次拍摄中，704 次（97.8%）给出完整输出，逐维 MAE 3.80 mm（对照两名训练操作者的卡尺测量），消防员手机 App 试点 268 张图中 260 张（97.0%）返回全部 44 维。
Motivation: 手套设计依赖手部人体测量，但现有方法需要受训操作者、专用设备或手工标点，难以大规模采集。
Method: 输入为 US letter 纸上掌心朝上的单张手机照片：重建被手腕遮挡的纸边界做透视校正，白化非手部像素，再用微调的 YOLO pose 模型输出 41 个人体测量专用 landmark，并结合图像特有几何与轮廓精修，最终估计 44 项投影手部尺寸。
Result: 受控评测含 45 名留出受试者 720 次拍摄（两部手机、两种背景、两个角度、两种标称光照，每人 16 张）；704 次（97.8%）输出完整，逐维 MAE 3.80 mm（对照两名训练操作者卡尺）；分区 MAE：非拇指手指 2.48 mm、拇指 6.04 mm、手掌与腕 6.17 mm。研究者协助的手机 App 试点中，268 张经筛查的消防员图像有 260 张（97.0%）返回全部 44 维；与独立全国消防员参考的 28 个性别×维度组均值对比，平均绝对差 2.40 mm。
Conclusion: 单张手机照片可在受控条件下达到接近卡尺的测量精度，并在研究者协助的消防员现场数据上显示分布式手部测量的可行性；拇指与掌腕区域误差明显高于其他手指。

papers.title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reliable FP8 attention remains a barrier to fully native 8-bit large language model training. We derive how forward-backward inconsistencies produce stale delta and empirically show how it distorts training dynamics. Our stale-delta hybrid runs show a modest loss gap at 569M parameters but substantial loss increases and downstream degradation at 1.67B and 5.29B. QK normalization, NoPE (no positional encoding), and lower-learning-rate context extension mitigate or delay degradation without eliminating it. This pattern suggests accumulated optimization error that smaller models and short runs can conceal. We propose Delta-Matching, proving that it restores the softmax gradient's zero-row-sum invariant under the stated numerical assumptions. It enables native block-scaled FP8 in every forward and backward attention-core matmul without architectural changes, smaller global batches, or auxiliary forward outputs. Across tested architectures, scales, and training stages, Delta-Matching matches BF16/FP32 mixed-precision training loss and overall downstream performance. We will release our implementation, trained models, and data recipes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Delta-Matching 修复 FP8 attention 前后向不一致导致的 stale delta，证明其恢复 softmax 梯度的零行和不变量，使每个 attention-core matmul 都能原生用 block-scaled FP8 而不改结构、不加大 global batch、不额外存 forward 输出。在测试的架构、scale 与训练阶段上，训练 loss 与下游表现追平 BF16/FP32 混合精度。
Motivation: FP8 attention 的前向-反向不一致会累积成 stale delta 并扭曲训练动态，使 LLM 无法完全原生 8-bit 训练；小模型和短 run 会掩盖这一退化。
Method: 先推导前向-反向不一致如何产生 stale delta，并用 stale-delta 混合实验观察其对训练动态的影响；再提出 Delta-Matching，在给定数值假设下证明它恢复 softmax 梯度的零行和不变量，从而在不改架构、不加 global batch、不产生额外 forward 输出的前提下，让每个前向与反向 attention-core matmul 都用 block-scaled FP8。
Result: stale-delta 混合训练在 569M 参数上只有 modest loss gap，在 1.67B 与 5.29B 上出现明显 loss 上升和下游退化；QK normalization、NoPE（无位置编码）和更低学习率的 context extension 能缓解或推迟退化但不能消除。Delta-Matching 在所测架构、scale 与训练阶段上匹配 BF16/FP32 混合精度的训练 loss 与整体下游表现。
Conclusion: stale delta 是随规模与训练时长累积的优化误差，小模型短 run 会掩盖它；Delta-Matching 让原生 block-scaled FP8 attention 训练达到混合精度水平，实现将开源。

papers.title: FlowMap-OPD: Rollout--Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators
papers.abstract_en: Few-step flow-map generators, including MeanFlow and consistency models, enable efficient sampling through long-range transport, yet their on-policy distillation remains underexplored. We introduce FlowMap-OPD, an on-policy distillation framework that separates student-state acquisition from teacher--student distribution comparison. A formulation based on state marginals establishes this separation, while flow--velocity consistency connects local supervision to the deployed long-range map. Within this framework, we develop flow-map, induced-velocity, and instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision, each paired with a separately specified native flow-map rollout. Cross-capacity ImageNet experiments across three teacher rewards identify instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision with independently tunable student consistency as the most effective choice. In text-to-image experiments, FlowMap-OPD demonstrates strong multi-specialist consolidation capabilities and surpasses multi-reward Flow-Map GRPO in task performance and convergence speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowMap-OPD 把少步 flow-map 生成器（MeanFlow、consistency models）的 on-policy 蒸馏拆成学生状态获取与师生分布比较两步，用 state marginal 形式化该分离，并以 flow–velocity consistency 把局部监督接到部署用的长程映射上。在跨容量 ImageNet 三教师奖励实验中，instantaneous-velocity 分布监督加可独立调节的学生一致性最有效；文生图上其多专家合并在任务性能与收敛速度上超过 multi-reward Flow-Map GRPO。
Motivation: MeanFlow 与 consistency models 等少步 flow-map 生成器能靠长程输运高效采样，但其 on-policy 蒸馏环节研究不足，缺少把状态获取与分布比较分开的监督设计。
Method: 基于 state marginals 的表述把学生状态获取与师生分布比较解耦，用 flow–velocity consistency 将局部监督与部署时的长程 flow map 连接；框架内给出 flow-map、induced-velocity、instantaneous-velocity 三种分布监督，各自配一个单独指定的 native flow-map rollout，并让学生一致性可独立调节。
Result: 跨容量 ImageNet 上、覆盖三种教师奖励的实验中，instantaneous-velocity 分布监督配独立可调学生一致性被识别为最有效选择；在文生图任务上，FlowMap-OPD 在任务性能与收敛速度两方面均超过 multi-reward Flow-Map GRPO，并展现较强的多专家整合能力。
Conclusion: 把状态获取与分布比较分离、并让监督速度量与学生一致性独立可调，是少步 flow-map 生成器 on-policy 蒸馏更有效的配方，且能用于把多个奖励专家合并为单模型。

papers.title: RelayVSR: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Efficient Real-World Video Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Large generative models can recover realistic detail in real-world video super-resolution (VSR), but processing an entire video with them is computationally expensive. In this work, we present RelayVSR, a streaming VSR framework built on the Sparse Generative Relay mechanism. A large generative model generates reference latents for sparse keyframes, while a lightweight VSR network uses these references and low-resolution video to super-resolve every frame. The lightweight VSR network, implemented as a Dual-Memory Video Transformer, reuses keyframe information across frames and updates recent video context, supporting first-keyframe conditioning and dual-endpoint conditioning with bounded lookahead. However, errors in shared keyframes can propagate and accumulate across output frames, making keyframe quality alone an insufficient optimization target. We address this collaboration gap with Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO), which uses reinforcement learning to update the large generative model with two reward levels: a system-level reward evaluates videos produced by the fixed lightweight VSR network, while a reference-level reward evaluates decoded keyframe quality. VARO improves final video quality over direct joint training, and its dual-level rewards outperform a system-level reward alone. At 1080p on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB, dual-endpoint RelayVSR with a 15-frame keyframe interval reaches 29.29 FPS, 13.82 GB peak GPU memory, and 0.327 s first-frame model latency, compared with 7.80 FPS, 24.447 GB, and 2.83 s for FlashVSR-Tiny. The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/RelayVSR.
papers.comment: The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/RelayVSR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RelayVSR 把大生成模型只用在稀疏关键帧上生成参考 latent，轻量 Dual-Memory Video Transformer 借参考与低分辨率视频逐帧超分，从而把 1080p 实时 VSR 的开销压下来。用 Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO) 的双层奖励（系统级 + 参考级）强化学习更新大模型，最终视频质量优于直接联合训练，且双层奖励优于仅系统级奖励。
Motivation: 大生成模型能恢复真实感细节但整段视频处理代价过高；而共享关键帧的误差会在输出帧间传播累积，只优化关键帧质量不足以保证最终视频质量。
Method: Sparse Generative Relay：大生成模型为稀疏关键帧生成参考 latent，轻量 VSR 网络（Dual-Memory Video Transformer，跨帧复用关键帧信息并更新近期上下文，支持 first-keyframe 与 bounded lookahead 的 dual-endpoint 条件）超分每一帧；再用 VARO 以强化学习更新大模型，奖励分系统级（评估固定轻量网络产出的视频）与参考级（评估解码关键帧质量）两层。
Result: 在单张 NVIDIA A100 80GB 的 1080p 上，dual-endpoint RelayVSR 关键帧间隔 15 帧达 29.29 FPS、峰值显存 13.82 GB、首帧模型延迟 0.327 s；对比 FlashVSR-Tiny 的 7.80 FPS、24.447 GB、2.83 s。VARO 提升最终视频质量并优于直接联合训练，双层奖励优于仅系统级奖励。
Conclusion: 大小模型分工 + 关键帧参考的流式 VSR 能在 1080p 实时下同时降显存与首帧延迟，且关键帧质量需用系统级与参考级双层奖励共同优化而非单独优化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: Sparse Generative Relay：大生成模型为稀疏关键帧生成参考 latent，轻量 VSR 网络（Dual-Memory Video Transformer，跨帧复用关键帧信息并更新近期上下文，支持 first-keyframe 与 bounded lookahead 的 dual-endpoint 条件）超分每一帧；再用 VARO 以强化学习更新大模型，奖励分系统级（评估固定轻量网络产出的视频）与参考级（评估解码关键帧质量）两层。
summary_sections.result: 在单张 NVIDIA A100 80GB 的 1080p 上，dual-endpoint RelayVSR 关键帧间隔 15 帧达 29.29 FPS、峰值显存 13.82 GB、首帧模型延迟 0.327 s；对比 FlashVSR-Tiny 的 7.80 FPS、24.447 GB、2.83 s。VARO 提升最终视频质量并优于直接联合训练，双层奖励优于仅系统级奖励。
summary_sections.conclusion: 大小模型分工 + 关键帧参考的流式 VSR 能在 1080p 实时下同时降显存与首帧延迟，且关键帧质量需用系统级与参考级双层奖励共同优化而非单独优化。

papers.title: Is manual software optimization a thing of the past?
papers.abstract_en: Scientific software is increasingly required to process larger datasets while maintaining acceptable execution times. Software optimization traditionally requires substantial expertise in programming, algorithms, and numerical methods. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer the possibility of automating much of this process. We investigate whether LLM-based agents can autonomously achieve substantial performance improvements in scientific software, including mature implementations that have already been extensively optimized by human developers. We tasked an LLM-based agent with optimizing software for three computational problems: t-SNE, single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), and graphlet counting. Humans defined the scope, correctness criteria, and a verification mechanism, after which the agent worked autonomously, in some cases for several hours. Code maintainers reviewed each resulting implementation and verified its correctness. The optimized implementations were faster in all tested configurations, by up to two orders of magnitude over the fastest existing tools. The improvements included low-level code optimizations, mathematical reformulations, and an entirely new algorithm for graphlet counting. Software optimization can increasingly be delegated to autonomous agents, with the human role shifting from implementing optimizations to deciding which software to optimize, defining objectives, providing verification mechanisms, and ensuring the correctness of the final software. For well-scoped, verifiable problems, we argue that manual software optimization may be a thing of the past.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 智能体在人类只负责划定范围、正确性判据与验证机制的前提下，自主优化三个科学计算任务（t-SNE、ssGSEA、graphlet counting）的成熟实现，全部测试配置下均更快，最高比现有最快工具快两个数量级。作者主张：对范围清晰、可验证的问题，手动软件优化可能成为过去式，人的角色转为决定优化对象、定义目标与把关正确性。
Motivation: 科学软件要处理更大数据集且保持可接受运行时间，而传统优化依赖编程、算法与数值方法的深厚经验；即便已被人类反复优化的成熟实现，也仍有大幅提速空间。
Method: 让 LLM 智能体自主优化三个计算问题的软件：t-SNE、单样本基因集富集分析 (ssGSEA)、graphlet counting；人类事先定义优化范围、正确性判据与验证机制，智能体随后自主工作（个别案例持续数小时），产出实现由代码维护者评审并验证正确性。
Result: 在全部测试配置中优化后的实现都更快，相对现有最快工具最高提速达两个数量级（100×）；改进涵盖底层代码优化、数学重构，以及一个全新的 graphlet counting 算法。
Conclusion: 对范围界定清晰、可验证的问题，软件优化可以越来越多地交给自主智能体，人的工作从亲自实现优化转向选定对象、设定目标、提供验证机制并保证最终正确性。

papers.title: Evaluation Choices Shape Biomedical ML Claims: A Pediatric Pneumonia Benchmark Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical machine learning papers often compress model performance into one headline number. That number can look like a property of the model even when it depends strongly on how the benchmark was evaluated. We study this problem on the widely used Kermany pediatric chest radiograph dataset using nine image classifiers and a controlled evaluation protocol. Under the same protocol, the eight pretrained backbones differ by only 0.026 AUROC. In contrast, changing whether the backbone is frozen or fine-tuned changes AUROC by 0.044 on average, and changing the decision threshold changes balanced accuracy by 0.090 on average. The official test split is also measurably different from the training pool: a partition classifier distinguishes them at AUC 0.697, rising to 0.898 for normal radiographs. Most strikingly, a classifier using only file properties, with no image anatomy, reaches 0.992 balanced accuracy within the training pool but falls to 0.496 on the official test split. Validation-fitted thresholds and calibration also transfer imperfectly. These results show that a high benchmark score can support different conclusions when the split, training policy, threshold, metric, calibration, and uncertainty are not communicated with it. We end with a seven-item reporting recommendation in which each item is tied to an effect measured in the study

TL;DR: 在 Kermany 儿科胸片数据集上用九个图像分类器做受控评估，发现同一协议下八个预训练 backbone 的 AUROC 只差 0.026，而冻结/微调策略平均改变 AUROC 0.044、决策阈值平均改变 balanced accuracy 0.090。只看文件属性、完全不看图像内容的分类器在训练池内达到 0.992 balanced accuracy，换到官方测试集却跌到 0.496。作者据此给出七项报告建议，每项都绑定本研究测到的效应。

papers.title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection
papers.abstract_en: Influence functions estimate how individual training examples affect the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Analyzing how training data influence different behaviors of an LLM involves repeated influence computation. Reusing stored training gradients reduces the computational cost, but storing full gradients is prohibitively expensive at LLM scale. We study how to compress these gradients while preserving influence estimates for future queries that are unknown at storage time. Through a worst-case analysis, we characterize the optimal fixed-dimensional linear representation and propose eigenbasis-corrected one-bit gradient projection (EOGP) to approximate it at scale. Specifically, EOGP uses EK-FAC to reduce gradient dimensionality, then applies PCA within the retained subspace to learn compression directions from the training gradients. We then apply one-bit quantization to the resulting coordinates, allowing more coordinates to be retained within a fixed storage budget. On GPT-2, EOGP predicts retraining outcomes more accurately than the evaluated compression baselines while using one-sixteenth of their per-example storage. On OLMo 2 SFT models from 1B to 32B parameters, EOGP remains competitive with the baselines allocated over 100 times as much storage per example.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 影响函数 (influence function) 需反复重算梯度、而全梯度存储不可行的问题，提出 EOGP：先用 EK-FAC 降维，再在保留子空间内用 PCA 学压缩方向，最后对坐标做 one-bit 量化。GPT-2 上其重训结果预测精度高于所评压缩基线，且每样本存储仅为基线的 1/16；OLMo 2 SFT（1B–32B）上可与每样本存储多 100 倍以上的基线竞争。
Motivation: 影响函数要反复计算以分析训练样本对 LLM 行为的作用，复用已存训练梯度可降本，但 LLM 规模下存全梯度代价过高；且压缩必须在存储时未知未来查询的条件下保住影响估计。
Method: 先做最坏情形分析，刻画最优的定维线性表示；EOGP 用 EK-FAC 降低梯度维度，在保留子空间内对训练梯度做 PCA 学习压缩方向，再对所得坐标施加 one-bit 量化，从而在固定存储预算下保留更多坐标。
Result: GPT-2 上 EOGP 预测重训结果比所评估的压缩基线更准，而每样本存储只有基线的 1/16；OLMo 2 SFT（1B 到 32B 参数）上，EOGP 与每样本存储多出 100 倍以上的基线仍有竞争力。
Conclusion: 在最坏情形最优线性表示指导下，EK-FAC 加 PCA 再 one-bit 量化可以在极小存储预算下保住影响函数对未来查询的可用性。

papers.title: Counterfactual Probing for Parallel Unmasking with Hidden Forest Structure
papers.abstract_en: Masked generative models offer parallel token prediction, but accurate parallel sampling must account for dependencies among tokens. When dependencies are unknown, finding safe batches also costs model evaluations. We study whether total evaluations, including discovery, can be sublinear in sequence length $N$; sublinear sequential depth then follows. We consider discrete distributions with hidden forest structure, accessed through a fixed approximate conditional oracle. Under explicit regularity conditions and uniform Hellinger error bounds, for any fixed target accuracy $\varepsilon\in (0,1/8]$ and sufficiently large $N$, our sampler achieves seed-averaged total-variation error at most $\varepsilon$, with total masked-state submissions and sequential depth both bounded by $O(N^C \varepsilon^a)$ for constants $0 <C <1$ and $a > 0$. These guarantees use polynomial vocabulary size and an edge-response lower bound set by $N$ and $\varepsilon$. The sampler shares evaluations of hypothetical reveals across dependence tests to identify safe parallel batches without requiring full recovery of the hidden forest. A tunable parameter trades probing cost against irreversible commit rounds. In the same class, any admissible irreversible product-commit sampler attaining the same seed-averaged accuracy requires $Ω(N^c \varepsilon^b)$ counterfactual submissions or commit rounds in the worst case, for constants $c,b>0$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在隐藏森林结构的离散分布上，用固定近似条件 oracle 做反事实探测 (counterfactual probing)，共享假设揭示的评估来识别可安全并行 unmask 的批次，使掩码生成模型的总评估次数与串行深度同时达到次线性 O(N^C ε^a)（0<C<1）。对任意固定目标精度 ε∈(0,1/8] 与足够大的 N，seed 平均 TV 误差不超过 ε；且同类中任何达到同精度的不可逆 product-commit 采样器在最坏情形需要 Ω(N^c ε^b) 次反事实提交或提交轮。
Motivation: 掩码生成模型并行采样必须处理 token 间依赖，而依赖未知时寻找安全批次本身要花模型评估；作者要判定含发现成本在内的总评估次数能否对序列长度 N 次线性，从而得到次线性的串行深度。
Method: 设定为带隐藏森林结构 (hidden forest structure) 的离散分布，只能通过固定近似条件 oracle 访问；在显式正则条件与统一 Hellinger 误差界下，采样器跨依赖测试共享对假设揭示 (hypothetical reveals) 的评估来找出安全并行批次，无需完全恢复隐藏森林，并用一个可调参数在探测成本与不可逆提交轮之间做权衡。
Result: 对任意固定 ε∈(0,1/8] 与足够大的 N，seed 平均 total-variation 误差 ≤ ε，掩码状态提交总数与串行深度均为 O(N^C ε^a)（0<C<1，a>0），依赖多项式词表规模与由 N、ε 设定的 edge-response 下界；下界方面，同类中任何达标不可逆 product-commit 采样器最坏情形需 Ω(N^c ε^b) 次反事实提交或提交轮（c,b>0）。
Conclusion: 在隐藏森林结构加近似条件 oracle 的假设下，含发现成本的并行 unmasking 可以做到次线性总评估与串行深度，且该量级在同类不可逆提交采样器中是最坏情形最优的。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Behavioral Convergence Without Representational Convergence: Persistent Training-History Dependence in Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks trained toward the same final objective can reach similar predictive performance while retaining internal representations shaped by earlier training history. We study this effect using controlled sequential-training experiments in which paired convolutional networks start from identical weights, experience reversed task orders, and then receive the same deterministic common-relaxation distribution. Across 20 paired MNIST runs, 16 satisfy a predeclared behavioral-matching criterion, yet their matched representations retain a mean history score of 0.139 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.127-0.153) and approximately 3.1% prediction disagreement. Extending common relaxation to 50,000 optimizer updates does not erase the measured difference: across five paired seeds, the representation-history score remains 0.190 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.161-0.219) at the end of the measured horizon while the mean accuracy gap is only 0.18 percentage points. Fresh linear probes show that, with sufficient labeled data, the two histories retain practically equivalent linearly accessible class information. A same-label rotated-MNIST control reproduces the effect: all five paired seeds reach behavioral matching while retaining a mean representation-history score of 0.162. Finally, a matched-learning-rate ReLU-LeakyReLU control reduces the 50,000-update representation residue by 0.040 on average in all five paired seeds, providing directional evidence that activation-mediated plasticity contributes to the persistence of training-history effects. These results provide protocol-scoped evidence that behavioral convergence need not imply representational convergence and that optimization history can leave measurable internal traces after prolonged common training.

papers.title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected branch head for each new input before execution. Across mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, our system achieves relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data. These results show that evolving branch objectives and proposal policies can yield complementary harnesses whose strengths a router combines without access to test outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 agent harness 的递归自改进 (RSI) 搜索拆成多条分支，每条分支用演化中的开发子集与提案策略，再用 router 按输入挑选分支头。相对 Meta-Harness，Olympiad 数学推理提升 34.8%，Terminal-Bench 2.0 提升 11.6%，SWE-bench Lite 提升 3.8%，且选择只用开发集数据。
Motivation: Meta-Harness 一类方法固定开发集与单一提案策略，搜索被压在一条轨迹上，容易收敛到局部最优。
Method: 按分支组织搜索：每条分支保留被本分支领先 harness 解出、而较少被其他分支解出的开发样例，丢弃所有分支领先 harness 都解出的样例，并依据自身搜索历史修订提案策略；部署时用 router 对每个新输入先选一个开发集选出的分支头再执行。
Result: 在数学推理与 agentic coding 基准上，相对 Meta-Harness 的相对提升为：Olympiad 级数学推理 34.8%，Terminal-Bench 2.0 11.6%，SWE-bench Lite 3.8%；harness 选择与 router 配置仅基于开发数据。
Conclusion: 演化分支目标与提案策略能产生互补 harness，由 router 组合其强项即可获益，且无需访问测试结果。

papers.title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?
papers.abstract_en: Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back. Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Certo（Qwen3-4B 的非生成式决策模型）把候选打分改为可缓存的独立编码后，规则敏感性从 recall@1 1.00 崩到 0.24，而联合打分器保持 1.00；针对性反事实监督能在合成规则任务上恢复强表现，但迁移到未见过来源的真实规则未被证实。真实规则短档上联合打分器 0.861 对 0.500 显著占优，硬档 0.655 对 0.483（n=29）方向性占优；匹配的跨域真实散文混合数据反而使合同准确率下降 9.3 与 16.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 联合打分器把状态、规则与候选一起编码，成本随候选菜单规模增长；独立编码可让每个候选只编码一次并在不同状态间复用（77 个候选时约便宜 5 倍），但把状态与候选割裂，规则敏感性能否保住、能否训练回来尚不清楚。
Method: 在 Certo 上做四个实验：对比可缓存的独立编码打分与联合打分器，并测试 shortlist+rerank 补救；用针对性反事实监督（counterfactual supervision）在合成规则任务（paraphrase、counterfactual、composition）上训练，跨种子复现；在真实规则上分短档与硬档评测，并修正一个截断混淆（truncation confound）；另加一组匹配的跨域真实散文混合数据检验迁移。
Result: 可缓存转换使 recall@1 从 1.00 掉到 0.24，联合打分器保持 1.00，shortlist+rerank 补救失败；反事实监督在留出的合成规则任务上恢复强表现且跨种子可复现，但未隔离预测是否真的依赖所给规则；真实规则上修正截断混淆后联合打分器短档 0.861 对 0.500 显著胜出，硬档 0.655 对 0.483（n=29）方向性胜出；跨域真实散文混合使合同准确率下降 9.3 与 16.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 可缓存编码器能在其训练分布上被训练成规则敏感，但向未见来源的真实规则迁移未被证实；联合打分器以放弃缓存为代价保住优势。

papers.title: ReCaVSR: One-Step Streaming Diffusion Video Super-Resolution with Recycled Latents and Learned Cache Routing
papers.abstract_en: Real-time diffusion-based video super-resolution (VSR) is in high demand for online streaming, yet stringent latency requirements often compromise generative fidelity. We propose ReCaVSR, a Wan2.2-based, one-step framework for streaming VSR that builds on two observations: recycled SR latents retain local temporal context, reducing the need for full historical Key-Value (KV) caches; and individual transformer layers benefit from distinct temporal scopes. ReCaVSR combines three complementary designs: (i) layer-wise cache routing with recycled SR latents: each DiT layer learns its KV-cache temporal scope under a cache budget and exports a static inference schedule, while recycled SR latents propagate local context by conditioning each new block on the model's own preceding predictions. (ii) Multi-Scope Query (MSQ) Discriminator: a compositional discriminator combining global, spatial-window, and temporal-tube feedback for holistic realism, local texture generation, and temporal stability. (iii) LR-conditioned adaptation of FlashDecoder: a VAE decoder that incorporates LR observations for efficient latent decoding. ReCaVSR enables streaming VSR without iterative sampling or full historical KV-cache materialization. Experiments on synthetic and real-world VSR benchmarks show better perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and streaming efficiency than representative VSR baselines. At $1080{\times}1920$ output resolution on a single NVIDIA A100-80GB, ReCaVSR achieves 21.20 FPS with 15.16 GB peak allocated GPU memory, running 2.72$\times$ faster while using 38.0\% less peak allocated memory than FlashVSR Tiny. The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/ReCaVSR.
papers.comment: The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/ReCaVSR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCaVSR 是基于 Wan2.2 的单步流式扩散视频超分辨率框架：逐层 KV-cache 路由让每个 DiT 层在缓存预算下学习自己的时间范围并导出静态推理调度，配合回收的 SR latent 传播局部上下文，再加 Multi-Scope Query 判别器与 LR 条件化的 FlashDecoder。在 1080×1920、单张 A100-80GB 上达 21.20 FPS、峰值显存 15.16 GB，比 FlashVSR Tiny 快 2.72×、峰值显存少 38.0%。
Motivation: 在线流式视频超分辨率对延迟极严，扩散模型的迭代采样与全历史 KV-cache 使生成保真度与实时性难以兼得。
Method: 三项设计：逐层 cache routing——每个 DiT 层在缓存预算下学习 KV-cache 时间范围并导出静态推理调度，同时用回收的 SR latent 以模型自身前序预测作为条件传播局部上下文；Multi-Scope Query (MSQ) 判别器组合全局、空间窗口与时间管三种反馈；LR-conditioned FlashDecoder 在 VAE 解码中引入 LR 观测。整体为单步、无迭代采样、无全历史 KV-cache 物化的流式 VSR。
Result: 在合成与真实 VSR benchmark 上，感知质量、时间一致性与流式效率均优于代表性 VSR 基线；1080×1920 输出、单张 NVIDIA A100-80GB 下 21.20 FPS、峰值分配显存 15.16 GB，相比 FlashVSR Tiny 快 2.72×、峰值显存少 38.0%。
Conclusion: 把 KV-cache 时间范围按层分配并复用自身预测的 latent，可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下让扩散式流式 VSR 达到实时帧率与更低显存占用。

papers.title: DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. DIET selects retained experts by minimizing Overall Diversity Loss (ODL), which preserves directional coverage in signature space, and combines intra-layer local search with an inter-layer regression-guided budget search to allocate experts across layers. On LingBot-Video 30B-A3B, pruning 50% of experts (6,144 to 3,072) reduces the checkpoint from 57 GB to 30 GB and enables single-card deployment on a 48 GB GPU without fine-tuning. Under a fixed 284-case VBench protocol, the VBench Total increases from 0.7941 to 0.8115. Across tested retention budgets, DIET consistently outperforms competitive pruning baselines adapted from large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIET 是面向视频 diffusion transformer (DiT) MoE 的免训练专家剪枝框架：一次全专家校准记录匹配的条件/无条件 token 的专家输出与路由状态，之后候选删除全部从缓存张量回放，不再前向。在 LingBot-Video 30B-A3B 上剪掉 50% 专家（6,144→3,072）后 checkpoint 从 57 GB 降到 30 GB，可在 48 GB 单卡免微调部署，固定 284 例 VBench 协议下 VBench Total 从 0.7941 升到 0.8115。
Motivation: 视频 DiT 用 MoE 降低活跃计算，但全量专家存储仍然昂贵；现有一次性剪枝准则依赖静态激活或路由统计，捕捉不到删除专家后的层内重路由。
Method: 单次全专家校准 pass 记录匹配条件/无条件 token 的专家输出与 router 状态，候选删除从缓存张量回放，无需额外前向；用删除响应签名刻画每个专家，按最小化 Overall Diversity Loss (ODL) 保留签名空间的方向覆盖，再用层内局部搜索加跨层回归引导的预算搜索分配各层专家数。
Result: LingBot-Video 30B-A3B 上剪枝 50% 专家（6,144→3,072），checkpoint 57 GB→30 GB，可在 48 GB 单卡免微调部署；固定 284 例 VBench 协议下 VBench Total 0.7941→0.8115；在测试过的各保留预算上均优于从大语言模型改造的竞争性剪枝基线。

papers.title: Privy to the Foil: Recasting Value Estimation with a Self-Privileged Critic for RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Assigning credit to intermediate steps remains a central challenge in training Large Language Models (LLMs) on multi-step reasoning tasks with sparse terminal rewards, and actor-critic methods such as PPO address this by learning value functions to construct token-level advantages. Their effectiveness, however, hinges on reliable value estimation, a difficult task requiring the critic to both assess progress toward a correct solution and anticipate an evolving policy's future behavior; errors in either can compromise credit assignment and destabilize online training. In this paper, we revisit the standard state-only formulation of value estimation and propose $π$PPO, a self-privileged actor-critic framework. By reusing verified same-prompt rollouts as contrastive evidence, $π$PPO helps the critic assess intermediate reasoning against successful and failed attempts, while preserving standard policy optimization and the deployment interface. Experiments show that $π$PPO consistently improves value-estimation quality by a substantial margin and outperforms representative actor-critic and critic-free RLVR baselines on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while remaining effective even when paired with substantially smaller asymmetric critics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: πPPO 把同一 prompt 下已验证的成功/失败 rollout 作为对比证据喂给 critic，让价值估计同时参照两条轨迹判断中间推理步的进展，从而改善稀疏终端奖励下的 credit assignment。在数学推理基准上，它稳定提升价值估计质量并超过代表性 actor-critic 与 critic-free RLVR 基线，且配更小的非对称 critic 仍有效。
Motivation: 多步推理任务只有稀疏终端奖励，PPO 类方法依赖 critic 估计 token 级 advantage，但 critic 既要判断当前进展又要预判不断演化的策略未来行为，任一出错都会破坏 credit assignment 并使在线训练不稳。
Method: πPPO 是 self-privileged actor-critic 框架，重访价值估计的 state-only 形式：复用同一 prompt 下已验证的 rollout 作为对比证据，让 critic 对照成功与失败尝试评估中间推理步；策略优化与部署接口保持标准形式，critic 可为非对称的小模型。
Result: 实验显示 πPPO 在价值估计质量上持续有大幅改善，并在有挑战的数学推理基准上超过有代表性的 actor-critic 与 critic-free RLVR 基线；即使配对规模小得多的非对称 critic 仍然有效。
Conclusion: 给 critic 引入同 prompt 的已验证对比轨迹能同时抬高价值估计可靠性与 RLVR 最终表现，且这一收益不依赖大 critic。

papers.title: The Geometry of Inference in Transformer Residual Streams
papers.abstract_en: Transformer language models build predictions through successive residual updates, but how their representations become specific to an eventual outcome remains unclear. We study this process by comparing intermediate residual states with their own final states and an empirical bank of final states from other contexts. Across six pretrained language models, the own endpoint becomes preferable to the average alternative early, while many individual endpoints remain closer. These competing sets generally shrink with depth, but their membership changes and their surviving endpoints need not become more similar to one another. Directional alignment and endpoint rank can therefore improve while Euclidean distance to the final state changes little. We develop a simple high-dimensional model that separates the roles of norm, alignment, and endpoint geometry, showing how gradual directional changes can produce sharp reductions in competition. We also prove that a straight path toward the own endpoint cannot introduce new competitors under either Euclidean or cosine distance; observed entries thus establish departures from straight-line convergence. Finally, endpoints associated with lower-ranked output tokens tend to lie farther away in cosine distance across all studied models, connecting residual geometry to output organization. Together, these findings characterize increasing geometric specificity during transformer inference and explain why distance, competitor count, and concentration of the surviving endpoints provide distinct views of that process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在六个预训练语言模型上，把中间残差状态与自身最终状态及其他上下文的最终状态库比较，发现随深度推进竞争端点集合收缩、方向对齐与端点 rank 上升，但欧氏距离几乎不变；低 rank 输出 token 的端点余弦距离更远。作者证明朝自身端点的直线路径在欧氏与余弦度量下都不会引入新竞争者，因此观测到的竞争者进入意味着偏离直线收敛。
Motivation: Transformer 通过逐层残差更新做预测，但表示如何逐步变得对某个具体输出结果具有特异性尚不清楚；距离、竞争者数量、端点集中度各自反映什么也未被区分。
Method: 将各中间残差状态与自身最终状态以及来自其他上下文的经验端点库对比，跨六个预训练语言模型统计竞争集合随深度的变化；另建一个分离范数、方向对齐与端点几何的高维简化模型，并给出直线路径不引入新竞争者的证明。
Result: 六个预训练模型中，自身端点很早即优于平均替代端点，但许多单个端点仍更近；竞争集合随深度收缩而成员更替，幸存端点彼此不必更相似，方向对齐与端点 rank 改善时欧氏距离变化很小；低 rank 输出 token 的端点在全部模型上余弦距离更远。
Conclusion: Transformer 推理中残差表示呈现递增的几何特异性，而距离、竞争者数量与幸存端点集中度是三个互不等价的观测视角；观测到的竞争者进入本身即构成对直线收敛的偏离。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Making Duplicate Reimbursement Unrepresentable: A Verified Ethereum E-Invoice System for Humans and AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Electronic invoices are replacing paper invoices worldwide, but today's centralized architectures leave three problems unsolved on the consumption side: an invoice can be submitted for reimbursement repeatedly, authenticity is difficult for recipients to verify, and data is siloed at a central authority that forms both a performance bottleneck and a single point of failure. This paper presents the design, formal analysis, and implementation of a complete blockchain-based electronic invoice system on Ethereum. We formalize the invoice lifecycle as a guarded labeled transition system and prove, under standard cryptographic and consensus assumptions, that the system guarantees: (i) reimbursement uniqueness--an invoice is reimbursed at most once, even across mutually distrusting organizations; (ii) face integrity--any verified invoice matches the recorded one unless keccak256 second-preimage resistance is broken; and (iii) authorization soundness for every lifecycle operation. The core invariants are machine-checked using Solidity SMTChecker, proving inductive validity across all reachable transaction sequences. The architecture models each invoice as a non-fungible, non-tradable token whose state transitions through five guarded subsystems, employing a lock-based protocol that makes duplicate reimbursement unrepresentable rather than merely detectable. We implement the design as a Solidity 0.8 contract with a four-role web application and evaluate it on a private Ethereum network: issuing costs 646,773 gas, full reimbursement costs under 135,000 gas, all operations run in O(1) time, and a single node sustains 137 issuances/s. Finally, the verified contract serves as a safety envelope for LLM-based reimbursement agents, provably rejecting unsafe actions (duplicate, over-limit, or forged-receipt claims) even when the agent's internal policy fails. All code and benchmarks are open-source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Ethereum 上把发票做成不可转让 NFT，用基于锁的协议让重复报销在状态机层面不可表示，而非事后检测；在标准密码学与共识假设下证明报销唯一性、面额完整性与操作授权可靠性，并用 Solidity SMTChecker 机器验证不变量的归纳有效性。私链实测开票 646,773 gas、全额报销低于 135,000 gas、单节点 137 张/秒，且该已验证合约可作为 LLM 报销 agent 的安全包络，即使 agent 内部策略失效也拒绝重复、超额与伪造票据操作。
Motivation: 中心化电子发票架构下同一张发票可被反复提交报销、真伪难验、数据被单一机构垄断，既是性能瓶颈也是单点故障。
Method: 把发票生命周期形式化为 guarded labeled transition system，证明报销唯一性、keccak256 第二原像抗性下的面额完整性、以及每个生命周期操作的授权可靠性；核心不变量用 Solidity SMTChecker 机器验证，覆盖所有可达交易序列。实现为 Solidity 0.8 合约加四角色 Web 应用，发票建模为不可转让 NFT，状态经五个 guarded 子系统流转，采用 lock-based protocol。
Result: 在私有 Ethereum 网络上评测：开票成本 646,773 gas，全额报销低于 135,000 gas，所有操作 O(1) 时间，单节点维持 137 次开票/秒。已验证合约作为 LLM 报销 agent 的安全包络，可证明地拒绝重复、超额、伪造票据三类不安全操作，即使 agent 内部策略失效。
Conclusion: 把唯一性做成协议中不可表示的状态而非检测规则，配合机器验证的不变量，可同时给出跨互不信任组织的报销唯一性保证，并为 LLM agent 提供可证明的安全边界；全部代码与基准开源。

papers.title: Thinking in Depth, Speaking Directly: Recurrent Latent Reasoning for Paralinguistically Grounded Spoken Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Empathetic spoken dialogue requires models to use both what is said and how it is said to decide how to respond. Explicit CoT can improve paralinguistic perception and make acoustic cues more explicit in replies, yet does not ensure their effective use in response planning. We call this mismatch the perception-reasoning gap. In addition, CoT may not fully capture acoustic cues in words, and generating it adds inference latency. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopSLM, which builds on looped Transformers for latent reasoning, reusing a decoder block to refine hidden states with acoustic grounding at every pass. Its two-stage training further narrows the perception-reasoning gap by separating learning to reason from learning to respond, enabling direct inference without CoT. On EchoMind, LoopSLM improves paralinguistic understanding, reasoning, and reply quality over Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. Against the CoT-SFT baseline, LoopSLM gains over 20 points in reasoning accuracy while generating 64.5% fewer tokens at half the latency. It also outperforms Qwen3-Omni-Thinking on most empathetic reply metrics with 34x lower latency. Despite training only on dialogue data, LoopSLM improves accuracy on general audio benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LoopSLM：基于 looped Transformer 复用解码块做隐式推理，每轮以声学 grounding 精炼隐状态，并用两阶段训练把「学会推理」与「学会回应」分开，从而免去显式 CoT。在 EchoMind 上相对 CoT-SFT 推理准确率提升 20+ 分、生成 token 少 64.5%、延迟减半，且以 34x 更低延迟在多数共情回应指标上超过 Qwen3-Omni-Thinking。
Motivation: 显式 CoT 能提升副语言感知却未必真正用于回应规划，即感知-推理缺口 (perception-reasoning gap)；CoT 也难以把声学线索完整落成文字，还额外增加推理延迟。
Method: LoopSLM 建立在 looped Transformer 之上，复用同一个 decoder block 多次前向以精炼隐状态，每一轮都注入 acoustic grounding；两阶段训练把学习推理与学习回应分开，推理时直接输出、不生成 CoT。
Result: 在 EchoMind 上，相对 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 改善副语言理解、推理与回应质量；相对 CoT-SFT 基线推理准确率提升超过 20 分，同时生成 token 减少 64.5%、延迟降至一半；在多数共情回应指标上超过 Qwen3-Omni-Thinking，延迟低 34 倍；仅用对话数据训练仍在通用音频基准上提升准确率。
Conclusion: 把推理放进隐状态循环而非显式 CoT，可以在缩小感知-推理缺口的同时砍掉 CoT 的 token 与延迟开销，且对话数据训练的副语言能力可迁移到通用音频任务。

papers.title: Minkowski Attractor Networks: Closed-Form Hyperbolic Flows for Visual Representations
papers.abstract_en: Geometric representation learning predominantly scaffolds representations onto flat Euclidean subspaces or compact product tori ($\mathbb{T}^K$). However, flat manifolds possess vanishing curvature and polynomial volume growth, inherently suffering from metric distortion when embedding multi-scale, tree-like visual hierarchies. While hyperbolic spaces ($\mathbb{H}^m$) circumvent this via constant negative curvature ($K<0$) and exponential volume expansion, prior hyperbolic deep architectures are hindered by computationally cumbersome Riemannian optimization, non-linear gyrovector calculus, and floating-point instabilities. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)}, an operator-splitting-inspired framework that embeds representations within pseudo-Riemannian Minkowski spacetime ($\mathbb{R}^{1,m}$). By framing hyperbolic manifolds as quadric level sets, MAN resolves hyperbolic geometry by combining linear Lorentz group transport with non-linear cone lifting and closed-form radial rescaling, evaluating in a single forward pass without numerical ODE solvers or iterative retractions. We establish \textbf{MAN-2D} ($\mathbb{R}^{1,1} \to \mathbb{H}^1$) as our primary, high-throughput visual backbone, which maximizes channel factorization granularity into $D/2$ independent two-dimensional Minkowski blocks. We further formulate \textbf{MAN-4D} ($\mathbb{R}^{1,3} \to \mathbb{H}^3$) as a spacetime extension, leveraging a commuting Cartan-subalgebra parameterization of $\mathrm{SO}^+(1,3)$ to evaluate 4D Lorentz isometries via two commuting 2D planar maps without matrix-exponential overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)，把双曲流形写成伪黎曼 Minkowski 时空中的二次曲面水平集，用线性 Lorentz 群输运加非线性锥提升与闭式径向缩放，单次前向完成双曲几何计算，无需数值 ODE 求解器或迭代 retraction。MAN-2D 把通道拆成 D/2 个独立二维 Minkowski 块作为高吞吐视觉骨干，MAN-4D 用 SO+(1,3) 的交换 Cartan 子代数参数化，以两个交换的二维平面映射求 4D Lorentz 等距变换。
Motivation: 欧氏子空间与环面曲率为零、体积多项式增长，嵌入多尺度树状视觉层级时度量失真；已有双曲深度架构又受黎曼优化、gyrovector 非线性演算与浮点不稳定拖累。
Method: MAN 采用算子分裂思路：双曲流形视为二次曲面水平集，组合线性 Lorentz 群输运、非线性 cone lifting 与闭式径向缩放，单次前向求值。MAN-2D 将 R^{1,1}→H^1 块最大化到 D/2 个独立二维块；MAN-4D 以 R^{1,3}→H^3 与 SO+(1,3) 的交换 Cartan 子代数参数化，用两个交换二维平面映射替代矩阵指数。
Result: 摘要给出的是构造性结论：MAN 单次前向即完成双曲几何求值，不依赖数值 ODE 求解器与迭代 retraction；MAN-4D 的 4D Lorentz 等距求值免矩阵指数开销，通道分解粒度达 D/2 个独立二维 Minkowski 块。
Conclusion: 双曲视觉表示可以绕开黎曼优化与 gyrovector 演算，改在 Minkowski 时空里用闭式线性-非线性算子分裂实现，MAN-2D 被定位为高吞吐主干、MAN-4D 为时空扩展。

papers.title: WINGS: Reference-Free Gaussian Splatting Inpainting with 3D-Native Generative Priors
papers.abstract_en: Inpainting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, a key challenge in 3D editing, requires generating plausible content within a masked region of 3D space. Prior approaches rely on 2D diffusion models to produce one or several inpainted reference views, making them susceptible to challenges associated with multi-view inconsistency and lengthy optimization times. Departing from these approaches, we introduce a reference-free Gaussian splatting inpainting method operating natively in 3D. Our method leverages the embedding space of a large, pre-trained 3D prior, combined with a structure completion network to feed a generative prior which reconstructs the missing region's geometry and appearance. Performing content generation entirely in 3D, it avoids the need to reconcile inconsistencies of multiple inpainted reference images, and is faster than related 2D-based methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method qualitatively and quantitatively, through extensive experiments and a user study. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first Gaussian splatting inpainting method to operate in the learned representation space of a 3D-native generative prior without relying on inpainted reference views.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WINGS 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景的补全 (inpainting) 直接搬进一个预训练 3D 生成先验的隐空间：用结构补全网络 (structure completion network) 补齐被遮蔽区域的几何与外观，全程在 3D 表示空间内生成，无需先用 2D diffusion 渲染 inpainted 参考视图。这样绕开了多视图不一致与冗长优化两个问题，速度快于基于 2D 参考视图的同类方法。
Motivation: 现有 Gaussian Splatting inpainting 依赖 2D diffusion 生成一张或多张 inpainted 参考视图，随后要调和这些视图之间的多视图不一致，并付出较长的优化时间。
Method: 取一个大型预训练 3D 先验的 embedding space，配合结构补全网络把缺失区域的几何与外观喂给生成先验，在学习到的 3D 原生表示空间内直接重建被遮蔽区域，不依赖任何 inpainted 参考视图。
Result: 定性与定量实验以及 user study 均显示该方法有效；生成完全在 3D 内完成，速度比相关 2D-based 方法更快。作者称这是首个在 3D 原生生成先验的表示空间中做 Gaussian Splatting inpainting、且不依赖 inpainted 参考视图的方法。
Conclusion: Gaussian Splatting 补全可以绕开 2D 参考视图这条路径，直接在 3D 生成先验的隐空间里完成，从而同时避开多视图不一致并缩短优化时间。

papers.title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action and world-action models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in robotics, yet generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. More recently, general-purpose multimodal agents have shown great potential for zero-shot robotic task solving. However, they often incur high execution costs by reasoning and exploring the physical world from scratch. To reduce these costs, we introduce RoboSkill, a framework that connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop. Within this loop, the agent explores to gather task-relevant information, executes tasks while adapting to feedback, and evolves its skill library based on execution records. It then reuses these skills to guide exploration and execution in the next cycle, closing the loop. To improve loop efficiency, we complement vision with tactile feedback to reduce uncertainty during physical interaction. We further augment textual guidance with reusable code to reduce reasoning overhead during skill reuse. On LIBERO-10, RoboSkill improves first-episode success rates by 12.5--25.0 percentage points and reduces average runtime by 7.6--72.4% across four agents. On real robots, it improves success rates by 8.3 percentage points and reduces average runtime for successful trials by at least 14.4%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboSkill 用 Explore-Execute-Evolve 闭环把具身智能体的技能获取与复用接起来：探索收集任务信息、执行中按反馈调整、据执行记录更新技能库，下一轮用技能引导探索与执行，并以触觉补视觉不确定性、以可复用代码替代文本推理。在 LIBERO-10 上四个智能体的首回合成功率提高 12.5–25.0 个百分点、平均运行时间下降 7.6–72.4%；真实机器人上成功率提高 8.3 个百分点，成功试验平均耗时至少降 14.4%。
Motivation: VLA 与 world-action 模型以及通用多模态智能体在零样本机器人任务上表现好，但每次都要从零推理和探索物理世界，执行成本高，且对未见任务泛化仍困难。
Method: RoboSkill 框架跑 Explore-Execute-Evolve 循环：探索阶段收集任务相关信息，执行阶段依据反馈调整，进化阶段按执行记录更新技能库，再把技能复用于下一轮的探索与执行；用触觉反馈补充视觉以降低物理交互的不确定性，用可复用代码补充文本指引以降低技能复用时的推理开销。
Result: 在 LIBERO-10 上，RoboSkill 使四个智能体的首回合成功率提高 12.5–25.0 个百分点，平均运行时间下降 7.6–72.4%；在真实机器人上成功率提高 8.3 个百分点，成功试验的平均运行时间至少下降 14.4%。
Conclusion: 把技能获取与复用闭成循环、并用触觉和可复用代码压低探索与推理开销，能同时提升机器人任务的首回合成功率并缩短执行时间。

papers.title: Pixel-Level Transformers in Remote Sensing: A Canopy Height Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Predicting canopy height from medium-resolution satellite imagery is a common and scalable approach for assessing the condition of the world's forests, which play a crucial role in climate change mitigation. While Transformer-based architectures have shown strong performance in many domains, their straightforward application to dense (i.e., pixel-level) regression tasks often yields suboptimal results. In particular, the patch size has a crucial impact on the model performance. In this work, we consider pixel-level attention schemes and show that the resulting models generally outperform those relying on larger patch sizes. However, pixel-level attention can be a prohibitively resource-intensive operation. For this reason, we conduct an extensive experimental study using efficient attention variants to identify favorable trade-offs between prediction quality and resource requirements, facilitating the practical deployment of the proposed models. In addition, we perform a comprehensive comparison with several well-established models in the field and show that, with suitable hyperparameter choices, Transformer-based architectures can outperform competing approaches. Our findings provide practical guidance for designing models for pixel-level regression tasks on medium-resolution satellite imagery, including canopy height and biomass estimation, soil moisture mapping, and yield forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在中分辨率卫星影像的冠层高度像素级回归中，直接套用大 patch 的 Transformer 效果不佳，改用 pixel-level attention 后模型普遍优于大 patch 版本；再用高效 attention 变体做权衡实验，配合合适的超参数，Transformer 可以超过该领域若干成熟模型。
Motivation: Transformer 在稠密像素级回归上直接应用常得到次优结果，patch size 对性能影响关键，而 pixel-level attention 计算代价又可能高到难以部署。
Method: 比较多种 pixel-level attention 方案与大 patch 方案，并系统实验若干高效 attention 变体，在预测质量与资源开销之间找折中；同时与该领域多个成熟模型做综合对比，任务为中分辨率卫星影像的冠层高度回归。
Result: pixel-level attention 模型总体优于依赖更大 patch 的模型；在合适超参数下 Transformer 架构能超过竞争方法；高效 attention 变体的实验给出预测质量与资源需求的折中选择。
Conclusion: 像素级回归任务（冠层高度、生物量、土壤湿度、产量）应优先考虑 pixel-level attention 并按资源预算选高效变体，超参数选择是 Transformer 胜出的前提。

papers.title: Feedback-Calibrated Protein Optimization with Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration
papers.abstract_en: Protein optimization aims to discover high-fitness sequences under a limited experimental budget. Existing machine-learning methods use task-specific predictors, biological priors, or ranking-aware objectives to guide which variants are tested in the next experimental round. However, these methods cannot adapt to shifts in the reliability of predictive evidence as measurements accumulate and ensure the correct ranking of key high-fitness candidates. To address these challenges, we propose Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA), which uses experimental feedback to adaptively combine prior-informed and task-specific rankings for next-batch selection, with calibration focused on the batch-aligned high-fitness region. Across measured GB1, PABP, and TrpB landscapes, BATA achieves the best mean task rank (1.67) in final best fitness after 480 measurements. Controlled comparisons further show task-dependent gains from high-fitness calibration and batch alignment. Our work introduces feedback-calibrated predictor arbitration, where experimental feedback dynamically determines how predictive evidence guides next-batch selection, opening a new direction for protein optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA)，用实验反馈动态校准先验排序与任务特定排序的组合权重，把校准集中在 batch 对齐的高 fitness 区域来决定下一批测哪些变体。在实测 GB1、PABP、TrpB landscape 上，480 次测量后 BATA 的最终最佳 fitness 平均任务排名为 1.67，为最优。
Motivation: 蛋白优化要在有限实验预算下挑出高 fitness 序列，但现有方法无法随测量累积适应预测证据可靠性的漂移，也难以保证关键高 fitness 候选的排序正确。
Method: BATA 用实验反馈自适应组合先验排序与任务特定排序做下一批选择，校准聚焦于 batch 对齐的高 fitness 区域；在实测 GB1、PABP、TrpB 三个 landscape 上与既有方法比较，并做高 fitness 校准与 batch 对齐的受控消融。
Result: 在实测 GB1、PABP、TrpB landscape 上，480 次测量后 BATA 最终最佳 fitness 的平均任务排名为 1.67，取得最优；受控比较显示高 fitness 校准与 batch 对齐带来任务相关的增益。
Conclusion: 实验反馈可以动态决定预测证据如何指导下一批选择，反馈校准的 predictor arbitration 是蛋白优化的一个新方向。

papers.title: CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data
papers.abstract_en: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires identifying training examples that refuse, evade or otherwise fail to fulfil the requested task. But existing annotation covers evaluation sets of a few thousand prompts at most. We present CompOrca, a compliance labelling over the entirety of the 4,233,923-example OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five independent passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters), and the corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncompliance (1.28%), and nonunanimous rows (3.97%) along with the raw vote counts. A single pass flags 2.7-3.2% of the corpus as noncompliant, while only 1.28% is flagged by all five, allowing for filtering the most ambiguous samples. Against 450 human-annotated examples, 150 of them annotated twice (human-human $κ= 0.93$), the unanimous compliance and noncompliance labels are 97.3% and 86.7% precise, the latter a high-precision subset, not a complete enumeration, of noncompliance. Published refusal-detection methods recall only between 0.4% and 94.1% of the noncompliance class. We release the full corpus with its per-row labels and vote counts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca
papers.comment: Accepted to PlurVA-LLM Workshop @ AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Dataset available on HuggingFace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompOrca 对 OpenOrca 全部 4,233,923 条指令微调样本做合规标注：由 1.6T 参数开源模型 LongCat-2.0 独立五次投票判 compliant/noncompliant，按一致性分三档发布。全票一致合规占 94.75%、全票一致不合规 1.28%、非一致 3.97%；单次判罚会标出 2.7–3.2%，五次全票才 1.28%，据此可筛掉最含糊的样本。
Motivation: 研究微调如何塑造拒绝与不合规行为，需要训练样本级的合规标签，但现有标注最多只覆盖几千条 prompt 的评测集，无法支撑语料规模的分析。
Method: 用开源权重 LLM 判官 LongCat-2.0（1.6T 参数）对 OpenOrca 全语料做五次独立判罚，输出 compliant/noncompliant 与逐行原始票数，并按全票一致合规、全票一致不合规、非一致三档发布；另取 450 条人工标注样本（其中 150 条双人重复标注）做精度核对。
Result: 全票一致合规 94.75%、全票一致不合规 1.28%、非一致 3.97%；单次判罚标出 2.7–3.2% 不合规，五次全票仅 1.28%。人工对照 450 条上，人-人 κ=0.93，全票合规与全票不合规标签精度分别为 97.3% 与 86.7%。已发表的拒绝检测方法对不合规类的召回仅 0.4%–94.1%。

papers.title: ByteTraX: Enhancing the ByteTrack Architecture with Optimised Thresholding
papers.abstract_en: The ByteTrack algorithm is a widely used and computationally efficient multi-object tracking architecture. Its core innovation lies in the combination of lenient bounding box associations with tracklet similarity matching to robustly deal with object occlusions. However, this strategy is nevertheless vulnerable to erroneous track reclassification and identity switching, as detection confidence scores dictate association priority. To address this, I present a simple enhancement of the ByteTrack architecture, named ByteTraX, that optimises track continuity via a single unified matching threshold, while penalising identity switches through stringent track initiation criteria. This approach achieves consistently improved performance across a range of diverse benchmarks including GMOT-40, LC-MOT, SportsMOT, TeamTrack, DAMUNT, and DeepSea-MOT, while simultaneously increasing processing speed by >10%. Specifically, results demonstrate a >40% reduction in identity switches, accompanied by mean increases in HOTA of 3.6, IDF1 of 5.6, and FPS of 6.3. As such, adoption of the ByteTraX algorithm has the potential to substantially enhance tracking performance over the ByteTrack baseline, while retaining the efficiency needed for real-time deployment. To facilitate usage, I provide the source code, integration functionality for the YOLO family of object detection models, and deployment instructions via an open source repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ByteTraX 用单一统一匹配阈值替代 ByteTrack 的分段置信度策略，并以严格的轨迹启动条件惩罚身份切换，在 GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT 上一致提升多目标跟踪性能：身份切换减少 >40%，HOTA 平均 +3.6、IDF1 +5.6、FPS +6.3（处理速度提升 >10%），适合实时部署。
Motivation: ByteTrack 依赖检测置信度决定关联优先级，容易发生错误的轨迹重分类与身份切换 (identity switch)，在遮挡场景下跟踪连续性受损。
Method: 在 ByteTrack 架构上做最小改动：用一个统一的匹配阈值优化轨迹连续性，并用严格的轨迹启动准则惩罚身份切换；提供开源代码与 YOLO 系列检测器的集成接口。
Result: 在 GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT 上一致改进：身份切换减少 >40%，HOTA 平均提高 3.6，IDF1 平均提高 5.6，FPS 平均提高 6.3，处理速度提升 >10%。
Conclusion: 单一阈值加严格启动准则即可在保留实时效率的同时显著压低身份切换，是对 ByteTrack 基线的可直接采用的增强。

papers.title: Challenges and Solutions for Bandits in the Wild: Warm-Started Mixture Bandits for Cross-Cohort Slate Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Many recommender services repeatedly encounter cold-start cohorts, where new users arrive with little or no interaction history. This creates two challenges: learning user preferences quickly from limited feedback and sustaining useful recommendations when each user has a finite catalog that can become repetitive or depleted over time. We propose CohortMix-TS, a warm-started mixture bandit that learns latent user groups from earlier cohorts and uses available metadata to construct group-informed priors for new users. Starting from these fixed priors, the model personalizes independently as feedback from each user becomes available. Session slates combine Thompson sampling with diversity and inventory-depletion controls. We evaluate CohortMix-TS through simulation, semi-synthetic experiments, and a 25-day randomized in-the-wild deployment with 713 registered participants in a Campus Games quiz application. Our evaluations show that cross-cohort transfer improves early recommendation quality and user-level regret, while inventory-aware slate construction helps prevent premature exhaustion of preferred items. In the field deployment, treatment users also showed a larger early-to-late change in correctness than users receiving random recommendations. Together, these results show how warm-start transfer and inventory-aware recommendations can support personalization for short-lived, repeatedly cold-starting cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CohortMix-TS：面向反复冷启动用户群的 warm-start 混合 bandit，用早期 cohort 学到的潜在用户分组加元数据构造新用户先验，session slate 结合 Thompson sampling、多样性与库存耗尽控制。跨 cohort 迁移改善早期推荐质量与用户级 regret，库存感知构造延缓偏好物品提前耗尽；25 天、713 名注册参与者的 Campus Games quiz 应用随机实地部署中，处理组的正确率从早期到晚期变化大于随机推荐对照组。
Motivation: 推荐服务反复遇到冷启动 cohort：新用户几乎没有交互历史，既要从有限反馈中快速学偏好，又要在有限且会重复或耗尽的目录上持续给出有用推荐。
Method: CohortMix-TS 是 warm-started mixture bandit：从早期 cohort 学潜在用户分组，用可用元数据为新用户构造分组先验，随后在个体反馈到达时独立个性化；session slate 把 Thompson sampling 与多样性、库存耗尽控制结合。评测含仿真、半合成实验与实地随机部署。
Result: 跨 cohort 迁移提升早期推荐质量与用户级 regret；库存感知 slate 构造有助于防止偏好物品过早耗尽。25 天、713 名注册参与者的 Campus Games quiz 应用随机实地部署中，处理组用户正确率的早期到晚期变化大于接收随机推荐的用户。
Conclusion: warm-start 迁移加库存感知推荐可以支撑短生命周期、反复冷启动 cohort 的个性化，且在实地部署中体现为正确率随时间的变化差异。

papers.title: GLaS-JEPA: Gaussian-Regularized Speech SSL without Engineered Prediction Targets
papers.abstract_en: Speech self-supervised learning aims to learn general-purpose representations for downstream speech tasks. However, current approaches rely on complex, carefully designed prediction targets. We challenge this necessity with GLaS-JEPA, a framework that directly predicts the current encoder's continuous representations at masked positions, without contrastive learning, discrete targets, or separate EMA target encoders. We prevent representation collapse using SIGReg representation-space regularization, eliminating the need for engineered target-generation mechanisms. Pretrained on 960 hours of LibriSpeech, our 57M-parameter model achieves a 6.89% WER on frozen-encoder SUPERB ASR and a 25.87% CER on slot filling, outperforming the best non-distilled sub-90M baselines by 43.1% and 22.0%, respectively. These results demonstrate that highly competitive speech representations can emerge from a radically simplified training recipe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLaS-JEPA 抛弃精心设计的预测目标，直接让编码器在掩码位置预测当前编码器自身的连续表示，用 SIGReg 表示空间正则化防止表示坍缩。在 960 小时 LibriSpeech 预训练的 57M 参数模型，在冻结编码器的 SUPERB ASR 上取得 6.89% WER、slot filling 上 25.87% CER，相对最佳非蒸馏 sub-90M 基线分别提升 43.1% 与 22.0%。
Motivation: 语音自监督学习依赖复杂且人工设计的预测目标（对比学习、离散目标、EMA target encoder），作者质疑这一必要性。
Method: GLaS-JEPA 在掩码位置直接预测当前编码器的连续表示，不使用对比学习、离散目标或独立 EMA target encoder；用 SIGReg 表示空间正则化抑制表示坍缩，替代目标生成机制。在 960 小时 LibriSpeech 上预训练，57M 参数。
Result: 冻结编码器 SUPERB ASR WER 6.89%，slot filling CER 25.87%；相对最佳非蒸馏 sub-90M 基线分别好 43.1% 和 22.0%。
Conclusion: 去掉工程化的预测目标、改用表示空间正则化，仍能涌现高竞争力的语音表示，训练配方可大幅简化。

papers.title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
papers.abstract_en: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system with self-attention, designed to additionally encode context and retrieve context-congruent memories. The resulting model not only better resembles human brain representations but also learns to retrieve memories like humans much faster than a model without context modulation. Together, our findings suggest a computational mechanism by which context modulates information maintenance and long-term memory retrieval in naturalistic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练带情节记忆缓冲区的循环网络 (RNN)，用贝叶斯推断在观看自然电影时持续推断情境，并让推断出的情境以低秩方式调制循环连接。低秩调制下模型活动模式最贴近同看这些电影的人类 fMRI 反应；情境同时调制情节记忆检索，使检索依据内容相似度与情境相似度双重匹配，且比无情境调制的模型快得多地学会像人类一样检索。
Motivation: 前额叶皮层发出的情境信号已知会调制工作记忆与情节记忆，但这种调制的算法层面理解仍然有限，缺少能在自然情境下同时解释记忆维持与检索的计算模型。
Method: 训练一个带情节记忆缓冲区的循环神经网络，用贝叶斯推断在连续预测下一场景的过程中推断情境；情境以低秩方式调制 RNN 循环连接（工作记忆基础）。情节记忆检索用带 self-attention 的 key-value 系统实现，额外编码情境并检索情境一致的记忆。
Result: 当情境以低秩方式调制循环连接时，模型活动模式与人类被试观看相同电影的 fMRI 神经反应匹配最佳；模型对人类脑表征的相似度更高，且比没有情境调制的模型快得多学会像人类一样检索记忆。
Conclusion: 情境通过低秩调制循环连接与情境一致的情节检索，共同构成自然环境中信息维持与长时记忆检索的计算机制。

summary_sections.conclusion: 情境通过低秩调制循环连接与情境一致的情节检索，共同构成自然环境中信息维持与长时记忆检索的计算机制。

papers.title: Predictive Self-Supervised Learning Provably Identifies Stochastic Signals under Nuisance
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) by predicting in latent space, without generating the input data itself, learns highly abstract, useful representations. Intuitively, this success is often attributed to its ability to discard nuisance information that is irrelevant to prediction. However, this poses a conundrum: both stochastic variation in a prediction-relevant latent signal and true nuisance make observations partly unpredictable; how could they be distinguished? Surprisingly, we prove that common SSL methods can achieve exactly this, by implicitly instantiating a latent-variable model with stochastic dynamics and observation-private nuisance. We trace their ability to recover the stochastic signal to two complementary principles: Predictive mutual information maximization ensures that representations retain the information needed for prediction, while latent distribution matching constrains how this information is encoded, thereby making the retained signal identifiable. We confirm this identifiability result in simulations for Gaussian predictors, which recover the true signal up to an affine transformation even in dynamic, nuisance-laden environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在隐空间做预测的自监督学习能区分「与预测相关的随机信号」和「真正 nuisance」：它隐式地实例化了一个带随机动力学与观测私有干扰的隐变量模型，靠预测互信息最大化保留预测所需信息、再用隐分布匹配约束编码方式，使保留的信号可辨识。高斯预测器仿真中，即使在动态且充满 nuisance 的环境里，也能把真实信号恢复到仿射变换意义下。
Motivation: SSL 常被解释为丢弃与预测无关的 nuisance，但预测相关的随机变化与 nuisance 都会让观测部分不可预测，二者如何区分是一个理论上的矛盾（conundrum）。
Method: 理论上证明常见 SSL 方法隐式实例化了一个含随机动力学与观测私有 nuisance 的隐变量模型；可辨识性由两条互补原理支撑——预测互信息最大化（predictive mutual information maximization）保证保留预测所需信息，隐分布匹配（latent distribution matching）约束编码方式从而带来可辨识性。
Result: 在高斯预测器 (Gaussian predictors) 的仿真中确认该可辨识性结果：即使在动态、含 nuisance 的环境中，也能把真实信号恢复到仿射变换 (affine transformation) 意义下。
Conclusion: 预测式 SSL 之所以有效，不是简单丢弃 nuisance，而是通过互信息最大化与隐分布匹配的组合，使预测相关的随机信号本身可辨识。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses
papers.abstract_en: Rubrics support the structured evaluation of language models. We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR.BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套用于给 LLM 自由文本临床推理打分的多维 rubric，把医学教育评估框架（ART、SCT、Key Feature Problems、OSCE）、临床 LLM 基准（MedR-Bench、HealthBench、TIMER-Bench、DR.BENCH、PrIME-LLM、PatientSafeBench）与通用推理评测（Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility 分类、FaithCoT-Bench、C2-Faith）合到一起，并把 factuality 改写为面向临床的 groundedness。rubric 含暂定行为锚点、适用性规则和病例级安全关键错误的独立标记，定位是让评分决策在实证检验前先变得显式、可审查，而非已验证的临床量表。
Motivation: LLM 临床推理的现有评测依赖各任务专用指标和病例参考标准，缺少一个把表达出的推理过程本身结构化打分、且决策过程可被审查的通用框架。
Method: 综合三类来源构建多维 rubric：医学教育评估框架（ART、SCT、Key Feature Problems、OSCE）、六个临床 LLM 基准的评测设计，以及通用推理评测研究（Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility 分类、FaithCoT-Bench、C2-Faith）；对 gold-standard 临床病例的自由文本回答打分，含暂定行为锚点、适用性规则与病例特异的安全关键错误独立标记，factuality 被改造为 groundedness。
Result: 产出一个多维评分框架，含暂定行为锚点、适用性规则和安全关键错误独立标记；作者明确其尚未经过 inter-rater reliability、construct validity 或临床效用检验，且不替代病例特异参考标准与既有基准的任务专用指标。
Conclusion: 该 rubric 的即时价值是让临床推理评分决策显式化、可审查，作为实证检验前的候选工具，而非已验证的临床测量仪器。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $δ^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $δ$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $δ^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 L0-Lp 广义光滑目标上，仅凭随机梯度的广义二阶矩 ABC 条件（允许沿轨迹增长、无需有界或次高斯尾部假设），Adam 仍能收敛：把 Jin et al. (2026) 的停止时间与去预条件 (de-preconditioning) 策略推广到广义光滑情形，得到 p<2 全范围的高概率收敛速率，置信度依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，而步长前因子只含单个对数因子；并构造硬实例证明该 δ^{-1/2} 依赖在仅二阶矩信息下是紧的。
Motivation: Adam 在目标显著偏离全局光滑时实践中仍稳定，但广义光滑框架下的既有分析都要求随机梯度几乎必然有界或次高斯等强尾部假设；Li et al. (2023) 明确把“仅用二阶矩信息能否保证 Adam 在广义光滑目标上收敛”列为公开问题。
Method: 在 Jin et al. (2026) 面向经典光滑与有界方差的 Adam 自归一化 (self-normalization) 框架上，把 stopping-time 与 de-preconditioning 策略推广到 L0-Lp 广义光滑条件和广义二阶矩 ABC 条件；论证即使二阶矩条件沿轨迹增长，随机轨迹仍停留在局部良态光滑区域，在有界方差与全局光滑下呈 stretched-exponential 尾部衰减；p<1 时再结合轨迹控制与稀有事件上的多项式增长估计给出期望意义下的收敛速率。
Result: 在 p<2 全范围建立高概率收敛速率保证，置信度依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，步长前因子对 δ 只有单个对数因子；构造硬实例证明仅二阶矩信息下 δ^{-1/2} 型置信度依赖是 sharp 的；p<1 情形额外给出期望意义下的收敛速率保证。
Conclusion: 广义光滑目标上 Adam 的收敛不需要随机梯度的有界性或次高斯等集中性尾部假设，仅二阶矩信息足够；且 δ^{-1/2} 的置信度依赖在该信息量下不可改进。

papers.title: CHOQOLATE: Organizing Concept Bottleneck Latent Spaces with Choquet Integrals
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) built on vision-language models such as CLIP represent a latent space as human-understandable concepts. These representations are unfaithful: related concepts are entangled, so individual scores do not reflect their intended meaning. We propose CHOQOLATE, an interpretable-by-design layer based on 2-additive Choquet integrals, which merges correlated concepts into compact nodes. Across four datasets, CHOQOLATE achieves a favorable accuracy-interpretability trade-off, with weight-sparse and semantically coherent nodes. A closed-form gradient derivation, backed by experiments, explains why Choquet layers drive this organization without explicit supervision. Choquet weights also map directly to Shapley values, which enables test-time intervention. On standard bias-mitigation benchmarks, suppressing spurious concepts after training performs on par with methods that require group annotations or retraining, while needing neither.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 CLIP 类 Concept Bottleneck Model 潜空间中概念纠缠、单个概念分数失真的问题，提出基于 2-additive Choquet 积分的可解释层 CHOQOLATE，把相关概念合并成权重稀疏且语义一致的紧凑节点。四个数据集上取得准确率与可解释性的良好权衡；闭式梯度推导解释了无显式监督下这种组织如何形成，Choquet 权重直接对应 Shapley 值，支持测试时干预：在偏见缓解基准上抑制虚假概念后表现与需要群体标注或重训练的方法相当，且两者都不需要。
Motivation: 基于 CLIP 的 CBM 潜空间中相关概念相互纠缠，单个概念分数无法反映其本意，表征不忠实，限制了可解释性与测试时干预的可靠性。
Method: 在 CBM 上叠加基于 2-additive Choquet 积分的可解释层，将相关概念合并为紧凑节点；给出闭式梯度推导说明该层在无显式监督下如何驱动这种组织；利用 Choquet 权重与 Shapley 值的直接对应关系实现测试时干预，并在偏见缓解基准上抑制虚假概念。
Result: 在四个数据集上取得有利的准确率-可解释性权衡，产生权重稀疏且语义一致的节点；闭式梯度推导经实验支持；在标准偏见缓解基准上，训练后抑制虚假概念的表现与需要群体标注或重训练的方法相当，而两者都不需要。
Conclusion: Choquet 积分层能在无监督条件下把纠缠概念组织成忠实、可干预的瓶颈表征，测试时抑制虚假概念即可达到需标注或重训练方法的水平。

papers.title: Planetary Feature Fields are Scalable Earth Representations
papers.abstract_en: Satellite observations, precomputed embeddings, and map products describe the same evolving Earth, yet are stored as independent, petabyte-scale data products. Their continued growth calls for compact representations of multiple products while preserving spatial and temporal detail. We introduce Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs), which exploit redundancy across data products by modeling them jointly as continuous functions of space and time at planetary scale. PFFs are spatially local explicit-implicit (hybrid) neural fields. Each field shares a factored feature volume---a decomposition of an explicit 3D grid with smaller factors---across products, while lightweight implicit decoders reconstruct individual products across multiple timesteps. PFFs reconstruct EO products over space and time more accurately than single-product fields at matched compression rates. At $1800\times$ compression relative to the uncompressed source data, reconstructed features retain approximately $90\%$ or more of the performance achieved with the original features on pixel-level segmentation, change detection, and patch-level classification tasks. PFFs can add new timesteps by extending their factored feature volumes and add new products by attaching new decoders, while leaving existing outputs unchanged. PFFs reduce end-to-end feature access latency by an order of magnitude relative to evaluated API and cloud-storage pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
