papers.title: A Benchmark & Dataset for Detecting AI-Manipulated Visual Evidence in the Court System
papers.abstract_en: Photographic evidence is becoming increasingly vulnerable to forms of alteration and fabrication that existing legal and technical workflows are not well equipped to evaluate. Surveillance frames, dashcam stills, and phone photographs may be used to establish presence, sequence, causation, damage, or identity, yet contemporary generative systems allow non-experts to alter or fabricate such images through ordinary prompt-based interfaces. Existing image-forensics benchmarks provide important resources for face manipulation, classical tampering, and general synthetic-image detection, but they are not organized around the forms of visual evidence submitted in courts, the localized edits that can change what an exhibit appears to prove, or the consumer-tool threat model now facing the justice system. We introduce the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for Detecting AI-Manipulated Images, a benchmark for evidentiary image authentication in court and justice-system contexts. The corpus contains 1,505 photographic items, including 720 authentic controls and 785 manipulated or fabricated images, spanning surveillance, dashcam, and consumer-photo imagery. Manipulations are organized into scene-condition edits, localized element edits, and full fabrications produced with contemporary generative systems. Each item is released with structured metadata covering source provenance, manipulation tier, subtype, generator, prompt template, and scene attributes, enabling controlled evaluation beyond aggregate binary detection. We also establish baselines with publicly available image-manipulation detectors, showing that current systems exhibit error profiles that remain problematic for evidentiary use. The dataset, prompts, metadata, code, and baseline evaluation scripts are released to support research on visual evidence authentication, information integrity, and trustworthy AI for the justice system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向法庭证据图像鉴伪的 CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus 基准，含 1,505 张照片（720 张真实对照、785 张被篡改或伪造），覆盖监控、行车记录仪与消费级照片，操纵按场景条件编辑、局部元素编辑、整体伪造三档组织并附生成器与 prompt 模板等结构化元数据。用公开图像篡改检测器建立基线后，现有系统在证据使用场景下仍呈现有问题的错误模式。
Motivation: 监控帧、行车记录仪截图和手机照片在法庭上用于确立在场、时序、因果与身份，但现有取证基准围绕人脸操纵、经典篡改与通用合成图检测组织，不匹配法庭提交的证据形态、会改变展品证明内容的局部编辑，以及消费级生成工具带来的威胁模型。
Method: 构建 CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus：1,505 张照片级条目，操纵分为场景条件编辑、局部元素编辑、整体伪造三档，均由当代生成系统产出；每条附来源出处、操纵档位与子类型、生成器、prompt 模板、场景属性等结构化元数据，支持超越整体二分类的受控评测；并用公开可用的图像篡改检测器建立基线。
Result: 语料含 1,505 项照片证据，其中 720 张真实对照、785 张被篡改或伪造，覆盖监控、行车记录仪与消费照片三类来源；公开图像篡改检测器基线显示当前系统在证据使用场景下错误模式仍属有问题。
Conclusion: 面向法庭证据的鉴伪需要按证据形态与编辑档位组织的受控评测，而当前检测系统尚不足以支撑证据使用；数据集、prompt、元数据、代码与基线脚本全部公开发布。

papers.title: HiRAE: Hierarchical Representation Autoencoding with Residual Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained visual representations support image generation, but may not fully preserve the fine-grained details needed for faithful reconstruction. Meanwhile, intermediate encoder layers contain complementary visual details, but learning to fuse them for reconstruction can produce a latent distribution that is difficult to model. Existing fusion methods require empirical tuning of layer selection or staged optimization of fusion and decoding, increasing configuration effort or training complexity. We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), which learns a hierarchical fusion framework over the full encoder hierarchy to improve reconstruction fidelity while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling. HiRAE groups encoder layers by depth and learns residual corrections to the deepest representation. Group-wise norm caps bound these corrections relative to the deep anchor, with tighter budgets for shallower groups. Our HiRAE-24 preserves the latent token count and channel dimension. On ImageNet-256, HiRAE-24 reduces reconstruction FID from 0.299 to 0.209 relative to RAEv2 while maintaining competitive guided generation quality. For text-to-image generation, HiRAE-24 improves alignment over RAEv2 on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench both before and after supervised fine-tuning. Under the same generator-training and evaluation protocol, post-fine-tuning GenEval increases from 84.86 to 87.70.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiRAE 把预训练视觉编码器各层按深度分组，对最深表示学残差修正，并用 group-wise norm 给浅层组更紧的预算，在保持 latent token 数与通道维不变的前提下提升重建保真度。ImageNet-256 上重建 FID 相对 RAEv2 从 0.299 降到 0.209，监督微调后 GenEval 从 84.86 升到 87.70。
Motivation: 预训练视觉表示做图像生成时未必保住忠实重建所需的细粒度细节；中间层含互补信息，但融合它们会得到难建模的 latent 分布，现有方法要么手工调层选择、要么分阶段优化融合与解码。
Method: HiRAE 在完整编码器层级上学分层融合：按深度分组，对最深表示学残差修正，group-wise norm 约束各组修正相对深锚点的幅度，浅层组预算更紧；HiRAE-24 保持 latent token 数与通道维不变，兼容生成建模。
Result: ImageNet-256 上 HiRAE-24 相对 RAEv2 把重建 FID 从 0.299 降到 0.209，同时保持有竞争力的引导生成质量；文本到图像在 GenEval、DPG-Bench、GenAI-Bench 上于监督微调前后对齐度均优于 RAEv2，同协议下微调后 GenEval 从 84.86 升到 87.70。
Conclusion: 按深度分组加残差预算的层级融合能同时改善重建保真度与生成对齐，且无需调层选择或分阶段优化。

papers.title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. We further introduce AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge framework with category-specific, reference-aware rubrics for evaluating open-ended responses. A complementary Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) strategy converts plausible errors observed during model inference into MCQ distractors for lower-cost evaluation. Within the evaluated heterogeneous model pool, MCQ accuracy correlates positively with AIVC-Judge scores, providing a complementary view of performance alongside open-response evaluation. Code and data demo are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OmniVCBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniVCBench 把 AI 虚拟细胞 (AIVC) 的评估从模拟层扩展到证据解释层，用 6,077 个源自文献图表的单/多子图 QA 对，按 Bloom 分类法实例化 Predict–Explain–Discover 三项科学推理任务。配套提出 AIVC-Judge（任务条件化、带类别参考的 MLLM-as-a-judge）与 MDHNM 策略，把模型推理中的典型错误转成 MCQ 干扰项；在被评测的异构模型池中 MCQ 准确率与 AIVC-Judge 分数正相关。
Motivation: 现有 AIVC benchmark 主要停留在模拟层，缺少对模型如何解读实验证据、如何形成生物学假设这一解释环节的评测。
Method: 构建 figure-centric、source-traceable 的 6,077 个单/多子图 QA 对，依据 Bloom 分类法设计三项解释层推理任务；用 AIVC-Judge 这一任务条件化 MLLM-as-a-judge 框架配类别专属、参考感知的 rubric 评开放回答，再用 Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) 把推理中出现的合理错误改写为 MCQ 干扰项以降低评测成本。
Result: 数据集含 6,077 个精选 QA 对；在被评测的异构模型池中 MCQ 准确率与 AIVC-Judge 分数呈正相关，为开放回答评测提供互补视角。
Conclusion: AIVC 的解释能力可以被独立、可溯源地评测，且低成本 MCQ 与开放回答评分在该模型池上给出一致方向的信号。

papers.title: When Noise Estimation Hides Basis Misspecification in Repeated Bayesian Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Basis-restricted priors in Bayesian inverse problems can lose coverage when the truth has components outside the basis. We show that estimating the observation-noise variance can hide this loss. Under a linear forward model, when the in-span prior variance dominates the noise, the maximum-likelihood noise estimate absorbs the out-of-basis energy in the complement of the model range. Residual-magnitude and observation-coverage checks then stay near nominal while field coverage falls. We study repeated problems sharing one forward operator and one basis, fixed independently of the tested data. After projection onto the complement, and conditionally on the fitted noise scale, every exact test is a test of the scale-free direction of the residuals. We test the shape of their sample spectrum with John's sphericity statistic. Under Gaussian noise its null model is exact at finite sample size, and we derive its null mean and its power at proportional dimension. On synthetic problems and in a preregistered GEBCO topography study, the test detects structured out-of-basis variation that cross-validation and observation-coverage checks largely miss. It cannot detect Gaussian out-of-basis variation that is isotropic in the complement, since that is indistinguishable from a change of noise scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基受限先验 (basis-restricted prior) 在真值含基外成分时会失覆盖，而估计观测噪声方差会把这部分能量吸收进噪声，使残差幅度与观测覆盖检查仍接近名义水平、场覆盖却已下降。作者在补空间投影后用 John 球形性统计量检验残差样本谱形状，在合成问题与预注册的 GEBCO 地形研究中检出交叉验证与观测覆盖检查基本漏掉的结构化基外变异。
Motivation: 重复贝叶斯反问题中，噪声方差的极大似然估计会掩盖基失配造成的覆盖损失，常规残差与覆盖诊断因此给出虚假的通过信号。
Method: 在线性前向模型、共享同一前向算子与固定基的重复问题设定下，先对模型值域的补空间投影，并在给定拟合噪声尺度的条件下把检验化为对残差无尺度方向的检验；用 John's sphericity statistic 检验样本谱形状，推导高斯噪声下有限样本精确的零假设分布，以及等比例维度下的零均值与功效。
Result: 高斯噪声下零模型在有限样本精确；推导出零均值与 proportional dimension 下的功效。在合成问题与预注册 GEBCO 地形研究中，该检验能检出交叉验证与观测覆盖检查基本漏掉的结构化基外变异；对补空间中各向同性的高斯基外变异无法检出，因其与噪声尺度变化不可区分。
Conclusion: 噪声尺度估计会吸收基外能量并伪装成正常覆盖，因此需要直接检验残差谱形状；但各向同性高斯基外成分在原理上不可检测。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.result: 高斯噪声下零模型在有限样本精确；推导出零均值与 proportional dimension 下的功效。在合成问题与预注册 GEBCO 地形研究中，该检验能检出交叉验证与观测覆盖检查基本漏掉的结构化基外变异；对补空间中各向同性的高斯基外变异无法检出，因其与噪声尺度变化不可区分。
summary_sections.conclusion: 噪声尺度估计会吸收基外能量并伪装成正常覆盖，因此需要直接检验残差谱形状；但各向同性高斯基外成分在原理上不可检测。

papers.title: Selective Channel Restoration for Backdoored Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong multimodal capabilities but remain vulnerable to backdoors implanted through poisoned fine-tuning data. Existing defenses often require extensive parameter updates during fine-tuning or incur per-query overhead during inference. To address these limitations, we propose Perturb-Select-Restore (PSR), a post-training defense that performs sparse updates to the projection interface and introduces no additional computation during inference. We reveal that backdoored VLM projectors are substantially more sensitive to bounded perturbations than clean VLM projectors, a phenomenon we term projection fragility. Building on this finding, PSR identifies the output channels most sensitive to perturbations in each projection layer of a backdoored VLM and restores their parameters to the corresponding pretrained values. Experiments across multiple tasks show that PSR reduces attack success rates to near zero while preserving clean-task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对投毒微调植入的视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 后门，提出训练后防御 Perturb-Select-Restore (PSR)：利用后门投影器对有界扰动远比干净投影器敏感的「投影脆弱性」，定位各投影层中最敏感的输出通道并将其参数恢复为预训练值。攻击成功率降到接近零，同时保持干净任务性能，推理阶段不引入额外计算。
Motivation: 投毒微调数据可给 VLM 植入后门，而现有防御要么在微调时更新大量参数，要么在每次推理时付出额外开销。
Method: PSR 是训练后防御，只对投影接口 (projection interface) 做稀疏更新：先施加有界扰动并测量各投影层输出通道的敏感度，识别最敏感的通道，再把这些通道参数回滚到预训练值；推理期零额外计算。
Result: 在多个任务上的实验中，PSR 把攻击成功率 (attack success rate) 降至接近零，同时保持干净任务性能；核心现象为后门 VLM 投影器对有界扰动的敏感度显著高于干净投影器（projection fragility）。
Conclusion: 后门效应集中在投影层的少数敏感输出通道上，把这些通道恢复到预训练值即可在不增加推理开销的前提下清除后门并保住干净任务表现。

papers.title: Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models scale model capacity by routing each token to a small subset of experts. Their routers are regularized with load balancing terms and learn affinity scores through the language-model objective. However, these objectives do not provide direct alignment between routing affinities and token-level error. We introduce token-error supervision for sparse routing in two forms. The first form predicts an error score per expert. The affinity-weighted aggregate of these scores is aligned to the next-token cross-entropy loss, while the individual scores attenuate affinity before top-$K$ selection. The second directly aligns the router's affinities to the model's objective without requiring an additional head or inference-time modification. Both formulations use the Itakura--Saito divergence or an exponential negative log-likelihood for aligning affinities and token errors. Across two sparse MoE backbones and four multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks, we evaluate both supervision mechanisms. On Granite, our method improves accuracy by approximately 2.3 percentage points on average over a parameter-matched routing baseline. With stronger supervision, the gain on ARC-Challenge reaches 2.94 points. Both mechanisms preserve the native sparse execution budget and aggregation policy. Our code is available in the supplementary materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏 MoE 大模型中把 token 级误差直接监督进路由：用 Itakura–Saito 散度或指数负对数似然，把专家误差分数的亲和加权聚合对齐到下一 token 交叉熵，或直接把 router 亲和对齐目标。在 Granite 上相对参数匹配的路由基线平均提升约 2.3 个百分点，强监督下 ARC-Challenge 提升 2.94 点，且保持原生稀疏执行预算与聚合策略。
Motivation: MoE router 只靠负载均衡正则和语言建模目标学亲和分数，路由亲和与 token 级误差之间没有直接对齐，选专家时并不知道哪个专家对该 token 错得少。
Method: 两种 token 误差监督形式：其一为每个专家预测误差分数，其亲和加权聚合对齐到下一 token 交叉熵，单个分数在 top-K 选择前衰减亲和；其二不加额外头、不改推理，直接把 router 亲和对齐模型目标。两者都用 Itakura–Saito 散度或指数负对数似然做对齐。
Result: 在两个稀疏 MoE backbone 和四个多选 QA benchmark 上评测两种机制；Granite 上相对参数匹配路由基线平均提升约 2.3 个百分点，强监督下 ARC-Challenge 提升 2.94 点，两种机制都保持原生稀疏执行预算与聚合策略。
Conclusion: 把 token 级误差信号直接注入稀疏路由可以在不改执行预算的前提下抬高多选 QA 准确率，交叉熵对齐的亲和比纯负载均衡更贴合模型目标。

papers.title: Multi-Site Real-World Performance of Commercial AI for Pulmonary and Incidental Pulmonary Embolism Detection
papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. We retrospectively evaluated two FDA-cleared AI algorithms from a single commercial platform (Aidoc Medical BriefCase), one for PE triage on dedicated CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA; n = 30,678) and one for incidental PE (iPE) detection on routine contrast-enhanced CTs (n = 37,191), across a 17-facility academic health system. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, kappa = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 17 家机构的学术医疗系统上回顾性评估 Aidoc Medical BriefCase 两个 FDA 已获批 AI：CTPA 上 PE 分诊模型敏感度 86.8%、特异度 99.1%，偶发 PE 模型敏感度 73.5%、特异度 99.8%。敏感度随栓塞部位与急慢性递减（鞍型 99.3% → 段下 72.9%，急性 89.7% → 非急性 65.3%），两者敏感度均低于 FDA 获批基准而特异度高于基准，作者据此主张对 AI 医疗器械做标准化上市后监测。
Motivation: FDA 已获批的 PE 检测 AI 在真实多中心环境中的表现刻画不完整，而 PE 是心血管死亡的主要病因之一，需要知道其在常规临床流中的实际检出能力。
Method: 回顾性评估单一商业平台 Aidoc Medical BriefCase 的两个 FDA 已获批算法：CTPA 上的 PE 分诊模型（n = 30,678）与常规增强 CT 上的偶发 PE（iPE）检测模型（n = 37,191），覆盖 17 家机构；参考标准标签由经验证的 LLM 流程从放射报告中抽取，该流程准确率 97%、kappa = 0.94。
Result: PE 模型敏感度 86.8%、特异度 99.1%；敏感度从鞍型栓塞 99.3% 降至段下 PE 72.9%，从急性 89.7% 降至非急性 65.3%。iPE 模型敏感度 73.5%、特异度 99.8%。两个模型的敏感度均低于 FDA 获批基准，特异度则高于获批基准。
Conclusion: 商业 AI 在外周与非急性栓塞上的敏感度下降与已知人类读片局限一致，真实世界敏感度低于获批基准，因此需要对 AI 医疗器械建立标准化的上市后监测。

papers.title: Optimizer-dependent training dynamics converge to the same one-third optimal data scaling
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling, in which loss falls as a power law with training, is central to large language models, and one recent proposal is that a $1/3$ exponent emerges from learning peaked distributions. That account describes SGD, but models in practice are trained with adaptive optimizers. Here we separate two exponents the $1/3$ account does not distinguish: how fast the loss falls with training steps along a single run, and how fast the optimally tuned loss falls with dataset size $D$. We show that the first, a dynamic exponent, is optimizer-specific while the second, an optimal data exponent, converges to $1/3$ across optimizers. In an online teacher-student model we decompose the loss into norm growth (radial) and alignment toward the teacher direction (tangential), each decaying as a power law with dynamic exponents $α_{r}$ and $α_{t}$. Under SGD, both are close to $1/3$, so the data exponent is also $1/3$ across different learning rates. Under Adam the two separate: $α_{r} \simeq 0.48$ but $α_{t} \simeq 0.08$. Since the total loss is minimized when these two parts are balanced, the optimal learning rate is optimizer-dependent: $D$-independent for SGD but falls with $D$ for Adam. Yet tuned to that optimum, the loss returns to $D^{-1/3}$ for both. A stochastic-dynamics analysis explains why: the optimizers can trade decay speed between the two channels, but they all fall on a single dynamic exponent relation, $2α_{r}+ α_{t} = 1$, which fixes the optimal data exponent at $1/3$. Across seven optimizers, including Muon, the measured exponents are consistent with this relation, and the optimal-loss envelopes agree with $D^{-1/3}$ across them. The optimizer sets how fast a model learns per step; tuned optimally, it changes the prefactor but not the rate at which loss falls per sample.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把神经缩放拆成两个指数：单次训练中损失随步数下降的动态指数，以及调到最优后损失随数据量 D 下降的数据指数。动态指数依赖优化器（SGD 下径向与切向都约 1/3，Adam 下 α_r≈0.48 而 α_t≈0.08），但调到各自最优学习率后，七个优化器（含 Muon）的数据指数都收敛到 D^{-1/3}。
Motivation: 1/3 指数的既有解释只针对 SGD，而实践中模型用自适应优化器训练；且该解释未区分随步数的动态指数与随数据量的最优数据指数，两者混在一起无法判断 1/3 是否普适。
Method: 在在线 teacher-student 模型中把损失分解为范数增长（radial）与向教师方向对齐（tangential）两部分，各自按幂律衰减并记动态指数 α_r、α_t；再做随机动力学分析，导出关系式 2α_r + α_t = 1，用它解释不同优化器如何在两通道间分配衰减速度，并在七个优化器上测量指数与最优损失包络。
Result: SGD 下 α_r 与 α_t 都接近 1/3，数据指数在不同学习率下均为 1/3；Adam 下 α_r ≈ 0.48 而 α_t ≈ 0.08，最优学习率随 D 下降（SGD 则与 D 无关）。七个优化器（含 Muon）测得的指数与 2α_r + α_t = 1 一致，最优损失包络在各优化器上都符合 D^{-1/3}。
Conclusion: 优化器决定每步学多快，但调到最优时只改变前因子，不改变损失随每样本下降的速率；数据指数 1/3 由 2α_r + α_t = 1 这一关系固定，对优化器普适。

papers.title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K history budget, well below the models' maximum context windows. Within this budget, it achieves task performance close to or above that of passing the full history while reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history. Ablations show that observed reuse improves task performance and retention of results reused later.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContextRender 用执行依赖的持久图管理 LLM agent 上下文：Tool-Flow Analysis 追踪后续操作对早期工具结果的复用，产出 observed reuse 信号，与近时性、语义相关性一起在固定历史预算内选结果。在 AppWorld 与 8-objective QA、三种执行模型上，6K 历史预算下任务表现接近或超过传入完整历史，平均推理成本相对 Full history 降低 10.2%–32.2%。
Motivation: 长程 agent 把完整历史传给每次调用代价高，直接截断又会丢掉后续步骤要用的信息；已有上下文管理方法忽略早期工具结果在后续执行中如何被复用，导致所需信息被排除在上下文之外。
Method: 维护执行依赖的持久图，用 Tool-Flow Analysis 追踪后续操作对先前工具结果的复用，得到 observed reuse 信号；renderer 将其与 recency、semantic relevance 合并，在固定历史预算内挑选结果，并保留被省略的结果供后续使用。
Result: 在 AppWorld 与 8-objective QA、三种执行模型上，使用 6K 历史预算（远低于模型最大上下文窗口）时优于所评估的上下文管理基线；该预算内任务表现接近或高于传入完整历史，平均推理成本相对 Full history 降低 10.2%–32.2%。消融显示 observed reuse 提升任务表现与后续被复用结果的保留率。
Conclusion: 按执行依赖中的复用信号来分配上下文，可以在远小于最大窗口的预算下保住完整历史的任务表现并显著降低推理成本。

papers.title: HyDI: A hybrid Deep Learning-Inductive Logic Programming ensemble for multi-label classification
papers.abstract_en: While attaining remarkable results for many applications, Deep Learning models are notoriously difficult to explain. This work introduces HyDI, a hybrid ensemble architecture for hierarchical multi-label classification. It combines a Deep Learning (DL) model with rule-based classifiers generated by Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). For leaf classes of the label hierarchy, the rule-based classifiers replace the DL model, leading to more transparent classification results. HyDI is applied to the Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (ChEBI) ontology, providing ILP-generated rules for 314 classes. For these classes, HyDI can generate global explanations as well as local explanations that combine visual and text-based descriptions.
papers.comment: Accepted at IJCLR26 (6th International Joint Conference on Learning & Reasoning, 16-18 September 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HyDI：把深度学习模型与归纳逻辑编程 (ILP) 生成的规则分类器组成混合集成，用于层次化多标签分类，在标签层次的叶类上用规则分类器替换 DL 模型以获得更透明的结果。在 ChEBI 本体上为 314 个类生成 ILP 规则，可同时给出全局解释和结合可视化与文本描述的局部解释。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在许多应用上效果显著但难以解释；层次化多标签分类中叶类的预测尤其缺少可读的规则依据。
Method: HyDI 混合集成架构：DL 模型与 ILP 生成的规则分类器组合，对标签层次的叶类用规则分类器替换 DL 模型；在 Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (ChEBI) 本体上运行 ILP 生成规则，并输出全局解释与融合可视化和文本的局部解释。
Result: 在 ChEBI 本体上为 314 个类生成了 ILP 规则；这些类上可产生全局解释以及结合可视化与文本描述的局部解释，叶类分类结果因此更透明。
Conclusion: 在叶类上用 ILP 规则替换深度模型，可以在保持层次多标签分类可用的同时把预测转成可读规则与多模态解释。

papers.title: Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States for Molecular Potential Energy Surfaces in Second Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Second-quantized neural-network quantum states have achieved accurate molecular energies, but extending them across molecular geometries requires a shared representation of the geometry-dependent wavefunction coefficients. We introduce geometry-conditioned foundation neural-network quantum states for molecular electronic structure in second quantization. A single autoregressive model learns a family of ground states from sparse anchor geometries and provides wavefunctions at untrained geometries without further optimization. Orbital alignment matches orbital identities and transports their phases, establishing an aligned orbital basis across geometries. Frozen energies reach chemical accuracy at every untrained query geometry for N$_2$, CO, and H$_4$. On additional molecular paths, the energy-trained wavefunctions yield dipoles, quadrupoles, and natural occupations without property labels. Across three paired N$_2$ training seeds, orbital alignment lowers the mean absolute energy error over all untrained query geometries from 34-37 mHa to 0.049-0.085 mHa. At approximately 1 mHa mean absolute error, frozen evaluation reduces the per-geometry cost by $986\times$ relative to independent optimization, yielding an estimated $25.8\times$ end-to-end GPU-cost reduction on a 161-point N$_2$ grid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把几何条件化的 foundation neural-network quantum state 塞进二次量子化框架，用单个自回归模型从稀疏 anchor 几何学出一族基态，配合 orbital alignment 对齐轨道身份与相位，直接在未训练几何上给出波函数而无需再优化。三个 N2 训练种子下，orbital alignment 把所有未训练查询几何的平均绝对能量误差从 34-37 mHa 压到 0.049-0.085 mHa，N2、CO、H4 在每个未训练几何均达 chemical accuracy。
Motivation: 二次量子化的神经网络量子态只能对单个分子几何做变分优化，跨几何推广需要共享的、随几何变化的波函数系数表示，否则每个新几何都要重新优化。
Method: 提出 geometry-conditioned foundation neural-network quantum state：单个自回归模型从稀疏 anchor 几何学习一族基态；引入 orbital alignment 匹配跨几何的轨道身份并传输其相位，建立对齐的轨道基；在冻结 (frozen) 参数下直接查询未训练几何，并由能量训练的波函数导出偶极、四极与自然占据数。
Result: N2、CO、H4 在每个未训练查询几何上 frozen 能量达到 chemical accuracy；三个配对 N2 训练种子中，orbital alignment 使全部未训练查询几何的平均绝对能量误差从 34-37 mHa 降至 0.049-0.085 mHa；在约 1 mHa 平均绝对误差水平上，frozen 评估相对逐几何独立优化把单几何成本降低 986 倍，在 161 点 N2 网格上估计端到端 GPU 成本降低 25.8 倍；额外分子路径上无需 property label 即得到偶极、四极与自然占据数。
Conclusion: 跨几何的轨道对齐加几何条件化自回归 NQS 可以把逐几何变分优化替换为一次训练后的冻结查询，在保持 chemical accuracy 的同时把评估成本降约三个数量级。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Camera Inside the Editor: Reading the Implicit Camera of Image Editors with Painted Calibration Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editors insert objects, restyle scenes and render new viewpoints, but it is unknown which camera they assume when they paint into a photograph. Asked to cover the floor with a checkerboard, an editor paints projective structure from which classical vanishing-point geometry reads pitch, roll, focal length, yaw and, on renders, the principal point, without any training. Unlike a calibrator such as GeoCalib, which estimates the camera of an image, this isolates the camera under which the editor paints. On 120 rendered cameras with exact ground truth, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 paints tile edges that meet their vanishing points within 0.26 degrees, and its implicit camera matches the true one to 0.8 degrees in pitch and 6% in focal length, more accurately than GeoCalib except in roll. Asked to draw the horizon or mark a vanishing point instead, the editor fails, so this knowledge is revealed by painting and not by the explicit tasks we tried. The implicit camera has two priors: roll is pulled towards level (slope 0.71), and telephoto perspective towards a default of about 30 mm, which roughly matches the camera the models paint without any scene. For Qwen, the priors do not grow when blur removes four fifths of the line evidence. They are stronger on real photographs, and on NYUv2 a shorter wording of the task removes the difference for roll. On photographs from a 24--240 mm zoom lens the painted perspective grows with only 0.62 of the lens's slope, while GeoCalib and MoGe-2 saturate at about 52 and 42 mm. FLUX.1 Kontext and LongCat-Image-Edit are pulled much harder. Finally, from a level camera a camera-control LoRA executes pose commands at only 50--70% of their strength, and a board painted into its output agrees with the camera it produced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 让指令式图像编辑器画棋盘格，再用经典消失点几何反读它作画时隐含的相机参数，无需训练即可得到 pitch、roll、焦距、yaw 及渲染图上的主点。Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 在 120 个有真值的渲染相机上，画出的格线与消失点偏差 0.26 度，隐含相机与真值差 0.8 度 pitch、6% 焦距，除 roll 外比 GeoCalib 更准；但显式要求画地平线或标消失点时编辑器失败，说明该知识只在作画中暴露。隐含相机带两个先验：roll 被拉向水平（斜率 0.71），长焦被拉向约 30 mm 默认值，24–240 mm 变焦照片上画出的透视只随镜头走 0.62 倍斜率，而 GeoCalib 与 MoGe-2 分别在约 52 与 42 mm 饱和；相机控制 LoRA 只执行 50–70% 的位姿指令强度。
Motivation: 指令式图像编辑器往照片里画物体时默认用了哪套相机参数并不清楚，现有标定器（如 GeoCalib）估计的是图像本身的相机，无法分离出编辑器作画时隐含的相机。
Method: 让编辑器在场景中画棋盘格等标定图案，再用经典消失点几何 (vanishing-point geometry) 从画出的投影结构直接解算 pitch、roll、焦距、yaw 与主点，全程无需训练；与 GeoCalib、MoGe-2 对比，并通过画地平线、标消失点等显式任务、模糊掉四分之五线条证据、真实照片与 NYUv2 上的不同措辞来检验先验强度。
Result: 在 120 个有精确真值的渲染相机上，Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 画出的格线与消失点相差 0.26 度，隐含相机与真值差 0.8 度 pitch、6% 焦距，除 roll 外优于 GeoCalib；roll 先验斜率 0.71，长焦先验默认约 30 mm，模糊掉四分之五线条证据后先验不变；24–240 mm 变焦照片上画出的透视斜率仅为镜头的 0.62，GeoCalib 与 MoGe-2 分别在约 52 mm 与 42 mm 饱和，FLUX.1 Kontext 与 LongCat-Image-Edit 被拉得更强；相机控制 LoRA 只执行 50–70% 的位姿指令强度。
Conclusion: 编辑器作画时隐含一个可被经典几何读出的相机，且带向水平 roll 与约 30 mm 焦距的强先验，这一知识只在作画行为中显现，显式画地平线或标消失点的任务反而失败。

papers.title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space
papers.abstract_en: Activation space and parameter space provide complementary views of model computation. Activations represent information, while weights read, transform, and write that information. Yet existing interpretability methods largely study the two spaces separately, leaving the connection between represented information and parameter-level computation underexplored. We introduce Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD), which jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces and grounds each learned weight component in the activation features it reads or writes. This grounding constrains otherwise non-unique parameter decompositions using the model's internal activations, while an internal reconstruction objective provides a local learning signal at the weight matrix being analyzed. Together, these properties enable scalable, interpretable, and causally editable parameter decomposition in pretrained large language models, demonstrated on Qwen-3-8B. The learned read--write components can also be composed into parameter-level mechanism circuits. We use ASPD to recover mechanisms underlying the classic IOI circuit and trace semantic transformations through model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD)，把激活空间与参数空间联合分解，用模型内部激活为每个学到的权重分量指定它读取或写入的特征，从而约束本不唯一的参数分解，并以权重矩阵处的内部重建目标提供局部学习信号。在 Qwen-3-8B 上展示可扩展、可因果编辑的分解，复原经典 IOI 电路的机制并把读写分量组合成参数级机制电路。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法把激活空间与参数空间分开研究，表示的信息与参数级计算之间的联系未被充分探索，参数分解本身也不唯一。
Method: ASPD 联合分解激活与参数空间，把每个学到的权重分量锚定到它读取或写入的激活特征上，用内部重建目标在被分析的权重矩阵上给出局部学习信号；学到的读写分量可组合为参数级机制电路。
Result: 在预训练大语言模型 Qwen-3-8B 上演示该分解，复原经典 IOI 电路背后的机制，并通过模型权重追踪语义变换。
Conclusion: 用激活特征约束参数分解可得到可扩展、可解释且可因果编辑的权重分解，读写分量能组合成参数级机制电路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CHB-MIT, HyBrain achieves the best AUROC on every reported setting against ten baselines, with the largest gap on long-clip preictal prediction. It also matches the most efficient baselines in training time and peak GPU memory. A qualitative analysis shows that even a single learned hyperedge cleanly captures the preictal -> ictal -> postictal trajectory on a real seizure clip.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HyBrain：用少量软超边 (soft hyperedges) 替代逐时刻成对通道边，把跨通道、跨时间的癫痫发作证据聚合成共享组嵌入，在 TUSZ 与 CHB-MIT 上于全部报告设置对十个基线取得最佳 AUROC，长片段发作前预测差距最大，同时训练时间与峰值显存追平最高效基线。
Motivation: 现有动态图神经网络对 EEG 只建模逐时间步的成对通道边，丢失构成发作的时空耦合，且训练开销大；发作事件稀少、时间上局部化、又跨多通道协同传播，检测与预测都难。
Method: 每通道用 Mamba backbone 生成 (channel, second) 粒度的 token，时空超边块通过软隶属度 (soft memberships) 把这些 token 池化为 E_h 个共享组嵌入再广播回去；同一编码器服务三个下游任务：窗口级检测、逐秒点式检测、发作前 (preictal) 预测。
Result: 在 TUSZ 与 CHB-MIT 上，HyBrain 在每个报告设置中相对十个基线取得最佳 AUROC，长片段 preictal 预测上差距最大；训练时间与峰值 GPU 显存与最高效的基线相当；定性分析显示单条学习到的超边即可在真实发作片段上清晰刻画 preictal → ictal → postictal 轨迹。
Conclusion: 用少量软超边取代成对边足以表示发作的时空耦合，能在不增加训练成本的前提下同时支撑检测与发作前预测三类任务。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Context Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Context Language Models (CLM)：把上下文当作模型可无限制读写的文件，让模型自己决定保留什么，天然扩展到多 agent 共享文件式上下文。零样本构建即超过现有 SOTA 上下文管理策略（BrowseComp-Plus 准确率 +11.4% 且 FLOPs 少 21.5%），在线 RL 使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上再提升 47.6% 且 FLOPs 少 12%。
Motivation: 上下文管理目前由外部 harness 控制，既费算力又限制模型学习自身管理策略；长时程 agent 任务（12 小时、24 小时）上算力开销尤其突出。
Method: 将上下文建模为文件，模型可对其做无限制更新，零样本基于现有模型构建；多 agent 场景中各 agent 上下文作为共存文件。上下文管理策略可同时通过 in-context 与 parametric 两种方式学习，并用自然语言指令经标准 skill-optimization loop 进行 steering，另提出面向 CLM 的在线强化学习方法，以及与 SGLang 对标的 Suffix Cache Reuse 服务共设计。
Result: BrowseComp-Plus 准确率 +11.4% 且 FLOPs 少 21.5%；12 小时 EdgeBench 分数 +5% 且 FLOPs 少 59%；24 小时多仓库 agent-swarm 任务在同等算力下提升幅度大 65%。skill-optimization loop 演化出的指令在 held-out 上最高提升 35.9 个点并降低算力；在线 RL 使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上提升 47.6% 且 FLOPs 少 12%；Suffix Cache Reuse 在同等性能下比标准 SGLang 再降 35% 服务端算力。
Conclusion: 把上下文管理从外部 harness 移入模型内在行为，可同时拿到更高准确率与更低算力，并使策略既能被自然语言指令调制、也能被在线 RL 优化。

papers.title: CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4 fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CogWAM 用持久 Semantic State 记录已完成任务事件与当前子任务，只在观测显示语义转移时更新它，并以 progress-conditioned WORLD/ACTION 查询把任务语义接到世界预测与动作生成上。推理时去掉未来预测分支，直接由观测与状态生成动作；不做额外机器人动作预训练即在 RoboDojo 上取得 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR，BiCoord 达到 SOTA，真机双臂闭环中 Semantic State 重建次数比逐步更新少 16.4 倍。
Motivation: 机器人策略里语义推理与未来世界预测各自存在，但局部预测与动作容易和任务整体进度脱节，任务级上下文在多个 action chunk 之间难以保持。
Method: CogWAM 维护持久 Semantic State（已完事件 + 活动子任务），仅在观测触发语义转移时更新；progress-conditioned WORLD 与 ACTION 查询分别抽取任务相关信息做未来世界预测与动作生成，训练时两分支共享该状态提供的任务进度上下文，推理时移除预测分支；另引入语义训练策略改进转移学习与闭环条件化。
Result: 在不做额外机器人动作预训练的条件下，RoboDojo 上 Score/SR 为 15.56 / 11.70 %，BiCoord 上达到 state-of-the-art；真机双臂闭环实验中 Semantic State 重建次数比 step-wise updating 少 16.4 次（16.4 fewer）。
Conclusion: 把任务语义状态作为显式接口、只在语义转移时更新，可以让任务上下文跨 action chunk 持续并支撑闭环双臂操作，同时省去逐步重建状态的开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks. Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum identifies output-sensitive directions and approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream. For causal transformers, the same geometry induces a tokenwise curvature score: a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of the target logits to perturbations of each token's hidden state. This score vanishes outside the causal ancestor set of the target and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings, making it a loss-aware alternative to attention magnitude. We estimate these quantities using matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluate them across decoder-only language models on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb. Empirically, the induced geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to stronger autoregressive distillation objectives such as reverse KL and skew KL. These results support a predictive-geometric view of transformer computation: near successful trajectories, the terminal loss induces a thin, anisotropic set of output-relevant hidden-state directions that can be measured and exploited for compression and distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 decoder-only transformer 的终端 next-token loss 写成 layerwise loss-to-go 函数，证明其在成功验证轨迹附近的二阶几何由 hidden-state 空间上的 pullback Fisher 算子主导，据此导出 tokenwise curvature score。该 score 在目标 token 的因果祖先集之外恒为零，是比 attention 幅度更贴近 loss 的敏感度度量；在 WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb 上它能预测扰动敏感度、给出非均匀层秩分配、产生有竞争力的结构化 token 剪枝信号，并在叠加 reverse KL、skew KL 等自回归蒸馏目标后改善低秩 student 恢复。
Motivation: 终端 loss 只约束最后一个 token，中间 hidden state 如何被下游计算反向锁定缺少形式化刻画；现有剪枝与蒸馏信号多依赖 attention 幅度，与真实 loss 敏感度并不对齐。
Method: 定义 layerwise loss-to-go：把候选 hidden state 继续过完剩余 block 得到的终端 loss；在成功验证轨迹附近展开其二阶项，识别出主导的 pullback Fisher 算子，谱分解给出 output-sensitive 与 prediction-null 方向，合成 residual stream 的局部可观测子空间。对因果 transformer 诱导 tokenwise curvature score（目标 logits 对各 token hidden state 扰动的 Fisher 加权敏感度），全部量用 matrix-free 的 Jacobian-vector / vector-Jacobian 乘积估计。
Result: 在 decoder-only 语言模型的 WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb 上评测：诱导几何能预测扰动敏感度，支持非均匀的 layerwise rank 分配，产生有竞争力的结构化 token 剪枝信号；把该 score 加到 reverse KL、skew KL 等更强的自回归蒸馏目标上能改善低秩 student 恢复。curvature score 在目标的因果祖先集之外为零，并受下游 Jacobian 耦合控制。
Conclusion: 在成功轨迹附近，终端 loss 诱导出一组薄而各向异性的 output-relevant hidden-state 方向，它们可被测量并直接用于压缩与蒸馏，构成一种 transformer 计算的 predictive-geometric 视角。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Volatility-Clustering Adaptation for Financial Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models are increasingly adapted to new domains through fine-tuning on target data, under the implicit assumption that more target data yields better forecasts. We show that this assumption can fail in financial forecasting, where individual price changes are difficult to predict, but large moves tend to cluster, creating alternating calm and turbulent periods. Using financial foundation models trained on price bars of open, high, low, close, and volume, we argue that adapting to financial domains requires training signals beyond next-token prediction. We introduce Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA), which augments next-token cross-entropy with a differentiable penalty on the autocorrelation of squared returns, the standard statistical signature of volatility clustering. This additional objective provides a multi-step training signal by matching the resulting dependence structure of autoregressive rollouts to those of the realized future. Across three asset sets and two evaluation conventions, VCA improves adaptation over the pre-trained model, with the strongest gains under the primary evaluation (\textsc{fore}), driven primarily by reduced variance error. Overall, our results suggest that effective financial adaptation requires objectives that capture domain-specific temporal structure beyond token-level prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VCA 在金融基础模型微调的 next-token 交叉熵之外，加入对收益率平方自相关 (autocorrelation of squared returns) 的可微惩罚，把自回归 rollout 的依赖结构对齐到真实未来，从而捕捉波动率聚集 (volatility clustering)。在三组资产、两种评估口径下，VCA 均优于直接微调预训练模型，且在主口径 fore 下提升最大，主要来自方差误差 (variance error) 的下降。
Motivation: 金融时序基础模型微调默认目标数据越多预测越好，但单个价格变动难以预测、大波动却会聚集，纯 next-token 目标缺少刻画这种跨步依赖的训练信号。
Method: 在预训练金融基础模型（输入 OHLCV 价格 bar）的 next-token 交叉熵上叠加一个可微惩罚项，约束收益率平方的自相关，使自回归 rollout 的依赖结构与真实未来匹配；在三组资产上做微调并与预训练模型对比，采用两种评估口径。

papers.title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyOCR 把 OCR 从纯文本转写推向统一的视觉智能基础模型族，用共享指令框架加大规模数据引擎产出质量校验的 OCR 监督，并以 Competence-Guided Policy Optimization（verifier-based GRPO + 基于教师可靠度与师生能力差距的逐样本路由 on-policy 蒸馏）训练不同规模模型。同时修订 OCRBench v2.1（人工校正标注 + 任务对齐评分），在 OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、in-house KIE Benchmark、OmniDocBench v1.6 与 MDPBench 上达到 SOTA 或极具竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 现有 OCR 系统往往只在部分任务上擅长，难以在识别、解析与推理之间跨场景取得平衡，而 OCR 的目标已扩展到在复杂视觉环境中识别、定位并推理文本信息。
Method: PolyOCR 家族采用共享的指令跟随框架，配一个把异构视觉资源转换为质量校验 OCR 监督的大规模数据引擎；训练用 Competence-Guided Policy Optimization，即 verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization 结合 on-policy 蒸馏，按教师可靠度与师生能力差距做逐样本路由；另发布 OCRBench v2.1，为 OCRBench v2 的修订版，含人工核验的标注更正与任务对齐评分指标。
Result: 在 OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、in-house KIE Benchmark、OmniDocBench v1.6 与 MDPBench 上的大量实验中，PolyOCR 达到 state-of-the-art 或极具竞争力的表现；OCRBench v2.1 本身带来人工核验的标注更正与任务对齐评分。
Conclusion: 统一的指令框架加能力引导的策略优化可以把识别、解析与推理收进同一 OCR 基础模型族，并在多个 OCR 基准上取得 SOTA 或高度竞争力的结果。

papers.title: VIF-Bench: Evaluating Visual Instruction Following in Multi-Reference Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues. However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images. To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity. Using these capabilities, we uncover three findings: (1) models face an adherence-artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts in generated images, (2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and (3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description. VIF-Bench is released as an open benchmark to establish a basis for fair comparison in controllable multi-reference image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIF-Bench 是一个含 1,241 个任务的多参考图像生成基准，测试最多 7 张参考图与最多 6 张异质视觉指令（布局、箭头、姿态）联合作用下的指令遵循能力。三项发现：指令遵循越强往往伴随越多指令伪影；当参考图本身带有被控属性的显著状态（如光照方向指令下的霓虹灯主体）时遵循度下降，光与风最明显；能理解视觉指令的模型直接给视觉约束优于用文字描述，文字描述中等详细度优于穷尽式。
Motivation: 现有基准不评估多张参考图与多张异质视觉指令图像联合组合的设定，无法衡量模型在该联合场景下的能力边界。
Method: 构建 VIF-Bench，1,241 个任务覆盖三类：多参考生成（最多 7 张）配多条异质视觉指令（最多 6 条）；参考图与视觉指令可能冲突的案例（如姿态强烈的主体 vs 目标姿态）；视觉指令与不同详细度文本描述的受控对比。
Result: 共 1,241 个任务，参考图最多 7 张、视觉指令最多 6 条。三项发现：遵循度与指令伪影存在权衡，遵循更强时伪影更多；参考图携带被控属性显著状态时遵循度更低，光与风最一致；直接给视觉约束通常优于文字描述，文字描述中等详细度优于穷尽式。
Conclusion: 可控多参考图像生成中，视觉指令遵循与图像伪影存在内在权衡，且参考图状态会削弱遵循；对能理解视觉指令的模型，直接给视觉约束比转述成文字更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Interactions: Weaving Multiparty Human Motion with Bilevel Latent Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Human social behaviour is not a collection of independent motions, but a jointly organised process in which group dynamics and individual variation continuously shape one another. Yet existing social motion models often prioritise plausible trajectories while leaving interaction state implicit, limiting their ability to transfer across groups, tasks, and partial-observation regimes. To address this gap, we introduce Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID), a hierarchical sequential latent-variable model for generative multi-person interaction. BRAID explicitly formulates social motion generation as a meta-transfer learning problem: shared interaction priors are learned across datasets and adapted through arbitrary context sets of observed people and joints. The model represents each scene through a group-level latent state that captures shared interaction dynamics and person-level latent states that capture individual behaviour conditioned on the evolving group context. This modelling choice enables coherent generation under full, sparse, or partial observations while exposing compact social-state vectors that can serve as an interface for downstream embodied-agent systems. We evaluate BRAID under a unified SMPL-based representation on social forecasting, tracking and in-filling, and response generation, using metrics that assess not only reconstruction accuracy but also realism, diversity, temporal alignment, and interpersonal coordination. We further analyse the hierarchical latent space, showing that it captures separable group- and individual-level structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BRAID：分层序列隐变量生成模型，用群体级隐状态与个体级隐状态共同表示多人交互，并把社交运动生成形式化为跨数据集的元迁移学习，共享交互先验可通过任意观测人物与关节的上下文集适配。在统一 SMPL 表示下，模型支持全观测、稀疏与部分观测下的连贯生成，并暴露紧凑的社会状态向量供下游具身智能体使用。
Motivation: 现有社交运动模型只追求轨迹合理而把交互状态隐式化，导致跨群体、跨任务与部分观测场景的迁移能力受限。
Method: BRAID 是分层序列隐变量模型：群体级隐状态捕捉共享交互动力学，个体级隐状态在演化中的群体上下文条件下刻画个体行为；共享交互先验跨数据集学习，再通过任意上下文集（观测的人与关节）做元迁移适配。评测采用统一 SMPL 表示，覆盖社交预报、跟踪与补全、响应生成四类任务。
Result: 在统一 SMPL 表示下评估 social forecasting、tracking、in-filling 与 response generation，指标同时覆盖重建精度、真实性、多样性、时间对齐与人际协调；对分层隐空间的分析显示其捕捉到可分离的群体级与个体级结构。
Conclusion: 把群体与个体隐状态显式分层并按元迁移学习组织，可在全、稀疏、部分观测下连贯生成社交运动，其紧凑社会状态向量可作为下游具身系统的接口。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SPARK: A General Goodness-of-Fit Assessment via Residual Projection
papers.abstract_en: Goodness-of-fit testing is a basic tool for assessing whether a fitted procedure has captured the systematic information contained in the covariates. While traditional theory has largely focused on parametric regression models, modern data analysis increasingly relies on flexible black-box learners, whose predictive success alone is insufficient to assess model accuracy. In this paper, we propose SPARK, a general framework for goodness-of-fit testing that applies to traditional statistical models and general black-box learning procedures, continuous and binary responses, and low- and high-dimensional predictors. Based on a debiasing strategy, the residuals from an initial fit of a learning procedure are projected onto nearly orthogonal directions to extract any remaining signal. To capture information across all projection directions, we propose a kernel-based projection method and establish both its asymptotic properties and the consistency of a bootstrap procedure. Comprehensive simulations and real data analyses illustrate the effectiveness and flexibility of our proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARK 是一个面向任意拟合流程的拟合优度检验 (goodness-of-fit testing) 框架：对初始拟合取残差，投影到近正交方向上提取残余信号，再用基于核的投影方法覆盖全部投影方向。它建立该核投影的渐近性质与 bootstrap 一致性，适用于传统统计模型与黑盒学习流程、连续与二值响应、低维与高维预测变量。
Motivation: 传统拟合优度理论主要覆盖参数回归模型，而现代分析依赖灵活的黑盒学习器，仅凭预测成功度不足以判断模型是否学到了协变量中的系统信息。
Method: 基于 debiasing 策略，对学习流程初始拟合的残差投影到近正交方向以提取残余信号；为捕捉所有投影方向上的信息，提出 kernel-based projection 方法，并建立其渐近性质与 bootstrap 程序的一致性。
Result: 综合仿真与真实数据分析说明该方法的有效性与灵活性；适用范围覆盖传统统计模型与一般黑盒学习流程、连续与二值响应、低维与高维预测变量。
Conclusion: 残差经近正交投影加核化方向平均，可作为跨模型类别与响应类型的通用拟合优度检验，其推断由所建立的渐近理论与一致 bootstrap 支撑。

papers.title: Width Expansion as a Method for Class Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Class Incremental Learning (Class-IL) requires models to learn new classes over time while preserving previously acquired knowledge without access to past data or task identity. This setting intensifies the stability-plasticity dilemma and makes catastrophic forgetting a central challenge. Existing approaches include regularization, knowledge distillation, replay, and architectural expansion. However, many expansion methods rely on explicit task identifiers or predefined growth strategies, limiting their applicability when task boundaries are unavailable at inference time. This work proposes a dynamic width expansion method that increases the number of neurons within existing layers according to a normalized loss criterion, without requiring task-specific information. An attention mechanism with persistent key-value memory is also incorporated to stabilize feature representations and reduce interference between previously learned and newly introduced classes. The approach is evaluated on Split MNIST and Split CIFAR-100 under the standard Class-IL protocol. Experiments compare fixed-capacity and dynamically expanding architectures, both with and without attention, combined with established continual learning methods including EWC, LwF, and A-GEM. Results show that progressive width expansion consistently improves performance over fixed architectures, particularly when combined with functional methods and A-GEM. The combination of width expansion and attention provides the most consistent gains. Overall, dynamic width expansion based on representational demand provides an effective and flexible strategy for Class-IL, although uncontrolled growth may increase overfitting and computational cost.

papers.title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy emerges: correctness concentrates in the answer span, recovered from the answer tokens even under retrieval, and the families carry it complementarily, so fusing them helps most out of distribution, where a single signal is weakest. The protocol is effective across two backbones and gates a retrieval controller as one downstream use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结 LLM 上系统搜索哪些内部信号能从单次前向读出答案正确性：遍历 hidden states、token 概率、residual-stream 特征、attention 及其融合，并在 closed-book 与 with-context 两种设定下分别做。结论是正确性信号集中在 answer span、即使有检索证据也仍由答案 token 恢复，各信号族互补，融合在分布外提升最大，并在两个 backbone 上有效、可用来门控检索控制器。
Motivation: 现有探针往往只锁定单一信号族或单一层，在分布偏移下脆弱；检索场景的专用检测器瞄准 passage faithfulness，而检索证据无用或冲突时 faithfulness 会偏离 correctness。
Method: 把选中的 readout 当作预测性测量而非机制定位，在 hidden states、token probabilities、residual-stream features、attention 及其融合构成的空间上搜索；closed-book 与 with-context 两套设定分开跑，最后用选出的读出门控一个 retrieval controller。
Result: 一致的解剖结构：正确性集中在 answer span，即使在检索条件下也能从答案 token 恢复；各信号族互补，融合在分布外（OOD）帮助最大，此时单一信号最弱；协议在两个 backbone 上均有效，并作为下游用途门控 retrieval controller。
Conclusion: 答案正确性是可从冻结模型单次前向读出的、跨信号族互补的信号，读出位置应随是否带上下文分别确定，融合读出最适合 OOD 场景。

papers.title: GARDiff: Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion for Probabilistic Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting by modeling complex conditional distributions. Recent decoupled diffusion frameworks further separate forecasting into deterministic prediction and stochastic residual generation, making it natural to derive dependency graphs from deterministic representations and use them to guide residual diffusion. However, we show that this direct structural transfer is unreliable. Although deterministic-derived graphs encode useful global dependency priors, they exhibit substantial edge-level misalignment with residual dependency structures, introducing inaccurate or redundant conditions during residual generation. This reveals a previously overlooked deterministic-to-residual structural alignment problem in decoupled diffusion forecasting. To address this problem, we propose GARDiff, a Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion framework for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting. Instead of treating deterministic-derived graphs as fixed diffusion conditions, GARDiff progressively adapts them to residual generation. Specifically, GARDiff estimates residual uncertainty to distinguish high- and low-uncertainty regions, enabling uncertainty-aware structural refinement, and further performs timestep-aware edge sparsification during reverse diffusion to evolve graph conditions from broad dependency aggregation to localized residual refinement. Extensive experiments on six real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GARDiff consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance and uncertainty calibration over strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GARDiff 指出解耦扩散预报中把确定性表示导出的依赖图直接当作残差扩散条件会与真实残差结构错位，引入错误或冗余条件；它改为逐步让图对齐残差生成，先估计残差不确定性区分高低不确定区域做结构细化，再在反向扩散中做时间步感知的边稀疏化，使图条件从全局依赖聚合演化到局部残差细化。在六个真实基准上一致提升概率预报性能与不确定性校准。
Motivation: 解耦扩散框架把预报拆成确定性预测与随机残差生成，自然地从确定性表示导出依赖图去引导残差扩散，但这种直接的结构迁移不可靠：确定性图与残差依赖结构存在显著的边级错位，即确定性到残差的结构对齐问题被忽视。
Method: GARDiff 不把确定性导出的图当作固定的扩散条件，而是渐进适配：估计残差不确定性以区分高、低不确定区域，据此做不确定性感知的结构细化；并在反向扩散过程中执行时间步感知的边稀疏化 (timestep-aware edge sparsification)，让图条件从宽泛依赖聚合演化到局部残差细化。
Result: 在六个真实世界基准上的实验显示，GARDiff 在概率预报性能与不确定性校准上一致优于强基线 (strong baselines)。
Conclusion: 确定性导出的依赖图不能直接充当残差扩散的固定条件，需要在残差生成过程中渐进对齐，才能稳定带来概率预报与校准的双重提升。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memory systems accumulate RGB observations or latent features, causing storage requirements to grow as generation proceeds. We introduce **Honeycomb**, a video world model built on **HexMemory**, a compact low-rank representation that stores scene features in a fixed-size memory comprising six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each newly generated video chunk to plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, HexMemory warps the existing planes while preserving their dimensions, then integrates new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latent features from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. Because the writer processes only observations from the latest chunk, Honeycomb avoids per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full generation history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust consistency when revisiting previously observed regions, while maintaining constant feature-storage requirements throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Honeycomb 用 HexMemory 把场景特征存进固定大小的六平面（空间与时空各半）低秩表征，随覆盖与时域扩张只对已有平面做 warp 而不增尺寸，再用置信度加权池化与学习残差校正融入新特征。前馈 writer 只处理最新 chunk，避免逐场景优化与全历史重处理；在 WorldScore 与 RealEstate10K 上展示长程生成质量与回访已见区域的一致性，且特征存储全程恒定。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型的空间记忆按 RGB 或 latent 累积，存储随生成进程线性增长，长时程生成的内存开销不可控。
Method: HexMemory 以六个空间/时空平面构成固定尺寸低秩场景表征；前馈 writer 把每个新生成 chunk 映射为平面特征，扩张时 warp 旧平面并保持尺寸，用 confidence-weighted pooling 与学习残差校正整合新特征；reader 从中取 latent 条件后续生成。
Result: 在 WorldScore 与 RealEstate10K 上展示强视频生成质量与回访已见区域的稳健一致性，同时整个生成过程特征存储需求保持恒定。
Conclusion: 固定尺寸、按 chunk 前馈更新的记忆足以支撑长时程视频世界模型的一致性，无需随历史增长的存储或逐场景优化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce \emph{budgeted ATTA} in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding \emph{what} to label within a batch to deciding \emph{when} supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach \emph{WISE-ATTA} that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifaa/WISE-ATTA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WISE-ATTA 把主动测试时适应 (active test-time adaptation) 的问题从「批内选哪些样本标注」改成「整个测试流上何时申请标注」：只在预算允许的少数批次上请求标签，并用基于漂移的样本选择挑出适应尚未收敛的样本，使单个标注样本就能有效更新。在 ImageNet-C 合成腐蚀与 ImageNet-R/K/A 自然分布偏移上，它以明显更少的标签取得与近期 ATTA 方法相当或更好的性能。
Motivation: 现有 ATTA 方法默认每个测试批次都能请求监督，长测试流上标注成本很高；真正稀缺时，核心难题变成监督在时间轴上如何分配。
Method: 提出预算感知的 WISE-ATTA：用在线计算的轻量信号在测试流上分配监督预算，优先选择监督最可能有用的时段；批次被选中后，再用基于漂移 (drift-based) 的样本选择准则锁定适应动态仍在进行、尚未收敛的样本，从而用单个标注样本完成更新。
Result: 在 ImageNet-C 合成腐蚀与 ImageNet-R/K/A 自然分布偏移上，WISE-ATTA 相比近期 ATTA 方法取得相当或更优的性能，同时所需标签数量大幅减少。
Conclusion: 监督的时机是主动测试时适应中一个关键但被忽视的维度：在固定标注预算下，选对何时标注比在批内多选样本更省标签。

papers.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EngiWorld 是首个覆盖完整设计闭环的工程智能体基准：1,301 个专家任务横跨 CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA、3D 可视化 6 大领域与 26 款专业软件，用统一 domain-verifier 对产物做几何、物理与规则的程序化校验并按规格达成度连续打分。评测 7 个前沿模型后发现能力差距巨大：最强模型 EngiScore 仅 44.3，跨多软件任务成功率只有 3.6%。
Motivation: 通用计算机操作智能体进展很快，但工业工程工作流要求跨软件与设计阶段保持几何、物理约束和依赖关系的推理，可靠自动化仍不可及，缺少衡量端到端工程软件操作能力的基准。
Method: 构建 1,301 个专家策划任务，覆盖 6 个工程领域、26 个专业软件平台、GUI 与 CLI 两种接口以及从软件选择到开放式任务的 6 种任务类型；提出以产物为中心 (artifact-centric) 的评测方法，用统一 domain-verifier 套件程序化检查最终与中间产物的几何有效性、物理可行性和规则符合性，对定量设计任务按规格达成度 (specification attainment) 连续打分而非二元成败。
Result: 对 7 个前沿模型的评测显示明显能力差距：最强模型 EngiScore 仅 44.3，多软件协同尝试的成功率仅 3.6%。
Conclusion: 前沿智能体目前尚无法端到端操作专业工程软件，EngiWorld 为此提供了首个可严格度量进展的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PAIQ: Patch-Aligned Semantic Injection via Residual Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate--base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q. This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAIQ 用内容匹配把 SigLIP 语义特征注入 DINOv3 空间 patch 特征，再经共享正交旋转 Q 施加残差更新，在冻结双编码器与语言模型的前提下保留 patch 可分性。在 2B 与 Qwen 9B 骨干上，图像描述与 VQA 的 judge 评估正确性平均比最强融合/token 压缩基线高约 2.9 分，同时降低幻觉严重度。
Motivation: 语言对齐与自监督视觉编码器分别长于语义抽象和空间细节，但融合时既要增强局部特征，又要保住语义相近 patch 之间的区分，现有单编码器接口做不到。
Method: 以 DINOv3 patch 特征为空间基，用内容式跨编码器匹配做联合源分配 (joint source allocation) 聚合 SigLIP 特征，把聚合与基的差经共享正交变换 Q 注入；该旋转调整更新方向同时保持残差范数与成对夹角。只训练投影与融合参数，双视觉编码器和语言模型全冻结，融合保留 196 个视觉 token。
Result: 对固定投影特征推导出相似语义聚合下的 patch 可分性条件，证明当聚合共享时旋转比直接插值多出一个非负分离项。在多样语言骨干上，图像描述与 VQA 的 judge 评估正确性普遍提升、幻觉严重度下降；Qwen 2B 与 9B 骨干上平均比最强的融合或 token 压缩基线高约 2.9 个正确性百分点。
Conclusion: 正交约束的残差旋转能在完全冻结编码器与语言模型的轻量接口里同时保住 patch 可分性并压低幻觉，是单编码器接口的可行替代。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Society (IEEE ITSS), Sep 2026, Naples, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把驾驶员对 ACC 的油门接管 (override) 当作隐式监督信号，提出 CoP-ACC：先从接管事件中无监督聚类出代表性加速度剖面，再用上下文分类器按超车前驾驶条件选剖面，最后由残差回归器细化为平滑的个性化加速度曲线。在真实公开道路数据上对照 withheld forced-ACC 基线，重建保真度高，生成的剖面在可能触发接管的场景中趋向驾驶员预期行为。
Motivation: ACC 通常按平均驾驶员标定，在高速超车这类时间紧迫操作中与个人预期不匹配；驾驶员感到过于保守或不一致时会油门接管，这些接管信号此前未被用作个性化反馈。
Method: CoP-ACC 混合流水线：(i) 无监督层次聚类从 override 事件提取代表性加速度剖面；(ii) 上下文分类器把超车前驾驶条件映射到合适剖面；(iii) 残差回归器在所选剖面上细化出贴合即时上下文的平滑个性化加速度剖面，以避免端到端回归的过度平滑。
Result: 在真实公开道路数据上、以 withheld forced-ACC 为基线评估，方法展现高重建保真度，生成的加速度剖面在潜在 override 上下文中趋向驾驶员预期行为；摘要给出定性结论，无具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 从共享控制接管中学习可以实现预期式、个性化的 ACC 行为，减少手动干预并提升乘坐舒适性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.abstract_en: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains. To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO, a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process. On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Med-RADIO 用多教师蒸馏把多个医学专科模型与通用模型的互补专长压缩进统一的医学视觉基础模型：按模态对齐分配蒸馏流，把通用模型的预训练数据重组到专科域上，并用平衡损失防止单一教师主导。在覆盖五种模态的内外部分类基准上，线性探测 (linear probing) 下优于强医学通用模型，多数模态上与代表性专科模型相当。
Motivation: 医学通用模型的训练数据规模不及自然图像通用模型，域内深度又不及专科模型；通用模型只提供跨模态性能基线，专科模型才是各域的性能上限，需要把基线抬向这些上限。
Method: 提出 Med-RADIO 多教师蒸馏框架：同时挑选通用教师与专科教师，按模态对齐分配蒸馏流 (modality-aligned distillation streams)，把通用模型的预训练数据重组为与专科域匹配的结构，并施加平衡损失 (balanced loss) 避免任一教师主导蒸馏过程，最终压缩为单一医学视觉基础模型。
Result: 在覆盖五种模态的内部与外部分类基准上，Med-RADIO 在线性探测下超过强医学通用模型 (strong medical generalists)，并在多数被评测模态上与代表性专科模型 (representative specialists) 竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 多教师蒸馏加模态对齐的数据重组可以把医学通用模型的跨模态基线推向各专科域的性能上限，而不必为每个模态单独训练专科模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Models Don't Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Comparison Task
papers.abstract_en: One of the current premises of mechanistic interpretability research is that detailed accounts of the geometry of neural network representations can tell us how models perform computations, and how to effectively intervene on them. While low dimensional manifolds have been observed for multiple concepts in the literature (e.g. numbers encoded on helices, days of the week on a circle, ...), with structure believed to reflect properties of data and tasks, the extent to which models rely on them for computation, and how they manipulate them, remains unclear. We characterize precisely the geometry of computation in a number-comparison task, as an abstraction of comparison for decision making, and how models utilize geometry in an elegant fashion to implement it. Specifically, we study the causal geometry of number comparison in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a capable and widely studied open-weight model, and find Qwen largely uses linear representations of numbers despite the presence of curved geometry. To compare two numbers, the model first encodes each number along a vector and adds the two representations using attention and the residual connection, bringing them into a shared space in the residual stream. Then, the model uses MLP neurons to compare the pair of numbers on local regions in this shared space, which correspond to smaller intervals of input numbers, and combines these to obtain the position of the maximum. In fact, this reliance on linear representations for comparison also persists when the model compares three numbers. Our findings demonstrate that the manifold hypothesis can co-exist with linear representations: while concepts that are ordered may have manifold structure in representations, the model may use an underlying linear structure of the concept in certain computations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的数字比较任务上刻画计算的因果几何：模型虽把数字编码在弯曲流形（如螺旋）上，实际比较却走线性表示——先用 attention 与残差连接把两个数的表示相加进共享空间，再由 MLP 神经元在对应较小输入区间的局部区域上比较并组合出最大值位置；比较三个数时同样依赖线性表示。结论是流形假设可与线性表示共存。
Motivation: 机制可解释性的一个前提是表征几何能说明模型如何计算以及如何干预，但已观察到的低维流形（数字在螺旋、星期在圆上）是否真被模型用于计算、如何被操纵，一直不清楚。
Method: 以数字比较作为决策比较的抽象任务，对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 做因果几何分析：追踪数字如何沿向量编码、经 attention 与残差连接相加进入残差流的共享空间，以及 MLP 神经元如何在共享空间的局部区间上比较并组合出最大值。
Result: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在数字比较中主要使用数字的线性表示，尽管表征中存在弯曲几何；两数比较经 attention 与残差相加进入共享空间后由 MLP 在局部区间上比较并组合，三数比较同样依赖线性表示。
Conclusion: 流形假设可与线性表示共存：有序概念的表征可能有流形结构，但模型在特定计算中使用的是该概念的底层线性结构。

papers.title: Learning Expressive and Compositional Motion Representation via Spectral Skills
papers.abstract_en: Robotic foundation models offer a promising path toward general-purpose humanoid robot control, often through hierarchical architectures. However, their effectiveness depends on the command interface between the planner and the controller, which must support accurate execution while remaining easy to predict, and ideally allow new behaviors to be composed from prior ones. In this work, we introduce spectral skills, a latent representation of this interface that meets these requirements through predictive representation learning. By design, spectral skills compactly encode short motion segments and are learned by predicting subsequent motion rather than reconstructing the encoder input. On a 29-DoF humanoid, a controller conditioned on spectral skills reduces global tracking error by 62\% relative to the state of the art. The same frozen controller chains independently encoded skills without a separate transition policy. It also composes new behaviors by adding orthogonal directions to any compatible base skill, producing combinations unseen in the training data. We demonstrate tracking, chaining, and composition, as well as control through a language-conditioned planner, on Unitree G1 hardware. Project page: https://spectral-skill.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 spectral skills：一种用于机器人基础模型规划器-控制器之间命令接口的潜在表示，通过预测后续运动而非重构编码输入来学习短运动片段。在 29 自由度人形机器人上，以 spectral skills 为条件的控制器相对 state of the art 将全局跟踪误差降低 62%，同一冻结控制器无需过渡策略即可串联技能，并通过向基础技能叠加正交方向组合出训练集中未见的新行为。
Motivation: 人形机器人基础模型的分层架构效果取决于规划器与控制器之间的命令接口：既要执行准确、又要易于预测，还希望新行为能由已有行为组合而来，现有接口难以同时满足。
Method: spectral skills 用预测式表示学习 (predictive representation learning) 编码短运动片段，训练目标是预测后续运动而非重构编码器输入；控制器以该潜在技能为条件，串联时直接编码各技能而不用单独的 transition policy，组合则向任意兼容的基础技能叠加正交方向。
Result: 在 29-DoF 人形机器人上，条件于 spectral skills 的控制器相对 state of the art 将全局跟踪误差降低 62%；同一冻结控制器完成技能串联与组合，生成训练数据中未见的行为；在 Unitree G1 硬件上演示了跟踪、串联、组合以及语言条件规划器驱动的控制。
Conclusion: 预测式学到的 spectral skills 可以同时充当易预测、可执行、可组合的规划器-控制器接口，使冻结控制器无需过渡策略即可复用与叠加技能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LEMON-ZEST: Evolution-Informed Tokenization for Efficient Protein Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Protein Language Models (PLMs) have made remarkable progress following scaling laws established in natural language processing across sequence- and structure-based tasks, yet the potential of tokenization remains underexploited. Unlike human language, proteins preserve structure despite extensive sequence variation a property standard tokenization strategies fundamentally fail to capture. We introduce ZEST (Zoned Encoding of Sequence Traits), an evolution-informed vocabulary derived from conserved regions of multiple sequence alignments. ZEST allows embedding domain-level biological priors directly at the tokenization stage rather than learning them implicitly through scale. ZEST natively compresses sequences to an average token length of 4 residues, enabling our model to process 4,000 residues within a standard 1024-token context window. Building on this, we present LEMON (Layered Extraction of Molecular Ordering from Nature), a compact 200M-parameter sequence-based model for detection of remote homology between protein sequences trained on a single H100 GPU for one week. Despite its modest size, LEMON outperforms state-of-the-art models ranging from 600M to 3B parameters. Our results demonstrate that evolution-informed tokenization can substitute for massive parameter scaling, opening a new direction for efficient, biologically-grounded protein representation learning. All code, model weights, and results are publicly available under the MIT license.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEMON-ZEST 用进化信息驱动的分词 ZEST（从多序列比对保守区构造词表）把蛋白序列平均压到每 token 4 个残基，使 4,000 残基可塞进 1024 token 上下文窗；在其上训练的 200M 参数序列模型 LEMON 在远程同源检测上超过 600M–3B 参数的最先进模型，说明进化先验在分词阶段注入可以替代大规模参数扩展。
Motivation: 蛋白语言模型沿 NLP 的 scaling law 走参数扩张路线，但蛋白在序列高度变异下仍保持结构，标准分词策略无法表达这一性质，tokenization 的潜力远未被利用。
Method: ZEST（Zoned Encoding of Sequence Traits）从多序列比对 (MSA) 的保守区域构造进化信息词表，在分词阶段直接嵌入结构域级生物先验；LEMON（Layered Extraction of Molecular Ordering from Nature）是基于序列的 200M 参数模型，用于检测蛋白序列间远程同源 (remote homology)，仅用单张 H100 训练一周。
Result: ZEST 平均压缩到每 token 4 个残基，1024 token 上下文可处理 4,000 残基；200M 参数的 LEMON 在远程同源检测上优于参数量 600M 至 3B 的最先进模型；代码、模型权重与结果以 MIT 许可公开。
Conclusion: 进化信息驱动的分词可以替代大规模参数扩展，为高效、基于生物学的蛋白表示学习开辟方向。
