papers.title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.
papers.comment: Technical Report. Official website: https://lsf.kupasai.com/ Report homepage: https://tongjiai4e.github.io/KUPAS-MASTER-Report/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KUPAS MASTER 是一个经验工程平台，用九层认知语料构建把工作记录与从业者访谈转成可追溯、可复用的 agent 经验语料：以 context、cues、judgment、action、boundaries、outcomes 六要素保留任务过程，按九个抽取维度存入规则、约束、最佳实践、反例、边界案例、技能六个库，再打包成带显式输入、步骤、依赖与停止条件的可调用技能。在 20 名随机选取的从业者、1,576 份源文件上产出 23,024 条个人经验记录与 13,113 项组织资产；统一任务输入与评分标准下，base model、原始语料 RAG、KUPAS MASTER agent 得分分别为 70.63、79.75、89.58，且在全部七个评分维度上优于原始语料 RAG。
Motivation: 例行工作记录只留事实与结论，丢掉“哪些线索重要、为何该判断合理、该采取什么行动”的隐性知识，LLM agent 难以有效利用专业经验。
Method: 平台围绕九层认知语料构建：用六案例要素（context、cues、judgment、action、boundaries、outcomes）保留任务过程，按九个抽取维度组织隐性经验并存入六个库（rules、constraints、best practices、negative examples、corner cases、skills）；语义对齐、个人经验蒸馏、组织合并与交叉评审保留源证据、使用条件与未解决分歧；最后把资产打包成带显式输入、步骤、依赖和停止条件的可调用技能，接入任务执行与评估反馈。
Result: 用 20 名随机选取从业者的授权样本，处理 1,576 份源文件，产出 23,024 条个人经验记录与 13,113 项组织资产。跨多个专业领域的评估中，在共同任务输入与评分标准下 base model、原始语料 RAG、KUPAS MASTER agent 分别得 70.63、79.75、89.58；KUPAS MASTER agent 在全部七个评分维度上均改进于原始语料 RAG。
Conclusion: 把隐性经验结构化为带使用条件与停止条件的可调用技能，能把个体经验转成组织知识与 agent 能力，评分显著高于原始语料 RAG 与 base model。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
papers.abstract_en: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeanFlowAdvantage 把奖励目标改写到平均速度 (average-velocity) 预测空间：用共享且 detach 的 MeanFlow 导数修正项，使 rollout 与参考正则成为部署网络上的精确惩罚，同时保留原生少步采样器。在 SD3.5-Medium 上，四步推理即超过匹配的四步 MeanFlowNFT 基线全部八项指标，并以仅 4 NFE 在八项中的六项追平或超过 40 步 DiffusionNFT。
Motivation: MeanFlow 用区间平均速度做少步生成，但现有 advantage 类奖励微调目标定义在瞬时速度或等价 x0 预测上，与推理实际使用的平均速度映射不一致，奖励改进难以传到部署的 flow map。
Method: 提出带符号 advantage 加权最小二乘目标：以共享、detach 的 MeanFlow 导数修正把奖励目标表达在预测空间，令 rollout 与参考正则成为对推理所用平均速度网络的精确惩罚；同一目标还用于 DNA 启动子设计上的 teacher-free on-policy RL（定义在流形上的生成器）与 teacher-guided 奖励分级蒸馏。
Result: SD3.5-Medium 上，四步 MeanFlowAdvantage 改善匹配四步 MeanFlowNFT 基线的全部八项报告指标；仅 4 NFE 时在八项中的六项追平或超过 40 步 DiffusionNFT 基线。迁移到 DNA 启动子设计后，teacher-guided 蒸馏在所比较配置中取得最低的一步 Sei profile MSE。
Conclusion: 把奖励目标对齐到推理实际使用的平均速度表示，可以在不换采样器的前提下把奖励改进直接注入部署的 flow map，并以极少 NFE 追平高步数基线；该目标可跨模态迁移到流形上的生成器任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrieve, Reproduce, Reveal: Dissecting Retrieval-Augmented Software Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly used to enhance Large Language Model (LLM)-based software vulnerability detection by grounding predictions in retrieved vulnerability knowledge, such as vulnerability reports. However, existing RAG-based software vulnerability detection (RAG4SVD) systems are often evaluated using proprietary models, which challenges open science and reproducibility. Further, studies use different datasets, custom knowledge bases, different backbone models, and diverse metrics, which hinders meaningful cross-system comparison. In this work, we study six open-source RAG4SVD systems and address these reproducibility and comparability challenges through (i) reproduction of their experimental settings under an open-weight setting, and (ii) a unified benchmark using a common dataset, metric suite, and pool of open-weight models. Further, RAG4SVD systems typically consist of multiple components, yet are often evaluated only as a whole system, i.e., end-to-end. Therefore, we perform (iii) a component-level analysis that decomposes representative RAG4SVD pipelines into input abstraction, knowledge retrieval, and detection. Our results demonstrate that reproducibility varies substantially across systems. Under the presented unified benchmark, published RAG4SVD performance does not transfer under a controlled open-weight evaluation and depends strongly on the used model. The component analysis shows that effective RAG4SVD depends on the alignment between pipeline stages. For example, oracle knowledge raises retrieval to near-optimal, yet performance remains low (0.51 pairwise accuracy), demonstrating that retrieval effectiveness alone is insufficient for reliable detection. These findings motivate evaluating RAG4SVD not only end-to-end, but at the level of pipeline components, and provide a basis for more standardized, RAG-aware evaluation practices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个开源 RAG 软件漏洞检测 (RAG4SVD) 系统在开放权重模型下复现并统一基准，发现已发表性能在受控评测中不迁移且强烈依赖所用模型；组件级分解显示即便用 oracle 知识把检索推到近最优，检测的 pairwise accuracy 仍只有 0.51，说明检索有效不足以支撑可靠检测。
Motivation: RAG4SVD 研究普遍用私有模型、互不相同的数据集与知识库和指标，既难复现也无法横向比较；且系统常只做端到端评测，无法定位瓶颈在哪一级流水线。
Method: 研究分三步：在开放权重设定下复现六个 RAG4SVD 系统的实验设置；用统一数据集、统一指标集与一组开放权重模型构建共同基准；把代表性流水线分解为输入抽象、知识检索、检测三个组件做组件级分析。

Conclusion: RAG4SVD 的有效性取决于流水线各阶段的对齐，单看检索指标不足以保证检测可靠，因此评测应同时做端到端与组件级分析，推动标准化的 RAG-aware 评测实践。

papers.title: Where Privacy Belongs: Placement Diagnosis and Certified Selection for Private Counterfactual Explanations on Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations for graph neural networks (GNNs) find the minimal intervention that flips a node's prediction--but computing one requires reading sensitive graph structure, and releasing it discloses that structure. Both existing placements fail. Privatizing the graph before explaining corrupts the target on exactly the borderline nodes needing recourse, manufacturing spurious flips that flip the privatized graph but not the true one. Explaining on the clean graph and perturbing the released explanation resists certification: re-auditing the standard heuristic shows an implied full-release budget of 573--753 on Cora and 256 on CiteSeer--orders of magnitude beyond its advertised budget--with worst-case single-entry leakage at AUC 1.0. We propose PrivCFS, which replaces certification-by-optimization with certification-by-construction: counterfactual selection over a fixed, data-independent candidate universe--edge interventions from a public prior graph, feature interventions from a public schema--whose no-op semantics give neighboring graphs the same output support. A validity-gated, clipped utility of global sensitivity $Δu \le 1$ released through the exponential mechanism gives pure $\varepsilon$-DP for the complete released object, composable over queries--to our knowledge the first such guarantee on graphs. Privacy noise is the cheapest stage: at $\varepsilon$=8 the release retains 94--97% of its support-restricted non-private optimum on the recourse population and 83--95% on the general one; the optimal edge-inference audit attains AUC 0.50 on average and 0.59 worst-pair, versus the heuristic's worst entry 1.0; and transfers to a 15K-node graph at 0.96 valid rate. The dominant cost is a measurable, monotone price in public disclosure, readable off one table before any budget is spent--turning explanation privacy from an accounting risk into a purchasable decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrivCFS 把图反事实解释的隐私认证从“优化后认证”换成“构造即认证”：在与数据无关的候选集（公共先验图的边干预、公共 schema 的特征干预）上做选择，用有效性门控、裁剪到全局敏感度 Δu≤1 的效用经指数机制发布，得到覆盖整个发布对象的纯 ε-DP 且可跨查询组合。在 ε=8 时发布结果保留受限非私有最优的 94–97%（recourse 群体）与 83–95%（一般群体），最优边推断审计 AUC 平均 0.50、最差对 0.59，而对照启发式最差单条目达 1.0；并以 0.96 有效率迁移到 1.5 万节点图。
Motivation: 图反事实解释要么先私有化图、在边界节点上制造虚假翻转，要么在干净图上解释再扰动发布结果、无法通过认证；重审标准启发式显示其隐含全量发布预算在 Cora 为 573–753、CiteSeer 为 256，远超宣称预算，最差单条目泄露 AUC 达 1.0。
Method: PrivCFS 在固定、数据无关的候选宇宙上做反事实选择：边干预来自公共先验图，特征干预来自公共 schema，no-op 语义保证相邻图输出支撑一致；效用经有效性门控并裁剪到全局敏感度 Δu≤1，再用指数机制发布，从而对完整发布对象给出纯 ε-DP 并可跨查询组合。
Result: ε=8 时，recourse 群体保留受限非私有最优的 94–97%，一般群体 83–95%；最优边推断审计平均 AUC 0.50、最差对 0.59，对照启发式最差单条目 1.0；在 15K 节点图上有效率 0.96。对照启发式的隐含全量发布预算为 Cora 573–753、CiteSeer 256。

papers.title: Semantic Map Sharing and Capability-Aware Coverage Planning for AI-Native 6G Robotic Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Search and Rescue (SAR) operations increasingly deploy heterogeneous teams of aerial and ground robots. However, conventional coverage methods typically do not translate perceived terrain into platform-specific reachability, while continuous image exchange imposes a high communication cost. We propose an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework that integrates aerial terrain perception, robot-specific traversability reasoning, and payload-efficient semantic state sharing. Aerial observations are converted into compact semantic grid maps, enabling reachability-constrained area decomposition and capability-aware coverage paths that assign only regions admitted by each robot's capability profile. The resulting perception-sharing-planning loop feeds semantic corrections into traversability reasoning and replanning, forming an application-level mechanism motivated by AI-enabled goal-oriented communication envisioned for AI-native 6G networks. For the high-update case, transmitting semantic corrections reduces the application payload by a factor of approximately $82$ relative to periodic full-map sharing. Across matched benchmark scenarios, the proposed method achieved $91.5\%$ coverage with no capability-infeasible allocations, compared with $78.8\%$ coverage and a $21.5\%$ capability-infeasible allocation rate for LS-MCPP. Semantic corrections update the shared planning state without requiring repeated transmission of the complete map.
papers.comment: An alternative version of this work was accepted for presentation at IEEE CSCN 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 6G 异构搜救机器人协同，提出边缘侧语义感知覆盖规划框架：把空中观测压成紧凑语义栅格图，按各机器人的能力画像做可达性约束的区域分解与覆盖路径分配，再用语义修正回灌可通行性推理与重规划。高更新场景下语义修正传输把应用载荷降到周期性全图共享的约 1/82；在匹配基准场景上覆盖率 91.5% 且无能力不可行分配，对比 LS-MCPP 为 78.8% 覆盖率与 21.5% 能力不可行分配率。
Motivation: 常规覆盖方法不把感知地形转成平台相关的可达性，异构空中与地面机器人能力差异被忽略；同时持续图像传输带来高通信开销，制约 AI-native 6G 下的机器人协同。
Method: 框架包含三部分：空中地形感知转成语义栅格图 (semantic grid map)、按机器人能力画像 (capability profile) 的可通行性推理与可达性约束区域分解、载荷高效的语义状态共享；感知-共享-规划闭环把语义修正送回可通行性推理触发重规划，作为面向 AI-native 6G 目标导向通信的应用层机制。
Result: 高更新场景下语义修正传输相对周期性全图共享把应用载荷降低约 82 倍；在匹配基准场景上本方法覆盖率达 91.5% 且无能力不可行分配，LS-MCPP 为 78.8% 覆盖率与 21.5% 能力不可行分配率。
Conclusion: 把平台能力画像与语义压缩共享一起纳入覆盖规划，可在降低通信载荷的同时提高覆盖率并消除能力不可行分配；语义修正即可更新共享规划状态，无需重复传输完整地图。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Learning Causal Normalizing Flows from Incomplete Data via Observed-Data Likelihood
papers.abstract_en: Causal Normalizing Flows (CNFs) enable causal inference from observational data given the causal structure, but they assume fully observed training data. We introduce MissCNF, which trains CNFs directly on incomplete data by maximizing the marginal likelihood of each partially observed sample, without discarding rows or constructing a completed dataset. Thanks to the causal structure encoded in the autoregressive factorization of CNFs, only missing variables in the ancestral closure of the observed set are integrated out, while the others are dropped without computation. We further establish the conditions under which MissCNF recovers the true joint distribution, and introduce \emph{causal-family positivity}, where identification is possible even when no record in the dataset is ever complete. We compare MissCNF with two common strategies for handling missing data: listwise deletion and impute-then-fit pipelines. Across eight synthetic causal benchmarks, three missingness mechanisms, and missing rates up to $90\%$, MissCNF achieves the lowest KL divergence in 23 of 24 nonlinear MCAR and MAR settings and in all nonlinear MNAR settings, as well as the lowest counterfactual error in 20 of 24 settings. On linear SCMs, where linear imputation performs best, MissCNF ranks in the top two in 22 of 24 settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MissCNF 让因果归一化流 (Causal Normalizing Flows) 直接在缺失数据上训练：对每个部分观测样本最大化观测数据边际似然，借助 CNF 自回归分解的因果结构，只对观测集祖先闭包内的缺失变量做积分，其余直接丢弃不算。在八个合成因果基准、三种缺失机制、缺失率最高 90% 的设置下，非线性 MCAR/MAR 的 24 个设置中 23 个 KL 最低，全部非线性 MNAR 设置 KL 最低，反事实误差在 24 个设置中 20 个最低。
Motivation: 因果归一化流需要完全观测的训练数据，而真实数据集常有缺失；常见做法是删行或先插补再拟合，前者丢样本，后者引入插补偏差，且在没有任何完整记录时无法识别。
Method: MissCNF 对每个部分观测样本直接最大化观测数据似然，不删行也不构造补全数据集；利用 CNF 自回归分解编码的因果结构，只积分观测集祖先闭包中的缺失变量，其余变量不参与计算。作者给出 MissCNF 恢复真实联合分布的条件，并提出 causal-family positivity 概念，说明即使数据集中没有完整记录也可识别。
Result: 在八个合成因果基准、三种缺失机制 (MCAR/MAR/MNAR)、缺失率至 90% 下与 listwise deletion 和 impute-then-fit 比较：非线性 MCAR/MAR 的 24 个设置中 MissCNF 在 23 个取得最低 KL 散度，全部非线性 MNAR 设置 KL 最低，反事实误差在 24 个设置中 20 个最低；在线性 SCM（线性插补最优）上 24 个设置中 22 个排名前二。
Conclusion: 利用因果结构按祖先闭包选择性积分，可在不删行、不插补的前提下从不完整数据训练因果归一化流，即使无完整记录也能识别；线性 SCM 上让位于线性插补。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Nonpreemptive Scheduling While Learning Context-Dependent Service Rates
papers.abstract_en: We study nonpreemptive contextual queueing bandits in a single-server system. Each job is represented by a $d$-dimensional context vector; in each round, a job may arrive with its context drawn from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{D}$, and its departure probability is determined by a logistic model of that context vector with an unknown parameter $θ^*$. The server learns from service outcomes while deciding which waiting job to serve and whether to idle, aiming to minimize queue-length regret, the gap between its expected terminal queue length and the minimum achievable by an admissible policy. Once selected, a job must be served until completion, and we refer to this as the nonpreemptive setting. A central challenge is that, even with full model knowledge, the optimal policy cannot in general be characterized by a simple myopic rule, since the optimal action can change with the remaining horizon at the same queue state. Nevertheless, when the model and horizon are known, the optimal action can be obtained through a finite-horizon Bellman recursion. Motivated by this, we propose Learn--Clear--Plan (LCP), which estimates the system and uses the resulting Bellman recursion to make horizon-dependent decisions. LCP achieves $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/T})$ queue-length regret, while a lower-bound construction gives $Ω(\min\{1/\sqrt{d},\sqrt{d/T}\})$ regret for every learning policy on some instance, establishing optimality up to polylogarithmic factors when $T\ge d^2$. When the horizon is unknown, no horizon-independent policy achieves vanishing regret against the finite-horizon optimum. We therefore use SEPT, the policy that serves a waiting job with the highest probability of departure, as a fixed reference, and suggest an estimated-SEPT algorithm that achieves a tracking error of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/t})$ without knowing the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究单服务器非抢占式上下文排队老虎机 (contextual queueing bandits)，提出 Learn-Clear-Plan (LCP)：先估计 logistic 离开概率模型，再用有限时域 Bellman 递归做依赖剩余时域的调度与空转决策。LCP 达到 Õ(√(d/T)) 的队长 regret，下界构造给出 Ω(min{1/√d, √(d/T)})，在 T ≥ d² 时最优至多差 polylog 因子；时域未知时改用估计版 SEPT 跟踪，跟踪误差 Õ(√(d/t))。
Motivation: 非抢占约束下，即使模型与时域已知，最优策略也无法用简单 myopic 规则刻画——同一队列状态下最优动作会随剩余时域改变；而时域未知时不存在对有限时域最优策略 regret 消失的时域无关策略。
Method: LCP 分三步：用服务结果估计 logistic 模型参数，基于估计模型做有限时域 Bellman 递归，据此选择服务哪个等待作业或空转。时域未知时以 SEPT（服务离队概率最高的作业）为固定参考，给出 estimated-SEPT 算法。
Result: LCP 队长 regret 为 Õ(√(d/T))；下界构造表明任何学习策略在某些实例上 regret 为 Ω(min{1/√d, √(d/T)})，故 T ≥ d² 时在 polylog 因子内最优。时域未知情形 estimated-SEPT 相对 SEPT 的跟踪误差为 Õ(√(d/t))。
Conclusion: 把学习与规划分开（先估模型再跑 Bellman 递归）可在非抢占上下文排队中取得时域最优的队长 regret；时域未知时只能退而跟踪一个固定参考策略。

papers.title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?
papers.abstract_en: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. We observe that this is the result of the model performing a dimensionality reduction of vision representations in early layers. In order to explain this phenomenon: (1) We show analytically that linear self-attention can perform a dimensionality reduction by projecting in-context data onto its principal components, with each layer implementing one gradient descent step toward this objective. (2) We provide evidence that trained LVLMs reduce the dimensionality of vision representations in early layers via a similar mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 的少样本图像分类中，发现一个跨所有图像分类任务共享的低维判别几何 (Shared Discriminative Geometry, SDG)：in-context 图像在早期层被压成线性可分表示。解析上证明线性 self-attention 通过把 in-context 数据投影到其主成分上实现降维，每层相当于朝该目标走一步梯度下降；训练好的 LVLM 早期层也经由类似机制降低视觉表示维度。
Motivation: LLM 的 induction circuit 已有大量研究，但 in-context 样本的线性表示最初如何构建几乎无人关注；视觉模态相比文本更具表达力，可用于揭示这一机制。
Method: 在 LVLM 中定位跨任务共享的低维 SDG 空间；给出线性 self-attention 执行主成分投影降维的解析证明（每层对应一步梯度下降），再用训练好的 LVLM 的早期层行为验证该机制。
Result: 识别出 SDG：in-context 图像在其中被压缩为线性可分表示并用于分类；解析结果表明线性 self-attention 可通过投影到主成分实现降维，每层实现一步梯度下降；实证证据显示训练好的 LVLM 早期层经类似机制降低视觉表示维度。
Conclusion: in-context 图像的线性表示由模型早期层的降维机制构建，且该几何在图像分类任务间共享；self-attention 的主成分投影为此现象提供了可解释的解析机制。

papers.title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnterpriseBench 把企业与金融 QA 数据集重组为基础套件，并新增 Consulting、Beer Game、Enterprise Digital Twin 三个交互式专业场景，覆盖从静态问答到动态决策的谱系。九种 agent 方法 × 四个 backbone 模型的实验显示，当前 LLM agent 在企业场景中尚未达到稳定、全面、跨任务可靠的表现。
Motivation: 现有企业与金融基准只测信息抽取、数值计算、领域知识、金融 QA 等静态能力，交互式与长时程决策在真实企业工作流（信息缺失、不确定性、反馈、长期权衡）下几乎未被覆盖。
Method: 将既有企业与金融 QA 数据集重组为按能力与难度标注的统一基础套件；新增三个交互场景：Consulting（管理咨询式案例、多轮信息搜集做客户问题诊断）、Beer Game（供应链库存控制、延迟反馈）、Enterprise Digital Twin（项目式业务模拟，含人力、风险与项目规划）。
Result: 在九种 agent 方法与四个 backbone 模型上的实验显示，当前 agent 在企业场景中尚未实现稳定、全面且跨任务的可靠性。
Conclusion: EnterpriseBench 可作为评估 LLM agent 在真实企业战略推理与决策能力上的实用基准；跨任务可靠性是当前 agent 的主要短板。

papers.title: The double descent and Runge phenomena in overparametrized polynomial interpolation
papers.abstract_en: The Runge phenomenon in polynomial interpolation is often considered a classical analogue of the double descent phenomenon in machine learning. In this note, we explore overparameterized polynomial interpolation in three popular polynomial bases: Monomial, Chebyshev and Legendre basis with coefficients that are minimal in the $\ell^2$-norm (and, for the monomial basis, also those minimal in the $\ell^1$-norm). We present our results primarily for equidistant and Chebyshev data points, but many results are independent of the exact form of sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Monomial、Chebyshev、Legendre 三种多项式基下研究过参数化多项式插值的 double descent 与 Runge 现象，取 ℓ2 范数最小系数（Monomial 基另含 ℓ1 最小解），在等距与 Chebyshev 节点上给出结果，且许多结论不依赖具体采样形式。
Motivation: Runge 现象常被视作机器学习 double descent 的经典类比，但该类比在不同多项式基与最小范数解选择下的具体行为尚需厘清。
Method: 在 Monomial、Chebyshev、Legendre 三种基下分析过参数化多项式插值，取 ℓ2 范数最小系数（Monomial 基另含 ℓ1 最小解），主要在等距与 Chebyshev 节点上推导，并说明多条结果与采样点具体形式无关。
Result: 给出过参数化多项式插值中 double descent 与 Runge 现象在三种基、两种最小范数准则下的刻画；结果主要针对等距与 Chebyshev 数据点，且许多结论对采样形式不敏感。
Conclusion: Runge 现象与 double descent 的对应关系可在最小范数解框架下于多种多项式基中被系统刻画，且核心结论对采样点分布具有稳健性。

papers.title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed mainly for text-based language models, and our empirical study reveals two challenges when complex multimodal sources are involved. First, the joint image-text attribution can underrepresent visual evidence relative to text, obscuring the image regions supporting the response. Second, visual evidence may influence the generated response through multiple intermediate reasoning paths, while existing methods trace only a limited subset of these paths, causing important visual contributions to be underestimated. Motivated by these insights, we introduce VTrace, a multimodal token-attribution framework that traces input contributions through intermediate reasoning and calibrates attribution scores across modalities. VTrace constructs pairwise attributions that highlight token-specific contributions and aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form to account for both direct and indirect contributions. Cross-modal calibration then rescales image and text attribution scores using modality contributions estimated from response-likelihood changes, enabling a unified ranking of input tokens. Evaluations against seven baselines across six visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior attribution faithfulness. Project page: https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VTrace 针对 LVLM 视觉-文本联合归因中视觉证据被低估、推理路径覆盖不全两个问题，用成对归因 (pairwise attribution) 加闭式聚合全部前向路径，再按响应似然变化估计的模态贡献做跨模态校准，给出图像与文本 token 的统一排序。在六个视觉推理基准、七个基线上评测，归因忠实性 (attribution faithfulness) 更优。
Motivation: 现有 token 归因方法主要为纯文本 LM 设计，复杂多模态输入下联合归因低估视觉证据，且只追踪有限推理路径，导致重要的图像贡献被低估。
Method: VTrace 构造成对归因以突出 token 级贡献，闭式聚合全部前向归因路径以覆盖直接与间接贡献；再用响应似然变化估计的模态贡献对图像与文本分数做跨模态校准 (cross-modal calibration)，输出统一 token 排序。
Result: 在六个视觉推理基准上对比七个基线，评测显示归因忠实性更优；忠实性判据为移除高排名 token 后生成响应似然下降更快。
Conclusion: 把路径聚合与跨模态校准一起做，才能让 LVLM 的图像与文本 token 归因在同一尺度上可信排序。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding
papers.abstract_en: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 33 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Exemplar2VQA 用多智能体写代码加几何工具库，在仿真环境中确定性地执行空间几何计算，把静态物体中心的空间查询模板自动扩展成大规模 3D 视觉问答 (VQA) 合成数据。仅用该合成室内数据微调 Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B）即可在多个基准上显著提升，且增益能外推到室外与混合场景基准。
Motivation: 多模态大模型的空间智能受限于复杂 3D 问答数据稀缺：人工标注成本高，而直接让 LLM 合成 QA 对会因空间与几何计算能力不足而失败。
Method: 框架让多个协作 agent 调用精心设计的几何工具库 (geometric utilities)，用确定性代码执行绕开 LLM 的空间推理缺陷；以多样的静态物体中心空间查询模板作为 exemplar，自动将其扩展为大规模高保真合成数据集，再用生成的合成室内数据微调 Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B）。
Result: 仅用 Exemplar2VQA 生成的合成室内数据微调 Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B），在多个多样的基准上取得显著性能提升；效果不止于域内室内数据，还稳健扩展到室外与混合场景基准。
Conclusion: 以 exemplar 驱动加确定性代码执行的合成范式可规模化弥合 Embodied AI 的 sim-to-real 鸿沟，且跨室内外场景通用。

summary_sections.method: 框架让多个协作 agent 调用精心设计的几何工具库 (geometric utilities)，用确定性代码执行绕开 LLM 的空间推理缺陷；以多样的静态物体中心空间查询模板作为 exemplar，自动将其扩展为大规模高保真合成数据集，再用生成的合成室内数据微调 Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B）。
summary_sections.result: 仅用 Exemplar2VQA 生成的合成室内数据微调 Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B），在多个多样的基准上取得显著性能提升；效果不止于域内室内数据，还稳健扩展到室外与混合场景基准。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以 exemplar 驱动加确定性代码执行的合成范式可规模化弥合 Embodied AI 的 sim-to-real 鸿沟，且跨室内外场景通用。

papers.title: Texture Space Material Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视频 diffusion transformer 微调后放到纹理空间 (texture space) 生成材质，利用已知的图像空间到纹理空间投影，让扩散过程跨任意几何与纹理参数化泛化，并绕开视频/多视角扩散的视角一致性问题。方法可扩到 8K 分辨率、100+ 输入视角与神经材质表示，在材质生成与重建上给出 state-of-the-art 的定量与定性结果。
Motivation: 视频与多视角扩散模型直接生成材质时受视角一致性问题制约，且难以跨不同几何与纹理参数化泛化；纹理空间是二维的，可以复用预训练视频扩散模型的强先验。
Method: 微调一个视频 diffusion transformer，承担文本引导材质生成、多视角材质生成与材质上采样 (material upscaling) 三类任务；核心是使用已知的图像空间到纹理空间投影，把扩散过程放在纹理空间进行。
Result: 在定量与定性评估中，材质生成与重建达到 state-of-the-art；方法可扩展到 8K 分辨率、100+ 输入视角以及神经材质表示，并用于未知光照下拍摄的姿态照片的高质量材质重建与文本/图像引导生成。
Conclusion: 把扩散放在纹理空间并复用图像到纹理的已知投影，可以在跨几何与纹理参数化的同时避开视角一致性问题，得到高质量材质生成与重建。

papers.title: RACE: Relation-Level Counterfactual Explanations for Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations of graph neural networks identify edge deletions that flip a prediction. On heterogeneous graphs, however, existing methods first collapse the graph into untyped edges, so they cannot answer the question a domain expert actually asks: which relation type drives this prediction? We present RACE (Relation-Aware Counterfactual Explanations), which gives this question an exact, per-instance answer. For every explained instance, an exhaustive search over relation subsets returns the certified minimum relation-deletion set that flips the prediction -- or an explicit report that no such deletion exists; each relation-level answer is then refined into a typed edge set within the attributed relations, verified on the discrete model by single-edge restoration. The relation-level answer is exact and deterministic given the frozen backbone, whereas soft-mask baselines vary by 6-8 pp in success rate across runs differing only in random ordering. On ACM, a Cora-derived graph, and ogbn-mag, RACE improves counterfactual success rate over the strongest baseline by up to +2.7 pp while deleting fewer edges, and attains the highest success rate among all same-task baselines on every dataset; the advantage reproduces across four backbones on ogbn-arXiv and on DBLP, with cross-seed relation-set agreement up to 0.89. A synthetic study with known generating mechanisms confirms that the search recovers the relation the trained model actually relies on -- and reports infeasibility rather than fabricating an attribution when the model has learned none -- so the explanations stay trustworthy exactly where explanations matter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RACE 对异构图神经网络做关系级反事实解释：对每个实例穷举关系子集，返回可认证的最小关系删除集（或显式报告不存在），再细化为类型化边集并用单边恢复验证。在 ACM、Cora 衍生图与 ogbn-mag 上，反事实成功率较最强基线最多提高 2.7 个百分点且删除边更少，跨种子关系集一致性最高 0.89；软掩码基线仅随机顺序不同就有 6–8 个百分点的成功率波动。
Motivation: 现有图反事实解释先把异构图塌缩成无类型边，无法回答领域专家真正关心的问题：究竟是哪一种关系类型驱动了该预测，且软掩码方法结果随随机顺序不稳定。
Method: RACE (Relation-Aware Counterfactual Explanations) 在冻结骨干网络上对关系子集做穷举搜索，得到可认证的最小关系删除集或不可行报告；随后在被归因的关系内细化为类型化边集，并在离散模型上用单边恢复 (single-edge restoration) 验证。
Result: 在 ACM、Cora 衍生图和 ogbn-mag 上，RACE 的反事实成功率较最强基线最多提升 +2.7 pp 且删除更少边，并在每个数据集上取得所有同任务基线中最高成功率；优势在 ogbn-arXiv 与 DBLP 上跨四个骨干网络复现，跨种子关系集一致性最高 0.89。软掩码基线仅随机顺序不同，成功率在不同运行间波动 6–8 pp。合成研究中搜索恢复了训练模型实际依赖的关系，并在模型未学到该关系时报告不可行而非伪造归因。
Conclusion: 关系级反事实解释可以做到精确、确定且可认证：既给出驱动预测的最小关系删除集，也在模型没有学到可归因关系时如实报告不可行，从而保持可信度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Finslerian Approach for Embedding Directed Data
papers.abstract_en: Many datasets carry an intrinsic directionality: citations point backward in time, cells differentiate along lineages, and traffic follows preferred routes. Spectral embedding methods, including most of their extensions to directed graphs, discard this information: they symmetrize the data and map it into a Euclidean space where asymmetry cannot be represented. We instead model directed data as sampled from a Finsler manifold, whose distance depends on the direction of travel, and study the kernel operator built from this asymmetric distance. Through a moment expansion of this operator, we show that its symmetric and antisymmetric parts separate geometry from direction. As the bandwidth of the kernel vanishes, the symmetric part converges to a weighted Laplacian, recovering diffusion maps in the Riemannian case, while the antisymmetric part converges to a first-order transport operator that encodes the directionality. We prove that the corresponding graph operators, built from finitely many samples, converge uniformly and almost surely to these limits. For Randers metrics, this vector field is explicit and yields an embedding algorithm recovering both the manifold structure, from the spectrum of the symmetric part, and the underlying drift. We illustrate the approach on synthetic directed graphs and point-clouds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把有向数据建模为 Finsler 流形上的采样，用依赖行进方向的距离构造非对称核算子，其对称部分在带宽趋于零时收敛到加权 Laplacian（Riemannian 情形退化回 diffusion maps），反对称部分收敛到编码方向性的一阶 transport 算子。由此得到的嵌入同时恢复流形结构与底层 drift，并在合成有向图与点云上做了演示。
Motivation: 谱嵌入及其有向图扩展普遍把数据对称化后投到欧氏空间，方向信息（引用、细胞谱系、交通流向）在不对称性无法表示的过程中被丢弃。
Method: 以 Finsler 流形（方向相关距离）建模有向数据，构造基于该非对称距离的核算子并做矩展开 (moment expansion)，分离对称与反对称部分；证明有限样本下图算子一致且几乎必然收敛到极限算子。对 Randers 度量，drift 向量场显式可写，从而给出同时用对称部分谱恢复流形、用反对称部分恢复 drift 的嵌入算法。
Result: 带宽趋于零时对称部分收敛到加权 Laplacian（Riemannian 情形恢复 diffusion maps），反对称部分收敛到一阶 transport 算子；有限样本图算子一致且几乎必然收敛到这些极限。方法在合成有向图与点云上做了演示。
Conclusion: 方向性应作为一阶 transport 项而非对称化损失来建模：Finsler 框架下流形几何与方向可从谱的两部分分别读出，Randers 情形有显式 drift。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: VoxelSage: Tool-Augmented 3D CT Analysis and Simulator-Shielded Sequential Resection Planning for Liver Tumors
papers.abstract_en: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures. Technical report. Code at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VoxelSage 把肝肿瘤术前 CT 的分割、物理测量、可视证据与切除规划集成进一个双端口系统：Port A 让 LLM 解释请求并选技能，Port B 在 CT 体数据与分割掩码上执行计算，物理测量被锁在 Port B 以避免 LLM 编造数值。序列切除规划用行为克隆 (behavior cloning) 神经排序器排候选切除目标，再由基于模拟器的 shield 校验预定义约束；在 256 个未见模拟场景上，相对确定性基线平均模拟时间从 34.274 降到 33.388 分钟（省 0.886 分钟，2.59%），平均模拟失血从 300.847 降到 183.852 mL（省 116.995 mL，38.89%）。
Motivation: 术前肝肿瘤评估需要在同一份三维 CT 上完成分割、物理空间测量、可视证据与切除规划，但现有工具各环节割裂，且语言模型无法可靠地从 CT 直接算出物理测量值。
Method: 双端口架构：Port A 由 LLM 解释请求并选择技能，Port B 在 CT 体数据与分割掩码上执行计算并返回结构化结果，物理测量固定留在 Port B。内置 8 个技能覆盖定量分析、可视证据生成、三维重建、分割精修与序列切除规划，并支持用户自定义技能；序列规划由行为克隆神经排序器对候选切除目标排序，模拟器 shield 按预定义约束校验。
Result: 在 256 个未见模拟场景上，相对确定性基线平均模拟时间 34.274 → 33.388 分钟（-0.886 分钟，-2.59%），平均模拟失血 300.847 → 183.852 mL（-116.995 mL，-38.89%）。
Conclusion: 作者主张该结果展示的是系统集成与模拟器层面的性能，而非临床疗效或安全性；把物理测量从 LLM 手里移出、用模拟器 shield 约束排序结果，可在模拟层面同时压低切除时间与失血。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
papers.abstract_en: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under USD 10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95-99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and ARC and 86.7% on Belebele across 122 languages. It beats Qwen on 27 of 37 datasets, with none of Qwen's nine leads outside the bootstrap intervals, and Gemma on all 37. All three models degrade on low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy labels, and rubric-based quality judgments. Jev's choice probabilities are well calibrated and support selective prediction. Binary probabilities rank well but are poorly placed relative to a fixed 0.5 threshold; thresholds tuned on training data raise micro-F1 on UNFAIR-ToS from 0.50 to 0.75. Jev answers MMLU's calculation-heavy questions more accurately than other MMLU questions (94% vs. 91%), whereas both open models, and all three on C-Eval, find them harder. Rotating the options leaves Jev's accuracy unchanged and withholding the question drops it to near chance, ruling out shallow memorization but not memorized question-answer pairs. We release the code, harness and all raw responses.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jev 是 TypeSafe AI 的非生成式 System One 模型，只在固定选项、rubric 位置或陈述为真的概率之间作答。零样本在 37 个数据集、346,009 次请求（成本低于 10 美元）上评测，Jev 在 27/37 个数据集上胜过 Qwen3.8-27B、全部 37 个胜过 Gemma-4-E4B，且 Qwen 的 9 次领先都不在 bootstrap 区间外。
Motivation: 信息访问管线中的小决策（路由、grounding 检查、内容审核、rubric 打分）需要校准的小模型，但缺少跨任务、跨语言的公开零样本基准来判断这类非生成式模型是否可靠。
Method: 对 jev-1.13.0 做零样本评测，每个数据集用一个冻结模板跑完整评测划分，覆盖分类、路由、NLI、阅读理解、常识推理、审核、法律条款分析与 rubric 打分共 37 个数据集；对照组为 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Gemma-4-E4B 在相同请求上的 next-token 概率，另做选项轮换与隐去问题的消融。
Result: Jev 在 IMDB、SST-2、HellaSwag、ARC 上达 95–99% 准确率，Belebele 跨 122 种语言 86.7%；37 个数据集中 27 个胜 Qwen、37 个全胜 Gemma。三模型在低资源语言、细粒度/噪声标签与 rubric 判断上均退化。阈值在训练数据上调参使 UNFAIR-ToS micro-F1 从 0.50 升到 0.75；Jev 在 MMLU 计算密集题上 94% 对其他题 91%，两个开源模型与 C-Eval 上则相反；选项轮换不改准确率，隐去问题降到近随机。
Conclusion: Jev 的选项概率校准良好、可支撑 selective prediction，但二元概率相对固定 0.5 阈值位置失准，需按训练数据重调阈值；消融排除了浅层记忆但不排除记忆题答对。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dual-WM 把潜空间世界模型拆成低层动作条件转移模型与高层宏动作规划模型，用 Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe) 在两个时间尺度上监督自生成预测，并按递归误差传播分析给两个尺度分别设指数型 horizon 权重衰减率。在五个目标条件视觉控制任务上从零训练，目标偏移 50 步时平均成功率从 75.9% 升到 84.4%，偏移 100 步时从 61.4% 升到 69.5%，且偏移 100 步在全部五个任务上超过无 actor 引导提议的最强基线，较 LeWM 高 30.8 个百分点。
Motivation: 潜空间世界模型短时预测准但长程规划失效：递归 rollout 误差累积，高维潜空间的距离集中效应削弱目标判别。
Method: Dual-WM 分离两级表征与动力学：低层模型预测动作条件转移，高层模型用学到的宏动作在更长时间跨度上规划并生成潜空间子目标，低层再细化为动作。LoRe 在两级上监督自生成预测，递归误差传播分析导出指数型 horizon 权重，两个时间尺度各用独立衰减率。
Result: 五个目标条件视觉控制任务、对比各任务最强且无 actor 引导提议的基线：目标偏移 50 步平均成功率 75.9% → 84.4%，偏移 100 步 61.4% → 69.5%；偏移 100 步在全部五个任务上胜出，平均成功率较 LeWM 高 30.8 个百分点。消融与分析显示目标评估表征信息量更高、递归预测下更一致。
Conclusion: 把局部执行与长程规划分到不同潜表征并跨多个 horizon 训练，能提升潜空间规划在长偏移下的可靠性；核心实现已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Flattening the Connectome Spectrum: A Spectral Filter for FC Induces a Pretraining Target for fMRI Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised pretraining reshaped prediction in language and vision, and brain foundation models (BFMs) inherited its promise. Representations learned from large unlabelled corpora should capture individual functional dynamics and generalise across cohorts. However, kernel ridge regression (KRR) fitted on functional connectivity (FC) matrices still predicts individual phenotypes more accurately than any BFM we tested. In this paper, we show that KRR is weighted by the eigenvalues of the FC which are miscalibrated for phenotype prediction. We apply an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate the eigenvalues of each subject's FC matrix, enabling the model to exploit more inter-individual variance. Across the 5 datasets, 11 parcellations and 6 prediction targets we tested, we match or exceed the KRR baseline. Based on this finding, we then pretrain a small encoder model on about 4,000 hours of fMRI from 162 open datasets, whereby we align the pairwise similarities between the embeddings of recording snippets with those between the recalibrated connectomes. Our model performs on par with the best of the 6 published BFMs we tested while having an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Our encoder performs better than FC on short scans and in smaller cohorts, especially in fingerprinting. We release the pretrained model weights, the code and the pretraining data, preprocessed and parcellated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 脑基础模型 (BFM) 在 fMRI 表型预测上仍不敌 KRR，原因是 FC 矩阵的特征值对表型预测失准。作者用高效谱滤波重标定每个被试 FC 的特征值，使 KRR 在 5 个数据集、11 种分区、6 个预测目标上追平或超过原基线；再据此构造预训练目标，用约 4,000 小时 fMRI 对齐片段嵌入相似度与重标定 connectome 相似度，得到参数量少一个数量级、性能与 6 个已发表 BFM 中最好者相当的编码器。
Motivation: 自监督脑基础模型宣称能从无标注语料学到可跨队列泛化的个体功能动态，但 KRR 直接拟合 FC 仍比所测任何 BFM 更准，说明预训练表征没有兑现预测个体表型的承诺。
Method: 先诊断 KRR 的权重由 FC 特征值决定且对表型预测失准，再对每个被试 FC 施加高效谱滤波 (spectral filter) 重标定特征值，让模型利用更多个体间方差；随后在 162 个开放数据集、约 4,000 小时 fMRI 上预训练一个小型编码器，损失为对齐 recording snippet 嵌入的成对相似度与重标定 connectome 的成对相似度。
Result: 谱滤波后的 KRR 在 5 个数据集、11 种 parcellation、6 个预测目标上追平或超过 KRR 基线；预训练编码器在与 6 个已发布 BFM 的对比中表现相当，参数量少一个数量级；在短扫描、小队列场景下编码器优于 FC，fingerprinting 上尤其明显。
Conclusion: FC 特征值的谱标定既是 KRR 表型预测的瓶颈，也可直接充当 fMRI 编码器的预训练目标，从而用小得多的模型达到 BFM 水平，并在短扫描与小队列上更稳。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision--language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce \textbf{M}ask-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{C}ounterfactual \textbf{E}xplanations (\mace), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. \mace constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source--target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate \mace on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MACE（Mask-guided Adaptive Counterfactual Explanations），面向 CLIP 零样本分类的目标化视觉反事实解释：由源归因或源-目标归因差构造可编辑掩码、必要时扩展掩码以到达指定目标类，再用 latent diffusion inpainting 修改该区域，冻结的 CLIP 提供修改引导并锚定其余图像内容。在 ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets、CUB-200 上，source-mask 变体在四个数据集上目标 top-1 成功率最高，difference-mask 变体像素级与感知改动最小、真实感最佳，两者在 proximity 与 realism 上都优于同一生成骨干的 Stable Diffusion-only 基线，同时暴露出反事实有效性与源图保持之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有针对 CLIP 等对比视觉-语言模型的解释方法主要标出重要区域，却不能说明如何改动输入才能得到目标预测，缺少目标导向的可操作反事实。
Method: MACE 先从源归因或源-目标归因差构造可编辑区域掩码，仅在需要到达指定目标类时扩展掩码；随后用 latent diffusion inpainting 模型修改选中区域，冻结的 CLIP 既提供修改引导，又把未选区域锚定在原图上。
Result: 在 ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets、CUB-200 四个数据集上评测：source-mask 变体在全部四个数据集上取得最高的目标 top-1 成功率；difference-mask 变体产生最小的像素级与感知改动并获得最佳真实感分数；两个变体在 proximity 与 realism 上均优于使用同一生成骨干的 Stable Diffusion-only 基线。
Conclusion: 自适应掩码引导的编辑能为 CLIP 生成有效的反事实解释，但反事实有效性（目标命中）与源图保持（改动小、真实感高）之间存在权衡，两个掩码变体分别偏向权衡的两端。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
papers.abstract_en: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLTL;DR 在失败尝试后让策略读取 verifier 输出并自己写一条 TL;DR insight，后续 rollout 以全部历史 insight 为条件，并对 in-context insight 反向传播以固化任务到 insight 的映射。在 Pass@128=0 的高难工具调用与编码集上，GRPO 训练 Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking 的 Pass@1 只有 0%–1%，RLTL;DR 训练时带 insight 达 14%–31%，评测时去掉 insight 仍有 12%–13%。
Motivation: RLVR 依赖多次尝试中出现成功样本，但在自我改进场景里任务太难、成功率接近 0，且没有教师模型或范例解可蒸馏，标准 GRPO 因此完全学不动。
Method: 每次失败后把 verifier 输出展示给策略，让它写一条 TL;DR insight；下一次 rollout 以全部先前 insight 为条件，顺序采样直到找到解；同时对 in-context insight 开启反向传播，建立任务到 insight 的直接映射。另将其简化为 SFTL;DR，只用 (task, insight) 元组训练，不展示也不反传任何 rollout。

papers.title: ProCTI: Prototype-Refined Global Conditioning for Diffusion-Based Time Series Imputation
papers.abstract_en: Time series imputation has progressed from statistical and deep learning approaches to diffusion-based models, which have shown strong recent performance. Existing diffusion-based methods typically condition the reverse process using local contextual information from the current or neighbouring windows. Meanwhile, global dataset-level structure often remains implicit, limiting performance when local observations are sparse, noisy, or unrepresentative. To address this issue, we propose ProCTI, a diffusion-imputation framework that augments local conditioning with retrieved global dataset-level priors through learned prototypes. A hybrid conditioning mechanism integrates this global context with local signals during reverse diffusion, enabling more accurate reconstruction under varying missingness scenarios. Experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that ProCTI outperforms strong baselines overall under random missingness, while remaining competitive under attribute-wise missingness. Furthermore, we use a latent-regime data model to characterise the precise conditions under which prototype-derived global conditioning provably improves imputation. We support this with a general theoretical analysis of local-global conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProCTI 用学习到的 prototype 检索全局数据集级先验，与局部上下文一起在扩散反向过程中做混合条件化，以补全缺失时间序列。多基准实验显示其在随机缺失 (random missingness) 下整体优于强基线、在属性级缺失 (attribute-wise missingness) 下保持竞争力；并用 latent-regime 数据模型给出全局条件化可证明改进插补的精确条件。
Motivation: 现有扩散插补方法只用当前或邻近窗口的局部信息条件化反向过程，数据集级全局结构是隐式的，在局部观测稀疏、含噪或不具代表性时性能受限。
Method: 提出 ProCTI：通过学习到的 prototypes 检索全局数据集级先验，作为对局部条件化的补充；在反向扩散中用混合条件机制把全局上下文与局部信号整合，以适配不同缺失场景。另构建 latent-regime 数据模型刻画全局条件化起效的条件，并给出局部-全局条件化的一般性理论分析。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，ProCTI 在随机缺失下整体优于强基线，在属性级缺失下保持竞争力；理论部分给出 prototype 全局条件化可证明改善插补的精确条件。
Conclusion: 把数据集级全局先验显式注入扩散插补的条件化过程，可在局部信息不足时提升重建精度，且其收益条件可由 latent-regime 模型刻画。

papers.title: Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 2.2 pp over standard random initialization. Our analysis identifies recurrence as essential for learning compact weights that transfer across models. In ViTs, we localize a key benefit in the suppression of high-norm tokens that produces substantial improvements in zero-shot segmentation (ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 to 42.9), object localization (VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 to 18.4), and depth estimation (NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 to 0.998). This demonstrates that transformers need not start from a blank slate, and can be initialized with generic capabilities at low cost with no domain- or task-specific data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Procedural Core 把在程序生成数据上训练的 1M 参数循环 Transformer 权重扩展到任意宽深，作为通用初始化，替代每个目标模型都要重做的预训练。用它初始化 85M 参数 ViT-Base，ImageNet top-1 比随机初始化高 2.2 pp，并抑制高范数 token，使 ImageNet-S 零样本分割 mAP 从 32.3 升到 42.9。
Motivation: Transformer 从随机初始化训练，能力全靠大规模优化涌现；近期用少量程序生成数据注入通用归纳结构的做法要为每个目标模型重复预训练阶段，成本高且不可复用。
Method: 先在程序生成数据上训练一个最小循环 Transformer (minimal recurrent transformer)，再把其权重扩展以初始化任意宽度与深度的 Transformer；分析指出循环 (recurrence) 是学到可跨模型迁移紧凑权重的关键，并把 ViT 中的收益定位到对高范数 token 的抑制。
Result: 1M 参数 core 初始化 85M 参数 ViT-Base 后 ImageNet top-1 较随机初始化提升 2.2 pp；零样本分割 ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 → 42.9，目标定位 VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 → 18.4，深度估计 NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 → 0.998；初始化同时改善自监督视觉学习 (DINO)、自然语言 (FineWeb-Edu) 与代码 (CodeParrot) 建模。
Conclusion: Transformer 不必从空白开始：用无领域或任务特定数据的通用紧凑初始化即可注入通用能力，循环结构是学到这类可迁移权重的必要条件。

papers.title: SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: No single way of parallelizing attention serves large language models well under all loads. Low concurrency favors tensor parallelism, many independent requests favor data-parallel attention, and long prompts favor context parallelism. Reasoning, agentic, and RL-rollout workloads make a fixed choice untenable: a batch that begins as many short requests ends as a few very long ones, so the best layout changes while the same requests run. Serving engines nevertheless fix one layout at launch, because changing it has meant draining requests and restarting workers. We present SPLASH, a serving system that switches the parallel layout of attention while requests are running. It builds on one observation: modern attention, with few or no KV heads, decouples where a request's KV cache lives from how attention weights are sharded. This has two consequences. First, layouts differ only in who owns the weights and the cache, and most of that state already sits where the next layout needs it; SPLASH reuses it, moves the rest in the background of ongoing inference, and hands off at a batch boundary, making a switch nearly free: its median overhead is under 0.51% of the step it runs in. Second, the decoupling exposes a layout that existing engines lack: Decoupled Ownership Parallelism (DOP) shards attention weights as tensor parallelism does while keeping each request's cache on a single owner as data-parallel attention does. DOP replicates neither, offers 27-60% more KV capacity than data-parallel attention, and gives the scheduler a choice when KV memory limits admission. A transition-aware scheduler follows the best of the four layouts as load changes. On B200 GPUs serving GLM-5.3, SPLASH improves end-to-end serving throughput by 1.3-1.73x over fixed-layout deployments, and the same layout regimes appear with DeepSeek-V3.2 on H200 and GLM-5.3-Flash on DCU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPLASH 让 LLM 服务引擎在请求运行中切换 attention 的并行布局：利用 KV head 极少时 KV cache 位置与权重分片解耦，复用已有状态、后台搬运其余状态并在 batch 边界交接，切换中位开销低于所在 step 的 0.51%。它还提出 Decoupled Ownership Parallelism (DOP)，按 TP 方式分片权重但把每个请求的 cache 留在单一 owner，比 data-parallel attention 多出 27-60% KV 容量；在 B200 上服务 GLM-5.3 时端到端吞吐比固定布局高 1.3-1.73x。
Motivation: 低并发适合张量并行、多独立请求适合数据并行、长 prompt 适合上下文并行，而 reasoning/agentic/RL-rollout 批次会从大量短请求演变成少量长请求，最优布局在同一批请求运行期间就变了；现有引擎启动时固定布局，换布局意味着排空请求并重启 worker。
Method: SPLASH 基于现代 attention 在极少或没有 KV head 时 KV cache 所在位置与 attention 权重分片方式解耦这一观察：布局差异只在谁持有权重与 cache，大部分状态已位于下一布局所需位置，直接复用，其余在推理后台搬运，并在 batch 边界完成交接。新增 DOP 布局（权重按 TP 分片、cache 单 owner），配合 transition-aware scheduler 在四种布局间随负载切换。
Result: 切换中位开销低于所在 step 的 0.51%；DOP 不复制权重也不复制 cache，比 data-parallel attention 多 27-60% KV 容量；B200 上服务 GLM-5.3 时端到端吞吐较固定布局提升 1.3-1.73x；相同布局需求也出现在 H200 上的 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 DCU 上的 GLM-5.3-Flash。
Conclusion: KV cache 位置与权重分片的解耦使运行时切换并行布局近乎免费，服务引擎应随负载在四种布局间动态选择，而不是启动时固定一种。

papers.title: Correct, Don't Delete: Mitigating Emergent Misalignment with Corrective Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a language model on a narrow set of harmful demonstrations, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned on unrelated questions, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). The usual defense is to find the offending rows and delete them, but a row locator failed our held-out test and deleting rows helps less than expected. We ask a different question: given a fixed set of poisoned rows, is it better to correct them than to remove them? We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on a mixture of bad medical advice and benign chat data, select a quarter of the poison rows in advance, and either delete them or replace each with a corrected answer to the same prompt, keeping everything else the same. Replacing the rows cuts the EM rate by about a third and improves answers on held-out medical questions, while deleting the same rows has little measurable effect. The advantage is larger when half the poison rows are corrected, and it holds on a second base model and a second misaligned model organism. The content of the replacement appears to matter: paraphrasing the rows while keeping their bad advice shows no clear benefit, and the correct answers distributed with the dataset appear to do about as well as our rewriter's. Realigning an already-poisoned model with further fine-tuning is known to work, but which data does the work has not been compared directly. We find that a short round of training on corrections beats the same amount of training on generic chat data, that corrections on other medical prompts do roughly as well as corrections of the poisoned prompts themselves, and that instructing the correction writer to model a careful, harm-avoiding assistant adds no measurable benefit over plain corrections. In the settings we tested, correcting harmful training data reduces EM more than deleting it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有害微调数据（poison rows）固定的前提下，把坏样本改写成正确答案比直接删除更有效：Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上替换四分之一毒样本使 emergent misalignment (EM) 率下降约三分之一，并改善留出医疗问题的回答，删除同批行则几乎无可测效果。优势在纠正一半毒样本时更大，且在第二个基座模型与第二个错位模型上成立；纯改写（保留坏建议）无明显收益。
Motivation: 窄域有害示范微调会让模型在无关问题上广泛错位（EM），常规防御是定位并删除问题行，但 row locator 未通过留出测试，删除行的效果也低于预期。
Method: 在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上用坏医疗建议与良性聊天数据混合微调，事先选定四分之一毒行，对照两种处理：删除，或把每行替换为同一 prompt 的正确回答，其余全部保持一致；另比较纠正一半毒行、第二个基座模型与第二个错位模型，以及改写（保留坏建议）、数据集自带正确答案、对其他医疗 prompt 的纠正、generic chat 训练、以及要求纠正写手模仿谨慎避害助手等变体。
Result: 替换毒行使 EM 率下降约三分之一并改善留出医疗问题回答，删除同批行几乎无可测效果；纠正一半毒行时优势更大，且在第二个基座模型与第二个错位模型上保持。改写保留坏建议无明显收益，数据集自带正确答案与自研 rewriter 效果相当；一轮纠正训练胜过等量 generic chat 训练，对其他医疗 prompt 的纠正与纠正被毒 prompt 本身大致相当，要求模仿谨慎避害助手的纠正相对普通纠正无可测增益。
Conclusion: 在所测设置中，纠正有害训练数据比删除它更能降低 EM；起作用的是纠正内容本身，而非改写形式或额外的避害指令。

summary_sections.motivation: 窄域有害示范微调会让模型在无关问题上广泛错位（EM），常规防御是定位并删除问题行，但 row locator 未通过留出测试，删除行的效果也低于预期。
summary_sections.method: 在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上用坏医疗建议与良性聊天数据混合微调，事先选定四分之一毒行，对照两种处理：删除，或把每行替换为同一 prompt 的正确回答，其余全部保持一致；另比较纠正一半毒行、第二个基座模型与第二个错位模型，以及改写（保留坏建议）、数据集自带正确答案、对其他医疗 prompt 的纠正、generic chat 训练、以及要求纠正写手模仿谨慎避害助手等变体。
summary_sections.result: 替换毒行使 EM 率下降约三分之一并改善留出医疗问题回答，删除同批行几乎无可测效果；纠正一半毒行时优势更大，且在第二个基座模型与第二个错位模型上保持。改写保留坏建议无明显收益，数据集自带正确答案与自研 rewriter 效果相当；一轮纠正训练胜过等量 generic chat 训练，对其他医疗 prompt 的纠正与纠正被毒 prompt 本身大致相当，要求模仿谨慎避害助手的纠正相对普通纠正无可测增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在所测设置中，纠正有害训练数据比删除它更能降低 EM；起作用的是纠正内容本身，而非改写形式或额外的避害指令。

papers.title: AS$^2$D: Accelerating On-Demand Audio Understanding on Mobile Devices
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a smaller drafter to propose tokens for batched verification by a larger target. However, conventional speculative decoding couples drafting to the target's evolving verified prefix, serializing drafting and verification. We ask whether this dependency is necessary for source-conditioned generation. Our key observation is that, for audio language models, the input audio and user request can provide useful speculative candidates without following the target's evolving text prefix. We propose AS$^2$D (Audio Speculative Speculative Decoding), which enables target-decoupled drafting: an audio-conditioned drafter follows its own generation history while the target independently verifies and corrects ready candidates. Without usable candidates, the target advances alone. Thus, target feedback determines which candidates are committed but no longer determines when the drafter can make progress, enabling drafting and verification to proceed concurrently while retaining target-side verification and correction. We implement AS$^2$D in MNN for Android and evaluate two target models across four phones, seven datasets, and three tasks covering 12.2 hours of audio. Across four phones, AS$^2$D improves pooled ASR throughput by 42-76% over target-only decoding, while only 5.7% of evaluation windows are slower than target-only, compared with 58.1-63.0% for speculative baselines. For ASR, AS$^2$D reaches 97.33-98.20% of a hindsight per-window oracle's pooled throughput over the evaluated drafter/budget catalog. Native on-demand execution with a 7B target achieves up to 78% higher throughput than target-only. These results show that source-conditioned audio generation can relax the conventional dependence of speculative drafting on the target's evolving output prefix, exposing substantial parallelism for efficient inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AS²D 把音频推测解码 (speculative decoding) 的起草与目标模型已验证前缀解耦：音频条件 drafter 沿自身历史起草，target 独立验证并纠正候选，无可用候选时 target 单独推进。在四款手机、两个 target 模型、七个数据集、三个任务共 12.2 小时音频上，ASR 吞吐较 target-only 提升 42–76%，仅 5.7% 评测窗口变慢（推测解码基线为 58.1–63.0%）。
Motivation: 常规推测解码把 drafting 绑在 target 不断增长的已验证前缀上，起草与验证被串行化；对源条件生成（音频输入 + 用户请求）这一依赖未必必要，移动端按需音频理解因此受限于串行推理。
Method: 提出 AS²D（Audio Speculative Speculative Decoding）实现 target-decoupled drafting：音频条件 drafter 独立于 target 前缀推进，target 对就绪候选做验证与纠正，无候选时单独前进，使起草与验证并发。在 MNN 中面向 Android 实现，评估两个 target 模型、四款手机、七个数据集、三个任务。
Result: 四款手机上 ASR 池化吞吐较 target-only 提升 42–76%；仅 5.7% 评测窗口慢于 target-only，而推测解码基线为 58.1–63.0%。ASR 吞吐达到 hindsight 每窗口 oracle 池化吞吐的 97.33–98.20%（在所评测的 drafter/budget 目录上）。原生按需执行下 7B target 吞吐最高比 target-only 高 78%。
Conclusion: 源条件音频生成可以放松推测起草对 target 输出前缀的依赖，从而暴露可观并行度；target 侧验证与纠正仍保留，候选是否提交由 target 反馈决定，但 drafter 的推进时机不再受其约束。

papers.title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable
papers.abstract_en: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45-88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds. Source deference and user agreement are not behaviorally interchangeable inside the model: on matched items with the same wrong answer, causal interventions can selectively suppress one without equally affecting the other. In three open-weight families, removing a fitted source direction lowers source compliance by 65-80 percentage points while removing a user or assistant direction has far smaller effects, and removing the user direction shows the reverse preference. A separately fitted intervention derived from source-versus-user cue activations moves compliance in both directions while leaving the prompt text unchanged. An authority direction fitted on trivia also transfers to PIQA and multi-turn SYCON dialogues without refitting, and removing it lowers wrong-source compliance by tens of percentage points in four of five families with no detected change in MMLU-Pro or GSM8K accuracy at our evaluation sizes. Source deference and user agreement therefore need separate evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Conference, Poster). 33 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://authority-bias.vercel.app/ . Code: https://github.com/Lossfunk/authority-bias
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语言模型对「用户附和」与「来源服从」是两种可分离的行为：一条标注为已验证来源的注释为错误答案背书，会在八个模型中的七个里翻转 45-88% 的原本正确回答，且注释听起来越权威服从率越高。因果干预可单独压制其中一种：移除拟合出的 source 方向使来源服从下降 65-80 个百分点，而移除 user/assistant 方向影响小得多，反向亦然。作者主张来源服从与用户附和必须分开评测。
Motivation: 后训练已针对谄媚（sycophancy）让模型按论点本身评判，但检索、工具输出与 grounded-search 常以「已验证来源」形式呈现信息，模型在此仍高度顺从；现有评测把来源服从与用户附和混为一谈，无法定位模型到底服从谁。
Method: 在五个开源权重模型家族与三个闭源 API 上测量该差距；用因果干预分别移除拟合的 source 方向、user/assistant 方向，以及一个由 source-vs-user 线索激活拟合出的干预方向（提示文本保持不变）；另在 trivia 上拟合 authority 方向并零重拟合迁移到 PIQA 与多轮 SYCON 对话，评测集含 MMLU-Pro 与 GSM8K。
Result: 单条已验证来源注释在八个模型中的七个里翻转 45-88% 的原本正确回答；三个开源家族中移除 source 方向使来源服从下降 65-80 个百分点，移除 user 方向影响远小且呈反向偏好；trivia 上拟合的 authority 方向零重拟合迁移到 PIQA 与多轮 SYCON，在五个家族中的四个里移除它使错误来源服从下降数十个百分点，且在当前评测规模下 MMLU-Pro 与 GSM8K 精度无可检出的变化。
Conclusion: 来源服从与用户附和在模型内部由可分离的表征方向承载，可被因果干预独立调节；因此二者需要分开评测，且针对谄媚的后训练并未消除对权威来源的顺从。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PHASE: Multi-Regime Modeling of Incompressible Magnetohydrodynamics
papers.abstract_en: Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) is central to plasma modeling in astrophysics, space science, fusion, and engineering, but resolving multiscale MHD dynamics is computationally expensive. Machine-learning surrogates enable fast inference by learning reusable solution operators, yet existing models require separate training for each physical regime, limiting generalization across varying parameter settings. We introduce PHASE, a PHysics-Adaptive Scalable operator with residual Error correction, designed to model incompressible MHD across varying physical parameters with a single model. PHASE combines transfer learning, regime-aware adaptation, physics-centered learning, and residual refinement to improve both physical fidelity and generalization across MHD regimes. Together, these improvements achieve state-of-the-art prediction accuracy on two-dimensional MHD turbulence by reducing relative $L_2$ errors on physical fields by more than an order of magnitude compared to prior MHD neural-operator baselines. Moreover, PHASE generalizes successfully to unseen parameter values without retraining, demonstrating the cross-regime adaptability expected from operator learning. We evaluate PHASE beyond point-wise prediction errors using derived physical fields, spectral analysis, and distribution statistics, consistently observing improved physical fidelity. We further show that our framework can accurately simulate MHD instabilities by testing it on the Kelvin--Helmholtz instability, demonstrating the robustness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHASE 用单一模型覆盖不同物理参数下的不可压缩磁流体动力学 (MHD)，通过迁移学习、regime-aware 适配、物理中心学习与残差修正 (residual refinement) 提升物理保真度。在二维 MHD 湍流上相对 L2 误差较既有 MHD 神经算子基线降低一个数量级以上，且对未见参数值无需重训即可泛化。
Motivation: MHD 多尺度动力学解析计算代价高，现有 ML 代理模型每个物理 regime 都要单独训练，跨参数设置泛化受限。
Method: PHASE（PHysics-Adaptive Scalable operator with residual Error correction）组合迁移学习、regime-aware adaptation、physics-centered learning 与残差修正四个组件，学习可复用的解算子；除逐点误差外还用导出物理场、谱分析与分布统计评估。
Result: 在二维 MHD 湍流上达到 SOTA 预测精度，物理场相对 L2 误差较先前 MHD 神经算子基线降低一个数量级以上；对未见参数值无需重训即可泛化；在 Kelvin–Helmholtz 不稳定性上验证可准确模拟。
Conclusion: 单一物理自适应算子加残差修正即可跨 MHD regime 泛化并保持物理保真，无需按参数分别训练。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TomoTransformer 把每条局部滤波投影当作一个 token，用自注意力在 back-projection 空间里直接预测缺失视角，从而用单一模型处理任意输入投影数、任意角度与探测器尺寸而无需重训。在多个稀疏视角 CT 基准上显著优于 ViewTrans 等多用途模型、匹配或超过协议专用基线，并在同步辐射 X 射线采集的真实纳米尺度脑数据上展现零样本泛化。
Motivation: 稀疏视角 CT 重建的监督模型把 FBP 图或 sinogram 映射到干净重建，一旦投影数、角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布变化就失效，每次都要重训，实际部署受限。
Method: Transformer 架构把每条局部滤波投影 (local filtered projection) 作为独立 token，用 self-attention 预测缺失视角；在 back-projection 空间操作，使视角插值几何上适定且对探测器尺寸不变。模型在覆盖多种医学 CT 解剖与自然图像的大规模数据集上训练，可查询任意目标角度。
Result: 在多个稀疏视角 CT 基准上显著优于 ViewTrans 等多用途模型，并匹配或超过协议专用基线，同时对输入与目标投影数量完全无关；在同步辐射 X 射线采集的真实实验纳米尺度脑数据上实现鲁棒的零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 把投影当作 token、在 back-projection 空间做视角插值，可以让单一基础模型跨解剖、材料、分辨率处理任意采集协议而无需重训，并能零样本迁移到真实实验数据。

papers.title: GraphVQ: Structure-Aware Autoregressive Decoding over Context-Quantized Graph Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Graph foundation models need a discrete token representation, but casting a graph as a generatable token sequence faces a structural obstacle: edges spanning beyond the serialization window cannot be emitted in one pass--so one-pass autoregressive generators systematically under-produce cycles--and a single global condition cannot tell candidate edges apart. GraphVQ removes both obstacles: node contexts--features plus a local edge mask under multi-order breadth-first serialization--are quantized into a shared codebook by a VQ-VAE with BCE-calibrated Bernoulli edge decoding, and a second-stage structure-aware decoder emits the global adjacency conditioned on token-derived pair features, whose necessity over any global-summary condition is formalized in a scoped impossibility result. The tokenizer reconstructs node features at 0.86--0.99 accuracy and decodes local edges at AUROC >= 0.89 (ECE <= 0.007). Under one same-split protocol on four datasets, pair conditioning improves orbit MMD 0.248 -> 0.174 on PROTEINS and 3.4x on a ring stress test, and vanishes on a random-label control--the signature of attribute--topology coupling--so the gain is claimed exactly where attributes carry edge-relevant signal. GraphVQ ranks first among learned generators on PROTEINS, ties for first on SYN-COMM, and improves orbit MMD 2.7--17x over one-stage generation on three datasets, with seed-level bootstrap intervals confirming the rankings are not seed noise; on MUTAG the unweighted edge target under-generates and is reported as such. These results locate the structural control of autoregressive graph generation in the granularity of the condition: pair-level token context turns a quantized vocabulary into a usable capacity axis for distribution-faithful graph generation and future token-level pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphVQ 把图节点上下文（特征+局部边掩码）经多阶 BFS 序列化后用 VQ-VAE 量化进共享码book，再由结构感知解码器以 token 派生的 pair 特征为条件生成全局邻接，从而补上单遍自回归漏生成环的短板。在四数据集同划分协议下，pair 条件把 PROTEINS 的 orbit MMD 从 0.248 降到 0.174、环压力测试提升 3.4 倍，且在随机标签对照上增益消失。
Motivation: 图基础模型需要离散 token 表示，但超出序列化窗口的边无法一次发出，导致单遍自回归生成系统性少产环；单一全局条件又无法区分候选边。
Method: 节点上下文（特征+局部边掩码）在多阶 breadth-first 序列化下由 VQ-VAE 量化进共享码本，边解码用 BCE 校准的 Bernoulli；第二阶段结构感知解码器以 token 派生的 pair 特征为条件输出全局邻接，其相对任何全局摘要条件的必要性由一个 scoped impossibility 结果形式化。
Result: tokenizer 节点特征重建准确率 0.86–0.99，局部边解码 AUROC ≥ 0.89（ECE ≤ 0.007）。四数据集同划分协议下，pair 条件使 PROTEINS orbit MMD 0.248 → 0.174，环压力测试提升 3.4 倍，随机标签对照上增益消失；在 PROTEINS 上居学习型生成器首位、SYN-COMM 并列第一，三个数据集上较单阶段生成 orbit MMD 改善 2.7–17 倍，seed 级 bootstrap 区间确认排名非种子噪声；MUTAG 上无权边目标少生成并如实报告。
Conclusion: 自回归图生成的结构控制在于条件的粒度：pair 级 token 上下文把量化词表变成分布保真图生成与后续 token 级预训练的可用容量轴；增益恰出现在属性携带边相关信号处。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Independent Verification Paths Are Not Independent: A Case Study of Common-Mode Failure in a Satellite Catalogue Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: A common safeguard for a data pipeline is redundant computation: derive each published number by two routes built on different technology and refuse to exit when they disagree. We report one such gate failing, in a cross-catalogue integrity study of two open registers of Earth-orbiting objects. A gate comparing a set-based Python path with SPARQL queries over the emitted RDF graph printed ALL CROSS-CHECKS AGREE on seven counts. Three were wrong, one overstated more than fourfold (932 against 220). Both paths imported the same constants, which encoded a misreading of the source's status vocabulary, so the error was common-mode and the gate could not see it. We give the mechanism, an object-level ledger reconciling every figure, and three checks that go back to the source's documentation, measured on the defective code and on its correction. We then checked that correction against each object's phase history, held in a source file the pipeline never read. The correction was also wrong: 42 of its 261 disagreements are artefacts, and none of our three checks flagged them. Finally, in a controlled replication with three pinned models and tools disabled, 72 of 75 paths generated on request as independent checks computed the defective count, 29 of 30 even when the prompt carried the source's own definitions of the codes. The evidence is one pipeline and one defect family. Within it, redundancy verified implementation, and the errors that reached publication were errors of meaning.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI for Science workshop (NeurIPS 2026). Code, prompts, raw model outputs and per-trial records: https://github.com/fabio-rovai/space-object-register-ontology (paper/gates/), archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22002834
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两条技术栈不同的校验路径（Python 集合运算与 SPARQL 查询 RDF 图）在七个计数上全部打印 ALL CROSS-CHECKS AGREE，其中三个是错的，最严重一项高估四倍以上（932 对 220）。原因是两条路径导入了同一份编码了源词汇表误读的常量，错误属共模 (common-mode)，冗余只验证了实现而未触及语义。受控复现中 75 条路径有 72 条算出同一缺陷计数，即使提示词里带上源码定义也有 29/30 如此。
Motivation: 数据管线常用双路冗余计算做发布前闸门，但当两条路径共享同一份被误读的常量或定义时，闸门对语义错误完全失明，错误仍会进入已发布数据。
Method: 在两个开放的地球轨道物体登记册交叉完整性研究中，对比基于集合的 Python 路径与对产出 RDF 图的 SPARQL 查询；给出机制分析、逐对象对账 ledger，以及三个回溯源文档的检查，并在缺陷代码与修正版上测量；再用管线从未读取的 phase history 文件独立核对修正版；最后用三个固定模型、工具禁用做受控复现。
Result: 闸门在七个计数上全部报 ALL CROSS-CHECKS AGREE，其中三个错误，最高一项 932 对 220（超过四倍）；修正版与 phase history 有 261 处分歧，其中 42 处是伪影，三个检查一个都没标出；受控复现中 75 条路径有 72 条算出缺陷计数，30 条提示词含源码代码定义的路径里有 29 条同样如此。
Conclusion: 在这一管线与这一类缺陷范围内，冗余验证的是实现，而到达发布的错误是意义 (meaning) 上的错误；共模依赖使双路交叉校验失效。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: When to Adapt: Multi-Signal Domain Shift Detection for Efficient Training-Free Adaptation in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Robust and reliable perception is essential for autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, particularly in long-term missions where environmental conditions may change significantly over time. Although recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have improved open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, these models can still suffer from domain shift, which can significantly degrade performance if they are not adapted to the current environment. Training-free domain adaptation is a relevant paradigm for adaptation, consisting of adjusting the model online using lightweight adapters. Recent approaches apply this on a per-frame basis, which is impractical for deployments on resource-constrained robotic hardware. To tackle this, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) in open-vocabulary segmentation. Our method leverages temporal coherence across consecutive frames by monitoring and combining complementary aspects of domain shift (visual change, adapter mismatch, and semantic drift) to trigger adaptation only when needed. We validate our approach on a benchmark including indoor and outdoor environments and using real robotic data. We demonstrate that our approach maintains segmentation accuracy while substantially reducing adaptations, making training-free adaptation practical and feasible for long-term, real-world robotic deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多信号域偏移检测方法，把视觉变化、adapter 失配与语义漂移三类信号结合，只在检测到域偏移时才触发训练无关持续测试时适应 (TF-CTTA)，而非逐帧适应。在含室内外环境与真实机器人数据的基准上，该方法保持分割精度的同时大幅减少适应次数，使免训练适应可用于资源受限的长期机器人部署。
Motivation: 开放词汇分割的视觉基础模型 (VFM) 在环境长期变化时会因域偏移掉点，而现有训练无关适应 (training-free adaptation) 逐帧触发轻量 adapter，在资源受限的机器人硬件上不可行。
Method: 多信号域偏移检测：利用连续帧的时间一致性，监控并融合域偏移的互补方面——视觉变化、adapter 失配 (adapter mismatch)、语义漂移 (semantic drift)，仅在需要时触发 TF-CTTA 的在线 adapter 更新。
Result: 在包含室内外环境并使用真实机器人数据的基准上验证：分割精度保持不变，同时适应次数大幅减少 (substantially reducing adaptations)。
Conclusion: 按需触发而非逐帧触发，可以在不损失分割精度的前提下把训练无关持续测试时适应变成长期真实机器人部署上可行的方案。
Relevance: 2
