papers.title: BlenDAgger: Blended Shared Control for Interactive Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies are frequently trained from human corrections, yet teleoperating a robot to provide corrections is burdensome, and human demonstrators are not always optimal. We propose Blended DAgger (BlenDAgger), an approach for collecting data to train imitation learning policies by using shared control to blend the policy's and demonstrator's actions during interventions. By blending human and policy actions, we aim to improve the autonomous performance of manipulation policies. We validate our approach across five manipulation tasks, two in the real world and three in simulation. Our approach achieves higher autonomous performance by 30 or more percentage points on two real-world tasks compared to a typical human-gated correction approach (HG-DAgger). We also investigate the advantages of BlenDAgger that allow for higher autonomous performance, finding that BlenDAgger results in 57% smoother transitions between policy control and human interventions, and 14% higher trajectory similarity to the training data. In a user study (n=14) on two real-world tasks, we find that BlenDAgger results in faster data collection (BF=13.32), and we do not find a difference in subjective perceptions. These results show that blended shared control leads to higher autonomous performance compared to typical methods for fine-tuning robot policies from fully teleoperated interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BlenDAgger 用 shared control 把策略动作与人类示范者的干预动作按比例混合来采集模仿学习数据，替代全遥操作的人门控纠正。在 5 项操作任务（2 项真实、3 项仿真）上，两项真实任务的自主性能比 HG-DAgger 高 30 个百分点以上，策略与人工干预之间的切换平滑 57%，轨迹与训练数据相似度高 14%。
Motivation: 用遥操作给机器人做纠正代价高，且示范者本身不一定最优；HG-DAgger 这类人门控纠正方式在策略接管与人工介入的切换处生硬，限制了微调后策略的自主性能。
Method: 提出 Blended DAgger (BlenDAgger)：在人类干预期间用 shared control 混合策略动作与示范者动作来采集数据，再用这些数据训练模仿学习策略；在 5 项操作任务上验证（2 项真实世界、3 项仿真），并与典型的人门控纠正方法 HG-DAgger 对比，另做 n=14 的用户研究。
Result: 两项真实任务上自主性能比 HG-DAgger 高 30 个百分点以上；策略控制与人工干预之间的切换平滑 57%；轨迹与训练数据的相似度高 14%。n=14 的用户研究（两项真实任务）显示数据采集更快（BF=13.32），主观感知上未发现差异。
Conclusion: 混合式 shared control 优于全遥操作干预的典型微调方法，能同时提高自主性能与数据采集速度，且不改变用户的主观感受。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: XU-RS: Explaining Credal Width in Random-Set Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty estimates tell us how unsure a model is, but not why. Without knowing which parts of an input influences a model's uncertainty, we cannot tell whether that uncertainty score depends on input features that are relevant for the task. We study this problem in randomset classifiers built using pretrained language models. These classifiers assign probability to individual answers and to groups of answers, producing lower and upper probabilities for each answer; The difference between these probabilities, called credal width, is used to represent epistemic uncertainty about an answer arising from limited training data. We propose XU-RS, a framework that attributes an answer's credal width to the input tokens (words or word pieces) supplied to a language model. XU-RS uses Expected Gradients (a standard feature attribution method) to estimate how input tokens contribute to credal width. The proposed framework is evaluated on a MedQA dataset using SmolLM3-3B and Llama-2-7B models, demonstrating that setting the embedding of a token ranked highly by XU-RS to zero (zero-masking) causes larger changes in credal width than zero-masking randomly selected tokens. In addition, we show that normalisation can cause other answer groups to influence an answer's width, reveal how token attribution can mask numerical errors, and provide diagnostic checks to verify whether a token ranked highly by XU-RS meaningfully explains model uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XU-RS 用 Expected Gradients 把 random-set 分类器的 credal width（上下概率之差，代表认知不确定性）归因到输入 token。在 MedQA 上用 SmolLM3-3B 与 Llama-2-7B 测试：把 XU-RS 高排名 token 置零（zero-masking）带来的 credal width 变化大于随机 mask；同时发现归一化会让其他 answer group 影响某答案的宽度，token 归因还可能掩盖数值错误。
Motivation: 不确定性分数只说明模型有多不确定，不说明是输入的哪部分驱动了这种不确定，因而无法判断该分数是否依赖与任务相关的输入特征。
Method: 在基于预训练语言模型的 random-set 分类器（对单个答案与答案组分别给概率，输出上下概率）上，用标准特征归因方法 Expected Gradients 估计各输入 token 对 credal width 的贡献，并给出诊断检查以验证高排名 token 是否真的解释了模型不确定性。
Result: 在 MedQA 数据集上以 SmolLM3-3B 和 Llama-2-7B 评测：zero-masking XU-RS 高排名 token 引起的 credal width 变化大于 zero-masking 随机 token；另展示归一化会使其他 answer group 影响某答案的宽度，以及 token 归因可掩盖数值错误。

papers.title: Credit-Guided Policy Improvement for Test-time Adaptive Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation for vision-language navigation (TTA-VLN) enables pretrained policies to adapt online to unseen environments using only test-time observations and interaction history. However, distribution shifts can distort local action preferences and lead to off-course decisions. Existing methods rely on predictive uncertainty, trajectory-level feedback, or accumulated adaptation experience to correct such deviations. These signals, however, do not directly reveal whether an executed action supports instruction-guided progress toward the goal. Moreover, a plausible corrective signal does not guarantee a reliable policy update. The key challenge is thus twofold: identifying interactions that support goal-directed improvement and determining whether the resulting updates are worth retaining. We observe that each executed action induces an immediate observation transition, providing evidence of its local consequences. Based on this insight, we propose Credit-Guided Policy Improvement (CGPI), which recovers signed, reference-relative decision credit from action-induced observation transitions without external outcome feedback. With the pretrained navigation policy frozen, CGPI uses this credit to propose lightweight adaptation updates and verifies them against prior credit-supported interactions. Updates are retained only when supported and rolled back otherwise. CGPI achieves consistent gains across the evaluated VLN benchmarks and navigation backbones, while qualitative robot trials further illustrate the feasibility of zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Credit-Guided Policy Improvement (CGPI)：在视觉语言导航 (VLN) 的测试时自适应中，从动作引发的观测转移里恢复带符号、相对参考路径的决策信用，用它提出轻量策略更新，并只在既有信用支持的交互上验证通过才保留、否则回滚。预训练导航策略全程冻结，CGPI 在所评测的 VLN 基准与多种导航骨干上取得一致增益，定性机器人试验显示零样本 sim-to-real 迁移可行。
Motivation: 测试时自适应 VLN 中分布偏移会扭曲局部动作偏好导致偏离路线；现有方法依赖预测不确定性、轨迹级反馈或累积适应经验，这些信号既不能直接说明某动作是否推动指令导向的目标进展，也不能保证更新可靠。
Method: CGPI 从动作诱导的观测转移中恢复带符号的、参考相对的决策信用 (signed, reference-relative decision credit)，无需外部结果反馈；冻结预训练导航策略，仅用该信用提出轻量适配更新，并在先前信用支持的交互上验证，支持则保留、否则回滚。
Result: 在所评测的多个 VLN 基准与不同导航骨干上取得一致增益；定性机器人试验展示了零样本 sim-to-real 迁移的可行性。
Conclusion: 动作引发的观测转移本身足以给出可验证的更新依据：以信用支持与否决定保留或回滚，可在不微调主干的前提下稳定提升测试时 VLN 性能。

papers.title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FOCUS 把 LLM agent 的上下文压缩重写为因果决策保留问题：在测试时判断哪些历史交互真正塑造后续决策，只保留这些单元，无需离线数据或微调。在 API/工具调用、QA、web 与多轮对话基准上，峰值上下文最多削减 48%、依赖度削减 73%，任务成功率相对未压缩执行最多提升 8.9 个百分点。
Motivation: agent 交互历史随任务长度线性增长，带来二次方推理开销与注意力稀释导致的性能下降；现有压缩方法离线学习丢弃策略，成本高且不随测试时轨迹动态调整。
Method: FOCUS 是纯测试时、training-free 的压缩框架，把压缩建模在离散交互单元上的因果决策保留问题；无需离线采集或微调，架构无关，可作为模块化压缩层挂在任意闭源 API 前沿模型上。
Result: 在 API 与工具调用、QA、web 域、多轮对话等 agentic 基准上达到新 SOTA：峰值上下文最多减少 48%，依赖度 (dependency) 减少 73%，任务成功率较未压缩执行最多提高 8.9 个百分点。
Conclusion: 上下文压缩可以在完全测试时、不训练的条件下同时降本增效：按因果决策保留来选历史，比离线学压缩策略更省成本且能随轨迹自适应。

papers.title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REVOIR 用推理时的价值信息量 (value-of-information) 计算澄清问题的期望任务奖励增益，据此决定是提问还是直接行动。在 CondAmbigQA 与 ADAPT 两个辅助任务上，它用更少问题取得更高成功率：ADAPT 偏好满足度比微调澄清策略高 13–15%，提问次数少五倍且无需训练；当行动后能收到廉价用户纠正时，它会自行推断提问并不总是划算。
Motivation: 语言辅助 agent 面对歧义请求时，常见做法是把用户意图的不确定性降到阈值以下再行动，但这忽略了不确定性下降对下游任务奖励的影响、提问与直接行动的成本差异，以及用户可能主动纠正的情况。
Method: REVOIR 在推理时对每个候选澄清问题做价值信息量推理，估计其答案带来的期望任务奖励提升，并把提问成本与直接行动的代价一起纳入决策；无需训练，与 prompting、chain-of-thought、微调策略和 information gain 基线对比。
Result: 在 CondAmbigQA（歧义问答）与 ADAPT（偏好对齐的家庭任务规划）上，REVOIR 以更少问题取得更高成功；ADAPT 偏好满足度比微调澄清策略高 13–15%，提问次数少五倍且不需训练。行动后可获廉价纠正时它推断提问未必高效；对照的 vanilla 推理 agent 随推理预算增加反而减少澄清。
Conclusion: 把澄清决策写成对下游奖励的价值信息量推理，能在少提问下提高任务成功，并随纠正成本自适应地在提问与行动之间切换；单纯加大推理预算不会让基线 agent 学会适时澄清。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReLMem: Learning Recurrent Memory for Longitudinal EHR Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) modeling requires integrating new visits with an expanding patient history. Yet the continual accumulation of clinical information imposes increasing computational and memory costs on large language models (LLMs) when they process and retain complete patient histories. A practical alternative is visit-wise recurrent compression, which incorporates each incoming visit into a compact, continually updated patient memory. However, under a fixed memory budget, successive updates must integrate new information without progressively losing critical historical evidence needed to subsequent tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Recurrent Longitudinal Memory (ReLMem), a framework that learns to maintain fixed-capacity patient memory for efficient downstream prediction with a frozen LLM. ReLMem equips this LLM with lightweight compression adapters to recurrently update the memory from its previous state and each incoming visit, without rereading earlier records. Specifically, we develop a multi-granularity optimization strategy to preserve task-relevant information throughout recurrent updates and support downstream prediction from the final memory. The intermediate supervision aligns attention outputs from compressed memory and the full history under identical queries, while prediction supervision minimizes cross-entropy with ground truth answers conditioned on the final memory. On EHR-based medication prediction, ReLMem approaches the F1 scores of full-history baseline while reducing average retained historical storage by 97.1%. Under the same memory budget, it improves macro- and micro-F1 over the strongest compressed-memory baseline by 4.66 and 4.75 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of learning recurrent patient memory for efficient longitudinal EHR modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReLMem 用轻量压缩适配器把每次新就诊递归写入固定容量的患者记忆，冻结 LLM 不再重读完整病史。在 EHR 用药预测上，它以减少 97.1% 历史存储的代价逼近全历史基线的 F1，并在同等记忆预算下把 macro-F1 与 micro-F1 比最强压缩记忆基线分别提高 4.66 和 4.75 个百分点。
Motivation: 纵向 EHR 每次就诊都在累积，LLM 处理并保留完整病史的计算与显存成本随时间增长；固定记忆预算下，逐次更新又会渐进丢失后续任务所需的历史证据。
Method: ReLMem 为冻结的 LLM 配上轻量压缩适配器，从上一记忆状态与当前就诊递归更新记忆，不重读旧记录；采用多粒度优化策略，中间监督用相同 query 对齐压缩记忆与全历史的 attention 输出，预测监督则在最终记忆条件下以交叉熵最小化答案。
Result: 在 EHR 用药预测任务上，ReLMem 的 F1 接近全历史基线，同时平均保留的历史存储减少 97.1%；在相同记忆预算下，macro-F1 与 micro-F1 较最强压缩记忆基线分别提升 4.66 和 4.75 个百分点。
Conclusion: 学习式递归患者记忆可以在固定容量下保住任务相关信息，用远少于全历史的存储换取接近全历史的下游预测精度。

papers.title: Learning as Deepfakes Evolve: RF-Prompt for Continual Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Continual audio deepfake detection requires learning newly emerging deepfake methods while retaining discrimination of previously encountered speech. Existing dataset-incremental evaluation changes both real-speech domains and deepfake mechanisms, making their effects difficult to distinguish. We construct five task organizations over identical training, development, and evaluation pools to study these factors under a controlled sample budget. Our proposed Real-Anchored Mechanism-Incremental (RAMI) protocol reflects the practical setting in which available real speech provides a recurring mixed-domain reference while new deepfake mechanisms arrive incrementally. We further propose RF-Prompt, an asymmetric continual prompt-learning method that preserves reusable real-speech knowledge through a shared real prompt and expands mechanism-specific knowledge through inherited fake experts with orthogonal residuals. Input-adaptive soft fusion combines the accumulated experts into a fixed number of injected tokens without requiring task identity at inference. On RAMI, RF-Prompt achieves 10.110% average EER and 10.370% pooled EER, outperforming all evaluated continual-learning baselines. Across the five controlled protocols, RAMI yields the lowest common-average and pooled EER. Component ablations, limited-data experiments, and cross-backbone evaluations further validate the proposed design.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSocket 把「接收方可执行」写进交换模型本身：共享 Q 统一接收方输入、任务自有输出与按所有权聚合，私有模型各自训练本地 Q 副本，只交换 Q 参数与计数即可支撑本地学习与 Joint 推理。在 MELD 与 UCF-51 上，缺模态接收方精度比 Local 分别高 14.44 和 15.51 个百分点；同等推理容量下 Joint 在 UCF-51 上比独立集成高 11.06 点。
Motivation: 联邦交换的模型常因模态、私有架构与任务不同而无法被接收方直接执行，异构多模态联邦学习中的知识交换因此难以落地。
Method: 提出共享 Q：以接收方可计算的输入、任务自有输出和 ownership-aware aggregation 组成公共预测接口；各私有模型训练本地 Q 副本，仅回传 Q 参数与计数，接收方结合本地预测与交换预测做 Joint 推理。另用 teacher controls、sharing-path interventions 与 component factorials 分离监督、共享与部署各自的作用。
Result: 六个数据集上，缺模态接收方精度较 Local 在 MELD 提升 14.44 个百分点、在 UCF-51 提升 15.51 个百分点；同等推理容量下 Joint 在 UCF-51 精度上超过独立集成 11.06 点，在 Flickr30k 双向平均 R@1 上高 4.87 点；Joint 在全部四个异构端点上均优于仅用 Q。
Conclusion: 把接收方执行作为交换模型的设计约束，配合本地与交换预测的联合，可让联邦知识从训练直接用于接收方推理，且在异构端点上稳定优于单一来源预测。

papers.title: TReVS: Integrating Textual Relevance and Visual Saliency for Efficient Vision-Language Model Token Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. We further find that high-variance attention heads are more sensitive to the textual query and yield more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for second-stage pruning. Motivated by these findings, we propose TReVS, a training-free framework that combines textual relevance with vision-encoder saliency for pre-LLM pruning and leverages high-variance attention heads to remove task-irrelevant tokens at shallow-to-intermediate layers of the LLM. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS retains 92.8% of the unpruned baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TReVS 是免训练的视觉 token 剪枝框架：在 LLM 之前就把文本相关性与视觉显著性一起用于剪枝，避免第一阶段只看显著性误删与查询相关的 token，再在 LLM 浅到中间层用高方差注意力头的 text-to-vision 注意力剪掉任务无关 token。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上剪掉 94.4% 视觉 token 仍保留未剪枝基线 92.8% 的性能，超过此前 SOTA。
Motivation: 两阶段视觉 token 剪枝的第一阶段通常只依赖 vision encoder 的显著性，会过早删掉与文本查询相关的 token，使后续 text-guided 阶段失去关键视觉证据，导致推理成本与性能难以兼顾。
Method: 免训练框架 TReVS：pre-LLM 剪枝阶段融合文本相关性与 vision encoder 显著性；LLM 内的第二阶段在浅到中间层利用对文本查询更敏感、text-to-vision 注意力信号更具判别力的高方差注意力头 (high-variance attention heads) 移除任务无关 token。
Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，TReVS 剪枝 94.4% 视觉 token 后保留未剪枝基线 92.8% 的性能，优于此前的 state-of-the-art 剪枝方法；经验分析显示第一阶段引入查询引导比纯视觉显著性剪枝更能保留任务相关证据并稳定提升性能。
Conclusion: 第一阶段就应把查询相关性纳入剪枝，并用高方差注意力头做第二阶段筛选，这样在极高剪枝率下仍能保住 VLM 的大部分性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Is Hard to Beat, Yet Superlinear Drift Ships Lower Transport Costs
papers.abstract_en: Brešar and Mijatović \cite{bresar2025} show that Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion is hard to beat in forward convergence under assumptions that exclude superlinear drift. We instead test superlinear Langevin diffusions for score-based image generation, computing their conditional scores numerically from a Fokker--Planck equation. In our experiments, the superlinear models beat the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck baseline on empirical Wasserstein distance across nearly the entire tested grid and show less variation across diffusion horizons. The ``hard to beat'' verdict of \cite{bresar2025} thus fails to be universal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 score-based 图像生成中的扩散漂移选择，作者用 Fokker–Planck 方程数值求条件分数，检验超线性漂移 (superlinear drift) 的 Langevin 扩散。在所测网格上超线性模型的经验 Wasserstein 距离几乎全面优于 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 基线，且随扩散时程 (diffusion horizon) 的波动更小，说明 OU 的“难以超越”结论不具普适性。
Motivation: Brešar 与 Mijatović 证明 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 扩散在前向收敛下难以被超越，但其假设排除了超线性漂移；这一判定是否适用于 score-based 生成尚未被检验。
Method: 构造超线性漂移的 Langevin 扩散用于 score-based 图像生成，条件分数不靠网络拟合而是由 Fokker–Planck 方程数值求解，再与 OU 基线在参数网格上比较经验 Wasserstein 距离。
Result: 在几乎整个测试网格上，超线性模型的经验 Wasserstein 距离优于 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 基线，且跨不同 diffusion horizon 的结果波动更小。
Conclusion: OU 在前向收敛上的“hard to beat”判定在 score-based 图像生成的超线性漂移设定下不成立，漂移函数形式是可调的设计变量。

papers.title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Diagnosing Large Multimodal Models for AI-Generated Image Assessment
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multimodal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects: Semantics, Quality, Authenticity, and Responsibility. SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AI-generated images sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro, already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SQUARE-Bench，从 Semantics、Quality、Authenticity、Responsibility 四个方面、38 个子维度统一评测大多模态模型 (LMM) 作为 AI 生成图像评估者的能力。在 23 个 LMM 上，Gemini-3-Pro 等头部闭源模型已超过单个人类专家基线，但模型间在细粒度推理与领域鲁棒性上差距仍显著；用分维度 LMM 反馈引导图像编辑只在语义、真实性、责任上选择性提升，同时带来一致的画质代价。
Motivation: 现有 LMM 评估基准把语义理解、质量感知、真实性识别分开考察，且基本不覆盖责任检测 (responsibility detection)，缺少对 LMM 作为 AI 生成图像评估者的统一、全面验证。
Method: 构建 SQUARE-Bench：覆盖 Semantics、Quality、Authenticity、Responsibility 四方面与 38 个子维度的细粒度分类体系，图像取自 22 个生成模型（从早期到 SOTA）的近 10K 张 AI 生成图，另加 3K 余张真实图像，并配人工整理的问答对；在 23 个 LMM 上做评测，并追加一项 LMM 引导的迭代编辑概念验证，由分维度 LMM 向固定图像编辑器提供诊断反馈。
Result: 23 个 LMM 的评测显示 Gemini-3-Pro 等头部闭源模型已超过单个人类专家基线，但模型间性能差距显著，细粒度推理与领域鲁棒性上存在明显不均衡。LMM 引导迭代编辑在 semantics、authenticity、responsibility 上取得选择性改善，同时伴随一致的视觉质量 (visual quality) 权衡。
Conclusion: LMM 已可作为 AI 生成图像的诊断性评估者且头部模型胜过单个人类专家，但细粒度与领域鲁棒性短板仍在；用其反馈驱动 T2I 迭代精修有效，代价是画质下降。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Task Scope and Information Retention in Source Coding
papers.abstract_en: We argue that dividing codec design into Coding for Machines (CfM) and Coding for Humans (CfH) is a misleading distinction for deciding what information a codec may discard. Receiver identity does not determine admissible information loss. The required rate depends on task scope, including the predictions to support, their losses and tolerated risks, the encoder observation, and the permitted decoding procedures. Notably, a machine task may have a higher minimum rate than a restricted human decision. Rate savings on selected machine tasks apply only to the stated requirements, not to an intrinsic ordering by receiver type. We extend source and feature coding to finite task families, derive when restricting the encoder observation preserves the minimum rate, and show that equality between source and split-feature coding rates can no longer hold as the task scope expands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文反驳 CfM/CfH（Coding for Machines / Coding for Humans）这一划分：可丢弃的信息不由接收方身份决定，而由任务范围（要支持的预测、其损失与容忍风险、编码器观测、允许的解码过程）决定。机器任务的最低码率可能高于受限的人类决策；随任务族扩大，源编码与 split-feature 编码的码率相等不再成立。
Motivation: 把编解码器设计按接收方是机器还是人来划分，会误导信息丢弃的取舍：码率需求实际取决于任务范围，而非接收方类型，现有区分无法判定哪些信息可安全丢弃。
Method: 把源编码与特征编码 (source and feature coding) 推广到有限任务族 (finite task families)，推导在何种条件下限制编码器观测仍保持最低码率，并分析任务范围扩大时源编码与 split-feature 编码码率的相等关系。
Result: 给出理论结论：机器任务的最低码率可能高于受限的人类决策；选定机器任务上的码率节省只对给定需求成立，不存在按接收方类型的内在码率排序；任务范围扩大时源编码与 split-feature 编码码率相等不再成立。
Conclusion: 码率是否可省应按任务范围（预测、损失、风险、编码器观测、解码过程）判定，而非按接收方是机器还是人；CfM 与 CfH 的二分对信息丢弃决策是误导性的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decompose Radicals, Then Reward: Fine-Grained Inspection for Accurate Chinese Text Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Rendering accurate Chinese text remains challenging for text-to-image models. Existing OCR-based reinforcement-learning rewards compare decoded transcripts with target strings. Such rewards overlook the compositional nature of Chinese writing: an ideograph consists of reusable components arranged through explicit spatial relations, yet OCR evaluates it as an atomic character. Consequently, visually different radical-level errors may receive equally coarse feedback, encouraging glyphs that merely resemble the target instead of faithfully reproducing its internal structure. We employ Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS), which comprise spatial operators and character components, and train an expert IDS recognizer to transcribe rendered Chinese text into this representation. Building on this recognizer, we introduce IDSpect, which deterministically decomposes the target text into IDS tokens and aligns crop-level visual IDS predictions with the target sequence. Globally unique token credit makes this comparison robust to the order of detected text regions. Combined with a whole-character semantic reward, IDSpect supplies fine-grained credit with component and spatial-relation without changing the image generator or adding inference-time cost. Experiments with GRPO post-training of Qwen-Image demonstrate that IDSpect achieves leading structural quality and semantic alignment on LongText and GenTextEval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对文生图模型渲染中文时 OCR 奖励把汉字当原子单元、radical 级错误只得到粗粒度反馈的问题，提出 IDSpect：用表意文字描述序列 (IDS) 把目标文本确定性分解为空间算子与部件 token，再将 crop 级视觉 IDS 预测与目标序列对齐，配合整字语义奖励做细粒度 credit。对 Qwen-Image 做 GRPO 后训练，在 LongText 与 GenTextEval 上取得领先的结构质量与语义对齐，且不改动图像生成器、不增加推理开销。
Motivation: OCR-based RL 奖励只比对解码文本与目标串，把汉字视作原子字符，视觉上差异很大的 radical 级错误会拿到同样粗的反馈，诱导模型生成“形似”而非结构忠实的字形。
Method: 训练一个 expert IDS recognizer 把渲染出的中文转写为 IDS 表示；IDSpect 据此把目标文本确定性分解为 IDS token，并将 crop 级视觉 IDS 预测与目标序列对齐，用全局唯一 token credit 使比较对文本区域检测顺序鲁棒，再叠加整字语义奖励；生成器保持不变。
Result: 在 Qwen-Image 上做 GRPO 后训练，IDSpect 在 LongText 与 GenTextEval 两个基准上取得领先的结构质量与语义对齐；不改变图像生成器，也不增加推理时开销。
Conclusion: 把汉字按部件与空间关系拆开给 credit，比 OCR 整字比对更能约束中文渲染的内部结构，且可作为即插即用的 RL 奖励接入现有文生图后训练。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Concealing LLM-Based Multi-Agent Topology via Phantom Structure Injection
papers.abstract_en: Driven by the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for collaborative reasoning over complex tasks. A key design element of MAS is the communication topology, which governs information flow among agents and often encodes proprietary knowledge about the system architecture. However, recent work has shown that such topologies can be inferred even in black-box settings by exploiting semantic dependencies in observable reasoning traces, posing significant risks of intellectual property leakage and exposure of system vulnerabilities. To address this threat, we propose MIRAGE, a topology-concealment framework that preserves the genuine communication topology for task execution while shaping adversary-facing semantic evidence toward a carefully constructed phantom topology. Specifically, MIRAGE operates in three stages: (1) phantom topology synthesis, (2) semantic edge realization, and (3) protected MAS execution. It constructs a phantom topology structurally distinct from the genuine one, materializes phantom edges as plausible semantic dependencies, and suppresses source-specific cues that could reveal genuine edges absent from the phantom topology. Extensive experiments across three topology optimization frameworks and four benchmark datasets demonstrate that MIRAGE substantially reduces the effectiveness of topology inference attacks while largely preserving the task utility of the protected MAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRAGE 在执行时保留真实 LLM 多智能体通信拓扑，同时把对手可见的推理痕迹塑造成一个结构上刻意不同的幻影拓扑 (phantom topology)，从而让黑盒拓扑推断攻击得到错误答案。三阶段流程（幻影拓扑合成、语义边实现、受保护的 MAS 执行）在三个拓扑优化框架与四个 benchmark 上显著降低攻击成功率，同时大体保持任务效用。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的通信拓扑常编码专有架构知识，攻击者可从黑盒推理痕迹中的语义依赖反推出拓扑，导致知识产权泄露与系统脆弱点暴露。
Method: MIRAGE 分三阶段：先合成与真实拓扑结构不同的幻影拓扑，再把幻影边物化为看似合理的语义依赖，并抑制会暴露幻影之外真实边的来源线索，最后在受保护模式下执行 MAS。
Result: 在三个拓扑优化框架和四个 benchmark 数据集上的实验显示，MIRAGE 显著降低拓扑推断攻击的效果，同时大体保持受保护 MAS 的任务效用。
Conclusion: 面向对手的语义证据可以与真实执行拓扑解耦，用一个构造出的幻影拓扑来隐藏真实 MAS 结构而不明显牺牲任务表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Model-Agnostic Physics-Guided Adapter for Few-Shot Transfer of Coastal Flood Prediction Models to Unseen Regions
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning surrogates can produce high-resolution coastal flood maps orders of magnitude faster than physics-based hydrodynamic simulators, yet transferring them to new coastal regions remains costly, since generating target-region data for fine-tuning typically requires numerous time-consuming simulations. To tackle this bottleneck, we introduce the Physics Adapter (PA), a compact, architecture-agnostic adaptation interface that enables efficient few-shot transfer of flood prediction models across diverse coastal regions. PA predicts peak water level through a differentiable wet/dry response that compares terrain elevation against a learned water level, and blends this physics-structured prediction with a data-driven branch through a learned gate. Unlike physics-informed formulations, PA imposes no PDE-residual or conservation losses and instead exploits elevation as an architectural inductive bias, adding a negligible number of trainable parameters. We integrate PA into 12 heterogeneous models, and evaluate them on two coastal regions with markedly distinct geometries, topographies, and shoreline protection configurations. The performance of PA is benchmarked against a no-physics baseline, full fine-tuning, and standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, considering both within-region generalization to unseen sea level rise values and between-region transfer. In low-shot regime (K=3), and averaged over all backbones and transfer settings, adding PA reduces root mean square error by 11.5% when only the output head is adapted on a frozen backbone, by 15.4% when combined with PEFT methods, and by 22.9% under full fine-tuning, compared to matched configurations without PA. Taken together, the findings of this work offer practitioners a concrete recipe for extending DL-based coastal flood predictors to new, data-scarce regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出架构无关的 Physics Adapter (PA)：用可微的干湿响应（地形高程对比学习到的水位）预测峰值水位，再经学习门控与数据驱动分支融合，且不加 PDE 残差或守恒损失。接入 12 个异构模型、在两个几何与地形差异显著的海岸区做少样本迁移，K=3 时相对无物理基线平均降低 RMSE 11.5%（仅训输出头）、15.4%（叠加 PEFT）、22.9%（全量微调）。
Motivation: 深度学习海洪代理虽比水动力模拟快若干数量级，但迁到新海岸区需为目标区生成大量耗时模拟数据做微调，数据稀缺地区扩展成本高。
Method: PA 是紧凑、架构无关的适配接口：以高程作为架构归纳偏置，通过可微干湿响应（地形高程 vs 学习水位）预测峰值水位，再用学习到的 gate 与数据驱动分支混合；不引入 PDE 残差或守恒损失，可训练参数量可忽略。将其集成进 12 个异构模型，与 no-physics 基线、全量微调及标准 PEFT 对比，评估覆盖区域内对未见海平面上升值的泛化与跨区域迁移。
Result: 在低样本 K=3、对全部 backbone 与迁移设置取平均时，相比匹配的无 PA 配置：仅在冻结 backbone 上适配输出头 RMSE 降低 11.5%，叠加 PEFT 降低 15.4%，全量微调下降低 22.9%。评测在两个几何、地形与岸线防护配置差异显著的海岸区域上进行。
Conclusion: 把高程做成架构内的物理归纳偏置、而非损失项，就能以可忽略的参数量在少样本下把海洪预测模型迁到数据稀缺的新区域，给出可直接照做的扩展配方。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants
papers.abstract_en: To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions. To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 549 sessions, 104 trajectories, and 2,719 candidates, spanning both objective and open-ended questions. Each session is a video with fine-grained annotations, and sessions within a trajectory revolve around related activities. Models then use persistent memory to answer questions about past sessions and provide proactive responses while maintaining real-time interaction. This raises challenges: persistent memory must be storable, selectively retain information, be injected at the right time, and remain efficient. Moreover, finite storage may leave required evidence unavailable, so assistants should recognize missing evidence. Therefore, we systematically evaluate general video models under different memory protocols and diverse specialized streaming memory systems, and test whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence. Our evaluation reveals a clear utility--latency--storage trade-off: existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, low overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions. APM-Bench provides a comprehensive testbed for developing and comparing persistent memory systems under realistic streaming conditions. We hope it encourages future work that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage toward more practical persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APM-Bench 把流式视频助手的交互重构为跨 session 的多段人生轨迹，用 549 个 session、104 条轨迹、2,719 个候选问题测试持久记忆能否跨中断留存并支持主动响应。系统评测显示明确的效用-延迟-存储三方权衡：现有方法无法同时做到可靠长期回忆、低开销与跨 session 主动辅助，且在证据不足时应承认缺失。
Motivation: 现有流式视频基准只覆盖单条连续视频或短片段，而真实交互是间断的，要求记忆跨中断持久留存；同时有限存储可能使所需证据不可得，助手需识别证据缺失。
Method: 将流式交互重构为多 session 生命轨迹，每个 session 是带细粒度标注的视频、同一轨迹内围绕相关活动；在不同记忆协议下系统评测通用视频模型与多类专用流式记忆系统，并测试模型是否承认证据不足。
Result: 基准含 549 个 session、104 条轨迹、2,719 个候选问题，覆盖客观题与开放题；评测揭示清晰的效用-延迟-存储权衡，现有方法难以同时实现可靠长期回忆、低开销与跨 session 有效主动辅助。
Conclusion: 持久记忆系统需在效用、延迟、存储三者间联合权衡才能走向实用，APM-Bench 提供了在真实流式条件下开发与比较这类系统的测试床。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 将流式交互重构为多 session 生命轨迹，每个 session 是带细粒度标注的视频、同一轨迹内围绕相关活动；在不同记忆协议下系统评测通用视频模型与多类专用流式记忆系统，并测试模型是否承认证据不足。
summary_sections.result: 基准含 549 个 session、104 条轨迹、2,719 个候选问题，覆盖客观题与开放题；评测揭示清晰的效用-延迟-存储权衡，现有方法难以同时实现可靠长期回忆、低开销与跨 session 有效主动辅助。
summary_sections.conclusion: 持久记忆系统需在效用、延迟、存储三者间联合权衡才能走向实用，APM-Bench 提供了在真实流式条件下开发与比较这类系统的测试床。

papers.title: Benchmarking graph-based models for in-silico toxicity prediction in drug discovery
papers.abstract_en: Drug discovery is a costly and high-risk process, where toxicity-related failures remain a major cause of attrition in both preclinical and clinical stages. As a result, accurate early prediction of chemical toxicity is essential to reduce downstream costs and improve compound prioritization. In this context, graph deep learning (GDL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for toxicity prediction, leveraging molecular graph representations to learn directly from chemical structure with improved expressivity over traditional approaches. Despite the growing number of proposed models, current literature-based comparisons are often difficult to interpret due to inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols. To address this limitation, we introduce a unified and standardized benchmarking framework for GDL-based toxicity prediction. We systematically evaluate more than 20 representative approaches under consistent experimental conditions and across multiple datasets and partitioning strategies, enabling a fair and reproducible comparison of model performance. In addition, we complement this empirical study with a structured literature analysis to contextualize existing methodological trends and performance claims. Our results provide a clearer and more reliable assessment of the current state of the field, highlighting both the strengths and limitations of existing graph-based approaches. To support transparency and reproducibility, we release our benchmarking framework as open-source software https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox, allowing the community to evaluate and compare models under consistent conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的图深度学习 (GDL) 毒性预测基准框架 benchtox，在一致实验条件、多数据集与多种划分策略下系统评测 20 余个代表性模型，并配套结构化文献分析。结果给出该领域现状的更可靠评估，指出既有图模型的强项与局限，框架以开源软件形式发布。
Motivation: 文献中已有的毒性预测模型对比因数据集、预处理流程与评估协议不一致而难以解读，无法公平判断图模型的真实性能。
Method: 构建标准化基准框架，在统一实验条件下跨多个数据集与多种划分策略评测 20 余个图深度学习方法，并补充结构化文献分析以梳理方法趋势与性能声明；框架以开源软件 benchtox 发布。
Result: 系统评估超过 20 个代表性 GDL 方法，覆盖多个数据集与多种划分策略；给出对当前图基毒性预测方法性能的更清晰可靠评估，标出既有方法的强项与局限。
Conclusion: 在一致协议下做标准化基准，才能公平可复现地比较图基毒性预测模型；该框架作为开源软件供社区复用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding for Trustworthy LLM-Based Robot Planning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as high-level planners in robot navigation, but their outputs may become unreliable when instructions are ambiguous, unsupported by the environment, or semantically inconsistent. This paper presents a Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding framework for trustworthy LLM-based robot planning. Unlike existing LLM-based planners that primarily optimize plan generation, we formulate semantic grounding reliability as a multi-dimensional risk estimation problem. The proposed architecture explicitly models grounding uncertainty through ambiguity, hallucination and semantic-conflict risks before planning occurs, enabling the system to decide whether to execute the instruction, request clarification, or reject it. To evaluate the approach, we introduce TRUST-NAV, a benchmark containing both standard navigation tasks and risk-inducing instruction scenarios. Experimental results show that while conventional LLM planners achieve strong performance on valid navigation tasks, the proposed framework substantially improves ambiguity detection and semantic conflict rejection. These findings suggest that trustworthy robot planning should be evaluated not only by task completion, but also by the ability to recognize when execution should not occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding 框架，在规划前把语义接地可靠性建模为歧义、幻觉、语义冲突三类风险，让系统在执行指令、请求澄清、拒绝三者间决策。配套发布 TRUST-NAV 基准，含标准导航任务与风险诱导指令；结果显示常规 LLM 规划器在有效任务上表现强，而该框架显著提升歧义检测与语义冲突拒绝。
Motivation: LLM 作机器人导航高层规划器时，指令含糊、环境不支持或语义不一致会导致不可靠输出，而现有方法只优化计划生成，不判断该不该执行。
Method: 在规划前显式估计三类接地不确定性风险（ambiguity、hallucination、semantic-conflict），据此在执行、请求澄清、拒绝之间决策；用新提出的 TRUST-NAV 基准评测，含标准导航任务与风险诱导指令场景。
Result: 常规 LLM 规划器在有效导航任务上表现强；所提框架在歧义检测与语义冲突拒绝上显著提升。
Conclusion: 可信机器人规划不能只看任务完成率，还要看系统能否识别出不该执行的时刻。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: End-to-End Optical Semantic Communication over a Nonlinear WDM Fiber Link
papers.abstract_en: Emerging optical-network applications increasingly use received data for inference and control rather than exact source reproduction, creating an opportunity to trade bit-level fidelity for greater transmission reach and efficiency. We propose an end-to-end optical semantic communication system for joint image classification and reconstruction over a nonlinear wavelength-division multiplexed (WDM) fiber channel. The system maps each image directly into a fixed-length sequence of channel symbols that preserves task-relevant information, without explicit source compression or channel coding. Experiments on the MNIST dataset cover launch powers from -9 to +3 dBm, fiber lengths up to 800 km, and 16-, 64-, and 256-Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) formats. At 0 dBm, classification accuracy remains between 98.92% and 99.31% across all tested link lengths and modulation orders, while requiring fewer transmitted symbols than a Low-Density Parity-Check (LDPC)-coded JPEG baseline at every tested modulation order. These results show that semantic communication can simultaneously extend optical reach and reduce transmission resources by conveying only task-relevant information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端光语义通信系统：图像直接映射为定长信道符号序列，同时完成分类与重建，跳过显式信源压缩与信道编码，在非线性 WDM 光纤信道上传输。在 MNIST 上、0 dBm 入纤功率下，所有测试链路长度与调制阶数的分类准确率保持在 98.92%–99.31%，且每个调制阶数所需符号数都少于 LDPC 编码的 JPEG 基线。
Motivation: 新兴光网络应用关心的是推理与控制结果而非比特级复现，传统信源压缩加信道编码的分离式链路为保真付出多余符号开销，限制传输距离与效率。
Method: 端到端联合设计：把每张图像直接映射为固定长度信道符号序列，保留任务相关信息，不做显式信源压缩与信道编码；在非线性 WDM 光纤信道上联合做图像分类与重建，实验覆盖 -9 至 +3 dBm 入纤功率、最长 800 km 链路以及 16/64/256-QAM 调制。
Result: MNIST 上，0 dBm 时分类准确率在全部测试链路长度与调制阶数下保持 98.92%–99.31%；在每个测试调制阶数上，所需传输符号数均少于 LDPC 编码的 JPEG 基线。实验参数范围为入纤功率 -9 至 +3 dBm、光纤长度至 800 km、调制格式 16/64/256-QAM。
Conclusion: 只传任务相关信息可以同时延长光传输距离并减少传输资源，语义通信在非线性 WDM 链路上对分类任务可行。

papers.title: How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?
papers.abstract_en: Content-generation agents continuously receive impressions, clicks, conversions, and negative feedback from recommendation systems, providing real-world outcome signals for memory evolution. However, these signals are delayed and noisy, confounded by audience composition, placement, and recommendation policies, and may result from the combined influence of multiple memories, making accurate attribution difficult. Existing methods rely primarily on immediate feedback or semantic retrieval and therefore struggle to reliably translate recommendation outcomes into memory fitness. To address this challenge, we propose TIDE (Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution), an external memory evolution framework driven by delayed recommendation feedback. We further introduce Memory Evolution Gain (MEG), which measures the utility improvement of evolved memory over a no memory baseline on strictly future tasks. TIDE treats memory as a capacity-constrained population of experiences: temporal and semantic credit assignment estimates contextual fitness, while responsibility credit distributes outcome signals according to the memories referenced during generation. These signals are then used to reinforce, crossover, mutate, or evict memories. On an e-commerce membership marketing content-generation agent, TIDE achieves a +7.75-percentage-point MEG in offline temporal replay and significantly improves both unique click-through rate (UCTR) and activation rate in an online A/B test. On a delayed-label benchmark, TIDE achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) and the highest MEG among the compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIDE 把推荐系统的延迟反馈转成记忆适应度，用时序与语义 credit assignment 估计上下文适应度、按生成时引用的记忆分摊结果信号，再对记忆做 reinforce、crossover、mutate 或 evict。在电商会员营销内容生成 agent 上，离线时序回放 MEG 提升 +7.75 个百分点，在线 A/B 显著提高 UCTR 与激活率，延迟标签基准上 MAE、RMSE 最低且 MEG 最高。
Motivation: 内容生成 agent 收到的点击、转化等推荐反馈延迟、嘈杂，且受受众构成、版位与推荐策略混杂，多记忆共同作用使归因困难；现有方法只靠即时反馈或语义检索，无法把推荐结果可靠转成记忆适应度。
Method: TIDE (Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution) 把记忆当作容量受限的经验种群：时序与语义 credit assignment 估计 contextual fitness，responsibility credit 按生成时被引用的记忆分摊结果信号，再据此执行 reinforce、crossover、mutate、evict。配套提出 Memory Evolution Gain (MEG)，衡量演化记忆相对无记忆基线在严格未来任务上的效用提升。
Result: 在电商会员营销内容生成 agent 上，离线时序回放 MEG 提升 +7.75 个百分点；在线 A/B 测试中 unique click-through rate (UCTR) 与 activation rate 均显著改善；在延迟标签基准上取得最低 MAE、最低 RMSE 与最高 MEG。
Conclusion: 把延迟推荐反馈经时序与责任分摊转成记忆适应度，能在严格未来任务上稳定提升内容生成 agent 的记忆效用，MEG 可作为该类演化的度量。

papers.title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
papers.abstract_en: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillGym 自动构建可验证环境来训练 LLM agent 的技能调用能力：从网络爬取可离线复现的工作流技能，用 builder-reviewer 管线生成难度可控、带参考解与可执行 verifier 的任务，再用验证通过的轨迹做 SFT。训练后 agent 读取相关技能的比例从 28% 升到 96%，Qwen3.5-9B SFT 在四个技能使用基准中的两个上超过 397B 未训练模型。
Motivation: 技能 (skill) 已广泛进入 agent 范式，但如何合成可靠训练数据、如何训练 agent 使用技能仍缺乏可行路径，缺少可验证的训练环境与轨迹来源。
Method: SkillGym 管线分三步：爬取大量网络技能并只保留工作流可离线可复现的；用 builder-reviewer 管线构造难度可控的任务，覆盖四类任务类型，每个任务带参考解和可执行 verifier；据此构建环境、采集轨迹并做监督微调 (SFT)。
Result: 构建 6.8k 个环境，采集 19k 条经验证的成功轨迹用于 SFT；微调提升 2B 到 122B 不同家族与规模的 LLM，覆盖四个 skill-use 基准；Qwen3.5-9B SFT 模型在其中两个基准上超过 397B 未训练模型；读取相关技能的比例从 28% 提升到 96%，增益跨推理结构成立，并延伸到训练数据中占少数的任务类型与训练时留出的技能。
Conclusion: 可验证环境加验证轨迹的 SFT 能教会 agent 主动调用技能，且这种增益可迁移到未充分训练的任务类型与留出技能上。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 技能 (skill) 已广泛进入 agent 范式，但如何合成可靠训练数据、如何训练 agent 使用技能仍缺乏可行路径，缺少可验证的训练环境与轨迹来源。
summary_sections.method: SkillGym 管线分三步：爬取大量网络技能并只保留工作流可离线可复现的；用 builder-reviewer 管线构造难度可控的任务，覆盖四类任务类型，每个任务带参考解和可执行 verifier；据此构建环境、采集轨迹并做监督微调 (SFT)。
summary_sections.result: 构建 6.8k 个环境，采集 19k 条经验证的成功轨迹用于 SFT；微调提升 2B 到 122B 不同家族与规模的 LLM，覆盖四个 skill-use 基准；Qwen3.5-9B SFT 模型在其中两个基准上超过 397B 未训练模型；读取相关技能的比例从 28% 提升到 96%，增益跨推理结构成立，并延伸到训练数据中占少数的任务类型与训练时留出的技能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可验证环境加验证轨迹的 SFT 能教会 agent 主动调用技能，且这种增益可迁移到未充分训练的任务类型与留出技能上。

papers.title: Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization. We call this phenomenon ``probabilistic forgetting'': suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T2I 扩散模型的机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 存在“概率性遗忘”：概念只在特定初始噪声区域显现，标准高斯采样与遗忘目标错位，导致被抑制概念在某些随机初始化下复现。提出自适应、概念条件化的噪声采样，把梯度更新集中到概念显现区域并降权无信息区域，跨随机初始化的条件裸露复现率平均降低 67.2%。
Motivation: 现有 SOTA 遗忘方法对初始噪声极不稳健：同一概念在部分初始化下看似已遗忘，在另一些初始化下重新出现，标准高斯采样产生的梯度更新稀疏且无信息，无法实现稳健擦除。
Method: 提出自适应概念条件化噪声采样策略，动态把梯度更新集中到目标概念显现的初始噪声区域并降权无信息区域；该框架与 6 种不同 SOTA 遗忘方法集成，在 4 个扩散 backbone 上运行，评测覆盖安全、物体、艺术风格三类概念遗忘，以及黑盒与白盒对抗攻击。
Result: 跨随机初始化的条件裸露复现率相对 4 个基线平均下降 67.2%；在黑盒与白盒对抗评测中攻击成功率均下降；跨概念域提升对抗鲁棒性与非目标概念保持，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量与目标擦除性能。
Conclusion: 遗忘失败的根源是采样分布与遗忘目标的错位，把初始噪声采样改成概念条件化的自适应分布，可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下同时增强擦除稳健性与对抗鲁棒性。

papers.title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Underestimate Rare Tokens
papers.abstract_en: In the softmax output layer, a rare token receives a small positive logit gradient on most steps and a much larger negative gradient on the few steps when it is the target. SGD simply adds these contributions. Coordinate-wise adaptive methods such as Adam, RMSProp, and sign descent instead divide each update by a running estimate of its magnitude, and that estimate is largest immediately after the token appears. This imbalance has two effects. At the level of the whole output layer, we characterize which optimizers preserve the mean output embedding: every method whose update is linear in past gradients does, as do Kronecker-factored and orthogonalized methods such as Shampoo and Muon. Adam, Adafactor, Lion, and sign descent do not, and for these methods we obtain an exact step-by-step expression for the change. At the level of an individual rare token, the same normalization shifts the training fixed point. In the unigram model, sign descent lowers the logit of every token that occurs in fewer than half of the minibatches at a constant expected rate. For RMSProp with periodic arrivals, we can solve the fixed point in closed form: if a token is absent for at least two consecutive minibatches, its equilibrium probability is strictly below its data frequency for every learning rate, and the ratio tends to $κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))$. Here $κ$ is the mean number of steps between occurrences divided by the second-moment time constant $1/(1-β_2)$. In the same model, SGD and AMSGrad retain the unbiased fixed point. We test these predictions both in a unigram model and in a small language model trained from a known generating distribution. With random arrivals, the bias is larger than the periodic formula predicts; in the language model, the optimizers with the biased fixed point also fit the generating distribution less well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 softmax 输出层，稀有 token 大多数步收到小的正梯度、极少数步收到大的负梯度，Adam/RMSProp/sign descent 用运行二阶矩归一化，恰好在 token 刚出现后分母最大，从而系统性压低稀有 token 的 logit。unigram 模型中 sign descent 以恒定速率压低出现率低于半数 minibatch 的所有 token 的 logit；RMSProp 在周期到达下可解出闭式不动点：token 连续缺席至少两个 minibatch 时，其平衡概率对任意学习率都严格低于数据频率，比值趋于 κ/(2(e^{κ/2}−1))。
Motivation: 自适应优化器按梯度幅度归一化，会把稀有事件的稀疏大负梯度与高频小正梯度不对等地处理，导致输出层对低频 token 的概率估计出现系统性偏差。
Method: 在 unigram 模型上分析：先按更新对历史梯度的线性性刻画哪些优化器保持平均输出 embedding（线性方法、Kronecker 分解的 Shampoo、正交化的 Muon 保持；Adam、Adafactor、Lion、sign descent 不保持并给出逐步变化的精确表达式），再对 sign descent 与 RMSProp 求训练不动点；随后在已知生成分布的小语言模型上检验这些预测。
Result: RMSProp 周期到达下不动点闭式解：token 缺席至少两个 minibatch 时平衡概率严格低于数据频率（对任意学习率），比值趋于 κ/(2(e^{κ/2}−1))，κ 为平均出现间隔除以二阶矩时间常数 1/(1−β2)；SGD 与 AMSGrad 保持无偏不动点。随机到达下偏差比周期公式预测的更大；在小语言模型中，不动点有偏的优化器对生成分布的拟合也更差。
Conclusion: 自适应归一化本身移动了稀有 token 的训练不动点，而 SGD、AMSGrad 以及所有对历史梯度线性的优化器（含 Shampoo、Muon）不受此偏差影响；偏差在随机到达下更严重并直接损害分布拟合。

papers.title: DScale: Scaling Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Verification
papers.abstract_en: Growing large language model applications demand efficient inference. At high concurrency, block-diffusion speculative decoding suffers from verification padding, rejected candidates, and incompatibility between variable prefixes and fixed-shape graphs. Uniform truncation sacrifices acceptable tokens. We present DScale, preserving drafter architecture, weights, and full draft length. A separate 112K-parameter predictor requires neither confidence calibration nor hardware speed-curve preparation. Path-aware tiles reduce padding. Dynamic verify-length (DVL) allocation packs scored prefixes into half the native verification capacity. Fixed-address workspaces propagate changing boundaries through verification and acceptance while reusing captured graphs. On A100-40GB with tensor parallelism 1, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B cover four datasets and concurrency 8-32, reusing each target's frozen predictor. Geometric-mean throughput gains across these configurations are respectively 43.9% and 48.8% over DFlash, 22.2% and 37.7% over DSpark, and 24.4% and 32.0% over Domino, with lower request latency. Cumulative ablations show that adding the three mechanisms successively increases geometric-mean throughput, while budget adjustment improves accepted-token retention. GPU profiling shows that complete decode-step time on GSM8K decreases by 30.8-52.5% relative to DFlash
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DScale 针对高并发下 block-diffusion 投机解码的验证 padding、候选被拒与变长前缀不兼容固定形状图三类开销，在不改动 drafter 架构、权重与完整 draft 长度的前提下，用路径感知分块 (path-aware tiles)、动态验证长度分配 (DVL) 与固定地址工作区三个机制逐一消除。在 A100-40GB、TP=1、Qwen3-8B/4B、四个数据集、并发 8–32 上，几何平均吞吐相对 DFlash 提升 43.9%/48.8%，GSM8K 完整 decode-step 时间下降 30.8–52.5%。
Motivation: 高并发服务中 block-diffusion 投机解码受验证 padding、被拒候选与变长前缀同固定形状计算图不兼容拖累；统一截断又会丢掉本可接受的 token，吞吐与请求延迟都受损。
Method: 保留原 drafter 架构、权重与完整 draft 长度，另加一个 112K 参数的预测器，无需置信度校准或硬件速度曲线标定；用 path-aware tiles 减少 padding，DVL 把带分数前缀打包进一半的原生验证容量，固定地址工作区让变化的边界在验证与接受过程中传播并复用已捕获的计算图。
Result: A100-40GB、tensor parallelism 1、并发 8–32、四个数据集上，几何平均吞吐：Qwen3-8B 相对 DFlash +43.9%、DSpark +22.2%、Domino +24.4%；Qwen3-4B 相对 DFlash +48.8%、DSpark +37.7%、Domino +32.0%，且请求延迟更低。累积消融显示三个机制依次加入均继续抬高几何平均吞吐，预算调整提升 accepted-token 保留率；GSM8K 完整 decode-step 时间相对 DFlash 下降 30.8–52.5%。
Conclusion: 三个机制叠加可在不重训 drafter 的前提下同时提高高并发 block-diffusion 投机解码的吞吐并降低延迟，且每个目标模型只需复用一个冻结的 112K 参数预测器。

papers.title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 策略吃的是固定 ISP 出的 RGB，成像管线被排除在学习与评测之外。RawVLA 用流式神经 ISP 自适应渲染 RAW 给冻结的 VLA 策略，并把算力集中在与具身行为相关的成像因素上；在 RawVLA-Bench 上标准条件下保持性能，成像退化时显著提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 固定 ISP 的增益、噪声、色彩响应、色调响应与位深会实质改变动作预测与操作成功率，但这条成像链路既不在学习回路也不在评测回路里，退化采集条件下的具身策略表现无从衡量。
Method: 先沿五个 ISP 维度（gain、sensor noise、chromatic response、tonal response、bit depth）系统考察其对动作预测与操作成功的影响，再据此提出 RawVLA：一个流式神经 ISP，自适应渲染 RAW 观测供冻结的 VLA 策略使用，并把容量集中在与具身行为相关的成像因素上；同时提出 RAW 域操作基准 RawVLA-Bench，把图像处理作为显式评测变量，覆盖 clean 与 adverse 采集条件。
Result: 分析显示 RAW-to-RGB 处理实质影响动作预测与操作成功率，且五个 ISP 维度的作用差异显著；RawVLA-Bench 实验中 RawVLA 在标准条件下保持性能，在成像退化条件下显著提升鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 自适应 RAW 处理可作为物理相机与具身策略之间的有效接口，成像管线应被纳入 VLA 的学习与评测回路。

summary_sections.result: 分析显示 RAW-to-RGB 处理实质影响动作预测与操作成功率，且五个 ISP 维度的作用差异显著；RawVLA-Bench 实验中 RawVLA 在标准条件下保持性能，在成像退化条件下显著提升鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应 RAW 处理可作为物理相机与具身策略之间的有效接口，成像管线应被纳入 VLA 的学习与评测回路。

papers.title: Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a $\textit{Maximum a Posteriori}$ (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subsequently, we apply our method to various ill-posed inverse problems and show that it surpasses convergent methods while competing with state-of-the-art empirical ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种把多噪声水平 denoiser 与专门设计的调度结合的 MAP 估计算法，在合适假设下证明收敛到 Maximum a Posteriori 估计，用于严重不适定的图像反问题。它在保持收敛保证的同时超过已有收敛方法，并与经验上最强的方法竞争。
Motivation: Plug-and-Play 与 RED 用固定噪声水平的一阶优化有收敛保证，但在严重不适定反问题上重建质量不足；基于 flow/diffusion 生成模型的 denoiser 沿递减噪声水平序列取用，经验效果强但收敛理论薄弱，两者之间存在缺口。
Method: 算法把沿递减噪声水平序列取用的 denoiser 与专门设计的调度 (schedule) 结合进一阶优化框架，从贝叶斯视角在合适假设下证明收敛到 MAP 估计，再应用于多种不适定反问题。
Result: 在多种 ill-posed inverse problems 上，该方法超过有收敛保证的方法，同时与 state-of-the-art 的经验方法竞争；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 收敛保证与经验重建质量可以由同一个算法同时达到，前提是把多噪声水平 denoiser 与收敛调度一起设计，而不是二选一。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Physical Muon: Orthogonalization as an Equilibrium Computation
papers.abstract_en: Physical neural networks and analog in-memory computing could reduce the energy cost of neural network training. Realizing this potential, however, requires optimizers that combine effective learning with physical implementability. SGD fits local analog updates but struggles on transformers, while Adam family is unstable against analog bias. Muon offers strong training performance, but its Newton--Schulz orthogonalization relies on dense matrix-matrix products. To address this obstacle, we introduce Physical Muon, which computes the orthogonalization as the equilibrium of a continuous-time flow. Random probes approximate the flow using matrix-vector products, reciprocal reads, and local rank-1 writes. To test whether this replacement preserves training performance, we evaluate it on a 10.95M-parameter transformer. The dense flow's mean validation cross-entropy is 0.0085 above Newton--Schulz across nine seeds per method; the probe implementation is 0.0188 above the control across two seeds. Circuit simulations further reproduce the flow dynamics and yield comparable training behavior.
papers.comment: Accepted at 18th annual workshop on Optimization for Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Physical Muon 把 Muon 优化器的 Newton--Schulz 正交化改写为连续时间流的平衡态，用随机探针以矩阵-向量乘、倒数读出和局部 rank-1 写入近似该流，从而避开稠密矩阵乘、便于模拟/存内计算实现。在 10.95M 参数 transformer 上，稠密流的验证交叉熵均值仅比 Newton--Schulz 高 0.0085（每方法九个种子），探针实现比对照高 0.0188（两个种子），电路仿真复现流动力学并给出可比训练行为。
Motivation: 物理神经网络与模拟存内计算有望降低训练能耗，但缺少既有效又物理可实现的优化器：SGD 适合本地模拟更新却在 transformer 上表现差，Adam 系对模拟偏差不稳定，Muon 的 Newton--Schulz 正交化依赖稠密矩阵-矩阵乘。
Method: 将正交化表示为连续时间流的平衡态 (equilibrium computation)，用随机探针仅通过矩阵-向量乘、倒数读出 (reciprocal reads) 与局部 rank-1 写入逼近该流；在 10.95M 参数 transformer 上与 Newton--Schulz 对照，并做电路仿真复现流动力学。
Result: 稠密流的验证交叉熵均值比 Newton--Schulz 高 0.0085（每方法九个种子）；探针实现比对照高 0.0188（两个种子）；电路仿真复现流动力学并产生可比的训练行为。
Conclusion: 以平衡态流替代稠密正交化可在几乎不损失训练性能的前提下满足物理可实现性，是把 Muon 类优化器搬上模拟硬件的一条可行路径。

papers.title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact language agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. In multi-turn tasks, compounding errors can move students beyond the teacher's effective supervision. We introduce Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD), which enriches an off-the-shelf teacher's scoring context with execution evidence. A graph indexes repeated teacher executions by shared states while preserving complete successful and failed histories. After each student episode, GC-OPD retrieves current-state references or historical alternatives and combines them with student hindsight to score the original thought-action tokens. Using the same original teachers, GC-OPD improves mean success over vanilla OPD from 24.70% to 48.78% on ScienceWorld (4B student), from 53.36% to 85.26% on ALFWorld Unseen, and from 29.10% to 37.65% on WebShop. At matched student sizes, it also achieves higher mean success than every evaluated OPD baseline using GRPO-trained teachers on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld; the strongest such ScienceWorld 4B baseline reaches 46.66%. GC-OPD requires no task-specific teacher optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GC-OPD 用一张按共享状态索引教师执行记录的图，把执行证据补进 off-the-shelf 教师的打分上下文，再结合学生 hindsight 对原始 thought-action token 打分，缓解多轮任务中复合误差把学生带出教师有效监督区的问题。在相同原始教师下，ScienceWorld 4B 平均成功率从 24.70% 升到 48.78%，ALFWorld Unseen 从 53.36% 升到 85.26%，WebShop 从 29.10% 升到 37.65%。
Motivation: 多轮任务里学生的复合误差会逐步偏离教师能有效监督的轨迹区域，vanilla on-policy distillation (OPD) 的教师打分因此失真，紧凑语言 agent 学不动。
Method: GC-OPD 建一张图，按共享状态索引重复的教师执行并保留完整成功与失败历史；每个学生 episode 结束后，检索当前状态参考或历史替代方案，与学生 hindsight 一起拼进教师打分上下文，对原始 thought-action token 打分，全程复用 off-the-shelf 教师、不做任务特定的教师优化。
Result: 同一原始教师下平均成功率：ScienceWorld（4B student）24.70% → 48.78%，ALFWorld Unseen 53.36% → 85.26%，WebShop 29.10% → 37.65%。在相同学生规模下，ScienceWorld 与 ALFWorld 上均高于所有用 GRPO-trained teachers 的 OPD 基线，其中 ScienceWorld 4B 最强基线为 46.66%。
Conclusion: 把执行证据按状态组织成可检索的图，能让 off-the-shelf 教师在多轮任务上给出仍有效的 token 级监督，无需任何任务特定的教师优化。

papers.title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Video-based policy learning is particularly promising, as it illustrates target behaviors without requiring action annotations or embodiment-matched demonstrations. A central challenge is deciding what information should be transferred from the video to the robot. Existing approaches commonly convert visual observations into scalar similarity or value signals, or ask foundation models to directly generate reward code. These approaches can make the temporal structure of a task difficult to inspect, ground, and reuse. We present Video2STL, a framework that converts observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and uses the resulting formal representation for robot learning. A vision-language model extracts an embodiment-independent semantic event trace and constructs a bank of symbolic temporal specifications. The model determines the task structure, while numerical predicate thresholds and temporal bounds are grounded from successful robot trajectories. For policy learning, we separate short- and long-timescale temporal information: short-horizon specifications provide dense rewards through rolling-window quantitative robustness, while a causal monitor over a retained long-horizon specification provides one-time progress rewards for valid temporal prefixes. The same representation supports cross-embodiment transfer from human or animal videos to robot control. Across four manipulation tasks, Video2STL achieves $85.8\%$ average success-once and $67.0\%$ success-at-end, compared with $81.5\%/59.5\%$ for native dense PPO and $65.0\%/42.3\%$ for Text2Reward; in quadruped locomotion, Qwen-3.8 and GPT-5.6-based Video2STL policies achieve $100\%$ success across velocities from $0.3$ to $2.1\,\mathrm{m/s}$ while remaining competitive in high-speed energy efficiency. Project webpage: \href{https://video2stl.github.io/}{video2stl}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video2STL 把仅含观测的视频转成参数化 Signal Temporal Logic (STL) 规格：VLM 抽取与具身无关的语义事件轨迹并生成符号时序规格库，任务结构由模型决定，谓词阈值与时序边界从成功机器人轨迹上数值落地。四个操作任务上平均 success-once 85.8%、success-at-end 67.0%，高于 dense PPO 的 81.5%/59.5% 与 Text2Reward 的 65.0%/42.3%；四足运动中基于 Qwen-3.8 与 GPT-5.6 的策略在 0.3–2.1 m/s 全速度段达 100% 成功率。
Motivation: 现有视频到策略的方法把视觉观测压成标量相似度/价值信号或让基础模型直接生成 reward 代码，任务的时序结构难以检查、落地与复用；且缺少从视频到机器人该迁移什么信息的准则。
Method: VLM 从观测视频抽取具身无关的语义事件轨迹并构建符号时序规格库，模型决定任务结构，数值谓词阈值与时间界由成功机器人轨迹回归落地。策略学习分长短时程：短时程规格经 rolling-window quantitative robustness 提供稠密奖励，对保留的长时程规格用 causal monitor 对合法时序前缀给一次性进度奖励；同一表示支持从人或动物视频到机器人的跨具身迁移。
Result: 四个操作任务上 Video2STL 平均 success-once 85.8%、success-at-end 67.0%，对比 native dense PPO 81.5%/59.5%、Text2Reward 65.0%/42.3%。四足运动中 Qwen-3.8 与 GPT-5.6 驱动的 Video2STL 策略在 0.3 至 2.1 m/s 各速度下成功率 100%，高速段能效仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 把视频转成可检查、可复用的 STL 形式表示，再用短时程稠密鲁棒度奖励加长时程因果前缀奖励，能在操作与四足任务上同时优于标量 reward 与 LLM 直接生成 reward 代码的路线，并天然支持跨具身迁移。

papers.title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRIMEBench 是面向视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 基准的分层压缩框架，四阶段依次剔除无需看图即可作答与全对样本、按能力类别选代表基准、用 Vision-Aware Variance (VAW) 剪题、再按类别数量剪枝。在留出模型上，5% 保留率时平均保真度最高，整套流程去掉 97% 以上题目仍保持模型排名。
Motivation: VLM 基准覆盖面越来越广、新模型不断涌现，完整评测成本已难以承受；语言模型的基准压缩方法对 VLM 尚未充分研究。
Method: 四阶段分层框架：数据清洗（去掉无图可答与全对题）、类别代表选择（每个能力类别选一个基准）、基于 Vision-Aware Variance 的题目剪枝（结合模型间方差与仅由多模态嵌入算出的视觉依赖分数，并鼓励题目多样性）、类别数量剪枝；层级结构允许按算力预算在任意阶段停止。
Result: 在参与选题之外的留出模型上，5% 保留率时该方法平均保真度最高；发布套件去掉超过 97% 的题目并保持模型排名。

papers.title: From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using feedback from a stronger teacher. Teacher interventions can improve these trajectories, but also change the distribution on which the student learns. Our controlled studies show that rollout quality alone is an incomplete criterion for allocating teacher guidance. Deeper intervention yields diminishing gains in rollout accuracy while increasing off-policy load. In a training probe with a restricted rollout horizon, peak student accuracy and performance retention favor different intervention strengths. The preferred intervention depth and placement also vary across benchmarks. These findings motivate MAESTRO, which uses local policy disagreement to jointly adapt when the teacher takes over and how long it generates. Its {policy disagreement score} combines teacher-weighted candidate coverage with local distribution similarity and is aggregated within reasoning paragraphs. Across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MAESTRO achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among the compared methods for both 0.6B and 1.7B Qwen3 students, with the 1.7B student leading on every benchmark. MAESTRO also reduces average training response length by 67.3\% relative to standard OPD. The code is available at https://github.com/yhao-wang/MAESTRO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAESTRO 用局部策略分歧分数 (policy disagreement score) 联合决定教师何时接管接管与接管多长，在 on-policy distillation 中自适应调度教师干预深度与位置。在八个数学推理 benchmark 上，0.6B 与 1.7B Qwen3 学生均取得对比方法中最高的 macro-average accuracy，1.7B 在每个 benchmark 上领先，平均训练响应长度比标准 OPD 缩短 67.3%。
Motivation: 教师干预能改善学生自身 rollout，却同时把学习分布推离 on-policy；只按 rollout 质量分配教师指导是不完整的判据，更深干预带来递减的准确率增益却抬高 off-policy 负担。
Method: MAESTRO 的 policy disagreement score 把教师加权候选覆盖度与局部分布相似度组合，并在推理段落 (reasoning paragraphs) 内聚合，据此联合自适应地选择教师接管时机与生成长度；作者先用受限 rollout horizon 的 training probe 与受控研究确定干预强度、深度与位置的作用。
Result: 受控研究显示更深干预使 rollout accuracy 增益递减而 off-policy load 上升；受限 horizon 的 probe 中，峰值学生准确率与性能保持率偏好不同的干预强度，且最优干预深度与位置随 benchmark 变化。八个数学推理 benchmark 上 MAESTRO 的 macro-average accuracy 在对比方法中最高（0.6B 与 1.7B Qwen3 学生皆是），1.7B 在每个 benchmark 领先；平均训练响应长度较标准 OPD 减少 67.3%。
Conclusion: 教师干预应按局部策略分歧而非 rollout 质量单独调度时机与长度，这样能在多个数学推理 benchmark 上同时拿到最高 macro 平均准确率并把训练响应长度压到标准 OPD 的三分之一左右。

papers.title: ScaGNN: a Graph Neural Network for Multiple Scattering Simulations
papers.abstract_en: The boundary element method (BEM) provides an efficient numerical framework for solving multiple scattering problems in unbounded homogeneous domains. By restricting the discretization to the domain boundaries, it substantially reduces computational complexity. The procedure first consists in determining the solution trace on the boundaries of the domain by solving a boundary integral equation. Then, the volumetric solution can be recovered at low computational cost using a boundary integral representation. As the first step of the BEM represents the main computational bottleneck, we present ScaGNN, a learning-based approach designed to approximate the solution trace. It relies on a graph neural network architecture that incorporates a dynamic adaptive edge sampling mechanism for selecting the most relevant interactions to model. Guided by intermediate predictions of expected error and edge length, this mechanism selects, at various stages of the forward pass, the most relevant distant interactions to model. The proposed method is tailored to achieve linear complexity with the number of nodes in the input graph. To train and evaluate our network, we present a benchmark consisting of several datasets with different types of multiple scattering problems. Our experiments show that our approach surpasses existing state-of-the-art learning-based methods on the considered tasks and investigate the generalization capabilities to settings with an increased number of obstacles and out-of-distribution obstacle shapes. github.com/LARIAD/ScaGNN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScaGNN 用图神经网络近似边界元法 (BEM) 中的边界解迹 (solution trace)，核心是动态自适应边采样：由前向过程中间预测的期望误差与边长，在多个阶段挑选最相关的远距离交互来建模，使复杂度相对节点数为线性。在作者提出的多类散射问题基准上，该方法在所考虑任务上超过现有基于学习的 SOTA，并能泛化到障碍物数量增多与分布外 (OOD) 形状的设置。
Motivation: BEM 求解无界均匀域中的多重散射时，第一步解边界积分方程得到解迹是主要计算瓶颈；直接离散求解代价高，需要一个能保持线性复杂度的学习式替代。
Method: 以 GNN 架构近似边界解迹，加入动态自适应边采样机制：前向传播各阶段用中间预测的期望误差和边长决定建模哪些远距离交互，目标是让计算量随输入图节点数线性增长；训练与评估用作者构建的多类多重散射问题数据集基准。
Result: 在所考虑的多重散射任务上超过现有基于学习的 state-of-the-art 方法，并在障碍物数量增加与 out-of-distribution 障碍形状的设置上检验了泛化能力；方法设计目标为相对节点数线性复杂度。
Conclusion: 用误差与边长引导的自适应交互采样，GNN 可以在保持线性复杂度的前提下逼近 BEM 解迹并跨障碍配置泛化；配套代码与基准见 github.com/LARIAD/ScaGNN。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把截至 2026 年 6 月的监督式因果发现 (supervised causal discovery) 方法按预测目标、粒度、编码器、结构解码器与训练机制分类，指出模拟器既提供监督也携带关于因果图、机制与噪声的假设。机制与噪声的限制能让原本歧义的因果方向变得可识别，但限制下的预测精度并不等于限制改变后仍能迁移；作者据此主张评测要让指标对应可识别的图目标，并检验训练与部署之间图、机制、噪声的变化。
Motivation: 监督式因果发现的训练对来自模拟器，观测数据本身可能与多个因果图相容，因此预测里混入了模拟器假设，而现有方法比较没有区分可识别性与分布外泛化这两个问题。
Method: 以预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器、训练机制五个维度组织代表性方法，把问题拆成目标在给定模型类下是否可识别、以及训练后的预测器是否越出训练分布两问；并提出匹配可识别图目标的指标与跨图/机制/噪声变化的评测设计，扩展到真实数据时还需记录基准参考图的外部因果证据与不确定性。
Result: 给出一项分析性结论：机制与噪声限制可使原本歧义的因果方向可识别，但在这些限制下的预测精度不能证明限制改变后仍可迁移；评测框架覆盖截至 2026 年 6 月可获得的代表性方法。
Conclusion: 因果发现的可识别性与迁移能力必须分开检验，方法比较应按可识别目标配指标并显式测试假设变化，同时开放问题集中在迁移、测试时自适应与不确定性评估。

papers.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MERA 把长期记忆问答拆成全局可检索记忆与问题专属证据状态两部分，用已验证证据引导后续检索但不锁死全局记忆，并以强化学习训练 0.6B 轻量 planner，奖励能找回此前缺失证据的查询。在 Qwen3-30B 上该 0.6B planner 在 LoCoMo 达 77.40%、LongMemEval-S 达 71.29%，比未经检索接地训练的 30B planner 分别高 4.10% 和 3.96%；LoCoMo 上多轮检索把累计证据召回从 55.5% 提到 80.5%。
Motivation: 长期记忆问答中，回答所需证据散落在相距很远的对话轮次，而问题本身缺少定位线索，一次性检索难以命中。
Method: MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation) 将全局可检索记忆与问题专属证据状态分离，已验证证据用于引导后续检索且不限制对全局记忆的访问；用强化学习训练轻量 planner，奖励能找回此前缺失证据的查询，证据处理与答案生成由 Qwen3-30B 或 GPT-4o-mini 承担。
Result: Qwen3-30B 上训练后的 0.6B planner 在 LoCoMo 取得 77.40% 准确率、LongMemEval-S 取得 71.29%，分别超出未经检索接地训练的 30B planner 4.10% 和 3.96%；LoCoMo 上后续检索轮次使累计证据召回由 55.5% 升至 80.5%。
Conclusion: 让检索决策以已找到的证据为条件，并用奖励找回缺失证据的方式训练小 planner，能在长期记忆问答上超过大得多的未接地 planner。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman Autoencoder for probabilistic time series forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Neural Koopman autoencoder models have been shown to successfully build a latent embedding with linear dynamics for arbitrary dynamical systems, enabling strong performance in long-term time series forecasting. However, these models usually work in a deterministic setting, which does not allow the quantification of the uncertainty of their predictions. Thus, we propose the new Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman AutoEncoder (VAIKAE), in which the latent embedding follows a Gaussian distribution instead of being deterministic. A key property of the VAIKAE architecture is that it leverages normalizing flow models, enabling the use of likelihood computations in the state space of dynamical systems for training a model. We further propose new strategies for uncertainty-aware latent data assimilation with a trained VAIKAE model. The effectiveness of our methods is demonstrated in a series of experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks.
