papers.title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Looped reasoning models repeatedly apply a shared set of parameters, enabling more computation without increasing the model size. These models also support input-dependent computation by dynamically deciding when to stop looping. Motivated by the recent success of looped transformers in language modeling and reasoning, we investigate whether dynamic looping can similarly benefit sequential decision-making. We provide a complexity-theoretic motivation for this approach by showing that there exist Markov decision processes in which a state-adaptive policy achieves the optimal return with asymptotically less expected computation than any optimal fixed-runtime policy. To learn compute-adaptive policies in practice, we introduce Looped Actor, a transformer-based policy that repeatedly refines a latent representation toward a fixed point using a shared computational block. This allows the model to allocate computation adaptively by varying the number of loops based on the current state. We evaluate Looped Actor on 22 tasks across six environments, ranging from combinatorial puzzles to robotic manipulation and spanning online and offline reinforcement learning (RL) with discrete and continuous actions. Looped Actor matches or exceeds the performance of an untied baseline with 16$\times$ more parameters, with the largest gains in environments where action selection requires substantial multistep planning. For the Boxoban environment, we find that the computation allocation is structured: the number of loops increases with the number of remaining pushes and future optimal pushes become increasingly predictable from the latent state over successive loops. Together, these results highlight actor looping as a simple and efficient way to equip RL agents with adaptive computation and improve their planning capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/camail-official/LoopedActor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Looped Actor 用共享计算块反复把隐表示迭代到不动点，按状态自适应决定循环次数，从而在不增加参数的前提下给 RL 策略加计算量。在 6 个环境 22 个任务（组合谜题、机器人操作、在线/离线 RL、离散与连续动作）上，它匹配或超过参数多 16 倍的 untied 基线，增益最大的是需要多步规划的任务；Boxoban 上循环次数随剩余推动数增加，且后续最优推动从隐状态越来越可预测。
Motivation: looped transformer 在语言建模与推理中已证明可按输入动态分配计算，但序贯决策（RL）中是否同样受益缺少依据；作者先给出复杂性理论动机：存在一类 MDP，状态自适应策略以渐近更少的期望计算达到最优回报，优于任何固定运行时的最优策略。
Method: 提出 Looped Actor：基于 transformer 的策略用共享计算块反复精化隐表示至不动点，循环次数随当前状态变化，实现 compute-adaptive 策略；在组合谜题到机器人操作的 6 个环境、22 个任务上评估，覆盖在线与离线 RL、离散与连续动作。
Result: 在 22 个任务上匹配或超过参数量 16 倍的 untied 基线，最大增益出现在需要大量多步规划的环境；Boxoban 中循环次数随剩余推动数上升，且未来最优推动从隐状态在逐次循环中变得越来越可预测。
Conclusion: actor looping 是给 RL 智能体加自适应计算并提升规划能力的简单高效手段，其计算分配在需要多步规划的任务上呈现结构化增长。

papers.title: LazySloth: Bounded LLM-based Lazy Tree Search for Fast Long Video Comprehension
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising results in long-video understanding due to the rich semantic information they can capture. However, most methods focus on coarse captioning of extracted image frames that are computationally inefficient and require models with large context windows. While past work has explored efficient methods through multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), they rely on lossy embeddings that lose temporal context and fine-grained detail. Few works to date have investigated how VLM-based query-relevant information retrieval can be optimized. We introduce LazySloth, an efficient tree-based search method that speeds up video comprehension and retrieval tasks 2.9-8.3x (compared to existing agentic methods) through bounded captioning of portions of the video considered irrelevant by a VLM of the video. Compared to contemporary specialized video-understanding VLMs and RAG-based methods, LazySloth achieved similar or better final task accuracy across two recent open-source base VLMs--Gemma 4 31B and Qwen3.6 27B--across four benchmarks. LazySloth reduced the gap between the base open-source model and a closed-source model, GPT-4o. Ablations showed that replacing VLM scene understanding with CLIP-based retrieval cost 8.8-19.9% in accuracy, while lazy tree construction matches eager construction at a fraction of the captioning cost. With LazySloth, we demonstrate the possibility of faster long-video comprehension without substantial loss in performance.
papers.comment: Under review at conference. Preprints allowed when under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LazySloth 用 VLM 判断视频片段是否与查询无关，对无关部分做有界 (bounded) 粗粒度标注，从而在树搜索中跳过大量无关内容。相比现有 agentic 方法，长视频理解与检索任务加速 2.9–8.3 倍，同时在四个 benchmark 上达到与专用视频 VLM 和 RAG 方法相当或更好的准确率。
Motivation: 现有长视频理解依赖对全部帧做粗粒度标注，计算开销大且要求长上下文窗口；多模态 RAG 虽高效但用有损 embedding，丢失时序上下文与细粒度细节，且 VLM 的查询相关检索很少被优化。
Method: 提出基于树的惰性搜索：由 VLM 判定哪些视频部分与查询无关，只对相关部分做精细标注、对无关部分做有界标注 (bounded captioning)，惰性构建树而非一次性 eager 构建；在 Gemma 4 31B 与 Qwen3.6 27B 两个开源基座 VLM 上评测，并与 CLIP 检索做消融对比。
Result: 相比现有 agentic 方法加速 2.9–8.3 倍；在四个 benchmark 上与专用视频理解 VLM 及 RAG 方法相比达到相当或更好的最终任务准确率；缩小了开源基座模型与 GPT-4o 的差距；消融中把 VLM 场景理解换成 CLIP 检索导致准确率下降 8.8–19.9%，惰性树构建以远低于 eager 构建的标注成本达到与之匹配的效果。
Conclusion: 长视频理解可以在不大幅损失性能的前提下显著提速，关键是对查询无关片段做有界标注并惰性建树；场景理解必须由 VLM 完成，换成 CLIP 检索会付出 8.8–19.9% 的准确率代价。

papers.title: A stochastic subgradient method with optimal failure exponent
papers.abstract_en: Fix a target accuracy $\varepsilon$, a gradient-noise level $s$, and a horizon $N$. We wish to design algorithms which minimize the probability of observing a suboptimality gap which exceeds the target accuracy, i.e., $\mathcal{E}_N = -\log \sup_{f,P} \mathbb{P}_P(f(x_A) - f_\star \ge \varepsilon)$, with the noise law $P$ known only to be sub-Gaussian. We single out a uniformly averaged schedule which is harmonic (of the form $h_k = R^2/(\varepsilon (N+m-k))$) and prove, via an optimized exponential supermartingale argument, that it attains the optimal exponent $\mathcal{E}_N^\star = \varepsilon^2 N (1+o(1))/(2R^2 s^2)$. Optimality is certified by a matching impossibility result: under Gaussian noise, a gradient-masking change of measure caps the exponent of every algorithm at the same leading order. In a small-noise limit, our setting degenerates into the adversarial-error model of Gösgens and van Parys (2025) for subgradient methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在梯度噪声仅知为 sub-Gaussian 的最坏情形下，把随机次梯度法的失败指数定义为 E_N = -log sup_{f,P} P(f(x_A)-f_* ≥ ε)，并证明调和步长的均匀平均调度 h_k = R²/(ε(N+m-k)) 达到最优指数 ε²N(1+o(1))/(2R²s²)。该最优性由高斯噪声下基于 gradient-masking 换测度的不可能性结果匹配认证，小噪声极限退化为 Gösgens 和 van Parys (2025) 的对抗误差模型。
Motivation: 固定精度 ε、噪声水平 s 与步数 N 时，需要在噪声分布仅知 sub-Gaussian 的条件下最小化观测到超过 ε 的次优间隙的概率，即最大化失败指数；此前缺少对随机次梯度法该指数的最优刻画。
Method: 针对形如 h_k = R²/(ε(N+m-k)) 的调和均匀平均步长调度，用优化的指数超鞅 (exponential supermartingale) 论证证明其失败指数上界；再在高斯噪声下用 gradient-masking 换测度 (change of measure) 给出匹配的不可能性结果，封顶任意算法的指数。
Result: 调和均匀平均调度达到最优失败指数 E_N* = ε²N(1+o(1))/(2R²s²)；高斯噪声下换测度论证把每个算法的指数封顶在同一主阶，构成匹配的不可能性结果；小噪声极限退化为 Gösgens 和 van Parys (2025) 的对抗误差模型。
Conclusion: 在 sub-Gaussian 噪声的最坏情形风险下，调和步长的均匀平均随机次梯度法在失败指数意义上是阶最优的，且该最优性在高斯噪声下不可改进。

papers.title: Simultaneous Neural Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for learning transformations between probability distributions from unpaired samples. In many applications, however, a single transformation must map several source distributions to a common target distribution. For example, image restoration might require handling different types of degradation without knowing the degradation of each input at inference time. Simple approaches of pooling the source distributions only encourage alignment with the target at the aggregate level and may leave individual sources misaligned. In our paper, we consider the simultaneous OT problem which formalizes the task of learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We propose a neural method for solving the simultaneous OT problem by learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We derive a max-min formulation for learning this map. We illustrate its application to image restoration, where a single model handles multiple degradation types using a common collection of clean target images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 simultaneous Optimal Transport：一个共享 transport map 同时把多个源分布各自对齐到同一目标分布，而非只在混合后的总体层面匹配。推导出 max-min 形式的神经求解方法，并在图像复原上说明单一模型可在推理时不知退化类型的情况下处理多种退化。
Motivation: 多个源分布映到同一目标时，简单把源混合再做 OT 只保证总体对齐，单个源仍可能错配；而图像复原等任务在推理时并不知道输入属于哪种退化。
Method: 形式化 simultaneous OT 问题：学习共享 transport map，最小化平均 transport cost 同时让每个源分布各自对齐到指定目标；由此推导 max-min 优化形式并用神经网络求解，应用示例为用一组干净目标图像处理多种退化类型。
Result: 给出 simultaneous OT 的问题形式化与对应的 max-min 学习公式，并以图像复原为例展示单一模型处理多种退化类型、共用同一干净目标图像集合。
Conclusion: 共享 map 加逐源对齐约束（而非源混合）才是多源到单目标变换的正确表述，max-min 形式可用于神经求解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scale Sensitivity in Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization: Curvature of the Quantization Error Landscape
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods in the GPTQ family minimize a layer-wise reconstruction error on a uniform grid whose scale must be chosen; the common max-based choice degrades sharply at low bit-widths. We study how sensitive this objective is to the scale. For a layer with i.i.d. Gaussian weights and calibration activations of sufficiently large effective rank, we prove that, as the width grows, the normalized round-to-nearest loss converges with high probability, uniformly over all scales, to the mean-squared error of a uniform quantizer applied to a standard Gaussian; we verify the effective-rank condition for wide, randomly initialized MLPs with odd Lipschitz activations and isotropic Gaussian calibration data. The limiting objective has a unique nondegenerate minimizer, whose scale decreases strictly with the number of levels and whose curvature with respect to relative scale errors decays approximately exponentially with the bit-width. GPTQ experiments on five LLMs show the same trend: the scale rule changes perplexity substantially at 2--3 bits and negligibly from 6 bits on, and a local measure of GPTQ scale sensitivity decreases with bit-width in line with the Gaussian curvature. The Gaussian-optimal scale fails on raw weights; after Hadamard incoherence processing it matches the best searched rule at 3 bits and above without any search, but remains clearly worse at 2 bits.

TL;DR: 研究 GPTQ 类低比特 PTQ 中量化网格 scale 的敏感性：证明在 i.i.d. 高斯权重与高有效秩校准激活下，宽度增大时归一化 round-to-nearest 损失一致收敛到均匀量化器作用于标准高斯的 MSE，其唯一极小点的曲率随 bit-width 近似指数衰减。GPTQ 在五个 LLM 上验证同一趋势：scale 规则在 2–3 bits 显著改变 perplexity、6 bits 起可忽略；经 Hadamard incoherence 处理后高斯最优 scale 在 3 bits 及以上免搜索即匹配最佳搜索规则，但 2 bits 仍明显更差。
Motivation: GPTQ 家族 PTQ 需要在均匀网格上选定 scale，常用的 max-based 选择在低 bit-width 下急剧退化，而该目标对 scale 的敏感度此前缺少刻画。

papers.title: Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting for Consistent Long-Form Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains a critical challenge, where a major bottleneck lies in conditioning independently generated shots to preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the full combination of required elements for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms recent-frame, memory-based, and entity-level retrieval baselines in cross-shot consistency and text-controllability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的互补检索增强提示框架 (Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting)：把剧本解析成跟踪角色、物体、场景及其镜头级状态的文本视觉元素注册表，由 agent 检索互补历史参考以最大化目标元素覆盖、最小化历史噪声，再与元素状态和 grounding 指令拼成统一提示喂给冻结的视频生成器。在多镜头故事生成的定量与定性评测中，跨镜头一致性与文本可控性均稳定优于 recent-frame、memory-based 与 entity-level 检索基线。
Motivation: 长视频生成的主要瓶颈是各镜头独立生成导致角色、场景、物体不一致；现有免训练方法用检索到的历史画面做条件，但参考常出现信息错配——要么引入无关冗余，要么凑不齐目标镜头所需的全部元素。
Method: 框架免重训、不改底层生成器：先把叙事剧本解析为 text-grounded visual element registry，逐镜头跟踪 characters、objects、scenes 及其状态；VLM 标注的 keyframe library 把这些元素映射到历史视觉观测；agent 据所需元素检索互补参考（最大化目标元素覆盖、最小化历史噪声），最后把参考、结构化元素状态与 grounding 指令组装成统一提示输入冻结的视频生成器。
Result: 在多镜头故事生成的定量与定性评测中，该方法在跨镜头一致性 (cross-shot consistency) 与文本可控性 (text-controllability) 上一致优于 recent-frame、memory-based 和 entity-level 三类检索基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按元素覆盖而非时间邻近来选历史参考，可以在不重训生成器的前提下同时改善长视频的跨镜头一致性与文本可控性，且整个元素感知过程保持可解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Complexity-Aware Evaluation of LLM Comprehension
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software engineering tasks that require understanding existing source code, including behavior prediction, function explanation, debugging, and code review. However, aggregate benchmark accuracy can conceal how model reliability changes as source code becomes structurally more complex. This paper presents a complexity-aware framework for evaluating LLM code comprehension using cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume. We evaluate DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and Llama through two complementary tasks: automatic input-output prediction over 300 Python functions and manually assessed semantic comprehension over a balanced subset of 60 functions. The functions are grouped into Low-, Medium-, and High-complexity bands. DeepSeek-Coder-V2 achieves an overall automatic accuracy of 78.33%, compared with 70.33% for Llama. However, accuracy decreases substantially from Low to High complexity, from 93.52% to 52.78% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 87.04% to 47.22% for Llama. Incorrect predictions are consistently associated with higher values of all four complexity metrics, and correlation and logistic-regression analyses confirm broadly comparable negative associations between structural complexity and correctness. Manual semantic comprehension shows the same degradation pattern, with accuracy decreasing from 100.00% to 75.00% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 90.00% to 60.00% for Llama. These findings demonstrate that complexity-aware evaluation provides a more diagnostic assessment of LLM code-comprehension reliability than aggregate accuracy alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出按代码结构复杂度分层评估 LLM 代码理解的框架，用圈复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和 Halstead 体积把 300 个 Python 函数分成 Low/Medium/High 三档。DeepSeek-Coder-V2 总体自动准确率 78.33%（Llama 70.33%），但从 Low 到 High 由 93.52% 跌到 52.78%（Llama 87.04% 到 47.22%）；错误预测与四项复杂度指标一致正相关。
Motivation: 总体 benchmark 准确率会掩盖模型可靠性随源码结构复杂度上升而下降的规律，无法定位 LLM 在代码理解上何时失效。
Method: 以圈复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子、Halstead 体积刻画复杂度并分三档；两项任务互补：300 个 Python 函数的自动输入输出预测，以及 60 个均衡子集函数的人工语义理解评估，配合相关分析与 logistic 回归检验复杂度与正确性的关系。
Result: 自动预测总体准确率 DeepSeek-Coder-V2 78.33% vs Llama 70.33%；随复杂度从 Low 到 High，DeepSeek-Coder-V2 由 93.52% 降至 52.78%，Llama 由 87.04% 降至 47.22%。人工语义理解同样退化：DeepSeek-Coder-V2 100.00% 降至 75.00%，Llama 90.00% 降至 60.00%。错误预测与四项复杂度指标均更高，相关分析与 logistic 回归确认复杂度与正确性呈大体相当的负相关。
Conclusion: 按复杂度分层的评估比单一总体准确率更能诊断 LLM 代码理解可靠性：两个模型在高复杂度代码上的准确率都接近腰斩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. We evaluate routing by jointly accounting for supervision expenditure and subsequent serving-time savings. Across four routing benchmarks, the main setting uses only about 33--41% of available training feedback while maintaining competitive or better routing quality, and reduces the break-even deployment volume by approximately 1.9--9.5 times compared with the fastest conventional router. Further analysis shows that acquiring more supervision is not always economically preferable: the supervision level that minimizes serving cost can differ from the one that achieves the earliest payback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/SaveRouter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SaveRouter 用稀疏监督学 LLM 路由：只选择性采集信息量高的 query-model 质量反馈，并在相关 query 间共享能力信息，同时保留 query 级细化。主设置只用约 33–41% 的可用训练反馈即保持有竞争力或更好的路由质量，并把回本部署量相比最快的传统路由器降低约 1.9–9.5 倍。分析进一步显示，最小化服务成本的监督水平与最早回本的监督水平可以不同。
Motivation: 学习路由器需在历史 query 上跑多个候选模型收集质量反馈，部署前就产生可观监督成本；现有工作只看服务时效率，不问省下的钱能否覆盖这笔前期支出，而路由质量往往在收齐全部反馈前就饱和。
Method: 提出稀疏监督路由框架 SaveRouter：选择性获取信息量高的模型反馈，在相关 query 之间共享能力信息，并保留 query 级细化做细粒度路由；评估时把监督支出与后续服务时节省合并记账，用回本部署量衡量经济性。
Result: 在四个路由基准上，主设置仅使用约 33–41% 的可用训练反馈，路由质量保持有竞争力或更好；相比最快的常规路由器，回本部署量 (break-even deployment volume) 降低约 1.9–9.5 倍。进一步分析显示，多买监督并不总是更经济：使服务成本最小的监督水平与最早回本的监督水平可以不同。
Conclusion: 密集监督在经济上被过度配置，稀疏采集反馈即可在保住路由质量的同时显著缩短回本距离；且最优监督量取决于目标是最小化服务成本还是最早回本。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: BeatDance: Generating Beat-Consistent 3D Dance with Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets.
papers.journal_ref: Pattern Recognition, Volume 180, 114344 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BeatDance 是一个从音乐生成 3D 舞蹈的扩散框架，用分层解耦注意力 (HDA) 分别建模人体姿态与时间动态并覆盖短长期依赖，再用循环一致学习引入辅助的 dance-to-music 模块，以重建音乐与原始音乐的差异作为更强的损失信号。在两个 benchmark 数据集上超过近期竞争方法，改善舞蹈与音乐节拍 (beat) 的对齐精度。
Motivation: 现有方法能生成物理上合理的舞蹈动作，但难以与音乐节拍精确对齐，同时还要表达人体运动的空间复杂性。
Method: 扩散式框架含两部分：Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) 先解耦姿态与时间动态的学习，再用分层结构捕捉短期与长期依赖；循环一致学习 (cycle-consistent learning) 增加一个辅助 dance-to-music 模块，用重建音乐与原始音乐的差异产生损失信号，约束音乐与舞蹈动作的一致性。
Result: 在两个 benchmark 数据集上的实验结果超过近期竞争方法；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 分层时空建模加循环一致约束能提升音乐到 3D 舞蹈生成中与节拍对齐的精度，优于所比较的近期方法。

papers.title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.
papers.comment: World Action Model; post-deployment training; dexterous manipulation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEWO 在部署后学习中不只模仿动作，还用视觉经验修正 World-Action Model 的世界表征：识别交互转折点、从成功与失败未来学习以支持 classifier-free guidance，并用价值头从视频表征估计任务进度、在进度停滞时激活 guidance。在五个 DexJoCo 任务上三种 WAM 配方的平均成功率均提升；Wuji 与 Sharpa 上四个真机任务的 3×3 网格评测中，两轮部署学习使初始至少有一次成功的格子成功率从 51.0% 升到 71.7%，提高 20.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 灵巧操作中高维动作空间里的小执行误差会累积，把交互推到世界模型训练分布之外；现有部署后学习范式只改进动作而不改进世界预测，无法抑制这种分布外漂移。
Method: DEWO 在动作模仿之外用视觉经验微调世界表征：识别交互 turning points，从成功与失败的未来轨迹学习以支撑 classifier-free guidance；另加一个价值头，从视频表征估计任务进度，在推理期进度停滞时才激活 guidance。
Result: 五个 DexJoCo 任务上，DEWO 提升全部三种 WAM 配方的平均成功率；消融显示来自成功与失败续接的视觉监督在预测与控制两方面都优于仅动作监督。Wuji 与 Sharpa 四个真机任务的 3×3 网格评测中，两轮部署学习把初始至少有一次成功的格子的成功率从 51.0% 提到 71.7%，即 +20.7 个百分点。
Conclusion: 部署经验中的持续预测学习能反过来改进控制，世界建模应成为 WAM 适配的活跃组成部分，而不只是动作模仿的附属。

papers.title: Learning Macroscopic Dynamics without Reconstructing Microscopic States
papers.abstract_en: Modeling the temporal evolution of macroscopic properties of complex systems is an important scientific task. To predict this evolution without full microscopic simulation, a common approach encodes microstates into compact latent states, learns their evolution, and reads out macroscopic predictions from the latent trajectory. These latent states are often learned through microstate reconstruction. However, with limited latent capacity, reconstruction can favor high-variance microscopic details over information needed for macroscopic prediction. Yet jointly learning latent states and their transition without reconstruction often fails to obtain latent dynamics that support accurate macroscopic prediction. We show that this failure can arise from latent scale collapse: shrinking the latent state scale reduces training loss while macroscopic evolution error remains large. Here, we propose a reconstruction-free framework to learn latent states with their dynamics for prescribed macroscopic prediction. Training alternates between updating the latent representation with the transition and next-state latent targets fixed, and updating the transition with the latent representation fixed. At inference, the trained model predicts macroscopic states recursively from an initial microstate. Our theoretical analysis characterizes reconstruction misalignment and scale collapse under joint training, and gives a sufficient condition for local convergence to correct latent dynamics for our method. Experiments on epidemic spreading on a lattice, mixing of two particle species, and polymer stretching demonstrate that the proposed method achieves substantially better macroscopic prediction over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在受限 latent 容量下，微状态重建会把容量花在高方差细节上，而联合学习又会陷入 latent scale collapse（缩小 latent 尺度即可降低训练损失，宏观演化误差却仍大）。作者提出免重建的交替训练框架：固定 transition 与 next-state latent target 更新表示，再固定表示更新 transition，推理时从初始微状态递归预测宏观量。在格点疫情传播、双粒子混合与聚合物拉伸三个实验上，宏观预测显著优于基线。
Motivation: 用紧凑 latent 预测复杂系统宏观演化时，重建目标与宏观预测信息不对齐，而不带重建的联合训练又常得到无法支撑准确宏观预测的 latent 动力学。
Method: 免重建框架交替训练：一步固定 transition 与 next-state latent target 来更新 latent 表示，另一步固定表示来更新 transition；推理时从初始微状态递归预测宏观状态。理论部分刻画联合训练下的重建错位与 scale collapse，并给出该方法局部收敛到正确 latent 动力学的充分条件。
Result: 在格点疫情传播 (epidemic spreading on a lattice)、双粒子物种混合 (mixing of two particle species) 与聚合物拉伸 (polymer stretching) 三组实验中，所提方法的宏观预测显著优于基线；理论刻画了联合训练下缩小 latent 尺度可降低训练损失而宏观演化误差仍大的 scale collapse 现象。
Conclusion: 宏观预测的 latent 动力学要靠交替固定两侧变量来学，绕开微状态重建；联合训练的失败可归因于 latent scale collapse，并有局部收敛的充分条件支撑。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Rethinking Soft Tokens for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel generation by predicting and committing multiple tokens at each denoising step, yet they can generate individually plausible but mutually inconsistent tokens. Recent work shows that \emph{soft tokens} can mitigate this issue by representing uncertain positions with continuous embeddings built from the model's predictive distribution at the previous decoding step. However, although soft tokens are commonly understood as preserving predictive uncertainty, how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding has not been systematically examined. In this paper, we investigate this question in frozen pretrained DLMs to examine soft-token feedback without the effects of additional training. To construct soft-token inputs in a training-free setting, we identify a geometric mismatch between conventional soft-token construction and the pretrained embedding space. Based on this observation, we propose a training-free, geometry-aware construction of soft tokens. Our analysis of soft-token feedback suggests that uncertainty preservation alone does not fully explain how it reshapes subsequent predictions. To better explain how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding, we provide empirical evidence that it favors coherent token sequences. Across four pretrained DLMs and four math and code benchmarks, our method outperforms standard parallel decoding and a training-free Euclidean soft-token baseline. Code: https://github.com/kodaikawamura/rethinking-soft-tokens
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的扩散语言模型 (DLM) 中，指出常规 soft token 构造与预训练嵌入空间存在几何错位 (geometric mismatch)，提出训练无关、几何感知的 soft token 构造。在四个预训练 DLM 与四个数学、代码基准上，该方法优于标准并行解码和一个 training-free 的欧氏 soft token 基线；分析表明仅靠不确定性保留不足以解释 soft token 反馈的作用，其真正机制是偏好连贯的 token 序列。
Motivation: DLM 每步并行提交多个 token 时会生成各自合理但彼此不一致的序列；soft token 被认为靠保留预测不确定性缓解该问题，但其改善并行解码的机制此前未被系统检验，且常规构造方式与预训练嵌入空间不匹配。
Method: 在冻结的预训练 DLM 上做 training-free 实验以隔离 soft token 反馈本身；先识别常规 soft token 构造与预训练嵌入空间的几何错位，再据此提出几何感知的 soft token 构造；分析上对比“仅不确定性保留”解释与“偏好连贯 token 序列”的经验证据。
Result: 在四个预训练 DLM、四个数学与代码基准上，所提方法在并行解码表现上超过标准并行解码以及一个 training-free 的欧氏 soft token 基线；分析给出经验证据表明 soft token 反馈偏好连贯 token 序列，仅不确定性保留不足以解释其收益。
Conclusion: soft token 反馈改善并行解码的关键不只是保留预测不确定性，还包括让后续预测偏向连贯序列；要拿到这份收益，构造 soft token 时需对齐预训练嵌入空间的几何，且无需额外训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-task learning for the automatic grading of enlarged perivascular space burden using MRI
papers.abstract_en: Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale - a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences. We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. We comparatively evaluated a conditional convolutional neural network (CNN) which accepts PVS masks as an extra input channel, a multi-task CNN which performs both PVS segmentation and scoring, and a logistic regression model which utilises features derived from PVS masks to predict PVS scores. Multi-task learning was the most effective method, achieving a mean average precision of 64.08% compared to 60.22% for the conditional CNN, 52.11% for a baseline CNN trained only to predict PVS scores, and 49.32% for the logistic regression model. The multi-task model showed an ability to localise individual PVS not shown by the other CNNs, and behaved in a probabilistically sensible way, predicting with lower confidence on inherently harder classes. Age, sex, hypertension status, white matter hyperintensity volume, and ischaemic stroke lesion status were shown to be associated with the multi-task model's PVS score predictions and the ground truth in a similar way.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用半自动生成的“银标准”PVS 分割掩膜辅助训练 MRI 上扩大的血管周围间隙 (PVS) 自动分级模型，多任务 CNN（同时做分割与评分）的 mAP 达 64.08%，高于条件 CNN 60.22%、仅评分的基线 CNN 52.11% 和逻辑回归 49.32%。多任务模型还能定位单个 PVS，并在固有困难类别上给出更低置信度。
Motivation: 放射科医生按 Potters/Wardlaw 量表目测评分脑区 PVS 负荷，耗时且受观察者间差异影响，自动化可加速大规模分析。
Method: 在基底节 (BG) 与半卵圆中心 (CSO) 上，用不完美的半自动 PVS 分割掩膜加放射学评分共同训练；对比三种方案：接受掩膜作为额外输入通道的条件 CNN、同时做分割与评分的多任务 CNN、以及基于掩膜特征的逻辑回归。
Result: 多任务 CNN mAP 64.08%，条件 CNN 60.22%，仅预测评分的基线 CNN 52.11%，逻辑回归 49.32%；多任务模型可定位单个 PVS（其他 CNN 不能），对更难类别预测置信度更低；其预测分数与年龄、性别、高血压状态、白质高信号体积、缺血性卒中病灶状态的关联方式与 ground truth 相似。
Conclusion: 把不完美的银标准分割掩膜以多任务形式引入训练，比条件输入或纯评分更有效，且预测行为在统计上合理、可与临床变量对上。

papers.title: Anatomy-Aware Prediction of Bronchoscopic Accessibility from 3D CT
papers.abstract_en: Pre-operative planning for bronchoscopy is critical for the diagnosis of lung lesions. Current accessibility assessment relies on subjective manual inspection of CT scans, which is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. In this paper, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a novel supervised learning task and present the first end-to-end framework to address it. We propose an Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that integrates specialized modules: a CT Expert for local morphological features, a Lobe Expert for anatomical priors, and a Path Geometry Expert that encodes the sequential constraints of the bronchial tree. To support this task, we curated the first clinical dataset of 438 cases with pre-operative CT scans and documented procedural outcomes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.8052, significantly outperforming both state-of-the-art baselines and experienced human experts. This work establishes a new benchmark for computer-aided interventional planning in pulmonary medicine. Our data and code will be publicly available at https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把支气管镜可达性预测形式化为首个端到端监督学习任务，用 Anatomy-Aware MoE 融合 CT 局部形态、肺叶解剖先验与支气管树路径几何三个专家。在自建的 438 例术前 CT 与操作结局数据集上 AUROC 达 0.8052，超过现有最优基线与有经验的人类专家。
Motivation: 术前支气管镜可达性目前靠医生主观读 CT 判断，耗时且存在明显的观察者间差异，缺少可量化的客观评估任务与基准。
Method: 提出 Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts 模型，含三个专门模块：CT Expert 提取局部形态特征，Lobe Expert 引入肺叶解剖先验，Path Geometry Expert 编码支气管树的序贯路径约束，端到端联合训练做可达性二分类。

papers.title: MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling. After pretraining on drug-like molecules with multiple conformers, MoTIF-X achieved the lowest mean absolute error on all nine OpenADMET ExpansionRx endpoints and the best overall performance among the evaluated methods. Significance analyses supported its advantage in the vast majority of endpoint-baseline comparisons after multiple-testing correction. Ablation studies supported the complementary contributions of motif-token contextualization, multimodal integration, and two-stage pretraining. Beyond molecular properties, the framework extended to drug-target interaction prediction, achieving the best average classification performance across the evaluated benchmarks and generalizing to an external drug-cold-start dataset without additional fine-tuning. Its motif-centered design also enabled substructure-level interpretation: higher motif attribution scores were associated with larger experimentally measured activity shifts. Together, these findings support MoTIF-X as a transferable and interpretable framework for molecular modeling.
papers.comment: 5 figures. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file. Code: https://github.com/Bin-Chen-Lab/Motif-X
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoTIF-X 以图上的化学 motif 作为多模态共享锚点，把图、SMILES、3D 构象在 token 级别对齐而非后期拼接，在 OpenADMET ExpansionRx 全部 9 个端点上取得最低 MAE，并在药物-靶点交互预测上取得所评测基准的最佳平均分类性能，且 motif 归因分数越高对应实测活性位移越大。
Motivation: 现有分子多模态方法把图、SMILES、3D 构象各自独立编码、只在后期对齐，细粒度跨模态交互和亚结构级可解释性受限。
Method: 两阶段预训练：第一阶段在原子、motif、分子三个尺度上做层次对比学习得到 motif 表示；第二阶段用 SMILES 与 torsion-angle token 做多模态掩码 token 建模将其上下文化，训练数据为带多个构象的类药分子。
Result: 在 OpenADMET ExpansionRx 全部 9 个端点上取得最低 mean absolute error，整体表现在所评测方法中最佳；经多重检验校正后，绝大多数端点-基线比较的显著性分析支持其优势；消融支持 motif-token 上下文化、多模态整合与两阶段预训练的各自贡献；药物-靶点交互预测在所评测基准上平均分类性能最佳，并在外部 drug-cold-start 数据集上无需额外微调即可泛化；motivation 归因分数越高与实测活性位移越大相关。
Conclusion: 以 motif 为中心的 token 级多模态整合可同时带来跨任务可迁移的分子建模性能与亚结构级可解释性。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Simulation-Based Inference in Latent Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Neural simulation-based inference (SBI) has been widely successful in inferring a relatively small number of interpretable parameters from potentially high-dimensional observations, such as images or time series. Accordingly, representation learning in SBI has focused almost exclusively on compressing the observations used to condition the posterior. More recently, however, SBI has begun to target increasingly high-dimensional parameter spaces, raising the complementary question of whether the inference target itself should be compressed. Our answer is a practical merger of SBI and latent generative modeling, which learns a low-dimensional representation of the simulator parameters, performs posterior inference directly in this latent space, and maps posterior samples back to the original parameter space. We characterize the conditions under which latent-space inference recovers the desired target posterior and systematically study its empirical trade-offs. Across four case studies and three generative families, we compare latent and standard estimators while controlling for network capacity, regularization, optimization, and training compute. At matched training compute, latent-space inference achieves accuracy and marginal calibration comparable to direct target-space inference while sampling up to more than an order of magnitude faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SBI 与潜空间生成模型合并：先学一个低维的模拟器参数表示，在该潜空间内直接做后验推断，再把后验样本映射回原参数空间。在四个案例研究、三种生成模型族并控制网络容量、正则化、优化与训练算力的对比中，潜空间推断的精度与边缘校准 (marginal calibration) 与直接在目标空间推断相当，采样速度提升可达一个数量级以上。
Motivation: SBI 已能从图像、时间序列等高维观测推断少量可解释参数，表征学习一直集中在压缩条件后验的观测上；如今 SBI 面向的参数空间本身越来越高维，需要回答是否也应压缩推断目标。
Method: 提出 SBI 与潜空间生成建模的实用合并：学习模拟器参数的低维表示，在该潜空间内做后验推断，再将样本映射回原参数空间；并刻画潜空间推断能恢复目标后验的条件。实验在四个案例研究、三种生成模型族上比较潜空间与标准估计器，控制网络容量、正则化、优化与训练算力。
Result: 在匹配训练算力下，潜空间推断的精度与边缘校准和直接目标空间推断相当，采样速度最高提升一个数量级以上；比较覆盖四个案例研究与三种生成模型族。
Conclusion: 当满足所刻画的条件时，压缩推断目标本身（参数潜空间）可以在不损失精度与校准的前提下大幅加速高维参数的 SBI 采样。

papers.title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers provide a parameter-efficient approach to depth scaling by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks. Recent reasoning models have likewise highlighted the value of scaling test-time computation through longer computation trajectories. However, the principles for designing effective loop transitions remain poorly understood. We view the looped hidden state as a fast weight that is updated throughout the depth. We formulate loop transitions as local gradient-based updates, with recurrent blocks predicting implicit targets at each depth. Our framework derives loop transitions in closed form from a projection, a local objective and an optimizer update rule. Mapping representative loop transitions into this framework reveals mismatches between their transitions and projections. We first align the input maps of existing transitions. We then derive OperLoop, which combines explicit weight decay, adaptive step size and a delta objective. The aligned variants reduce training loss and improve average commonsense accuracy. OperLoop improves average generative performance over the compared looped and non-looped baselines under matched training FLOPs. These results support the framework's usefulness for loop design. We extend the analysis to additional loop models and outline a roadmap for future loop transition design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 looped Transformer 的循环转移统一写成由投影、局部目标与优化器更新规则闭式导出的局部梯度更新，据此对齐现有转移的输入映射，并提出含显式 weight decay、自适应步长与 delta 目标的 OperLoop。对齐变体降低训练损失并提高平均常识准确率；在匹配训练 FLOPs 下 OperLoop 的平均生成性能超过所比较的 looped 与非 looped 基线。
Motivation: Looped Transformer 用共享块重复实现深度扩展，但循环转移的设计原则不清楚；已有转移与其隐含投影之间存在不匹配，缺少统一的推导框架。
Method: 把循环隐状态视为随深度更新的 fast weight，将循环转移表述为局部梯度更新，其中循环块在每个深度预测隐式目标；框架从投影、局部目标与优化器更新规则闭式导出转移，先对齐现有转移的输入映射，再据此推导 OperLoop（显式 weight decay + 自适应步长 + delta 目标）。
Result: 对齐变体降低训练损失并提高平均常识准确率；在匹配训练 FLOPs 下 OperLoop 的平均生成性能优于所比较的 looped 与非 looped 基线；框架还被扩展到更多 loop 模型。
Conclusion: 循环转移可以按统一的投影—局部目标—优化器框架设计，对齐转移与投影能带来训练损失与常识准确率的改善，该框架可作为后续 loop 转移设计的路线图。

papers.title: Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Do-JEPA 把因果干预从「遮住模型看到什么」改成「遮住世界发生什么」：从同一份模拟器状态分别跑动作 a 与参考动作 a_∅，训练模型预测两个 latent 未来的差 Δz。在合成系统中 support 监督以 99.95% 找到被直接干预的物体（稀疏动作掩码把动作送进 nuisance slot 则为 100%），response-onset 监督恢复环形传播图 edge AUROC 0.975 vs 0.624；从像素训练时 effect loss 使 LeWM 的 latent effect error 降 28.4%、自然动作序列上的 physical effect error 降 13.5%，三个 CausalWorld 基准上 physics shift 下 responsive effect error 约降 20%、预测效应的 latent context sensitivity 降 66%。从零训练会损失 factual accuracy，改为微调已有模型则消除这一代价。
Motivation: latent world model 的预测目标只学「接下来发生什么」，无法区分动作造成的与仅仅与动作同时出现的事件；C-JEPA 一类物体遮挡模型只干预预测器能看到什么，而非物理上发生了什么。
Method: 从一份保存的 simulator state 出发，分别在动作 a 与参考动作 a_∅ 下推进动力学，训练模型预测 latent 差 Δz = z^a − z^{a_∅}，即 Do-JEPA 目标；目标由 effect loss、support loss（动作进入处）、propagation loss（效应传播处）与 invariance losses（不应改变处）组成，另有 support supervision 与 response-onset supervision 两种监督信号，可从 pixels 端到端训练 LeWM 模型。
Result: 合成系统中 support supervision 在 99.95% 测试用例找到被直接干预的物体，而稀疏动作 mask 在每个用例都把动作送到 nuisance slot；response-onset supervision 恢复环形传播图，edge AUROC 0.975 对 0.624。从 pixels 训练时 effect loss 相对同数据的对照训练，把 end-to-end LeWM 的 latent effect error 降低 28.4%，在自然动作序列上训练与测试时 physical effect error 降低 13.5%；在三个独立生成的 CausalWorld 基准上，physics shift 下 responsive effect error 约降低 20%，预测效应的 latent context sensitivity 降低 66%。从零训练会损失 factual accuracy，微调已有模型则消除该代价。
Conclusion: 干预世界本身而非模型输入，能让 latent world model 预测动作真正造成的结果；代价是 scratch 训练掉 factual accuracy，因此作者主张用 Do-JEPA 微调既有模型。

papers.title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. Functional alignment with the teacher varies across supports and target tasks; in continuation pairs, teacher-aligned prediction changes can coexist with weak parameter alignment. Continued OPD on effective supports can restore performance after unfavorable transfer. Finally, targeted selection does not consistently outperform uniform random sampling, and filtering out a source that performs poorly alone yields no consistent gain across three paired support draws. Overall, our results distinguish prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability and show that effective data choice depends on the teacher-student pair and target capability, with random sampling providing a competitive baseline in the studied settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中 prompt 数量、来源与选择对师生对迁移的影响：4 条 DAPO prompt 即可匹配 3,840 条 DeepMath prompt 的观测数学分数，但 prompt 效用是关系性的——只换 teacher 就能让数学与代码 prompt 的相对优劣反转。定向筛选并不稳定优于均匀随机采样，作者据此区分 prompt 效率与 prompt 可互换性。
Motivation: OPD 用 teacher 对学生自采样回答的反馈来训练，但 prompt 如何选择才能在不同师生对之间有效迁移缺乏系统认识，选数据的代价与收益不清楚。
Method: 在 RL- 与 SFT-continuation 配对及跨模型设置下，系统考察 prompt 数量、来源与选择策略；并跨 prompt 支撑集与模型对分析参数变化与功能变化（functional alignment），比较定向选择与均匀随机采样。
Result: 4 条 DAPO prompt 匹配 3,840 条 DeepMath prompt 的观测数学分数；只改 teacher 即可反转数学与代码 prompt 的相对效果；continuation 对中 teacher 对齐的预测变化可与弱参数对齐并存；在有效支撑集上继续 OPD 可在不利迁移后恢复性能；定向选择未稳定优于随机采样，剔除单独表现差的来源在三组配对支撑抽样中无一致增益。
Conclusion: prompt 效率不等于可互换性：有效数据选择取决于师生对与目标任务，在所研究设置中随机采样即是有竞争力的基线。

papers.title: MG-Thinker: Bi-Axial Self-Reflection for Multi-Image Reasoning Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently delivered substantial gains in multimodal reasoning, opening a promising route for fine-grained visual perception. Yet for multi-image reasoning grounding (MRG), reasoning over real-world multi-image contexts toward pixel-precise localization, existing RL-based approaches overlook two characteristics intrinsic to this paradigm: a coarse-to-fine hierarchical reasoning pattern, and heterogeneously distributed task--sample difficulties. In this work, we present MG-Thinker, a post-training RL framework that advances a new MRG paradigm featuring such hierarchical reasoning, supported by a curated 25K MRG dataset with task-adaptive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotations that elicit multi-perspective evidence before conclusion. To remedy the heterogeneous task--sample difficulties, we further propose Bi-Axial DAPO (BiA-DAPO), which decomposes rollout advantages along an intra-group signal axis and an inter-group competence axis through two complementary mechanisms, both grounded on our defined candidate pool for stable group-level statistics. Extensive experiments show that MG-Thinker achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-image reasoning grounding while consistently improving generalization across multi-image understanding and diverse multimodal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MG-Thinker 是面向多图推理定位 (multi-image reasoning grounding, MRG) 的后训练 RL 框架：用 25K 带任务自适应 CoT 标注的 MRG 数据集激发由粗到细的层级推理，再用 Bi-Axial DAPO (BiA-DAPO) 沿组内信号轴与组间能力轴分解 rollout 优势。在多图推理定位上达到 SOTA，并在多图理解与多模态基准上持续提升泛化。
Motivation: 现有基于 RL 的 MRG 方法忽略了该范式的两个内在特性：由粗到细的层级推理模式，以及任务—样本难度的异质分布，导致像素级定位的推理与训练信号都不匹配。
Method: 构建 25K MRG 数据集，配任务自适应 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 标注，要求在结论前给出多视角证据；提出 BiA-DAPO，把 rollout 优势沿组内信号轴与组间能力轴两个互补机制分解，组级统计建立在其定义的 candidate pool 上以保持稳定。
Result: 在多图推理定位上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并在多图理解与多样的多模态基准上持续改善泛化；数据集规模为 25K MRG 样本。
Conclusion: 把层级推理结构与异质难度同时纳入 RL 后训练（CoT 数据 + 双轴优势分解），是提升 MRG 定位与跨多模态基准泛化的有效路径。

papers.title: Think Before You Score: Thinking Reward Model for Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Visual reward models are essential for evaluating and improving visual generation models, yet existing approaches typically map task conditions and candidate outputs directly to scalar rewards, leaving implicit what should be evaluated for each individual case. We introduce Think Before You Score, a paradigm that explicitly determines what matters for each case before judging how well the candidate performs. Following this principle, we propose the Thinking Reward Model (TRM), which formulates case-adaptive rubrics, performs rubric-guided assessment, and produces fine-grained pointwise rewards. We further observe that conventional pairwise preference optimization can induce score polarization, and introduce Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization (PD-GRPO), which leverages pairwise supervision to improve reward discrimination while preserving fine-grained pointwise scoring. Extensive experiments on image generation and editing reward-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that TRM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source reward models while remaining highly competitive with proprietary alternatives. Moreover, using TRM as a reward for reinforcement learning consistently improves diverse visual generation models, demonstrating that its fine-grained, case-adaptive rewards translate into effective optimization signals for visual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Thinking Reward Model (TRM)：先为每个样本自适应生成评估 rubric，再按 rubric 做细粒度 pointwise 打分，而不是把条件与候选图直接映射成一个标量。配套提出 PD-GRPO 用成对监督提升奖励区分度并抑制成对偏好优化导致的分数极化；在图像生成与编辑奖励建模基准上达到开源奖励模型 SOTA，并作为 RL 奖励稳定提升多种视觉生成模型。
Motivation: 现有视觉奖励模型把任务条件与候选输出直接映射为标量奖励，每个样本究竟该评估什么被隐式略过，导致奖励信号粗糙、区分度不足。
Method: TRM 分三步：为每个 case 生成自适应 rubric、按 rubric 引导逐项评估、输出细粒度 pointwise 奖励；PD-GRPO 利用成对监督改进奖励区分度，同时保留 pointwise 打分，用于对抗常规成对偏好优化引发的 score polarization。
Result: 在图像生成与编辑的奖励建模基准上，TRM 取得开源奖励模型中的 state-of-the-art 表现，并与专有奖励模型保持高度竞争；以 TRM 作为强化学习奖励时，多种视觉生成模型得到一致提升。
Conclusion: 先决定评什么再打分，配合成对监督的 PD-GRPO，能把细粒度、case-adaptive 的奖励转化为有效的视觉生成优化信号。

papers.title: Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 adaptation compilation：把模型该在哪、如何、多大程度上适配变成联合预测与决策问题，编译器从历史适配经验学出候选更新程序的反事实响应面（acquisition、transfer、boundedness、preservation 四维），在适配开始前选程序。在五类学习任务上，Llama-3.1-8B 中编译器所选程序逼近穷举搜索并超过全局与按目标的默认程序；Gemma-2-9B 复现保留了程序异质性与选择空间，但利用该空间需在偏离强默认值时建模不确定性。
Motivation: 模型适配通常套用固定 recipe，而不同更新程序会带来差异很大的行为结果；逐次为每个学习 episode 重新搜索程序代价高。
Method: 把 where/how/to what extent 的适配决策形式化为联合预测与决策问题：编译器从既往适配中学习候选程序的向量化反事实响应面，预测其对 acquisition、transfer、boundedness、preservation 的预期影响，并在适配前选程序；该几何刻画多维行为后果而非单一标量分数，可在不同下游优先级下复用而无需重训。
Result: 跨五类学习类型，偏好程序在 episode 间差异显著且可由适配前信息预测；在 Llama-3.1-8B 上编译器所选程序接近穷举搜索，并优于全局默认与按目标默认；在 Gemma-2-9B 上复现保留了程序异质性与选择空间，但要吃到这一空间需在偏离强默认值时考虑不确定性。
Conclusion: 适配搜索可以在相关学习问题间摊销（amortized），把既往适配经验变成决定未来如何学习的依据；而在强默认值附近做选择时必须把预测不确定性算进去。

papers.title: Backdoor Mitigation in Decentralized LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized large language model (LLM) fine-tuning lets organizations collaboratively train a shared LLM on data they cannot pool, without a central coordinator. In every round, each node exchanges a trainable adapter with its neighbors over a communication graph, and then aggregates them. This setting, however, is vulnerable to propagated backdoors, which is a hidden behavior that lets a model perform normally on clean inputs but produce an attacker-chosen output whenever a secret trigger appears. We show that a single node poisoning its own model can backdoor adapters of nodes that have never seen a poisoned example, making them refuse prompts that contain a secret trigger. We present Chorus, a decentralized mechanism that lets each node detect and reject backdoored adapters from its neighbors before aggregation, without requiring shared validation data or any knowledge of the attacker's trigger or target. Chorus judges each adapter by its behavior, using the receiver's own adapter as a trusted reference. Crucially, no node in Chorus judges adapters alone: the receivers of each adapter update probe it independently, pool their findings in the neighborhood, and vote to make a decision. So a backdoor that slips past one receiver is still caught by the others. We evaluate the effectiveness of Chorus using two instruction-tuning datasets and LLM architectures, and against a state-of-the-art baseline. Chorus cuts the average attack success rate (ASR) of the attacker's neighbors from 48-63% to at most 2.2%, within 0.6 percentage points of an omniscient oracle that knows the exact malicious nodes. Even the worst-affected honest node never exceeds 10% ASR, the same bound as the oracle, against up to 78% without defense. This all comes at a negligible communication overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Chorus：去中心化 LLM 微调中，各节点在聚合前用自身 adapter 作可信参照、按行为检测并投票拒绝邻居的后门 adapter，无需共享验证数据或已知触发器。攻击者邻居的平均 ASR 从 48–63% 降到至多 2.2%，通信开销可忽略。
Motivation: 去中心化微调中单个节点投毒自己的模型，就能让从未见过毒样本的节点 adapter 被传染后门，触发时输出攻击者指定内容；现有做法缺少共享验证数据或触发器知识时难以拦截。
Method: Chorus 让每个 adapter 的接收者各自用自己 adapter 作参照探测其行为，在邻域内汇总探测结果并投票决定是否拒绝该 adapter，聚合前完成过滤，不依赖中心协调者、共享验证数据或对触发器/目标的先验知识。
Result: 在两个 instruction-tuning 数据集与 LLM 架构、对比 state-of-the-art 基线的评测中：攻击者邻居的平均 ASR 从 48–63% 降至至多 2.2%，与知晓恶意节点的 omniscient oracle 相差 0.6 个百分点；最受影响的诚实节点 ASR 不超过 10%（与 oracle 同界），无防御时可达 78%；通信开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 基于行为的邻域投票能在不共享数据、不掌握触发器的前提下阻断去中心化微调中的后门传播，把 ASR 压到接近全局知情 oracle 的水平。

papers.title: Pretrain Once, Route Anywhere: Towards a Foundation Model for LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. Through episodic pretraining across heterogeneous routing environments, this capability can be reused by a frozen router and adapted to new environments through context alone. Experiments demonstrate transfer across changes in domains, modalities, candidate pools, and context budgets, with the largest gains when behavioral evidence is limited. On MMR-Bench, which is excluded from pretraining, RouteFM outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.23 quality points with only eight observations per candidate. These results support moving LLM routing from repeated local fitting toward a pretrain once, route anywhere paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/RouteFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RouteFM 把 LLM 路由做成基础模型式能力：从行为上下文刻画匿名候选模型并推断其针对当前任务的能力，经跨异构路由环境的 episodic 预训练后，冻结路由器仅靠 context 即可适配新环境。在未参与预训练的 MMR-Bench 上，每个候选仅 8 条观测时比最强基线高 2.23 个质量点，且在行为证据受限时增益最大。
Motivation: 现有 LLM router 都是局部拟合：绑定特定 query workload 与候选池，环境一变就要额外监督或重训，无法复用。
Method: RouteFM 不绑定固定模型身份，而是从行为上下文 (behavioral context) 刻画匿名候选模型、推断 target-specific 能力；通过跨异构路由环境的 episodic 预训练学习该能力，推理时冻结路由器、仅靠 context 适配新环境。
Result: 在排除出预训练的 MMR-Bench 上，每候选仅 8 条观测时 RouteFM 比最强基线高 2.23 个质量点；迁移覆盖 domain、modality、候选池与 context budget 的变化，行为证据有限时增益最大。
Conclusion: LLM 路由应从反复局部拟合转向 pretrain once, route anywhere：可复用的路由能力靠 context 即可跨环境迁移，代码已开源。

papers.title: Visual Anomaly Synthesis for Model Selection in Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Defect detection systems for industrial condition monitoring can only be relied upon if they are validated, yet defective samples are rare and, for a specific asset, often nonexistent. We present a framework that synthesizes severity-graded defects on real non-defective images without any defect references for the target asset, that can be used for model selection and validation. A defect taxonomy for common failure modes is distilled from literature into prescriptive prompts at varying defect severities. Regions of interest are cropped from in defect-free images and edited with a pre-trained image generation model ("FLUX.2 [klein]"). Color-matching and blending are employed to improve structural coherence with the original image. Generations are filtered out by a scorer and by estimated detection difficulty. Model selection experiments on MVTecAD show image AUROC choice regret over model selection can be nearly halved compared to the best fixed model chosen with access to test data. Experiments show the need for severity-graded anomaly synthesis. A case study investigates the proposed method for in-situ monitoring of Pelton turbine runners in hydropower, where real defect images are rare and expensive to collect. A PatchCorebased anomaly detection model is fit on Pelton turbine images and selected and validated using synthetic images, showing strong detection performance (94 % correct detection at optimal threshold and AUROC 0.97). The model reliably detects moderate and advanced defects, while early-stage defects remain challenging, indicating the synthetic data meaningfully stresses detector sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在目标资产完全没有缺陷样本的条件下，用预训练图像生成模型 FLUX.2 [klein] 在无缺陷图上合成按严重度分级的缺陷，供工业异常检测模型做选择与验证。MVTecAD 上模型选择的 image AUROC choice regret 相比用测试数据选出的最优固定模型几乎减半；水电 Pelton 转轮案例中 PatchCore 在最优阈值下正确检出 94%、AUROC 0.97，中后期缺陷可靠、早期缺陷仍困难。
Motivation: 工业状态监测的缺陷检测系统必须先被验证才能信任，但特定资产的缺陷样本极稀少甚至不存在，导致模型选择与验证无据可依。
Method: 从文献蒸馏出常见失效模式的缺陷分类体系，转成不同严重度的指令式 prompt；从无缺陷图裁出 ROI 并用 FLUX.2 [klein] 编辑，配合 color-matching 与 blending 保持结构一致；再用打分器和估计的检测难度过滤生成结果，用于模型选择与验证。
Result: MVTecAD 上模型选择的 image AUROC choice regret 相比可访问测试数据选出的最优固定模型几乎减半；实验显示需要按严重度分级的异常合成。Pelton 转轮案例中，用合成图选择并验证的 PatchCore 模型在最优阈值下 94% 正确检出、AUROC 0.97，中后期缺陷可靠、早期缺陷仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 无需目标资产真实缺陷即可用严重度分级的合成异常完成模型选择与验证，合成数据能实质压测检测器灵敏度，但早期缺陷检测仍是短板。

papers.title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them, and the frozen programs outperform the strongest prior agentic system run with the same language model (96.3% against 89.3%). On RoboDojo tasks whose instructions leave the goal unstated, no program succeeds without demonstrations. ENCORE also runs on a real bimanual robot, learning cube handover and cup inversion from five demonstrations each.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ENCORE 把少量演示当作可读证据而非训练数据：确定性 builder 将每条演示蒸馏成多视角关键帧、夹爪事件、帧条带与完整轨迹包，coding agent 据此写策略程序并在封盲评测前冻结。在 LIBERO-PRO 上首个程序即在有演示时成功一半扰动任务、无演示时仅一个任务，冻结程序以 96.3% 对 89.3% 超过同语言模型的最强既有 agentic 系统；真实双臂机器人各用五条演示学会方块交接与杯子翻转。
Motivation: 机器人任务常只给一句话，缺少抓取方式、接触顺序与目标外观，agent 只能靠试错摸索；而演示通常被当作训练数据，浪费了其作为可推理证据的价值。
Method: 确定性 builder 把每条演示蒸馏成 multi-view keyframes、gripper events、frame strips 与完整轨迹的证据包；coding agent 阅读该包，针对固定的感知与动作 API 编写策略程序，在少量 development rollouts 上迭代改进，随后在不泄露成功信号的 sealed evaluation 中冻结评测。
Result: LIBERO-PRO 上，有演示时 agent 的首个程序即成功一半扰动任务，无演示时仅成功一个任务；冻结程序以 96.3% 对 89.3% 超过同语言模型的最强既有 agentic 系统。RoboDojo 中指令未说明目标的任务在无演示时没有任何程序成功；真实双臂机器人各用五条演示学会 cube handover 与 cup inversion。
Conclusion: 把演示当证据读而非当数据训，能让 coding agent 在少样本下写出可冻结、可封盲评测的操作策略；但指令未给出目标的任务没有演示就无解。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Teaching LLMs to Generate Challenging MILP Instances via Solver Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Generating optimization instances that are both feasible and computationally challenging is crucial for benchmarking solvers and training learning-based optimization algorithms. Existing non-LLM generators rely on seed instances or parameter tuning, resulting in high test-time computational cost, while existing LLM generators lack explicit hardness measures. Recent reinforcement learning methods with verifier feedback evaluate only binary correctness, which is misaligned with generating challenging problems. We note that an optimization solver reports the cost of solving at several stages of its pipeline, and leverage this to design a reward that scores both the solvability and the hardness of generated problems, measured by branch-and-bound nodes and post-cut relaxation gaps. Our key idea is a challenger-solver asymmetric self-play approach, where an LLM challenger generates progressively harder instances and the solver verifies feasibility and hardness, so no seed or training MILP instances are required. We fine-tune Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3.5-4B with GRPO and a size curriculum into OptiScribe-12B and OptiScribe-4B, which generate feasible yet challenging MILP problems from natural language instructions. On capacitated facility location and max-cut, OptiScribe-12B raises median SCIP search nodes by 1.7-5x and post-cut gaps by 1.1-1.7x over its base model and improves the feasibility rate on facility location by 9-19 points, while OptiScribe-4B raises median nodes by up to 15.6x. The problems cover a wider difficulty range than public benchmarks of the same size, follow instructions on density and difficulty, and can tune solver settings for families that public libraries lack. These results indicate that optimization-specific rewards, used in self-play mode, can teach LLMs to generate high-difficulty optimization benchmarks. We will release our code and models publicly on acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用求解器流水线各阶段的代价信号构造奖励，通过挑战者-求解器非对称自博弈让 LLM 生成既可行又难解的 MILP 实例，无需种子或训练实例。GRPO 微调得到的 OptiSolve-12B 在设施选址与 max-cut 上把 SCIP 中位搜索节点数提高 1.7–5 倍、post-cut gap 提高 1.1–1.7 倍，设施选址可行率提升 9–19 个百分点；OptiSolve-4B 节点数最高提升 15.6 倍。
Motivation: 非 LLM 生成器依赖种子实例或参数调优、测试期计算开销高；现有 LLM 生成器缺少显式硬度度量，而近期带验证器反馈的强化学习只奖励二元正确性，与生成有挑战性问题的目标错位。
Method: 利用求解器在流水线多个阶段报告的代价，设计同时衡量可解性与硬度的奖励（branch-and-bound 节点数、post-cut relaxation gap）；采用 challenger-solver 非对称自博弈，LLM 挑战者逐步生成更难实例、求解器验证可行性与硬度，不需种子或训练 MILP 实例。用 GRPO 加 size curriculum 微调 Gemma-4-12B 与 Qwen3.5-4B，得到 OptiSolve-12B 与 OptiSolve-4B，从自然语言指令生成实例。
Result: 在 capacitated facility location 与 max-cut 上，OptiSolve-12B 相对基座模型把 SCIP 中位搜索节点数提高 1.7–5 倍、post-cut gap 提高 1.1–1.7 倍，设施选址可行率提升 9–19 个百分点；OptiSolve-4B 中位节点数最高提升 15.6 倍。生成问题的难度范围比同规模公开基准更宽，能遵循密度与难度指令，并可为公开库缺失的实例族调参求解器设置。
Conclusion: 优化专用奖励配合自博弈模式可以教会 LLM 生成高难度优化基准；代码与模型计划在接收后公开。

summary_sections.result: 在 capacitated facility location 与 max-cut 上，OptiSolve-12B 相对基座模型把 SCIP 中位搜索节点数提高 1.7–5 倍、post-cut gap 提高 1.1–1.7 倍，设施选址可行率提升 9–19 个百分点；OptiSolve-4B 中位节点数最高提升 15.6 倍。生成问题的难度范围比同规模公开基准更宽，能遵循密度与难度指令，并可为公开库缺失的实例族调参求解器设置。
summary_sections.conclusion: 优化专用奖励配合自博弈模式可以教会 LLM 生成高难度优化基准；代码与模型计划在接收后公开。

papers.title: Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeekVLN 针对视觉语言导航 (VLN) 中的 Progress Myopia——证据缺失时仍自信推进——把语义进度推理与主动获取观测耦合：先用 Future-guided Reverse Generation 增广专家轨迹做监督微调，再用 Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization 对比同一状态下的寻证分支与直接导航分支做强化微调。在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上相对基座模型成功率分别提升 12.7% 与 7.5%，仿真与真实评测均出现类人的寻证行为。
Motivation: VLM 导航智能体只在现有观测上推理，地标不在视野内时仍自信前进并迷路，即 Progress Myopia：无法识别进度锚定不可靠却继续行动。
Method: 两阶段训练：Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) 用未来专家动作为离线专家轨迹补充视角与证据标注，监督微调建立寻证与进度推理先验；随后引入 Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) 做强化微调，把每个寻证分支与同状态的反事实直接导航分支对比，用对比奖励按后续导航收益为寻证决策分配信用。
Result: 在仿真基准上达到 state-of-the-art：相对基座模型成功率在 R2R-CE 提升 12.7%、在 RxR-CE 提升 7.5%；仿真与真实世界评测均展现类人的证据寻求行为，进度锚定更可靠。
Conclusion: 把进度推理与主动寻证耦合、并用反事实对比奖励给寻证决策分配信用，能缓解 Progress Myopia，使 VLN 的进度判断在证据不足时更可靠。

papers.title: Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation: Mitigating the Deliberation Drift Cliff in Test-Time Compute Scaling
authors: Zeyu Jia (School of Biomedical Engineering and Technology
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute scaling has emerged as a cornerstone of advanced machine reasoning, yet performing iterative deliberation directly within continuous latent representation spaces reveals a catastrophic pathology: the Deliberation Drift Cliff. While unconstrained recurrent latent models achieve initial reasoning gains at short horizons (K <= 4), their reasoning collapses when extrapolated to deeper thinking steps (K >= 16), dropping by 22% to 62% across standard logical benchmarks. We resolve the trilemma among expressivity, Lyapunov stability, and computational efficiency in test-time latent reasoning through a 22-round empirical and theoretical investigation. We demonstrate that strictly conservative scalar potential gradient flows suppress long-range drift (cliff 3.40%) but bottleneck peak reasoning accuracy at 32.73%, whereas unconstrained rotational flows achieve high symbolic expressivity (82.33%) but suffer a severe 36.87% drift cliff. To resolve this geometric duality, we establish Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) and propose the Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD). DG-HHD parameterizes the attracting flow as a tangent projection tensor network while orthogonally decoupling non-zero circulation (Hodge machine error 1.65e-17, contraction error 5.55e-17), eliminating runtime autograd dependencies to achieve 1.84x vector field and 2.09x RK45 rollout speedups. In a 15-arm symmetrical Pareto benchmark, DG-HHD achieves 58.67% peak accuracy (+25.94% absolute gain over conservative HHD) and retains 35.27% at K=32. Transferred to small language model (SLM) multi-hop causal reasoning, DG-HHD delivers monotonic compute scaling (49.33% to 51.56%) and suppresses out-of-distribution drift (cliff -0.66%). All 30 Level 0 deterministic invariants are certified.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) 与 Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD)，把连续隐空间中的迭代推理流分解为吸引势梯度与非零环流两部分：保守势流压住漂移却卡死精度，无约束旋转流表达力高却崩在 Deliberation Drift Cliff。DG-HHD 用切向投影张量网络参数化吸引流并正交解耦环流，在 K=32 保留 35.27% 精度、峰值 58.67%，迁移到 SLM 多跳因果推理后实现单调 test-time compute scaling（49.33%→51.56%），分布外漂移 cliff 仅 -0.66%。
Motivation: 连续隐空间里的迭代推理在短视界 (K≤4) 有收益，但外推到深思考步 (K≥16) 时在标准逻辑基准上崩 22%–62%，即 Deliberation Drift Cliff；表达力、Lyapunov 稳定性与计算效率三者难以兼得。
Method: 以 22 轮实验与理论分析为支撑，建立 PH-LD 框架并提出 DG-HHD：把吸引流参数化为切向投影张量网络 (tangent projection tensor network)，正交解耦非零环流，消除运行时 autograd 依赖；用 RK45 rollout 做向量场积分，并在 15-arm 对称 Pareto 基准上比较保守势流、无约束旋转流与 DG-HHD。
Result: 无约束递归隐模型在 K≥16 时推理崩 22%–62%；严格保守标量势梯度流 cliff 仅 3.40% 但峰值精度卡在 32.73%，无约束旋转流峰值 82.33% 却有 36.87% drift cliff。DG-HHD 的 Hodge machine error 1.65e-17、contraction error 5.55e-17，向量场加速 1.84x、RK45 rollout 加速 2.09x；15-arm Pareto 基准峰值精度 58.67%（较保守 HHD 绝对 +25.94%），K=32 保留 35.27%；SLM 多跳因果推理上从 49.33% 单调升到 51.56%，OOD cliff -0.66%，30 条 Level 0 确定性不变量全部通过认证。
Conclusion: 把隐空间推理流按 Helmholtz-Hodge 分解成势与环流两支，可以在保住表达力的同时消除深视界漂移 cliff，使 test-time compute scaling 在 K=32 与 SLM 迁移上保持单调。

papers.title: PCaPaint: Prostate Cancer Inpainting by Mitigating Shortcut Learning
papers.abstract_en: The development of AI systems for tumor-specific applications is limited by the scarcity of labeled data. Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach but faces challenges for prostate cancer MRI which contains high-resolution multi-sequence data. Although methods leveraging latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable large-volume synthesis, they are prone to shortcut learning, simply reproducing the condition image created by masking the lesion region. In this work, we introduce PCaPaint, a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that explicitly addresses this failure mode. To overcome shortcut learning that compromises synthetic tumor texture, we propose a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy in which the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise, and we provide theoretical justification. In addition, we propose a novel training objective for LDM that emphasizes the error within the lesion region. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the generated synthetic data improves downstream performance in prostate lesion segmentation, patient-level classification and lesion-level detection. Furthermore, our method significantly outperforms a recent state-of-the-art LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.
papers.comment: Accepted at the DGM4MICCAI workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PCaPaint 用三处改动堵住前列腺癌 MRI 肿瘤 inpainting 的捷径学习：条件图在病灶区域填高斯噪声而非保留被掩膜的原图、新的 LDM 训练目标加大病灶区域内误差权重、T2w 与 DWI&ADC 各用独立 autoencoder 压缩以保留各自频率特性。生成的合成数据提升下游前列腺病灶分割、患者级分类与病灶级检测性能，并在下游性能和合成图像质量上显著优于近期基于 LDM 的肿瘤 inpainting 方法。
Motivation: 肿瘤专用 AI 受标注数据稀缺限制，合成肿瘤 inpainting 是可行路径，但前列腺癌 MRI 的高分辨率多序列数据上，基于 LDM 的方法会走捷径——直接复现掩膜病灶区域后的条件图，导致合成肿瘤纹理失真。
Method: PCaPaint 基于 latent diffusion model (LDM)：条件图的病灶区域填入高斯噪声以切断捷径（附理论论证）；提出强调病灶区域内误差的新 LDM 训练目标；多序列 latent 设计用两个独立 autoencoder 分别压缩 T2w 与 DWI&ADC 扫描，保留二者不同的频率特性。
Result: 生成的合成数据改善下游前列腺病灶分割、患者级分类与病灶级检测三项任务的性能；在下游性能与合成图像质量两方面均显著优于近期基于 LDM 的 SOTA 肿瘤 inpainting 方法。
Conclusion: 把条件图中的病灶区域换成噪声并按区域加权训练目标，是缓解 LDM 肿瘤 inpainting 捷径学习、保住合成肿瘤纹理的有效做法；论文为该条件策略给出理论论证。

papers.title: TAEC: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination for Multi-Step Visual RAG
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers complex questions by repeatedly retrieving visual evidence, updating an intermediate state, and deciding whether to continue searching or answer. Yet retrieving relevant evidence does not ensure its effective use throughout the reasoning trajectory. As multi-step reasoning progresses, redundant sources occupy context capacity needed for missing evidence, observations tied to resolved requirements or unproductive searches linger in context, and visual sources are revisited with insufficient detail for fine-grained reading. We term this loss of usable evidence over a reasoning trajectory trajectory-level evidence utilization degradation. To address it, we propose Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC), a training-free framework that coordinates evidence use around unresolved answer requirements. TAEC tracks these requirements in a shared trajectory state to guide which evidence enters the context, how accumulated memory is retained, and at what level of detail visual evidence is examined. Under a unified evaluation protocol on ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and MMLongBench-Doc, TAEC achieves the best overall performance against leading training-free visual RAG baselines, with the highest average accuracy across multiple proprietary vision-language models. These results demonstrate that aligning evidence with evolving reasoning needs improves evidence use throughout multi-step visual RAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAEC 是一个 training-free 的多步视觉 RAG 证据协调框架：把尚未解决的答案需求 (unresolved answer requirements) 记在共享轨迹状态里，统一决定哪些证据进 context、累积记忆如何保留、视觉证据以何种细节粒度读取。在 ViDoSeek、SlideVQA、MMLongBench-Doc 统一评测协议下，它对多个闭源 VLM 取得最高平均准确率，整体表现优于其他 training-free 视觉 RAG 基线。
Motivation: 多步视觉 RAG 中检索到证据不等于能被用上：冗余来源占住 context 容量、已解决需求的观察和无效搜索残留、视觉来源被重复访问但细节不足，作者称之为 trajectory-level evidence utilization degradation。
Method: TAEC 以共享轨迹状态追踪未解决的答案需求，据此协调三件事：哪些证据进入 context、累积记忆如何保留、视觉证据以何种细节层级检查；整个框架无需训练 (training-free)。
Result: 在 ViDoSeek、SlideVQA、MMLongBench-Doc 的统一评测协议下，TAEC 对多个闭源 vision-language models 取得最高平均准确率，在领先的 training-free 视觉 RAG 基线中整体表现最佳。
Conclusion: 把证据组织方式与推理过程中不断演化的需求对齐，就能改善多步视觉 RAG 全程的证据利用，而不必引入训练。

papers.title: When to Retrieve, When to Stay: Uncertainty-Aware Temporal Evidence Allocation for Streaming Video-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints. As the visual history grows, a bounded visual?processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance. Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous. We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation. A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty. WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty. Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM. Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench. In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WRWS 是面向流式 Video-LLM 的免训练证据分配框架：用轻量外部 VLM 编码器对已观测历史打查询相关性，以相似度分布的归一化熵作为检索不确定性代理，相关性可靠时偏向语义检索、不确定时加强 recency 先验，并在目标模型视觉编码之前先选证据。在四个 Video-LLM 家族与多个规模上，StreamingBench 与 OVO-Bench 精度具竞争力，平均 vision-to-answer 时间降至 SOTA 方法的 47.93%。
Motivation: 流式视频理解中视觉历史不断增长而处理预算有界，Recent-only 会丢掉相关历史证据，Semantic-only 在相关性打分含糊时又会挤掉有用的近期上下文，需要在 recency 与 query relevance 之间自适应分配。
Method: WRWS 为免训练框架：轻量外部视觉-语言编码器对全历史打查询相关性，自适应分配模块用相似度分布的归一化熵代理检索不确定性，据此在语义检索与 recency 先验之间加权；采用 retrieve-first、encode-later 流水线，在目标 Video-LLM 视觉编码前完成证据选择，只编码被选中的观测。
Result: 在四个 Video-LLM 家族、多个模型规模上，StreamingBench 与 OVO-Bench 精度具竞争力；效率评测中平均 vision-to-answer 时间降至当前 SOTA 方法的 47.93%。
Conclusion: 以检索不确定性自适应地在语义检索与近期先验间切换，可在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅压缩流式 Video-LLM 的视觉编码开销；代码将开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Sharp Transition in Data Reconstruction under Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Data reconstruction attacks have empirically been successful in recovering training samples from learned models, raising privacy concerns and motivating defenses with guarantees that remain valid against future threats. While differential privacy (DP) provides formal protection, choosing the privacy budget remains a challenge: small budgets severely reduce utility, but it is hard to quantify how large the budget can be without allowing accurate reconstruction. In this work, we study informed attackers who aim to reconstruct a single $d$-dimensional training sample from a $ρ$-zero-concentrated DP model, knowing all other training data. Our main contribution is to establish a sharp transition at $ρ\asymp d$ for data reconstruction: on the one hand, we derive entropy-based lower bounds for any private mechanism and any attack, characterizing a set of target priors for which reconstruction is information-theoretically impossible for $ρ\ll d$; on the other hand, we analyze a simple attack on private linear regression with output perturbation, showing that reconstruction is practically feasible for $ρ\gg d$. Remarkably, the transition moves to $ρ\asymp s$ for data lying in an $s$-dimensional subspace, demonstrating that the privacy budget guaranteeing adequate protection must be assessed in terms of the effective dimension of the data. We validate our findings via experiments on synthetic data and natural images (CIFAR-10, ImageNet).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ρ-zCDP 差分隐私下，数据重构存在临界相变：隐私预算 ρ 远小于数据维度 d 时重构信息论上不可能，ρ 远大于 d 时对私有线性回归（输出扰动）实际可行；若数据落在 s 维子空间，相变点从 ρ≈d 移到 ρ≈s，即保护预算必须按数据有效维度而非原始维度设定。
Motivation: 差分隐私的隐私预算 ε/ρ 难以定量选取：预算太小严重损害效用，但多大才会允许训练样本被重构缺乏理论刻画，而重构攻击已实证成功。
Method: 设定知情攻击者重构单个 d 维训练样本、且知晓其余全部训练数据；一方面对任意私有机制与任意攻击推导基于熵的下界，刻画 ρ≪d 时信息论上不可重构的目标先验集合；另一方面分析私有线性回归加输出扰动下的一个简单攻击，并在合成数据与 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 上做实验验证。
Result: 确立重构的相变点 ρ≈d：ρ≪d 时熵下界给出信息论不可重构，ρ≫d 时输出扰动私有线性回归的重构实际可行；数据位于 s 维子空间时相变点变为 ρ≈s；结论在合成数据及 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 实验中得到验证。
Conclusion: 保证充分保护的隐私预算必须按数据的有效维度评估，而不是按原始维度 d；这为在效用与可重构风险之间定量选择预算提供了判据。
