papers.title: HyperSAM: A Promptable Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral remote sensing provides dense spectral measurements that are indispensable for material-level Earth observation, yet the construction of a general-purpose hyperspectral foundation model remains difficult. Two bottlenecks are especially limiting. First, large hyperspectral corpora rarely provide high spatial resolution together with reliable dense annotations. Second, many hyperspectral models are still trained almost from scratch, so the geometric and interactive priors learned by modern vision foundation models are not fully reused. To alleviate these issues, we \highlight{present} \textbf{HyperSAM}, a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that couples a data-centric hyperspectral synthesis pipeline with a spectral adaptation architecture based on Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). On the data side, HyperSAM synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution SpaceNet multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer generator, while SAM3-derived pseudo-masks provide object-centric supervision. On the model side, the latest implementation uses a frozen SAM3 RGB image branch, a trainable hyperspectral side encoder initialized from the RGB vision transformer (ViT), ControlNet-style zero-initialized feature injection, and a lightweight mixture-of-experts mask refiner. To enhance training robustness against noisy pseudo-labels, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS)-style confidence selection is incorporated for noisy-label weighting. Extensive experiments show that HyperSAM obtains strong generalization on diverse hyperspectral tasks (e.g., classification, anomaly detection, change detection, target detection, and airborne oil-spill mapping) and that high-quality synthetic hyperspectral data can be more effective than simply scaling noisy hyperspectral supervision.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Magazine (GRSM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperSAM 把 SAM3 改造成可提示的高光谱基础模型：用物理驱动的丰度迁移生成器从 SpaceNet 高分辨率多光谱影像合成全谱高光谱立方体，配 SAM3 伪掩码做目标中心监督；模型侧冻结 SAM3 RGB 分支、训练由 RGB ViT 初始化的高光谱旁路编码器，经 ControlNet 式零初始化特征注入送入轻量 MoE 掩码精修器，并用 CromSS 式置信度选择给噪声伪标签加权。实验显示其在分类、异常检测、变化检测、目标检测与机载溢油制图等任务上泛化强，且高质量合成高光谱数据比直接堆噪声高光谱监督更有效。
Motivation: 高光谱语料很少同时具备高空间分辨率与可靠稠密标注，且多数高光谱模型近乎从零训练，无法复用视觉基础模型的几何与交互先觉，通用高光谱基础模型因此难以构建。
Method: 数据侧：由 SpaceNet 多光谱影像经物理信息丰度迁移生成器合成全谱高光谱立方体，SAM3 生成伪掩码提供监督。模型侧：冻结 SAM3 RGB 分支 + 从 RGB ViT 初始化的可训练高光谱旁路编码器，ControlNet 式零初始化特征注入，轻量 mixture-of-experts 掩码精修器；用 Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS) 式置信度选择对噪声伪标签加权。
Result: 在分类、异常检测、变化检测、目标检测和机载溢油制图等多样高光谱任务上取得强泛化；并显示高质量合成高光谱数据比简单扩大噪声高光谱监督规模更有效。
Conclusion: 以合成数据加基础模型先觉的路线可以绕开高光谱稠密标注稀缺的瓶颈，数据质量而非监督规模是高光谱基础模型的关键杠杆。

papers.title: UGO: Unified Architecture for General Multi-Object Tracking by Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: General multi-object tracking (GMOT) tracks all instances of a user-specified category from a single first-frame exemplar. Prior work relies on bounding boxes and surrogate training, and struggles with non-rigid objects, crowded scenes, and distractors. We introduce UGO, a unified GMOT tracker that pairs a pretrained exemplar-conditioned detection head with an instance-propagation head in a common architecture. A novel training-free, energy-minimization consolidation method converts overlapping proposals into exclusive pixel-wise masks and detections, resolving over-segmentation, duplicates, and conflicts. A hierarchical memory spanning global and instance levels improves recall and per-instance segmentation accuracy using a new memory management protocol. UGO sets a new state-of-the-art on GMOT benchmarks and video object counting, and is competitive with specialist MOT methods, establishing a strong paradigm for unified, open-category multi-object tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UGO 把通用多目标跟踪 (GMOT) 做成单一架构：预训练的 exemplar 条件检测头加实例传播头，配合免训练的能量最小化整合步骤，把重叠提议压成互斥的逐像素掩码与检测。层级记忆（全局级 + 实例级）配新记忆管理协议提升召回与逐实例分割精度，在 GMOT 基准与视频目标计数上取得新 state-of-the-art，并与专用 MOT 方法相当。
Motivation: 现有 GMOT 依赖边界框与替代训练 (surrogate training)，在非刚性目标、拥挤场景和干扰物上表现不佳，且缺少统一的开放类别跟踪范式。
Method: 架构内配对 exemplar 条件检测头与实例传播头；用免训练的能量最小化整合方法把重叠提议转成互斥的逐像素掩码与检测，解决过分割、重复与冲突；采用跨全局与实例两级的层级记忆及新的记忆管理协议。
Result: 在 GMOT 基准与视频目标计数 (video object counting) 上取得新的 state-of-the-art，并与专用 MOT 方法竞争力相当；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 统一的开放类别多目标跟踪范式可行：检测与实例传播共架构、掩码整合免训练、层级记忆提升召回与逐实例分割精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OFBD: Object-Focused Background Debiasing for Long-Tailed Learning
papers.abstract_en: Balancing performance trade-offs on long-tailed data distributions remains a long-standing challenge in visual recognition. Existing methods mainly improve tail classes through re-balancing, representation learning, or data augmentation, but the underlying cause of tail class degradation is still insufficiently explored. In this paper, we find that standard long-tailed training induces background-biased representation and optimization: tail classes suffer larger background distribution shifts and become increasingly driven by background gradients. This reveals that tail degradation is not merely caused by insufficient samples, but also by the learning of irrelevant background features. To tackle this issue, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a framework that mitigates background bias from both distribution and optimization perspectives. Specifically, Foreground-guided CutMix preserves target-related foregrounds while diversifying complementary backgrounds, and Background-guided Feature Rectification suppresses background-biased features without learnable parameters or additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method improves overall accuracy, achieves significant tail-class gains, and can serve as a plug-in for mainstream long-tailed methods without external data or pretrained recognition models. The code is available at: https://ofbd-neurips2026-longtail-learning.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OFBD 指出长尾识别中尾部类退化的根因之一是背景偏置表征与优化：尾部类承受更大的背景分布偏移，梯度越来越由背景驱动。框架用 Foreground-guided CutMix 保留目标前景并多样化互补背景，再用无参数、无需额外训练的 Background-guided Feature Rectification 抑制背景偏置特征，从而提升总体精度并显著改善尾部类，可作为主流长尾方法的即插即用模块。
Motivation: 长尾视觉识别中尾部类退化通常被归因于样本不足，靠重加权、表征学习或数据增强缓解，但尾部类为何退化的深层原因尚未被充分揭示。
Method: OFBD 从分布与优化两个角度同时去偏：Foreground-guided CutMix 在混合时保留与目标相关的前景、只替换互补背景；Background-guided Feature Rectification 在特征层面抑制背景偏置特征，该模块无可学习参数、不需额外训练，且不依赖外部数据或预训练识别模型。
Result: 实验显示该方法提升总体精度并带来显著的尾部类增益，可作为主流长尾方法的即插即用组件；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 尾部类退化不只是样本不足问题，还来自对无关背景特征的学习，因此在分布与优化两端同时去背景偏置即可在不引入外部数据的前提下改善长尾识别。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 实验显示该方法提升总体精度并带来显著的尾部类增益，可作为主流长尾方法的即插即用组件；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 尾部类退化不只是样本不足问题，还来自对无关背景特征的学习，因此在分布与优化两端同时去背景偏置即可在不引入外部数据的前提下改善长尾识别。

papers.title: The Domain Is a Residue: Adapting Self-Supervised Features, Not Generators
papers.abstract_en: Clearing fog, rain or snow from footage, or turning renders into photographs, must remove the source domain and keep the scene. Unpaired translators carry it through because their generator sees the source appearance (pixels, a near-invertible latent or a control map) and keeps it. A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style as a residue of 13 to 14% of the feature norm. We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9M-parameter network that moves this residue. We train only the adapter and its discriminators; the encoder and a feature-conditioned decoder, trained once for all conditions, stay frozen. Against CycleGAN-Turbo it is ahead on both metrics on fog and on KID on night, and level within noise on snow, rain and haze. On sim-to-real it leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on both metrics. Only the RFA removes the rain while keeping the scene. The removal costs scene structure: CycleGAN-Turbo keeps more on every condition but fog. On VAE latents the identical adapter collapses to the identity, and decoders from other groups that never saw it render its output. The RFA has about 160 times fewer trainable parameters than CycleGAN-Turbo and under a fifth of its per-condition training time.
papers.comment: 9 pages main text, 28 pages including appendix. 12 figures, 13 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 去雾、去雨雪或渲染转照片这类非成对域翻译中，生成器会把源域外观带进输出；本文改用冻结的 DINO 特征空间，把天气、光照与渲染风格当作仅占特征范数 13%–14% 的残差 (residue)，用 2.9M 参数的 Representation Feature Adapter (RFA) 只移动该残差。在 fog、night、sim-to-real 等条件下 RFA 对比 CycleGAN-Turbo、REGEN、HyPER-GAN 取得领先或持平，且是唯一真正去掉雨同时保住场景的方法，可训练参数少约 160 倍、单条件训练时间不到五分之一。
Motivation: 非成对域翻译的生成器会看到源域外观（像素、近可逆 latent 或 control map）并把它带进输出，导致源域去除不干净、场景内容被改写。
Method: 冻结 DINO encoder 与一个对所有条件只训练一次的 feature-conditioned decoder，只训练 2.9M 参数的 Representation Feature Adapter (RFA) 及其判别器；把天气、光照、渲染风格建模为特征图上占特征范数 13%–14% 的残差并只移动它，同时在 VAE latent 上做同一 adapter 的对照。
Result: 对比 CycleGAN-Turbo：fog 上两项指标均领先，night 上 KID 领先，snow、rain、haze 上持平（level within noise）；sim-to-real 上两项指标均领先 REGEN 与 HyPER-GAN；只有 RFA 在去雨的同时保住场景。代价是场景结构：除 fog 外 CycleGAN-Turbo 在每个条件上保留更多场景结构。VAE latent 上同一 adapter 塌缩为恒等映射，其他组从未见过该输出的 decoder 也能渲染它。RFA 可训练参数比 CycleGAN-Turbo 少约 160 倍，单条件训练时间不到其五分之一。

papers.title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 小规模 on-policy 蒸馏把 Qwen3-8B 教师的解题能力传给 4B/1.7B/0.6B 学生，但不传授「何时停止思考」：thinking 模式下学生在训练中越来越不肯结束推理，且模型越小保留的停止能力越少。非 thinking 模式下所有学生都保持正常停止；最小的学生常算出正确数值却不作答——要么不标记答案，要么标记后又继续写。
Motivation: 长推理需要解题与判断何时解完两种能力，但 on-policy 蒸馏在小模型上到底转移了哪一种、以及学生规模如何影响这一转移，此前缺少系统刻画。
Method: 把 Qwen3-8B 教师蒸馏到 Qwen3 4B、1.7B、0.6B 三种规模学生，分别在 thinking 模式（长推理后结束并作答）与非 thinking 模式（无独立推理阶段）下做 on-policy 蒸馏；提出一个把答案标记 (answer marking)、正确性与停止 (stopping) 分离开的诊断，并综合测量两类上限：单次尝试上限与多次尝试可达上限。
Result: 解题能力在所有学生规模上都提升，但受两重上限约束——学生单次尝试从不超过其训练前多次尝试已能达到的水平，且学生越小与教师差距越大。停止能力上，非 thinking 模式每个学生都保持停止；thinking 模式下学生在训练中不再提早结束推理，且越小的学生保留越少：教师的停止信号几乎只出现在学生本来就会停止的位置，蒸馏教不出新的停止点，只保留那些恰好落在正确答案上的既有停止。最小的学生常得到正确数值却不承诺作答，要么很少标记答案，要么标记后又写过头。
Conclusion: 小规模 on-policy 蒸馏只转移解题、不转移停止判断，且学生越小停止能力损失越严重；可用答案标记、正确性、停止三者分离的诊断来定位失败模式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VISTA: Value-Informed Event Appraisal for Multimodal Emotion Conflict
papers.abstract_en: Conflicting emotional cues can be individually valid: a subdued voice may reflect a blocked goal while a smile satisfies a social obligation. Their interpretation depends on what the event means to the person. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration), a learned seven-field appraisal interface that conditions modality arbitration on concerns, event relations, and expression conditions while retaining a joint-evidence residual. A log-odds decomposition separates emotion expectation from cue diagnosticity, motivating an interface that lets appraisal change how evidence is interpreted. With a shared Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone and matched training examples and steps, VISTA reaches 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER, improving on modality gating by 2.5 percentage points on conflict and 0.2 on consistency. Shuffling appraisal across scenes or removing its decision connection reduces this benefit. A common frozen-backbone probe reaches 0.600 macro CCC for appraisal readout, compared with 0.505 for emotion-only fine-tuning. Evaluations across five benchmarks connect recognition under increasing conflict with appraisal readout and downstream decision use. Together, the analyses and experiments support scene-specific appraisal as an intermediate representation that helps interpret conflicting emotional evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VISTA 提出价值知情语义信任仲裁 (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration)：一个可学习的七字段评价接口，把模态仲裁建立在关切、事件关系与表达条件之上，并保留联合证据残差；log-odds 分解把情绪预期与线索诊断性分开。在共享 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 骨干、训练样本与步数对齐的条件下，CA-MER 冲突准确率达 64.5%，比模态门控高 2.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 冲突情绪线索各自可能都成立（低沉嗓音与社交性微笑），其解读取决于事件对当事人的价值含义，而现有模态仲裁无法让这种评价改变证据的解释方式。
Method: 以 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 为共享骨干，训练七字段评价接口调节模态仲裁并保留联合证据残差；log-odds 分解区分情绪预期与线索诊断性；训练样本与步数与基线对齐，并用跨场景打乱评价、切断评价与决策连接做消融，另设冻结骨干探针读出评价。
Result: CA-MER 冲突准确率 64.5%，较模态门控在冲突上提升 2.5 个百分点、一致性上提升 0.2；跨场景打乱评价或移除评价到决策的连接会削弱该收益；冻结骨干探针读出评价的 macro CCC 为 0.600，情绪单独微调为 0.505；评测覆盖五个基准，连接递增冲突下的识别、评价读出与下游决策。
Conclusion: 场景特定的评价可作为中间表示，帮助解释相互冲突的情绪证据，且该收益依赖评价与决策之间的连接而非评价本身的存在。

papers.title: Parallel Tempering for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving combinatorial optimization (CO) problems on graphs by learning to sample high-quality solutions. A common inference-time approach is to generate multiple candidate solutions independently and return the best-performing sample, improving solution quality at the expense of an increase in computational cost. In this work, we introduce PT-Denoise, an inference-time procedure that allows these concurrent denoising trajectories to interact through parallel tempering, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the underlying denoiser. Our method assigns a temperature to each diffusion process and allows processes to swap temperatures based on their relative performance. This dynamically reallocates promising, low-energy trajectories to colder, more concentrated sampling regimes while allowing higher-energy states to escape local minima through randomized exploration. Experiments on canonical graph-structured CO problems show that our approach consistently improves the quality of the best solution found, while only adding minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PT-Denoise 在推理阶段让离散扩散模型的多条并行去噪轨迹通过 parallel tempering 交换温度，无需重训或微调去噪器即可提升图组合优化问题上最优解的质量，且只增加极少计算开销。
Motivation: 离散扩散解组合优化时通常独立采样多个候选再取最优，解质量提升但计算成本线性上升；轨迹之间互不通信，缺少利用相对性能重新分配搜索资源的机制。
Method: 为每条扩散过程分配一个温度，按相对性能（能量）在轨迹间交换温度：低能量轨迹被调到更冷、更集中的采样机制，高能量状态则通过随机探索逃出局部极小；该过程是纯推理时的，不改动底层 denoiser 的训练。
Result: 在 canonical 图结构组合优化问题上的实验中，该方法一致提升所找到最优解的质量，且仅带来极少的额外计算开销（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 并行退火式的温度交换可以在不重训的前提下，用可忽略的开销把独立多采样策略变成有协作的搜索，从而稳定改善离散扩散的解质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mubric: Mutation Testing-Guided Rubric Generation for LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess LLM-based systems by decomposing response quality into task-specific scoring criteria. However, automatically generating rubrics that reliably capture task-specific quality requirements remains challenging. We introduce Mubric, a mutation testing-guided approach to rubric generation. Mutation testing, a classic software testing methodology, evaluates a test suite by injecting faults into programs and checking whether the tests detect them. We draw an analogy between test suites and rubrics: if a rubric captures an important quality requirement, introducing a corresponding defect into an otherwise high-quality response should reduce its score. Mubric first mines common defects from real pairs of preferred and dispreferred responses and abstracts these defects into reusable mutation operators, each specifying how to introduce a particular type of response defect. For a new task, it applies relevant operators to a reference response, checks whether the injected defects reduce response quality, and uses insufficiently penalized defects to refine the rubric. We evaluate Mubric on 703 tasks across four representative domains against six advanced rubric generation methods. Mubric achieves the highest overall evaluation accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 7.48 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mubric 把软件变异测试 (mutation testing) 移植到 rubric 生成：若 rubric 覆盖某条重要质量要求，向高质量回答注入对应缺陷就应压低其得分，据此用未被充分扣分的缺陷反向修补 rubric。在四个代表性领域共 703 个任务上对比六种先进 rubric 生成方法，总体评估准确率最高，比最强基线高 7.48 个百分点。
Motivation: rubric 式 LLM 评估依赖自动生成的评分标准，但现有自动方法难以稳定捕捉任务特有的质量要求，导致评分不可靠。
Method: 先从真实 preferred/dispreferred 回答对中挖掘常见缺陷并抽象成可复用的 mutation operators；对新任务把相关算子作用于参考回答，检查注入缺陷是否降低质量，再用扣分不足的缺陷迭代修补 rubric。
Result: 在四个代表性领域 703 个任务上对比六种先进 rubric 生成方法，Mubric 总体评估准确率最高，超出最强基线 7.48 个百分点。
Conclusion: 用变异测试的“缺陷注入—检出”闭环可以系统性暴露 rubric 漏掉的质量要求，从而生成更可靠的评分标准。

papers.title: PowerMarketJax: A JAX Benchmark Suite for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Power Markets
papers.abstract_en: Power markets are a natural testbed for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), where multiple self-interested participants repeatedly submit bids. A market-clearing mechanism then determines dispatch and prices subject to power grid constraints and market settlement rules. However, existing MARL environments typically focus on a single market setting, implement simplified clearing mechanisms, or rely on CPU-based optimization solvers that slow large-scale training and limit the systematic study of bidding strategies and market behavior. We introduce PowerMarketJax, a benchmark suite for MARL across five power markets: day-ahead wholesale, real-time balancing, ancillary services, peer-to-peer double auctions, and local flexibility. Each environment implements its own clearing, pricing, and settlement rules while providing a common framework for learning and evaluation. We find that learned bidding behavior depends strongly on the market design: independent learners can miss better strategies when gains require many agents to change together, when more profitable strategies lie beyond a region of lower profit, or when profits disappear as more agents adopt the same strategy. PowerMarketJax implements both market simulation and policy training in JAX, allowing the entire pipeline to run on the GPU with 1,024 X 1,200 parallelisms across both environments and market participants, achieving up to 33X speedup over CPU-based baselines. Our open-source benchmark is available at: https://github.com/powermarketjax/PowerMarketJax.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PowerMarketJax 是一个用 JAX 实现、可全 GPU 并行的多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 电力市场基准套件，覆盖日前批发、实时平衡、辅助服务、点对点双拍卖、本地灵活性五类市场，各自实现独立的出清、定价与结算规则。全管线在 GPU 上以 1,024 × 1,200 并行度运行，相对 CPU 基线最高 33 倍加速；学到的投标行为强烈依赖市场设计——当收益需要多个智能体同时改变、更优策略位于低利润区域之外、或策略被大量采用后利润消失时，独立学习者会错过更好的策略。
Motivation: 现有 MARL 电力市场环境多局限于单一市场设定、出清机制被简化，或依赖 CPU 优化求解器，导致大规模训练慢，难以系统研究投标策略与市场行为。
Method: 提出 PowerMarketJax 基准套件，五个市场环境各自实现出清、定价与结算规则，同时共享统一的学习与评估框架；市场仿真与策略训练均用 JAX 实现，整条管线在 GPU 上并行运行，覆盖环境与市场参与者两个维度。
Result: GPU 上实现 1,024 × 1,200 并行度（环境 × 市场参与者），相对基于 CPU 的基线最高 33 倍加速。定性发现：学到的投标行为强烈依赖市场设计，独立学习者在三种情形下会错过更优策略——收益需要许多智能体同时改变、更优策略位于较低利润区域之外、以及更多智能体采用同一策略后利润消失。
Conclusion: 市场设计本身决定了 MARL 能否学到好策略，独立学习 (independent learners) 在需要协同偏离或存在利润拥挤的市场中系统性地收敛到次优投标；把仿真与训练都放到 JAX/GPU 上可让这类研究扩展到大规模并行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Comes Next? Omni-StoryBench for Evaluating Story-Grounded Omnimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal evaluation should go beyond independent text, image, and speech production: individually plausible outputs may not express a coherent shared event. We introduce Omni-StoryBench, a story-grounded omnimodal benchmark evaluating whether models can coherently continue stories across image, narration, and speech. Each instance provides a current storybook page and structured next-page conditions, requiring models to generate the next illustration, narration, and spoken character utterance. Omni-StoryBench contains 900 rigorously validated story transitions from openly licensed children's books, with ground-truth next-page references and speech metadata. We evaluate systems with modality-specific metrics and consistency-centered LLM-as-a-judge rubrics for context preservation, condition following, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence. Across 32 baseline configurations spanning orchestration, semi-orchestration, and native any-to-any paradigms, we find orchestration with strong VLM planning most reliable, while current native omnimodal models often struggle with output completeness and controllability. Our analysis shows text-side performance is associated with image and speech quality, but image generation and visual continuity form the clearest observed bottleneck among the evaluated configurations. These results position Omni-StoryBench as a system-level benchmark measuring coherent omnimodal generation beyond isolated modality quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Omni-StoryBench 用 900 条经严格校验的开源童书故事转场，要求模型在给定当前书页与结构化下一页条件下同时续写插图、旁白与角色语音。跨 32 个基线配置（编排、半编排、原生 any-to-any 三类）评测显示，强 VLM 规划的编排式最可靠，原生全模态模型常在输出完整性与可控性上失手，图像生成与视觉连续性是最明显瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有全模态评测只分别打分文本、图像、语音，无法判断三者是否表达同一个连贯事件；缺少以故事为锚、跨模态一致的系统级基准。
Method: 每个样本给出当前故事书页与结构化下一页条件，要求生成下一页插图、旁白与角色语音；用模态各自指标加上以一致性为中心的 LLM-as-a-judge 评分细则，覆盖上下文保持、条件遵循、参考一致性与跨模态连贯。
Result: 基准含 900 条经严格校验的故事转场，来自公开授权童书，附真值下一页参考与语音元数据；在 32 个基线配置上，编排式（orchestration）配强 VLM 规划最可靠，原生全模态模型常在输出完整性与可控性上失败；文本侧表现与图像、语音质量相关，而图像生成与视觉连续性是所评配置中最清晰的瓶颈。
Conclusion: 连贯的全模态生成应靠强 VLM 规划的编排式达成，当前瓶颈在图像生成与视觉连续性，而非孤立的单模态质量。

papers.title: Do Agent Benchmarks Do What They Say? An Executable-Contract Audit of Tool-Using Agent Environments
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents are entering settings where a wrong action carries real cost, and the benchmarks certifying them grade what each simulated tool call reports having done, assuming the tool did what its interface advertises. The audit taxonomies we survey publish no category for that assumption, and a defect beneath a score is present on every rerun. We treat a tool's advertised surfaces as an executable contract, check the implementation against it, and trace each score's provenance through the task files and evaluator code to the verdicts that derive from state a defective tool should have written. Across 34 audited mutating tools in four benchmarks we confirm seven tool defects and one evaluator property at pinned commits. On injected defects the checker raised no false positive in 25 flags, flagged 2 of 5 negative controls, and missed most: in 29 of 33 scored misses a clause covered the defect but no probe revealed it. The checker's own static half, run alone, flags 14 of 17 confirmed sites, so on these findings the dynamic half confirms and traces rather than discovers. Twelve further AgentDojo tools, with six held-out tools and the seven audited first, complete its 25-tool mutating surface, on which at least 5 tools diverge from their advertised surface as our contracts read it, a rate for AgentDojo alone. No gold trajectory reaches either tau2-bench defect; on 1,120 paths built to isolate the telecom defect, a number fixed by construction, the evaluator rewards a refuel of a suspended line and fails the repaired tool. The clearest case is a clinical benchmark whose tool tells the agent each write executed under a documented no-write design its interface does not disclose; its grader takes that message as evidence, so its action success rate records whether a request carried the expected payload, not whether any record changed.
papers.comment: 10 pages. Submitted to IEEE BigData 2026, Intelligent Data Mining special session. Code, contracts and data: https://github.com/rohithreddybc/tool-contract-conformance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把工具的对外接口当作可执行契约 (executable contract)，对四个 agent 基准的 34 个有状态工具做实现一致性审计并追溯评分来源，确认 7 个工具缺陷和 1 个 evaluator 属性缺陷。静态检查单独命中 17 处已确认缺陷中的 14 处，而动态探针在 33 处计分漏报中有 29 处因无探针触发而漏检；临床基准的 action success rate 实际只记录请求是否带了预期 payload，而非记录是否真的被改写。
Motivation: 现有 agent 基准评测按工具接口声称的行为打分，假设工具确实照接口执行；而被调查的审计分类体系没有覆盖这一假设，工具层缺陷会在每次重跑中稳定地污染分数。
Method: 将工具的 advertised surfaces 视为可执行契约，用检查器比对实现与契约，并沿 task files 与 evaluator 代码追溯每个分数的来源，定位依赖缺陷工具应写入状态的判定；在注入缺陷上检验检查器，并对 AgentDojo 的 25 个 mutating surface 工具补齐审计。
Result: 四个基准 34 个被审计 mutating 工具中确认 7 个工具缺陷与 1 个 evaluator 属性缺陷（pinned commits）。注入缺陷上检查器 25 个 flag 无假阳性，5 个阴性对照中报出 2 个，33 处计分漏报中 29 处是“有条款覆盖但无探针触发”；静态部分单独运行命中 17 处已确认位点中的 14 处。AgentDojo 的 25 个 mutating 工具中至少 5 个与其 advertised surface 不一致。无 gold trajectory 到达 tau2-bench 的两个缺陷；在为隔离 telecom 缺陷而构造的 1,120 条路径上，evaluator 奖励对停机线路的 refuel 并让修复后的工具判失败。
Conclusion: 按这些发现，动态检查主要起确认与追溯作用而非发现缺陷，静态部分才是发现主力；基准分数可能度量的是请求是否携带预期 payload，而非状态是否真的改变，因此需把工具契约符合性纳入审计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FLASH: A "Generate Once, Synthesize Many" Framework for Synthetic Anomaly Generation in Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic anomaly generation helps expand industrial anomaly datasets when real defects are scarce or unavailable. Existing approaches lie at two extremes: procedural approaches are fast but struggle to represent complex anomalies, while generative approaches produce diverse defects but require costly per-sample generation. We present FLASH, a framework that decouples defect generation from anomaly synthesis under a ``generate once, synthesize many'' paradigm. Given only normal images, FLASH uses Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance and an image-generation model to produce a small set of defect images, from which it extracts, validates, and banks reusable defect patches. For synthesis of anomalous images, Object Boundary Suppression (OBS) first identifies the probable foreground object-aware region of the host image, while Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid (MRSP) noise generates diverse, size-controllable masks that determine the defect location and spatial extent. It then composes a large and diverse synthetic anomalous image set by localizing the defect region, sampling size-controllable placement masks and seamlessly blending retrieved defects onto new defect-free images without further need for image generation. Experiments on the MVTec AD 2 dataset show that FLASH-generated anomalies nearly close the calibration gap on real defects, reaching 78.1% image-level F1 against an 83.6% real-anomaly upper bound and providing the most consistent calibration transfer across detectors among procedural and generative alternatives. Moreover, FLASH synthesizes anomalies more than 11.95x faster than per-sample generative approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLASH 用「一次生成、多次合成」范式做工业异常检测的合成缺陷：先靠 VLM 引导的图像生成模型产出少量缺陷图，抽取并校验成可复用缺陷 patch 库，再用 Object Boundary Suppression (OBS) 定位宿主前景区域、Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid (MRSP) 噪声生成尺寸可控掩码，把缺陷无缝贴到新的无缺陷图像上，无需再调用图像生成。在 MVTec AD 2 上图像级 F1 达到 78.1%，接近 83.6% 的真实异常上界，合成速度比逐样本生成方法快 11.95 倍以上。
Motivation: 工业缺陷真实样本稀缺时需要合成异常，但程序化方法难以表达复杂缺陷，生成式方法又必须逐样本生成、成本高，两者各占一端。
Method: 仅用正常图像，先由 Vision-Language Model (VLM) 引导图像生成模型产出少量缺陷图，抽取、校验并存入可复用缺陷 patch 库；合成阶段用 OBS 识别宿主图像的前景物体相关区域，用 MRSP 噪声生成多样且尺寸可控的掩码决定缺陷位置与范围，再把检索到的缺陷无缝融合到新的无缺陷图像上，不再需要图像生成。
Result: 在 MVTec AD 2 上，FLASH 合成异常使图像级 F1 达到 78.1%，真实异常上界为 83.6%，即几乎弥合与真实缺陷的校准差距；在程序化与生成式替代方案中对各检测器给出最一致的校准迁移；合成速度比逐样本生成方法快 11.95 倍以上。

papers.title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Can reasoning models trick chain of thought (CoT) monitors and perform hidden computation without revealing it in their thinking traces? We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. Simple computations can be performed covertly; however, beyond a threshold depending on model size, successfully solving the task necessarily leaks a near-linear amount of information about the covert task input into the CoT. Therefore, sufficiently complex hidden computation always leaves an information-theoretic footprint. However, concerningly, this leakage need not be readable: Under plausible cryptographic assumptions, even a one-layer Transformer can encrypt its reasoning online so that no polynomial-time monitor can extract information about the hidden computation. Overall, our theoretical and empirical results provide a holistic view of both the opportunities and the limitations of CoT monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出 CoT 监控的双向理论边界：任务难度超过随模型规模变化的阈值后，成功求解必然把近线性量的隐蔽任务输入信息泄漏进思维链，因此复杂隐藏计算必留信息论足迹；但在合理密码学假设下，即便单层 Transformer 也能在线加密推理，使任何多项式时间监控器都无法提取隐藏计算的信息，即泄漏存在但不可读。
Motivation: 推理模型可能在思维链里隐藏计算而不被监控器察觉，需要判定这种隐蔽推理在什么条件下必然暴露、暴露的信息又是否可被监控方读取。
Method: 结合理论与实证结果：按任务难度与模型规模刻画隐蔽计算可被隐藏的条件，证明超过阈值时泄漏量近线性于隐蔽任务输入，并在密码学假设下构造单层 Transformer 的在线加密推理作为不可读性的上界构造。
Result: 简单计算可隐蔽完成；超过依赖模型规模的阈值后，成功求解必然向 CoT 泄漏近线性量的隐蔽任务输入信息；在合理密码学假设下，单层 Transformer 即可在线加密推理，任何多项式时间监控器都无法提取隐藏计算信息。
Conclusion: CoT 监控的机会与极限并存：复杂隐藏计算必留信息论足迹，但该足迹可以对多项式时间监控器不可读，因此泄漏本身不等于可监控。

papers.title: ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReMem 把推荐 agent 的物品感知从解析原始 HTML 改为截图加 OCR 提取结构化多模态信息，并用分块顺序记忆更新维持固定大小的历史交互记忆，使长上下文推理保持线性复杂度与有界上下文长度。在三个数据集的 searching、ranking、judging 三类推荐 agent 任务上平均比 SOTA 基线提升 5.16%。
Motivation: 现有 RecAgents 的物品感知依赖嘈杂异构的物品页面，且在长用户历史与多步交互轨迹上做长上下文推理效率低。
Method: ReMem 框架包含两部分：OCR 工具读取物品页截图并抽取结构化多模态信息，替代 HTML 解析；chunk-wise sequential memory update 选择性保留固定大小的高信息交互记忆，配合不引入外部记忆模块、不打断标准自回归生成的机制。另提出 multi-memory GRPO 变体，把最终答案的 advantage 传播到所有促成该回答的中间对话。
Result: 在三个数据集上，ReMem 在 searching、ranking、judging 三类推荐 agent 任务上一致优于 SOTA 基线，平均提升 5.16%；长上下文处理的推理复杂度为线性、上下文长度有界。
Conclusion: 截图式 OCR 感知加有界动态记忆足以支撑长时程偏好建模，无需外部记忆模块，且在三类推荐任务上稳定超过现有 RecAgents。

papers.title: AutoMark: Enabling Autoresearch to Discover Better LLM Watermarks
papers.abstract_en: With LLM watermarking being deployed commercially and now required by regulations, improving its reliability and effectiveness has become crucial. Yet, recent progress in the field of LLM watermarking has increasingly been driven by improving details of existing methods, an effort fundamentally limited by the pace of human researchers. In this work, we enable for the first time the autonomous discovery of new distortion-free state-of-the-art watermarking schemes. To enable this, we (i) establish strict criteria to ensure that watermarks are reliable (e.g., they do not have an unexpectedly high false positive rate), (ii) propose rigorous statistical tests to automatically evaluate whether a watermarking scheme satisfies our criteria, and (iii) design an evaluation suite to rank watermarks along three key dimensions: detectability, quality, and robustness. By running our framework with 3 frontier models (GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5, Gemini-3.8 Flash), we discover over 50 different watermarking schemes, including several that outperform prior works along all key dimensions. We complement this by a manual study of the discovered schemes, distilling the key ideas into smaller components, and individually studying the impact of each component across dimensions (detectability, quality, robustness) to better understand how the proposed schemes operate. Importantly, we find that the agents, on top of improving existing ideas, also discover fundamentally new ideas (e.g., aligning watermark scores with random per-request direction). Overall, our work establishes the first steps of fully autonomous watermarking research, enabling the discovery of more reliable and effective watermarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/eth-sri/automark, and a blogpost to visualize our results at https://www.sri.inf.ethz.ch/blog/automark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoMark 让 LLM agent 自主发现无失真 (distortion-free) 水印方案：先定可靠性判据（如假阳性率不能过高），再配自动统计检验和按可检测性、质量、鲁棒性三维排序的评测套件。在 GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5、Gemini-3.8 Flash 三个前沿模型上跑出 50 多种新水印方案，其中若干在全部三个维度上超过既有工作，且 agent 还提出了全新思路（如把水印分数对齐到每次请求的随机方向）。
Motivation: LLM 水印已进入商用并被法规要求，但近期进展靠人工打磨既有方法的细节，受限于研究者速度，缺少自动判定水印是否可靠、并系统比较方案的机制。
Method: 三件套：严格可靠性判据（含假阳性率约束）、自动判定方案是否达标的统计检验、按 detectability/quality/robustness 三维排序的评测套件；由 agent 在 3 个前沿模型上搜索方案，再人工拆解发现的方案为更小组件并逐个考察各维度影响。
Result: 在 GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5、Gemini-3.8 Flash 上发现 50 多种水印方案，其中数种在三个关键维度上同时超越先前工作；人工研究进一步分离出各组件对可检测性、质量、鲁棒性的单独影响，并发现 agent 提出了既有工作之外的新想法（对齐水印分数与随机 per-request 方向）。
Conclusion: 水印研究可以进入全自动发现阶段：可靠判据加统计检验加三维评测，让 agent 产出比人工更快、且在各维度上更优的水印方案。

papers.title: Hybrid Joint-Selective Optimization: Reduced-Space Levenberg-Marquardt Refinement of Low-Dimensional Parameters of Interest
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a hybrid joint-selective optimization (HJSO) framework for large-scale numerical problems in which a small subset of trainable quantities is of primary interest. We partition the full parameter vector into a high-dimensional remaining block and a low-dimensional block of parameters of interest (POIs), perform joint first-order optimization over the full parameter set, and then freeze the remaining variables while applying a reduced-space Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) refinement to the POIs. The method is designed for settings in which the POIs are low-dimensional but strongly influence the quality of the computed solution, while the full parameter space remains too large for full-space second-order methods. The framework is evaluated on three representative problems: a matrix eigenvalue problem, an inverse Bratu problem solved with a physics-informed neural network, and a 100-dimensional nonlinear Black-Scholes problem solved with the DeepBSDE method. In each test, HJSO reaches prescribed POI-error thresholds faster than the corresponding joint first-order baseline and improves the final POI accuracy for the reported solver configurations. The contribution is therefore not a universal optimizer, but a practical reduced-space strategy for problems with known low-dimensional parameters of interest and expensive high-dimensional training variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HJSO 把参数向量拆成高维剩余块与低维关注参数 (POI)，先对全体参数做联合一阶优化，再冻结剩余变量、只对 POI 做 reduced-space Levenberg-Marquardt 精修。在矩阵特征值、PINN 求解的 inverse Bratu、以及 DeepBSDE 求解的 100 维非线性 Black-Scholes 三个测试上，HJSO 比对应联合一阶基线更快达到预设 POI 误差阈值，并在所报告的求解器配置下提高最终 POI 精度。
Motivation: 当只有低维参数是主要关注对象、而全参数空间大到无法承受全空间二阶方法时，一阶联合优化对这些 POI 的收敛慢且最终精度不足。
Method: 将全参数向量划分为高维剩余块与低维 POI 块；先对全参数做联合一阶优化，随后冻结剩余变量，对 POI 施加 reduced-space Levenberg-Marquardt 精修。测试对象为矩阵特征值问题、用 physics-informed neural network 求解的 inverse Bratu 问题、以及用 DeepBSDE 方法求解的 100 维非线性 Black-Scholes 问题。
Result: 在三个测试问题上，HJSO 达到预设 POI 误差阈值的速度快于对应的联合一阶基线，并在所报告的求解器配置下改善最终 POI 精度；Black-Scholes 测试为 100 维。
Conclusion: HJSO 的定位不是通用优化器，而是针对已知低维关注参数加昂贵高维训练变量这类问题的实用 reduced-space 策略。

papers.title: MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. We formulate reasoning regulation as a sequential metacognitive control problem: MetaCtrl observes the evolving reasoning trace and decides whether to continue, simplify, skip redundant steps, or conclude reasoning. It is trained directly with reinforcement learning using a reward that prioritizes correctness while favoring shorter trajectories among correct solutions, requiring neither supervised intervention trajectories nor problem-specific budgets. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, MetaCtrl consistently improves the accuracy of LRMs while reducing their reasoning length. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it improves average accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing generation length by 53.3%. Without further training, the same controller transfers to an unseen reasoner (e.g., Qwen3-14B), improving average accuracy by 2.9 points and reducing generation length by 50.3%. These results establish MetaCtrl as a plug-and-play controller for improving reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference-time generation. The code is available at https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaCtrl 是一个用强化学习训练的元认知控制器，在不改动冻结 reasoner、不设 token 预算的前提下，根据演化中的推理轨迹决定继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或收束。在七个数学、科学与代码基准上，它同时提升准确率并缩短推理：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 平均准确率 +4.7 分、生成长度 −53.3%，零训练迁移到 Qwen3-14B 仍 +2.9 分、−50.3%。
Motivation: 长推理在简单题上产生大量冗余，激进截断又损害难题表现；现有方法依赖预设 token 预算或干预规则、需要重训 reasoner 或额外监督。
Method: 把推理调控建模为序列化元认知控制问题：控制器观测演化中的推理轨迹，输出继续/简化/跳步/收束四类动作，直接用 RL 训练，奖励优先正确性、在正确解中偏好更短轨迹，无需监督干预轨迹与题目级预算；被控 reasoner 保持冻结。
Result: 在数学、科学、代码共七个基准上，MetaCtrl 一致提升 LRM 准确率同时缩短推理长度；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 平均准确率提高 4.7 分、生成长度减少 53.3%；不进一步训练迁移到未见过的 Qwen3-14B，平均准确率提高 2.9 分、生成长度减少 50.3%。
Conclusion: 推理长度应由控制器按解题状态动态决定而非固定预算，这样一个轻量、可插拔且可跨 reasoner 迁移的控制器就能同时改善准确率与推理开销。

papers.title: Technical note on: Zero-Training Feature-Space Alignment via Information Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Deep vision models often degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation can improve robustness but typically requires iterative optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and multiple forward-backward passes. We propose Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA), a closed-form method that improves robustness under covariate shift without modifying model parameters. ZFGA is based on the observation that distribution shifts distort feature-space geometry. It estimates the Fisher information matrix of the predictive distribution with respect to feature embeddings and applies a linear transformation that aligns test-feature Fisher geometry with a reference geometry computed from clean data. This provides a natural-gradient-inspired preconditioning step in feature space. We evaluate ZFGA on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C using ResNet-50, DINO ViT-S/16, and CLIP ViT-B/32. ZFGA consistently improves over zero-shot inference across all three models, although it is not the strongest method for every model. Covariance whitening performs better on ResNet-50, while Fisher whitening is statistically indistinguishable from ZFGA on CLIP. Across six training-free and gradient-based alternatives (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, and AdaNPC), ZFGA is the only method that does not substantially harm any of the three model families. The Fisher geometry distortion is also positively correlated with ZFGA gain (Pearson r = 0.366, p = 0.017), providing preliminary evidence that geometric misalignment contributes to robustness degradation. ZFGA requires only forward passes and matrix operations at inference time, offering a lightweight and deterministic alternative to optimization-based test-time adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零训练的 Fisher 几何对齐 (ZFGA)：估计预测分布对特征嵌入的 Fisher 信息矩阵，用闭式线性变换把测试特征的 Fisher 几何对齐到干净数据的参考几何，只做前向传播与矩阵运算、不改模型参数。在 CIFAR-10-C 与 ImageNet-C 上对 ResNet-50、DINO ViT-S/16、CLIP ViT-B/32 均优于 zero-shot，且是六个对比方法中唯一不显著损害任一模型族的方法。
Motivation: 分布偏移会扭曲特征空间几何，现有测试时自适应 (TTA) 方法需要迭代优化、调超参和多次前向-反向传播，代价高且可能损害某些模型族。
Method: ZFGA 估计预测分布相对特征嵌入的 Fisher 信息矩阵，施加线性变换将测试特征的 Fisher 几何与干净数据参考几何对齐，相当于特征空间的 natural-gradient 预条件步骤；推理时仅需前向传播与矩阵运算，属确定性、免优化的 TTA。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10-C 和 ImageNet-C 上用 ResNet-50、DINO ViT-S/16、CLIP ViT-B/32 评测，ZFGA 在三个模型上均一致优于 zero-shot，但并非每个模型上最强：ResNet-50 上 covariance whitening 更好，CLIP 上 Fisher whitening 与 ZFGA 统计上无差别。与 covariance whitening、Fisher whitening、TENT、T3A、LAME、AdaNPC 六个免训练或基于梯度的方法相比，ZFGA 是唯一不显著损害任一模型族的方法。Fisher 几何扭曲程度与 ZFGA 增益正相关 (Pearson r = 0.366, p = 0.017)。
Conclusion: 几何失配是分布偏移下鲁棒性下降的一个贡献因素，用闭式 Fisher 几何对齐即可在不训练、不调参的前提下稳定提升鲁棒性，且是各模型族上最不伤性能的轻量选择。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across multiple benchmarks, including ImageNet, T-FCP enables practical full-conformal image classification with modest test-time overhead, yielding efficient prediction sets and more stable empirical coverage than split conformal alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP)：用轻量 inductive conformal predictor 先剪掉大标签空间中不太可能的标签，只对剩余候选做 full conformal prediction (FCP)，在保留组合 conformal 程序形式化覆盖保证的同时把测试时重拟合开销压到可实用的水平。在含 ImageNet 的多个基准上，T-FCP 以适度的测试时开销给出更高效的预测集，且经验覆盖比 split conformal 更稳定。
Motivation: split conformal prediction 数据效率低，而 full conformal prediction 虽统计效率更强，却要求测试时对每个候选标签重拟合模型，在大标签空间图像分类中计算上不可行。
Method: 以零样本 vision-language model (VLM) 为骨干：先用轻量 inductive conformal predictor 对标签剪枝，再对剩余候选执行 FCP；另提出 Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA)，一种基于 rank-one 逆协方差更新的高效 VLM 适配求解器。
Result: 在包括 ImageNet 在内的多个基准上，T-FCP 使 full-conformal 图像分类变得实用，测试时开销适度，预测集更高效，经验覆盖比 split conformal 替代方案更稳定；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用轻量剪枝加选择性 FCP 可以在大标签空间里兼顾覆盖保证与计算可行性，VLM 适配可用 SO-LDA 的秩一更新高效完成。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Why Cross-Skeleton Retargeting Is Non-Identifiable: Structural Limits of Generative Motion Models
papers.abstract_en: Cross-skeleton motion generation trains generative models to carry action structure and motion intention from one body to another. Yet a target motion that shows the right action has two explanations that the training data cannot tell apart: the model transferred the source clip, or it recovered a typical motion for the requested action. We show that this ambiguity is structural rather than incidental: under standard generative objectives, the source-conditioned retargeting map is non-identifiable in sparse heterogeneous motion domains. Unpaired distribution matching yields gauge non-identifiability: the latent spaces of different skeletons can be transformed relative to one another without changing the training evidence, so different source-conditioned maps fit it equally well. Sparse paired supervision admits the complementary failure mode, \emph{conditional-mean degeneration}: when clips are paired only by action, squared-error training converges to an average target motion that ignores the source clip. To make the missing evidence observable, we introduce Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF), a diagnostic that tests whether outputs differ from one another the way their source clips do, with the target skeleton and action held fixed. Under this diagnostic, methods that succeed at the standard action-level test on animal motion data often sit at the source-blind floor, while the methods that rise above it retain only a partial relational signal. Retargeting therefore needs objectives and evaluations that can identify the source-conditioned map it claims to learn. Project page: https://cross-skeleton-retargeting.netlify.app/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨骨架动作迁移在稀疏异构运动数据上存在结构性不可辨识：同一目标动作既可能来自源片段迁移，也可能只是该动作的典型运动，训练证据无法区分。无配对分布匹配产生规范非辨识（gauge non-identifiability），仅按动作配对的平方误差训练则退化为忽略源片段的条件均值。作者提出 Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF) 诊断，在动物运动数据上发现标准动作级测试成功的方法常落在源盲基线，勉强超过者也只保留部分关系信号。
Motivation: 跨骨架生成模型声称学习源条件化的重定向映射，但训练数据无法区分“迁移了源片段”与“生成了该动作的典型运动”，导致评估通过并不证明映射被学到。
Method: 在标准生成目标下分析源条件化重定向映射的不可辨识性，区分无配对分布匹配的规范非辨识与稀疏按动作配对监督下的条件均值退化（conditional-mean degeneration）；提出 Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF) 诊断，固定目标骨架与动作，检验输出之间的差异是否复现源片段之间的差异。
Result: 在动物运动数据上，通过标准动作级测试的方法在 SIF 下常处于源盲基线（source-blind floor），少数超过者仅保留部分关系信号；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 跨骨架重定向需要能辨识其声称学习的源条件化映射的目标函数与评估方式，现有动作级测试不足以支撑这一主张。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SafeLLM4SE: Statistical Evaluation and Reporting for LLM-based Software Engineering Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software engineering tasks, yet their stochastic behavior challenges the validity, reproducibility, and comparability of their evaluations. Conventional practices such as reporting a single output, an average score, best-of-N, or pass@k performance can obscure variability and estimation uncertainty, potentially leading to misleading conclusions about system reliability. This article presents SafeLLM4SE, a practical methodology and reporting standard for statistically principled evaluation of LLM-based software engineering systems. Rather than treating generated outputs as deterministic artifacts, SafeLLM4SE treats them as realizations of a stochastic process and distinguishes quality, stability, and estimation uncertainty. It combines adaptive sampling with confidence intervals, distribution-aware statistical comparisons, effect sizes, and a minimum reporting standard covering model configuration, reproducibility, evaluation procedures, and resource usage. SafeLLM4SE is also provided as an open-source software package available on PyPI, enabling researchers and practitioners to reproduce and extend the methodology. We illustrate its application by comparing two LLMs on HumanEval, a benchmark of programming problems assessed through functional tests.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeLLM4SE 把 LLM 生成结果当作随机过程的实现而非确定性产物，用自适应采样加置信区间、分布感知统计比较与效应量，区分质量、稳定性与估计不确定性，并给出覆盖模型配置、可复现性、评估流程和资源使用的最低报告标准。它以 PyPI 开源包形式发布，并在 HumanEval 上用两个 LLM 的对比演示用法。
Motivation: LLM 的随机性使单次输出、平均分、best-of-n 或 pass@k 这类常规报告掩盖变异与估计不确定性，导致对系统可靠性的误导性结论，跨系统比较也因此失效。
Method: SafeLLM4SE 组合自适应采样 (adaptive sampling)、置信区间、分布感知的统计比较与效应量，并规定一份最低报告标准（模型配置、可复现性、评估流程、资源使用）；方法以 PyPI 开源包发布，可在其上复现与扩展。
Result: 在 HumanEval（以功能测试评分的编程问题基准）上比较两个 LLM，作为方法应用示例；摘要未给出该对比的具体数值。
Conclusion: LLM 软件工程系统的评估应把输出当作随机过程实现，同时报告质量、稳定性与估计不确定性，而不是只报单点分数。

papers.title: VISTA-Bench: Benchmarking Multilingual Image Translation with Image-Specific Rubrics
papers.abstract_en: Image translation is a fundamental capability of multimodal models for multilingual applications, requiring visual understanding and meaning preservation across languages. However, existing benchmarks have limited language coverage and often lack explicit image-specific evaluation criteria, making it difficult to comprehensively assess this capability. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce VISTA-Bench, covering 22 languages and 10 domains, and develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol. The benchmark combines sampling for language and scenario coverage with model-assisted, human-verified annotations that group related text into coherent semantic units and provide multilingual reference translations. The rubrics specify essential content, semantic relations, and acceptable translation variants, yielding separate output-based scores for translation quality and the preservation of visual and knowledge-dependent information. We conduct extensive evaluations of 16 mainstream models, including 12 multimodal models and four text-input models, and provide systematic analyses across languages, domains, and evaluation dimensions.

papers.title: AssayRouter: Historical Utility Priors for Frozen Molecular Predictor Routing
papers.abstract_en: Laboratories often face a new molecular assay with 16-64 labels and a bank of predictors whose training data and parameters are unavailable. The practical question is which frozen outputs to include in a small local model. AssayRouter treats completed assays as pseudo-targets and labels each candidate by its post-fit utility: the reduction in held-out discovery loss when the candidate is added to the local target predictor. A shared regressor learns to predict this utility from candidate behavior on the support set, without source identity; on a new assay, one frozen ranking selects four sources and separate labels fit a convex combiner. We train only on completed ChEMBL-MT assays and evaluate 24 external regression assays across six frozen interface families. AssayRouter-C lowers strict four-call negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0409 relative to Support-CV@4. Frozen candidate-label permutations confirm that candidate-utility correspondence carries the transferred information, and leave-one-interface-out training shows that the mapping generalizes to unseen predictor families. Completed assays therefore provide transferable supervision for scarce-label routing through frozen prediction interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AssayRouter 把已完成的分子测定当作伪目标，用共享回归器预测每个冻结预测器候选在局部模型中的后拟合效用（加入后留出发现损失的下降量），再用一次冻结排序选出四个来源并拟合凸组合。在 24 个外部回归测定、六类冻结接口上，AssayRouter-C 把严格四次调用的 NLL 相对 Support-CV@4 降低 0.0409。
Motivation: 实验室拿到 16–64 标签的新分子测定，却只有训练数据与参数不可知的预测器库，无法判断该把哪些冻结输出纳入小型局部模型。
Method: 把完成的测定视为伪目标，按候选加入局部目标预测器后留出发现损失的下降量标注效用；共享回归器从候选在 support set 上的行为预测该效用且不使用来源身份；新测定上用一次冻结排序选四个来源，再用各自标签拟合凸组合。仅在完成的 ChEMBL-MT 测定上训练。
Result: 在 24 个外部回归测定、六类冻结接口上，AssayRouter-C 使严格四次调用的负对数似然 (NLL) 相对 Support-CV@4 降低 0.0409；冻结候选-标签置换确认信息来自候选与效用的对应关系；leave-one-interface-out 训练显示映射可泛化到未见过的预测器家族。
Conclusion: 已完成的测定能为标签稀缺场景下的冻结接口路由提供可迁移的监督，且候选-效用对应关系是迁移信息的载体。

papers.title: SAM Meets VLM: Parameter-Decoupled Full-Parameter Training for Unified Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected not only to answer clinical questions, but also to localize the visual evidence behind their predictions. A common strategy connects a vision--language model (VLM) with SAM-style segmentation through a special <SEG> token, yet full-parameter training of this unified architecture is difficult because image-level reasoning and pixel-level segmentation impose different requirements on the shared representation space. To address this issue, we propose a parameter-decoupled training framework for unified medical reasoning and segmentation. The framework treats the <SEG> hidden state as a semantic-to-spatial prompt for the mask decoder and encourages it to become separable from generic language states, reducing ambiguous segmentation prompts and potential disruption to reasoning representations. It first performs medical shallow alignment to adapt visual features to clinical language without disturbing the LLM; then controlled instruction tuning shapes separable <SEG> prompt states, monitored by the Davies--Bouldin Index (DBI), while scaling segmentation gradients entering the language backbone; finally, the SAM branch is specialized with the VLM frozen to improve mask precision without altering reasoning parameters. Experiments on medical referring segmentation, grounding, visual QA, and textual QA benchmarks show that our framework achieves strong language-conditioned segmentation while preserving competitive reasoning ability. Ablations show that two-phase instruction tuning, gradient scaling, and segmentation specialization all contribute to the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出参数解耦全参数训练框架，把 <SEG> 隐藏态当作 mask decoder 的语义到空间提示，并使其与通用语言状态可分，从而在统一医学推理与分割中同时保住分割精度与推理能力。三阶段训练（医学浅对齐、受 Davies–Bouldin Index 监控的受控指令微调加分割梯度缩放、VLM 冻结下的 SAM 分支专门化）在医学指代分割、grounding、视觉 QA 与文本 QA 基准上取得强语言条件分割并保持有竞争力的推理。
Motivation: 用 <SEG> token 连接 VLM 与 SAM 的统一架构难以做全参数训练：图像级推理与像素级分割对共享表示空间的要求互相冲突，分割提示含糊还会破坏推理表示。
Method: 三阶段参数解耦训练：先做医学浅对齐，把视觉特征适配到临床语言而不扰动 LLM；再做受控指令微调，塑造可分的 <SEG> 提示状态并用 Davies–Bouldin Index (DBI) 监控，同时缩放进入语言主干的分割梯度；最后冻结 VLM，只专门化 SAM 分支以提升 mask 精度。
Result: 在医学指代分割、grounding、视觉 QA 与文本 QA 基准上实现强语言条件分割并保持有竞争力的推理能力；消融显示两阶段指令微调、梯度缩放与分割专门化均有贡献。
Conclusion: 把分割提示与推理表示在参数和梯度上解耦，可让统一医学 MLLM 在不牺牲推理的前提下做好像素级定位，三个训练组件缺一不可。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Transolver-$σ$: Joint Spectral-Physical Subspace Modeling for Neural PDE Solving
papers.abstract_en: Neural solvers offer efficient surrogates for numerical simulation of partial differential equations (PDEs). For time-dependent problems, strong one-step accuracy does not necessarily translate into reliable autoregressive rollout. We observe that a solver based only on physical-state modeling can achieve lower one-step error, whereas its spectral-only counterpart can become more accurate at later rollout steps. Motivated by this observation, we present Transolver-$σ$, a neural PDE solver based on joint spectral--physical subspace modeling. Within each block, adaptive physical-state interactions and spectral transformations are modeled in dedicated latent subspaces, whose responses are recomposed to enable information exchange between the two representations. Within the physical subspace, we introduce Slice-Residual Physics-Attention (SRPA), which preserves an explicit slice-space identity path while retaining learnable cross-slice interaction. In parallel, an axis-factorized Fourier operator captures global spectral structure. Across five well-established PDE benchmarks spanning steady-state prediction and time-dependent dynamics, Transolver-$σ$ achieves state-of-the-art with a benchmark-averaged relative error reduction of 33.4% over the strongest baseline for each metric, while consistently improving autoregressive rollout over single-operator counterparts. Transolver-$σ$ further delivers strong gains on coupled multiphysics systems and real-world fluid and combustion measurements from RealPDEBench, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond standard simulation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Transolver-σ 把物理状态建模与谱变换放进同一网络的两个独立隐子空间并重组响应，配合 Slice-Residual Physics-Attention (SRPA) 与轴分解 Fourier 算子，缓解单算子模型一步误差低但自回归 rollout 后期变差的问题。在五个 PDE 基准上相对误差较各指标最强基线平均降低 33.4%，并在 RealPDEBench 的真实流体与燃烧测量上取得明显增益。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器中一步精度高不等于自回归 rollout 可靠：纯物理状态建模一步误差更低，纯谱方法却在后续 rollout 步更准，单一算子无法兼顾两者。
Method: 每个 block 内在专用隐子空间分别建模自适应物理状态交互与谱变换，再重组两路响应以交换信息；物理子空间用 SRPA 保留显式 slice-space 恒等路径并保留可学习的跨 slice 交互，谱侧用轴分解 (axis-factorized) Fourier 算子捕捉全局谱结构。
Result: 在覆盖稳态预测与时间动力学的五个公认 PDE 基准上，各指标相对最强基线的平均相对误差降低 33.4%，达到 state-of-the-art，并在自回归 rollout 上一致优于单算子对应模型；在耦合多物理系统以及 RealPDEBench 的真实流体与燃烧测量上也取得强增益。
Conclusion: 谱与物理子空间联合建模能同时保住一步精度与长 rollout 稳定性，且效果可外推到标准仿真基准之外的真实测量数据。

papers.title: Geometry-Aided Channel Deduction with Partial Channel Estimates and Uncalibrated Digital Twin
papers.abstract_en: The acquisition of high-dimensional channel state information (CSI) in wireless MIMO-OFDM communications usually requires high pilot overhead, or relies on accurate and complete positional or environmental information. In this paper, we propose a geometry-aided channel deduction (GCD) approach, which utilizes an uncalibrated digital twin (DT) with only approximate environmental geometry and positions to assist the channel acquisition. The key rationale behind is that, even imprecise geometric information, which can be easily obtained in advance through radio sensing technologies or existing geographic databases, provides certain structural features about the current channel; meanwhile, the coarse instantaneous channel estimates using only a small amount of pilots provide dedicated information that aligns with the channel structure and further compensates for the geometry inaccuracy and other channel unknowns. To this end, we first extract geometric features from the DT, which contain only simple structural information of the channel. Then we propose random prompt augmentation, a novel method to generate an appropriate prompt that converts geometric multi-path structure into a CSI-like representation while suppressing the disturbance of other unknown channel parameters. The prompt is then fused with the pilot-based instantaneous channel estimate via a channel deduction network. To further enhance the network's versatility, we incorporate pilot configurations into the existing learning architecture to support variable pilot patterns. Comprehensive experiments validate the superiority of the proposed method, which demonstrates high channel acquisition quality, low pilot overhead, and strong robustness. Furthermore, the structural prompt also serves as scenario-related context, enabling our approach to generalize well in new scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 MIMO-OFDM 信道估计，提出几何辅助信道推断 (GCD)：用只有近似几何与位置的未校准数字孪生 (uncalibrated digital twin) 提取多径结构，经随机提示增强 (random prompt augmentation) 转成 CSI 形式的结构提示，再与少量导频的瞬时信道估计在网络中融合。实验显示该方法信道获取质量高、导频开销低、鲁棒性强，并能借助结构提示泛化到新场景。
Motivation: MIMO-OFDM 获取高维 CSI 要么导频开销高，要么依赖精确完整的位置或环境信息；而实际中几何信息往往只能拿到粗糙版本。
Method: 从未校准 DT 提取几何特征，用随机提示增强把几何多径结构转成 CSI 形式提示并抑制其他未知信道参数干扰；信道推断网络把该提示与基于导频的瞬时估计融合，并把导频配置纳入学习架构以支持可变导频图案。
Result: 综合实验验证所提方法的优越性，表现为高信道获取质量、低导频开销与强鲁棒性；结构提示作为场景相关上下文使方法在新场景上泛化良好。
Conclusion: 粗糙几何加少量导频即可替代精确环境信息完成高质量信道获取，结构提示同时充当跨场景泛化的上下文。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals for Non-Injective Neural Mappings
papers.abstract_en: Non-injective mappings in neural networks map distinct inputs to the same representation, thereby implicitly inducing equivalence relations in the input space. However, the input differences eliminated by these mappings may still be required by downstream tasks, creating a mismatch between operator-induced indistinguishability and task-required distinctions. For non-injective linear operators realized in the current forward pass, their null spaces exactly characterize these invisible input variations. We propose Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals (NSR), a general residual framework for non-injective linear mappings. NSR combines null-space component extraction from pre-mapping representations, member-level encoding and gating, and application-specific integration to exploit potentially task-relevant information under downstream supervision while preserving the original aggregation or merging rules. We evaluate NSR in two structurally different settings: token merging and graph aggregation. In token merging, NSR achieves higher semantic segmentation performance than the corresponding compressed baselines in 34 out of 36 evaluated configurations, with a maximum observed gain of 31.51 mIoU points under strong compression. In graph aggregation, NSR achieves 100% training accuracy on Tree-NeighborsMatch at depths d=2--6 across three backbones, alongside gains on heterophilic node classification and molecular graph regression. Together, these results support null-space residuals as a practical complement to non-injective linear mappings, enabling downstream models to learn from input distinctions invisible in the original operator's output.

papers.title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym
papers.abstract_en: Proactive LLM agents can turn idle compute into useful support before users ask. Yet even correct work can misread user context, impose review costs, or undermine trust. This work proposes foundations for designing, realizing, and evaluating proactive LLM agents around three joint principles (3T): Task Capability, anticipating relevant needs and correctly performing useful work; Temporal Allocation, allocating compute according to resource availability and when results are needed; and Trust, sustaining users' confidence and appropriate reliance on the agent. We connect these objectives to a design space organized around five dimensions: task scope, anticipation horizon, activation trigger, processing timing, and intervention depth, and specify the situation and system modeling needed to support its choices, including user and environment representations, backbone LLMs, and agent harnesses. Lastly, we propose PROACTIVITY-GYM, a simulation-based evaluation testbed including multi-day scenarios, stateful environments, and persona-conditioned simulated users that can evaluate the consequences of proactive assistance across interactions. Evaluations across 23 model-harness configurations uncover substantial performance gaps across 3T and reveal that LLM judges often conflate task capability and trust. A human study with 30 participants demonstrates the importance of the joint 3T optimization: participants show sharp trust declines after intervention misalignment despite correct outcomes, and prefer sleep-time assistance, even when imperfect, to preserve ongoing focus. Together, these findings support designing and evaluating proactive agents through the joint consideration of useful work, compute allocation, and evolving user trust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出主动型 LLM agent 的 3T 设计基础：Task Capability、Temporal Allocation、Trust 三原则联合约束，并给出五维设计空间（任务范围、预期时长、激活触发、处理时机、介入深度）。PROACTIVITY-GYM 仿真测试床在 23 个 model-harness 配置上发现 3T 间存在显著性能差距，30 人人类实验显示介入错位即使结果正确也会让信任骤降，且用户偏好睡眠时段的不完美协助以保住当下专注。
Motivation: 主动 agent 在用户开口前自行开工，但即使做对了事也可能误读用户上下文、增加审核成本并损害信任；现有设计与评测缺少把任务能力、算力时序分配和信任放在一起考虑的框架。
Method: 以 3T 三原则（Task Capability、Temporal Allocation、Trust）为核心，连接到五维设计空间（task scope、anticipation horizon、activation trigger、processing timing、intervention depth），并规定支撑这些选择的情境与系统建模需求，包括用户与环境表征、backbone LLM 和 agent harness；提出 PROACTIVITY-GYM 仿真评测测试床，含多日场景、有状态环境和 persona 条件化的模拟用户。
Result: 在 23 个 model-harness 配置上的评测发现 3T 之间存在显著性能差距，且 LLM judge 常把 task capability 与 trust 混为一谈；30 名参与者的实验显示介入错位（intervention misalignment）即使结果正确也造成信任急剧下降，参与者偏好睡眠时段协助，即便不完美，以保护持续专注。
Conclusion: 主动 agent 的设计与评测必须把有用工作、算力分配和随交互演化的用户信任联合考虑，单看任务正确率会因 LLM judge 混淆能力与信任而误判。

papers.title: UniAfford: Token-Routed Multitask Learning for Generalizable 2D-3D Affordance Perception
papers.abstract_en: Affordance perception aims to localize actionable regions supporting embodied interaction, yet 2D and 3D affordance grounding have evolved as separate problems, with different task definitions, supervision formats, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This fragmentation limits the learning of transferable object-affordance semantics across visual and geometric spaces. We propose Token Router for Tasks, a multitask training paradigm for MLLM-based systems that routes contextual hidden states to task-specific branches without requiring the language head to generate predefined markers. Routed states are supervised directly by branch-specific objectives, enabling dense prediction losses to shape shared MLLM representations. We instantiate this paradigm as UniAfford, a unified framework for generalizable 2D-3D affordance perception, together with UniAfford-Data, a dataset integrating pixel-level 2D annotations, point-level 3D annotations, and language instructions under a shared object-affordance taxonomy, supporting heterogeneous supervision through semantic-level 2D-3D pairing. UniAfford adopts an MLLM as a shared semantic hub and a modality-aware token router to produce image- and point-cloud-affordance queries. These queries respectively condition a SAM-style pixel decoder and a SONATA-based point decoder, enabling flexible 2D, 3D, and joint affordance inference from image-only, point-cloud-only, or paired multimodal inputs. Experiments demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization across 2D and 3D affordance benchmarks without target-specific fine-tuning, alongside state-of-the-art branch-wise performance under modality-isolated protocols. Ablations validate token routing, joint 2D-3D supervision, and decoder coupling, while language-head diagnostics show that routed latent states carry meaningful object-affordance semantics. Project page: https://4dvlab.github.io/UniAfford
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniAfford 用 Token Router for Tasks 把 MLLM 的上下文隐状态按模态路由到 2D/3D affordance 分支，绕开语言头生成标记的限制，使稠密预测损失能直接塑造共享表征。配合统一的 UniAfford-Data 数据集，它在 2D 与 3D affordance 基准上实现无需目标域微调的零样本泛化，并在模态隔离协议下达到 branch-wise 最优。
Motivation: 2D 与 3D affordance grounding 在任务定义、监督格式、数据集和评测协议上各自演化，割裂阻碍了跨视觉与几何空间的可迁移 object-affordance 语义学习。
Method: 以 MLLM 为共享语义中枢，模态感知的 token router 产出图像与点云 affordance query，分别条件化 SAM-style 像素解码器与 SONATA 点解码器；路由后的隐状态由分支专属目标直接监督，无需语言头生成预定义标记。配套 UniAfford-Data 在统一 object-affordance 分类下整合像素级 2D、点级 3D 标注与语言指令，通过语义级 2D-3D 配对支持异构监督。
Result: 实验显示在 2D 与 3D affordance 基准上无需目标域微调即有强零样本泛化，并在模态隔离协议下取得 branch-wise 最优性能；消融验证 token routing、联合 2D-3D 监督与解码器耦合各自有效，语言头诊断表明路由隐状态携带有意义的 object-affordance 语义。
Conclusion: 用 token 路由把稠密预测损失引入共享 MLLM 表征，可以在不依赖语言头标记的前提下统一 2D 与 3D affordance 推理，并支持从仅图像、仅点云或成对多模态输入的灵活推断。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Attention Imbalance: Mitigating Hallucinations via Spectral Surgery
papers.abstract_en: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve remarkable success, hallucinations remain a significant barrier to their reliable deployment. Recent studies primarily attribute these issues to cross-modal attention imbalances; most solutions therefore focus on reweighting visual tokens or suppressing language priors. However, such approaches often overlook the spectral characteristics of the visual information flow and frequently rely on Contrastive Decoding (CD), which doubles inference time. Instead of following conventional approaches, we identify two distinct hallucination patterns-Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation and Localized Fixation-and propose FLASH (Frequency-Localized Attention SHaping), a training-free and CD-free framework. FLASH utilizes a Spectral Vortex Score to detect vision heads within multi-head attention layers and applies adaptive spectral modulation to rectify the visual information flow during decoding. Empirical results demonstrate that FLASH achieves a superior balance between performance and efficiency compared to SOTA methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLASH 用 Spectral Vortex Score 在多头注意力中定位视觉头，解码时对其做自适应频谱调制 (adaptive spectral modulation)，在不训练、不用 Contrastive Decoding 的前提下矫正视觉信息流，缓解 LVLM 幻觉并优于 SOTA 的性能-效率权衡。
Motivation: 现有幻觉归因集中在跨模态注意力失衡，靠重加权视觉 token 或压制语言先验，且多依赖 Contrastive Decoding，推理时间翻倍，视觉信息流的频谱特性被忽略。
Method: 训练-free、CD-free 的 FLASH 框架：先识别 Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation 与 Localized Fixation 两种幻觉模式，再用 Spectral Vortex Score 检测注意力层中的 vision heads，解码阶段对其施加自适应频谱调制以矫正视觉信息流。
Result: 实证结果显示 FLASH 在性能与效率的平衡上优于 SOTA 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 幻觉可从视觉信息流的频谱层面而非仅注意力重加权来缓解，且无需 CD 的双倍推理开销。

papers.title: Efficiently Approximating Attention Is Hard
papers.abstract_en: Softmax attention is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but its quadratic scaling with sequence length makes it costly. To reduce this cost, attention is often approximated with fast algorithms, which incur error but can still perform well in practice and on some inputs. At the same time, the growing diversity of attention applications makes approximation guarantees that do not depend on particular input structure a compelling target. For such uniform guarantees over all inputs, known runtime lower bounds rule out fast algorithms for near-exact attention, but leave open the practically important regime: is there an efficient algorithm with even a modest uniform approximation guarantee? We answer this question negatively. Under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions, no truly subquadratic algorithm can approximate attention with any nontrivial additive or relative guarantee uniformly over all inputs. This impossibility holds in the mildest parameter regime for which known algorithms do not already achieve strong approximation guarantees in near-linear time, and extends to practically relevant relaxations: even after polynomial preprocessing of the KV cache, no efficient algorithm can obtain a nontrivial uniform approximation guarantee, or identify a small set of keys receiving substantial attention under sparsity. Overall, our results settle the computational limits of uniform attention approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在标准复杂性假设下，不存在对所有输入一致成立的次二次时间 attention 近似算法：即使只要求很弱的加性或相对误差保证也不行。该不可能性还覆盖多项式预处理 KV cache 的情形，以及在稀疏性下找出承载大部分注意力的少量 key 这一任务。
Motivation: 现有 attention 近似算法的误差依赖输入结构，而运行时下界只排除了近似精确 attention 的快速算法；实践中真正想要的「对任意输入都成立的温和近似保证」是否存在高效算法，此前是开放问题。
Method: 在标准复杂性理论假设下做下界证明，参数区间取在已知算法尚不能于近线性时间给出强保证的最温和情形；论证同时扩展到允许对 KV cache 做多项式预处理的放松设定，以及稀疏性下识别承载显著注意力的少量 key 的问题。
Result: 证明不存在真正次二次时间的算法能对所有输入一致给出非平凡的加性或相对 attention 近似保证；即便允许对 KV cache 做多项式预处理，仍无高效算法获得非平凡一致近似保证或在稀疏性下识别承载显著注意力的少量 key。
Conclusion: 一致（input-uniform）的 attention 近似在计算上不可行，其极限由复杂性下界而非算法设计决定；因此近似算法的实用价值必须依赖输入结构假设。

papers.title: Collision-Aware and Observation-Aligned Object-Centric Scene Reconstruction from Point Cloud
papers.abstract_en: Object-centric scene reconstruction requires completing partial object observations while preserving metric alignment and avoiding collisions with the surrounding. Existing generation-based methods are often image-conditioned and suffer from scale ambiguity and insufficient geometric constraints. We propose COOL, a framework for COllision-aware and Observation-aLigned reconstruction. Based on an object generation model, COOL conditions the generation on instance and background point clouds. Instance geometry anchors generation in scene coordinates, while background geometry provides local context for scene-consistent completion. We further introduce an explicit collision loss and use joint optimization and resampling to reduce collisions during inference. Experiments on 3D-Front and Scan2CAD demonstrate strong scene-level fidelity, observation alignment, and collision reduction. Moreover, additional studies validate its robustness to mask errors and its applicability to real-world scene replicas.

Motivation: 物体中心场景重建要在补全部分观测的同时保持度量对齐并与周围不碰撞；现有生成式方法多以图像为条件，存在尺度歧义且几何约束不足。
Method: COOL（COllision-aware and Observation-aLigned）以物体生成模型为基础，用实例点云与背景点云共同条件化生成：实例几何锚定场景坐标，背景几何提供局部上下文；再引入显式碰撞损失，并在推理阶段用联合优化与重采样减少碰撞。
Result: 在 3D-Front 与 Scan2CAD 上展示强场景级保真、观测对齐与碰撞减少；额外研究验证其对 mask 误差的鲁棒性以及在真实场景复刻上的适用性。
Conclusion: 把点云条件化与显式碰撞约束放进生成式物体补全，可以在场景坐标内同时做到观测对齐和无碰撞的场景级重建。

papers.title: Loss-Guided Pretraining Data Selection for Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are pretrained on heterogeneous collections containing billions of observations, yet their training windows are typically sampled without estimating whether they provide useful learning signal. We introduce a static data-selection framework that scores each window with a reference forecaster and retains an intermediate interval within every source dataset. Specifically, we connect forecasting loss to optimization difficulty by showing that normalized squared loss controls the per-sample gradient norm under a local Jacobian condition. We then define a reference loss score and apply dataset-stratified selection to preserve the diversity of samples. Across various TSFM architectures, our method outperforms random selection by an absolute margin and even improves both relative MASE and CRPS over full-data pretraining by retaining fewer candidate pretraining windows. Further analyses show strong cross-scale and cross-architecture score correlations, indicating that a small reference model can often select data for larger targets, provided that the reference and target share compatible difficulty orderings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的静态预训练数据选择框架：用参考预报器给每个训练窗口打分，在每个源数据集内保留中间难度区间。在多种 TSFM 架构上，该选择在绝对幅度上优于随机采样，且只保留更少候选窗口时相对 MASE 与 CRPS 仍超过全量数据预训练。
Motivation: TSFM 的预训练数据达数十亿观测，但训练窗口通常直接随机采样，没有估计窗口是否提供有效学习信号，导致算力浪费在过易或过难的样本上。
Method: 在局部 Jacobian 条件下证明归一化平方损失控制单样本梯度范数，把预报损失与优化难度挂钩；据此定义 reference loss score，用参考预报器打分，并做按数据集分层 (dataset-stratified) 的选择以保留样本多样性，每个源数据集只留中间难度区间。
Result: 在多种 TSFM 架构上，该方法相对随机选择有绝对幅度上的领先；相比全量数据预训练，在保留更少候选预训练窗口的同时同时改善相对 MASE 与 CRPS。进一步分析显示分数在跨尺度与跨架构间高度相关。
Conclusion: 只要参考模型与目标模型的难度排序兼容，小的参考模型就足以替更大的目标模型选数据，因此预训练数据选择可以只保留中等难度窗口而不损失甚至改善预报质量。

papers.title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, pretraining the predictor on DROID video--instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for effective WAM learning from task-specific demonstrations and for transferring future-modeling knowledge acquired from broader in-the-wild videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-JEPA Policy 在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 视觉 latent 上，从零联合训练指令条件的未来 latent 预测器与 flow-matching 动作专家，用预测器的未来上下文 key-value 状态去条件化动作生成。0.9B 总参数（0.6B 可训练）在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa-GR1 上达到与代表性 WAM 和 vision-language-action 基线相当的性能，且在分布偏移下更稳。
Motivation: 现有 world-action model 靠改编大规模预训练的视频生成或图像编辑模型来继承预测知识，代价是连带整个生成模型；问题在于仅靠预测式视觉 latent 空间能否独立支撑有效的 WAM 学习。
Method: 冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器，其 latent 上构建指令条件未来 latent 预测器与 flow-matching 动作专家，两者在单一下游阶段从零联合训练，预测器的未来信息上下文 key-value 状态作为动作生成的条件；另在 DROID 视频-指令对（无动作标签）上预训练预测器再适配为 WAM。
Result: 0.9B 总参数、0.6B 可训练，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa-GR1 上与代表性 WAM 和 VLA 基线相当；同框架同训练预算下对比多种视觉基础，V-JEPA latent 优于判别式、重建式和视频理解导向的替代方案，分布偏移下优势更明显；DROID 无动作标签预训练后适配带来下游控制与 OOD 泛化的显著提升。
Conclusion: 预测式视觉 latent 足以作为 WAM 的学习基础，无需继承完整的预训练视觉生成模型，并可把野外视频中学到的未来建模知识迁移到机器人控制。

papers.title: Codebook-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Structurally Heterogeneous Features
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher modality to a student modality. Existing feature-level alignment methods typically assume that teacher and student features reside in structurally alignable representation spaces. However, this assumption does not hold when cross-modal features are structurally heterogeneous and lack clear unit-level correspondence, such as 2D spatial visual grids and 1D temporal audio sequences, thereby limiting the applicability of feature-level alignment. To address this challenge, we propose a cross-modal distillation framework that enables effective knowledge transfer across structurally heterogeneous feature spaces via a vector-quantized codebook. Specifically, teacher features are abstracted into a set of vector-form codes regardless of their original feature structure, and the selected codes serve as concept-level anchors for student learning. Code selection is guided by both task relevance and student compatibility, allowing the student to receive transferable teacher knowledge without requiring direct unit-level feature alignment. Experimental results across diverse cross-modal distillation scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on classification and semantic segmentation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于向量量化 codebook 的跨模态知识蒸馏框架，把教师特征抽象成与原始结构无关的向量码，选码同时受任务相关性与学生兼容性约束，作为学生学习的概念级锚点，从而绕开 2D 空间网格与 1D 时序这类结构异质特征的单元级对齐。在分类与语义分割的多种跨模态蒸馏场景中验证有效。
Motivation: 现有特征级对齐方法假设师生特征处在可对齐的表示空间，但 2D 视觉网格与 1D 音频序列这类结构异质特征缺少清晰的单元级对应，使特征级跨模态蒸馏难以适用。
Method: 提出 codebook 引导的跨模态蒸馏：教师特征被向量化编码为一组与原结构无关的 code，选码由任务相关性与学生兼容性共同引导，选中的码作为概念级锚点指导学生，无需单元级特征对齐。
Result: 在多种跨模态蒸馏场景下，于分类与语义分割任务上展示了该框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 结构异质的跨模态特征可以通过共享的向量码空间传递知识，而不必依赖可对齐的表示结构。
Relevance: 2
