papers.title: Trident: Unifying Guarded Dispatch and Host Execution for PyTorch Triton Workloads
papers.abstract_en: User-written Triton kernels enable high-performance GPU computation within PyTorch, but their end-to-end latency can remain dominated by host-side orchestration, especially when device execution is short. Although torch.compile can generate native host wrappers for captured graphs, each invocation still passes through runtime-managed specialization lookup, guard evaluation, and preparation before reaching the wrapper. We present Trident, a compiler backend that removes this recurring overhead from the specialization cache-hit path. Trident introduces the Specialization Cache Module (SCM), which compiles guarded specialization selection, argument and execution-environment preparation, and host execution for multiple specializations into a single executable module. An invocation enters the SCM once, remains in compiled code when a specialization matches, and returns to Python only when a new specialization must be compiled. Built on Torch-MLIR, Trident lowers guards and host-side orchestration to native code while retaining calls to optimized runtime implementations of supported ATen operators. Our evalu- ation on two LLMs shows that Trident achieves up to a 1.47x speedup in model-level end-to-end latency over eager execution and up to 1.68x over torch.compile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Trident 是面向 PyTorch Triton 短内核的编译器后端，把 guard 判定、特化选择、参数与执行环境准备、以及多特化的宿主执行整体编译成单一可执行模块 (SCM)：命中特化缓存时全程留在编译代码内，只有需要新特化才返回 Python。在两个 LLM 上，模型级端到端延迟相对 eager 最高加速 1.47x，相对 torch.compile 最高 1.68x。
Motivation: 用户手写的 Triton 内核设备执行很短时，端到端延迟被宿主侧编排吃掉；torch.compile 虽生成原生宿主包装，但每次调用仍要经过运行时管理的特化查找、guard 求值与准备。
Method: 提出编译器后端 Trident，核心是 Specialization Cache Module (SCM)，把带 guard 的特化选择、参数与执行环境准备、以及多个特化的宿主执行编译为单个可执行模块；基于 Torch-MLIR 将 guard 与宿主编排下沉为原生代码，同时保留对受支持 ATen 算子优化运行时实现的调用。
Result: 在两个 LLM 上，模型级端到端延迟相对 eager 最高 1.47x 加速，相对 torch.compile 最高 1.68x 加速。
Conclusion: 把特化缓存命中路径上的 guard 与宿主编排整体编译进一个模块，可以消除 Triton 短内核场景下反复发生的宿主侧开销，从而在模型级延迟上超过 eager 与 torch.compile。

papers.title: Differentiating Bisimulation Metrics: A Framework for Parametric Markov Chain Fitting via Bicausal Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Many problems in sequential decision-making, such as imitation learning from observations, state-space compression, world-model learning, and sim-to-real transfer, can be reduced to learning a model such that a notion of distance with respect to the target process is minimized. We consider this general framework and consider the bisimulation metric, equivalently Bicausal Optimal Transport (BOT), as the notion of distance to minimize. We show that BOT, since it can be formulated as a linear program (LP), is differentiable with respect to the model dynamics. We then derive an exact closed-form gradient via the envelope theorem applied to the LP saddle point. The result is a general algorithm, Differentiable Bicausal Optimal Transport (D-BOT), that can be applied to each of the problems above. The proposed algorithm learns the best model by alternating between distance computation and gradient steps. We apply D-BOT for three different settings: state-space compression, parametric model learning, and imitation learning from observations (ILfO). We show empirical results that confirm the viability of all three instantiations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 D-BOT：把 bisimulation metric 等价的 Bicausal Optimal Transport (BOT) 写成线性规划，用包络定理对 LP 鞍点求导，得到关于模型动力学的精确闭式梯度，从而可对参数化模型做梯度下降式拟合。算法在状态空间压缩、参数化模型学习、模仿学习 (ILfO) 三个设定上给出实证结果，验证三种实例化可行。
Motivation: 从观测做模仿学习、状态空间压缩、世界模型学习与 sim-to-real 迁移，都可归结为学一个使某种距离最小的模型；但 bisimulation metric / BOT 这类距离对模型动力学不可微，难以直接用梯度法优化。
Method: 将 BOT 表述为线性规划 (LP)，证明其对模型动力学可微，并用包络定理作用于 LP 鞍点导出精确闭式梯度；D-BOT 算法在距离计算与梯度步之间交替，学习最优模型，可套用到上述各类问题。
Result: 在状态空间压缩、参数化模型学习、模仿学习从观测 (ILfO) 三个设定上给出实证结果，确认三种实例化均可行。
Conclusion: BOT 作为可微距离配合闭式梯度，能把 bisimulation 度量下的模型拟合变成可交替优化的通用算法，适用于多类序列决策建模问题。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents
papers.abstract_en: An agent that uses tools typically responds to what the user explicitly asks, yet completing the task may require information the user never requested. Work on proactive agents mainly studies whether and when an agent should act on its own, not what information it should pursue. We study a distinct axis of proactivity: its content. Horizontal proactivity pursues unstated information that the current context already identifies, and vertical proactivity pursues needs that only earlier evidence reveals. A need graph, recovered from a benchmark's own decomposition, records which needs depend on which, so both forms, and whether the agent stops at the right time, can be scored from a transcript without a model judge. To learn this behavior, we propose Q&D (questioner and drafter), which trains a questioner to prefer the question whose continuation retrieves more of the required evidence, with no reward model or judge. On held-out splits of three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, at equal retrieval spend, the trained questioner improves both forms of proactivity over the same model, prompted, and outperforms a prompted model $15\times$ larger in the same role on two of the three, and the gain persists after controlling for question volume and length. Without further training, we place the questioner in an interactive customer-service agent with a simulated customer, where it completes more tasks while asking fewer questions, and in retail it outperforms the $15\times$ larger model with fewer follow-up turns from the customer. These results show that proactivity depends not only on whether an agent acts without being asked, but also on what it chooses to pursue and when it stops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出智能体主动性的内容维度：horizontal proactivity 追当前上下文已指明的未言明信息，vertical proactivity 追只有早期证据才暴露的需求，并用从 benchmark 自身分解恢复的 need graph 在无模型评委的情况下从对话记录打分。训练方法 Q&D（questioner + drafter）让 questioner 偏好能检索到更多所需证据的续写，在三个多跳 QA benchmark 的 held-out 划分上、同等检索开销下同时提升两种主动性，并在其中两个上超过大 15 倍的 prompted 模型。
Motivation: 现有 proactive agent 研究主要问智能体该不该自主行动，没有刻画它该主动追求什么信息；而完成任务常需要用户从未开口要的信息，缺少对主动性内容与停止时机的可评分定义。
Method: 从 benchmark 自带的任务分解恢复 need graph（记录需求间依赖），据此对 horizontal/vertical 两种主动性以及是否在正确时机停止打分，全程不依赖 reward model 或 model judge。训练侧提出 Q&D：训练 questioner 使其偏好那个续写后能检索到更多必需证据的问题。
Result: 在三个多跳问答 benchmark 的 held-out 划分上，同等检索开销下训练出的 questioner 相对同一模型的 prompted 版本同时提升两种主动性，且在其中两个 benchmark 上胜过同角色大 15 倍的模型；增益在控制问题数量与长度后仍然保持。不加训练地接入带模拟顾客的交互式客服 agent 后，完成更多任务同时问更少问题，零售场景下用更少追问轮次胜过那个 15 倍大的模型。
Conclusion: 主动性不仅取决于是否在未被要求时行动，还取决于选择追求什么以及何时停止；用 need graph 可以在无模型评委的条件下对这两点打分，并可通过 Q&D 训练改善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DatalogBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Text-to-Datalog Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Datalog underpins reasoning tasks such as program analysis, but its programs are hard to write. Existing synthesizers automate this task but require users to state their intent as input-output examples. Large language models (LLMs) suggest a more natural route, text-to-Datalog synthesis from a natural-language question, yet how well they do so has not been systematically evaluated. We present DatalogBench, a benchmark of 136 text-to-Datalog synthesis tasks curated from existing Datalog-based artifacts. Synthesized programs are graded by execution on held-out inputs against an oracle validated by mutation analysis. Across six LLMs and four prompting configurations, exact match peaks at 68.4%, and relation descriptions or an input-output example have only modest, model-dependent effects. Under direct prompting, most failures occur at compile time, typically because a model invents auxiliary predicates that it never declares or types consistently. Two coding agents reach up to 83.8% and eliminate nearly all such failures, leaving mostly semantic errors concentrated in recursive tasks. DatalogBench thus identifies recursive reasoning and decomposition as open challenges for current LLMs and agents, and offers a reliable, execution-grounded measure of both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DatalogBench 是一个含 136 个任务的 text-to-Datalog 合成基准，程序按 held-out 输入上的执行结果对照经 mutation analysis 验证的 oracle 打分。六个 LLM 加四种提示配置下 exact match 最高 68.4%，直接提示的失败多在编译期（模型发明未声明或类型不一致的辅助谓词）；两个 coding agent 最高 83.8% 并几乎消除此类失败，剩余错误集中在递归任务的语义层面。
Motivation: 现有 Datalog 合成器要求用户以输入-输出示例表达意图，而 LLM 提供了从自然语言问题直接生成 Datalog 的更自然路径，但其实际能力此前没有被系统评测。
Method: 从既有 Datalog 工件整理 136 个 text-to-Datalog 任务；合成程序在 held-out 输入上执行，与经 mutation analysis 验证的 oracle 对比打分；评测覆盖六个 LLM 与四种提示配置，并对比直接提示与 coding agent。
Result: exact match 最高 68.4%；关系描述或输入-输出示例只带来幅度 modest 且依赖模型的影响；直接提示下多数失败发生在编译期，典型原因是模型发明未声明或类型不一致的辅助谓词；两个 coding agent 最高达 83.8%，几乎消除此类失败，剩余多为集中在递归任务上的语义错误。
Conclusion: 递归推理与任务分解仍是当前 LLM 与 agent 在程序合成上的开放挑战，DatalogBench 提供了执行落地 (execution-grounded) 的可靠度量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Addressing: Auditing Linguistic Access to Frozen Visual Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Visual distinctions are often finer than those reflected in linguistic conceptualization. Vision-language models exhibit a similar asymmetry: a distinction can remain discriminable in frozen image geometry while being weakly addressable through the native text interface. We study this gap by separating visual discriminability from linguistic addressability in text-to-image retrieval. Using FactorAtlas, a fully crossed testbed of 23,040 images spanning shape, hue, pattern, and nuisance variation, we compare both readouts on held-out images of the same distinctions. We then derive image-side contrasts that separate each value from its alternatives for matched visual grounding, and test whether this reduces the native-text access gap across factors and models. Direction-specific and visual-absence controls tie these gains to the relevant visual contrast; the gains persist after global alignment and extend to compositional retrieval and natural images. Together, these results show that visual discriminability and linguistic addressability need not coincide, and that matched visual grounding can probe and reduce the resulting access gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出视觉可判别性与语言可寻址性 (linguistic addressability) 的分离框架：一个区分在冻结图像几何中可分，却难以通过原生文本接口寻址。用 23,040 张图像的全交叉测试集 FactorAtlas 在文本到图像检索上比较两种读出，并构造匹配视觉基底的图像侧对比，可缩小原生文本访问差距，且增益在全局对齐后仍保持。
Motivation: 视觉区分常比语言概念化更细，VLM 中冻结表征可分的区分可能无法经文本接口访问，导致文本到图像检索出现访问差距。
Method: 构建 FactorAtlas 全交叉测试集（23,040 张图像，覆盖 shape、hue、pattern 与 nuisance 变化），在同一批区分的留出图像上比较视觉判别读出与语言寻址读出；再推导图像侧对比把每个取值与其备选项在匹配视觉基底下分离，测试其是否缩小访问差距，并用方向特定与视觉缺失对照验证增益来源。
Result: 在 23,040 张图像的 FactorAtlas 上比较两种读出；图像侧对比在各因子与各模型上缩小原生文本访问差距，增益通过方向特定与视觉缺失对照、在全局对齐后仍持续，并扩展到组合检索与自然图像。
Conclusion: 视觉判别性与语言寻址性不必一致；匹配视觉基底既能探测也能缩小这一访问差距。

papers.title: AESOP: Asymmetric Human-Camera Generation with Translation-Intensity Control
papers.abstract_en: Human motion defines an action, while a camera trajectory determines how it is presented. Camera generation for a given human motion and joint human-camera generation are usually treated as separate tasks, although both share an asymmetric dependency: human motion can be generated independently, whereas the camera responds to the realized action. We introduce AESOP, a unified framework with an independent human pathway and a shared human-conditioned camera generator. Its asymmetric architecture serves both tasks while preserving the human output during camera generation. Although human context anchors the shot to the action and camera text describes its movement, translation intensity remains underspecified. We therefore construct trajectory pairs that differ in camera translation magnitude while sharing human motion and camera text, then use these pairs to learn an explicit intensity condition. Experiments on the PulpMotion dataset demonstrate strong camera distributional and framing quality in both tasks and effective control over camera translation intensity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AESOP 把相机生成与人-相机联合生成统一成非对称架构：人体通路独立生成，相机生成器以人体动作为条件，从而在生成相机时保住人体输出。针对同一人体动作与相机文本下平移幅度仍欠定的问题，构造仅平移量级不同的人-相机文本配对轨迹对，从中学习显式的平移强度条件。在 PulpMotion 数据集上，两项任务都展现出强的相机分布与构图质量，并能有效控制相机平移强度。
Motivation: 给定人体动作的相机生成与人-相机联合生成通常被当作两个独立任务，但两者共享非对称依赖：人体动作可独立生成，相机必须响应已实现的动作；同时相机文本无法指定平移幅度。
Method: 统一框架 AESOP：独立的人体通路 + 共享的以人体动作为条件的相机生成器，相机生成期间保持人体输出不变；构造共享人体动作与相机文本、仅平移量级不同的轨迹对，用这些配对学习显式的平移强度条件。
Result: 在 PulpMotion 数据集上，相机生成与人-相机联合生成两项任务均展现强的相机分布质量与构图 (framing) 质量，并对相机平移强度实现有效控制。
Conclusion: 非对称的人体-相机分工加显式平移强度条件，可以在一个框架内同时服务两项任务并保留对平移幅度的可控性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interacting particle guidance for sampling reward-tilted generative priors
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow-based models to new tasks, e.g., to generate samples from a conditional distribution or samples with desired properties, without retraining. This can be formalized as sampling from a reward-tilted generative prior. As exact sampling from this distribution is intractable, guidance-based methods rely on approximations producing biased samples, and sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods correct for this bias using importance weights. However, while exact in the large particle limit, SMC suffers from weight degeneracy and particle collapse in practice. We propose interacting particle guidance (IPG), which replaces reweighting with transport. The particles interact through an additional drift, derived from the Feynman--Kac PDE to cancel the reweighting term, and remain unweighted. Choosing the drift in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space yields a closed-form solution that is cheap to compute, with negligible overhead compared to SMC. We demonstrate the method on Gaussian mixtures with known posteriors, and on high-dimensional image inpainting and protein structure inference tasks.
papers.comment: Code will be made available after publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 interacting particle guidance (IPG)，用粒子间额外漂移替代 SMC 的重要性重加权，从 Feynman–Kac PDE 推出的漂移取在再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS) 中有闭式解，计算开销相对 SMC 可忽略。在已知后验的高斯混合、高维图像补全与蛋白质结构推断任务上演示了该方法。
Motivation: 推理时对扩散/流模型做任务适配可形式化为从 reward-tilted 先验采样，但精确采样难解：guidance 类近似有偏，SMC 能纠偏却在实践中出现权重退化与粒子坍缩。
Method: IPG 用输运 (transport) 取代重加权：粒子通过由 Feynman–Kac PDE 导出的附加漂移相互作用以抵消重加权项，粒子始终保持无权重；漂移函数空间选为 RKHS，从而得到闭式解。
Result: 在已知后验的高斯混合、高维图像补全 (image inpainting) 与蛋白质结构推断任务上演示；闭式漂移计算廉价，相对 SMC 开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 以 RKHS 中的相互作用漂移替代重要性重加权，可以在避免权重退化与粒子坍缩的同时保持对 reward-tilted 后验的纠偏能力。

papers.title: Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search
papers.abstract_en: Answering questions and completing tasks over large document collections often requires connecting evidence spread across multiple documents, such as a project's approval recorded in one, its requirements in another, and its latest status in a third. Recent LLM agents approach this by iteratively searching the full corpus rather than reading only a fixed set of top-ranked documents. However, when the corpus is exposed only as a flat collection of files, a relevant document gives no indication of how it relates to others, so the agent must rediscover these relationships for every query, often missing complementary evidence while simultaneously consuming substantial additional tokens. To address this, we introduce CorpusMap, a navigation layer that organizes the corpus around its recurring entities, which are identifiable from the documents themselves and can link a single document to many others across sources. Specifically, CorpusMap represents each recurring entity as an Entity Page that aggregates information about it and links to every document that refers to it, forming a graph between entities and documents that the agent can traverse to gather otherwise disconnected evidence. Moreover, since CorpusMap is constructed offline by resolving mentions of the same entity across documents, its links are shared across queries rather than rediscovered repeatedly at inference time. Using 7 different models with 3 benchmark datasets, we show that CorpusMap improves both evidence discovery and answer quality over raw-corpus agentic search while using fewer tokens on average, and further outperforms 4 alternative navigation layers, suggesting that entities serve as effective anchors for navigating large document collections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CorpusMap 为语料库加一层离线构建的实体导航：把反复出现的实体做成 Entity Page，聚合其信息并链接到所有提及该文档，形成实体-文档图供 agent 遍历。在 7 个模型、3 个基准上，它相对原始语料的 agentic search 同时提升证据发现与答案质量且平均用更少 token，并超过 4 种替代导航层。
Motivation: 语料库若只以扁平文件集合暴露，单个相关文档不显示与其他文档的关系，agent 每次查询都要重新发现这些关联，既漏掉互补证据又消耗大量额外 token。
Method: 离线解析跨文档的同名实体提及，为每个反复出现的实体构建 Entity Page，聚合其信息并链接到所有提及它的文档，形成实体-文档二部图；agent 在推理时直接遍历该图，链接跨查询共享而非每次重新发现。
Result: 在 7 个不同模型与 3 个基准数据集上，CorpusMap 相对 raw-corpus agentic search 同时改善证据发现与答案质量，且平均使用更少 token；并超过 4 种替代导航层 (navigation layers)。
Conclusion: 实体可作为导航大型文档集合的有效锚点，离线构建的共享链接比推理时反复重发现关系更划算。

papers.title: ResComEmb: Effective and Efficient Multimodal Embedding via Residual Homogeneity Compression
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for universal multimodal representation learning. However, existing methods either compress each input into a single vector, limiting fine-grained expressiveness, or retain long sequences of visual-token vectors, incurring substantial storage and interaction costs. To resolve this trade-off, we propose ResComEmb, a trainable framework for effective and efficient universal multi-vector multimodal embedding. ResComEmb first encodes each input at native dynamic resolution into ordered global, intermediate, and fine-grained views. After MLLM contextualization and embedding projection, a trainable Residual Homogeneity Compression (RHC) module reduces within-granularity redundancy and cross-granularity repetition under explicit visual token budgets. Then, ResComEmb introduces a length-adaptive Bidirectional Late-Interaction Matching mechanism for robust query-document scoring, which averages the strongest token-level matches in each direction and combines the two scores using a weight based on how many valid tokens each side has. Extensive experiments on MMEB, ViDoRe V1, and ViDoRe V2 show that ResComEmb produces higher-quality universal multimodal embeddings than VLM2Vec-V2, and outperforms ColQwen2.5 in visual document retrieval using only 37.5% of its full visual token budget, demonstrating a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResComEmb 是一个可训练的多向量多模态嵌入框架：按原生动态分辨率把输入编码成全局/中间/细粒度三层视图，经 MLLM 上下文化后用 Residual Homogeneity Compression (RHC) 在显式视觉 token 预算下压掉同粒度冗余与跨粒度重复，再用长度自适应的双向 Late-Interaction 打分。在 MMEB、ViDoRe V1/V2 上，其通用多模态嵌入质量高于 VLM2Vec-V2，且只用 ColQwen2.5 全部视觉 token 预算的 37.5% 就在视觉文档检索上超过它。
Motivation: 现有方法要么把每个输入压成单向量、损失细粒度表达，要么保留长序列视觉 token 向量、带来高昂存储与交互成本，效果与效率难以兼得。
Method: 先按原生动态分辨率编码出有序的全局、中间、细粒度视图，经 MLLM 上下文化与嵌入投影后，由可训练的 Residual Homogeneity Compression (RHC) 模块在显式视觉 token 预算内削减粒度内冗余与跨粒度重复；打分用长度自适应的 Bidirectional Late-Interaction Matching，对每个方向上最强的 token 级匹配取平均，再按双方有效 token 数量加权合成双向分数。
Result: 在 MMEB、ViDoRe V1、ViDoRe V2 上，ResComEmb 产出的通用多模态嵌入质量高于 VLM2Vec-V2；视觉文档检索上超过 ColQwen2.5，而只使用后者完整视觉 token 预算的 37.5%。
Conclusion: 在显式 token 预算下做残差同质性压缩配合双向 late-interaction 打分，可以在多模态嵌入上同时拿到更高质量与更低视觉 token 开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OptiCom : A Unified Framework for State-Conditioned Composition in LLM-Driven Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to solve complex scientific and practical problems via iterative optimization. However, dynamically coordinating diverse search mechanisms as candidate quality, failure modes, and resource budgets evolve remains a critical open challenge. Targeted empirical diagnostics reveal that mechanism effectiveness is highly state-dependent. Motivated by this, we analyze how individual decisions drive final outcomes, decomposing the expected terminal improvement under a shared budget into cumulative decision opportunities minus cumulative selection losses. Guided by this opportunity-loss theoretical foundation, we propose OptiCom, a unified framework that represents LLM-driven optimizers within a shared configuration space: C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S), corresponding to artifact, query, operator, evaluation, memory, and strategy. Operating within this space, a fast LLM-based Optimization Controller dynamically composes immediate mechanisms through structured Action Packages, while a slower Strategy Adapter refines long-term selection preferences, operator weights, and templates based on accumulated trajectory feedback. Comprehensive evaluations across 32 benchmark groups demonstrate the superiority of framework: OptiCom achieves an average Max-score rank of 1.72 among 14 evaluated configurations, securing the top score in 23 groups. Ultimately, these results highlight the broad applicability and high extensibility of OptiCom as a general-purpose paradigm for robust LLM test-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OptiCom 把 LLM 驱动的优化器统一进配置空间 C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S)，由快速的 Optimization Controller 用结构化 Action Package 即时组合机制，慢速的 Strategy Adapter 依据轨迹反馈调整长期选择偏好、算子权重与模板。在 32 个 benchmark group 上，14 种配置中平均 Max-score 排名 1.72，并在 23 个 group 上取得最高分。
Motivation: LLM 迭代优化中，候选质量、失败模式与资源预算随进程变化，如何动态调度多种搜索机制仍是开放问题；实证诊断显示机制有效性高度依赖状态。
Method: 先给出 opportunity-loss 理论分解：把共享预算下的期望终端改进拆成累计决策机会减累计选择损失；据此在统一配置空间 C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S)（artifact、query、operator、evaluation、memory、strategy）上运行双层控制——LLM Optimization Controller 组合即时 Action Package，Strategy Adapter 依据累积轨迹反馈精修长期偏好、算子权重与模板。
Result: 在 32 个 benchmark group 的综合评测中，OptiCom 在 14 个被评配置里平均 Max-score 排名为 1.72，并在其中 23 个 group 上拿到最高分。
Conclusion: 以状态为条件、双时间尺度地组合搜索机制，可作为通用且可扩展的 LLM test-time scaling 范式。

papers.title: Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive Hypergraph Transformer for Brain Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Exploring high-order correlations and long-range dependencies in brain networks holds significant value for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnosis. However, previous studies have lacked a unified integration of high-order and long-range dependency information in brain networks, and there is substantial redundancy behind various types of information. These issues limit their effectiveness in the diagnosis of brain diseases. To address this, we propose an Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive HyperGraph Transformer (IBAHGT). By incorporating the information bottleneck (IB) principle, this approach enables adaptive learning of high-order correlations and both short- and long-range dependencies within a unified framework for brain network analysis, achieving high-precision brain disease diagnosis. IBAHGT consists of three key components: an information bottleneck-guided adaptive hypergraph convolution, which introduces a novel hypergraph information bottleneck (HIB) principle to adaptively learn hypergraph message-passing weights between nodes and hyperedges, optimizes information flow and captures high-order information in brain networks that is maximally informative and minimally redundant (MIMR). The Transformer encoder captures global information within brain networks through the attention mechanism, specifically modeling short- and long-range dependencies. An information bottleneck-guided node-level adaptive fusion employs the IB principle to learn independent weights for each node, facilitating the fine-grained integration of high-order information and global information to obtain an efficient representation for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods and can identify biomarkers for clinical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 IBAHGT：用超图信息瓶颈 (HIB) 自适应学习脑网络节点与超边间的消息传递权重，配合 Transformer 编码器建模短程与长程依赖，再以 IB 引导的节点级自适应融合高阶与全局信息。在脑疾病诊断实验中超过当前 SOTA 方法，并能识别临床生物标志物。
Motivation: 脑网络分析缺少高阶关联与长程依赖的统一建模，且各类信息冗余严重，限制了脑疾病诊断精度。
Method: IBAHGT 三组件：信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图卷积，用 HIB 原则学习节点-超边消息传递权重并最大化信息、最小化冗余 (MIMR)；Transformer 编码器用注意力捕获全局短程与长程依赖；IB 引导的节点级自适应融合为每个节点学独立权重，整合高阶与全局表示供下游任务。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法优于当前 SOTA 方法，并可识别用于临床应用的生物标志物。
Conclusion: 把信息瓶颈原则同时注入超图卷积与节点级融合，可在统一框架内兼顾高阶关联与长程依赖，实现高精度脑疾病诊断。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic Narrowing: Robust and Efficient LLM Watermarking with Hamming Neighborhoods
papers.abstract_en: Semantic watermarking improves robustness against watermark removal attacks by embedding detectable signals into sentence-level representations. However, existing watermarking methods typically impose watermark-specific semantic preferences on generated sentences without explicitly accounting for the highly non-uniform and context-dependent semantic preference of LLM generation. When these two preferences are poorly aligned, many natural continuations become incompatible with the watermark, causing semantic narrowing: reduced semantic freedom, increased resampling cost, and potential degradation on tasks with strict semantic requirements. To alleviate this problem, we propose HammingMark, which uses the semantic hash of the preceding sentence as a dynamic center and accepts candidates whose hashes fall within its Hamming neighborhood. Defining watermark validity over a Hamming neighborhood in compact hash space retains a larger fraction of naturally likely semantic continuations. The coarse many-to-one hash mapping further allows diverse semantic realizations to remain watermark-valid. Experiments on C4 and BookSum show that HammingMark achieves strong robustness, high detectability, and near-unwatermarked generation quality, requiring only 2.2 sampled candidates per accepted sentence,a 72.8% reduction compared with the most sampling-efficient existing method. On more complex tasks with strict semantic constraints, HammingMark achieves the highest detection rates with the highest or tied-highest ROUGE-L scores, demonstrating its effectiveness in balancing watermark detectability and generation quality under constrained generation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 语义水印因水印偏好与模型自身语义偏好不对齐而出现语义收窄 (semantic narrowing)。HammingMark 用前一句的语义哈希作动态中心，接受落在其 Hamming 邻域内的候选，从而保留更多自然续写。在 C4 与 BookSum 上每接受一句仅需采样 2.2 个候选，比最省采样的现有方法少 72.8%。
Motivation: 现有语义水印强加水印特定的语义偏好，与 LLM 生成本身高度非均匀、依赖上下文的偏好不对齐，导致语义自由度下降、重采样成本上升、严格语义任务上质量退化。
Method: 以紧致哈希空间中前一句语义哈希为动态中心，把水印有效性定义在其 Hamming 邻域内；多对一的粗哈希映射让多种语义实现同时有效，候选按哈希是否落入邻域接受。
Result: 在 C4 与 BookSum 上达到强鲁棒性、高可检测性与接近无水印的生成质量，每接受一句平均仅采样 2.2 个候选，比最采样高效的现有方法减少 72.8%；在语义约束更严的复杂任务上取得最高检测率，同时 ROUGE-L 最高或并列最高。
Conclusion: 把水印有效性从精确语义点放宽到 Hamming 邻域，可在严格语义约束下同时保住检测率与生成质量，并大幅压低重采样成本。

papers.title: CRJudgeBench: Can AI Detect Plausible but Invalid Code Reviews?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate plausible code-review comments, but such comments may contain technically incorrect claims that mislead developers. We study technical trustworthiness judgment: determining whether a review comment's core technical claims are correct and applicable to the reviewed code in its repository context. Existing code-review benchmarks primarily evaluate review generation, issue discovery, or general comment quality, but do not directly assess whether an agent can determine the technical trustworthy of an individual review comment. To fill this gap, we introduce CRJudgeBench, a benchmark of 1199 instances constructed from real pull requests and expert-verified perturbations, covering both trustworthy and plausible but untrustworthy comments. We further present Sentinel, a repository-grounded agentic judge that actively gathers code evidence to verify review comments before making judgments. Starting from Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, Sentinel is trained on the CRJudgeBench training split through iterative action-level learning from a privileged teacher. On the 359-instance CRJudgeBench test set, Sentinel achieves 76.60\% accuracy, outperforming GLM-5.3 by 6.13 percentage points and its base model by 19.78 points. These results show that even state-of-the-art general-purpose LLMs struggle to identify untrustworthy comments, while iterative action-level learning substantially improves the accuracy of repository-grounded trustworthiness judgments. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/dcloud347/CRJudgeBenchmark
papers.comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, and 14 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/dcloud347/CRJudgeBenchmark

Result: 在 359 条测试集上 Sentinel 准确率 76.60%，比 GLM-5.3 高 6.13 个百分点，比其基座模型高 19.78 个百分点；数据集含 1199 条实例。
Conclusion: 即便是最先进的通用 LLM 也难以识别不可信评审意见，而基于仓库证据的迭代式 action-level 学习能大幅抬高此类可信度判断的准确率。

papers.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Multilayer Planar Winding Inductance Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Rapid and accurate self-inductance estimation for multilayer rectangle-shaped planar windings is essential for modern high-frequency power converters, yet traditional workflows rely on complex mathematical equations, rigid monomial formulas or unexplainable black-box machine learning (ML) models that degrade severely outside their training domain. This paper introduces an explainable ML framework unifying post-hoc feature attribution (SHAP and permutation importance) with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-guided symbolic regression via the SR-KAN framework to discover closed-form analytical equations without prior structural assumptions. Evaluated on a new open-source dataset of over 10,000 Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations across seven out-of-distribution (OOD) classes, standard tree-based ensembles exhibit severe extrapolation errors (> 36%), whereas the unconstrained SR-KAN expression achieves a robust OOD relative error of 8.22%. Experimental verification across 55 physical printed circuit board prototypes (up to 8 layers, with inductances from 4.11 μH to 559.27 μH) confirms that the KAN-discovered expression translates effectively to real-world hardware, predicting inductance with a mean absolute relative error of 6.26%. To support reproducible research, the complete FEA simulation dataset and prototype measurements are released open-source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SR-KAN 框架把 SHAP/置换重要性的事后归因与 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network 引导的符号回归结合，在 10,000+ 条 FEA 仿真上无先验结构假设地发现平面绕组自感闭式表达式。树模型在 7 类分布外 (OOD) 上误差超过 36%，无约束 SR-KAN 表达式 OOD 相对误差 8.22%，55 块 PCB 实测平均绝对相对误差 6.26%。
Motivation: 多层矩形平面绕组的自感估计依赖复杂数学公式、刚性单项式公式或不可解释的黑箱 ML，后者在训练域外严重退化，且无法给出可审查的解析式。
Method: SR-KAN 框架：先用 SHAP 与 permutation importance 做事后特征归因，再由 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network 引导符号回归 (symbolic regression)，在无结构先验下搜索闭式方程；训练/拟合数据为新公开的 10,000+ 条 Finite Element Analysis (FEA) 仿真，覆盖 7 类 OOD。
Result: 标准树集成在 7 类 OOD 上外推误差超过 36%，无约束 SR-KAN 表达式 OOD 相对误差 8.22%；在 55 块实体 PCB 原型（最多 8 层，电感 4.11 μH 至 559.27 μH）上实测平均绝对相对误差 6.26%。
Conclusion: 归因引导的符号回归能发现既可外推又可迁移到真实硬件的平面绕组电感闭式式，优于黑箱树模型；完整 FEA 数据集与原型测量开源以支持复现。

papers.title: Pointwise or Pairwise: When Do Pairwise Losses Help Reward Learning, Provably?
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise losses are increasingly used for reward learning even when pointwise rewards are observed, with mixed empirical results. When and why do pairwise losses outperform pointwise losses? We study this question in a grouped offline contextual-bandit setting allowing multiple actions per context, capturing many reward learning scenarios. We compare Value Regression (VR), which regresses observed rewards pointwise, with Value Difference Regression (VDR), which regresses reward differences between a pair of actions sampled under the same context. We consider a semiparametric model where the mean reward is the sum of a learnable action-dependent component and an arbitrary context-dependent yet action-independent nuisance, capturing context-specific disturbances. Using a unified localized analysis, we prove finite-sample regression guarantees for finite and linear function classes and translate them into offline-regret bounds. For finite classes, VDR eliminates the misspecification term in the VR bound and improves a reward-scale-dependent error term by averaging over actions within each context, a benefit absent from the corresponding VR term. For linear classes, neither method uniformly dominates: within-context differencing removes nuisance-induced bias but may increase estimation variance relative to using absolute rewards when the misspecification is sufficiently low. This yields a feature geometry-dependent bias-variance tradeoff, which we corroborate with numerical experiments.
papers.comment: 58 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables; second through sixth authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分组离线 contextual-bandit 的奖励学习中，比较逐点回归 (VR) 与同上下文动作对差分回归 (VDR)：半参数模型下 VDR 通过上下文内差分消掉与动作无关的 nuisance，并对奖励尺度相关误差项在上下文内对动作取平均。有限函数类中 VDR 消除 VR 界中的 misspecification 项；线性函数类中两者互不占优，差分去掉偏差但可能抬高方差，形成依赖特征几何的偏差-方差权衡。
Motivation: 即便观测到逐点奖励，实践中仍越来越多用 pairwise loss，但经验结果不一致；缺少何时、为何 pairwise 优于逐点的理论刻画。
Method: 在允许同一 context 多动作的分组离线 contextual-bandit 设定下，对比 VR（直接回归观测奖励）与 VDR（回归同 context 两动作的奖励差）；采用半参数模型，均值奖励 = 可学的动作相关分量 + 任意但与动作无关的 context nuisance；用统一的 localized analysis 对有限与线性函数类给出有限样本回归保证并转化为 offline-regret 界。
Result: 有限函数类：VDR 消除 VR 界中的 misspecification 项，并通过在每个 context 内对动作取平均改进奖励尺度相关的误差项，而 VR 项没有这一收益。线性函数类：两法互不一致占优，上下文内差分去掉 nuisance 引起的偏差，但在 misspecification 足够低时相对绝对奖励可能增大估计方差，产生依赖特征几何的偏差-方差权衡；作者用数值实验佐证该权衡。
Conclusion: VDR 的优势来自消除 misspecification 与上下文内平均，因此在 misspecification 高时更划算；线性情形下是否用差分取决于 misspecification 水平与特征几何决定的偏差-方差权衡，不能一概而论。

papers.title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant steps. We propose Proof-R1, an RL framework from formal verification that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. Proof-R1 admits a generated conclusion into the verified proof state only when the corresponding reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. Proof-R1 also recovers the answer-supporting dependency closure to trace the proof structure of the final answer and align outcome credit with the proof dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that Proof-R1 improves answer accuracy across three logical reasoning benchmarks and four backbone models and outperforms training-free agents and training-based methods in terms of reasoning-process verifiability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Proof-R1 用基于 UNSAT 的机器可检验形式化验证约束强化学习：只有当推理动作满足证明义务时，生成的中间结论才被接纳进已验证的证明状态，并回收支撑最终答案的依赖闭包来对齐过程级信用。在三个逻辑推理基准、四种骨干模型上提升答案准确率，并在推理过程可验证性上超过免训练 agent 与训练类方法。
Motivation: 自然语言逻辑推理中最终答案易校验、其背后的证明难校验，现有方法无法机器检验中间结论与答案支撑依赖，会把信用分配给无效或与答案无关的步骤。
Method: 提出 Proof-R1：以形式化验证驱动的 RL 框架，推理动作须通过 UNSAT-based 机器可检验形式化验证满足证明义务，其结论才进入已验证证明状态；同时回收答案支撑依赖闭包以追踪最终答案的证明结构并对齐 outcome 信用。
Result: 在三个逻辑推理基准、四种骨干模型上均提升答案准确率；在推理过程可验证性 (reasoning-process verifiability) 上优于 training-free agents 与 training-based 方法。
Conclusion: 把机器可检验的形式化验证嵌入 RL 的信用分配，能让 LLM 学会构造可验证的证明而不只是给出答案。

papers.title: Probabilistic Symbolic-Distillation Model of Droplet Collision for Spray Simulation at High Ambient Pressures
papers.abstract_en: Droplet collision governs droplet population dynamics in many chemical engineering processes, such as spray drying, spray cooling, agricultural spraying, and combustion. Existing analytical models impose deterministic, pairwise boundaries between collision outcomes, whereas machine-learning classifiers lack the explicit functional form required of analytical collision submodels. In this study, we develop a probabilistic symbolic-distillation model using nearly forty thousand experimental events spanning eight regimes and five dimensionless parameters, including over five thousand data for ambient pressure up to 50 atm. A machine-learning teacher learns the joint outcome-probability landscape from these data, and symbolic regression subsequently distils it into eight class-specific expressions that jointly define a coupled analytical model. The resulting analytical field replaces abrupt regime switching with finite-width fuzzy boundaries. It outperforms the evaluated conventional analytical boundary models and reveals that their main limitation is the inability of zero-width boundaries to represent gradual probability transitions. The "biased-dice" sampling scheme provides a statistically consistent and practically convenient model implementation for Eulerian-Lagrangian spray simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用符号蒸馏把液滴碰撞从确定性硬边界改成概率式解析子模型：ML teacher 从近四万个实验碰撞事件学出联合结果概率场，符号回归再蒸馏成八条类别表达式，边界由零宽度突变变为有限宽度的 fuzzy boundary。在含 50 atm 高环境压力、跨八个工况区间的实验数据上，该解析模型优于所评估的传统解析边界模型，其主要缺陷正是零宽度边界无法表达渐变的概率过渡。
Motivation: 传统解析碰撞模型用确定性的成对结果边界，工况切换是零宽度的突变；ML 分类器虽能学概率，却给不出解析子模型所需的显式函数形式，两者都无法表示渐变的结果概率过渡。
Method: 以近 40000 个实验碰撞事件（覆盖 8 个 regime、5 个无量纲参数，其中超过 5000 条为环境压力最高 50 atm 的数据）训练一个学习联合结果概率场的 ML teacher，再用 symbolic regression 将其蒸馏为八条类别专属表达式，共同构成耦合解析模型；采样用 biased-dice 方案，面向 Eulerian-Lagrangian 喷雾模拟实现。
Result: 在所评估的传统解析边界模型对比中胜出，并诊断出后者的主要局限是零宽度边界无法表示渐变概率过渡；数据规模为近 40000 个实验事件、8 个 regime、5 个无量纲参数、超过 5000 条 50 atm 以内高压数据，产出八条解析表达式。
Conclusion: 解析碰撞子模型应直接携带有限宽度的概率边界而非硬切换，符号蒸馏可把 ML 概率场压成可嵌入 Eulerian-Lagrangian 喷雾模拟的解析形式。

papers.title: Adaptive Reward Routing: Dynamic Multi-Reward Optimization for Joint Audio-Video Diffusion via Forward-Process RL
papers.abstract_en: Multi-reward guided reinforcement learning (i.e., RL) offers a promising way to improve joint audio-video diffusion models along several complementary objectives, including modality-specific quality, cross-modal semantic alignment, and temporal synchronization. Its effectiveness, however, depends on two quantities that change during training: where reward-driven updates should act, and how competing rewards should be combined. Existing methods tend to rely on fixed routing and reward weights, failing to track evolving model functions. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Reward Routing to jointly adapt update locations and reward coordination during forward-process RL (i.e., DiffusionNFT) of joint audio-video diffusion models. Our method consists of two components. (i) Cross-Modal Influence-Guided Routing (Localizing Updates): We use bidirectional cross-attention responses as an efficient proxy for evolving cross-modal influence, dynamically reweighting token-aware losses and scaling gradients across cross-modal layers without additional model interventions. (ii) Preference-Preserving Modality-Aware Reweighting (Coordinating Rewards): We preserve predefined weights as preference priors and use branch-specific reward-gradient interactions as residual corrections after warm-up. This resolves evolving conflicts without letting dominant rewards suppress weak but essential objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in modality quality, semantic consistency, and audio-video synchronization over strong RL baselines. Ablations and mechanism analyses further validate the complementary benefits of adaptive update routing and reward coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对联合音视频扩散的多奖励 RL 训练，提出 Adaptive Reward Routing：用双向 cross-attention 响应动态定位更新层并缩放梯度，同时把预设奖励权重当作偏好先验、以分支奖励梯度交互做残差修正。在 forward-process RL (DiffusionNFT) 上，模态质量、语义一致性与音视频同步相对强 RL 基线一致提升。
Motivation: 多奖励引导的 RL 效果取决于训练中不断变化的两个量——更新应作用在哪一层、竞争奖励如何加权；现有方法用固定路由与固定权重，跟不上模型函数的演化。
Method: 两组件：Cross-Modal Influence-Guided Routing 以双向 cross-attention 响应作为跨模态影响的代理，动态重加权 token-aware loss 并跨层缩放梯度，不引入额外模型干预；Preference-Preserving Modality-Aware Reweighting 把预定义权重保留为偏好先验，warm-up 后用分支奖励梯度交互作残差修正，避免主导奖励压制弱但必要的目标。整体在联合音视频扩散的 forward-process RL (DiffusionNFT) 中联合自适应更新位置与奖励协调。
Result: 实验显示在模态质量、语义一致性与音视频同步三项上相对强 RL 基线一致提升；消融与机制分析验证自适应更新路由与奖励协调的互补收益。
Conclusion: 更新位置与奖励权重都必须随训练动态自适应，二者联合调节才能在多奖励音视频扩散 RL 中同时保住各模态质量与跨模态对齐。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: V-Engram: Trigger-Indexed External Memory for Modular Text-to-Image Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained text-to-image models contain broad visual knowledge, yet they cannot reliably acquire or refine a specific visual identity from only a few references while preserving compositional control. Token-embedding methods are compact but often underfit identity, whereas adapter-based methods improve fidelity through persistent weight updates that can be costly to store and interfere when concepts are composed. We introduce V-Engram, a trigger-indexed external memory mechanism for Stable Diffusion 3.5. Each concept is assigned an explicit trigger that retrieves concept-specific memory, whose gated directions enter frozen text-encoder and MMDiT context states as relative residuals. Separating this memory from backbone adaptation enables prompt-selective and multi-concept access without merging model updates. Experiments show that V-Engram broadly matches DreamBooth-LoRA in overall subject fidelity while showing advantages in settings such as contextual subject preservation. Prompt-matched loading retrieves only matched entries, reducing most additional adaptation-state loading for a single-concept query. Qualitative results further demonstrate paired-trigger composition and same-class separation, while prompts without registered entries retain the frozen model's base behavior. Together, these results establish trigger-indexed memory as a modular interface for adding targeted visual evidence without rewriting the generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-Engram 为 Stable Diffusion 3.5 提出触发词索引的外部记忆机制：每个概念绑定显式 trigger，检索其专属记忆并以门控方向作为相对残差注入冻结的 text encoder 与 MMDiT 上下文状态。整体主体保真度与 DreamBooth-LoRA 大体相当，在上下文主体保持等场景占优，且单概念查询只加载匹配条目，未注册的 prompt 保持冻结模型原行为。
Motivation: 预训练文生图模型难以从少量参考图可靠习得特定视觉身份并保持组合控制：token embedding 方法体积小但身份欠拟合，adapter 方法靠持久权重更新提高保真度，却存储昂贵且在概念组合时互相干扰。
Method: 为每个概念分配显式 trigger 以检索概念专属记忆，记忆的门控方向 (gated directions) 以相对残差形式进入冻结的 text encoder 与 MMDiT 上下文状态；记忆与骨干适配解耦，实现 prompt 选择性与多概念访问而不合并模型更新，加载时按 prompt 匹配只取对应条目。
Result: 整体主体保真度 (overall subject fidelity) 与 DreamBooth-LoRA 大体相当，在上下文主体保持 (contextual subject preservation) 等设置上占优；单概念查询只检索匹配条目，减少大部分额外适配状态加载；定性结果展示 paired-trigger 组合与同类概念分离，未注册 prompt 保留冻结模型基础行为。
Conclusion: 触发词索引的记忆可以作为模块化接口，在不重写生成器的前提下注入定向视觉证据，并支持按需加载与概念组合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ToolFence: Fine-Grained Authorization for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents remain vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because trusted instructions and untrusted observations share one context, allowing malicious content to steer consequential input-filtering defenses. Multi-path consensus defenses still leave a high attack success rate because they examine content or aggregated outputs rather than authorizing effects, especially for the within-tool attack, which preserves the intended tool but manipulates its arguments. Data-Flow Control such as CaMeL provides stronger guarantees, but incurs substantial time latency that limits practical deployment. We introduce ToolFence, which compiles a typed authorization blueprint before execution, enforces it through a deterministic monitor, and when the blueprint is incomplete asks a judge to grant new capabilities rather than adjudicate each concrete call. ToolFence provides two key advantages. First, its fine-grained provenance-aware authorization enables the system to distinguish user-authorized values from untrusted observations, effectively addressing the within-tool attack. Second, its deterministic fast path and capability-level runtime grants substantially reduce the frequency of expensive judge calls, improving runtime efficiency. On AgentDojo with Qwen3-max, ToolFence reduces overall ASR to near zero with only a 3.80 percentage-point clean-utility drop and practical runtime overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToolFence 在执行前把工具调用编译成类型化授权蓝图 (typed authorization blueprint)，用确定性 monitor 强制执行，蓝图不完备时才让 judge 授予新能力而非逐条裁决具体调用。在 AgentDojo + Qwen3-max 上把总体攻击成功率 (ASR) 降到接近零，clean utility 仅下降 3.80 个百分点，运行时开销可控。
Motivation: 工具调用 LLM agent 中可信指令与不可观测内容共处同一上下文，间接提示注入可操纵输入过滤类防御；多路径共识防御只看内容或聚合输出而不授权效果，within-tool 攻击（保留原工具、篡改参数）尤其难挡；CaMeL 类 Data-Flow Control 保证强但时延高，难以部署。
Method: 执行前编译类型化授权蓝图，由确定性 monitor 在运行时强制执行；蓝图不完备时由 judge 授予 capability 级新能力，而非逐个裁决具体调用。provenance-aware 授权区分用户授权值与不可信观测，确定性快路径与 capability 级运行时授权减少昂贵的 judge 调用次数。
Result: 在 AgentDojo 上用 Qwen3-max 测试，总体 ASR 降至接近零，clean utility 仅下降 3.80 个百分点，运行时开销为 practical 级别；针对 within-tool 攻击与多路径共识防御的高 ASR 场景给出对比定位。
Conclusion: 按效果授权（而非按内容判断）加上确定性快路径与 capability 级运行时授予，可以在压低攻击成功率的同时保住工具 agent 的可用性与运行效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploring In-Context Learning for Handwritten Text Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) systems have become an indispensable tool for the digitization of historical documents. Not only do they cut down time and cost, but they also allow democratizing access and processing of their contents by generating their transcripts. However, literature in HTR currently focuses mostly on specialized models that require large amounts of annotated samples to achieve satisfactory performance. We explore the use of In-Context Learning with pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to create a transcription pipeline without updating the model's parameters. We then evaluate this pipeline across multiple collections and models, and demonstrate that general-purpose VLMs can be effectively taught how to transcribe handwritten text from images. To assess how our observations may translate to practical applications, we evaluate the performance in a Cross-Domain (CD) scenario, where context examples are drawn from a different collection than the query image. Results in both the controlled In-Domain (ID) scenario and the realistic CD scenario follow the same patterns. First, as context size grows, the error range is expected to narrow towards the average performance. Thus, larger context sizes sacrifice the performance of the oracle-best sampling for lower expected error rates. The results obtained show that, without any parameter updates, this methodology has strong potential to compete with traditional HTR in the presence of domain shift. Moreover, we show and argue that some context samplings work better than others and suggest more effort should be put into finding an ideal sampling method in future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在手写文本识别 (HTR) 上探索用预训练视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的 In-Context Learning 做转写，全程不更新参数。上下文示例越多，误差范围越向平均性能收窄：大上下文牺牲 oracle-best 采样的上限、换取更低的期望错误率；ID 与跨集合的 CD 场景呈现同一规律。
Motivation: 现有 HTR 文献主要依赖需要大量标注样本的专用模型，标注成本高且跨领域 (domain shift) 时性能下降；作者想检验通用 VLM 能否靠上下文示例直接学会转写。
Method: 用预训练 VLM 做 In-Context Learning：把示例图像与转写放进上下文，直接对查询图像生成转写，不微调任何参数；在多个文献集合与多个模型上评测，并设置 In-Domain 与 Cross-Domain（上下文示例取自与查询图像不同的集合）两种场景，比较不同上下文大小与不同上下文采样策略。
Result: 在 ID 与 CD 两种场景下结果遵循相同模式：随上下文规模增大，误差范围向平均性能收窄，即更大的上下文以牺牲 oracle-best 采样性能为代价换取更低的期望错误率；不更新参数的方法在 domain shift 下显示出与传统 HTR 竞争的强潜力，且某些上下文采样明显优于其他采样。
Conclusion: 无需参数更新的 ICL 转写管线在领域偏移下有实用竞争力，而上下文采样策略是决定性能的关键变量，值得作为后续工作的重点。

summary_sections.result: 在 ID 与 CD 两种场景下结果遵循相同模式：随上下文规模增大，误差范围向平均性能收窄，即更大的上下文以牺牲 oracle-best 采样性能为代价换取更低的期望错误率；不更新参数的方法在 domain shift 下显示出与传统 HTR 竞争的强潜力，且某些上下文采样明显优于其他采样。
summary_sections.conclusion: 无需参数更新的 ICL 转写管线在领域偏移下有实用竞争力，而上下文采样策略是决定性能的关键变量，值得作为后续工作的重点。

papers.title: HaPRL: Human-Anchored Process Reinforcement Learning for Visual Search Agent
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn visual search agents answer questions about high-resolution images by iteratively deciding where to look. Reinforcement learning for these agents rewards only the final answer, leaving the search process unsupervised. Consequently, faulty routes in which the reasoning process is erroneous yet the final result is correct arise frequently, which in turn leads to ineffective training, i.e., scaling along the wrong paths. In this paper, we introduce HaPRL, the first framework to reinforce the search process with human search behavior. We first build an annotation platform and collect 1K+ human-annotated data with fine-grained behavioral signals. During training, a carefully designed judge scores each rollout with task-adaptive weights, anchored on the distilled trace of how a human annotator actually searched the same image. Extensive experiments show that HaPRL consistently outperforms outcome-based RL, and early-stage process supervision yields 6.7x more improvement in subsequent outcome-based scaling. Our results also demonstrate the importance of aligning model behavior with human process annotation signals, which offer new insight into the training of foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HaPRL 用人类搜索行为给多轮视觉搜索 agent 的中间搜索过程打分，而非只奖励最终答案，从而抑制“过程错了但答案对”的 faulty routes。基于 1K+ 人工标注轨迹与任务自适应权重的 judge，早期过程监督让后续 outcome-based RL 的提升放大 6.7 倍。
Motivation: 多轮视觉搜索 agent 的 RL 只奖励最终答案，搜索过程无人监督，导致推理过程错误却答对的 faulty routes 频繁出现，训练沿错误路径扩展、效率低下。
Method: 搭建标注平台收集 1K+ 含细粒度行为信号的人类搜索数据；训练时用任务自适应权重的 judge 对每条 rollout 打分，锚定在人类标注者搜索同一图像的蒸馏轨迹 (distilled trace) 上，以此强化搜索过程。
Result: 实验显示 HaPRL 一致优于 outcome-based RL；早期阶段的过程监督使后续 outcome-based scaling 的提升幅度达到 6.7 倍。
Conclusion: 把模型行为与人类过程标注信号对齐，能在视觉搜索 agent 上比只看最终答案的 RL 更有效地扩展训练。

papers.title: Corruption-Robust Sparse Linear Contextual Bandits with Knapsack Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study sparse linear contextual bandits with knapsack constraints under joint reward and consumption corruption. Consumption corruption creates a challenge beyond corrupted rewards: it affects not only statistical estimates, but also the recorded budget, resource prices, and stopping decisions that govern future allocation. We develop Robust Optimistic Primal--Dual (ROPD), an estimator-modular framework that combines corruption-aware confidence widths with online resource prices and a budget-safety rule. With concrete sparse implementation, ROPD achieves regret against a clean population-LP benchmark of $\widetilde O(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})$ under forced exploration and population-design coverage, and $\widetilde O(\sqrt T+Γ)$ under on-policy realized-design coverage, for a supplied valid corruption bound $Γ$ under the stated proportional-budget scaling and fixed model/design parameters. When the corruption level is unknown, Shared-Grid adapts confidence radii around common point estimates fitted to a single realized history, incurring explicit initialization and master-comparison costs; its sharper on-policy guarantee additionally requires recommendation coverage. Both methods preserve observed budgets on every realization and bound clean resource violation by cumulative consumption corruption. These results connect corruption-robust sparse estimation with resource accounting, pricing, and stopping in high-dimensional online allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在奖励与消耗同时被污染的稀疏线性上下文 bandit + 背包约束问题下，提出 ROPD：把污染感知置信区间、在线资源价格与预算安全规则组合成可插拔的估计器框架，对干净 population-LP 基准给出 Õ(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})（强制探索 + population-design 覆盖）与 Õ(√T+Γ)（on-policy realized-design 覆盖）的 regret，且每次实现都保住观测预算。
Motivation: 消耗污染不同于只污染奖励：它同时污染统计估计、记录的预算、资源价格和停止决策，从而影响后续分配，而现有污染鲁棒 bandit 方法只处理奖励侧。
Method: ROPD 采用估计器模块化设计，结合 corruption-aware confidence widths、online resource prices 与 budget-safety rule，并给出具体稀疏实现；污染水平未知时用 Shared-Grid 在单一实现历史上共享点估计、自适应调整置信半径，代价是显式的初始化与主比较开销。
Result: 在给定有效污染界 Γ、比例预算缩放与固定模型/设计参数下，ROPD 对干净 population-LP 基准的 regret 为 Õ(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})（强制探索 + population-design 覆盖）与 Õ(√T+Γ)（on-policy realized-design 覆盖）；Shared-Grid 更紧的 on-policy 保证还需 recommendation coverage。两种方法在每次实现上都保持观测预算，并把干净资源违例界到累计消耗污染。
Conclusion: 污染鲁棒的稀疏估计可以与资源记账、定价和停止决策统一处理，从而在高维在线分配中同时控制 regret 与干净资源违例；保证依赖给定的污染界 Γ 与相应覆盖条件。

papers.title: InsightMap: Structured Spatial Modeling for Embodied Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided navigation requires connecting partial observations to a persistent spatial reference and learning how actions change that representation. We introduce InsightMap, a framework that uses top-down maps as both explicit spatial memory and action-conditioned prediction targets. Historical views are linked to labeled map locations, and a shared multimodal backbone jointly learns navigation action prediction and post-action map generation. Map prediction provides auxiliary training supervision, while navigation inference decodes actions from the observed spatial context. An aligned RGB-D data pipeline supports a common interface for navigation, visual question answering, situated reasoning, and 3D grounding. On the validation-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, InsightMap achieves success rates (SR) of 56.9% and 54.9%, respectively. Adding map-prediction supervision improves R2R-CE SR by 4.3 and success weighted by path length (SPL) by 3.2 percentage points. On static spatial tasks, InsightMap achieves 103.7 CIDEr on ScanQA, 60.1% exact-match accuracy on SQA3D, and 53.1% grounding accuracy at 0.5 IoU on ScanRefer with detected object proposals. On Unitree Go2, it outperforms NaVid and NaVILA in hallway, lab, and office environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InsightMap 把俯视地图同时当作显式空间记忆和动作条件下的预测目标：历史视角关联到带标注的地图位置，共享多模态主干联合学习导航动作预测与动作后地图生成，地图预测作为辅助监督。在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 的 validation-unseen 上 SR 分别为 56.9% 和 54.9%，加入地图预测监督使 R2R-CE SR 提升 4.3 个百分点、SPL 提升 3.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 语言引导导航需要把局部观测连到持久的空间参照，并理解动作如何改变该表示；现有方法缺少把历史观测与动作后果统一编码的显式空间记忆。
Method: 以俯视地图为空间记忆与预测目标，历史视角链接到标注地图位置；共享多模态 backbone 联合训练导航动作预测与动作后地图生成，地图预测提供辅助监督，推理时从观测空间上下文解码动作；配套对齐的 RGB-D 数据管线统一支撑导航、VQA、situated reasoning 与 3D grounding。
Result: R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE validation-unseen SR 分别 56.9% 与 54.9%；加地图预测监督使 R2R-CE SR +4.3 个百分点、SPL +3.2 个百分点；ScanQA CIDEr 103.7，SQA3D exact-match 60.1%，ScanRefer（检测框提议、IoU 0.5）grounding 准确率 53.1%；在 Unitree Go2 上于 hallway、lab、office 环境优于 NaVid 与 NaVILA。
Conclusion: 把地图预测作为辅助监督能同时提升具身导航的成功率与路径效率，且同一表示可跨导航与静态空间任务复用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Accelerated surrogate dynamics for dynamical, stochastic system evolution
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic simulations are an entrenched way of gaining insight into the evolution of system dynamics. Their computational cost however is often prohibitively high, especially in cases of stochastic frameworks. Machine learning algorithms are especially suited as simulation surrogates. Nevertheless, they face some very distinct limitations. Firstly, the sheer dimensionality of these systems, however, precludes the use of traditional time series models who struggle with high dimensional feature spaces. Additionally, traditional time series focus exclusively on either long or short range effects, causing local or global drift given enough time. In this paper, we propose a framework that addresses those limitations. Our framework combines a Variational Autoencoder, with a convolutional or graph basis that reduces the dimensionality of the system. This latent vector is propagated in time using a Temporal Fusion Transformer model, which includes both long range and short range effect encoding, as well as static covariate support. We test our framework on three distinct cases, to prove its robustness and in all three we have achieved practically identical to the simulation results at a fraction of the time. Further, our framework is flexible enough to be adapted to any new system and provides an inbuilt uncertainty quantification for targeted experiment design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VAE + Temporal Fusion Transformer 的代理仿真框架：用卷积或图结构的 VAE 把高维动态随机系统压到潜空间，再用同时编码长程与短程效应的 TFT 在潜空间推进时间，并自带不确定性量化。在三个不同算例上，代理结果与原仿真几乎一致，耗时只是原仿真的很小一部分。
Motivation: 动态随机系统仿真计算成本过高，而传统时间序列模型难以处理高维特征空间，且只建模长程或短程之一，长时间积分后产生局部或全局漂移。
Method: 框架由两部分组成：卷积或图基底的 Variational Autoencoder 负责降维得到潜向量；Temporal Fusion Transformer 在潜空间做时间推进，同时编码长程与短程效应并支持静态协变量，内置不确定性量化用于定向实验设计。
Result: 在三个不同算例上测试，代理输出与原仿真结果 practically identical，耗时仅为原仿真的 fraction（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: VAE 降维加 TFT 潜空间推进可作为通用动态随机系统代理，兼顾长短期效应并可迁移到新系统，同时提供不确定性量化。

papers.title: EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores are comparable to those of policies trained on teleoperation data at a lower collection cost. These results support human data as direct skill supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoHumanoid-V2 把第一人称人类演示直接迁移为人形机器人的协调全身 loco-manipulation 技能：粗到细动作对齐（运动学参考校正 + 动力学感知精修）提升末端执行器位姿精度并保持全身协调，机器人臂渲染与训练时图像增强缩小视觉具身差距。在四个真实任务上，用对齐人类数据训练的 VLA 策略零样本迁移成功，任务得分与用遥操作数据训练的策略相当，而采集成本更低。
Motivation: 既有的人体到人形迁移工作聚焦解耦控制下的场景泛化，协调全身技能的直接迁移少有人做；遥操作采集机器人演示成本高，限制了 loco-manipulation 策略的数据规模。
Method: 核心是粗到细动作对齐：先做运动学参考校正 (kinematic reference correction)，再做动力学感知精修 (dynamics-aware refinement)，在提升末端执行器位姿精度的同时保留全身协调；另用机器人臂渲染与训练时图像增强来缩小视觉具身差距、提升视角鲁棒性，最后在对齐后的人类数据上训练 vision-language-action (VLA) 策略。
Result: 在四个真实世界任务上，基于对齐人类数据训练的 VLA 策略实现零样本技能迁移，无需目标任务的机器人演示；任务得分与用遥操作数据训练的策略相当，且数据采集成本更低。
Conclusion: 人类第一人称数据可以直接充当人形机器人协调全身 loco-manipulation 的技能监督，替代成本更高的遥操作演示。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 核心是粗到细动作对齐：先做运动学参考校正 (kinematic reference correction)，再做动力学感知精修 (dynamics-aware refinement)，在提升末端执行器位姿精度的同时保留全身协调；另用机器人臂渲染与训练时图像增强来缩小视觉具身差距、提升视角鲁棒性，最后在对齐后的人类数据上训练 vision-language-action (VLA) 策略。
summary_sections.result: 在四个真实世界任务上，基于对齐人类数据训练的 VLA 策略实现零样本技能迁移，无需目标任务的机器人演示；任务得分与用遥操作数据训练的策略相当，且数据采集成本更低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 人类第一人称数据可以直接充当人形机器人协调全身 loco-manipulation 的技能监督，替代成本更高的遥操作演示。

papers.title: Sparse cubical complexes for efficient topology-preservation in image data
papers.abstract_en: Persistent homology (PH) is a frequently used tool for extracting and preserving topological information from image data, particularly in image segmentation, where preservation of topological structures is important. However, despite its general applicability across dimensionality, domains, and target structures, the runtime cost of PH-based methods often makes their practical use infeasible. In this work, we argue that this runtime cost is largely driven by processing information that is unimportant for downstream application (e.g. as optimization objective). We propose sparse cubical filtrations as an alternative foundation for PH computation, reducing subsequent computational costs by factors of up to 100 on real datasets. We show close agreement with the optimization signal of the dense counterpart and empirically evaluate our solution's effectiveness as an optimization objective in realistic training regimes where other PH-based objectives can practically not operate (i.e., 3D data with large patch sizes). We show how our solution improves topological accuracy by up to 80\% across six diverse datasets while maintaining pixel- and region-based accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出稀疏立方复形过滤 (sparse cubical filtrations) 作为持久同调 (PH) 计算的基础，只处理对下游有用的体素，把真实数据集上的 PH 计算成本降低最多 100 倍，且优化信号与稠密版本高度一致。作为分割训练中的拓扑损失目标，在六个多样数据集上把拓扑精度最多提高 80%，同时保持像素级与区域级精度，并可运行到其他 PH 目标实际无法处理的 3D 大 patch 设置。
Motivation: PH 类拓扑保持方法在图像分割中通用，但运行时开销常使其实际不可用；开销主要花在对下游无用的信息上，导致 3D 大 patch 训练中其他 PH 目标无法运行。
Method: 以稀疏立方过滤替代稠密立方过滤计算 PH，只保留相关结构以降低后续计算成本；把该过滤产生的 PH 作为训练中的优化目标（拓扑损失），在真实训练范式下评估，包括 3D 大 patch 数据。
Result: 真实数据集上计算成本最多降低 100 倍；与稠密对应物的优化信号高度一致；在六个多样数据集上拓扑精度最多提升 80%，同时保持像素级与区域级精度；可在 3D 大 patch 的现实训练设置中作为优化目标运行，而其他 PH 目标在此场景实际无法运行。
Conclusion: PH 的运行时开销主要来自处理对下游无用的信息，用稀疏立方过滤做拓扑保持既省算力又能在大 3D patch 训练中充当可用的优化目标。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Absorbed in Inertia: Activation Analysis for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents have become increasingly capable of executing tasks on live desktops through natural-language instructions, based on trajectories of screenshots, actions, and reasoning. We discover that they can stealthily exhibit inertia, in which they repeat fruitless actions despite recognizing that these actions are ineffective. We hypothesize that inertia is reflected in the agent's internal state, i.e., the activation values of the agent's underlying model, and propose a protocol to measure the relationship between the two. Extensive analysis of high-dimensional activation states shows that inertia corresponds to an absorbing region of activation space, where activation values become stale across actions and even after attempts to steer them. We conjecture that drastically changing the agents' activations by re-initializing them is necessary to escape inertia. Specifically, we propose R$^3$ (Reset, Reroute, Restore), which temporarily resets the agent's context trajectory to escape the absorbing region and then restores the historical context to effectively complete the task. Our approach yields 17-55% lower measured inertia across models relative to unmodified agents. These results suggest that changing the context can interrupt recurrence more effectively than directly steering the resulting activations. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/vlm-agent-defense-D076
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发现计算机使用 agent 存在隐性惯性 (inertia)：明知动作无效仍反复执行，且在模型激活空间中对应一个吸收区域，激活值跨动作停滞、直接引导也难以逃出。提出 R³（Reset, Reroute, Restore）先重置上下文轨迹逃出吸收区域再恢复历史上下文，相比未修改 agent 使测得惯性降低 17–55%。
Motivation: 计算机使用 agent 会在桌面上重复无效动作而不自知，其内部激活陷入停滞的吸收区域，直接操纵激活难以纠正这种复发行为。
Method: 提出一套协议度量惯性与模型激活值的关系，并对高维激活状态做分析；据此提出 R³（Reset, Reroute, Restore），临时重置 agent 的上下文轨迹以逃出吸收区域，随后恢复历史上下文以完成任务。
Result: 跨多个模型，R³ 相比未修改的 agent 使测得惯性降低 17–55%；激活分析显示惯性对应激活空间的吸收区域，激活值跨动作停滞且在尝试引导后依然如此。
Conclusion: 改变上下文比直接引导激活更能打断动作复发，重置激活是逃出惯性的必要手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SimpleEvol: An Agent-Loop Framework for LLM-Driven Automated Heuristic Design with Minimal Human Priors
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for automated heuristic design (AHD), enabling iterative generation and refinement of heuristics. However, the dominant paradigm embeds LLMs as narrow, fixed components, such as crossover or mutation, within heavily hand-engineered evolutionary frameworks. We argue this misapprehends LLMs. It treats them as specialized tools rather than general reasoners, constrains them to low-level operations, and underutilizes their autonomy. Moreover, the extensive human priors in these frameworks violate the bitter lesson principle that general methods scaling with computation surpass hand-crafted solutions. This raises a key question: which AHD framework designs best convert stronger LLM capabilities into better heuristics? To address this, we propose metrics for LLM-driven AHD framework handcraftedness (AHI) and intelligence conversion efficiency (ICE). Evaluating ten LLMs across three challenging combinatorial optimization problems, we obtain a notable finding that frameworks with fewer human priors consistently yield higher ICE. Based on this finding, we propose SimpleEvol, an agent-loop framework for AHD which removes nearly all human priors and allows the LLM to operate autonomously. SimpleEvol consistently achieves the highest ICE, often by a large margin. Our results challenge the trend toward complex AHD pipelines and point to a lighter and more model-centric alternative, suggesting that reducing human priors is a more effective strategy to scale up with model intelligence. The source code is available at https://github.com/HenryZhu1029/SimpleEvol-Master.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimpleEvol 把 LLM 从进化框架里的交叉/变异算子解放为自主 agent-loop，几乎去掉全部人工先验，并提出 AHI（人工先验度）与 ICE（智能转化效率）两个框架度量。在三个组合优化问题上评测十个 LLM，发现人工先验越少 ICE 越高，SimpleEvol 的 ICE 一致最高且常大幅领先。
Motivation: 现有自动启发式设计 (AHD) 把 LLM 塞进重度手工设计的进化框架当固定算子，人工先验过多、压低了 LLM 自主性，也违背随算力扩展的通用方法原则；哪种框架设计最能把更强的 LLM 能力转成更好的启发式尚不清楚。
Method: 提出两个度量：handcraftedness (AHI) 衡量框架的人工先验程度，intelligence conversion efficiency (ICE) 衡量 LLM 能力向启发式的转化效率；用它们评测十个 LLM 在三个有挑战的组合优化问题上的表现，再据此设计 SimpleEvol——一个移除几乎全部人工先验、让 LLM 自主运行的 agent-loop 框架。
Result: 十个 LLM × 三个组合优化问题的评测显示：人工先验更少的框架 ICE 一致更高；SimpleEvol 取得最高 ICE，且常常以较大差距领先。
Conclusion: 复杂 AHD 流水线的方向被质疑，减少人工先验、走更轻且以模型为中心的路线，是随模型智能扩展自动启发式设计的更有效策略。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy and on-policy distillation have traditionally been formulated as separate paradigms, each favoring a different property of distillation trajectories. Teacher-generated (off-policy) traces are typically high-quality but lie far from the student's distribution, whereas student-generated (on-policy) rollouts are more learnable but often contain erroneous reasoning. We view these paradigms as the endpoints of a policy continuum and posit that a more effective rollout policy may lie in between. We introduce \textbf{Interpolated Policy Distillation (IPD)}, which defines the next-token distribution at every decoding step as an explicit linear interpolation between the student and teacher distributions. The interpolation operates at the distribution level, token by token, and its coefficient provides direct control over the balance between trajectory quality and student learnability. Naively sampling from this policy would require sequentially querying the teacher at every token and is thus expensive. To make IPD practical, we accelerate it with a new speculative-decoding rule while exactly preserving the interpolated next-token distribution.At the trajectory level, the resulting rollouts naturally interleave student- and teacher-generated segments. Unlike recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, however, this interleaving is induced by an exactly realized token-level interpolated policy rather than by hand-designed switching rules. Across text-only and multimodal reasoning benchmarks, IPD consistently outperforms both endpoint policies (SFT and OPD), their conventional two-stage combination (SFT-then-OPD), and recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, demonstrating that token-level policy interpolation better balances trajectory quality and student learnability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 off-policy 与 on-policy 蒸馏视为策略连续统的两端，提出 Interpolated Policy Distillation (IPD)：每个解码步的 next-token 分布取学生与教师分布的线性插值，插值系数直接调控轨迹质量与学生可学习性的平衡。配套的 speculative-decoding 规则在精确保留插值分布的前提下避免逐步查询教师；在纯文本与多模态推理基准上，IPD 一致优于 SFT、OPD、SFT-then-OPD 两阶段组合及启发式分段交替方法。
Motivation: 教师生成的 off-policy 轨迹质量高但偏离学生分布，学生自生成的 on-policy rollout 可学却常含错误推理；现有做法把两者当独立范式或用启发式分段切换硬拼，缺少对中间策略的显式控制。
Method: IPD 在 token 级把学生与教师的 next-token 分布做显式线性插值，得到的 rollout 自然交替学生与教师生成的片段；为避免每步查询教师的开销，引入新的 speculative-decoding 接受规则，精确保留插值后的下一 token 分布。
Result: 在纯文本与多模态推理基准上，IPD 一致优于两个端点策略（SFT 与 OPD）、它们的常规两阶段组合（SFT-then-OPD），以及近期的启发式分段交替方法。
Conclusion: token 级的策略插值比端点策略与手工切换规则更能平衡轨迹质量与学生可学习性，且插值系数提供了对这一平衡的直接旋钮。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Trajectory Soup: Pushing the Compute-Scaling Frontier of LLM Mid-training via Diverse Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Mid-training equips pretrained large language models with specialized and reasoning capabilities, but the returns of this stage are bounded since additional serial compute yields little further downstream improvement and can even degrade some capabilities, which places a practical ceiling on how much compute mid-training absorbs. We revisit how this compute should be allocated to a single run or multiple similar optimizations. We find that branches forked from a shared checkpoint under various controlled recipe reaches measurably different regions of parameter space, and establish a form of compatible diversity that extending one run cannot supply. Therefore, we introduce Trajectory Soup, which distributes a mid-training budget over several independent branches, and consolidates strongest checkpoints selected on validation through intra- and inter-trajectory averaging into a single model. A local bias and variance analysis separates the two averaging levels, showing that inter-trajectory averaging removes residual error beyond the reach of averaging within a trajectory, while checkpoint selection carries a bias that bounds how many checkpoints are worth merging. Across model scales, learning-rate schedules, token budgets, and trajectory counts, Trajectory Soup improves aggregate downstream performance over the strongest single-trajectory average under matched budgets and keeps improving as budgets expand, with the advantage preserved after an identical post-training pipeline. These results position trajectory allocation and merging as a practical way to extend the compute-scaling frontier of mid-training beyond serial saturation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Trajectory Soup 把 mid-training 预算分给多个从共享 checkpoint 分叉、配方受控的独立分支，再按验证集挑出最强 checkpoint 做轨迹内与轨迹间平均合并成单一模型。在匹配预算下，它在各模型规模、学习率调度、token 预算与轨迹数上都优于最强单轨迹平均，且预算扩大时优势持续增长，post-training 后仍保留。
Motivation: mid-training 阶段继续追加串行算力收益递减、甚至会退化部分能力，形成该阶段可吸收算力的实际天花板；需要回答同一预算该投给单次运行还是多次相似优化。
Method: 从共享 checkpoint 按不同受控配方分叉出多条独立轨迹，用验证集选出最强 checkpoint，做 intra-trajectory 与 inter-trajectory 两级 averaging 合并为单一模型；并给出局部 bias–variance 分析，区分两级平均的作用并刻画 checkpoint 选择引入的 bias。
Result: 在匹配预算下，跨模型规模、学习率调度、token 预算与轨迹数，聚合下游性能均超过最强单轨迹平均，且预算扩大时持续提升，优势在完全相同的 post-training pipeline 后保留；分析显示 inter-trajectory averaging 能消除单轨迹内平均够不到的残差，而 checkpoint 选择带来的 bias 决定了值得合并的 checkpoint 数量上限。
Conclusion: 轨迹分配与合并是把 mid-training 的 compute-scaling 前沿推过串行饱和点的可行手段：共享 checkpoint 分叉产生的兼容多样性是单次延长运行拿不到的。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: Trajectory Soup 把 mid-training 预算分给多个从共享 checkpoint 分叉、配方受控的独立分支，再按验证集挑出最强 checkpoint 做轨迹内与轨迹间平均合并成单一模型。在匹配预算下，它在各模型规模、学习率调度、token 预算与轨迹数上都优于最强单轨迹平均，且预算扩大时优势持续增长，post-training 后仍保留。

papers.title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations in Vision-Language-Action Models via Predicting Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle under visual distribution shifts, often relying on spurious correlations tied to domain-specific factors rather than task-relevant structure. We propose Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead (DILL), a representation-learning framework that mitigates shortcut learning in VLA policies. Our key idea is to supervise policies with domain-invariant future latents learned from domain-transformed trajectory data. A Task-Domain Encoder is trained with contrastive objectives and Gaussian disentanglement regularization to separate task-relevant structure from domain-specific visual variation. The learned encoder then provides future latents for VLA policy learning through lookahead prediction and domain disentanglement, encouraging the policy to focus on task-relevant structure rather than incidental visual factors. Counterfactual task-view evaluations show that DILL reduces shortcut reliance, while LIBERO-Plus evaluations demonstrate improved visual robustness, with 69.1% average success, 11.4 percentage points above the strongest baseline. Real-world manipulation experiments further support DILL's applicability beyond controlled simulation. Complementary latent-space diagnostics show that these behavioral gains are accompanied by representations that better preserve task-consistent structure while suppressing domain-specific variation. Our project page is available at https://dill-vla.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project website: https://dill-vla.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DILL 用域不变的未来隐变量 (domain-invariant latent lookahead) 监督 VLA 策略，切断视觉分布偏移下的伪相关捷径。Task-Domain Encoder 经对比目标与高斯解耦正则分离任务结构与域特异视觉变化，再通过 lookahead 预测为策略提供未来隐变量。LIBERO-Plus 上平均成功率 69.1%，比最强基线高 11.4 个百分点。
Motivation: VLA 策略在视觉分布偏移下易依赖与域绑定的伪相关而非任务相关结构，导致捷径学习与脆弱性。
Method: 训练 Task-Domain Encoder，用对比学习目标加高斯解耦正则 (Gaussian disentanglement regularization) 分离任务相关结构与域特异视觉变化；再以该编码器在域变换轨迹数据上产出的未来隐变量，通过 lookahead 预测与域解耦监督 VLA 策略学习。

Conclusion: 用域不变未来隐变量做策略监督可同时减少 VLA 的捷径依赖并提升视觉鲁棒性，且在真实操作中同样成立。

papers.title: End-to-End Self-Supervised RGB-T Tracking without Modality Misleading
papers.abstract_en: RGB-T object tracking leverages the complementary characteristics of visible and thermal infrared modalities to improve robustness under adverse conditions. Existing supervised methods typically rely on costly modality-aligned bounding box annotations, while most self-supervised approaches follow a two-stage pseudo-labeling paradigm, making tracker training sensitive to pseudo-label quality and preventing joint end-to-end optimization. In this paper, we propose ESMTrack, a fully end-to-end self-supervised RGB-T tracking framework without offline pseudo-label generation or dense frame-level bounding box annotations. Given only the standard initial-frame annotation used in visual tracking, ESMTrack learns discriminative and temporally consistent representations through two complementary objectives: a grounding triplet loss on annotated initial frames and a cross-frame temporal triplet loss on unlabeled search frames, with reliable samples selected by forward-backward consistency. To address modality dominance bias, ESMTrack employs a three-branch architecture consisting of a fusion branch and two unimodal branches for RGB and thermal inputs. We quantify modality contributions using the Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy by measuring response discrepancies between the fusion and unimodal branches. The resulting reliability estimates guide a training-time modality decoupling mechanism that suppresses dominant-modality shortcuts and adaptively weights cross-modal contrastive learning for task-level alignment. Extensive experiments on five RGB-T tracking benchmarks show that ESMTrack achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance, strong cross-dataset generalization, and real-time inference speed. The source code is available at https://github.com/LiShenglana/ESMTrack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ESMTrack 把 RGB-T 目标跟踪做成完全端到端的自监督训练：只用首帧标注，靠 grounding triplet loss 与跨帧 temporal triplet loss 联合优化，无需离线伪标签。三分支结构用 Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy 量化融合分支与单模态分支的响应差异，据此在训练时解耦主导模态捷径并自适应加权跨模态对比学习。在五个 RGB-T 跟踪基准上达到有竞争力的 SOTA 水平、强跨数据集泛化与实时推理速度。
Motivation: RGB-T 跟踪的监督方法依赖昂贵的模态对齐框标注，现有自监督方法又走两阶段伪标签范式，训练对伪标签质量敏感且无法联合端到端优化。
Method: 仅给首帧标注，用 grounding triplet loss（标注首帧）与 cross-frame temporal triplet loss（无标注搜索帧）两个互补目标，靠 forward-backward consistency 筛选可靠样本；三分支架构含融合分支与 RGB、热红外两个单模态分支，以 Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy 度量融合与单模态响应差异得到模态可靠性估计，驱动训练时模态解耦与跨模态对比学习的自适应加权。
Result: 在五个 RGB-T 跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的 state-of-the-art 性能、强跨数据集泛化与实时推理速度；源码发布于 github.com/LiShenglana/ESMTrack。
Conclusion: 去掉离线伪标签、只留首帧标注也能把 RGB-T 跟踪训练成端到端流程，模态贡献的量化估计是抑制主导模态捷径、实现任务级对齐的关键。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Vote Hides the Failure: Aggregation Choice and Noise Robustness in Heart Murmur Detection
papers.abstract_en: Noise robustness in automated phonocardiogram (PCG) murmur detection, and how it is measured, remains underexamined despite growing interest in low-resource screening. We evaluate two independently reimplemented pipelines, Hierarchical Multi-Scale Convolutional Network (HMS-Net)--CNN, and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM)--LSTM, under controlled, multi-severity noise with noise-augmented fine-tuning and held-out generalization testing. Under matched aggregation, the complete BiLSTM pipeline outperforms the complete HMS-Net pipeline across all conditions in accuracy and Weighted Accuracy. A stable aggregate accuracy score can misrepresent what individual predictions show: HMS-Net's native aggregation degrades under salt-and-pepper noise far less than majority-vote (MV) aggregation at the same severity, a gap reflecting window-level disagreement its native rule absorbs, while BiLSTM's MV accuracy rises after noise-augmented training even though its individual predictions do not improve. HMS-Net's training effect is significant under one accuracy metric but not another. Noise-robustness conclusions can depend as much on evaluation choices as on the models themselves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在心音 (PCG) 杂音检测上对比两条复现管线 HMS-Net 与 BiLSTM，发现聚合方式本身会掩盖噪声鲁棒性结论：匹配聚合下 BiLSTM 全面更优，但 HMS-Net 原生聚合在椒盐噪声下比多数投票 (MV) 退化小得多，而 BiLSTM 经噪声增强训练后 MV 精度上升、个体预测却没变好。作者主张噪声鲁棒性结论同时取决于评估选择与模型本身。
Motivation: 低资源场景下自动 PCG 杂音检测的噪声鲁棒性及其度量方式长期被忽视，聚合规则可能让稳定的总分掩盖个体预测的真实表现。
Method: 独立复现两条管线：Hierarchical Multi-Scale Convolutional Network (HMS-Net) 与 Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM)，在受控多严重度噪声下做噪声增强微调与留出泛化测试，并对比原生聚合与多数投票 (MV) 两种聚合规则，指标用 accuracy 与 Weighted Accuracy。
Result: 匹配聚合下完整 BiLSTM 管线在所有条件下 accuracy 与 Weighted Accuracy 均高于完整 HMS-Net 管线；同一严重度椒盐 (salt-and-pepper) 噪声下 HMS-Net 原生聚合的精度退化远小于 MV，差距来自其原生规则吸收的窗口级分歧；BiLSTM 经噪声增强训练后 MV accuracy 上升但个体预测未改善；HMS-Net 的训练效应在一个精度指标下显著、另一个下不显著。
Conclusion: 噪声鲁棒性结论对聚合与指标选择高度敏感，单看稳定总分会误判模型的真实预测质量。

papers.title: GLASS: Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding for Scalable All-Atom Crystal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for crystals enable the discovery of novel structures, but scaling all-atom generation to larger systems such as metal--organic frameworks remains challenging. We connect this difficulty to the correspondence problem of particle-space generation. Even on a single fixed target set, index-free permutation-equivariant particle flows require substantially more training for reliable generation as set size and density increase, under both independent and optimal-transport couplings. To resolve this challenge, we introduce GLASS---Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding, which encodes structures in a permutation-invariant global latent space and learns their distribution via flow matching. A learned-slot decoder constructs all atoms in parallel, removing atom-wise correspondence from generative transport. On MP20, GLASS is competitive with particle-space models, and flow training can reach the validity of the training data at every structure size. On a QMOF subset, GLASS generates MOFs with up to 150 atoms per unit cell without conditioning on building blocks, topology, or composition, and approaches the structural validity of the training data. On both datasets, flow training exposes a validity--novelty tradeoff, and MOF novelty remains limited by autoencoder generalization on the available data. These results show that separating correspondence assignment from generative transport provides a simple route toward high-validity generation of larger atomistic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLASS 把全原子晶体生成的对应分配从生成传输中剥离：用置换不变全局潜空间编码结构并以 flow matching 学分布，再由 learned-slot 解码器并行构造全部原子。在 MP20 上与 particle-space 模型相当，flow 训练在各结构尺寸上都能达到训练数据的 validity；在 QMOF 子集上无需 building block、topology 或 composition 条件即可生成单胞最多 150 原子的 MOF，并接近训练数据的结构 validity。
Motivation: 把全原子生成扩展到金属有机框架 (MOF) 这类大体系很困难，根源是 particle-space 生成的对应问题：即便目标集合固定，index-free 的置换等变粒子流在集合规模与密度上升时需要多得多的训练才能可靠生成，独立耦合与最优传输耦合下都是如此。
Method: GLASS (Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding) 将结构编码进置换不变的全局潜空间，用 flow matching 学其分布；learned-slot 解码器并行构造所有原子，从而把原子级对应从生成传输中移除。
Result: 在 MP20 上 GLASS 与 particle-space 模型相当，flow 训练在每种结构尺寸上都能达到训练数据的 validity；在 QMOF 子集上生成单胞最多 150 原子的 MOF 且不依赖 building block、topology 或 composition 条件，接近训练数据的 structural validity。两个数据集上 flow 训练都呈现 validity–novelty 权衡，MOF 新颖性受可用数据上 autoencoder 泛化限制。
Conclusion: 把对应分配与生成传输分开，是走向更大原子体系高 validity 生成的简单路径；代价是 validity–novelty 权衡，且 MOF 新颖性受 autoencoder 泛化制约。
Relevance: 2
