papers.title: From Learner Behavior to Reusable Skills for Effective and Efficient Learner Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Learner simulation aims to reproduce how a particular learner behaves on new tasks. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate increasingly fine-grained learning behaviors, existing approaches often need to repeatedly process a growing interaction history to reconstruct the learner. This introduces additional context and inference costs and makes the acquired learner-specific simulation capability difficult to reuse across different LLMs. We therefore propose Learner2Skill, which externalizes the simulation capability acquired from historical interactions into a persistent and reusable Simulation Skill. The Skill captures the learner's current learning state and recurring response patterns, evolves as new real interactions arrive, and can be adapted to a new LLM through lightweight executor calibration without reconstructing the learner from scratch. Experiments show that Learner2Skill more faithfully reproduces fine-grained learner behavior while reducing overall token cost, and that the same constructed Skills can be effectively reused across different LLM executors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Learner2Skill 把 LLM 从历史交互中学到的模拟能力外化为持久可复用的 Simulation Skill，记录学习者当前学习状态与反复出现的响应模式，随新真实交互演化，并通过轻量 executor calibration 迁移到新 LLM，无需从零重建学习者。实验显示它更忠实复现细粒度学习者行为，同时降低整体 token 成本，且同一 Skill 可跨不同 LLM executor 复用。
Motivation: 现有学习者模拟方法需反复处理不断增长的交互历史来重建学习者，带来额外上下文与推理成本，且学到的模拟能力难以跨不同 LLM 复用。
Method: 提出 Learner2Skill：将历史交互中获得的模拟能力外化为持久的 Simulation Skill，捕获学习者当前学习状态与反复出现的响应模式；Skill 随新真实交互演化，并通过轻量 executor calibration 适配到新 LLM，而不必从零重建学习者。

Conclusion: 把学习者模拟能力外化为可演化、可跨 executor 校准的 Skill，是同时改善模拟保真度与成本、并实现能力复用的路径。

papers.title: Lucid Dreaming for World Models: Learning to Doubt Imagination and Decide by Trust
papers.abstract_en: World models enable agents to learn and plan in imagination, but predictions beyond their experience can become unreliable and mislead decisions. Existing uncertainty estimates derived from predictions can remain overconfident on unfamiliar state-action pairs. We propose the Lucid World Model (LucidWM), which learns doubt from experience and propagates trust through imagination. By integrating Subjective Logic into categorical latent transitions, LucidWM distinguishes predicted outcomes from their evidential support and assigns each transition a degree of doubt. The complement of this doubt defines transition-level trust, which accumulates multiplicatively along imagined trajectories to reweight returns for policy learning and guide action selection. Uncertainty estimation requires no additional parameters or forward passes. Evaluated on four base world models against seventeen uncertainty readouts, LucidWM detects environmental changes and signals uncertainty during action-corrupted rollouts. In a controlled navigation case study, acting on trust reduces the number of steps required to reach the goal from 362 to 190. Fifteen demonstration videos show how LucidWM doubts its dreams and acts on that doubt. Videos are available at https://lucidwm.github.io.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 22 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://lucidwm.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Lucid World Model (LucidWM)，把 Subjective Logic 接入 categorical latent transition，让世界模型在想象中区分预测结果与其证据支撑，为每个 transition 赋 doubt，其补即 trust 并沿想象轨迹相乘累积，用于重加权回报与指导动作选择。在四个基座世界模型、十七种 uncertainty readout 上可检测环境变化并在动作污染 rollout 中发出不确定信号，受控导航案例中到达目标所需步数从 362 降到 190。
Motivation: 世界模型在经验之外的想象预测不可靠并会误导决策，而基于预测本身得到的不确定性估计在陌生 state-action 对上仍会过度自信。
Method: 将 Subjective Logic 融入 categorical latent transition，把预测与证据支撑分离并输出 transition 级 doubt；doubt 的补定义为 trust，沿想象轨迹乘法累积，用于重加权策略学习的 return 并引导动作选择，估计过程不引入额外参数或前向传播。
Result: 在四个基座世界模型上对照十七种 uncertainty readout 进行评估，LucidWM 能检测环境变化并在动作污染 (action-corrupted) rollout 中给出不确定信号；受控导航案例中按 trust 行动把到达目标的步数从 362 降至 190。
Conclusion: 从经验中学习 doubt、让 trust 沿想象传播，可以在不增加参数与前向开销的前提下抑制世界模型想象的过度自信并改善决策。

papers.title: When Tools Silently Lie: Evaluating and Mitigating Blind Compliance in Tool-Augmented Data Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented data agents rely on tool outputs for analytical decisions. Yet successful execution can return plausible but incorrect evidence, requiring agents to decide whether to trust or verify it. Understanding this failure requires examining both the evidence obtained through checking and the answer ultimately adopted. We introduce ToxicBench to measure checking and adoption under numerical, label, schema, and retrieval errors, pairing clean and poisoned observations over fixed source data. In the 118-task GPT evaluation across three adapters, poisoning lowers task success by 26 to 39 percentage points. Ordinary retries help under one-shot poisoning, whereas repeated poisoning reveals wrong-answer adoption after checking. Controls on three public tables isolate how supplied evidence affects recovery. After freezing the scorer, we compare its judgments with human annotations on 200 trajectories, finding 96% task-success agreement. Human judgments support retry gains over Base and confirm adoption after checking on audited tasks. We release trajectories, versioned scoring, and reference and delivery audits. These findings highlight evidence availability and answer selection as complementary dimensions of agent reliability.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 8 figures. Code and benchmark materials: https://github.com/turambar928/Toxic_Tool_Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ToxicBench，用成对的干净/污染观测度量工具增强数据 agent 在检查后是否仍采纳错误答案：118 任务、三种 adapter 的 GPT 评测中，投毒使任务成功率下降 26 到 39 个百分点；普通重试在一次性投毒下有效，但重复投毒时 agent 检查过后仍采纳错误答案。
Motivation: 工具执行成功也可能返回貌似合理但错误的证据，agent 难以判断该信任还是该验证；现有评测只看最终答案，不区分“检查得到的证据”与“最终采纳的答案”这两个失效环节。
Method: ToxicBench 在固定源数据上配对干净与投毒观测，注入数值、标签、schema、检索四类错误；在 118 任务、三种 adapter 上做 GPT 评测，并用三张公开表格的对照实验隔离所提供证据对恢复的影响；打分器冻结后与人工标注比对。
Result: 投毒使任务成功率下降 26–39 个百分点（118 任务、三 adapter）；冻结打分器与 200 条轨迹的人工标注在任务成功上一致率 96%；人工判断支持重试相对 Base 的增益，并在受审任务上确认“检查后仍采纳”现象。
Conclusion: 证据可得性与答案选择是 agent 可靠性的两个互补维度，只测最终答案会漏掉检查后仍采纳错误答案的失效；作者发布轨迹、版本化打分器以及 reference 与 delivery 审计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multimodal Detection of Higher-Order Behavioral Constructs: Self-Compassion in Structured Reflective Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Many of the qualities that matter most in how people learn and grow, how someone regulates their emotions, reflects on a setback, or stays aware of others during a difficult conversation, are not directly observable. They have to be inferred from how someone speaks, moves, and sounds over time, and they resist the kind of clean labeling that most machine learning pipelines are built around. We study this challenge through a case that is well grounded in psychological theory but rarely modeled computationally: self-compassion, the tendency to respond to one's own setbacks with patience rather than harsh self-criticism. We examine how it appears during structured reflective interviews in a technology-mediated training setting, where people naturally talk through socio-emotionally demanding situations. Since no existing dataset captures this kind of construct in this kind of setting, we collected and annotated 51 reflective dialog sessions using an independent, temporally overlapping annotation scheme grounded in established theory. We consolidate the underlying six-component psychological model into a three-class supervision space, balancing self-kindness and mindfulness against self-critical or overwhelmed states, and build a reproducible window-based pipeline that aligns video, audio, and text on a shared timeline. Unimodal models trained on each modality separately are compared against a simple probability-level fusion strategy, which yields modest but consistent gains over the best single modality. We close by discussing where each modality succeeds or struggles, what this suggests about how this kind of construct is actually expressed in reflective speech, and what would be needed to model it, and constructs like it, more effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对难以直接观测的高阶心理构念（自我关怀 self-compassion），用 51 场结构化反思访谈的多模态数据做三分类检测：把六成分心理学模型压成三类监督空间，对齐视频、音频、文本时间线后训练单模态模型，再做概率级融合。融合相对最佳单模态取得 modest but consistent 的提升。
Motivation: 情绪调节、挫折反思等高阶构念无法直接观测，只能从说话、动作、声音随时间的变化中推断，且难以干净标注；现有数据集没有在技术中介的培训场景中捕捉这类构念。
Method: 收集并标注 51 场反思对话 session，采用独立的、时间上重叠的标注方案；将六成分心理学模型整合为三类监督空间（自我友善与正念 对比 自我批判或失控状态）；构建可复现的窗口式管线，把视频、音频、文本对齐到共享时间轴，分别训练单模态模型并与简单概率级融合策略对比。
Result: 概率级融合相对最佳单模态取得 modest but consistent 的提升；摘要给出数据规模为 51 场反思对话 session、监督空间为三类、原始模型含六个成分，并讨论各模态的成功与失败位置。
Conclusion: 这类构念在反思性言语中的表达需要多模态对齐与融合才能较有效地建模，且融合收益是温和而非压倒性的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Improved Distributional Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Distributional Diffusion Models (DDMs) replace the standard mean-prediction denoiser with a \emph{distributional} denoiser trained via a scoring rule objective, learning a stochastic approximation to $p(x_1 \mid x_t)$ rather than its conditional mean. However, scaling DDMs to modern image-generation settings faces two obstacles: (i) multi-particle training incurs overhead that scales with the number of particles, (ii) DDMs use globally fixed scoring rule hyperparameters, forcing a single trade-off across sampling budgets. We mitigate these limitations by deferring particle expansion to late transformer layers, and the hyperparameter trade-off by introducing time-dependent scoring rule schedules informed by the dynamical regimes of~\citet{Biroli2024}. Combined with a DiT-based latent setup, these changes make DDM training practical on class-conditional ImageNet-$256^2$, achieving 4.48 FID at 4 steps and 2.38 at 50 steps with DiT-XL/2, from a single model trained from scratch in one stage, without a teacher, self-distillation or JVPs. The result is a stochastic few-step generator whose FID does not degrade as the sampling budget grows from 4 to 50 NFE, and the same recipe transfers to text-to-image generation. Code and pre-trained models available at https://github.com/CompVis/iDDM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把分布式扩散模型 (DDM) 的多粒子训练推迟到 Transformer 后段层，并用 Biroli2024 动力学区间驱动的时变 scoring rule 调度替代全局固定超参，使其在 DiT-XL/2 潜空间生成上从零单阶段训练即可实用。在 class-conditional ImageNet-256² 上单模型达到 4 步 FID 4.48、50 步 FID 2.38，采样预算从 4 增到 50 NFE 时 FID 不劣化，同一配方可迁移到文生图。
Motivation: DDM 用 scoring rule 训练的分布去噪器替代条件均值去噪器，但多粒子训练开销随粒子数增长，且 scoring rule 超参全局固定，无法在不同采样预算间取舍，难以扩展到现代图像生成规模。
Method: 粒子扩展推迟到 Transformer 后段层以降低多粒子开销；引入由 Biroli2024 动力学区间 (dynamical regimes) 决定的时变 scoring rule 调度替代固定超参；整体采用 DiT-based latent 设置，单模型从零训练、单阶段，不使用 teacher、self-distillation 或 JVP。
Result: class-conditional ImageNet-256² 上 DiT-XL/2 达到 4 步 FID 4.48、50 步 FID 2.38；采样预算从 4 增至 50 NFE 时 FID 不下降；同一配方可迁移到 text-to-image 生成。
Conclusion: 延迟粒子扩展加时变 scoring rule 调度足以让 DDM 在现代潜空间图像生成上实用，产出的随机少步生成器在 4–50 NFE 范围内 FID 对采样预算不敏感。

papers.title: From Judgment Quality to Downstream Utility: Rethinking LLM-as-a-Judge for Open-Ended Tasks
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Judge is increasingly used to evaluate policy responses on open-ended tasks that lack ground-truth answers. Existing work often directly converts the resulting judgments into reward signals for policy training, paying limited attention to intrinsic judgment quality and largely restricting the use of Judges to training-time supervision. We systematically investigate judgment quality and downstream utility by examining both how judgments are elicited and how they are used. For judgment elicitation, we vary the Judge protocol along three dimensions: verdict granularity, critique usage, and evaluation batching. For judgment usage, beyond policy training, we extend Judge to test-time inference through Best-of-N selection, Judge-guided revision, and beam search. We find that, (i) Surprisingly, judgment quality and downstream utility do not always align. (ii) Judge protocol design substantially affects both intrinsic judgment quality and downstream utility. (iii) Judge guidance effectively converts test-time compute into performance gains, with benefits varying across inference strategies. Our results call for a multifaceted evaluation of LLM Judges on open-ended tasks, encompassing intrinsic judgment quality, and downstream utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究 LLM-as-a-Judge 在无标准答案开放任务上的判断质量与下游效用，发现二者并不总是一致：改变 Judge 协议（判决粒度、批评使用、评估批处理）会同时显著改变内在判断质量与策略训练收益，而 Judge 引导能把测试时算力转成性能提升，且收益随推理策略不同。作者主张对开放任务上的 Judge 做多维评估，同时看内在质量与下游效用。
Motivation: 现有工作把 Judge 判断直接转成策略训练奖励，既不系统考察判断质量本身，也基本只把 Judge 用在训练期监督，导致判断质量与下游收益是否对齐这一前提未经检验。
Method: 沿两个轴做系统实验：判断生成端改变 Judge 协议的三个维度（verdict granularity、critique usage、evaluation batching）；判断使用端除策略训练外扩展到测试时推理，包括 Best-of-N 选择、Judge-guided revision 与 beam search。

Conclusion: 开放任务上评估 LLM Judge 必须同时覆盖内在判断质量与下游效用，单看其中一面会误判协议优劣；Judge 的价值不止于训练期奖励，也在于测试时推理引导。

papers.title: MSTypography: Multi-character Semantic Typography via Balancing Word Legibility and Object Recognizability
papers.abstract_en: Semantic typography is a design technique where the visual representation of a word conveys its semantic meaning, while maintaining its legibility. Existing digital typography methods mainly focus on single-character scenarios. They suffer from a lack of legibility constraints and insufficient local deformation when extended to multi-character words, as the intricate structures among multiple characters are hardly preserved during the typography process. In this paper, we propose a global-to-local typography framework for multi-character scenarios. It performs mask-driven silhouette approximation at the global level, while semantic-guided refinement at the local level, with a culling step in between to improve efficiency. To preserve word legibility, we designed structural losses (including explicit collision constraints and implicit Jacobian singular value constraints) and an OCR constraint for character-level readability. To enhance the object recognizability, we leverage semantic guidance with diffusion priors, which drives the character glyph toward the target concept while preserving its structural integrity. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first multi-character semantic typography method that effectively balances word legibility and object recognizability. Evaluations on five representative languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic) demonstrate superiority over SOTA methods. Codes will be open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSTypography 提出首个面向多字符语义排版的全局到局部框架：全局做 mask 驱动的轮廓逼近，中间插入剔除步骤省算力，局部用语义引导细化，并以结构损失（显式碰撞约束 + 隐式 Jacobian 奇异值约束）和 OCR 约束保住字词可读性，用扩散先验把字形推向目标概念。在英、中、日、韩、阿五种语言的评测中优于 SOTA 方法，代码将开源。
Motivation: 现有数字排版方法主要面向单字符，缺少可读性约束，扩展到多字符词时字符间复杂结构难以保留，局部形变不足。
Method: 全局到局部框架：全局层做 mask 驱动的轮廓逼近，中间插入 culling 步骤提升效率，局部层做语义引导细化；可读性靠结构损失（显式碰撞约束与隐式 Jacobian 奇异值约束）加 OCR 字符级约束，可识别性靠扩散先验的语义引导驱动字形逼近目标概念同时保持结构完整。
Result: 在 English、Chinese、Japanese、Korean、Arabic 五种代表性语言上评测，优于 SOTA 方法；作者称其为首个有效平衡字词可读性与物体可识别性的多字符语义排版方法。
Conclusion: 把可读性约束与语义先验分层耦合，可以在多字符场景下同时守住字词结构与目标概念识别，代码将开源。

papers.title: TaoFlowForge: Progressive Native Mesh Generation via Cascaded Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: 3D content generation technology has significantly advanced the work of designers, as well as the 3D printing and gaming industries. However, it remains difficult to produce lightweight, editable, and topologically clean artistic content that is directly production-ready. To achieve this, we present TaoFlowForge, an artistic mesh foundation model that generates production-ready meshes. Specifically, TaoFlowForge decomposes the mesh generation process into vertices generation and their connectivity prediction, i.e., edges. We formulate vertices generation as a two-stage coarse-to-fine process and incorporate several effective loss functions to further enhance its performance. In the connectivity prediction stage, we propose a simple yet effective method for estimating the connectivity affinity between vertices and additionally predict per-vertex normals, which determines the correct orientation of faces. Besides, we construct a large-scale dataset combining hand-crafted 3D assets with public high-quality topology datasets. Based on this, a carefully designed data curation pipeline is employed to filter the raw dataset, retaining only high-quality topology data for model training. Our model is trained on the combined dataset and tested on both out-of-distribution hand-crafted set of 3D assets and public datasets. Under image-conditioned generation, TaoFlowForge outperforms autoregressive methods and achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source mesh topology generators. We will release all the code and weights together with a portion of our test dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaoFlowForge 把艺术网格生成拆成顶点生成与连通性（边）预测两阶段：顶点用由粗到细的两阶段 flow matching 加多种损失，连通性阶段估计顶点间连接亲和度并同时预测逐顶点法线以确定面朝向。在图像条件生成下，它超过自回归方法，在开源网格拓扑生成器中达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 3D 内容生成难以直接产出轻量、可编辑、拓扑干净且可直接投产的艺术网格，现有方法在拓扑质量与生产可用性上存在缺口。
Method: 将网格生成解耦为顶点生成与连通性预测：顶点侧采用两阶段 coarse-to-fine 流程并配合多种有效损失；连通性侧提出顶点间连接亲和度估计方法，并额外预测逐顶点 normals 以确定面朝向。同时构建融合手工 3D 资产与公开高质量拓扑数据集的大规模训练集，并用数据筛选管线只保留高质量拓扑数据训练。
Result: 在图像条件生成设定下，TaoFlowForge 优于自回归 (autoregressive) 方法，并在开源网格拓扑生成器中取得 state-of-the-art 结果；测试覆盖分布外的手工 3D 资产集与公开数据集。
Conclusion: 把网格生成拆成顶点与连通性两阶段并配合高质量拓扑数据筛选，可以产出可直接投产的网格；作者将开源全部代码、权重及部分测试数据集。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Language-Guided Imitation Learning via Instruction Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Using language instructions as conditions to guide robot policy learning has recently become an important research domain. However, existing language-guided policy learning methods typically use an overall task description to guide the entire demonstration trajectory. For manipulation tasks involving multiple execution stages, these methods assign the same language description to different subtasks, making it difficult to distinguish the behaviors required at different stages. In this work, we propose a multi-granularity language guidance method based on instruction decomposition. The proposed method decomposes an overall task description into more fine-grained, concrete subtask-level language instructions, thereby enhancing learning efficiency and improving performance. We evaluate the proposed method in the setting of multi-task imitation learning and validate its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多阶段操作任务中整段任务描述无法区分各阶段行为的问题，把总体指令分解为子任务级的细粒度语言指令，作为多任务模仿学习 (multi-task imitation learning) 的条件。分解后的多粒度语言指导提升了学习效率与性能，作者在多任务模仿学习设定下验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有语言引导策略学习用一句总体任务描述覆盖整条演示轨迹，多阶段操作任务里不同子任务被贴上同一描述，模型难以区分各阶段应有的行为。
Method: 提出基于指令分解 (instruction decomposition) 的多粒度语言引导：把总体任务描述拆成更细粒度、具体的子任务级指令，再以这些指令为条件指导策略学习，评估设定为多任务模仿学习。
Result: 分解后的子任务级语言指令增强了学习效率并改善性能；作者在多任务模仿学习设定下验证了方法有效性。
Conclusion: 把语言条件细化到子任务粒度，是让多阶段操作任务的模仿学习区分各阶段行为、提升效率的有效途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SQUARE: Structured Quantum Representation Adapters as Compact Quadratic Feature Maps for Frozen Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Frozen language models (LMs) are increasingly used as fixed feature extractors for downstream reranking, scoring, and preference modeling, raising a practical question: how should a compact module represent interactions among features in a fixed low-dimensional bottleneck? Common linear and low-rank adapters remain linear at the adaptation module itself, whereas explicit second-order alternatives introduce pairwise interactions through direct parameterization or predefined factorizations. We propose SQUARE, a Structured QUAntum REpresentation adapter that amplitude-encodes the bottleneck vector, applies a parameterized quantum circuit, and measures the resulting state. We show that each basis-probability feature is exactly a normalized quadratic form in the bottleneck coordinates, while the additional Pauli-$Z$ readouts are signed linear combinations of these probabilities. The measured map can therefore parameterize interactions over $O(d^2)$ coordinate pairs through a small set of shared circuit parameters, where $d$ is the bottleneck dimension. It provides a structured parameterization within, rather than beyond, the classical normalized-quadratic feature class. In a disjoint same-pipeline evaluation over eight GLUE-derived controlled interaction tasks and five shared seeds, SQUARE achieves an average test accuracy of $0.7565$, compared with $0.7355$ for an affine normalized-quadratic predictor, $0.7271$ for the evaluated parameter-matched Givens mixing model, $0.6817$ for an MLP, and $0.6155$ for a frozen-circuit control. Under reduced supervision, it also shows consistent gains over the strongest evaluated classical comparator, with the same qualitative pattern across multiple frozen LM backbones. All circuit experiments use simulation, while the learned feature map can be evaluated exactly in batched PyTorch without quantum hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SQUARE 把冻结语言模型瓶颈向量做振幅编码送入参数化量子电路并测量，证明每个基概率特征恰是瓶颈坐标的归一化二次型，Pauli-Z 读出是这些概率的带符号线性组合，从而用少量共享电路参数参数化 O(d²) 坐标对交互。在八个 GLUE 衍生受控交互任务、五个共享种子上平均测试准确率 0.7565，高于仿射归一化二次预测器 0.7355、参数匹配 Givens mixing 0.7271、MLP 0.6817 与冻结电路对照 0.6155。
Motivation: 冻结 LM 作固定特征提取器时，线性与低秩 adapter 在适配模块本身仍是线性的，显式二阶替代又依赖直接参数化或预定义分解，缺少在固定低维瓶颈内紧凑表示特征交互的结构化参数化。
Method: 对瓶颈向量做振幅编码 (amplitude encoding)，经参数化量子电路后测量；基概率特征为归一化二次型，附加 Pauli-Z 读出为其带符号线性组合，共享电路参数覆盖 O(d²) 对交互。评测为 disjoint same-pipeline，八个 GLUE 衍生受控交互任务、五个共享种子，对照 affine normalized-quadratic、参数匹配 Givens mixing、MLP 与 frozen-circuit control，并含降监督设置与多个冻结 LM backbone；全部电路实验为模拟，特征映射可在 PyTorch 中精确批量计算。
Result: 八个 GLUE 衍生任务、五种子平均测试准确率：SQUARE 0.7565，affine normalized-quadratic 0.7355，参数匹配 Givens mixing 0.7271，MLP 0.6817，frozen-circuit control 0.6155。降监督下相对最强已评估经典对照保持一致增益，多个冻结 LM backbone 上定性模式一致。
Conclusion: SQUARE 的量子电路特征映射属于（而非超越）经典归一化二次特征类，却通过结构化共享参数化在受控交互任务上取得更高准确率，且无需量子硬件即可精确评估。

papers.title: Train Ahead, Distill Back: Bootstrapping On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves large language models by letting a self-teacher with privileged information provide dense token-level supervision on the model's own trajectories. Yet existing methods typically construct the self-teacher from the current, initial, or slowly averaged policy state, leaving the quality of supervision constrained by the teacher's ability to exploit privileged information. We ask whether the model's own optimization progress can instead be recycled into a stronger self-teacher. In this paper, we introduce Bootstrapped On-Policy Self-Distillation (B-OPSD), which temporarily trains the policy ahead to obtain a future teacher, restores the student to the original policy state, and then uses the future teacher to supervise the restarted student. The future teacher improves supervision in two complementary ways, it can generate more reliable privileged trajectories and, conditioned on them, provide more informative token-level targets along the restarted student's on-policy trajectories. Experiments on mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B show consistent improvements over standard OPSD in both settings, including gains from 27.50 to 41.30 and from 48.80 to 64.44 in the rollout-privileged setting. Our findings point to a broader principle for self-improving models that future learning progress can be distilled backward, preserving acquired knowledge while bootstrapping beyond the optimization state that produced it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 B-OPSD：先把策略往前训练若干步得到“未来教师”，再把学生回滚到原始策略状态，用该未来教师对重启学生在其自身轨迹上做 token 级自蒸馏。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 的数学推理上，rollout-privileged 设置下指标分别从 27.50 提到 41.30、从 48.80 提到 64.44，均优于标准 OPSD。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 的自教师取自当前、初始或缓慢平均的策略状态，监督质量受限于该教师利用特权信息的能力，模型自身的优化进展没有被回收。
Method: B-OPSD 三步：临时把策略训练到更靠后的状态得到 future teacher，将学生恢复到原始策略状态，再由 future teacher 提供更可靠的特权轨迹，并在这些轨迹条件下对重启学生的 on-policy 轨迹给出更有信息量的 token 级目标。
Result: 数学推理实验在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 上相对标准 OPSD 均一致提升；rollout-privileged 设置下两组指标分别由 27.50 升至 41.30、由 48.80 升至 64.44。

papers.title: SkillCome: Group Contrast Skill Optimization with Dual Memory
papers.abstract_en: Skill evolution improves the capabilities of large language models by analyzing trajectories generated under a given skill and modifying the skill accordingly. Existing approaches typically generate a single trajectory per question. However, this provides insufficient optimization signals since it requires inferring effective skill edits from a solitary path. It is difficult to pinpoint which actions caused the failure in a failed trajectory, or to determine which actions in a successful one should be incorporated into the skill. Furthermore, they rely on a local batch of trajectories for analysis, making the optimization direction susceptible to noisy evidence. To address these, we propose SkillCome, a Skill-evolution method based on group Contrast optimization with dual memory. For each question, SkillCome generates trajectories and performs group contrast analysis to precisely identify key behavioral divergences between successful and failed trajectories, offering reliable optimization signals. The dual memory system further accumulates evidence from historical steps to track patterns shared across different groups, leading to more generalized optimization directions. Together, SkillCome builds a systematic optimization process that transforms experience from observed successful trajectories into reusable skills. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks spanning question answering, reasoning, and agentic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. SkillCome consistently outperforms baselines across five models of varying families and scales, with gains up to +5.69 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillCome 是面向大语言模型的技能进化方法：每题生成多条轨迹做组间对比 (group contrast)，找出成功与失败轨迹的关键行为分歧，再用双记忆 (dual memory) 累积历史步骤证据以稳定优化方向。在覆盖问答、推理与 agentic 任务的六个基准上，跨五个不同家族与规模的模型均稳定超过基线，最高提升 +5.69 分。
Motivation: 现有技能进化方法每题只生成一条轨迹，单条路径难以定位失败动作或成功动作，且依赖局部批次分析，优化方向容易被噪声证据带偏。
Method: 对每道题生成多条轨迹并做组间对比分析，从成功与失败轨迹的行为分歧中提取可靠优化信号；双记忆系统累积历史步骤证据，跨不同组追踪共性模式，把成功轨迹经验转化为可复用技能。
Result: 在六个基准（涵盖 question answering、reasoning 与 agentic 任务）上，跨五个不同家族与规模的模型 consistently outperform baselines，最高增益达 +5.69 分。
Conclusion: 单条轨迹提供的优化信号不足，组间对比加历史证据累积能把成功经验稳定地转成可复用技能。

papers.title: When Should Agents Check External State? Budgeting Observations for Stored Intentions
papers.abstract_en: Prospective memory allows an agent to retain an intention tied to a future condition, but the stored intention does not reveal whether that condition currently holds. Checking it may require web access, multi-step tool use, and paid calls. Existing systems decide when intentions require attention, but do not allocate the resulting observations under a shared budget. We introduce the first resource-allocation formulation for the external observations required by stored intentions under a shared episode budget. BudgetPM offers two policy variants that share a hard-budget executor. BudgetPM-Static uses a lightweight Logistic scorer to learn whether a check improves the current decision. BudgetPM-Sequential distills full-episode hindsight schedules into a lightweight policy that decides when to spend or reserve capacity using only pre-query information at deployment. We evaluate BudgetPM against two public memory-agent systems, five matched controls, and four hand-designed monitoring or budget-adaptation rules. Across two benchmarks and three backbones, BudgetPM-Static outperforms adapted Mem0 and PMA workflows. On PM-Bench, its Logistic scorer reaches competitive quality--cost operating points alongside higher-capacity scorers and retains 99.9--100\% of unconstrained quality with 42--54\% fewer observations. Under severe scarcity and the same hard caps, BudgetPM-Sequential exceeds the strongest tested natural monitoring schedule by 1.92--2.58 Set F1 points. It reaches the same Set F1 and on-time recall with 16--33\% fewer observations. Matched attribution, exact-cost analysis, and a fixed-budget load intervention link this gain to competition between present and future opportunities. These results yield a demand--capacity design rule: local gating works when capacity covers demand, while future-aware supervision adds value when observations compete across time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把带未来条件的存储意图 (prospective memory) 的外部观测查询建模为共享 episode 预算下的资源分配问题，提出 BudgetPM-Static（Logistic 打分器判断检查是否改善当前决策）与 BudgetPM-Sequential（蒸馏全回合 hindsight 调度，部署时仅凭查询前信息决定花费或保留容量）。在 PM-Bench 上 Static 保留 99.9–100% 无约束质量而少用 42–54% 观测；在观测严重稀缺、硬上限相同时 Sequential 比最强自然监控调度高 1.92–2.58 Set F1 点，并以少 16–33% 观测达到相同 Set F1 与 on-time recall。
Motivation: 现有记忆体系统只决定存储意图何时需要被注意，却不把由此产生的外部观测在共享预算下统一分配；而 web 访问、多步工具调用与付费调用使检查成本真实存在。
Method: 提出首个针对存储意图外部观测的共享 episode 预算资源分配形式化。BudgetPM-Static 用轻量 Logistic scorer 学习一次检查是否改善当前决策；BudgetPM-Sequential 把全回合 hindsight 调度蒸馏成轻量策略，部署时仅用查询前信息决定花费或保留容量；两者共用一个硬预算 executor。评测对比两个公开记忆体系统 (Mem0、PMA)、五个匹配对照与四条手工监控/预算自适应规则，覆盖两个 benchmark 与三个 backbone。
Result: 在两个 benchmark、三个 backbone 上，BudgetPM-Static 优于改造后的 Mem0 与 PMA 工作流。PM-Bench 上其 Logistic scorer 在质量–成本操作点上与更高容量 scorer 竞争，并以少 42–54% 的观测保留 99.9–100% 的无约束质量。观测严重稀缺且硬上限相同时，BudgetPM-Sequential 比最强受测自然监控调度高 1.92–2.58 Set F1 点，并以少 16–33% 的观测达到相同 Set F1 与 on-time recall；匹配归因、精确成本分析与固定预算负载干预把增益归因于当前机会与未来机会之间的竞争。
Conclusion: 作者给出 demand–capacity 设计规则：容量覆盖需求时局部 gating 足够，观测跨时间竞争时才需要面向未来的监督信号。

papers.title: EviViT: Evidence-Adaptive Vision Transformers for Fine-Grained Perception
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained visual perception enables vision-language models to distinguish subtle attributes and ground their answers in visual evidence. In high-resolution scenes, processing the whole image at greater resolution spends visual tokens on irrelevant content, while isolated crops can lose the context needed to interpret the selected evidence. We introduce EviViT, a lightweight attachment that learns where a pretrained vision transformer should acquire detail. Human visual-search traces supervise a question-conditioned evidence density, which guides regional re-reading from the original pixels and the allocation of visual tokens. A sparse, coordinate-aware bridge then connects the regional features to the global scene, allowing the host to interpret precise evidence in context. Learned with the host backbone frozen, the attachment serves both the base model and compatible post-trained descendants without refitting. Experiments across nine hosts show consistent gains in average fine-grained accuracy. Matched-budget comparisons further show that EviViT outperforms global-only processing at every tested token ceiling while using fewer visual tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EviViT 是一个轻量插件，用人类视觉搜索轨迹监督的问题条件证据密度图，决定预训练 ViT 在何处重读原始像素并分配视觉 token，再经坐标感知稀疏桥接把区域特征接回全局场景。骨干冻结训练后可直接服务基座及其后训练后代；在九个宿主模型上平均细粒度精度一致提升，且在每个测试 token 上限下都以更少视觉 token 超过全局处理。
Motivation: 高分辨率场景里整图提特征会把 token 花在无关内容上，孤立裁剪又丢掉解释证据所需的上下文，细粒度视觉问答缺少兼顾精度与 token 预算的取证据方式。
Method: 以人类视觉搜索轨迹 (Human-Search-Traces) 监督问题条件的证据密度估计，据此引导从原始像素的区域重读与视觉 token 分配；再用稀疏、坐标感知的 bridge 将区域特征接入全局场景。宿主骨干全程冻结，插件训练一次即可服务基座与兼容的后训练模型。
Result: 在九个宿主模型上平均细粒度精度一致提升；在匹配预算对比中，EviViT 在每一个测试过的 token 上限下都优于 global-only 处理，且所用视觉 token 更少。
Conclusion: 把取证据的位置决策交给可复用的轻量附件，可以在冻结骨干的前提下同时提高细粒度感知精度并压低视觉 token 开销。

papers.title: Learning the Structure of Triangular Transport Maps
papers.abstract_en: Triangular transport maps provide a flexible approach to sampling-based probabilistic modeling, including density estimation, generative modeling, and Bayesian inference. They transform an unknown target distribution into a simpler reference through a monotone triangular map. The map structure is defined by a variable ordering and sparsity pattern, which together encode a directed acyclic graph. Map quality can depend strongly on this structure, yet finding a good structure is computationally expensive because each candidate generally requires fitting a different map. A central challenge is therefore to learn density and structure jointly, while keeping computation manageable as dimension grows. We introduce Self-Structuring Transport Maps (SSTM), which learn the map, ordering, and sparsity jointly. We use SoftSort to learn the variable ordering and $L_0$ gates to learn the sparsity, while preserving a triangular structure. To keep the map scalable, we use a monotone BatchEnsemble that shares one weight matrix across all map components through rank-one adapters. Across synthetic and real data, jointly learning the structure and map gives better density estimates than estimating the structure first. When the structure is identifiable from the density, SSTM matches the density performance of a map fitted with the true structure and outperforms autoregressive flows. On large datasets, SSTM is competitive with autoregressive flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Structuring Transport Maps (SSTM)，用 SoftSort 学变量排序、L0 门学稀疏模式、单调 BatchEnsemble 共享权重矩阵，联合学习三角传输映射的密度与结构。联合学习比先定结构再拟合给出更好的密度估计；结构可辨识时 SSTM 追平用真实结构拟合的映射并优于自回归流，大数据集上与自回归流相当。
Motivation: 三角传输映射的结构（变量排序与稀疏模式）强烈影响映射质量，但每个候选结构通常要重新拟合一次映射，搜索代价随维度增长而失控，需要在保持计算可承受的同时联合学密度与结构。
Method: SSTM 联合学习映射、排序与稀疏：SoftSort 学可微变量排序，L0 门学稀疏模式并保持三角结构；映射用单调 BatchEnsemble，通过 rank-one adapters 在所有映射分量间共享同一权重矩阵以保证可扩展性。
Result: 在合成与真实数据上，联合学结构与映射比先估结构再拟合给出更好的密度估计；当结构可从密度辨识时，SSTM 达到用真实结构拟合的映射的密度性能并优于自回归流 (autoregressive flows)；在大数据集上与自回归流相当。
Conclusion: 排序与稀疏可以和密度一起端到端学出来，不必先搜结构再拟合，且在结构可辨识时能追平已知真实结构的上界。

papers.title: Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Recent approaches to reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models increasingly remove the critic to reduce training instability and memory overhead. Even where a critic is trained, it is discarded once training ends, although it has learned to predict outcomes. We revisit this trend and show that a pretrained critic's ability to predict future outcomes can make it a valuable asset for efficient long-horizon reasoning. First, we find that instability in critic-based RL for long chain-of-thought reasoning is largely an optimization artifact: keeping policy updates small and low in variance restores stable convergence. Second, a well-pretrained critic estimates the posterior probability of eventual success from later trajectory states and unfinished prefixes. Its predictions provide outcome-derived, dense, per-prefix learning signals that, during policy optimization, require neither completed rollouts, step-level annotations, nor external reward labels. Building on this insight, we introduce Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO), which repurposes a single calibrated, frozen critic as a rollout-level reward, a value baseline for generalized advantage estimation, and a success forecaster for unfinished prefixes. We further show that binarizing the debiased score stops the policy from exploiting the critic's length bias. Binarized, RFPO matches supervised PPO without a single label in the training loop, while cutting compute and memory overhead. This makes RFPO well suited to long-horizon reasoning tasks, where outcomes arrive late and generation dominates cost: because rollouts can be rewarded before they finish, training no longer has to pay for waiting on every trajectory to complete. Our findings challenge the prevailing critic-free paradigm and establish critic-based, reward-free optimization as a scalable and computationally efficient path for LLM post-training.

papers.title: Multichannel Audio Quality Assessment: Extending Pretrained Perceptual Models to Spatial Audio
papers.abstract_en: Accurate perceptual quality assessment is essential for evaluating and optimizing spatial audio, where perceived quality depends on both signal fidelity and inter-channel spatial relationships. However, subjective evaluation is costly, while existing perceptual models are often trained for limited channel configurations and cannot be directly applied to higher-channel-count audio. This raises the question: how can pretrained perceptual knowledge be effectively reused for multichannel spatial audio? Using 5.1-channel audio, we study four levels of multichannel integration: signal, prediction, latent, and feature and propose two learned approaches: latent-level aggregation of spatial-group representations and the feature-level Feature-Band Group Attention (FGAtt), which adaptively fuses spatial groups at the feature level before perceptual processing. Across five 5.1-channel test sets, FGAtt achieves the strongest over- all performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of feature-level adaptation for reusing pretrained perceptual knowledge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 5.1 声道空间音频感知质量评估，比较信号、预测、潜变量 (latent)、特征四个层级的多声道整合方式，并提出特征级的 Feature-Band Group Attention (FGAtt)，在感知处理前自适应融合空间分组。在五个 5.1 声道测试集上 FGAtt 整体表现最强，说明特征级适配能有效复用预训练感知知识。
Motivation: 主观听音评估成本高，而现有感知质量模型多针对有限声道数训练，无法直接用于更高声道数的空间音频，预训练感知知识难以迁移复用。
Method: 以 5.1 声道音频为对象，系统比较四个整合层级：信号级、预测级、潜变量级（空间分组表示的 latent 聚合）与特征级；提出的 FGAtt 在感知处理之前对空间分组做特征级自适应融合（feature-band group attention）。
Result: 在五个 5.1 声道测试集上，FGAtt 取得最强的整体性能，验证特征级适配优于信号、预测、潜变量等其他整合层级。
Conclusion: 复用预训练感知模型做多声道空间音频质量评估时，特征级适配是四个整合层级中最有效的路径。

papers.title: NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Expressive and Compact Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the role of appearance modeling in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and show that limited expressiveness in view-dependent reflectance is a key driver of representation redundancy. In standard 3DGS, low-order spherical harmonics (SH) are used, restricting the splats' ability to model high-frequency directional effects, which is typically compensated by increasing the number of splats. We propose \emph{NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Gaussian Splatting}, a hybrid representation that replaces per-splat SH-bases with a shared neural residual field. Each Gaussian encodes a compact set of appearance features and a lambertian base color, while a lightweight \emph{global scene-level MLP} predicts view-dependent residuals conditioned on viewing direction, distance, and per-splat features. This formulation enhances directional reflectance modeling by combining diffuse per-splat reflectance representations with a shared global function for high-frequency details, enabling both higher expressiveness and parameter sharing across splats. Our key insight is that by accurately capturing high-frequency directional reflectance, especially in specular regions, the GS-representation becomes more expressive, reducing the need for geometrically redundant splats. As a result, NRF-GS achieves comparable or better rendering quality while reducing the number of Gaussians by up to 50\%, and produces visibly improved specular and high-frequency details.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NRF-GS 用共享的神经残差场 (neural residual field) 替换 3DGS 中每个 splat 的低阶球谐 (SH) 外观基，把视角相关反射建模交给一个以视线方向、距离和 per-splat 特征为条件的轻量全局场景级 MLP。高频方向反射（尤其镜面区域）被准确表达后，几何冗余 splat 的需求下降，Gaussian 数量最多减少 50%，渲染质量相当或更好，镜面与高频细节可见改善。
Motivation: 标准 3DGS 用低阶 SH 建模视角相关反射，难以表达高频方向效应，只能靠增加 splat 数量来补偿，造成表示冗余。
Method: 混合表示：每个 Gaussian 只保留紧凑外观特征与 lambertian 基色，per-splat SH 基被共享的神经残差场取代；轻量全局场景级 MLP 以视线方向、距离和 per-splat 特征为条件预测视角相关残差，把 per-splat 漫反射与共享全局高频函数结合，实现跨 splat 参数共享。
Result: 在保持相当或更好渲染质量的前提下，Gaussian 数量最多减少 50%，镜面与高频细节可见改善。
Conclusion: 视角相关反射的表达能力不足是 3DGS 表示冗余的关键驱动，用共享神经残差场补上高频方向反射即可在不牺牲画质的情况下压缩 splat 数量。

papers.title: Interpretable intrinsic dimension estimation through componentwise calibration of distance and angle
papers.abstract_en: DANCo (Dimensionality from Angle and Norm Concentration) jointly calibrates nearest-neighbor distance and angular statistics and consistently reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on clean intrinsic-dimension (ID) benchmarks. Practical data, however, introduce neighborhood-relative noise and sample-amplitude heterogeneity that can distort these geometric signals. We reformulate DANCo componentwise, retaining separate distance and angular discrepancy curves so that the source of an estimate can be identified and interpreted. For the distance component, we derive a closed-form Kullback-Leibler divergence for the generic-order ratios of the generalized ratios ID estimator (Gride); when both angular parameters are matched (Full), Gride reduces mean percentage error from $27.7\%$ to $17.6\%$ at noise equal to $40\%$ of typical neighbor spacing on 24 manifolds. For the angular component, two sampling regimes motivate aligning mean direction while retaining concentration matching (Profiled). On a Gaussian scale mixture with generating dimension 70 embedded in 100 dimensions, profiling raises the Minimum Neighbor Distance (MiND) estimate from $22.8$ to $66.7$, while removing the known amplitudes restores MiND-Full to $71.9$; the control thus attributes the Full shortfall to amplitude heterogeneity. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, amplitude-reducing normalizations move angular location toward the references and narrow the Full-Profiled gap, an observational counterpart to the controlled mixture. Across four pretrained convolutional neural networks, Gride-Profiled, the two-nearest-neighbor estimator (TWO-NN), and the maximum-likelihood estimator (MLE) exhibit similar rise-and-fall profiles, while Full-Profiled differences identify the layers most sensitive to angular calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 DANCo 拆成距离与角度两条独立校准曲线，使 ID 估计的来源可归因；在噪声等于典型邻域间距 40% 时，Gride-Full 把 24 个流形上的平均百分比误差从 27.7% 降到 17.6%。在生成维度 70、嵌入 100 维的高斯尺度混合上，Profiled 把 MiND 估计从 22.8 提到 66.7，去掉已知幅度后 MiND-Full 恢复到 71.9，说明 Full 的偏差来自幅度异质性。
Motivation: DANCo 在干净 ID 基准上已达 SOTA，但实际数据的邻域相对噪声与样本幅度异质性会扭曲距离和角度几何信号，且整体估计无法指出偏差来自哪一部分。
Method: 将 DANCo 分量式重构，保留独立的距离与角度偏差曲线：距离分量为广义比率 ID 估计器 (Gride) 的广义比率推导闭式 KL 散度，角度分量在两种采样机制下对齐均值方向并保留集中度匹配 (Profiled)；在受控高斯尺度混合、CIFAR-10、ImageNet 及四个预训练 CNN 上做对照。
Result: 噪声为典型邻域间距 40% 时，Gride-Full 在 24 个流形上平均百分比误差 27.7% → 17.6%；生成维度 70 嵌入 100 维的高斯尺度混合上，Profiled 使 MiND 从 22.8 → 66.7，去除已知幅度后 MiND-Full 回到 71.9；CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet 上降幅度归一化使角度位置向参考值移动并收窄 Full-Profiled 差距；四个预训练 CNN 上 Gride-Profiled、TWO-NN 与 MLE 呈相似的先升后降剖面。
Conclusion: 把距离与角度分量分开校准可定位 ID 估计的偏差来源：幅度异质性是 Full 短板的成因，降幅度归一化能收窄该差距，并可据 Full-Profiled 差异识别对角度校准最敏感的层。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Neural Constitutive Learning for Generalized Reaction-Diffusion Systems
papers.abstract_en: Generalized reaction-diffusion systems encompass diverse transport mechanisms and coupled reaction kinetics. A central question for neural PDE solvers is what should be learned so that a common interface can accommodate phase-field and degenerate transport, local reactions, and multispecies coupling. We propose the Neural Constitutive Laws--Mass-Compression-Transport (NCL-MCT) Solver, which learns PDE-specific constitutive responses while retaining temporal evolution in a shared MCT integrator. Transport is represented through mobility and thermodynamic driving force, and reaction through relative reaction rates. These constitutive responses depend on the current density rather than explicitly on the initial condition or elapsed time, motivating their reuse across different initial conditions and time horizons. The same interface supports velocity-data supervision and known-law supervision, neither of which requires time integration during training. When constitutive laws are known, supervision can be evaluated on independently sampled density fields, enabling trajectory-free constitutive learning without generating solution trajectories. Across seven systems, separately trained constitutive modules share the same interface and MCT integrator and achieve relative rollout $L^2$ errors of $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-2}$. Tests with unseen initial-condition families and an extended time horizon assess reuse beyond training conditions, while separate experiments demonstrate trajectory-free constitutive learning. These results support constitutive responses as an effective learning target for a shared neural PDE framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NCL-MCT 求解器：把广义反应扩散系统的本构响应（mobility、热力学驱动力、相对反应速率）作为学习目标，时间演化交给共享的 MCT 积分器。本构律只依赖当前密度、不依赖初值与已历时间，因此可在七个系统上分别训练后共用同一接口与积分器，相对 rollout L2 误差达 10^-4 至 10^-2。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器缺少统一学习目标，难以在同一接口下同时容纳相场与退化输运、局部反应和多物种耦合。
Method: NCL-MCT 将输运表示为 mobility 与热力学驱动力、反应表示为相对反应速率，本构模块与共享 MCT 积分器分离；支持速度数据监督与已知律监督，两者训练时都不需时间积分，已知律时可在独立采样的密度场上评估监督，实现 trajectory-free constitutive learning。
Result: 在七个广义反应扩散系统上，分别训练的本构模块共享同一接口与 MCT 积分器，相对 rollout L2 误差为 10^-4 至 10^-2；在未见过的初值族与延长的时间跨度上检验复用性，并以独立实验演示 trajectory-free constitutive learning。
Conclusion: 本构响应是共享神经 PDE 框架的有效学习目标，可在不同初值与时间跨度下复用，且已知律时无需生成解轨迹即可训练。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 在七个广义反应扩散系统上，分别训练的本构模块共享同一接口与 MCT 积分器，相对 rollout L2 误差为 10^-4 至 10^-2；在未见过的初值族与延长的时间跨度上检验复用性，并以独立实验演示 trajectory-free constitutive learning。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本构响应是共享神经 PDE 框架的有效学习目标，可在不同初值与时间跨度下复用，且已知律时无需生成解轨迹即可训练。

papers.title: Learning from Viable Failure Prefixes: Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents require reinforcement learning methods that can assign credit to intermediate decisions under sparse and delayed rewards. Existing group-based methods such as GRPO and GiGPO alleviate this issue by comparing rollout returns or repeated anchor states, but they still fail when the compared returns have no variation. We identify this failure mode as zero-credit failure: during early training, many failed rollouts contain useful prefixes, yet existing methods assign them no task-discriminative advantage. To address this issue, we propose Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization (MVPO), a potential-routed policy optimization algorithm that learns from viable failure prefixes. MVPO estimates prefix potential over Union-Find viability regions, repairs zero-credit groups with potential-difference advantages, and attenuates the potential branch according to relative performance progress. Experiments with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct show that MVPO outperforms eight strong baselines, including GRPO and GiGPO. Under the same training length, MVPO improves over the GiGPO baseline by +4.4 success points on ALFWorld and +5.3 on WebShop, while adding only 0.16%-0.20% advantage-construction overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长程 LLM agent 强化学习中的 zero-credit failure（组内 rollout 返回值无差异、失败轨迹的有用前缀拿不到任务区分性优势），提出 MVPO：在 Union-Find viability region 上估计前缀势能，用势能差修复零信用组，并按相对性能进展衰减势能分支。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上，同等训练长度下相对 GiGPO 在 ALFWorld 提升 +4.4 成功点、WebShop +5.3，优势构造开销仅 0.16%-0.20%。
Motivation: GRPO、GiGPO 等组式方法靠比较 rollout 返回或重复锚点状态分配信用，但当被比较的返回值没有差异时完全失效；早期训练中大量失败 rollout 含有用前缀却得不到任务区分性优势。
Method: MVPO (Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization) 是 potential-routed 策略优化算法：在 Union-Find viability region 上估计前缀势能，用 potential-difference advantage 修复零信用组，并按相对性能进展衰减势能分支。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上超过包括 GRPO 与 GiGPO 在内的八个强基线；同等训练长度下相对 GiGPO，ALFWorld 成功点 +4.4，WebShop +5.3，优势构造额外开销仅 0.16%-0.20%。
Conclusion: 零信用失败源于组内返回无差异，用前缀势能差补上任务区分性优势即可在 ALFWorld、WebShop 上以极低开销提升长程 agent 成功率。

papers.title: Designing a Boundary Negotiating Artifact for Collaborative Socio-Technical Sense-Making in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
papers.abstract_en: The rapid, unpredictable advancements in AI system capabilities has seen regulators take adaptive and experimental approaches to policymaking. Established in other domains as instruments balancing regulation with innovation, regulatory sandboxes are seen as solutions for AI regulation. However, analyses mostly focus on the legal and institutional design of AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRSes). With the legal framework leaving the socio-technical interpretation to stakeholders, this creates a gap on the sense-making required to fulfill the AIRS purpose. In this paper, we approach this by designing a Boundary Negotiating Artifact as a way to mediate meaning in AIRSes. Through Research-through-Design we iteratively develop a tool, providing an interface for the different stakeholders to collaborate in AI assessment. We then position it as technical backbone in established AIRS frameworks, structuring the collaborative sense-making of the involved stakeholders. We further report the insights gained from our design process leaving the qualitative evaluation for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI 监管沙盒 (AIRS) 中法律框架把社会技术解释留给各方、缺少协同意义建构 (sense-making) 工具的空白，用 Research-through-Design 迭代开发了一个 Boundary Negotiating Artifact，作为多方协作 AI 评估的界面，并将其定位为既有 AIRS 框架的技术骨干。设计过程产出定性洞见，定量评估留待后续工作。
Motivation: AI 监管沙盒的既有分析集中在法律与制度设计上，而法律框架把社会技术解释推给利益相关方，导致履行 AIRS 目的所需的协同意义建构环节没有工具支撑。
Method: 采用 Research-through-Design 方法迭代开发 Boundary Negotiating Artifact，为不同利益相关方提供协作式 AI 评估的界面，并将其定位为既有 AIRS 框架的技术骨干，结构化各方的协同意义建构。
Result: 产出一个可嵌入既有 AIRS 框架的协作评估工具及其设计过程洞见；摘要明确将定量评估 (qualitative evaluation) 留作未来工作，因此无实验指标或数值。
Conclusion: AI 监管沙盒的社会技术解释需要一个中介意义的边界协商工件来承载，其效果验证属于后续工作。

papers.title: Waypoint-1.5: A Real-Time Video World Model for Consumer Hardware
papers.abstract_en: We present Waypoint 1.5, a real-time diffusion world model for interactive video generation on consumer-grade hardware. Unlike general video diffusion models, interactive world models (iWMs) must respond to dense user controls under strict latency and throughput constraints. Waypoint 1.5 is pre-trained on 100,000 hours of diverse, control-aligned video game data across hundreds of games, and generates playable video conditioned on full keyboard and mouse input. The model includes two resolution variants that run across a wide spectrum of consumer hardware. To characterize this unique setting, we distinguish rendered FPS, latent FPS, and control rate. We describe the data pipeline, architecture, training methodology, and runtime system behind Waypoint 1.5. We evaluate interactivity through latency and throughput. Finally, we discuss the safety and ethics considerations unique to iWMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Waypoint 1.5 是面向消费级硬件的实时交互式扩散世界模型 (interactive world model)，在 10 万小时、数百款游戏的控制对齐视频上预训练，可按完整键盘鼠标输入生成可玩视频，并区分 rendered FPS、latent FPS 与 control rate 三个指标来刻画该场景。模型提供两个分辨率变体以覆盖不同消费级硬件，评估围绕延迟与吞吐展开。
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需在严格延迟与吞吐约束下响应稠密用户控制，这一设定不同于通用视频扩散模型，缺少合适的刻画指标与评测方式。
Method: 在 100,000 小时控制对齐的游戏视频上预训练扩散世界模型，条件为完整键盘与鼠标输入；提供两个分辨率变体适配不同消费级硬件，并给出数据管线、架构、训练方法与运行时系统；用 latency 与 throughput 评估交互性。
Result: 预训练数据为 100,000 小时、覆盖数百款游戏；提出 rendered FPS、latent FPS、control rate 三个指标区分该场景；在 latency 与 throughput 上评估交互性。
Conclusion: 实时交互式世界模型可以在消费级硬件上按稠密控制生成可玩视频，其核心约束是延迟与吞吐而非画质本身；作者同时讨论 iWM 特有的安全与伦理问题。

papers.title: VACE: Validation-Gated Alternating Co-Evolution of Agent Models and Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents can be improved by updating their model weights or refining the harness that guides task execution. These components are coupled: weight updates change how the model uses the harness, while harness updates change the trajectories used for training. We propose VACE, Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution, which alternates agentic reinforcement learning with trajectory-driven harness refinement. After each RL stage, VACE reuses the collected trajectories to propose a harness revision and evaluates the incumbent and candidate with the updated model held fixed. The candidate guides subsequent training only if it improves validation performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, VACE achieves 45.26% test accuracy on OfficeQA and a mean partial-credit score of 75.19% on AutomationBench, exceeding weight-only RL by 6.43 and 9.09 percentage points and ungated alternation by 4.59 and 6.95 points, respectively. Across 44 harness proposals, 17 reduce validation performance at the updated checkpoint and are rejected before subsequent RL training, highlighting the importance of validation gating.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VACE 把智能体模型的权重更新与 harness（任务执行脚手架）改进交替进行：每轮 agentic RL 之后复用已收集轨迹提出 harness 修订，并在更新后的模型固定时比较新旧 harness 的验证表现，只有验证变好才让候选 harness 指导后续训练。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，OfficeQA 测试准确率 45.26%、AutomationBench 平均部分分 75.19%，分别比只做 RL 高 6.43 和 9.09 个百分点，比无门控交替高 4.59 和 6.95 个百分点。
Motivation: 模型权重与 harness 相互耦合：权重更新改变模型使用 harness 的方式，harness 更新又改变用于训练的轨迹，直接交替而不加验证门控会让变差的 harness 进入后续训练。
Method: VACE（Validation-Gated Alternating Co-Evolution）交替执行 agentic reinforcement learning 与轨迹驱动的 harness 精化；每个 RL 阶段后复用收集到的轨迹提出 harness 修订，在更新后的模型固定不动的条件下评估在位与候选 harness，候选仅在验证性能提升时才接管后续训练。
Result: 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，VACE 取得 OfficeQA 测试准确率 45.26%、AutomationBench 平均部分分 75.19%，比 weight-only RL 分别高 6.43 和 9.09 个百分点，比 ungated alternation 分别高 4.59 和 6.95 个百分点；44 个 harness 提案中有 17 个在更新后的 checkpoint 上降低验证性能并被拒绝。
Conclusion: 验证门控是交替共进化的关键：约 39%（44 中 17）的 harness 提案会让验证性能变差，先在固定模型上过验证再放行才能避免这些提案污染后续 RL 训练。

papers.title: What Does Post-Training Change in Multilingual Reasoning?
papers.abstract_en: Open-source reasoning models provide unequal access to reasoning capability across languages. When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requested language in any of 16 samples, compared with 92.9% in English. To identify the source of this disparity, we evaluate thirteen endpoints from one model family, spanning released checkpoints, multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) at two scales, controlled SFT ablations, and three reinforcement-learning (RL) reward formulations. We jointly track correctness, language adherence, termination, and delivery efficiency. The dominant bottleneck shifts across post-training stages. Released models often reason in English. Multilingual SFT restores target-language reasoning, but accuracy declines across multilingual, English-only, and single-language SFT runs, showing that this cost is not specific to multilingual mixing; non-English reasoning traces additionally become prone to non-terminating loops. RL restores termination in both arms at no cost in accuracy, but only the arm whose reward includes a language term delivers: rewarding correctness alone returns the model to English. Together, these stages establish a constructive post-training path from English-pivoted capability to multilingual reasoning that is reliably delivered.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 21 tables. Main paper and supplementary material in one document
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Qwen3 系列在 11 种语言的竞赛数学任务做后训练审计：10 种非英语语言中仅 15.4–17.9% 的题目能在 16 个采样中任一次给出目标语言、正确且终止的可见推理，英语为 92.9%。多语 SFT 恢复目标语言推理但三种 SFT 设置下准确率都下降且非英语推理易陷入不终止循环；RL 恢复终止且不损失准确率，但只有奖励含语言项的分支才真正交付目标语言解，只奖励正确性会退回英语。
Motivation: 开源推理模型在不同语言上给出的能力严重不均：模型会解题却无法用用户语言交付完整解答时，语言就从性能差异变成获取能力的壁垒。
Method: 审计 Qwen3 检查点在 11 种语言的竞赛数学任务，评估同一模型族的 13 个端点，涵盖已发布检查点、两个规模的多语 SFT、受控 SFT 消融与三种 RL 奖励形式；联合追踪正确性、语言遵从、终止与交付效率 (delivery efficiency)。
Result: 10 种非英语语言中仅 15.4–17.9% 的题目在 16 个采样中任一次得到目标语言、正确且终止的解，英语为 92.9%；多语、纯英语、单语三类 SFT 运行的准确率均下降，非英语推理轨迹易出现不终止循环；RL 在两个分支都恢复终止且准确率无损失，但仅奖励含语言项的分支交付目标语言解，只奖励正确性则退回英语。
Conclusion: 后训练各阶段的主导瓶颈不同：SFT 负责语言遵从但代价是准确率与终止，RL 负责终止，交付目标语言必须由奖励中的语言项保证，由此构成从英语中枢能力到可靠交付的多语推理路径。

summary_sections.result: 10 种非英语语言中仅 15.4–17.9% 的题目在 16 个采样中任一次得到目标语言、正确且终止的解，英语为 92.9%；多语、纯英语、单语三类 SFT 运行的准确率均下降，非英语推理轨迹易出现不终止循环；RL 在两个分支都恢复终止且准确率无损失，但仅奖励含语言项的分支交付目标语言解，只奖励正确性则退回英语。
summary_sections.conclusion: 后训练各阶段的主导瓶颈不同：SFT 负责语言遵从但代价是准确率与终止，RL 负责终止，交付目标语言必须由奖励中的语言项保证，由此构成从英语中枢能力到可靠交付的多语推理路径。

papers.title: V2X-WAM: A Cooperative World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle-infrastructure cooperation can complement onboard sensing with broader and more informative observations of the traffic environment, providing valuable support for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing cooperative driving methods mainly exploit roadside information to enhance the representation of the current scene, while the future consequences of prospective driving actions are rarely modeled explicitly. This limits the ability of the planner to anticipate how its decisions may interact with the evolving traffic environment. To address this issue, we propose V2X-WAM, a cooperative world action model that tightly couples cooperative scene understanding, action generation, and future-world reasoning. V2X-WAM constructs a reliability-aware spatiotemporal representation from vehicle- and infrastructure-side observations, while compressing infrastructure information into a compact quantized message for efficient communication. Based on the resulting cooperative representation, a multimodal planner generates prospective trajectories, which explicitly condition future occupancy and dynamic-flow prediction. The predicted world consequences are then fed back to refine the planned trajectory, forming a closed interaction between action and future-world evolution. Experiments on a large-scale real-world cooperative driving dataset demonstrate that V2X-WAM consistently improves planning accuracy and safety over representative end-to-end cooperative driving methods, while achieving stronger future-world prediction and substantially lower communication overhead. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V2X-WAM 把车路协同场景理解、动作生成与未来世界推理耦合成闭环：可靠性感知的时空表征压缩为量化消息，多模态 planner 生成候选轨迹并显式条件化未来占据与动态流预测，再用预测到的世界后果反向修正轨迹。在大规模真实协同驾驶数据集上，规划精度与安全性、未来世界预测均优于代表性端到端协同驾驶方法，通信开销显著降低。
Motivation: 现有协同驾驶方法主要用路侧信息增强当前场景表征，几乎不显式建模候选动作的未来后果，planner 无法预判自身决策如何与演化中的交通环境交互。
Method: V2X-WAM 由三部分紧耦合：从车端与路端观测构建可靠性感知时空表征，并把路侧信息压缩成紧凑量化消息以降低通信量；多模态 planner 据此生成候选轨迹；这些轨迹显式条件化未来占据 (occupancy) 与动态流 (dynamic-flow) 预测，预测结果再反馈修正规划轨迹，形成动作与未来世界演化的闭环交互。
Result: 在大规模真实世界协同驾驶数据集上，V2X-WAM 相对代表性端到端协同驾驶方法持续提升规划精度与安全性，同时取得更强的未来世界预测与明显更低的通信开销；消融实验验证了各设计组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 把未来世界后果预测纳入规划闭环、并配合可靠性感知表征与量化通信，可同时改善端到端协同驾驶的规划、预测与通信效率。

papers.title: Breaking the Illusion of Review Reliability under Static Evaluation: SCOPE Fuzzing for LLM-based Scientific Reviewers
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of submissions and reviewing workload has accelerated the use of large language models (LLMs) in peer review. Prior studies suggest that LLM-based reviewers can penalize content perturbations, such as overclaiming, indicating a certain degree of reliability. Yet these conclusions are largely based on a narrow set of perturbation strategies instantiated with static templates, providing limited evidence of actual reliability. In this paper, we construct a three-level evaluation framework covering perturbations to surface presentation, argumentative logic, and value judgment. Experiments on representative LLM-based reviewers reveal two limitations of static evaluation: stratified vulnerability, where perturbation effects depend on whether the paper's original review score is high or low, and perturbation undercoverage, where a single template misses vulnerabilities exposed by diverse realizations. To address these limitations, we propose SCOPE-Fuzzer, a strategy-aware fuzzer that combines feedback-driven strategy selection with adaptive mutation of paper content. By iteratively probing reviewers with dynamic perturbations, SCOPE-Fuzzer consistently uncovers vulnerabilities overlooked by static evaluation and other baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE-Fuzzer 用三层扰动框架（表层呈现、论证逻辑、价值判断）加反馈驱动的策略选择与自适应内容变异，动态探测 LLM 审稿人的评分漏洞。实验揭示静态评估的两个假象：扰动效果依赖原评分高低（分层脆弱性），单一模板漏掉多种实现暴露的漏洞（扰动欠覆盖）。该 fuzzer 持续发现静态评估与其他基线遗漏的脆弱点。
Motivation: 既有研究称 LLM 审稿人会对过度声称等内容扰动扣分、因而具有一定可靠性，但这些结论只基于少数静态模板扰动策略，证据面窄，无法支撑真实可靠性判断。
Method: 构建覆盖表层呈现、论证逻辑、价值判断的三层扰动评估框架；在此之上提出 SCOPE-Fuzzer，把反馈驱动的策略选择与论文内容的自适应变异结合，用动态扰动迭代探测代表性 LLM 审稿人。
Result: 在代表性 LLM 审稿人上揭示静态评估的两项局限：分层脆弱性（扰动效果取决于论文原审稿评分高低）与扰动欠覆盖（单一模板会漏掉多样实现才能暴露的漏洞）；SCOPE-Fuzzer 持续找出静态评估和其他基线遗漏的脆弱点。
Conclusion: 静态模板评估会高估 LLM 审稿人的可靠性，须用策略感知的动态扰动持续探测才能暴露其真实脆弱面。

papers.title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Count: Overcoming Individuation and Aggregation Bottlenecks with ConvStack
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) consistently struggle with fine-grained visual counting, yet the underlying causes remain poorly understood. In this work, we present a mechanistic analysis of this failure mode, identifying two critical bottlenecks inherent to the global attention pipeline of MLLMs. First, we reveal an individuation bottleneck stemming from image patchification: because Vision Transformers process patches independently, they struggle to group fragmented geometric features across boundaries into distinct object representations. Second, we identify a collapse in the subsequent counting aggregation process, where representation separation rapidly diminishes as numerosity increases due to attention compression. Identifying and formalizing these twin bottlenecks constitutes our first major contribution. To overcome them, we propose ConvStack, a lightweight architecture that operates directly in the visual token space to explicitly aggregate and inject local spatial structures via zero-initialized residual connections. By explicitly addressing the individuation bottleneck, ConvStack provides unambiguous geometric evidence for downstream aggregation. Remarkably, by fine-tuning exclusively on counting tasks, the model achieves substantial improvements in dense object counting and broader spatial understanding benchmarks, without compromising on general visual capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConvStack 在 MLLM 的视觉 token 空间用零初始化残差连接显式注入局部空间结构，缓解 patch 化导致的个体化瓶颈与注意力压缩导致的计数聚合坍塌。仅在计数任务上微调即在密集计数与更广的空间理解基准上取得实质提升，且不损害通用视觉能力。
Motivation: MLLM 在细粒度视觉计数上持续失败，但成因不清：ViT 独立处理 patch，难以跨边界把碎片几何特征归并成独立物体表征，随后计数聚合阶段的表征分离度随数量增加而迅速坍塌。
Method: 先对全局注意力管线做机制分析，形式化 individuation 与 aggregation 两个瓶颈；再提出 ConvStack，一个轻量架构，直接在视觉 token 空间通过零初始化残差连接聚合并注入局部空间结构，为下游聚合提供明确几何证据；仅在计数任务上微调。
Result: 在密集物体计数基准与更广的空间理解基准上均取得实质提升，同时不牺牲通用视觉能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 计数失败的根源是 patch 化的个体化瓶颈与注意力压缩下的聚合坍塌，在视觉 token 空间补上局部空间结构即可同时改善计数与空间理解而不损伤通用能力。

papers.title: Task-Oriented Visual Feature Compression via Residual Vector Quantization for Device-Edge Multimodal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal models (LMMs) support diverse visual understanding and reasoning tasks but are often impractical to run entirely on resource-constrained devices. Device-edge co-inference reduces device computation, yet transmitting visual data over bandwidth-limited uplinks can introduce substantial delay. Task-oriented feature compression (TOFC) reduces the payload through feature aggregation and entropy coding. However, continuous-feature coding remains costly, and query-agnostic aggregation may discard task-relevant local evidence. We propose query-guided task-oriented feature compression (Q-TOFC) for device-edge multimodal inference. Q-TOFC employs residual vector quantization (RVQ) to encode each merged feature as a compact sequence of codebook indices, reducing its representation cost and allowing more features to be transmitted. It further incorporates query relevance into feature aggregation and uses a quantization error compensation adapter to mitigate the distortion introduced by discrete quantization. Experiments on seven multimodal benchmarks show that Q-TOFC reduces the visual payload by 53.6% relative to TOFC while maintaining comparable average normalized task performance. End-to-end latency evaluations further demonstrate lower latency under bandwidth-constrained uplinks.
papers.comment: 13 pages. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-TOFC 用残差向量量化 (RVQ) 把设备端视觉特征压成码本索引序列，并把 query 相关性引入特征聚合、再用量化误差补偿 adapter 抵消离散化失真。在七个多模态基准上，相比 TOFC 视觉载荷降低 53.6% 而平均归一化任务性能相当，带宽受限上行链路的端到端时延更低。
Motivation: LMM 难以整体跑在资源受限设备上，设备-边缘协同推理虽省算力，但带宽受限上行链路传输视觉数据会带来明显时延；现有任务导向特征压缩 (TOFC) 的连续特征编码开销大，且 query 无关的聚合会丢掉任务相关的局部证据。
Method: Q-TOFC 用 RVQ 将每个合并特征编码为紧凑的码本索引序列以降低表示成本；聚合阶段引入 query 相关性；再加一个量化误差补偿 adapter 缓解离散量化引入的失真，配合熵编码压缩载荷。
Result: 在七个多模态基准上，Q-TOFC 相比 TOFC 将视觉载荷减少 53.6%，同时保持相当的平均归一化任务性能；端到端时延评测显示在带宽受限上行链路下时延更低。
Conclusion: 把 query 引导的聚合与 RVQ 加误差补偿结合，可以在不明显牺牲任务性能的前提下显著压缩视觉特征并降低设备-边缘上行时延。

papers.title: Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots
papers.abstract_en: Real-world videos provide rich demonstrations of manipulation, but turning them into reusable robot skills requires visually aligned environments, executable physical interactions, and mechanisms for learning from experience. We introduce Real2Gym, an agentic Real2Sim2Real framework that turns human and robot demonstrations into interactive simulation gyms and brings skills acquired in simulation to physical robots. The Real2Sim module reconstructs editable scenes, aligns objects and cameras with the input, validates demonstrated or retargeted actions through native physics execution, and generates task-conditioned variations with action-feasibility checks. Within these environments, the agent generates executable code for manipulation stages, observes their outcomes, and distills successful attempts and failures into reusable task procedures, object-relative motions, and recovery strategies. Through a shared perception-and-control interface, these skills guide subsequent execution in simulation and on real robots, with motions adapted to current observations and no updates to the underlying model weights. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Real2Gym enables high-fidelity simulation environment reconstruction, outperforming GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode by 16.7% in success rate with approximately 74.9% fewer policy-execution tokens across these environments, while exceeding it by 33.3% in physical robot execution success rate across four tasks on a real Franka robot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Real2Gym 把真实操作视频经 Real2Sim 重建为可编辑、可物理执行的交互式仿真 gym，再通过共享感知-控制接口把仿真中学到的技能零权重更新地迁移到实体机器人。在重建环境中其成功率比 GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode 高 16.7%，策略执行 token 减少约 74.9%；在 Franka 实体机器人四项任务上成功率高 33.3%。
Motivation: 真实视频里有丰富操作演示，但缺少视觉对齐的环境、可执行的物理交互和从经验中学习的机制，难以变成可复用机器人技能。
Method: Real2Sim 模块重建可编辑场景、对齐物体与相机、用原生物理执行校验演示或重定向动作，并生成带动作可行性检查的任务条件变体；智能体在环境中为操作阶段生成可执行代码、观察结果，把成功与失败蒸馏为任务流程、物体相对运动和恢复策略，经共享感知-控制接口驱动仿真与实机执行，不更新模型权重。
Result: 在这些重建环境中，成功率比 GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode 高 16.7%，策略执行 token 约减少 74.9%；在真实 Franka 机器人四项任务上的执行成功率高 33.3%。
Conclusion: 把真实演示转成带物理校验的可交互仿真 gym，配合代码化技能蒸馏，可在不微调模型权重的前提下把操作技能从仿真带到实机。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ARGOS: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multidimensional Elasticity for Service Orchestration in the Computing Continuum
papers.abstract_en: Data-intensive services in the Computing Continuum must balance analytics quality, resource usage, and cost across heterogeneous nodes with limited and uneven capacity. This balance becomes especially difficult when resource scaling reaches capacity limits, because changes in demand and cluster pressure must then be absorbed without violating client-defined quality ranges. Existing orchestrators mainly adapt resources, placements, or replicas, while analytics requirements such as coverage, sample, and freshness remain fixed. This article presents ARGOS, the Adaptive Reinforcement Learning-Driven Governance for Orchestrated Services, an end-to-end controller that formulates multidimensional elasticity as a per-request Markov decision process over analytics quality and cluster pressure, supported by capacity-aware admission. ARGOS is evaluated under controlled workloads and time-varying multi-tenant arrivals on a heterogeneous cluster. Across the controlled scenarios, the deep reinforcement learning policies consistently outperform the non-learning baselines and approach the independently tuned best-fixed reference. A separate live evaluation reports improvements over the static midpoint under realistic and saturated arrivals, with no recorded CPU or memory violations but remaining coverage violations. These results support deep reinforcement learning as an adaptive mechanism for multidimensional elasticity when resource scaling alone is insufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARGOS 把计算连续体服务的多维弹性建模为逐请求 MDP，同时调度分析质量（coverage、sample、freshness）与集群压力，并用容量感知准入控制兜底。在受控负载与随时间变化的多租户到达下，深度强化学习策略稳定优于非学习基线并逼近独立调优的 best-fixed 参考；实机评估中相对静态中点有提升，CPU 与内存零违规，但 coverage 违规仍存在。
Motivation: 现有编排器只调资源、放置与副本，而 coverage、sample、freshness 等分析需求固定不变；当资源扩展触及容量上限，需求与集群压力的波动无法在不违反客户端质量区间的前提下被吸收。
Method: ARGOS（Adaptive Reinforcement Learning-Driven Governance for Orchestrated Services）是端到端控制器：把多维弹性表述为覆盖分析质量与集群压力两个维度的逐请求马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，由深度强化学习策略驱动，并辅以容量感知的准入控制 (capacity-aware admission)。
Result: 在受控场景中，深度强化学习策略一致优于非学习基线，并逼近独立调优的 best-fixed 参考；单独的实机评估在真实与饱和到达下相对静态中点 (static midpoint) 有提升，未记录任何 CPU 或内存违规，但 coverage 违规仍然存在。
Conclusion: 当单纯资源扩展已不足够时，深度强化学习可作为多维弹性的自适应机制；容量约束可由准入控制守住，但质量维度中的 coverage 仍未被完全满足。

papers.title: Identifying ODEs from Unstructured Data with Causal Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of recovering the governing ODE of a dynamical system from unstructured, high-dimensional observations such as images. Existing methods for ODE discovery typically assume direct measurements of the variables, or do not provide theoretical guarantees on the learned variables and equations. While Causal Representation Learning (CRL) methods provide guarantees on identifying variables from high-dimensional observations up to component-wise diffeomorphisms, we show that in general these variables cannot be used directly as input to equation discovery methods, which typically assume that the variables will lead to sparse equations. So we introduce SParse Equivalent Equation Discovery AutoEncoder (SPEED-AE), a framework that combines a pretrained CRL method with a component-wise autoencoder that learns transformations of variables that are amenable to sparse ODE discovery. We show that for polynomial ODEs, this additional step allows us to restrict the identifiability of each variable from polynomial to monomial diffeomorphisms. Experiments on Lotka-Volterra, Lorenz, and a two-pendulum system show that SPEED-AE improves on the disentanglement of the CRL methods and that it recovers ODEs that are closest to the ground truth, while achieving state-of-the-art forecasting performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEED-AE 把预训练因果表示学习 (CRL) 与逐分量自编码器串联，把高维非结构观测（如图像）中识别出的变量再变换为适合稀疏方程发现的形式，从而从图像级观测恢复动力系统的控制 ODE。对多项式 ODE，该额外步骤把每个变量的可识别性从一般分段同胚 (diffeomorphism) 收紧到单项式同胚。在 Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz 与双摆实验中，它改善了 CRL 的解耦程度，恢复的 ODE 最接近真值，并达到 state-of-the-art 的预报性能。
Motivation: 现有 ODE 发现方法通常假设变量可直接测量，或对学到的变量与方程缺乏理论保证；CRL 虽能从高维观测识别变量，但其输出一般不满足稀疏方程发现对变量的要求。
Method: SPEED-AE 框架：先用预训练 CRL 方法从非结构观测中提取变量，再接一个逐分量自编码器学习变量变换，使变换后的变量可用于稀疏 ODE 发现；理论上针对多项式 ODE 将逐变量可识别性从分段同胚限制到单项式同胚。
Result: 在 Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz 和双摆 (two-pendulum) 系统上的实验中，SPEED-AE 改善了 CRL 方法的解耦 (disentanglement)，恢复的 ODE 最接近 ground truth，并取得 state-of-the-art 的 forecasting 性能。
Conclusion: CRL 识别出的变量不能直接喂给稀疏方程发现，补一个面向稀疏性的逐分量变换层即可同时收紧可识别性并恢复更接近真值的 ODE。

papers.title: LDM-is-AE: Latent Diffusion Model is an Auto-Encoder for End-to-End Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) typically adopt a two-stage pipeline: an auto-encoder (AE) is first pre-trained to define a latent space, then a diffusion model is trained to perform denoising within it. Such a two-stage design introduces a representation mismatch, as the latent space is optimized for reconstruction rather than adapting the denoising dynamics. We reveal that the LDM itself is an AE, and consequently present LDM-is-AE, an end-to-end one-stage LDM training framework that eliminates the need for a separately trained tokenizer. Our key observation is that the LDM backbone actually performs a latent-to-feature-to-latent transformation at each denoising step, which can be interpreted as an internal decoding--encoding process. Leveraging this structure, we split the DiT backbone into two reciprocal components, DiT-E (i.e., DiT Encoding) and DiT-D (i.e., DiT Decoding), and impose image-space supervision on the intermediate features across all timesteps. Our model encourages the internal representation to align with the image domain throughout denoising, thereby establishing an explicit latent-to-image-to-latent path. At the zero-noise timestep, our model further performs an image-to-latent-to-image mapping, corresponding to an auto-encoding process. As a result, LDM-is-AE jointly learns latent representations and denoising dynamics in an end-to-end manner, yielding a diffusion-native latent space tailored to the generation process. Experiments demonstrate that LDM-is-AE exhibits highly competitive generation performance, achieving an FID of 1.80 and 1.90 on 256x256 and 512x512 class-conditional image generation, respectively.
papers.comment: Accepted by NIPS 2026. More info can be found in https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/LDMisAE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LDM-is-AE 把两阶段 LDM（先训 AE 再训扩散）合并为单阶段端到端训练：将 DiT backbone 拆成互逆的 DiT-E 与 DiT-D，并在所有 timestep 的中间特征上施加图像空间监督，从而显式建立 latent-to-image-to-latent 路径，无需单独训练 tokenizer。类条件图像生成 FID 在 256x256 与 512x512 上分别达到 1.80 与 1.90。
Motivation: 两阶段 LDM 中 latent space 只为重建优化，与去卷积 (denoising) 动力学之间存在 representation mismatch，需要额外训练一个独立 tokenizer。
Method: 观察到 LDM backbone 每个去噪步都在做 latent-to-feature-to-latent 变换，可视为内部解码-编码过程；据此把 DiT backbone 切成互逆的 DiT-E（编码）与 DiT-D（解码），在全部 timestep 的中间特征上加图像空间监督，使内部表示与图像域对齐；零噪声 timestep 上进一步构成 image-to-latent-to-image 的自编码通路，联合学习 latent 表示与去噪动力学。
Result: 类条件图像生成 FID：256x256 为 1.80，512x512 为 1.90，摘要称其为 highly competitive 的生成性能。
Conclusion: LDM 本身可视为一个自编码器，端到端单阶段训练能产出面向生成过程定制的 diffusion-native latent space，并省去独立 tokenizer。

papers.title: ZeroDiff: Zero-Shot Time Series Reconstruction via Informed-Prior Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Time series modeling increasingly demands high-quality supervision, yet target observations remain scarce - exogenous inputs are broadly available, but target measurements are often unavailable due to cost, infrastructure, or accessibility constraints. Can models trained on observed locations reconstruct target time series where measurements have never been collected? We term this zero-shot time series reconstruction. A naive approach - directly mapping exogenous inputs to targets - can yield predictions at unobserved locations, but without target signals, such models fail to capture the intrinsic dynamics of the target variable, producing overly smooth outputs that underestimate extremes. This reveals systematic errors that call for explicit modeling and calibration. We propose ZeroDiff, which constructs an informed prior from exogenous variables alone, then learns to calibrate reconstruction errors through diffusion - training on observed locations and generalizing to unobserved ones. Experiments across diverse real-world datasets demonstrate significant improvements over existing approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/YingdaFan/ZeroDiff-ICML2026.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306:28802-28823, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeroDiff 做零样本时间序列重建：只用外生变量构造 informed prior，再用 diffusion 校准重建误差，在有观测的站点训练、直接泛化到从未测过的站点。直接把外生输入映射到目标的朴素做法会输出过度平滑、低估极值的结果，ZeroDiff 在多个真实数据集上相对现有方法有显著改进。
Motivation: 目标变量的观测因成本、基础设施或可达性限制长期稀缺，外生输入却随处可得；直接映射无法学到目标变量的内在动力学，输出过平滑并低估极端值。
Method: 先仅由外生变量构建 informed prior，再以 diffusion 学习校准重建误差；训练只在有观测的位置进行，推理泛化到无观测位置，即 zero-shot time series reconstruction。
Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上相对现有方法有显著改进（abstract 未给出具体指标数值）；核心定性对比是克服朴素外生映射的过平滑与极值低估。
Conclusion: 外生变量驱动的 informed prior 加 diffusion 校准，可以在从未采集过目标测量的位置重建目标时间序列，而不必依赖目标信号本身。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: UnlearningSoup: Is Repeated Tuning Necessary for Large Language Model Unlearning?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models trained on vast corpora inherently risk memorizing harmful content that may later re-emerge in their outputs. To mitigate this issue, existing unlearning methods typically rely on training-based parameter updates, such as gradient ascent and its variants, to delete targeted content while preserving other knowledge. However, balancing the competing goals of forgetting and retention makes hyperparameter choices for these methods particularly difficult, often requiring repeated tuning to obtain a strong model that still leaves substantial room for improvement and transfers poorly across models and datasets. To address this challenge, we investigate whether unlearning runs exhibit exploitable structure in weight space, and observe that models from different runs still lie in a shared evaluation-performance basin. This suggests that stronger models may be recovered through an unlearning-tailored soup strategy, reducing the need for repeated tuning for further improvement or new settings. Motivated by this, we propose UnlearningSoup, a unified framework that provides two strategies: EfficientSoup uses binary-search-based interpolation to quickly discover a well-performing model in the early stage, where repeated tuning would otherwise make strong model selection costly. PerformanceSoup uses reweighted souping to efficiently unlock the remaining performance potential in the later stage, where repeated tuning becomes increasingly inefficient. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and models show that UnlearningSoup delivers 2.4x to 3.3x efficiency gains in hyperparameter selection, while consistently improving performance across settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 遗忘 (unlearning) 中梯度上升类方法需反复调超参才能得到强模型。作者观察到不同遗忘 run 的权重仍落在同一评估性能 basin 内，据此提出 UnlearningSoup：早期用 EfficientSoup 的二分搜索插值快速找到好模型，后期用 PerformanceSoup 的重加权 soup 榨取剩余性能，在超参选择上取得 2.4x–3.3x 效率提升并跨设置持续改善性能。
Motivation: 遗忘方法要在遗忘与保留之间权衡，超参选择困难，往往需要反复调参，且结果在不同模型与数据集间迁移性差。
Method: 先检验不同遗忘 run 的权重空间结构，发现其共享同一评估性能 basin；据此提出 UnlearningSoup，含两个策略：EfficientSoup 用基于二分搜索的插值在早期快速找到表现良好的模型，PerformanceSoup 用重加权 soup (reweighted souping) 在后期释放剩余性能。
Result: 在多种数据集与模型上的实验显示，UnlearningSoup 在超参选择上带来 2.4x 至 3.3x 的效率提升，并在各设置下持续改善性能。
Conclusion: 不同遗忘 run 的权重存在可利用的共享 basin 结构，因此用面向 unlearning 的 soup 即可替代反复调参，同时覆盖早期选型与后期提效两个阶段。

summary_sections.tldr: LLM 遗忘 (unlearning) 中梯度上升类方法需反复调超参才能得到强模型。作者观察到不同遗忘 run 的权重仍落在同一评估性能 basin 内，据此提出 UnlearningSoup：早期用 EfficientSoup 的二分搜索插值快速找到好模型，后期用 PerformanceSoup 的重加权 soup 榨取剩余性能，在超参选择上取得 2.4x–3.3x 效率提升并跨设置持续改善性能。
