summary_sections.method: 先检验不同遗忘 run 的权重空间结构，发现其共享同一评估性能 basin；据此提出 UnlearningSoup，含两个策略：EfficientSoup 用基于二分搜索的插值在早期快速找到表现良好的模型，PerformanceSoup 用重加权 soup (reweighted souping) 在后期释放剩余性能。
summary_sections.result: 在多种数据集与模型上的实验显示，UnlearningSoup 在超参选择上带来 2.4x 至 3.3x 的效率提升，并在各设置下持续改善性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不同遗忘 run 的权重存在可利用的共享 basin 结构，因此用面向 unlearning 的 soup 即可替代反复调参，同时覆盖早期选型与后期提效两个阶段。

papers.title: Context without Commitment: Robust Dense Correspondence under Non-Rigid Deformation
papers.abstract_en: Non-rigid point-cloud registration aims to find the corresponding target point for each point on a deforming source surface. Point-level matching keeps the full target cloud available, but correspondence becomes ambiguous when different regions have similar local geometry. Regional or coarse-to-fine methods provide broader spatial context, but an incorrect regional match can exclude the correct correspondence before dense matching. We propose CoCo-Reg, which uses regional patches to enrich dense point features without allowing patch predictions to restrict the final point-level search. CoCo-Reg constructs farthest-point-sampled patches, exchanges geometric information within and between source and target, supervises patch similarity using identity-corrected point overlap, and projects the resulting regional information back to dense point features. The final registration stage still scores the full target cloud before global point-level candidate selection. On 726 held-out ModelNet10 objects across nine deformation levels, two established learning-based baselines obtain mean correspondence errors of 0.1993 and 0.1921, whereas CoCo-Reg obtains 0.0547. Relative to its point-level baseline, this is a 72.6\% reduction. CoCo-Reg achieves lower correspondence error on 92.3\% of paired test objects and reduces the mean fraction of points with error above 0.1 from 47.3\% to 17.3\%. Chamfer distance and HD95 decrease in the same direction, and CoCo-Reg remains lower across all tested deformation levels. These results support using regional context for dense non-rigid correspondence without imposing a hard patch-level restriction on the final search. Because evaluation uses one checkpoint per method, the reported gains characterize the complete systems rather than the isolated causal contribution of an individual component. Code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoCo-Reg 在非刚性点云配准中用区域 patch 丰富稠密点特征，但不让 patch 预测限制最终的点级搜索：先做 farthest-point-sampled patch 与源/目标间几何信息交换，用 identity-corrected point overlap 监督 patch 相似度，最后仍在全目标云上打分再做全局点级候选选择。在 726 个 ModelNet10 留出物体、九档变形下，平均对应误差 0.0547，相对点级基线下降 72.6%。
Motivation: 点级匹配保留完整目标云但局部几何相似时对应歧义；区域或 coarse-to-fine 方法提供更大上下文，却可能在稠密匹配前就因错误的区域匹配排除掉正确对应。
Method: CoCo-Reg 构造 farthest-point-sampled patches，在源与目标内部及之间交换几何信息，用 identity-corrected point overlap 监督 patch 相似度，再把区域信息投影回稠密点特征；最终配准阶段仍在完整目标云上打分后做全局点级候选选择。
Result: 在 726 个 ModelNet10 留出物体、九档变形上，两个已建立的学习基线平均对应误差为 0.1993 与 0.1921，CoCo-Reg 为 0.0547，相对其点级基线降低 72.6%；92.3% 的配对测试物体上对应误差更低，误差超过 0.1 的点占比从 47.3% 降到 17.3%；Chamfer distance 与 HD95 同向下降，且在全部测试变形档位上均更低。
Conclusion: 区域上下文可以用于稠密非刚性对应而不必对最终搜索施加硬性 patch 级限制；因每方法只用一个 checkpoint 评测，增益刻画的是完整系统而非单个组件的独立因果贡献。

papers.title: Predictive Safety Curricula for Robust Legged Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Rare but consequential failures can persist in learned locomotion policies for legged robots even when average task performance is high, in part because standard curricula primarily adapt task difficulty rather than the distribution of safety-critical experience. We introduce Predictive Safety Curricula (PSC), a framework for allocating locomotion training experience using learned predictions of future safety cost. PSC trains a distributional safety critic from policy rollouts and uses its predictions to prioritize both terrain contexts and previously encountered randomized events. The resulting curriculum modifies the training distribution while leaving the task reward and policy-optimization loss unchanged. We evaluate PSC in controlled rough-terrain locomotion and in production locomotion systems. PSC improves reliability relative to standard terrain progression, advantage-based replay, and learning-progress curricula, with the largest gains on difficult terrain and under degraded observations. The same allocation principle transfers to two production locomotion stacks. On ANYmal-D hardware, PSC reduces shank-collision incidence by $63\%$ relative to the learning-progress curriculum across three matched training seeds, with a reduction in every seed. On a production stair-climbing platform, PSC eliminates observed shank collisions in the evaluated hardware trials. These results show that learned predictions of future safety cost can provide an effective signal for allocating training experience toward rare failure modes and improving locomotion reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSC 用分布式 safety critic 预测未来安全代价，据此分配腿足机器人步态训练经验，优先困难地形与曾触发的随机事件，任务奖励与策略优化损失保持不变。在 ANYmal-D 上相对 learning-progress 课程使小腿碰撞 (shank collision) 下降 63%（三个匹配随机种子，每个种子都下降），在生产爬楼梯平台上评估的硬件试验中碰撞归零。
Motivation: 学习型步态策略即使平均任务性能很高，仍会留下罕见但后果严重的失败，因为标准课程只调任务难度而不调安全关键经验的分布。
Method: PSC 从策略 rollout 训练一个分布式的 safety critic，用其对未来安全代价的预测同时优先化地形上下文与此前遇到的随机事件，只改训练分布；对照标准地形递进、advantage-based replay 与 learning-progress 课程，在受控粗糙地形与生产步态系统上评估。
Result: 相对标准地形递进、advantage-based replay 与 learning-progress 课程均提升可靠性，困难地形与观测退化下增益最大；ANYmal-D 硬件上相对 learning-progress 课程 shank collision 发生率下降 63%，跨三个匹配训练种子且每个种子都下降；生产爬楼梯平台上评估的硬件试验中 shank collision 被消除；同一分配原则迁移到两个生产步态栈。
Conclusion: 对未来安全代价的学得预测可以作为把训练经验导向罕见失败模式的有效分配信号，从而提高腿足运动可靠性，且该分配原则可跨平台迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FACT: Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins
papers.abstract_en: Visually plausible articulated assets may still fail during contact interactions or exhibit inaccurate motion. We present FACT (Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins), an agentic framework that progressively constructs articulated twins to improve geometry, contact, and dynamic fidelity. The agent drives an evidence--diagnosis--revision loop on a shared editable representation, selecting measurements and model edits using quantitative feedback, while numerical tools execute and validate the updates. It reconstructs editable articulated geometry from images through feature planning, targeted measurements, and diagnostic refinement. On this reference, it repairs collision proxies through task-aware local repartitioning before fidelity-constrained compression. Finally, it constructs response models from passive-response videos, using simulation residuals to guide model revision and constrained physical parameter fitting. Experiments show that FACT improves geometric reconstruction over baselines, enables more reliable interaction with simpler collision proxies, and better reproduces held-out physical responses than direct parameter inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FACT 是一个把图像与被动响应视频转成可编辑铰接孪生 (articulated twin) 的 agent 框架，用证据-诊断-修订循环在共享可编辑表示上逐步提升几何、接触与动力保真度。实验显示其几何重建优于基线，用更简单的碰撞代理也能更可靠地交互，并比直接参数推断更好地复现留出的物理响应。
Motivation: 视觉上看似合理的铰接资产在接触交互中仍会失效或产生不准确运动，几何、碰撞代理与动力参数三方面的保真度需要在构造过程中被持续度量与修正。
Method: FACT 由三部分组成：通过 feature planning、针对性测量与诊断式修订从图像重建可编辑铰接几何；用任务感知局部重划分 (task-aware local repartitioning) 修复碰撞代理，再做保真度约束压缩；从被动响应视频构建响应模型，以仿真残差引导模型修订并做受约束的物理参数拟合。整个流程由 agent 驱动证据-诊断-修订循环，用定量反馈选择测量与模型编辑，数值工具负责执行并验证更新。
Result: 实验表明 FACT 在几何重建上优于基线，能用更简单的碰撞代理实现更可靠交互，并比直接参数推断 (direct parameter inference) 更好地复现留出的物理响应 (held-out physical responses)。
Conclusion: 把几何、接触与动力保真度放进同一个由定量反馈驱动的证据-诊断-修订循环里构造铰接孪生，比一次性生成或直接参数推断更能得到可交互、可复现物理响应的资产。

papers.title: Beyond Compression: Diagnosing How Post-Training Changes Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Post-training is central to mathematical reasoning in modern large language models (LLMs), but endpoint pass@1 alone underidentifies what has changed. Gains may reflect newly reachable solutions, cheaper sampling of latent solutions, surface robustness, or memorisation. We compare three post-training paths under a common diagnostic readout: our sufficiently trained off-policy distillation trajectories, released Qwen3 off-policy-plus-on-policy distillation endpoints, and a released DeepSeek-Math endpoint trained with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). Our probe uses cross-surface pass@K over verbatim prompts, paraphrases, numerical isomorphisms, and translations, plus consistency, distribution-shape, and verified supervised-fine-tuning (SFT) membership analyses. We find two regimes. On easier AMC problems, large-K ceilings are near saturation, so post-training mainly compresses sample cost. On harder AIME problems, post-training expands the large-K ceiling over the base model: sufficient off-policy distillation already raises this ceiling, Qwen3 released endpoints raise it further, and DeepSeek-Math GRPO does not dominate sufficient off-policy distillation at large K. English-dominant distillation improves non-English reasoning but preserves language-tier gaps. A controlled-overfit audit finds limited sensitivity in current SFT-membership probes. Compression is one regime of post-training, not a universal explanation.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 17 figures, 10 tables. Includes technical appendix. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用统一诊断读出比较三条后训练路径（自训 off-policy 蒸馏、Qwen3 off-policy+on-policy 蒸馏端点、DeepSeek-Math GRPO），发现后训练在简单 AMC 题上主要压缩采样成本（大 K 上限近饱和），在困难 AIME 题上才真正抬高大 K 上限；GRPO 在大 K 并不优于充分 off-policy 蒸馏。
Motivation: 只看端点 pass@1 无法区分后训练到底改变了什么：是解锁新解、还是更便宜地采样已有解、表面鲁棒性或记忆，因此需要可分离这些机制的诊断读出。
Method: 在统一读出下对比三条路径：自训充分 off-policy 蒸馏轨迹、发布的 Qwen3 off-policy+on-policy 蒸馏端点、以 GRPO 训练的 DeepSeek-Math 端点；探针用跨表面 pass@K（verbatim、改写、数值同构、翻译），配合一致性、分布形状与经验证的 SFT membership 分析，并做受控过拟合审计。
Result: AMC 上大 K 上限接近饱和，后训练主要降低采样成本；AIME 上后训练抬高大 K 上限，充分 off-policy 蒸馏已能抬升，Qwen3 端点抬得更高，DeepSeek-Math GRPO 在大 K 不支配充分 off-policy 蒸馏。英语主导的蒸馏改善非英语推理但保留语言层级差距；受控过拟合审计显示当前 SFT membership 探针敏感度有限。
Conclusion: 压缩只是后训练的一种机制而非普适解释：在难题上后训练确实扩展可达解空间，在易题上只是更高效地采样既有解。

papers.title: RL-PaO: Prediction as Action in Decision Making under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making under uncertainty often relies on predicted parameters, yet accurate prediction does not necessarily lead to good operational decisions. Aligning prediction with downstream optimization requires learning from the consequences of the decisions those predictions induce. We introduce RL-PaO, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates system formulation, optimization, and decision execution into a single environment. This yields a Markov decision process in which prediction is regarded as action: it shifts the environment to produce subsequent context and reward that explicitly aligns prediction error with realized cost, and learning the optimal policy does not require differentiating through the black-box solver. We evaluate RL-PaO on day-ahead energy scheduling using real historical data. On the test year, RL-PaO achieves the lowest annual cost among the non-oracle baselines, achieving on average $10\%$ cost reduction. Moreover, RL-PaO is capable of further analyses to provide strong interpretability both from the policy evolution perspective and the cost-accuracy trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RL-PaO 把预测本身当作动作放进强化学习环境，使预测误差直接对齐下游优化的实现成本，从而绕开对黑盒求解器的反向传播。在用真实历史数据做的日前能源调度测试年上，它在所有非 oracle 基线中年成本最低，平均降低 10%。
Motivation: 预测精度高不等于运营决策好：预测与下游优化之间缺少让预测从决策后果中学习的机制，且调度求解器常是不可微的黑盒。

papers.title: vSkipper: Translating Dynamic Layer Skipping into LLM Serving Gains
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic layer skipping reduces LLM computation by allowing each token to execute only a subset of the model's layers. However, existing skippers rely on specialized generation loops and do not integrate with modern serving engines. As a result, fewer executed layers do not necessarily translate into lower serving latency: FlexiDepth skips 8 of Llama-3-8B's 32 layers on average, yet its standard generation loop decodes 14.6--21.0% more slowly than the base model. We present vSkipper, a virtualization layer that makes dynamic layer skippers pluggable in serving engines while preserving continuous batching, fixed-shape batches, paged KV caching, and captured decode graphs. At each routed layer, vSkipper groups tokens by the skipper's decision and uses routed execution only when predicted to be profitable. We implement vSkipper in SGLang and evaluate the released FlexiDepth checkpoint against upstream SGLang under identical prompts, arrivals, output lengths, and launch settings. At the knee of upstream's load curve, vSkipper reduces mean end-to-end latency by 36.8% on GSM8K and 13.6% on BBH. Under saturation, it increases request throughput by 11.3% and 7.4%. Serving adds no statistically resolved quality loss beyond the checkpoint's own. Across synthetic skip policies, two Qwen3 skippers, and three GPUs, we demonstrate reuse without workload-specific tuning. To our knowledge, vSkipper is the first system to realize serving-efficiency gains from per-token interior layer skipping within a modern LLM serving engine. The code is open-sourced as an SGLang fork at https://github.com/AKafakA/sglang-vskipper/tree/vskipper-ref
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: vSkipper 是一个把动态跳层 (dynamic layer skipping) 接入现代 LLM serving 引擎的虚拟化层：在每个被路由的层按 skipper 决策对 token 分组，仅在预测有利可图时走 routed execution，同时保住 continuous batching、固定形状 batch、paged KV cache 与 captured decode graphs。在 SGLang 上以相同 prompt、到达、输出长度与启动设置对比上游 SGLang，负载曲线拐点处 GSM8K 平均端到端延迟降 36.8%、BBH 降 13.6%，饱和时请求吞吐提升 11.3% 与 7.4%。
Motivation: 现有 skipper 依赖专用生成循环、无法接入 serving 引擎，少算层不等于低延迟：FlexiDepth 平均跳过 Llama-3-8B 的 32 层中的 8 层，其标准生成循环反而比基座模型解码慢 14.6–21.0%。
Method: 在 SGLang 中实现 vSkipper 虚拟化层，保留 continuous batching、固定形状 batch、paged KV caching 与 captured decode graphs；每个 routed layer 按 skipper 决策对 token 分组，并用一个可预测的收益判断决定是否走 routed execution。评测用已发布的 FlexiDepth checkpoint，对照上游 SGLang，控制 prompt、到达、输出长度与启动设置一致。
Result: 负载曲线拐点处平均端到端延迟降低 36.8%（GSM8K）与 13.6%（BBH）；饱和时请求吞吐提升 11.3% 与 7.4%；相对 checkpoint 自身无统计上可分辨的质量损失。对照背景数字：FlexiDepth 平均跳过 32 层中的 8 层，标准生成循环比基座模型解码慢 14.6–21.0%。在合成 skip 策略、两个 Qwen3 skipper 与三种 GPU 上验证可复用、无需按负载调参。
Conclusion: 把 per-token 内部跳层做成 serving 引擎内的可插拔虚拟化层，才能把少算层真正换成端到端延迟与吞吐收益；作者称其为首个在现代 LLM serving 引擎中实现该收益的系统，代码以 SGLang fork 开源。

papers.title: A Comprehensive View of Fairness through Distributional Stability
papers.abstract_en: We view fairness as a property of distributional stability. Rather than assessing a predictor under a fixed data distribution, we study how its predictions change under perturbations that modify the composition of protected groups. A predictor is fair if it remains stable under such shifts. Under this perspective, several classical notions of fairness arise as stability with respect to specific perturbations, with the associated unfairness gap given by a Lipschitz constant of a prediction-rate functional. This formulation also yields guarantees that hold uniformly over a range of demographic compositions at test time, without requiring knowledge of the deployment distribution. It leads to a learning procedure based on convex combinations of reweighted predictors, formulated as a second-order cone program, for which we establish generalization bounds. Experiments on standard benchmarks illustrate the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把公平性重定义为分布稳定性：预测器在改变受保护群体构成的扰动下若保持稳定即为公平，经典公平性概念对应不同扰动下的稳定性，不公平差距由预测率泛函的 Lipschitz 常数给出。由此得到在测试时人口构成范围内一致成立、无需知道部署分布的保证，并导出基于重加权预测器凸组合、表述为二阶锥规划 (SOCP) 的学习过程。
Motivation: 传统公平性评估固定数据分布，无法刻画预测器在受保护群体构成变化时的行为，也难以在未知部署分布下给出保证。
Method: 将公平性形式化为预测率泛函在群体构成扰动下的 Lipschitz 稳定性，经典公平性概念对应特定扰动；学习过程用重加权预测器的凸组合，表述为二阶锥规划 (SOCP)，并建立泛化界。
Result: 在标准基准上进行了实验以说明该方法；推导出在测试时一系列人口构成上一致成立、无需部署分布知识的保证，并为 SOCP 学习过程建立泛化界。
Conclusion: 公平性可统一视为分布稳定性视角下的性质，能在未知部署分布下给出一致保证，并对应一个可解的凸优化学习过程。

papers.title: Message Passing Does More with Less for In-Context Learning on Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Achieving strong performance with graph neural networks (GNNs) typically requires training and hyperparameter tuning for each dataset, incurring repeated costs and effort. Graph in-context learning (ICL) avoids this by using a single pretrained model to predict unknown node labels directly from labeled context nodes. Existing approaches, however, rely on dense attention across nodes, making inference increasingly expensive as graphs grow. In this work, we present Ephris, a new graph in-context learner built on sparse message passing, scaling linearly with the number of node-feature entries and graph edges. Ephris is pretrained entirely on synthetic graphs generated from structural causal models with diverse graph structures and relational dynamics, exposing the model to varied dependencies among topology, features, and labels. We evaluate Ephris on 51 node-classification datasets against 15 extensively tuned GNNs and existing graph ICL methods under both high- and low-label train/validation/test splits. Across both settings, Ephris ranks first on all four aggregate measures: Elo, improvability, average rank, and accuracy. Its inference cost remains comparable to training a single GNN once, while being over 10 times faster than previous graph ICL models. Together, these results advance the performance-runtime Pareto frontier, demonstrating that strong graph ICL does not require dense attention. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/ephris.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ephris 用稀疏消息传递替代稠密注意力做图上节点标签的 in-context learning，推理代价随节点特征项数与边数线性增长。在 51 个节点分类数据集、对 15 个充分调参的 GNN 与已有图 ICL 方法的高/低标签两种划分下，Ephris 在 Elo、improvability、平均排名、准确率四项汇总指标上均排第一，推理比此前图 ICL 模型快 10 倍以上，代价仅相当于训练一个 GNN 一次。
Motivation: 图 GNN 需要逐数据集训练与调参，而现有图 ICL 方法依赖节点间稠密注意力，图变大后推理开销急剧上升。
Method: Ephris 是基于稀疏消息传递的图 in-context learner，完全在由结构因果模型 (structural causal models) 生成的合成图上预训练，覆盖多样的图结构与关系动态，从而暴露于拓扑、特征、标签之间的各种依赖；推理时直接从带标签上下文节点预测未知节点标签。
Result: 在 51 个节点分类数据集上，对 15 个充分调参的 GNN 及已有图 ICL 方法，在高标签与低标签两种 train/val/test 划分下，Ephris 在 Elo、improvability、平均排名、准确率四项汇总指标上均排第一；推理开销与训练单个 GNN 一次相当，比此前图 ICL 模型快 10 倍以上，整体随节点特征项数与边数线性扩展。
Conclusion: 强图 ICL 不必依赖稠密注意力：稀疏消息传递加合成图预训练即可把性能-运行时 Pareto 前沿整体外推。

papers.title: Evolving Towards Better Codes: LLM-Guided Search for High-Distance Binary Linear Codes
papers.abstract_en: Evolutionary program search driven by large language models (LLMs) has produced record-breaking constructions for open problems in combinatorics and beyond. We apply this approach to the longstanding problem of improving the best-known bounds for binary linear codes. Building on the EvoTune evolutionary framework and the ShinkaEvolve codebase, we introduce LinCodeEvolve, which evolves code-construction programs against an exact minimum-distance evaluator. A strategy loop combines diversity-driven search and expert supervision: when progress plateaus, new strategies are used to redirect the search. LinCodeEvolve discovers seven record-breaking codes, $[172,21,66]$, $[173,20,68]$, $[176,21,68]$, $[181,21,70]$, $[184,21,72]$, $[189,22,72]$ and $[200,21,77]$, six of which have concise quasi-cyclic descriptions. With standard code modification techniques, they improve $22$ entries of the tables. Every code is verified by exhaustive enumeration. These results suggest that LLM-guided search can help find improved codes and complement existing methods in coding theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 驱动的进化程序搜索用于改进二元线性码的最小距离上界，提出 LinCodeEvolve：在精确最小距离评估器上进化构造程序，用多样性搜索加专家监督的策略环在停滞时改换策略。发现 7 个破纪录码（[172,21,66] 到 [200,21,77]），配合标准码修改技术改进了码表 22 个条目，全部经穷举验证。
Motivation: 改进二元线性码最小距离的已知界是长期开放问题，现有构造方法难以系统推进码表条目。
Method: 基于 EvoTune 进化框架与 ShinkaEvolve 代码库构建 LinCodeEvolve，用精确最小距离评估器作为适应度，进化生成构造程序；策略环结合多样性驱动搜索与专家监督，进展停滞时引入新策略重定向搜索。
Result: 发现 7 个破纪录码：[172,21,66]、[173,20,68]、[176,21,68]、[181,21,70]、[184,21,72]、[189,22,72]、[200,21,77]，其中 6 个有简洁准循环 (quasi-cyclic) 描述；配合标准码修改技术共改进码表 22 个条目，每个码均经穷举枚举验证。
Conclusion: LLM 引导的搜索能产出改进的二元线性码，可作为编码理论中现有方法的补充。

papers.title: Spatial-OPSD: Self-Improving Spatial Reasoning via Label-Free Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly operate in embodied and spatially grounded settings, where accurate understanding of depth, viewpoint, and three-dimensional relations is essential. However, improving spatial reasoning typically relies on ground-truth answers, answer-derived rewards, or other forms of task-specific supervision. We introduce Spatial-OPSD, a label-free self-improvement framework that instead exploits spatial structure naturally available from perception and reconstruction tools. During training, a privileged teacher receives automatically obtainable spatial priors, such as depth, reconstructed 3D relations, and camera geometry, while the student observes only the original visual-language input. On trajectories sampled by the student itself, the teacher provides dense token-level supervision, allowing the student to internalize spatial knowledge without ground-truth answer labels or privileged information at inference time. To extend this supervision beyond a single round, we adopt a round-wise recursive training scheme: the teacher remains frozen within each round to provide a stable learning target, and the improved student initializes both teacher and student in the next round, where privileged spatial priors re-establish an informative teacher--student asymmetry. This enables repeated self-improvement while avoiding a rapidly moving teacher during optimization. Across four VLM families, a single round of Spatial-OPSD consistently improves the five-benchmark average, while three rounds further push a strong spatially specialized model to the open-source frontier, achieving the highest average among the open models and the best results on three of five spatial reasoning benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/vermouth599/Spatial-OPSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spatial-OPSD 提出免标签的空间推理自改进框架：训练时特权 teacher 拿到深度、重建 3D 关系与相机几何等自动空间先验，student 只看原始视觉-语言输入，在 student 自采样轨迹上接收 token 级稠密监督，推理时无需特权信息。跨四个 VLM 家族，单轮即稳定提升五基准平均分，三轮把一个空间特化强模型推到开源前沿，取得开源模型最高平均分与五个空间推理基准中三个的最优结果。
Motivation: VLM 的空间推理改进通常依赖 ground-truth 答案、答案派生奖励或任务特定监督，获取成本高；而感知与重建工具本身已能自动产出空间结构，此前未被用作免标签的自改进信号。
Method: 训练阶段设特权 teacher（输入深度、重建 3D 关系、相机几何等自动空间先验）与仅见原始视觉-语言输入的 student；在 student 自采样轨迹上由 teacher 提供稠密 token 级监督。采用 round-wise 递归训练：每轮内 teacher 冻结以保持稳定学习目标，改进后的 student 同时初始化下一轮的 teacher 与 student，使特权先验重新建立非对称性，避免优化中 teacher 快速漂移。
Result: 跨四个 VLM 家族，单轮 Spatial-OPSD 一致提升五基准平均分；三轮进一步把一个强空间特化模型推至开源前沿，取得开源模型中最高平均分，并在五个空间推理基准中的三个上取得最佳结果。
Conclusion: 用感知与重建工具产出的空间先验做特权 teacher 的免标签自蒸馏，可以在不依赖 ground-truth 答案的情况下多轮持续提升 VLM 空间推理，且推理阶段无需特权信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: actr: aligning thoughts and responses for multilingual safety in reasoning llms
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the safety of reasoning large language models (LLMs) across languages is essential for their reliable deployment. However, when exposed to jailbreak attacks in non-high-resource languages, these models may generate unsafe responses even when their reasoning traces identify safety risks. To address this issue, we propose aligning cross-lingual thoughts and responses (ACTR), a framework that improves multilingual safety alignment by strengthening the use of existing safety reasoning. Specifically, we first present the think gap score (TGS) to compare the normalized contributions of reasoning traces to attention outputs during response generation across languages, and use reasoning- trace substitution to measure the cross-lingual safety gap. Next, using a corpus of jailbreak queries, we assess neuron importance through changes in response representations caused by neuron masking and compare the high-importance neuron sets obtained with reasoning enabled and disabled to identify safety think neurons that support the use of safety reasoning. Finally, we devise neuron-selective consistency optimization (NSCO), which uses a frozen judge model to reward agreement between the safety categories of reasoning traces and responses while updating only the parameters associated with the selected neurons, requiring no human-annotated responses or preference data. Across two reasoning models, ACTR achieves lower average attack success rates than the evaluated state-of-the-art methods on AdvBench-X and MultiJail, with safety gains extending to unseen languages, while preserving or improving average performance on multilingual knowledge and mathematical reasoning tasks and limiting false refusals of benign requests. Warning: this paper contains examples with unsafe content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACTR 针对推理 LLM 在非高资源语言下越狱攻击时「推理已识别风险但仍输出不安全回复」的问题，用 think gap score (TGS) 与推理轨迹替换量化跨语言安全缺口，定位 safety think neurons，再以冻结 judge 驱动的 neuron-selective consistency optimization (NSCO) 只更新这些神经元。在 AdvBench-X 与 MultiJail 上，两个推理模型的平均攻击成功率低于所评估的 SOTA 方法，收益泛化到未见语言，同时保持或提升多语言知识与数学推理表现并抑制对良性请求的误拒。
Motivation: 推理 LLM 在非高资源语言遭遇越狱攻击时，即使推理轨迹已识别安全风险仍会生成不安全回复，跨语言安全对齐存在缺口。
Method: ACTR 三步：用 TGS 归一化比较各语言推理轨迹对响应生成注意力输出的贡献，并用 reasoning-trace substitution 度量跨语言安全缺口；在越狱查询语料上通过神经元掩蔽引起响应表示变化评估重要性，对比开启/关闭推理的高重要性神经元集合以定位 safety think neurons；最后用 NSCO 借冻结 judge 奖励推理轨迹与回复的安全类别一致性，仅更新所选神经元参数，无需人工标注响应或偏好数据。
Result: 在 AdvBench-X 与 MultiJail 上，两个推理模型的 ACTR 平均攻击成功率低于所评估的 SOTA 方法，安全收益延伸到未见语言；在多语言知识与数学推理任务上平均表现保持或提升，并限制对良性请求的误拒。
Conclusion: 强化模型已有的安全推理（而非另加偏好数据）即可提升多语言越狱防御，且不牺牲通用推理能力与良性请求通过率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98. For OriginPro figure-generation tasks, we further conduct a human-LLM agreement study to validate the use of a multimodal judge for secondary aesthetic assessment. Our experiments show that strong performance on general benchmarks does not transfer to professional scientific workflows, and that this gap is not a visual-grounding problem alone: failures arise from domain-specific operational knowledge, sparse pretraining coverage of scientific software, weak cross-tool artifact handoff, and critical states exposed only visually. Even the best model reaches only 25% success rate on GUI tasks and 45% on code tasks. MatToolBench therefore serves as a challenging diagnostic benchmark and real-environment testbed for data-scarce, knowledge-intensive scientific workflows.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 15 figures. Mei Wu and Rui Xie contributed equally. Bo Chen and Lu Chen are corresponding authors. Project page: https://mattoolbench.github.io/ ; code: https://github.com/meiwu5/MatToolBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MatToolBench 是首个在真实 Windows 11 VM 中评测多模态 GUI 智能体操作专业材料科学软件的基准，含 10 个工具、204 个任务、三种模态（GUI 操作、OriginPro 脚本、代码式数据库查询）。最强模型在 GUI 任务上成功率仅 25%、代码任务 45%，说明通用基准上的强表现无法迁移到专业科学工作流，且失败不止于视觉定位。
Motivation: 多模态 GUI 智能体在通用软件基准上表现强劲，但材料科学领域网页数据稀疏、界面专业、工作流惯例属隐性知识，通用预训练难以覆盖，其在专业科学软件上的操作能力基本未被检验。
Method: 构建真实环境基准 MatToolBench：10 个工具、204 个任务，覆盖 GUI 操作、OriginPro 脚本、代码式数据库查询三种模态，全部在 Windows 11 VM 内执行；由领域专家把每个任务分解为细粒度子判据实现可解释的部分得分，多级评测管线的 GUI 部分配合多模态 judge 做 OriginPro 出图的美学二次评分，并用人机一致性研究验证该 judge。
Result: 评测管线 GUI 部分平均 F1 达 0.98；最强模型在 GUI 任务上成功率仅 25%，代码任务 45%；失败归因于领域操作知识缺失、科学软件预训练覆盖稀疏、跨工具工件交接弱，以及仅以视觉暴露的关键状态。
Conclusion: 通用基准的强表现不迁移到专业科学工作流，该差距并非单纯视觉定位问题；MatToolBench 被定位为数据稀缺、知识密集型科学工作流的挑战性诊断基准与真实环境测试台。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OmniRoute: Mapping Temporal Semantic Evidence to Audio-Visual Token Budgets for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) encode audio and visual streams into temporally interleaved token sequences for multimodal reasoning. However, processing long audio-visual token sequences incurs substantial prefill costs. Existing compression methods have made progress, but often overlook temporal changes in audio-visual semantic relevance. Motivated by temporal variation and local continuity, we propose OmniRoute, a training-free, two-stage compression framework. First, Temporal Evidence-Guided Budgeting (TEGB) derives chunk-wise modality preferences and initial leading-modality budgets from semantic relevance and local content variation. Second, Budget-Constrained Semantic Compression (BCSC) compresses the leading modality and then calibrates the follower's retention target using the actual retained fraction. For video, it combines spatiotemporal grouping with query-guided selection; for audio, it selects tokens based on encoder attention and query relevance, then merges residual tokens into context anchors under visual guidance. Experiments on four representative benchmarks demonstrate a better trade-off between inference efficiency and performance than competitive baselines. The code and interface will be released to facilitate further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniRoute 是面向全模态大模型 (Omni-LLM) 的免训练两阶段音视频 token 压缩框架：先用时序证据引导预算 (TEGB) 按语义相关性与局部内容变化分配各 chunk 的模态偏好与主导模态预算，再用预算约束语义压缩 (BCSC) 按实际保留比例校准跟随模态的保留目标。在四个代表性基准上，它相对竞争基线取得推理效率与性能的更优折中。
Motivation: Omni-LLM 把音频与视觉编码成时序交错的长 token 序列，prefill 开销大；已有压缩方法忽略音视频语义相关性随时间的变化。
Method: 免训练两阶段框架：TEGB 依据语义相关性与局部内容变化给出逐 chunk 模态偏好和主导模态初始预算；BCSC 先压主导模态，再按实际保留比例校准跟随模态保留目标。视频侧用时空分组 (spatiotemporal grouping) 加 query 引导选择，音频侧按 encoder attention 与 query 相关性选 token，残余 token 在视觉引导下并入 context anchors。
Result: 在四个代表性基准上，相对竞争基线取得推理效率与性能之间更好的折中；代码与接口将发布。
Conclusion: 时序语义相关性可以用来分配音视频 token 预算，在免训练条件下同时压低 prefill 成本并保住多模态推理性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NHO: A Neural Hamiltonian Operator for Anchor-based Region Localization and Dense Correspondance
papers.abstract_en: Non-rigid partial-to-full shape correspondence from sparse anchors requires identifying the corresponding region on the full surface and recovering dense correspondences between the partial shape and that region. We present NHO, which combines sparse anchors with the intrinsic geometry of the partial shape to learn a neural Hamiltonian operator whose localized eigenspace encodes both the region support and intrinsic coordinates for dense correspondence. NHO parameterizes the Hamiltonian potential as an intrinsic neural field and optimizes it using anchor evidence together with spectral and geometric constraints. To resolve the spatial ambiguity left by sparse anchors, we introduce reciprocal refinement between operator estimation and correspondence recovery. At each round, the current eigenspace provides spectral coordinates and restricts matching to its induced support, while geometrically reliable correspondences provide additional evidence for updating the potential. After refinement, aggregated eigenfunction energy yields the final localization, and the recovered map initializes dense correspondence refinement. Experiments demonstrate competitive accuracy on both tasks and robustness to uniform scaling and rotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NHO 把稀疏 anchor 与部分形状的内蕴几何结合，学习一个神经 Hamiltonian 算子，其局域本征空间同时编码区域支撑与内蕴坐标，用于非刚性部分到完整形状的区域定位与稠密对应。算子估计与对应恢复做互易细化：每轮用当前本征空间给出谱坐标并把匹配限制在其支撑内，再用几何可靠对应反哺势函数；最终聚合本征函数能量得到定位。实验显示两项任务精度具竞争力，且对均匀缩放与旋转鲁棒。
Motivation: 从稀疏 anchor 做非刚性部分到完整形状对应时，既要找出完整表面上对应的区域，又要恢复稠密映射，稀疏 anchor 留下的空间歧义是核心难点。
Method: 将 Hamiltonian 势参数化为内蕴神经场 (intrinsic neural field)，用 anchor 证据连同谱约束与几何约束优化；引入算子估计与对应恢复之间的互易细化 (reciprocal refinement)，每轮以当前本征空间提供谱坐标并约束匹配支撑，以几何可靠对应更新势；细化后聚合本征函数能量得到定位，恢复的映射再初始化稠密对应细化。
Result: 实验在区域定位与稠密对应两项任务上均展现具竞争力的精度，并对均匀缩放与旋转表现出鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 用神经 Hamiltonian 算子的局域本征空间统一承载区域支撑与内蕴坐标，配合互易细化，可同时解决 anchor 引导的区域定位与稠密对应。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 将 Hamiltonian 势参数化为内蕴神经场 (intrinsic neural field)，用 anchor 证据连同谱约束与几何约束优化；引入算子估计与对应恢复之间的互易细化 (reciprocal refinement)，每轮以当前本征空间提供谱坐标并约束匹配支撑，以几何可靠对应更新势；细化后聚合本征函数能量得到定位，恢复的映射再初始化稠密对应细化。
summary_sections.result: 实验在区域定位与稠密对应两项任务上均展现具竞争力的精度，并对均匀缩放与旋转表现出鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用神经 Hamiltonian 算子的局域本征空间统一承载区域支撑与内蕴坐标，配合互易细化，可同时解决 anchor 引导的区域定位与稠密对应。

papers.title: Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion for Feedforward, Locally Trained Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new spiking neural network (SNN) design to process static images and event streams using time-to-first-spike (TTFS) latencies. Our key research question is which architectural choices best accommodate local and online learning in multi-layer convolutional SNNs. This question is addressed via an original framework combining residual-like connections with multi-depth feature aggregation and consensus. The full SNN pipeline features an early-vision front end, to convert raw visual data into sparse spike latencies, a four-layer convolutional backbone trained layerwise with unsupervised spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), a deterministic Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF) and a final classifier trained with reward-modulated spike-timing-dependent plasticity (R-STDP). Rather than replacing early features in deeper layers, the proposed MDTF preserves early temporal evidence, adding sparse residual events from intermediate layers, and incorporating deeper features only when they agree in time with earlier representations. The resulting architecture is experimentally validated across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and N-MNIST, delivering strong classification performance under a fully local learning regime. Selective multi-depth fusion significantly outperforms traditional STDP/R-STDP baselines on higher-variability visual tasks (achieving +18.2 pp on Fashion-MNIST and +29.2 pp on CIFAR-10). Furthermore, activity-budget analyses show that the network retains high accuracy even when removing a large fraction of late or weak spike events, confirming its high data efficiency and reduced event-processing requirements. The codebase is publicly available at github.com/aidinattar/multi-depth- temporal-fusion-snn.
papers.comment: 22 pages. Submitted to Neurocomputing. Code available at https://github.com/aidinattar/multi-depth-temporal-fusion-snn
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向静态图像与事件流的 SNN 架构 Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF)：用 time-to-first-spike (TTFS) 编码、逐层无监督 STDP 训练的四层卷积骨干，加上确定性多深度时间融合与 R-STDP 分类器，在完全本地学习下把 Fashion-MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 相对传统 STDP/R-STDP 基线分别提升 18.2 pp 与 29.2 pp。
Motivation: 多层卷积 SNN 中深层特征会覆盖早期时间证据，而本地在线学习（STDP/R-STDP）在高类内变化的视觉任务上精度明显不足，需要在不引入反向传播的前提下保留早期特征。
Method: 流水线为：早期视觉前端把原始数据转成稀疏 spike latency；四层卷积骨干逐层用无监督 STDP 训练；确定性 MDTF 保留早期时间证据、叠加中间层的稀疏残差事件，仅在深层特征与早期表征时间一致时才纳入；末端分类器用 reward-modulated STDP (R-STDP) 训练。
Result: 在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、N-MNIST 上验证：选择性多深度融合相对传统 STDP/R-STDP 基线在 Fashion-MNIST 提升 18.2 pp、CIFAR-10 提升 29.2 pp；activity-budget 分析显示移除大量晚期或弱 spike 事件后仍保持高精度。
Conclusion: 在完全本地学习体制下，保留早期时间证据并按时间一致性选择性融合多深度特征，可显著提升高变化视觉任务的 SNN 分类精度，同时降低事件处理量与数据需求。

papers.title: Speed in the Blind Spot: An Interpretability Analysis of Dynamic Perception in VLMs for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models are increasingly used in autonomous-driving systems, yet their ability to recover dynamic physical state from visual input remains insufficiently characterized. We study velocity understanding as a controlled diagnostic across three tasks: surrounding-agent speed, current ego speed, and short-horizon future ego-speed proposal. On nuScenes, we evaluate open-weight general-purpose and PhysicalAI VLMs, together with the driving-oriented Alpamayo-1.5 Vision-Language-Action model, using multiple input and output formulations. We combine verbal evaluation with temporal perturbations, counterfactual ego-speed hints and linear probes of hidden representations. The tasks exhibit distinct failure modes. Surrounding-agent speed is weakly encoded in an agent-specific form, whereas current ego speed is often internally accessible but poorly verbalized: continuous probes achieve 4.7-5.8 km/h MAE compared with 10.2-16.8 km/h MAE for verbal outputs. Multiple frames provide inconsistent verbal gains to single frame inputs, and frame order is rarely exploited. Under non-optimized QLoRA, task-specific adaptation improves both task-relevant latent speed representations and verbal readout, but continuous surrounding-agent speed estimation remains weak, while most future-speed gains survive frame shuffling, indicating limited temporal grounding. Driving specialized Alpamayo-1.5 shows stronger latent representations for surrounding-agent and future ego speed, while current ego-speed decodability is comparable and substantial probe-verbal gaps remain. Thus, driving specialization can strengthen motion representations but does not guarantee stronger encoding across both scene and ego states or reliable readout. The results show that plausible planning outputs do not necessarily imply reliable recovery or temporal grounding of the underlying dynamic state.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 nuScenes 上用速度理解作为诊断，发现 VLM 的当前自车速度常在隐层可解码却说不出来：线性 probe MAE 4.7–5.8 km/h，而语言输出 10.2–16.8 km/h。多帧对语言读出的增益不稳定、帧序几乎不被利用，未来速度的 QLoRA 增益大多在打乱帧序后仍保留，说明时序 grounding 有限。
Motivation: VLM 已进入自动驾驶系统，但从视觉输入恢复动态物理状态（速度）的能力缺乏刻画，而看似合理的规划输出并不等于底层动态状态被可靠恢复。
Method: 在 nuScenes 上围绕三个任务（周边车辆速度、当前自车速度、短时未来自车速度提议）评测开放权重通用与 PhysicalAI VLM 及驾驶专用 Alpamayo-1.5 Vision-Language-Action 模型，组合语言评测、时序扰动、反事实自车速度提示与隐层线性 probe，并在非优化 QLoRA 下做任务适配。
Result: 连续 probe 达 4.7–5.8 km/h MAE，语言输出为 10.2–16.8 km/h MAE；多帧相对单帧的语言增益不一致，帧序很少被利用；多数未来速度增益在帧序打乱后保留；Alpamayo-1.5 对周边与未来自车速度的隐层表征更强，但当前自车速度可解码性相当，probe 与语言输出差距仍大。
Conclusion: 驾驶专用化能加强运动表征，但不保证场景与自车两类状态都被更强编码或可靠读出；看似合理的规划输出不必然意味着底层动态状态被可靠恢复或具备时序 grounding。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance for Energy-Based Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from unnormalized distributions over large discrete state spaces becomes difficult when a multimodal target is far from a tractable reference. We introduce Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance (IEDG), a population-exact, trajectory-wise guidance framework for unnormalized discrete targets. Rather than learn the full reference-to-target correction in one step, IEDG introduces a global Boltzmann tilt along an annealing trajectory. Each stage learns a stage-local posterior correction for an incremental Boltzmann tilt of the current source, while the resulting corrections are accumulated relative to a fixed analytic posterior. At the population optimum, exact stage posteriors recover the correct reverse dynamics, whose exact simulation reproduces the target distribution. IEDG chooses stage increments by relative effective sample size (rESS), which controls Rényi-2 displacement and locally adapts the step size to the thermodynamic geometry of the annealing path. Our stagewise total-variation analysis shows that limited overlap amplifies Bregman fitting error by $1/\sqrt{\mathrm{rESS}}$, while posterior, simulation, and truncation errors enter additively. IEDG improves all distribution-level errors over the neural baselines on ordered, exactly enumerated Ising $4\times4$, while substantially reducing one-shot errors on Ising/Potts $16\times16$ across thermodynamic regimes and attaining the best neural-sampler result on several reported local-statistic and phase-coverage metrics. On Max-Cut, its best-of-512 and average-sample ratios exceed all the baselines. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/StillFantasy123/iterative-exact-discrete-guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IEDG 面向远离可解参考分布的多模态离散目标，沿退火轨迹逐步施加全局 Boltzmann tilt，每阶段只学一个 stage-local 后验校正并相对固定解析后验累积，用相对有效样本量 (rESS) 自适应选步长。在总体最优处精确 stage 后验可复现目标分布；总变差分析给出重叠不足时 Bregman 拟合误差按 1/√rESS 放大、其余误差可加。
Motivation: 大离散状态空间上未归一化目标若远离可解参考分布，一次性学完整校正困难；需要一种分阶段、可控误差的采样框架。
Method: IEDG 沿退火轨迹引入全局 Boltzmann tilt，每阶段学习针对增量 tilt 的 stage-local 后验校正，并相对固定解析后验累积；用 rESS 选阶段增量以控制 Rényi-2 位移并自适应热力学几何；给出 stagewise 总变差误差分解分析。
Result: 在有序、可精确枚举的 Ising 4×4 上改善所有分布层面误差；在 Ising/Potts 16×16 跨热力学区制显著降低 one-shot 误差，并在若干已报告的局域统计量与相位覆盖指标上取得最佳神经采样器结果；在 Max-Cut 上 best-of-512 与平均样本比值超过全部基线。
Conclusion: 分阶段 Boltzmann tilt 加 rESS 自适应步长可把离散目标采样的拟合、模拟与截断误差分开控制，重叠不足时误差按 1/√rESS 放大。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: GleanVID: Complementary Token Selection for Efficient Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved strong video understanding capabilities but incur substantial inference overhead due to the large number of visual tokens. Existing VideoLLM token compression methods largely rely on selection-independent scoring, overlooking cross-frame complementarity and consequently retaining redundant evidence across frames. Instead, we view video token selection as a progressive evidence accumulation process. It aims to retain visual evidence that is individually informative and collectively complementary under a limited token budget. Building on this insight, we introduce GleanVID, a training-free inference acceleration framework for VideoLLMs. Specifically, GleanVID first allocates the global token budget across frames according to temporal novelty and then selects tokens by jointly considering local representativeness and subspace complementarity, thereby preserving richer and less redundant visual evidence. Extensive experiments across diverse VideoLLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that GleanVID consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, with only 25% of visual tokens, GleanVID preserves 98.6% of Qwen3-VL's original performance while reducing its prefill latency by 44.7%. On LLaVA-OV-7B, GleanVID at a 25% retention ratio even slightly surpasses the original model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GleanVID 把视频 token 选择视为渐进证据累积：先按时间新颖度在帧间分配全局 token 预算，再在帧内同时考虑局部代表性与子空间互补性选 token，从而在压缩时保留跨帧互补证据。仅保留 25% 视觉 token 时，Qwen3-VL 原性能的 98.6% 得以保持，prefill 延迟下降 44.7%；LLaVA-OV-7B 在 25% 保留率下甚至略超原模型。
Motivation: 现有 VideoLLM token 压缩多用逐 token 独立打分，忽略跨帧互补性，导致各帧重复保留冗余证据，在有限 token 预算下浪费容量。
Method: GleanVID 是免训练 (training-free) 的推理加速框架：先按时间新颖度把全局 token 预算分配到各帧，再以局部代表性与子空间互补性联合打分选 token，压缩视觉 token 输入 VideoLLM。
Result: 在多种 VideoLLM 与 benchmark 上达到 state-of-the-art：仅用 25% 视觉 token 时保留 Qwen3-VL 原性能的 98.6%，prefill 延迟降低 44.7%；LLaVA-OV-7B 在 25% 保留率下略超原模型。
Conclusion: 在 token 预算下把逐帧独立打分换成跨帧互补的证据累积选择，可在大幅削减视觉 token 与 prefill 延迟的同时基本不掉点，甚至小幅超过原模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beam Search as Test-Time Self-Distillation via Counterfactual Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) enables a language model to act as its own teacher: by conditioning on a demonstration, the model produces an implicit reward via pointwise mutual information, which guides on-policy learning without external supervision. However, SDFT operates at training time: it requires gradient updates and access to expert demonstrations, making it inapplicable at inference. We propose test-time self-distillation, a decoding-time method that extracts a steering signal from the self-distillation framework without any parameter updates, reward models, or training data. Our key insight is that counterfactual contexts, i.e. fixed textual templates that hypothetically prime the model for excellent versus poor reasoning, can substitute for the demonstration. The log-odds ratio of a candidate answer under these two counterfactual conditions defines a new reward signal. We derive the optimal KL-regularized policy under this reward, which takes the form of a Gibbs reweighting of the base distribution. Crucially, this reweighting is global: it cannot be decomposed into independent per-token operations without ignoring future trajectory quality. We therefore approximate the target distribution via beam search. Experiments on mathematical reasoning (MATH500), code generation (HumanEval), and graduate-level science QA (GPQA) across multiple model scales show that test-time self-distillation improves over standard sampling, low temperature, beam search and power sampling baselines on average, demonstrating that the self-distillation principle can be operationalized at inference time.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把训练时的 Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) 搬到推理阶段：用「假设模型推理极好/极差」的固定反事实文本模板替代专家示范，两者下候选答案的 log-odds 比值即奖励信号。由该奖励导出的 KL 正则最优策略是基分布的全局 Gibbs 重加权，无法分解为逐 token 操作，故用 beam search 近似。在 MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA 上平均优于标准采样、低温、beam search 与 power sampling 基线。
Motivation: SDFT 依赖梯度更新与专家示范，只能在训练时做，无法在推理时使用；而推理阶段的自我引导需要不更新参数、不依赖奖励模型与训练数据的信号。
Method: 以反事实上下文模板（prime 出优秀/糟糕推理）替代示范，计算候选答案在两种条件下的 log-odds 比作为奖励；推导该奖励下 KL 正则的最优策略，得到对基分布的 Gibbs 重加权；因重加权是全局的、不能分解为独立逐 token 操作，转而用 beam search 近似目标分布。
Result: 在数学推理 MATH500、代码生成 HumanEval、研究生级科学 QA GPQA 上、跨多个模型规模，测试时自蒸馏平均优于标准采样、低温度、beam search 和 power sampling 基线。
Conclusion: 自蒸馏原理可以在推理时被操作化：无需参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据，仅靠反事实上下文的 log-odds 与 beam search 即可给出比采样类解码更优的平均表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, without requiring a model forward pass for position selection. On three of four datasets, explaining just $5\%$ of positions retains nearly all of the success rate from explaining every position, where success means obtaining an explanation about the threat. The benefit varies with the audit task. We also show that pretrained verbalizers recover words that models have learned to conceal through fine-tuning, without additional verbalizer training. These results identify where auditors can concentrate explanation generation and show that useful explanations can extend beyond the model a verbalizer was trained to describe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自然语言自编码器的可解释性审计中，只挑少数 token 位置生成解释即可覆盖大部分威胁信息：基于聊天结构训练的 ranker 通常比依赖模型计算的信号选出更多相关解释，且无需为选位做前向传播；四个数据集中的三个上，只解释 5% 的位置就几乎保留了全位置解释的成功率。
Motivation: 对语言模型内部激活做逐 token 解释成本极高，审计者需要知道该优先检查哪些位置才能发现 prompt injection 与 concealment 这类威胁。
Method: 在 470 万条解释上比较两类选位信号：来自模型计算的信号，与只用聊天结构训练的 ranker；成功定义为获得关于威胁的解释，并在四个数据集上评估。另检验预训练 verbalizer 能否恢复经微调被模型隐藏的词。
Result: 共 470 万个解释；聊天结构 ranker 通常比计算信号选出更多相关解释且不需要前向传播；四个数据集中三个上只解释 5% 位置即几乎保留全位置解释的成功率，收益随审计任务而变；预训练 verbalizer 无需额外训练即可恢复微调中被隐藏的词。
Conclusion: 解释生成可以集中在少数由聊天结构信号选出的位置上，且 verbalizer 的有效性可超出其训练时所描述的模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: NowcastDiT: Diffusion Transformers are Effective Precipitation Nowcasters
papers.abstract_en: Precipitation nowcasting demands accurate short-term forecasts under strong spatiotemporal variability. Diffusion models are well suited to modeling complex precipitation distributions, yet existing approaches often introduce increasingly specialized designs, leaving the capability of a standard diffusion architecture underexplored. We show that a standard Diffusion Transformer already provides a simple and scalable foundation for precipitation nowcasting, with domain-specific requirements accommodated naturally within its design space. Based on this principle, we develop NowcastDiT and instantiate this flexibility through two complementary adaptations: a dynamics-aware noise prior for temporally coherent forecasts, and end-to-end reinforcement learning with timestep-aware rewards for meteorological skill. Experiments on SEVIR and MRMS benchmarks show that NowcastDiT achieves state-of-the-art performance in both perceptual quality and meteorological skill. These results suggest that standard DiT can serve as an effective foundation for precipitation nowcasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NowcastDiT 证明标准 Diffusion Transformer 本身就是有效的降水临近预报 (precipitation nowcasting) 骨架，只需两个适配：动力学感知噪声先验 (dynamics-aware noise prior) 保证时序连贯，以及带时间步感知奖励的端到端强化学习提升气象技巧。在 SEVIR 与 MRMS 基准上同时取得感知质量与气象技巧的最先进表现。
Motivation: 现有扩散降水临近预报模型不断堆叠专用设计，标准扩散架构在该任务上的能力被低估，缺少一个简单且可扩展的通用基础。
Method: 以标准 Diffusion Transformer 为骨干，加入动力学感知噪声先验以获得时序连贯的预报序列，并用时间步感知奖励 (timestep-aware rewards) 做端到端强化学习优化气象技巧；在 SEVIR 与 MRMS 上实验。
Result: 在 SEVIR 和 MRMS 两个基准上，NowcastDiT 在感知质量 (perceptual quality) 与气象技巧 (meteorological skill) 两方面均达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 标准 DiT 无需大量领域专用改造即可作为降水临近预报的有效基础，领域需求可在其设计空间内自然满足。
Relevance: 94

papers.title: High-Resolution Dynamic Functional Connectivity Generation with Graph-Variate Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution dynamic functional connectivity (DFC) can reveal rapidly evolving brain-network interactions, but short temporal windows yield noisy, often low-rank covariance estimates. Graph-Variate Dynamic (GVD) connectivity addresses this by modulating fast instantaneous interactions with stable trial-level support. This suppresses spurious fluctuations and emphasizes persistent, informative connections. We show that the Hadamard construction lifts low-rank instantaneous connectivity from the positive-semidefinite to the positive-definite cone, keeping high-resolution trajectories on the SPD manifold without ridge regularisation or post-hoc projection. We introduce GVD-CFM, a class-conditional generative model for high-resolution dynamic connectivity. Each trial is represented as SPD GVD matrices on a product Riemannian manifold, then mapped through a global log-Euclidean diffeomorphism and an invertible temporal DCT basis. A Transformer-based conditional flow models all spectral modes jointly and generates the full trajectory non-autoregressively in Euclidean coordinates while preserving exact correspondence with valid SPD sequences. Retaining the full DCT basis also enables decoding on denser temporal grids without retraining. Across multiple EEG motor-imagery datasets, GVD-CFM delivers the strongest overall results for held-out distributional fidelity, temporal-dynamics preservation, and synthetic-to-real classification. It also remains computationally efficient relative to strong raw-signal and direct GVD-space generative baselines. GVD-CFM therefore provides a practical framework for realistic, temporally coherent, high-resolution brain-network generation with preserved manifold structure and resolution-flexible decoding from a single trained model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GVD-CFM：把 EEG 高分辨率动态功能连接 (DFC) 表示为乘积黎曼流形上的 SPD GVD 矩阵，经全局 log-Euclidean 微分同胚与可逆时域 DCT 基映射到欧氏坐标，再用 Transformer 条件流匹配一次性生成整条轨迹。Hadamard 构造把低秩瞬时连接从半正定锥提升到正定锥，无需 ridge 正则或事后投影；在多个 EEG 运动想象数据集上，其留出分布保真、时序动力学保持与合成到真实分类综合最强，且保留完整 DCT 基可在更密时间网格上解码而无需重训练。
Motivation: 短时间窗下的高分辨率 DFC 协方差估计噪声大且常低秩，难以得到既平滑又保留快速脑网络动态的生成样本。
Method: 每试次表示为乘积黎曼流形上的 SPD GVD 矩阵（快瞬时交互受稳定试次级支撑调制），经全局 log-Euclidean 微分同胚与可逆时域 DCT 基映射到欧氏坐标；Transformer 条件流 (conditional flow matching) 联合建模全部谱模态，非自回归地生成完整轨迹，并保持与合法 SPD 序列的精确对应。
Result: 在多个 EEG 运动想象数据集上，GVD-CFM 在留出分布保真、时序动力学保持和合成到真实分类三项上取得最强的综合结果，同时相对强的原始信号生成基线与直接 GVD 空间生成基线保持计算高效；保留完整 DCT 基使单个训练好的模型可在更密时间网格上解码。
Conclusion: 把 DFC 生成放到 SPD 流形上并用可逆 DCT 参数化，可以在不加 ridge 或事后投影的情况下同时保住流形结构、时序连贯性与分辨率灵活性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Watch-Think-Interact: Bootstrapping Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Streaming Video Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video assistance requires models to answer asynchronous questions from an observed prefix under a fixed context budget. Existing approaches model response timing or compress history, but an online state formed before future questions are known can omit visual details before later questions reveal their relevance; the retained state alone cannot recover them. We introduce Watch-Think-Interact (WTI), a closed-loop framework for multi-question streaming video reasoning. WTI maintains compact natural-language memory entries tagged with source-video time ranges; these entries support direct reasoning when sufficient and otherwise anchor selective recall of finer visual evidence. For each question, WTI answers when current context and memory suffice, continues watching when required evidence has not appeared, or recalls a relevant past interval and decides again after incorporating the returned chunks, without replaying the full observed history. To train this behavior, we construct WTI-82K, comprising 82,335 timed questions across 4,812 causally aligned trajectories, and develop Stream-GDPO to optimize complete multi-question streaming rollouts using trajectory-level feedback for response timing, source-video recall, and memory updates. WTI achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance among the compared open-source streaming baselines, reaching 83.3% on StreamingBench and 73.6% weighted overall accuracy on OVO-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出闭环流式视频推理框架 Watch-Think-Interact (WTI)：维护带源视频时间戳的紧凑自然语言记忆条目，每题在三种动作间决策——直接作答、继续观看等待证据出现、或召回相关历史片段后重新判断。用 82,335 条计时问题、4,812 条因果对齐轨迹训练的 Stream-GDPO 优化完整多题 rollout，在开源流式基线中达到 SOTA：StreamingBench 83.3%，OVO-Bench 加权总体准确率 73.6%。
Motivation: 固定上下文预算下，问题到来之前形成的在线状态会丢掉当时看似无关、后续问题却需要的视觉细节，仅靠保留状态无法找回。
Method: WTI 维护带源视频时间范围标签的自然语言记忆条目，足够时直接推理，否则锚定式召回更细的视觉证据；每题在作答、继续观看、召回后重判三动作间循环，不重放全部历史。训练用自建 WTI-82K（82,335 条计时问题、4,812 条因果对齐轨迹）与 Stream-GDPO，以轨迹级反馈优化响应时机、源视频召回与记忆更新。
Result: 在所比较的开源流式基线上取得聚合 SOTA：StreamingBench 83.3%，OVO-Bench 加权总体准确率 73.6%。
Conclusion: 把记忆做成可锚定召回的自然语言条目并显式训练作答/观看/召回的时机决策，能在固定上下文预算下支撑长时程多轮流式视频推理。

papers.title: FedLAFP: Low-Rank Aggregation Meets Full-Rank Personalization in Federated Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables clients to adapt pre-trained models without sharing raw data or communicating the full model, but statistical heterogeneity makes a single global adapter insufficient for personalized prediction. Existing personalized methods typically use the same low-rank structure for both shared and private adaptation, overlooking their distinct requirements for aggregation and personalization. We propose FedLAFP, a role-aware framework that couples a compact, globally aggregated LoRA branch with a client-private, full-rank-capable RandLoRA branch. The shared branch provides an efficient interface for transferring common knowledge, whereas the private branch combines fixed random low-rank bases with learned scaling coefficients to provide expressive client-specific adaptation without additional communication. Client- and layer-specific mixing coefficients jointly fuse the two branches, and only the shared LoRA parameters are exchanged. A controlled linear study supports this role assignment: LoRA yields more aligned client updates and lower aggregation error, while RandLoRA more accurately recovers client-specific residuals. Experiments across four visual recognition benchmarks show that FedLAFP consistently outperforms local-only and federated LoRA baselines, achieving an average personalized accuracy of $86.93\%$ and exceeding the best baseline average by $1.30$ percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedLAFP 把联邦参数高效微调拆成两条角色不同的分支：共享的紧凑 LoRA 只做全局聚合与知识传递，客户端私有的 RandLoRA（固定随机低秩基 + 可学习缩放系数）负责全秩表达的个性化适配，仅交换共享 LoRA 参数。在四个视觉识别基准上平均个性化准确率 86.93%，比最优基线平均高 1.30 个百分点。
Motivation: 统计异质性使单一全局 adapter 无法满足各客户端的个性化预测需求，而现有个性化方法对共享与私有部分一律用同一种低秩结构，忽略了二者对聚合与个性化的要求差异。
Method: 角色感知框架 FedLAFP：共享分支用紧凑 LoRA 做全局聚合接口，私有分支用 RandLoRA 的固定随机低秩基加可学习缩放系数实现免额外通信的表达性适配；客户端级与层级 mixing 系数融合两分支，通信时只交换共享 LoRA 参数。另设受控线性研究检验该角色分工。
Result: 受控线性研究显示 LoRA 的客户端更新更对齐、聚合误差更低，而 RandLoRA 更准确地恢复客户端特有残差。四个视觉识别基准上 FedLAFP 持续优于 local-only 与联邦 LoRA 基线，平均个性化准确率 86.93%，超出最优基线平均 1.30 个百分点。
Conclusion: 共享聚合与私有个性化应使用不同容量结构：低秩 LoRA 适合聚合、RandLoRA 适合吸收客户端残差，且只需通信共享分支即可在视觉识别上取得更高个性化准确率。

papers.title: UniBuild: Unified Building Mapping From Multi-Source Optical Remote Sensing Imagery With Detail Decoding and Geometry Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Building extraction from optical remote sensing (RS) imagery is fundamental to urban mapping, yet existing methods are often dataset-specific and generalize poorly to unseen domains. Their practical use is also limited by insufficient detail recovery and weak geometric regularization, leading to blurred boundaries, irregular shapes, and merged adjacent buildings. To address these issues, we propose UniBuild, a unified building extraction framework for multi-source RGB optical RS imagery. First, a unified multi-dataset training scheme is constructed over heterogeneous RGB optical datasets to learn transferable building representations across sensors and resolutions. Second, a novel detail-preserving HR-DPT decoder is designed to integrate high-level semantic features with high-resolution spatial features, enhancing building detail recovery. Third, geometry-aware regularization is introduced through a structure-tensor-based direction-aware loss for boundary direction consistency and a saddle-aware loss for suppressing false activations in narrow inter-building gaps under low-resolution conditions. We train and evaluate UniBuild on multi-source RGB optical datasets, including 10 public high-resolution datasets and two self-collected low-resolution datasets. Experiments show that UniBuild consistently improves building-region accuracy, boundary sharpness, and adjacent-building separation across diverse datasets. It also generalizes well to unseen domains and supports practical building extraction from RGB optical RS imagery up to 10\,m resolution. The predicted masks can be further converted into GIS-compatible building footprints through simple polygonization. The trained model and inference code are released at https://github.com/zhu-xlab/UniBuild.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniBuild 用统一多数据集训练加细节解码与几何正则，把多源 RGB 光学遥感的建筑提取做到跨传感器泛化：HR-DPT 解码器融合高层语义与高分辨率空间特征恢复边界细节，structure-tensor 方向感知损失与 saddle-aware 损失分别约束边界方向一致性和抑制低分辨率下窄间隙误激活。在 10 个公开高分辨率与 2 个自采低分辨率数据集上一致提升建筑区域精度、边界锐度与相邻建筑分离，并可泛化到未见域、支持最高 10 m 分辨率的提取。
Motivation: 现有建筑提取方法多为数据集专用、跨域泛化差，且细节恢复不足、几何正则弱，导致边界模糊、形状不规则、相邻建筑粘连。
Method: 三部分：在异构 RGB 光学数据集上做统一多数据集训练以学习跨传感器/分辨率的可迁移表征；设计细节保持的 HR-DPT 解码器融合高层语义与高分辨率空间特征；引入几何感知正则，即基于 structure tensor 的方向感知损失（边界方向一致性）与 saddle-aware 损失（抑制低分辨率下窄间隙误激活）。
Result: 在 10 个公开高分辨率数据集与 2 个自采低分辨率数据集上训练与评估，建筑区域精度、边界锐度、相邻建筑分离在各数据集上一致提升；对未见域泛化良好，支持最高 10 m 分辨率 RGB 光学遥感影像的建筑提取，掩膜可经简单 polygonization 转为 GIS 兼容建筑轮廓。
Conclusion: 统一多数据集训练配合细节解码与几何正则，可让单一模型跨多源 RGB 光学数据提取建筑并泛化到未见域，模型与推理代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MotionInsight: Diagnosing Object Motion Deficiencies in Generated Videos
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in video generation models, they still exhibit obvious motion deficiencies, often manifested as incorrect object motion. However, most existing video quality evaluations focus on aesthetic quality or text-video alignment. To address this gap, we study object-centric motion fidelity assessment, evaluating target objects along object consistency, motion continuity, and physical plausibility. To achieve this, we first introduce VidMotion, a diagnostic dataset of 6,879 videos with designated moving objects and fine-grained annotations including dimension-wise scores and failure causes. We further propose MotionInsight, a diagnostic evaluator that shifts assessment from implicit RGB-frame observation to explicit motion-space diagnosis. By constructing motion-aware representations, MotionInsight makes subtle motion deficiencies more observable. We also introduce motion-specific rewards during GRPO to transform observed motion into a diagnostic assessment. Experiments demonstrate that MotionInsight provides an effective basis for diagnosing object motion deficiencies, producing human-aligned scores along three dimensions and grounded explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视频生成模型中物体运动错误而现有评测只看美学或文本对齐，提出以物体为中心的运动保真度诊断：VidMotion 数据集含 6,879 段指定运动物体的视频及分维度分数与失败原因标注，MotionInsight 用运动感知表征把评估从 RGB 帧观察转到显式运动空间诊断，并在 GRPO 训练中加入运动专属 reward。实验显示其给出的三维度分数与人类判断对齐，并附有可归因的解释。
Motivation: 视频生成模型普遍存在物体运动错误，但现有视频质量评测主要关注美学质量或文本-视频对齐，缺少针对物体运动保真度的诊断式评估。
Method: 构建 VidMotion 诊断数据集（6,879 段视频，含分维度分数与失败原因标注）；提出 MotionInsight 评估器，构造运动感知表征使细微运动缺陷更易观察，并在 GRPO 训练中引入运动专属 reward，把观察到的运动转化为诊断评分。
Result: VidMotion 含 6,879 段带指定运动物体的视频与细粒度标注；实验表明 MotionInsight 在物体一致性、运动连续性、物理合理性三个维度上给出与人类对齐的分数及有依据的解释。
Conclusion: 把评估从隐式 RGB 帧观察转到显式运动空间诊断，可有效识别生成视频中的物体运动缺陷，并同时产出对齐人类判断的分数与解释。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LongSpark: Efficient speculative decoding with a fixed-cost parallel drafter
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target forward pass. However, as the context grows, existing state-of-the-art drafters become increasingly expensive, eroding the very efficiency advantage they are designed to provide. We argue that this scaling is unnecessary. A standalone language model must grow with its prefix because it is solely responsible for every token it produces. A drafter, by contrast, only proposes candidates; the target catches and corrects every error before any token is committed. The drafter's decoding cost can therefore be made entirely independent of the prefix length. We introduce LongSpark, a block-diffusion drafter that achieves this by extracting fixed-size, multiscale views from the target's verification pass, thereby eliminating the need for a growing persistent state. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that LongSpark achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end efficiency across multiple model scales and realistic serving conditions. Notably, it delivers the lowest time-per-output-token on long-context tasks while reducing the drafter's context state by several orders of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LongSpark 提出固定成本的 block-diffusion 投机解码草稿器 (drafter)：草稿器只负责提议、错误由目标模型在验证步全部纠正，因此其解码开销可与前缀长度解耦，做法是从目标模型的验证 pass 中抽取固定尺寸的多尺度视图，取代随上下文增长的持久状态。在多模型规模与真实服务条件下达到 SOTA 端到端效率，长上下文任务的 time-per-output-token 最低，草稿器上下文状态缩小数个数量级。
Motivation: 投机解码靠一次目标前向验证多个草稿 token 来加速自回归推理，但上下文变长时现有 SOTA 草稿器自身开销随之增长，抵消了它本该带来的效率收益。
Method: LongSpark 是一个 block-diffusion 草稿器：不维护随前缀增长的持久状态，而是从目标模型的验证 pass 中抽取固定尺寸的多尺度视图作为输入，使草稿器解码成本与前缀长度完全无关；错误仍由目标模型在提交前捕获纠正。
Result: 在多个模型规模与真实服务条件下取得 SOTA 端到端效率；长上下文任务上 time-per-output-token 最低，同时草稿器的上下文状态缩减数个数量级 (several orders of magnitude)。
Conclusion: 草稿器的解码开销不必随前缀增长：只要错误由目标模型兜底，用固定尺寸视图替代增长的持久状态即可在长上下文下同时拿到更低延迟和更小状态。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Low-Rank Parameterization: Narrowing the Gap Between LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning via Gradient Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), yet a performance gap can remain relative to full fine-tuning (FFT). Many LoRA variants improve the initialization or optimization of low-rank factors. At each training step, however, their first-order weight-space directions are constrained by the current parameterization. We characterize the corresponding LoRA-accessible gradient space and show that it coincides with the tangent space induced by the current LoRA parameterization. This characterization yields an orthogonal decomposition of the full weight gradient at the current model parameters. We term the component orthogonal to this space the normal gradient. Based on this decomposition, we propose GDLoRA (Gradient-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation). GDLoRA reconstructs the full weight gradient from forward activations and backward signals, extracts its normal component, and directly updates the base weights with this component, while retaining standard AdamW optimization for the LoRA factors. GDLoRA incorporates complementary normal gradients without increasing standard LoRA's optimizer-state memory budget under matched adapter and optimizer configurations. Experiments on natural language understanding, mathematical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and image classification show that GDLoRA consistently improves over LoRA and narrows the performance gap to FFT. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GDLoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GDLoRA 把 LoRA 可达的一阶梯度空间刻画为当前参数化诱导的切空间，并对全权重梯度做正交分解，用切空间之外的 normal gradient 直接更新基座权重，LoRA 因子仍走 AdamW。在自然语言理解、数学推理、常识推理与图像分类上一致优于 LoRA、缩小与全量微调 (FFT) 的差距，且不增加标准 LoRA 的优化器状态显存。
Motivation: LoRA 与全量微调之间始终存在性能差距，既有变体只改低秩因子的初始化或优化，但每步的一阶权重方向被当前参数化锁死，无法触及切空间之外的梯度分量。
Method: 先刻画 LoRA-accessible 梯度空间并证明其等于当前参数化诱导的切空间，据此对当前模型参数处的全权重梯度做正交分解；GDLoRA 由前向激活与反向信号重建全权重梯度，取出 normal 分量直接更新基座权重，LoRA 因子保留标准 AdamW，在匹配的 adapter 与优化器配置下不增加优化器状态显存。
Result: 在自然语言理解、数学推理、常识推理和图像分类四类任务上，GDLoRA 一致优于 LoRA 并缩小与 FFT 的差距，同时不增加标准 LoRA 的优化器状态内存预算。
Conclusion: 补齐参数化切空间之外的 normal 梯度，是在不增加优化器状态开销的前提下缩小 LoRA 与全量微调差距的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnyAct: Universal Action for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) advance, AI agents are increasingly deployed in open-world environments to tackle complex sequential tasks (e.g., document processing, cross-application collaboration), relying heavily on actions ranging from GUI operations to semantic APIs. However, three core challenges persist: the "scale dilemma" of massive tool ecosystems exceeding LLM context windows, the "non-stationarity" of tool quality due to updates or outages, and the "heterogeneity" of feedback formats (pixels, text, structured data) creating information silos. To address these, we propose AnyAct, a universal action layer that unifies available capabilities into a self-evolving action space, enabling agents to operate efficiently and reliably in large-scale, dynamic tool ecosystems. AnyAct's core design focuses on two objectives: constructing this action space via hierarchical progressive retrieval (filtering task-relevant actions) and test-time reliability evolution (pruning unreliable actions), and enabling reliability-aware action orchestration through a heterogeneous observation grounding module that unifies multi-modal feedback. Additionally, it defines a hybrid action space (primitive + semantic actions) and optimizes for a balance between task success rate and execution cost. Evaluations on LiveMCPBench and OSMCP (a new benchmark we developed for multi-granularity action collaboration) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. AnyAct delivers substantial performance gains over baseline methods across various LLM base models on LiveMCPBench and improvements are particularly notable for models with constrained native capabilities. On OSMCP, it achieves 77.27% overall success with only 50 steps, which is half the steps required by most competitors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnyAct 把大规模工具生态统一成可自演化的动作空间：用层级渐进检索筛出任务相关动作、用 test-time 可靠性演化剪掉不可靠动作，再以异构观测 grounding 融合像素/文本/结构化反馈做可靠性感知编排。在 LiveMCPBench 与自建 OSMCP 上达到 SOTA，OSMCP 整体成功率 77.27% 且只用 50 步，约为多数竞争者所需步数的一半。
Motivation: LLM agent 面对的工具生态规模超出上下文窗口，工具质量因更新或故障而非平稳，反馈格式又异构，导致动作选择不可靠、执行成本高。
Method: AnyAct 作为通用动作层：层级渐进检索 (hierarchical progressive retrieval) 过滤任务相关动作，test-time reliability evolution 剪除不可靠动作，heterogeneous observation grounding 统一多模态反馈以支持可靠性感知动作编排；定义 primitive + semantic 的混合动作空间，并在任务成功率与执行成本之间做联合优化。
Result: 在 LiveMCPBench 与自建 OSMCP（多粒度动作协作基准）上达到 state-of-the-art；LiveMCPBench 上对多种 LLM 基座均相对基线方法有显著增益，对原生能力受限的模型提升尤其明显；OSMCP 上以 50 步取得 77.27% 整体成功率，步数为多数竞争者的一半。
Conclusion: 把动作空间的构建与可靠性治理放进一个统一层，可在大规模动态工具生态中同时提高成功率并压低执行步数，且对弱基座模型收益最大。

papers.title: Language as the Interface: Foundation-Model Contrastive Learning Links Transcriptomes and Electrophysiology
papers.abstract_en: Integrating transcriptomic and electrophysiological data is essential for building multimodal foundation models for neuroscience. Patch-seq provides paired measurements of gene expression and intrinsic electrophysiology from the same neuron, establishing a basis for training cross-modal models. Here we introduce LangPatch, a foundation-model-based contrastive learning framework that uses paired Patch-seq data to align pretrained GenePT representations with electrophysiological phenotypes through a language-based interface. Gene descriptions and verbalized electrophysiological profiles are embedded by the same frozen text encoder. A context adapter and projection modules connect the modalities through paired contrastive learning. Across mouse visual, mouse motor, and human cortical cohorts, LangPatch achieves the highest mean transcriptome-to-electrophysiology prediction correlation among the evaluated foundation-model and representation-learning methods. It also improves held-out cross-modal alignment in the two mouse cohorts (FOSCTTM 0.107/0.135 vs. 0.208/0.222 for JAMIE, an existing cross-modal Patch-seq imputation method). It predicts transcriptomic family, type, cortical layer, and marker-gene expression from electrophysiology, exceeding other baselines on most endpoints. More importantly, the method transfers across brain areas and species: a model trained on mouse visual cortex predicts electrophysiology in motor cortex with approximately 70% correlation retention and in human cortex with 47% (58% on acute-slice recordings). Together, these results demonstrate alignment between molecular and functional representations of neurons, providing a building block for multimodal foundation models in neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LangPatch 用语言作接口做对比学习，把 GenePT 转录组表征与同一神经元的电生理表征对齐：基因描述与口述化的电生理 profile 用同一个冻结文本编码器嵌入，再经 context adapter 与投影模块做配对对比学习。在小鼠视觉、运动与人皮层队列上，其转录组到电生理的预测相关性在所评方法中最高，跨脑区/跨物种迁移保留约 70%（小鼠运动皮层）与 47%（人皮层，急性切片 58%）的相关性。
Motivation: Patch-seq 提供同一神经元的基因表达与内在电生理配对测量，但把转录组与电生理两种模态对齐、并让模型跨脑区与跨物种迁移仍是缺口。
Method: LangPatch 是基于 foundation model 的对比学习框架：基因描述与口述化电生理 profile 由同一冻结文本编码器嵌入，context adapter 与 projection modules 连接两模态，用配对 Patch-seq 数据做对比学习，对齐预训练 GenePT 表示与电生理表型。
Result: 在小鼠视觉、小鼠运动、人皮层三个队列上，转录组到电生理预测相关性在所评 foundation-model 与表征学习方法中最高；两个小鼠队列的 held-out 跨模态对齐 FOSCTTM 为 0.107/0.135，对比 JAMIE 的 0.208/0.222；从电生理预测转录组 family、type、皮层层与 marker-gene 表达，在多数端点上超过其他基线；小鼠视觉皮层训练的模型迁移到运动皮层保留约 70% 相关性，迁移到人皮层 47%（急性切片记录 58%）。
Conclusion: 语言接口加配对对比学习能把神经元的分子表征与功能表征对齐，并跨脑区与物种迁移，可作为神经科学多模态 foundation model 的构建块。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination for Hospital Patient Flow Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Efficient patient flow coordination across autonomous hospital departments is critical for mitigating overcrowding and balancing resource utilization. While classical queueing theory, specifically open Baskett--Chandy--Muntz--Palacios (BCMP) networks, provides an interpretable mathematical topology for healthcare operations, analytical models rely on stationary assumptions and fixed routing matrices that degrade under state-dependent real-world dynamics. Conversely, centralized reinforcement learning approaches struggle to accommodate the decentralized structure of hospital governance, where individual clinical departments function with localized observations, heterogeneous resources, and divergent operational objectives. In this paper, we present a Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) framework titled \emph{Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination}, which embeds empirically calibrated BCMP queueing topologies as physical priors within a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture. Formulated as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) under coupled resource constraints, our method enables autonomous departmental agents to cooperatively negotiate patient routing and dynamic service scaling. To mitigate environmental non-stationarity without inducing excessive communication overhead, agents exchange localized action fingerprints along network edges and optimize a spatially decomposed reward structure. Empirical evaluations driven by real-world MIMIC-IV patient trajectories indicate that this cooperative multi-agent approach substantially reduces cumulative system delay compared to static Markovian approximations, heuristic dispatching, and independent multi-agent baselines, while maintaining clinical safety constraints.
papers.comment: Accepted to PRIMA 2026 (Full paper). 16 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把经验标定的 BCMP 排队网络拓扑作为物理先验嵌入去中心化多智能体强化学习 (Dec-POMDP)，让各科室智能体在耦合资源约束下协商患者路由与动态服务规模，并沿网络边交换局部 action fingerprint 以缓解环境非平稳。基于真实 MIMIC-IV 患者轨迹的评估显示，该协作式多智能体方案相比静态马尔可夫近似、启发式调度和独立多智能体基线显著降低累积系统延迟，同时维持临床安全约束。
Motivation: 医院跨科室患者流协调要同时应对拥挤与资源利用失衡：BCMP 等解析排队模型依赖平稳假设和固定路由矩阵，在状态相关的真实动态下失效，而集中式强化学习又难以匹配医院去中心化治理结构。
Method: 提出 Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination：将经验标定的 BCMP 排队拓扑作为物理先验嵌入去中心化多智能体 RL，建模为耦合资源约束下的 Dec-POMDP；科室智能体协作协商患者路由与动态服务规模，沿网络边交换局部 action fingerprint，并优化空间可分解的奖励结构以抑制非平稳性同时控制通信开销。
Result: 在真实 MIMIC-IV 患者轨迹驱动的实证评估中，该协作多智能体方法相比静态马尔可夫近似、启发式调度 (heuristic dispatching) 与独立多智能体基线显著降低累积系统延迟，并在评估中维持临床安全约束。
Conclusion: 把可解释的排队论拓扑作为物理先验放进去中心化多智能体 RL，可以在不牺牲临床安全约束的前提下改善医院患者流的延迟表现，优于静态近似与独立智能体做法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Back2Struct: Making Structured Images Editable Again
papers.abstract_en: Structured images, such as diagrams, charts, and flowcharts, are inherently symbolic and can be compactly represented in an editable format, yet in practice, they are often rendered as images, and therefore not graphically editable. This mismatch presents a significant challenge for researchers, engineers, and designers who wish to incorporate modified versions of existing graphic content into new materials without manually reconstructing it. In this study, we presentBack2Struct, which "makes structured images editable again" by directly recovering vector graphics code (SVG / XML) from image representations. Given an image of a structured graphic, Back2Struct predicts semantically object-level SVG / XML code that explicitly encodes text, shapes, topology, and layout, rather than performing low-level pixel vectorization. The generated code can be seamlessly imported into tools such as PowerPoint, allowing users to edit, refine, restyle, and reuse graphic content while preserving structural fidelity. Beyond supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth SVG token sequences, we further optimize Back2Struct with reward-based learning to better match deployment-time requirements: the output should be syntactically valid, properly concise, and visually faithful to the input diagram. Specifically, we design a composite reward that jointly encourages SVG / XML compilability, length consistency with the reference code, and structural or semantic similarity between the generated and ground-truth graphics. These complementary signals guide the model to produce SVGs that are not only closer to the training distribution, but also more complete, editable, and renderable in practice. Experiments show that Back2Struct improves accuracy, editability, validity, and user alignment over baselines. Dataset and code are available at: pengyu965.github.io/Back2Struct.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Back2Struct 把图表、流程图等结构化图像直接还原为对象级 SVG/XML 代码，显式编码文本、形状、拓扑与布局，而非低层像素矢量化。在监督微调之外用复合奖励做 reward-based learning，联合约束 SVG 可编译性、与参考代码的长度一致性、以及生成图与真值图的结构/语义相似度。实验显示其在准确性、可编辑性、有效性与用户契合度上相对基线均有提升。
Motivation: 图表、流程图等结构化图像本可用可编辑格式紧凑表示，实践中却常以位图形式存在，导致研究者、工程师和设计师想复用并修改已有图形时只能手工重绘。
Method: 给定结构化图形图像，模型预测对象级 SVG/XML 代码，显式编码 text、shapes、topology、layout；训练分两段：先在真值 SVG token 序列上做监督微调，再用 reward-based learning 优化，复合奖励同时鼓励 SVG/XML 可编译、输出长度与参考代码一致、生成图与真值图结构或语义相似。
Result: 实验显示 Back2Struct 在准确性、可编辑性、有效性 (validity) 与用户契合度 (user alignment) 上相对基线均有提升；数据集与代码发布于 pengyu965.github.io/Back2Struct.github.io。
Conclusion: 把结构化图像恢复当作对象级代码生成并用可编译性、长度、视觉保真三路奖励约束，得到的 SVG 可直接导入 PowerPoint 等工具继续编辑、重样式与复用，同时保持结构保真。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RBF-GNN: Rational Basis Functions for Pseudo-Coordinate based Graph Convolutions
papers.abstract_en: We propose RBF-GNN, a new pseudo-coordinate based graph neural network architecture that takes into account Euclidean, spherical or angular coordinates and uses them to induce a powerful spatial inductive bias. Similar in architecture to SplineCNN, we improve upon the latter by replacing the less efficient sparse-activation based B-splines whose number grows exponentially with dimension by rational Padé basis functions. For effective training we propose a spline-subspace initialization and a variance-preserving weight rescaling. Experimentally, we evaluate on a number of popular neural network architectures that use SplineCNNs. We replace only the SplineCNNs with RBF-GNN. We achieve improved results, including on semantic keypoint matching, shape matching, event based camera computer vision tasks. We will make our implementation publicly available upon acceptance of the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RBF-GNN 用有理 Padé 基函数替换 SplineCNN 中随维度指数增长的稀疏激活 B-spline，在伪坐标 (pseudo-coordinate) 图卷积中引入欧氏、球面或角度坐标的空间归纳偏置，并配以 spline-subspace 初始化与保方差权重重缩放。在仅替换 SplineCNN 的对照实验中，语义关键点匹配、形状匹配与事件相机视觉任务均取得改进结果。
Motivation: SplineCNN 依赖的 B-spline 基函数数量随坐标维度指数增长，稀疏激活效率低，限制了伪坐标图卷积在高维坐标下的可用性。
Method: 以有理 Padé 基函数替代 B-spline 构建图卷积核，支持欧氏、球面、角度伪坐标；训练上采用 spline-subspace 初始化与 variance-preserving weight rescaling。评测时在若干使用 SplineCNN 的流行架构中只替换 SplineCNN 部分，其余保持不变。
Result: 在语义关键点匹配 (semantic keypoint matching)、形状匹配 (shape matching) 与事件相机 (event based camera) 计算机视觉任务上均取得改进结果；摘要未给出具体数值。

papers.title: Embedded Bi-Temporal Building Damage Assessment for On-Board Data Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Rapid assessment of building damage after natural disasters is essential to support emergency response. Earth Observation satellites can acquire relevant imagery shortly after an event, but exploitation is limited by uplink and downlink capacity and by ground-processing latency. We address this with a bi-temporal building damage assessment pipeline built on a siamese detector derived from YOLOX, designed to compress information at both ends of the ground/space link. On the ground, pre-disaster reference images are encoded into a compact latent space -- compressed by up to a factor of 64 -- and uplinked to the satellite. On board, this reference is compared with a fresh post-disaster acquisition so that the downlink carries only actionable object-level products, bounding boxes and damage classes, instead of full scenes. This cuts the data exchanged in both directions, while on xBD the strongly compressed reference still preserves most of the detection performance. Because on-board acquisitions suffer from residual pre/post co-registration errors, we introduce a latent-space shift estimation and correction module that regresses the global offset from the coarse feature level and realigns the post-disaster features before fusion. It substantially improves robustness to de-registration -- especially under large shifts, where fusion-only variants collapse -- while also raising nominal accuracy and remaining compatible with the strongest compression. We finally port the pipeline to two embedded targets, a Xilinx Versal VCK190 and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, and report hardware performance (latency, throughput, power efficiency). The core detector and its compression port cleanly to both, but the operators needed for long-range robustness survive only on the Jetson GPU, whereas the Versal DPU does not.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向星地链路的双时相建筑损毁评估管线：地面把灾前参考图压进潜空间（最高 64 倍压缩）上行，星上用 siamese 检测器（源自 YOLOX）与灾后影像比对，只下传目标框与损毁类别。潜空间位移估计与校正模块从粗特征层回归全局偏移并在融合前重对齐，在大配准偏差下避免仅融合方案崩溃，同时提升标称精度并兼容最强压缩；移植到 Xilinx Versal VCK190 与 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 后，长程鲁棒算子仅在 Jetson GPU 上存活，Versal DPU 不支持。
Motivation: 灾害后 Earth Observation 卫星能快速拍到影像，但上下行带宽与地面处理时延限制了可用性：整景下传与地面端灾前参考比对都来不及支撑应急响应。
Method: 基于 YOLOX 的 siamese 检测器，两端压缩：地面把灾前参考图编码进紧凑潜空间（最高 64 倍压缩）上行；星上将该参考与新灾后影像比对，只输出目标级产品（bounding boxes + damage classes）。针对残余前后配准误差引入潜空间位移估计与校正模块，从粗特征层回归全局偏移并在融合前重对齐灾后特征。管线移植到 Xilinx Versal VCK190 与 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 两个嵌入式目标并报告时延、吞吐与能效。
Result: 在 xBD 上，强压缩后的参考图仍保留大部分检测性能；位移校正模块显著提升对去配准的鲁棒性，大偏移下仅融合的变体崩溃，同时标称精度也上升且与最强压缩兼容。硬件侧：核心检测器与压缩可干净移植到 VCK190 与 Jetson AGX Orin，长程鲁棒所需算子仅在 Jetson GPU 上可用，Versal DPU 不支持。
Conclusion: 把压缩同时做到星地链路两端并把配准校正放进潜空间，可在大幅削减上下行数据的同时保住 xBD 检测性能；但长程鲁棒算子的部署受 DPU 算子支持限制，选嵌入式平台时需先核对算子可用性。
