papers.title: CADOC: Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: For a long-horizon agent, context is the bottleneck: the history is resent with every request, the window caps task length, and reasoning degrades as the history grows. Replacing structured objects with compact retrieval Cards shortens the prompt and keeps the exact originals retrievable, but editing the history can break prefix-cache reuse, and prior recoverable methods time their edits by forecasts of future reuse or by preset intervals. We propose CADOC (Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context), an online algorithm that replaces structured objects with compact Cards while preserving exact, on-demand retrieval of their original contents. CADOC schedules replacements in batches by balancing accumulated waiting cost against shared cache-reconstruction cost. Its scheduling rule follows from an economic order quantity trade-off, recovers the optimal integer batch under stationary assumptions. Across evaluation, CADOC consistently achieves the lowest aggregate input cost among the compared configurations, which reduces input cost by approximately 40\% on average while maintaining task performance close to full context. CADOC thus provides a cost-derived approach to compressible context management, demonstrating that efficient compression depends not only on shortening prompts but also on scheduling edits to preserve cache reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADOC 用紧凑 Card 替换长程 agent 的结构化历史对象，同时保留对原文的按需精确检索，并按经济订货量 (EOQ) 权衡累积等待成本与共享缓存重建成本，分批调度替换以保住前缀缓存复用。在对比配置中它取得最低的聚合输入成本，平均降低约 40% 输入成本，同时任务性能接近全上下文。
Motivation: 长程 agent 每次请求都重发历史，上下文窗口限制任务长度且推理随历史增长而退化；可恢复压缩虽能缩短 prompt，但编辑历史会破坏前缀缓存复用，已有方法靠未来复用预测或固定间隔定时，缺乏成本推导的调度依据。
Method: CADOC 是在线算法：把结构化对象换成紧凑 Card 并保留原文的按需精确检索；调度规则由经济订货量 (EOQ) 的权衡推出，在平稳假设下恢复最优整数批量，按累积等待成本与共享缓存重建成本的平衡分批执行替换。
Result: 在所比较的配置中 CADOC 始终取得最低的聚合输入成本，平均降低约 40% 输入成本，同时任务性能保持在接近全上下文 (full context) 的水平。
Conclusion: 上下文压缩的效率不只取决于把 prompt 变短，还取决于如何调度编辑以保留缓存复用；成本推导出的分批调度能在维持任务性能的同时显著压低输入成本。

papers.title: OPFL: Optimistic Verification of Federated Learning via Empirical Boundary
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables multiple clients to collaboratively train models without sharing their private data. However, the lack of visibility into local training makes it difficult to verify whether clients follow the prescribed training procedure or submit malicious updates, such as model poisoning. A natural approach is to replay client training for verification. However, privacy-preserving replay produces numerical results that cannot be directly matched with local client execution because the two run in different environments. We present OPFL, an optimistic verification framework for privacy-preserving federated learning. To protect data privacy, OPFL performs replay inside secure multi-party computation (MPC). Although gradients computed on MPC and local GPUs are not bitwise identical, we observe that their absolute differences are stable and bounded. OPFL therefore calibrates an empirical boundary offline and uses it to distinguish benign numerical deviations from malicious manipulation. To reduce the cost of expensive MPC replay, OPFL adopts optimistic verification by post auditing only sampled training steps. Experiments on LeNet, BERT, and Qwen show that the boundary generalizes across datasets, input lengths, and GPUs, while achieving $0$\% ASR against model poisoning and PGD-based attacks. On a LeNet workload, at $p=0.01$, OPFL is approximately $98.6\times$ faster than full MPC-based FL and $625.5\times$ faster than ZK-based approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPFL 在安全多方计算 (MPC) 内重放客户端训练来验证联邦学习，发现 MPC 与本地 GPU 的梯度虽非逐位一致但绝对差稳定有界，据此离线标定经验边界 (empirical boundary) 区分数值偏差与恶意篡改，并只对抽样训练步做乐观事后审计。在 LeNet、BERT、Qwen 上该边界跨数据集、输入长度和 GPU 泛化，对模型投毒与 PGD 攻击达到 0% ASR；LeNet 负载在 p=0.01 时比完整 MPC 联邦学习快约 98.6 倍、比 ZK 方案快 625.5 倍。
Motivation: 联邦学习缺乏对本地训练的可见性，难以验证客户端是否按规程训练或提交恶意更新（如模型投毒）；而隐私保护重放产生的数值结果与本地执行环境不同，无法直接比对。
Method: OPFL 在 MPC 内执行隐私保护重放，离线标定 MPC 与本地 GPU 梯度绝对差的经验边界以区分良性数值偏差与恶意操纵；采用乐观验证 (optimistic verification)，只对抽样训练步做事后审计以降低昂贵的 MPC 重放成本。
Result: 在 LeNet、BERT、Qwen 上，经验边界跨数据集、输入长度和 GPU 泛化，对模型投毒与基于 PGD 的攻击达到 0% ASR；LeNet 负载在 p=0.01 时约为完整 MPC 联邦学习的 98.6 倍快、约为基于 ZK 方案的 625.5 倍快。
Conclusion: MPC 与本地执行的梯度差异稳定有界，因此可用离线标定的经验边界加抽样审计，在保住隐私的前提下以远低于全量 MPC 或 ZK 重放的代价检出投毒。

papers.title: World2Motion: Turning Video World Models into 3D Human Motion Generators
papers.abstract_en: We present World2Motion, a framework that generates scene-aware 3D human motion and corresponding video from a single image and a text prompt. While existing 3D motion generators learn from motion datasets, their generalization is constrained by limited coverage of environments. In contrast, video world models such as Cosmos 3 offer broader environmental priors but are not designed for full-body motion generation; recovering motion from their generated videos requires costly two-stage inference. To address these, we turn Cosmos 3 into a single-stage 3D motion generator. This adaptation has two challenges: the scarcity of paired video--motion data and temporal instability in the generated motion. First, we construct a training dataset combining synthetic video--motion pairs with real videos paired with estimated 3D motion. Second, we propose a shift-decoupled noise schedule that assigns different noise levels to video and motion through shared denoising progress. This design accommodates the different denoising requirements of the two modalities, reducing motion jitter. Experiments on a multi-source interaction benchmark show that World2Motion has better motion--text alignment and scene interaction compared with the evaluated 3D motion generators. It also matches the interaction success rate of the two-stage baseline while achieving approximately 3.3$\times$ faster inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: World2Motion 把视频世界模型 Cosmos 3 直接改造成单阶段的场景感知 3D 人体动作生成器，从单张图像加文本提示同时生成动作与视频。其 shift-decoupled noise schedule 通过共享去噪进度给视频和动作分配不同噪声水平，缓解动作抖动；在多源交互基准上动作-文本对齐与场景交互优于被评估的 3D 动作生成器，交互成功率追平两阶段基线且推理快约 3.3 倍。
Motivation: 现有 3D 动作生成器只从动作数据集学习，环境覆盖有限导致泛化受限；而 Cosmos 3 等视频世界模型环境先验更广却不面向全身动作生成，从其生成视频反推动作需要代价高昂的两阶段推理。
Method: 将 Cosmos 3 适配为单阶段 3D 动作生成器：先构建训练数据集，把合成视频-动作对与真实视频及其估计的 3D 动作配对；再提出 shift-decoupled noise schedule，在共享去噪进度下为视频与动作两个模态分配不同噪声水平，以匹配二者不同的去噪需求并降低动作抖动。
Result: 在多源交互基准 (multi-source interaction benchmark) 上，World2Motion 的动作-文本对齐与场景交互优于被评估的 3D 动作生成器；交互成功率与两阶段基线相当，推理速度约快 3.3 倍。
Conclusion: 视频世界模型可以直接被改造成单阶段动作生成器，在保住交互成功率的同时省掉两阶段推理的开销，配对数据稀缺与时间不稳可通过数据构造和解耦噪声调度缓解。

summary_sections.result: 在多源交互基准 (multi-source interaction benchmark) 上，World2Motion 的动作-文本对齐与场景交互优于被评估的 3D 动作生成器；交互成功率与两阶段基线相当，推理速度约快 3.3 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 视频世界模型可以直接被改造成单阶段动作生成器，在保住交互成功率的同时省掉两阶段推理的开销，配对数据稀缺与时间不稳可通过数据构造和解耦噪声调度缓解。

papers.title: VesselBench-800K: A Large-scale Perception Benchmark for Multimodal Vessel Detection, Counting, and Density Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Vessel perception from space is crucial for a wide range of maritime applications, from traffic monitoring to environmental protection. However, most existing datasets predominantly focus on general object detection tasks in optical remote sensing (RS) images. Relying solely on single-modality optical RS images proves inadequate for effectively perceiving vessel objects in complex maritime scenarios, where ever-changing weather conditions (e.g., clouds and rain), the need for day-and-night coverage, and the inherent limitations of a single imaging modality pose significant challenges. To fill this gap, we introduce VesselBench-800K, the largest-to-date benchmark dataset on a global scale for vessel perception in multimodal RS images. As its name suggests, VesselBench-800K comprises 800,000 images, each at a resolution of 512x512 pixels, specifically curated for vessel perception tasks such as detection, counting, and density estimation. These multimodal image pairs (i.e., optical, SAR) are collected from diverse platforms, sensors, scenes, shooting heights, and synthetic sources, spanning spatial resolutions from 4.5m to 0.1m. Furthermore, we evaluate numerous state-of-the-art detection, counting, and density estimation models on VesselBench-800K through both qualitative and quantitative comparisons. By revealing previously unrecognized cues, this dataset holds immense potential to significantly advance our understanding of marine traffic. Our VesselBench dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/danfenghong/IEEE_TGRS_VesselBench to support and contribute to community development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VesselBench-800K 是面向多模态遥感船舶感知的大规模基准：80 万张 512×512 图像，光学与 SAR 成对，覆盖 4.5m 到 0.1m 空间分辨率，用于检测、计数与密度估计。作者用定性与定量对比评测了多个 SOTA 模型，并公开数据集以支撑社区。
Motivation: 现有遥感船舶数据集多局限于光学单模态的一般目标检测，难以应对云雨等多变天气、昼夜覆盖需求与单一成像模态的固有局限。
Method: 构建全球尺度多模态（光学、SAR）图像对基准，从多平台、传感器、场景、拍摄高度与合成来源收集，空间分辨率 4.5m–0.1m；在检测、计数、密度估计三类任务上对众多 SOTA 模型做定性与定量对比评测。
Result: 数据集含 800,000 张图像，每张 512×512 像素，空间分辨率跨度 4.5m 至 0.1m；在 VesselBench-800K 上对多个 SOTA 检测、计数与密度估计模型进行了定性和定量比较。
Conclusion: 多模态光学+SAR 配对数据可揭示此前未被识别的线索，作者认为该数据集有潜力推进对海上交通的理解，并将公开于 GitHub 供社区使用。

papers.title: Visual Parallel Search: Learning to Search High-Resolution Images with Parallel Tile Inspection and Adaptive Zoom
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution visual question answering often fails because a multimodal model does not acquire the small, spatially localized evidence needed to answer a question. Sequential zooming can recover detail, but it asks the main model to choose a region before obtaining a reliable overview. We introduce VPS, a visual parallel-search framework in which a main agent first invokes grid_search to inspect image tiles in parallel with question-conditioned sub-agents, and then adaptively invokes zoom_in PSisual Parallel Search improves mean accuracy over dedicated zoom-only search in 14 of 15 same-model comparisons, with gains up to 8.0 points and especially strong improvements for smaller main models. ZoomBench retains an approximately 3.2-point gain at every tested size. We further develop a supervision pipeline with hint-free verification and a paired role-specific GRPO surrogate for learning the controller and tile-reader roles. SFT improves observed accuracy on all five benchmark splits, including a 4.17-point gain on HR-Bench 4K. Role-specific RL further reshapes search behavior: main-only RL reduces mean tool use from 2.65 to 2.11 with similar pass@1 in an internal four-response evaluation, while external accuracy changes are mixed. Joint training reveals an asymmetry between local evidence reading and global search control. Together, these results support VPS as an effective inference-time scaffold and a trainable decomposition for visual evidence acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VPS 让主 agent 先用 grid_search 并行检查图像分块、再自适应 zoom_in，取代必须先选区域的顺序式缩放。在 15 组同模型对比中 14 组平均准确率高于纯 zoom 搜索，最高提升 8.0 点，小模型收益更大；SFT 在五个 benchmark split 上全部提升，HR-Bench 4K 提升 4.17 点。
Motivation: 高分辨率 VQA 常因模型拿不到小而局部的证据而失败；顺序式缩放要求主模型在没有可靠全局视图前就选定区域，容易选错。
Method: VPS 框架：主 agent 先调用 grid_search，由 question-conditioned sub-agents 并行检查分块，再自适应调用 zoom_in；配套监督管线含 hint-free verification 与针对 controller 和 tile-reader 两种角色的 paired role-specific GRPO surrogate，先 SFT 再做角色特定 RL。
Result: 15 组同模型对比中 14 组 VPS 平均准确率高于专用 zoom-only 搜索，最高提升 8.0 点，小模型提升尤其明显；ZoomBench 上各测试规模保持约 3.2 点增益；SFT 在全部五个 benchmark split 提升，HR-Bench 4K 提升 4.17 点；main-only RL 在内部四回答评测中把平均工具调用从 2.65 降到 2.11 而 pass@1 相近，外部准确率变化不一。
Conclusion: VPS 既是有效的推理时脚手架，也是可训练的视觉证据获取分解；联合训练显示局部证据读取与全局搜索控制存在不对称。

papers.title: Parameterized Stripe Attention for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable high-quality video generation but suffer from substantial inference latency, primarily attributable to the computationally expensive full spatio-temporal attention. While sparse attention methods offer potential solutions, existing approaches face an inherent flexibility--efficiency dilemma: predefined masks lack the flexibility to capture diverse attention patterns, while runtime-determined masks introduce overheads and sacrifice hardware efficiency. We identify the lack of a unified structural characterization of DiT attention as a key limitation of existing methods, and establish that video DiT attention exhibits \textbf{periodic diagonal stripe structures} along both temporal and spatial dimensions. To formally encode these structured patterns within a single efficient kernel, we present {\bf PSA}, a parameterized stripe attention that formalizes the observed stripe regularity, unifying diverse attention patterns for efficient mask generation. This unified representation enables a single hardware-efficient CUDA kernel to process all sparse patterns, achieving FlashAttention-3-level Model FLOPs Utilization. To determine optimal sparsity configurations, we propose a training-free offline search algorithm that automatically maximizes sparsity under a specified error tolerance for each attention head. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan~2.1 demonstrate that PSA achieves 1.57$\times$ and 1.37$\times$ end-to-end speedups over FlashAttention-3 baselines, with acceptable visual quality degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSA 把视频 DiT 注意力统一刻画为时间与空间两个方向上的周期性对角条纹结构，用一个参数化条纹掩码和单个硬件高效 CUDA kernel 覆盖多种稀疏模式，并用免训练的离线搜索为每个注意力头在给定误差容限下最大化稀疏度。在 HunyuanVideo 与 Wan 2.1 上相对 FlashAttention-3 取得 1.57× 与 1.37× 端到端加速，视觉质量退化可接受。
Motivation: 视频 DiT 的全时空注意力推理延迟高；预定义稀疏掩码不够灵活，运行时确定掩码又带来额外开销并牺牲硬件效率，根源是缺少对 DiT 注意力的统一结构刻画。
Method: 先确立视频 DiT 注意力沿时间与空间维度的周期性对角条纹结构，提出参数化条纹注意力 (PSA) 把该规律形式化为统一表示，使单个高效 CUDA kernel 处理全部稀疏模式并达到 FlashAttention-3 级别的 Model FLOPs Utilization；再用免训练的离线搜索算法在指定误差容限下为每个注意力头自动最大化稀疏度。
Result: 在 HunyuanVideo 与 Wan 2.1 上，PSA 相对 FlashAttention-3 基线取得 1.57× 与 1.37× 端到端加速，视觉质量退化可接受；单 kernel 达到 FlashAttention-3 级别的 Model FLOPs Utilization。
Conclusion: 视频 DiT 注意力的条纹规律可以被统一参数化，从而同时拿到灵活性与硬件效率，稀疏配置可按头离线搜索而非运行时决定。

papers.title: Cross-Organizational SysML Model Integration: A Survey of Challenges and AI-Supported Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Cross-organizational collaboration is widely regarded as a key promise of SysML-based Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), yet practitioners still face persistent challenges when exchanging and integrating system models. In parallel, Large Language Models (LLMs) raise expectations for AI-assisted model understanding and integration, while reliability and required human oversight continue to pose challenges. This paper reports the results of an online questionnaire survey with 29 MBSE stakeholders involved in cross-organizational collaboration. Respondents rated eight predefined integration challenge categories and six AI-supported task types on five-point Likert scales. The results indicate that stakeholders perceive model integration as a multi-dimensional alignment problem across semantics, behavior, traceability, and exchange interoperability. These perceptions vary by organizational role and frequency of integration involvement. AI is rated highly useful for analysis tasks such as semantic structure analysis and inconsistency detection, and respondents predominantly prefer human-in-the-loop use with mandatory verification. These findings motivate AI support that enhances, rather than replaces, engineering responsibility in SysML-based integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 29 名参与跨组织协作的 MBSE 干系人做在线问卷，用五点 Likert 量表评 8 类集成挑战与 6 类 AI 支持任务。干系人把模型集成视为语义、行为、可追溯性与交换互操作性四个维度的对齐问题，且看法随组织角色与参与集成频率变化；AI 在语义结构分析、不一致性检测等分析类任务上被评为高度有用，但受访者压倒性偏好 human-in-the-loop 并要求强制校验。
Motivation: 跨组织 SysML 模型交换与集成仍是 MBSE 落地的持续障碍，而 LLM 带来的 AI 辅助预期与其可靠性、人工监督要求之间存在张力，缺少干系人视角的实证依据。
Method: 在线问卷调查，29 名跨组织协作 MBSE 干系人参与；受访者在五点 Likert 量表上对 8 个预定义集成挑战类别和 6 类 AI 支持任务打分，并按组织角色与参与集成的频率分组比较看法。
Result: 29 名 MBSE 干系人评分显示：模型集成被感知为跨语义、行为、可追溯性与交换互操作性的多维对齐问题，感知随组织角色与集成参与频率而异；AI 在语义结构分析、不一致性检测等分析任务上被评为高度有用，受访者以 human-in-the-loop 加强制校验为首选。
Conclusion: AI 在 SysML 跨组织集成中应定位为增强而非替代工程责任，且支持形式需按角色与任务类型定制，强制人工校验是受访者认可的前提。

papers.title: ImbalancE: Inference-Time Latent Search Against Degree Imbalance in Link Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Graph Embedding models have been extensively used to learn representations of entities and relations in Knowledge Graphs for predicting missing links. However, the quality of the learned representations varies a lot across different areas of the graph. If previous research has loosely linked the problem to relation types or degree bias, we show that it is more widespread and it correlates with the degree imbalance of the entities in test triples. In particular, the prediction of a target entity that has a degree much smaller than the degree of the anchor entity is extremely problematic. This is critical in recommender systems and other use cases, where these triples represent important corner cases. To address this issue, we propose an inference-time latent search optimization method capable of significantly improving model predictions on the most imbalanced triples. Built on top of a pre-trained model, it explores the embedding space at evaluation time, blending known and out-of-band information to mitigate the degree imbalance bias. We show the value of our approach on imbalanced triples from common benchmark datasets, where we outperform conventional methods, opening the door to the successful adoption of Knowledge Graph Embedding models on these critical corner cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 知识图谱嵌入 (KGE) 链接预测中，测试三元组的实体度数不平衡会让低度目标实体的预测严重失准。ImbalancE 在预训练模型之上做推理时隐空间搜索，评估阶段在嵌入空间中混合已知与带外信息，显著改善最不平衡三元组上的预测并超过常规方法。
Motivation: KGE 表示质量在图的不同区域差异很大，此前研究只把问题松散归因于关系类型或度偏差；当目标实体度数远小于锚实体时预测极难，而这正是推荐系统等场景的关键 corner case。
Method: 提出 ImbalancE：一种推理时 (inference-time) 隐空间搜索优化方法，构建在预训练 KGE 模型之上，在评估阶段探索嵌入空间，混合已知信息与带外 (out-of-band) 信息以缓解度不平衡偏差。
Result: 在常见 benchmark 数据集的不平衡三元组上，该方法在最不平衡三元组的预测上超过常规方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 推理时隐空间搜索能让 KGE 模型在度数不平衡这一关键 corner case 上可用，从而支持其在推荐系统等场景的落地。

papers.title: Salt++: Context-Aligned Post-Training for Few-Step Streaming Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Few-step streaming audio--video generation requires both causal modeling and step distillation, yet standard training recipes face two context-related challenges. Teacher forcing pairs clean history with a noisy target, but supervises predictive contextual representations only indirectly through velocity prediction. Meanwhile, directly reusing bidirectional score models in causal Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) creates a mismatch between generation and scoring contexts. We address these challenges with Salt++, a two-stage post-training framework comprising Causal Self-Flow (CSF) and context-aligned autoregressive DMD. CSF exploits contextual information asymmetry by varying the history while keeping the noisy target fixed: a noise-mixed-history student aligns its intermediate representations with those of a clean-history exponential-moving-average teacher. This self-supervised signal encourages the student to extract semantic information and improves cross-modal alignment. Context-aligned AR DMD shares the causal mask and prefix across generator sampling, fake-score training, and real-score evaluation to match generated and reference distributions under a block-conditional KL objective. With calibrated teacher guidance, it performs clean-prefix few-step distillation and then adapts to generated histories without switching objectives or requiring separate consistency distillation. At 480p, Salt++ improves visual and motion quality by 57% and 45% over OmniForcing on JavisBench under the same 4-step causal setting. A separate scale-wise post-training stage extends Salt++ to 4-step $1664\times960$ generation, outperforming bidirectional LTX-2 on six of seven reported metrics. Project page: https://xingtongge.github.io/Saltpp

TL;DR: Salt++ 是面向少步流式多模态音视频生成的两阶段后训练框架：Causal Self-Flow 用「固定噪声目标、变换历史」的自监督让噪声历史学生对齐干净历史 EMA 教师的中间表征，context-aligned AR DMD 则在生成采样、fake-score 训练与 real-score 评估间共享 causal mask 和 prefix，按 block-conditional KL 做分布匹配。在 480p、同为 4 步 causal 的设定下，JavisBench 上视觉质量与运动质量较 OmniForcing 分别提升 57% 与 45%。
Motivation: 少步流式音视频生成同时受制于因果建模与步数蒸馏：teacher forcing 让干净历史配噪声目标、只能通过 velocity prediction 间接监督上下文表征；把双向 score 模型直接复用到因果 DMD 又造成生成与打分上下文不匹配。

papers.title: CF-LoRA: Decoupled Factor Aggregation and Adaptation-Aware Client Clustering for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Federated LoRA fine-tuning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained models without sharing private data, but suffers from two fundamental mismatches under heterogeneous client data: a structural aggregation mismatch caused by independently averaging LoRA factors, and a statistical collaboration mismatch caused by enforcing a single global adapter across divergent clients. To address these issues, we propose CF-LoRA, a clustered federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that combines decoupled factor aggregation with adaptation-aware client clustering. CF-LoRA first learns a globally shared $A$ factor while retaining personalized $B_i$ factors, then identifies clients with similar adaptation patterns based on the cosine similarity of their learned $B_i$ factors, and finally performs intra-cluster $B$-factor aggregation with a frozen $A$ factor. By decoupling LoRA factor aggregation, CF-LoRA preserves the low-rank structure and mitigates the structural aggregation mismatch, while adaptation-aware clustering promotes collaboration among clients with similar adaptation patterns and reduces negative transfer caused by statistical heterogeneity. Experiments on four language tasks and four vision datasets with RoBERTa and ViT show that CF-LoRA achieves the highest average accuracy in both modalities while communicating only one LoRA factor per optimization round.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CF-LoRA 把联邦 LoRA 微调中的两个失配拆开处理：先全局共享 A 因子、保留个性化 B_i，再按 B_i 余弦相似度做 adaptation-aware 客户端聚类，簇内冻结 A 只聚合 B。在 RoBERTa 的四项语言任务与 ViT 的四个视觉数据集上，两种模态的平均准确率均最高，且每轮通信只传一个 LoRA 因子。
Motivation: 异构客户端数据下，独立平均 LoRA 因子破坏低秩结构（结构性聚合失配），强制单一全局 adapter 又让发散客户端互相拖累（统计协作失配）。
Method: CF-LoRA 分三步：学习全局共享 A 因子并保留个性化 B_i；用 B_i 之间的余弦相似度识别 adaptation pattern 相近的客户端聚类；簇内冻结 A、只做 B 因子聚合。
Result: 在 RoBERTa 上的四项语言任务与 ViT 上的四个视觉数据集实验中，CF-LoRA 在两种模态的平均准确率均为最高，且每个优化轮次只通信一个 LoRA 因子。
Conclusion: 解耦 A/B 聚合加按 adaptation pattern 聚类，可以在保住低秩结构、减少统计异构负迁移的同时把通信量压到每轮一个因子。

papers.title: Abductive World Modeling via Causal Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: The central challenge of world modeling is to learn representations that capture how the world evolves. However, existing world models predominantly represent future states without explicitly capturing the latent causes underlying their evolution, limiting their ability to reason about why and how the world changes. To address this limitation, we propose Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures. Specifically, we realize AWM through the Hierarchical Abductive State Pyramid (HASP), which organizes the inferred world state into three complementary components - Entity, Dynamic, and Relation - capturing what exists, how it changes, and how entities interact, respectively. By jointly reasoning over the current observation and its predicted future, HASP abductively infers these latent factors and integrates them into a structured state representation for downstream reasoning. To the best of our knowledge, AWM is the first framework to introduce abductive state inference into latent-space world modeling for learning structured representations of world dynamics. Experiments across physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with V-JEPA, a state-of-the-art latent-space world model, AWM improves physical prediction AUROC by 10.7%, causal reasoning accuracy by 16.8%, and action Top-1 accuracy by 68.0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Abductive World Modeling (AWM)，用 Hierarchical Abductive State Pyramid (HASP) 从当前观测与预测未来中溯因推断 Entity、Dynamic、Relation 三类潜因子，组成结构化状态供下游推理。相比 V-JEPA，物理预测 AUROC 提升 10.7%、因果推理准确率提升 16.8%、动作 Top-1 准确率提升 68.0%。
Motivation: 现有潜空间世界模型只表示未来状态，不显式刻画驱动演化的潜在原因，因而难以回答世界为何以及如何变化。
Method: AWM 通过 HASP 把推断的世界状态组织为 Entity（存在什么）、Dynamic（如何变化）、Relation（实体如何交互）三个互补部分，联合当前观测与预测未来做溯因推断并整合为结构化状态表示，用于物理预测、因果推理与动作理解三类下游任务。
Result: 在物理预测、因果推理、动作理解实验中，AWM 相比 SOTA 潜空间世界模型 V-JEPA：物理预测 AUROC 提升 10.7%，因果推理准确率提升 16.8%，动作 Top-1 准确率提升 68.0%。
Conclusion: 把溯因状态推理引入潜空间世界模型，可以学到同时支撑物理预测、因果推理与动作理解的结构化世界动态表示。

papers.title: REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Complex questions often require multi-hop reasoning that connects facts distributed across sources or distant regions of a long context through intermediate steps. Benchmarks commonly evaluate this ability with questions built around predefined reasoning chains, treating a correct answer as evidence that the intended composition was used. Yet answer correctness alone leaves open whether success depends on the evidence associated with each intended step: models may instead rely on memorized associations, shorter paths, or partial evidence. We examine this dependence using the Behavioral Necessity Rate (BNR), which measures how often targeted evidence removal prevents answer recovery on initially correct instances. Across five existing benchmarks, panel-mean BNR ranges from 16.6% to 48.9%, exposing a substantial gap between annotated structure and observed dependence. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce REALHOP, a diagnose-construct-verify framework that rebinds entities, factorizes selected relations, adds complete competing paths, and places evidence at traceable locations. Structural and semantic checks precede freezing; behavioral interventions follow. On 790 paired MuSiQue questions, REALHOP raises panel-mean BNR from 27.4% to 94.4% while retaining high Full accuracy. It also yields high BNR on REALHOP-FRAMES and REALHOP-LONGBENCH. On 216 long-context questions, the matched multiple-choice spread across 16 models grows from 13.9 to 59.2 points and persists under repeated open-ended evaluation. Together, these results show that a conceptually coherent chain and a correct final answer do not by themselves establish multi-hop reasoning. Verifying that success depends on every intended hop is therefore as fundamental to multi-hop evaluation as measuring answer accuracy itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REALHOP 用行为必要性率 (BNR) 审计多跳问答基准：在五个现有基准上 panel-mean BNR 仅 16.6%–48.9%，说明答对并不等于走了标注的推理链。其 diagnose-construct-verify 框架在 790 对 MuSiQue 问题上把 BNR 从 27.4% 提到 94.4% 且保持高 Full accuracy，并在 216 道长上下文题上把 16 个模型的多选分差从 13.9 点拉到 59.2 点。
Motivation: 多跳基准默认答对即证明模型用了预定义推理链，但模型可能靠记忆关联、更短路径或部分证据作答，标注结构与真实依赖之间存在系统性缺口。
Method: 先用 BNR 度量删除目标证据后原本答对的题能否被恢复；再按 diagnose-construct-verify 流程重建题目：重绑实体、分解选定关系、补入完整竞争路径、把证据放在可追溯位置，冻结前做结构与语义检查，之后施加行为干预。
Result: 五个现有基准 panel-mean BNR 介于 16.6% 与 48.9%；790 对 MuSiQue 问题上 REALHOP 将 panel-mean BNR 从 27.4% 提至 94.4% 并保持高 Full accuracy；REALHOP-FRAMES 与 REALHOP-LONGBENCH 也得到高 BNR；216 道长上下文题上，16 个模型的匹配多选分差从 13.9 点扩大到 59.2 点，且在重复开放式评测下持续存在。
Conclusion: 概念上连贯的链加正确答案本身不能确立多跳推理，验证成功是否依赖每一个预期跳与测量答案准确率同等基础。

papers.title: SRJudge: Empowering Large Language Models with Selective Reasoning for Fine-Grained Knowledge Concept Tagging
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge concept tagging aims to assign specific concept or topic labels to educational content, which is essential for both educators and learners in traditional and online teaching practices. Recent work has explored large language models (LLMs) for this task, achieving promising performance. However, LLMs still struggle to select the correct concept from a large-scale candidate set due to the high dimensionality of the decision space. In this paper, we propose a novel three-stage Select-Reason-Judge (SRJudge) framework, which empowers LLMs with selective reasoning capability for fine-grained knowledge concept tagging. Specifically, the Selector in Stage 1 first narrows the candidate concepts to a top-K shortlist by fine-tuning a small language model (SLM), e.g., BERT, since the top-$K$ predictions hit the correct concept in most cases, thereby reducing the decision space of correct candidates. Next, the Stage 2 Reasoner employs a lightweight LLM for refined reasoning over the shortlisted candidates. It further integrates an improved reinforcement learning strategy with a dynamic task-specific reward function and a pruning mechanism to better align with human reasoning preferences. Finally, a larger LLM acts as a judger that evaluates the overall rationality of the reasoning process and its explanations to determine the final output. In addition, we construct two high-quality datasets for further validation, i.e., the biology dataset S_Bio and the physics dataset S_Phy. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmark datasets, verifying its effectiveness and superiority. Resources are available at: https://github.com/Nicozwy/SRJudge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRJudge 用三段式 Select-Reason-Judge 框架把大规模候选集上的知识概念标注拆成先缩小决策空间、再推理、再裁决：先用微调的 BERT 类 SLM 把候选裁到 top-K 短名单（top-K 命中正确概念的大多数情况），再由轻量 LLM 在短名单上做精炼推理并配合动态任务奖励与剪枝的强化学习，最后由更大的 LLM 评判推理过程与解释并定稿。在自建的生物 S_Bio 与物理 S_Phy 数据集上一致优于 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 知识概念标注要在大规模候选概念集中选对标签，决策空间维度高，LLM 直接在全集上选择容易选错。
Method: 三阶段框架：Stage 1 的 Selector 微调 BERT 类小语言模型产出 top-K 候选短名单以压缩决策空间；Stage 2 的 Reasoner 用轻量 LLM 在短名单上精炼推理，配合改进的强化学习（动态任务特定奖励函数）与剪枝机制对齐人类推理偏好；Stage 3 由更大的 LLM 作为 judger 评估推理过程与解释的整体合理性并决定最终输出。另构建生物数据集 S_Bio 与物理数据集 S_Phy。
Result: 在基准数据集（含自建 S_Bio、S_Phy）上一致优于 state-of-the-art 基线；top-K 预测在大多数情况下命中正确概念。
Conclusion: 先缩小候选决策空间、再让 LLM 分级推理与裁决，是细粒度知识概念标注在大规模候选集上可行且优于直接标注的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UltraMatch: Transport Path Routing for Ultra-Fast and Memory-Efficient Image Matching
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in accuracy and efficiency, coarse matching remains an indispensable yet costly stage in existing semi-dense matchers due to dense token-level matching. We present UltraMatch, an ultra-efficient and scalable semi-dense matching framework that bypasses the quadratic computation and memory cost of dense token-level matching by routing only a small fraction of candidate matching paths. At its core, a lightweight Transport Path Router operates on coarse block representations to rank candidate target blocks for each source block and retain only a small set, restricting subsequent token-level matching to the selected paths and avoiding the construction of the full token-to-token matching matrix. We further design a sparse global Dual-Softmax that performs matching only over the routed block candidates while retaining global competition across the sparse matching space. Beyond matching acceleration, UltraMatch employs deployment-oriented structural reparameterization for feature extraction and a tiny fine matching head with shared parameters, further reducing inference cost and memory consumption. UltraMatch achieves competitive accuracy among semi-dense matchers, while running 1.67$\times$ faster than SuperPoint+LightGlue with only 0.44 GiB peak inference memory. Its scalability enables inference at up to 6K resolution on a single RTX 3090, whereas existing semi-dense matchers run out of memory before reaching 2K. Our routing strategy is also transferable, delivering about 2$\times$ end-to-end speedup in EDM and ELoFTR without accuracy loss. The project repository is available at https://github.com/JiajunLe/UltraMatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraMatch 用轻量 Transport Path Router 在粗块级给目标块排序、只保留少量候选路径，把 token 级匹配限制在稀疏路径上，从而绕开稠密匹配的二次计算与显存开销。在半稠密匹配器上达到有竞争力的精度，比 SuperPoint+LightGlue 快 1.67×、峰值显存仅 0.44 GiB，单张 RTX 3090 可推到 6K 分辨率（现有方法 2K 前即 OOM）；路由策略迁移到 EDM 与 ELoFTR 可带来约 2× 端到端加速且不掉点。
Motivation: 半稠密匹配器的 coarse matching 依赖稠密 token 级匹配，带来二次复杂度的计算与显存开销，限制高分辨率推理与部署。
Method: Transport Path Router 在粗块表示上为每个源块排序候选目标块并只保留少量，后续 token 级匹配仅在被选路径上进行，不构建完整 token-to-token 匹配矩阵；配合只在路由候选上做匹配、但保留稀疏空间全局竞争的 sparse global Dual-Softmax，以及面向部署的结构重参数化特征提取与共享参数的轻量 fine matching head。
Result: 精度在半稠密匹配器中有竞争力；比 SuperPoint+LightGlue 快 1.67×，峰值推理显存 0.44 GiB；单张 RTX 3090 上可推理至 6K 分辨率，而现有半稠密匹配器不到 2K 即 OOM；路由策略迁移至 EDM 与 ELoFTR 约 2× 端到端加速且无精度损失。
Conclusion: 只对少量候选匹配路径做路由即可保住半稠密匹配精度，同时把推理速度与显存压到可高分辨率部署的水平，且该路由策略可迁移到其他匹配器。

papers.title: A Dual-Track Curation-and-Classification Framework for Resolving Ground-Truth Label Noise in Operational Sentinel-2 Wheat Area Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Operational estimation of wheat-cultivated area is persistently constrained by discordance between administrative record-keeping and remotely sensed classification products. We address this administrative reference discordance for the 2022 Rabi season in Patiala district, Punjab, India, using a thirteen-timestep Sentinel-2 NDVI time series. A curated 849-sample reference dataset, developed through an iterative rule-based bootstrapping procedure, underpins both a feature sensitivity analysis and an operational classifier. Feature sensitivity independently assessed via Cohen's d and gradient-boosted information gain converges on the February-to-March grain-fill window as most discriminative. Four classifiers (1D-CNN, LSTM, hybrid CNN-LSTM, and XGBoost) were benchmarked on an identical 679/170 sample split. XGBoost achieved the highest overall accuracy (78.82%) against deep-learning baselines (64-66%), consistent with tree-based ensembles' favourable parameter-to-sample ratio in low-sample regimes. At full-population deployment across 36.25 million valid district pixels, the operational classifier attained 86.31% precision and 71.05% recall. The predicted wheat extent deviated by only +2.99% from the official tabular target, whereas the government's spatial reference mask exhibited a +25.11% positive area bias against the identical target. This asymmetry indicates that a classifier trained on an auditor-curated reference set reconciles more closely with the official tabular area than the spatial product conventionally used to validate it. We present this dual-track curation-and-classification framework as a methodological reference for crop-area reconciliation in label-noisy administrative settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对行政台账与遥感分类产品在小麦面积上不一致的问题，提出双轨（dual-track）框架：用迭代规则自举构建 849 条人工审核参考样本，再训练分类器做区域制图。在旁遮普 Patiala 2022 Rabi 季，XGBoost 在 679/170 划分上总体精度 78.82%（深度学习基线 64–66%），全境 3625 万有效像元上精确率 86.31%、召回率 71.05%，预测面积仅比官方表格目标高 +2.99%，而政府空间参考掩膜偏高 +25.11%。
Motivation: 行政记录与遥感小麦面积产品长期对不上，而官方通常用有偏的空间掩膜去校验分类结果，标签噪声使验证本身失真。
Method: 用 13 期 Sentinel-2 NDVI 时间序列，经迭代规则自举 (rule-based bootstrapping) 构建 849 条审核参考样本；以 Cohen's d 与梯度提升信息增益做特征敏感性分析，并在 679/170 划分上对比 1D-CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM 与 XGBoost 四个分类器，最后在全区像元上部署。
Result: 特征敏感性分析一致指向 2–3 月灌浆期最具判别力；XGBoost 总体精度 78.82%，深度学习基线 64–66%；全境部署精确率 86.31%、召回率 71.05%；预测面积较官方表格目标偏差 +2.99%，政府空间掩膜偏差 +25.11%。
Conclusion: 在标签噪声重的行政场景下，审核自举参考集训练的分类器比用于校验它的空间产品更贴近官方表格面积，该双轨框架可作为作物面积对账的方法学参照。

papers.title: Structured Visual Target Learning For Cross-Subject eeg-to-image retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval requires a neural represen- tation trained on source subjects to remain aligned with a visual embedding space for an unseen subject. Whereas existing methods primarily focus on the EEG side, we address this problem from the perspective of the visual target. Our approach preserves the spatial information of the Perception Encoder, converts its patch grid into a compact set of learned visual views, and aggregates them for each image with a block-structured, content-dependent router. The target is learned jointly with the EEG encoder through contrastive learning with MMD regularization across source subjects. For deployment, we propose a training-free representation refinement that aligns frozen embeddings without updating either encoder. Under leave- one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2, the structured target achieves 35.3%/65.6% Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, the best among com- pared methods. Refinement raises this to 48.1%/77.1%, an 18.5% Top-1 gain over the strongest compared method, improving all ten held-out subjects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索的关键在视觉目标侧：把 Perception Encoder 的 patch grid 压成一组可学习视觉视图，用块结构内容相关路由器聚合，与 EEG 编码器经对比学习加 MMD 正则联合训练。THINGS-EEG2 留一被试评测上取得 35.3%/65.6% 的 Top-1/Top-5，为所比较方法中最好；再加免训练的表示精调升到 48.1%/77.1%，Top-1 比最强对比方法高 18.5 个百分点，且十名留出被试全部提升。
Motivation: 跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索要求源被试训练的神经表示对未见被试仍与视觉嵌入空间对齐，而现有方法主要只在 EEG 一侧做文章，视觉目标侧的信息被浪费。
Method: 保留 Perception Encoder 的空间信息，把其 patch grid 转成一组紧凑的可学习视觉视图，并用块结构、内容相关的路由器 (block-structured content-dependent router) 对每张图的视图做聚合；该目标与 EEG 编码器通过对比学习联合训练，跨源被试加 MMD 正则。部署时另提出免训练的表示精调，只对齐冻结的嵌入、不更新任一编码器。
Result: 在 THINGS-EEG2 的 leave-one-subject-out 评测上，结构化目标达到 Top-1 35.3%、Top-5 65.6%，为所比较方法中最佳；精调后升至 Top-1 48.1%、Top-5 77.1%，Top-1 相对最强对比方法提升 18.5 个百分点，并在全部十名留出被试上均有改善。
Conclusion: 跨被试 EEG 图像检索的瓶颈可以放在视觉目标侧解决：结构化视觉目标加免训练精调能在不更新编码器的情况下把未见被试的检索精度整体抬高。

papers.title: Equally Good, Yet Different: Benchmarking Rashomon sets in AutoML packages
papers.abstract_en: The Rashomon effect describes the existence of multiple near-optimal models that achieve comparable performance while offering fundamentally different explanations. This creates a critical vulnerability in AutoML: x-hacking, the selective post-hoc choice of a model based on its explanation rather than predictive merit. No existing AutoML framework exposes this risk. We introduce ARSA ML, an open-source Python framework that quantifies Rashomon set structure and predictive multiplicity within AutoML pipelines. Using ARSA ML, we benchmark AutoGluon and H2O across 28 binary classification datasets, and conduct a post-hoc x-hacking analysis revealing a consistent structural asymmetry: AutoGluon produces larger, diverse sets with stable explanations, while H2O generates compact sets with markedly higher prediction divergence and explanation instability -- making H2O users considerably more exposed to x-hacking. This gap persists across all evaluated metrics and epsilon thresholds, pointing to a fundamental difference in each framework's model-building strategy. ARSA ML is available at https://pypi.org/project/arsa-ml/ .
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Automated Machine Learning 2026, ABCD Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开源框架 ARSA ML，量化 AutoML 管线中的 Rashomon 集结构与预测多样性，并在 28 个二分类数据集上对比 AutoGluon 与 H2O。AutoGluon 产生更大、解释稳定的集合，H2O 集合更紧凑但预测分歧与解释不稳定性明显更高，因而 H2O 用户更易遭受 x-hacking（按解释而非预测力事后挑模型）。
Motivation: AutoML 中多个近最优模型给出根本不同的解释，事后按解释挑模型（x-hacking）构成风险，而现有 AutoML 框架都不暴露这一风险。
Method: 提出 ARSA ML（Python 开源框架，已发布至 PyPI），量化 Rashomon 集结构与预测多样性（predictive multiplicity）；用它对 AutoGluon 与 H2O 在 28 个二分类数据集上做基准测试，并做事后 x-hacking 分析，扫描多个 epsilon 阈值与指标。
Result: 在 28 个二分类数据集上：AutoGluon 生成更大、更多样且解释稳定的 Rashomon 集；H2O 生成紧凑集合但预测分歧显著更高、解释不稳定，H2O 用户明显更易受 x-hacking 影响；该差距在所有评估指标与 epsilon 阈值上持续存在。
Conclusion: 两个框架的模型构建策略存在根本差异，导致 Rashomon 集结构与 x-hacking 暴露度不同；使用 H2O 的 AutoML 用户需格外警惕按解释事后选模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior-Driven Enhancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting: Normals and Depths Regularization
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a state-of-the-art technique for 3D scene rendering, offering high efficiency and excellent visual quality. However, because 3DGS relies on an initial sparse point set from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and view-dependent properties, it can suffer from geometric inaccuracies and visual artifacts, particularly in complex scenes. To address these challenges, we propose an improved 3DGS approach that regularizes the optimization process by integrating geometric priors, including surface normals and dense depth information. Surface normal regularization improves geometric consistency by aligning Gaussian covariance with local surface structures, while dense depth priors combined with an initial points from SfM enhance per-pixel depth estimation, increasing accuracy and reducing ambiguities. These enhancements enable robust handling of diverse and complex real-world scenarios, minimizing visual distortions and improving reconstruction quality across various environments. To validate our method, we evaluate it on challenging datasets, including street-view scenes and highly reflective environments, while testing it across multiple SfM pipelines. Our results demonstrate compatibility across diverse environments and highlight the robustness of our approach. Experimental findings further show that our method enhances geometric accuracy and visual quality, establishing a reliable solution for real-time 3D scene rendering in complex environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 中引入表面法线与稠密深度两类几何先验做正则：法线正则把 Gaussian 协方差对齐到局部表面结构，稠密深度先验与 SfM 初始点结合提升逐像素深度估计。在街景与高反射场景、跨多个 SfM 管线的评测中，几何精度与视觉质量均提升，且保持实时渲染。
Motivation: 3DGS 依赖 SfM 稀疏初始点与视角相关属性，在复杂场景中容易出现几何不准与视觉伪影，需要在优化阶段注入几何约束。
Method: 在 3DGS 优化中加入几何先验正则：表面法线正则约束 Gaussian 协方差与局部表面结构对齐，稠密深度先验联合 SfM 初始点约束逐像素深度；在街景与高反射环境数据集上评测，并跨多个 SfM 管线测试。
Result: 在具有挑战性的数据集（街景场景、高反射环境）上评测并跨多个 SfM 管线测试，结果显示方法提升几何精度与视觉质量，在多样环境中表现兼容与鲁棒，可用于实时 3D 场景渲染。
Conclusion: 把法线与稠密深度先验作为正则项加入 3DGS 优化，可在复杂真实场景中同时改善几何一致性与渲染质量，且对不同 SfM 管线鲁棒。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TaskBridge: Bridging Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection and In-Context Learning via Virtual Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection (TAD) aims to identify anomalous rows in tabular data using normal training samples. While conventional methods rely on dataset-specific training and configuration search, recent tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable zero-shot anomaly detection on unseen datasets via in-context learning. Most TFM-based approaches, however, require anomaly-specific pretraining from scratch, making detection inherently dependent on synthetic TAD-specific priors and costly to update. Some approaches instead repurpose pretrained general-purpose TFMs for TAD to avoid this burden, but rely on computationally expensive formulations with restrictive anomaly inductive biases. In this work, we introduce TaskBridge, a new framework that efficiently repurposes pretrained general-purpose TFMs for unsupervised TAD by constructing virtual supervised tasks that directly recast anomaly detection as supervised in-context inference of TFMs. The resulting virtual tasks induce predictive structures under which normal queries and their target pairs receive high support, whereas anomalies tend to violate the induced structures and receive lower support, providing direct anomaly evidence. Across 790 real-world datasets, TaskBridge consistently outperforms 30 baselines, including state-of-the-art TFM-based approaches, without anomaly-specific TFM pretraining or dataset-specific model optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaskBridge 把无监督表格异常检测 (TAD) 重写成由虚拟监督任务驱动的 in-context 推理：正常查询与其目标配对获得高支持度，异常违反诱导出的预测结构因而支持度更低，直接充当异常证据。在 790 个真实数据集上持续优于 30 个基线（含 SOTA 的 TFM 方法），且无需异常专用预训练与数据集级模型优化。
Motivation: 现有 TFM 异常检测要么需从头做异常专用预训练、依赖合成 TAD 先验且更新昂贵，要么改用通用 TFM 但代价高昂并带有受限的异常归纳偏置。
Method: 构造虚拟监督任务，把异常检测直接改写为通用表格基础模型 (TFM) 的有监督 in-context 推理；虚拟任务诱导出预测结构，使正常查询-目标对获高支持、异常获低支持，从而免去异常专用预训练与数据集特定优化。
Result: 在 790 个真实世界数据集上，TaskBridge 持续优于 30 个基线，包括 state-of-the-art 的 TFM-based 方法，同时不做异常专用 TFM 预训练、不做数据集特定模型优化。
Conclusion: 用虚拟任务桥接通用 TFM 的 in-context 能力即可支撑无监督 TAD，不必为异常检测专门预训练或逐数据集调参。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JudgeCast: Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Informed Covariate Judgements
papers.abstract_en: Covariate effects vary across contexts and shift over time, requiring forecasters to assess how to use them for each forecasting context. As forecasting proceeds, observations for earlier forecasts become available, providing feedback on past covariate use for subsequent forecasts. However, when multiple covariates act together, the forecast error reveals the numerical discrepancy from the observation but not how the covariates should have been used. We introduce JudgeCast, an experience-based framework for time series forecasting with covariates. Following the judgmental adjustment practice, a frozen TSFM provides the base forecast, while a frozen LLM uses the current context and relevant experience to adjust it. Within the adjustment, assessing covariate effects and determining the numerical adjustment serve distinct roles, so JudgeCast first forms explicit covariate-wise judgments and then determines the adjustment. After observation, JudgeCast uses the observed residual of the base forecast to reconstruct alternative judgments and evaluates the original and alternatives through their resulting adjustments. The best-performing decision is selected and retained as validated experience for subsequent forecasts. Across diverse real-world datasets, JudgeCast outperforms strong baselines. Ablations show that explicit covariate-wise judgment can improve forecast-time adjustment, while residual-guided experience construction yields more reliable forecasting gains than retaining raw decisions as experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JudgeCast 用冻结的 TSFM 出基预报、冻结的 LLM 按当前上下文与历史经验做 judgmental adjustment：先给出逐协变量 (covariate-wise) 的显式判断，再决定数值调整量；观测到基预报残差后，用残差重构备选判断并按其产生的调整效果择优，把最佳决策存为 validated experience 供后续预报复用。在多个真实数据集上超过强基线，消融显示显式逐协变量判断能改善预报时调整，残差引导的经验构造比直接保留原始决策带来更可靠的增益。
Motivation: 协变量效应随上下文变化且随时间漂移，多协变量共同作用时预报误差只给出与观测的数值偏差，无法说明各协变量本应如何使用，预报者缺少可复用的判断依据。
Method: 冻结的时序基础模型 (TSFM) 提供基预报，冻结的 LLM 承担调整；调整分两步，先形成显式的逐协变量判断，再据此确定数值调整量。观测到基预报残差后，用残差重构备选判断，比较原判断与备选判断各自产生的调整效果，择优保留为 validated experience 供后续预报使用。
Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上优于强基线；消融表明显式 covariate-wise judgment 能改善 forecast-time adjustment，residual-guided experience construction 比保留原始决策 (raw decisions) 带来更可靠的预报增益。
Conclusion: 把协变量判断与数值调整拆开、并用观测残差筛选可复用经验，是让 LLM 在时序预报中稳定发挥调整作用的有效做法。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks
papers.abstract_en: System One models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative language models for tasks that require decisions rather than open-ended responses. However, existing Jev models exhibit limited Chinese-language decision accuracy, restricting their utility in both general and specialized settings. In this paper, we introduce Chinese-Jev, a System One model that addresses this gap through a unified data processing and training pipeline. Our data processing protocol converts heterogeneous Chinese-language annotations into probability targets over candidate options, enabling a shared training formulation across domains and question formats. To enable efficient inference, Chinese-Jev adopts a lightweight encoder-only backbone for text encoding and learns to score candidate answers through decision-oriented training. To address the misalignment between the pre-training distribution and downstream Chinese-language scenarios, we first train the model on a general-purpose corpus of 10 million examples, then fine-tune it separately for the medical, legal, and financial domains. To evaluate decision accuracy and calibration in both general and domain-specific Chinese-language settings, we introduce Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench). After first-stage pre-training, Chinese-Jev exceeds the accuracy of the closed-source Jev model by 1.24% on general-domain tasks while achieving a 20.3x speedup. Subsequent domain-specific fine-tuning yields a 4.0% accuracy improvement over Jev in medicine and achieves 92% of Jev's average accuracy across specialized domains, with a 17x speedup and an average latency of only 15 ms per example. We further demonstrate on-device deployment of an INT8-quantized model on mobile devices, achieving an inference latency of approximately 1.0 second per decision. The project is available at https://gulucaptain.github.io/Chinese-Jev/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chinese-Jev 是面向中文决策任务的 System One 模型：把异构中文标注统一转成候选选项上的概率目标，用轻量 encoder-only 主干做决策导向打分，先在 1000 万条通用语料上预训练，再分别对医疗、法律、金融微调。在自建 CJ-Bench 上，一阶段预训练后通用域准确率超闭源 Jev 1.24%、加速 20.3 倍；领域微调后医疗准确率比 Jev 高 4.0%，专业域平均达 Jev 的 92%，加速 17 倍、单例延迟 15 ms。
Motivation: Jev 一类 System One 模型在需要决策而非开放式生成的任务上更高效，但现有 Jev 模型中文决策准确率有限，通用与专业场景都用不起来。
Method: 数据协议把异构中文标注转成候选选项上的概率目标，使不同领域与题型共享同一训练形式；主干为轻量 encoder-only 文本编码器，通过 decision-oriented training 学会给候选答案打分。先在 1000 万条通用语料上预训练，再对医疗、法律、金融分别微调，评测用新提出的 Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench) 度量决策准确率与校准。
Result: 一阶段预训练后，通用域准确率超闭源 Jev 1.24%，推理加速 20.3 倍；领域微调后医疗准确率比 Jev 高 4.0%，专业域平均准确率达 Jev 的 92%，加速 17 倍，单例平均延迟 15 ms。INT8 量化模型在移动设备上单次决策推理延迟约 1.0 秒。
Conclusion: 统一的概率目标加两阶段（通用预训练再分领域微调）训练，能让轻量 encoder-only 模型在中文决策任务上以一个量级以下的延迟逼近闭源 Jev 的准确率，并支持端侧部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VStress: Correlation-Aware Auditing and Adaptive Budget Allocation for Repeated Verifiers
papers.abstract_en: Repeated verifier calls are useful only when they contribute conditional information. We introduce VStress, an auditable replay contract, and VStress-CA, a correlation-aware allocation policy that estimates the conditional marginal information of an unqueried verifier on a sealed calibration split, discounts uncertainty, normalizes by call cost, and stops or abstains when the next call is not informative. The controller freezes its decision and cost ledger before joining the clean oracle; a dependence-shift alarm disables channel preference and falls back to exact-stop. The controlled audit gives the mechanism boundary: at 35% symmetric corruption, majority-5 improves balanced accuracy from 0.6578 to 0.7739, whereas at 65% it loses 0.1226 points. In the matched fixed-budget comparison, breadth, redundancy, and adaptive allocation obtain balanced accuracies 0.6048, 0.6375, and 0.6538, with 3.4216 calls per item and an RLVR score of 0.6417 for VStress-CA. Dependence diagnostics also increase from same-model repeats to cross-family channels, with conditional marginal gains of 0.0126, 0.0462, and 0.0913. These measurements turn correlation from a post-hoc warning into an auditable allocation decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VStress-CA 在密封校准集上估计未查询 verifier 的条件边际信息，按调用成本归一化后分配预算，信息不足即停止或弃权，并在依赖漂移告警时退回 exact-stop。受控审计显示：35% 对称噪声下 majority-5 把 balanced accuracy 从 0.6578 提到 0.7739，65% 噪声下反而损失 0.1226；同预算对比中自适应分配以 3.4216 次/样本取得 0.6538，高于 breadth 0.6048 与 redundancy 0.6375。
Motivation: 重复调用 verifier 只有在提供条件信息时才有价值，而相关性通常只在事后被当作警告，无法转成可审计的预算决策。
Method: VStress 提供可审计的 replay contract，决策与成本账本在接入 clean oracle 前冻结；VStress-CA 在密封校准集上估计条件边际信息，折扣不确定性、按调用成本归一化，信息不足即 stop/abstain，依赖漂移告警会关闭 channel preference 并退回 exact-stop。
Result: 35% 对称噪声下 majority-5 使 balanced accuracy 从 0.6578 升至 0.7739，65% 噪声下则损失 0.1226；同预算对比中 breadth、redundancy、adaptive allocation 的 balanced accuracy 分别为 0.6048、0.6375、0.6538，VStress-CA 每样本 3.4216 次调用、RLVR score 0.6417；依赖诊断的条件边际增益从 same-model repeats 到 cross-family channels 依次为 0.0126、0.0462、0.0913。
Conclusion: 相关性应作为可审计的分配决策而非事后警告：多数投票在中等噪声下有效、高噪声下反转，而按条件边际信息自适应分配能在固定预算内取得更高 balanced accuracy。

papers.title: Beyond Readability: Evaluating Task Information Recoverability
papers.abstract_en: Direct visual readability and task-information recoverability are different quantities. Failure to decode a target from a fixed observation need not eliminate access to that target through another recovery route. We develop an evaluation perspective that makes the observation, query, target, and available knowledge explicit and measures the overlap between routes' success sets. For information available on the original visible surface under suitable imaging conditions, direct optical recovery reads the target from the image, optionally after restoration; entity-linked recovery uses residual visual evidence to identify the depicted entity and accesses its target through an entity--attribute relation in a specified knowledge resource. Such access can draw on stored knowledge or an external source. A controlled book-cover study instantiates external access with a fixed title--author catalog, comparing optical author recovery with visual title resolution and deterministic lookup under resolution degradation. Entity-linked successes persist across the tested vision--language models, revealing information access beyond the tested direct visual frontier despite substantial differences in absolute performance. A substantial optical-only region remains. These complementary outcomes show why visual degradation should be evaluated through the task information accessible along specified routes and knowledge resources, alongside direct readability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把「直接可读性」与「任务信息可恢复性」分开评估的框架：显式定义观测、查询、目标与可用知识，度量不同恢复路径成功集的重叠。在书封面受控实验中，实体链接路径（视觉解析书名 + 固定书目目录确定性查表）在分辨率退化下仍能恢复作者信息，且在所测 VLM 上普遍存在，说明直接视觉前沿之外仍有信息通路，同时保留一块相当大的仅光学成功区。
Motivation: 从固定观测中直接解码目标失败，并不等于该目标不可访问；仅用直接可读性评估视觉退化会低估沿其他路径仍可获得的任务信息。
Method: 框架显式刻画观测、查询、目标与可用知识，度量各路径成功集的重叠；区分直接光学恢复（原图读取，可先做复原）与实体链接恢复（用残余视觉证据识别实体，再经知识资源中的实体-属性关系取回目标）。以书封面受控实验实例化：固定书名-作者目录，在分辨率退化下比较光学作者恢复与视觉书名解析加确定性查表。
Result: 实体链接路径的成功在所测试的 vision-language models 上持续存在，尽管各模型绝对性能差异很大；同时保留相当大的仅光学成功区域。
Conclusion: 视觉退化应沿指定路径与知识资源评估可访问的任务信息，而不能只看直接可读性；两条路径互补，各自覆盖对方未及的成功区。

papers.title: Controlled Decoding Attacks on Black-Box LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Manipulating next-token probabilities during generation can bypass the safety alignment of large language models. Existing approaches, however, rely on access to model weights or numerical token probabilities and therefore do not apply to interfaces that return only sampled text. Reconstructing probabilities from sampled outputs offers a possible alternative, but finite sampling produces sparse and noisy estimates, while repeating this process at every generation step incurs substantial query costs. Our empirical observations suggest that large distributional changes along successful jailbreak trajectories are concentrated at a small subset of positions, motivating selective control. We introduce \method{}, a framework for jailbreaking through text-only continuation interfaces that permit repeated sampling and assistant-prefix continuation. Sample-Based Distribution Reconstruction combines sampled outputs with a prior over unobserved actions to obtain a usable control signal. Risk-Gated Residual Control uses the evolving response prefix to decide when to reconstruct and modify the distribution, concentrating sampling costs at selected positions. Speculative Multi-Token Execution further amortizes target calls by verifying and accepting draft prefixes that require no intervention. Across four target endpoints and three benchmarks, \method{} achieves the highest mean score most comparisons against baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向仅返回采样文本的黑盒 LLM 越狱框架，用 Sample-Based Distribution Reconstruction 从有限采样重建分布作为控制信号，Risk-Gated Residual Control 按响应前缀决定在哪些位置干预，Speculative Multi-Token Execution 用草稿前缀验证摊薄目标模型调用。在四个目标端点与三个基准上，多数对比中取得最高平均分。
Motivation: 操纵 next-token 概率可绕过 LLM 安全对齐，但现有方法依赖模型权重或数值概率，无法用于只返回采样文本的接口；从采样重建概率又稀疏有噪、逐步重复采样查询开销大。
Method: 框架包含三部分：Sample-Based Distribution Reconstruction 结合采样输出与未观测动作上的先验得到可用控制信号；Risk-Gated Residual Control 用演化中的响应前缀决定何时重建并修改分布，把采样开销集中在少数位置；Speculative Multi-Token Execution 验证并接受无需干预的草稿前缀以摊薄目标调用。
Result: 在四个目标端点和三个基准上，多数对比中取得最高平均分 (highest mean score most comparisons against baselines)。
Conclusion: 只靠文本续写接口的重复采样与选择性干预即可对黑盒 LLM 实施受控解码攻击，且成功越狱轨迹上的大幅分布变化集中在少数位置，选择性控制因此有效。

papers.title: Purlin: Separating Orchestration from the Datapath of Collectives
papers.abstract_en: Distributed inference depends on GPU collective communication that must keep pace with evolving hardware and specialized workloads. However, existing collective implementations often couple semantics, orchestration (where and when data moves), and the datapath (how data moves). This coupling makes it costly to adopt new hardware mechanisms and customize communication for applications. We present Purlin, a scale-up communication framework that separates these concerns. At the top of Purlin, we specify collectives as a naming of an input and output layout and a copy or reduction operation. In the middle, we introduce a shared orchestration protocol, Stage, Notify, And Consume (SNAC), which derives coordination from these specifications. Below SNAC sits a hardware-specific datapath we call Atom, which implements two key data movement primitives for collectives: copy and reduce. This separation lets us customize collectives and adopt new hardware mechanisms while reusing orchestration via SNAC. We evaluate Purlin on A100, H200, and B200 GPUs. Across seven collectives, Purlin achieves latency speedups of up to 5.14x and bandwidth improvements of up to 4.50x over baselines. Integrated into SGLang, Purlin improves offline LLM serving throughput and interactivity by 1.13x on average and up to 1.37x over baselines. For online LLM inference, Purlin improves interactivity by 1.26x on average and up to 2.85x, with the largest gain occurring under overload. For diffusion image generation, Purlin reduces end-to-end latency by up to 1.13x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Purlin 把 GPU 集合通信的语义、编排（数据何时何地移动）与数据通路（数据如何移动）解耦：顶层把集合通信写成输入/输出布局命名加 copy 或 reduce 操作，中层用共享编排协议 SNAC 从规格推导协调，底层是硬件相关数据通路 Atom。在 A100、H200、B200 上跨七种集合通信延迟加速最高 5.14x、带宽提升最高 4.50x；接入 SGLang 后离线 LLM 服务吞吐与交互性平均提升 1.13x、最高 1.37x。
Motivation: 现有集合通信实现把语义、编排与数据通路耦合在一起，导致采用新硬件机制和针对应用定制通信的成本都很高。
Method: 三层分离框架：顶层以输入/输出布局命名加 copy/reduce 操作规格化集合通信；中层共享编排协议 Stage, Notify, And Consume (SNAC) 从规格推导协调；底层硬件相关数据通路 Atom 实现 copy 与 reduce 两个数据移动原语，使编排可跨硬件复用。
Result: 在 A100、H200、B200 GPU 上跨七种集合通信，延迟加速最高 5.14x、带宽提升最高 4.50x（对比 baselines）。接入 SGLang 后离线 LLM serving 吞吐与交互性平均提升 1.13x、最高 1.37x；在线 LLM 推理交互性平均提升 1.26x、最高 2.85x，最大增益出现在 overload 工况；扩散图像生成端到端延迟降低最高 1.13x。
Conclusion: 把编排从数据通路中抽离并复用 SNAC，可以在不重写协调逻辑的前提下适配新硬件与定制集合通信，同时在 LLM serving 与扩散生成负载上带来实际加速。

papers.title: Cool the Sampler, Not the Learner: Sampling Temperature Moves the Staleness Cliff of Importance-Corrected GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Production RL for language models lets the sampler fall behind the learner and repairs the resulting mismatch with a truncated importance weight. We ask how long the sampler can go without a refresh under that correction, and find a cliff: on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and GSM8K, importance-corrected GRPO refreshed every 192 updates learns well for 180 steps and then degrades severely in all three data seeds before the refresh arrives. Published remedies for staleness act on the update; we act on the sampler instead. Decoupled cooling draws samples at temperature 0.8 while the learner, the reference model and the importance weights stay at temperature 1, with the behaviour probability recorded from the tempered distribution, so the learner's objective is unchanged. All corresponding cooled runs are stable, and the longer interval keeps what the short one delivered: at the same update budget, a cooled sampler refreshed every 192 steps matches an uncooled sampler refreshed every 96 at the end of training (0.857 for both) and averaged over it (0.79), whereas lowering the learning rate to a safe value ends 3-7 points lower. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B the degradation points at interval 192 predict that an interval of 144 is fatal without cooling and survivable with it; on two data seeds the uncooled runs degrade before their first refresh and the cooled runs pass it and end at 92-93% against 68-81%, with one cooled run degrading transiently late in the second cycle. The benefit has a window: at three times the safe interval and in a high-mismatch MATH setting cooling delays degradation without preventing it, stronger cooling is not better, and cooling without the correction collapses. Sampling temperature is a control on staleness tolerance, and temperature and refresh interval should be chosen together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在截断重要性权重修正的 GRPO 中，采样器落后学习器会产生 staleness cliff：Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/GSM8K 上每 192 步刷新的修正 GRPO 前 180 步学得好，随后在三个数据种子上全部严重退化。解耦降温 (decoupled cooling) 让采样器用温度 0.8 出样本、学习器与重要性权重保持温度 1，学习目标不变，全部降温运行保持稳定；降温后 192 步刷新追平未降温 96 步刷新的期末成绩 0.857、全程均值 0.79，而调低学习率收尾低 3–7 分。结论是采样温度是 staleness 容忍度的控制量，温度与刷新间隔必须一起选。
Motivation: 生产环境 RL 允许采样器落后于学习器，再用截断重要性权重修补错配，但采样器最多能落后多久没有答案；已发表的 staleness 补救都改更新侧，没有从采样侧下手。
Method: 解耦降温：采样温度取 0.8，学习器、参考模型与重要性权重保持温度 1，行为概率从 tempered 分布记录，使学习器目标不变；在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 与 7B 上按不同刷新间隔与数据种子运行，并对照降低学习率与不加重要性修正的设置。
Result: 1.5B/GSM8K 上未降温、192 步刷新的修正 GRPO 学 180 步后在全部三个数据种子严重退化；降温后所有对应运行稳定，192 步刷新期末 0.857 与未降温 96 步刷新相同、全程均值 0.79，而把学习率降到安全值收尾低 3–7 分。7B 上由 192 步的退化点预测 144 步间隔不降温致命、降温可活：两个数据种子上未降温运行首次刷新前就退化，降温运行越过刷新并以 92–93% 对 68–81% 收尾，其中一个降温运行在第二周期末短暂退化。收益有窗口：三倍安全间隔以及高错配 MATH 设置下降温只延迟而非阻止退化，更强降温并不更好，没有重要性修正的降温会崩溃。
Conclusion: 采样温度是 staleness 容忍度的控制旋钮，温度与刷新间隔应联合选择；降温的收益依赖重要性修正，且在间隔过长或错配过高时只能推迟退化。

papers.title: ER-JEPA: Experience Replay Improves Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel at token-level generation but may learn undesirable abstract semantics and lack comprehensive perception. LLM-JEPA mitigates this by aligning different views of the same underlying knowledge via a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). However, strong alignment does not necessarily lead to accurate, stable predictions. To address this, we propose ER-JEPA, which adds an episodic replay path to LLM-JEPA. ER-JEPA stores training pairs in a memory. At each step, it stores and retrieves relevant data to provide additional supervision. This enables learning from both the current batch and stored training pairs, providing additional supervision for token prediction and representation alignment. Experiments across multiple datasets (NL-RX, GSM8K, Spider, and NQ-Open) demonstrate that ER-JEPA consistently outperforms LLM-JEPA.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 在 LLM-JEPA 之上增加 episodic replay：把训练对存入 memory，每步检索相关数据，使当前 batch 与存储训练对共同监督 token 预测和表征对齐。

papers.title: Scalable Diffusion SBI for Compositional Inference under Simulator Misspecification
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference is challenging when many heterogeneous observations must be composed, hierarchical latent structure must be preserved, and the simulator is misspecified relative to observed data. We develop sampling and fine-tuning methods for diffusion-based inference in design-conditional settings, where the same simulator is queried across different experimental conditions $ξ$. We extend compositional score-based inference with a continuous-time diffusion coefficient that accounts for the number of observations, avoiding Jacobian and auxiliary-covariance corrections. We introduce Hierarchical Blockwise Diffusion Sampling (HBDS), which infers shared parameters and group-specific latent states using a single pretrained model, with the hierarchy specified only at sampling time. Together, these methods support variable observation sets and groupings without retraining. To address misspecification, we introduce path-regularized fine-tuning that adapts the learned likelihood to observations and transfers corrections to posterior inference. Using Girsanov's theorem, we quantify path divergence between pretrained and fine-tuned models across experimental designs and interpret it alongside predictive errors to distinguish candidate misspecification correction from unnecessary adaptation. We evaluate compositional sampling on exact-score Gaussian and Simple Likelihood, Complex Posterior benchmarks, HBDS with analytic and learned scores on a controlled hierarchical model, and fine-tuning and localization on a separate analytic model with known design-dependent discrepancy. Finally, we apply the framework to 940 measurements across four cell lines in a mechanistic Bone Morphogenetic Protein signaling model, where fine-tuning improves posterior-predictive accuracy relative to the pretrained model and shifts posterior marginals toward the least-squares reference while retaining spread.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向模拟器误设 (simulator misspecification) 的扩散式 simulation-based inference 组合推断框架：用随观测数连续调整的扩散系数免去 Jacobian 与辅助协方差修正，用 Hierarchical Blockwise Diffusion Sampling (HBDS) 在采样期才指定层级结构，并用路径正则化微调修正误设。在 940 个测量、四条细胞系的 BMP 信号模型上，微调提升后验预测精度并把后验边缘推向最小二乘参考。
Motivation: 大量异质观测需组合、层级潜变量需保留、且模拟器相对真实数据误设时，标准 SBI 难以在不重训的前提下同时处理这三点。
Method: 组合 score-based 推断中引入随观测数变化的连续时间扩散系数；HBDS 用单个预训练模型同时推断共享参数与组特异潜态，层级仅在采样时指定；路径正则化微调适配学到的似然，并用 Girsanov 定理量化预训练与微调模型间的路径散度，与预测误差一起区分必要修正与多余适配。
Result: 在 exact-score Gaussian 与 Simple Likelihood, Complex Posterior 基准上检验组合采样，在受控层级模型上用解析与学习 score 检验 HBDS，在含已知设计相关差异的解析模型上检验微调与定位；最终在四条细胞系共 940 个测量的机制性 Bone Morphogenetic Protein 模型上，微调相对预训练模型提升后验预测精度，使后验边缘向最小二乘参考移动并保留分布宽度。
Conclusion: 同一预训练扩散模型可支持可变观测集与分组的组合层级推断，路径散度与预测误差联合可用于判断误设修正是否必要。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data: Learning Dynamics, Convergence Rates, and Benefits of Off-Policyness
papers.abstract_en: We study the learning dynamics of fine-tuning a policy model on self-generated and reward-weighted data, with particular focus on a generalized version of REINFORCE -- referred to as RE(S) -- that updates the rollout distribution once every $S \ge 1$ gradient steps. Prior work in bandits and reinforcement learning has developed rich theory for policy gradient methods, and on-policy sampling (i.e., a small $S$, ideally $1$) is often viewed as crucial to their success; yet in prominent application like post-training large language models, reward-guided self-training has proved to be effective even when the rollout distribution is updated infrequently, but theoretical understanding remains limited for the convergence properties of these off-policy methods. To bridge these gaps, we develop a unified theory for RE(S) that covers the full spectrum of $S \ge 1$: it can be interpreted as a stage-wise optimization process, where each stage takes $S$ gradient steps for minimizing the Kullback-Leibler distance to a fixed reward-weighted rollout distribution. For multi-arm bandits with softmax policies, our in-depth analysis and numerical experiments reveal three key findings: (1) for any fixed $S$, RE(S) enjoys global convergence to the optimal policy as the number of rollout distribution updates $B = \lfloor T / S \rfloor \rightarrow \infty$, where $T$ denotes the number of gradient steps; (2) we prove tight two-sided bounds showing that the suboptimality gap of RE(S) achieves an asymptotic $Θ(1 / T)$ convergence rate, while $S$ only affects the length of a burn-in phase; (3) when initialized at a weak policy with a small optimal-action probability, RE(1) gets trapped around suboptimal policies for a long period, whereas RE(S) with a suitable $S$ avoids the detour and achieves significantly faster convergence to the global optimum, highlighting the benefits of off-policyness in this case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 RE(S)（每 S≥1 步梯度才更新一次 rollout 分布的广义 REINFORCE）给出统一收敛理论：在 softmax 多臂老虎机上，任意固定 S 都随 rollout 更新次数 B=⌊T/S⌋→∞ 全局收敛到最优策略，次优间隙达到渐近 Θ(1/T) 的速率，S 只改变 burn-in 阶段长度。当初始化是最优动作概率很小的弱策略时，RE(1) 长期困在次优策略附近，而选取合适的 S 的 RE(S) 绕开这段弯路、显著更快收敛到全局最优，说明 off-policyness 在该情形下有益。
Motivation: bandit 与 RL 的策略梯度理论强调 on-policy 采样（S 小、理想为 1）是成功关键，但 LLM 后训练中 rollout 分布更新不频繁的 reward-guided self-training 依然有效，这类 off-policy 方法的收敛性质缺少理论解释。
Method: 把 RE(S) 建模为分阶段优化过程：每个阶段做 S 步梯度，最小化到固定 reward-weighted rollout 分布的 KL 距离；在多臂老虎机 + softmax 策略上做深入分析并配合数值实验，覆盖全部 S≥1。
Result: 对任意固定 S，当 B=⌊T/S⌋→∞ 时 RE(S) 全局收敛到最优策略；次优间隙的渐近收敛率为紧的双侧界 Θ(1/T)，S 只影响 burn-in 阶段长度；初始化为最优动作概率小的弱策略时，RE(1) 长期滞留于次优策略附近，而合适 S 的 RE(S) 显著更快收敛到全局最优。
Conclusion: off-policyness 不损害渐近收敛速率（仍是 Θ(1/T)），却能在弱初始化下省掉 RE(1) 的长时间次优徘徊，因此 rollout 分布不必每步更新。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dual-Channel Robust Group-Relative Policy Optimization via Advantage and Sequence-Weight Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Group-relative policy optimization relies on reward-derived advantages and sequence-level likelihood weights, both of which can be sensitive to localized outliers. Extreme rewards can collapse the contrast among clean responses after group normalization, while token-level log-ratio perturbations can alter sequence weights and clipping decisions. We introduce RoVR-GSPO, a dual-channel robust optimizer that addresses these failure modes separately. Its reward channel combines robust reference estimation with bounded residual credit, while its ratio channel uses differentiable SoftRoVR aggregation to construct robust sequence weights. We provide stability and efficiency analyses for both channels. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, long-context summarization, and tool-call annotation show consistent improvements over GSPO, while controlled perturbation studies demonstrate stronger robustness to reward contamination and token-ratio anomalies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RoVR-GSPO：针对组相对策略优化中奖励与序列似然权重两条通道各自的离群敏感性，分别用鲁棒参考估计加有界残差信用、以及可微 SoftRoVR 聚合来构造鲁棒序列权重。在数学推理、长上下文摘要与工具调用标注三类任务上一致优于 GSPO，扰动实验显示对奖励污染与 token-ratio 异常更稳健。
Motivation: 组归一化后极端奖励会压垮干净响应之间的对比，token 级 log-ratio 扰动又会改变序列权重与裁剪决策，使 GRPO 类优化在含噪奖励下不稳。
Method: 双通道设计：奖励通道用鲁棒参考估计加有界残差信用 (bounded residual credit)，比率通道用可微 SoftRoVR 聚合构造鲁棒序列权重；作者对两通道给出稳定性与效率分析。
Result: 在数学推理、长上下文摘要、工具调用标注三类实验中一致优于 GSPO；受控扰动研究显示对奖励污染与 token-ratio 异常的鲁棒性更强。
Conclusion: 把奖励与比率两类离群源分开处理，可在保持 GSPO 训练效率的同时提升策略优化对奖励污染和比率异常的稳健性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safe-by-Design Learning via Energy-based Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Learning neural-network models of dynamical systems with safety guarantees is a fundamental requirement for their deployment in safety-critical settings. Safety is commonly established by proving the invariance of a desired subset in state-space, ensuring that every trajectory initialized in this subset remains confined to it for all time under admissible inputs. Existing frameworks, however, either rely on computationally expensive post-hoc verification or employ safety-enforcing mechanisms without formal correctness guarantees. In this paper, we introduce a novel neural architecture grounded in energy-based modern Hopfield networks to guarantee safety-by-design while retaining sufficient expressiveness to model complex nonlinear dynamics. Specifically, we integrate modern Hopfield networks with a port-Hamiltonian neural ODE, enabling by design the construction of barrier functions yielding explicit admissible-input sets and quantitative robustness radii. Across several benchmarks, including an 12-dimensional nanodrone model, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing certified invariant sets that are more robust to external solicitations than comparable existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 energy-based modern Hopfield 网络的安全保障学习架构，把 Hopfield 网络与 port-Hamiltonian neural ODE 结合，使 barrier function 由构造直接给出显式可容许输入集与定量鲁棒半径，实现 safety-by-design 而非事后验证。在含 12 维 nanodrone 模型在内的多个基准上达到 state-of-the-art，所得认证不变集对外部扰动比同类方法更鲁棒。
Motivation: 神经动力学模型要部署到安全关键场景，必须证明状态空间某子集的不变性；现有框架要么依赖计算昂贵的事后验证，要么施加安全机制却无形式化正确性保证。
Method: 以 energy-based modern Hopfield 网络为骨干，集成 port-Hamiltonian neural ODE，由架构本身构造 barrier function，进而导出显式 admissible-input 集合与定量 robustness radius，同时保留对复杂非线性动力学的表达能力。
Result: 在多个基准（含 12 维 nanodrone 模型）上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并产出认证不变集，对外部扰动（external solicitations）比可比的既有方法更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 把 Hopfield 能量结构与 port-Hamiltonian neural ODE 结合，可以在不牺牲非线性建模能力的前提下把安全不变性做成架构内生性质，替代昂贵的事后验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DispFlow-GS: Displacement Flow Supervision with Motion Disentangling for Monocular Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate dynamic scene reconstruction is important for robotic perception, where temporally consistent representations of dynamic environments are essential. Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models dynamic scenes through deformation fields, and recent methods incorporate motion supervision by aligning rendered Gaussian flow with optical flow. However, we find that such Gaussian-flow-based supervision provides only limited improvements in motion modeling. We identify a fundamental limitation of this supervision paradigm, namely a domain gap between rendered Gaussian flow and optical flow. To address this limitation, we propose a motion supervision framework built on Displacement Flow, which splats per-Gaussian 3D displacements onto the image plane to provide direct and stable optimization signals. We further disentangle scene motion from camera motion via intermediate-view rendering, enabling more reliable motion priors and targeted constraints on deformation and geometry. We also observe a discrepancy between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, where improved motion awareness does not necessarily translate into better rendered image quality or higher image-based metric scores. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce Deformation-Rendering Consistency (DRC), a motion-aware metric that measures the alignment between predicted deformation and rendering improvement. Experiments on dynamic scene benchmarks show substantial improvements in motion localization and motion--rendering consistency, reaching up to 39% and 6%, respectively, while image-based metrics change by only about 0.1%. These results confirm the observed mismatch between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, demonstrating the significance of DRC for motion-aware evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DispFlow-GS 用位移流 (Displacement Flow) 替代渲染高斯光流做形变 3DGS 的运动监督，并通过中间视角渲染把场景运动与相机运动解耦。动态场景基准上运动定位与运动-渲染一致性最高提升 39% 和 6%，而图像指标仅变化约 0.1%，说明运动保真度与图像指标脱节。
Motivation: 现有形变 3DGS 用渲染高斯光流对齐光学流做监督，但渲染光流与光学流之间存在 domain gap，对运动建模改进有限；同时运动保真度与图像指标不一致，缺少能反映形变质量的评价手段。
Method: 提出 Displacement Flow 监督：把每个高斯的 3D 位移 splat 到图像平面，提供直接稳定的优化信号；用中间视角渲染 (intermediate-view rendering) 解耦场景运动与相机运动，得到更可靠的运动先验与针对形变、几何的约束；另提出 Deformation-Rendering Consistency (DRC) 度量，衡量预测形变与渲染改善的对齐程度。
Result: 在动态场景基准上，运动定位与运动-渲染一致性分别最高提升 39% 和 6%，而图像指标仅变化约 0.1%。
Conclusion: 渲染光流监督存在 domain gap，位移流监督能更有效地约束形变；运动保真度的提升不必然转化为更好的渲染图像质量或更高的图像指标，因此需要 DRC 这类运动感知评价。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SCA: Spatial Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning of GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents automate tasks on digital devices by grounding language instructions in visual interfaces. Existing group-relative reinforcement learning improves GUI action prediction by comparing the rewards of multiple responses sampled from the same GUI state. However, binary evaluation treats spatially different failed clicks as identical and provides no relative signal when all sampled clicks fail. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial Credit Assignment (SCA), which uses the screen coordinates of sampled clicks to refine group-relative credit. Specifically, SCA predicts each held-out response's reward from the other responses in groups containing both successes and failures, then uses the prediction residual to adjust credit. When all sampled clicks fail, SCA instead orders them by distance to the annotated target. These spatial references are used only to construct the training update; the deployed policy remains unchanged. We evaluate whether this correction improves the policy update itself by comparing its error and directional alignment with the exact return gradient in a controlled synthetic study. Across GUI grounding and offline action-prediction benchmarks, SCA improves grounding across professional domains and achieves the strongest results among reinforcement-fine-tuned models on most action-prediction metrics, with consistent gains across the reported GUI suites.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCA 用采样点击的屏幕坐标修正 group-relative RL 的信用分配：混合成败组里用其余响应预测留出响应的奖励并以残差调信用，全失败组按到标注目标的距离排序，且这些空间参考只进训练更新、部署策略不变。在 GUI grounding 与离线动作预测基准上，SCA 在多数动作预测指标上取得强化微调模型中最强结果，并在专业领域 grounding 上带来一致增益。
Motivation: GUI agent 的 group-relative RL 用二值奖励比较同一状态下的多个采样响应，把空间上不同的失败点击视为等同，且当所有采样点击都失败时完全没有相对信号。
Method: SCA (Spatial Credit Assignment)：在含成功与失败的组里用其余响应预测每个留出响应的奖励，以预测残差调整信用；全失败时按点击到标注目标的距离排序作为相对信号。这些空间参考仅用于构造训练更新，部署策略保持不变；在受控合成研究中把更新误差与方向对齐度同精确 return 梯度比较。
Result: 在 GUI grounding 与离线动作预测基准上，SCA 在多数动作预测指标上取得强化微调 (RL-fine-tuned) 模型中最强结果，在专业领域 grounding 上跨所报告的 GUI suites 带来一致增益；受控合成研究中比较了策略更新误差与方向同精确 return 梯度的对齐度。
Conclusion: 把点击的空间关系引入 group-relative 信用分配能修正二值奖励在全失败与空间异质失败上的信号缺失，且只改训练更新即可改善策略更新本身。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WeLike2Party! In-Context Motion Transfer for Multi-Human Image Animation
papers.abstract_en: Human image animation aims to transfer motion from a driving video to subjects in a reference image. Despite remarkable progress in video generation, achieving high-fidelity animation of multiple interacting subjects remains a challenge. Many existing approaches rely on explicit motion representations such as 2D skeletons or parametric body meshes and struggle to preserve identity-motion binding under inter-person occlusion. To address this limitation, we propose WeLike2Party, a multi-human animation framework built on direct in-context video conditioning without explicit pose or mesh extraction at inference. We further introduce Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning to preserve fine-grained appearance details, and Identity Binding Supervision to associate each reference identity with its intended motion trajectory. To support cross-identity training, we construct MotionTwin, a large-scale synthetic dataset comprising 14.4K cross-identity video pairs with shared subject and camera motions, totaling 84.3 hours of photorealistic video. We additionally present MotionTwin-Bench, a cross-identity benchmark specifically designed to evaluate subject-level visual fidelity and identity-motion binding. Extensive experiments on MotionTwin-Bench and real-world videos demonstrate that WeLike2Party outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods in subject-level visual fidelity, identity-motion binding, and overall perceptual quality, particularly in multi-person interactions with substantial occlusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeLike2Party 用直接的 in-context 视频条件化做多人图像动画，推理时不提取 2D 骨架或参数化人体网格，靠 Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning 保外观细节、Identity Binding Supervision 把每个参考身份绑到对应运动轨迹。在自建 MotionTwin-Bench 与真实视频上，它在主体级视觉保真、身份-运动绑定和整体感知质量上超过近期 SOTA，尤其是多人强遮挡场景。
Motivation: 多人交互动画中，依赖显式骨架或人体网格的方法在人与人遮挡时难以保持 identity-motion binding，即参考图中的身份与目标运动轨迹容易错配。
Method: 框架以直接 in-context 视频条件化替代显式姿态/网格提取；引入 Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning 保留细粒度外观，Identity Binding Supervision 将每个参考身份关联到指定运动轨迹。为跨身份训练构建 MotionTwin 合成数据集，并提出配套评测基准 MotionTwin-Bench。
Result: MotionTwin 含 14.4K 跨身份视频对（共享主体与相机运动），共 84.3 小时照片级真实视频；在 MotionTwin-Bench 与真实视频上，WeLike2Party 在主体级视觉保真、identity-motion binding 与整体感知质量上优于近期 SOTA 方法，优势集中在多人强遮挡交互。
Conclusion: 不依赖显式骨架/网格、改用 in-context 条件化加身份绑定监督，可以在多人遮挡条件下更可靠地保持身份与运动的对应关系。
Relevance: 1
