papers.title: Safer Content or Firmer Refusals? A Hybrid Perturbation Defense for Alignment under Harmful Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning-as-a-service lets users adapt a safety-aligned language model to their own data, but it also creates a harmful fine-tuning attack surface: a small amount of harmful data mixed into an otherwise benign fine-tuning set can degrade the model's alignment. Two recent alignment-stage defenses address this problem at different levels of the model. Vaccine improves the robustness of hidden embeddings to the representation shifts induced by harmful fine-tuning, whereas Booster simulates harmful weight updates and attenuates their effect during alignment. We investigate whether these mechanisms are complementary and propose VaccineBooster, a single alignment procedure that combines embedding perturbation and weight-level gradient attenuation within each training step. On Llama-2-7B aligned with BeaverTails and then attacked through poisoned fine-tuning, VaccineBooster achieves the lowest OpenAI moderation score among the compared defenses, 0.315, while a Booster-Only variant retains the highest post-attack refusal rate, 50%. Together with ablations over the embedding-perturbation and gradient-attenuation strengths, these results indicate a trade-off: embedding perturbation primarily reduces flagged harmful content, whereas gradient attenuation primarily preserves explicit refusal behavior. Because our evaluation uses ten prompts and a single unseeded run per configuration, we report this trade-off as an observed pattern rather than a statistically resolved effect. These results provide practical guidance for prioritizing content safety or refusal retention when aligned models are exposed to untrusted fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VaccineBooster，把 Vaccine 的嵌入扰动与 Booster 的权重级梯度衰减合进同一个对齐训练步，在 Llama-2-7B 上经 BeaverTails 对齐后做投毒微调攻击。它取得被比较防御中最低的 OpenAI moderation score 0.315，而 Booster-Only 变体保留最高攻击后拒绝率 50%：嵌入扰动主要压低被标记的有害内容，梯度衰减主要保住显式拒绝，二者构成取舍。
Motivation: Fine-tuning-as-a-service 让少量有害数据混入良性微调集即可破坏已对齐模型的安全性，而现有对齐阶段防御分别作用在嵌入层与权重层，尚未检验二者是否互补。
Method: VaccineBooster 在每个训练步内同时施加嵌入扰动（沿用 Vaccine 的表征鲁棒化）与权重级梯度衰减（沿用 Booster 的有害权重更新抑制），并做针对两种强度的 ablation；评测对象为先用 BeaverTails 对齐、再经投毒微调攻击的 Llama-2-7B，与若干防御对比。
Result: 在被比较防御中 VaccineBooster 的 OpenAI moderation score 最低，为 0.315；Booster-Only 变体攻击后拒绝率最高，为 50%。ablation 显示嵌入扰动主要降低被标记的有害内容，梯度衰减主要保留显式拒绝。评测为每个配置 10 条 prompt、单次无随机种子运行。
Conclusion: 嵌入扰动与梯度衰减在内容安全与拒绝保留之间形成取舍，可按优先级二选一；由于每配置仅 10 条 prompt 且单次无种子运行，作者把该取舍报告为观察到的模式而非统计上已分辨的效应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IronLLM: Forging Compact Edge-Native Language Models for Real-Time Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We present IronLLM-0.6B, a 654M-parameter language model designed for efficient on-device inference. IronLLM-0.6B combines a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design that eliminates per-depth KV-cache replay and employs a lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting, achieving a 1.48x decoding speedup. The model is pretrained on approximately 6.2 trillion tokens using a quality-oriented data pipeline and is further post-trained with Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation to integrate capabilities from domain-specialized teachers. To better meet the low-latency requirements of on-device scenarios, IronLLM-0.6B adopts an Instruct-Only design. Evaluations show that IronLLM-0.6B achieves competitive performance relative to larger models such as Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B, while producing more concise responses on many tasks. We further present IronLLM-0.6B-Light, which replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh and simplifies several computationally expensive components to improve inference and quantization efficiency. Together, the IronLLM models provide an effective performance-efficiency trade-off for resource-constrained deployment.

papers.title: Markovian Nonconvex ADMM for Reinforcement Learning: Bellman-Resolvent Stability Beyond Smooth Blocks
papers.abstract_en: We identify and study a structural mechanism for Markovian nonconvex ADMM in reinforcement learning. Using finite discounted MDPs as a canonical proving ground, we show that the discounted Bellman resolvent $(I-γP_π)^{-1}$ can provide the multiplier stability that classical nonconvex ADMM analyses often obtain from a designated smooth block. Starting from this mechanism, we establish convergence under controlled Markov sampling and then under stochastic observations using an empirical Bellman surrogate that jointly represents the random residual and its Jacobian. Markov mixing, initialization drift, observation noise, and decaying bias enter as one operator perturbation, avoiding unbiased product and double sampling requirements. When the perturbations are square summable, the true KKT residual converges almost surely to zero. Under a finite conditional fourth moment condition, a companion iterate satisfies $ \mathbb{E}[\widetilde G_{K+1}] \le A/T+(B/T)\sum_{k<T}m_k^{-1}, $ which becomes $O(T^{-1}+T/N)$ for total Markov sample budget $N$, giving $O(ε^{-1})$ iteration complexity and $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity for squared KKT accuracy $ε$. Beyond stationarity, discounted occupancy coverage yields $J^\star-J(π)=O(\sqrt G)$ for direct tabular policies, so covered exact KKT points are globally optimal, while a statewise quadratic Bellman-improvement condition sharpens the relation to $O(G)$. Finally, nonlinear policy, projected Bellman, and explicit occupancy formulations exhibit the same chain of operator invertibility, dual representation, and multiplier stability. This supports discounted operator invertibility as a reusable structural principle for primal-dual reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限折扣 MDP 上，用折扣 Bellman resolvent (I-γP_π)^{-1} 替代经典非凸 ADMM 分析中指定的光滑块来提供乘子稳定性，使 Markov 混合、初始化漂移、观测噪声与衰减偏差统一为一个算子扰动项。扰动平方可和时真 KKT 残差几乎必然收敛到 0，平方 KKT 精度 ε 的迭代复杂度为 O(ε^{-1})、样本复杂度为 O(ε^{-2})；在 occupancy 覆盖下 J*-J(π)=O(√G)，覆盖的精确 KKT 点即全局最优。
Motivation: 经典非凸 ADMM 收敛分析依赖某个指定光滑块提供乘子稳定性，而强化学习的 primal-dual 更新里往往没有这样的块；Markov 采样还带来非独立残差与 Jacobian 的双采样/无偏乘积难题。
Method: 以有限折扣 MDP 为证明场景，用折扣 Bellman resolvent 提供乘子稳定性；先在受控 Markov 采样下、再在随机观测下用经验 Bellman surrogate 同时表示随机残差及其 Jacobian，把 Markov mixing、初始化漂移、观测噪声与衰减偏差合并为单一算子扰动。收敛结论在扰动平方可和与有限条件四阶矩下给出，并推广到 nonlinear policy、projected Bellman、explicit occupancy 三类表述。
Result: 扰动平方可和时真 KKT 残差几乎必然趋于 0；伴随迭代量满足 E[G̃_{K+1}] ≤ A/T + (B/T)·Σ_{k<T} m_k^{-1}，在总 Markov 样本预算 N 下化为 O(T^{-1}+T/N)，对平方 KKT 精度 ε 给出 O(ε^{-1}) 迭代复杂度与 O(ε^{-2}) 样本复杂度。直接表格策略在 discounted occupancy 覆盖下满足 J*-J(π)=O(√G)，状态二次 Bellman 改进条件进一步收紧到 O(G)。
Conclusion: 折扣算子可逆性可作为 primal-dual 强化学习的可复用结构原则：它替代光滑块给出乘子稳定性，并让覆盖下的精确 KKT 点直接等价于全局最优。

papers.title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on message passing among specialized agents to accomplish complex tasks. However, an upstream agent may provide useful information or an incorrect answer that causes a downstream agent to override a correct answer supported by its own evidence. Prior work has not clearly separated the benefits of communication from the damage caused by incorrect messages. We study this problem with controlled experiments across five benchmarks and five receivers, keeping the downstream task and evidence fixed while comparing answers under three conditions: no message, the upstream agent's original message, or a message with the opposite conclusion. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, messages often help when the downstream agent would otherwise answer incorrectly. Second, messages can also hurt: when the downstream agent would answer correctly without a message, an incorrect upstream message changes the answer in up to 32% of cases. Third, in 94% of audited harmful cases, the downstream agent copies the upstream's specific wrong answer--a pattern we term answer substitution. Removing unreliable messages recovers part of the lost accuracy, suggesting that communication should be selective based on upstream reliability and the evidence already available to the downstream agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在五个基准、五个接收方的受控实验中固定下游任务与证据，只改变上游消息（无消息 / 原始消息 / 相反结论消息），发现消息在下游本会答错时常常有益，但在下游本会答对时，错误上游消息会使其改答的比例最高达 32%；94% 的有害案例中下游直接照抄上游那个具体错误答案，作者称之为 answer substitution。剔除不可靠消息能收回部分损失精度，结论是通信应按上游可靠性与下游已有证据选择性进行。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 靠消息传递协作，但既有工作没有把通信带来的收益与错误消息造成的损害分开度量，无法判断何时该传、何时该拦。
Method: 受控实验：固定下游任务与其证据，对五个基准、五个接收方比较三种条件下的回答——不给消息、给上游原始消息、给结论相反的消息，从而隔离消息本身的影响；并对有害案例做人工审核归类。
Result: 三条发现：下游本会答错时消息常有帮助；下游本会答对时，错误上游消息使其改答的比例最高达 32%；被审核的有害案例中 94% 是下游照抄上游的具体错误答案（answer substitution）。移除不可靠消息可恢复部分损失的准确率。
Conclusion: 多智能体通信的净效应取决于上游可靠性与下游已有证据，应选择性转发消息而非无条件传递。

papers.title: Socialality Anchors: Towards Group-bounded Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory prediction is a key component for understanding human behavior patterns in dynamic scenes. Researchers have devoted substantial efforts to modeling social interactions, especially group-wise interactions, since group membership often reflects shared intention, coordinated motion, and stable mutual adaptation, thus providing a persistent and semantically meaningful social prior for forecasting. However, existing group modeling methods may rely on a fixed threshold and infer groups mainly from agents' relative positions within the observation window, overlooking the fact that grouping rules should be agent-specific, temporally coherent, and context-adaptive across diverse personalities, culturalities, and evolving interaction contexts. Inspired by human social perception that alternates between interpersonal distance in boundary-sensitive situations and relative speed consistency in dynamic interactions, we propose Socialality, a human-inspired trajectory prediction framework with interpretable Socialality anchors and an extended grouping window for stable, context-aware grouping inference. Concretely, Socialality introduces a duo-scalar-controlled grouping kernel Socialality that jointly leverages historical observations and short-term future trajectory previews to learn agent-specific grouping rules, and employs a group-wise perception mechanism to model in-group and out-of-group interactions in an intuitive and explainable manner. Furthermore, we conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmarks to demonstrate the performance gains of Socialality, and provide qualitative analyses and statistical studies of anchor distributions to verify the interpretability and stability of the proposed Socialality anchors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出轨迹预测框架 Socialality：用双标量控制的分组核 (duo-scalar-controlled grouping kernel) 依据历史观测与短期未来轨迹预览学习 agent 特异、时序连贯、随情境自适应的分组规则，替代固定阈值分组，并以组内/组外感知机制建模交互。在标准 benchmark 上实验显示性能提升，锚点分布的统计研究验证其可解释性与稳定性。
Motivation: 现有群体建模依赖固定阈值、仅从观测窗口内相对位置推断分组，忽略了分组规则应随个体、文化与交互情境变化，导致群体先验不稳定。
Method: Socialality 框架包含双标量控制的分组核，联合历史观测与短期未来轨迹预览学习 agent 特异的分组规则，并扩展分组窗口以稳定推断；再用组内/组外 (in-group/out-of-group) 感知机制建模交互，锚点设计借鉴人际距离与相对速度一致性两种社会感知。
Result: 在标准 benchmark 上的大量实验展示了 Socialality 的性能增益，并通过锚点分布的定性分析与统计研究验证 Socialality 锚点的可解释性与稳定性（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 分组规则应由数据驱动、随个体与情境自适应而非固定阈值，可解释的 Socialality 锚点能同时带来预测性能提升与稳定的群体推断。

papers.title: RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving policies are commonly trained via imitation learning on logged demonstrations without observing the consequences of their own actions, leading to causal confusion in closed-loop real-world deployment. To address this issue, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training offers a promising alternative by leveraging world models as interactive training environments to enable future scene generation for policy improvement. Nevertheless, existing approaches either rely on reconstruction-based simulators, offering limited counterfactual interaction, or adopt synthetic simulators to enable long-horizon closed-loop interaction at the cost of a substantial sim-to-real gap. Recently, video world models have exhibited the ability to generate realistic multi-step future rollouts but may not faithfully reflect action conditions, resulting in action-vision mismatch. In this paper, we introduce RoXDrive, a plug-and-play closed-loop RL framework that enables reliable policy optimization by identifying action-faithful world-model rollouts, consisting of two stages: 1) Model pre-training: In addition to imitation-based policy pre-training, we devise an Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator for inverse dynamics estimation with our geometry-aware auxiliary trajectory supervision, enabling long-horizon assessment of whether visual dynamics faithfully reflect the conditioning ego actions. 2) Action-faithful RL post-training: Agents iteratively interact with world models to form long-horizon scene rollouts, retaining only action-faithful ones for dense safety-aware scoring and scene-level closed-loop RL post-training. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and an in-house dataset with over 130K training scenarios demonstrate consistent gains across planners, reducing safety violations by 27.6% with DiffusionDrive on nuScenes and 33.7% with Qwen3-VL on the internal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoXDrive 是即插即用的闭环强化学习后训练框架，用 Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator 通过逆动力学估计与几何感知轨迹监督，筛出视觉动态确实反映 ego 动作的 world-model rollout，只保留这些 rollout 做稠密安全打分与场景级闭环 RL 后训练。在 nuScenes 与超过 130K 训练场景的内部数据上，安全违规分别下降 27.6%（DiffusionDrive）与 33.7%（Qwen3-VL）。
Motivation: 端到端驾驶策略靠模仿学习训练，看不到自身动作的后果，闭环部署时出现因果混淆；现有 RL 后训练方案要么基于重建式模拟器、反事实交互有限，要么用合成模拟器换取长程闭环却带来 sim-to-real 差距，视频 world model 又可能不忠实响应动作条件（action-vision mismatch）。
Method: 两阶段：先做模仿式策略预训练，并设计 Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator，用逆动力学估计加几何感知的辅助轨迹监督，长程判断视觉动态是否忠实于条件 ego 动作；再让 agent 与 world model 迭代交互生成长程场景 rollout，只保留 action-faithful 的 rollout 做稠密安全打分与场景级闭环 RL 后训练，作为即插即用模块接入不同 planner。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上用 DiffusionDrive 安全违规降低 27.6%，在含超过 130K 训练场景的内部数据上用 Qwen3-VL 降低 33.7%；实验覆盖 nuScenes 与内部数据集，多个 planner 上均有一致增益。
Conclusion: 把 world-model rollout 按动作忠实性筛过再做闭环 RL 后训练，能在不依赖重建式或合成模拟器的前提下缓解 action-vision mismatch，稳定提升端到端驾驶策略的安全性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: RoXDrive 是即插即用的闭环强化学习后训练框架，用 Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator 通过逆动力学估计与几何感知轨迹监督，筛出视觉动态确实反映 ego 动作的 world-model rollout，只保留这些 rollout 做稠密安全打分与场景级闭环 RL 后训练。在 nuScenes 与超过 130K 训练场景的内部数据上，安全违规分别下降 27.6%（DiffusionDrive）与 33.7%（Qwen3-VL）。
summary_sections.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略靠模仿学习训练，看不到自身动作的后果，闭环部署时出现因果混淆；现有 RL 后训练方案要么基于重建式模拟器、反事实交互有限，要么用合成模拟器换取长程闭环却带来 sim-to-real 差距，视频 world model 又可能不忠实响应动作条件（action-vision mismatch）。
summary_sections.method: 两阶段：先做模仿式策略预训练，并设计 Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator，用逆动力学估计加几何感知的辅助轨迹监督，长程判断视觉动态是否忠实于条件 ego 动作；再让 agent 与 world model 迭代交互生成长程场景 rollout，只保留 action-faithful 的 rollout 做稠密安全打分与场景级闭环 RL 后训练，作为即插即用模块接入不同 planner。
summary_sections.result: 在 nuScenes 上用 DiffusionDrive 安全违规降低 27.6%，在含超过 130K 训练场景的内部数据上用 Qwen3-VL 降低 33.7%；实验覆盖 nuScenes 与内部数据集，多个 planner 上均有一致增益。

papers.title: Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era
papers.abstract_en: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

TL;DR: 提出生成感知分层推理框架 GAHR，把内容是否由生成模型产生这一信号纳入新闻真实性推理，实现全局判定与局部纠错结合。配套构建面向生成内容场景的多模态假新闻数据集 Weibo26，在多个既有假新闻检测基准与 Weibo26 上同时取得有竞争力的真实性判定性能并有效识别生成内容。

papers.title: Does the Unsafe Gradient Survive a Conversation? On the Fragility of Gradient-Based Jailbreak Detection in Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned language models are commonly deployed as multi-turn assistants, which lets adversaries spread unsafe intent across several user turns instead of a single prompt. Gradient-based jailbreak detectors such as GradSafe were developed for single prompts: they score an input by the alignment between its induced gradient and a fixed unsafe reference direction, and their effectiveness in multi-turn dialogue remains unclear. We conduct a controlled evaluation of gradient-based jailbreak detection in multi-turn settings. We extend GradSafe with a Context Window Scanner that applies the detector to fixed-size windows of user turns and uses the maximum window score as the conversation-level score. We evaluate different window sizes, attack families, benign conversation distributions, and target models. The results differ sharply between synthetic and realistic benign settings. Against synthetic benign conversations, the detector achieves an ROC-AUC of 0.98 on human-authored multi-turn jailbreaks. On WildChat benign conversations, ROC-AUC drops to 0.76, and a threshold calibrated on synthetic data flags more than 90% of benign conversations as unsafe. Under realistic benign distributions, single-turn windows give the highest separability, whereas longer windows and accumulated contexts reduce performance. The detector is also sensitive to the attack-generation method and target model: successful Crescendo attacks receive scores comparable to or lower than benign conversations, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct yields near-random separability with a different optimal window size. These findings show that gradient-based signals can support multi-turn jailbreak detection, but reliable deployment requires calibration on realistic benign conversations, short-window scoring, length-aware thresholds, and evaluation across attack types and model architectures.

TL;DR: 把单 prompt 的梯度越狱检测器 GradSafe 扩展为 Context Window Scanner，在固定大小的用户轮次窗口上打分并取窗口最大值作为整段对话分数，用于多轮越狱检测。在合成良性对话上 ROC-AUC 达 0.98（人工撰写的多轮越狱），换成 WildChat 真实良性对话后降到 0.76，且用合成数据校准的阈值会把超过 90% 的良性对话误判为不安全。
Motivation: GradSafe 一类梯度检测器按输入梯度与固定不安全参考方向的对齐打分，只在单 prompt 上设计；多轮对话中攻击者可把意图拆散到多轮，其在真实良性分布下的有效性未知。
Method: 提出 Context Window Scanner：在固定大小的用户轮次窗口上运行 GradSafe，取各窗口分数最大值作为对话级分数；系统改变窗口大小、攻击家族、良性对话分布与目标模型进行受控评估。
Result: 合成良性对话上对人工多轮越狱 ROC-AUC 0.98；WildChat 良性对话上降至 0.76，合成数据校准的阈值把超过 90% 的良性对话标为不安全。真实良性分布下单轮窗口可分性最高，更长窗口与累积上下文反而降低性能；成功的 Crescendo 攻击得分与良性对话相当或更低，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上接近随机可分且最优窗口大小不同。
Conclusion: 梯度信号可支撑多轮越狱检测，但可靠部署必须在真实良性对话上校准、用短窗口打分、采用长度感知阈值，并跨攻击类型与模型架构评估。

papers.title: An Effective, Reliable, and Robust Framework for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) through wearable sensors greatly improves the quality of human life through its multiple applications. For HAR, multi-sensor channel information is vital for optimal performance. Current work states that applying an attention neural network to prioritize discriminatory sensor channels helps the model classify activity more precisely. However, obtaining discriminatory information from multisensory channels is not always trivial, such as when collecting data from older hospitalized patients. In this context, existing HAR methods struggle to classify activities, particularly activities with similar natures. Moreover, HAR models predominantly suffer from overfitting due to the small size of available datasets, which leads to poor performance. Data augmentation (DA) is a viable solution to this problem. However, available DA methods have various drawbacks, including the possibility of being domain-dependent, resulting in distorted models for test sequences. To address these HAR problems, we propose a novel framework, ALAE-TAE-CutMix+, which focuses on two aspects. First, it enhances the latent information across each sensor channel and learns to exploit the relation among multiple latent features and the ongoing activity. Consequently, the discriminatory feature representations of each activity is enriched. Second, a new augmentation strategy is introduced to address the shortcomings of existing multi-sensor channel data augmentation. We then extend the framework to create a further enhanced version, namely ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+, which learns to capture the interactions between the features of each pair of sensor channels. We find that although the first framework performs slightly better than the latter, the latter is nonetheless more reliable and robust. Both frameworks significantly outperform SOTA approaches on the four HAR datasets from diverse domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可穿戴传感器人体活动识别 (HAR) 框架 ALAE-TAE-CutMix+，增强各传感器通道的潜变量信息并学习其与当前活动的关系，同时引入新的多通道数据增强策略；扩展版 ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+ 进一步建模每对传感器通道间的特征交互。在四个来自不同领域的 HAR 数据集上，两个框架均显著超越 SOTA，其中前者精度略高、后者更可靠稳健。
Motivation: 住院老年人等场景下多传感器通道的判别信息难以获取，相似活动难以区分；可用数据集偏小导致 HAR 模型普遍过拟合，而现有数据增强方法可能依赖特定领域、造成测试序列上的模型失真。
Method: ALAE-TAE-CutMix+ 从两方面入手：增强每个传感器通道的潜变量信息并学习多潜变量特征与当前活动的关系以富化判别表示，同时提出新的多传感器通道数据增强策略以弥补现有 DA 的不足；扩展版 ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+ 额外学习每对传感器通道特征之间的交互。
Result: 两个框架在四个来自不同领域的 HAR 数据集上均显著超越 SOTA 方法；对比两者，ALAE-TAE-CutMix+ 表现略好，ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+ 则更可靠、更稳健。
Conclusion: 同时做通道内潜变量增强与通道间交互建模，配合新的多通道数据增强，可在小样本 HAR 上显著超过现有方法；精度与可靠稳健性之间存在取舍，需按部署场景在两个版本间选择。

papers.title: Automated Screw Planning for Reduced Pelvic Fractures Based on Statistical Shape Models and Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Percutaneous iliosacral screw fixation is an important minimally invasive treatment for unstable pelvic fractures. Because the sacroiliac region has complex anatomy and narrow screw corridors, the accuracy and safety of screw placement directly affect surgical outcomes. Accurate and reliable preoperative screw planning is therefore essential to improve surgical success and reduce intraoperative risks. Conventional preoperative planning typically requires surgeons to determine screw trajectories through manual measurements, a labor-intensive process that depends on subjective clinical experience. To address these challenges, we propose a fully automated pipeline for preoperative iliosacral screw planning in patients with pelvic fractures. Using patient-specific three-dimensional anatomy, the pipeline automatically identifies safe screw corridors and generates individualized insertion trajectories to support clinical preoperative planning. We evaluated the proposed pipeline on 200 clinical cases of pelvic fractures. Compared with conventional manual measurements, the safety margin of the safe insertion corridors increased by 2% across the four screw types, the mean planning time decreased by more than 90%, and the clinical acceptance rate reached 95%.

TL;DR: 提出全自动的骨盆骨折经皮骶髂螺钉术前规划流程：用患者特异三维解剖与统计形状模型 (statistical shape models)、深度学习自动识别安全螺钉通道并生成个体化置入轨迹。在 200 例骨盆骨折临床上，相比人工测量，四类螺钉的安全通道安全裕度提高 2%，平均规划时间下降超过 90%，临床接受率达 95%。

Method: 基于患者特异三维解剖，结合统计形状模型与深度学习构建全自动管线，自动识别安全螺钉通道并生成个体化置入轨迹，覆盖四类螺钉；在 200 例临床骨盆骨折病例上与常规人工测量对比评估。

Conclusion: 统计形状模型加深度学习的自动规划可以在缩短术前规划时间两个数量级的同时不牺牲、且略提升通道安全性，达到 95% 的临床接受率。

papers.title: DSWM: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal World Model for Demand-Driven UAV Base Station Repositioning
papers.abstract_en: Uncrewed aerial vehicle base stations (UAV-BSs) are expected to cover traffic demand that shifts across space and time, yet most repositioning schemes either re-solve an optimization problem per slot or learn reactive policies without an explicit demand model. We cast demand-driven fleet repositioning as latent-space decision-time planning and propose DSWM, a decomposed spatio-temporal world model: an agentic controller that perceives the demand field through a rolling observation window, retains operational context in a latent recurrent state, reasons about candidate motions by imagined rollouts under an uncertainty penalty, and coordinates the fleet through replanned first actions. DSWM learns a recurrent state-space model shaped by an exponential-moving-average (EMA) based latent predictive objective with variance regularization. It attaches a differentiable service simulator that replays the association, probabilistic line-of-sight channel, and Shannon rate chain inside latent rollouts. Planning uses a cross-entropy method whose imagined demand is anchored on the current observation window with mixing coefficient $ρ=0.95$. On a unified pipeline over three real datasets (Milan CDR (call detail record), Shanghai Telecom, YJMob100K) and 14 methods including five reproduced IEEE baselines, DSWM attains weekday served ratios of 0.889, 0.908, and 0.898, ranking first among non-ablated configurations on every dataset. On Milan it improves over the strongest non-learning baseline (Greedy, 0.780) by 0.109, a margin that comes from decision-time use of observations rather than prediction accuracy.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables, 2 algorithms. Submitted to IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications (Special Issue on Agentic AI for Intelligent Networks)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSWM 把 UAV 基站集群的需求驱动重定位建模为潜空间决策时规划：滚动观测窗口驱动 agentic controller，在 EMA 潜预测目标与方差正则训练的循环状态空间模型里做带不确定性惩罚的想象 rollout，并用可微服务仿真器回放关联、概率视距信道与 Shannon 速率链。在 Milan CDR、Shanghai Telecom、YJMob100K 三个真实数据集、14 种方法的统一流水线上，weekday served ratio 达 0.889/0.908/0.898，各数据集均列非消融配置第一；Milan 上比最强非学习基线 Greedy（0.780）高 0.109。
Motivation: 现有 UAV-BS 重定位方案要么每个时隙重新求解优化问题，要么学反应式策略而没有显式需求模型，难以应对时空迁移的业务需求。
Method: DSWM 由三部分组成：感知滚动观测窗口并维护潜循环状态的 agentic controller；以 EMA 潜预测目标加方差正则训练的循环状态空间模型；附着的可微服务仿真器在潜 rollout 内回放关联、probabilistic line-of-sight 信道与 Shannon 速率链。规划用 cross-entropy method，想象需求以当前观测窗口锚定，混合系数 ρ=0.95，并对不确定性加惩罚后输出重规划的首步动作协调整个机群。
Result: 在 Milan CDR、Shanghai Telecom、YJMob100K 三个真实数据集、含 5 个复现 IEEE 基线的 14 种方法统一流水线上，weekday served ratio 分别为 0.889、0.908、0.898，在每个数据集上均排非消融配置第一；Milan 上相对最强非学习基线 Greedy（0.780）提升 0.109，作者指出该增益来自决策时对观测的使用而非预测精度。
Conclusion: 把需求场显式建模并做决策时潜空间规划，可在 UAV-BS 重定位上稳定超过逐时隙优化与反应式策略；增益的关键是决策时利用观测，而非把需求预测做得更准。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE IROS 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Suhani92/GlassFormer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlassFormer 用毫米波雷达与 RGB-D 融合做透明表面实时分割：雷达在玻璃上强反射，与视觉/深度失效区形成跨模态不一致，据此生成雷达引导的空间先验，经 cross-modal attention 注入轻量 Transformer 分割网络。混合场景测试划分 mIoU 0.88，专门压测纯视觉方法的低光划分 0.59，同时保持资源受限平台上的实时性。
Motivation: RGB 看到的是玻璃背后的背景，LiDAR/ToF/RGB-D 在透明区常返回无效或背景值，机器人会把玻璃墙、门、镜子当成自由空间；现有方法依赖反射、边界等 RGB 视觉线索，在低光、眩光、无特征或遮挡下退化。
Method: 毫米波雷达与 RGB-D 多模态融合：利用雷达在玻璃表面的强反射与视觉/深度失效之间的跨模态不一致，生成雷达引导的空间先验，通过 cross-modal attention 融入轻量级基于 Transformer 的分割网络 GlassFormer。
Result: 在覆盖全部场景类型的 mixed-condition 测试划分上 mIoU 0.88；在专门设计来压测纯视觉方法的 low-light 划分上 mIoU 0.59；相对纯视觉基线取得显著鲁棒性提升，并在资源受限平台上保持实时性能。
Conclusion: 玻璃分割的失效根源是光学传感在透明区的系统性错误，把雷达几何线索作为先验注入分割网络可在低光等恶劣条件下保住精度与实时性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. This reference intervention improves later predictions in all nine model and task combinations and outperforms the best fitted editor in eight, yet its sustained gain decreases with horizon in five of nine combinations. Current fitted editors recover only limited and inconsistent long term effects. By restoring individual state components to their untouched values, we find that persistent effects travel through the newest generated frame in DIAMOND, recurrent memory in DreamerV3, and both in STORM. These findings suggest that training should reward future consequences. To test this hypothesis, we propose Delayed LoReFT, which optimizes the same low rank intervention through four frozen future transitions and improves sustained intervention effects to some extent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RolloutFaith 把世界模型的内部干预审计从“干预当下”扩展到“干预停止后的自主 rollout”，在固定事件、动作、噪声与信息预算下度量语义改善的持续性。Reference Activation Patching 用真实观测的配对激活替换模型激活，在 9 个模型-任务组合中全部改善后续预测、并在 8 个组合中胜过最好的 fitted editor，但其中 5 个组合的增益随 horizon 衰减；当前 fitted editor 的长期效应有限且不一致。持久效应的通路按模型而异：DIAMOND 走最新生成帧、DreamerV3 走循环记忆、STORM 两者兼有。
Motivation: 探针、activation patch 与 learned editor 只刻画模型当下的计算，而世界模型的预测会成为后续预测的输入，因此内部修正必须在编辑停止后仍然存活，现有可解释性工具无法度量这一持续性。
Method: RolloutFaith 在干预时刻与后续自主 rollout 两个层面度量语义改善，约束事件、动作、噪声与信息预算固定；用 Reference Activation Patching（以真实观测的配对激活替换模型激活）测出接口处可用的修正上限，并通过把单个状态分量恢复为未触碰值来定位持久效应的传播通路；再提出 Delayed LoReFT，让同一个 low-rank 干预穿过四个冻结的未来转移来优化。
Result: 在 Crafter、Cartpole、CoinRun 三个世界模型（DIAMOND、DreamerV3、STORM）上评测十个 fitted editor：Reference Activation Patching 在全部 9 个模型-任务组合中改善后续预测，在 8 个组合中优于最好的 fitted editor，但其持续增益在 9 个组合中的 5 个随 horizon 下降；fitted editor 只恢复有限且不一致的长期效应。Delayed LoReFT 在一定程度上提升了持续干预效果。
Conclusion: 训练目标应当奖励未来后果，而不只是干预当下的正确性；持久效应的载体随架构而变（DIAMOND 的最新生成帧、DreamerV3 的循环记忆、STORM 两者），干预设计需对应具体通路。

papers.title: Does the VGGT Family Need All Its Layers?
papers.abstract_en: Which layers of a feed-forward geometry model are needed to preserve both camera poses and dense 3D structure? We study layer redundancy in VGGT, $π^3$, and VGGT-$Ω$: 3,018 pruned configurations, scored on seven camera-pose and dense-geometry metrics across four indoor and outdoor datasets. Four findings follow: (i) Removable layers cluster in two redundancy regions: a dominant early region and a narrower late one, while deletions spanning the intervening layers are consistently more disruptive. This recurring pattern holds across models, datasets, and metrics, and contrasts with the middle-to-late redundancy commonly reported in the literature. (ii) Within these regions, we observe that the joint degradation from deleting two intervals is approximately the sum of their individual degradations, reducing the number of model evaluations for pruning search from $O(L^4)$ to $O(L^2)$, where $L$ is the aggregator depth. (iii) We find that CKA provides a cheaper representation-based proxy for interval degradation, offering a practical trade-off between pruning quality and calibration cost. (iv) Closed-form linear calibration recovers accuracy after pruning without end-to-end retraining. A least-squares analysis shows that using a shared map for special and patch tokens generally incurs excess reconstruction loss, motivating token-aware recovery. Recovery maps fitted on just 100 calibration scenes generalize to held-out scenes and unseen datasets. The resulting models reduce aggregator parameters by up to 44% while maintaining accuracy comparable to their intact counterparts. Code and experimental results will be available at our project page: https://xian-bei.github.io/vggt-family-layer-redundancy/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对前馈几何模型 VGGT、π³、VGGT-Ω 做层级冗余扫描，共 3,018 个剪枝配置、7 项相机位姿与稠密几何指标、4 个室内外数据集。可删层集中在早期主冗余区与较窄的晚期区，跨区间删除破坏更大；区间删除的联合退化近似可加，把剪枝搜索的模型评估量从 O(L⁴) 降到 O(L²)，配合 CKA 代理与闭式线性校准，聚合器参数最多减 44% 而精度与原模型相当。
Motivation: 前馈几何模型层数多、推理开销大，但哪些层真正承担相机位姿与稠密 3D 结构的计算并不清楚；已有文献报告的中后段冗余规律与实际删除行为可能不一致，且穷举剪枝搜索代价高昂。
Method: 在 VGGT、π³、VGGT-Ω 上枚举 3,018 个剪枝配置，用 7 项相机位姿与稠密几何指标在 4 个室内外数据集上打分；用 CKA 表示相似度作为区间退化的廉价代理；剪枝后用闭式最小二乘线性校准恢复精度，比较 special token 与 patch token 共用映射与 token-aware 恢复两种方案，校准仅用 100 个场景拟合。
Result: 可删层聚成早期主冗余区与较窄的晚期区，跨中间层的删除破坏性一致更大，该模式跨模型、数据集与指标复现，与文献常见的中后段冗余相反；区间删除的联合退化近似等于各自退化之和，剪枝搜索评估量由 O(L⁴) 降至 O(L²)；CKA 可作为更便宜的退化代理；共用线性映射对 special 与 patch token 产生额外重建损失；100 个校准场景拟合的恢复映射可泛化到留出场景与未见数据集；最终模型聚合器参数最多减少 44%，精度与完整模型相当。
Conclusion: VGGT 家族的层级冗余呈早期加晚期的双区结构而非中后段，且区间退化近似可加，因此剪枝搜索可降到 O(L²)；剪枝后用 token-aware 的闭式线性校准即可恢复精度，无需端到端重训练。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: On-Policy Visual Evidence Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Visual agents solve problems by interleaving reasoning with image operations, and on-policy distillation (OPD) provides guidance from a strong teacher on student-generated interaction trajectories. However, image operations change the evidence available for subsequent reasoning, so local errors in evidence acquisition (Acquire), reading (Read), or answer grounding (Ground) can propagate through the trajectory and lead to incorrect answers. Existing multimodal OPD methods primarily construct or contrast auxiliary views of the original image to strengthen supervision, without explicitly modeling the connections between student actions, resulting observations, and subsequent reasoning. This limits their ability to provide corrections tailored to different failure stages. We introduce Reflection on Visual Evidence (ReVuE), an on-policy distillation method for visual agents. ReVuE compares multiple student-generated trajectories for the same query, summarizes the observed visual evidence, and diagnoses the first failure across the Acquire, Read, and Ground stages. The resulting reflections provide training-time context for the teacher. We group and reweight token-level distillation losses according to how strongly these reflections affect the teacher's predictions. This design translates trajectory-level evidence diagnosis into targeted token-level supervision, guiding students to improve their visual evidence acquisition and reasoning. Across 11 benchmarks spanning the Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 model families, ReVuE outperforms all evaluated OPD baselines in weighted-average scores for perception, mathematical reasoning, and general tasks. ReVuE also reduces redundancy in reasoning and tool calls while improving tool-call accuracy and task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE

TL;DR: ReVuE 是面向视觉智能体的 on-policy 蒸馏方法：对同一问题比较学生多条交互轨迹，总结已观察到的视觉证据并定位首个失败环节（Acquire/Read/Ground），把该反思作为训练时上下文喂给教师，再按反思对教师预测的影响程度对 token 级蒸馏损失分组加权。在覆盖 Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL3.5 两个模型家族的 11 个 benchmark 上，其感知、数学推理与通用任务的加权平均分超过全部被评估的 OPD 基线，同时减少推理与工具调用冗余并提升工具调用准确率和任务准确率。
Motivation: 现有视觉 OPD 多是对原图构造或对比辅助视图来加强监督，没有显式建模学生动作、观测结果与后续推理之间的联系，因而无法针对 Acquire、Read、Ground 三个不同失败阶段给出差异化纠正，证据获取阶段的局部错误会沿轨迹传播成错误答案。

papers.title: You Cannot Recover What Was Never Measured: Quantifying the Information Ceiling of Ultra-Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Generative super-resolution models can turn portable 64 mT MRI into images that look like 3T scans, and the field evaluates them with PSNR, SSIM, and pixelwise uncertainty, most often on pairs built by synthetically degrading high-field images. Prior work acknowledges that these models hallucinate and that the problem is ill posed, but to our knowledge no study measures how much information about the individual subject the real low-field scan actually contains. We measure it. Using paired 64 mT and 3T scans of the same subjects from three public datasets, and a measurement protocol validated on tests whose correct answer is known in advance, we find that, judged over the whole brain, real 64 mT scans carry structure specific to the individual only down to approximately 3 to 4 mm half-pitch in plane, and coarser still through plane. Standard synthetic degradations preserve subject information roughly 1 mm beyond this ceiling, so models trained and benchmarked on synthetic pairs are evaluated on information that real scanners never record. We then test trained diffusion models and a publicly released external model on real paired acquisitions; 24 trained runs of five architectures (GAN, diffusion, and transformer families) give the coverage of the audit. On every subject where faithfulness can be measured, fine output detail is no more correlated with the subject's own 3T scan than with a stranger's, while sample-variance uncertainty does not distinguish fabricated structure from reconstruction difficulty. Because PSNR and SSIM score resemblance to a reference rather than whether detail belongs to the subject, a benchmark scored by them cannot tell recovery from fabrication. Code for the measurement protocol will be released so that recoverability claims can be tested for newer models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用同受试者 64 mT 与 3T 配对扫描量化超低场 MRI 超分辨的信息天花板：真实 64 mT 图像在全脑尺度上只保留到约 3–4 mm 半周期 (half-pitch) 的个体特异结构，层间更粗；标准合成退化比这一天花板多保留约 1 mm 个体信息，因此在合成退化对上训练与评测的模型测的是真实扫描从未记录的信息。在真实配对采集上，24 个训练 run、5 种架构（GAN、diffusion、transformer）的输出细节与本人 3T 的相关性不高于与陌生人 3T 的相关性，且 sample-variance 不确定度无法区分伪造结构与重建困难。
Motivation: 超低场 MRI 超分辨模型被指会幻觉且问题不适定，但此前没有研究测量真实低场扫描本身包含多少关于个体受试者的信息；而 PSNR、SSIM 与像素级不确定度评测的是与参考的相似度，无法区分恢复与伪造。
Method: 用三个公开数据集中同一受试者的配对 64 mT 与 3T 扫描，配合一套在答案预先已知的测试上验证过的测量协议，量化个体特异信息随空间频率的衰减；再把训练好的 diffusion 模型与一个公开发布的外部模型放到真实配对采集上测试，覆盖 5 种架构（GAN、diffusion、transformer）的 24 个训练 run。
Result: 全脑尺度上真实 64 mT 扫描的个体特异结构只到约 3–4 mm half-pitch（层间更粗）；标准合成退化比该天花板多保留约 1 mm 个体信息。在每个可测忠实度的受试者上，输出细节与其本人 3T 的相关性不高于与陌生人 3T 的相关性；sample-variance 不确定度不能区分伪造结构与重建难度。审计覆盖 5 种架构的 24 个训练 run。
Conclusion: PSNR/SSIM 衡量的是与参考的相似度而非细节是否属于该受试者，因此以它们打分的基准无法区分恢复与伪造；可恢复性主张应放到真实配对采集上、用作者将发布的测量协议来检验。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: ARC-KV: Amortizing Anchor Search for Reconstruction-Based KV Cache Compaction
papers.abstract_en: Long-context large language model inference is bottlenecked by KV caches that grow linearly with sequence length. This burden is especially severe for long, reusable context prefixes, whose cache must serve many downstream queries. Reconstruction-based methods such as Attention Matching achieve strong downstream task performance with compact KV caches. However, iterative anchor search dominates the compaction cost of OMP-based Attention Matching. This motivates our selective amortization principle of learning a reusable anchor-selection policy across contexts while retaining context-specific reconstruction. In this work, we propose ARC-KV, a novel reconstruction-based KV cache compaction method that follows this principle. To this end, we first train a value-aware indexer to select real-key anchors in a single scoring pass. ARC-KV then applies convex-hull-constrained key merging and fits an attention-mass bias and compact values against the full cache. At inference time, ARC-KV builds the compact cache once per context using the frozen indexer and reuses it for all subsequent queries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARC-KV outperforms reported compaction methods in most settings across QuALITY, RULER, and LongBench on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. In particular, at 10% KV retention on QuALITY, ARC-KV improves accuracy from 0.6409 to 0.6474 over Attention Matching while reducing compaction time by a factor of 25.73, from 959.8 s to 37.3 s.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARC-KV 把重建式 KV cache 压缩中的迭代 anchor 搜索换成一次前向的 value-aware indexer 打分，选出真实 key 作 anchor，再做凸包约束的 key 合并并拟合 attention-mass bias 与压缩 value，压缩结果按 context 只建一次、供后续所有 query 复用。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，QuALITY 10% KV 保留率时准确率 0.6409→0.6474，压缩时间 959.8 s→37.3 s（25.73 倍），并在 QuALITY、RULER、LongBench 多数设置上超过已报告的压缩方法。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理的 KV cache 随序列长度线性增长，可复用的长前缀要服务大量下游 query；重建式方法（如 Attention Matching）效果好，但基于 OMP 的迭代 anchor 搜索主导了压缩开销。
Method: 选择性摊销 (selective amortization)：跨 context 学一个可复用的 anchor 选择策略，同时保留 context 特定的重建。先训练 value-aware indexer 用单次打分选出真实 key anchor；再做凸包约束 (convex-hull-constrained) 的 key 合并，对 full cache 拟合 attention-mass bias 与压缩 value；推理时用冻结 indexer 每个 context 建一次压缩 cache 并复用。
Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，QuALITY、RULER、LongBench 多数设置优于已报告的压缩方法；QuALITY 10% KV 保留率下准确率从 0.6409 提到 0.6474（对比 Attention Matching），压缩时间从 959.8 s 降到 37.3 s，快 25.73 倍。
Conclusion: anchor 选择可以跨 context 摊销成一次打分，而重建保持 context 特定，从而在保持重建式压缩精度的同时把压缩开销降一个数量级以上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Motion Concept Unlearning in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can generate realistic depictions of actions such as kicking, stabbing, and shooting, raising safety concerns that motivate targeted concept erasure. Although concept erasure has been extensively studied for static concepts in text-to-image and T2V models, erasing motion concepts remains largely unexplored. We present a systematic study of motion concept erasure in video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). Through causal interventions, we show that text-conditioning attention carries concept-specific motion information and supports selective intervention, whereas perturbing temporal positional encoding suppresses both target and non-target dynamics. We further find that directly adapting ESD, a representative weight-level image erasure method, to a video DiT yields modest and uneven motion suppression: reducing its erasure training loss does not by itself remove the concept signal from the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which classifier-free guidance (CFG) then scales at every denoising step. From these findings, we derive three requirements for motion concept erasure: concept specificity, spatial selectivity, and temporal naturalness. Each determines one component of MUTE (Motion concept Unlearning in Text-to-video gEneration): at each denoising step, MUTE extracts a concept direction through token neutralization, derives a spatial gate from the direction's intrinsic structure, and subtracts the resulting correction from the velocity output before CFG is applied. MUTE is training-free and requires no weight modification. Experiments on 20 motion concepts show that MUTE outperforms representative prompt-level, weight-level, and inference-time baselines on Wan2.1-T2V, and the same formulation transfers to CogVideoX, supporting its applicability across distinct T2V attention architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. Dr. Chi Zhang is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视频扩散模型可生成踢打、持刀、射击等动作的安全问题，提出免训练的运动概念擦除方法 MUTE：在每个去噪步用 token 中和提取概念方向，由其内在结构生成空间门控，从 velocity 输出中减去修正后再做 CFG。在 20 个运动概念上，MUTE 在 Wan2.1-T2V 上优于 prompt 级、权重级与推理时基线，并可迁移到 CogVideoX。
Motivation: 概念擦除在文本到图像与 T2V 的静态概念上已被广泛研究，但运动概念的擦除基本空白；直接把权重级图像擦除方法 ESD 适配到视频 DiT 只能产生温和且不均匀的运动抑制。
Method: 因果干预显示 text-conditioning attention 携带概念特异的运动信息、可选择性干预，而扰动 temporal positional encoding 会同时压制目标与非目标动态；据此 MUTE 在每个去噪步用 token 中和提取概念方向，从方向的内在结构导出空间门控，从 velocity 输出中减去修正，且在 CFG 之前执行，全程免训练、不改权重。
Result: 在 20 个运动概念上，MUTE 在 Wan2.1-T2V 上优于代表性的 prompt 级、权重 级与推理时基线，同一形式可迁移到 CogVideoX；直接适配 ESD 时降低其擦除训练 loss 并不能从条件与无条件预测之差中移除概念信号，而 CFG 会在每个去噪步放大该信号。
Conclusion: 运动概念擦除需要同时满足概念特异性、空间选择性与时间自然性三条要求，且应在 CFG 之前对 velocity 输出做免训练干预，而非改权重或压 loss；该形式可跨不同 T2V 注意力架构适用。

papers.title: Where Does Staleness Accumulate? Pool Aware Effective Staleness Control for Asynchronous RL in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves resource utilization in large language model post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but it also introduces policy lag as trajectories are generated and queued while the trainer continues to update. We study how this lag accumulates over a trajectory's lifetime and how it can be controlled without sacrificing the wall-clock benefits of asynchronous execution. We decompose trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness, accumulated before rollout completion, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated after a completed trajectory enters the pool. Motivated by this decomposition, we introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks completed trajectories using an effective-staleness score that combines Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness. This avoids penalizing long or interrupted rollouts solely because they span multiple policy versions. In single-turn mathematical reasoning, PACE improves the six-benchmark average validation accuracy by 18.7\% over unfiltered asynchronous RL at the same wall-clock budget and matches synchronous RL performance with 47.1\% less GPU time. PACE also improves validation performance in multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning, outperforming both synchronous and unfiltered asynchronous RL. TL;DR: PACE 把异步 RL 的轨迹陈旧度拆成 rollout 完成前累积的 Generation Staleness 与入池后累积的 Waiting Staleness，用池占用折算成自适应拒绝预算，再按结合两者的有效陈旧度分数排序轨迹。在单轮数学推理上，同等 wall-clock 预算下六基准平均验证准确率比未过滤异步 RL 高 18.7%，并以少 47.1% GPU 时间追平同步 RL。
Motivation: 异步 RL 让 rollout 生成与策略更新重叠以提升资源利用率，但轨迹在排队期间策略持续更新产生 policy lag，过滤陈旧样本又会牺牲异步的 wall-clock 收益。
Method: PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness)：将轨迹陈旧度分解为 Generation Staleness 与 Waiting Staleness，把超出的池占用转为自适应拒绝预算，并用结合 Waiting Staleness 与前缀感知 Generation Staleness 的有效陈旧度分数对已完成轨迹排序，避免仅因跨越多个策略版本而惩罚长或中断的 rollout。

Conclusion: 按池占用与前缀感知的有效陈旧度来过滤轨迹，可以在不牺牲异步 wall-clock 收益的前提下控制 policy lag，且跨模型架构与训练算法适用。

papers.title: The Default Trap: Rethinking Plan Evaluation in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: An executor can respond strongly to a change in a supplied plan's priority while showing a small change in the same information-selection probability when a default-aligned whole plan is removed. We call the risk of interpreting the latter as weak responsiveness to alternative priorities the default trap. We compare paired plans that prioritize different information targets with a shared no-plan reference. An accounting identity relates these distinct behavioral contrasts. Across 3,200 decision windows on 160 selected Retail, Airline, and AgentDojo tasks, switching priorities strongly redirects two models' choices, while the two plan-versus-default contrasts differ. In 2,160 additional windows, reversing account-list order shifts default target selection by 63.3-98.3 percentage points; priority-switching effects remain 96.7-100.0 points in either order. A separate 3,240-window component study finds strong control under single priority sentences, with effects of additional text varying by group and direction. Finally, 1,080 full-task episodes yield observed success differences of -19.4 to +8.3 points relative to no plan. All Retail and Airline success intervals include zero; AgentDojo results describe four fixed application worlds. These findings support joint reporting of priority responsiveness, presentation-dependent defaults, and task success and cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工具使用 LLM agent 中，把「默认对齐的整套计划被移除后信息选择概率变化很小」当作对其他优先级不敏感是错的：切换计划优先级会强烈改写模型选择，而计划对默认的两个对比由一个会计恒等式联系。作者主张同时报告优先级响应性、呈现依赖的默认效应与任务成功率。
Motivation: 执行器对计划优先级变化反应强，却在默认对齐计划被移除时只小幅改变选择；把后者误读为对替代优先级响应弱，会系统性误判计划干预的效果。
Method: 配对两套指向不同信息目标的计划并共享一个 no-plan 参照，用一个会计恒等式联系两类对比；在 Retail、Airline、AgentDojo 任务上做决策窗口实验，另设账户列表顺序反转与单句优先级的组件研究。
Result: 3,200 个决策窗口、160 个任务上切换优先级强烈改写两个模型的选择，而两个计划对默认的对比不同；2,160 个窗口中反转账户列表顺序使默认目标选择移动 63.3–98.3 个百分点，优先级切换效应在两种顺序下保持 96.7–100.0 个百分点；3,240 窗口的组件研究显示单句优先级控制强，附加文本的效应随组别与方向变化；1,080 个完整任务 episode 中相对 no plan 的成功率差异为 -19.4 至 +8.3 个百分点，Retail 与 Airline 的区间都含零。
Conclusion: 计划评估必须联合报告优先级响应性、呈现依赖的默认效应与任务成功和成本，单看计划对默认的差异会得出错误结论；AgentDojo 结果只描述四个固定应用世界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Calibrate the Decisions That Change the Future: On-Policy Post-Training Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) lowers deployment cost for multimodal large language models, but calibration typically reconstructs fixed sequences with local objectives. This overlooks autoregressive feedback: a quantization-induced token change redirects the prefix and changes future states. Yet on-policy coverage alone is insufficient because many decision mismatches barely affect future generation. We propose OnPTQ, an on-policy framework that calibrates on trajectories visited by the current quantized policy. On shared prefixes, OnPTQ identifies quantization-eroded boundaries, evaluates competing tokens through short counterfactual rollouts, and combines current discrepancy with branch consequence into a Decision--Consequence risk. The risk prioritizes critical states, while context anchoring and trajectory refresh preserve multimodal behavior and keep calibration aligned with the updated policy. We further derive a Decision--Consequence bound linking behavioral deviation to current policy discrepancy and action-conditioned future-value span. Across vision--language and omni-modal Qwen models under multiple low-bit settings, OnPTQ improves downstream performance and yields fewer correctness flips against the corresponding Dense/FP16 references, without changing the deployed inference graph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OnPTQ 把多模态大模型的 PTQ 校准放到当前量化策略实际访问的轨迹上：在共享前缀处定位被量化侵蚀的 token 边界，用短反事实 rollout 评估竞争 token，把当前偏差与分支后果合成 Decision–Consequence 风险来排序关键状态。在多种低位宽设置下的 vision–language 与 omni-modal Qwen 模型上，它提升下游性能并相对 Dense/FP16 参考产生更少的 correctness flip，且不改动部署推理图。
Motivation: 常规 PTQ 校准用固定序列加局部目标重建，忽略自回归反馈：量化引起的 token 改变会改写前缀并改变后续状态；而单纯 on-policy 覆盖也不够，因为多数决策失配对未来生成几乎无影响。
Method: OnPTQ 在当前量化策略访问的轨迹上校准；在共享前缀处识别量化侵蚀的边界，对竞争 token 做短反事实 rollout，将当前偏差与分支后果组合为 Decision–Consequence 风险以优先关键状态；配合 context anchoring 与 trajectory refresh 保持多模态行为并与更新后的策略对齐；另推导一个 Decision–Consequence 界，把行为偏差与当前策略失配及动作条件化的未来价值跨度联系起来。
Result: 在多种低位宽设置下的 vision–language 与 omni-modal Qwen 模型上，OnPTQ 改善下游性能，相对对应 Dense/FP16 参考的 correctness flip 更少，且不改变部署推理图。
Conclusion: 量化校准应按决策对未来生成的后果加权，而不只按局部重建误差；带 Decision–Consequence 界的 on-policy 校准能在不改推理图的前提下降低行为偏差。

papers.title: Learning via Self-Consistency for Diffusion-based Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models have demonstrated emerging zero-shot capabilities for visual reasoning, perception, and other vision tasks. However, diffusion-based video generation is inherently stochastic, while many downstream vision tasks are deterministic. Motivated by the effectiveness of self-consistency in chain-of-thought reasoning for large language models, we investigate whether self-consistency can similarly improve diffusion-based video reasoning. We first introduce a training-free test-time scaling method that samples multiple video generations and aggregates their predictions through self-consistency. Specifically, we aggregate extracted paths, locations, or masks from multiple rollouts into a consensus prediction. To reduce the inference overhead of multi-rollout generation, we read out predictions early in the denoising trajectory, which preserves consensus quality while reducing denoising steps by more than half. We further propose Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) to distill consensus predictions into the video generation model. The resulting model internalizes the benefit of multi-sample consensus and requires only a single generation at inference time, while substantially outperforming the original model. Experiments on three tasks, including maze solving, visual search, and referring segmentation, show that both our self-consistency inference and consensus distillation dramatically improve video-based perception and reasoning, without requiring ground-truth videos or task-specific verification. For visual search, self-consistency raises task accuracy from 48.4% for a single generation to 99.0%. The distilled model retains much of the consensus benefit with a single rollout. For 4-by-4 maze solving, consensus-based training improves the single-generation strict success rate from 72.0% to 84.0% with the same inference latency.
papers.comment: 23 pages, including 10 pages for the main body
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 的 self-consistency 思路搬到扩散式视频推理：多次采样视频 rollout，把抽出的路径、位置或掩码聚合成共识预测，并在去噪轨迹早期读出以砍掉一半以上去噪步数；再用 Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) 把共识蒸馏回模型，使单次生成即可保留大部分收益。视觉搜索任务准确率从单次生成的 48.4% 提到 99.0%，4×4 迷宫单次严格成功率从 72.0% 提到 84.0% 且推理延迟不变。
Motivation: 扩散式视频生成本质上随机，而下游视觉任务多为确定性求解，单次采样的预测方差直接变成任务误差；LLM 里 self-consistency 能缓解这一问题，但尚未验证是否适用于扩散视频推理。
Method: 先提出免训练的测试时扩展：多次 rollout 生成视频，从中抽取路径、位置或掩码并聚合为共识预测，且在去噪轨迹早期读出以减少一半以上去噪步数；再提出 Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT)，把共识预测蒸馏进视频生成模型，推理时只需单次生成。
Result: 在 maze solving、visual search、referring segmentation 三个任务上，视觉搜索准确率由单次生成 48.4% 升至 99.0%；4×4 迷宫单次严格成功率由 72.0% 升至 84.0%，且推理延迟相同；早期读出在保留共识质量的同时将去噪步数减少一半以上，全程无需 ground-truth 视频或任务专用验证器。
Conclusion: 多采样共识既能作为免训练的测试时扩展直接提升扩散视频推理，也能经 RFT 蒸馏进模型，使单次生成在相同延迟下显著超过原模型。

papers.title: RED: Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of image generators calls for forensic cues that generalize beyond known generation mechanisms. Existing detectors often rely on static image representations or endpoint reconstruction discrepancies, leaving the evolution of intermediate reconstruction stages underexplored. We observe that the relative token predictability of real and generated images can reverse across reconstruction scales, suggesting that intermediate stages may expose forensic evidence overlooked by endpoint comparisons. Motivated by this observation, we propose RED (Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics), a framework that captures transferable forensic cues from coarse-to-fine reconstruction evolution. To our knowledge, RED is the first framework to use scale-wise token predictability to guide forensic evidence aggregation across intermediate reconstruction states. It represents the reconstruction trajectory produced by a frozen multiscale VQ-VAE in the shared feature space of a frozen CLIP encoder. To connect the observed predictability variations with visual evidence, RED learns image-adaptive stage weights from scale-wise token negative log-likelihoods provided by a frozen VAR model. A cross-stage evidence aggregation module then jointly models the original-image representation and the weighted reconstruction features, capturing complementary forensic cues through interactions along the reconstruction trajectory. Experiments on six diverse benchmarks demonstrate that RED achieves the highest average accuracy of 92.5\% and average precision of 97.5\% among the evaluated methods. Further evaluations show strong robustness to common image degradations, supporting the value of reconstruction evolution for generalizable AI-generated image detection. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RED 用冻结的多尺度 VQ-VAE 生成由粗到细的重建轨迹，并用尺度级 token 可预测性反转这一观察来定位中间阶段的取证证据。冻结 VAR 给出的各尺度 token 负对数似然被转成图像自适应的阶段权重，再由跨阶段聚合模块联合建模原图表示与加权重建特征。在六个基准上 RED 平均准确率 92.5%、平均精度 97.5%，为所评估方法中最高，且对常见图像退化稳健。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器依赖静态表示或只比较重建端点，中间重建阶段的演化信息被忽略，导致对未见过的生成机制泛化能力不足。
Method: RED (Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics)：用冻结多尺度 VQ-VAE 产出重建轨迹并映射到冻结 CLIP 编码器的共享特征空间；用冻结 VAR 模型的尺度级 token 负对数似然学习图像自适应阶段权重；跨阶段证据聚合模块联合建模原图表示与加权重建特征，沿轨迹交互提取互补取证线索。
Result: 在六个多样基准上，RED 平均准确率 92.5%、平均精度 97.5%，在所评估方法中最高；进一步评测显示对常见图像退化具有强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 中间重建阶段的演化动态（而非仅端点差异）包含可迁移的取证证据，尺度级 token 可预测性可作为聚合这些证据的通用线索。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CorrGRPO: Correlation-Normalized GRPO for Multi-Reward Learning
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to train reasoning language models, where it computes advantages by centering and normalizing rewards across rollouts of the same prompt. For multiple rewards, GRPO sums the reward components and normalizes the total reward by its within-group standard deviation. The corresponding variance equals the sum of all pairwise reward covariances. For a fixed centered reward, larger aggregate covariance produces smaller advantages, and vice versa, allowing update magnitudes to adapt to reward dependence. However, correlated rewards with large scales can dominate this normalization and suppress signals from smaller-scale rewards. We propose Correlation-Normalized GRPO (CorrGRPO), which normalizes pairwise covariances into Pearson correlation coefficients. CorrGRPO keeps the centered total reward unchanged while balancing the influence of differently scaled rewards on the correlation-based normalization. This allows advantage magnitudes to adapt to reward correlations without the normalization being dominated by large-scale reward components. We compare CorrGRPO with GRPO and other variants on code generation, tool calling, and agent security, using models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters. These tasks all involve multiple rewards that can improve together or present tradeoffs. Results show improvements across three domains, including code generation, tool calling, and agent security. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CorrGRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多奖励 GRPO 用组内标准差归一化总奖励，方差等于所有两两奖励协方差之和，大尺度且相关的奖励会主导归一化、压低小尺度奖励的信号。CorrGRPO 把两两协方差归一化成 Pearson 相关系数，保持中心化总奖励不变，只让优势幅度随奖励相关性自适应而不被大尺度分量支配。在 0.5B–8B 模型的代码生成、工具调用、agent 安全三类多奖励任务上均带来提升。
Motivation: 多奖励 GRPO 的组内标准差归一化中，奖励间协方差与尺度差异会让大尺度相关奖励主导优势幅度，小尺度奖励的梯度信号被抑制。
Method: CorrGRPO 将总奖励方差中的两两协方差替换为 Pearson 相关系数，中心化总奖励保持不变，从而在归一化中平衡不同尺度奖励的影响；与 GRPO 及其他变体在代码生成、工具调用、agent 安全三个多奖励任务上对比，模型规模 0.5B 到 8B。
Result: 在代码生成、工具调用、agent 安全三个领域相对 GRPO 及其他变体均取得提升，覆盖 0.5B–8B 参数模型；这些任务的多奖励或可同向改善或存在权衡。

papers.title: Towards Better Training Signal: Advantage Clipped Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but the need for on-policy data substantially limits training efficiency. Reusing off-policy data through importance sampling (IS) can improve efficiency but introduce considerable instability. Hence, algorithms such as PPO and GRPO widely adopt IS-ratio clipping to stabilize training. However, training stability and gradient estimate are mainly determined by the product of IS ratio and advantage. To further stabilize training, we propose ACPO, which clips the product of the IS ratio and the advantage, leading to more stable gradient estimates. We also establish a connection between ACPO and gradient clipping in policy mirror descent (PMD), which is a standard technique to stabilize optimization process, and prove the convergence of clipped-PMD under the standard RL setting. Experiments on widely used mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ACPO consistently outperforms PPO and GRPO in both accuracy and training efficiency, delivering 4-6 percentage points gains on standard math benchmarks, with Qwen3-8B+PPO. Hence, ACPO is a practical and effective alternative to conventional IS-ratio clipping for RL post-training of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ACPO：把重要性采样比与优势的乘积整体做裁剪，而非只裁 IS 比，以得到更稳定的梯度估计。该方法与 policy mirror descent 中的梯度裁剪建立联系并证明 clipped-PMD 在标准 RL 设定下收敛；在数学推理基准上较 PPO、GRPO 同时提升准确率与训练效率，Qwen3-8B+PPO 上取得 4–6 个百分点提升。
Motivation: LLM 的 RL 后训练依赖 on-policy 数据，限制训练效率；用重要性采样复用 off-policy 数据虽提效却带来明显不稳定，而 PPO/GRPO 只裁 IS 比，忽略了真正决定梯度的 IS 比与优势的乘积。
Method: ACPO 对 IS ratio × advantage 的乘积做裁剪以稳定梯度估计；理论上将其与 policy mirror descent (PMD) 中的梯度裁剪关联，并证明 clipped-PMD 在标准 RL 设定下的收敛性。
Result: 在常用数学推理基准上，ACPO 在准确率与训练效率两方面均优于 PPO 与 GRPO，取得 4–6 个百分点的提升（Qwen3-8B+PPO）。
Conclusion: 裁剪 IS 比与优势的乘积是比传统 IS-ratio clipping 更实用有效的 LLM RL 后训练方案，且有 clipped-PMD 收敛性支撑。

papers.title: CurvSpec: Adaptive Multi-Curvature Learning for Partial Relevant Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) seeks to retrieve untrim-med videos containing a moment that matches a text query, without temporal annotations. The relevant moment may last only seconds within a video spanning several minutes, creating an extremely low signal-to-noise ratio that makes PRVR more challenging than standard full-video retrieval. This task presents two intertwined challenges: (1) signal dilution, where coarse global representations blur the brief relevant signal into the dominant irrelevant surroundings;(2) curvature rigidity, where embedding all videos in the same fixed-geometry space distorts representations for videos that range from flat atomic events to deep compositional hierarchies. Existing PRVR methods have improved moment selection and cross-modal matching, but they still typically encode all videos in a single fixed-curvature retrieval space, limiting their ability to model diverse video structures. To address both challenges, we propose CurvSpec, a framework that learns content-adaptive curvature for video retrieval representations rather than imposing a fixed geometric prior. CurvSpec processes features through parallel Euclidean and hyperbolic attention layers, with independently learned curvatures assigned to the hyperbolic layers, and a content-aware fusion mechanism routes each input to its most suitable geometric regime. To further suppress signal dilution, CurvSpec represents each video with semantic centroids whose number is determined by the video's content complexity, projects them onto the learned manifold, and matches each query against its nearest centroid by geodesic distance. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions, TVR, and Charades-STA demonstrate state-of-the-art retrieval performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CurvSpec 为部分相关视频检索 (PRVR) 学习内容自适应曲率：并行的 Euclidean 与 hyperbolic attention 层各带独立可学曲率，由内容感知融合把每段视频路由到合适几何 regime，并用数量随内容复杂度变化的语义质心在学习到的流形上按测地距离匹配查询。在 ActivityNet Captions、TVR、Charades-STA 上报告 SOTA 检索性能。
Motivation: PRVR 中相关片段可能只占几分钟视频里的几秒，信噪比极低：粗粒度全局表征会把短暂信号稀释掉，而把所有视频嵌入同一固定曲率空间会扭曲从扁平原子事件到深层组合层级的多样结构。
Method: 特征先过并行 Euclidean 与 hyperbolic attention 层，hyperbolic 层曲率各自独立学习，再由 content-aware fusion 机制把每个输入路由到最合适的几何 regime；每段视频用数量由内容复杂度决定的语义质心表示，投影到学习到的流形上，查询按 geodesic distance 匹配最近质心，以抑制 signal dilution。
Result: 在 ActivityNet Captions、TVR、Charades-STA 三个检索基准上展示了 state-of-the-art 的检索性能。
Conclusion: 放弃固定几何先验、按内容自适应地学习曲率并配合复杂度自适应的质心表示，是提升部分相关视频检索效果的有效路径。

papers.title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RESCUE 把可解释性里的稀疏电路分析从「能力」扩展到「错误」：先定位与任务失败相关的电路，再用带掩码模型多次 rollout 的强化学习精修掩码，最后剪枝并只微调这些错误电路。在数学推理上把 1.40% 密度的 math error circuit 修复后准确率从 6.0% 升到 75.5%，医学 QA 上 1.44% 密度电路把修复集准确率从 0% 提到 81%。
Motivation: 现有电路研究主要关注保持功能或解释安全，跨任务失败背后的内部机制很少被触及；而多步推理与长文本生成中早期偏离会让前缀漂移，基于 SFT 的掩码优化会漏掉生成期出错的电路。
Method: RESCUE（Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing）分三步：定位错误相关电路；用多个 masked-model rollouts 的强化学习精修掩码，使其更贴合观测到的任务失败；引入剪枝技术并精确微调错误电路，把错误定位转成稀疏定向的模型更新。
Result: 数学推理上识别出密度 1.40% 的 math error circuit，修复后准确率 6.0% → 75.5%；医学 QA 上密度 1.44% 的电路使修复集准确率 0% → 81%。验证覆盖两个领域的异构修复集。
Conclusion: 跨任务失败可被定位为可编辑的稀疏内部电路，对这些电路做外科式微调能在保持其他能力的同时把准确率大幅拉回。

papers.title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PReFlow 把 critic 式 proposal 选择与条件 refinement flow 结合做离线 RL 策略提取：KL 正则目标的最优解是高斯平滑行为先验下的 Gibbs 策略，proposal 中心的高斯参考既允许同一 proposal 表示多个高价值分离模态，又限制动作大改。在 50 个 OGBench 任务上取得有竞争力的离线性能，且在线微调后聚合分最高，500K 环境步后达到 91%。
Motivation: 对 diffusion/flow 策略施加相对行为策略的 KL 惩罚会压制 critic 值高但行为密度低的动作；而直接精修行为 proposal 时，高斯或确定性编辑器无法表达同一 proposal 对应的多个分离模态。
Method: PReFlow 由 critic-based proposal selection 与 conditional refinement flow 组成，用一个 KL 正则目标联合优化选择与精修，其最优解在高斯平滑行为先验下诱导出最终动作上的 Gibbs 策略；以 proposal 中心的高斯参考约束大动作改动，并利用该高斯参考从采样端点与 critic 梯度得到 simulation-free 的闭式 adjoint matching 目标，退化为单一 velocity regression 损失，无需反向 adjoint 求解。
Result: 在 50 个 OGBench 任务上，PReFlow 离线性能有竞争力；在线微调后在所比较方法中取得最高聚合分，500K 环境步后达到 91%。
Conclusion: 把 proposal 选择与精修放进同一个 KL 正则目标、并用高斯参考换取闭式匹配目标，可以在离线 RL 中同时保住高 critic 值的稀疏动作与多模态动作分布，并在在线微调后领先。

papers.title: MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model
papers.abstract_en: Video world models aim to predict future content from an observed scene while following prescribed camera motion. Real-world scene evolution is determined not only by changes in viewpoint and object dynamics, but also by environmental conditions such as weather, which can substantially alter scene appearance and visibility. Modeling such realistic weather evolution is challenging because the required weather modification depends jointly on the observed and desired weather states. Depending on their relation, the model may need to preserve, introduce, or remove a weather effect. Existing video world models typically leave this weather transition implicit, forcing the generation backbone to infer weather evolution together with scene dynamics and camera motion, which leads to imprecise weather control. To address this limitation, we propose MeteoVerse, a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single sunny or adverse-weather image, conditioned on a weather-free scene description, a target-weather instruction, and a camera trajectory. Rather than conditioning only on the desired weather, MeteoVerse explicitly estimates the observed and target weather states and represents the required weather transition. A transition-aware mixture of weather experts then translates this transition into category-specific residual weather features, unifying weather preservation, introduction, and removal while enabling fine-grained control over introduced weather intensity. We further construct the MeteoVerse dataset with over 50K real-world weather video clips, generated sunny counterparts, disentangled scene and weather descriptions, weather-intensity annotations, and camera trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantially improved weather controllability while retaining competitive scene consistency and camera-control performance.

TL;DR: MeteoVerse 把天气变化显式建模为“观测天气态→目标天气态”的转移，用天气专家混合 (mixture of weather experts) 把该转移翻译成分天气类别的残差特征，从而在单一晴天或恶劣天气图像上统一实现天气的保留、引入与移除，并可细粒度控制引入强度。构建了含 50K+ 真实天气视频片段的 MeteoVerse 数据集，实验显示天气可控性显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的场景一致性与相机控制表现。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型把天气过渡隐式交给生成骨干，与场景动态、相机运动混在一起推断，导致天气控制不精确；而真实场景演化同时受视角、物体动态和天气条件共同决定。
Method: 输入单张晴天或恶劣天气图像，条件为无天气场景描述、目标天气指令与相机轨迹；显式估计观测与目标天气状态并表示所需天气转移，再由 transition-aware mixture of weather experts 将其转为类别特定的残差天气特征，统一处理天气保留、引入与移除。同时构建 MeteoVerse 数据集，含 50K+ 真实天气视频片段、生成的晴天对应片段、解耦的场景与天气描述、天气强度标注和相机轨迹。
Result: 在 MeteoVerse 数据集上的大量实验中，天气可控性较现有视频世界模型显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的场景一致性与相机控制性能；数据集规模为 50K+ 真实天气视频片段。
Conclusion: 把天气转移作为显式中间量并交由分天气类别的专家残差特征去实现，比让生成骨干隐式推断天气演化更能做到细粒度、可保留/引入/移除的天气控制。

papers.title: Geometry-Conditioned Fixed-Scaffold Encoders for Time-Warp Robust Sequence Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Embedding-based retrieval is attractive for long sequence collections because each item can be encoded once and searched by nearest-neighbor ranking. The difficulty is that the objects being indexed are often observed under a noncanonical clock: cardiac cycles stretch with rate, speech changes with tempo, and sensor traces reach comparable states at different speeds. This paper studies a specific source of instability in patch-based encoders for this regime. If patch boundaries are chosen from signal geometry, then the tokenization can change under the same temporal deformation that the representation is expected to tolerate. We propose GeoPatch, a fixed-scaffold patch encoder that keeps token support independent of geometry and uses slope, curvature, acceleration, affine-residual, and confidence descriptors only as continuous conditioning variables. The design turns boundary variation into feature modulation: geometry can change the embedding through a controlled pathway, but it cannot change the number, order, or support of local tokens. We formalize this distinction through a mechanism-level stability analysis that separates boundary drift, affine timing variation, confidence-weighted geometry perturbation, and retrieval-margin effects. The same local tokens support global embedding retrieval and late-interaction scoring, so the scoring rule can be matched to the evaluation protocol. Across ECG, speech, and multivariate time-series retrieval tasks, GeoPatch improves early-rank retrieval under timing variation while exposing a clear trade-off between local surface matching and strict non-overlap retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoPatch 把 patch 边界固定在与信号几何无关的脚手架上，只把 slope、curvature、acceleration、affine-residual、confidence 描述子当作连续条件变量调制特征，使时间形变只能通过受控通路影响 embedding，而不能改变 token 的数量、顺序与支撑。在 ECG、语音与多变量时间序列检索任务上，它在 timing variation 下改善 early-rank 检索，同时暴露局部表面匹配与严格 non-overlap 检索之间的明确取舍。
Motivation: 基于 embedding 的长序列检索要求每个条目只编码一次，但心脏周期随速率伸缩、语音随 tempo 变化、传感器轨迹以不同速度到达相同状态；若 patch 边界由信号几何决定，tokenization 会随表示本应容忍的同一时间形变而改变，检索排序因此不稳定。
Method: 提出固定脚手架 patch 编码器 GeoPatch：token 支撑与几何解耦，slope、curvature、acceleration、affine-residual、confidence 描述子仅作为连续条件变量，把边界变化转成特征调制；配套做机制级稳定性分析，分离 boundary drift、affine timing variation、confidence-weighted geometry perturbation 与 retrieval-margin 效应；同一组局部 token 同时支持全局 embedding 检索与 late-interaction scoring，使打分规则可对齐评测协议。
Result: 在 ECG、speech、多变量时间序列三类检索任务上，GeoPatch 在 timing variation 下改善 early-rank 检索，并给出局部表面匹配与严格 non-overlap 检索之间的清晰取舍；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 让 token 支撑与几何脱钩、把几何降级为受控的特征调制通路，是时变序列编码器在时间形变下保持检索排序稳定的可行设计，但局部表面匹配与严格不重叠检索不可兼得。

papers.title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
papers.abstract_en: Current embodied models do not respond to their own failures, although what just went wrong could inform a small adjustment on the next attempt, the kind of reflection behind the gains of thinking in language models. We test whether they can repair a known error, which requires producing a correction and judging whether it is right. Stopped at a failure and allowed to retry, they seldom repair it through their own randomness or from a language description of the error, and best-of-N selection cannot pick the successful candidate after a failure. We attribute this to training only on successful demonstrations and to inputs too narrow to show what went wrong, and conclude that reflection must come from a vision-language model (VLM), which takes in far more information, such as the episode history and text, and is more general. Prior VLM-led work has the VLM plan every step and invoke the embodied model as a tool, placing the VLM on the critical path. We propose Spotter, which reverses the roles: the embodied model leads and executes continuously, while the VLM runs in parallel, monitors through a lightweight local screener, intervenes only when an error is detected, reflects on and corrects it, and returns control. We run Spotter with Qwen and with GPT as the VLM, and both improve the embodied models; with GPT, Spotter improves Cosmos Policy and $π_{0.5}$ by 5.6 and 7.5 percentage points on RoboCasa, and raises $π_{0.5}$ from 47.2% to 57.0% on the Hard setting of RoboTwin 2.0 and from 53% to 83% on a real robot. Because the VLM steps in only when an error is confirmed, a successful episode with Qwen takes only 13 to 16 s longer than with the embodied model alone and about 70% less time than with a VLM-led baseline using the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/zqc3117/Spotter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spotter 把具身模型放在执行主循环上，让 VLM 并行监视、只在轻量筛查器确认出错时才介入反思并交还控制权，从而让具身模型自己修复已知错误。以 GPT 为 VLM 时，RoboCasa 上 Cosmos Policy 与 π0.5 分别提升 5.6 和 7.5 个百分点，RoboTwin 2.0 Hard 从 47.2% 升到 57.0%，真机从 53% 升到 83%；成功回合仅比具身模型单独运行多 13–16 秒，约为同模型 VLM 主导基线耗时的 30%。
Motivation: 具身模型在失败后不会自我反思：靠自身随机性重试或语言描述错误都很少修复，best-of-N 也无法在失败后挑出成功候选，根因是只用成功示范训练且输入过窄。
Method: Spotter 反转角色：具身模型连续主导执行，VLM（Qwen 或 GPT）并行运行，经轻量局部筛查器 (local screener) 监视，仅在检测到错误时介入、反思并纠正，再把控制权交回；对照 VLM 主导逐步规划的基线。
Result: 以 GPT 为 VLM：RoboCasa 上 Cosmos Policy 与 π0.5 分别提升 5.6 与 7.5 个百分点；RoboTwin 2.0 Hard 上 π0.5 从 47.2% 升至 57.0%；真机上从 53% 升至 83%。Qwen 与 GPT 均提升具身模型；Qwen 下成功回合仅多 13–16 秒，比同模型 VLM 主导基线少约 70% 时间。
Conclusion: 反思应由信息更广的 VLM 承担，且只在确认出错时介入即可同时拿到修复收益与低开销，避免把 VLM 放在关键路径上。

papers.title: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Modern engineering systems, from automobiles to aircraft, are designed by using precise, continuous parametric computer-aided design (CAD) models. Evaluating design changes through numerical simulation requires meshing the continuous geometry, a computationally expensive and often brittle process that can require manual intervention and replaces the continuous representation with a discrete approximation. Most neural surrogates accelerate the simulation, but inherit this representation gap by relying on meshes, point clouds, voxels, or other sampled approximations of geometry. We introduce CANTO, a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous CAD geometry to physical fields, without meshing the input geometry. We develop a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields, representing geometry through sequences of parametric patches. CANTO instantiates this framework by directly tokenizing non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) patches from their control points, knot vectors, and weights, and predicts continuous surface and volume fields at arbitrary query locations. We evaluate CANTO on four automotive and aircraft aerodynamics industry benchmarks: AhmedML, WindsorML, DrivAerML, and HiLiftAeroML. CANTO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on most evaluated surface and volume prediction tasks, including a 19.8% reduction in surface-pressure relative $L_2$ error compared with AB-UPT on HiLiftAeroML. Differentiability with respect to CAD parameters further enables gradient-based inverse design of designs. On AhmedML, CANTO identifies designs with 4.4 to 20.4% lower drag than the best dataset designs satisfying the same volume and lift constraints, with the improvements verified using the same CFD setup used to generate the original dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CANTO 是直接吃连续 CAD 几何的 transformer neural operator：把 NURBS patch 按控制点、节点矢量与权重直接 token 化，无需网格化即可在任意查询点预测连续表面与体积物理场。在 AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML 四个汽车与飞机气动工业基准上，多数表面/体积预测任务达到 state-of-the-art，HiLiftAeroML 表面压力相对 L2 误差较 AB-UPT 降低 19.8%；对 CAD 参数可微还支持梯度反设计，在 AhmedML 上找出比数据集中最优设计阻力低 4.4%–20.4% 且满足同体积、升力约束的方案，并用生成数据集的同一 CFD 设置复核。
Motivation: 数值仿真必须先把连续参数化 CAD 几何网格化，过程昂贵、脆弱且需人工介入；多数神经代理继承了这一表示鸿沟，依赖网格、点云、体素等采样近似。
Method: 提出 CANTO（transformer neural operator），配套一套从几何流形到物理场函数空间的学习算子理论框架；几何以参数 patch 序列表示，直接对 NURBS patch 的控制点、节点矢量和权重做 token 化，输出任意查询位置的连续表面与体积场，并对 CAD 参数保持可微。
Result: 在 AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML 四个汽车/飞机气动工业基准上，多数表面与体积预测任务达到 state-of-the-art 精度；HiLiftAeroML 表面压力相对 L2 误差较 AB-UPT 降低 19.8%。在 AhmedML 上，CANTO 找到的设计比数据集中满足同体积与升力约束的最优设计阻力低 4.4% 至 20.4%，改进用生成原数据集的同一 CFD 设置验证。
Conclusion: 跳过网格化、直接从连续 CAD 几何学算子是可行的：既能在气动基准上取得 SOTA 精度，又凭对 CAD 参数的可微性把代理模型直接接进梯度反设计流程。
