summary_sections.result: 在 AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML 四个汽车/飞机气动工业基准上，多数表面与体积预测任务达到 state-of-the-art 精度；HiLiftAeroML 表面压力相对 L2 误差较 AB-UPT 降低 19.8%。在 AhmedML 上，CANTO 找到的设计比数据集中满足同体积与升力约束的最优设计阻力低 4.4% 至 20.4%，改进用生成原数据集的同一 CFD 设置验证。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跳过网格化、直接从连续 CAD 几何学算子是可行的：既能在气动基准上取得 SOTA 精度，又凭对 CAD 参数的可微性把代理模型直接接进梯度反设计流程。

papers.title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents reuse external memory to guide new tasks, but effective retrieval requires learning which memory sets improve execution. Such learning relies on costly outcome feedback: ordinary retrieval observes only executed sets, while evaluating alternatives requires additional rollouts. We introduce \textsc{UpliftMem}, which learns memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to the same executor without memory. A theoretical analysis of how retrieval preferences restrict feedback coverage motivates targeted probing of alternative memory sets. Probe selection follows an expected value of sample information (EVSI) criterion, derived in closed form under a correlated Gaussian model, to allocate limited training rollouts according to their expected improvement in local retrieval decisions. The shared scorer is trained with a frozen executor and selects memory sets without test-time probes. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and BigCodeBench, \textsc{UpliftMem} achieves the best success rates among evaluated baselines on the main evaluation sets. Controlled fixed-store and matched probe budget evaluations further demonstrate improved memory-use decisions and more effective use of execution feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UpliftMem 把 LLM agent 的记忆检索学习改写为「相对同一 executor 无记忆执行的集合级 uplift」，并用闭式 EVSI 准则挑选要额外 rollout 的候选记忆集，把有限训练 rollout 花在最能改善局部检索决策的地方。共享 scorer 在冻结 executor 下训练、测试时不再探测，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、BigCodeBench 主评测集上取得所评估基线中最好的成功率。
Motivation: 普通检索只观测到被执行过的记忆集，评估备选集需要额外 rollout，反馈覆盖被检索偏好本身限制，导致学习「哪些记忆集真正改善执行」的代价很高。
Method: 以集合级执行 uplift（相对同一 executor 无记忆）作为学习目标；先分析检索偏好如何限制反馈覆盖，据此对备选记忆集做定向探测；探测选择用期望样本信息量 (EVSI) 准则，在相关高斯模型下推得闭式解，按预期局部检索改进分配有限训练 rollout；scorer 共享且在冻结 executor 下训练，测试时不探测。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、BigCodeBench 上，UpliftMem 在所评估基线中主评测集成功率最高；受控的 fixed-store 与 matched probe budget 评测进一步显示记忆使用决策改善、执行反馈利用更有效。
Conclusion: 把检索目标从记忆集本身换成相对无记忆的执行 uplift，并用闭式 EVSI 指导探测，可以在不增加测试时开销的前提下更省 rollout 地学出更好的记忆集选择。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VAA-CSEC: Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for Chinese Semantic Error Correction
papers.abstract_en: Chinese Semantic Error Correction (CSEC) targets semantic errors in Chinese text, which are typically more subtle and complex than spelling and grammatical errors but remain relatively underexplored. Existing LLM-based approaches face two recurring obstacles in this task: over-correction, and unclear interaction between Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-consistency decoding, such that the benefits brought by CoT cannot be reliably transferred to final corrections. We propose Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for CSEC (VAA-CSEC), a multi-stage framework that combines CoT distillation, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and self-consistency decoding. During RL, we design a task-specific reward function that directly aligned with the minimal-editing principle of CSEC. We further introduce Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO), which reallocates GRPO advantages according to the margin between individual rollout rewards and the vote-aggregated group reward, aligning the RL training objective with the self-consistency objective used at inference time. Experiments on CSED-C and NaSGEC-Exam show that VAA-CSEC outperforms all LLM-based baselines on CSED-C with an F0.5 of 47.72%, achieves the highest recall of 42.15% among all methods, and establishes a new state of the art of 41.55% F0.5 on NaSGEC-Exam.
papers.journal_ref: The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VAA-CSEC 把 CoT 蒸馏、SFT、RL 与 self-consistency 解码串成多阶段框架，并用 GLPO 按个体 rollout 奖励与组投票聚合奖励的差额重分配 GRPO 优势，使 RL 目标与推理时的投票目标对齐。在 CSED-C 上 F0.5 达 47.72%、召回 42.15% 均为所有 LLM 基线中最高，NaSGEC-Exam 上以 41.55% F0.5 刷新 SOTA。
Motivation: 中文语义纠错比拼写和语法错误更细微、研究更少；现有 LLM 方法存在过度纠正，且 CoT 推理与 self-consistency 解码的交互不清，CoT 的收益难以传导到最终纠错结果。
Method: 多阶段框架 VAA-CSEC：先 CoT 蒸馏，再 SFT，然后 RL，最后 self-consistency 解码。RL 阶段设计与 CSEC 最小编辑原则直接对齐的任务奖励；提出 Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO)，按个体 rollout 奖励与组投票聚合奖励的差额重分配 GRPO 优势，使训练目标与推理时的 self-consistency 目标一致。
Result: 在 CSED-C 上 VAA-CSEC 的 F0.5 为 47.72%，超过全部 LLM 基线；召回率 42.15%，在所有方法中最高。在 NaSGEC-Exam 上取得 41.55% F0.5，为新的 state of the art。
Conclusion: 把投票聚合的组奖励反馈进优势分配，可以让 RL 训练目标与 self-consistency 推理目标对齐，从而在中文语义纠错上同时压住过度纠正并提升召回，刷新两个数据集的最好结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EGSD: Event-Grounded Self-Distillation for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video understanding requires incrementally maintaining a memory of streaming content, and optimizing this requires dense process signals. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which lets one model serve as both teacher and student with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as the question and ground-truth (GT) answer, can supply such token-level signals. However, applying it directly to streaming video raises two problems. (1) The student cannot be optimized end-to-end, where memory is written before the question arrives, yet the teacher scores it with the question-and-GT privilege, misaligning their preferences. (2) Effective-entity memory collapses, where the question-and-GT privilege makes the teacher favor only question-relevant entities, and token-mean averaging over a memory renders its signal invariant to how many entities that memory covers, both driving memory against the streaming need for diversity. To address these issues, we propose Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD), which characterizes streaming memory as an incremental update over verifiable Events (key visual entities, actions, and details) and targets the two problems on this basis. For problem (1), we adapt the OPSD signal into a multiplicative weight combined with the outcome reward; for problem (2), we re-weight the teacher with Events as privileged information to counter its question-relevance bias, and add an entity-coverage reward to supply the coverage preference the token-mean teacher lacks. Extensive experiments on mainstream online and offline benchmarks show EGSD achieves strong performance, reaching 79.8% on StreamingBench and 73.4% on the OVO-Bench Real-Time track, while memory analysis shows effective-entity recall rises 17.4% at only 6.8% more memory length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EGSD 把流式视频记忆写成可验证事件（实体、动作、细节）的增量更新，用事件作为特权信息重加权 On-Policy Self-Distillation 教师，并加入实体覆盖奖励，纠正教师只偏向问题相关实体的偏差。在 StreamingBench 达到 79.8%、OVO-Bench Real-Time 轨道 73.4%，有效实体召回提升 17.4% 而记忆长度只增 6.8%。
Motivation: 流式视频理解需要在问题到来前就写入记忆，但 OPSD 教师带着问题与 GT 特权打分，与学生的写入时机偏好错位；同时 token-mean 平均使记忆信号对覆盖实体数不敏感，导致有效实体记忆坍缩。
Method: 把 OPSD 信号改造成与 outcome reward 相乘的权重，使记忆写入与问题解耦；用 Events（关键视觉实体、动作、细节）替代问题与 GT 作为教师特权信息以抵消问题相关性偏置，并额外加入 entity-coverage reward 补足 token-mean 教师缺失的覆盖偏好。
Result: 在主流在线与离线基准上，StreamingBench 达 79.8%，OVO-Bench Real-Time 轨道达 73.4%；记忆分析显示有效实体召回提升 17.4%，记忆长度仅增加 6.8%。
Conclusion: 以可验证事件为锚的自蒸馏能同时修正特权信息错位与记忆覆盖坍缩，在几乎不加记忆开销的前提下提高流式视频理解的实体召回与总体性能。

papers.title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
papers.abstract_en: A key strength of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is its learned critic, which uses historical trajectories collected during reinforcement learning to estimate expected returns and reduce policy-gradient variance. However, we find that the critic is also a major source of instability in reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). We identify two critic failure modes that destabilize PPO. First, filtering truncated rollouts from both actor and critic shifts the policy objective to reward conditioned on completion, allowing truncation to increase even as conditional reward improves. Second, heterogeneous return noise can cause high-variance prompts to dominate critic updates in finite batches. We introduce EasyPPO to address these failures. Actor-only overlong filtering trains the critic on returns from both completed and truncated rollouts. Noise-normalized critic regression weights each prompt's critic loss by the inverse standard deviation of its sampled returns, balancing noise contributions across prompts. Moderately smaller critic mini-batches confine outlier influence to fewer rollouts during gradient clipping. Across continuous-reward coding on FrontierCS, binary-reward mathematical reasoning on AIME24, and multi-turn search on Search-R1, EasyPPO remains stable throughout the full training horizon and consistently outperforms vanilla PPO, VAPO, and HL-Gauss PPO. Its best validation scores show relative gains of 14.89%, 2.28%, and 9.47% over PPO, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EasyPPO 针对 LLM 强化学习中 PPO critic 的两类失稳：截断 rollout 被同时从 actor 和 critic 过滤会把目标扭曲成以完成为条件的奖励，异质回报噪声会让高方差 prompt 主导 critic 更新。方法是 actor-only overlong filtering、按采样回报标准差倒数加权的 noise-normalized critic regression，以及更小的 critic mini-batch。在 FrontierCS、AIME24、Search-R1 上全程训练稳定，最佳验证分相对 vanilla PPO 提升 14.89%、2.28%、9.47%。
Motivation: PPO 的 critic 用历史轨迹估计期望回报以降低策略梯度方差，但它也是 LLM 强化学习不稳定的主因：截断处理会扭曲目标，回报噪声异质会让少数高方差 prompt 主导有限批量的 critic 更新。
Method: 三处改动：actor-only overlong filtering 只在 actor 侧过滤超长 rollout，让 critic 同时学习完成与截断 rollout 的回报；noise-normalized critic regression 按每个 prompt 采样回报标准差的倒数加权其 critic loss；适度缩小 critic mini-batch，使离群影响在梯度裁剪时被限制在更少 rollout 内。
Result: 在 FrontierCS（连续奖励代码生成）、AIME24（二元奖励数学推理）、Search-R1（多轮搜索）上，EasyPPO 全程训练保持稳定，一致优于 vanilla PPO、VAPO 和 HL-Gauss PPO；最佳验证分相对 PPO 分别提升 14.89%、2.28%、9.47%。
Conclusion: 稳定 critic 是 PPO 在 LLM 上可靠训练的关键：同时保留截断 rollout 的回报、按噪声倒数平衡各 prompt 的回归权重、并收紧 critic 批量，即可在三类任务上消除训练失稳并抬高验证分。

papers.title: Scene Retargeting: Learning Object Placement with Analogical Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Interactive simulations of embodied AI or spatial computing applications build on realistic 3D scenes that support daily activities. However, sparse, irregular layout structures impose scene-specific physical constraints, making it hard to define a generalizable framework for generating similar functional context. We formalize Scene Retargeting as stably transferring the semantically coherent spatial organization across layouts, rather than relying on textual descriptions or pairwise relationships. Our cluster-wise transfer flexibly handles mismatched object instances and adapts to distinctive floor plans. We optimize to preserve the rich semantic context of individual clusters by respecting the spatial distribution of foundation features. We can then impose physical constraints to refine wall contacts, pairwise alignment, or clear passageways and openings. Our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods on layout generation on the 3D-FRONT dataset, and demonstrates downstream applications including real-to-sim transfer, analogical trajectory transfer, and multi-reference composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把跨布局的场景重定向 (Scene Retargeting) 形式化为按簇迁移语义一致的空间组织：先对齐 foundation feature 的空间分布以保留各簇语义，再施加墙体接触、成对对齐、通道开口等物理约束精修。在 3D-FRONT 布局生成上超过 SOTA，并支撑 real-to-sim 迁移、类比轨迹迁移与多参考组合等下游应用。
Motivation: 具身 AI 与空间计算的交互仿真依赖真实 3D 场景，但稀疏不规则的布局带来场景专属的物理约束，缺少能跨户型生成同类功能语境的通用框架。
Method: 将 Scene Retargeting 定义为跨布局迁移语义一致的空间组织（而非依赖文本描述或成对关系）；采用 cluster-wise transfer 处理不匹配的对象实例与不同户型，优化时尊重 foundation feature 的空间分布以保留各簇语义，随后施加物理约束精修墙接触、成对对齐与通道开口。
Result: 在 3D-FRONT 数据集的布局生成上超过 state-of-the-art 方法；展示 real-to-sim transfer、analogical trajectory transfer 与 multi-reference composition 三类下游应用。

papers.title: AI as a Compiler: Compiling Triton kernels without the Triton compiler
papers.abstract_en: Compiler backends are expensive to build and maintain as programming models, workloads, and accelerators evolve. We investigate whether large language models can replace the conventional optimizing and lowering pipeline, a process that we call AI lowering. We study AI lowering from Triton to NVIDIA PTX: an LLM agent translates Triton kernels directly into PTX. We build an environment that evaluates candidate PTX, and an agentic harness in which an LLM translates Triton kernels into PTX. Across twelve common kernels on Ada, Hopper, and Blackwell GPUs and ten kernels from recent ML papers, AI lowering achieves 0.83x-3.34x the performance of autotuned Triton. The largest gains come from transformations that Triton's lowering pipeline does not perform, such as decoding packed binary weights directly into Tensor Core operands (3.34x on BitDelta), assigning each thread a complete softmax row in tensor memory (1.37x on FlashAttention), and reusing overlapping convolution windows (up to 2.23x). These results rely on a robust evaluation harness with comprehensive verification support. We build on Volta, an existing PTX verifier, and substantially extend it to support modern GPU architectures by introducing support for Blackwell's tcgen05 Tensor Core interface. This requires modeling three architectural features: managed tensor memory, descriptor-based operand layouts, and asynchronous execution coordinated through commits, waits, memory barriers, and proxy fences. We discuss the challenges involved in formalizing them, as well as the current limitations. Our results suggest an emerging future in which AI compilers replace custom-written intermediate representations and checkers, reducing the time and engineering effort required to bring up software for new general-purpose and custom chips.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM agent 直接把 Triton kernel 翻译成 NVIDIA PTX，绕过传统编译器的优化与 lowering 流水线（称为 AI lowering）。在 Ada、Hopper、Blackwell 上的 12 个常见 kernel 加 10 个近期 ML 论文 kernel 上，性能达到 autotuned Triton 的 0.83x–3.34x，最大收益来自 Triton 流水线不做的变换（BitDelta 3.34x、FlashAttention 1.37x、卷积窗口复用最高 2.23x）。
Motivation: 编译器后端随编程模型、负载和加速器演进，构建与维护成本高；作者要检验 LLM 能否替代传统的优化与 lowering 流水线。
Method: 构建一个评估候选 PTX 的环境与 agentic harness，让 LLM agent 把 Triton kernel 直译为 PTX；同时在已有 PTX 验证器 Volta 上大幅扩展，加入 Blackwell 的 tcgen05 Tensor Core 接口支持，建模 managed tensor memory、descriptor-based operand layout、以及由 commits/waits/memory barriers/proxy fences 协调的异步执行。
Result: 在 Ada、Hopper、Blackwell 三类 GPU 上的 12 个常见 kernel 与 10 个近期 ML 论文 kernel 上，AI lowering 达到 autotuned Triton 性能的 0.83x–3.34x；BitDelta 上把 packed binary weights 直接解码为 Tensor Core operands 得 3.34x，FlashAttention 上每线程分配完整 softmax 行到 tensor memory 得 1.37x，复用重叠卷积窗口最高 2.23x。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AI compiler 有望取代手写的中间表示与检查器，缩短新通用芯片和定制芯片的软件 bring-up 时间与工程投入；形式化 tcgen05 异步执行等特性仍存在当前局限。

papers.title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even more. To systematically diagnose this behavior, we introduce the Factorized Modality Diagnostic, which independently swaps audio and images between samples to isolate each modality's causal contribution. Across two model families in different settings, we find that this shortcut persists throughout supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training, while judge-based RL may further amplify such reliance on irrelevant visual information. Based on this finding, we propose DMC-Repair, which trains models on the same kind of cross-modal swapped samples while assigning supervision according to the modality specified by the question. This prevents models from exploiting the spurious correspondence between modalities within the same clip. Experiments demonstrate that DMC-Repair reduces the image-induced share of the answer effect by 59.9%, effectively suppressing the cross-modal shortcut without compromising audio-question answering performance. The reduction in shortcut reliance generalizes across two model families and zero-shot to an unseen dataset and an unseen benchmark, and persists through subsequent post-training. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMC-Repair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 全模态 LLM 存在跨模态捷径：被问到音频相关问题时，模型对图像的依赖与音频相当甚至更强。Factorized Modality Diagnostic 通过独立交换音频与图像隔离各模态的因果贡献，证实该捷径贯穿 SFT 与 RL 后训练，judge-based RL 还会放大对无关视觉信息的依赖；DMC-Repair 用同类跨模态交换样本、按问题指定的模态给监督，把图像诱导的答案效应份额降低 59.9%，且不损害音频问答性能。
Motivation: 同一样本的多模态输入常为同一答案提供冗余证据，现有训练范式不检验模型是否真的按问题指定的模态作答，导致模型可借模态间虚假对应走捷径。
Method: 提出 Factorized Modality Diagnostic：在样本间独立交换音频与图像，隔离每个模态对答案的因果贡献；再提出 DMC-Repair，在跨模态交换样本上训练，并按问题所指模态分配监督，切断模态内虚假对应。
Result: DMC-Repair 使图像诱导的答案效应份额下降 59.9%，同时不损害音频问答性能；该捷径在两个模型家族、SFT 与 RL 后训练设置中持续存在，judge-based RL 可能进一步放大对无关视觉信息的依赖；修复效果跨两个模型家族泛化，并零样本迁移到未见数据集与未见基准，且在后续后训练中保持。
Conclusion: 跨模态捷径是全模态 LLM 训练范式的系统性问题，按问题指定模态分配监督的交换样本训练可有效修复它，且效果能跨模型家族、跨数据集与后续后训练保持。

papers.title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. Finally, among 30 models that all pass the same reconstruction test, eight of ten grow-trained models become off-target at 4,096 steps, while all persist and regenerate models retain the target; damage recovery separates persist from regenerate. The results distinguish optimization reliability, execution mode, and task-specific behavior instead of treating them as one stability property.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 NCA 的训练期随机更新与执行期随机更新拆开做受控 Growing NCA 实验：标准 constant-rate persist 配方下异步（asynchronous）训练 10/10 通过短时程质量检验，同步只有 3/10；且这 10 个异步模型在确定性评估下都能保持目标 4,096 步。对标量平移不变格点导出的精确均方判据显示，随机掩码能压低均值模但同时注入方差，仅看均值的检验会误判四个非边缘设置。
Motivation: NCA 全生命周期都用随机 cell 更新，把「随机性是否帮助学到有用规则」和「执行时是否必须保留随机性」两个问题纠缠在一起，无法区分优化可靠性、执行模式与任务行为。
Method: 在 Growing NCA 中分离训练与评估的 update mode 做受控实验，并改变训练时展示的状态（persist、regenerate、grow）；对标量平移不变格点推导精确 mean-square 判据，分析随机掩码对均值模与方差的作用；在 30 个都通过同一重建检验的模型上比较 4,096 步 rollout 与损伤恢复。
Result: constant-rate persist 配方下异步训练 10/10 通过短时程质量检验，同步 3/10；10 个异步模型在确定性评估下全部保持目标 4,096 步。均方判据下仅均值的检验误判四个非边缘设置。30 个通过同一重建检验的模型中，10 个 grow 训练模型有 8 个在 4,096 步偏离目标，而 persist 与 regenerate 模型全部保持目标；损伤恢复把 persist 与 regenerate 区分开。
Conclusion: 训练期随机性与执行期随机性应分开对待：异步随机训练提升优化可靠性且可与确定性执行共存，而 4,096 步保持与损伤恢复是任务相关行为，不能合并成单一的「稳定性」性质。

papers.title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. Selected earlier targets are reused to supervise later stages, encouraging the corresponding features to remain accessible in longer-input representations. Direct decoding from the final encoder shows that earlier features remain recoverable from longer-input representations, while later-stage features show higher mean decoding performance at their introduction durations. Controlled comparisons further show that prior-stage learning provides a better basis for learning newly introduced features at both transitions. Across 18 tasks from eight datasets, the final frozen encoder achieves the best observed score on 12 tasks compared with five existing PPG foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAE-PPG 把 PPG 特征所需的信号时长直接组织成自监督课程：单一 Transformer 编码器依次在 10 s、30 s、240 s 输入上训练，并按时长划分参数组，后期只更新当前组并复用早期组与部分早期目标。最终冻结编码器在八个数据集的 18 项任务上，对五个已有 PPG foundation model 取得 12 项任务的最佳观测分数，且早期特征仍可从长输入表示中解码恢复。
Motivation: PPG 不同特征需要不同信号时长才能刻画，但现有 PPG foundation model 只把时长当作预训练或评测条件，没有用它来组织自监督，导致单一编码器难以在保留早期学习的同时逐级获得更长时长才可见的特征。
Method: RAE-PPG 用单一 Transformer 编码器按 10 s、30 s、240 s 顺序做阶段性训练，每个阶段新增该时长支持的信号特征监督；编码器按输入时长划分为 duration-specific 参数组，后期阶段复用早期组、只更新当前阶段所属组，并复用部分早期目标来监督后期阶段以维持早期特征可及性。
Result: 直接从最终编码器解码显示早期特征仍可从长输入表示中恢复，后期阶段特征在其引入时长上平均解码性能更高；受控比较显示在 10→30 s 与 30→240 s 两个过渡上，前一阶段的学习都是学习新引入特征的更好基础。跨八个数据集的 18 项任务，最终冻结编码器在 12 项任务上取得优于五个已有 PPG foundation model 的最佳观测分数。
Conclusion: 让自监督随信号时长扩展、并用分组参数与目标复用保留早期学习，可以在一个编码器里同时保住早期特征和获得长时长特征，最终冻结表示在多任务上比现有 PPG foundation model 更强。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 让自监督随信号时长扩展、并用分组参数与目标复用保留早期学习，可以在一个编码器里同时保住早期特征和获得长时长特征，最终冻结表示在多任务上比现有 PPG foundation model 更强。

papers.title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synthetic functions and real-world benchmarks, we find that LLM harnesses can effectively compile context into standard BO, achieving competitive performance with specialised LLM-embedding-based and direct LLM-in-the-loop BO methods. General coding harnesses can be effective in familiar domains such as hyperparameter optimisation, but fall short in unfamiliar, context-rich domains. Together, these results establish LLM harnesses as a promising, but not automatically reliable, route for making rich task context usable in BO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HarBO，把 LLM 编译任务上下文（领域知识、外部观测）为标准贝叶斯优化 (BO) 的核心构件（模型与数据 artefact），并把 LLM-编译 BO 形式化为广义上下文决策问题。在合成函数与真实基准上，LLM harness 能有效编译上下文，性能与 LLM-embedding 及 direct LLM-in-the-loop BO 方法相当；通用 coding harness 在超参数优化等熟悉领域有效，在陌生且上下文丰富的领域则明显不足。
Motivation: 把领域知识与外部观测等丰富任务上下文注入 BO 一直是难点；新兴的 LLM 生成并执行 BO 程序的做法中，后验同时被贝叶斯推断与 LLM 生成的模型/数据 artefact 塑造，其可靠性尚无系统刻画。
Method: 将 LLM-编译 BO 形式化为广义上下文决策 (generalised-context decision making)；提出 BO 专用 harness HarBO，用多阶段且带验证的工作流把广义上下文编译进标准 BO 的核心 artefact；并给出不完美编译下的 regret 理论分析以及新增上下文的效果分析。
Result: 在合成函数与真实基准上，LLM harness 能有效把上下文编译进标准 BO，性能与 specialized LLM-embedding-based 及 direct LLM-in-the-loop BO 方法相当；通用 coding harness 在超参数优化等熟悉领域有效，但在陌生、上下文丰富的领域表现不足。
Conclusion: LLM harness 是让丰富任务上下文在 BO 中可用的有前景但并非自动可靠的路径，其有效性取决于领域熟悉度与编译质量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Decoding Affective Nuances: Enhancing MLLMs via Hierarchical Emotion Reasoning and Contrastive Discriminative Pruning
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in objective understanding tasks, their performance in affective reasoning still falls significantly short of human standards. We attribute it to a central capability gap: MLLMs are difficult to reliably distinguish semantically proximal emotions based on fine-grained visual evidence, which could be decoupled as two limitations: 1) Insufficient Attribution. The global reasoning paradigm of conventional MLLMs severely dilutes fine-grained emotion cues, where subtle emotional states are usually implicitly encoded, thereby generating emotional misjudgments in complex scenarios. 2) Insufficient Discrimination. Existing methods could only identify regions generally associated with emotions, which fails to distinguish discriminative regions between semantically similar emotions, leading to ambiguous emotion judgements. To overcome these limitations, we present a training-free inference-time optimization framework, named Decoding Affective Nuances (DAN). Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Emotional Reasoning Chain (HERC) that enhances the insufficient attribution by harmonizing fine-grained scene/object-level cues and performing a soft-gated reasoning. Furthermore, to discriminate between semantically proximal emotions, we design a Contrastive Discriminative Visual Pruning (CDVP), which isolates discriminative visual tokens to reason the final emotion category by computing the absolute discrepancy between the attention distributions of similar emotions. Performances on several benchmarks demonstrate that DAN significantly improves discrimination for affective nuances without consuming additional training resources, especially achieving +10.47% improvements with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on WebEmo25 dataset that contains 25 fine-grained emotion categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的推理时优化框架 DAN，用分层情绪推理链 (HERC) 补足细粒度归因、用对比判别视觉剪枝 (CDVP) 区分语义相近情绪。在 WebEmo25（25 个细粒度情绪类）上配合 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 取得 +10.47% 提升，且不消耗额外训练资源。
Motivation: MLLLM 在客观理解上已强，但情绪推理远逊人类：全局推理稀释细粒度情绪线索导致归因不足，现有方法只能定位与情绪大体相关的区域、无法区分语义相近情绪的判别性区域。
Method: DAN 是训练-free 的推理时优化框架：HERC 协调场景/物体级细粒度线索并做软门控 (soft-gated) 推理以补归因；CDVP 计算相似情绪注意力分布的绝对差异，隔离出判别性视觉 token 再推理最终情绪类别。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上显著提升对细微情绪的判别，无需额外训练资源；其中 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在含 25 个细粒度情绪类的 WebEmo25 数据集上提升 +10.47%。
Conclusion: 情绪误判的根因可拆成归因不足与判别不足两个可分别修复的环节，推理时的分层线索整合加注意力对比剪枝即可在不训练的情况下补上语义相近情绪的判别。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Aperture: Merge-Consistent Rotary States for Compressed Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Token compression combines content from several positions, yet rotary position embeddings usually assign the merged token one coordinate. We ask what positional information must survive later merges. Aperture stores Fourier moments of the token's weighted support at the model's rotary frequencies. We prove that these moments have minimal real dimension among continuous states sufficient for the selected expected rotary interactions. Represented mass makes updates additive; attention normalisation remains a separate readout choice. Uniform intervals give a centre rotation times a sinc gain. We characterise when centres determine interval widths and construct matched examples where they do not. Numerical checks verify the weighted-support implementation. In trained temporal readers, compression transfer varies with gain calibration and feature placement. In a prespecified native video question-answering comparison, stored support reaches $65.63\%$ accuracy versus $67.12\%$ for the deployed merging rule. These results separate exact positional preservation under compression from downstream benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Aperture 为 token 压缩后的 rotary 位置编码提出合并一致的状态表示：存储 token 加权支撑在模型 rotary 频率上的 Fourier 矩，使位置信息在多次合并后仍可加更新。在预注册的原生视频问答对比中，存储支撑达 65.63% 准确率，而已部署的合并规则为 67.12%，作者据此把压缩下的精确位置保持与下游收益明确分开。
Motivation: token 压缩把多个位置的内容合并，但 rotary 位置嵌入通常只给合并后 token 一个坐标，多次合并后位置信息如何保留缺少刻画。
Method: Aperture 在模型 rotary 频率上存储 token 加权支撑的 Fourier 矩，并证明在所选期望 rotary 交互下这些矩是连续状态中实维数最小的充分表示；质量表示使更新可加，attention 归一化作为独立读出选择。均匀区间情形给出中心旋转乘 sinc 增益，并刻画中心何时能决定区间宽度、构造不能决定的匹配反例，再用数值检查验证加权支撑实现。
Result: 在预注册的原生视频问答对比中，存储支撑 (stored support) 准确率 65.63%，已部署合并规则 67.12%；在训练过的 temporal reader 上，压缩迁移表现随增益校准与特征放置而变化。
Conclusion: 压缩下的精确位置保持与下游收益是两回事：Fourier 矩给出最小充分且可加的位置状态，但在该视频问答对比中并未超过已部署合并规则。

papers.title: DRHeC: Differentiable Rendering for Hand-Eye Calibration with RGB-Based Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Accurate hand-eye calibration is crucial for precision manipulation. Traditional methods rely on markers, with their precision dependent on marker accuracy and observability. In contrast, markerless methods, such as learning-based approaches, use deep neural networks to directly extract keypoints or features from images, enabling the computation of hand-eye transformation with a single image and without the need for physical markers. Recently, differentiable rendering-based methods for hand-eye calibration have leveraged physical models to render binary masks and compare them with observations, enabling hand-eye calibration without fiducial markers in the calibration stage and providing interpretable optimization. While the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods achieve remarkable accuracy, the use of binary masks can result in the loss of internal profile details, reducing precision. Additionally, these methods can also suffer from unstable optimization and local minima. In this study, we propose a novel RGB-based differentiable rendering framework that provides richer geometric and appearance cues by incorporating color and mask geometric features, thereby improving calibration accuracy and optimization stability. Additionally, we propose a mask-guided image-to-image translation method to ensure explicit preservation of color and geometric consistency throughout the translation. Our approach is validated through both simulation and real-world experiments, with results demonstrating strong accuracy and robustness and clear improvements over existing differentiable rendering methods. Our method achieves a grasping success rate of 88.9% and insertion success rate of 57.4% on the UR5e real-world experiment, outperforming the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering hand-eye calibration method EasyHeC by 46.3 and 48.1 percentage points, respectively.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement, vol. 75, Art. no. 7505816, pp. 1-16, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRHeC 把可微渲染手眼标定的监督从二值 mask 换成 RGB，同时注入颜色与 mask 几何特征，并用 mask 引导的 image-to-image 翻译保持颜色和几何一致性，从而保住内部轮廓细节、缓解优化不稳与局部极小。在 UR5e 真实实验中抓取成功率 88.9%、插入成功率 57.4%，比 SOTA 可微渲染标定方法 EasyHeC 分别高 46.3 和 48.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有可微渲染手眼标定用二值 mask 与观测比对，内部轮廓细节在二值化中丢失，且优化不稳、易陷局部极小，标定精度受限。
Method: 提出基于 RGB 的可微渲染框架，把颜色信息与 mask 几何特征一起作为渲染监督，提供更丰富的几何与外观线索；另提出 mask 引导的 image-to-image 翻译方法，在翻译过程中显式保持颜色与几何一致性；在仿真与真实实验上验证。
Result: UR5e 真实实验中抓取成功率 88.9%、插入成功率 57.4%，相对 SOTA 可微渲染手眼标定方法 EasyHeC 分别高出 46.3 与 48.1 个百分点；仿真与真实实验均显示精度与鲁棒性提升，优于已有可微渲染方法。
Conclusion: 用 RGB 渲染监督替代二值 mask 并保证翻译中的颜色几何一致，可同时提高手眼标定精度与优化稳定性，抓取与插入任务上明显超过 EasyHeC。

papers.title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Frontier coding agents can now write and execute code that authors 3D environments, but whether they reliably understand 3D structure and precisely control scene state remains unclear. The generated 3D scene is a persistent, executable artifact: a convincing render can hide incorrect spatial relations, intersecting objects, or unintended modifications. We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface. Construction tests scene-level spatial reasoning from open-ended language specifications, where many realizations are valid; editing tests precise control of scene state, where the agent must recover the target scene from reference images while preserving everything else. Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact integrity, and static physical validity, with edits additionally compared against withheld ground truth. Across 14 coding-agent configurations on the 95-case public set, construction and editing performance are strongly correlated but not interchangeable (Spearman $ρ= 0.78$): Claude Fable 5.1 leads construction, Gemini 3.8 Flash leads editing, and GPT-6 Astra narrowly leads overall. Spatial Composition is the weakest construction category for every agent, while editing remains imprecise: the best Repair F1 is only 0.527, and 35.8% of edits that fully recover the target still introduce unintended changes elsewhere in the scene. These results expose a gap between plausible 3D generation and reliable spatial reasoning and state control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Code4Scene 用 190 个由人工搭建的 Unreal Engine 场景，把 3D 场景的构建与编辑拆成两项共享执行接口的评测，直接检查引擎原生场景而非代码或渲染图。14 个 coding-agent 配置在 95 例公开集上，构建与编辑成绩强相关但不可互换（Spearman ρ=0.78）：Claude Fable 5.1 构建最佳，Gemini 3.8 Flash 编辑最佳，GPT-6 Astra 总体略胜；最好的 Repair F1 仅 0.527，且 35.8% 完全还原目标的编辑仍在场景别处引入意外改动。
Motivation: coding agent 能写出并执行生成 3D 环境的代码，但是否真正理解 3D 结构、精确控制场景状态并不清楚：一张看似合理的渲染可能掩盖错误空间关系、物体相交或 unintended 修改，而现有评测多按代码或渲染视图打分。
Method: 构建 Code4Scene：190 个基于人工组装场景的 Unreal Engine 用例，在共享执行接口下设两个互补设置——Construction 从开放式语言规格测试场景级空间推理（合法实现不唯一），Editing 要求从参考图恢复目标场景并保留其余一切。评分对象是生成的引擎原生场景，维度为 task fulfillment、artifact integrity、static physical validity，编辑任务另与 withheld ground truth 比对。
Result: 在 95 例公开集的 14 个 coding-agent 配置上，构建与编辑表现强相关但不可互换（Spearman ρ=0.78）；Claude Fable 5.1 领先构建，Gemini 3.8 Flash 领先编辑，GPT-6 Astra 总体略领先。Spatial Composition 是所有 agent 最弱的构建类别；编辑仍不精确，最好的 Repair F1 只有 0.527，35.8% 完全恢复目标的编辑在场景其他位置引入了 unintended changes。

papers.title: Causal-EVC: Breaking Emotional Spurious Causality via Spatiotemporal Grounding and Counterfactual Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Emotional Video Captioning aims to generate factually accurate and emotionally empathetic descriptions. While recent methods have recognized the importance of visual causes to guide emotion perception and caption generation, they fundamentally rely on simple attention matching, which inevitably suffers from {causal redundancy and spurious correlations} in co-occurrence bias (e.g., misclassifying ``sadness'' as ``joy'' on a sunny beach), leading to severe shortcut learning from confusing backgrounds. Furthermore, existing evaluations fail to verify whether models have genuinely mastered causal reasoning or merely exploited background confounders. To address these limitations, we first construct {EVC-CauseGround}, a comprehensive benchmark with dense spatio-temporal causal annotations. Crucially, it introduces a carefully selected {Causal-Faithfulness Subset} to explicitly quantify genuine emotion-cause attribution. Second, we propose {Causal-EVC}, an emotion-grounding captioning framework, which introduces a Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization module to precisely decouple causal triggers from background confounders. Besides, we introduce an Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing module. By synthesizing counterfactual representations and formulating a novel counterfactual contrastive objective, we enforce the model to anchor its emotion predictions strictly on authentic causal triggers instead of confusing background. Extensive experiments show that Causal-EVC not only achieves the best performance on semantic metrics but also exhibits significant advantages in the causal-faithfulness subset, which demonstrates that our model could mine emotional cues from genuine visual causes and mitigate co-occurrence bias for interpretable multimodal emotion understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Causal-EVC 用 Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization 把情绪触发从背景混淆中解耦，再用 Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing 合成反事实表征并施加反事实对比目标，强制情绪判断锚定在真实视觉因果上。配套构建 EVC-CauseGround 基准（含稠密时空因果标注与 Causal-Faithfulness Subset），实验显示其在语义指标上取得最佳表现，并在因果忠实子集上优势显著，缓解晴天海滩被判成 joy 之类的共现偏置。
Motivation: 现有情感视频描述方法只靠简单注意力匹配视觉原因，存在因果冗余与虚假相关，会从混淆背景走捷径；现有评测也无法区分模型是真懂因果推理还是只利用了背景混淆因子。
Method: 先构建 EVC-CauseGround 基准，带稠密时空因果标注和专门的 Causal-Faithfulness Subset 用于量化真实的情绪-原因归因；再提出 Causal-EVC 框架，用 Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization 模块解耦因果触发与背景混淆，用 Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing 合成反事实表征并设计反事实对比目标 (counterfactual contrastive objective)。
Result: 实验中 Causal-EVC 在语义指标上取得最佳表现，并在 Causal-Faithfulness 子集上展现出显著优势；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把情绪预测严格锚定在真实因果触发而非混淆背景上，可同时提升语义描述质量与因果忠实性，从而缓解共现偏置、支持可解释的多模态情绪理解。

papers.title: DSPO: Diversity-aware Subjective Policy Optimization for Robust Emotional Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning has significantly advanced the complex reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. However, prevailing RL algorithms suffer a severe failure in emotion reasoning tasks. These methods heavily rely on deterministic hard-label supervision and point-wise isolated evaluation, creating a fundamental gap with the inherently subjective and continuously distributed nature of human emotions. Furthermore, unlike explicit physical objects, emotional states are deeply implicit within visual cues. This abstract nature exacerbates visual hallucinations in MLLMs, leading to plausible yet ungrounded emotional evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization (DSPO), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly promotes subjective affective coverage and visual grounding. First, we construct a context-grounded emotional distribution prior in the VAD space by combining the lexical prior of the annotated emotion with image-specific contextual information. Based on this prior, we introduce a Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR), which measures the leave-one-out marginal contribution of each candidate emotion within a rollout. DEDR rewards candidates whose inclusion brings the predicted affective set closer to the context-grounded prior, thereby preserving plausible subjective interpretations without encouraging unconstrained dispersion. We further develop Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating (CVIG), which masks the visual region highlighted in the reasoning process and uses the resulting candidate-wise probability changes to reduce the weights of interpretations unsupported by visual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple public benchmarks, especially on the cross-domain performance, i.e., improving +10.8\% on average cross-domain accuracy than EMO-R3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSPO 用两条奖励同时约束多模态大模型的情绪推理：DEDR 按 leave-one-out 边际贡献奖励让预测情绪集合更贴近上下文先验的候选，CVIG 遮蔽推理高亮的视觉区域、按候选概率下降削弱无视觉证据的解释。在多个公开基准上达到 SOTA，跨域平均准确率比 EMO-R3 高 10.8%。
Motivation: 现有 RL 算法用确定性硬标签和逐点孤立评估训练情绪推理，与情绪本身主观、连续分布的性质冲突；情绪又隐含在视觉线索里，导致 MLLM 产生看似合理却无视觉依据的幻觉证据。
Method: 在 VAD 空间构造结合标注情绪词先验与图像上下文的分布先验；据此提出 Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR)，度量每个候选情绪在 rollout 内的 leave-one-out 边际贡献；再用 Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating (CVIG) 遮蔽推理中高亮的视觉区域，按候选概率变化降低无视觉证据解释的权重。
Result: 在多个公开基准上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，跨域设置提升最明显：跨域平均准确率比 EMO-R3 高 10.8%。
Conclusion: 把主观情绪分布对齐与反事实视觉证据门控一起放进 RL 奖励，可以在保留多种合理情绪解读的同时抑制视觉幻觉，跨域泛化尤其受益。

papers.title: Beyond Conditional Independence: Root Cause Analysis with Deep Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical problem in many real-world scenarios. RCA enables the identification of faulty or failing mechanisms in a system by comparing anomalous observations with corresponding reference (i.e., regular) observations. However, existing approaches rely either on heuristic methods or on conditional independence tests with a strong unconfoundedness assumption, and thus fail to exploit other complicated distributional constraints in the presence of latent variables. To relax these assumptions, we model the underlying system as a causal model and the anomalous system as a change in the structural functions of the same causal model. Specifically, to handle unobserved confounders, we establish an implicit connection between distributional constraint testing and root cause analysis. To adapt our approach to data generated from arbitrary causal models, we employ the deep causal model (DCM) framework, in which we design the causal model using neural networks. Finally, we illustrate how our method, RCA-DCM, can utilize different levels of partial graphical knowledge to perform RCA. We evaluate RCA-DCM against state-of-the-art baselines on simulated datasets, a physics-based causal chamber and two micro-service applications. RCA-DCM improves top-1 accuracy over the strongest baseline on both Sock Shop (0.880 vs. 0.752) and Online Boutique (0.776 vs. 0.712), and when the true root cause in the causal chamber is unobserved and acts as a latent confounder, it recovers the exact root-cause set more often than any competing method (perfect recovery rate (PRR) 0.846 vs. 0.731).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCA-DCM 把异常系统建模为同一因果模型上结构函数的变化，用深度因果模型 (DCM) 把分布约束检验与根因分析连起来，从而在存在隐变量时绕开无混杂假设。在 Sock Shop 与 Online Boutique 上 top-1 准确率分别为 0.880 与 0.776，均高于最强基线的 0.752 与 0.712；因果舱中真实根因未观测且充当隐混杂时，完美恢复率 (PRR) 0.846 对 0.731。
Motivation: 现有根因分析要么靠启发式，要么依赖条件独立检验并假设无混杂 (unconfoundedness)，在有隐变量时无法利用其他分布约束，定位会失效。
Method: 把系统写成因果模型，异常视为结构函数改变；建立分布约束检验与根因分析的隐式联系以处理未观测混杂；用神经网络参数化因果模型构成 DCM 框架 (RCA-DCM)，并支持利用不同程度的先验图结构知识。
Result: 在模拟数据、基于物理的因果舱 (causal chamber) 与两个微服务应用上对比 SOTA 基线：Sock Shop top-1 准确率 0.880 vs 0.752，Online Boutique 0.776 vs 0.712；因果舱中真实根因未观测并作为隐混杂时，精确恢复根因集合的比例 PRR 0.846 vs 0.731，高于所有竞争方法。
Conclusion: 放松无混杂假设、改用 DCM 上的分布约束检验，能在含隐变量的系统里更准地定位根因，且可按可用的图先验程度灵活使用。

papers.title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Can a population of neural networks develop a useful division of labor without a shared gate or gradients between agents? We study a setting where each network has its own weights, trains independently on the same heterogeneous data, and can ask another agent for help through a forward pass. Unlike mixtures of experts, where a jointly trained gate assigns inputs to experts, specialization here must emerge without central control. We test this in a small scale proxy for predictive visual pretraining. Initially identical agents are finetuned on an unlabeled mixture of six visual domains using masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features. We measure specialization by asking whether the best agent for an input aligns with its latent domain, and utilization by asking whether responsibility is distributed across agents. We progressively remove central control, ending with DISCO (DIStributed COllaboration) where each agent locally selects a helper, reads its internal state through a gradient free channel, and rewards its router only for the improvement that help provides. Specialization emerges and is useful. Randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist, while semantically routed populations outperform it, showing that specialization rather than population size drives the gain. Specialization persists without a central router, and gradient free communication lets nonexperts exploit emergent expertise. In DISCO, a random agent helped by the expert matches the solo generalist, while experts surpass it, including on data outside the specialization mixture. Local routers select the emergent expert for 98% of inputs. These effects persist across population size, model capacity, data imbalance, and finetuning seeds, providing measurable evidence for the dynamics needed by decentralized predictive pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无共享门控、无跨智能体梯度的多网络群体中，各 agent 独立在相同异构数据上微调，仅通过前向通道请求帮助，特化仍会自发涌现且有用。在六个视觉域的掩码预测代理任务上，语义路由群体超过单个 generalist，而随机路由反而更差；DISCO 中局部路由器为 98% 的输入选出涌现的专家。
Motivation: Mixture-of-experts 依赖联合训练的门控与集中控制，而分布式预测预训练需要在没有中心路由、没有跨 agent 梯度的条件下让分工自发形成，此前缺少可度量的证据。
Method: 初始相同的 agent 在无标注的六个视觉域混合数据上微调，用掩码预测冻结的 DINOv3 特征作为目标；逐步移除中心控制，最终得到 DISCO：每个 agent 局部选择 helper、经无梯度通道读取其内部状态，只因帮助带来的改进奖励自己的路由器。特化用最优 agent 是否对齐输入的潜在域衡量，利用率用责任是否分散到各 agent 衡量。
Result: 随机路由的群体表现低于单个 generalist，语义路由的群体高于它，说明增益来自特化而非群体规模；DISCO 中被专家帮助的随机 agent 与 solo generalist 持平，而专家超过 generalist，包括在特化混合之外的数据上；局部路由器为 98% 的输入选择涌现专家。上述效应在群体规模、模型容量、数据不平衡与微调种子变化下均保持。
Conclusion: 去中心化的预测预训练所需的特化动力学可以在没有共享门控和跨 agent 梯度的条件下涌现，且无梯度通信足以让非专家利用涌现专长；增益由特化驱动，而非群体规模。

summary_sections.result: 随机路由的群体表现低于单个 generalist，语义路由的群体高于它，说明增益来自特化而非群体规模；DISCO 中被专家帮助的随机 agent 与 solo generalist 持平，而专家超过 generalist，包括在特化混合之外的数据上；局部路由器为 98% 的输入选择涌现专家。上述效应在群体规模、模型容量、数据不平衡与微调种子变化下均保持。
summary_sections.conclusion: 去中心化的预测预训练所需的特化动力学可以在没有共享门控和跨 agent 梯度的条件下涌现，且无梯度通信足以让非专家利用涌现专长；增益由特化驱动，而非群体规模。

papers.title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
papers.abstract_en: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. Third, implementation: under affine query exposure, $2r$ signed slots approximate a rank-$r$ value update, but their values grow as $O(ε^{-3/2})$, and the construction passes all 400 tolerance checks in float64 yet only 38 in bfloat16. A first-layer GPT-2 readout with fixed token and position meets the common-query condition without clamping activations; at three such heads, the capped optimum leaves 18.4\% to 74.2\% of the projected adapter effect uncompiled, with a head-dependent value--query ordering. All claims concern local approximation at one head, not whole-network equivalence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文判定固定连续 prefix 能否在注意力头冻结时替代 rank-r LoRA，取决于可观测性、可实现性与可实施性三个条件：单因果读出下 prefix 只经 query、attention partition 与 value 分子看到内容，摘要相同的目标存在与 prefix 长度无关的误差下界；范数受限最优解是一个可达到的二阶锥规划 (SOCP)。在 GPT-2 第一层三个头上，capped 最优解仍留下 18.4% 到 74.2% 的投影 adapter 效应未被编译，且 2r 个 signed slot 的构造值按 O(ε^{-3/2}) 增长，在 float64 通过全部 400 次容差检查、bfloat16 只通过 38 次。
Motivation: LoRA 等低秩 adapter 需要额外权重，若能用固定 prefix 在冻结注意力头内等价替代即可省去这些参数，但什么条件下 prefix 能编译给定 adapter 缺少可判定的判据。
Method: 从单因果读出的摘要结构 (query、attention partition、value 分子) 推导可观测性误差下界；在公共 query 下把任意 prefix 化简为两个聚合变量，将范数受限最优解表述为可达到的二阶锥规划，并在固定输出投影下重解；再在 affine query exposure 下构造 2r 个 signed slot 近似 rank-r value update，并在 GPT-2 第一层读出 (固定 token 与位置、不 clamp 激活) 上检验。
Result: 2r signed slot 构造的值按 O(ε^{-3/2}) 增长，float64 下通过全部 400 次容差检查，bfloat16 下仅通过 38 次；GPT-2 第一层三个满足公共 query 条件的头上，capped 最优解留下 18.4% 到 74.2% 的投影 adapter 效应未被编译，且 value--query 排序随头变化。
Conclusion: prefix 能否替代 LoRA 由 adapter 目标决定：受范数上限约束时存在不可消除的误差下界与未编译残余，且所有结论只针对单头局部近似而非全网络等价。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRASP 用图谱路径 (graph-spectral path) 替换 flow matching 的线性概率路径，把变量间依赖写进生成动力学：以动能加图 Dirichlet 能的固定端点作用量最小化，得到基于图频率双曲插值的闭式路径，再用正常数据上训练的速度预测器按源样本、流时间与图频率加权的速度差异检出异常。四个基准上的实验显示其异常检测性能更优，并验证了图谱路径与加权机制有效。
Motivation: 多变量时间序列异常检测通常靠正常数据训练模型再比对重构差异，而标准 flow matching 的线性概率路径忽略变量间依赖，与结构化数据分布不对齐。
Method: GRASP 在概率路径中引入图结构，最小化结合动能与图 Dirichlet 能的固定端点作用量，导出图频率依赖的双曲插值闭式路径；在正常数据上训练速度预测器，按源样本、流时间、图频率加权聚合速度差异作为异常分数。理论上证明结果对 Laplacian 特征基选择不变，并把期望 oracle 异常分数分解为有界端点不确定性与图频率加权 Fisher 差异两项。
Result: 在四个基准上的实验中 GRASP 展示了更优的异常检测性能，并验证了图谱路径与加权机制的有效性；理论结果给出 Laplacian 特征基不变性与期望 oracle 分数的两项分解。
Conclusion: 把变量依赖写进 flow matching 的概率路径（而非只用线性插值）能改善多变量时间序列异常检测，且该分数可分解为端点不确定性与图频率加权 Fisher 差异。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities
papers.abstract_en: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦聚类中客户端本地簇数 K_g 通常被假定已知，本文提出两阶段框架让 K_g 与全局 K 都未知：客户端先用 Adaptive Split-Merge (ASM) 从自身数据估计 K_g，再把估计值交给需要本地簇数的聚合器 FedGEM。在八个数据集上，ASM+FedGEM 平均 ARI 0.333，高于次优无标签估计器的 0.256，接近提供真实本地簇数时的 0.361。
Motivation: 已有无需全局簇数 K 的联邦聚类方法仍假设每个客户端知道自己的本地簇数 K_g；当客户端对自身数据的了解不比服务器多时（如独立运营的工业站点间的故障诊断），这一假设难以成立。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段由各客户端用 Adaptive Split-Merge (ASM) 无标签估计 K_g——以 BIC 驱动的分裂生长球形高斯混合再合并多余成分，超参数仅在客户端留出数据上选择；第二阶段把估计的 K_g 输入需要本地簇数的聚合器 FedGEM。另推导闭式分裂判据，其临界簇大小随各向异性下降、随维度上升。
Result: 八个数据集上 ASM+FedGEM 平均 ARI 0.333，次优无标签估计器 0.256，提供真实本地簇数时 0.361；同时给出最可靠的全局 K 估计，且在客户端规模与本地簇数解耦时表现稳健。经验上过度碎片化随每簇点数增加而加剧，而联邦化会把点数分摊到各客户端。
Conclusion: 本地簇数可以由客户端无标签自估后替代真值送入聚合器，性能接近提供真实计数的水平；闭式判据表明临界簇大小随各向异性下降、随维度上升。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuantMLA 为 MLA 的 content 与 RoPE 双路径 KV cache 建立量化误差模型，解释 RoPE 路径误差为何被放大，并在可离线融合进参数的路径特定变换空间内做 function-aligned 量化。在四个 MLA 模型族上实现首个 content+RoPE 联合 INT4 缓存且精度损失极小，content 降到 INT2、RoPE 保持 INT4 时在推理与代码基准上仍有竞争力；128K 上下文物理缓存压缩 3.59x，cache-pressure 负载下整作业输出吞吐比 BF16 高 5.168x。
Motivation: MLA 的紧凑 cache 仍随上下文长度与 batch size 线性增长，双路径量化误差对 attention 输出的失真机制不同，RoPE 路径误差还会被显著放大，低比特缓存因此难以在可接受精度损失下落地。
Method: 先对 MLA 双路径量化误差建模，区分其对 attention 输出失真的影响；再推导保全精度计算且可离线融合进模型参数的路径特定变换空间，在其中以 function-aligned 目标学习变换——content 路径用 attention-output 重建刻画耦合的 matching 与 aggregation 误差，RoPE 路径用 positional QK 重建保留 logits 中 RoPE 分量并给出输出失真的理论界；同时开发把解包与反量化直接并入 attention 计算的原生低比特 kernel。
Result: 在四个 MLA 模型族上实现首个 content 与 RoPE cache 联合 INT4 缓存且精度损失极小；content cache 进一步压到 INT2、RoPE key cache 保持 INT4 时，在有挑战的推理与代码基准上保持竞争力。物理 cache 布局在 128K 上下文带来 3.59x 压缩，cache-pressure 服务负载下整作业输出吞吐达到 BF16 的 5.168x。
Conclusion: 双路径量化误差可被分别建模并用路径特定、可离线融合的变换对齐到函数输出，从而让 MLA 的低比特 KV 缓存在精度与推理吞吐上同时成立；代码将在论文接收后发布。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 双路径量化误差可被分别建模并用路径特定、可离线融合的变换对齐到函数输出，从而让 MLA 的低比特 KV 缓存在精度与推理吞吐上同时成立；代码将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: Dual-Mode Low-Rank Learner with Bridge-Prototype Ensemble for Vision-Language Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Benefiting from transferable visual-textual alignment, CLIP has been widely adopted for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, existing learners either repeatedly update components shared across tasks, leading to knowledge overwriting, or overly isolate new-task updates, hindering the reuse of CLIP's transferable knowledge and limiting plasticity. Moreover, the text-based or bimodal classifier designs still fail to effectively integrate complementary information from the visual and textual modalities. To address these challenges, we introduce DuLBE, which couples dual-mode low-rank learning with a bridge-prototype ensemble classifier for exemplar-free CIL. DuLBE allocates two visual low-rank update modes according to the gradient demand and uses gradient routing to coordinate them: a compact and rewritable shared mode is selected from historically occupied visual directions to reuse transferable knowledge, while residual modes provide low-interference channels for task-specific variations. Building on the resulting stable inter-modal structure, we further construct geodesic bridges between visual prototypes and text embeddings on the unit hypersphere, and ensemble reliable bridge prototypes to compensate for the modality-gap limitations of textual decision boundaries. Extensive experiments under multiple settings show that DuLBE achieves state-of-the-art CIL performance while retaining the high parameter efficiency of low-rank tuning.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, and 12 tables, including the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuLBE 把 CLIP 的类增量学习 (CIL) 拆成两种视觉低秩更新模式并用梯度路由协调：从历史占用的视觉方向中选一个紧凑可重写的共享模式复用可迁移知识，残差模式以低干扰通道承载任务特有变化；再在单位超球面上构造视觉原型与文本嵌入之间的测度桥 (geodesic bridge) 并集成可靠桥原型，弥补纯文本决策边界的模态鸿沟。在多种设定下达到 SOTA 的无样本 (exemplar-free) CIL 性能，同时保持低秩微调的参数效率。
Motivation: 现有 CLIP-based CIL 学习器要么反复更新跨任务共享组件导致知识覆写，要么过度隔离新任务更新而牺牲 CLIP 可迁移知识与可塑性；文本式或双模态分类器也未能有效融合视觉与文本模态的互补信息。
Method: DuLBE 按梯度需求分配两种视觉低秩更新模式并用 gradient routing 协调：共享模式从历史占用的视觉方向中选取、紧凑且可重写，残差模式提供低干扰通道；在此稳定跨模态结构上，在单位超球面的视觉原型与文本嵌入间构造 geodesic bridges，并集成可靠桥原型构成分类器，全程无需存储样本 (exemplar-free)。
Result: 在多种设定下的实验中，DuLBE 取得 state-of-the-art 的 CIL 性能，同时保持低秩微调的高参数效率（具体数值见论文 12 张表格）。
Conclusion: 把共享可重写与任务特异低干扰两类低秩更新分开并用梯度路由协调，配合超球面上的桥原型集成，可以在不存样本的前提下同时保住 CLIP 的可迁移性与新任务可塑性。

papers.title: FastVR: Efficient Streaming Video Restoration with One-Step Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based video restoration recovers realistic details, but its practical deployment is limited by two efficiency bottlenecks: costly VAE encoding and decoding, and the quadratic cost of full self-attention in diffusion transformers (DiTs). This paper presents FastVR, a streaming video restoration framework built on a one-step diffusion model, which delivers strong restoration quality and temporal consistency while processing 1080p video at 11 FPS on a single H20 GPU. To improve inference efficiency, FastVR combines a lightweight VAE with chunk-wise causal attention, which substantially reduces the computational cost. During training, it further adopts velocity consistency regularization and continuous trajectory learning, which improve restoration quality. Extensive experiments show that FastVR is more efficient than the evaluated diffusion baselines while achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. We hope that this work supports further progress in the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastVR 是基于一步扩散 (one-step diffusion) 的流式视频修复框架，用轻量 VAE 加 chunk-wise 因果注意力砍掉 VAE 编解码开销与 DiT 全自注意力的二次复杂度，在单张 H20 GPU 上以 11 FPS 处理 1080p 视频，同时在合成与真实基准上取得所评估基线中的 SOTA 修复质量与时序一致性。
Motivation: 扩散视频修复的部署受两个效率瓶颈限制：昂贵的 VAE 编解码，以及扩散 Transformer 中全自注意力的二次复杂度，使高分辨率流式处理难以落地。
Method: 框架建立在一步扩散模型上，推理端组合轻量 VAE 与 chunk-wise 因果注意力以降低计算量；训练端加入 velocity consistency regularization 与 continuous trajectory learning 两项正则来提升修复质量。
Result: 在单张 H20 GPU 上以 11 FPS 处理 1080p 视频；在合成与真实基准上，比所评估的扩散基线更高效，同时达到 state-of-the-art 修复性能。
Conclusion: 把 VAE 轻量化、因果分块注意力与一步扩散的轨迹学习结合起来，可以在保持 SOTA 修复质量的同时让 1080p 流式视频修复达到实时量级。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On downstream image generation, it achieves the state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.46 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 among existing variable-length autoregressive image generation methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/jaiwei804/NesTok.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NesTok 用嵌套自对齐 (nested self-alignment) 训练一维变长视觉 tokenizer：跨长度训练联合优化各 token 长度的重建，并用全长序列引导较短序列，使短序列重建逼近全长水平。在 ImageNet 上 rFID 达 0.98，下游 ImageNet 256×256 变长自回归图像生成 gFID 达 1.46，为该类方法中最佳。
Motivation: 基于 nested dropout 的变长 tokenizer 未能用尽表示能力，重建与生成两头都次优，导致同一 tokenizer 下质量与算力的权衡空间受限。
Method: 提出 NesTok 嵌套自对齐框架，核心是 cross-length training：联合优化不同 token 长度下的重建目标，并以全长序列作为引导信号约束较短序列，训练得到的一维变长 tokenizer 供下游自回归模型按 token 数调节质量与开销。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上 rFID 0.98，显著优于标准训练；下游图像生成在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得 gFID 1.46，为现有变长自回归图像生成方法中的 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 让短 token 序列对齐全长序列的重建质量，是释放变长视觉 tokenizer 表示容量的有效路径，一个 tokenizer 即可支撑质量与算力的弹性权衡。

papers.title: Drag as Evidence: Motion-Grounded Latent Recomposition for Drag-Based Editing
papers.abstract_en: Modern image editors excel at semantic manipulation and visual synthesis, yet remain limited in precise spatial control, motivating the development of drag-based editing. However, existing drag-based methods often struggle to balance drag accuracy with natural, plausible, and intent-aligned generation. We propose MoRe-Drag, a motion-grounded drag-based editing method. Our key insight is to treat pixel-space warping as coarse motion evidence, and to inject this evidence into the generative sampling trajectory. Specifically, MoRe-Drag performs region-aware latent recomposition over refinement, inpainting, and anchor regions, coupled with stage-adaptive conditioning that progressively shifts from motion-grounded structure formation to semantic refinement. We further support an instruction-free interface by adapting the MLLM-based text encoder for drag-aware instruction inference. Experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR show that MoRe-Drag substantially improves drag precision over strong base editors and achieves superior drag accuracy among SOTA drag-based methods, while delivering strong semantic consistency and visually realistic results. Code and dataset will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoRe-Drag 把像素空间形变当作粗运动证据注入生成采样轨迹，通过区域感知的 latent 重组（refinement/inpainting/anchor 三区）与阶段自适应条件，把结构先从运动约束成形再转向语义精修。在 DragBench-SR 与 DragBench-DR 上，其拖拽精度优于强基线编辑器并达到 SOTA 拖拽方法中的领先水平，同时保持语义一致性与真实感。
Motivation: 拖拽式图像编辑难以同时兼顾拖拽点的几何精度与生成结果的自然、意图一致，现有方法两者常此消彼长。
Method: MoRe-Drag 将像素空间 warping 作为粗运动证据注入扩散采样轨迹：对 refinement、inpainting、anchor 三类区域做区域感知的 latent recomposition，并配合阶段自适应条件（先运动约束结构、后语义精修）；另改造 MLLM 文本编码器以支持免指令的拖拽意图推断。
Result: 在 DragBench-SR 与 DragBench-DR 上，MoRe-Drag 相对强基线编辑器显著提升拖拽精度，在 SOTA 拖拽方法中取得领先 drag accuracy，并保持强语义一致性与视觉真实感（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把形变当作可注入采样轨迹的运动证据、并按区域分阶段重组 latent，是兼顾拖拽精度与生成质量的有效路径；代码与数据集将公开。

papers.title: cktFormer: Transformer-Based Approach for Automated Analog Circuit Design
papers.abstract_en: Circuit design is a complex and iterative process that requires expertise in electronic engineering. It involves selecting components while meeting performance constraints, such as power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and signal integrity. However, manual design is time-consuming and prone to errors. Although other stages of the manufacturing pipeline have benefited from AI-driven optimizations, circuit design remains a bottleneck, limiting overall productivity. Generative AI and machine learning offer the potential to automate and improve this stage, boosting efficiency and accuracy. To address this, we introduce a dual transformer architecture that bridges the gap between AI and circuit design by leveraging attention mechanisms to model complex, non-sequential circuit relationships. Our approach structures netlist data into graph-based representations, enabling effective learning of circuit topology and component interactions. The system consists of two interlinked models: a node prediction model that proposes components and an edge prediction model that infers valid connections. This collaborative and decoupled design captures both component-level semantics and global structural coherence. In our experiments, this architecture outperforms recent models such as AnalogGenie and cktGNN in the validity of generated circuits. By addressing key limitations in existing methods, our work advances automation in electronics engineering and contributes a benchmark for AI-driven circuit synthesis.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, IECON 2025 51st Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society
papers.journal_ref: IECON 2025 - 51st Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society, 2025, pp. 1-6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: cktFormer 用双 Transformer 架构做模拟电路自动设计：把 netlist 结构化为图表示，一个节点预测模型选元件、一个边预测模型推断合法连接，两者解耦协同。实验中生成电路的合法性超过 AnalogGenie 与 cktGNN 等近期模型。
Motivation: 模拟电路设计依赖专家经验、迭代耗时且易错，是制造流程中尚未被 AI 优化的瓶颈，限制整体生产力。
Method: 将 netlist 数据组织成基于图的表示以学习电路拓扑与元件交互；双模型架构中，节点预测模型提出元件，边预测模型推断有效连接，解耦设计同时捕捉元件级语义与全局结构一致性，依靠 attention 建模非序列化的电路关系。
Result: 在实验中，该架构在生成电路的合法性 (validity)上超过 AnalogGenie 和 cktGNN 等近期模型；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 解耦的节点-边双 Transformer 能同时保住元件语义与结构连贯性，可作为 AI 驱动电路合成的基准方案。

papers.title: Group-Marginalized Self-Rewarding RL Drives Zero-Label Self-Evolving
papers.abstract_en: Self-rewarding reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to self-evolve without human labels. Existing ensemble-based methods construct reward references from rollout groups and assign rewards accordingly. However, a response's reward representation also depends on its randomly sampled group context, i.e., the other responses in its group. Using only one group-context realization may miss desired reward signals and provide unreliable guidance for policy optimization. To address this issue, we propose Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE), which aggregates reward realizations across possible contexts into a response-level distribution and estimates expected advantages. Experiments across eight benchmarks and four base models demonstrate strong performance and cross-domain generalization. GMAE also exhibits stable learning, low extra cost, and good applicability across training datasets and RL backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE)，把同一响应在不同 rollout 组上下文下的多种奖励实现聚合为响应级分布并取期望优势，替代只用单次组上下文的自奖励 RL。在八个基准与四个基模型上验证，性能强、跨域泛化好，且学习稳定、额外开销低。
Motivation: 自奖励 RL 中响应的奖励表示依赖于随机采样的组上下文，只用一次组上下文实现会丢失期望的奖励信号，给策略优化带来不可靠的引导。
Method: GMAE 将同一响应在可能的组上下文下的多种奖励实现聚合为响应级分布，并在该分布上估计期望优势 (expected advantage)，替代仅基于单次 rollout 组的奖励参照。
Result: 在八个基准和四个基模型上的实验显示强性能与跨域泛化；GMAE 表现出稳定学习、低额外开销，并对不同训练数据集与 RL backbone 有良好适用性。
Conclusion: 把组上下文带来的奖励随机性边缘化后再估优势，可以在无人工标签的自奖励 RL 中提供更可靠、更稳定的优化信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing via Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge editing enables rapid updates of specific factual knowledge in large language models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, more realistic scenarios call for a lifelong framework that handles continual updates rather than one-off modifications. In such settings, existing editing methods often overfit to target prompts, significantly degrading both the generalization of the edited knowledge and the model's general capabilities. To address this issue, we propose GLIME (Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing), which combines knowledge editing with preference optimization over generation behavior. GLIME further incorporates replay-based editing and a gradient constraint to preserve previously edited knowledge. Experimental results show that GLIME significantly improves knowledge generalization in lifelong editing settings while maintaining both editing performance and general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLIME 把知识编辑与生成行为上的偏好优化 (preference optimization) 结合，用基于回放的编辑和梯度约束保住已编辑知识，缓解终身编辑中对目标 prompt 的过拟合。作者称其在终身编辑设定下显著提升被编辑知识的泛化性，同时保持编辑性能与模型通用能力。
Motivation: 现实场景需要持续更新而非一次性修改，现有编辑方法对目标 prompt 过拟合，导致被编辑知识的泛化性和模型通用能力同时明显下降。
Method: 提出 GLIME (Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing)：将知识编辑与针对生成行为的偏好优化结合，并加入 replay-based editing 与梯度约束 (gradient constraint) 以保留先前编辑的知识。
Result: 实验结果显示 GLIME 在终身编辑设定下显著改善知识泛化，同时维持编辑性能与通用能力；摘要未给出具体指标数值或数据集。
Conclusion: 把偏好优化与回放、梯度约束一起引入终身知识编辑，可以在持续更新中同时守住泛化性、编辑效果和通用能力。

papers.title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for self-evolving agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, existing learned skill curators typically optimize curation without explicitly modeling downstream executor behavior. We show that this can cause systematic cross-executor degradation: curators trained with different executors perform best when paired with their own training executor, indicating that effective skill curation is executor-dependent. We formulate behavior-adaptive skill curation and introduce EASE, a framework that learns a single curator that adapts its decisions to different executor behaviors. EASE maintains an online behavioral profile of recent execution patterns and conditions the curator on this profile, the current trajectory, and retrieved skills to add, modify, or remove skills from an evolving repository. We train the shared curator jointly across multiple frozen executors with reinforcement learning, using retrieval-aware and behavior-aware temporal attribution to focus optimization on curation actions with observable downstream influence. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, with executors ranging from Qwen3-8B/32B and GPT-OSS-120B to unseen Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, EASE outperforms strong skill- and memory-based baselines without per-executor finetuning. EASE also maintains 34.5--41.0% fewer skills, improves skill retrieval by 36.3--38.7% and measured edit utility by 51.8--60.0%, and reduces deployment-time inference tokens by 9.1--14.5%. These results establish behavior-adaptive skill curation as an effective principle for building self-evolving agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EASE 学一个跨执行器通用的技能策展器 (skill curator)：维护执行器近期行为的在线 profile，把 profile、当前轨迹和检索到的技能一起作为条件，对技能库做增删改，并用 retrieval-aware 与 behavior-aware 的时序归因把 RL 优化集中在对下游有可观测影响的策展动作上。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，对 Qwen3-8B/32B、GPT-OSS-120B 及未见过的 Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash，无需按执行器微调即超过强技能与记忆基线，技能数少 34.5–41.0%，检索提升 36.3–38.7%，编辑效用提升 51.8–60.0%，部署期推理 token 减少 9.1–14.5%。
Motivation: 现有学习式技能策展器优化策展时显式忽略下游执行器行为，导致系统性的跨执行器退化：用某执行器训练的策展器只在配对同一执行器时表现最好，说明有效策展本身是 executor-dependent 的。
Method: EASE 维护执行器近期执行模式的在线行为 profile，将该 profile、当前轨迹与检索到的技能共同条件化策展器，对演化技能库执行 add/modify/remove；用 RL 在多个冻结执行器上联合训练这一个共享策展器，并引入 retrieval-aware 与 behavior-aware 的时序归因，把优化聚焦到有可观测下游影响的策展动作。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，执行器覆盖 Qwen3-8B/32B、GPT-OSS-120B 以及未见过的 Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash，EASE 无需按执行器微调即超过强 skill-based 与 memory-based 基线；同时技能数少 34.5–41.0%，技能检索提升 36.3–38.7%，测得的编辑效用 (edit utility) 提升 51.8–60.0%，部署期推理 token 减少 9.1–14.5%。
Conclusion: 行为自适应策展是构建自进化 agent 的有效原则：把执行器行为纳入策展决策，一个共享策展器即可跨已见与未见执行器泛化，同时更省技能、更省推理 token。

papers.title: SIPO: Unifying Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for improving large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, yet its sparse outcome rewards lack token-level credit assignment for intermediate steps. To address this, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a self-teacher with privileged context to provide additional dense learning signals. However, because the self-teacher is often overconfident and imposes excessive penalties on long reasoning trajectories, OPSD frequently struggles in practice. To mitigate this, we propose self-instructing policy optimization (SIPO) with a contrastive self-teacher to provide dense credit. At each iteration, SIPO samples multiple rollouts per prompt from the current policy, scores them with environment rewards, and constructs two teacher contexts for each rollout by pairing the reference answer with mistakes made within the group. The model then re-evaluates its own responses under both contexts, using the difference between the two teacher log-probabilities as token-level feedback, so that biases shared by both contexts are expected to largely cancel. The resulting objective yields a token-level advantage for every rollout: the reward still sets the main direction of each update while the self-teacher redistributes credit across tokens. Even in groups where every rollout fails and group-relative advantages vanish, SIPO still provides a learning signal. By preserving direct optimization of the task reward while providing dense, token-level feedback, this approach bridges reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that SIPO outperforms both RLVR and OPSD baselines without an external teacher or additional generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIPO 用对比式自教师 (contrastive self-teacher) 把 on-policy 自蒸馏并入 RLVR：对每条 rollout 构造两个教师上下文（参考答案 vs 组内错误），取两者的 log-probability 差作为 token 级反馈，共享偏差相互抵消。奖励仍主导更新方向，自教师只在 token 间重分配 credit，即使组内全部失败、组相对优势为零也仍有学习信号；在多个推理与代码生成基准上同时超过 RLVR 和 OPSD 基线，且不需要外部教师或额外生成。
Motivation: RLVR 的稀疏结果奖励无法给中间步骤做 token 级 credit assignment；而现有 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 的自教师常过度自信、对长推理轨迹惩罚过重，实践中难以奏效。
Method: 每轮从当前策略对每个 prompt 采样多条 rollout 并用环境奖励打分；对每条 rollout 用参考答案与组内错误配对构造两个教师上下文，模型在两个上下文下重评自身回答，取两个教师 log-probability 之差作为 token 级反馈，与任务奖励合成 token 级 advantage。
Result: 在多个推理与代码生成基准上，SIPO 同时优于 RLVR 与 OPSD 基线，无需外部教师、不需额外生成；即使组内所有 rollout 都失败、组相对优势消失时仍产生学习信号。
Conclusion: 直接优化任务奖励与密集 token 级自蒸馏反馈可以共存：奖励定方向、对比自教师重分配 credit，从而把强化学习与 on-policy 自蒸馏桥接起来。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Distinguish or Homogenize: Last-Chance Policy Identification and Risk-Budgeted Recovery under Irreversible Resource Depletion
papers.abstract_en: Under irreversible resource depletion, an agent can spend resources to distinguish among latent fault models, or to change the system state so that the remaining models admit a common acceptable continuation--at which point further diagnosis becomes unnecessary. This distinguish-or-homogenize principle identifies a path that existing frameworks for identification, planning, and diagnosis do not make explicit: prior formulations treat the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a given, whereas LCPI makes it a function of the agent's own actions. We formalize this principle through Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI), where correctness is evaluated at the state the agent reaches rather than at the initial state. The Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marks the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing. For deterministic diagnostic graphs we provide the Exact-LIM recursion; for noisy finite-horizon recovery we propose Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP), which searches a compatibility-aware frontier under a hard worst-case failure constraint. Across incident recovery on abstract microservice topologies and latent-damage navigation in MiniGrid, RBCP improves risk-feasible recovery while satisfying the failure budget. A sham control--cost-matched actions that preserve model incompatibility--eliminates the gain entirely, confirming that the benefit comes from changing which policies are acceptable for which models, not from extra search or additional budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI)：在不可逆资源耗尽下，正确性按智能体到达的状态而非初始状态评估，agent 可以选择区分潜在故障模型，或改变系统状态使剩余模型共享可接受的延续（distinguish-or-homogenize）。判定边界由 Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) 给出，噪声有限时域恢复用 Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP) 在硬最坏失败约束下搜索兼容性前沿。
Motivation: 既有辨识、规划与诊断框架把故障模型到可接受策略的映射当作给定，无法表达 agent 自身动作可以改变哪些模型共享可接受策略；在不可逆资源耗尽下这会错过本可利用的恢复路径。
Method: 对确定性诊断图给出 Exact-LIM 递归以刻画区分与同质化的可行性边界；对噪声有限时域恢复提出 RBCP，在硬最坏失败约束下搜索兼容性感知前沿。评估用抽象微服务拓扑上的 incident recovery 与 MiniGrid 中的 latent-damage navigation，并设成本匹配、保持模型不兼容的 sham control。
Result: 在抽象微服务拓扑的 incident recovery 与 MiniGrid latent-damage navigation 上，RBCP 在满足失败预算的同时提升 risk-feasible recovery；成本匹配且保持模型不兼容的 sham control 完全消除该增益。
Conclusion: 增益来自改变哪些策略对哪些模型可接受，而非更多搜索或额外预算；distinguish-or-homogenize 是既有辨识与规划框架未显式刻画的一条路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Offline Learning of Ranking Policies via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Many recommender systems such as for e-commerce and news platforms aim to provide users with rankings they are likely to interact with. Off-Policy Learning (OPL) of ranking policies enables us to learn new ranking policies using only historical logged data. However, ranking settings make OPL remarkably challenging because their action spaces consist of permutations of unique items, being extremely large. Existing methods primarily use either policy- or regression-based approaches. The policy-based approach, which typically uses importance-weighted policy gradients, can suffer from high variance due to large action spaces. The regression-based approach, on the other hand, estimates the expected reward using conventional machine learning methods, avoiding variance issues but potentially suffering from severe bias. To circumvent these issues of existing methods, we propose a new OPL method for ranking, named Ranking Policy Optimization via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition (R-POD), which combines the policy- and regression-based approaches in an effective fashion. Specifically, R-POD decomposes a ranking policy into a first-stage policy for selecting top-$k$ actions and a second-stage policy for choosing the bottom actions given the top-$k$ actions. It learns the first-stage policy using a new policy gradient estimator and the second-stage policy via the regression-based approach. This method can substantially reduce variance, since it applies importance weighting only to the top-$k$ actions. We also demonstrate that our policy-gradient estimator for the first-stage policy is unbiased under a conditional pairwise correctness condition, which only requires that the expected reward differences of pairs of rankings sharing the same top-$k$ actions can be estimated correctly.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at CIKM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出排序策略的离线策略学习 (OPL) 方法 R-POD，把排序策略分解为选 top-k 的第一阶段与给定 top-k 后选剩余动作的第二阶段：第一阶段用新的 policy gradient estimator 学习，第二阶段走回归路线，重要性加权只作用于 top-k 动作以压低方差。作者证明该估计量在 conditional pairwise correctness 条件下无偏，该条件只要求能正确估计共享同一 top-k 动作的排序对之间的期望奖励差。
Motivation: 排序动作空间是唯一物品的排列，规模极大：基于策略的重要性加权梯度方差高，基于回归的方法虽避开方差却有严重偏差，现有 OPL 排序方法难以两全。
Method: R-POD 将排序策略拆成 top-k 第一阶段与 bottom 第二阶段；第一阶段用新的 policy gradient estimator（重要性权重只覆盖 top-k 动作）训练，第二阶段用回归式方法估计期望奖励；并给出该估计量在 conditional pairwise correctness 条件下的无偏性证明。
Result: 给出的理论结果是：第一阶段的 policy-gradient estimator 在 conditional pairwise correctness 条件下无偏，该条件仅要求共享相同 top-k 动作的排序对的期望奖励差可被正确估计；方法被声称可显著降低方差，因为重要性加权只施加于 top-k 动作。
Conclusion: 把排序 OPL 按 top-k 分解、让策略梯度与回归各管一段，是在大排列动作空间下同时缓解方差与偏差的可行路径，其无偏性依赖 pairwise 奖励差可正确估计这一条件。
Relevance: 0
