papers.title: Frontier Autolab: Organizational Memory, Adversarial Dissent and Temporal Leakage in Multi-Agent LLM Firms Across Fifty Years of Technological Change
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly structured like organizations, with roles, critics and shared memory, yet they are evaluated on tasks that last minutes. We ask how such an organization behaves when the ground it stands on keeps moving. Frontier Autolab is a long-horizon testbed in which one simulated firm, voiced by sixteen role personas and a dedicated Red Team, must re-found itself in nine technology eras from 1990 to 2040. Each era is temporally gated: the firm decides from a dated briefing, a historian-judge then reveals what happened and scores the decision on a five-dimension rubric, and lessons enter a persistent Playbook. Six eras are scored against history, one against the live market and two are open forecasts. Across four trajectories (36 era decisions, 180 subscores) we find a consistent foresight-commitment gap: in all 24 historically scored eras the judge rated the firm's recognition of the coming shift above its choice of where to build (mean gap 1.9 points on a 10-point scale), because boards chose the layer their existing assets could reach. Organizational design shaped long-run character. A Red Team armed with numeric kill gates produced fifty years of gated pilots and no product, and the rubric rated this firm highest; firms whose memory stored market-structure lessons pivoted every era, while a firm whose memory stored only validation procedure kept one method throughout. We also show why such results are hard to trust. Scores rise across eras in every run while the judge's own hindsight subscore falls (within-run r = -0.58), so apparent learning is confounded with recall of history, and we trace further distortions to self-judging, briefing selection and score aggregation. We release all records and an API harness, and specify fictional and post-cutoff eras that would turn the testbed into a benchmark.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LoopGlitch26/Frontier-Autolab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Frontier Autolab 是一个长时程多-agent LLM 测试床：一个由 16 个角色人格加 Red Team 构成的模拟公司，需在 1990–2040 九个技术时代中重新自我奠基，每个时代按日期门控决策、由 historian-judge 按五维评分并把经验写入持久 Playbook。四条轨迹（36 次时代决策、180 个子分）显示一致的“预见—投入”缺口：24 个历史评分时代中识别变革的得分均高于选择在哪里建设（10 分制平均差 1.9 分），且分数随时代上升与 judge 自身 hindsight 子分下降相关（within-run r = -0.58），说明表面学习与历史回忆混淆。
Motivation: 多-agent LLM 系统被组织化（角色、批评者、共享记忆）却只在持续几分钟的任务上评测；缺少能检验组织在地面持续移动（跨数十年技术变革）时如何行为的长时程测试床。
Method: 构建 Frontier Autolab：一个模拟公司由 16 个角色人格与专职 Red Team 构成，在 1990–2040 的九个技术时代中重新自我奠基；每个时代按时间门控——公司基于带日期的 briefing 决策，historian-judge 事后揭示真实发生的事并按五维 rubric 打分，经验写入持久 Playbook。六个时代对照历史评分、一个对照实时市场、两个为开放预测；共四条轨迹、36 次时代决策、180 个子分，并追踪自评、briefing 选择与分数聚合带来的失真。
Result: 在全部 24 个历史评分时代，judge 给出的“识别即将到来的转变”得分均高于“选择在哪里建设”得分，10 分制平均差距 1.9 分，原因是董事会选择其现有资产能触及的层。组织设计决定长期性格：配备数值 kill gates 的 Red Team 造就五十年门控试点而无产品，却在 rubric 下得分最高；记忆存储市场结构教训的公司每个时代都转型，而只存储验证流程的公司全程沿用同一方法。分数在每次运行中随时代上升，而 judge 自身的 hindsight 子分下降（within-run r = -0.58），表面学习与历史回忆混淆；作者还把进一步失真追溯到自评、briefing 选择与分数聚合。
Conclusion: 长时程多-agent 组织的“学习”信号可能由 judge 的历史回忆与评测设计失真驱动，因此此类结果在加入虚构与 post-cutoff 时代并转成 benchmark 之前难以信任；作者公开全部记录与 API harness。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Backpropagated Output Momentum: Relocating Optimizer History from Parameters to Task Space
papers.abstract_en: Optimizer momentum is usually stored as a parameter-sized moving average of past gradients, which makes history costly and fixes each past signal in the coordinates in which it was computed. We introduce Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM), which instead stores a compact moving average of prediction errors at the model output and reprojects that history through the current network at every step. A batch-level analysis characterizes the information retained and omitted by this relocation, while the implementation preserves the current supervised gradient and can replace the first-moment component of several adaptive optimizers. As a plug-in for momentum-based optimizers, including ones that already compress their state, BOM reduces parameter-shaped optimizer state by 49.7-99.8% in three compositions and, averaged over three language backbones, paired step time by 4.0%. It also improves mean validation performance across language and vision fine-tuning, by 1.42 points in the primary five-task comparison. Language and vision pretraining studies, together with matched mechanism controls, further test the construction across output spaces and model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM)，把优化器动量从参数空间的梯度滑动平均改为模型输出处的预测误差滑动平均，每步经当前网络重投影回参数空间，可替换多个自适应优化器的一阶矩分量。作为即插即用组件，它在三种组合下把参数形状的优化器状态减少 49.7-99.8%，三个语言 backbone 平均配对步时缩短 4.0%，并在语言与视觉微调的五任务主对比上平均提升 1.42 点验证性能。
Motivation: 常规动量按参数尺寸保存历史梯度，存储开销大，且把过去的信号固定在计算时所用的坐标系中，无法随网络更新而重新表达。
Method: BOM 在模型输出端维护预测误差的紧凑滑动平均，每步通过当前网络把该历史重投影到参数空间，同时保留当前监督梯度；作为插件替换 momentum 类与自适应优化器（含已压缩状态者）的一阶矩分量，并用 batch 级分析刻画这次搬移保留与丢弃的信息，辅以匹配的机制对照实验。
Result: 三种组合下参数形状优化器状态减少 49.7-99.8%；三个语言 backbone 平均配对步时降低 4.0%；语言与视觉微调的五任务主对比上平均验证性能提升 1.42 点；另在语言与视觉预训练及匹配机制对照中检验该构造在不同输出空间与模型规模上的表现。
Conclusion: 把优化器历史搬到任务输出空间并经当前网络重投影，可以在压缩状态、略降步时的同时不牺牲反而提升微调性能，且该机制跨输出空间与模型规模成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BiFE: Search-Efficient Discovery of CPU-Only Branching Policies via LLM-based Bi-Fidelity Evolution
papers.abstract_en: In branch-and-bound (B&B) for mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), branching variable selection critically impacts efficiency. Existing neural branching policies often require GPU inference, while CPU-efficient symbolic expressions lack the representational capacity for complex logic. Large Language Model (LLM)-generated code provides a flexible search space for designing lightweight branching rules with diverse algorithmic logic. To discover effective rules within LLM-based evolutionary frameworks, a core challenge arises: full B&B evaluation on real instances is prohibitively expensive, whereas offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift. To address this, we introduce a Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary framework (BiFE). It employs low-fidelity imitation scores as a rapid pre-screener and selectively applies high-fidelity on-instance evaluation only to elite candidates, effectively balancing search efficiency with performance reliability. Experiments validate both the search efficiency of BiFE and the competitiveness of its discovered rules, which outperform the SCIP solver and other baselines on CPUs, and even surpass certain GPU-based neural policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiFE 用 LLM 生成分支规则代码，在分支定界 (B&B) 搜索中以低保真模仿分数快速预筛，只对精英候选做高保真实例评估，从而在 CPU 上发现高效的 MILP 分支策略。发现的规则在 CPU 上超越 SCIP 求解器与其他基线，甚至超过部分基于 GPU 的神经策略。
Motivation: MILP 分支变量选择直接决定 B&B 效率，但神经分支策略通常需要 GPU 推理，CPU 上的符号表达式又缺乏表达能力；在 LLM 进化框架中，真实实例上的完整 B&B 评估代价过高，离线模仿学习则有分布偏移。
Method: Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary 框架 (BiFE)：LLM 生成多样算法逻辑的轻量分支规则代码作为搜索空间，用低保真模仿分数做快速预筛，仅对精英候选施加高保真实例评估，在搜索效率与性能可靠性之间折中。
Result: 实验验证了 BiFE 的搜索效率与其所发现规则的竞争力：这些规则在 CPU 上超越 SCIP 求解器及其他基线，并超过部分基于 GPU 的神经策略。
Conclusion: 以低保真预筛加精英高保真评估的双保真进化，可以在 CPU 上搜出比 SCIP 乃至部分 GPU 神经策略更强的分支规则，绕开完整 B&B 评估的高成本与模仿学习的分布偏移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
papers.abstract_en: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of programs written by three user agents from different model families. The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages. On eleven of the fifteen tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions of the human-written production library. Downstream agents adopt agent- and human-written libraries alike but underuse them, reimplementing capabilities the library already provides. Our failure analysis finds that downstream agents write extra code mainly because agent-written libraries are rigid or hard to use, not because capabilities are missing. We also experiment with giving designers more prescriptive, agent-first guidance and having them test their library with subagents; this improves downstream scores and yields simpler programs. LibraryDesignBench provides both a testbed for evaluating library-design practices for agent users and an initial design baseline that improves downstream reuse.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SprocketLab/librarydesignbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LibraryDesignBench：让设计 agent 依据只规定能力与用例、不规定设计的 spec 实现完整库，再用三个不同模型家族的用户 agent 所写程序的正确性与简洁度来评测。15 个库设计任务中 11 个能复现人类生产库的抽象；下游 agent 虽会采用这些库却普遍少用、重复实现已有能力，失败主因是 agent 写的库僵硬难用而非缺能力；给设计者更规定性的 agent-first 指导并让 subagent 测试其库可提升下游得分并产出更简洁程序。
Motivation: agent 越来越多地在其他 agent 写的代码上继续构建，却倾向重新实现而非复用，导致代码库不断膨胀；缺少衡量 agent 为其他 agent 设计库质量的基准。
Method: 两阶段基准：设计 agent 从规定必需能力与潜在用例、但不规定设计的规格出发实现完整功能库；再由三个不同模型家族的用户 agent 用该库写程序，按正确性与简洁度评分。覆盖 4 种编程语言、15 个库设计任务、242 个专家验证的编程问题；另设消融：给设计者更规定性的 agent-first 指导，并让其用 subagent 测试库。

papers.title: Can AI Scientists Change Their Minds? Prior-Evidence Conflict in Synthetic Universes
papers.abstract_en: Can a scientific agent distinguish a law it inferred from evidence from one it merely recognizes? We introduce Synthetic Universes, a controlled benchmark that pairs canonical famous worlds with matched twisted twins governed by nearby noncanonical mechanisms. We evaluate each reported law twice: by executing it on held-out continuations and transfer settings, and by independently checking whether it recovers the generating mechanism. In the current checkpoint of a pre-specified 60-cell study, 22 trials were graded and one additional run ended in infrastructure failure. Among 20 twin trials, 8 pass predictive verification while 5 recover the generator. The dissociation is bidirectional: six parsable outputs predict successfully while missing the mechanism, whereas three recover the mechanism but fail predictive rollout. Drag exhibits the first pattern (5/5 predictive pass, 1/5 mechanism recovery); Gravity exhibits the second (1/5 predictive pass, 4/5 mechanism recovery). Because matched famous controls, the corrected identifiability sweep, and the Evidence Ladder remain incomplete, we do not claim a confirmatory causal prior-conflict effect. Instead, the completed runs establish a narrower verification result: predictive adequacy and mechanism recovery are distinct scientific claims and require distinct tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Synthetic Universes 基准：把经典著名世界与配对的“扭曲孪生”世界（由邻近的非正统机制生成）配对，对科学智能体报告的定律做双重检验——既在留出延续与迁移设定上执行验证预测能力，又独立检查是否恢复生成机制。在预设 60 单元研究的当前检查点中，20 个孪生试验里 8 个通过预测验证、5 个恢复机制，且解离是双向的：Drag 5/5 预测通过但仅 1/5 恢复机制，Gravity 仅 1/5 预测通过却 4/5 恢复机制。
Motivation: 科学智能体可能只是“认出”一个著名定律而非从证据中推断出它；现有评测通常只看预测是否成功，无法区分预测充分性与机制恢复这两种不同的科学主张。
Method: 构建配对的 Synthetic Universes：canonical 著名世界与 matched twisted twin（由附近非正统机制生成）；对每条报告定律做两种独立评测——在 held-out continuations 与 transfer settings 上执行，以及检查是否恢复生成机制。研究为预设的 60 单元设计，含 matched famous controls、corrected identifiability sweep 与 Evidence Ladder。
Result: 当前检查点已评 22 个 trial，另有 1 次运行因基础设施故障终止。20 个 twin trial 中 8 个通过预测验证、5 个恢复机制；6 个可解析输出预测成功但缺失机制，3 个恢复机制但预测 rollout 失败。Drag 为 5/5 预测通过、1/5 机制恢复；Gravity 为 1/5 预测通过、4/5 机制恢复。
Conclusion: 作者不主张已确证的因果 prior-conflict 效应（因 matched famous controls、corrected identifiability sweep 与 Evidence Ladder 尚未完成），只主张已完成运行确立的更窄结论：预测充分性与机制恢复是不同的科学主张，需要不同的检验。

papers.title: Routing in Gradient Space: Balanced Usage Is Not Expert Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Sparse expert models can distribute traffic evenly while still grouping incompatible training signals within the same experts. We study routing as a gradient-partitioning problem and introduce gradient-aligned routing (GAR), whose load-normalized router objective rewards grouping observations with aligned gradients. On five multi-task text-classification mixtures, we compare GAR with task-loss-only routing, gradient-combination and gradient-conflict methods, and load-balancing losses. With a fully trainable RoBERTa backbone and classification-head experts, GAR has the highest aggregate validation accuracy, 1.07 percentage points above task-loss-only routing. With frozen DeBERTa and Qwen3-1.7B backbones and low-rank adapter experts, it again ranks first, 1.10 points above task-loss-only routing, with better-balanced expert load and higher gradient-mass purity, the share of each expert's gradient-norm mass from its dominant task; the load-balancing losses flatten load further but leave this purity near its task-loss-only level. Top-1 routing, trainable full-parameter feed-forward network (FFN) experts, and a larger backbone also show positive aggregate gains. The results distinguish expert-load balance from gradient-based routing organization and indicate the predictive value of gradient-informed routing in multi-task text classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把稀疏专家路由当作梯度划分问题，提出 gradient-aligned routing (GAR)，其负载归一化的路由目标奖励把梯度方向一致的样本分到同一专家。在五个多任务文本分类混合任务上，GAR 在可训练 RoBERTa + 分类头专家上聚合验证准确率比仅用任务损失的路由高 1.07 个百分点，在冻结 DeBERTa 与 Qwen3-1.7B + LoRA 专家上高 1.10 个百分点，且专家负载更均衡、梯度质量纯度更高。
Motivation: 稀疏专家模型可以做到负载均匀，却仍把互相冲突的训练信号分进同一专家；负载平衡损失压平了负载，却不改善专家内部的梯度组织。
Method: GAR 在路由目标中加入负载归一化项，按梯度对齐程度给样本分组；对比对象包括仅任务损失路由、梯度组合与梯度冲突方法、负载平衡损失，骨干为可训练 RoBERTa（分类头专家）以及冻结的 DeBERTa、Qwen3-1.7B（低秩适配器专家），并考察 Top-1 路由、可训练全参数 FFN 专家与更大骨干。
Result: 在五个多任务文本分类混合上，可训练 RoBERTa + 分类头专家设置下 GAR 聚合验证准确率最高，比仅任务损失路由高 1.07 个百分点；冻结 DeBERTa 与 Qwen3-1.7B + LoRA 专家设置下 GAR 仍排第一，高 1.10 个百分点，同时专家负载更均衡、梯度质量纯度（每个专家梯度范数质量中来自主导任务的份额）更高。负载平衡损失能把负载压得更平，但纯度仍停留在仅任务损失路由的水平。
Conclusion: 专家负载均衡与基于梯度的路由组织是两回事：负载平衡损失只改善前者，梯度信息才带来多任务文本分类上的预测收益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CALIBUDGET: Calibration-Guided Source Allocation for Fixed-Budget Mixed-Reasoning Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-budget adaptation from heterogeneous data sources requires deciding not only how much data to use, but how much exposure each source receives. Size-proportional rules can crowd out small sources, whereas difficulty-only rules can chase noisy estimates or allocate residual budget to nearly saturated pools. We introduce CALIBUDGET, a floor-protected, reliability-aware integer allocator that treats source exposure as an explicit adaptation variable. From small train-internal calibration splits, it combines model need, post-floor availability, and bootstrap stability, then produces exact capacity-respecting quotas without changing the model, objective, or total budget. In a controlled setting combining mathematical and commonsense data, CALIBUDGET improves CommonAvg, FragileAvg, and MacroAvg over validation-error-with-floor, the strongest matched comparator, in all three paired LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ runs. The respective mean gains are 0.56, 0.46, and 0.41 percentage points (pp). Overall increases by 0.18 pp, whereas MathAvg decreases by 0.20 pp, exposing a coverage-retention boundary rather than a uniform gain. CALIBUDGET changes only 1.14-1.42% of the source budget but improves performance in 15 of 24 comparisons across commonsense tasks and seeds. These results suggest that small changes in source quotas can matter; example-level selection can then determine which examples fill each quota.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CALIBUDGET 是一个带下限保护、考虑可靠性的整数数据源配额分配器，把「每个源获得多少曝光」当作显式自适应变量：从训练集内部的小校准切分出发，结合模型需求、下限后可用量与 bootstrap 稳定性，输出精确满足总预算的配额，且不改动模型、目标函数与总预算。在数学与常识混合的受控设置中，它相对最强匹配基线 validation-error-with-floor 在三组配对 LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ 运行上均提升 CommonAvg、FragileAvg、MacroAvg（平均增益 0.56、0.46、0.41 pp），Overall +0.18 pp，但 MathAvg 下降 0.20 pp，呈现覆盖-保留边界而非均匀增益。
Motivation: 固定预算下异构数据源的曝光分配：按规模成比例会让小源被挤出，只按难度则会追逐噪声估计或把剩余预算耗在接近饱和的池子上。
Method: CALIBUDGET：floor-protected、reliability-aware 的整数分配器，从 train-internal 校准切分估计模型需求、下限后可用量与 bootstrap 稳定性，再给出精确满足容量的配额；不改模型、目标与总预算。评测用 LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+，对照 validation-error-with-floor，跨常识任务与种子共 24 项比较。
Result: 在数学+常识混合的受控设置中，三组配对 LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ 运行上 CommonAvg、FragileAvg、MacroAvg 相对 validation-error-with-floor 均提升，平均增益分别为 0.56、0.46、0.41 pp；Overall +0.18 pp，MathAvg −0.20 pp。仅改动 1.14–1.42% 的源预算，即在 24 项比较中的 15 项上改善性能。
Conclusion: 小幅调整源配额即可影响最终性能，且增益与覆盖-保留权衡并存；配额定下后，example-level selection 决定每个配额由哪些样本填充。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Information-theoretic receding-horizon active learning of nonlinear dynamical systems
papers.abstract_en: Accurately learning nonlinear dynamics from a finite-duration experiment requires the efficient collection of informative data. We address this challenge for stochastic controlled nonlinear dynamical systems whose state is observed along a single trajectory. Our goal is to reconstruct the unknown controlled state-increment map over a prescribed compact subset of state-input space. We construct a parametric estimator of the map using fixed nonlinear features, so that the model is nonlinear in the state and input, but linear in the unknown parameters. A Gaussian prior over the parameters yields recursive Bayesian posterior updates as data stream in, enabling online quantification of predictive uncertainty in the reconstructed dynamics over the target set. We formulate an optimal adaptive-design problem over an information state, using a prediction-oriented acquisition criterion based on the mean marginal mutual information between candidate future trajectories and the reconstructed dynamics over the target set. We then approximate the resulting adaptive-design problem by a non-myopic receding-horizon formulation, evaluate its remaining expectation using a scenario-based sample average, and solve the resulting deterministic program with the cross-entropy method, leveraging parallel candidate-scenario evaluations. Numerical experiments on a noisy multistable system demonstrate that the proposed adaptive information-seeking strategy reduces predictive uncertainty and reconstruction error more efficiently than common excitation baselines under comparable experimental constraints.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对单条轨迹上观测的随机受控非线性系统，用固定非线性特征的线性参数模型加高斯先验做递归贝叶斯后验更新，再以候选未来轨迹与重构动力学之间的平均互信息为采集准则，做非短视滚动时域 (receding-horizon) 主动实验设计，并用场景样本均值加交叉熵法 (cross-entropy method) 求解。在含噪多稳态系统的数值实验中，该信息寻优策略在相当实验约束下比常用激励基线更高效地降低预测不确定性与重构误差。
Motivation: 有限时长实验中从单条轨迹学习受控非线性动力学，需要高效采集有信息量的数据；常用激励基线在同等实验约束下采集效率不足。
Method: 用固定非线性特征构造对状态与输入非线性、对未知参数线性的参数化估计器，参数高斯先验给出流式数据的递归贝叶斯后验更新，从而在线量化目标集上的预测不确定性；采集准则是候选未来轨迹与目标集上重构动力学之间的平均边际互信息 (mean marginal mutual information)，定义在信息状态上的最优自适应设计问题用非短视滚动时域近似，剩余期望用基于场景的样本均值估计，最终的确定性规划用交叉熵法 (cross-entropy method) 并行求解。
Result: 在含噪多稳态 (multistable) 系统的数值实验中，所提自适应信息寻优策略在相当实验约束下比常用激励基线 (common excitation baselines) 更高效地降低预测不确定性与重构误差。
Conclusion: 以互信息为采集准则的滚动时域主动设计，配合递归贝叶斯后验，能在单轨迹约束下更高效地重构未知受控状态增量映射。

papers.title: Into the danger zone: stable extrapolation in high-dimensional function and operator learning
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We study regression problems in which the test distribution differs from the training distribution and ask: under what assumptions on the target function or operator is stable extrapolation possible, and how far beyond the training domain can one extrapolate? Existing theory controls the test error through additive penalties measuring the discrepancy between the training and test distributions. Such guarantees show robustness to small distribution shifts, but can very pessimistic in comparison to OOD performance observed empirically. We identify classes of holomorphic functions and operators for which the OOD generalization error converges at algebraic rates even in the presence of large distribution shifts. This phenomenon stems from the increasing smoothness of higher-index coordinates, leading to what we term a `blessing of high dimensionality'. For learning with either polynomials, deep neural networks or deep neural operators, we derive explicit rates for arbitrary test measures supported on suitable domains and quantify how the admissible domain depends on the underlying regularity of the function or operator. Our extrapolation guarantees are independent of the test distribution, depending only on its support. We also present a series of numerical experiments across a range of functions and operators that support the main theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在科学机器学习的分布外 (OOD) 回归中，证明对全纯 (holomorphic) 函数与算子类，即使训练与测试分布偏移很大，OOD 误差仍按代数速率收敛，因为高维坐标指标越高越光滑，作者称之为“高维的祝福”。对多项式、深度神经网络与深度神经算子三类学习器都给出显式速率，且保证只依赖测试分布的支撑集而不依赖其本身。
Motivation: 现有 OOD 理论用训练/测试分布差异的加性罚项控制测试误差，只对小分布偏移稳健，相对实证 OOD 表现过于悲观，也无法回答“能外推多远”。
Method: 针对全纯函数与算子类推导 OOD 泛化误差的显式代数速率，覆盖多项式、深度神经网络与深度神经算子三种学习器；速率对任意支撑在合适区域上的测试测度成立，并量化可容许外推域随函数/算子正则性的依赖关系；辅以覆盖多类函数与算子的数值实验。
Result: 在大分布偏移下 OOD 误差仍按代数速率收敛；保证与测试分布无关、只依赖其支撑；可容许外推域随底层正则性变化被显式量化；数值实验覆盖一系列函数与算子并支持主要理论结论。
Conclusion: 稳定外推在高维全纯目标上是可能的，且高维本身（高指标坐标更光滑）是利好而非负担；外推保证应按测试分布支撑而非分布本身来写。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: JudgeProfile: Understanding and Steering Subjectivity in LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges are inherently subjective, often favoring different responses in pairwise comparison when neither option is objectively wrong. To study this subjectivity, we introduce JudgeProfile, a framework that dissects LLM evaluation into perception (how a judge compares two responses across specific attributes like clarity, correctness, and detail) and prioritization (how much each attribute influences the final choice). We curate SubjectiveSet, a dataset of 50,013 response pairs from 17 public data sources, evaluated by 21 LLM judges across 87 attributes. We find a hidden consensus in perception: judges frequently agree on attribute judgments even when their overall choices diverge. Building on this separation, we first characterize each judge's prioritization using attribute weights estimated from its own overall choices. These weights differ across judges even when estimated from the same attribute judgments. We then learn new weights from reference labels to adapt their decisions to a target evaluation standard. Reweighting perceived attributes improves average held-out agreement with reference labels from 66.48% to 71.97%, outperforming fine-tuning and rubric prompting. Our findings show that understanding and steering the subjectivity of LLM judges requires attention not only to what they perceive, but also to how they prioritize it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JudgeProfile 把 LLM 评委的主观性拆成感知 (perception) 与优先级 (prioritization) 两层，并用从参考标签学到的属性权重重构其最终选择。在 SubjectiveSet（50,013 对回答、17 个公开数据源、21 个 LLM 评委、87 个属性）上，重加权把留出集与参考标签的一致率从 66.48% 提到 71.97%，超过微调与 rubric prompting。
Motivation: LLM 评委在双方都不客观错误时会偏好不同回答，整体选择的分歧掩盖了评委在单个属性判断上其实高度一致，需要区分这两层才能解释和引导主观性。
Method: 将评估拆为感知（评委如何在 clarity、correctness、detail 等属性上比较两回答）与优先级（各属性对最终选择的影响权重）；先用评委自身的整体选择反推其属性权重，再从参考标签学习新权重以对齐目标评估标准。数据集 SubjectiveSet 含 50,013 对回答、17 个公开数据源、21 个 LLM 评委、87 个属性。
Result: 感知层存在隐藏共识：即使整体选择分歧，评委也常在属性判断上一致；不同评委从相同属性判断估计出的优先级权重不同。按参考标签重加权后，留出集平均一致率由 66.48% 升至 71.97%，优于 fine-tuning 与 rubric prompting。
Conclusion: 理解和引导 LLM 评委的主观性，既要管它们感知到什么，也要管它们如何对感知到的属性排序加权。

papers.title: When Is Coarse Supervision Worth It? Cost-Aware Learning under Unknown Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Modern learning systems often acquire supervision at multiple resolutions, trading annotation cost against information content. We study cost-aware two-resolution learning, where expensive fine labels reveal a vector response and cheaper coarse labels reveal a scalar aggregate formed with unknown weights, while the target remains the full response. The challenge is that unknown aggregation changes which directions coarse data can identify, so the value of coarse supervision depends jointly on cost, noise, and identification. We characterize this information geometry and develop an estimate-and-track policy that learns the aggregation rule and tracks the optimal resolution mix. We derive a closed-form break-even condition for coarse supervision and prove that the online policy attains the optimal leading cumulative-risk coefficient, with a matching local asymptotic minimax lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted all-fine/mixed transition, show the online learner approaching the oracle-share benchmark, and demonstrate a finite-budget gain over all-fine acquisition when coarse supervision is sufficiently favorable. Our results provide a principled way to balance information and annotation cost across supervision resolutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在细标签贵、粗标签便宜但聚合权重未知的两分辨率标注问题中，粗监督的价值由成本、噪声与可识别性共同决定。作者给出粗监督的闭式 break-even 条件，并提出 estimate-and-track 在线策略：先学聚合规则再跟踪最优分辨率配比，其累计风险的主项系数达到最优且匹配局部渐近 minimax 下界。合成实验复现了 all-fine/mixed 相变，在线学习逼近 oracle-share，且在粗监督足够有利时相对全细标注取得有限预算增益。
Motivation: 多分辨率标注里，未知聚合权重会改变粗数据能识别的方向，导致粗监督的价值无法仅凭成本或噪声单独判断，最优标注配比难以事先确定。
Method: 刻画两分辨率监督的信息几何（细标签为向量响应、粗标签为未知权重的标量聚合）；提出 estimate-and-track 在线策略，先估计聚合规则再跟踪最优分辨率混合；推导闭式 break-even 条件，并证明在线策略达到最优主累计风险系数，配匹配的局部渐近 minimax 下界。
Result: 合成实验支持预测的 all-fine/mixed 相变；在线学习者逼近 oracle-share 基准；在粗监督足够有利时相对 all-fine 采集取得有限预算增益。理论结果为闭式 break-even 条件、最优主累计风险系数与匹配的局部渐近 minimax 下界。
Conclusion: 粗监督是否值得取决于成本、噪声与可识别性三者的联合，而 estimate-and-track 能在未知聚合下自动逼近最优分辨率配比，为跨标注分辨率权衡信息与成本提供原则性判据。

papers.title: Quantum Fidelity Landscape-Guided Prior Calibration for Single-Circuit QGAN Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks (QGANs) have emerged as representative generative models in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era and have attracted increasing attention in quantum machine learning. However, most existing QGAN methods rely on patch-based decomposition strategies, which weaken the global consistency of generated images and increase quantum resource overhead. In this work, we investigate a simpler approach: pixel-level, end-to-end image generation using a single-quantum-circuit QGAN. By analyzing the structural matching relationship between the quantum prior and the target data distribution in Hilbert space, we provide a new theoretical perspective for understanding the training behavior of naive end-to-end QGANs. Specifically, we introduce the Quantum Fidelity Landscape (QFL), defined as the pairwise-fidelity structure induced by an ensemble of quantum states and preserved under shared unitary transformations of the quantum generation process. We show that, under a fixed Lipschitz readout, this invariant imposes a one-sided bound on decoded sample separation, motivating calibration of the prior-induced QFL before adversarial training. To validate this theoretical insight, we propose BasicQGAN, a QGAN framework incorporating quantum prior calibration. Before adversarial optimization, BasicQGAN aligns the prior-induced QFL with the data-induced QFL. Experimental results on small-scale grayscale image datasets show that BasicQGAN achieves stable and effective end-to-end pixel-level image generation while requiring fewer qubits and trainable parameters than representative patch-based quantum generators. Furthermore, experiments with different initial quantum-state ensembles show that QFL-calibrated ensembles achieve better generative performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单量子线路 QGAN 的 BasicQGAN：在对抗训练前先校准量子先验，使先验诱导的 Quantum Fidelity Landscape (QFL) 与数据诱导的 QFL 对齐，从而做像素级端到端图像生成。小规模灰度图像数据集上生成稳定有效，所需 qubit 与可训练参数少于代表性 patch-based 量子生成器，且 QFL 校准后的初始量子态系综生成性能更好。
Motivation: 现有 QGAN 普遍依赖 patch 分解，削弱生成图像的全局一致性并抬高量子资源开销；朴素端到端 QGAN 训练行为也缺少理论解释。
Method: 定义 Quantum Fidelity Landscape (QFL)：由量子态系综诱导的成对保真度结构，在生成过程的共享幺正变换下不变；在固定 Lipschitz readout 下证明该不变量对解码样本分离度给出单侧界，据此在对抗优化前把先验诱导 QFL 与数据诱导 QFL 对齐，构成 BasicQGAN 框架。
Result: 在小规模灰度图像数据集上，BasicQGAN 实现稳定的像素级端到端生成，相比代表性 patch-based 量子生成器使用更少的 qubit 和可训练参数；不同初始量子态系综的对比实验显示，经 QFL 校准的系综取得更好的生成性能。
Conclusion: 先校准先验的 QFL 再做对抗训练，可以在单量子线路、更少量子资源的条件下支撑端到端像素级 QGAN 生成。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在小规模灰度图像数据集上，BasicQGAN 实现稳定的像素级端到端生成，相比代表性 patch-based 量子生成器使用更少的 qubit 和可训练参数；不同初始量子态系综的对比实验显示，经 QFL 校准的系综取得更好的生成性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 先校准先验的 QFL 再做对抗训练，可以在单量子线路、更少量子资源的条件下支撑端到端像素级 QGAN 生成。

papers.title: Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG
papers.abstract_en: When conversing with large language models (LLMs), users often begin with a simple question and build towards a multi-hop question through follow-up turns. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Building on prior work on multi-turn LLM evaluation, we transform questions from multi-hop question answering (QA) benchmarks into underspecified conversations and evaluate ten LLM assistants with eight retrieval systems across 1.5 million simulated conversations. Our findings reveal that multi-turn interaction causes widespread performance degradation, incurring relative performance drops of up to 21% and increasing unreliability by 47%, making RAG systems simultaneously less accurate and less reliable. We identify two distinct failure modes behind this degradation. Systems are either lost in translation, where conversational rephrasing distorts the retrieval query, or lost in conversation, where retrieval succeeds but the LLM fails to synthesize evidence distributed across turns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多跳 QA 基准题改写成欠指定的多轮对话，在 150 万条模拟对话上测 10 个 LLM 助手与 8 个检索系统，发现多轮交互使 RAG/GraphRAG 相对性能最多下降 21%、不可靠性上升 47%。退化来自两种可区分的失败模式：检索查询被对话改写扭曲（lost in translation），或检索成功但 LLM 无法跨轮综合证据（lost in conversation）。
Motivation: RAG 与 GraphRAG 几乎只在单轮、完整表述的查询上评测，而真实用户往往从简单问题逐轮追问成多跳问题，评测设定与实际使用方式错位。
Method: 把多跳 QA 基准的问题变换为欠指定的多轮对话，构建大规模模拟研究，评测 10 个 LLM 助手与 8 个检索系统，共 150 万条模拟对话，并区分两类失败模式进行诊断。
Result: 多轮交互造成广泛性能退化：相对性能下降最高达 21%，不可靠性增加 47%，RAG 系统同时变得更不准确也更不可靠；退化归因为 lost in translation（对话改写扭曲检索查询）与 lost in conversation（检索成功但 LLM 无法综合跨轮证据）两类模式。
Conclusion: 单轮评测会系统性高估 RAG 的实际表现：多轮退化同时削弱准确性与可靠性，且需要分别从查询改写与跨轮证据综合两处定位问题。

papers.title: Learned Queries and Keys Are All You Need: Replacing the Value Projection with Structured Transforms
papers.abstract_en: To reduce the number of parameters and cache memory requirements of transformers we introduce dual-headed transformers instead of three heads. We studied Walsh-Hadamard Transform (WHT), Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Discrete Fourier Transform, filterbank based Shearlet Transform, and Multiplication-Avoiding (MA) operators to construct dual heads. We combine spatial patches and their orthogonal transforms (or Shearlet and MA operators) in a structure similar to the attention block. We obtained better results than triple headed transformers in ImageNet. Extensive simulation examples are presented.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双头 (dual-headed) transformer：把标准注意力的 Q/K/V 三头减为两头，用空间 patch 与其正交变换（WHT、DCT、DFT、Shearlet、乘法规避 MA 算子）配对替代 Value 投影，以减少参数量与 cache 内存。在 ImageNet 上取得优于三头 transformer 的结果。
Motivation: 标准 transformer 的 Q、K、V 三组投影带来额外参数与 KV cache 内存开销，作者希望在不损失精度的前提下削减这部分开销。
Method: 构造双头结构：一头用空间 patch，另一头用其正交变换或滤波器组 Shearlet、MA 算子，按类似 attention block 的方式组合；候选变换包括 Walsh-Hadamard (WHT)、DCT、DFT。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上，双头 transformer 的结果优于三头 transformer，并给出大量仿真实例。
Conclusion: Value 投影可由结构化正交变换替代，双头设计在减少参数与 cache 内存的同时保持乃至提升 ImageNet 精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation turns knowledge distillation into a closed learning loop and offers a path toward recursive self-improvement. Without an external teacher, however, the model must determine both what information can improve its supervision and which induced changes should be learned. Existing methods typically improve teacher-generated data or select training examples in isolation, leaving the information transferred between these stages unmeasured. We introduce InFlow, a retrieval-guided on-policy self-distillation framework that models this process as potential-to-realized information flow. InFlow first retrieves potentially informative sources using certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories, then measures their realized effect through the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the teacher's initial and retrieval-conditioned answer beliefs. Examples with larger belief shifts are selected for on-policy distillation. Our analysis formalizes the information optimized by retrieval and selection and relates the answer-level shift to the teacher--student distillation gap. Across four open-weight language models and three knowledge domains, InFlow achieves the strongest cross-model average among the compared selection methods, with ablations supporting both stages of the framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/1240148048/INFLOW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InFlow 把自蒸馏中的数据构造与样本选择统一建模为“潜在信息到已实现信息”的流动：先用经过确定性校准的隐状态轨迹检索潜在有信息的源，再用教师在初始与检索条件化后答案信念的 Jensen--Shannon 散度衡量已实现效应，按信念偏移大小挑选样本做 on-policy 自蒸馏。在四个开源权重语言模型与三个知识领域上，InFlow 在所比较的选择方法中取得最强的跨模型平均表现，消融支持框架两个阶段各自的作用。
Motivation: 无外部教师的自蒸馏中，模型既要决定什么信息能改进监督、又要决定哪些诱导变化该被学习；现有方法只各自改进教师生成数据或孤立挑选训练样本，两个阶段之间被传递的信息从未被度量。
Method: InFlow 是检索引导的 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，把流程形式化为 potential-to-realized information flow：第一步用 certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories 检索潜在有信息的源，第二步用教师初始答案信念与检索条件化答案信念之间的 Jensen--Shannon 散度度量已实现效应，选取信念偏移更大的样本做 on-policy 蒸馏；分析部分形式化了检索与选择各自优化的信息，并把答案层面的偏移与教师-学生蒸馏差距联系起来。
Result: 在四个开源权重语言模型与三个知识领域上，InFlow 在所比较的选择方法中取得最强的跨模型平均 (strongest cross-model average)，消融实验支持框架的检索与选择两个阶段。
Conclusion: 把自蒸馏的数据构造与样本选择当作一条可度量的信息流来联合优化，比孤立改进其中一阶段更有效；答案信念的 JS 偏移可作为连接检索价值与蒸馏差距的量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AESplat: Advancing Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Decoupled Appearance Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable potential for generalized novel view synthesis. However, existing methods typically predict Gaussian appearance attributes represented by spherical harmonics (SH) in the same manner, overlooking the fundamental distinction between view-independent and view-dependent appearance, which results in suboptimal rendering quality. In this paper, we present AESplat, a novel and general framework for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that introduces an effective decoupled appearance modeling strategy based on an analysis of SH, enabling higher-quality rendering. Specifically, AESplat directly derives the zeroth-order SH coefficient, which represents the base view-independent appearance component, from the input images without training. The higher-order SH coefficients are subsequently predicted by a shallow multilayer perceptron equipped with two efficient 3D-aware inductive biases to model view-dependent appearance variations. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a $0.8$ dB improvement in PSNR over the pose-free method NAS3R and a $1.1$ dB improvement over the pose-required method DepthSplat on the RealEstate10K dataset. Project page: https://aesplat.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AESplat 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的球谐 (SH) 外观属性拆成视角无关与视角依赖两部分：零阶 SH 系数直接从输入图像不经训练导出，高阶系数由带两个 3D 感知归纳偏置的浅层 MLP 预测。在 RealEstate10K 上，无位姿 (pose-free) 设置的 PSNR 比 NAS3R 高 0.8 dB，比需要位姿的 DepthSplat 高 1.1 dB。
Motivation: 现有 pose-free feed-forward 3DGS 方法用同一方式预测全部 SH 系数，混淆了视角无关与视角依赖外观，导致渲染质量次优。
Method: 基于对 SH 的分析提出解耦外观建模：零阶 SH 系数（视角无关基色）直接由输入图像不经训练导出；高阶系数用浅层 MLP 预测，并加入两个高效的 3D-aware inductive bias 来刻画视角依赖变化，整体仍是 pose-free feed-forward 3DGS 框架。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K 数据集上 PSNR 相比 pose-free 方法 NAS3R 提升 0.8 dB，相比 pose-required 方法 DepthSplat 提升 1.1 dB；作者称在多个数据集上显著优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 把视角无关与视角依赖外观分开处理（零阶直接导出、高阶用带 3D 归纳偏置的浅层 MLP 预测）能提升 pose-free feed-forward 3DGS 的渲染质量，且无需输入位姿。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Normalize-Then-Precondition: A Hierarchical Approach to Marginal Scale and Interaction Geometry for LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Matrix optimizers have emerged as a promising direction, with Muon standing out as a prominent design. Revisiting Muon through its full-Gram representation, we observe that it jointly processes marginal-scale and interaction information. This opens an alternative way to organize geometric information hierarchically, motivating the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework. Specifically, it first uses diagonal-Gram information to construct a marginally normalized update, then applies spectral preconditioning to its directional interaction geometry. Building on this framework, we develop NormPre with NormPre-G and NormPre-L adopting global and localized spectral preconditioning, grounded in spectral-norm steepest descent and a regularized formulation followed by leading mode selection, respectively. To enable large-scale training, NormPre-G uses Newton-Schulz iterations and NormPre-L employs randomized sketching to approximate the leading interaction eigenspace. Theoretically, we establish $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ convergence guarantees for simplified versions of NormPre. Across extensive pretraining experiments on GPT-2 Small, LLaMA and Qwen3, both variants consistently outperform AdamW, Muon and MANO under matched training budgets. Further efficiency and spectral analyses reveal the complementary strengths of two variants and characterize their performance-efficiency trade-off. We open-source our code through a GitHub repository at https://github.com/zx-gong/NormPre.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架，把 Muon 的 full-Gram 更新拆成先用对角 Gram 做边缘归一化、再对方向交互几何做谱预条件，并据此给出 NormPre-G（全局谱预条件，Newton-Schulz 迭代）与 NormPre-L（局部谱预条件，正则化加主导模态选择，随机 sketching 近似主导交互特征空间）。在匹配训练预算下，两个变体在 GPT-2 Small、LLaMA、Qwen3 预训练上一致优于 AdamW、Muon 与 MANO，并给出简化版 NormPre 的 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛保证。
Motivation: 矩阵优化器（以 Muon 为代表）的更新同时混杂边缘尺度与交互几何信息，缺少把这两类几何信息分层组织的明确原则，也难以在大规模训练中兼顾效率与谱性质。
Method: Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架先用对角 Gram 信息构造边缘归一化更新，再对其方向交互几何施加谱预条件；NormPre-G 走谱范数最速下降的全局预条件并用 Newton-Schulz 迭代实现，NormPre-L 走正则化表述加主导模态选择的局部预条件并用随机 sketching 近似主导交互特征空间。
Result: 在匹配训练预算的 GPT-2 Small、LLaMA、Qwen3 大规模预训练实验中，NormPre-G 与 NormPre-L 均一致优于 AdamW、Muon 和 MANO；对简化版 NormPre 建立 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛保证；效率与谱分析刻画了两个变体的互补优势及性能-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 把边缘尺度与交互几何分层处理（先归一化再谱预条件）是组织矩阵优化器几何信息的有效方式，全局与局部两种谱预条件各有互补的性能-效率位置，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CHAIN: Calibrated LLM Forecasting via Causal-Temporal Hypergraph Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have achieved significant progress in event forecasting, yet their probability outputs exhibit systematic calibration bias that varies heterogeneously across different domains and question types, undermining the trustworthiness of probabilistic outputs for decision-making under uncertainty. However, existing calibration methods typically correct probability outputs after prediction is complete, without modeling the structural sources of bias within the prediction process itself. To address this challenge, we decompose probabilistic prediction over causal-temporal hypergraphs into three stages, evidence weighting, evidence aggregation, and source fusion, and propose CHAIN, which designs stage-specific mechanisms to mitigate bias at each stage: (i) modulating the temporal decay function by causal topological distance, (ii) aggregating approximately independent causal chains via Noisy-OR after direction-aware deduplication, and (iii) driving adaptive fusion by causal coverage and directional balance. Experimental results on cross-domain forecasting benchmarks show CHAIN outperforms existing methods in expected calibration error, Brier score, and accuracy. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHAIN 把 LLM 在因果-时序超图上的概率预测拆成证据加权、证据聚合、源融合三阶段，分别用因果拓扑距离调制时间衰减、方向感知去重后以 Noisy-OR 聚合近独立因果链、由因果覆盖度与方向平衡驱动自适应融合，从而在预测过程中而非事后纠正校准偏差。在跨域事件预测基准上，CHAIN 的期望校准误差 (ECE)、Brier 分数与准确率均优于现有校准方法。
Motivation: LLM 事件预测的概率输出存在随域与题型异质分布的系统性校准偏差，而现有方法只在预测完成后事后修正，不建模预测过程内部偏差的结构性来源。
Method: 将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为三阶段并各设机制：证据加权阶段用因果拓扑距离调制时间衰减函数；证据聚合阶段先做方向感知去重再用 Noisy-OR 聚合近独立因果链；源融合阶段由因果覆盖度与方向平衡自适应加权。
Result: 在跨域事件预测基准 (cross-domain forecasting benchmarks) 上，CHAIN 在期望校准误差 (ECE)、Brier 分数和准确率三项指标上均超过现有校准方法。
Conclusion: 把校准机制嵌入预测的各阶段而非事后打补丁，可以同时改善 LLM 概率输出的校准度与预测准确率。

papers.title: MyoCodec: A Streaming Neural Codec for Electromyography
papers.abstract_en: Neural codecs encode continuous signals into compact sequences of discrete tokens, providing an interface for efficient transmission, storage, and token-based sequence modeling. This paradigm has been widely adopted in modern speech and audio frameworks; however, the biosignal domain still lacks a neural codec designed specifically for low-bitrate streaming and generalization across diverse downstream tasks. We present MyoCodec, a streaming neural codec designed for electromyography (EMG). Inspired by recent neural audio codecs, MyoCodec combines causal Transformers with residual vector quantization to encode continuous EMG signals into different levels of EMG representations spanning from continuous latent features to discrete tokens operating at 50 Hz. Trained on twelve public EMG datasets, MyoCodec achieves favorable performance in both intrinsic codec quality and representative downstream tasks, including typing (emg2qwerty), hand-pose (emg2pose), speech decoding (emg2speech), and speech-to-EMG synthesis (speech2emg). Across these tasks, MyoCodec exhibits strong performance against prior models while providing a compact and causal EMG representation. During streaming inference, it requires compute time of only 0.482 ms for each 20 ms frame, enabling real-time streaming. Also, the discrete token representation provided by MyoCodec has the potential to support integration into language-model based approaches, creating a path toward LLM-based interactive systems, where tokenized EMG representations are directly processed into such language or speech models. Code and model weights are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MyoCodec 是面向肌电 (EMG) 的流式神经 codec，用因果 Transformer 加残差向量量化 (RVQ) 把连续 EMG 编成 50 Hz 的离散 token，在 12 个公开 EMG 数据集上训练。在 emg2qwerty 打字、emg2pose 手部姿态、emg2speech 语音解码、speech2emg 合成四个下游任务上相对既有模型表现强劲，且每 20 ms 帧仅需 0.482 ms 计算时间，可实时流式推理。
Motivation: 神经 codec 已在语音音频框架普及，但生物信号领域缺少专为低码率流式传输、并能跨多样下游任务泛化的 codec。
Method: 结合因果 Transformer 与残差向量量化 (RVQ)，输出从连续 latent 到离散 token 的多级 EMG 表征，token 率 50 Hz；在 12 个公开 EMG 数据集上训练，覆盖内在 codec 质量与四类下游任务。
Result: 在 emg2qwerty、emg2pose、emg2speech、speech2emg 上相对先前模型表现强劲，同时保持紧凑因果表征；流式推理每 20 ms 帧计算时间 0.482 ms，满足实时；代码与模型权重已发布。
Conclusion: 因果 codec 加 RVQ 可以同时给出低延迟实时流式 EMG 表征和跨任务竞争力，离散 token 形式为接入 LLM 式语言/语音模型留出接口。

papers.title: Where Root Cause Analysis Fails: A Retrieval-Reranking Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the root cause of an anomaly among hundreds of sensors is critical for preventing safety incidents and costly downtime in complex monitored systems. Existing studies evaluate root cause analysis (RCA) methods using top@k accuracy. We show that this metric has a fundamental blind spot: it conflates two failure modes, retrieval failure, where the true cause is never considered, and reranking failure, where it is considered but ranked too low. In this work, we introduce a retrieval-reranking decomposition and audit four well-known benchmarks to expose this blind spot. Our experiments show that, on benchmarks with complex faults, statistical baselines mis-rank the true cause 79-100% of the time, and graph-based methods never clearly beat the best statistical baseline, whether their causal graphs are learned on short fault windows, on retrieved candidate pools guaranteed to contain the cause, or on multi-day normal-operation data. Meanwhile, on simple benchmarks where faults manifest significantly at their origin, retrieval is nearly solved (98-100%). Guided by the decomposition, we build a two-stage pipeline combining a multi-signal retriever with an LLM reranker that, as one fixed configuration, matches or exceeds the best baseline's top@1 accuracy on all six benchmark suites (by up to +12 points), with no causal graph or labeled data required. When all methods rank the same retrieved candidates with the true cause guaranteed present, adding a short system-description document lets the reranker lead the best baseline by +7 to +18 points on every benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/DecompRCA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCA 评测的 top@k 把检索失败与重排序失败混为一谈，作者提出 retrieval-reranking 分解并审计四个基准：复杂故障下统计基线 79-100% 次错排真实原因，而简单基准检索已近饱和（98-100%）。据此构建的两阶段管线（多信号检索器 + LLM 重排序器）以单一固定配置在全部六套基准上追平或超过最佳基线 top@1（最高 +12 点），无需因果图与标注数据。
Motivation: RCA 方法长期用 top@k 评测，但该指标无法区分真实原因从未被检索到与被检索却排位过低这两种性质不同的失败，导致基准结论失真。
Method: 提出 retrieval-reranking 分解，审计四个知名基准以暴露 top@k 盲区；再据此构建两阶段管线：多信号检索器 (multi-signal retriever) 加 LLM 重排序器，单一固定配置，不使用因果图或标注数据；另在所有方法对同一候选池排序、真实原因保证在场的设定下，加入简短系统描述文档。
Result: 复杂故障基准上统计基线 79-100% 次错排真实原因；图方法在短故障窗口、保证含原因的候选池、多日正常运行数据三种建图方式下都未明显胜过最佳统计基线；简单基准检索率 98-100%。两阶段管线在全部六套基准上 top@1 追平或超过最佳基线，最高 +12 点；候选池固定且原因在场时，加系统描述文档使重排序器在每套基准上领先最佳基线 +7 至 +18 点。
Conclusion: top@k 掩盖了检索与重排序两种失败的分工，按分解设计的检索加重排序两阶段管线可在不依赖因果图与标注的前提下稳定提升 RCA 的 top@1。

papers.title: When Semantics Matter: Reliability-Aware Semantic-Rhythm Control for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.abstract_en: Co-speech gesture generation aims to synthesize natural gestures that are both temporally synchronized with speech and semantically consistent with the spoken content. Although recent methods can generate rhythmically plausible motions, they often rely heavily on acoustic prosody while underutilizing textual semantics, especially when semantic annotations are incomplete, noisy, or unavailable. Consequently, the generated gestures may follow speech rhythm while failing to express the intended semantics. To address this problem, we propose a reliability-aware semantic-rhythm control framework for co-speech gesture generation. We first learn a discrete motion prior that represents continuous gestures in a compact and structured motion-code space. We then introduce a dual-branch semantic contribution estimation mechanism consisting of a full multimodal branch and an audio-only branch. Their distributional discrepancy is formulated as conditional information gain to quantify how much textual semantics changes the predicted motion. Based on this estimate, a controllable semantic-rhythm objective selectively strengthens semantic guidance in content-relevant segments while limiting unnecessary semantic intervention in rhythm-dominant segments. Furthermore, we treat background noise as an acoustic reliability condition and introduce noise-conditioned feature modulation together with beneficial latent perturbation to improve generation robustness under realistic acoustic environments. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a favorable balance among semantic expressiveness, rhythmic synchronization, motion diversity, and robustness, enabling reliable and controllable co-speech gesture generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对共语手势生成过度依赖韵律、忽略文本语义的问题，提出可靠性感知的语义-节奏控制框架：用离散 motion prior 编码动作，以全模态分支与纯音频分支的分布差异作为条件信息增益，只在内容相关片段加强语义引导、在节奏主导片段抑制语义干预，并把背景噪声当作声学可靠性条件做噪声条件特征调制。在基准数据集上取得语义表达、节奏同步、动作多样性与噪声鲁棒性之间的有利平衡。
Motivation: 现有方法能生成节奏合理的动作，但严重依赖声学韵律、低估文本语义，尤其在语义标注不完整、含噪或缺失时，手势跟上了节奏却表达不出说话内容。
Method: 先学习紧凑结构化的 motion-code 离散动作先验；再用双分支语义贡献估计（全多模态分支 vs 纯音频分支），把两者的分布差异形式化为条件信息增益，量化文本语义对预测动作的改变量；据此构建可控语义-节奏目标，按片段选择性强化或抑制语义引导；并引入噪声条件特征调制与有益潜变量扰动 (beneficial latent perturbation) 提升真实声学环境下的鲁棒性。
Result: 在基准数据集上的实验显示，该框架在语义表达、节奏同步、动作多样性与鲁棒性之间取得有利平衡，实现可靠且可控的共语手势生成。
Conclusion: 把语义贡献按可靠性量化后再分配引导强度，配合噪声条件调制，可以在不牺牲节奏的前提下让手势既同步又表意，并在含噪声学环境中保持可控生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MARCO: Multi-Round Agentic Reinforcement for Conditional Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Molecular optimization is inherently iterative: a candidate is proposed, evaluated against several objectives, and revised while preserving a relationship to the source molecule. Most instruction-following models instead emit one edited molecule, forcing validity, property improvement, and similarity control into a single response. We introduce MARCO, an evaluator-grounded reinforcement-learning framework that trains molecular editors on bounded proposal--feedback--revision trajectories. MARCO aggregates shaped turn rewards into an undiscounted trajectory return for group-relative policy optimization. We evaluate two consequences of this training: Same-1 tests the trained policy under a one-response budget, while Same-5 tests whether the same policy can use verifier feedback when up to five responses are available. Across the three-objective MuMOInstruct benchmark, three Qwen backbones, and seen/unseen instruction splits, SFT-initialized MARCO obtains the highest product of property success rate and similarity in every reported primary setting. Same-5 further improves the observed score under the tested budget, while four-objective and public-checkpoint experiments test transfer across constraint sets and initialization regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARCO 把分子优化建模为多轮提案-反馈-修订轨迹，用评估器打分的逐轮 shaped reward 聚合成不折扣的轨迹回报，做 group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) 训练分子编辑器。在三目标 MuMOInstruct 上、三个 Qwen backbone 与 seen/unseen 指令划分中，SFT 初始化的 MARCO 在每个报告的主设置里都取得属性成功率与相似度乘积最高；Same-5 在最多五次响应预算下进一步提高观测分数。
Motivation: 分子优化本身是迭代过程：候选分子要同时满足有效性、属性提升与对源分子的相似度约束，而多数指令跟随模型只输出一次编辑，把这三个目标压进单次响应里。
Method: 评估器打分的强化学习框架 MARCO，在有界的 proposal--feedback--revision 轨迹上训练分子编辑器：逐轮 shaped reward 聚合成不折扣的轨迹回报，用于 GRPO；训练分 Same-1（单次响应预算）与 Same-5（最多五次响应、可利用 verifier 反馈）两种评测后果，并含 SFT 初始化、四目标与公开 checkpoint 的迁移设置。
Result: 在三目标 MuMOInstruct、三个 Qwen backbone、seen/unseen 指令划分下，SFT 初始化的 MARCO 在每个报告的主设置中都获得最高的属性成功率与相似度乘积；Same-5 在所测预算内进一步提高观测分数；另设四目标与公开 checkpoint 实验检验跨约束集与不同初始化的迁移。

papers.title: Reprogramming Vision-Language Models via Structured Prompt Reparameterization
papers.abstract_en: Visual reprogramming adapts pretrained models to downstream tasks by modifying their input and output interfaces while keeping the backbone fixed. In vision-language models, existing methods mainly rely on intra-class prompt aggregation and do not explicitly model relationships among classes. However, fine-grained categories often exhibit highly overlapping attribute descriptions and strong inter-class correlation in the text embedding space, where discriminative cues lie in subtle low-variance components. We propose Reparameterized Inter-Class Visual Reprogramming (RVP), a structured framework that aggregates multiple text prompts within each class and applies residual correction across classes. We also show that CLIP-based visual reprogramming with input-independent linear output aggregation can be expressed as a linear mapping from frozen image embeddings to downstream logits, and use this view to design a structured reparameterization that models shared semantic components and class-specific differences. RVP uses only a single visual prompt and can be reparameterized at inference into a frozen backbone followed by a linear classifier, incurring nearly zero computational overhead. Across 11 few-shot classification benchmarks and four CLIP backbones, RVP consistently improves over prior visual reprogramming methods with comparable or better inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RVP（Reparameterized Inter-Class Visual Reprogramming）：类内聚合多条文本 prompt、类间做残差校正，并把 CLIP 视觉重编程等价改写为冻结图像嵌入到下游 logits 的线性映射，推理时重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器。在 11 个 few-shot 分类基准、4 个 CLIP 骨干上一致优于已有视觉重编程方法，只用单个视觉 prompt，推理开销近乎为零。
Motivation: 视觉重编程只改输入输出接口而不动骨干，但现有方法只做类内 prompt 聚合、不建模类间关系；细粒度类别在文本嵌入空间里属性描述高度重叠、判别线索藏在低方差分量中，容易被忽略。
Method: RVP 框架在每个类内聚合多条文本 prompt 并跨类做残差校正；同时证明基于 CLIP、输入无关的线性输出聚合可写成从冻结图像嵌入到下游 logits 的线性映射，据此设计结构化重参数化，分别建模共享语义成分与类特异差异。
Result: 在 11 个 few-shot 分类基准与 4 个 CLIP 骨干上，RVP 一致优于先前视觉重编程方法，推理效率相当或更好；仅用单个视觉 prompt，推理时可重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器，计算开销近乎为零。
Conclusion: 把类间关系显式纳入结构化重参数化，可以在不增加推理开销的前提下稳定提升 CLIP 视觉重编程在细粒度 few-shot 分类上的表现。

papers.title: MLToolBench: Learning Tool-Augmented Agents for Machine Learning Development
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made substantial progress, but learning through ML experimentation remains costly in time and computation. Synthetic environments reduce these costs while introducing variations in data and experimental settings that require task-specific diagnosis. Access to diagnostic tools alone does not ensure that agents learn when to use them or how to act on their findings. We introduce ToolMLBench, a suite of executable tools for data inspection, code verification, and experiment diagnosis, together with an SFT and RL pipeline for learning their use. Diagnostic calls acquire evidence whose value depends on subsequent decisions, so final outcomes provide limited guidance on which calls to reinforce. We address this challenge with SPICE, which measures how privileged context changes the likelihood of a sampled tool action and uses this difference as a turn-level reward alongside the final outcome. We train on 80 synthetic tasks and evaluate on 25 in-domain and 10 out-of-domain tasks. Providing tool interfaces and descriptions alone yields inconsistent gains across unadapted models. With the same diagnostic interface, our training pipeline raises in-domain success from 24.8% to 52.4% for Qwen3-8B and from 35.6% to 69.2% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. The latter also improves from 31% to 48% out-of-domain, supporting learned diagnostic tool use on held-out sources and targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ToolMLBench：一套面向机器学习工程 (MLE) agent 的可执行诊断工具（数据检查、代码验证、实验诊断）配合 SFT+RL 训练管线，并用 SPICE 奖励——以特权上下文改变采样工具动作概率的差值作为 turn 级奖励，补上最终结果对诊断调用的稀疏反馈。在 80 个合成任务训练、25 个同域与 10 个跨域任务评测下，同接口训练把 Qwen3-8B 同域成功率从 24.8% 提到 52.4%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 从 35.6% 提到 69.2%，后者跨域从 31% 提到 48%。
Motivation: MLE agent 靠 ML 实验学习代价高，合成环境带来数据与实验设置差异需要逐任务诊断；但只给工具接口与描述，未适配模型的收益不一致，且诊断调用的价值取决于后续决策，最终结果无法指出该强化哪次调用。
Method: 发布 ToolMLBench：数据检查、代码验证、实验诊断三类可执行工具，配套 SFT 与 RL 管线；核心奖励 SPICE 度量特权上下文对采样工具动作似然的改变量，将其与最终结果结合作为 turn 级奖励；在 80 个合成任务上训练。
Result: 同诊断接口下，训练管线使 Qwen3-8B 同域成功率 24.8%→52.4%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 35.6%→69.2%；后者跨域（10 个 held-out 任务）31%→48%。仅提供工具接口与描述时，未适配模型收益不一致。
Conclusion: 诊断工具的价值要靠针对性训练才能兑现：SPICE 这类 turn 级奖励能把诊断调用学成可迁移的技能，在 held-out 来源与目标上仍成立。

papers.title: Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把差分隐私合成数据算法 Private Evolution (PE) 重写为生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习，理论上证明当生成器落在真实分布的低维空间时，样本复杂度由内在维度而非环境维度决定；同时给出 PE 标准变体在简单良聚类实例上不收敛的反例，并提出几何感知的新版本，在此类实例上有可证收敛。
Motivation: PE 实践表现远好于最坏情况 Wasserstein 分析的预测，理论与经验之间存在缺口；且标准 PE 变体在良聚类数据上可能根本不收敛。
Method: 将 PE 视作生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习并重新推导性能界，利用生成器捕捉真实分布结构来改进界；分析标准变体的收敛失败，提出 geometry-aware 的 PE 变体并给出良聚类实例上的收敛证明。
Result: 样本复杂度在生成器给出与分布同一低维空间的样本时依赖内在维度而非环境维度；标准 PE 变体在简单良聚类实例上不收敛；新算法实验中与标准基线相当并可提升 recall。
Conclusion: PE 的实际优势可由生成模型提供的分布结构来解释，几何感知的修改能修复其在聚类数据上的收敛失败。

papers.title: ReWorld-Track: A Recursive Event World Model for Language-Guided Multi-Camera Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided multi-camera tracking must preserve a target identity across unobserved gaps, where similar candidates and uncertain returns can make early associations unreliable. A wrong match can corrupt the history used to predict later observations and propagate identity errors across subsequent camera handoffs. We propose ReWorld-Track, a recursive event world model that carries association uncertainty into future predictions. Candidate matches and continued waiting define alternative target states, whose posterior probabilities are used to update a persistent recurrent belief. This representation preserves uncertainty about alternative trajectories through successive observations. This belief predicts the next camera, arrival time, and entry region, while appearance and language evidence guide association. By training across successive handoffs, the model learns to retain uncertainty that remains useful for later predictions and identity decisions. ReWorld-Track achieves HOTA scores of 65.19 on CityFlowV2 and 45.36 on MTMMC, with improved identity continuity across repeated handoffs. On MTMMC, its structured posterior update gains 0.50 HOTA points over a similarly sized generic updater and 0.94 points over fixed-moment soft association, raising next-camera accuracy from 86.03% to 87.41% and reducing median arrival-time error from 0.78 s to 0.71 s for subsequent target returns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReWorld-Track 把跨摄像头跟踪中的关联不确定性递归地带进后续预测：候选匹配与继续等待构成备选目标状态，其后验概率更新一个持久循环 belief，由它预测下一摄像头、到达时间与进入区域，外观与语言证据再引导关联。在 CityFlowV2 上 HOTA 65.19、MTMMC 上 45.36；MTMMC 上结构化后验更新比同规模通用 updater 高 0.50 HOTA、比固定时刻软关联高 0.94，下一摄像头准确率 86.03%→87.41%，后续返回的到达时间中位误差 0.78 s→0.71 s。
Motivation: 语言引导的多摄像头跟踪在目标未被观测的间隙中，相似候选与不确定的再次出现使早期关联不可靠；一次错配会污染用于预测后续观测的历史，并把身份错误传播到之后的摄像头交接。
Method: 提出递归事件世界模型 ReWorld-Track：把候选匹配与继续等待建模为备选目标状态，用其后验概率更新持久循环 belief，该 belief 预测下一摄像头、到达时间与进入区域，外观和语言证据用于关联；模型在连续摄像头交接上训练，使不确定性对后续预测与身份判定保持有用。
Result: HOTA：CityFlowV2 65.19，MTMMC 45.36，并在重复交接中改善身份连续性。MTMMC 上结构化后验更新相对同规模 generic updater 提升 0.50 HOTA，相对 fixed-moment soft association 提升 0.94 HOTA；下一摄像头准确率由 86.03% 升至 87.41%，后续目标返回的到达时间中位误差由 0.78 s 降至 0.71 s。
Conclusion: 把关联不确定性作为后验递归带入后续预测，可以在多摄像头交接中保住身份连续性，并同时小幅抬高 HOTA、下一摄像头准确率与到达时间精度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Human-inspired, Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration for Efficient Learning in High Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: Efficient exploration in high-dimensional decision spaces remains a central challenge for decision-making systems. Humans, in contrast, can navigate large decision spaces with remarkable efficiency. Recent behavioral studies suggest that humans reduce dimensionality in large decision spaces by probing candidate feature dimensions, identifying reward-relevant ones, and restricting the effective decision space. Inspired by this mechanism, we propose TDGE (Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration), a human-inspired, model-agnostic algorithm with an automatically constructed task-dimension--feature--item hierarchy. TDGE follows a top-down exploration strategy: it first selects task-relevant feature dimensions, then identifies informative features within those dimensions, and finally recommends concrete items based on the selected features. Experiments on MovieLens-20M, Last.fm, and Amazon recommendation datasets show that TDGE substantially improves exploration efficiency and cold-start adaptation over baseline algorithms. Comparisons with other structured algorithms and ablation studies attribute these gains to TDGE's hierarchical structure and semantic feature-space exploration, with robust results across clustering methods and hierarchy depths. Recommendation-trajectory visualizations also show exploration patterns similar to human dimension-guided behavior.

TL;DR: TDGE 借鉴人类降维探查机制，在高维决策空间中自建任务维度—特征—条目三层结构，自上而下先选任务相关维度、再挑信息量大的特征、最后给出具体条目推荐。在 MovieLens-20M、Last.fm 与 Amazon 推荐数据集上，相较基线算法显著提升探索效率与冷启动适应，消融与聚类/层级深度敏感性实验把收益归因于层级结构与语义特征空间探索。
Motivation: 高维决策空间中的高效探索是决策系统的核心难题，而推荐场景下的冷启动与探索效率问题正源于此；人类行为研究表明可通过探查候选特征维度、锁定与奖励相关的维度来压缩有效决策空间。
Method: 提出模型无关的 TDGE (Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration)，自动构建任务维度—特征—条目层级，采用自上而下的探索策略：先选任务相关特征维度，再在其中识别信息量大的特征，最后基于所选特征推荐具体条目；并与其它结构化算法比较、做消融，并在不同聚类方法与层级深度下检验稳健性。
Result: 在 MovieLens-20M、Last.fm 和 Amazon 推荐数据集上，TDGE 相比基线算法显著提升探索效率与冷启动适应；消融研究将收益归因于层级结构与语义特征空间探索，结果在不同聚类方法与层级深度下稳健；推荐轨迹可视化显示其探索模式与人类维度引导行为相似。

papers.title: FairDiff: Mitigating the Self-Reinforcing Matthew Effect in Diffusion Recommender Models
papers.abstract_en: While the "Matthew Effect" and filter bubbles are widely recognized outcome-level biases in recommender systems, we reveal that Diffusion Recommender Models (DRMs) uniquely compound this issue through their generative dynamics. Rather than merely inheriting data imbalances, DRMs trigger a self-reinforcing amplification of popularity bias. We identify that this phenomenon is driven by two compounding mechanisms. First, while optimization loss is universally dominated by high-frequency items across recommenders, DRMs suffer from a unique structural prior mismatch during generation. Because the forward terminal distribution of long-tailed data deviates significantly from the standard Gaussian prior, reverse sampling trajectories inherently collapse toward high-density popular items, fundamentally suppressing niche item generation. To dismantle this self-reinforcing loop, we propose FairDiff, a plug-and-play fairness-aware diffusion framework. To overcome the popularity-dominated loss, we introduce Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG). Rather than altering the training objective, PCG acts as an inference-time distributional reweighting mechanism, mathematically reshaping the score-based gradient field to penalize high-popularity regions and guide trajectories toward niche semantics. Furthermore, we design a Semantic Calibration (SC) Module to bridge the prior mismatch, aligning the forward and reverse distributions via one-step optimal transport. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that FairDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while effectively mitigating the self-reinforcing Matthew Effect, highlighting its value as a general framework for DRMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FairDiff 指出扩散推荐模型 (DRM) 会自我强化流行度偏差：长尾数据的前向终端分布偏离标准高斯先验，反向采样轨迹天然塌向高流行度热门物品，抑制小众物品生成。提出的即插即用框架用推理时的 Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG) 重加权 score 梯度场把轨迹引向小众语义，再用 Semantic Calibration (SC) 模块经一步最优传输对齐前向与反向分布，摘要称达到 state-of-the-art 并缓解自我强化的马太效应。
Motivation: 推荐系统里的马太效应与过滤气泡通常被视为结果层面的偏差，而 DRM 的生成动力学会把数据不平衡进一步放大成自我强化的流行度偏差，且损失被高频物品主导加上先验失配使小众物品被系统性压制。
Method: FairDiff 是即插即用的公平性感知扩散框架，含两个组件：Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG) 不改训练目标，作为推理时的分布重加权机制重塑 score-based 梯度场、惩罚高流行度区域；Semantic Calibration (SC) 模块用一步最优传输 (one-step optimal transport) 对齐前向与反向分布以弥合先验失配。
Result: 摘要给出的结论是定性的：FairDiff 在综合评测中达到 state-of-the-art 表现，同时有效缓解自我强化的马太效应；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标数值或基线对比数字。
Conclusion: 流行度偏差在 DRM 中是生成动力学放大而非仅继承数据不平衡的结果，可在推理时通过梯度场重加权加分布对齐来打断，且该框架可作为 DRM 的通用组件。

papers.title: FineSID: Scalable and Efficient Semantic Identifier Learning for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: A critical prerequisite of generative recommendation is designing semantic identifiers (SIDs) that are both scalable to large item sets and efficiently learnable. Existing SID learning methods fundamentally rely on Top-1 hard assignment during vector quantization. While heuristic strategies -- such as clustering-based initialization or forced post-hoc collision resolution -- can artificially inflate codebook coverage, they often disrupt end-to-end semantic alignment and fail to address the underlying optimization bottleneck: sparse gradient propagation. In standard Top-1 assignment, gradients concentrate on a narrow subset of frequently selected codewords, leaving the majority inherently under-trained and causing severe SID collisions. To overcome this limitation natively without relying on complex initialization priors, we propose FineSID, a unified quantization framework that moves beyond Top-1 assignment by enabling fine-grained gradient propagation across the entire codebook. Instead of updating only a single selected codeword, FineSID distributes learning signals to all codewords in a soft, differentiable manner. This design promotes globally balanced codebook optimization while strictly preserving semantic consistency, effectively alleviating SID collisions and stabilizing training in large, high-dimensional codebooks. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that FineSID is robust to initialization configurations and consistently improves both codebook utilization and recommendation accuracy. Our work provides a principled, initialization-agnostic solution for semantic identifier learning, advancing the practicality of generative recommendation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FineSID 把生成式推荐语义标识 (SID) 学习中的 Top-1 硬分配换成全码本的软、可微梯度分发，使每个 codeword 都收到学习信号。这样在不依赖聚类初始化或事后碰撞消解的前提下缓解 SID 碰撞、稳定大码本训练，并在多个公开基准上同时提升码本利用率与推荐精度。
Motivation: 向量量化的 Top-1 硬分配让梯度集中在少数高频 codeword，大部分码字欠训练，导致严重 SID 碰撞；聚类初始化或强制事后碰撞消解虽能抬高码本覆盖，却破坏端到端语义对齐。
Method: 提出统一量化框架 FineSID：不再只更新被选中的单个 codeword，而是以软、可微的方式把学习信号分发给整个码本，实现细粒度梯度传播，同时保持语义一致性，且不依赖复杂初始化先验。
Result: 在多个公开基准上的实验显示 FineSID 对初始化配置稳健，并一致提升码本利用率 (codebook utilization) 与推荐精度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张这是一个与初始化无关、原则性的 SID 学习方案：全码本软分配能同时解决稀疏梯度传播这一优化瓶颈和 SID 碰撞，从而推进生成式推荐的实用性。

papers.title: Stochastic Heavy Ball with Polyak Step Size and Armijo Line Search: A General Convergence Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Polyak step size (PS) and Armijo line search (ALS) have received increasing attention in stochastic optimization, with encouraging empirical performance and theoretical guarantees. However, their convergence theory for stochastic heavy ball (SHB) methods remains limited. In this work, we develop a unified convergence analysis for SHB equipped with PS and ALS. To this end, we introduce a modified Armijo rule that closely parallels the Polyak step size, together with a decoupling analysis that isolates the historical dependence induced by momentum. For SHB with standard PS and ALS, we establish expected convergence for strongly convex, convex, and non-convex objectives without interpolation or restrictive conditions on the momentum parameter. Under interpolation or strong growth, we further strengthen the results to almost sure rates and last-iterate convergence. Moreover, for general settings beyond interpolation, we prove almost sure convergence to the exact optimum or to stationarity for SHB with diminishing variants of PS and ALS. These results provide a more comprehensive theoretical view of Polyak step size and Armijo line search for stochastic heavy ball methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为带 Polyak 步长 (PS) 与 Armijo 线搜索 (ALS) 的随机 heavy ball (SHB) 方法给出统一收敛分析：提出与 Polyak 步长平行的改进 Armijo 规则，并用解耦分析隔离动量带来的历史依赖。在不假设 interpolation、也不对动量参数加限制的条件下证明强凸、凸、非凸目标的期望收敛；在 interpolation 或 strong growth 下加强到几乎必然速率与 last-iterate 收敛，递减变体则在一般设定下几乎必然收敛到精确最优或驻点。
Motivation: PS 与 ALS 在随机优化中已有经验表现与理论保证，但它们用于 SHB 这类带动量方法的收敛理论仍然有限，动量引入的历史依赖是主要障碍。
Method: 提出一个与 Polyak 步长紧密对应的新 Armijo 规则，并设计解耦分析 (decoupling analysis) 单独处理动量造成的历史依赖；在此框架下统一分析标准 PS 与 ALS 版本的 SHB，以及它们的递减 (diminishing) 变体。
Result: 对标准 PS 与 ALS 的 SHB，在无 interpolation、动量参数无限制条件下，证明强凸、凸、非凸目标的期望收敛；在 interpolation 或 strong growth 下加强为几乎必然速率与 last-iterate 收敛；对一般设定下的递减 PS/ALS 变体，证明几乎必然收敛到精确最优解或驻点。
Conclusion: PS 与 ALS 随机优化理论可以统一推广到带动量的 SHB，且不必依赖 interpolation 或动量参数限制；递减变体在一般条件下仍保证几乎必然收敛。

papers.title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
papers.abstract_en: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenLimitLib 是一个 Lean 4 形式化库，把 Kleinberg 与 Mullainathan（NeurIPS 2024）提出的 limit 语言生成 (language generation in the limit) 领域 30 篇论文的形式化成果集中到共享定义、可复用证明组件与跨论文关系记录中，同时保留各论文自己的假设与陈述。作者用数学案例研究和 LLM 实验展示该库既能支撑人类数学研究，也能支撑 AI 辅助研究。
Motivation: limit 语言生成是一个由 LLM 启发、起步不久且快速扩张的理论领域，论文各自为政的定义与假设让读者难以看清文献全貌，也难以在大规模形式化中复用证明。
Method: 构建 source-aligned 的 Lean 4 库 GenLimitLib，覆盖 30 篇论文的形式化；抽取共享定义与可复用证明组件，同时保留每篇论文特有的假设和命题，并显式记录论文之间的关系；以数学案例研究和 LLM 实验两种方式演示用途。
Result: 库内含 30 篇论文的形式化开发，抽取共享定义与可复用证明组件并记录跨论文关系；通过数学案例研究与 LLM 实验展示其对人类数学研究和 AI 辅助研究的支持，代码发布于 github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib。
Conclusion: limit 语言生成这类年轻领域适合当作大规模形式化的试验场：把共享定义、可复用证明与跨论文关系结构化沉淀到一个 Lean 4 库中，可同时服务于人工数学研究与 LLM 辅助研究。

summary_sections.result: 库内含 30 篇论文的形式化开发，抽取共享定义与可复用证明组件并记录跨论文关系；通过数学案例研究与 LLM 实验展示其对人类数学研究和 AI 辅助研究的支持，代码发布于 github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib。
summary_sections.conclusion: limit 语言生成这类年轻领域适合当作大规模形式化的试验场：把共享定义、可复用证明与跨论文关系结构化沉淀到一个 Lean 4 库中，可同时服务于人工数学研究与 LLM 辅助研究。

papers.title: AutoLoCo: Communication Efficient Distributed LLM Training via Adaptive Synchronization
papers.abstract_en: The pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly conducted across multiple data centers. As training scales to a larger number of accelerators, the fraction of time spent on computation decreases, while the fraction spent on communication increases. Therefore, frequent synchronization becomes a growing bottleneck. Local update methods reduce this cost by allowing workers to perform several optimizer steps between synchronizations. Most local update methods set the number of local optimizer steps between synchronizations before training and keep this interval fixed throughout the run. However, the best interval can change during the entire train process. If the interval and optimizer are adapted to the current training state, the communication frequency is reduced while maintaining the training performance. In this work, we introduce AutoLoCo, an adaptive training framework to reduce communication in LLM training. It adapts the local interval using scalar training statistics and corrects each outer update. Our method is motivated by two observations: 1) the appropriate local interval varies across training stages, and 2) changing the number of inner steps per interval creates a mismatch with an unchanged outer optimizer, requiring a correction to the outer update. We optimize this mismatch by correction of the outer optimizer for the momentum and the learning rate using the accumulated inner learning rate. Our experiments under communication constraints demonstrate that AutoLoCo reduces communication frequency by 27% relative to DiLoCo while maintaining training performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoLoCo 针对跨数据中心 LLM 预训练的同步瓶颈，用标量训练统计量自适应调整本地优化步数（local interval），并按累积内层学习率修正外层优化器的动量与学习率，以补偿内外步数变化带来的失配。在通信受限实验中，相对 DiLoCo 降低 27% 通信频率且保持训练性能。
Motivation: LLM 预训练扩展到多数据中心后，通信时间占比上升、频繁同步成为瓶颈；现有 local update 方法（如 DiLoCo）在训练前固定同步间隔，但最优间隔随训练阶段变化，固定间隔与不变的外层优化器还会产生失配。
Method: AutoLoCo 是自适应训练框架：用标量训练统计量动态决定本地优化步数（local interval），并在每次外层更新时按累积内层学习率修正外层优化器的动量与学习率，以消除内外步数变化造成的失配。
Result: 在通信约束下的实验中，AutoLoCo 相对 DiLoCo 将通信频率降低 27%，同时保持训练性能。
Conclusion: 同步间隔与外层优化器应随训练状态一起自适应调整：间隔可变而外层优化器不变会产生失配，修正后能在不损失训练性能的前提下减少通信。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: You Only Reprogram Once: Rethinking Prolonged Training for Visual Reprogramming
papers.abstract_en: Visual reprogramming is a parameter-efficient method for adapting pretrained models, yet its training can remain computationally expensive: even with a frozen backbone, visual prompts are often optimized through the full model for hundreds of epochs. Before changing what the pretrained model sees, we ask whether we are fully using what it already tells us. We find that modeling the full source response can already yield strong downstream predictions without prompt optimization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce You Only Reprogram Once (YORO), which constructs a downstream predictor from the frozen response space in a single forward-only traversal. Its Bayesian Discriminant Mapping (BDM) derives a covariance-aware affine mapping from streaming class statistics, requiring no backpropagation, optimizer updates, or repeated visits to the training set. When further input adaptation helps, YORO-FP optionally refines the visual prompt for 20 epochs. BDM also extends naturally to CLIP by treating attribute-prompt similarities as source responses. Across three full-data settings, YORO improves average accuracy over the strongest prior gradient-free mapping by 18.4--24.4\%. On 16-shot CLIP, it raises the four-backbone average from 71.4\% to 77.2\%. YORO-FP provides further gains on selected tasks, while validation often retains the one-pass predictor. These results suggest a different default for visual reprogramming: read out the frozen response first, and optimize the input only when needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: YORO 在冻结骨干的响应空间上只做一次前向遍历就构造下游预测器：Bayesian Discriminant Mapping (BDM) 从流式类别统计导出协方差感知的仿射映射，无需反向传播与优化器更新。三个全数据设置下平均准确率比最强的无梯度映射高 18.4–24.4%，16-shot CLIP 上四骨干平均从 71.4% 提到 77.2%；需要时再用 YORO-FP 微调视觉 prompt 20 个 epoch。
Motivation: 视觉重编程 (visual reprogramming) 即使骨干冻结，视觉 prompt 仍要经整个模型训练数百 epoch，计算代价高；作者质疑是否已用尽预训练模型本身给出的信息。
Method: YORO 用单次前向遍历在冻结响应空间上构造预测器：BDM 从流式类别统计 (streaming class statistics) 拟合协方差感知的仿射映射，不需要反向传播、优化器更新或重复访问训练集；可选 YORO-FP 再对视觉 prompt 微调 20 epochs。BDM 通过把属性-文本相似度当作源响应自然扩展到 CLIP。
Result: 三个全数据设置下，YORO 平均准确率比最强的先前无梯度映射提高 18.4–24.4%；16-shot CLIP 上四骨干平均准确率从 71.4% 升至 77.2%。YORO-FP 在部分任务上带来进一步增益，而验证时常保留单次遍历预测器。
Conclusion: 视觉重编程的默认做法应改为先读出冻结响应，仅在需要时才优化输入；prompt 的数百 epoch 训练通常可省。

papers.title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($τ$) or the number of iterations ($T$). In particular, our non-asymptotic parameter recovery error bound reveals three terms: (i) an initialization-dependent error that goes away with $T$, (ii) finite-sample noise terms that decreases with $τ$ and the number of honest clients, and (iii) a stochastic gradient variance term that also reduces with $T$. Importantly, with no irreducible model-heterogeneity bias in our bounds. We extend the regression analysis to multiclass classification, and empirically validate it on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and School Exam Score datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在异构联邦学习中，单一共享模型参数会带来不可消除的模型异构偏差并削弱 Byzantine 鲁棒性；本文改为共享非线性表示、每个客户端个性化线性头，用 Byzantine-robust 聚合共同估计表示。非渐近恢复误差界分解为随迭代 T 消失的初始化项、随每客户端样本数 τ 与诚实客户端数下降的有限样本项、以及随 T 下降的随机梯度方差项，且不含不可消除的模型异构偏差。
Motivation: 异构客户端下单一共享参数无法刻画各自不同的数据生成过程，产生不可消除的模型异构偏差，严重限制对对抗（Byzantine）客户端的鲁棒性。
Method: 通过表示学习重构 FL：每个客户端维护个性化线性头，客户端协作用 Byzantine-robust 聚合估计共享非线性表示；对诚实客户端表示梯度的异构性由表示误差与统计误差控制，推导非渐近参数恢复误差界并把回归分析推广到多分类。
Result: 恢复误差界含三项：随迭代 T 消失的初始化相关项、随每客户端样本数 τ 与诚实客户端数下降的有限样本噪声项、随 T 下降的随机梯度方差项；界中不含不可消除的模型异构偏差。在 CIFAR-10、FEMNIST 和 School Exam Score 数据集上做实证验证。
Conclusion: 把共享对象从模型参数换成共享表示加个性化线性头，可在异构联邦学习中消除模型异构偏差项并提升对 Byzantine 客户端的鲁棒性，误差随 T、τ 与诚实客户端数收敛。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: The strong generalization performance of on-policy post-training paradigms has motivated studies of their parameter update behaviors. However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve such improvements. First, our analyses reveal that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions, while the on-policy paradigm continuously adjusts the direction during training. This difference inspires us to focus on the cumulative update direction of each parameter as a promising behavior. Then, we evaluate its effectiveness for improving generalization by proposing On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning (OPSFT), which constrains SFT updates to the direction identified by on-policy paradigms. The strong performance of OPSFT indicates that the generalization advantage of on-policy paradigms can be transferred to SFT through the parameter update direction. Once such a direction is identified, even SFT can generalize with its updates constrained to this direction. This finding offers two practical benefits by combining the strong generalization of on-policy paradigms with the advantages of SFT, including the high training efficiency and ability to leverage high-quality trajectories. For efficiency, we identify update directions that support strong generalization using a few on-policy training steps, and subsequently apply OPSFT to achieve high training efficiency. For leveraging high-quality trajectories, OPSFT can utilize these trajectories to continue improving a post-trained model along its update direction without disrupting the ability learned from on-policy training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 SFT 的参数更新方向在训练中保持一致，而 on-policy 后训练会持续调整更新方向；据此提出 On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning (OPSFT)，把 SFT 的更新约束到 on-policy 范式识别出的累积更新方向上。约束后 SFT 也能获得 on-policy 范式的泛化优势，并可用少量 on-policy 步骤识别方向、再用 OPSFT 高效训练，同时沿该方向利用高质量轨迹继续改进已后训练模型。
Motivation: 现有对 on-policy 后训练参数更新行为的研究只把这些行为当作副产品，没有把它们当作可迁移的优化原则去改进 SFT 等其他范式的泛化。
Method: 先对比分析 SFT 与 on-policy 范式的参数更新方向，识别出每个参数的累积更新方向 (cumulative update direction)；再提出 OPSFT，将 SFT 更新约束到该方向上，先用少量 on-policy 训练步数确定方向，随后用 OPSFT 完成训练。
Result: OPSFT 表现出强性能，表明 on-policy 范式的泛化优势可通过参数更新方向转移到 SFT；方向一旦确定，被约束到该方向的 SFT 也能泛化。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: on-policy 的泛化优势可以与 SFT 的训练效率和利用高质量轨迹的能力结合：沿识别出的方向继续训练，既保持高效率，也不破坏 on-policy 训练已学到的能力。
