papers.title: Constitutional adapters: Inference-time interventions for misalignment and misuse
papers.abstract_en: Training models to act in accordance with an explicitly defined set of principles, or "constitution," has shown promise as a robust and transparent mechanism for AI alignment. However, the generality and flexibility of such methods remain unclear. Here, we show that constitution-consistent behavior can be distilled from synthetic corpora into lightweight objects (low-rank adapters and steering vectors). Despite never seeing a harmful request or jailbreak during training, such objects increase jailbreak defense success and measured alignment -- particularly at long context lengths and against multi-turn attacks, where they outperform both prompted and steered baselines. Subtracting control-trained from constitution-trained objects further accentuates these effects, yielding defenses we call "constitutional adapters" (CAs). CAs can be trained on a base model, transferred zero-shot to its post-trained checkpoint, and scaled at inference time to predictably trade off defense for benign compliance. Taken together, these results recommend CAs as a lightweight, portable, and tunable lever for mitigating misalignment and misuse in API deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把宪法式对齐行为从合成语料蒸馏进低秩 adapter 与 steering vector，训练时从不接触有害请求或越狱样本，再用「宪法训练对象减去控制训练对象」的差分得到 constitutional adapters (CAs)。CAs 提升越狱防御成功率与实测对齐度，在长上下文和多轮攻击下超过 prompted 与 steered 基线，且可在推理时缩放，以可预测的方式在防御与良性遵从之间取舍。
Motivation: 宪法式对齐 (constitution-based alignment) 的通用性与灵活性尚不清楚，且现有 prompted/steered 防御在长上下文与多轮攻击下表现不足。
Method: 从合成语料把宪法一致行为蒸馏到轻量对象：低秩 adapter 与 steering vector；训练阶段不出现任何有害请求或越狱样本。再从宪法训练对象中减去控制训练对象，得到 constitutional adapters (CAs)，可在基座模型上训练并零样本迁移到其后训练 checkpoint。
Result: 这些对象提高越狱防御成功率与实测对齐度，尤其在长上下文长度和多轮攻击下，超过 prompted 与 steered 基线；差分构造进一步放大该效应。CAs 可零样本迁移到后训练 checkpoint，并在推理时缩放以可预测地权衡防御与良性遵从。
Conclusion: CAs 是用于缓解 API 部署中 misalignment 与 misuse 的轻量、可移植、可调的推理时干预手段。

papers.title: Not Every Correction Helps: Gain-Guided Continual Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) adapts a source model to an unlabeled test stream whose distribution may change over time. Existing TTA methods often assess prediction reliability using confidence or entropy, which primarily reflect the model's self-certainty for the current sample. In CTTA, accumulated target observations can provide complementary evidence for correcting the source prediction, but this history may become misaligned as the target distribution changes. The key question is therefore not how much the correction differs from the source prediction, but whether and how strongly it should be applied. This paper proposes Gain-Aware INtervention (GAIN), a backpropagation-free CTTA framework guided by a simple principle: history proposes, gain decides. GAIN maintains compact target statistics to form a correction proposal and a posterior-predictive evaluator that accounts for estimation uncertainty. The resulting source-relative gain estimates the proposal's benefit and determines a sample-specific intervention strength along a continuous path through efficient one-dimensional optimization. Gain-controlled predictions then update the target statistics online, limiting the propagation of unreliable corrections, all without backpropagation, sample storage, or replay. Across five benchmarks, our method achieves strong predictive performance, with favorable accuracy--calibration--efficiency trade-offs in continual adaptation. On ImageNet-C, for example, GAIN achieves 61.9% accuracy with near-source calibration. It remains stable under diverse and challenging continual shifts while running 15.9x faster than a representative optimization-based CTTA baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免反向传播的持续测试时适应 (CTTA) 框架 Gain-Aware INtervention (GAIN)：由紧凑目标统计给出修正提案，用考虑估计不确定性的后验预测评估器算出相对源模型的 gain，再经一维优化决定逐样本的连续干预强度，受控预测再在线更新统计。在五个基准上取得良好的精度-校准-效率权衡，ImageNet-C 上 61.9% 精度且校准接近源模型，比代表性优化式 CTTA 基线快 15.9 倍。
Motivation: 现有 TTA 用置信度或熵衡量可靠性，只反映模型对当前样本的自确信；CTTA 中累积的目标观测虽可提供修正证据，但分布漂移后历史会失配，关键不是修正与源预测差多少，而是该不该、以多强施加。
Method: GAIN 维护紧凑的目标统计量生成修正提案，配一个考虑估计不确定性的后验预测评估器；以相对源模型的 gain 估计提案收益，经高效一维优化确定逐样本干预强度并沿连续路径施加；受控预测再在线更新目标统计，全程无需反向传播、样本存储或回放。
Result: 在五个基准上取得强预测表现与有利的精度-校准-效率权衡；ImageNet-C 上 GAIN 达 61.9% 精度且校准接近源模型；在多样且困难的持续漂移下保持稳定，运行速度比代表性优化式 CTTA 基线快 15.9 倍。
Conclusion: 是否施加修正及其强度应由相对源模型的 gain 决定而非自确信度，受控干预能在持续漂移下同时保住稳定性、校准与效率。

papers.title: Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its final reconstruction error. Large models pose a second challenge: full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all remain on one accelerator, while assigning complete layers to devices leaves each time-consuming layer solve serial. We introduce \emph{Schur Replay}, a scale-selection algorithm that reproduces the GPTQ updates caused by each block scale and scores the resulting block error after accounting for compensation from unquantized columns. Separately, our execution infrastructure keeps only the active layer resident, tiers activations across device, host, and disk, retires full-precision layers after export, and distributes independent output rows across tensor-parallel ranks. Together, the algorithm and infrastructure attain $99.35\%$ and $100.84\%$ question-weighted recovery from BF16 across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reduces measured per-layer time by $15.17\times$ over ModelOpt and $23.14\times$ over LLM Compressor, with lower memory used per GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Schur Replay：在 GPTQ 中复现每个 block scale 引起的后续列更新，并在扣除未量化列补偿后再评分块误差，从而正确选 NVFP4 的 16 个 E2M1 权重共享的 E4M3 block scale。配套执行基础设施只驻留当前层、跨 device/host/disk 分层激活、导出后回收全精度层并按输出行分发到 tensor-parallel ranks。在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上七个基准达到 BF16 的 99.35% 与 100.84% question-weighted recovery，397B 上每层耗时比 ModelOpt 快 15.17×、比 LLM Compressor 快 23.14×。
Motivation: GPTQ 中量化一列会更新后续列，单独评估一个 block 会误估最终重建误差；同时大模型的全精度权重、校准激活与二阶状态无法放进单个加速器，整层分配到设备又让耗时层的求解串行化。
Method: Schur Replay 复现每个 block scale 触发的 GPTQ 更新，并在计入未量化列补偿后给块误差打分；执行侧只驻留活动层，激活在 device/host/disk 三层分级，导出后回收全精度层，并把独立输出行分发到 tensor-parallel ranks。
Result: 在七个基准上，Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 达到 BF16 的 99.35% question-weighted recovery，Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 达到 100.84%；397B 模型上基础设施使实测每层耗时比 ModelOpt 降低 15.17×、比 LLM Compressor 降低 23.14×，且每 GPU 占用内存更低。
Conclusion: 把 block scale 的选择建立在复现的 GPTQ 更新与补偿后误差之上，配合分层驻留与行级并行的执行基础设施，可在 NVFP4 上以接近 BF16 的恢复率大幅压缩大模型量化耗时。

papers.title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent reasoning models have attracted growing attention for scaling test-time computation, typically by iteratively refining latent states with shared parameters. However, these models apply each learned update with a fixed unit scale, which can be conservative when updates make persistent progress and overly aggressive when they fluctuate, limiting the benefit of additional loops. To understand how the scale should vary along the trajectory, we first analyze the sensitivity of terminal loss to recurrent update scale. We show that its temporal average admits an exact decomposition into persistent-progress and centered-fluctuation contributions. Based on this, we introduce the Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler (TAPS), which tracks their balance across recurrent updates and adapts the step size online. Theoretically, we establish sufficient conditions under which TAPS reduces expected terminal loss and reaches a target quality in fewer recurrent loops. Empirically, we show that TAPS improves terminal accuracy across structured reasoning tasks without retraining. By further incorporating the progress-fluctuation principle into training, TAPS yields additional accuracy gains with up to 1.56 times wall-clock speedup at matched baseline accuracy. The broad applicability of TAPS is supported by its effectiveness across diverse recurrent architectures and inference strategies. Together, these results establish update scale as complementary control axis of recurrent inference alongside architecture and depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Looped Transformer 用固定步长做递归推理，持续进展时偏保守、波动时偏激进。TAPS 把终端损失对更新步长的敏感度分解为持久进展与中心化波动两部分，据此在线自适应步长：免重训即提升结构化推理任务的终端精度，再把该原则并入训练可获额外增益，并在匹配基线精度下取得最高 1.56 倍墙钟加速。
Motivation: 递归推理模型以共享参数迭代精化隐状态来扩展 test-time 计算，但每步更新固定为单位尺度，使额外循环的收益受限；更新尺度这一控制轴此前未被单独研究。
Method: 先分析终端损失对递归更新尺度的敏感度，证明其时间平均可精确分解为持久进展 (persistent-progress) 与中心化波动 (centered-fluctuation) 两个贡献；据此提出 Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler (TAPS)，跨递归更新跟踪两者平衡并在线调整步长，同时给出 TAPS 降低期望终端损失、以更少循环达到目标质量的充分条件，并可将该原则并入训练。
Result: TAPS 在结构化推理任务上免重训即提升终端精度；把进展-波动原则并入训练后获得额外精度增益，并在匹配基线精度下取得最高 1.56 倍墙钟加速；其有效性横跨多种递归架构与推理策略。
Conclusion: 更新尺度是与架构、深度互补的递归推理控制轴，按进展与波动的平衡在线调度步长可同时减少所需循环数并提高精度。

papers.title: RankBuffer: Efficient Ranking-Based Rewards for Open-Ended Generation
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended generation lacks canonical answers, making pointwise rewards difficult to calibrate for group-based reinforcement learning. Directly ranking same-query rollouts provides a more suitable relative reward signal, but existing ranking-based reward methods can incur substantial judging cost. We introduce RankBuffer, which maintains an ordered, query-specific buffer of previously judged responses as a reusable quality scale. Each rollout is first inserted into an anchor interval through an independent coarse judgment, after which only rollouts assigned to the same interval undergo local fine ranking. The resulting complete order is converted into bounded rank rewards, while boundary expansion, local refinement, and inactive-anchor pruning adapt the buffer as the policy evolves. Across four open-ended benchmarks, RankBuffer consistently outperforms all pointwise baselines. It also achieves nearly on-par performance with the strongest ranking-based reward baseline while substantially reducing judging cost. Ablations demonstrate the importance of both local fine ranking and anchor response content, while buffer analyses show that rollout-derived anchors progressively extend and refine the covered quality scale. These results establish response reuse as an effective approach to efficient relative reward construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RankBuffer 为开放式生成的组相对强化学习维护按查询缓存的有序已评判响应，作为可复用的质量标尺：新 rollout 先经独立粗判插入锚定区间，仅同区间内做局部细排，再把完整序转换为有界 rank reward。在四个开放式基准上一致优于全部 pointwise 基线，并以大幅降低 judging cost 接近最强 ranking-based 基线的性能。
Motivation: 开放式生成没有标准答案，pointwise 奖励难以校准；直接对同查询 rollout 排序虽是更合适的相对奖励信号，但现有 ranking-based 奖励方法的评判开销很大。
Method: 维护按查询划分的有序缓冲区存已评判响应；rollout 先经独立粗判落入锚定区间，仅同区间做局部细排，完整序转为有界 rank reward；通过 boundary expansion、local refinement、inactive-anchor pruning 随策略演化更新缓冲。
Result: 在四个开放式基准上一致超过所有 pointwise 基线；与最强 ranking-based 奖励基线性能近乎持平同时显著降低 judging cost；消融显示 local fine ranking 与 anchor response content 均重要，缓冲分析显示 rollout 派生的锚点逐步扩展并细化所覆盖的质量标尺。
Conclusion: 响应复用是构建高效相对奖励的有效途径：把已评判响应当作可复用质量标尺，可在压低评判开销的同时保住 ranking-based 奖励的收益。

papers.title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning in large language models incurs substantial computation and memory costs. Visual text compression (VTC) reduces input length by rendering text as images, but fixed-resolution rendering creates a compression-performance trade-off: low DPI saves tokens at the expense of legibility, whereas high DPI spends tokens on irrelevant content. We introduce FocusVTC, which breaks this trade-off through adaptive resolution while preserving general multimodal capabilities. It combines compressed low-DPI global views with selective region enhancement, integrating enhanced views into ongoing reasoning. We construct 29.4K high-quality Reasoning-Evidence Localization (REL) chain-of-thought examples (REL-CoT) that link reasoning traces to page indices and bounding boxes. Multi-resolution REL supervised fine-tuning (REL-SFT) teaches the model to localize relevant regions, and Group Relative Policy Optimization learns when to enhance resolution and how to use the resulting observations, without a separate continual-pretraining stage. At 72 DPI on RULER v1, FocusVTC scores 87.4 at $2.9\times$ input compression, including tool observations, versus 57.5 for Glyph at $3.0\times$ input compression. It surpasses its text-input backbone on LongBench (56.40 versus 55.86), improves the MRCR macro-average by 13.91 points, and achieves a 51.19 macro-average on VTCBench. The MRCR latency evaluation also shows a $2.79\times$ online end-to-end speedup over Text. papers.title: VLM4Cluster: Benchmarking Deep Clustering In the Era of Vision-Language Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language pre-training has reshaped image clustering, giving rise to language-assisted image clustering (LaIC), which leverages textual semantics to complement visual representations. Despite the rapid proliferation of LaIC methods, it remains unclear how much LaIC has actually advanced image clustering, as existing studies generally suffer from major limitations, including inconsistent experimental settings, inadequate dataset selection, and limited evaluation dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce VLM4Cluster, a comprehensive benchmark for image clustering in the era of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs). VLM4Cluster implements 17 representative methods spanning classical, deep, and language-assisted image clustering, and evaluates them on 20 datasets covering classical, challenging, fine-grained, large-scale, and out-of-distribution settings. Beyond effectiveness, VLM4Cluster systematically investigates image clustering along three complementary dimensions: robustness to adversarial perturbations, generalization under distribution shifts, and computational efficiency. Our study shows that LaIC substantially advances the clustering performance frontier on many semantically demanding benchmarks, generally exhibits stronger generalization under distribution shifts, and achieves a more favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off. However, its gains become less consistent on large-scale and fine-grained datasets, while language assistance does not systematically reduce sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. VLM4Cluster is released at https://github.com/YuanweiHuu/VLM4Cluster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM4Cluster 是图像聚类基准，统一评测 17 种经典、深度与语言辅助聚类 (LaIC) 方法，覆盖 20 个数据集并从对抗鲁棒性、分布偏移泛化、计算效率三个维度评估。结论是 LaIC 在语义要求高的基准上明显推进聚类性能前沿、分布偏移下泛化更强且效果-效率权衡更优，但在大规模与细粒度数据集上增益不稳定，语言辅助也未系统性降低对抗扰动敏感性。
Motivation: 视觉-语言预训练催生的语言辅助图像聚类 (LaIC) 方法快速增多，但既有研究实验设置不一致、数据集选择不足、评测维度有限，无法判断 LaIC 究竟把图像聚类推进了多少。
Method: 构建基准 VLM4Cluster，实现 17 个代表性方法（经典、深度、语言辅助三类），在 20 个数据集上统一评测，覆盖经典、挑战性、细粒度、大规模与分布外 (out-of-distribution) 设定；除有效性外，沿对抗扰动鲁棒性、分布偏移下泛化、计算效率三个互补维度系统考察。
Result: 研究显示 LaIC 在多个语义要求高的基准上显著推进聚类性能前沿，分布偏移下泛化普遍更强，效果-效率权衡更有利；但在大规模与细粒度数据集上增益变得不一致，语言辅助并未系统性降低对对抗扰动的敏感性。
Conclusion: 语言辅助确实抬高了语义密集场景的聚类上限并改善效率权衡，但其收益依赖数据集规模与粒度，且对抗鲁棒性不由语言语义自动带来。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Where Predictive Supervision Goes Shapes What VLA Policies Learn
papers.abstract_en: Future prediction is increasingly used to improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies, based on the premise that anticipating scene evolution encourages representations useful for control. However, forecast quality alone does not establish that a policy has learned a better representation for action. This distinction matters under distribution shift, where successful control depends on preserving spatial state and likely scene change beyond familiar configurations. We study what determines whether predictive supervision improves the visual representation used by a VLA policy. Through controlled comparisons with matched target constructions, prediction horizons, and training conditions, we find that different prediction interfaces produce markedly different forecasts and visual representations, including in the spatial, dynamics, and action information that transfers beyond familiar scenes. We trace these differences to how predictive errors shape the policy's visual stream. Consistent with this controlled finding, VLA policies trained with more direct, scene-matched future supervision show stronger robustness under simulated and physical distribution shifts. Together, our results frame future prediction as a representation-learning design problem whose value for control depends on whether its supervision reaches the representations through which the policy acts.
papers.comment: 38 pages (9 pages main text + appendix), 13 figures, 21 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 VLA 策略里的未来预测监督是否有效，取决于预测接口落在哪条视觉表征通路上：受控对比中，更直接、与场景匹配的未来监督让策略在模拟与真实分布偏移下表现出更强鲁棒性，而预测质量本身并不等于动作表征变好。
Motivation: 用未来预测改进 VLA 策略的前提是“预演场景演化会带来对控制有用的表征”，但预测好不等于动作表征好；在分布偏移下控制依赖于保留空间状态与可能的场景变化，这一区分尚未被厘清。
Method: 在匹配的目标构造、预测时长 (prediction horizon) 与训练条件下做受控对比，比较不同预测接口 (prediction interface) 产生的预测与视觉表征，并追踪预测误差如何塑造策略的视觉流 (visual stream)；评估覆盖模拟与物理分布偏移。
Result: 不同预测接口产生显著不同的预测与视觉表征，差异体现在迁移到熟悉场景之外的空间、动态与动作信息上；采用更直接、场景匹配未来监督的 VLA 策略在模拟与物理分布偏移下鲁棒性更强。
Conclusion: 未来预测应被当作表征学习设计问题：其对控制的价值取决于监督是否真正到达策略据以行动的那些表征，而不取决于预测本身的质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OCA: ODE-Driven Cross-Attention for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration
papers.abstract_en: Cross-attention is a crucial component in learning-based image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration. Although existing cross-attention mechanisms have achieved promising progress, attention ambiguity remains a fundamental challenge that hinders the learning of discriminative 2D-3D correspondences. To address this problem, we revisit cross-attention and establish ordinary differential equations (ODEs) to model the ideal I2P feature interaction. Based on this formulation, we develop an ODE-driven cross-attention (OCA) module that refines feature representations and attention matrices through ODEs. In practice, OCA can be seamlessly integrated into existing I2P registration frameworks. To validate its effectiveness, we incorporate OCA into five state-of-the-art baselines and evaluate on four public benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that OCA improves registration recall by up to 5\%, 9\%, and 15\% under the standard, fine-tuning, and zero-shot settings, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对图像到点云 (I2P) 配准中交叉注意力的注意力歧义问题，用常微分方程 (ODE) 刻画理想的 2D-3D 特征交互，提出 ODE 驱动的交叉注意力模块 OCA，通过 ODE 迭代精化特征表示与注意力矩阵。将 OCA 嵌入五个 SOTA 配准框架并在四个公开基准上测试，配准召回率在标准、微调、零样本三种设置下分别最多提升 5%、9%、15%。
Motivation: 现有交叉注意力虽有进展，但注意力歧义 (attention ambiguity) 仍是制约判别性 2D-3D 对应学习的根本问题。
Method: 重新审视交叉注意力并用 ODE 建模理想的 I2P 特征交互，在此基础上构造 OCA 模块，通过求解 ODE 同时精化特征表示与注意力矩阵；OCA 可无缝接入现有 I2P 配准框架，实验中嵌入五个 SOTA 基线。
Result: 在四个公开基准数据集上，OCA 使配准召回率 (registration recall) 最多提升：标准设置 5%、微调设置 9%、零样本设置 15%。
Conclusion: 用 ODE 约束交叉注意力的特征交互可以缓解注意力歧义，且该模块对不同 I2P 配准框架与三种训练设置均具可插拔的增益，零样本设置下提升最大。

papers.title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD). After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective, with no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead. On ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones, PR-OPD achieves the best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/balibata/PR-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PR-OPD 把特权自蒸馏的对齐通道从 token 概率换到隐状态：GRPO 热启后，策略为每条轨迹写事后技能 (hindsight skill)，再以带该技能的自身响应作 stop-gradient 教师，逐层对齐投影后的隐状态并同时优化奖励目标。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop、两个 backbone 上，相对 GRPO 成功率最多提升 4.7 点（ALFWorld）与 14.0 点准确率（WebShop）。
Motivation: 语言模型 agent 通常只有每回合一个奖励，特权自蒸馏用 token 概率让同一策略的有技能版本教无技能版本，但该通道存疑：技能把 WebShop 成功率从 42.2% 抬到 56.2%，却只改变不到四分之一采样 token 的概率。
Method: GRPO 热启后，策略为每条轨迹生成事后技能，再用带技能的自身响应作 stop-gradient 教师重读自己的输出，在奖励目标之外逐层对齐投影隐状态；无需外部技能库、独立教师或推理开销。诊断依据是线性 probe 能从隐状态回溯到具体技能，且技能改变超过 80% 响应 token 的隐状态。
Result: 技能在上下文中使 WebShop 成功率从 42.2% 升到 56.2%，但只改变不到 25% 采样 token 的概率，而改变超过 80% 响应 token 的隐状态。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop、两个 backbone 的每种设置中 PR-OPD 均取得最佳总体结果，相对 GRPO 最多提升 4.7 点 ALFWorld 成功率与 14.0 点 WebShop 准确率。
Conclusion: 技能信息主要藏在隐状态而非 token 概率里，因此对齐隐状态比概率蒸馏更有效地传递特权技能；该做法不引入外部技能库、独立教师或推理开销。

summary_sections.conclusion: 技能信息主要藏在隐状态而非 token 概率里，因此对齐隐状态比概率蒸馏更有效地传递特权技能；该做法不引入外部技能库、独立教师或推理开销。

papers.title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIPS 用仅结果的强化学习 (outcome-only RL) 诱导生成式过程奖励模型 (generative PRM) 的步级监督：模型先产出 CoT、再给步级标签和结果标签，奖励只看预测结果是否与 ground truth 一致，组相对优势 (group-relative advantage) 回传优化整段回答。TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 用仅 3.2K 条结果标注轨迹在 ProcessBench 上达到 85.2 F1，超过所有被评估的训练型 PRM 与 GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus 等纯 prompt 判别器，但仍落后 o1-mini。
Motivation: 训练强 PRM 成本高：人工步级标注难以规模化，Monte Carlo 估计计算昂贵且会偏离步骤本身的内在正确性。
Method: TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision) 框架：模型生成 chain-of-thought (CoT) 后接步级标签与结果标签，奖励仅由预测结果是否匹配 ground truth 决定，用组相对优势优化整段生成回答，从而在没有显式过程监督的情况下强化步级验证；在数学与 agent 基准、四个 backbone 家族上验证。
Result: TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 在 ProcessBench 上 85.2 F1，仅用 3.2K 条结果标注轨迹；超过全部被评估的训练型 PRM 以及 GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus 等强纯 prompt 判别器，但仍不及 o1-mini。
Conclusion: 只要检查中间步骤有助于判定结果，仅结果的 RL 就能替代显式过程标注，以低成本训练出步级反馈有效的 PRM。

papers.title: A Digital Simulation Toolkit for Physics-Based Generation of Realistic Experimental Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Images
papers.abstract_en: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) is a widely used tool for characterizing surfaces of materials at the atomic scale, playing a crucial role in discoveries across condensed matter physics and materials science. Despite its extreme spatial resolution, STM is one of the most sensitive microscopy techniques and is highly prone to noise. While existing unsupervised denoising methods are very cheap to train, these are primarily focused on removing the noise with minimal recovery of key physical information. While supervised methods can offer superior performance, the major bottleneck is that a large amount of paired clean-noisy experimental images is required which are impractical to obtain. Thus, we developed a low-cost physics-driven digital toolkit to rapidly generate large volume of realistic STM images. Firstly, we simulate clean images from a chosen material system. Then, with prior knowledge of the physical characteristics of the artifacts and noise present in STM experiments, we formulate several artifact-noise functions such as Gaussian electronic noise, 1/f flicker noise, scan-line noise, background tilt and mechanical drift. These physically informed noise components are then added to the simulated clean images to generate realistic STM images. We demonstrated the capability of the proposed digital toolkit to generate AI-ready data for denoising images of the (111) surfaces of copper and lead, while preserving atoms, defects, and electron waves. We also validated the quality of the downstream image analysis of learning electron wave patterns induced by quantum interference from Cu(111) images. Results show that the supervised models trained on digitally generated AI-ready data can more effectively denoise and learn electron wave patterns on Cu(111) images than benchmarked unsupervised approaches, indicating that the proposed toolkit facilitate scientific discovery.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures in main text and 2 supplementary figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理驱动的 STM 图像数字生成工具包：先仿真干净表面图，再按实验伪影与噪声的物理特征叠加高斯电子噪声、1/f 闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜和机械漂移，批量产出 AI-ready 配对数据。用其训练的监督模型在 Cu(111) 与 Pb(111) 去噪及电子波图案学习上优于对比的无监督方法。
Motivation: STM 极易受噪声影响，无监督去噪训练便宜但几乎不恢复关键物理信息；监督方法效果更好却需要大量实验配对的干净-含噪图像，实际难以获得。
Method: 先从选定材料体系仿真干净图像，再依据 STM 实验中伪影与噪声的物理特性构造多个 artifact-noise 函数（Gaussian electronic noise、1/f flicker noise、scan-line noise、background tilt、mechanical drift），叠加到干净图上生成真实感 STM 图像，产出供监督去噪模型训练的 AI-ready 数据。
Result: 在 Cu(111) 与 Pb(111) 表面去噪演示中保留了原子、缺陷与电子波；在 Cu(111) 图像上验证了下游分析——学习量子干涉诱导的电子波图案，并显示用数字生成数据训练的监督模型比 benchmarked 无监督方法更有效去噪并学习电子波图案。
Conclusion: 用物理信息噪声函数合成配对数据可以绕开实验配对数据瓶颈，使监督去噪在 STM 上可行并优于无监督方案，从而辅助科学发现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PE-OPSD 把推理期 Prompt Enhancer 的增益内化进 text-to-image flow-matching 模型：训练时用增强提示教师在学生自生成轨迹访问的状态上提供 vector-field 目标，推理时移除 PE 与教师，学生直接吃原始提示生成。在多个模型家族、多种 PE 与基准上取得所评估基线中最强的聚合提示保真度 (prompt fidelity)，聚合视觉吸引力为正，并保持基模型推理效率。
Motivation: 用户提示简短欠定，而生成模型需要详细文本条件才能可靠遵循指令；现有 Prompt Enhancer 在推理期重写提示，带来额外延迟，且提示细化始终在生成器之外。
Method: 提出 Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD)，用于 text-to-image flow-matching 模型：训练时原始提示学生沿自身生成轨迹前进，增强提示教师在学生访问的状态上给出 vector-field 目标，以 on-policy 自蒸馏把增强提示诱导的行为蒸馏进学生，且不需要额外图文对。
Result: 在多个模型家族、多种 PE 与基准上，PE-OPSD 取得所评估基线中最强的聚合提示保真度，聚合视觉吸引力增益为正，并保留基模型的推理效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 增强提示可作为特权训练信息被内化，推理期无需 PE 与教师即可从原始提示直接生成，同时不牺牲推理效率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase computational depth through parameter sharing, offering a path to scale inference computation without adding parameters. However, it remains unclear when additional recurrence is beneficial and how architectural choices affect its effectiveness. Through controlled experiments, we systematically examine (1) when recurrence helps, (2) where it should be applied, and (3) how its conditioning affects performance. Our evaluation covers inference budgets below, within, and beyond the training horizon under knowledge and reasoning tasks. (1) We find that recurrence can improve reasoning beyond the training horizon while degrading knowledge performance, but harder reasoning instances do not consistently benefit more. (2) Performance also depends on how distinct layers and recurrent iterations are allocated, showing that effective depth alone is insufficient to predict behavior. Non-recurrent output layers improve robustness to under-unrolling, while the preferred placement of input and output layers varies with inference budget. (3) Finally, we find that conventional initial-state injection offers limited robustness to varying recurrence depth. We therefore propose history-state injection as an alternative, and show that channel-wise history-state injection combined with timestep conditioning offers a low-cost and more effective design, better preserving knowledge under extended unrolling while improving robustness across inference budgets. Overall, our results clarify when recurrent computation helps, where it fails, and offer practical guidelines for designing LoopLMs across variable inference budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Looped LM 上做受控实验，判定循环何时有效：超出训练时域的循环能提升推理任务但会损害知识保持，且更难的推理样本并不因此获益更多；层与循环迭代的分配方式决定效果，单看有效深度不足以预测行为。作者提出 channel-wise history-state injection 加 timestep conditioning，作为比常规 initial-state injection 更低成本的方案，在延长展开时更好保住知识并跨推理预算更稳健。
Motivation: LoopLM 用参数共享增加计算深度，但额外循环何时有益、层与迭代如何分配、条件化方式如何影响性能都不清楚，且推理预算可能低于、等于或超出训练时域。
Method: 受控实验系统考察三个问题：循环何时有帮助、应施加在何处、条件化如何影响性能；评测覆盖低于/等于/超出训练时域的推理预算，任务含知识与推理两类；对比 initial-state injection 与提出的 history-state injection（含 channel-wise 变体加 timestep conditioning）。
Result: 循环在超出训练时域时可提升推理但降低知识表现，且更难的推理实例并不一致获益更多；有效深度不足以预测行为，非循环输出层提升 under-unrolling 稳健性，输入/输出层的最优位置随推理预算变化；常规 initial-state injection 对不同循环深度稳健性有限，channel-wise history-state injection 配 timestep conditioning 更低成本且更有效。
Conclusion: 循环计算的收益取决于任务类型与推理预算，设计 LoopLM 时应按预算安排层分配并改用 history-state injection 条件化，而非只堆有效深度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WitnessGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents on the Construction of Bug Witnesses
papers.abstract_en: Bug validation asks a coding agent to produce an executable witness for a reported bug. The witness combines a concrete input with a testing harness and exposes faulty behavior during execution. Such evidence makes audit findings actionable, yet benchmark evaluation is difficult when cases reuse public historical bugs and witnesses or require manual construction. We present WitnessGym, an automated framework for constructing bug-validation benchmarks through bug injection. It injects bugs into test-reached paths of real projects, rebuilds each project, and retains cases exposed by a construction-time witness. Bug specifications and execution adapters allow extension to additional bug types and languages. Bug-preserving transformations vary the surrounding structure while preserving the witness behavior. Based on real-world Java projects with test suites, WitnessGym automatically constructs 1,300 benchmark cases. The injected patches resemble historical bug patches and are difficult for the two evaluated models to distinguish in blinded comparisons. We evaluate four coding agent frameworks in six framework/model pairings across bug types, execution contexts, and transformation depths. Witness construction remains difficult even when the bug pattern is known. Our framework, benchmark cases, and evaluation scripts are available.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, and 12 tables, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WitnessGym 通过把 bug 注入真实 Java 项目的测试可达路径并重建项目，自动构造 bug 验证（bug validation）基准：只有能被构造期 witness 暴露的案例才被保留。基于带测试套件的真实 Java 项目自动构造 1,300 个案例，注入补丁与历史 bug 补丁相似、两个被评估模型在盲测中难以区分；对四个 coding agent 框架的六组框架/模型配对评测显示，即使 bug 模式已知，构造 witness 仍然困难。
Motivation: bug 验证要求 coding agent 给出可执行 witness（具体输入 + 测试 harness），但当基准案例复用公开历史 bug 与 witness、或需人工构造时，评测难以规模化。
Method: WitnessGym 先把 bug 注入真实项目的测试可达路径，重建项目并只保留被构造期 witness 暴露的案例；用 bug specification 与 execution adapter 支持扩展到更多 bug 类型与语言，再用 bug-preserving transformations 改变周边结构而保持 witness 行为不变。
Result: 在带测试套件的真实 Java 项目上自动构造 1,300 个基准案例；注入补丁与历史 bug 补丁相似，两个被评估模型在盲测比较中难以区分；对四个 coding agent 框架、六组框架/模型配对按 bug 类型、执行上下文与 transformation depth 评测，即使 bug 模式已知，witness 构造仍然困难。
Conclusion: bug 注入可以自动化地规模化构造 bug 验证基准，且注入补丁具有足以骗过模型的逼真度，但 witness 构造本身对现有 coding agent 仍是难题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Physics-Aware Machine Unlearning for Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a physics-guided gradient-ascent-based machine unlearning method that couples the forgetting signal with the physical residual of the target cyber-physical systems, ensuring that weight updates during unlearning are steered toward physically feasible regions of the weight space. The physics residual acts as a safety fence during gradient ascent: the model is steered away from the poisoned behavioral basin and simultaneously toward physics-compliant territory, rather than toward an arbitrary alternative that may still violate domain constraints. We evaluate the proposed method against four baselines: naive gradient ascent, exact unlearning, SISA, and full retraining on an IEEE 34-bus distribution system, driven by two physics-informed neural network-based distribution energy resource controllers and validated through high-fidelity OpenDSS power-flow co-simulation. From the evaluation, we found that our proposed physics-guided model simultaneously removes poison and restores physical compliance, which are essential for the safe deployment of safety-critical cyber-physical systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理引导的梯度上升式机器遗忘 (physics-guided machine unlearning)：把遗忘信号与目标信息物理系统的物理残差耦合，使梯度上升的权重更新被约束在物理可行区域，同时逃离投毒行为盆地并回到满足物理约束的解。在 IEEE 34-bus 配电系统、由两个 PINN 控制器驱动并经 OpenDSS 高保真潮流协同仿真验证的设置下，该方法同时去除投毒并恢复物理合规。
Motivation: 信息物理系统中被投毒的模型需要遗忘，但朴素梯度上升可能把权重推向任意替代解，仍违反领域物理约束，对安全关键系统不可接受。
Method: 在梯度上升的遗忘目标上耦合目标 CPS 的物理残差作为安全栅栏，把权重更新导向物理可行区域；对比四个基线：naive gradient ascent、exact unlearning、SISA、full retraining，实验平台为 IEEE 34-bus 配电系统，控制器为两个基于物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 的分布式能源控制器，验证用 OpenDSS 高保真潮流协同仿真。
Result: 在 IEEE 34-bus 配电系统与 OpenDSS 潮流协同仿真设置下，对照 naive gradient ascent、exact unlearning、SISA、full retraining 四个基线，所提方法同时去除投毒并恢复物理合规。
Conclusion: 把物理残差作为遗忘阶段的约束，可以在安全关键信息物理系统中同时满足数据遗忘与物理合规这两项部署要求。

papers.title: Distilling Agentic Systems: A Roadmap across Models, Artifacts, and Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Modern agents increasingly rely on memories, tools, and execution logic, so their competence extends beyond model parameters. This shift exposes a limitation of conventional knowledge distillation, which asks how a student model imitates a teacher model. We define Agent Distillation as the persistent transfer of task-solving knowledge from a teacher agent to a student agent. Our study organizes the field by where transferred knowledge is retained: within the model, as artifacts, through the execution harness, or across substrates. This perspective separates transfer evidence from its outcome and clarifies how knowledge moves between agent components. We develop an evaluation framework that relates retention to causal contribution and deployed utility. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for the reliable, maintainable, and safe development of increasingly complex agentic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把知识蒸馏的对象从模型参数扩展到智能体系统，定义 Agent Distillation 为任务求解知识从教师智能体到学生智能体的持久迁移，并按知识留存位置（模型内、artifacts、执行 harness、跨 substrate）组织整个领域。提出一个把留存性 (retention) 与因果贡献、部署效用挂钩的评估框架，从而把迁移证据与其结果区分开。
Motivation: 现代智能体的能力依赖记忆、工具与执行逻辑，已超出模型参数范围；传统知识 distillation 只问学生如何模仿教师模型，无法刻画这类系统级知识的迁移。
Method: 定义 Agent Distillation 概念，按知识留存位置建立四分法分类（模型内、artifacts、execution harness、跨 substrate），并开发一个将 retention 与 causal contribution、deployed utility 相关联的评估框架。
Result: 给出领域组织视角与评估框架，将 transfer evidence 与其 outcome 分离，澄清知识在智能体各组件间的流动路径；摘要中的贡献为框架与分类本身。
Conclusion: 以留存位置来组织迁移证据并用因果贡献与部署效用评估，可为复杂智能体系统的可靠、可维护、安全开发提供基础。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate rich video captions, yet often misidentify which person performs an action or which limb is involved, particularly across camera cuts. Improving these details requires evaluation and training that distinguish missing information from incorrect assertions. We introduce FlexBench, a benchmark spanning 3,105 shots and 18,161 evaluation queries, with human-verified identities and systematic per-person coverage of fine-grained limb actions and states. Its reference-derived checklists support automated assessment of complete captions in their person and shot contexts. Our Graded Physical Alignment score (GPA) awards credit for correct content and deducts points for incorrect or fabricated actions, making these errors explicit in the aggregate score. Building on this rubric, we propose Graded Margin Direct Preference Optimization (GM-DPO), which assigns stronger preference margins and greater training weight to more severe action errors. Across three VLM backbones, GM-DPO achieves the highest substantive-action and GPA scores among the evaluated preference objectives, improving GPA over DPO by 2.02-3.40 points. On Qwen3-8B, it reduces the weighted hallucination rate by 21.3% relative to DPO. These gains accompany sustained long-form output, improved shot structure, and competitive performance on three additional multimodal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FlexBench（3,105 个镜头、18,161 条评测查询）与分级评分 GPA，把「漏说」和「说错」分开计分，并据此提出 GM-DPO：动作错误越严重，偏好间隔与训练权重越大。在三个 VLM backbone 上 GM-DPO 的实质动作与 GPA 得分在所评测偏好目标中最高，较 DPO 提升 GPA 2.02–3.40 分，Qwen3-8B 上加权幻觉率相对 DPO 降低 21.3%。
Motivation: VLM 视频描述常弄错是哪个人、哪条肢体在做动作，尤其在镜头切换处；现有评测与训练无法区分「漏掉信息」与「断言错误」，因此这类错误既测不准也训不动。
Method: FlexBench 覆盖 3,105 个镜头、18,161 条评测查询，含人工核验的人物身份与逐人细粒度肢体动作/状态覆盖，用参考清单在人物与镜头上下文中自动评估完整描述；Graded Physical Alignment (GPA) 对正确内容给分、对错误或编造动作扣分；Graded Margin Direct Preference Optimization (GM-DPO) 按动作错误严重程度分配更强的偏好间隔与更大训练权重。
Result: 在三个 VLM backbone 上，GM-DPO 的实质动作得分与 GPA 在所评测偏好目标中最高，GPA 较 DPO 提升 2.02–3.40 分；Qwen3-8B 上加权幻觉率相对 DPO 下降 21.3%。同时保持长篇输出长度、改善镜头结构，并在另外三个多模态基准上表现有竞争力。
Conclusion: 把偏好强度与错误严重程度挂钩的分级 DPO，能在不牺牲描述长度与结构的前提下压低肢体动作幻觉，说明偏好优化应当按错误等级而非二元对错来分配梯度。

papers.title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly rely on persistent natural-language skills to adapt beyond their frozen model parameters. When a shared skill is repeatedly revised from a non-stationary, heterogeneous task stream, however, improvements for new tasks can overwrite procedures needed for earlier ones. In continual learning, Orthogonal Gradient Descent (OGD) addresses analogous interference by projecting a new-task gradient onto a subspace that locally preserves prior predictions. Natural-language skill revisions, however, have neither gradients nor a canonical vector space in which such a projection can be performed. We introduce \emph{Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution} (SSPE), which transfers the functional principle of gradient projection from parameter space to behavior space. SSPE treats an unconstrained skill revision as a proposed update, identifies acquired capabilities with which it may interfere, and uses the observed gains and regressions to construct a compatible revision rather than merely rejecting the update. This enables one shared skill to evolve across latent and recurring task contexts without exposing semantic domain identities to the evolution model. Across controlled synthetic streams and heterogeneous real-agent benchmarks, SSPE improves final cross-domain competence and mitigates forgetting relative to strong skill-evolution baselines. The evolved skill also retains the strongest average performance after transfer to a different executor model. These results establish semantic projection as a promising principle for stable and adaptive self evolution of language agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSPE 把 OGD 的梯度投影思想从参数空间搬到行为空间：把无约束的技能改写当作候选更新，用观测到的增益与回退识别会干扰的已获能力，构造兼容改写而非直接拒绝。在受控合成流与异构真实 agent 基准上，它相对强技能演化基线提升最终跨域能力并缓解遗忘，迁移后平均性能仍最强。
Motivation: 语言 agent 的持久自然语言技能在非平稳异构任务流上反复改写时，新任务的改进会覆盖旧任务所需流程；而技能改写既无梯度也无规范向量空间，无法直接套用 OGD 式投影。
Method: 提出 Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution (SSPE)：把无约束技能改写视为候选更新，识别可能被干扰的已获能力，利用观测到的增益与回退构造兼容改写；演化过程不向演化模型暴露语义域身份。
Result: 在受控合成流与异构真实 agent 基准上，SSPE 相对强技能演化基线提升最终跨域能力并缓解遗忘；演化后的技能迁移到不同 executor 模型后仍保持最强平均性能。
Conclusion: 语义投影可作为语言 agent 稳定且自适应自我演化的原则，让单一共享技能在潜在与复现任务上下文中持续演进。

papers.title: DualTrack: Synchronized speech-gesture generation via symmetric coupling of pretrained priors
papers.abstract_en: Joint speech-gesture synthesis must coordinate two modalities despite limited paired data. Existing approaches often lack bidirectional interaction, have limited language coverage, or simplify body and finger representations. We present DualTrack, which couples pretrained speech and motion priors on a shared 12.5 Hz timeline. Causal adapters exchange previous-packet information, while current-state fusion coordinates the streams before they separately complete sixteen-codebook packets. We evaluate 43 BEAT2 recordings in four languages, with speakers held out from joint training and validation. On the shared English/Spanish inputs, without speech or motion prefixes, DualTrack achieves lower word error rate and full-motion Fréchet Gesture Distance, higher beat consistency and speech naturalness than the evaluated GELINA baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualTrack 把预训练语音先验与动作先验耦合到共享的 12.5 Hz 时间线上，用因果 adapter 交换前一包信息、再做当前状态融合，两路各自完成十六码本包 (sixteen-codebook packets) 的生成。在 43 条 BEAT2 四语言录音上（说话人留出、无语音或动作前缀），共享英/西输入上相对 GELINA 基线取得更低的词错误率与全动作 Fréchet Gesture Distance、更高的节拍一致性与语音自然度。
Motivation: 语音-手势联合生成要在配对数据有限的条件下协调两个模态，现有方法缺少双向交互、语言覆盖窄，且对身体与手指表示做了简化。
Method: 在共享 12.5 Hz 时间线上耦合预训练 speech prior 与 motion prior：因果 adapter 交换上一包信息，当前状态融合 (current-state fusion) 协调两路流，之后各自独立完成十六码本包的生成。
Result: 在 43 条 BEAT2 录音、四种语言、说话人从联合训练与验证中留出的设置下，无语音或动作前缀时，DualTrack 在共享英/西输入上相对被评测的 GELINA 基线：词错误率 (WER) 更低、全动作 Fréchet Gesture Distance 更低、节拍一致性 (beat consistency) 更高、语音自然度更高。
Conclusion: 对称耦合预训练先验并让两路在包级双向交互，可在配对数据有限、说话人留出的条件下同时改善语音与手势的联合生成质量。

summary_sections.method: 在共享 12.5 Hz 时间线上耦合预训练 speech prior 与 motion prior：因果 adapter 交换上一包信息，当前状态融合 (current-state fusion) 协调两路流，之后各自独立完成十六码本包的生成。
summary_sections.result: 在 43 条 BEAT2 录音、四种语言、说话人从联合训练与验证中留出的设置下，无语音或动作前缀时，DualTrack 在共享英/西输入上相对被评测的 GELINA 基线：词错误率 (WER) 更低、全动作 Fréchet Gesture Distance 更低、节拍一致性 (beat consistency) 更高、语音自然度更高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对称耦合预训练先验并让两路在包级双向交互，可在配对数据有限、说话人留出的条件下同时改善语音与手势的联合生成质量。

papers.title: Neural Structural Reasoner: A Brain-inspired Architecture for Reasoning over Structured Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Structural reasoning, the ability to recognize and make inferences over the relational structure between objects and concepts, is a hallmark of human cognition, yet prevailing methods often collapse relational topology into flat embeddings, cannot discover hidden structure and lack interpretability. We introduce Neural Structural Reasoner (NSR), a brain-inspired network that preserves relational structure directly in the connectivity and dynamics of coupled neuronal populations. NSR draws inspiration from three biological mechanisms: multi-layered architecture for encoding hierarchical knowledge, stable representations of entity and concepts, and path integration for input-driven state inference. At query time, NSR parallelizes computation over candidate relational structures and leverages confidence-weighted scores to perform link prediction. Across standard knowledge-graph benchmarks, NSR achieves competitive accuracy without leading on every dataset, and has lower reported training times than several neural baselines. Because reasoning is implemented through sequences of human-readable neuron activations, NSR affords native interpretability by tracking intermediate inference steps. The model further extracts latent relational hierarchies and compositional rules, demonstrating the brain-inspired architecture as an effective, efficient, and highly interpretable substrate for structural reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NSR 把关系拓扑直接编码进耦合神经元群体的连接与动力学中，用多层结构表示层级知识、以 path integration 做输入驱动的状态推断，查询时并行计算候选关系结构并用置信度加权打分做 link prediction。在标准知识图谱基准上准确率有竞争力但并非每个数据集领先，训练时间低于若干神经基线，且中间推理步骤是可读的神经元激活序列。
Motivation: 结构推理的主流方法把关系拓扑压平成嵌入向量，既发现不了隐藏结构也缺乏可解释性。
Method: NSR 借鉴三个生物机制：多层架构编码层级知识、实体与概念的稳定表征、path integration 做输入驱动的状态推断；查询时并行计算候选关系结构，用 confidence-weighted scores 做 link prediction，并从中抽取潜在关系层级与组合规则。
Result: 在标准知识图谱基准上取得有竞争力的准确率，但并非在每个数据集上领先；报告的训练时间低于若干神经基线；推理以人类可读的神经元激活序列表示，可追踪中间推理步骤。
Conclusion: 把关系结构放进网络连接与动力学本身，可以同时做到结构发现、组合规则抽取与原生可解释性，代价是准确率只到有竞争力而非全面领先。

papers.title: SemPSG: A Semantic Channel-Aware Foundation Model for Polysomnography Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Polysomnography (PSG) integrates multiple physiological signals to provide a comprehensive characterization of human sleep, yet its heterogeneous channel configurations across centers pose substantial challenges for transferable representation learning. Existing foundation models mainly focus on physiological modeling or temporal learning, while channel identity is often treated as a fixed structural index, overlooking the physiological semantics encoded by signal modality and reference configuration. To this end, we propose SemPSG, a Semantic channel-aware foundation model for heterogeneous PSG analysis. SemPSG explicitly represents the physiological semantics of channel identity and incorporates them into both signal representation learning and channel aggregation, enabling flexible modeling across diverse data configurations. Specifically, a semantic-conditioned time-series encoder captures signal-specific temporal dynamics and cross-signal interactions, while a multi-view image encoder extracts complementary time-frequency and morphological patterns from the same physiological recordings. We evaluate SemPSG on sleep and health-related tasks, including sleep staging, sleep-disorder breathing analysis, disease prediction, cognition and emotion recognition, and demographic estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over both general-purpose time series foundation models and PSG-specific foundation models, together with generalization across heterogeneous datasets across diverse channel configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemPSG 把 PSG 通道身份背后的生理语义（信号模态与参考配置）显式建模，注入信号表征学习与通道聚合，使同一模型能适配各中心异构的通道配置。语义条件化的时序编码器与多视角图像编码器分别刻画跨信号时序动态和时频/形态模式，在睡眠分期、睡眠障碍呼吸、疾病预测、认知情绪识别与人口学估计任务上一致优于通用时序基础模型和 PSG 专用基础模型，并跨异构数据集泛化。
Motivation: 各中心 PSG 通道配置异构，通道身份被当作固定结构索引，导致表征学习难以跨配置迁移；现有基础模型偏重生理或时序建模，忽略通道身份编码的生理语义。
Method: SemPSG 显式表示通道身份的生理语义并同时用于信号表征与通道聚合：语义条件化时序编码器捕捉信号特异的时序动态与跨信号交互，多视角图像编码器从同一生理记录提取时频与形态两类互补模式。
Result: 在睡眠分期、睡眠障碍呼吸分析、疾病预测、认知与情绪识别、人口学估计等任务上，相比通用时序基础模型与 PSG 专用基础模型取得一致改进，并跨通道配置多样的异构数据集泛化。
Conclusion: 把通道身份从结构索引提升为带生理语义的条件，是让 PSG 基础模型跨中心异构配置迁移的关键；作者主张语义条件化应同时进入信号编码与通道聚合两处。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: CrossTimeEdit: A Decade-Spanning Cross-View Dataset and Reward-Guided Editing for Historical Street-View Generation
papers.abstract_en: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records. Generating plausible past appearances requires restoring changed structures while preserving persistent scene content. We construct VIGOR-his, a decade-spanning cross-view dataset containing 43,653 location-level quadruplets across 11 cities on three continents. Its automated pipeline performs spatial pairing, consistency screening, change classification, and the generation and validation of satellite-based change descriptions and local editing instructions. Based on VIGOR-his, we propose CrossTimeEdit, a model that reformulates historical street-view generation as editing, using recent street views to constrain viewpoint and unchanged appearance and temporal satellite differences as change evidence. Starting from FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B, we train CrossTimeEdit through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by online reinforcement learning (RL). We design three street-view editing criteria, namely Instruction Alignment (IA), Background Preservation (BP), and Quality and Physical Plausibility (QP), as both RL reward dimensions and evaluation metrics. We optimize this multi-reward objective using Within Group Relative Policy Optimization for flow-matching models (Flow-GRPO) with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO), which normalizes each reward dimension before aggregation. CrossTimeEdit improves overall performance across the three editing criteria by 17.12\% over the pretrained baseline and outperforms cross-view generation models in scene consistency, visual realism, and perceptual quality. The implementation code, dataset, and model weights are available at https://luhanwen67.github.io/CrossTimeEdit-release/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrossTimeEdit 把历史街景生成重写为受约束的图像编辑：用近期街景锁定视角与不变外观、用跨时相卫星差异作为变化证据，从 FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B 出发经 SFT 再在线 RL 训练。在自建 VIGOR-his 数据集上，三项编辑准则综合性能比预训练基线提升 17.12%，并在场景一致性、视觉真实感与感知质量上超过跨视角生成模型。
Motivation: 历史街景影像覆盖不均造成记录缺口，直接生成过去外观容易破坏持续存在的场景内容，需要在恢复已变化结构的同时保持未变部分。
Method: 构建 VIGOR-his：跨三大洲 11 城、43,653 条位置级四元组，流水线含空间配对、一致性筛查、变化分类与卫星变化描述/局部编辑指令的生成与验证。模型以 FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B 为底座，先 SFT 后在线 RL，用 Flow-GRPO 配合 GDPO 优化多奖励目标，奖励与评测共用 Instruction Alignment、Background Preservation、Quality and Physical Plausibility 三个准则。
Result: 三项编辑准则综合性能较预训练基线提升 17.12%；在场景一致性、视觉真实感与感知质量上优于跨视角生成模型。数据集规模为 11 城 43,653 条位置级四元组。
Conclusion: 把历史街景生成当作以近期街景和卫星差异为约束的编辑任务，并按 IA/BP/QP 三准则分维度归一化做多奖励 RL，可同时保住未变内容与恢复变化结构；代码、数据集与权重已公开。

papers.title: CI-PINN: Causal Integral Physics-Informed Neural Network for Solving Evolution Equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) solve partial differential equations (PDEs) by incorporating governing physical laws into the training loss. For evolution equations, however, their conventional pointwise space--time representation does not explicitly encode temporal dependence, which can hinder accurate prediction. To mitigate this limitation, this work proposes a novel neural architecture termed a causal integral neural network (CinNet). The core module of CinNet is a Volterra-type causal integral term, which aggregates historical features to encode temporal dependence, thereby incorporating temporal causality at the architectural level rather than through training-level modifications as in many existing methods. Building on CinNet, we further develop a causal integral physics-informed neural network (CI-PINN) for solving evolution equations. Extensive numerical experiments on benchmark evolution equations demonstrate that the presented method outperforms various baseline PINN variants in terms of solution accuracy, with pronounced superiority under sparse-collocation scenarios. Additional empirical analyses show that CI-PINN exhibits low sensitivity to hyperparameter choices, while ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of the proposed network components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CI-PINN 用 Volterra 型因果积分模块 CinNet 在架构层面编码时间依赖，替代逐点时空表示，用于求解演化方程。在基准演化方程上其解精度超过多种 PINN 变体，稀疏配点 (sparse collocation) 场景下优势更明显，且对超参数选择不敏感。
Motivation: 传统 PINN 的逐点时空表示不显式编码时间依赖，导致演化方程预测精度受限；现有方法多靠训练层面的修改补救。
Method: 提出因果积分神经网络 CinNet，核心是 Volterra 型因果积分项，聚合历史特征以在架构层面引入时间因果性；在其上构建 CI-PINN 求解演化方程，并做组件消融实验。
Result: 在基准演化方程的数值实验中，CI-PINN 在解精度上超过多种基线 PINN 变体，稀疏配点场景下优势尤为显著；额外实验显示其对超参数选择敏感度低，消融研究确认各网络组件有效。
Conclusion: 把时间因果性放进网络架构本身（而非训练技巧）足以提升演化方程求解精度，尤其在配点稀疏时。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Selective Elicitation as a Commercial Influence Channel: A Reproducible Synthetic Shopping-Agent Stress Test
papers.abstract_en: A commercial incentive need not enter the final ranking algorithm to affect a shopping assistant's recommendation: it may instead influence which preference question the assistant asks. We make this distinction experimentally observable in a deliberately small, synthetic setting. Each task has two products, three verified numerical attributes, a price limit, and a private fixed preference vector. An honest simulated user answers one pairwise question. A separate recommender receives the products and this answer but not the sponsorship assignment. We contrast a neutral question, a soft commercial instruction, and an explicitly adversarial instruction to ask about the sponsor's advantage while omitting the rival's advantage. Across 40 held-out sponsorship-assignment cases (20 distinct catalog-preference contexts), the soft instruction changes no selections. The targeted instruction raises sponsored selection by 0.30 and reduces mean synthetic utility by 0.0547 relative to neutral questioning (95% context-bootstrap interval [-0.0828, -0.0291]) for one language-model recommender. A fixed Bayesian recommender shows a similar effect; a second model makes the same choices on all 120 frozen question-answer inputs. A terminal-answer consistency judge rates all 20 sampled targeted answers consistent, although five have synthetic regret above 0.05; a separate question-coverage dimension flags their one-sided elicitation. A robust partial-preference certificate remains valid under the stipulated synthetic utility but certifies only 16 of 40 targeted cases and is not better than asking a neutral question directly. These results establish neither typical behavior under advertising incentives nor effects on actual consumers.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 table; synthetic data and reproduction code in ancillary files; substantial AI-tool use disclosed in the manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合成购物代理压力测试中，商业激励不必进入排序算法，只需改变助手提出的问题即可左右推荐：把中性提问换成明确要求「问赞助方优势、回避竞品优势」的定向指令，赞助商品被选中的概率上升 0.30，合成效用均值下降 0.0547（95% context-bootstrap 区间 [-0.0828, -0.0291]）。软性商业指令不改变任何选择；作者据此指出单侧提问可被一致性判据放行，而部分偏好证书在 40 个定向案例中仅覆盖 16 个且不优于直接中性提问。
Motivation: 商业影响通常被假定通过排序算法或打分注入，选择性提问这一更隐蔽的通道难以被现有评测观测到；需要一个可控、可复现的最小设定把「问什么」与「排什么」分离。
Method: 每个任务含两个商品、三个已验证数值属性、价格上限与私有固定偏好向量；诚实模拟用户只回答一个成对问题，独立推荐器只见商品与答案、不见赞助分配。对比中性提问、软性商业指令、以及明确要求问赞助方优势并省略竞品优势的对抗性指令，覆盖 40 个留出赞助分配案例（20 个不同的目录-偏好上下文），并加入固定 Bayesian 推荐器、第二个语言模型、终端答案一致性判据与鲁棒部分偏好证书。
Result: 软性指令不改变任何选择；定向指令使赞助选择相对中性提问上升 0.30、合成效用均值下降 0.0547（95% context-bootstrap 区间 [-0.0828, -0.0291]），对一个语言模型推荐器成立，固定 Bayesian 推荐器呈相似效应，第二个模型在全部 120 个冻结问答输入上给出相同选择。一致性判据把 20 个抽样定向答案全部判为一致，其中 5 个合成 regret 超过 0.05，另有独立的提问覆盖维度标记其单侧提问；部分偏好证书在 40 个定向案例中仅 16 个成立。

papers.title: Do LLMs Really Forget? Hidden-State Leakage in Model Unlearning and How to Fix it
papers.abstract_en: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) is typically evaluated at the output level, where a model appears to suppress sensitive or undesirable content. In this work, we show that such evaluations can create an illusion of forgetting: even when output-level leakage is eliminated, sensitive information can remain encoded in the model's hidden representations. We first provide a theoretical analysis establishing a fundamental separation between output suppression and representational erasure. Specifically, we show that the decoder can be made arbitrarily insensitive to sensitive directions, driving output-level leakage to zero, while the hidden representations retain the underlying information. To empirically validate this phenomenon, we train generative probe decoders on hidden states across transformer layers, enabling layer-wise measurement of information leakage. Across three widely used benchmarks, TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, and state-of-the-art unlearning methods, we find that substantial sensitive information remains recoverable from hidden representations, even when standard output-level metrics indicate successful unlearning. To address this gap, we propose Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression (PARS), an unlearning objective that adversarially minimizes the extractable information from hidden representations. PARS directly targets representational leakage and provides significantly stronger guarantees of erasure under adversarial probing and relearning attacks, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Our results highlight a fundamental limitation of existing unlearning paradigms and suggest that true forgetting in LLMs requires controlling not only model outputs, but also the information encoded in hidden representations. Codes are available at https://github.com/OptimAI-Lab/HiddenStateUnlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 模型遗忘 (unlearning) 只在输出层评测会造成“已遗忘”的假象：即使输出泄漏归零，敏感信息仍留在 hidden representations 中。理论上可让 decoder 对敏感方向任意不敏感、输出泄漏为零，而隐藏表征仍保留信息；为此提出 PARS，用对抗方式压低隐藏表征中可提取的信息，在对抗探测与再学习攻击下给出更强的擦除保证，胜过全部被评基线。
Motivation: 现有 unlearning 评测只看输出层，无法区分“输出被抑制”与“表征被擦除”，导致模型看似遗忘但敏感内容仍可从隐藏状态恢复。
Method: 先给出理论分析，证明输出抑制与表征擦除存在根本分离；再在各 transformer 层的 hidden states 上训练生成式 probe decoder，逐层度量信息泄漏；最后提出 Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression (PARS)，以对抗目标直接最小化隐藏表征中可提取的信息。
Result: 在 TOFU、MUSE、WMDP 三个广泛使用的 benchmark 上，对 SOTA unlearning 方法检验：即使标准输出级指标显示 unlearning 成功，隐藏表征中仍可恢复大量敏感信息。PARS 在对抗探测 (adversarial probing) 与再学习攻击 (relearning attacks) 下提供显著更强的擦除保证，优于所有被评估基线。
Conclusion: 真正的遗忘必须同时控制模型输出和隐藏表征中编码的信息，仅靠输出级评测的 unlearning 范式存在根本局限。

papers.title: Multi-Channel Mitigation of Source-Trust Shortcuts in Fact-Checking RL Agents
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented fact-checkers often receive a reliability label, such as HIGH or LOW trust, for each evidence source. These labels should adjust the model's confidence and its decision to search for more evidence, while the verdict should follow the evidence content. We introduce TrustSwap, a counterfactual test that swaps, lowers, or removes source labels while keeping every evidence text fixed, and measures its three output channels (the verdict, the confidence, and the search decision) separately. Across untrained and RL-trained models at two scales, three datasets, and two prompts, confidence and search respond to the labels as intended in 49 of 50 comparisons, yet a label change alone alters 4-23% of confident verdicts for Qwen3 models and up to 50% for an existing RL-trained fact-checker. Standard GRPO fine-tuning amplifies this shortcut at 8B in all six settings. To reduce it, we propose trust-swap augmentation (TSA), which trains GRPO on each claim with both its original and its label-swapped evidence under the same gold verdict. At 4B, TSA lowers the verdict flip rate by 7-35% (relative) in four of six settings, keeps accuracy and the intended confidence and search responses, outperforms reward-based alternatives in the main setting, and carries over to an unseen label-removal perturbation. An added consistency reward helps on the trained-on swap but not on unseen perturbations. At 8B, TSA's effect is not detectable, which makes scale the main open question.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 事实核查 RL agent 会把来源信任标签当成捷径：TrustSwap 反事实只改标签、固定证据文本，发现标签单独变化就能翻转 4–23%（Qwen3）乃至最高 50%（已有 RL 训练的 fact-checker）的高置信判决。提出的 trust-swap augmentation (TSA) 在 4B 上把判决翻转率相对降低 7–35%（六种设置中四种）且不损准确率，但 8B 上效果检测不到，规模成为主要开放问题。
Motivation: 检索增强事实核查器收到 HIGH/LOW 来源信任标签时，标签本应只调节置信度与是否继续检索，判决应由证据内容决定；若模型把标签当判决捷径，RL 微调还可能放大这一捷径，使核查结果随标签而非证据摆动。
Method: 提出 TrustSwap 反事实测试：交换、降低或移除来源标签而保持全部证据文本不变，分别测量判决、置信度、检索决策三条输出通道；在此基础上提出 trust-swap augmentation (TSA)，用同一 gold verdict 对每条 claim 同时以原始证据与标签交换后的证据训练 GRPO，并与基于奖励的替代方案对比。
Result: 在两个规模、三个数据集、两种 prompt 的未训练与 RL 训练模型上，置信度与检索决策按预期响应标签的比例为 50 次比较中的 49 次；但仅改标签会改变 4–23% 的高置信判决（Qwen3），对已有 RL 训练的 fact-checker 最高达 50%。标准 GRPO 微调在 8B 的全部六种设置中都放大该捷径。TSA 在 4B 的六种设置中四种把判决翻转率相对降低 7–35%，保持准确率与预期的置信/检索响应，在主设置上优于基于奖励的替代方案，并迁移到未见过的标签移除扰动；附加一致性奖励在训练过的 swap 上有效但在未见扰动上无效。8B 上 TSA 效果检测不到。
Conclusion: 来源信任标签会渗入事实核查判决这一本不该受其影响的通道，TSA 通过标签交换增广可在 4B 抑制该捷径并泛化到未见扰动，但其效果在 8B 消失，规模依赖性是核心未解问题。

papers.title: Communication-Efficient Agnostic Federated Learning via Faster Convergence and Compression
papers.abstract_en: Agnostic federated learning (AFL) seeks a model that performs reliably across $m$ heterogeneous workers, but communication remains a bottleneck. We improve communication efficiency by reducing the number of synchronization rounds via faster convergence and the communication cost per round via compression. We first propose AFL-BR, which updates the dual weights over workers using online mirror ascent with KL divergence and blockwise restarts. It achieves an $O((\log m)^{1/4}T^{-1/8})$ stationarity rate after $T$ update rounds, reducing the $m$-dependence of the synchronization rounds required for convergence from polynomial to logarithmic order. Building on AFL-BR, we develop AFL-Com by applying bidirectional compression with error feedback (EF). Instead of compressing local gradients, workers apply EF to their dual-weighted gradients, enabling direct control of the aggregated compression error under time-varying weights. We then establish an $O((δ^{-1}+(\log m)^{1/4})T^{-1/8})$ stationarity rate for AFL-Com under general $δ$-approximate compressors and improve the $δ$-dependence from $δ^{-1}$ to $δ^{-1/2}$ for additive-and-idempotent compressors with shared randomness (SR). With suitable compression levels, AFL-Com retains the same convergence rate as AFL-BR at a lower per-round communication cost, yielding reductions in total communication complexity by factors of $(\log m)^{1/4}$ with Top-$k$ and $(\log m)^{1/2}$ with Rand-$k$ and SR. Experiments validate the improved synchronization and communication efficiency of our methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向异构 worker 的 agnostic 联邦学习 (AFL)，提出 AFL-BR 与压缩版 AFL-Com：前者用带 KL 散度的在线镜像上升加 blockwise restart 更新 worker 上的对偶权重，把收敛所需同步轮数对 worker 数 m 的依赖从多项式降到对数级；后者对 dual-weighted gradients 做带误差反馈 (EF) 的双向压缩，在同等收敛速率下把总通信复杂度分别降低 (log m)^{1/4}（Top-k）与 (log m)^{1/2}（Rand-k 加共享随机性）。
Motivation: AFL 要在 m 个异构 worker 上得到可靠模型，但同步轮数随 m 多项式增长、每轮传输量大，通信成为主要瓶颈。
Method: AFL-BR 用 KL 散度的在线镜像上升加 blockwise restart 更新对偶权重，得到 O((log m)^{1/4}T^{-1/8}) 平稳性速率；AFL-Com 在其上对 dual-weighted gradients（而非本地梯度）施加带 EF 的双向压缩，以便在时变权重下直接控制聚合压缩误差，覆盖一般 δ-approximate compressors。
Result: AFL-BR 的平稳性速率为 O((log m)^{1/4}T^{-1/8})，同步轮数对 m 的依赖由多项式降为对数；AFL-Com 在一般 δ-approximate compressor 下为 O((δ^{-1}+(log m)^{1/4})T^{-1/8})，对带共享随机性的 additive-and-idempotent compressors 把 δ 依赖从 δ^{-1} 改进到 δ^{-1/2}；总通信复杂度降低 (log m)^{1/4}（Top-k）与 (log m)^{1/2}（Rand-k 与 SR），摘要称实验验证了同步与通信效率的改进。
Conclusion: 把对偶权重的加速收敛与对 dual-weighted gradients 的压缩结合，可在保持 AFL-BR 收敛速率的同时降低每轮通信成本，从而同时减少同步轮数与每轮开销。

papers.title: Best Practices in EEG Analysis: Preprocessing, Modeling, and Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis requires careful choices in preprocessing, statistical modeling, and machine learning because EEG signals are highly susceptible to artifacts, volume conduction, low signal-to-noise ratio, and substantial inter-subject variability. This chapter provides a practical and methodological guide to modern EEG analysis, spanning EEG preprocessing, artifact removal, filtering, bad-channel detection and interpolation, re-referencing, independent component analysis (ICA), and preprocessing of simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings. We review major approaches for computational EEG analysis, including event-related potentials (ERPs), time-frequency analysis, functional and effective connectivity, source localization, multivariate decoding, permutation testing, and multiple-comparison correction. We then examine machine-learning methods for EEG, from feature-based classifiers to deep learning and emerging EEG foundation models, with emphasis on cross-subject generalization, limited-data regimes, data leakage, evaluation metrics, and fair benchmarking. Reproducibility is treated as a core requirement throughout, including transparent preprocessing, BIDS-EEG data organization, standardized derivatives, preservation of raw data, and FAIR data practices. The chapter is intended as a practical reference for researchers developing reliable, interpretable, and reproducible EEG analysis and machine-learning pipelines.

TL;DR: 这是一本 EEG 分析方法学章节，系统给出从预处理到机器学习的完整流程选择：伪迹去除、滤波、坏道检测与插值、重参考、ICA、EEG-fMRI 同步记录预处理，以及 ERP、时频、功能与有效连接、源定位、多变量解码、置换检验与多重比较校正。核心主张是把可复现性（BIDS-EEG、标准化 derivatives、保留原始数据、FAIR）当作硬约束，并在跨被试泛化、小样本、数据泄漏与公平基准上评估模型，包括新兴 EEG foundation model。
Motivation: EEG 信号易受伪迹、容积传导、低信噪比和被试间差异影响，预处理与建模的每一步选择都会左右结论；同时深度学习方法在 EEG 上常因数据泄漏和不公平基准而高估性能。
Method: 按流程组织：预处理（滤波、坏道检测与插值、重参考、ICA、EEG-fMRI 预处理）→ 统计与计算分析（ERP、时频、功能/有效连接、源定位、多变量解码、置换检验、多重比较校正）→ 机器学习（特征分类器到深度学习与 EEG foundation model），并以 BIDS-EEG、标准化 derivatives、保留原始数据和 FAIR 原则贯穿复现性要求。
Result: 章节为方法学综述与实践指南，覆盖跨被试泛化、有限数据、数据泄漏、评估指标与公平基准等评估维度；本摘要未给出实验数值对比。
Conclusion: 可靠、可解释、可复现的 EEG 分析与机器学习流水线，取决于预处理透明、数据组织标准化，以及在跨被试与小样本条件下诚实评估模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains multi-turn language agents with dense teacher supervision on student-generated responses. However, standard think-then-act rollouts require lengthy reasoning before each short action, delaying environment transitions and experience collection. Generating actions directly reduces this delay but can degrade rollout quality. To address this, we propose ActFirst-OPD, an act-first, reason-later training framework that decouples environment interaction from full-response generation. The student infers and executes actions through reference-conditioned inverse dynamics using its current interaction context and a reference next observation, and switches to autonomous next-action prediction when the resulting transition deviates from the reference trajectory. From the collected interaction contexts, the student asynchronously generates full think-then-act responses for token-level teacher supervision. Experiments across 0.6B-, 1.7B-, and 4B-parameter Qwen3 students show that ActFirst-OPD achieves average wall-clock training speedups of $2.3\times$ on ALFWorld, $1.8\times$ on WebShop, and $4.9\times$ on ScienceWorld over Vanilla OPD. It matches or exceeds all compared OPD baselines in mean task success rate across eight of nine benchmark-model settings. These results demonstrate that reasoning need not block acting during multi-turn agent distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActFirst-OPD 把多轮智能体的 on-policy distillation 改成先行动后推理：学生用参考条件逆动力学 (reference-conditioned inverse dynamics) 直接从当前交互上下文和参考下一观测推断并执行动作，偏离参考轨迹时切回自主预测，再异步生成完整 think-then-act 响应供 token 级教师监督。在 0.6B/1.7B/4B Qwen3 学生上，相对 Vanilla OPD 的平均墙钟训练加速为 ALFWorld 2.3×、WebShop 1.8×、ScienceWorld 4.9×，且在九个 benchmark-model 设置中的八个上平均任务成功率持平或更高。
Motivation: 标准 think-then-act rollout 要在每个短动作前生成冗长推理，拖慢环境状态转移与经验收集；直接生成动作虽省时却会降低 rollout 质量，多轮智能体蒸馏因此在吞吐与样本质量之间被迫取舍。
Method: 框架将环境交互与完整响应生成解耦：学生依据当前交互上下文加一个参考下一观测，用参考条件逆动力学推断并执行动作；当该动作导致的转移偏离参考轨迹时切换为自主的下一动作预测。收集到的交互上下文随后用于异步生成完整 think-then-act 响应，为教师提供 token 级稠密监督（on-policy distillation）。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个基准上，相对 Vanilla OPD 的平均墙钟训练加速分别为 2.3×、1.8×、4.9×；在九个 benchmark-model 设置中的八个上，平均任务成功率持平或超过全部对比的 OPD 基线。测试学生为 0.6B、1.7B、4B 参数的 Qwen3。
Conclusion: 在多轮智能体蒸馏中，推理不必阻塞行动：把动作推断与完整推理生成解耦并异步化，可以在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下大幅缩短训练墙钟时间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pixel-wise Exposure for Highly Robust In-Vehicle Remote-PPG
papers.abstract_en: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) offers a promising non-contact solution for heart rate monitoring, yet its real-world robustness is fundamentally limited by an inherent hardware limitation: existing camera exposure control paradigms, whether fixed or auto-exposure, impose a uniform exposure time across all pixels within a frame. In high-dynamic-range scenes such as automotive cabins with strong directional sunlight, this spatially invariant exposure constraint inevitably leads to localized facial overexposure or underexposure, irreversibly corrupting the subtle pulsatile signals essential for rPPG at the point of capture, a physical degradation that no downstream algorithm can recover. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose PixExpo (Pixel-wise Exposure), a "temporal-for-spatial" framework that sequentially captures frames under a predefined cyclic exposure schedule and performs non-iterative pixel-wise fusion. At each pixel location, PixExpo selects the observation closest to an rPPG-motivated target intensity. This criterion seeks to reduce local saturation and severe underexposure rather than optimize perceptual appearance. PixExpo requires no sensor modification but assumes programmable frame-level exposure control. We validate the proposed PixExpo framework using our newly introduced MEX-Drive dataset, comprising 48 participants under real-world driving conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that PixExpo outperforms manufacture-default auto-exposure methods, reducing the mean absolute error (MAE) by 7.21 bpm (from 13.94 to 6.73 bpm) and increasing the success rate by 37.29 percentage points (from 25.95% to 63.24%) across challenging driving scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixExpo 用「时间换空间」的逐像素曝光框架解决车载 rPPG 在强定向阳光下整帧统一曝光导致的局部过曝/欠曝：按预设循环曝光序列采集多帧，每个像素选取最接近 rPPG 目标强度的观测做非迭代融合。在 48 人真实驾驶数据集 MEX-Drive 上，心率 MAE 从 13.94 降到 6.73 bpm，成功率从 25.95% 提到 63.24%。
Motivation: 固定曝光与自动曝光都对整帧施加统一曝光时间，高动态范围车内场景下局部过曝或欠曝会在采集端不可逆地破坏脉搏信号，任何下游算法都无法恢复。
Method: 提出 PixExpo（Pixel-wise Exposure）：按预设循环曝光时序连续采集多帧，逐像素选取最接近 rPPG 目标强度的观测做非迭代融合，判据旨在抑制局部饱和与严重欠曝而非优化观感；无需改传感器，但要求可编程的帧级曝光控制。
Result: 在新提出的 MEX-Drive 数据集（48 名参与者、真实驾驶条件）上，相对出厂默认自动曝光，MAE 降低 7.21 bpm（13.94 → 6.73 bpm），成功率提高 37.29 个百分点（25.95% → 63.24%），覆盖多种挑战性驾驶场景。
Conclusion: 逐像素曝光控制能在采集端保住被统一曝光牺牲的 rPPG 脉搏信号，是车载非接触心率监测在高动态范围光照下的有效路径，前提是相机支持可编程帧级曝光。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-test state mismatch by training a student on its own generated trajectories, but weak students may visit teacher-misaligned prefixes where supervision is less representative. We introduce SAKI (Supervision Allocation with KL-constrained Interpolation), which combines a KL-constrained teacher-guided rollout with maximal coupling and reuses realized accept/correction events to route token-level supervision. Accepted positions retain sampled-token reverse-KL supervision, while correction positions receive direct supervision on the teacher's highest-probability token. Under maximal coupling, the correction probability is exactly TV(p_t, q_t), so the same trust-region radius controls rollout deviation and upper-bounds intervention and specialized-supervision frequency. We further implement an engine-resident speculative verifier that preserves the exact-q trajectory distribution and coupling semantics while improving matched-workload rollout throughput by 4.22x. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SAKI improves the matched teacher-guided baseline in Mean@8 and Pass@8 for both 1.7B and 0.6B students. Placement controls and fixed-prefix analysis further support correction-triggered routing as a conflict-adaptive supervision signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAKI 用 KL 约束的教师引导 rollout 加 maximal coupling 把 token 级监督按接受/纠正事件分流：接受位保留采样 token 的 reverse-KL，纠正位直接监督教师最高概率 token，纠正概率恰为 TV(p_t, q_t)，同一 trust-region 半径同时约束 rollout 偏离并上界干预频率。在七个数学推理基准上，1.7B 与 0.6B 学生的 Mean@8 和 Pass@8 均优于匹配的教师引导基线，配套的 engine-resident speculative verifier 把匹配负载 rollout 吞吐提升 4.22x。
Motivation: On-policy distillation 虽然缓解训练-测试状态失配，但弱学生会走到教师不对齐的前缀上，那里的监督代表性不足，需要按冲突程度重新分配 token 级监督。
Method: SAKI（Supervision Allocation with KL-constrained Interpolation）组合 KL 约束的教师引导 rollout 与 maximal coupling，并复用已实现的接受/纠正事件来路由监督：接受位用采样 token 的 reverse-KL，纠正位对教师最高概率 token 直接监督；纠正概率等于 TV(p_t, q_t)，由同一 trust-region 半径控制。另实现 engine-resident speculative verifier，保持精确 q 轨迹分布与 coupling 语义。
Result: 在七个数学推理基准上，SAKI 在 Mean@8 与 Pass@8 两个指标上均提升匹配的教师引导基线，1.7B 与 0.6B 两种学生规模都成立；speculative verifier 在匹配工作负载下把 rollout 吞吐提升 4.22x；placement controls 与 fixed-prefix 分析支持纠正触发路由作为冲突自适应监督信号。
Conclusion: 把纠正事件当作冲突自适应的监督路由信号，可以在同一 trust-region 半径下同时约束 rollout 偏离与干预频率，并在不同规模学生上稳定改善数学推理的 Mean@8 与 Pass@8。

papers.title: Second-Moment Stochastic Approximation Methods
papers.abstract_en: Classical stochastic approximation methods rely on estimators of the first moment (mean) of a random regression function. We study methods that employ estimators of both the first and the second moments, which include modern deep-learning optimizers such as Adam and Muon as special cases. We derive second-moment stochastic approximation methods through the lens of optimal preconditioning for solving matrix equations, and develop a two-stage framework for their convergence analysis. The first stage focuses on the analysis of conceptual (impractical) methods that rely on the exact first and second moments. In the second stage, we replace the exact moments with their respective estimators, and invoke Dvoretzky's theorem to show that the resulting practical methods converge almost surely to a neighborhood of the target solution. The size of the neighborhood depends on the biases and variances of the first- and second-moment estimators. We derive concrete bounds for Muon and a spectral variant of Adam that determine the radius of their neighborhood of convergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Adam、Muon 这类同时用一阶矩与二阶矩估计的优化器统一为「二阶矩随机逼近」，从求解矩阵方程的最优预条件视角推导其构造，并给出两阶段收敛分析框架。第一阶段分析使用精确一、二阶矩的概念方法，第二阶段用估计量替换并借助 Dvoretzky 定理证明实用算法几乎必然收敛到目标解的邻域，邻域半径由估计量的偏差与方差决定；据此导出了 Muon 与 Adam 谱变体的具体收敛邻域半径界。
Motivation: 经典随机逼近只依赖随机回归函数一阶矩（均值）的估计，而 Adam、Muon 等现代深度学习优化器还使用二阶矩信息，缺少统一的推导视角与收敛刻画。
Method: 从求解矩阵方程的最优预条件 (optimal preconditioning) 出发推导二阶矩随机逼近方法；建立两阶段收敛分析：先分析依赖精确一、二阶矩的概念方法，再以各自估计量替换精确矩，调用 Dvoretzky 定理处理逼近误差。
Result: 证明实用方法几乎必然收敛到目标解的邻域，邻域大小取决于一阶与二阶矩估计量的偏差和方差；并为 Muon 和 Adam 的一个谱变体 (spectral variant) 导出确定收敛邻域半径的具体界。
Conclusion: Adam 与 Muon 可纳入同一二阶矩随机逼近框架，其收敛性可归结为矩估计量的偏差与方差，从而给出可计算的收敛邻域半径。

papers.title: Scaling Video Generation for Reasoning: At What Cost?
papers.abstract_en: We study whether scaling video generation enables models to reason about hidden information from the past frames, and at what computational cost. Our controlled benchmark requires predicting nine prescribed moves of an initially solved 2x2x2 Rubik's Cube from a fixed view of three faces. Correct predictions require inferring how actions change hidden states, and the simulator provides exact ground truth for evaluation. Models learn plausible cube geometry early, while correct sticker configurations require substantially more training. Although validation MSE follows approximate power-law scaling, lower MSE loss does not reliably indicate downstream reasoning capabilities. Smaller autoregressive models achieve higher state accuracy with limited compute, while larger models reach higher accuracy after more training. At roughly 0.1 PF-days, the 70M-parameter model correctly predicts the visible sticker configuration in 44.6% of post-action frames, compared with 0.3% for the 1B model, which reaches 83.7% at 3.14 PF-days. Symbolic state supervision raises the 20M model's frame accuracy from 31.1% to 67.3% at the same training-data budget, suggesting that learning representations of state changes can complement scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定视角观察 2x2x2 魔方三面、预测后续九步操作的受控基准上，视频生成模型的验证 MSE 大致服从幂律，但更低的 MSE 并不能可靠指示下游推理能力：约 0.1 PF-days 时 70M 模型可见贴纸状态准确率 44.6%，而 1B 模型仅 0.3%，后者需 3.14 PF-days 才达 83.7%。同等训练数据预算下，符号状态监督把 20M 模型帧准确率从 31.1% 提到 67.3%，说明学习状态变化表征可与单纯扩大规模互补。
Motivation: 扩大视频生成规模是否真能让模型从历史帧推断隐藏状态、以及代价多大，缺少受控可验证的评测；而验证损失与推理能力可能脱钩，使按 loss 选模型不可靠。
Method: 构建受控基准：从固定视角看已还原 2x2x2 魔方的三个面，要求预测规定的九步操作后的状态，模拟器提供精确 ground truth；对比不同参数量的自回归视频生成模型在不同计算预算下的训练，并加入符号状态监督 (symbolic state supervision) 变体。
Result: 验证 MSE 近似幂律缩放，但低 MSE 不可靠指示下游推理；约 0.1 PF-days 时 70M 模型在操作后帧上正确预测可见贴纸配置的比例为 44.6%，1B 模型同预算仅 0.3%，后者在 3.14 PF-days 达到 83.7%；同等训练数据预算下符号状态监督使 20M 模型帧准确率从 31.1% 升至 67.3%；模型先学会合理的魔方几何，正确的贴纸配置需要多得多的训练。
Conclusion: 在该基准上，小自回归模型在有限算力下状态准确率更高，大模型需更多训练才追上；损失缩放不等于能力缩放，状态变化表征监督可作为扩规模的补充手段。

papers.title: Beyond Legibility: Benchmarking Visual Text Rendering and In-Place Editing in Unified Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: A video can exhibit convincing motion and photorealism yet fail immediately when visual text collapses. Unlike generic scene content, visual text is unforgiving in video generation: minor stroke corruption, temporal instability, or editing errors instantly break legibility and realism. Existing benchmarks overlook this challenge by treating text as incidental or using static OCR metrics that ignore temporal dynamics. We introduce VidScribe, a unified diagnostic benchmark spanning four generation regimes: writing from language (T2V), transferring text identity from a reference (R2V), sustaining text under dynamics (I2V), and localized text editing (V2V). VidScribe contains 803 human-verified samples across a 12-axis conditionally orthogonal factor space covering Intrinsic Text Properties, Physical Imaging Conditions, and Temporal Behavior. For reliable evaluation, we build a track-grounded, gated suite with 11 shared metrics and 2 task-specific probes under strict measurability conditions. Benchmarking 11 commercial and open-source systems shows that video text capability is non-monolithic, with content recognition decoupled from stroke-level glyph correctness. Performance is highly task-asymmetric: I2V sustains text most reliably, whereas V2V editing is the primary bottleneck. Counter-intuitively, degradation concentrates on a small subset of text-centric structural and temporal factors rather than adverse imaging conditions. Further probes show that visual references improve glyph and typographic fidelity rather than content accuracy, while localized editing fails to isolate target text without corrupting undeclared source text. Beyond evaluation, VidScribe also provides an actionable training signal, where benchmark-aligned preference optimization measurably improves visual text generation. https://huggingface.co/datasets/Vicky0720/VidScribe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VidScribe 是面向统一视频生成中视觉文字的诊断基准：803 个人工核验样本覆盖 T2V/R2V/I2V/V2V 四种生成模式与 12 轴条件正交因子空间，配 11 个共享指标加 2 个任务探针。对 11 个商用与开源系统的评测显示文字能力非单一维度，内容识别与笔画级字形正确性解耦；I2V 维持文字最稳，V2V 局部编辑是主要瓶颈，且退化集中在少数文字中心的结构与时序因子而非不利成像条件。基准对齐的偏好优化可测量地提升视觉文字生成。
Motivation: 视频生成里文字笔画损坏、时序不稳或编辑错误会立刻破坏可读性，而现有基准把文字当附带内容，或只用忽略时序动态的静态 OCR 指标，无法定位失败来源。
Method: VidScribe 覆盖四种生成模式：从语言书写 (T2V)、从参考转移文字身份 (R2V)、在动态中维持文字 (I2V)、局部文字编辑 (V2V)；含 803 个人工核验样本与 12 轴条件正交因子空间（内在文字属性、物理成像条件、时序行为三类）。评测用 track-grounded、gated 的指标套件：11 个共享指标加 2 个任务特定探针，并施加严格可测性条件。
Result: 对 11 个商用与开源系统的基准显示：文字能力非单一维度，内容识别与笔画级字形正确性解耦；任务高度不对称，I2V 维持文字最可靠，V2V 编辑是主要瓶颈；退化集中在少数文字中心的结构与时序因子，而非不利成像条件。探针显示视觉参考提升字形与排版保真度而非内容准确性，局部编辑在隔离目标文字时会破坏未声明的源文字；基准对齐的偏好优化可测量地提升视觉文字生成。
Conclusion: 视频生成的文字能力应按任务与因子分解评估，V2V 局部编辑是最需改进的环节，且基准信号可直接用作偏好优化的训练目标。
