papers.title: Simple Agentic Memory for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Visual-memory systems commonly retain or compress past observations. Robot control additionally requires interaction-derived state that no individual frame may explicitly represent, such as persistent identity relations, accumulated progress, or ordered procedures. We introduce Simple Agentic Robot Memory (SimpleARM), a training-free memory layer for frozen generalist robot policies. From the task instruction, SimpleARM specifies what to monitor; frozen perceptual tools maintain compact typed state online; structured access retrieves that state only when a proposed subgoal depends on history; and current-view grounding resolves recalled entities before execution. We evaluate SimpleARM on RoboMME, a benchmark of memory-dependent robot manipulation tasks that require history information no longer available in the current observation. Across all 16 tasks and three policy seeds, SimpleARM achieves 67.17% mean success, compared with 44.51% for the strongest non-oracle baseline. Matched ablations show mechanism specificity: removing relation, reference, progress, or route state produces large losses where the affected state is retrieved for control, while largely sparing other tasks. These results support a state-based view of robot memory: effective memory for control is not simply retained visual history, but compact task-relevant state derived from the interaction history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimpleARM 为冻结的通用机器人策略加一层免训练的 agentic memory：从任务指令推出要监控什么，用冻结感知工具在线维护紧凑的类型化状态，只在候选子目标依赖历史时检索，并在执行前用当前视野做实体落地。在 RoboMME 的 16 个记忆依赖操作任务、3 个策略种子上平均成功率 67.17%，最强非 oracle 基线为 44.51%。
Motivation: 机器人控制需要的是交互派生的状态（持久身份关系、累积进度、有序流程），而这些状态单帧未必显式存在；常规视觉记忆只保留或压缩过去的观测，抓不到这类信息。
Method: SimpleARM 是训练-free 的记忆层，挂在冻结的通用机器人策略上：由任务指令指定监控内容，冻结的感知工具在线维护紧凑的类型化状态（relation、reference、progress、route），结构化访问仅在提出的子目标依赖历史时检索该状态，执行前用当前视野对召回实体做 grounding。
Result: 在 RoboMME（16 个记忆依赖机器人操作任务、3 个策略种子）上平均成功率 67.17%，最强非 oracle 基线 44.51%。匹配消融显示机制特异性：移除 relation、reference、progress 或 route 状态时，被检索用于控制的任务出现大幅下降，而其他任务基本不受影响。
Conclusion: 控制用的有效记忆不是被保留的视觉历史，而是从交互历史派生出的紧凑任务相关状态；四类状态各自对应特定任务，可按需检索。

papers.title: Optimal detection of general moment changes: Simultaneous mean and covariance change detection and beyond
papers.abstract_en: We study multiple change-point detection in multivariate time series whose distributions change in a piecewise constant manner. Distributional changes can manifest across different moment orders, from shifts in the mean and covariance to changes in higher-order moments. Higher-order moments capture increasingly rich distributional features but become difficult to estimate in high dimensions. Our tensor representation unifies moments of different orders within a common linear algebraic framework, enabling a new method to detect changes in moments of all orders up to a prescribed fixed order $p$. The resulting procedure accommodates temporal dependence and allows the dimension of the time series to grow with the sample size. Under suitable regularity conditions, the proposed procedure achieves a localization error rate that matches a newly developed minimax lower bound. We further derive limiting distributions under both nonvanishing and vanishing moment jumps and construct asymptotically valid confidence intervals in the vanishing-jump regime. Numerical experiments and real-data analyses demonstrate the method's effectiveness in detecting moment changes and a range of distributional shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于张量表示的多元时间序列多变点检测方法，把均值、协方差直至任意给定阶 p 的高阶矩变化统一进同一线性代数框架，在时间依赖与维数随样本增长的条件下达到与新推导的 minimax 下界相匹配的定位误差率。
Motivation: 分布变化可能出现在不同矩阶上，高阶矩虽刻画更丰富的分布特征却在高维下难以估计；现有方法难以在统一框架内同时检测均值、协方差及高阶矩变化并处理时间依赖与维数增长。
Method: 用张量表示把不同阶矩统一到共同线性代数框架，构造可检测至指定阶 p 的所有矩变化的检测程序；允许时间依赖与维数随样本量增长，并在合适正则条件下推导定位误差率、非消失与消失矩跳变下的极限分布。
Result: 定位误差率与新推导的 minimax 下界相匹配；在消失跳变 (vanishing-jump) 情形构造了渐近有效的置信区间；数值实验与真实数据分析展示了对矩变化及一系列分布偏移的检测效果。
Conclusion: 张量化的矩表示可在时间依赖和高维增长条件下实现各阶矩变化的最优检测，并支持消失跳变体制下的推断。

papers.title: Text2Sim: Agentic Physics-Based Simulation Generation with Distilled Expertise
papers.abstract_en: Creating diverse physical simulations remains labor-intensive because assets, layout, physical parameters, motion, control, and rendering must be designed and debugged jointly. We present Text2Sim, a simulation-specialized agentic pipeline that converts a text-only request into an executable, editable dynamic case. Built on Genesis, Text2Sim uses a hierarchical agentic structure that combines a Planner with specialized Writers, asset-generation tools, and an independent Critic. Compact skills (Debug Cards) distilled from graphics demonstrations provide role-specific physical guidance for execution-based repair. We evaluate physical quality, visual quality, and human preference on 42 held-out prompts spanning rigid, articulated, deformable, and cloth phenomena, with a paper-level split between experience construction and evaluation. We design automatic physical and visual scorers to evaluate the quality of the results, and Text2Sim achieves higher scores than all four state-of-the-art baselines on both metrics. In blinded user studies with these baselines, significantly more participants prefer Text2Sim than prefer the baselines, which is consistent with the results from our automatic scorers. The pipeline also supports a broad range of downstream applications; we select dataset construction and extension to multimodal input as two representative examples. We will release the code, the Debug Card library, and a dataset of generated cases, each pairing the text prompt and rendered video with the executable program, assets, physical parameters, controls, and recorded states.

TL;DR: Text2Sim 把纯文本请求变成可执行、可编辑的物理仿真场景：在 Genesis 上用 Planner、多个 Writer、资产生成工具和独立 Critic 组成分层 agentic 流水线，并用从图形学演示蒸馏出的 Debug Cards 提供按角色的物理指导，做基于执行的修复。在 42 个覆盖刚体、铰接、可变形与布料现象的 held-out prompt 上，其物理质量与视觉质量自动评分均高于四个 SOTA 基线，盲测中参与者偏好也显著更高。
Motivation: 物理仿真场景的资产、布局、参数、运动、控制与渲染必须联合设计调试，人工创建多样仿真既费时又依赖专业经验。
Method: 基于 Genesis 构建分层 agentic 结构：Planner 协调专用 Writer、资产生成工具与独立 Critic；从 graphics demonstrations 蒸馏出紧凑的 Debug Cards，为各角色提供面向执行修复的物理指导；另设计自动物理评分器与视觉评分器，评测按 experience construction 与 evaluation 做 paper-level 划分。
Result: 在 42 个 held-out prompts（覆盖 rigid、articulated、deformable、cloth 现象）上，Text2Sim 的物理质量与视觉质量两项自动评分均高于全部四个 SOTA 基线；与这些基线的盲测用户研究中，显著更多参与者偏好 Text2Sim，与自动评分结果一致。
Conclusion: 分层 agentic 编排加蒸馏出的 Debug Card 物理专长，能从纯文本直接产出质量更高的可执行仿真案例；流水线可延伸到数据集构建与多模态输入，代码、Debug Card 库与生成案例数据集将开源。

papers.title: SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder
papers.abstract_en: Self-speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by drafting tokens from the target model itself, but faces a sharp tradeoff between the quality and cost of the draft. Early-exit methods produce drafts cheaply by terminating computation at intermediate layers, but forgo the deeper representations that later layers provide and thus suffer in draft quality. Multi-token prediction preserves draft quality by emitting from the model's final hidden states, but pays for a full forward pass to produce those states at every drafting step. We propose self-speculative encoder-decoder (SEED), a self-speculative method that obtains high-quality drafts cheaply by reusing the deep contextual representations already computed during verification. We reinterpret the standard decoder-only transformer as an implicit encoder-decoder: the first layers (encoder) build deep contextual representations, and the last few layers (decoder) emit tokens from them. Encoding and verification are merged into a single step: verification is performed by the full encoder-decoder, and the contextual representations of the verified prefix are cached for reuse during drafting. Drafting is therefore very fast: between verifications, the lightweight decoder drafts multiple tokens autoregressively, each conditioned on the cached representations and on preceding drafts. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that SEED achieves up to 2.7$\times$ average speedup on 4B-scale models, outperforming both early-exit and MTP-style self-speculative baselines and running 28% faster than the state-of-the-art EAGLE-3, while preserving or even improving the generation quality of standard autoregressive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/SEED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEED 把 decoder-only Transformer 重解释为隐式 encoder-decoder：验证阶段的完整前向同时产出已验证前缀的深层上下文表征并缓存，草稿阶段由轻量 decoder 基于缓存表征自回归起草多个 token。在 4B 规模模型上平均加速最高 2.7×，比 SOTA 的 EAGLE-3 快 28%，同时保持甚至提升标准自回归微调的生成质量。
Motivation: 自推测解码 (self-speculative decoding) 中草稿质量与成本存在尖锐权衡：early-exit 草稿便宜但丢掉深层表征导致质量差，multi-token prediction 质量好但每步起草都要跑完整前向。
Method: 把标准 decoder-only Transformer 视为隐式 encoder-decoder：前几层作 encoder 构建深层上下文表征，最后几层作 decoder 据此出 token；编码与验证合并为一步，缓存已验证前缀的上下文表征，两次验证之间由轻量 decoder 以缓存表征和先前草稿为条件自回归起草多个 token。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上，4B 规模模型平均加速最高 2.7×；优于 early-exit 与 MTP 类自推测基线；比 SOTA 的 EAGLE-3 快 28%；生成质量相对标准自回归微调持平或更优。
Conclusion: 复用验证时已算出的深层上下文表征，可以在不牺牲生成质量的前提下让自推测解码的草稿阶段变得很快，从而同时压过 early-exit、MTP 类方法与 EAGLE-3。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning (RL) methods for cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This problem is challenging because VLAs are pretrained on large-scale single-agent data and therefore lack the fine-grained coordination skills required for inter-robot collaboration. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on multi-robot demonstrations partially bridges this gap, but its performance is bounded by the demonstration data and cannot improve from its own experience. We present a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) pipeline for multi-agent VLAs. First, initialization-aware data collection sweeps over initial configurations and invokes human demonstrations only when the pretrained VLA repeatedly fails, yielding robustness to initialization shift with reduced human cost. Second, offline credit-filtered tuning assigns credit to individual agents and fine-tunes on per-agent trajectories with positive advantage rather than on entire joint rollouts. Third, we find existing online RL for VLAs are less effective for hard multi-agent tasks, which we attribute to noisy co-exploration and unstable updates. We instead use online latent-space fine tuning, which freeze the VLA and perform RL in its latent noise space. We evaluate our multi-agent VLA with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ backbones across 11 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboFactory and real-world manipulation with two Franka robots. Our multi-agent VLA improves the average success rate by $+23.1\%$, $+16.4\%$, and $+44\%$ on RoboTwin, RoboFactory, and real-world tasks, respectively. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mavla_rft-2BC0/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对协作多智能体 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型缺乏细粒度协同技能的问题，提出三阶段强化微调 (RFT) 流程：初始化感知数据采集、离线信用过滤微调、以及冻结 VLA 后在 latent noise space 中做在线 RL 的 latent-space fine tuning。在 RoboTwin、RoboFactory 与双 Franka 真实操作共 11 个任务上，平均成功率分别提升 +23.1%、+16.4% 和 +44%。
Motivation: VLA 预训练数据以单智能体为主，缺少机器人间协同所需的细粒度协调能力；SFT 受演示数据上限约束且无法从自身经验继续改进，而现有在线 RL 在困难多智能体任务上因协同探索噪声与更新不稳而效果有限。
Method: 三阶段 RFT：初始化感知数据采集遍历初始配置、仅在预训练 VLA 反复失败时调用人类演示；离线信用过滤按单个智能体分配 credit，只在正 advantage 的 per-agent 轨迹上微调而非整条联合 rollout；在线阶段冻结 VLA，仅在 latent noise space 中做 RL。评测使用 π0 与 π0.5 两种 backbone。
Result: 在 RoboTwin、RoboFactory 与真实双 Franka 操作共 11 个任务上，平均成功率分别提升 +23.1%、+16.4%、+44%；评测覆盖 π0 与 π0.5 两种 backbone。
Conclusion: 多智能体 VLA 的协同能力可通过三阶段 RFT 显著提升，且在线 RL 应在 latent noise space 中进行而非直接在策略上更新，以规避协同探索噪声与不稳定更新。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learned Reporting Preferences in RLVR Can Conflict with the Current Request
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a prominent approach for improving language-model performance on reasoning tasks using automatically checked answers. Yet convention-matched evaluation cannot reveal whether reinforcing one reporting convention reduces adherence to a different request that the initial policy already follows. To test this, we train matched policies under two reporting conventions and evaluate each policy under both current requests, using the same initial policy as a shared reference. We complement this crossed design with controlled interventions and independent human calibration. On GSM8K, boxed-format RLVR reduces the fraction of Qwen2.5-7B responses containing the requested hash-format payload by 35.33--74.37 percentage points relative to a 95.45% initial baseline in four of five training seeds; the fifth improves by 2.50 points. In the four deteriorating runs, almost every response that omits the requested payload instead retains the trained boxed convention, and the same four seeds deteriorate under two fixed paraphrases. Changing only the final-answer marker in supervised targets reverses which reporting convention the model prefers across three seeds, providing controlled evidence that this preference is learnable. Across three settings with independent human calibration, gains under a convention-sensitive scorer exceed the corresponding gains in committed-answer correctness, i.e., the correctness of the answer the model actually commits to. Together, these results separate three distinct post-training outcomes: learned reporting preference, current-request adherence, and committed-answer correctness. They show that convention-matched accuracy alone does not fully characterize post-training behavior and motivate evaluating current-request adherence alongside convention-matched task accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 强化一种输出格式会挤掉初始策略本已遵守的另一条当前请求：在 GSM8K 上对 Qwen2.5-7B 训练 boxed 格式后，含请求的 hash-format payload 的回答比例相对 95.45% 的初始基线在 5 个训练种子中的 4 个下降 35.33–74.37 个百分点，且这些回答几乎都改回 boxed 约定。只改监督目标里的最终答案标记即可在 3 个种子上反转模型偏好的格式，说明该偏好可学；作者主张评估时把当前请求遵守度与约定匹配准确率并列。
Motivation: 约定匹配的评测看不出强化一种报告约定是否会损害初始策略原本能遵守的另一条请求，即后训练把「学会偏好」与「遵守当前请求」和「提交答案的正确性」混在一起。
Method: 在同一初始策略下做交叉设计：按两种报告约定分别训练匹配策略，再让每个策略在两种当前请求下评测，并辅以受控干预（只改监督目标的最终答案标记）与独立人工校准；报告约定敏感的 scorer 与提交答案正确性分开计分。
Result: GSM8K 上 boxed 格式 RLVR 使 Qwen2.5-7B 含请求 hash-format payload 的回答比例相对 95.45% 初始基线在 5 个种子中 4 个下降 35.33–74.37 个百分点，第 5 个种子反而提升 2.50 个百分点；4 个变差的运行中省略 payload 的回答几乎全部保留训练的 boxed 约定，且同样这 4 个种子在两个固定改写下也变差。只改监督目标的最终答案标记可在 3 个种子上反转模型偏好的报告约定。在 3 个带独立人工校准的设置中，约定敏感 scorer 上的增益大于提交答案正确性的相应增益。
Conclusion: 后训练结果应拆成学习到的报告偏好、当前请求遵守度、提交答案正确性三者；仅凭约定匹配准确率不能刻画后训练行为，需与当前请求遵守度一起评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program lines pass on their chain identity through a short range of middle layers. Frozen heads read progressively further up the chain, and removing parent-line attention stops the relay. A frozen-model measurement locates the last useful intervention layer within tolerance in three of four held-out models. Task-specific LoRAs also improve MuSiQue. Default answers therefore understate the computation accessible through a tiny edit. Code and an interactive demo are available at https://lunamos.github.io/stop-thinking-too-early/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预训练 Transformer 在上下文里做多步引用传递时只用到很浅的深度：13 个 base 模型稳定跟随的链条只有 1.4–3.6 行。在一个早期层插入 rank-8、全参数冻结的任务 LoRA 后，Qwen3-8B 在 24 行链上的 exact accuracy 从 15.5% 升到 99%，训练更久可达 50 行；Ouro-1.4B 经四轮循环达 60 行、八轮至少 160 行。
Motivation: 预训练模型在上下文多步引用（in-context reference chaining）上深度利用不足，额外的预训练循环收益很小，而默认输出低估了冻结权重里实际可达的计算。
Method: 在单个早期层插入任务训练的 rank-8 LoRA，全部模型权重冻结；该 LoRA 启动一个 relay，程序行携带 chain identity 经中层短程传递，冻结的注意力头逐级读取更上游的父行，移除 parent-line attention 即中断 relay。另用冻结模型测量定位最后一个有效干预层。

papers.title: Making Analog Training Scale: Co-Designing Mapping, Optimizer, and Converters
papers.abstract_en: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) offers an alternative for model training by executing matrix operations directly where weights are stored. However, scaling AIMC to train modern deep models remains an open challenge due to severe hardware non-idealities, including physical weights with finite dynamic range and write granularity, analog-digital converters with finite resolution, and noisy and asymmetric updates. Guided by the insight that gradient accumulation is sensitive to precision and rounding errors, we adopt a mixed-precision training paradigm: executing forward and backward matrix multiplications in the analog domain while computing weight gradients in the digital domain. To enable scalable training, we present a holistic system-algorithm co-design that co-optimizes weight mapping to ensure well-conditioned physical and logical weight profiles, couples a preconditioned optimizer with threshold-triggered open-loop pulsing to stabilize training trajectories, and aligns converter dynamic ranges to suppress quantization errors. Evaluated via hardware-calibrated architectural simulations calibrated with electrochemical RAM measurements, our framework scales Transformer training up to $123\text{M}$ parameters with validation loss scaling as $L\propto N^{-0.231}$, where $N$ is the parameter count, comparable to $L\propto N^{-0.238}$ for digital training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向模拟存内计算 (AIMC) 训练，提出混合精度范式：前向与反向矩阵乘在模拟域执行，权重梯度在数字域计算，并联合优化权重映射、预条件优化器与阈值触发开环脉冲、以及转换器动态范围对齐。在以电化学 RAM 测量校准的架构仿真中，Transformer 训练扩展到 123M 参数，验证损失随参数量按 L∝N^-0.231 缩放，接近数字训练的 L∝N^-0.238。
Motivation: AIMC 直接在权重存放处做矩阵运算，但硬件非理想性——物理权重动态范围与写入粒度有限、模数转换器分辨率有限、更新噪声与不对称——使现代深度模型的训练难以扩展；梯度累积对精度与舍入误差尤其敏感。
Method: 采用混合精度训练：前向与反向矩阵乘在模拟域执行，权重梯度在数字域计算。系统-算法协同设计包含三部分：优化权重映射以保证物理与逻辑权重分布良态；将预条件优化器与阈值触发的开环脉冲 (threshold-triggered open-loop pulsing) 耦合以稳定训练轨迹；对齐转换器动态范围以抑制量化误差。
Result: 在用 eRAM 测量校准的硬件架构仿真中，框架把 Transformer 训练扩展到 123M 参数，验证损失缩放指数 L∝N^-0.231，与数字训练的 L∝N^-0.238 相当。
Conclusion: 把精度敏感的梯度累积放到数字域、其余矩阵运算留在模拟域，配合映射、优化器与转换器的联合设计，可让 AIMC 训练逼近数字训练的缩放行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemEvo: Automatic Discovery of Streaming Video Memory Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Query-agnostic streaming video understanding requires vision-language models to continuously compress an indefinitely growing visual stream into a bounded memory before future queries are known. The performance depends critically on the memory mechanism--what observations to preserve, how to represent and consolidate them, and what information to retrieve when a query eventually arrives. Rather than designing a single memory architecture by hand, we formulate memory design as a search problem over executable memory programs. We introduce a lightweight domain-specific language that expresses memory mechanisms through structured primitives for representation, admission, retention, consolidation, budgeting, and retrieval, while enforcing causal and bounded-memory constraints. Although structured, the derived program space remains large and contains heterogeneous, conditionally dependent design choices whose effects can only be assessed via downstream execution. We therefore propose MemEvo, an LLM-driven auto-research framework that uses pretrained LLM as a semantics-aware proposal model to iteratively generate and refine candidate memory programs based on accumulated experimental feedback. At runtime, a deterministic evaluation pipeline validates and evaluates each candidate, while the underlying vision-language model remains frozen throughout discovery. We finally produce a training-free, bounded-memory mechanism. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate strong streaming video understanding performance together with substantial context and inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemEvo 把流式视频记忆机制的设计形式化为可执行程序空间上的搜索：用一个轻量 DSL 描述表示、准入、保留、整合、预算与检索原语并强制因果与有界内存约束，再由 LLM 作为语义感知提议模型依据实验反馈迭代生成与精化候选程序，评估管线确定性、视觉语言模型全程冻结。最终产出训练免费的有界记忆机制，在 StreamingBench 与 OVO-Bench 上取得强流式视频理解性能并显著降低上下文与推理开销。
Motivation: 查询未知时 VLM 必须把无限增长的视觉流压进有界记忆，性能取决于记忆机制的设计；手工设计单一架构难以覆盖异构且条件依赖的设计选项，程序空间只能靠下游执行评估。
Method: 提出表达记忆机制的轻量 DSL，原语覆盖 representation、admission、retention、consolidation、budgeting、retrieval 并强制因果与有界内存约束；MemEvo 用预训练 LLM 作为 proposal model，依据累积实验反馈迭代生成与精化候选记忆程序，运行时由确定性评估管线校验评估，VLM 保持冻结。
Result: 在 StreamingBench 与 OVO-Bench 上展示强流式视频理解性能，并带来可观的上下文与推理效率提升；产出的机制为 training-free、bounded-memory。
Conclusion: 把记忆设计当作可执行程序搜索、由 LLM 提议加确定性评估闭环，可以在不训练 VLM 的前提下得到有界且高效的流式视频记忆机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeCoEvo: Co-Evolving Safety Harnesses and Guards for LLM Agents at Test-Time
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents deployed in real-world environments continually encounter new tasks and safety risks, while execution feedback typically becomes available only after each task is completed. However, existing self-evolving approaches commonly rely on multiple rounds of optimization over fixed and repeatedly accessible task distributions, fundamentally differing from test-time adaptation in real-world deployment, where only experience accumulated from past tasks can be used to improve safety decisions on future unseen tasks. To address this limitation, we propose SafeCoEvo, a test-time Harness-Guard co-evolution framework for LLM agent safety that enables the external safety system to continually adapt from accumulated runtime experience. SafeCoEvo jointly improves two complementary safety capabilities at different timescales: S-Harness rapidly externalizes recent runtime experience into updatable explicit safety knowledge that can promptly influence subsequent tasks, while GuardVPO internalizes accumulated runtime safety experience over a longer timescale into parametric risk-judgment capabilities. By combining short-term rapid adaptation with long-term capability consolidation, SafeCoEvo continually improves the agent's safety capabilities, reducing the unsafe outcome rate by 10.05% while improving the task success rate by 12.15% over the strongest baseline, thereby achieving simultaneous gains in safety and task utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeCoEvo 针对 LLM agent 部署中只能用过去任务经验改进未来未见任务安全决策的场景，提出测试时 Harness-Guard 协同演化框架：S-Harness 把近期运行时经验快速外化为可更新的显式安全知识，GuardVPO 在更长时标上把累积安全经验内化为参数化风险判断能力。相对最强基线，unsafe outcome rate 下降 10.05%，task success rate 提升 12.15%，安全与任务效用同时改善。
Motivation: 现有自演化方法依赖对固定、可反复访问任务分布的多轮优化，与真实部署中的 test-time adaptation 不符：执行反馈只在任务完成后出现，只能用历史经验改进未来未见任务的安全决策。
Method: SafeCoEvo 在测试时联合演化两个互补组件：S-Harness 在短时标上把近期运行时经验外化为可更新的显式安全知识，直接影响后续任务；GuardVPO 在长时标上把累积运行时安全经验内化为参数化风险判断能力。两者结合短时快速适应与长时能力固化。
Result: 相对最强基线，unsafe outcome rate 降低 10.05%，task success rate 提升 12.15%，实现安全与任务效用的同步增益。
Conclusion: 把外部安全系统拆成短时标显式知识外化与长时标参数化能力内化两条通道协同演化，可在测试时同时提升 LLM agent 的安全性与任务成功率。

papers.title: Factorized Scheduling Principle: Learning Interpretable and Transferable Policies via Structured Additive Functions
papers.abstract_en: Scheduling problems arise from repeatedly selecting one item from a set of candidates based on their states. These problems often reduce to assigning priority scores and choosing the highest-ranked item. In this work, we propose a factorized scheduling principle (FSP) framework to learn interpretable and transferable scheduling rules. The FSP framework represents system states as condition distributions and decomposes a global scheduling principle into additive univariate and pairwise components with identifiability constraints. The scheduling principle enables the framework to maintain a simple priority-based structure during deployment. This principle is learned by using a policy-based objective combined with a temporal-difference signal defined on the condition distribution. Experiments on synthetic and realistic scheduling tasks demonstrate the FSP framework's strong performance, interpretability, and zero-shot generalization across different system scales.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出因子化调度原则 (Factorized Scheduling Principle, FSP)：把系统状态表示为条件分布，将全局调度原则分解为带可辨识性约束的可加单变量与成对项，部署时仍保持简单的优先级打分结构。在合成与真实调度任务上，FSP 展示强性能、可解释性，以及跨不同系统规模的零样本泛化。
Motivation: 调度问题通常归结为给候选打优先级分再取最高，但学到的策略往往不可解释、换规模就失效，难以在部署时保持简单透明的规则结构。
Method: FSP 用条件分布 (condition distribution) 表示系统状态，把全局调度原则分解为可加的单变量与成对分量并施加可辨识性约束 (identifiability constraints)；训练用基于策略的目标 (policy-based objective) 加上定义在条件分布上的时序差分信号 (temporal-difference signal)，部署时只保留优先级排序结构。
Result: 在合成与真实调度任务上，FSP 表现出强性能与可解释性，并在不同系统规模之间实现零样本泛化 (zero-shot generalization)。
Conclusion: 把调度原则因子化成带可辨识约束的可加分量，可以在保持优先级式简单部署结构的同时获得可解释且跨规模可迁移的策略。

papers.title: Long-Term Memory-Guided Enhancement for Target Perception in Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Audio large language models (ALLMs) can reason about the content of audio recordings to perform complex tasks. However, these capabilities usually collapse in real-world environments when background noise and competing sources mix the target sound. Inspired by long-term memory in human listening, we propose Long-Term Memory-Guided Audio Enhancement (LTM-AE) to improve selective target perception by refining the audio representations of ALLMs without training. LTM-AE extracts representations in hidden states from separate clean reference recordings as long-term memory for each category, guiding enhancement toward a user-specified listening target. We reconstruct incoming audio tokens in the selected category long-term memory and interpolate the reconstructions with the original tokens before language backbone decoding. This interpolation controls the influence of stored auditory experience while keeping all ALLM parameters fixed. Diagnostic readouts across twenty sound categories and three ALLMs show that LTM-AE strengthens responses to a specified target amid three interfering sources. Averaged over constrained and free-form classification, accuracy gains over raw mixtures range from 29.53 to 46.15 percentage points across multiple open source models. For speech content recovery, LTM-AE with an additional learned token-level gate reduces Qwen2-Audio's word error rate from 23.07% to 14.77%. This work takes an initial step toward using principles of human long-term memory to enhance ALLMs for real-world listening. Our code is available at https://github.com/aynlp/ltm-audio-code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Long-Term Memory-Guided Audio Enhancement (LTM-AE)：用各类别干净参考录音的隐层表征作为长期记忆，重建目标类别的音频 token 并与原始 token 插值后再解码，从而在多干扰源混音中保住用户指定的听觉目标。在 20 个声音类别、3 个 ALLM 上，相对原始混音的分类准确率提升 29.53 至 46.15 个百分点；加一个可学习 token 级门控后 Qwen2-Audio 的 WER 从 23.07% 降到 14.77%。
Motivation: 音频大语言模型 (ALLM) 在背景噪声与竞争声源混合的真实环境中选择性听觉能力会崩溃，需要在不重训模型的前提下增强指定目标的表征。
Method: LTM-AE 从各类别的干净参考录音中抽取隐层状态作为长期记忆；对用户指定类别的输入音频 token 做重建，再与原始 token 插值后送入语言骨干解码，插值权重控制存储听觉经验的影响，ALLM 参数全程固定；语音恢复场景另加一个可学习的 token 级门控。
Result: 在 20 个声音类别、3 个 ALLM、3 个干扰源的诊断读出中，约束与自由形式分类平均后，相对原始混音的准确率提升在多个开源模型上为 29.53 至 46.15 个百分点；语音内容恢复上，LTM-AE 加 token 级门控使 Qwen2-Audio 的词错误率 (WER) 从 23.07% 降至 14.77%。
Conclusion: 把干净参考录音当作长期记忆并以插值方式注入音频 token，可以在参数完全冻结的条件下显著增强 ALLM 在真实混音中的目标感知与语音恢复。

papers.title: Divide and Inject: Can Agents Reconstruct an Indirect Prompt Injection from Fragments?
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems are now being widely used to orchestrate tools and reason over long contexts. However, the improving capabilities of the large language models powering these agents also create new attack surfaces for indirect prompt injection. In particular, an attacker may not need to place a complete malicious instruction in retrieved content if the agent can reconstruct the objective from incomplete fragments distributed across a long context. In this work, we introduce adaptive long-context prompt injection (AdaLCPI), which combines long-context fragmentation with adaptive search. AdaLCPI splits an attack objective into incomplete fragments, embeds them in external content retrieved through the agent's tools, and uses a reconstruction cue to prompt the agent to combine them. It then iteratively refines the fragments and cue with OpenEvolve using graded scoring and natural-language execution feedback from the target agent. Empirically, AdaLCPI achieves higher attack success than strong adaptive baselines, reaching 61.4\% macro-average ASR compared with 32.8\% for Trojan Hippo-style and 30.0\% for AgentVigil. Safety evaluations should therefore test whether agents remain robust when harmful objectives must be reconstructed from incomplete fragments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AdaLCPI：把攻击目标拆成不完整片段藏进工具检索的外部内容，再用 reconstruction cue 诱导 agent 自行拼接，并用 OpenEvolve 依据分级打分与自然语言执行反馈迭代优化片段与 cue。宏平均攻击成功率 (macro-average ASR) 达 61.4%，高于 Trojan Hippo 风格基线的 32.8% 与 AgentVigil 的 30.0%。
Motivation: LLM agent 在长上下文上编排工具时，攻击者不必在检索内容里放完整恶意指令，只要目标能从分散的不完整片段被重建即可生效；现有安全评测未覆盖这种间接 prompt injection 形态。
Method: AdaLCPI 结合长上下文碎片化与自适应搜索：将攻击目标切成不完整片段嵌入经 agent 工具检索的外部内容，附 reconstruction cue 促使 agent 组合片段；随后用 OpenEvolve 以分级打分 (graded scoring) 和来自目标 agent 的自然语言执行反馈迭代精炼片段与 cue。
Result: 宏平均 ASR 61.4%，对比 Trojan Hippo 风格基线 32.8%、AgentVigil 30.0%，攻击成功率更高。
Conclusion: 安全评测应检验当有害目标必须从不完整片段重建时 agent 是否仍然稳健，即长上下文碎片化加自适应搜索能显著抬高间接 prompt injection 的成功率。

papers.title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been extended to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), and perception-aware methods further encourage policies to rely on visual evidence. Yet relying on the image does not guarantee that visual claims are supported by it. Before RL training, 27.81% of the correctly answered responses of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four multimodal reasoning benchmarks contain at least one direct visual claim that the image does not support. Since outcome-level RL rewards each response as a whole, these claims inherit the positive credit of the correct answer. We introduce a fixed-rollout counterfactual diagnostic that re-scores the same response under an intervened image to separate Evidence-Function Sensitivity (EFS), how strongly the model's predictions change, from claim persistence, whether the model keeps supporting the same claim rather than retracting it. The diagnostic reveals Sensitivity-Persistence Decoupling (SPD): under DAPO and VPPO, EFS increases and claims become more retractable overall, yet unsupported claims become significantly more persistent, whereas GRPO raises EFS without this deterioration. We therefore propose Persistence-Aware Credit Gating (PACG), which attenuates positive credit for unusually persistent visual claims and leaves all other credit unchanged. It requires no supported/unsupported labels and adds no inference cost. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, PACG raises the nine-benchmark average over three seeds from 58.1% to 59.9% with DAPO and from 59.8% to 60.9% with VPPO, while making unsupported claims more retractable. The gains extend to a larger model, a newer backbone, and the accuracy of HallusionBench also improves consistently. These results suggest that visual sensitivity and claim retractability are complementary dimensions of multimodal credit assignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态 RLVR 中模型对图像敏感并不等于会撤回无图像支撑的视觉断言：干预图像重打分的诊断显示 DAPO 与 VPPO 提升 Evidence-Function Sensitivity 的同时让无支撑断言更顽固，GRPO 则无此恶化。据此提出 PACG，削弱异常顽固断言获得的正向 credit，在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上把九基准三种子均值从 58.1% 提到 59.9%（DAPO）、59.8% 提到 60.9%（VPPO）。
Motivation: RLVR 按整条回答给 outcome-level reward，回答正确时其中图像不支撑的视觉断言也一并继承正 credit；RL 训练前 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在四个多模态推理基准上 27.81% 的正确回答至少含一条无图像支撑的直接视觉断言。
Method: 提出固定 rollout 的反事实诊断：对同一条回答在被干预的图像下重新打分，把 Evidence-Function Sensitivity（预测变化强度）与 claim persistence（是否撤回断言）分开；再提出 Persistence-Aware Credit Gating (PACG)，只削弱异常顽固视觉断言的正 credit，其余 credit 不变，无需 supported/unsupported 标注且不增加推理开销。
Result: RL 训练前 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 四个基准正确回答中 27.81% 含至少一条无支撑视觉断言。诊断显示 DAPO、VPPO 下 EFS 上升且断言整体更可撤回，但无支撑断言显著更顽固；GRPO 提升 EFS 而无此恶化。PACG 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上把九基准三种子均值由 58.1% 提至 59.9%（DAPO）、59.8% 提至 60.9%（VPPO），并使无支撑断言更可撤回；收益可迁移到更大模型与更新 backbone，HallusionBench 准确率也一致提升。
Conclusion: 视觉敏感性与断言可撤回性是多模态 credit assignment 中互补的两个维度，outcome-level reward 必须按断言的顽固程度单独调制正 credit。

papers.title: CounterSteer: Suppressing Indirect Prompt Injection with Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection makes an LLM agent treat untrusted retrieved text as instructions. We present CounterSteer, an inference-time defense that suppresses this behavior inside the model. Per model, a five-step recipe fits a residual-stream direction from paired episodes differing only in whether an embedded instruction is followed, and retains it only if it passes pre-specified causal and capability gates. At deployment, the direction is subtracted from every tool-result token during prefill. The edit is always on--there is no detection decision to evade--and requires no fine-tuning, auxiliary model, or added tokens, only white-box serving and tool-result span boundaries. Across five open-weights models (8B-106B, five vendor lineages), held-out attack success falls from 0.21-1.00 undefended to 0.00-0.17 defended, and AgentDojo compromise rate from 0.10-0.49 to 0.006-0.079, at 93-100% typography-normalized benign utility, with larger task-dependent costs when reasoning over steered content. A benchmark-level adaptive attacker reaching 0.67-0.73 undefended is held to roughly a quarter of that on the two most deeply evaluated models. Among the defenses we measured on capable models, those achieving lower compromise rates either lost 22-89% of benign utility or fine-tuned the served weights. White-box gradient attacks through the deployed vector compromise at most 2 of 52 episodes, and none of 2,052 replayed human red-team attacks succeeds. CounterSteer largely neutralizes instructional takeover: a black-box framing search cracks 3 of 18 development samples. Parameter manipulation--attacker-chosen arguments in otherwise legitimate calls--is only partially resisted (13 of 18); the decision becomes linearly readable at argument emission but not at the examined pre-generation sites, and is not removed by the tested prefill- or decode-time steering, motivating argument-provenance controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CounterSteer 是一种推理期激活引导 (activation steering) 防御：按模型用五步流程从仅差「是否执行嵌入指令」的成对 episode 拟合残差流方向，只保留通过预设因果与能力门控的方向，部署时在 prefill 阶段从每个 tool-result token 上减去该方向。在五个开源权重模型 (8B–106B、五个厂商系) 上，held-out 攻击成功率从未防御的 0.21–1.00 降到 0.00–0.17，AgentDojo compromise rate 从 0.10–0.49 降到 0.006–0.079，良性效用保持 93–100%。
Motivation: 间接提示注入让 LLM agent 把不可信的检索文本当作指令执行；现有防御要么掉良性效用、要么微调服务权重，且基于检测的开关可被规避。
Method: 每模型五步配方：用仅在「是否遵循嵌入指令」上不同的成对 episode 拟合残差流方向，通过预设 causal gate 与 capability gate 才保留；部署时在 prefill 对所有 tool-result token 减去该方向，编辑常开、无需检测决策，只需白盒服务与 tool-result span 边界，不微调、不加辅助模型、不加 token。
Result: 五个开源权重模型 (8B–106B) 上 held-out 攻击成功率 0.21–1.00 → 0.00–0.17，AgentDojo compromise rate 0.10–0.49 → 0.006–0.079，良性效用 93–100%（在被引导内容上做推理时任务相关代价更大）；benchmark 级自适应攻击者 0.67–0.73 被压到约其四分之一（两个深入评估的模型）；白盒梯度攻击最多攻破 52 个 episode 中的 2 个，2,052 次重放人类红队攻击全部失败；黑盒 framing 搜索攻破 18 个开发样本中的 3 个；参数操纵仅部分抵抗（18 中 13）。
Conclusion: 常开的推理期方向减法能大体中和指令性接管且不牺牲良性效用，而其他低 compromise 的防御要么损失 22–89% 良性效用、要么微调权重；但参数操纵（合法调用中攻击者指定的参数）只被部分抵抗，需 argument-provenance 控制。

papers.title: From Checkpoint Variation to Selection Gains in Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Checkpoint selection is a routine decision in supervised fine-tuning (SFT): training produces multiple checkpoints, but only one is retained. Yet fixed-budget comparisons do not by themselves distinguish three empirical claims: whether more validation data improve checkpoint selection, whether a selection rule outperforms validation-loss selection, and whether it improves over simply retaining the final checkpoint. We therefore treat checkpoint selection as a finite-information decision problem. Holding completed training trajectories, candidate checkpoints, and independent test items fixed, we vary the validation budget and separately measure improvement from additional validation data, gain over negative log-likelihood (NLL) selection, and gain over the final checkpoint. Across 60 mathematical SFT trajectories and 19 configurations, increasing the validation budget from 32 to 305-313 examples raises independent-test accuracy by 0.32 percentage points (pp) for generated-accuracy selection and 0.29 pp for checkpoint agreement, with 95% configuration-bootstrap CIs of [0.10, 0.56] and [0.11, 0.50], respectively. At the full validation budget, the two generation-based rules outperform matched NLL selection by 0.71 and 0.85 pp, respectively, while their gains over the final checkpoint remain unresolved. A cross-domain replication on 12 newly trained Commonsense trajectories shows the same qualitative separation: increasing the validation budget from 32 to 1,024 questions improves generated-accuracy and checkpoint-agreement selection by 0.87 and 0.27 pp, while gains over the final checkpoint again remain unresolved. Together, these results show that benefiting from more validation data, outperforming NLL selection, and outperforming the final checkpoint are distinct empirical claims that require separate evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SFT 的 checkpoint 选择当作有限信息决策问题，固定训练轨迹与测试集、只变验证预算，发现「多验证数据有用」「优于 NLL 选择」「优于直接留最后一个 checkpoint」是三个必须分开检验的独立命题。验证预算从 32 增到 305-313 例，generated-accuracy 与 checkpoint agreement 选择的独立测试准确率分别提升 0.32 pp 与 0.29 pp；满预算下两者比 NLL 选择高 0.71 与 0.85 pp，但相对最终 checkpoint 的增益仍未分辨。
Motivation: 固定预算的对比无法区分三种经验命题：更多验证数据是否改善选择、选择规则是否胜过验证损失、以及是否胜过直接保留最后一个 checkpoint。
Method: 固定已完成训练轨迹、候选 checkpoint 与独立测试条目，只改变验证预算，分别测量三项增益；在 60 条数学 SFT 轨迹、19 个配置上做配置级 bootstrap，并在 12 条新训 Commonsense 轨迹上做跨域复现。
Result: 数学 SFT：验证预算 32 → 305-313 例，generated-accuracy 选择独立测试准确率 +0.32 pp（95% CI [0.10, 0.56]），checkpoint agreement +0.29 pp（[0.11, 0.50]）；满预算下两规则超 NLL 选择 0.71 与 0.85 pp，超最终 checkpoint 的增益未分辨。Commonsense 复现：预算 32 → 1,024 题，两规则分别 +0.87 与 +0.27 pp，超最终 checkpoint 仍未分辨。

papers.title: Sharp Convergence and Sampling Trade-offs for Riemannian Diffusion under Nonnegative Ricci Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as state-of-the-art generative models, with recent extensions from Euclidean spaces to Riemannian manifolds. However, existing convergence guarantees for Riemannian diffusion models typically require $\tilde{O}(\mathrm{poly}(d,T)/ε^2)$ score evaluations, with potentially unfavorable dependence on the dimension. In this work, we develop a general framework that separates score discretization from Brownian-motion simulation and allows multiple geodesic random-walk steps per score evaluation. Under nonnegative Ricci curvature assumption and an exact Brownian-motion simulation oracle, we show that $\tilde{O}(d/ε^2)$ score evaluations suffice to achieve an $ε^2$ KL divergence from the target distribution, matching the existing convergence rate of Euclidean diffusion models. We further show that $\tilde{O}(d^4T/ε^2)$ geodesic random-walk steps suffice to approximate the required drifted Brownian motion to $ε$ total variation error. Combining these results yields a sampling scheme with $\tilde{O}(d/ε^2)$ score evaluations and $\tilde{O}(d^4T/ε^2)$ geodesic random-walk steps, motivating multiple random-walk steps between consecutive score evaluations. Our results provide a sharper characterization of the convergence and sampling complexity of Riemannian diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非负 Ricci 曲率与精确 Brownian 运动模拟 oracle 下，把 score 离散化与 Brownian 模拟解耦的框架只需 Õ(d/ε²) 次 score 评估即可达到 ε² KL 散度，与欧氏扩散模型的收敛率持平；同时 Õ(d⁴T/ε²) 步测地线随机游走足以把漂移 Brownian 运动近似到 ε 总变差误差，因此应在相邻两次 score 评估之间跑多步随机游走。
Motivation: 现有黎曼扩散模型的收敛保证通常需要 Õ(poly(d,T)/ε²) 次 score 评估，对维度的依赖可能很不利，收敛与采样复杂度的刻画不够锐利。
Method: 提出一个把 score 离散化与 Brownian 运动模拟分离的通用框架，允许每次 score 评估对应多步测地线随机游走 (geodesic random walk)；在非负 Ricci 曲率假设和精确 Brownian 模拟 oracle 下分别分析两部分误差并合并。
Result: Õ(d/ε²) 次 score 评估即可达到对目标分布 ε² 的 KL 散度，匹配欧氏扩散模型的已知收敛率；Õ(d⁴T/ε²) 步测地线随机游走可把所需漂移 Brownian 运动近似到 ε 总变差误差；合并后得到 Õ(d/ε²) 次 score 评估加 Õ(d⁴T/ε²) 步随机游走的采样方案。
Conclusion: 黎曼扩散的收敛与采样复杂度可以刻画得更锐利：score 评估次数的维度依赖可降到与欧氏情形一致，代价由随机游走步数承担，故应以多次随机游走步换取更少的 score 评估。

papers.title: AffectReveal: Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition Beyond Visual Appearances
papers.abstract_en: Visual emotion recognition commonly assumes that all evidence required for prediction is contained in the observed image or video. Yet the same visible reaction can convey different emotions depending on events beyond the input: tears, for example, may indicate grief or joy. We formulate Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition (EGER), where emotion recognition requires recovering the affect-determining event. We construct EGER-Bench, comprising 10,052 videos and 10,734 images across 11 emotions, two source domains, and four visual settings. A study with six annotators shows that event context raises human recognition accuracy from 33.96% to 72.08%, confirming that visual evidence alone is often insufficient. Semantic relevance alone does not solve EGER: a plausible event may imply the wrong emotion if its identity, focal-person role, relationship, or outcome is misinterpreted. We therefore propose AffectReveal, a tuning-free framework that first constructs and independently verifies evidence-grounded alternatives over these affect-critical factors. It then cross-checks the recovered event against face-masked in-media facts through bidirectional atomic evidence support, while retaining the original unmasked input for final prediction. Across three downstream models and four input settings, AffectReveal yields average UAR gains of 5.26--10.53 points. For three fine-tunable models, it also enables untuned models to outperform their fine-tuned visual-only counterparts in all 12 accuracy comparisons, without updating downstream parameters.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉情绪识别假设证据全在画面内，但同一表情在不同事件下含义相反。作者提出事件接地情绪识别 (EGER) 与免微调框架 AffectReveal：先对事件的身份、焦点人物角色、关系、结果等关键因子构造并独立验证候选证据，再与遮脸后的画面事实做双向原子证据交叉核对。在 EGER-Bench 上相对三个下游模型与四种输入设置取得平均 UAR 提升 5.26–10.53 个百分点，12 项准确率比较中全部超过微调过的纯视觉对照。
Motivation: 同一可见反应（如流泪）可对应悲伤或喜悦，仅凭图像/视频的视觉证据无法确定情绪，现有情绪识别的封闭世界假设因此失效。
Method: 构建 EGER-Bench（10,052 段视频、10,734 张图像、11 种情绪、两个来源域、四种视觉设置），并提出免微调 (tuning-free) 的 AffectReveal：对影响情绪判定的事件因子（身份、焦点人物角色、关系、结果）生成证据接地的候选并独立验证，再将恢复的事件与遮脸后的画面事实做双向原子证据支持 (bidirectional atomic evidence support) 交叉核对，最终预测时保留原始未遮挡输入。
Result: 六名标注者实验显示加入事件上下文使人类识别准确率从 33.96% 升到 72.08%；在三个下游模型与四种输入设置上 AffectReveal 平均 UAR 提升 5.26–10.53 个百分点；对三个可微调模型，它让未微调模型在全部 12 项准确率比较中超过其微调过的纯视觉对照，且不更新下游参数。
Conclusion: 情绪判定的决定性证据在事件而非画面，恢复并核验事件可在不改动下游模型参数的前提下稳定抬高情绪识别准确率；单纯语义相关性不足以解决该任务，因为事件的身份、角色、关系或结果被误读会导向错误情绪。

papers.title: ThinkingGuard: Decoding Implicit Hazards via Step-by-Step Risk Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, their reliability is threatened by multimodal implicit risks. Unlike explicit threats, these hazards emerge when individually benign text and neutral visual entities logically converge to induce unsafe outputs. Current detection methods fail to address this because they overlook the underlying risk activation mechanisms that govern cross-modal risk activation, leading to single-modality shortcut learning and hallucinated rationalizations. To bridge this gap, we first construct TriggerBench, the first dataset explicitly modeling risk compositionality (5,600 instances). By formally isolating Key Elements and Trigger Elements to build counterfactual contrastive pairs, TriggerBench eliminates risk residues and forces models to perform genuine logical deduction rather than superficial pattern matching, which provides a rigorous foundation for both large-scale training and fine-grained evaluation. Building on this, we propose a Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning training framework and employ it to train ThinkingGuard, a specialized guard model. Inspired by Situation Awareness theory, we decouple implicit risk identification into progressive cognitive stages, and utilize a step-reward Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm to explore optimal reasoning trajectories, which are then distilled into the model through Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment. Extensive experiments across both standard and implicit safety benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkingGuard achieves strong performance. Project resources are available at https://github.com/FroggyChen/ThinkingGuard.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia(MM '26), November 10-14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. ACM, New York, NY, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThinkingGuard 用分步风险归因解码 MLLM 的多模态隐式风险：先构建 TriggerBench（5,600 条实例，把 Key Elements 与 Trigger Elements 隔离成反事实对比对），再以 Situation Awareness 理论拆解识别阶段，用 step-reward MCTS 搜索推理轨迹并经 Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment 蒸馏进 guard model。在标准与隐式安全基准上均取得强表现。
Motivation: MLLM 部署到安全关键场景时，单独看无害的文本与中性视觉实体会在逻辑上汇聚而触发不安全输出；现有检测方法忽略跨模态风险激活机制，导致单模态捷径学习与幻觉式合理化。
Method: 构建 TriggerBench 数据集（5,600 条实例），通过隔离 Key Elements 与 Trigger Elements 构造反事实对比对以消除风险残留；提出 Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning 训练框架，按 Situation Awareness 理论把隐式风险识别拆成分阶段认知步骤，用 step-reward Monte Carlo Tree Search 探索最优推理轨迹，再经 Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment 蒸馏训练 ThinkingGuard。
Result: TriggerBench 含 5,600 条实例，为首个显式建模风险组合性的数据集；在标准与隐式安全两类基准的实验中 ThinkingGuard 表现出强性能（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把隐式风险识别拆成分步认知阶段并用 MCTS 搜索加偏好对齐蒸馏，可让 guard model 做真正的逻辑推导而非表面模式匹配；项目资源已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: FM-ReID: Selective Competitive Token Routing for Object Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Object re-identification (ReID) faces a recurring challenge: different identities can share highly similar global appearances, while the cues that distinguish them are localized, heterogeneous, and visible only under particular viewpoints. This challenge arises in animal ReID through markings, contours, and scars, in person ReID through subtle clothing and accessory cues, and in vehicle ReID through localized appearance details. Although visual foundation models encode such information in dense tokens, a single holistic descriptor can obscure discriminative local signals. We propose FM-ReID, an end-to-end framework that formulates local representation learning as selective competitive token routing. Its Competitive Fine-grained Mining module uses multiple mining queries and a residual query to compete for dense DINOv3 tokens. Above-prior selection retains tokens preferentially allocated to each mining query, while the residual slot receives tokens excluded from the retrieval descriptors. The resulting multi-query descriptors are jointly trained with a holistic representation for retrieval, without fixed spatial partitions or equal-area constraints. FM-ReID achieves strong results on animal, person, and vehicle ReID benchmarks, supporting competitive token routing as an effective way to augment holistic foundation-model representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FM-ReID 把 ReID 的局部表征学习形式化为选择性竞争 token 路由：多个 mining query 加一个 residual query 竞争 DINOv3 的稠密 token，按高于先验的阈值各自保留分到的 token，被检索描述子排除的 token 归入 residual 槽。多 query 描述子与整体表征联合训练做检索，不设固定空间划分或等面积约束，在动物、行人、车辆 ReID 基准上取得强结果。
Motivation: 不同身份的全局外观高度相似，而区分线索是局部、异质且只在特定视角可见；视觉基础模型虽以稠密 token 编码这些信息，单一整体描述子会掩盖有判别力的局部信号。
Method: 端到端框架 FM-ReID：Competitive Fine-grained Mining 模块用多个 mining query 与一个 residual query 竞争 DINOv3 稠密 token，Above-prior selection 优先保留分配给各 mining query 的 token，residual 槽接收被排除的 token；得到的多 query 描述子与整体表征联合训练用于检索，无固定空间划分与等面积约束。
Result: 在动物、行人、车辆三类 ReID 基准上取得强检索结果，支持竞争 token 路由能增强整体基础模型表征。
Conclusion: 竞争式 token 路由是增强整体基础模型表征、捕捉局部判别线索的有效方式，可跨动物、行人、车辆三类 ReID 场景。

papers.title: HiTS-CL: A Continual Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Extrapolative temporal knowledge graph reasoning (TKGR) predicts future facts from historical snapshots. Most existing methods train once on an early prefix of the timeline and then use a frozen model for all future timestamps. We argue that this fixed-prefix protocol is misaligned with extrapolation. It learns from a static prefix, whereas the target stream is non-stationary: new entities and facts emerge, temporal dependencies shift across regimes, and recurring historical signals must be refreshed online. As a result, models trained only on early snapshots become outdated and degrade over long horizons. We address this mismatch by formulating extrapolative TKGR as continual learning over streaming snapshots. Under this view, effective extrapolation must jointly handle current dynamics, stable knowledge, and recurring historical evidence. Based on these requirements, we propose History-enhanced Two-Step Continual Learning (HiTS-CL), a backbone-agnostic continual learning framework for extrapolative TKGR. HiTS-CL tracks current dynamics via continual fine-tuning, preserves stable knowledge via multi-teacher adaptive distillation, and retains recurring historical evidence via a selective memory of recent and frequent facts. We integrate HiTS-CL into five representative TKGR backbones and evaluate it on four benchmark datasets. HiTS-CL consistently improves extrapolation accuracy, reduces long-horizon degradation, and outperforms strong continual-learning baselines, including a recent method for temporal knowledge graphs. Source code and data are available at https://github.com/liuyansong98/HiTS-CL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把时序知识图谱外推 (extrapolative TKGR) 重写成对流式快照的持续学习：HiTS-CL 用持续微调跟踪当前动态、多教师自适应蒸馏保住稳定知识、选择性记忆保留近期与高频事实。接入五个代表性 TKGR backbone 并在四个 benchmark 上评测，外推精度一致提升、长时程退化减轻，并超过包括近期时序知识图谱方法在内的强持续学习基线。
Motivation: 现有 TKGR 方法只在时间线早期前缀上训练一次，之后用冻结模型覆盖所有未来时间戳；但目标流是非平稳的——新实体与新事实不断出现、时间依赖跨 regime 漂移、周期性历史信号需要在线刷新，导致模型在长时程上过时并退化。
Method: 提出 backbone-agnostic 的 History-enhanced Two-Step Continual Learning (HiTS-CL)：两步中先用 continual fine-tuning 跟踪当前动态，再用 multi-teacher adaptive distillation 保留稳定知识，并以 selective memory（近期与高频事实）召回周期性历史证据；框架集成进五个代表性 TKGR backbone。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 数据集、五个 TKGR backbone 上，HiTS-CL 一致提升外推精度、减轻长时程退化，并优于包括一个近期时序知识图谱方法在内的强持续学习基线；源码与数据发布于 github.com/liuyansong98/HiTS-CL。
Conclusion: 固定前缀的一次性训练与外推目标错配，把外推 TKGR 视为对流式快照的持续学习、并同时处理当前动态、稳定知识与周期性历史证据，才能在长时程上维持精度。

papers.title: How Medical VLMs Underutilize Their Vision Encoders: A Dermatology Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show significant promise for clinical image understanding, offering accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning. However, a critical performance gap exists between their strong vision encoders and the full multimodal model: in dermatology, the MedSigLIP encoder outperforms MedGemma by an average of 10.26 percentage points even when both use zero target-task labels; few-shot linear probing provides further evidence of strong visual representations. This gap motivates an investigation of how visual information is used in end-to-end diagnosis and why plausible-sounding predictions can lack grounding in image evidence. Using dermatology as our primary testbed, we systematically investigate three hypotheses for this phenomenon. We further provide a mechanistic analysis of the model's internal attention patterns, showing that a simple describe-then-decide prompting strategy increases vision attention by 30-40% during generation. Task-specific fine-tuning improves dermatology classification but reduces cross-domain medical question-answering performance in our evaluation. To address these challenges, we combine label-free prompting with low-label encoder-assisted reranking while keeping the VLM frozen. We validate the interventions across five VLM backbones in dermatology and provide supporting representation and attention analyses across additional medical modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 医学 VLM 的视觉编码器能力被端到端诊断浪费：在零目标标签下 MedSigLIP 编码器平均比 MedGemma 高 10.26 个百分点。describe-then-decide 提示使生成期视觉注意力提升 30–40%，任务微调虽提升皮肤科分类却拉低跨域医学问答；作者改用免标签提示加低标签编码器辅助重排并保持 VLM 冻结，在五个 VLM backbone 上验证。
Motivation: 医学 VLM 的强视觉编码器与整机多模态模型之间存在性能落差，导致看似合理的预测缺少图像证据支撑，端到端诊断中视觉信息未被充分利用。
Method: 以皮肤科为主试验场系统检验三种假说，并对模型内部注意力做机理分析；提出免标签提示 (label-free prompting) 与低标签编码器辅助重排 (low-label encoder-assisted reranking) 的组合干预，全程冻结 VLM，另配表示与注意力分析。
Result: 零目标标签下 MedSigLIP 编码器平均优于 MedGemma 10.26 个百分点，few-shot 线性探测进一步佐证视觉表示强度；describe-then-decide 提示使生成期视觉注意力提高 30–40%；任务特定微调提升皮肤科分类但降低跨域医学问答表现；干预在皮肤科的五个 VLM backbone 上验证，并在其他医学模态补充表示与注意力分析。
Conclusion: 医学 VLM 的瓶颈在于视觉信息的使用方式而非编码器质量，冻结 VLM、靠免标签提示加编码器辅助重排即可缩小落差，比任务微调更保跨域问答能力。

papers.title: MAADBench: The Refreshable Paradigm for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies report that LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) fail at rates of 41%-87%, yet to our knowledge, no benchmark to date supports systematic anomaly detection (AD) for them. Building MAS AD benchmarks is hard because they must remain fresh as LLM systems evolve: tasks may leak into training data and thus be memorized by LLMs, traces and anomaly patterns expire as backbones evolve, and labels must be provided reliably for each refresh. To address these challenges, we present MAADBench (MA: multi-agent; AD: anomaly detection), the first refreshable MAS AD benchmark designed for diverse, evolving LLM backbones underlying the agents. MAADBench combines (1) sampled-and-coupled generative tasks over an approximately 10^37-task space to mitigate task leakage, (2) refreshable trace generation under configurable LLM backbones, and (3) automated provision of cost-free, deterministic step-level labels for fine-grained AD evaluation. Beyond offering the paradigm itself, we run MAADBench with five state-of-the-art LLM backbones and release the MAADBench-Full dataset with 5,200 step-labeled traces. Benchmarking 25 AD methods on the MAADBench dataset reveals substantial limitations in current approaches: they rely heavily on supervision, struggle with subtle MAS-specific anomalies, and lack robustness across LLM backbones. These gaps point to a rich research agenda for MAS-specific anomaly detection, with MAADBench providing a systematic and refreshable testbed for method development and evaluation. We open-source MAADBench-Full at https://huggingface.co/datasets/hww123/MAADBench-full.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAADBench 是首个可刷新的多智能体系统 (MAS) 异常检测基准：用约 10^37 任务空间的采样耦合生成任务防任务泄漏，按可配置 LLM backbone 重生成 trace，并自动产出零成本、确定性的 step 级标签。用 5 个 SOTA LLM backbone 跑通并发布含 5,200 条 step 标注 trace 的 MAADBench-Full，对 25 个 AD 方法的基准测试显示现有方法重度依赖监督、难以捕捉 MAS 特有的细微异常、跨 backbone 不稳健。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的失败率高达 41%–87%，但至今没有支持系统性异常检测的基准；而 MAS AD 基准本身难以构建——任务会泄漏进训练数据被 LLM 记忆，trace 与异常模式随 backbone 演进而过期，每次刷新还需可靠标注。
Method: MAADBench 由三部分组成：在约 10^37 任务空间上做采样耦合的生成式任务 (sampled-and-coupled generative tasks) 以缓解任务泄漏；在可配置 LLM backbone 下做可刷新的 trace 生成；自动提供零成本、确定性的 step 级标签以支持细粒度 AD 评测。作者用 5 个 SOTA LLM backbone 运行该基准并开源数据集。
Result: LLM-based MAS 失败率为 41%–87%；任务空间规模约 10^37；发布 MAADBench-Full 含 5,200 条 step 标注 trace，覆盖 5 个 SOTA LLM backbone；对 25 个 AD 方法的基准测试显示它们重度依赖监督、难以识别细微的 MAS 特有异常、跨 LLM backbone 缺乏稳健性。
Conclusion: 现有 MAS 异常检测方法在监督依赖、细微异常识别和跨 backbone 稳健性上存在系统性缺口，需要 MAS 专用的 AD 方法；MAADBench 以可刷新范式提供可持续的测试床。

papers.title: SERA: Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation for Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL) targets prompt-wise log-success and has shown strong performance on reasoning tasks. Under finite rollout budgets, however, the estimator used by MaxRL attenuates each prompt's likelihood gradient by a factor that depends on its success probability and rollout count. Under uniform rollout allocation, the common rollout count fails to compensate for success-dependent attenuation, leaving low-success prompts more strongly attenuated and distorting their relative contributions to the expected aggregate gradient. We introduce SERA (Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation), which redistributes a fixed rollout budget to approximately equalize these finite-rollout scaling factors. Building on our theoretical analysis of how finite rollouts distort prompt-wise likelihood gradients, we formulate the allocation as a fixed-budget max--min problem, derive a waterline solution to its continuous relaxation, and introduce a multiplicity correction to remove the additional prompt weighting induced by heterogeneous rollout counts. Experiments show stronger alignment with exact likelihood gradients in a controlled ImageNet setting and improved multi-sample solution coverage over MaxRL on maze navigation and mathematical reasoning under matched training rollout budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SERA 在固定 rollout 预算下按各 prompt 的成功概率重新分配采样数，使有限 rollout 造成的梯度缩放因子近似相等，从而纠正均匀分配对低成功率 prompt 的过度衰减。它把分配写成固定预算 max–min 问题，给出连续松弛的 waterline 解，并加 multiplicity correction 消除异构 rollout 数引入的额外 prompt 加权。
Motivation: MaxRL 的有限 rollout 估计量按成功概率与采样数对每个 prompt 的似然梯度做衰减，均匀分配无法补偿这种成功概率相关的衰减，低成功率 prompt 被压得更狠，扭曲了期望聚合梯度中各 prompt 的相对贡献。
Method: 基于对有限 rollout 如何扭曲 prompt 级似然梯度的理论分析，把预算分配建模为固定预算 max–min 问题，对连续松弛推导 waterline 解，再引入 multiplicity correction 去掉异构 rollout 数额外诱导的 prompt 加权。
Result: 在受控 ImageNet 设定下与 exact likelihood 梯度对齐更强；在 maze navigation 与数学推理任务上，匹配训练 rollout 预算时相对 MaxRL 提升多样本解覆盖 (multi-sample solution coverage)。
Conclusion: 按成功概率均衡有限 rollout 缩放因子的预算分配，能在相同 rollout 预算下让 MaxRL 的梯度更接近精确似然梯度并提高解覆盖。

papers.title: Interactive-Policy Distillation with Bidirectional Propose-and-Verify
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its self-generated trajectories with dense token-level teacher feedback. However, naive OPD may suffer from teacher unanchoring, where the student's reasoning trajectory drifts far from the teacher, causing the teacher to be queried on states it would hardly visit and thus provide unreliable supervision. We propose Interactive-Policy Distillation (IPD), which applies adaptive teacher intervention to the student rollout. Under a bidirectional propose-and-verify state machine, the student and teacher alternately exchange their roles as proposer and verifier, and collaboratively generate mixed-source trajectories. Then different supervisions are applied according to the source of each token. This bidirectional propose-and-verify mechanism and the source-split loss make IPD not only a more performant distillation method, but also a unified bridge between on-policy and off-policy paradigms. To make the interleaved dual-model rollouts more efficient, we also design a dedicated fused inference engine that co-hosts both models in one serving instance with separate KV caches and instantiates the state machine model to distribute, collect, and process requests. On math reasoning tasks and across multiple teacher-student model pairs, student models trained with IPD not only outperform those trained with OPD, but also demonstrate higher data efficiency. Specifically, when distilling Qwen3-30B-A3B into Qwen3-1.7B-Base, IPD brings a +3.28 mean@8 and a +3.28 best@8 benchmark-averaged accuracy improvement compared with OPD. Besides, IPD only consumes about 1/4 of the training examples and steps to outperform OPD trained on the whole training dataset for one epoch. We also investigate the impact of different loss variants and takeover / handback configurations, and demonstrate the robustness of IPD on different training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Interactive-Policy Distillation (IPD)：在双向 propose-and-verify 状态机里让学生与教师交替担任 proposer/verifier，混合来源轨迹按 token 来源分别施加监督，从而缓解 on-policy 蒸馏中的 teacher unanchoring。在数学推理任务上把 Qwen3-30B-A3B 蒸馏进 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 时，相比 OPD 平均提升 +3.28 mean@8 与 +3.28 best@8，且只用约 1/4 的训练样本与步数就超过 OPD 训满一个 epoch 的表现。
Motivation: On-policy 蒸馏中学生的推理轨迹会漂离教师（teacher unanchoring），导致教师被查询到几乎不会访问的状态、给出不可靠监督，同时双模型交错 rollout 的推理开销也高。
Method: IPD 对学生 rollout 施加自适应教师干预：双向 propose-and-verify 状态机中双方交替交换 proposer/verifier 角色，协作生成 mixed-source trajectories，再按每个 token 的来源施加不同监督（source-split loss）；另设计专用 fused inference engine，把两个模型共置于同一 serving 实例、各带独立 KV cache，并以状态机模型分发、收集与处理请求。
Result: 在数学推理任务、多组师生模型配对上，IPD 训练的学生超过 OPD 且数据效率更高：Qwen3-30B-A3B → Qwen3-1.7B-Base 时相对 OPD 提升 +3.28 mean@8 与 +3.28 best@8（benchmark 平均准确率）；IPD 只用约 1/4 的训练样本与步数即超过 OPD 在全量数据上训练一个 epoch 的结果。另比较了不同 loss 变体与 takeover/handback 配置，并在不同训练数据上展示鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 双向 propose-and-verify 加按来源拆分的损失能把 on-policy 与 off-policy 蒸馏统一起来，既提升数学推理蒸馏性能又大幅降低所需数据量；其效率依赖共置双模型的 fused inference engine。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCCM: Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching for ERP Dense Feature Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: Equirectangular projection (ERP) is the standard representation for 360$^\circ$ imagery, and robust dense feature matching on ERP underpins panoramic stereo, view synthesis, and omnidirectional SLAM. Dense matchers trained on flat images degrade systematically on ERP because the chart introduces three coupled distortions -- topological, metric, and area -- that standard coarse matching and visibility estimation do not explicitly model. We show that correcting the three distortions at the coarse-stage interfaces where they arise -- pairwise distortions in attention, per-pixel distortion in covisibility gating -- improves PCK@$1^\circ$ from 0.229 to 0.275 on Matterport3D under a fixed coarse scaffold, with the refiner architecture unchanged -- our central result. Concretely, SCCM (Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching) augments a chart-naive cross-attention/dual-softmax coarse matcher with two sphere-derived priors: Spherical Positional Attention (SPA) pairs a yaw-periodic RoPE (topology) with a tangent-plane bias (metric), and Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC) applies a pre-sigmoid log-area correction (area). The chart-naive scaffold serves as a controlled reference, separating the scaffold-replacement effect from the spherical-prior effect. Instantiated in the RoMa V1 framework with the same frozen encoder, refiner architecture, and loss, SCCM also outperforms the ERP-native EDM (0.163) and an ERP-retrained RoMa V1 (0.198) under a unified ERP dense matching protocol, while perspective-trained matchers largely fail on ERP. It further transfers zero-shot to Stanford2D3D and, when trained on outdoor Holo360D, leads there as well.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages: 16-page main paper (including references) and 19-page supplementary material. Project page: https://gandanlee.github.io/sccm/ Code: https://github.com/gandanlee/sccm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCCM 在 ERP 全景稠密特征匹配中把球面投影的三类耦合畸变（拓扑、度量、面积）在粗匹配阶段显式校正：SPA 用 yaw 周期 RoPE 加切平面偏置，AAC 用 pre-sigmoid log-area 校正共视门控。在固定粗匹配骨架与不变 refiner 下，Matterport3D 上 PCK@1° 从 0.229 提到 0.275，并超过 EDM（0.163）与 ERP 重训的 RoMa V1（0.198）。
Motivation: 平面图像训练的稠密匹配器在 ERP 上系统性退化，因为投影引入拓扑、度量、面积三类耦合畸变，而标准粗匹配与可见性估计不显式建模它们。
Method: 在 chart-naive 的 cross-attention/dual-softmax 粗匹配器上加两个球面先验：Spherical Positional Attention (SPA) 组合 yaw 周期 RoPE 与切平面偏置，Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC) 施加 pre-sigmoid log-area 校正；在 RoMa V1 框架内实例化，保持冻结编码器、refiner 架构与损失不变，以分离骨架替换与球面先验的效果。
Result: Matterport3D 上 PCK@1° 由 0.229 提升至 0.275（固定粗匹配骨架、refiner 不变）；在统一 ERP 稠密匹配协议下超过 ERP 原生 EDM（0.163）与 ERP 重训的 RoMa V1（0.198）；透视训练的匹配器在 ERP 上基本失效；零样本迁移到 Stanford2D3D 有效，在户外 Holo360D 上训练后同样领先。
Conclusion: 三类球面畸变应在粗匹配接口处就地校正，而非留给 refiner；chart-naive 骨架加球面先验即可在 ERP 稠密匹配上取得中心结论所称的改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DraftTrace: A Multi-View Analytics Environment for AI-Integrated Writing
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI has changed how students produce writing assignments. The final artifact is no longer sufficient to understand the process through which it was produced. We introduce DraftTrace, a writing environment that jointly captures three complementary views of writing: the final product, the writing process and interactions with an integrated AI-assistant. DraftTrace reconstructs how a document develops over time and organizes these signals into submission, longitudinal, and class-level analytics for instructors. We deployed DraftTrace in a graduate NLP course with 81 students and compared their sessions with LLM-generated responses entered by automated tools and with copy-typed responses. While product measures distinguish differences in text formulation, process measures distinguish differences in how text is entered. Considering both views together helps characterize cases such as copy-typing. Interaction traces show that students use the assistant differently across stages of writing: to clarify the question at an early stage and to verify answers at a later stage. A preliminary instructor survey highlights the importance of multi-view writing analytics and their interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DraftTrace 是一个写作环境，同时记录最终文本、写作过程（文本如何被逐字输入）以及与内置 AI 助手的交互三重视图，并重组为提交级、纵向和班级级三类教师分析。在研究生 NLP 课程 81 名学生的部署中，产品度量区分文本表述差异，过程度量区分输入方式差异，两者结合可识别 copy-typing；交互轨迹显示学生早期用助手澄清题目、后期用它核对答案。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 改变了学生完成写作作业的方式，只看最终产物已无法还原其产生过程，教师缺少可解释的过程与 AI 使用证据。
Method: DraftTrace 联合捕获最终产物、写作过程、与集成 AI 助手的交互三重视图，重建文档随时间的形成过程，并组织成 submission、longitudinal、class-level 三类分析；在研究生 NLP 课程部署，比较学生会话与自动化工具输入的 LLM 回复及 copy-typed 回复，并做一次初步教师问卷。
Result: 在 81 名学生的研究生 NLP 课程部署中，产品度量能区分文本表述差异，过程度量能区分文本输入方式差异，两者结合可刻画 copy-typing 这类情形；交互轨迹显示学生在写作早期用助手澄清题目、后期用它核对答案；初步教师问卷强调多视图写作分析及其可解释性的重要。
Conclusion: 只看最终文本不足以刻画 AI 时代的学生写作，产品、过程与 AI 交互三视图合起来才能区分表述差异与输入方式差异，并解释学生在不同写作阶段如何使用助手。

papers.title: Reactive Real-Time Flow Policies via Asynchronous Distribution Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) have achieved remarkable generalization, but their inference delays can conflict with the demands of real-time control. Asynchronous execution avoids pauses between action chunks by predicting the next sequence of actions while the robot carries out the previous one. In this paper, we study whether asynchronous execution produces the same action distribution as the original VLA. We find that, for non-Markovian demonstrations, asynchronous execution can produce a fundamentally different action distribution, which can limit the policy's reactivity. In our method, we seek to restore this reactivity by aligning the asynchronously produced action distribution with that of the original VLA through two complementary mechanisms. First, Recursive Flow-Field Distillation trains the asynchronous policy using the VLA's action-generation flow. We characterize the learned distribution theoretically and show experimentally that our asynchronous policy can generate nearly the full range of actions the original VLA would produce, while existing asynchronous methods recover only a fraction of that range. Second, Propose-Resolve prepares multiple action sequences asynchronously and uses the latest observation to select among them based on a lightweight approximation of their likelihood under the VLA's action distribution. Our resulting method matches the original VLA's success on LIBERO and retains about 80% of its success on RoboMimic, about 30 percentage points more than existing asynchronous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 异步执行 VLA 会改变动作分布、削弱反应性；提出 Recursive Flow-Field Distillation 用 VLA 的动作生成 flow 训练异步策略，再用 Propose-Resolve 基于最新观测按 VLA 分布似然近似在多条候选动作序列中选择。在 LIBERO 上达到原 VLA 的成功率，在 RoboMimic 上保留约 80% 成功率，比现有异步方法高约 30 个百分点。
Motivation: VLA 推理延迟与实时控制冲突，异步执行虽消除动作块间停顿，但对非马尔可夫演示会产生与原 VLA 明显不同的动作分布，限制策略反应性。
Method: 两条互补机制：Recursive Flow-Field Distillation 借助 VLA 的 action-generation flow 训练异步策略并给出所学分布的理论刻画；Propose-Resolve 异步准备多条动作序列，用最新观测按其在 VLA 动作分布下的轻量似然近似做选择。
Result: 异步策略可生成原 VLA 动作范围的几乎全部，而现有异步方法只能恢复其中一部分；在 LIBERO 上匹配原 VLA 的成功率，在 RoboMimic 上保留约 80% 成功率，比现有异步方法高约 30 个百分点。
Conclusion: 异步执行对非马尔可斯演示会系统性偏移动作分布，通过 flow 蒸馏加似然选择的分布对齐可以恢复反应性并保住成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hierarchical Utility Calibration for Structured Multiclass Decisions
papers.abstract_en: In multiclass probabilistic prediction, Utility Calibration (UC), which focuses auditing on specified utilities, has recently received attention as a way to guarantee downstream decisions while controlling computational and sample requirements. At the same time, some multiclass problems have meaningful label hierarchies that play important roles in medicine and image classification, yet how UC evaluates utility within a hierarchy remains insufficiently understood. We show that the difference between realized utility and predicted mean utility admits an exact decomposition into a sum of contributions from the internal nodes of the label tree. This decomposition shows that positive and negative contributions from different nodes can cancel, and that even when UC is small, the utility errors remaining in parts of the hierarchy need not be small. To address this problem, we propose Hierarchical Utility Calibration (HUC), which evaluates each node contribution before summation while retaining the same target utility, subgroup, and predicted-utility interval. We further provide finite-sample evaluation over all predicted-utility intervals and propose HUC-Boost, which updates only violated internal nodes, with theoretical guarantees for both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在标签具有层级结构的多类概率预测中，Utility Calibration (UC) 的总体校准误差可精确分解为标签树各内部节点贡献之和，正负贡献会相互抵消，因此 UC 很小仍可能掩盖层级局部的效用误差。为此提出 Hierarchical Utility Calibration (HUC)：在求和前逐节点评估贡献，并给出覆盖所有预测效用区间的有限样本评估；HUC-Boost 只更新被违反的内部节点，两者均有理论保证。
Motivation: 多类问题中标签层级在医学与图像分类里很关键，但 UC 如何在层级内评估效用尚不清楚：节点间正负贡献抵消会让总体 UC 变小，而层级某些部分的效用误差仍然很大。
Method: 先证明实现效用与预测平均效用之差可精确分解为标签树内部节点贡献之和；再提出 HUC，在求和前对每个节点贡献单独评估，同时保持相同的目标效用、子群与预测效用区间；进一步给出覆盖全部预测效用区间的有限样本评估，并提出只更新被违反内部节点的 HUC-Boost，两者均附理论保证。
Result: 得到实现效用与预测平均效用之差按标签树内部节点的精确分解，显示不同节点的正负贡献可相互抵消，且即使 UC 很小，层级中残留的效用误差也不必小；HUC 与有限样本评估、HUC-Boost 均给出理论保证。
Conclusion: 总体 UC 不足以保证层级结构下的局部决策效用，须在求和前逐节点审计贡献；HUC-Boost 通过只修正被违反的节点来降低更新开销。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 先证明实现效用与预测平均效用之差可精确分解为标签树内部节点贡献之和；再提出 HUC，在求和前对每个节点贡献单独评估，同时保持相同的目标效用、子群与预测效用区间；进一步给出覆盖全部预测效用区间的有限样本评估，并提出只更新被违反内部节点的 HUC-Boost，两者均附理论保证。
summary_sections.result: 得到实现效用与预测平均效用之差按标签树内部节点的精确分解，显示不同节点的正负贡献可相互抵消，且即使 UC 很小，层级中残留的效用误差也不必小；HUC 与有限样本评估、HUC-Boost 均给出理论保证。
summary_sections.conclusion: 总体 UC 不足以保证层级结构下的局部决策效用，须在求和前逐节点审计贡献；HUC-Boost 通过只修正被违反的节点来降低更新开销。

papers.title: Foresight at the Event Boundary: Evaluating Physical Prediction in Video World Models
authors: Hugo Jair Escalante (2) ((1) National Autonomous University of Mexico
(2) University of Texas at El Paso)
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are largely regarded as predictive models of the physical world and are therefore expected to anticipate the consequences of observed events. However, evaluation has mainly focused on reference similarity, physical-law consistency, or judgment plausibility, estimating anticipation only indirectly. We address this directly: when a release or impact has just occurred but its consequence is withheld, can a world model anticipate what should happen next? We introduce an event-anchored evaluation based on 62 controlled real-world free-fall recordings and 124 clips spanning three object types, with fine-grained release and impact annotations and ground-truth trajectories. The protocol separates consequence production, temporal placement, and physical realization. Across six contemporary video generation and world models, Runway and Veo produce release and subsequent impact events at rates above 93% but often initiate them substantially late, whereas Cosmos-Predict-2.5 and MAGI-1 frequently preserve the pre-event state and produce little or no measurable consequence. Among measurable falls, plausible timing does not necessarily imply physically consistent motion. We further conduct a 15-participant, 20-condition human study in which participants describe the expected consequence from a single event-anchored frame and draw its trajectory. Human predictions favor the recorded future in aggregate while revealing genuine ambiguity among plausible continuations. Overall, physical foresight emerges as a sequence of distinct challenges: initiating a consequence, anchoring it in time, and realizing its motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出事件锚定 (event-anchored) 评测协议：在释放或撞击刚发生、后果被隐去的单帧上，检验视频世界模型能否预判接下来会发生什么。基于 62 段受控真实自由落体录像与 124 个片段（3 类物体），在六个当代视频生成/世界模型上，Runway 与 Veo 产生释放及后续撞击事件的比例超过 93% 但起始时间明显偏晚，Cosmos-Predict-2.5 与 MAGI-1 则常保持事件前状态、几乎不产生可测后果。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型评测只看参考相似度、物理律一致性或判断合理性，对“预判”只是间接估计；而模型在后果被隐去时能否预期下一步，才是其作为物理世界预测模型的核心能力。
Method: 构建事件锚定评测：用带精细释放/撞击标注与真实轨迹的 62 段受控自由落体录像、124 个片段（3 类物体），把评测拆成后果生成、时间定位、物理实现三个独立维度；另做 15 名参与者、20 条件的人类研究，让参与者看单帧事件锚定图并描述预期后果、画出轨迹。
Result: 六个模型中 Runway 与 Veo 生成释放与后续撞击事件的比例高于 93%，但起始时间大幅偏晚；Cosmos-Predict-2.5 与 MAGI-1 频繁保持事件前状态、几乎不产生可测后果；在可测的下落中，时间合理并不意味着运动物理一致。人类预测在总体上偏好录像中的真实未来，同时在多个合理延续之间存在真实歧义。
Conclusion: 物理预判不是单一能力，而是“启动后果、在时间上锚定、实现运动”三个可分离的挑战，评测必须把三者分开报告；时间合理不能替代运动一致性。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Triadic Linear Attention: Three-Dimensional Recurrent States for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) compress the historical context into a memory state of fixed size, thus allowing for constant-time inference. The memory state size is a crucial factor in their performance, as exemplified by the strong performance and resurgence of linear attention, which extends the vector-valued hidden states of ordinary RNNs to matrix-valued hidden states. Crucially, linear attention does so in a parameter-efficient way, in particular by using an outer product of the key and value vectors to write to the matrix-valued hidden state. We generalize this construction and propose triadic linear attention, which writes the triadic outer product of a key, a second key, and a value, into a third-order (i.e., 3D) tensor state, and reads from it by contracting both key axes with two queries. An $E$-dimensional second key thus yields an $E$-fold increase in state size while adding only two projections. Triadic linear attention is compatible with data-dependent forgetting, the delta rule, and chunkwise-parallel training. Applied to Gated DeltaNet and scalar-gated linear attention, triadic linear attention substantially improves long-context language modeling and recall, outperforming alternatives that enlarge the state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 triadic linear attention：把 key、第二个 key、value 的三阶外积写入 3D 张量状态，读取时用两个 query 分别收缩两条 key 轴。E 维第二 key 使状态容量扩大 E 倍而只多两个投影，并与 data-dependent forgetting、delta rule、chunkwise-parallel 训练兼容；接入 Gated DeltaNet 与 scalar-gated linear attention 后显著改善长上下文语言建模与 recall，胜过其他扩大状态的方案。
Motivation: RNN 把历史压进定长记忆态以实现常数时间推理，而记忆态大小直接决定性能；linear attention 用 key-value 外积把向量状态升到矩阵状态，但要在参数开销可控的前提下继续扩大状态容量并不容易。
Method: 把 linear attention 的二阶外积推广为三阶外积：写入 key、第二 key、value 的 triadic outer product 到 3D 张量状态，读取时用两个 query 收缩两条 key 轴；E 维第二 key 带来 E 倍状态扩容且只新增两个投影。方法与 data-dependent forgetting、delta rule、chunkwise-parallel 训练兼容，并实装到 Gated DeltaNet 和 scalar-gated linear attention 上。
Result: 在长上下文语言建模与 recall 任务上，triadic linear attention 相比原有版本以及其它扩大状态的替代方案有实质性提升；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用三阶张量状态加双 query 收缩是扩大 linear attention 记忆容量的参数高效路径，且不牺牲 delta rule 与并行训练等既有机制。

papers.title: SCOPE: Observation-Conditioned Full-Target Prediction for Sparse PDE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Recovering complete physical fields from sparse observations is challenging because the measurements may not uniquely determine the underlying state. Diffusion-based PDE solvers address this problem through iterative sampling whereas neural operators provide deterministic one-pass predictions. We propose SCOPE (Sparse-Context Observability-aware Predictive Embeddings) to recover complete PDE fields from sparse observations by coupling full-field latent prediction with physical reconstruction. A shared decoder reconstructs fields from both predicted and complete-view representations so that representation learning is guided by both physical recovery and latent matching. We derive a quadratic risk decomposition at fixed teacher-decoder pairs showing why optimal latent prediction need not yield optimal field reconstruction. We also establish sufficient conditions for decoder improvements on complete inputs to transfer to recovery from partial observations. Experiments across five PDE settings show that SCOPE outperforms mask-aware neural operators on all ten forward and inverse tasks and achieves lower errors than those reported for diffusion-based solvers including DiffusionPDE and FunDPS. Decoder-only adaptation further improves recovery without retraining the backbone while retaining deterministic single-pass inference.
papers.comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/SCOPE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE 把稀疏观测下的完整 PDE 场恢复拆成全场 latent 预测加物理重建：共享解码器同时从预测表示与完整视图表示重建场，使表示学习同时受物理恢复与 latent 匹配约束。在五个 PDE 设定的十个正/逆问题上，它在全部任务上超过 mask-aware neural operator，并低于 DiffusionPDE、FunDPS 等扩散式求解器所报告的误差，同时保持确定性单次前向推理。
Motivation: 稀疏测量未必唯一确定底层物理状态，扩散式求解器靠迭代采样代价高，神经算子的单次预测又缺少对部分观测恢复的约束。
Method: SCOPE (Sparse-Context Observability-aware Predictive Embeddings) 耦合全场 latent 预测与物理重建：共享解码器从预测表示和完整视图表示两路重建场；在固定 teacher-decoder 对下推导二次风险分解，说明最优 latent 预测不必给出最优场重建，并给出解码器在完整输入上的改进可迁移到部分观测恢复的充分条件；另用 decoder-only adaptation 在不重训 backbone 的情况下继续提升。
Result: 在五个 PDE 设定上，SCOPE 在全部十个 forward 与 inverse 任务上优于 mask-aware neural operator，并取得低于 DiffusionPDE、FunDPS 等扩散式求解器所报告的误差；decoder-only adaptation 在不重训 backbone 的前提下进一步降低恢复误差，且保持确定性单次推理。
Conclusion: 把 latent 预测与物理重建用共享解码器绑在一起，可以在保持单次前向推理的同时，把稀疏观测下的 PDE 场恢复做到优于 mask-aware 神经算子与已报告的扩散式求解器误差。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Adapting Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents with Counterfactual Continuations
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents require context compression to manage growing interaction histories. Compression quality, however, is ultimately determined by downstream execution. Existing prompt-adaptation methods infer compression errors by comparing full-context and compressed trajectories. Such comparisons cannot isolate individual compressions and are confounded by agent stochasticity. We first find that compression degrades reliability before solvability. Using matched counterfactual continuations that compare execution from the same agent state with versus without compression, we further show that severe degradation concentrates at isolated compression events. Motivated by this finding, we propose PAIR (Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts) for adapting structured compression prompts. PAIR identifies individual compressions that degrade subsequent execution, diagnoses their effects, and revises the relevant sections of a fixed compression template. PAIR achieves the strongest cross-run reliability among compressed methods in every main benchmark-scope combination, consistently exceeding the competing prompt-adaptation baseline. Without modifying the downstream agent, PAIR brings compressed execution close to the no-compression baseline and sometimes numerically exceeds it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长程 agent 的上下文压缩质量只能由下游执行判定，而现有 prompt-adaptation 用全上下文与压缩轨迹对比，无法定位单次压缩且被 agent 随机性混淆。作者用同一起始状态、有无压缩的配对反事实续跑 (matched counterfactual continuations) 发现：压缩先损害可靠性 (reliability) 再损害可解性 (solvability)，且严重退化集中在孤立的压缩事件上。据此提出 PAIR，逐个识别拖累执行的压缩、诊断其影响并改写固定压缩模板的相关段落，在每个主 benchmark-scope 组合上取得压缩方法中最强的跨 run 可靠性，稳定超过竞争的 prompt-adaptation 基线，不改动下游 agent 即可把压缩执行拉近无压缩基线，个别情况数值上还超过它。
Motivation: 长程 agent 的交互历史不断增长，必须压缩；但现有方法靠全上下文与压缩轨迹的对比来推断压缩错误，这种对比既无法隔离单次压缩，又会被 agent 自身的随机性混淆，导致压缩质量的归因不可靠。
Method: 先构造 matched counterfactual continuations：从同一个 agent 状态分别在有压缩与无压缩下续跑，做配对比较以隔离单次压缩的因果效应。基于“退化集中在孤立压缩事件”的发现，提出 PAIR (Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts)：识别拖累后续执行的单个压缩，诊断其影响，再改写一个固定压缩模板 (fixed compression template) 的相关段落，且不修改下游 agent。
Result: PAIR 在每一个主 benchmark-scope 组合上都取得压缩方法中最强的跨 run 可靠性，持续超过参与比较的 prompt-adaptation 基线；在不改动下游 agent 的前提下把压缩执行拉近无压缩 (no-compression) 基线，个别情形数值上超过无压缩基线。配对反事实续跑显示压缩先降低 reliability 再降低 solvability，严重退化集中于孤立压缩事件。
Conclusion: 压缩的伤害应按单次事件、用配对反事实续跑来归因，而不是靠全上下文与压缩轨迹的整体对比；按此诊断去改写压缩模板的对应段落，就能在不改 agent 的情况下把压缩执行恢复到接近无压缩的水平。
Relevance: 0
