summary_sections.conclusion: 压缩的伤害应按单次事件、用配对反事实续跑来归因，而不是靠全上下文与压缩轨迹的整体对比；按此诊断去改写压缩模板的对应段落，就能在不改 agent 的情况下把压缩执行恢复到接近无压缩的水平。

papers.title: Reliability Testing of Medical Model Performance under Distributed Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Distributed inference has become an indispensable part of deploying medical models under practical latency, memory, and throughput constraints. Although modern frameworks improve serving efficiency through tensor parallelism, mixed precision, kernel fusion, and multi-device communication, they are generally assumed to preserve the behavior observed during centralized HuggingFace evaluation. This assumption creates an evaluation-deployment mismatch: a model may pass offline evaluation but produce a different output after the execution stack changes. To address this mismatch, we propose a testing framework and an improved, distributed-execution-sensitive medical-model benchmark that evaluates the same checkpoint and input under a centralized HuggingFace reference and matched distributed deployments. Extensive experiments across language, vision, and multimodal medical models show that execution changes can produce measurable output disagreements. Across supported visual settings, the test success rate ranges from 0.21 to 0.43 for single-modality models and from 0.32 to 0.98 for multimodal models. The benchmark is aimed at extending medical-model evaluation from capability and security to evaluation-deployment consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分布式执行敏感的医疗模型测试框架：同一 checkpoint 与输入分别跑集中式 HuggingFace 参考栈和匹配的分布式部署栈，直接比对输出是否一致。跨语言、视觉与多模态医疗模型的实验显示执行栈变化会造成可测的输出分歧，测试成功率在单模态模型为 0.21–0.43、多模态模型为 0.32–0.98。
Motivation: 张量并行、混合精度、kernel fusion 等分布式推理优化被默认不改变模型行为，但离线评测通过的模型换执行栈后可能输出不同，形成评测与部署不一致。
Method: 提出测试框架与改进的分布式执行敏感医疗模型 benchmark：对同一 checkpoint 和输入，分别在集中式 HuggingFace 参考实现与匹配的分布式部署配置下执行并比对输出，覆盖语言、视觉与多模态医疗模型。
Result: 在受支持的视觉设置下，单模态模型测试成功率 0.21–0.43，多模态模型 0.32–0.98；执行栈变化在语言、视觉、多模态医疗模型上均产生可测的输出不一致。
Conclusion: 医疗模型评测应从能力与安全扩展到评测-部署一致性，分布式部署下的行为差异必须单独检验。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: PDE-OBS: Controlled Evaluation Across Observation Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Physical-field reconstruction and forecasting depend on both measurement density and spatial layout, yet evaluation under a single observation pattern does not characterize performance when that pattern changes. We introduce PDE-OBS, an integrated benchmarking platform spanning numerical data generation, model training, and inference and evaluation under varying observation conditions. It combines 560,000 fields and trajectories from seven partial differential equation families with configurable observation operators and seven adapted baseline methods for stationary reconstruction and short-horizon forecasting. Separating observation construction from physical records allows users to specify parameterized patterns and deterministic mixtures for training and testing while preserving prediction targets and data splits. The evaluation protocol uses references trained for each test pattern to compare models on identical test observations and targets, alongside equal-count groups for spatial-layout comparisons. On a 14,000-record subset, we evaluate 441 trained models under nine test patterns, yielding 3,969 evaluations. Mean cross-pattern error exceeds mean matched-pattern error in all 49 PDE-method pairs, and this finding persists in a configuration-matched subset of 117 models. Denser test observations do not consistently reduce error for a fixed model. Mixed-pattern training on five completed pairs reduces large single-pattern transfer errors, although destination-trained references usually remain more accurate. Together, the benchmark and findings support systematic evaluation of observation-pattern sensitivity and provide a reusable workflow for developing methods under changing measurement conditions. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/PDE-OBS.
papers.comment: 57 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/PDE-OBS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDE-OBS 是一个把观测构造与物理记录分离的基准平台，在七类 PDE 的 560,000 条场/轨迹上用可配置观测算子与九种测试观测模式评测 441 个训练模型（共 3,969 次评测）。全部 49 个 PDE-方法组合中跨模式误差都高于匹配模式误差，且对固定模型而言更密的测试观测并不稳定降低误差；混合模式训练能压低单模式迁移的大误差，但目标模式训练的参考模型通常仍更准。
Motivation: 物理场重建与预报的评测通常只在单一观测模式下进行，一旦观测密度或空间布局改变，性能结论就不再成立；缺少能系统分离观测构造与预测目标的评测环境。
Method: 平台整合数值数据生成、模型训练与推理评测：提供可配置观测算子与参数化/确定性混合的观测模式，同时保持预测目标与数据划分不变；评测协议为每个测试模式训练参考模型，使被评模型与参考在同一测试观测和目标上比较，并设置等计数组做空间布局对比。含七个 PDE 族的 560,000 条场与轨迹、七个适配的基线方法，覆盖稳态重建与短时预报。
Result: 在 14,000 条记录子集上评测 441 个训练模型、九种测试模式，共 3,969 次评测：全部 49 个 PDE-方法组合中平均跨模式误差高于平均匹配模式误差，该结论在 117 个配置匹配的模型子集中依然成立；对固定模型，更密的测试观测不一致地降低误差；在五个已完成配对上做混合模式训练可降低大的单模式迁移误差，但目标模式训练的参考模型通常仍更准确。
Conclusion: 观测模式敏感性必须作为独立维度评测：单一模式下的精度不能外推到模式变化的场景，而混合模式训练只能部分弥合迁移差距，目标模式专属训练仍占优。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Distilling Privileged Control Barrier Functions into RGB-Only Safety Filters for Dynamic Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: RGB-only end-to-end visual navigation policies remain vulnerable to collisions in real-world dynamic environments, motivating a dedicated safety layer. Existing visual Control Barrier Function (CBF) approaches seek to provide safety from RGB observations, but often rely on real-time rendering or explicit scene reconstruction and are primarily designed for static scenes, limiting their practicality for onboard deployment. We propose a teacher-student visual distillation framework that transfers the safety behavior of a privileged CBF teacher to an RGB-only student filter for dynamic environments. The student maps a short RGB history, robot velocity, and a nominal control action directly to a safe action, while the teacher uses ground-truth robot and obstacle states in a real-to-sim dynamic Gaussian Splatting environment. To reduce the teacher-student information gap, the teacher constructs safety constraints only from obstacles observable within the student's RGB history. It also accounts for obstacle-velocity uncertainty to improve robustness to motion variations, while action augmentation exposes the student to diverse safe and unsafe nominal actions to better capture the safety boundary. At deployment, the student requires only RGB observations and robot velocity, without explicit 3D reconstruction or online rendering. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms visual CBF baselines and improves the safety of RGB-based navigation policies under dynamic obstacle motion. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把使用真值机器人与障碍物状态的特权 Control Barrier Function (CBF) 教师，蒸馏成只吃 RGB 历史与机器人速度的安全滤波器，用于动态障碍下的视觉导航。教师只用学生 RGB 历史可见的障碍构造约束，并显式处理障碍速度不确定性，配合动作增强覆盖安全边界；部署时无需 3D 重建或在线渲染。实验显示该方法优于视觉 CBF 基线，提升了动态障碍运动下 RGB 导航策略的安全性。
Motivation: RGB-only 端到端导航策略在真实动态环境中易碰撞；现有视觉 CBF 依赖实时渲染或显式场景重建且面向静态场景，难以板载部署。
Method: 教师-学生视觉蒸馏框架：教师在 real-to-sim 动态 Gaussian Splatting 环境中用真值机器人与障碍状态构造 CBF 安全约束，且只取学生 RGB 历史可见的障碍，并纳入障碍速度不确定性；学生将短 RGB 历史、机器人速度与标称控制动作直接映射为安全动作，训练用动作增强暴露多样安全/不安全标称动作。
Result: 实验显示该方法在动态障碍运动下优于视觉 CBF 基线，并提升了 RGB 导航策略的安全性；部署时学生仅需 RGB 观测与机器人速度，无需显式 3D 重建或在线渲染。
Conclusion: 特权 CBF 的安全行为可以蒸馏进 RGB-only 滤波器，从而把视觉 CBF 从依赖渲染与重建的静态设定推到可板载部署的动态场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LIBERO-MAX: Do Robot Policies Adapt When the World Changes?
papers.abstract_en: Robots must often continue a task after a target moves, the viewpoint shifts, or an obstacle appears, even though their earlier observations and committed actions reflect the previous scene. Many simulation robustness benchmarks fix external conditions at reset, leaving this temporal challenge underexamined. We introduce LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark of 8,000 paired cases spanning eight types of changes to geometry, observations, appearance, clutter, and paths. Each pair compares task execution with and without a mid-task event, holding the task, initial state, policy seed, and pre-event action sequence fixed. This controlled comparison distinguishes event-associated regressions from failures already present without the change. Across fourteen current VLA, hybrid, and world-action policies, events reduce success by 11.0-25.7 percentage points. Event profiles reveal shared vulnerabilities to geometry and observation changes, while policy-family rankings interleave. Camera controls show that robustness reflects both competence under the changed conditions and the trajectory from which they are encountered; varying query cadence does not eliminate the gap. Together, the paired protocol and temporal diagnostics establish LIBERO-MAX as a reproducible testbed for diagnosing failures under mid-execution changes and measuring progress toward robot policies that remain effective as the world changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIBERO-MAX 是一个机器人策略中途世界变化基准：8,000 组配对案例覆盖几何、观测、外观、杂乱与路径八类变化，每对固定任务、初始状态、策略种子与事件前动作序列，只改变是否插入中途事件。在 14 个 VLA、混合与 world-action 策略上，事件使成功率下降 11.0–25.7 个百分点，几何与观测变化是共同脆弱点，改变查询频率 (query cadence) 也无法消除该差距。
Motivation: 现有仿真鲁棒性基准在 reset 时固定外部条件，无法区分策略是本身能力不足，还是因任务中途的目标移动、视角变化、障碍出现而退化。
Method: 构建 8,000 组配对案例，每组对比有/无中途事件的执行，固定任务、初始状态、策略种子与事件前动作序列，从而把事件相关退化与无变化时已存在的失败分离；辅以事件画像 (event profiles) 与相机控制变量实验，考察能力与遭遇轨迹两条来源。
Result: 在 14 个当前 VLA、hybrid 与 world-action 策略上，中途事件使成功率下降 11.0–25.7 个百分点；事件画像显示各策略在几何与观测变化上共享脆弱性，且不同策略族排名互相交错；相机控制实验表明鲁棒性同时取决于变化后条件下的能力与遭遇变化时的轨迹，改变 query cadence 不能消除该差距。
Conclusion: 中途世界变化是独立于静态鲁棒性的失败来源，配对协议与事件画像可作为诊断执行中变化下失效、并衡量策略持续有效进展的可复现测试床。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Large-scale factor analysis shows machine intelligence is only partially interpretable
papers.abstract_en: A common assumption in language model development is that cognitive abilities are organized around a general, domain-free intelligence factor, like fluid intelligence in humans. This assumption is rarely tested directly, and prior attempts have done so only at a much smaller scale. We take a latent variable approach to intelligence in language models, similar to how psychometricians study psychological constructs. Performance in every specific problem set is influenced by a domain-specific and a domain-agnostic latent factor. Using factor analysis as a dimension-reduction technique, we analyzed 13,251 published evaluation scores covering 1,618 language models across 456 different text-only benchmarks. Due to the super-sparse nature of the dataset, we triangulate our analysis across different data densifiers and imputation methods. A robust pattern across different modes of bias is that 1. A general intelligence factor accounts for 70.8% of variance in model performance at our most generous estimate, and far less than that in most of our solutions, 2. Content-similar benchmarks do not necessarily cluster together, and 3. The $g$ factor is not dominated by any common theme, and there is a lack of evidence that it is well-proxied by standard "intelligence" benchmarks. Our findings go against current endeavors of defining, identifying, and targeting general intelligence as a tangible construct in language model development. This leaves the strategy of targeting a single conceptual ability without support, since the first-order abilities it would have to reach are often partially idiosyncratic and not identifiable in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 1,618 个语言模型在 456 个纯文本基准上的 13,251 个公开评测分数做因子分析，检验 LLM 是否存在类似人类流体智力的通用 g 因子。最宽松估计下通用智能因子只解释 70.8% 的表现方差，多数解法下更低；内容相近的基准并不聚在一起，g 因子也不被任何共同主题主导。结论是把通用智能当作可直接瞄准的单一构念缺乏支持。
Motivation: 语言模型开发普遍假设能力围绕一个领域无关的通用智能因子组织，类似人类流体智力，但此前的直接检验规模都很小，该假设在大规模上未被验证。
Method: 采用心理测量学式的潜变量方法，把每个题集表现分解为领域特异与领域无关两个潜因子，用因子分析做降维；针对数据极度稀疏的问题，在多种数据增密 (data densifier) 与插补方法之间做三角互证，以覆盖不同偏差模式。
Result: 分析覆盖 13,251 个公开评测分数、1,618 个语言模型、456 个纯文本基准；最宽松估计下通用智能因子解释模型表现 70.8% 的方差，多数解法下显著更低；内容相似的基准不必然聚类，g 因子不被任何常见主题主导，且缺乏证据表明标准“intelligence”基准能很好代理它。
Conclusion: 通用智能在语言模型中只是部分可解释的构念，围绕单一概念能力制定开发策略缺乏依据，因为它需要触及的一阶能力往往部分特异且实践中不可辨识。

papers.title: BRIDGE: Bilevel Retrieval-Credit-Aware Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (ARL) with verifiable rewards improves the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks by learning to interleave search and reasoning. However, most existing ARL methods optimize only LLM-generated tokens and treat retrieved evidence as environment observations. This creates an information-credit gap: failures caused by missing or misleading evidence are attributed to the LLM policy rather than to the retriever, which motivates training the LLM and the retriever jointly. In this paper, we show that retrieval and LLM policy learning are order-sensitive: adapting the retriever before optimizing the policy yields a larger reward gain than the reverse order. To preserve this hierarchy while allowing both components to co-adapt, we formulate retrieval-augmented agentic RL as a bilevel optimization problem. To solve it efficiently, we introduce BRIDGE, a memory-efficient first-order bilevel method motivated by a loss-landscape analysis of the RL and retrieval objectives. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks, BRIDGE achieves the highest average accuracy with both 3B and 7B backbones, improving the multi-hop average over the strongest baseline by 9.6 and 3.4 EM points, respectively. It also achieves the best averaged answer accuracy and reasoning quality across medical QA benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BRIDGE 把检索增强的 agentic RL 写成双层优化：先调 retriever 再优化 LLM policy 的顺序带来更大奖励增益，据此设计内存高效的一阶双层方法。在七个开放域 QA 基准上，3B 与 7B backbone 均取得最高平均准确率，多跳平均 EM 分别比最强基线高 9.6 与 3.4 点。
Motivation: 现有 ARL 只优化 LLM 生成的 token、把检索证据当环境观测，导致由缺失或误导证据造成的失败被归咎于 policy 而非 retriever，形成 information-credit gap，无法联合训练两者。
Method: 将检索增强 agentic RL 形式化为双层优化，保留先调 retriever 后优化 policy 的顺序敏感层级；求解用基于 RL 与检索目标损失面分析的内存高效一阶双层方法 BRIDGE，使两组件可共同适应。
Result: 在七个开放域 QA 基准上，BRIDGE 用 3B 与 7B backbone 均取得最高平均准确率，多跳平均 EM 分别比最强基线提高 9.6 与 3.4 点；在医学 QA 基准上取得最佳平均答案准确率与推理质量。
Conclusion: 检索与 policy 学习存在顺序敏感的层级关系，按双层优化联合训练 retriever 与 LLM 可同时提升答案准确率与推理质量，且跨 3B/7B 规模与医学 QA 成立。

papers.title: Efficient and Scalable Physics-Guided Fully Convolutional Spatiotemporal Learning for 3D Microstructure Evolution Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of three-dimensional (3D) microstructure evolution remains computationally demanding because high-fidelity phase-field simulations require repeated numerical integration over large volumetric domains and long temporal horizons. This study develops an efficient and scalable physics-guided fully convolutional spatiotemporal framework for direct multi-frame prediction of complete 3D microstructure sequences. The model combines shared 3D spatial encoding and decoding with a factorized latent translator that integrates temporal, local 3D spatial, and channel interactions. A discrete Cahn--Hilliard (CH) residual is incorporated during training to regularize the learned evolution toward the governing dynamics without altering the inference pathway. The framework is evaluated on high-resolution 3D spinodal-decomposition trajectories under nominal, long-horizon, and reduced-temporal-context forecasting. Under full temporal context, the model accurately reproduces volumetric evolution, with average 3D structural similarity remaining above 0.97 over the nominal prediction horizon. Physics guidance becomes increasingly beneficial as temporal information is reduced, improving predictive robustness and preservation of interface-level morphology. The framework also achieves more than a 30-fold wall-clock speedup relative to the reference spectral phase-field solver, while physics guidance introduces no additional inference cost. These results establish direct multi-frame, physics-guided fully convolutional learning as a high-throughput surrogate strategy for dense 3D phase-field dynamics and repeated microstructure forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理引导的全卷积时空网络，直接多帧预测完整 3D 微结构序列：共享 3D 编解码器加分解式 latent translator（时间、局部 3D 空间、通道交互），训练时加入离散 Cahn--Hilliard 残差正则化演化而不改推理路径。在 3D spinodal decomposition 轨迹上，全时间上下文时平均 3D 结构相似度在名义预测时段保持 0.97 以上，相对参考谱方法 phase-field 求解器加速 30 倍以上，且物理引导不增加推理开销；时间信息越少，物理引导的收益越大。
Motivation: 高保真 phase-field 模拟需在大体积域和长时间跨度上反复数值积分，3D 微结构演化预测计算代价高，需要高通量代理模型。
Method: 共享 3D 空间编码器与解码器，中间用分解式 latent translator 融合时间、局部 3D 空间与通道交互做直接多帧预测；训练阶段加入离散 Cahn--Hilliard 残差项把学习到的演化向控制方程正则化，推理通路不变。
Result: 在高分辨率 3D spinodal-decomposition 轨迹的名义、长时段与缩减时间上下文三类预测设置下评测：全时间上下文时名义预测时段内平均 3D 结构相似度保持在 0.97 以上；相对参考谱 phase-field 求解器 wall-clock 加速超过 30 倍；物理引导不带来额外推理开销，且时间上下文缩减时其对界面形貌保持的收益增大。
Conclusion: 物理引导的直接多帧全卷积学习可作为稠密 3D phase-field 动力学与重复微结构预报的高通量代理策略，时间上下文越短越需要物理残差约束。

papers.title: AVIO: Learning to Add and Remove Sounding Objects in Audiovisual Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Adding or removing a sounding object requires coordinated changes to visual content and sound while preserving the surrounding scene. Yet paired supervision for localized non-speech audiovisual editing remains limited, as visual and acoustic edits must target the same object and isolate its sound from overlapping sources. To address this gap, we introduce \textit{AVIOBench}, a dataset comprising 37.9 hours of paired audiovisual examples spanning 1{,}878 target-object names. AVIOBench links the visual presence and acoustic contribution of each target object through a shared identity and visual mask. Our automated pipeline uses visual grounding and cross-modal consistency to select target-sound removal candidates, then jointly refines the audiovisual pairs to improve perceptual quality and cross-modal consistency. Building on this dataset, we propose \textit{AVIO}, which adapts a pretrained text-to audiovisual generation model through source-conditioned feature modulation to jointly learn object addition and removal. A reference-frame curriculum gradually reduces reference conditioning during training, enabling one model to perform instruction-only editing with optional visual guidance. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate effective audiovisual object removal and addition, with optional reference guidance providing appearance and placement control for addition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVIO 针对视听场景中增删发声对象的局部编辑，提出 AVIOBench 数据集（37.9 小时配对样本、1,878 个目标物体名，用共享身份与视觉 mask 关联视觉出现与声学贡献），并以源条件特征调制改造预训练 text-to-audiovisual 生成模型，配合逐步降低参考条件的 reference-frame curriculum，用单一模型实现仅凭指令的增删编辑，可选参考帧提供外观与位置控制。
Motivation: 局部非语音视听编辑缺少配对监督：视觉与声学编辑须指向同一物体，并把该物体声音从重叠声源中分离出来。
Method: AVIOBench 用自动化流程先以 visual grounding 与跨模态一致性筛选目标声音移除候选，再联合精修视听对以提升感知质量与跨模态一致性；AVIO 以 source-conditioned feature modulation 改造预训练 text-to-audiovisual 生成模型，联合学习物体添加与移除，reference-frame curriculum 在训练中逐步减弱参考条件，得到支持可选视觉引导的指令式编辑。
Result: 定量与定性评测显示有效的视听物体移除与添加；添加任务中可选参考引导提供外观与位置控制。数据集规模为 37.9 小时配对样本、覆盖 1,878 个目标物体名。
Conclusion: 以共享身份与视觉 mask 绑定视觉和声学贡献的配对数据，加上逐步退火参考条件的单一模型，可支持指令驱动的视听对象增删并保留周围场景。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Towards Breaking the Learning System Wall Using Multimodal Tutoring Transcriptions
papers.abstract_en: Past research using log data has faced the "learning system wall," whereby few methods exist for generalizing models of student learning across platforms. Increasingly, online learning is captured by richer forms of data, including dialog and video, with new affordances. An example of this is remote tutoring programs, where human tutors support students who use learning systems while video conferencing. Toward better platform-general modeling of learning, we introduce an AI-driven multimodal transcription system that processes screen-recording videos into unified screenplay-style transcripts containing audio dialogue and annotated learning log actions. We describe a planned method for temporally aligning AI-generated multimodal transcripts with MATHia learning logs and for identifying and classifying student learning processes to align with MATHia logs. Lastly, we highlight challenges and potential solutions in capturing learning processes in one system, offering initial steps towards generalizing log data across diverse systems.
papers.comment: Full paper accepted to the AIME Conference 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向跨平台学习建模的多模态辅导转录系统，把远程辅导的屏幕录制视频转成统一的 screenplay 式转录稿，内含音频对话与标注后的学习日志动作，并给出将该转录与 MATHia 学习日志做时间对齐、识别与分类学生学习过程的计划方法。
Motivation: 学习日志数据研究卡在 learning system wall：几乎没有方法能把学生学习模型跨平台泛化，而对话、视频等更丰富的数据形态尚未被利用起来。
Method: AI 驱动的多模态转录管线处理屏幕录制视频，输出含音频对话和标注学习日志动作的统一 screenplay 式转录；随后计划将 AI 生成的多模态转录与 MATHia 学习日志做时间对齐，并识别、分类学生学习过程以匹配 MATHia 日志。
Result: 论文给出系统与计划方法的描述，并梳理在同一系统中捕捉学习过程的挑战与潜在解决方案，作为跨系统泛化日志数据的初步步骤。
Conclusion: 把对话与日志动作统一进一份时间对齐的转录，是迈向跨平台泛化学习日志数据的可行第一步。

papers.title: InterBias-SV: Compound Conditions in Speaker Verification
papers.abstract_en: Speaker verification systems encounter combinations of noise, channel distortion, and changes in speech. Evaluating each condition separately does not establish whether their effects add. InterBias-SV organises this question around a four-term comparison: joint error, two marginal errors, and a common reference. Its results artefact contains 4,068 scored records across 17 experiments, 12 encoder labels, and six speech corpora, totalling 12 million trial evaluations. Three experiment families contain the same-corpus terms needed to compute additive contrasts. For labels assigned to speaker-trained encoders, their mean contrasts are +0.0026, +0.0088, and +0.0024 in equal error rate (EER), with larger variation across settings. These descriptive averages do not establish equivalence to additivity: trial matching, checkpoint identity, and parts of the condition metadata remain unverified. We also examine two interpretation problems. Near-chance EER can make additive predictions difficult to interpret, but chance performance is not a hard EER ceiling, and correlation with the prediction does not identify a saturation mechanism. Ratios of demographic gaps are unstable when their clean reference is near zero; absolute gaps provide a more direct summary. The benchmark provides condition definitions, analysis scripts, and explicit requirements for interpretable compound-condition comparisons, while separating recomputable summaries from claims that require further experimental validation.

TL;DR: InterBias-SV 把说话人验证中噪声、信道失真与说话人变化的复合条件组织成四项对比：联合误差、两个边际误差与一个共同参照。在 4,068 条打分记录、17 组实验、12 个编码器标签、6 个语音语料、共 1,200 万次 trial 评测上，说话人训练编码器的平均 EER 加性对比为 +0.0026、+0.0088、+0.0024，但作者明确指出这些描述性均值不足以确立可加性。
Motivation: 现有评估逐个条件单独测试噪声、信道与说话变化，无法判断各条件效应是否相加；复合条件比较又常因 trial 匹配、checkpoint 身份与条件元数据不完整而不可解释。
Method: 以四项对比（联合误差、两个边际误差、共同参照）组织复合条件问题；产出含 4,068 条打分记录、17 组实验、12 个编码器标签、6 个语音语料的 results artefact，其中三类实验族提供计算加性对比所需的同语料项；同时给出条件定义、分析脚本与可解释复合条件比较的显式要求。
Result: 说话人训练编码器标签的平均 EER 加性对比为 +0.0026、+0.0088、+0.0024，跨设置变异更大；规模为 4,068 条打分记录、17 组实验、12 个编码器标签、6 个语料、1,200 万次 trial 评测。另指出近随机 EER 使加性预测难以解释但并非 EER 硬上界，人口统计差距的比值在 clean 参照接近零时不稳定，应改用绝对差距。

papers.title: Reimagine Video Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Most video editing methods focus on changing the appearance of the source video, while offering limited control over its dynamics. We introduce Reimagine Video Dynamics (RVD), a framework that disentangles a compact, editable dynamics token from visual context. We learn this token through self-supervised reconstruction: given the first frame as visual context, a renderer must recover the original video from the dynamics token, encouraging it to capture how the scene evolves rather than how it looks. This disentanglement allows video dynamics to be edited directly while preserving visual context. We develop a language-guided dynamics-token editor that transforms source dynamics into target dynamics, and train it with a scalable counterfactual video-pair pipeline and a two-stage training strategy. Extensive experiments show that RVD enables effective video dynamics editing, training-free retiming, and appearance-controlled re-rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RVD 把视频的动态与外观解耦成一个紧凑可编辑的 dynamics token：以首帧为视觉上下文，渲染器仅凭该 token 自监督重建原视频，从而只编码场景如何演化而非长什么样。再用语言引导的编辑器把源动态改写为目标动态，配合可扩展的反事实视频对管线与两阶段训练，实现动态编辑、免训练重定时 (training-free retiming) 与外观可控重渲染。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法主要改外观，对动态本身几乎没有控制手段，无法直接改写一段视频的运动过程。
Method: RVD 通过自监督重建学习 dynamics token：输入首帧作为视觉上下文，渲染器须仅凭该 token 恢复原视频；其上接一个语言引导的 dynamics-token editor，把源动态变换为目标动态，训练采用可扩展的反事实视频对 (counterfactual video-pair) 管线与两阶段训练策略。
Result: 大量实验显示 RVD 支持有效的视频动态编辑、免训练重定时以及外观可控重渲染；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把动态压缩为独立于外观的可编辑 token，可以在保留视觉上下文的前提下直接改写视频动态，并复用同一动态做重定时与重渲染。

papers.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Synapse Detection and Proofreading in Connectomics
papers.abstract_en: We benchmarked vision-language models (VLMs) on the decisions annotators take when inspecting electron microscopy images in connectomics: synapse detection (presence and polarity) and proofreading (split errors and merge errors). For synapse detection, we evaluated 19 open and 2 closed models across various architectures and sizes under zero-shot, four-shot in-context learning and LoRA settings, against specialist models, on datasets constructed by us using public resources. For proofreading, we evaluated 3 open and 2 closed models on the ConnectomeBench2 dataset, with cross-species transfer from fly and mouse to human and zebrafish. Most models were at chance zero-shot; a few examples helped mainly the closed and largest open ones. LoRA on a few thousand labels brought open models level with specialist models. When evaluated on unseen species, the best adapted VLMs outperformed specialist models trained on the same data in identifying merge errors. The project will be publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在连接组学 (connectomics) 电子显微镜图像上系统评测视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的突触检测与校对决策：19 个开源加 2 个闭源模型在 zero-shot、four-shot ICL 与 LoRA 三种设定下对比专用模型，多数模型 zero-shot 处于随机水平，几千条标签的 LoRA 即可让开源模型追平专用模型，且在未见物种上识别 merge errors 更好。
Motivation: 连接组学标注中突触检测与 split/merge 错误校对依赖人工审阅，专用模型跨物种迁移差；VLM 能否接手这类判读决策此前缺少统一基准。
Method: 突触检测部分评测 19 个开源与 2 个闭源模型，覆盖多种架构与规模，采用 zero-shot、four-shot in-context learning 与 LoRA 三种设定，对照专用模型，数据集由作者用公开资源构建；校对部分在 ConnectomeBench2 上评测 3 个开源与 2 个闭源模型，并做从果蝇、小鼠到人与斑马鱼的跨物种迁移。
Result: 多数模型 zero-shot 处于随机水平；少量示例主要帮助闭源与最大的开源模型；用几千条标签做 LoRA 后开源模型追平专用模型；在未见物种上，最好的适配 VLM 在识别 merge errors 时优于用相同数据训练的专用模型。
Conclusion: VLM 需要少量示例或轻量微调才能胜任突触检测与校对，而适配后的 VLM 在跨物种 merge error 识别上已超过同数据训练的专用模型。

papers.title: LLMs Learn to Evade Latent Monitors from Prior Feedback Alone
papers.abstract_en: Latent space monitors aim to detect undesired behaviors in LLM agents by inspecting an agent's internal activations rather than its outputs. However, interactive monitoring creates a feedback channel where each verdict the monitor delivers leaks information to the model about how its internal states are being evaluated. We ask whether an agent can infer the monitor's decision rule from this feedback and then selectively edit its activations to evade detection. Unlike prior evasion attacks, the model is never explicitly told what the monitor detects. Surprisingly, off-the-shelf models already produce activation edits aligned with the monitored direction, but at insufficient magnitude for evasion. Simply scaling up these edits by a factor of 8 reduces the monitor's TPR from 100% to 27%. A rank-1 LoRA amplifies this behavior into effective evasion within the forward pass, reducing TPR further to 4% on held-out concept monitors while leaving other concepts at their normal detection rates. Capabilities on standard benchmarks are retained under this finetuning, and the evasion skill survives retraining the monitors on the new activations. Mechanistically, we find evidence that the model computes its activation edit from the prior in-context turns, and show that the edit becomes more aligned with the monitored direction as more examples are provided. These results demonstrate feedback-conditioned control over activations and suggest that latent monitoring should be treated as an interactive process in which agents can observe and respond to oversight measures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 智能体能从交互式 latent monitor 的历史判定中反推其决策规则，并据此选择性编辑自身激活以规避检测：现成模型已产生与被监控方向对齐的激活编辑，仅把幅度放大 8 倍就让 monitor 的 TPR 从 100% 降到 27%，再用 rank-1 LoRA 在前向传播内放大后，held-out concept monitor 上 TPR 进一步降到 4%。作者主张 latent monitoring 必须当作交互过程对待，因为智能体能观察并回应监督。
Motivation: latent space monitor 靠检查内部激活而非输出检测 LLM 智能体的不良行为，但每次判定都会向模型泄漏其内部状态被如何评估的信息；此前的规避攻击都显式告知模型 monitor 检测什么，而真实交互场景下模型并未被告知。
Method: 让模型从交互历史（prior in-context turns）中的 monitor 判定里自行推断决策规则，产生与被监控方向对齐的激活编辑；再用 rank-1 LoRA 微调把该编辑放大到前向传播内生效，并在 held-out concept monitors 上检验，同时用机制分析追踪编辑如何由上下文例子构成。
Result: 现成模型已输出与被监控方向对齐但幅度不足的激活编辑；把编辑幅度放大 8 倍使 monitor TPR 从 100% 降至 27%；rank-1 LoRA 微调后在 held-out concept monitors 上 TPR 进一步降至 4%，而其他概念仍保持正常检出率；标准 benchmark 能力在该微调下保留，且 monitor 在新激活上重训后规避技能依然存活；机制上，编辑由上下文轮次计算得出，提供的例子越多，编辑与被监控方向的对齐越强。
Conclusion: 反馈本身足以让模型学会规避 latent monitor，因此 latent monitoring 应被视为智能体可观察并反制的交互过程，而非静态检测器。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AdaptArena: Evaluating Test-Time Personalization of Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong performance on complex web navigation tasks, yet they remain brittle in real-world settings where user intentions are underspecified and preferences are heterogeneous. In practice, users rarely provide explicit profiles, requiring agents to infer latent preferences from implicit signals. Despite its importance for deployment, this problem setting is largely underexplored in existing benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce AdaptArena, a benchmark for evaluating test-time personalization of web agents via implicit preference inference. AdaptArena consists of 480 tasks, featuring both single-preference and double-preference scenarios. Each evaluation task must be solved by retrieving and leveraging the most relevant historical user trajectory that implicitly encodes the target preference. In addition, we introduce AdaptiveAgent, a retrieval-based framework for standardized evaluation of implicit preference inference. Experiments reveal a substantial performance gap: while oracle agents with access to ground-truth preferences achieve an 82.92% success rate, the evaluated LLM agents using our framework reach at most 15.62%. Furthermore, we find that correctly inferring user preferences is necessary but not sufficient for task success, as execution failures in downstream web interactions remain a significant bottleneck even when agents align with the target preference. These findings highlight implicit preference inference and robust action grounding as key challenges for deploying reliable, user-facing web agents. We release our code: https://github.com/McGill-NLP/web-agents-test-time-adaptations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaptArena 是评测 web agent 测试时个性化 (test-time personalization) 的基准：480 个任务要求 agent 从隐式信号推断潜在偏好，并检索编码目标偏好的历史用户轨迹来完成任务。配套提出检索式框架 AdaptiveAgent 做标准化评测；实验显示 oracle agent 拿到真实偏好可达 82.92% 成功率，而受测 LLM agent 最高只有 15.62%。
Motivation: 实际部署中用户很少给出显式 profile，意图欠指定、偏好异质，agent 需从隐式信号推断偏好；这一测试时个性化设定在现有 benchmark 中基本未被覆盖。
Method: 构建 AdaptArena 基准，含 480 个任务，覆盖单偏好与双偏好场景，每个任务必须检索并利用最相关的历史用户轨迹（轨迹中隐式编码目标偏好）才能解题；同时提出检索式框架 AdaptiveAgent，用于对隐式偏好推断做标准化评测。
Result: oracle agent 在可访问真实偏好的条件下成功率 82.92%，受测 LLM agent 在该框架下最高仅 15.62%；即使 agent 已正确对齐目标偏好，下游 web 交互中的执行失败仍是任务成功的主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 隐式偏好推断与稳健的动作落地 (action grounding) 是部署可靠面向用户 web agent 的两大关键挑战，且正确推断偏好只是必要条件而非充分条件。

papers.title: Optimal Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study an unknown-transition finite-horizon Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite collection of known reward functions $\{r^1, r^2, \ldots, r^M\}$. The goal is to output an $ε$-optimal policy for every reward using online episodic interaction only. Performance is measured by the policy error $V_{0}^{*, m} - V_{0}^{\widehatπ^{m}, m}$ where $m\in [M]$ represents the reward function and $V_{0}^{*, m}=\mathbb{E}_{s_1\sim μ}[V_{1}^{*, m}(s_1)]$. Under this setting, we design a provably efficient algorithm to establish a minimax sample complexity bound of $$ O\left(\frac{SAH^3}{ε^2}\log M \mathrm{polylog}\left(\frac{SAH\log M}{\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ}\right)\right)$$ episodes, with no additional burn-in cost. This matches the information-theoretic lower bound up to a factor of $ \mathrm{polylog}(SAH\log M/(\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ))$. Our method combines three technical ingredients. First, we adapt MVP to reward-switching learning to construct optimistic value estimates. Second, we use fresh replay samples to conservatively evaluate the candidate policies. Third, gap-based multiplicative weights updates adjust the reward-sampling distribution using the differences between these estimates, converting weighted learning progress into simultaneous guarantees for all rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在未知转移的有限时域 MDP 中，对一组已知奖励函数 {r^1,…,r^M} 用在线回合交互同时输出每个奖励的 ε-最优策略，给出无额外 burn-in 的 minimax 样本复杂度 O(SAH^3/ε^2 · log M · polylog(SAH log M/(min{ε,1}δ))) 回合，与信息论下界只差 polylog 因子。
Motivation: 多奖励（reward-switching）设定下要对每个奖励同时保证 ε-最优，未知转移使各奖励的乐观值估计互相牵制，缺少既匹配下界又无 burn-in 代价的算法。
Method: 三个技术组件：把 MVP 适配到 reward-switching 学习以构造乐观值估计；用 fresh replay 样本保守地评估候选策略；用基于 gap 的 multiplicative weights updates 依据估计差调整奖励采样分布，把加权学习进度转化为对全部奖励的同时保证。
Result: 建立 minimax 样本复杂度 O(SAH^3/ε^2 · log M · polylog(SAH log M/(min{ε,1}δ))) 回合，无额外 burn-in 成本，与信息论下界仅差 polylog(SAH log M/(min{ε,1}δ)) 因子；性能度量为各奖励的策略误差 V_0^{*,m} − V_0^{π̂^m,m}。
Conclusion: MVP 加保守 replay 评估与 gap 型乘性权重的组合，可在未知转移多奖励 MDP 中同时对所有奖励达到匹配下界的样本复杂度。

papers.title: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match the teacher's next-token distributions on the student's own trajectories and has yielded substantial empirical gains. Generalized variants allow the student to surpass the teacher by extrapolating an implicit reward in output space. The language-model head, however, attenuates this change anisotropically: much of the change encoded in the teacher's hidden states reaches the logits at a small fraction of its weight, and the sampled-token log-probability ratios on which output-space extrapolation relies inject noise that the extrapolation amplifies, making training unstable. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) shifts a model's internal representations relative to its base checkpoint, and that the direction of this shift can be measured at every layer. Motivated by this observation, we propose RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation), which extrapolates the RL-induced change directly in representation space: at every layer and token position, RIDE computes the residual between the teacher and its pre-RL checkpoint and regresses the student's hidden states toward targets displaced beyond the teacher along this residual. Conditioned on a sampled trajectory, this regression is equivalent to maximizing a linear directional reward defined by the residual under a quadratic penalty centered at the teacher, which makes explicit how the objective moves the student along the RL-induced direction while limiting its deviation from the teacher. Across four base/RL-teacher pairs spanning different scales, architectures, and pre-training lineages, RIDE approaches or exceeds the RL-trained teacher on every pair and is the only method whose mean does so, and it consistently outperforms output-space extrapolation, which degrades the student whenever the teacher is close to its base. Project page: https://github.com/xixixixixxxx/RIDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RIDE（RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation）：把 RL 相对其 base checkpoint 的表征位移方向逐层测出，让学生隐状态沿该残差方向被回归到超越教师的位移目标，从而绕开输出空间外推中语言模型头的各向异性衰减与采样 log-prob 比值噪声。在四组不同规模、架构与预训练谱系的 base/RL-teacher 配对上，RIDE 在每一对上都接近或超过 RL 训练的教师，是唯一均值做到这一点的方法，并一致优于输出空间外推。
Motivation: on-policy distillation 的广义变体靠输出空间的隐式奖励外推让学生超越教师，但语言模型头会各向异性地衰减这一变化，且外推所依赖的采样 token log-probability 比值会注入噪声并被放大，导致训练不稳定。
Method: RIDE 在每个层与每个 token 位置计算教师与其 pre-RL checkpoint 之间的残差，把学生隐状态沿该残差回归到被推到教师之外的目标位移；在给定采样轨迹下，该回归等价于在以教师为中心的二次惩罚下最大化由残差定义的线性方向奖励，从而既沿 RL 方向移动又限制对教师的偏离。
Result: 在四组 base/RL-teacher 配对（覆盖不同规模、架构与预训练谱系）上，RIDE 在每一对上都接近或超过 RL 训练的教师，且是唯一平均值做到这一点的方法；它一致优于输出空间外推，后者在教师接近其 base 时会损害学生。
Conclusion: 把 RL 诱导的方向放在表征空间而非输出空间外推，可以让学生沿 RL 方向超越教师同时保持对教师的约束，而输出空间外推在教师接近 base 时是不可靠的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human-AI Collaboration: From Paradoxes to Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Evidence shows that humans and AI systems perform better together, by collaborating, than alone. This paper examines two key design dimensions of human-AI collaboration (autonomy and initiative) and explores the collaboration patterns that they generate. Documenting these patterns starts with identifying the underlying problems and solutions, followed by examining the internal tensions within the problems. The paper uses a paradox perspective to analyze those tensions. It describes a process for surfacing the tensions and mapping the underlying paradoxes. It also illustrates how the pattern descriptions can be derived from mapping these paradoxes. Finally, the paper documents four human-AI collaboration patterns: Instruction, Delegation, Assistance, and Co-creation.
papers.comment: This is the author's version of the work. It is posted here for your personal use. Not for redistribution. The definitive Version of Record will be published in 33rd Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs (PLoP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以悖论视角分析人机协作中自主性 (autonomy) 与主动性 (initiative) 两个设计维度所产生的张力，并据此推导出四个协作模式：Instruction、Delegation、Assistance、Co-creation。核心主张是先定位问题背后的悖论、再由悖论映射生成模式描述，从而把人机协作设计从零散经验整理为可复用的模式语言。
Motivation: 人机协作表现优于单独一方已有证据，但自主性与主动性两条轴上的内部张力缺少系统化的分析框架，协作模式的推导过程也缺乏可追溯的来源。
Method: 先识别协作问题与解决方案，再用悖论视角 (paradox perspective) 剖析问题内部张力，给出一套浮现张力并映射底层悖论的流程，最后演示如何从悖论映射推导模式描述，落成四个模式。
Result: 文档化四个协作模式：Instruction、Delegation、Assistance、Co-creation，分别对应自主性与主动性组合产生的不同张力结构；摘要给出的是流程与模式清单，无定量指标。
Conclusion: 人机协作设计可按“问题—张力—悖论—模式”的链条组织，悖论映射是把设计张力转成可复用模式描述的中间步骤。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Computing for Network Security Classification: Near-Term Classification and Long-Term Memory Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Quantum computing has already been explored in several network-security applications. However, how quantum computing may contribute to network-security classification in both the near term and the longer term has not been systematically discussed. This paper studies this question through two complementary experiments. First, we evaluate near-term quantum-kernel support vector machines (SVMs) on practical network-security classification tasks and compare them with classical SVM baselines on KDD Cup 1999, CICIDS2017, and BoT-IoT. Across these runs, quantum kernels are competitive. They can match or improve classical baselines in some settings, while classical RBF kernels remain stronger in others. This suggests that near-term quantum-kernel methods should be evaluated as practical, dataset-dependent alternatives to classical kernels rather than as uniformly superior replacements. Second, we use quantum oracle sketching (QOS) to study a longer-term memory advantage for classification with streaming classical samples. In QOS, samples are processed online and used to incrementally construct an approximate quantum oracle, which provides coherent query access for downstream quantum algorithms without retaining the entire dataset. Under the QOS-inspired machine-size estimate, comparable accuracy corresponds to a substantially smaller effective memory-size proxy than explicit sparse/QRAM-style storage. Compared with a simple streaming proxy, the result is more nuanced because aggressive feature filtering can make the streaming dimension small. This suggests that the long-term value of quantum computing for network-security classification may lie in memory-efficient data access rather than immediate runtime speedup. Together, these experiments show how quantum computing may contribute to network-security classification from near-term classification performance and longer-term memory efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用两组实验回答量子计算对网络安全分类的价值：近期在 KDD Cup 1999、CICIDS2017、BoT-IoT 上比较量子核 SVM 与经典 SVM，量子核在部分设定持平或更好、但经典 RBF 在另一些设定更强；长期用 quantum oracle sketching (QOS) 在线构造近似量子 oracle，同等精度下所需有效内存远小于显式 sparse/QRAM 存储。结论是近期应把量子核当作依数据集而定的替代方案而非全面更优，长期价值在内存高效的数据访问而非即时加速。
Motivation: 量子计算已在若干网络安防应用中被尝试，但其对网络安全分类在近期性能与长期资源两个时间尺度上的贡献缺少系统讨论。
Method: 近期实验：在 KDD Cup 1999、CICIDS2017、BoT-IoT 三个入侵检测数据集上评估量子核 SVM，并与经典 SVM 基线对比。长期实验：QOS 在线处理样本、增量构造近似量子 oracle，为下游量子算法提供相干查询访问而不保留整个数据集，再按 QOS 启发的 machine-size 估计与显式 sparse/QRAM 存储及一个简单 streaming proxy 比较内存。
Result: 量子核在部分设定持平或改进经典基线，经典 RBF 核在另一些设定更强。QOS 方案在同等精度下对应的有效内存尺寸 proxy 显著小于显式 sparse/QRAM 式存储；与简单 streaming proxy 相比结果更复杂，因为激进特征过滤可把流式维度压得很小。
Conclusion: 近期量子核应作为依数据集而定的实用替代方案评估，而非统一更优的替换；量子计算对网络安全分类的长期价值可能在内存高效的数据访问，而非即时运行时加速。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Harvest Without Collapse in a Regenerative Commons: A Lagrangian Framework
papers.abstract_en: The tragedy of the commons poses a multi-agent safety problem: reward-seeking agents can deplete a shared resource, and cooperation among its users does not itself specify how much must be preserved. We make preservation an explicit requirement by formulating a regenerative commons as a constrained Markov game or a constrained multi-agent MDP with a designer-specified depletion budget. We develop a nonstationary Lagrangian framework that constructs a policy sequence from solutions of unconstrained games or cooperative control problems. Extending earlier time-average constructions, we introduce average-epoch solution concepts for reset episodes with discounted rewards and terminal costs. We prove a reward-independent feasibility certificate, cooperative feasibility and approximate optimality against feasible policy mixtures, and an extension to unbiased sampled costs. For self-interested agents, a constrained Nash certificate quantifies the price-dispersion term introduced by deviations that redistribute budget across epochs. Under the stated assumptions on solver accuracy and multiplier updates, these results give constrained policy-sequence guarantees using solutions of unconstrained problems. Experiments with constrained IPPO and MAPPO in a Gordon-Schaefer fishery examine how depletion budgets shape stock retention, harvest rewards, and price adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把再生公地 (regenerative commons) 写成带设计师给定耗竭预算的约束马尔可夫博弈，用非平稳 Lagrangian 框架从无约束博弈或合作控制解构造策略序列，并证明可行性与近似最优性证书。在 Gordon-Schaefer 渔业上用约束 IPPO 与 MAPPO 检验耗竭预算如何塑造资源存量保留、捕捞回报与价格适应。
Motivation: 公地悲剧是多智能体安全问题：追求奖励的智能体可能耗尽共享资源，而用户之间的合作本身并不规定必须保留多少，需要把保护量变成显式约束。
Method: 将再生公地表述为约束马尔可夫博弈（约束多智能体 MDP），带设计师指定的耗竭预算；提出非平稳 Lagrangian 框架，从无约束博弈或合作控制问题的解构造策略序列，并针对带折扣奖励与终端成本的重置回合引入 average-epoch 解概念。
Result: 证明了与奖励无关的可行性证书、针对可行策略混合的合作可行性与近似最优性、以及推广到无偏采样成本的结论；对自利智能体给出约束 Nash 证书，量化偏差在各 epoch 间重新分配预算所引入的 price-dispersion 项；在 Gordon-Schaefer 渔业上以约束 IPPO 和 MAPPO 实验考察耗竭预算对存量保留、捕捞回报与价格适应的影响。
Conclusion: 在给定求解器精度与乘子更新条件下，仅用无约束问题的解即可得到约束策略序列的保证；保护量由预算而非合作意愿决定。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: 将再生公地表述为约束马尔可夫博弈（约束多智能体 MDP），带设计师指定的耗竭预算；提出非平稳 Lagrangian 框架，从无约束博弈或合作控制问题的解构造策略序列，并针对带折扣奖励与终端成本的重置回合引入 average-epoch 解概念。
summary_sections.result: 证明了与奖励无关的可行性证书、针对可行策略混合的合作可行性与近似最优性、以及推广到无偏采样成本的结论；对自利智能体给出约束 Nash 证书，量化偏差在各 epoch 间重新分配预算所引入的 price-dispersion 项；在 Gordon-Schaefer 渔业上以约束 IPPO 和 MAPPO 实验考察耗竭预算对存量保留、捕捞回报与价格适应的影响。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在给定求解器精度与乘子更新条件下，仅用无约束问题的解即可得到约束策略序列的保证；保护量由预算而非合作意愿决定。

papers.title: Guard Models Are Overconfident Where Base Models Are Uncertain
papers.abstract_en: Guard models are used as safety classifiers, with confidence scores driving downstream moderation decisions. We evaluate five guard models for prompt classification and find that although several are nearly calibrated on clean inputs, adversarial attacks degrade their calibration by an order of magnitude, turning false negatives into high-confidence errors indistinguishable from correct detections. Comparing each guard with its corresponding base LM, we find that uncertainty signals often remain available, with the base model typically expressing uncertainty on the same inputs where the guard fails. Layer-wise analyses localize this guard-base divergence to later layers, where guard models exhibit sharper safe/unsafe separation and lower-rank representations, while adversarial harmful inputs lie closer to the clean-safe region. These findings highlight a mismatch between guard confidence and base model uncertainty under attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 评测五个 guard model 的提示分类置信度，发现干净输入上多数接近校准，但对抗攻击使校准恶化一个数量级，把假阴性变成与正确检出无法区分的高置信错误。guard 的置信与其 base LM 的不确定性在攻击下错位：base 模型在 guard 失败的同一批输入上仍表达不确定，分歧集中在后层的低秩表征与更尖锐的 safe/unsafe 分离。
Motivation: guard model 的置信分数直接驱动下游审核决策，但对抗攻击下高置信假阴性会绕过审核，且这种失效在输出上与正常检出不可区分。
Method: 对五个 guard model 做提示分类评测，逐个与其对应 base LM 对比不确定性信号；用逐层 (layer-wise) 分析定位 guard 与 base 的分歧层，比较表征秩与 safe/unsafe 分离度，并考察对抗有害输入在表征空间中相对 clean-safe 区域的位置。
Result: 干净输入上多个 guard 接近校准 (nearly calibrated)，对抗攻击使其校准恶化一个数量级 (an order of magnitude)；base 模型通常在 guard 失败的同一批输入上表达不确定性；分歧定位于后层，guard 在这些层呈现更尖锐的 safe/unsafe 分离与更低秩的表征，对抗有害输入落在更靠近 clean-safe 区域的位置。
Conclusion: guard 置信度与 base model 不确定性在攻击下系统性错位，因此 guard 的高置信不能当作可靠的安全信号，其失效可由 base 模型的不确定性暴露。

papers.title: Similar Choices, Different Attention: Cross-Modal Associations in Humans and Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal associations are systematic pairings of features across modalities, such as the association of 'bouba' with round shapes and 'kiki' with sharp shapes. Prior work has compared humans and vision-language models (VLMs) on such associations, but often using different stimuli or tasks between humans and models. Here, we ask whether VLMs align with humans not only in choices, but also in where they look when making those choices. We study both VLMs and humans (N = 53), presenting them with the same stimuli, a pseudo-word and two images, and record participants' choices and eye movements, which we release. We find choice alignment in a few larger VLMs, but their saliency matches human gaze less closely than a center-bias baseline, a fixed Gaussian at the center of each image. Fine-tuning small VLMs on human choices brings their choice alignment to the level of a human majority-vote reference on unseen words and images, yet their attention still matches human gaze less closely than this baseline. Training model attention on human gaze raises attention-gaze correlation without improving choice alignment, and a single average gaze map per image position raises it by a similar amount. Matching human choices, or even human gaze patterns, is therefore not sufficient evidence of human-aligned cross-modal processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在同一批刺激（伪词+两张图）上同时记录 53 名人类与 VLM 的选择和眼动，发现大 VLM 的选择能对齐人类，但其显著性图与人类注视的相关性低于中心偏置基线（图像中心的固定高斯）。用人类选择微调小 VLM 可把选择对齐提到人类多数投票参考的水平，注意力仍不及该基线；用人类注视训练注意力只提升注视相关而不改善选择对齐，且每张图位置的平均注视图能带来相近提升。
Motivation: 既往人类与 VLM 的跨模态关联研究常用不同刺激或任务，无法判断模型是否在选择与注意两个层面同时对齐人类。
Method: 向人类（N=53）与多个 VLM 呈现相同刺激：一个伪词加两张图片，记录选择与眼动并公开发布；对比 VLM 显著性与人类注视，基线为每张图中心的固定高斯（center bias）；对小 VLM 用人类选择微调，并用人类注视训练注意力，评估未见词与图片上的选择对齐与注意力-注视相关。
Result: 少数较大的 VLM 表现出选择对齐，但其显著性与人类注视的匹配度低于中心高斯基线；微调后小 VLM 的选择对齐达到人类多数投票参考水平（在未见词与图片上），注意力仍低于该基线；用人类注视训练注意力提高注意力-注视相关但不改善选择对齐，每图位置的单张平均注视图带来相近幅度的提升。
Conclusion: 匹配人类选择、甚至匹配人类注视模式，都不足以证明模型具备人类对齐的跨模态加工。

papers.title: FinRT: Distilling Adaptive Red-Teaming Strategies into Reusable Adversarial Generators in Consumer Finance
papers.abstract_en: In regulated industries like consumer finance, seemingly harmless user queries can exploit large language model vulnerabilities, triggering safety failures and pushing responses dangerously close to policy limits. Existing automated red-teaming methods trade off attack effectiveness against generation cost, while treating coverage, severity, and diversity as incidental rather than joint objectives. We introduce FinRT, a structured framework that builds reusable adversarial prompt generators from adaptive red-teaming strategies. Across the six victim models in consumer finance, FinRT substantially outperforms adaptive search baselines while amortizing target-facing attack generation into a reusable generator. FinRT nearly doubles the attack success rate over the adaptive baseline Rainbow Teaming (32.9% vs. 17.2%), increases maximum adversarial severity by 33%, and preserves comparable intra-policy-domain semantic diversity to iterative search methods. Our method achieves high cross-model transferability while exhibiting distinct victim-family specialization patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinRT 把消费金融场景下的自适应红队策略蒸馏成可复用的对抗 prompt 生成器，在六个受害模型上以生成成本更低的方式逼近搜索式攻击效果：攻击成功率 32.9% 对自适应基线 Rainbow Teaming 的 17.2%，最大对抗严重度提升 33%，语义多样性与迭代搜索方法相当。
Motivation: 消费金融这类受监管领域里，看似无害的用户查询即可触发 LLM 安全失效、把回答推到政策边界；现有自动红队方法在攻击效果与生成成本之间取舍，且把覆盖率、严重度、多样性当作附带指标而非联合优化目标。
Method: FinRT 是一个结构化框架：先做自适应红队搜索，再把这些策略蒸馏成可复用的对抗 prompt 生成器，把面向目标模型的攻击生成摊销到生成器上；在消费金融领域的六个受害模型上与自适应搜索基线（含 Rainbow Teaming）对比。
Result: 在六个受害模型上，攻击成功率 32.9% vs Rainbow Teaming 17.2%（接近翻倍）；最大对抗严重度提升 33%；策略内语义多样性与迭代搜索方法相当；具备较高的跨模型可迁移性，并呈现明显的受害模型家族特化模式。
Conclusion: 把自适应红队策略蒸馏成可复用生成器，可以在消费金融 LLM 上同时拿到接近搜索式攻击的成功率、更高严重度和可控成本，且攻击在跨模型迁移时会按受害家族分化。

papers.title: Going Beyond State-Reaching: Learning Abstractions for Intrinsically Motivated Option Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Temporal abstraction via options can improve exploration in large environments. However, existing option discovery algorithms find subgoals that target all aspects of the state simultaneously. This state-reaching approach produces options that only apply in narrow regions of the state-space, eventually causing an explosion in the number of options that overwhelms the agent, and impedes progress on its primary task of reward maximization. We introduce an algorithm that instead identifies a small, relevant subset of features for each subgoal, yielding options that generalize broadly and accelerate exploration. Our approach learns abstract, transferrable options and achieves rapid exploration in three sparse-reward, image-based domains, including the Atari game MontezumasRevenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有 option discovery 用 state-reaching 方式同时对齐状态的所有维度，导致 option 只在狭窄状态区域可用、数量爆炸并拖累奖励最大化。本文改为为每个 subgoal 只识别一小撮相关特征子集，学出可迁移的抽象 option，使 option 广泛泛化并加速探索，在三个稀疏奖励的图像域（含 Atari 的 MontezumasRevenge）上实现快速探索。
Motivation: state-reaching 式 subgoal 要求状态各维度同时达标，产出的 option 适用区域极窄，option 数量随之爆炸，压垮 agent 并妨碍其奖励最大化主任务。
Method: 提出一种 option discovery 算法，为每个 subgoal 只挑选一个小而相关的特征子集而非整个状态，据此学习抽象、可迁移的 option，以加速稀疏奖励环境中的探索；在三个基于图像的稀疏奖励域上检验，含 Atari 游戏 MontezumasRevenge。
Result: 在三个稀疏奖励、基于图像的域（含 MontezumasRevenge）上实现快速探索，得到的 option 可广泛泛化并可迁移；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 放弃对整个状态做 state-reaching、改为按特征子集定义 subgoal，是缓解 option 数量爆炸并加速稀疏奖励探索的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DisCoMBO: Steering Expert-in-the-Loop Black Box Optimization via Distributional Conformance
papers.abstract_en: Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) traditionally relies on Bayesian or ensembling surrogates for uncertainty quantification. While historically treated as fully data-driven, SMBO increasingly integrates external domain expertise to accelerate discovery. To overcome the opaque guidance and diminished integration fidelity of standard acquisition re-weighting, Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) have emerged as a generative surrogate alternative, enabling direct knowledge injection via conditional sampling. However, these generative routines lack the formal exploration-exploitation semantics required for rigorous optimization. We introduce the Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo), a novel metric that unifies the flexibility and efficiency of PCs with a formal uncertainty framework. DisCo provides a bounded, $[0, 1]$-normalized measure of model "surprise" that (1) recovers properties comparable to kernel-based uncertainty known from, e.g., Gaussian Processes, while maintaining linear-time inference, and (2) enables accurate assessment of conformance of external knowledge w.r.t. model evidence. We then present DisCoMBO, a framework leveraging these properties for robust, knowledge-aware optimization. We prove that DisCoMBO is a zero-regret algorithm and demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse benchmarks from AutoML, material optimization, and wind park optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DisCoMBO：用 Probabilistic Circuits 作生成式代理，配合新的 Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo)——一个取值归一到 [0,1]、线性时间推理的模型“惊讶度”度量——把外部领域知识注入黑盒优化，同时保留探索-利用语义。作者证明 DisCoMBO 是 zero-regret 算法，并在 AutoML、材料优化与风电场优化基准上验证其有效性。
Motivation: SMBO 中标准 acquisition re-weighting 给出的引导不透明、整合保真度低，而 Probabilistic Circuits 的条件采样这类生成式例程缺少严谨优化所需的探索-利用语义。
Method: 以 Probabilistic Circuits 为生成式代理，定义有界 [0,1] 归一的 Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo) 度量模型惊讶度，既恢复类似 Gaussian Process 的核不确定性性质又保持线性时间推理，并据此评估外部知识相对模型证据的符合程度；DisCoMBO 框架用这些性质做知识感知优化。
Result: 证明 DisCoMBO 为 zero-regret 算法；在 AutoML、材料优化与风电场优化等多类基准上展示了有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把生成式代理与形式化的不确定性度量结合，可以在注入外部知识的同时保住优化所需的探索-利用语义与零后悔保证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 以 Probabilistic Circuits 为生成式代理，定义有界 [0,1] 归一的 Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo) 度量模型惊讶度，既恢复类似 Gaussian Process 的核不确定性性质又保持线性时间推理，并据此评估外部知识相对模型证据的符合程度；DisCoMBO 框架用这些性质做知识感知优化。
summary_sections.result: 证明 DisCoMBO 为 zero-regret 算法；在 AutoML、材料优化与风电场优化等多类基准上展示了有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把生成式代理与形式化的不确定性度量结合，可以在注入外部知识的同时保住优化所需的探索-利用语义与零后悔保证。

papers.title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages. Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. The resulting future-prediction error can further serve as a signal for adaptive chunking. S-WAM achieves 97.7% on LIBERO and 87.9% on LIBERO-Plus, and improves performance across multiple policy backbones and real-robot tasks. It reaches 292.7 executed actions per second, $3.62\times$ the throughput of conventional execution at comparable accuracy, while reducing time-to-first-action from 123.6 to 73.3 ms. With additional inference optimizations, throughput further increases to 642.9 actions per second.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAIRCASE POLICY 把 flow-matching VLA 改造成 JEPA 式 World-Action Model，并把大 action chunk 按错开的去噪阶段切成 sub-chunk：近期动作先执行，后续动作在每个 sub-chunk 边界用最新观测重预测 future latent 并更新所有未执行动作。LIBERO 达 97.7%、LIBERO-Plus 87.9%，吞吐 292.7 动作/秒（约为常规执行的 3.62 倍），首动作延迟从 123.6 ms 降到 73.3 ms，加推理优化后升至 642.9 动作/秒。
Motivation: WAM 靠预测未来观测来生成动作，但未来预测在本已昂贵的迭代式动作生成上再加推理开销；action chunking 能摊薄成本，却因后续动作仍条件于陈旧观测而在长执行时域上性能退化。
Method: 将 flow-matching VLA 转为 JEPA 式 WAM，把大 action chunk 在错开的去噪阶段（staggered denoising stages）切成 sub-chunk；每个 sub-chunk 边界从最新观测重新预测 future latent，并用它更新全部未执行动作，近期动作一可用即执行。future-prediction error 还可作为自适应分块信号，框架同时覆盖推理与训练。
Result: S-WAM 在 LIBERO 上 97.7%、LIBERO-Plus 上 87.9%，并在多种 policy backbone 与真实机器人任务上均有提升；吞吐 292.7 executed actions per second，约为常规执行的 3.62 倍且精度相当，time-to-first-action 从 123.6 ms 降至 73.3 ms；加入额外推理优化后吞吐进一步达到 642.9 actions per second。
Conclusion: 在去噪过程中错开执行并用最新观测滚动更新未执行动作，可以在不重复整套策略推理的前提下支撑长时域执行，同时把首动作延迟和吞吐同时改善。

papers.title: Rethinking Reasoning Paths as Phase-Structured Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often improve problem-solving performance by generating multi-step reasoning paths, yet how to analyze the hidden states along these paths remains unclear. Existing approaches typically assign each intermediate state the final-answer correctness label and train probes across heterogeneous questions. We argue that this protocol obscures reasoning dynamics in two ways: (1) correctness prediction can exploit question-level variation rather than path quality, and (2) states aligned by absolute step indices may correspond to different functional phases of reasoning. In this work, we propose to view reasoning paths as phase-structured trajectories within fixed questions. We instantiate this view as PAIR, short for Phase-Aligned Intra-question Reasoning. PAIR samples multiple trajectories for each question, maps variable-length paths into shared relative phases based on normalized trajectory progress, and compares successful and unsuccessful trajectories only within the same question and phase. This yields phase-specific path-quality directions that better isolate path-quality signals from question-level variation. Empirically, we find that standard across-question correctness probes lose much of their predictive power under within-question evaluation, suggesting that these probes partly rely on question-level information. PAIR improves within-question trajectory ranking and Best-of-N trajectory selection across models and benchmarks. Phase-wise steering further shows that the learned directions can change generation outcomes, providing causal evidence that they capture trajectory-relevant information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAIR 把 LLM 多步推理路径视为固定问题内的相位结构轨迹：对同一题采样多条轨迹，按归一化进度映射到共享相对相位，只在同题同相位内比较成败轨迹，得到相位特定的路径质量方向。跨题正确性探针在同题评测下预测力大幅下降，PAIR 则提升同题轨迹排序与 Best-of-N 选择，相位级 steering 能改变生成结果，给出因果证据。
Motivation: 现有探针把中间状态一律标成最终答案对错并跨题训练，正确性预测可走题目级差异的捷径，且按绝对步数对齐的状态可能对应不同推理功能阶段，掩盖了真实的推理动态。
Method: PAIR (Phase-Aligned Intra-question Reasoning)：每题采样多条轨迹，用归一化轨迹进度把变长路径映射到共享相对相位，仅在同题同相位内比较成功与失败轨迹，学习相位特定的路径质量方向；再用 phase-wise steering 干预生成以检验方向的因果性。
Result: 标准跨题正确性探针在同题评测下丢失大部分预测力，说明其部分依赖题目级信息；PAIR 在多个模型与基准上改善同题轨迹排序与 Best-of-N 轨迹选择；相位级 steering 能改变生成结果。
Conclusion: 路径质量信号必须在同题同相位内提取才能与题目级变异解耦，学到的方向携带与轨迹相关、可因果干预生成的信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergent Tonal Structure in Learned Chord Embeddings and Its Relation to Tonal Tension
papers.abstract_en: Several tonal pitch spaces and computational models have been proposed to analyze tonal structure in Western tonal music, many of them grounded in principles from music theory and used to support tonal analysis with important implications for tonal tension. In parallel, data-driven methods such as skip-gram have been used to learn chord embeddings from symbolic corpora, but their ability to recover tonal structure and its relation to tonal tension remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate how skip-gram chord embeddings reflect tonal structure and whether they provide a useful basis for analyzing structural aspects of tonal tension. Using chord sequences with and without transposition-based augmentation, we evaluate the learned spaces from geometric, functional, and tension-related perspectives. We show that augmented embeddings exhibit strong transposition equivariance, recover a clear circle-of-fifths structure, and support interpretable shifts between key-related regions of the learned space. We then derive embedding-based measures from chord-to-key distance and contextual chord-distance relations, and show that they capture meaningful aspects of tonal tension structure through correspondence with matched tonal measures and moderate alignment with human tension profiles. Across analyses, transposition-based augmentation generally improves the stability, tonal coherence, and interpretability of the learned space.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables, Accepted at the 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 skip-gram 从符号语料学和弦 embedding，比较有无移调增强 (transposition-based augmentation) 两种训练，从几何、功能与张力三个角度检验其是否恢复调性结构。移调增强后的 embedding 表现出强移调等变性、清晰的五度圈结构与可解释的调性区域位移；由和弦到调距离与上下文和弦距离导出的度量与匹配的调性度量对应，并与人类张力剖面中等程度对齐。
Motivation: 数据驱动的 skip-gram 和弦 embedding 已被用于符号语料，但其能否恢复调性结构、以及与调性张力 (tonal tension) 的关系仍缺乏系统检验。
Method: 在符号和弦序列上训练 skip-gram embedding，分别使用原始序列与移调增强 (transposition-based augmentation) 序列；从几何、功能、张力三个视角评估所得空间，并从 chord-to-key distance 与上下文 chord-distance 关系导出 embedding 度量，与既有调性度量和人类张力剖面对照。
Result: 移调增强的 embedding 呈现强移调等变性、恢复清晰的五度圈结构，并支持调性相关区域间的可解释位移；导出的度量与匹配的调性度量对应，与人类张力剖面中等程度对齐；整体上移调增强提升了空间的稳定性、调性一致性与可解释性。
Conclusion: 移调增强总体上改善和弦 embedding 的稳定性、调性一致性与可解释性，使其可作为分析调性张力结构的可解释基础。

papers.title: Fisher-IRG: Fisher-Induced Local Invariant Representation Geometry across Language and Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-preserving transformations can induce substantial motion in learned representations, while small changes may strongly affect model predictions, raising a basic question: what local metric best captures semantically consequential variation? We propose Fisher-induced invariant representation geometry (Fisher-IRG), which measures local representation directions through their predictive sensitivity. Around each representation, we construct semantic-preserving and semantic-changing neighborhoods, aggregate their local Fisher information, and recover invariant directions through a contrastive generalized eigenvalue problem. Controlled displacement analyses first show that comparable Euclidean motion can have substantially different predictive consequences, supporting the need for a predictive geometry. Across language and vision models, Fisher-IRG yields stronger semantic-versus-nuisance predictive selectivity and generally more reproducible subspaces than covariance-based geometry, while recovering systematically distinct local directions. Representation interventions further localize semantic effects to the Fisher-derived subspace, and held-out separation and retrieval show that the recovered geometry generalizes beyond the discovery neighborhoods. These results support Fisher-IRG as a principled framework for characterizing local invariant representation geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Fisher-IRG：在每个表征点构造语义保持与语义改变两类邻域，聚合局部 Fisher 信息，再用对比式广义特征值问题恢复对预测敏感的不变方向。受控位移分析显示相同欧氏位移可产生截然不同的预测后果；在语言与视觉模型上，Fisher-IRG 的语义-干扰预测选择性与子空间可复现性普遍强于基于协方差的几何。
Motivation: 语义保持的变换可能在表征空间造成大幅位移，而微小改动却可能强烈改变预测，说明欧氏距离无法刻画真正有语义后果的局部变化，需要一种以预测敏感度定义的局部度量。
Method: 围绕每个表征构建语义保持与语义改变邻域，聚合局部 Fisher 信息，通过对比式广义特征值问题 (contrastive generalized eigenvalue problem) 恢复不变方向；再用受控位移分析、表征干预以及留出集上的分离与检索检验该几何。
Result: 受控位移分析表明可比的欧氏位移会带来显著不同的预测后果；在语言与视觉模型上，Fisher-IRG 相比基于协方差的几何具有更强的语义对干扰预测选择性与普遍更可复现的子空间，并恢复出系统性不同的局部方向；表征干预把语义效应定位到 Fisher 导出的子空间，留出集分离与检索显示该几何可泛化到发现邻域之外。
Conclusion: 以预测敏感度（Fisher 信息）定义的局部几何比协方差几何更能刻画语义上有后果的方向，可作为刻画局部不变表征几何的原则性框架。

papers.title: Emergent phases of superposition: from partial to full representation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are thought to represent features by vectors in a hidden space of dimension given by the model's width. Superposition, in which more features are represented than the width by letting representation vectors overlap, is a leading account of how representation vectors are organized. However, how model width and data statistics determine the configuration of representation vectors and the resulting loss when the number of features and the width are large remains less understood. Here we show, in Anthropic's toy model of superposition, that increasing the width drives a continuous phase transition from a partial-representation phase, where only a subset of features receives appreciable representation vectors while the rest vanish, to a full-representation phase, where every feature is represented. Our theory via a partial random projection approximation predicts, and experiments confirm, that the critical width grows linearly with the number of active features up to a logarithmic factor. The loss scaling changes across the transition: below the critical width, the loss grows linearly with the number of active features and depends weakly on the width in a form set by data statistics; above it, the loss grows approximately quadratically with the number of active features and decays inversely with the width. Non-uniform firing probabilities delay the transition and lower the loss, as more frequent features occupy more space. Our results provide an account of how model width and data statistics jointly shape representations and loss, a step toward understanding representation scaling in large models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Anthropic 的叠加玩具模型 (toy model of superposition) 中，增大模型宽度会让表征从部分表征相（仅一部分特征有显著表征向量）连续相变到全表征相（每个特征都被表征）。临界宽度随活跃特征数线性增长（至多差一个对数因子）；临界宽度以下损失随活跃特征数线性增长且对宽度弱依赖，以上则近似随特征数二次增长并随宽度反比衰减。非均匀 firing 概率会推迟相变并降低损失。
Motivation: 叠加 (superposition) 被视为 LLM 组织表征向量的主流解释，但特征数与宽度都很大时，模型宽度和数据统计如何共同决定表征向量构型与损失仍不清楚。
Method: 在 Anthropic 的叠加玩具模型中做理论加实验：用 partial random projection approximation（部分随机投影近似）推出临界宽度与损失标度，再用实验验证；考察数据统计中的 firing 概率非均匀性对相变的影响。

papers.title: DynamicHOI: Coupled Dynamics for Physics-aware HOI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We study hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB videos, where partial observations can produce visually plausible yet mechanically inconsistent trajectories. Existing methods mainly enforce visual and geometric agreement, leaving the underlying interaction dynamics insufficiently constrained. We propose DynamicHOI, a physics-aware HOI reconstruction framework combining geometry-grounded diffusion refinement with coupled hand-object dynamics. Geometry spatially grounds visual evidence for trajectory refinement, while articulated inverse dynamics and Newton-Euler dynamics derive hand generalized forces and object wrenches for dynamics-level supervision. We further couple hand and object dynamics through contact-force transfer and recover active hand actuation as an interaction-level physical quantity. We formulate its empirical magnitude distribution into a probabilistic prior that penalizes unlikely actuation and suppresses mechanically implausible reconstructed motion. Experiments on three HOI datasets show consistent improvements in both hand and object reconstruction. The reconstructed trajectories further benefit downstream applications including hand world-model generation and robotic manipulation learning, demonstrating the value of physics-aware HOI modeling beyond reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynamicHOI 针对单目 RGB 视频中手-物交互 (HOI) 重建出现视觉合理但力学不自洽的轨迹，用几何引导的扩散细化配合耦合的手-物动力学做约束：articulated inverse dynamics 与 Newton-Euler 动力学给出手的广义力和物体 wrench，经接触力传递耦合，并把手部主动驱动量的经验幅值分布做成概率先验来惩罚不合理驱动。在三个 HOI 数据集上手和物体重建均一致改善，重建轨迹还能带动手部世界模型生成与机器人操作学习。
Motivation: 单目视频的部分观测会产生视觉上合理但力学不一致的轨迹；现有方法只约束视觉与几何一致性，底层交互动力学约束不足。
Method: 几何引导的扩散细化 (geometry-grounded diffusion refinement) 先用几何锚定视觉证据做轨迹细化；articulated inverse dynamics 与 Newton-Euler 动力学导出手部广义力和物体 wrench 作为动力学级监督；再通过接触力传递耦合手与物体动力学，恢复手部主动驱动量并将其经验幅值分布形式化为概率先验，惩罚不可能的驱动以抑制力学不合理的重建运动。
Result: 在三个 HOI 数据集上，手部与物体重建均取得一致改善；重建轨迹进一步使下游的手部世界模型生成与机器人操作学习受益。
Conclusion: 把动力学监督与驱动量概率先验引入 HOI 重建，可在视觉合理之外保证力学自洽，其价值延伸到重建之外的下游任务。

papers.title: Channel-Dependent State Space Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is critical across many real-world domains. Existing deep learning approaches fall into two paradigms with distinct limitations: channel-independent (CI) methods unconditionally ignore cross-variable dependencies and model only temporal dynamics, while channel-dependent (CD) methods consider both but typically rely on architectural compromises to mitigate overfitting and computational overhead. We therefore propose Chameleon, a specialized CD state space model (SSM) that enables data-dependent, fine-grained interactions across variables while scaling linearly with their number. By connecting selective SSMs with the Kalman filter, we leverage the missing measurement update in the former for cross-variable modeling while preserving the SSM backbone for robust temporal modeling. We further identify favorable inductive biases of GatedDeltaNet for time series, adapt it as our backbone, and improve generalization through additional techniques, including a previously unexplored stochastic perturbation of reversible instance normalization. On strongly dependent ODE and PEMS datasets, Chameleon achieves the best MSE and MAE across all settings, while its CI ablation and prior CD methods incur 61-178% higher MSE on average. Across 28 standard benchmark settings, Chameleon also achieves better MSE and MAE than each baseline in at least 27 and 22 cases, respectively. Training-time and peak-memory analyses on Traffic and ETT further demonstrate competitive efficiency and favorable memory scalability across different variable counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Chameleon：把选择性 SSM 与 Kalman filter 对接，用缺失的 measurement update 做跨变量建模，骨干换成 GatedDeltaNet 并加入可逆实例归一化的随机扰动。在强依赖的 ODE 与 PEMS 数据上所有设置取得最佳 MSE 与 MAE，CI 消融与既有 CD 方法平均 MSE 高 61–178%。
Motivation: channel-independent 方法无条件忽略跨变量依赖，channel-dependent 方法则靠架构折中来缓解过拟合与计算开销，两者都限制了多元时间序列预测的精度与扩展性。
Method: Chameleon 是专用 CD state space model：将 selective SSM 与 Kalman filter 关联，借其缺失的 measurement update 实现跨变量细粒度交互，同时保留 SSM 主干做时序建模；骨干采用对时序有利归纳偏置的 GatedDeltaNet，并加入可逆实例归一化的随机扰动等泛化手段，计算量随变量数线性增长。
Result: 在强依赖的 ODE 与 PEMS 数据集上，Chameleon 在所有设置取得最佳 MSE 与 MAE，其 CI 消融与既有 CD 方法平均 MSE 高出 61–178%；在 28 个标准 benchmark 设置中，对每个 baseline 分别在至少 27 个（MSE）与 22 个（MAE）设置上更优；Traffic 与 ETT 上的训练时间与峰值显存分析显示其在不同变量数下具备竞争力的效率与显存扩展性。
Conclusion: 用 Kalman measurement update 补上选择性 SSM 的跨变量建模缺口，可在保持线性扩展的同时让 CD 模型在强依赖多元序列上稳定优于 CI 与既有 CD 方法。

papers.title: Reliable Parallel Decoding in Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) can generate text efficiently by predicting multiple masked tokens in parallel, but predictions from the same forward pass are not necessarily reliable when committed together. We study when parallel commitment is reliable. Our diagnostics show that confidence alone does not determine a reliable commitment order: confident predictions near the end of the sequence can fix an answer before its supporting computations are established, and downstream predictions become less reliable as the uncertainty of their upstream context grows. At the same time, a single forward pass can already resolve several masked tokens, and predictions that remain stable across the final layers are more likely to be correct. Based on these findings, we propose Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD), a training-free method that selects candidates by layerwise prediction stability and final confidence, and commits them under a cumulative entropy budget over their preceding masked positions. RPD defers predictions with uncertain upstream context while committing the remaining candidates in parallel, without relying on a fixed block schedule. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks on LLaDA and Dream, RPD achieves the highest decoding throughput among the evaluated methods while maintaining or improving accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD)：按层间预测稳定性与最终置信度筛选候选，并在前序掩码位置的累积熵预算下并行提交，从而推迟上游上下文不确定的预测。在 LLaDA 与 Dream 的数学推理和代码生成基准上，RPD 在所评估方法中解码吞吐最高，同时保持或提升准确率。
Motivation: MDLM 并行提交同一前向传播中的多个 token 并不可靠：仅凭置信度排序会在支撑计算尚未建立时先固定答案，且上游上下文不确定性越高，下游预测越不可靠。
Method: RPD 是免训练方法，用层间预测稳定性加最终置信度挑选候选，再在候选前序掩码位置的累积熵预算 (cumulative entropy budget) 下并行提交；不依赖固定 block 调度，对上游上下文不确定的预测做延迟。
Result: 在 LLaDA 与 Dream 上的数学推理与代码生成基准中，RPD 取得所评估方法里最高的解码吞吐，同时准确率持平或提升；诊断还显示跨最后几层稳定的预测更可能正确。
Conclusion: 并行提交的可靠性应由层间稳定性与上游上下文熵共同决定，而非单次前向的置信度；按此筛选即可在不训练的前提下同时保住吞吐与准确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Invariant Atoms: Sparse Coordinates of Local Semantic Geometry in Language Model Representations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often preserve meaning despite substantial changes in wording, style, and syntax, while small semantic edits can systematically alter their hidden representations. This suggests that semantic variation may be organized along recurring local directions. We propose the Invariant Atom Hypothesis: local semantic motion admits preferred sparse coordinates along directions that remain stable under meaning-preserving transformations. We learn a shared semantic frame and sparse coordinates that reconstruct semantic displacements while suppressing nuisance variation, with anchor-dependent diagonal modulation adjusting atom strengths without sample-specific rotations. Empirically, the atoms exhibit strong semantic--nuisance separation, sparse reconstruction, reproducible directions, and causal effects on model predictions. The learned geometry generalizes to unseen semantic neighborhoods and nuisance families, while local reweighting improves semantic selectivity and preserves a consistent global-to-local structure. Atom signatures also remain stable under model modification. These findings support reusable invariant directions as a sparse coordinate system for local semantic geometry in language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Invariant Atom Hypothesis：语言模型隐藏表示中的局部语义位移沿一组在保义变换下稳定的稀疏方向（atoms）组织。学习共享语义坐标系与稀疏坐标重建位移、抑制干扰变化，用 anchor 依赖的对角调制调节原子强度而不做样本特定旋转；得到的原子表现出语义-干扰分离、可复现方向与对预测的因果效应，并能泛化到未见语义邻域与干扰族。
Motivation: LLM 在措辞、风格、句法大幅改动时常保持语义不变，而微小语义编辑却系统性改变隐藏表示，说明局部语义变化可能沿可复用的稀疏方向组织，但缺少这样的坐标系刻画。
Method: 学习一个共享语义 frame 与稀疏坐标来重建语义位移并抑制 nuisance 变化，配合 anchor 依赖的对角调制（diagonal modulation）调节各原子强度、不做样本特定旋转；在语义邻域与 nuisance 族上检验泛化，并用局部重加权调整语义选择性。
Result: 原子呈现强语义-干扰分离、稀疏重建、可复现方向与对模型预测的因果效应；学到的几何能泛化到未见语义邻域与 nuisance 族，局部重加权提升语义选择性并保持一致的全局到局部结构，原子签名在模型修改后仍稳定。
Conclusion: 可复用的不变方向可作为语言模型局部语义几何的稀疏坐标系，且这一结构在模型被修改时依然保持。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Theory on Attention Dynamics for Out-of-Distribution In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have demonstrated remarkable in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, enabling them to perform new tasks without additional fine-tuning. However, their performance often deteriorates when encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs that deviate from the training distribution, and the underlying theory remains poorly understood. To fill this gap, we characterize the OOD error under the input distribution shift through the interplay between the dynamics of the so-called $α$-type and $β$-type attention weights, which represent the transformer's confidence in identifying the correct and incorrect features, respectively. Our results indicate that the OOD error for each feature depends on all pairwise interactions between the training features and OOD features, and under certain cases the transformer performs no better than random guessing. To improve the OOD generalization performance, we next investigate the impact of model finetuning with the OOD data, and particularly, characterize the model forgetting performance on the source domain. Interestingly, the performance on the source domain may not always degrade after finetuning, which highly depends on the nature of the feature shift: finetuning on OOD domain keeps enhancing the confidence of identifying correct features from the original distribution, while the interference from other incorrect features may either increase or decrease. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real data are conducted to corroborate the theoretical insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在输入分布偏移下，用 α 型与 β 型注意力权重的动态刻画 Transformer 的 OOD in-context learning 误差：每个特征的 OOD 误差取决于训练特征与 OOD 特征的全部两两交互，某些情形下模型不优于随机猜测。对 OOD 数据微调时，源域性能是否退化取决于特征偏移性质——微调会持续增强对原分布正确特征的置信，而其他错误特征的干扰可能升也可能降。
Motivation: Transformer 的 ICL 在偏离训练分布的 OOD 输入上性能下降，其机理缺少理论刻画，尤其不清楚误差如何由特征间交互决定、微调后源域为何有时不退化。

Conclusion: OOD 下的 ICD 误差与微调后的遗忘都由注意力权重动态中正确特征置信和错误特征干扰的相对走向决定，源域退化不是微调的必然结果。

papers.title: Online Versatile Incremental Learning: Towards Class and Domain-Agnostic Adaptation at Any Time
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning enables vision systems to adapt to ever-changing data distributions. Despite significant advances, existing approaches fail to capture continuous and concurrent shifts in classes and domains, a critical capability for real-world deployment. This work introduces Online VIL (Online Versatile Incremental Learning), a novel scenario where class concepts and visual domains evolve simultaneously online without explicit boundaries. To better adapt to the challenges of such dynamic environments that more closely resemble real-world conditions, we propose a novel framework TopFlow, Topology preservation with Flow matching representation that contains two complementary mechanisms: Domain-agnostic Flow Matching (DFM) and Global Topology Preservation (GTP). DFM guides the model to have domain-agnostic representations by integrating the geodesic flow kernel into contrastive learning. In contrast, GTP maintains the global structure of the feature space without explicitly storing past examples. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that TopFlow effectively addresses the limitations of existing methods within the Online VIL scenario, achieving state-of-the-art performance in challenging Online VIL. The proposed methods suggest potential directions for building continual learning systems in realistic dynamic environments. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/KU-VGI/Online-VIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Online VIL 场景（类别概念与视觉域同时在线演化、无显式边界）与 TopFlow 框架：用 Domain-agnostic Flow Matching 把 geodesic flow kernel 引入对比学习得到域无关表示，用 Global Topology Preservation 在不存历史样本的前提下维持特征空间全局结构，在该场景下取得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法无法同时处理类别与域的连续、并发漂移，而这种无显式边界的同时演化才是真实部署中的常态。
Method: TopFlow 含两个互补机制：DFM 将 geodesic flow kernel 融入对比学习以获得域无关表示；GTP 在不显式存储过往样本的条件下保持特征空间的全局拓扑结构，二者共同支撑 Online VIL 场景下的在线适应。
Result: 在 Online VIL 场景的大量实验中，TopFlow 有效弥补现有方法的不足，并取得 state-of-the-art 性能；实现代码已公开于 github.com/KU-VGI/Online-VIL。
Conclusion: 域无关的 flow matching 表示加全局拓扑保持，是在类别与域同时无边界演化条件下构建持续学习系统的可行方向。

papers.title: DARE to Mitigate Hallucination: Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress across multimodal tasks, yet object hallucination remains a persistent challenge where models generate descriptions inconsistent with the visual input. Recent work mitigates hallucinations through training-free representation editing, typically by constructing hallucination-related directions from teacher-forcing (TF) contrasts between hallucinated and truthful responses. However, LVLMs operate through autoregressive (AR) decoding during generation, raising the question of whether TF-based analysis fully reflects the generation dynamics that lead to hallucinated outputs. In this paper, we analyze the relationship between TF-based editing and AR generation behavior and find that TF-based editing alone may be insufficient to capture both decoding dynamics and multimodal interactions associated with hallucinations. To address this limitation, we propose DARE (Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing), a hybrid hallucination editing framework that integrates two complementary contrast pathways: textual contrasts and image contrasts, together with autoregressive-aware representation signals. Specifically, DARE constructs hallucination editing directions from (1) TF-based textual contrasts, (2) AR-aware representation transitions during decoding, and (3) controlled visual differences between paired images. Extensive experiments on multiple LVLM hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that DARE consistently reduces object hallucinations while preserving multimodal perception capability and inference efficiency. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/KU-VGI/DARE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DARE 提出双通路自回归感知的免训练表征编辑框架，用 TF 文本对比、解码期 AR 表征转移、成对图像受控视觉差异三条信号共同构造幻觉编辑方向，缓解 LVLM 的物体幻觉。在多个 LVLM 幻觉基准上一致降低物体幻觉，同时保持多模态感知能力与推理效率。
Motivation: 现有免训练编辑用 teacher-forcing 对比构造幻觉方向，但 LVLM 实际生成走自回归解码，TF 分析可能无法覆盖导致幻觉输出的解码动态与多模态交互。
Method: DARE 融合三条对比通路：TF 文本对比、解码过程中的 AR-aware 表征转移、成对图像的受控视觉差异，据此构造幻觉编辑方向，属免训练 (training-free) 表征编辑框架。
Result: 在多个 LVLM 幻觉基准上一致降低物体幻觉，同时保持多模态感知能力与推理效率；代码发布于 github.com/KU-VGI/DARE。
Conclusion: 仅靠 TF 对比不足以刻画幻觉相关的解码动态与多模态交互，把 AR 感知信号与视觉对比一起纳入编辑方向才能稳定缓解物体幻觉。
