papers.title: Bits Under ZK-LLM: Evaluating Zero-Knowledge-Friendly Quantization for Verifiable Private LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Zero-knowledge proofs are emerging as a promising approach for enabling private, verifiable LLM governance and auditing, where regulators, users, and auditors need to verify claims about training-data usage or LLM inference-time behavior, while model providers must protect proprietary model parameters. However, despite the growing interest in ZK-LLMs, the understanding of ZK-friendly quantization remains limited. This gap matters because in the ZK setting, quantization directly shapes the arithmetic structure, constraint complexity, and proving cost of ZK inference. ZK protocols operate over finite fields and incur costs that depend heavily on the number and type of arithmetic operations, nonlinearities, and lookup constraints. Understanding ZK-friendly quantization is therefore essential for making ZK-LLMs practical. In this work, we present the first systematic study of ZK-friendly quantization for LLMs. We first formalize the definition of ZK-friendly quantization, capturing the properties required for ZK proof generation. We then evaluate nine language models, including Qwen2.5-14B and the mixture-of-experts model Qwen3-30B-A3B, across a broad design space of weight, activation, and nonlinear lookup table precision. Our results show that activation precision is substantially more sensitive than weight precision, while nonlinear lookup approximations can become the dominant source of utility degradation. Also, we identify RMSNorm inverse-square-root lookups as a recurring bottleneck in several large models and recover near-baseline utility by selectively increasing precision only at the bottleneck. Finally, we show that reducing bit-width or lookup-table size does not necessarily yield proportional end-to-end proving savings, showing that conventional low-bit quantization heuristics do not directly translate to ZK proving efficiency and motivating operator-aware precision selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个 ZK-friendly 量化 (ZK-friendly quantization) 系统研究：在零知识证明 (ZK) 推理下，激活精度比权重精度敏感得多，非线性查找表 (lookup table) 近似会成为效用下降的主因；RMSNorm 的倒数平方根查找是多个大模型的共同瓶颈，只在该瓶颈处选择性提高精度即可恢复接近基线的效用。同时，减小位宽或查找表规模并不带来成比例的端到端 proving 节省，传统低位量化启发式不能直接迁移到 ZK proving 效率。
Motivation: ZK-LLM 用于可验证的私有推理与治理审计，但 ZK 协议运行在有限域上，成本取决于算术运算、非线性与查找约束的数量和类型，量化直接决定约束复杂度与 proving 成本，而 ZK-friendly 量化本身缺乏系统认识。
Method: 形式化 ZK-friendly 量化定义，刻画 ZK 证明生成所需性质；在权重、激活与非线性查找表精度构成的设计空间上，评测九个语言模型，含 Qwen2.5-14B 与 MoE 模型 Qwen3-30B-A3B。
Result: 激活精度对效用的敏感度显著高于权重精度；非线性查找近似可成为效用退化的主导来源；RMSNorm 倒数平方根查找在多个大模型中是反复出现的瓶颈，仅在瓶颈处提高精度即可恢复接近基线的效用；降低位宽或查找表规模不必然带来成比例的端到端 proving 节省。
Conclusion: ZK 推理下的精度选择应按算子感知 (operator-aware) 进行，而非沿用常规低位量化启发式，因为位宽与查找表规模的缩减不直接转化为 proving 效率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Merlin Plus: A Large-Scale, Multi-Cancer, Image-Mask-Report Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Multi-cancer segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is fundamentally limited by the scarcity of tumor masks across different organs. We present Merlin Plus, the first large-scale CT dataset with radiologist-created tumor masks across 9 organs. Merlin Plus extends the Merlin dataset by adding 1,153 per-voxel tumor masks and longitudinal metadata. To create these tumor masks, we developed a report-based active-learning framework in which radiology reports identify tumor cases for annotation and support training of a tumor segmentation model. The model generates initial masks, which radiologists review and correct to produce the final masks, reducing annotation burden while maintaining high-quality annotations. Besides tumor masks, the longitudinal metadata in Merlin Plus enables temporal modeling of cancer progression. By directly addressing the major bottleneck of limited multi-cancer segmentation masks, Merlin Plus supports scalable multi-organ cancer detection, segmentation, and longitudinal analysis in CT. Dataset is available at: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/MerlinPlus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Merlin Plus 是首个覆盖 9 个器官、由放射科医生制作肿瘤掩膜的大规模 CT 数据集，在 Merlin 基础上新增 1,153 个逐体素肿瘤掩膜与纵向元数据。掩膜由报告驱动的主动学习流程产出：放射学报告筛出待标注病例并训练分割模型，模型给出初始掩膜后经放射科医生复核修正，从而在保持标注质量的同时降低标注负担。
Motivation: 多癌种 CT 分割的核心瓶颈是跨器官肿瘤掩膜稀缺，缺少掩膜直接限制了多器官癌症检测、分割与纵向进展分析的可扩展性。
Method: 提出报告驱动的主动学习框架：用放射学报告定位肿瘤病例并支撑肿瘤分割模型训练，模型生成初始掩膜后由放射科医生审阅修正得到最终掩膜；数据集在 Merlin 之上扩展逐体素掩膜与纵向元数据以支持时序建模。
Result: Merlin Plus 覆盖 9 个器官，新增 1,153 个放射科医生制作的逐体素肿瘤掩膜及纵向元数据，掩膜流程在降低标注负担的同时保持高质量标注。
Conclusion: 直接补齐多癌种分割掩膜这一瓶颈，可支撑 CT 上可扩展的多器官癌症检测、分割与纵向分析；数据集已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Safety Operator: Modulating the Expression of Safety Instructions via Spectral Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Context tokens in a transformer-based language model can be absorbed into the model's weights as a multiplicative operator. We study this operator in the setting of safety instructions and show that influencing its dominant eigenvalue modulates how strongly the instruction shapes generation. We derive a Contrastive Safety Loss with a suppression weight that controls the tradeoff between emphasizing the safety instruction on harmful queries while suppressing it on harmless queries. Varying the suppression weight maps a relationship between the attack success and the over-refusal rates, supporting the hypothesis that the operator's eigenvalue acts as a continuous dial for the instruction's influence. Moreover, this relationship holds relatively independently of how the Safety Loss is parameterized, yielding Pareto-improved safety instructions for appropriate values of suppression weight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把上下文 token 吸收为语言模型权重中的乘性算子，通过调控其主特征值来连续调节安全指令对生成的约束强度。带抑制权重的 Contrastive Safety Loss 在有害查询上强化指令、在无害查询上抑制指令，抑制权重扫描出攻击成功率与过度拒绝率的权衡曲线，且该关系对损失参数化方式基本不敏感，可得到 Pareto 改进的安全指令。
Motivation: 安全指令对生成的约束强度目前缺少可连续调节的机制，强化指令往往同时抬高攻击成功率与过度拒绝率，二者难以解耦。
Method: 将上下文 token 吸收为模型权重上的乘性算子，分析其主特征值对指令表达的控制作用；提出 Contrastive Safety Loss，用抑制权重在有害查询上强调安全指令、在无害查询上抑制指令，通过改变该权重刻画攻击成功率与过度拒绝率的权衡。

papers.title: RA-CFGCache: From Branch-Level Criteria to Guided-Risk Control under Classifier-Free Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models enable high-quality visual generation, but iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, especially under classifier-free guidance (CFG), which requires both conditional and unconditional evaluations. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reuse of previously computed features or predictions. However, existing branch-local reuse criteria do not explicitly account for how cache errors combine under CFG or how local perturbations affect the final output. We identify two misalignments in cache control: a branch-guided mismatch, where guided error depends on both the magnitudes and alignment of branch errors, and a local-final mismatch, where the downstream impact of a local error varies across timesteps. We propose RA-CFGCache, a Risk-Aligned Caching framework under CFG that incorporates both factors while keeping the sampling schedule and guidance rule fixed. CFG-aware Guided-Risk Composition combines existing branch-wise proxies using CFG coefficients and offline-calibrated cross-branch alignment. Propagation-Aware Rescaling further weights the resulting guided-risk estimate with a timestep-dependent propagation prior calibrated from isolated reuse perturbations. An online threshold controller then determines when to jointly refresh or reuse both branches. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and CogVideoX-2B demonstrate improved efficiency--fidelity trade-offs over evaluated training-free caching baselines. Moreover, RA-CFGCache is compatible with diverse base proxy families, including TeaCache-, DiCache-, and MagCache-style estimators, and consistently improves fidelity at nearly unchanged latency. Code is available at https://github.com/yiming-l21/RA-CFGCache.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RA-CFGCache 把 CFG 下的缓存控制从分支局部判据改为风险对齐：用 CFG 系数与离线标定的跨分支对齐度合成引导风险，再乘以由孤立复用扰动标定的逐时间步传播先验，由在线阈值控制器决定两分支同时刷新还是复用。在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、CogVideoX-2B 上相对被评估的 training-free 缓存基线取得更好的效率-保真权衡，并在 TeaCache、DiCache、MagCache 风格估计器上以几乎不变的延迟一致提升保真度。
Motivation: CFG 下缓存需同时算条件与无条件两支，现有复用判据只看单分支局部误差，既不刻画两支误差在 CFG 下如何合成，也不刻画局部扰动经下游传播后对最终输出的影响，导致缓存错误与真实输出偏差错位。
Method: 提出 Risk-Aligned Caching 框架，固定采样调度与 guidance 规则：CFG-aware Guided-Risk Composition 用 CFG 系数与离线标定的跨分支对齐度组合既有分支级代理；Propagation-Away Rescaling 用从孤立复用扰动标定的逐时间步传播先验加权该估计；在线阈值控制器据此决定联合刷新或复用两分支。
Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、CogVideoX-2B 上，相对所评估的 training-free 缓存基线取得更优的效率-保真权衡；可兼容 TeaCache、DiCache、MagCache 风格的多种基代理族，并在几乎不改变延迟的前提下一致提升保真度。
Conclusion: 缓存控制必须同时对齐 CFG 下的分支误差合成与误差随时间步的下游传播，才能在不改调度与 guidance 的前提下稳定换取更低采样开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Temporal-Aware Fusion for Robust Outdoor LiDAR Localization
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR relocalization aims to estimate the global 6-DoF pose of a sensor in the environment. However, existing regression-based approaches often encounter limitations in dynamic or ambiguous scenarios, as they typically prioritize single-frame inference, leaving the potential of spatio-temporal consistency across scans not fully explored. In this paper, we propose a Temporal-aware Localization framework (TempLoc) designed to enhance the robustness of outdoor localization by effectively modeling sequential consistency. Specifically, a Global Coordinate Estimation module is first introduced to predict point-wise global coordinates and associated uncertainties for each LiDAR scan. A Prior Coordinate Generation module is then presented to estimate inter-frame point correspondences by the attention mechanism. Lastly, an Uncertainty-Guided Coordinate Fusion module is deployed to integrate both predictions of point correspondence in an end-to-end fashion, yielding a more temporally consistent and accurate global 6-DoF pose. Experimental results on the NCLT and Oxford RobotCar benchmarks show that our TempLoc outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal-aware correspondence modeling in LiDAR relocalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出时序感知的 LiDAR 重定位框架 TempLoc，用全局坐标估计、注意力生成的帧间先验坐标与不确定性引导融合三条链路联合建模跨帧一致性，在动态或退化场景下输出更稳定的全局 6-DoF 位姿。在 NCLT 与 Oxford RobotCar 上超过现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 基于回归的 LiDAR 重定位通常只做单帧推理，在动态或特征退化场景下位姿易跳变，跨扫描的时空一致性没有被利用。
Method: TempLoc 含三个模块：Global Coordinate Estimation 逐点预测全局坐标及其不确定性；Prior Coordinate Generation 用 attention 机制估计帧间点对应；Uncertainty-Guided Coordinate Fusion 以端到端方式融合两类对应预测，输出全局 6-DoF 位姿。
Result: 在 NCLT 与 Oxford RobotCar 两个基准上，TempLoc 的重定位精度超过最先进方法，摘要表述为 a large margin，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 时序对应建模是提升室外 LiDAR 重定位鲁棒性的有效途径，单帧回归范式在动态与歧义场景下存在明显上限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Towards Scalable Context-Aware Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology Images
papers.abstract_en: Predicting gene expression from H&E-stained histology images offers a scalable alternative to costly spatial transcriptomics, yet most existing methods operate at the spot level, where signals from multiple cells are aggregated and critical cellular heterogeneity is obscured. Extending this paradigm to single-cell resolution is non-trivial. Naively applying pathology foundation models faces a scale mismatch: their patch-level representations mix multiple cells, whereas per-cell cropping or resizing distorts morphology and removes local context. Conversely, segmentation-based models without strong pretrained visual encoders often lack the morphological representation capacity needed for accurate molecular prediction and inherit errors from imperfect cell boundary masks. Here, we present CELLO, an efficient end-to-end framework that performs a single pathology foundation model forward pass per image and uses grid sampling to extract location-specific features for all cells simultaneously. We further introduce a distance-decay cross-attention module that refines each cell representation using spatially biased local morphological context. Using 52 public Xenium-H&E pairs from HEST-1k that span 12 organs and approximately 10 million cells, CELLO improves the average predictive accuracy over the evaluated baselines while reducing the mean whole-slide inference time compared to DeepSpot2Cell, a 14.0x speed-up on average that excludes upstream cell segmentation. Our work establishes a scalable foundation for single-cell gene expression prediction from H&E images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CELLO 用单次病理基础模型前向加 grid sampling 一次性抽取全片所有细胞的位置特征，再用 distance-decay cross-attention 注入空间偏置的局部形态上下文，实现单细胞分辨率的基因表达预测。在 HEST-1k 的 52 组 Xenium-H&E 配对（12 个器官、约 1000 万细胞）上，平均预测精度高于所评估基线，整片推理时间相对 DeepSpot2Cell 平均加速 14.0 倍（不含上游细胞分割）。
Motivation: 现有方法多在 spot 层面聚合信号，掩盖细胞异质性；直接套用病理基础模型会遇到尺度错配——patch 表征混杂多个细胞，而逐细胞裁剪或缩放会扭曲形态并丢失局部上下文。
Method: CELLO 是端到端框架：每张图只做一次病理基础模型前向，用 grid sampling 同时抽取所有细胞的位置特异特征；再引入 distance-decay cross-attention 模块，用空间偏置的局部形态上下文精炼每个细胞表征。
Result: 在 HEST-1k 的 52 组公开 Xenium-H&E 配对、覆盖 12 个器官、约 1000 万细胞上，平均预测精度优于所评估基线；相对 DeepSpot2Cell 的整片推理时间平均降低，加速 14.0 倍（该数字不含上游细胞分割）。
Conclusion: 单次基础模型前向加 grid sampling 与距离衰减交叉注意力，可以在保持精度的同时把单细胞基因表达预测做成可扩展的整片推理流程。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Losing the name before the box: measuring and repairing what narrow fine-tuning costs a detector outside its deployment vocabulary
papers.abstract_en: A detector pretrained on a broad corpus is fine-tuned on a narrow domain, its in-domain accuracy improves, and it ships. We ask what happens meanwhile to its coverage of objects the vocabulary never names, which in obstacle detection and inspection carry the risk. No in-domain test set holds an example of one. We give a longitudinal protocol: one pretrained checkpoint against its own fine-tuned descendants. It tracks held-out top-$K$ proposal coverage $C_τ$: of categories pretraining covered and the vocabulary omits, the share of boxes a detector's top $K$ regions still cover. The quantity is the open-world proposal literature's; the longitudinal reading is not. $C_τ$ falls while in-domain accuracy rises, on four architectures and three domains, by $5.12$ to $63.35$ points on boxes above $1024$ px$^2$. No in-domain number identifies the fall, and neither does detection average precision, which charges a missed and a misnamed box alike. On the one architecture scoring both, adaptation costs $87\%$ of the AP against a fifth of the coverage, and the naming goes first at all six depths of its freeze ladder, every run. What breaks is structured: three architectures sharing no pretraining run agree on which categories lose coverage, and those a model never learned do not lose any. A repair follows and needs no training: mixing a quarter of the pretrained state back, normalisation statistics included, raises coverage on every cell swept for at most $2.47$ points of in-domain accuracy. Seeing it costs one extra evaluation pass.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material (69 pages) is included as an ancillary file. Submitted to the International Journal of Computer Vision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 窄域微调会先牺牲检测器对预训练词表未命名类别的覆盖：纵向追踪同一预训练检查点与其微调后代，held-out top-K proposal coverage Cτ 在四个架构、三个域上随域内精度上升而下降 5.12 到 63.35 点（面积 >1024 px²）。无需训练的修复是把四分之一预训练权重（含归一化统计量）混回，覆盖在所有扫描格点上回升，代价至多 2.47 点域内精度。
Motivation: 检测器在窄域微调后域内精度提升即出厂，但词表从未命名的物体覆盖会同时退化，而障碍物检测与巡检场景中漏检带风险；域内测试集不含这类样本，域内指标与检测 AP 都无法暴露这次退化。
Method: 提出纵向协议：拿一个预训练检查点对照它自己的微调后代，追踪 held-out top-K proposal coverage Cτ，即预训练覆盖但词表省略的类别中，检测器 top K 区域仍覆盖的框比例；在四个架构、三个域上测量，并在单一架构上比较 AP 与覆盖的代价、检验六层 freeze ladder。修复方案为混合四分之一预训练状态（含归一化统计量），无需训练，仅需一次额外评估前向。
Result: Cτ 在四个架构、三个域上随域内精度上升而下降 5.12 到 63.35 点（框面积 >1024 px²）；域内指标与检测 AP 均无法识别该下降。在同时给出两者的那一架构上，适配以五分之一的覆盖代价换掉 87% 的 AP，且命名先失效在六层 freeze ladder 的每一层、每一次运行中都出现。三个不共享预训练运行的架构在哪些类别失去覆盖上一致，模型从未学会的类别不失去覆盖。混入四分之一预训练状态（含归一化统计量）在所有扫描格点上提升覆盖，代价至多 2.47 点域内精度。
Conclusion: 窄域微调的退化是结构性的：先丢的是预训练学过但词表未命名的类别命名，且域内指标无法预警；按四分之一比例混回预训练状态即可在几乎不损失域内精度的条件下修复覆盖，代价只需一次额外评估前向。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出纵向协议：拿一个预训练检查点对照它自己的微调后代，追踪 held-out top-K proposal coverage Cτ，即预训练覆盖但词表省略的类别中，检测器 top K 区域仍覆盖的框比例；在四个架构、三个域上测量，并在单一架构上比较 AP 与覆盖的代价、检验六层 freeze ladder。修复方案为混合四分之一预训练状态（含归一化统计量），无需训练，仅需一次额外评估前向。
summary_sections.result: Cτ 在四个架构、三个域上随域内精度上升而下降 5.12 到 63.35 点（框面积 >1024 px²）；域内指标与检测 AP 均无法识别该下降。在同时给出两者的那一架构上，适配以五分之一的覆盖代价换掉 87% 的 AP，且命名先失效在六层 freeze ladder 的每一层、每一次运行中都出现。三个不共享预训练运行的架构在哪些类别失去覆盖上一致，模型从未学会的类别不失去覆盖。混入四分之一预训练状态（含归一化统计量）在所有扫描格点上提升覆盖，代价至多 2.47 点域内精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 窄域微调的退化是结构性的：先丢的是预训练学过但词表未命名的类别命名，且域内指标无法预警；按四分之一比例混回预训练状态即可在几乎不损失域内精度的条件下修复覆盖，代价只需一次额外评估前向。

papers.title: Sample Complexity of Equivariant Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for robotic control, yet its practical application is often hindered by high sample complexity. This is particularly restrictive in physical domains where interaction data is costly. While the world often exhibits geometric and physical symmetries, standard RL algorithms typically fail to exploit this structure. In this paper, we demonstrate that exploiting group symmetries significantly reduces the sample complexity of RL. Focusing on finite-horizon Markov decision processes, we find that leveraging homomorphisms induced by group symmetries significantly reduces the theoretical upper and lower bounds on the number of environment interactions required to reach an optimal return. We further extend these bounds to continuous state and action spaces, providing corresponding sample-complexity guarantees under appropriate regularity assumptions. Beyond theory, we validate our findings through controlled experiments and demonstrate the advantages of symmetry-aware policy learning on high-dimensional continuous robotic simulations. Our results show that integrating symmetry into the learning pipeline yields substantial gains in sample efficiency and performance, offering a principled path toward more data-efficient robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在有限时域 MDP 中利用群对称性诱导的同态 (homomorphism) 能显著降低达到最优回报所需的环境交互数的理论上界与下界，并把界推广到连续状态动作空间。在高维连续机器人仿真上的对照实验显示，对称性感知的策略学习在样本效率与性能上都有实质提升。
Motivation: RL 在物理机器人等交互数据昂贵的领域受高样本复杂度制约，而标准 RL 算法通常不利用世界中普遍存在的几何与物理对称结构。
Method: 在有限时域 MDP 框架下，用群对称性诱导的同态推导环境交互数的理论上界与下界，并在适当正则性假设下推广到连续状态与动作空间；再以受控实验和高维连续机器人仿真验证对称性感知的策略学习。
Result: 利用同态使达到最优回报所需交互数的理论上界与下界都显著降低，并给出连续状态动作空间下的样本复杂度保证；受控实验与高维连续机器人仿真显示对称性整合带来样本效率与性能的实质增益（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把对称性纳入学习流程是提升机器人 RL 数据效率的原则性路径，理论界与实验一致支持这一点。

papers.title: Support-Set Target Leakage in Relational Foundation Models during In-Context Learning: Model Dependence and Evaluation Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Relational in-context learning (ICL) uses labeled support examples and their linked relational context to predict labels for new queries. This creates a failure mode when target-derived features are present in the support context but unavailable for the query. We study this setting as support-set target leakage. We construct 20 controlled target-derived features that vary in signal fidelity, representation, semantic transparency, coverage, and zero-, one-, and two-hop relational placement, and evaluate them across 13 RelBench tasks and five relational ICL configurations that vary the ICL head, message-passing depth, pretraining cohort, or relational encoder architecture. We evaluate matched 0-hop, 1-hop, and 2-hop leakage settings, together with a Full leakage condition containing all 20 leaker columns. Within the tested configurations, target-table (0-hop) and Full leakage produce the largest aggregate deviations from clean evaluation, while higher-hop effects are often weaker, consistent with differences in effective exposure associated with temporal reachability, sampling, and aggregation fidelity. Leakage effects are strongly task- and model-dependent and can reverse relative conclusions between model variants even when aggregate changes are small. For leaker detection, we compare an Integrated Gradients (IG)-based screening method with mutual information (MI) and leave-one-column-out (LOCO) on a common Baseline subset. Ranking quality is strongest in the high-impact 0-hop and Full leakage conditions, but detector-based removal does not consistently restore the clean evaluation. A four-task rel-salt case study further shows the same evaluation concern with native-schema leakage candidates from the original relational schema. These results identify the support/query information boundary as an important component of reliable relational ICL evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 关系型 in-context learning 中，若支撑集 (support set) 含由目标派生的特征而查询样本没有，会形成 support-set target leakage，扭曲评测结论。构造 20 个人工泄漏特征，在 13 个 RelBench 任务与 5 种关系 ICL 配置上测试：0-hop（目标表）与 Full 泄漏造成最大偏离，且泄漏效应强依赖任务与模型，甚至可反转模型变体间的相对结论。
Motivation: 关系型 ICL 评测中支撑集与查询集的信息边界不清晰，目标派生特征一旦进入支撑上下文，模型排名可能被泄漏而非能力决定，评测可靠性受损。
Method: 构造 20 个受控目标派生特征，按信号保真度、表示、语义透明度、覆盖度及 0/1/2-hop 关系位置变化；在 13 个 RelBench 任务、5 种关系 ICL 配置（改变 ICL head、消息传递深度、预训练群体、关系编码器架构）下评测 0-hop、1-hop、2-hop 与 Full（含全部 20 列）泄漏条件；泄漏检测对比 Integrated Gradients (IG)、互信息 (MI) 与 leave-one-column-out (LOCO)，另有 4 任务 rel-salt 案例研究。
Result: 0-hop 与 Full 泄漏产生最大的整体偏离，高跳数效应往往更弱；泄漏效应强任务与模型依赖，可反转模型变体间相对结论，即便整体变化很小。检测方面 IG 排名质量在高影响的 0-hop 与 Full 条件下最强，但基于检测器的移除不能一致恢复干净评测；4 任务 rel-salt 案例在原生 schema 泄漏候选上复现同一评测问题。
Conclusion: 支撑集/查询集的信息边界是关系型 ICL 可靠评测的关键组成部分，仅靠泄漏检测与列移除不足以恢复干净评测结论。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in real-world environments must execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets struggle to support this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode while the rare bimanual effort that does label subtasks annotates only a fraction of its hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset of 40,543 episodes, 1,718 hours, and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask, and show that mid-training it this way yields substantial gains. Specifically, success on a spatial disambiguation task increases from 32.0% to 100.0%, and step-by-step human subtask guidance lifts success on an unseen long-horizon task from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, after minimal fine-tuning on a new robot, the policy requires one-tenth the data of baselines without mid-training and generalizes zero-shot to completely unseen tasks on the new hardware. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.
papers.comment: 26 pages. Code and model weights will be integrated into Hugging Face LeRobot https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FineART 提供 40,543 条双臂操作 episode、1,718 小时、533,913 个子任务标注（151 个任务）的细粒度数据集，并提出会自行预测下一个子任务的视觉-语言-动作策略 FineART-VLA。把「预测自身子任务」加入 mid-training 后，空间消歧任务成功率从 32.0% 升到 100.0%，在未见过的长程任务上配合逐步子任务引导从 16.0% 升到 76.0%；换新机器人只需基线十分之一的数据微调即可零样本泛化到全新任务。
Motivation: 现有操作数据集难以支撑长程多步双臂任务：单臂数据集虽达数十万条轨迹，但每条 episode 通常只有一条高层指令，少数标注子任务的双臂数据也只覆盖其时长的一小部分。
Method: 构建密集标注的双臂数据集 FineART（40,543 episodes / 1,718 小时 / 533,913 子任务 / 151 任务），并提出 FineART-VLA 策略：在 mid-training 阶段让模型预测自身的下一个子任务，推理时可接受逐步人类子任务引导；随后在新机器人上做最小微调。
Result: 加入子任务自预测的 mid-training 后，空间消歧任务成功率 32.0% → 100.0%；在未见过的长程任务上，配合逐步人类子任务引导成功率 16.0% → 76.0%；在新机器人上最少微调即只需基线（无 mid-training）十分之一的数据，并对全新任务零样本泛化。数据集、模型权重与训练代码全部开源。
Conclusion: 让 VLA 在 mid-training 中自预测子任务，是把长程双臂操作成功率与跨硬件数据效率同时抬起来的关键设计；细粒度子任务标注是这条路径的前提。

papers.title: Longer Records, Broader Invariance: The Hidden Scaling Problem in Longitudinal Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal data are valuable because people change. Yet the objectives used to learn from these data can inadvertently erase that change. In person-level contrastive learning, observations from the same person are treated as positives; as records grow, those positives can span increasingly distant---and increasingly different---behavioral states. More history can therefore produce not only more data, but broader invariance. We show that this distinction is fundamental. We separate \emph{record span}, how much history the learner sees, from \emph{supervision span}, how far across that history positive-pair supervision reaches. Across in-home sensing records spanning up to 2.7 years, broader supervision systematically suppresses recoverable changing-state information, even when the available history is held fixed. At the broadest span, less than 10\% of the information recoverable from an untrained encoder remains. Yet keeping positives local is not sufficient: as records grow, even distant states that are never paired become increasingly similar. Explicitly contrasting other observations from the same person reverses this loss without shortening the record, revealing a second route by which longitudinal scale can broaden invariance. Finally, we prospectively reproduce the supervision-span effect in 199 GLOBEM participants. Longitudinal scale therefore presents a choice: more history need not mean more invariance. By controlling what is held invariant as records grow, we can preserve the change that made the longitudinal data valuable in the first place.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 纵向对比学习中，把同一人的所有观测当正样本会随记录变长而抹掉个体行为变化：作者把 record span（看到多少历史）与 supervision span（正样本监督跨越多远）分开，发现监督跨度越宽，可恢复的变化状态信息越少，最宽跨度下只剩未训练编码器可恢复信息的不到 10%。仅把正样本保持局部仍不够，因为记录变长后远距离状态本身也会趋同；显式把同一人其他观测作为负样本对比可在不缩短记录的前提下逆转这一损失，并在 199 名 GLOBEM 参与者上前瞻复现。
Motivation: 纵向传感数据的价值在于人会变，但 person-level 对比学习把同人观测当正样本，记录越长正样本跨越的行为状态越远越不同，导致更多历史反而带来更强的不变性、抹掉可恢复的变化信息。
Method: 在跨度最长 2.7 年的 in-home sensing 记录上，分离 record span 与 supervision span 两个变量，固定可用历史、系统改变正样本监督跨度，测量可恢复的变化状态信息；再通过把同一人其他观测显式作为对比负样本的方案，并在 199 名 GLOBEM 参与者上做前瞻性复现。
Result: 监督跨度越宽，可恢复的变化状态信息被系统性抑制；最宽跨度下，未训练编码器可恢复信息中不足 10% 仍可保留。仅保持正样本局部不足以阻止远距离状态趋同；显式对比同人其他观测可逆转该损失。该 supervision-span 效应在 199 名 GLOBEM 参与者上被前瞻性复现。
Conclusion: 纵向规模本身构成一种选择：更多历史不必意味着更强不变性，通过控制记录增长时什么被保持不变，可以保住使纵向数据有价值的变化。

papers.title: What Makes High-Magnification Knowledge Transferable? A Study of Cross-Resolution Distillation in Whole-Slide Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Cross-resolution knowledge distillation aims to improve low-magnification whole- slide analysis by transferring high-magnification representations, yet the conditions for useful transfer remain unclear. We develop a decomposition-based analysis of teacher access, representation loss, and model excess, motivating three questions: whether (a) teacher targets help the task, (b) low-magnification students can predict them, and (c) slide models benefit from those predictions. We investigate them through controlled experiments across ten pathology cohorts spanning classifi- cation, grading, and survival prediction. In the main comparison, providing teacher regional means alongside native low-magnification features improves downstream performance in all ten cohorts. Direct prediction achieves lower reconstruction error than residual prediction, yet the predicted features underrepresent variation in the teacher targets. Moreover, better reconstruction does not consistently improve downstream scores, and retaining native features changes performance even when the predicted teacher features are held fixed. Together, these findings expose a gap between reconstructing teacher representations and realizing their downstream value. They challenge the sufficiency of reconstruction error as a measure of cross-resolution transfer and provide a diagnostic framework for examining where that transfer breaks down. Future distillation designs must account for both what students can predict and how slide models use those predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在全切片病理图像 (WSI) 的跨分辨率蒸馏中，把高倍教师的区域均值 (regional means) 与低倍学生原生特征一起输入，十个病理队列的下游任务全部提升；但直接预测的重建误差低于残差预测，重建更好却并不稳定带来下游分数提升，且保留原生特征在预测教师特征固定时仍改变性能。结论是重建误差不足以衡量跨分辨率迁移价值，蒸馏设计必须同时考虑学生能预测什么以及切片模型如何使用这些预测。
Motivation: 跨分辨率知识蒸馏何时真正有用一直缺少判据：教师目标是否对任务有用、低倍学生能否预测、切片模型能否用上这些预测，三个条件此前未被分解检验。
Method: 提出基于分解的分析框架，把迁移拆成 teacher access、representation loss、model excess 三部分，并据此设计三个受控问题；在十个病理队列上做受控实验，覆盖分类、分级与生存预测三类任务，对比提供教师区域均值与仅用低倍原生特征、以及直接预测与残差预测两种方案。
Result: 在全部十个病理队列中，教师区域均值叠加低倍原生特征均提升下游表现；直接预测的重建误差低于残差预测，但预测特征对教师目标的变化表征不足；重建误差更低并不一致地提高下游分数，且在预测教师特征固定时保留原生特征仍会改变性能。
Conclusion: 重建教师表征与兑现其下游价值之间存在缺口，重建误差作为跨分辨率迁移的度量并不充分；未来蒸馏设计需同时约束学生的可预测性与切片模型对预测特征的使用方式。

papers.title: From Retrieval to Reasoning: Agentic Mechanism Prediction from Cell Painting Profiles
papers.abstract_en: Cell Painting is a high-content morphological profiling assay widely used for phenotype-based biological inference, with mechanism of action (MOA) prediction as a central application. Existing approaches largely formulate Cell Painting-based inference as representation matching, assigning predictions from nearby reference perturbations in morphological feature space. However, retrieved neighbors are often noisy and partially misleading evidence due to batch effects, non-specific cytotoxicity, phenotypic convergence, and source-dependent variability. We reformulate Cell Painting-based MOA prediction as a calibrated evidence reasoning problem, where retrieved neighbors are treated as uncertain observations that must be evaluated, compared, and sometimes rejected before supporting a mechanistic conclusion. We propose PhenoAIR, a reliability-aware multi-agent framework that maintains a candidate-centric evidence memory and performs controller-guided refinement over phenotype- and mechanism-side evidence. PhenoAIR uses offline reference-set calibration to weight evidence by source reliability, phenotype stability, and mechanism-level confusion. We evaluate PhenoAIR on a benchmark constructed from JUMP Cell Painting profiles and annotations, covering controlled, realistic, and discovery-oriented open-world MOA prediction settings. PhenoAIR outperforms representation-matching and LLM-based baselines across all settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Cell Painting 的作用机制 (MOA) 预测从表征匹配重构为可校准的证据推理：检索到的邻居被视为带噪、可能误导的不确定观测，需先评估比较再决定采纳或拒绝。多智能体框架 PhenoAIR 用离线参考集校准按来源可靠性、表型稳定性与机制级混淆加权证据，在 JUMP Cell Painting 构建的受控、真实与开放世界发现三类设定上均超过表征匹配与 LLM 基线。
Motivation: Cell Painting 推理长期被当作表征匹配，直接取形态特征空间近邻的预测，但近邻常因批次效应、非特异性毒性、表型趋同与来源差异而带噪甚至误导，机制结论缺乏可靠性控制。
Method: 提出 PhenoAIR：可靠性感知多智能体框架，维护以候选为中心的证据记忆，由 controller 引导对表型侧与机制侧证据做迭代精炼；用离线参考集校准，按来源可靠性、表型稳定性、机制级混淆为证据加权，把检索邻居当作需评估、比较、必要时拒绝的不确定观测。
Result: 在基于 JUMP Cell Painting profiles 与标注构建的 benchmark 上，覆盖受控、真实与面向发现的开放世界 MOA 预测三类设定，PhenoAIR 在全部设定中均优于表征匹配类与 LLM 类基线。
Conclusion: MOA 预测应作为带可靠性校准的证据推理问题处理，检索邻居须先经评估与拒绝机制再支撑机制结论，而非直接取近邻标签。

papers.title: Gap-free Differentially Private PCA for Gaussian Data
papers.abstract_en: We give a gap-free $(ε,δ)$-differentially private algorithm for the principal component analysis (PCA) problem with Gaussian data. The algorithm is based on a private variant of the power iteration method, and it is computationally efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出高斯数据下主成分分析 (PCA) 的无 gap (ε,δ)-差分隐私算法，基于私有化的幂迭代 (power iteration) 构造，且计算高效。
Motivation: 在高斯数据上做差分隐私 PCA 时，现有做法通常需要目标谱上存在间隔 (gap) 才能保证精度，本文要消除这一前提。
Method: 设计幂迭代的私有变体，构成一个 (ε,δ)-差分隐私的 PCA 算法，输入为高斯数据，并保持计算高效。
Result: 给出一个无 gap 前提的 (ε,δ)-差分隐私 PCA 算法，适用于高斯数据，计算高效；摘要未给出误差、运行时间或与基线的数值对比。
Conclusion: 高斯数据上的差分隐私 PCA 可以在不要求谱间隔的条件下用私有幂迭代高效求解。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: TaskIR: Task-Driven Image Restoration via Degradation Adaptation and Task Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Task-driven image restoration aims to improve both image quality and downstream task performance. However, existing methods predominantly focus on single degradation type and struggle to handle the diverse degradations encountered in real-world scenarios. Different degradations impose distinct restoration demands, and insufficient restoration may leave residual degradations and artifacts that impair object boundaries and semantic cues, thereby compromising downstream task performance. To address these challenges, we propose TaskIR, a two-stage task-driven unified image restoration framework that integrates degradation-adaptive restoration with task feedback refinement. In Stage I, a Degradation Representation Module (DRM) extracts degradation representations, enabling a Degradation-Guided Transformer Block (DGTB) to dynamically modulate feature transformations for adaptive restoration. In Stage II, a Task-to-Restoration Feedback Generation module (TRFG) transforms heterogeneous task features into restoration feedback by modeling task-representation discrepancies associated with the current restoration. Subsequently, a Selective Task Feedback Refinement module (STFR) assesses feedback relevance and selectively refines intermediate restoration features to mitigate interference with well-restored content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaskIR achieves competitive restoration quality and downstream task performance across diverse degradations and tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaskIR 是两阶段任务驱动统一图像复原框架：先用退化表征模块 (DRM) 提取退化表征并由退化引导 Transformer 块 (DGTB) 动态调制特征变换，再由任务到复原反馈生成 (TRFG) 把异构任务特征转成复原反馈，选择性任务反馈精炼 (STFR) 按相关度精炼中间特征。实验显示它在多种退化与多种任务上取得有竞争力的复原质量与下游任务性能。
Motivation: 现有任务驱动复原方法多针对单一退化类型，难以应对真实场景的多样退化；复原不足会留下残余退化与伪影，破坏目标边界和语义线索，进而损害下游任务表现。
Method: 两阶段框架：Stage I 用 DRM 提取退化表征，驱动 DGTB 动态调制特征变换实现退化自适应复原；Stage II 的 TRFG 建模当前复原的任务-表征差异，把异构任务特征转为复原反馈，STFR 评估反馈相关度并选择性精炼中间复原特征，避免干扰已复原内容。
Result: 在多种退化与多种任务上的大量实验中，TaskIR 取得有竞争力的复原质量与下游任务性能。
Conclusion: 把退化自适应复原与任务反馈精炼串成两阶段流程，可在统一框架下同时兼顾图像质量与下游任务表现，覆盖多样真实退化。

papers.title: RAZOR: Pruning Replaceable Experts in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token yet store the entire expert pool. Whole-expert pruning shrinks that pool, but for reasoning models it must remove experts without eroding reasoning ability. Common scores rank experts by routing frequency or output magnitude, which measures isolated contribution rather than deletion damage. What decides the damage is functional replaceability, whether the surviving computation can reproduce what is removed. A large contribution may be replaceable by the remaining mixture, whereas a small one may carry a direction the survivors cannot recover. We introduce RAZOR, a training-free method that scores replaceability from consensus residuals, the deviations of individual expert outputs from their original weighted mixture. Holding the layer input fixed, these residuals yield the exact output change from deleting one expert, including survivor reweighting and the replacement expert promoted by router refill. RAZOR aggregates this change over calibration tokens and prunes to a layerwise budget using forward passes alone, without gradients, subset search, or recovery training. On GLM-4.7-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, and Hy3 at 25% and 50% expert removal, RAZOR attains the highest macro average over nine reasoning-centered tasks among the evaluated pruning methods in all eight model-budget settings. Against REAP on GLM-4.7-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, it gains 2.12-5.59 points on this average and lowers reverse KL in all four comparisons. Retained accuracy is not the whole picture, as pruned Qwen3.6-35B-A3B still shifts in response diversity, formatting, and termination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAZOR 是面向 MoE 推理模型的免训练整专家剪枝方法，用“共识残差”（各专家输出相对原加权混合的偏差）度量可替代性而非贡献大小：固定层输入时，残差精确给出删除单个专家的输出变化，含幸存者重加权与 router refill 晋升的替补专家。在 GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、Hy3 上按 25% 与 50% 专家删除共八种模型-预算组合，RAZOR 在九项推理任务的宏平均上均为所评剪枝方法中最高；对 REAP 在两个模型上高出 2.12–5.59 分且四次比较的 reverse KL 全部下降。
Motivation: MoE 每 token 只激活少数专家却存下整个专家池；整专家剪枝要缩小这个池，但对推理模型必须在删专家时不损伤推理能力。按路由频率或输出幅度打分衡量的是孤立贡献，而非删除造成的实际损害。
Method: 免训练、仅前向：从共识残差（单专家输出对其原加权混合的偏差）打分可替代性，固定层输入使残差精确给出删除一个专家的输出变化（含幸存者重加权与 router refill 晋升的替补专家）；在校准 token 上聚合该变化，按层预算剪枝，无需梯度、子集搜索或恢复训练。
Result: 在 GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、Hy3 的 25% 与 50% 专家删除共八种模型-预算设置中，RAZOR 在九项推理任务的宏平均上均为所评剪枝方法最高；对 REAP 在 GLM-4.7-Flash 与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上该平均高 2.12–5.59 分，四次比较的 reverse KL 全部更低。剪枝后的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在响应多样性、格式与终止行为上仍有偏移。
Conclusion: 决定剪枝损害的是功能可替代性而非贡献大小，共识残差加仅前向打分即可在不损伤推理的前提下按层预算删除专家；但保留精度不是全部，剪枝后模型的响应多样性、格式与终止仍会偏移。

summary_sections.result: 在 GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、Hy3 的 25% 与 50% 专家删除共八种模型-预算设置中，RAZOR 在九项推理任务的宏平均上均为所评剪枝方法最高；对 REAP 在 GLM-4.7-Flash 与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上该平均高 2.12–5.59 分，四次比较的 reverse KL 全部更低。剪枝后的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在响应多样性、格式与终止行为上仍有偏移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 决定剪枝损害的是功能可替代性而非贡献大小，共识残差加仅前向打分即可在不损伤推理的前提下按层预算删除专家；但保留精度不是全部，剪枝后模型的响应多样性、格式与终止仍会偏移。

papers.title: Aim Short to Reach Far: Your Frozen World Model Can Plan Better Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models plan toward goal images with a frozen pretrained predictor, without task rewards or extra trained heads. However, their planners struggle with long-range goals, and prior work addresses this by training extra components such as value functions or subgoal models. We show that the planning target itself can cause this failure: even with exact dynamics and globally optimal short-horizon search, scoring predictions by their distance to the final goal rejects the first steps of a route that initially moves away from the goal. Building on this insight, we propose Anchored Planning (AP), a training-free method that reuses the world model's own offline trajectories. AP retrieves a segment that leads from the current observation toward the goal and aims the frozen planner at an observation shortly after the segment's start. Across four diverse tasks, AP substantially improves frozen LeWM planners for both action synthesis and action ranking, and it outperforms both additional final-goal search and the LeWM planner on long-range goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结 latent world model 用最终目标图像做长程规划会失败，因为按与最终目标的距离给预测打分会拒绝那些先绕开目标的正确起步动作。提出免训练的 Anchored Planning (AP)：复用世界模型自己的离线轨迹，检索一段从当前观测通向目标的片段，再把冻结规划器的目标改设为该片段起点稍后的一帧观测。在四类任务上 AP 显著改善 frozen LeWM 的动作合成与动作排序，并在长程目标上超过追加的最终目标搜索与原 LeWM 规划器。
Motivation: latent world model 的规划器在长程目标上失效，既有做法要额外训练 value function 或 subgoal model；作者指出根因在规划目标本身，而非模型能力。
Method: Anchored Planning (AP)：不训练任何组件，复用世界模型的离线轨迹，检索从当前观测指向目标的片段，把冻结规划器的瞄准点改为片段起点稍后的一帧观测，用于动作合成 (action synthesis) 与动作排序 (action ranking)。
Result: 在四类不同任务上，AP 显著提升 frozen LeWM 规划器在动作合成与动作排序两种用法上的表现，并在长程目标上优于额外的最终目标搜索 (additional final-goal search) 与原 LeWM 规划器；摘要给出的是定性提升，未附具体数值。
Conclusion: 长程规划失败可由规划目标的打分方式解释：即使动力学精确、短程搜索全局最优，按最终目标距离打分也会拒掉先远离目标的正确起步；改瞄中间锚点即可在不训练新组件的前提下改善冻结规划器。

papers.title: Decoupled Early Exits for Task-Dependent Compute Allocation in Flow-Matching VLAs
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a potential solution for generalist robot control, designed by combining a pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with an action expert that generates continuous robot actions. While these models exhibit impressive capabilities, due to their very high number of parameters, their computational requirements are often prohibitive for robotics control. To mitigate these inefficiencies, existing methods predominantly skip VLM backbone layers with early exits or reduce denoising steps, while leaving action expert depth untouched. We propose a framework that exposes backbone depth $V$, action expert depth $A$, and denoising steps $D$ as three jointly configurable compute axes in a VLA. Starting from a pretrained VLA, we attach lightweight Exit Transformers (ET) at intermediate depths in both the backbone and the action expert, trained to distil the last layer of the policy into each exit. Furthermore, we introduce a KV Cache synthesis mechanism that manages the missing keys and values of the skipped backbone layers, allowing the action expert to exit deeper than the backbone. Finally, we show that the optimal compute budget is task-dependent, with different tasks benefiting from different axes and depths. Notably, our method does not require training the original policy from scratch, and for each exit, it increases the number of parameters by only $2.1\%$ for SmolVLA and $4.1\%$ for $π_{0.5}$. We validate our approach across two flow-matching VLAs (SmolVLA, $π_{0.5}$) and two benchmarks (LIBERO, Meta-World), revealing complementary effects: $V$ and $A$ respectively reduce FLOPs and latency, while $D$ improves both. Our joint configurations $(V,A,D)$ reduce latency by $79.2\%$ and computation (FLOPs) by $31.8\%$, while improving mean success rate by $5.6\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 flow-matching VLA 的推理开销问题，把 backbone 深度 V、action expert 深度 A、去噪步数 D 暴露为三个可联合配置的计算轴，并在中间层挂轻量 Exit Transformer (ET) 蒸馏策略最后一层。KV Cache synthesis 让 action expert 能比 backbone 退出得更深；在 SmolVLA 与 π0.5 上、LIBERO 与 Meta-World 两个基准上，联合 (V,A,D) 配置把延迟降 79.2%、FLOPs 降 31.8%，同时平均成功率提升 5.6%。
Motivation: VLA 模型参数量极大，推理算力开销对机器人实时控制往往不可承受；现有早退方法只跳过 VLM backbone 层或减少去噪步数，action expert 的深度始终不动，可调的算力预算维度不足。
Method: 在预训练 VLA 的 backbone 与 action expert 中间深度各挂轻量 Exit Transformer，用蒸馏把策略最后一层的输出对齐到每个退出点；引入 KV Cache synthesis 补齐被跳过 backbone 层的 key/value，使 action expert 可比 backbone 更深退出；无需从头训练原策略，每个退出点仅增加 2.1%（SmolVLA）或 4.1%（π0.5）参数。
Result: 在 SmolVLA 与 π0.5 两个 flow-matching VLA、LIBERO 与 Meta-World 两个基准上验证：V 与 A 分别降低 FLOPs 与延迟，D 同时改善两者；联合 (V,A,D) 配置延迟降低 79.2%、计算量 (FLOPs) 降低 31.8%，平均成功率同时提升 5.6%；每个退出点参数增量仅 2.1%（SmolVLA）与 4.1%（π0.5）。
Conclusion: 最优算力预算是任务相关的，不同任务分别受益于不同计算轴与深度，因此应把 V、A、D 联合配置而非只调其中一条；该框架在不重训原策略的前提下即可实现这一分配。

papers.title: Generative Atmospheric Super-Resolution from Heterogeneous In Situ Observations through Composable Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric observations are sparse, heterogeneous, and unevenly distributed, whereas many generative atmospheric models learn distributions over regularly gridded multivariate states. Once pretrained, diffusion models can supply atmospheric priors that can be combined with observation-derived likelihood factors in a Bayesian formulation. However, these observation sources differ substantially in geometry and sampling density, complicating the consistent use of their observations within a common inference framework. Here, we formulate this reconstruction problem as generative atmospheric super-resolution and introduce composable observation interfaces for conditioning a single pretrained 13-variable atmospheric diffusion model. The interfaces convert sparse radiosonde (R), clustered aircraft (A), and dense irregular surface-station (S) observations into source-specific likelihood factors that specify where observations constrain the gridded state, how residuals are counted under uneven sampling, and how strongly each source guides posterior sampling. We developed the aircraft and surface observation interfaces using 2019 observations and evaluated the selected interfaces throughout 2020 without further tuning. Compared with reconstructions conditioned only on radiosonde observations, the composed R+A+S interface reduces RMSE evaluated against ERA5 by $9.24\%$ across all 13 state variables over the CONUS domain. The aircraft and surface factors provide complementary improvements in upper-air and surface variables. The R+A+S combination also lowers the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS), while evaluations at held-out aircraft and surface-station observations show reduced prediction errors. Together, these results demonstrate a modular route for conditioning a pretrained atmospheric generative prior on heterogeneous in situ observations without retraining the underlying model.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 20 figures, 11 tables; acknowledgment updated to recognize NERSC Perlmutter computing resources; no scientific content or results changed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把稀疏异质的原位观测重组为生成式大气超分辨率问题：用可组合的观测接口把探空 (R)、飞机 (A)、地面站 (S) 三类观测转成各自的似然因子，条件化同一个预训练的 13 变量大气扩散模型，无需重训。在 CONUS 上以 ERA5 为参照，R+A+S 相比仅用探空的重建使 13 个状态变量的 RMSE 平均下降 9.24%，CRPS 同时降低。
Motivation: 大气观测稀疏、异质且分布不均，而生成式大气模型学的是规则网格多变量状态的分布；不同观测源在几何与采样密度上差异大，难以在同一推断框架里一致使用。
Method: 将重建表述为生成式大气超分辨率：预训练的 13 变量大气扩散模型提供大气先验，观测接口把 R、A、S 转成源特定的似然因子，规定观测在何处约束网格态、残差在不均匀采样下如何计权、各源对后验采样的引导强度。飞机与地面接口用 2019 年观测开发，选定后在 2020 年全年评估且不再调参。
Result: 相对仅以探空为条件的重建，组合 R+A+S 接口使 CONUS 域上全部 13 个状态变量相对 ERA5 的 RMSE 降低 9.24%；飞机与地面因子分别在上层大气变量与地面变量上带来互补改善；R+A+S 同时降低 CRPS，在留出的飞机与地面站观测上预测误差也减小。
Conclusion: 观测接口可组合成模块化条件化路径，在不重训底层生成先验的前提下融合异质原位观测，且跨年份（2019 训练接口、2020 评估）无需再调参即有效。

papers.title: LabFactory: Building and Evaluating Executable AI Labs
papers.abstract_en: Scientific tasks specify a desired capability, but realizing it often requires building a computational system tailored to the task---acquiring data, designing representations, training models, implementing tools, and deciding how they are used at inference. We present, a framework in which an AI builder turns a scientific brief into an executable AI lab: a task-specific solver that integrates models, knowledge resources, tools, and a controller behind a fixed interface. The builder develops and packages the lab in a metered workspace; a separate host then executes the delivered artifact on held-out inputs, with reference labels kept outside the solver's input interface, and scores its outputs under the task's protocol. This makes the delivered system, rather than the builder's account of its progress, the object of evaluation. We document 10 selected constructions across six scientific task categories---from molecular and genomic prediction to medical imaging, clinical decision support, and biomedical text---whose delivered labs exceeded their configured reference values on all 12 subtests under host-side execution. Four contain predictive models fitted during construction; the others assemble executable analysis environments, knowledge resources, and tool-driven workflows around a fixed platform LLM. Together they show that an AI agent can carry a scientific brief all the way to a working lab that can still be invoked, inspected, and checked after construction ends.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LabFactory 让 AI builder 把科学任务简报直接构建成可执行的 AI lab（含模型、知识资源、工具与控制器，接口固定），由独立 host 在留出输入上执行并按任务协议打分，参考标签不进入 solver 输入。六个科学任务类别共 10 个构建案例，在 host 侧执行下全部 12 项子测试均超过配置的参考值。
Motivation: 科学任务只规定目标能力，落地却要自行采集数据、设计表示、训练模型、实现工具并决定推理用法；而 builder 对自身进展的描述无法被独立检验，评估对象应是交付的系统本身。
Method: AI builder 在计量工作区 (metered workspace) 内开发并打包任务专用 solver，把模型、知识资源、工具与控制器集成到固定接口后交付；独立 host 在留出输入上执行该产物，参考标签置于 solver 输入接口之外，按任务协议对输出打分。
Result: 记录了六个科学任务类别（分子与基因组预测、医学影像、临床决策支持、生物医学文本等）中的 10 个选定构建案例；host 侧执行下，交付的 labs 在全部 12 项子测试上均超过配置的参考值。其中 4 个含构建期间拟合的预测模型，其余 6 个围绕固定平台 LLM 组装可执行分析环境、知识资源与工具驱动工作流。
Conclusion: 评估应以交付的可执行系统而非 builder 的进度陈述为对象；AI agent 能把科学简报一路做到构建结束后仍可调用、检查和核验的可运行 lab。

papers.title: RoadOcc Learns When to Persist, Transport, or Refresh Memory for Roadside Occupancy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Fixed roadside cameras repeatedly observe a stable scene overlaid by sparse moving traffic. Temporal memory can recover weak observations, but reusing moving evidence at stale locations can corrupt occupancy predictions. Motion compensation addresses displacement, while reliance on the resulting history remains a separate learning problem. We introduce RoadOcc, which learns soft routing among fixed-coordinate history (\emph{Persist}), velocity-addressed history (\emph{Transport}), and current evidence (\emph{Refresh}). Motion state and class-consistent historical support supervise these source choices. Dynamic-aware cross-attention (DCA) updates candidate locations, multi-scale voxel velocity estimation (VVE) constructs transport addresses from multi-scale current--history correspondence, and velocity-guided dynamic sparse fusion (VDSF) combines routed evidence under fixed sparse-token budgets. On InfraOcc, RoadOcc reaches 65.29 mIoU and 32.37 dynamic mIoU, gains of 4.44 and 4.71 over STCOcc. Controlled address experiments show that VVE raises dynamic mIoU by 0.87 over fixed-coordinate reading. Across three seeds, supervised P/T/R adds 1.40 dynamic points over motion-corrected retrieval, while removing Refresh costs 0.32 points. Results from two transfer models, Occ3D-nuScenes, and longer intervals provide additional support. Code will be released.

papers.title: When Post-Processing Fairness Constraints Help and When They Harm: Evidence from Eight Cross-Domain Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits in production ML typically occur once, at deployment, on a single domain. Both fail in practice: fairness can shift after retraining or a changing user base, and interventions validated on one dataset are rarely tested across the heterogeneous domains an organization deploys. We present FAPE (Fairness Auditing for Production Environments), a four-stage framework evaluating a single post-processing intervention, Fairlearn's ThresholdOptimizer, across eight domain evaluations: criminal justice, income prediction, legal admissions, credit lending, agricultural lending, a multi-domain benchmark corpus, healthcare, and education. Each is scored on demographic parity and equalized odds difference, plus disparate impact ratio and accuracy cost where computable. Intervention effectiveness tracks baseline disparity magnitude: across model-domain pairs the constraint improved disparity in 9 of 14 high-disparity cases and worsened it in 3 of 4 near-fair ones. Each of the five high-disparity exceptions reverses under one of two measurement checks, a minimum group size or thresholds fit on held-out data. A CUSUM monitor started at deployment, tested on a simulated shift, separates constrained models that never met a 0.1 parity convention from those that met it and later regressed. A single deployment-time audit is therefore an unreliable guide, which argues for baseline-disparity screening and continuous monitoring
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code, data loaders and figures: github.com/nithinnarla/fape-fairness-ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAPE 框架在八个领域上评估 Fairlearn 的 ThresholdOptimizer 后处理公平性约束，发现约束效果取决于基线差异大小：高差异情形 14 例中 9 例改善、近公平情形 4 例中 3 例反而恶化，且 5 个高差异反例中有 5 个在最小群体规模或留出数据拟合阈值的检查下反转。部署时一次性审计不可靠，应先做基线差异筛查并配合 CUSUM 持续监控。
Motivation: 生产环境的公平性审计通常只在部署时做一次、只覆盖单一领域，但重训或用户群变化会让公平性漂移，且在单一数据集上验证的干预很少跨异构领域检验。
Method: 提出 FAPE（Fairness Auditing for Production Environments）四阶段框架，对单一后处理干预 Fairlearn 的 ThresholdOptimizer 在八个领域评估（刑事司法、收入预测、法律录取、信贷、农业贷款、多领域基准语料、医疗、教育）；指标为 demographic parity 与 equalized odds difference，可算时加 disparate impact ratio 与 accuracy cost；另用部署起始的 CUSUM 监控在模拟漂移上检验。
Result: 跨模型-领域对，高差异情形 14 例中约束改善 9 例，近公平 4 例中恶化 3 例；5 个高差异反例各在两种测量检查之一（最小群体规模、留出数据拟合阈值）下反转；CUSUM 能区分从未达到 0.1 parity 约定的受约束模型与达标后回退的模型。
Conclusion: 单次部署时审计不可靠，应先按基线差异筛查再决定是否施加约束，并对已部署模型做持续监控。

papers.title: Double Descent and Malign Overfitting in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Conventional wisdom in deep learning holds that overparameterization---having more parameters $p$ than training samples $n$---is benign: larger models generalize better and, even without regularization, interpolating models generalize well, the test error following a double-descent curve. One might expect the same benign overfitting for diffusion models, whose training reduces to regression, i.e. to minimizing a quadratic score-matching loss. Yet the opposite is observed: overfitting here is catastrophic, driving the model into a memorization regime. We resolve this paradox by combining experiments on U-Nets trained on CelebA with a random-features model for which we derive closed-form learning curves. We show that with a fixed number $m$ of noise realizations per training sample, an interpolation peak does occur, but at $p\sim nm$ rather than at $p\sim n$ as in standard regression. The rise of the test loss, however, sets in much earlier, at $p\sim n$, independently of $m$. This overfitting is malign because, although the implicit regularization of training is fully at work, it drives the model toward the empirical score, which memorizes the training set, rather than toward the true score. A bias-variance decomposition pinpoints the mechanism: the bias of the score estimator starts to grow at $p\sim n$; past the peak the variance decays, as in regression, whereas the bias keeps growing and both saturate at a large value. Since diffusion models are trained with $m\gg1$, the peak is pushed to very large model sizes, and therefore sit on the rising branch that precedes it, where malign overfitting is already in play. Nevertheless, overparameterization remains beneficial when paired with regularization: in the random-features theory and in U-Net experiments, optimally regularized large models---via a ridge penalty or early stopping, respectively---outperform any unregularized models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型训练虽可化为二次 score-matching 回归，但过参数化并非良性：测试损失在 p~n 就开始上升（与每样本噪声次数 m 无关），插值峰被推到 p~nm，模型被隐式正则推向记住训练集的经验 score 而非真实 score。在随机特征闭式解与 CelebA 上 U-Net 实验中，配 ridge 惩罚或 early stopping 的最优正则化大模型优于任何无正则模型。
Motivation: 深度学习常识认为过参数化良性、测试误差呈 double descent，但扩散模型（训练等价于回归）却出现灾难性过拟合与记忆化，这一悖论需要机制解释。
Method: 结合 CelebA 上训练的 U-Net 实验与可推导闭式学习曲线的随机特征模型 (random features)，对 score 估计做 bias-variance 分解定位机制，并比较 ridge 惩罚与 early stopping 两种正则化。
Result: 插值峰出现在 p~nm 而非标准回归的 p~n；测试损失上升却在 p~n 就开始且与 m 无关。bias-variance 分解显示 score 估计的 bias 在 p~n 开始增长，过峰后 variance 像回归一样衰减但 bias 持续增长并双双饱和于大值。随机特征理论与 U-Net 实验中，最优正则化的大模型优于任何无正则模型。
Conclusion: 扩散模型的过拟合是恶性的，因为隐式正则把模型推向记住训练集的经验 score；由于实际训练 m≫1，模型落在峰前上升支、正处于恶性过拟合区，但配合适当正则化过参数化仍然有益。

papers.title: KwaiMind Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Commercial image editing requires product identity preservation, accurate text rendering, and user appeal alongside general editing quality. We present KwaiMind, an image editing system combining general capabilities with e-commerce specialization. An agent-based data engine maintains approximately 1.8 million high-quality editing pairs. Built on a multimodal diffusion transformer, KwaiMind undergoes continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, followed by preference optimization and online reinforcement learning. A general-purpose vision-language judge and specialized rewards for click-through rate (CTR), text rendering, and product consistency guide specialized policies, which are consolidated through on-policy distillation. We introduce Ecom-Bench, covering 11 commercial editing tasks with task-specific visual evaluation and CTR-based ranking. KwaiMind achieves the strongest overall scores among evaluated open-source editors on ImgEdit, GEdit, both language splits of REDEdit, and Ecom-Bench visual quality, and the highest aggregate CTR ranking score among compared systems. Offline, CTR-guided optimization increases the proportion of generated images whose predicted CTR exceeds that of the original product image from 12.16% to 37.41%. In an online A/B experiment, CTR-based selection of product main images yields an approximately 2.44% relative increase in actual CTR. These results demonstrate the value of domain-specific data and reward-driven alignment for commercial image editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KwaiMind 是面向商业图像编辑的系统：以 agent 数据引擎维护约 180 万对编辑数据，在多模态 diffusion transformer 上做继续预训练与 SFT，再用 CTR、文字渲染、商品一致性等奖励做偏好优化与在线强化学习，策略经 on-policy 蒸馏合并。离线 CTR 引导使预测 CTR 超过原商品图的图片占比从 12.16% 升到 37.41%，线上 A/B 中按 CTR 选主图带来约 2.44% 的实际 CTR 相对提升。
Motivation: 商业图像编辑除通用编辑质量外还要求商品身份保持、文字准确渲染与用户吸引力，通用编辑模型在电商场景下缺少对应数据与对齐信号。
Method: agent 驱动的数据引擎生成约 180 万高质量编辑对；基座为 multimodal diffusion transformer，依次做 continued pre-training、SFT、偏好优化与在线 RL；奖励来自通用 vision-language judge 以及 CTR、文字渲染、商品一致性专项奖励，多个专项策略经 on-policy distillation 合并。评测提出 Ecom-Bench，覆盖 11 类商业编辑任务，含任务级视觉评价与 CTR 排序。
Result: 在 ImgEdit、GEdit、REDEdit 两个语言划分与 Ecom-Bench 视觉质量上取得被评估开源编辑器中最强综合分，并在对比系统中获得最高聚合 CTR 排序分；离线 CTR 引导优化把预测 CTR 超过原商品图的生成图片比例从 12.16% 提到 37.41%；线上 A/B 中按 CTR 选商品主图带来约 2.44% 的实际 CTR 相对提升。
Conclusion: 领域专属数据加奖励驱动的对齐能同时提升商业图像编辑的视觉质量与点击率，且离线 CTR 优化可迁移到线上真实 CTR。

papers.title: FAST-ML: A Hybrid Physics-Machine Learning Framework for Tropical Cyclone Intensity Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Rapid intensification (RI) remains one of the most consequential and difficult aspects of tropical cyclone (TC) forecasting. Although full-physics numerical weather prediction models can represent the processes governing RI, resolving storm-environment interactions remains computationally expensive, while purely data-driven approaches often lack physical interpretability. We present FAST-ML, a hybrid framework that bridges data-driven efficiency with physical constraints. A physically informed dual-stream neural parameterization ingests 3D ERA5 fields to diagnose ventilation controls---environmental wind shear and mid-level entropy deficit. By optimizing these parameters end-to-end through a differentiable FAST intensity model, this architecture establishes a robust new paradigm for observation-driven parameter optimization, ensuring storm evolution remains strictly governed by thermodynamic principles. By better capturing the storm's continuous intensity evolution, FAST-ML improves upon its physical baseline, reducing ensemble CRPS across forecast lead times, with a reduction of approximately 31% at 60 h and nearly halving the RI false alarm ratio without sacrificing detection skill. In a 100-member ensemble configuration, FAST-ML produces intensity forecasts comparable to FNV3 for selected storms under the evaluated input configurations. Furthermore, zero-shot tests on selected Eastern Pacific storms provide encouraging evidence of cross-basin transferability. FAST-ML provides a modular intensity forecasting framework that can be coupled with externally supplied storm tracks and environmental fields. It demonstrates that observation-driven parameter learning within physically constrained dynamics simultaneously enhances accuracy, interpretability, and computational efficiency.
papers.comment: Code and models available at https://github.com/Shijie-Xiao/FAST-ML
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAST-ML 用双流神经参数化从 3D ERA5 场诊断通风控制量（环境风切变与中层熵亏缺），端到端穿过可微 FAST 强度模型优化，使风暴演变受热力学约束。相对物理基线，集合 CRPS 在各预报时效下降、60 h 处约降 31%，快速增强 (RI) 虚警率近乎减半且检测能力不损失；100 成员集合在所评估输入配置下对选定风暴与 FNV3 相当，东太平洋零样本测试显示跨盆地可迁移性。
Motivation: 快速增强 (RI) 是热带气旋预报中最关键也最难的环节：全物理数值模式解析风暴-环境相互作用算力代价高，纯数据驱动方法又缺乏物理可解释性。

papers.title: Sex Estimation from Footwear Outsole Impressions Using CNN Transfer Learning and Interpretable Image Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Footwear outsole impressions are a common form of forensic pattern evidence, yet quantitative methods for estimating wearer attributes from these images remain relatively underdeveloped. We investigate binary sex estimation from footwear outsole impressions by comparing convolutional neural network (CNN) transfer learning with traditional feature-based classification. Using a publicly available outsole-impression dataset, we adopt a shoe-level training and test partition that keeps replicate scans of the same physical shoe together to reduce data leakage. We evaluate pretrained CNNs through end-to-end fine-tuning, frozen feature extraction followed by support vector machine classification, and hybrid feature fusion incorporating handcrafted, geometric, and metadata-derived descriptors. Fine-tuned CNNs achieve the strongest overall predictive performance and substantially outperform traditional classifiers trained on the manually specified descriptors alone, while frozen-feature approaches offer a less computationally demanding alternative. Exploratory analysis of low-dimensional CNN representations reveals associations with frequency threshold ratio, image contrast, and wavelet-based summaries, providing a connection between learned representations and measurable properties of outsole impressions. These findings suggest that CNN transfer learning captures discriminative information beyond the descriptors considered and offers a promising approach to footwear-based forensic screening. Further validation on independently collected and casework-like impressions is needed before operational use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 CNN 迁移学习做鞋底外底印痕 (footwear outsole impression) 的二元性别估计，端到端微调取得最强性能，明显优于仅用人工描述子训练的传统分类器；低维 CNN 表征与频率阈值比、图像对比度和小波统计量相关。作者指出投入实战前还需在独立采集、贴近案件的印痕上进一步验证。
Motivation: 鞋底印痕是常见的法庭物证模式，但从中量化估计穿着者属性的方法仍不成熟，且同一物理鞋的多次扫描容易造成数据泄漏。
Method: 在同一公开外底印痕数据集上按鞋划分训练/测试集，使同一物理鞋的重复扫描留在同一侧；对比三条路线：预训练 CNN 端到端微调、冻结特征提取后接 SVM、以及手工+几何+元数据描述子的混合特征融合，并与仅用人工描述子的传统分类器比较。
Result: 端到端微调的 CNN 整体预测性能最强，大幅优于仅用人工指定描述子训练的传统分类器；冻结特征方案计算开销更低。低维 CNN 表征的探索性分析显示其与 frequency threshold ratio、image contrast 及小波统计量存在关联。
Conclusion: CNN 迁移学习捕捉到超出所比较描述子的判别信息，可用于基于鞋底的法庭筛查，但需在独立采集、案件式印痕上复验后才能投入业务使用。

papers.title: VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools. Project page: https://andyca111.github.io/VideoGen_Agent/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoGen-Agent 是一个多模态视频生成 agent，用多任务 agentic 强化学习学会调用增强、生成、验证三类外部工具，先靠教师轨迹 SFT 建立工具使用行为，再用类别感知的混合奖励精修。在自建的 600 条 VABench 上，相对基座文生视频模型从 56.5 提到 75.6（+19.1 分），升级生成工具后进一步到 86.1 且无需再训练 agent。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型在需要专业知识、特定身份、物理一致性或有序事件的 prompt 上表现不佳，单靠端到端生成难以满足这类组合性要求。
Method: 在覆盖六个任务的类别平衡数据集上训练共享策略：先用教师生成轨迹做监督微调 (SFT) 确立工具调用行为，再经多轮交互的多任务 agentic RL 精修；奖励为 category-aware hybrid reward，同时评估工具调用有效性、任务是否选对工具、以及生成视频质量。
Result: VABench（600 条 held-out prompt，覆盖程序性知识、单/多实体身份保持、物理一致性、场景构图、多镜头时序结构）上，VideoGen-Agent 相对基座文生视频生成器提升 19.1 分，56.5 → 75.6；升级生成工具后升至 86.1 且无需额外 agent 训练；人工评分中升级配置在 84.3% 的对比里胜过最强的独立基线。
Conclusion: 跨视频生成任务学习工具使用是有效的，且训练好的 agent 能直接吃到后续生成工具进步带来的收益，无需重训。

papers.title: From Semantic Decisions to Feasible Trajectories: Self-Evolving LLM-Guided Optimal Control for Narrow-Space Parking
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous parking in nonconvex and narrow environments remains challenging. Although optimal-control methods can explicitly enforce vehicle dynamics and collision constraints, nonconvexity compromises solver robustness and can cause failures. Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning capabilities, but directly generating dense trajectories makes it difficult to guarantee physical feasibility. We introduce SE-LLM-OCP, a unified framework in which LLMs make high-level discrete maneuver decisions, while an optimal-control module enforces low-level vehicle dynamics and collision constraints. Online, the LLM proposes sparse maneuver plans, decomposing the parking task into a sequence of short-horizon trajectory-optimization problems. A low-level solver then sequentially solves optimal-control problems. If the solver fails, the LLM aggregates failure evidence from the solver and validation stages to guide replanning. Offline, SE-LLM-OCP automatically evolves a structured decision-making knowledge base from scratch, driven by accumulated online failures. We validate our proposed framework in simulation on a car-like vehicle model and on a differential-drive robot. Our experimental results show that SE-LLM-OCP enables safer autonomous parking in narrow scenarios and demonstrates transfer of the same maneuver representation to a different kinematic platform.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SE-LLM-OCP 把窄空间停车拆成 LLM 做离散机动决策、最优控制求解器管车辆动力学与碰撞约束的两层框架：在线由 LLM 提出稀疏导引计划并分解为短时域轨迹优化子问题，求解失败时聚合求解器与验证阶段的失败证据重规划，离线再从在线失败中自动演化结构化决策知识库。仿真在类车模型与差速驱动机器人上验证，结果显示该框架在窄场景中实现更安全的自主停车，且同一机动表示可迁移到不同运动学平台。
Motivation: 非凸窄环境下的最优控制求解器鲁棒性差易失败，而 LLM 直接生成稠密轨迹又难以保证物理可行性，两条路线各自卡住自主停车。
Method: SE-LLM-OCP 采用分层架构：LLM 在高层做离散机动决策并提出稀疏导引计划，把停车任务分解为一串短时域轨迹优化子问题；低层最优控制求解器顺序求解各子问题，强制车辆动力学与碰撞约束。求解失败时 LLM 聚合求解器与验证阶段的失败证据指导重规划，离线阶段则由累积在线失败驱动，从零自动演化结构化决策知识库 (knowledge base)。
Result: 在类车模型 (car-like vehicle model) 与差速驱动机器人 (differential-drive robot) 上的仿真验证表明，SE-LLM-OCP 在窄场景中实现更安全的自主停车，并展示了同一机动表示向不同运动学平台的迁移。
Conclusion: 让 LLM 只做离散机动决策、把连续可行性交给最优控制求解器，可以在非凸窄空间停车中兼顾语义推理与物理可行，且机动表示具备跨平台迁移性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Entropy Can Flow, or It Can Guide. Be Entropy. LEDFlow: Introducing Entropy-guided Generation Order into Uniform Discrete Flow
papers.abstract_en: Uniform discrete flow permits repeated updates at every generation position. While continued revision supports correction of wrong tokens, it also exposes correct intermediate predictions to later errors. An experiment on Sudoku puzzles shows that 9.4% of generated cells are correct at an intermediate step but incorrect in the final output. We introduce generation order into uniform discrete flow through selective absorption, which fixes chosen predictions while preserving the uniform flow velocity at active positions. To prioritize reliable predictions for absorption, we propose Low-Entropy Discrete Flow (LEDFlow), a training-free sampler that adaptively orders absorption by local entropy. By decomposing absorption error into joint dependence and conditional prediction terms, we show that, under entropy-error regularity, selecting the lowest-entropy positions under a fixed absorption count minimizes an upper bound on the conditional term. We further analyze sensitivity of global lookahead, whose worst-case decision-error bound grows with lookahead window under an imperfect denoiser. Across reasoning benchmarks, LEDFlow attains 0.845 Nikoli Sudoku solve accuracy, with largest gains on strongly constrained tasks. On a text-to-image generation benchmark it attains the best overall score among decode-time samplers, and on multimodal understanding it improves over the default sampler on all six benchmarks, at an inference cost comparable to standard flow sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEDFlow 在 uniform discrete flow 中引入选择性吸收 (selective absorption) 的生成顺序，按局部熵自适应决定先固定哪些位置；Sudoku 上 9.4% 的格子在中间步正确却在最终输出出错，而 LEDFlow 达到 0.845 Nikoli Sudoku 求解准确率，在强约束任务上提升最大。
Motivation: Uniform discrete flow 允许每个生成位置被反复更新，持续修订虽能纠错，却也让原本正确的中间预测暴露在后续错误下，Sudoku 实验中 9.4% 的生成格子因此由对变错。
Method: 提出 training-free 采样器 Low-Entropy Discrete Flow (LEDFlow)：用 selective absorption 固定选定预测、同时在活跃位置保持 uniform flow velocity，并按局部熵自适应排序吸收顺序；把吸收误差分解为 joint dependence 与 conditional prediction 两项，在 entropy-error 正则性下证明固定吸收数时选最低熵位置可最小化条件项上界，并分析 global lookahead 在不完美 denoiser 下最坏决策误差界随 lookahead 窗口增长的敏感性。
Result: Sudoku 求解准确率 0.845（Nikoli），在强约束任务上提升最大；在文生图生成基准上取得 decode-time samplers 中最佳综合分；在多模态理解的全部六个基准上均优于默认采样器，推理开销与标准 flow sampling 相当。
Conclusion: 让熵来决定生成顺序而非仅让熵驱动流动，可以在不增加推理成本的前提下减少反复修订引入的错误，收益集中在强约束任务。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 training-free 采样器 Low-Entropy Discrete Flow (LEDFlow)：用 selective absorption 固定选定预测、同时在活跃位置保持 uniform flow velocity，并按局部熵自适应排序吸收顺序；把吸收误差分解为 joint dependence 与 conditional prediction 两项，在 entropy-error 正则性下证明固定吸收数时选最低熵位置可最小化条件项上界，并分析 global lookahead 在不完美 denoiser 下最坏决策误差界随 lookahead 窗口增长的敏感性。
summary_sections.result: Sudoku 求解准确率 0.845（Nikoli），在强约束任务上提升最大；在文生图生成基准上取得 decode-time samplers 中最佳综合分；在多模态理解的全部六个基准上均优于默认采样器，推理开销与标准 flow sampling 相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 让熵来决定生成顺序而非仅让熵驱动流动，可以在不增加推理成本的前提下减少反复修订引入的错误，收益集中在强约束任务。

papers.title: A Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator for Generalization of Atrioventricular Valve Mechanics across Pressure and Tissue Properties
papers.abstract_en: Mitral and tricuspid regurgitation are the most common regurgitant valvular lesions, yet only a minority of severe cases undergo corrective surgery. Rapid assessment of valve mechanics could enable earlier, more precise intervention, but finite element (FE) analysis is slow to repeat across the many loading and tissue-property values of interest, which for a given valve are not known in advance. We introduce the Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator (PCNO), a transformer-based neural operator predicting leaflet displacement, strain, and stress fields conditioned on systolic blood pressure and tissue properties. PCNO is trained on, and evaluated against, FEBio simulations of functional and regurgitant mitral and tricuspid valves and of three mitral pathologies. With pressure and all material parameters simultaneously outside the training support, displacement error against FE reaches 4.48% and the mean errors of unsupervised geometric measures of valve function stay within 3.5%, indicating a conditioned solution operator over parameter space rather than an interpolator of the training set. Under this shift, PCNO is also more accurate than graph neural network and graph neural operator baselines trained on the same simulations, with the largest margins in stress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Transformer 的物理条件化神经算子 PCNO，以收缩期血压和组织材料参数为条件，直接预测房室瓣（二尖瓣、三尖瓣）小叶的位移、应变与应力场，替代反复运行的有限元分析。当压力与全部材料参数同时落在训练支撑之外时，相对 FEBio 的位移误差为 4.48%，无监督几何功能指标平均误差保持在 3.5% 以内，且在应力上领先同数据训练的图神经网络与图神经算子基线。
Motivation: 二尖瓣与三尖瓣反流常见但仅少数重症接受手术，早期评估需要跨大量载荷与组织参数反复做有限元分析，而这些参数对具体患者事先未知，FE 太慢无法遍历。
Method: PCNO 是 transformer-based neural operator，以收缩期血压和组织材料参数为条件，输出小叶位移、应变、应力场；训练与评测数据来自 FEBio 仿真，覆盖功能性与反流性二尖瓣、三尖瓣以及三种二尖瓣病理，并与在相同仿真上训练的图神经网络 (GNN) 和图神经算子 (GNO) 基线对比。
Result: 压力与全部材料参数同时超出训练支撑时，相对 FE 的位移误差达 4.48%，瓣膜功能的无监督几何指标平均误差保持在 3.5% 以内；该偏移条件下 PCNO 比同仿真训练的 GNN 与 GNO 基线更准，应力上的差距最大。
Conclusion: PCNO 学到的是参数空间上的条件化解算子而非训练集插值器，可在训练支撑之外的压力与组织性质组合上给出可用于快速评估的瓣膜力学场。

papers.title: HOIBlender: Blending Lightweight Detection with Vision-Language Priors for Efficient Human-Object Interaction Detection
papers.abstract_en: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection requires grounding an interacting human-object pair and recognizing the verb that links them, often under severe long-tail supervision. Recent methods improve accuracy with stronger detectors and vision-language priors, but many still stack heavy transformer encoders, intricate denoising schedules, or post-hoc semantic calibration on top of the detector. We present \textbf{HOIBlender}, an efficient HOI detector named after its core design principle: blending detector-grounded visual tokens, spatial subject-object reasoning, and BLIP-2 semantic priors inside one lightweight decoding pipeline. HOIBlender builds on an RF-DETR/LW-DETR-style foundation with a DINOv2 backbone and selects top-$K$ image-conditioned tokens directly from the multi-scale projector as subject and object candidates, removing the dedicated encoder stage retained by prior HOI methods. A dual-stage decoder first stabilizes human-object geometry and then performs verb and HOI classification through progressive BLIP-2 prior fusion, with classifier weights initialized from BLIP-2 text embeddings for long-tail categories. Grouped-query training further enriches optimization without increasing inference cost. Across three model scales (Nano, Small, 2XL), HOIBlender consistently outperforms SOV-STG-VLA and Hybrid-SOV-VLA on HICO-DET, reaching $44.49$ Default Full mAP in only $9$ training epochs while maintaining competitive latency and parameter budgets. These results show that lightweight detection, structured spatial-semantic decoding, and deeply integrated vision-language priors can be blended into a single efficient HOI pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HOIBlender 把检测器视觉 token、空间主客体推理与 BLIP-2 语义先验融进一条轻量解码管线做 HOI 检测：从多尺度 projector 直接选 top-K 图像条件 token 作主客体候选，去掉专用 encoder，双阶段解码器先稳几何再做动词分类，分类器权重用 BLIP-2 文本嵌入初始化。在 HICO-DET 上以 9 个训练 epoch 达到 44.49 Default Full mAP，三个规模均超过 SOV-STG-VLA 与 Hybrid-SOV-VLA。
Motivation: HOI 检测受严重长尾监督困扰，现有方法靠更强检测器与视觉语言先验提精度，但常在检测器之上堆叠重型 transformer encoder、复杂去噪调度或事后语义校准，推理开销大。
Method: 基于 RF-DETR/LW-DETR 风格架构，backbone 用 DINOv2，从多尺度 projector 直接选 top-K 图像条件 token 作为 subject/object 候选，移除先前方法保留的专用 encoder 阶段；双阶段解码器先稳定人-物几何，再通过渐进式 BLIP-2 先验融合做动词与 HOI 分类，分类器权重由 BLIP-2 文本嵌入初始化以覆盖长尾类；另用 grouped-query training 丰富优化而不增加推理开销。
Result: 在 HICO-DET 上，Nano、Small、2XL 三个规模均稳定超过 SOV-STG-VLA 与 Hybrid-SOV-VLA，其中达到 44.49 Default Full mAP 只用 9 个训练 epoch，同时保持有竞争力的延迟与参数量。
Conclusion: 轻量检测、结构化空间-语义解码与深度整合的视觉语言先验可以融合进单一高效 HOI 管线，在不堆重型 encoder 的前提下取得更好精度与训练效率。

papers.title: Bayesian Deck-of-cards-based Ordinal Regression with Sequential Preference Elicitation
papers.abstract_en: The Deck-of-cards-based Ordinal Regression (DOR) infers a value function from a ranking of reference alternatives in which the Decision Maker (DM) inserts blank cards between consecutive levels to express preference intensity. DOR, and its stochastic extension (SMAA-DOR), treat these answers as hard constraints defining a set of compatible value functions. We propose B-DOR, a probabilistic reformulation of DOR in which each pair of adjacent levels yields an ordinal observation, the declared direction and the number of cards, modelled through a cumulative-link likelihood that relates the number of blank cards to the latent value difference between alternatives. Two Bayesian inference algorithms are proposed: BAYES-DOR samples the whole posterior distribution by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo; FTRL-DOR tracks the maximum a posteriori estimate by constrained convex optimization. Moreover, through a multi-step elicitation process, elicitation can be spread over several short sessions reducing the cognitive burden on the DM. Both algorithms enjoy logarithmic regret bounds for prediction that hold for any sequence of DM responses and that guide the choice of the prior hyperparameters. A Monte Carlo study over 768 configurations shows that accuracy grows with the number of sessions, that blank cards add significant information over preference directions alone, that both algorithms maintain good performance under inconsistent answers, and that both outperform DOR and SMAA-DOR. An illustrative application to Italian regional healthcare performance demonstrates the practical applicability of the approach for building composite indicators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: B-DOR 把 Deck-of-cards 序数回归 (DOR) 中「插入空白卡片」的硬约束改写为累积链接 (cumulative-link) 概率似然，用卡片数与方向推断相邻等级间的潜在价值差。768 种配置的 Monte Carlo 研究显示精度随会话数增加而上升，空白卡片相对仅用偏好方向提供显著更多信息，两种算法在回答不一致时仍保持良好性能并优于 DOR 与 SMAA-DOR。
Motivation: DOR 与 SMAA-DOR 把决策者 (DM) 的卡片回答当作硬约束，只定义一个相容价值函数集合，无法表达回答的随机性与不一致性；且一次性排序对 DM 认知负担大。
Method: B-DOR 将每对相邻等级建模为一个序数观测（声明方向 + 卡片数），用累积链接似然把卡片数与潜在价值差关联。两个贝叶斯推断算法：BAYES-DOR 用 Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 采样整个后验，FTRL-DOR 用约束凸优化追踪 MAP 估计；多步 elicitation 把询问分散到多个短会话。两者都有对任意 DM 回答序列成立的预测对数 regret 界，并据此指导先验超参数选择。
Result: Monte Carlo 研究覆盖 768 种配置：精度随会话数增加而增长；空白卡片相对仅用偏好方向带来显著额外信息；两算法在不一致回答下保持良好性能；两算法均优于 DOR 与 SMAA-DOR。另在意大利区域医疗绩效综合指标 (composite indicators) 上做了示例应用。
Conclusion: 把卡片回答当作带累积链接似然的概率序数观测而非硬约束，可在不一致回答下仍给出有 regret 保证的预测，并通过分次 elicitation 降低 DM 负担。

papers.title: Are Coreset Selection Methods Worth Their Cost?
papers.abstract_en: Coreset selection picks a representative subset of the labeled training set to make training cheaper. However, it is usually evaluated by downstream accuracy at a fixed subset size, ignoring both the time spent selecting the subset and the training recipe behind each reported number. We introduce an end-to-end benchmark that standardizes downstream training and charges selection and training to the same auditable wall-clock budget, spanning 4 datasets from CIFAR-10 to ImageNet-1K, 11 selectors, 5 fractions, and 3 seeds, with over 1,500 released runs. Repeated-sampling work has shown that budget-aware evaluation already favors random strategies. Our two budget studies test whether that verdict survives when every selector is granted its most favorable operating point. Across eight wall-clock budget anchors on each of CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet, no anchor is won by a sophisticated selector: every winner is class-balanced random sampling, repeated random sampling, or full-data training. In fixed-budget duels on ImageNet-1K, training on all data for fewer epochs beats every selection strategy we probe while also costing the least. A per-dataset cost audit shows that selection cost is dominated at every scale by a fixed full-dataset scan, so it cannot be amortized away by selecting a smaller fraction, and its absolute size does not extrapolate from one dataset to another. We further quantify when selection does pay back through subset reuse, and document 9 correctness fixes to a widely used codebase, one of which shifts a standard Herding baseline by nearly 6 points. Selection time is not free preprocessing, and an evaluation that ignores it measures the wrong quantity.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. Benchmark artifacts include per-run result tables, selected indices, and raw timing-audit tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 端到端 coreset 选择基准把选择耗时与训练耗时记入同一可审计 wall-clock 预算，在 CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 各 8 个预算锚点上，没有一个锚点被复杂选择器拿下，胜者全是类平衡随机采样、重复随机采样或全量训练；ImageNet-1K 固定预算对决中全量数据少训若干 epoch 反而击败所有选择策略且成本最低。作者结论是选择时间不是免费预处理，忽略它的评测量错了对象。
Motivation: coreset 选择通常只在固定子集规模下报下游精度，既不计选择子集所花的时间，也不计每个数字背后的训练配方，因此无法判断选择是否真的划算。
Method: 提出端到端基准：统一下游训练流程，把选择与训练记入同一可审计 wall-clock 预算；覆盖 CIFAR-10 到 ImageNet-1K 共 4 个数据集、11 个选择器、5 个子集比例、3 个种子，发布超过 1,500 次运行（含逐次结果表、所选索引与计时审计表）。另做逐数据集成本审计与子集复用的回本量化，并修复一个被广泛使用的代码库中的 9 处正确性问题。
Result: CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 各 8 个 wall-clock 预算锚点上，无一锚点由复杂选择器获胜，胜者均为类平衡随机采样、重复随机采样或全量训练；ImageNet-1K 固定预算对决中全量数据少训 epoch 击败全部所测选择策略且成本最低。成本审计显示各规模下选择开销都被一次固定全量扫描主导，无法靠选更小比例摊薄，且其绝对大小不能从一个数据集外推到另一个。代码库修复中有一处使标准 Herding 基线偏移近 6 个点。
Conclusion: 在把选择时间计入预算的评测下，复杂 coreset 选择器目前不值其成本，随机或全量训练更优；只有通过子集复用选择才可能回本，而忽略选择时间的评测测错了量。
Relevance: 3
