summary_sections.result: CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 各 8 个 wall-clock 预算锚点上，无一锚点由复杂选择器获胜，胜者均为类平衡随机采样、重复随机采样或全量训练；ImageNet-1K 固定预算对决中全量数据少训 epoch 击败全部所测选择策略且成本最低。成本审计显示各规模下选择开销都被一次固定全量扫描主导，无法靠选更小比例摊薄，且其绝对大小不能从一个数据集外推到另一个。代码库修复中有一处使标准 Herding 基线偏移近 6 个点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在把选择时间计入预算的评测下，复杂 coreset 选择器目前不值其成本，随机或全量训练更优；只有通过子集复用选择才可能回本，而忽略选择时间的评测测错了量。

papers.title: Abstention and Noise Filtering: Two Missing Primitives of Softmax Attention
papers.abstract_en: Softmax attention has two structural gaps. A head cannot abstain, because its weights sum to one, so it outputs something even when nothing is relevant. Nor can it filter what it reads, because its output is a weighted average of value vectors, passing interference as faithfully as signal. We call these missing primitives abstention and noise filtering. Recent studies report that gating the value pathway improves pretraining but attribute the gain to different causes. We show that a value gate partly supplies both primitives, which unifies the reported causes as views of one gain. We give each primitive its own mechanism in matched models of 10M to 350M parameters and measure what each contributes. The gain from gating is almost entirely abstention at 10M, whereas by 350M filtering contributes as much as abstention, so what a study observes depends on its scale. The two benefits are largely additive, with a small overlap. A gate determined by each value alone leaves the attention sink in place, whereas a query-controlled mechanism removes it. Injecting interference into the value reads shows that abstention and filtering protect against it in distinguishable ways. The same patterns appear in pretrained models up to 20B parameters.
papers.comment: 20 pages (8 pages main text plus appendices), 5 figures, 12 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 softmax attention 的两个结构缺陷命名为 abstention（权重和为 1，无法“什么都不选”）与 noise filtering（输出是 value 的加权平均，干扰与信号同样通过），并论证 value gating 的收益正是同时补上这两个原语。在 10M–350M 参数的配对模型上，10M 时 gating 收益几乎全来自 abstention，到 350M 时 filtering 贡献与 abstention 相当；query 控制的机制能移除 attention sink，仅由 value 自身决定的门则不能，20B 预训练模型上同样出现这些模式。
Motivation: 近期工作报告对 value 通路加 gating 能改善预训练，但对收益来源归因不一；attention 本身缺少“拒绝输出”和“过滤读入”两种能力，导致干扰被原样传递。
Method: 在 10M 到 350M 参数的 matched models 中为 abstention 与 filtering 各配独立机制，分别测量各自贡献；用注入 value 读入的干扰检验两种原语的防护方式，并比较 value-only 门与 query-controlled 机制对 attention sink 的作用，再在最大 20B 的预训练模型上核对同样模式。
Result: 10M 时 gating 的收益几乎全部来自 abstention；350M 时 filtering 的贡献与 abstention 相当，即观察到的归因随规模变化。两种收益大体可加、仅有小量重叠；value-only 门保留 attention sink，query-controlled 机制移除它；干扰注入显示两种原语以可区分的方式防护；相同模式在最大 20B 的预训练模型中复现。
Conclusion: value gating 的多种归因可统一为“同时补上 abstention 与 filtering”这一个收益的两种视角，而研究者在不同规模下看到的主导原语不同。

papers.title: Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop, in effect serving as a \textbf{latent harness} for distilling a stronger reasoning models ability to solve long-horizon tasks to a reactive robotic policy. We further demonstrate that the workspace tokens are not only more lightweight, but also lead to better policy performance compared to conditioning policies on explicit modalities like curated past image frames, motivating a ``latent'' approach to history curation and reasoning model harnesses more broadly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把昂贵的 VLM 推理从部署时移到训练时，蒸馏出可直接查询的轻量 workspace token 作为机器人策略的长期记忆。训练时用 VLM 识别完成任务所需的当前与历史信息，再用 set-reconstruction decoder 损失把这些信息蒸馏进 token；部署时该 token 可直接替代观测，无需在线 VLM 推理。仿真与硬件上该 token 比显式历史模态（如精选过去图像帧）带来更好的策略表现。
Motivation: 机器人操作策略若直接以完整历史为条件，容易学到虚假相关并掉点；现有做法靠部署时反复调用 VLM 只保留任务显著信息，但在线查询开销大。
Method: 训练时调用 VLM 判定完成任务所需的当前与历史信息，再用 set-reconstruction decoder 损失将这些信息蒸馏进单一 workspace token；部署时该 token 作为观测的 drop-in 替代喂给反应式策略，充当把强推理模型的长程能力蒸馏给策略的 latent harness。
Result: 在仿真与硬件实验中，workspace token 可在部署期替代观测使策略完成记忆密集型任务，且相比以显式模态（精选过去图像帧）为条件取得更好的策略表现。
Conclusion: 历史信息的筛选与推理可以整体前移到训练期，用一个轻量 latent token 承载即可，不必在部署时保留 VLM 推理回路；作者据此主张 latent 式历史策展与推理模型 harness 的更广适用性。

papers.title: FlowSGS: Improving Flow Matching Priors for Inverse Imaging with Stochastic Interpolants
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has emerged as the state-of-the-art generative model and has been used for plug-and-play (PnP) priors to solve inverse problems in computational imaging. However, existing flow-based inverse solvers assume linear forward models and/or make simplifying approximations in posterior sampling. To circumvent these problems, we introduce FlowSGS, a flow-based posterior sampling method using Split Gibbs Sampling (SGS) to decompose the posterior into a likelihood step and a prior step. Specifically, we sample from the likelihood step using Langevin dynamics and leverage the Stochastic Interpolants (SI) framework to integrate a pretrained flow model into the prior step. We provide a form for the prior step that uses SI's reverse-time SDE, and show connections to previous PnP methods. Moreover, with the aid of the flow prior's straight probability paths and a novel timestep correction technique for the reverse-time SDE, FlowSGS requires fewer network evaluations in its prior step than plug-and-play diffusion samplers. Our experiments show state-of-the-art performance on a range of inverse problems. For the first time, we provide an experiment on a nonlinear inverse problem (Fourier phase retrieval) for flow-based inverse solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowSGS 用 Split Gibbs Sampling 把 flow-based 逆问题后验拆成似然步与先验步：似然步走 Langevin dynamics，先验步用 Stochastic Interpolants (SI) 的 reverse-time SDE 接入预训练 flow 模型，并加时间步校正。借助 flow 先验的直线概率路径，其先验步所需网络评估次数少于 plug-and-play diffusion 采样器，在一系列逆问题上达到 state-of-the-art，并首次为 flow-based 逆求解器给出非线性问题 (Fourier phase retrieval) 实验。
Motivation: 现有 flow-based 逆问题求解器假设前向模型线性，或在后验采样中做简化近似，限制了其在非线性前向算子上的适用性。
Method: FlowSGS 以 Split Gibbs Sampling 分解后验：似然步用 Langevin dynamics 采样，先验步借 Stochastic Interpolants 框架把预训练 flow 模型接入，给出基于 SI reverse-time SDE 的先验步形式，并与既有 PnP 方法建立联系；再利用 flow 先验的直线概率路径与针对 reverse-time SDE 的新时间步校正 (timestep correction) 减少网络评估。
Result: 在一系列逆问题上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；先验步所需网络评估次数少于 plug-and-play diffusion 采样器；首次为 flow-based 逆求解器在非线性逆问题 Fourier phase retrieval 上给出实验。
Conclusion: 把 flow 先验经 SI 的 reverse-time SDE 装进 Split Gibbs Sampling，可以同时放宽线性前向模型假设并降低先验步的网络评估开销，且能处理非线性逆问题。

papers.title: Uni-LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Unifies Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models increasingly think with different modalities such as images, 3D point clouds, and robot states, not just text. Yet each modality is still encoded into its own representation space, creating a modality-switching gap whenever reasoning moves from one modality to another. In this paper, we introduce Uni-LaDiR (Unified Latent Diffusion Reasoner), a framework that unifies different modalities into a shared latent space for multimodal reasoning. A unified encoder maps teacher reasoning steps from different modalities into latent thought tokens in a shared space, trained to extract the information needed for later reasoning steps and the final output. A diffusion reasoner, trained jointly with the encoder, generates these tokens at inference without teacher reasoning steps. Across eleven vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks and two vision-language-action (VLA) suites, Uni-LaDiR achieves relative gains over the strongest baselines of 7.3% on four mathematical and logical VLM benchmarks and 6.1% on RLBench manipulation tasks. Controlled comparisons show increasing gains as more teacher modalities are unified. These results suggest that unification improves multimodal reasoning by weaving it into a single thread, where the model predicts successive thoughts in a common representation space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Uni-LaDiR 用统一编码器把不同模态的教师推理步骤映射到共享 latent space 中的 thought tokens，再由联合训练的 diffusion reasoner 在推理时无教师步骤地生成这些 token。在 11 个 VLM benchmark 与 2 个 VLA suite 上，相对最强基线在 4 个数学与逻辑 VLM 任务上提升 7.3%，在 RLBench 操作任务上提升 6.1%，且统一的教师模态越多增益越大。
Motivation: 图像、3D 点云、机器人状态等模态各自编码在独立表示空间，推理跨模态切换时存在 modality-switching gap，无法在统一表示中连续推进思考。
Method: 统一编码器将各模态的教师推理步骤编码为共享空间的 latent thought tokens，训练目标是抽取后续步骤与最终输出所需信息；diffusion reasoner 与编码器联合训练，推理阶段在无教师步骤时直接生成这些 tokens。
Result: 在 11 个 VLM benchmark 与 2 个 VLA suite 上，相对最强基线：4 个数学与逻辑 VLM benchmark 提升 7.3%，RLBench 操作任务提升 6.1%；受控对比显示统一的教师模态越多，增益越大。
Conclusion: 多模态推理的收益来自把思考织进单一表示线程，让模型在共同 latent 空间中预测连续 thoughts，而非各模态各自编码。

papers.title: What Do Current Systematic Generalization Tasks Miss? A Reasoning-Centered Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Systematic generalization, the ability to solve novel problems by recombining known atomic elements, is central to human intelligence but difficult to study rigorously under controlled settings. Existing studies therefore rely on simplifications such as elemental composition, productivity-based tests, and action-explicit goals, which make systematic generalization easier to study but omit some essential aspects of this capability. To characterize what these simplifications miss, we adopt a reasoning-centered lens and introduce TranSGrid, a testbed that brings deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning together within a unified task. Experiments with seven Transformer models on 4,800 TranSGrid instances show that all models perform much worse on TranSGrid than on a held-out test set: the largest model solves 79.6% of the test set, but only 55.3% of TranSGrid and 15.8% of the hardest subset. The gap remains within the training length range, showing that productivity alone is not sufficient to evaluate systematic generalization. Additionally, we reintroduce the other two simplifications into TranSGrid: one variant limits interactions among action effects to approximate elemental composition (reducing the inductive demand); the other makes goals action-explicit (reducing the abductive one). In both, solve rates return to roughly the test set level, showing that either simplification alone is enough to reduce TranSGrid to an ordinary held-out test set. Together, our results show that existing tasks reduce either or both of the inductive and abductive demands of systematic generalization, and that comprehensively measuring this capability requires a task that involves all three forms of reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有系统泛化任务靠元素组合、productivity 测试和 action-explicit 目标三种简化，把归纳与溯因难度削掉了。作者提出统一任务 TranSGrid，同时承载演绎、归纳、溯因推理；七个 Transformer 在 4,800 个实例上，最大模型 held-out 测试集解出 79.6%，TranSGrid 只有 55.3%，最难子集 15.8%，且差距在训练长度范围内仍在。把任一简化重新加回 TranSGrid，解出率就回到测试集水平。
Motivation: 系统泛化难以在受控条件下严格研究，现有基准靠简化换取可操作性，但这些简化恰好删掉了该能力的关键成分，导致测出的结论不可靠。
Method: 提出 TranSGrid 测试床，把 deductive、inductive、abductive 三种推理放进同一任务；在 4,800 个 TranSGrid 实例上评测七个 Transformer，并与 held-out 测试集对照；再构造两个变体分别重新引入元素组合（限制动作效果交互，降低归纳需求）和 action-explicit 目标（降低溯因需求）。
Result: 最大模型在 held-out 测试集解出 79.6%，在 TranSGrid 上仅 55.3%，最难子集 15.8%；该差距在训练长度范围内依然存在。重新引入元素组合或 action-explicit 目标任一简化后，解出率回到约测试集水平。
Conclusion: 现有任务系统性削弱了系统泛化的归纳与溯因需求，仅靠 productivity 不足以评估该能力；完整测量需要同时包含三种推理形式的任务。

papers.title: Decodable but Misrouted: Sparse Features Uncover a Readout Gap in Vision-Language Models for Harmful Meme Detection
papers.abstract_en: When large vision-language models misclassify harmful memes, the failure may reflect missing internal evidence or an inability to route represented evidence to their outputs. We distinguish these cases in Gemma-3 and Qwen3.5 using sparse autoencoders, role-conditioned probes, causal interventions, and recovery experiments across six harmful content benchmarks, with additional Spanish and Hindi-English code-mixed evaluations. Sparse readouts outperform native prediction on all six primary binary tasks: Qwen averages $0.740$ versus $0.432$ for native macro-F1, residual reconstruction reaches $0.486$, and Gemma improves from $0.532$ to $0.714$. These gains measure how accessible the label is to a supervised readout; they do not show that the model's native generation already applies such a decision rule. Under the evaluated scales, Qwen silent-feature ablation is $24-63$ times more probe-sensitive, whereas routed-feature patching on literal yes/no tasks is $16-140$ times more output-sensitive. Native-only threshold calibration explains much, but not all of the gap: on five tasks with matched probe scores, it recovers $69.8$\% of the raw native-to-probe difference, while direct routing adds $0.094$ mean macro-F1 beyond calibrated native scoring. Joint gold-label, probe-KL, and pairwise LoRA supervision improves dedicated FHM prediction, but a gold-only adapter performs better on the shared seven-task mean. A case study of Gemma-3-12B on the Facebook Hateful Memes dataset finds a distributed rank-32 image-prompt interaction, reaching $0.756$ versus $0.685$ native macro-F1. Robustness controls show that the signal is not explained solely by accompanying OCR and depends on paired visual evidence, and that it extends beyond English. In many of the errors we study, the evidence is represented but does not reach the answer; therefore, routing is a common bottleneck in harmful meme classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 sparse autoencoder、角色条件探针、因果干预与恢复实验区分 Gemma-3 与 Qwen3.5 有害 meme 误判的两种成因：证据缺失还是证据无法路由到输出。稀疏读出在六个二分类基准上全面高于原生预测（Qwen 平均 macro-F1 0.740 对 0.432，Gemma 0.532 到 0.714），且消融与 patching 显示静默特征更影响探针、路由特征更影响输出，说明路由是常见瓶颈。
Motivation: VLM 有害 meme 分类的误判可能源于内部根本没有表征证据，或证据已表征却无法送达输出；这两种失败机制不同，需要可区分的诊断手段。
Method: 在 Gemma-3 与 Qwen3.5 上训练 sparse autoencoders，配合 role-conditioned probes、因果干预（silent-feature ablation、routed-feature patching）与恢复实验，在六个有害内容基准上评测，另加 Spanish 与 Hindi-English code-mixed 评测；并做原生阈值校准、LoRA 联合监督（gold label、probe-KL、pairwise）与 OCR/配对视觉稳健性对照。
Result: 六个主二分类任务上稀疏读出均胜过原生：Qwen 平均 macro-F1 0.740 对原生 0.432，残差重构 0.486，Gemma 0.532→0.714。Qwen 静默特征消融的探针敏感度高 24–63 倍，literal yes/no 任务上路由特征 patching 的输出敏感度高 16–140 倍。五个探针分数匹配的任务上原生阈值校准恢复了原生-探针差距的 69.8%，直接路由再加 0.094 平均 macro-F1。Gemma-3-12B 在 Facebook Hateful Memes 上的 rank-32 图文交互达到 0.756 对原生 0.685；信号不单由 OCR 解释且跨语言成立。
Conclusion: 在所研究的多数错误中证据已被表征但未到达答案，路由是有害 meme 分类的常见瓶颈；但稀疏读出的增益只说明标签对监督读出可及，不等于原生生成已应用该决策规则。

papers.title: Understanding Dynamic Scenes at Gigapixel Scale: Wide-Area Spatio-Temporal Perception from UAVs
papers.abstract_en: UAV-borne imaging has advanced from megapixel to gigapixel sensors, shifting aerial perception from recognizing individual targets to understanding entire dynamic scenes. We characterize this demand as Wide-area Spatio-temporal Scene Understanding (WSTU), which requires wide-area coverage, per-target resolution, and temporal continuity at once, a combination existing datasets lack. To fill this gap, we introduce an ultra-High-resolution (12768x9564) Airborne Remote-sensing Dataset (HARD) annotated at three levels for object detection, multi-object tracking, and scene-level visual question answering. Ultra-high-resolution imagery raises per-frame processing time to seconds. At that scale latency can no longer be ignored in evaluation. Thus, we propose a latency-aware metric for multi-object tracking called streaming-HOTA (s-HOTA). Extensive baseline experiments show how ultra-high-resolution processing reshapes each task. For detection, the end-to-end pipeline affects accuracy and speed as much as the detector itself does. For tracking, high latency charges the association axis far more unevenly than the detection axis, and association is where pipelines diverge. As a result, the pipeline that performs best offline can lose its lead under s-HOTA. For VQA, vision-language models remain weak at cross-frame identity binding and cannot transfer their single-frame gains to it. Together these findings show that the baselines we evaluate fall short of WSTU. HARD provides the data and the systematic baselines to advance it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出宽幅时空场景理解 (WSTU) 这一任务定义，要求同时满足大范围覆盖、单目标分辨率与时间连续性，并发布 12768×9564 的机载遥感数据集 HARD，含目标检测、多目标跟踪与场景级 VQA 三级标注。针对超高分辨率下每帧处理耗时达秒级，提出延迟感知跟踪指标 streaming-HOTA (s-HOTA)：高延迟对关联轴的惩罚远重于检测轴，离线最优的 pipeline 在 s-HOTA 下会丢掉领先位置。
Motivation: UAV 成像已从百万像素走向十亿像素级，感知需求从识别单个目标转为理解整幅动态场景；现有数据集无法同时给出宽幅覆盖、逐目标分辨率与时间连续性，且超高分辨率使单帧处理进入秒级，延迟在评测中不可再忽略。
Method: 构建 12768×9564 的 Airborne Remote-sensing Dataset (HARD)，按目标检测、多目标跟踪、场景级视觉问答三级标注；提出延迟感知跟踪指标 streaming-HOTA (s-HOTA)，把处理延迟计入关联与检测两轴；并跑大量基线实验，逐任务考察端到端 pipeline 对精度与速度的影响。
Result: 检测上，端到端 pipeline 对精度与速度的影响与检测器本身相当；跟踪上，高延迟对关联轴的惩罚远比检测轴不均匀，而关联正是各 pipeline 分歧之处，导致离线表现最好的 pipeline 在 s-HOTA 下失去领先；VQA 上视觉语言模型在跨帧身份绑定 (cross-frame identity binding) 上仍然很弱，无法把单帧上的增益迁移过来。
Conclusion: 所评测的基线整体达不到 WSTU 要求；HARD 数据集与这套系统化基线是推进该任务的起点，而跟踪评测必须把延迟计入指标，否则会选错 pipeline。

papers.title: Accelerating Transfer-Learning-Based Autotuning with Predictive LLVM IR Performance Ranking
papers.abstract_en: As the complexity of High Performance Computing (HPC) ecosys- tems continually increases, achieving optimal performance becomes a challenge. Traditional performance autotuning techniques pro- vide promising means to navigate this complexity, these techniques remain computationally intensive and require many evaluations to find optimal configurations. This work proposes an autotuning framework that designs a machine learning-based ensemble LLVM Intermediate Representa- tion (IR) ranker, Neural Configuration Scorer (NCS). NCS ranks the performance of IRs sampled by a transfer-learning-based autotuner, improving the efficiency of the tuning process by reducing tuning overheads and circumventing subpar evaluations. By leveraging knowledge from related tasks, we are able to effectively exploit the transfer relationship to access high-performing configurations in fewer samples than traditional techniques that rely upon itera- tive refinement. Our framework can achieve similar performance improvements as state-of-the-art autotuning techniques with up to 61.67% fewer evaluations, averaging 27.85% fewer evaluations across various HPC benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Neural Configuration Scorer (NCS)：一个基于集成学习的 LLVM IR 性能排序器，对迁移学习 autotuner 采样出的中间表示配置打分，先筛掉低质候选再评测。在多个 HPC benchmark 上达到与 SOTA autotuning 相当的性能提升，评测次数最多减少 61.67%，平均减少 27.85%。
Motivation: HPC 生态复杂度上升使性能 autotuning 需要大量配置评测，传统迭代细化方法计算开销大、评测次数多，成为调优效率瓶颈。
Method: 构建机器学习集成的 LLVM IR 排序器 NCS，对迁移学习 autotuner 采样的 IR 配置做性能排序，用排序结果跳过低质评测，从而减少调优开销；方法依赖相关任务的迁移关系来更快命中高性能配置。
Result: 在各类 HPC benchmark 上取得与最先进 autotuning 技术相当的性能提升，同时评测次数最多减少 61.67%，跨 benchmark 平均减少 27.85%。
Conclusion: 用 IR 级性能排序替代盲目评测，可以在不牺牲最终调优质量的前提下显著压缩 autotuning 所需的评测预算。

papers.title: Tabby: An Open Pretraining Recipe for Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: In this report, we release Tabby, a long context probabilistic time series foundation model, together with a complete and open recipe of how it was built. Tabby adopts an encoder-only patch Transformer architecture and concentrates the contributions on the data and the training procedure. The pretraining corpus combines an extended real-world collection, GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+ and BLAST, with synthetic data from KernelSynth and CauKerV2, an online generator that composes temporal dynamics through randomly sampled structural causal models. Training couples a progressive convergence schedule, which yields reusable intermediate checkpoints, with a deep quantile supervision objective for intermediate layers. The resulting 145M parameter backbone supports contexts of up to 8,192 observations and serves forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection, while a prompt-tuning module further improves in-distribution forecasting performance with the pretrained weights frozen. Tabby achieves competitive zero-shot forecasting performance on GIFT-Eval and the out-of-distribution TIME benchmark, while the same pretrained backbone also supports classification on the UCR Archive and zero-shot anomaly detection on TSB-AD-U. We release training pipeline and model as open source at huawei-noah/trustworthyAI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tabby 是一个开源的长上下文概率时间序列基础模型：encoder-only patch Transformer，145M 参数，上下文最长 8,192 个观测，用 GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+、BLAST 与 KernelSynth、CauKerV2 合成数据预训练，配合渐进收敛调度和深度分位数监督。在 GIFT-Eval 与分布外 TIME 基准上取得有竞争力的零样本预报表现，同一骨干还能做 UCR Archive 分类与 TSB-AD-U 零样本异常检测，prompt tuning 在冻结权重下进一步提升分布内预报。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型的预训练配方大多不透明，长上下文概率预报需要同时覆盖真实与合成数据、可复用的训练阶段以及跨任务的通用骨干。
Method: encoder-only patch Transformer 架构，预训练语料混合扩展的真实数据集 GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+ 与 BLAST，以及合成数据 KernelSynth 和 CauKerV2（用随机采样的结构因果模型组合时序动态的在线生成器）；训练采用渐进收敛调度（progressive convergence schedule，产出可复用的中间 checkpoint）并对中间层施加深分位数监督 (deep quantile supervision)；另加 prompt-tuning 模块在冻结预训练权重下微调。
Result: 145M 参数骨干支持最长 8,192 个观测的上下文；零样本预报在 GIFT-Eval 与分布外 TIME 基准上表现有竞争力，同一骨干在 UCR Archive 上支持分类、在 TSB-AD-U 上支持零样本异常检测，prompt tuning 进一步提升分布内预报性能；训练管线与模型在 huawei-noah/trustworthyAI 开源。
Conclusion: 数据与训练流程（真实+合成语料、渐进调度、深度分位数监督）本身足以支撑一个通用长上下文时间序列骨干，预报、分类、异常检测可共用同一套预训练权重。

papers.title: How Should Reasoning Be Organized in a Transformer's Latent Space?
papers.abstract_en: Continuous reasoning has emerged as a promising way to improve reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Yet we still lack a clear principle for deciding what a latent state should preserve. Reasoning by superposition shows that a single latent state can encode several search alternatives and expand them in parallel. We ask how those states should be weighted as reasoning proceeds. A natural choice is to preserve only the states active at the frontier step, since keeping every reached state appears to spread a limited hidden width too thin. We show that the opposite can hold. When later computation draws on several reached states, a cumulative state can guide attention correctly at a smaller hidden width than a frontier state that stores fewer states. At the same width, the cumulative state therefore keeps more intermediate states available for later reasoning. More generally, equal cumulative weights are optimal when future queries are unknown and remain close to the best task-specific weights when those queries are known. Experiments with two-layer and GPT-2 Transformers reproduce the predicted width advantage and show that unequal weights fail first on the states that receive the least weight. This suggests a important principle: keep reached states equally weighted, and restore equal weights as computation proceeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文在 Transformer 潜空间连续推理 (continuous reasoning) 框架下回答：已到达的搜索状态应如何加权。结论是等权累积状态 (cumulative state) 优于只保留前沿 (frontier) 状态——当后续计算要用到多个已到达状态时，等权累积状态在更小的 hidden width 下就能正确引导 attention，同宽度下保留更多中间状态；未来查询未知时等权即最优，已知时也接近任务最优权重。
Motivation: 连续推理中潜状态该保留什么缺乏明确原则：直觉上只保留前沿步活跃状态、丢弃其余，以免有限 hidden width 被摊薄，但论文指出这一选择可能恰好相反。
Method: 基于 reasoning by superposition（单个潜状态叠加多个搜索候选并行展开）分析不同加权策略对 attention 引导所需 hidden width 的影响，比较 frontier 状态与 cumulative 状态；用两层与 GPT-2 Transformer 实验检验预测的宽度优势。
Result: 两层与 GPT-2 Transformer 实验复现了预测的 width advantage：等权累积状态在小于 frontier 状态的 hidden width 下即可正确引导 attention，同宽度下保留更多中间状态；不等权先在权重最小的状态上失效。
Conclusion: 作者提出的原则是：已到达状态应等权保留，并在计算推进过程中恢复等权；未来查询未知时等权最优，已知时也接近最优任务权重。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: BridgeMatch: Conditional Transport Bridges in Matching Matrix Space for 3D Deformable Registration
papers.abstract_en: Reliable matching between partially observed, deforming point clouds requires global context and fine geometric detail. Coarse candidate selection can exclude correct fine-level correspondences. We present \paper, a unified conditional transport framework with the matching matrix itself as the evolving state. Coarse diffusion establishes global matching hypotheses; hierarchy-preserving lifting expands them into a structured high-resolution source. Geometry-conditioned ODE and SDE bridges continue refinement in the complete fine-level candidate space, allowing coarse errors to be corrected. The deterministic endpoint-parameterized conditional flow matching (CFM) design improves matching through iteration, while the SDE forward drift enables effective few-step refinement. Experiments on 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch demonstrate competitive matching and non-rigid registration, with transfer to CAPE and DeepDeform without target-domain training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BridgeMatch 把匹配矩阵本身当作条件传输 (conditional transport) 的演化状态做 3D 可变形配准：粗扩散给出全局匹配假设，层级保持的 lifting 展开成高分辨率源，再由几何条件化的 ODE/SDE bridge 在完整细层候选空间里继续细化，从而纠正粗阶段的错误匹配。在 4DMatch 与 4DLoMatch 上展示有竞争力的匹配与非刚性配准，并可零目标域训练迁移到 CAPE 与 DeepDeform。
Motivation: 部分观测、形变点云的匹配需要同时保留全局上下文与细几何细节，而粗候选筛选会把正确的细层对应直接排除掉，导致后续无法恢复。
Method: 以匹配矩阵为演化状态的统一条件传输框架：粗扩散 (coarse diffusion) 建立全局匹配假设，hierarchy-preserving lifting 将其扩展为结构化高分辨率源，几何条件化的 ODE 与 SDE bridge 在完整细层候选空间中继续细化；确定性端点参数化的 conditional flow matching (CFM) 通过迭代改进匹配，SDE 前向漂移支持少步细化。
Result: 在 4DMatch 和 4DLoMatch 上展示有竞争力的匹配与非刚性配准表现，并在不使用目标域训练的情况下迁移到 CAPE 与 DeepDeform。
Conclusion: 把匹配矩阵作为传输状态、让粗层假设在完整细层候选空间中被 ODE/SDE bridge 修正，可在部分观测形变点云上兼顾全局匹配与细节配准，并具备跨数据集迁移能力。

papers.title: AcFlow: Controlling Text-to-Image Diffusion Transformers via Learned Conditional Activation Flow
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion transformers (DiTs) are powerful generators, yet direct prompting provides limited control interface for style intensity and can fail to suppress unwanted concepts. To enable these controls, we introduce AcFlow, an inference-time controller that transports intermediate layer image-token activations through a learned concept-conditioned velocity field while keeping the base DiT frozen. A textual concept description specifies the desired intervention, while the integration horizon provides a continuous control parameter. The field produces token-varying, activation-dependent updates. With parameters shared across concepts within each task family, one field covers over 15,000 style descriptions or over 1,000 suppression concepts, and generalizes to concepts unseen during training without per-concept fitting. On style control, AcFlow achieves the best style--content trade-off among the evaluated baselines in the high-style-alignment regime. At a fixed operating point, AcFlow attains style--content alignment of 0.5365/0.2860, compared with 0.4397/0.2684 for the baseline with the highest style alignment. On concept suppression, AcFlow reduces the fraction of images showing the concept from 95.3%/82.1% to 41.6%/40.5% on held-in/held-out concepts, including cases where deleting them from the prompt fails to remove them. Our analyses support the learned velocity field as an adaptive control mechanism, with update directions varying across tokens and depending on their activation states. Our code is available at https://github.com/Nove1yst/AcFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AcFlow 是一个推理时的文本到图像 diffusion transformer (DiT) 控制器：冻结基座模型，用学习到的概念条件速度场搬运中间层图像 token 激活，以积分时长 (integration horizon) 作为连续控制量。在风格控制上它在高风格对齐区间取得最优风格-内容权衡，固定工作点风格/内容对齐为 0.5365/0.2860（最高风格对齐基线 0.4397/0.2684）；在概念抑制上把出现该概念的图像比例从 95.3%/82.1% 降到 41.6%/40.5%（held-in/held-out）。
Motivation: 直接 prompt 对风格强度的控制接口有限，且难以压掉不想要的概念——即使从 prompt 中删掉该概念，图像里仍会出现。
Method: 推理时把中间层 image-token 激活沿概念条件速度场 (velocity field) 输运，基座 DiT 保持冻结；文本概念描述指定干预目标，积分时长提供连续控制参数，更新量随 token 与激活状态变化。同一任务族内参数共享：一个场覆盖 15,000+ 风格描述或 1,000+ 抑制概念，无需逐概念拟合。
Result: 风格控制在高风格对齐区间取得所评估基线中最好的风格-内容权衡；固定工作点风格-内容对齐 0.5365/0.2860，对比风格对齐最高的基线 0.4397/0.2684。概念抑制把概念出现比例从 95.3%/82.1% 降到 41.6%/40.5%（held-in/held-out），涵盖从 prompt 删除概念仍无法去除的情形。
Conclusion: 学习到的速度场可作为自适应控制机制：更新方向跨 token 变化并依赖激活状态，一个共享场即可泛化到训练中未见的概念。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Large-scale bioacoustic detection using semantic segmentation: a deep learning framework applied to fin whale calls in ocean-bottom seismometer recordings
papers.abstract_en: Ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS), originally deployed for geophysical research, continuously record low-frequency sound for months to years across broad areas of ocean, offering a largely untapped resource for passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) of baleen whales. Realising this potential requires automated detection methods that operate reliably across the varied conditions in large sensor networks. We present a deep learning semantic segmentation framework that detects the 20-Hz notes of fin whales (Balaenoptera physalus) in OBS spectrograms, assigning each pixel a probability of belonging to a call and converting the resulting probability maps into time-frequency bounding boxes describing individual detections. We trained the model on hydrophone data from one OBS deployment in the Azores-Madeira-Canaries region and applied it without retraining to vertical-component seismometer data from a second, geographically distinct deployment, showing that a single trained model generalises across sensor types and recording environments. Applied to 378,912 h of recordings from 46 OBS sites, the detector identified 6.3 million calls, forming the largest fin whale call catalogue assembled to date, with high precision (~97%) across both deployments. The resulting catalogue resolves call timing and spectral structure accurately enough to support ecological analyses, revealing coherent seasonal shifts in three persistent inter-note interval (INI) groups across the singing season and basin-scale patterns in calling activity. By transforming existing geophysical infrastructure into a scalable sensing network, our approach substantially expands the spatial and temporal reach of PAM without new hardware investment, offering a transferable framework for tracking other low-frequency vocalising species and informing conservation planning, marine spatial management, and abundance estimation across large scales.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用语义分割深度学习框架在海底地震仪 (OBS) 频谱图上逐像素标注长须鲸 20 Hz 叫声并转成时频边界框，单次训练即可跨传感器类型与海域直接应用。处理 46 个 OBS 站点共 378,912 小时记录，检出 630 万次叫声，两个部署上精度均约 97%，构成迄今最大长须鲸叫声目录。
Motivation: 海底地震仪长期连续记录低频声学信号却基本未被用于被动声学监测 (PAM)，人工听测无法覆盖大传感器网络中数月到数年、条件各异的记录。
Method: 在 Azores-Madeira-Canaries 区域一次 OBS 部署的水听器数据上训练语义分割模型，为频谱图像素赋予属于叫声的概率，再把概率图转成时频边界框；随后不重训练直接应用到第二次地理上独立部署的垂直分量地震仪数据。
Result: 在 46 个 OBS 站点 378,912 小时记录上检出 630 万次长须鲸叫声，为迄今最大目录，两个部署上精度均约 97%；目录解析出歌唱季内三组持续的音间隔 (INI) 的一致季节性漂移与盆地尺度的鸣叫活动格局。
Conclusion: 单一训练模型可跨传感器类型与记录环境泛化，把既有地球物理基础设施转成可扩展 PAM 网络，无需新硬件即可支撑生态分析、保护规划与丰度估计，并可迁移到其他低频发声物种。

papers.title: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose AgentGrad, a prompt optimization framework for multi-agent systems based on sequential intervention and semantic textual gradient abstraction. For each failure, sequential intervention modifies the behavior of one agent at a time to identify the target agent whose modification resolves the failure. The modified output of the target agent then serves as agent-level supervision for extracting a fine-grained gradient. Semantic textual gradient abstraction clusters semantically similar gradients to prevent mixing unrelated failure modes, and abstracts each cluster into a generalized gradient that captures the shared corrective pattern. Experimental results show that AgentGrad achieves state-of-the-art performance across five MAS benchmarks while reducing wall-clock optimization time by $2.5\times$ and optimization cost by 21.8\% on average compared to the next-best baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentGrad 针对多智能体系统 (MAS) 的文本梯度 prompt 优化，用逐个干预定位真正导致失败的目标 agent，再以该 agent 修改后的输出作为监督抽取细粒度梯度，并按语义聚类抽象梯度避免混合无关失败模式。在五个 MAS benchmark 上达到 SOTA，同时把优化墙钟时间降低 2.5×、平均优化成本降低 21.8%。
Motivation: 现有文本梯度方法在梯度抽取时未验证改哪个 prompt 真正能修复失败、也缺少 agent 级中间输出监督；梯度聚合时随机分组拼接，混入无关失败模式，导致 prompt 泛化差。
Method: AgentGrad 包含两部分：sequential intervention 对每个失败逐个修改单个 agent 行为以定位目标 agent，其修改后输出作为 agent 级监督抽取细粒度梯度；semantic textual gradient abstraction 对语义相似的梯度聚类并抽象为覆盖共同纠正模式的泛化梯度。
Result: 在五个 MAS benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能；相比次优 baseline，平均墙钟优化时间减少 2.5×，优化成本降低 21.8%。
Conclusion: 先用干预确认目标 agent 再抽梯度、并按语义聚合梯度，能同时提升 MAS prompt 优化的最终性能与优化效率。

summary_sections.result: 在五个 MAS benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能；相比次优 baseline，平均墙钟优化时间减少 2.5×，优化成本降低 21.8%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 先用干预确认目标 agent 再抽梯度、并按语义聚合梯度，能同时提升 MAS prompt 优化的最终性能与优化效率。

papers.title: SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems enable complex reasoning and tool use by coordinating agents that divide roles and refine candidate solutions. Existing methods typically update individual agent responses or treat a complete trajectory as one training example. However, these methods may produce misleading policy updates because they assign the same final outcome to responses or trajectory segments that may play different roles in different team decisions. This is because treating each response as an independent update may separate outputs that jointly determine the next action, while treating an entire trajectory as one update may combine decisions made after different observations. These limitations call for a policy update defined at the level of a team decision, outputs that lead to the same state transition are optimized under a shared objective. In this paper, we propose Setwise Relative Policy Optimization (SRPO) for multi-agent systems. We represent the outputs used together to produce one state transition as an active set. A singleton set covers division of labor, while a larger set covers joint co-evolution, and the set composition can change across decisions. SRPO assigns a shared advantage to each active set, clips the combined policy change, and normalizes its scale according to the set size. This ties each update to the decision that produced the next state. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search demonstrate the effectiveness of SRPO across both tasks. Additional ablation studies analyze the normalization choice and training behavior under changing active-set sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRPO 把多智能体训练的更新单位从单条回复或整条轨迹改成产生同一次状态转移的 active set：集合内共享同一 advantage，裁剪组内合并后的策略变化，并按集合大小归一化尺度。在数学推理与多轮搜索两类任务上实验显示该更新有效，消融分析了归一化选择与集合大小变化时的训练行为。
Motivation: 现有方法按单条回复或整条轨迹做策略更新，会把在不同团队决策中角色不同的输出绑到同一个最终结果上：单回复更新拆散了共同决定下一步动作的输出，整轨迹更新又把不同观测之后的决策混在一起，导致误导性的策略更新。
Method: 提出 Setwise Relative Policy Optimization (SRPO)：把共同产生一次状态转移的输出表示为 active set（单元素集合覆盖分工，更大集合覆盖联合演化，集合构成随决策变化），对每个 active set 赋共享 advantage，裁剪合并后的策略变化，并按集合大小归一化尺度，使每次更新绑定到产生下一状态的那次决策。
Result: 在数学推理和多轮搜索两个任务上实验验证 SRPO 的有效性；另做消融研究分析归一化选择以及 active-set 大小变化下的训练行为。
Conclusion: 以团队决策层级（active set）而非单回复或整轨迹为更新单位，能把策略更新与产生状态转移的那次决策对齐，从而避免误导性的策略更新。

papers.title: TV-Regulated OPD: Direction Matters in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) facilitates the transfer of knowledge from domain expert to student in the post-training phase of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the supervision signals in mainstream OPD methods suffer from high variance and noise which is generally instable during training. In this work, we systematically investigated what really matters to the performance and the fundamental mechanisms behind the instability during training. We found that retaining only the sign of token-level advantages is sufficient to achieve the performance comparable to standard OPD. Meanwhile, smoother and bounded advantages can stabilize the training process without sacrificing its performance. These motivated us to shape the advantages using the Total Variation (TV) and propose a robust TV regulated On-Policy Distillation (TV-OPD) method. Benefiting from the bounded and diminished advantages, TV-OPD exhibits stable training dynamics and steady late-stage performance. We conducted comprehensive experiments and found that, across various settings, TV-OPD consistently achieved better performance and lower variance in the late-stage of training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 在线蒸馏 (On-Policy Distillation) 中，token 级优势信号的高方差与噪声是训练不稳的根源；只保留优势的符号就足以达到标准 OPD 相当的性能，而平滑且有界的优势能在不损失性能的前提下稳定训练。据此用 Total Variation (TV) 整形优势提出 TV-OPD，其优势有界并趋于消失，训练动力学稳定、后期性能平稳，各设置下后期性能更好且方差更低。
Motivation: 主流 OPD 的监督信号方差大、含噪，导致 LLM 后训练阶段训练过程不稳定、后期性能波动。
Method: 系统考察 OPD 性能的真正决定因素与不稳定的机制，发现仅保留 token 级优势的符号即可，随后用 Total Variation (TV) 对优势做平滑与有界整形，提出 TV-Regulated On-Policy Distillation (TV-OPD)。
Result: 仅保留 token 级优势符号即可达到与标准 OPD 相当的性能；平滑且有界的优势可稳定训练而不牺牲性能；TV-OPD 在多种设置下训练后期性能一致更好、方差更低，训练动力学稳定、后期性能平稳。
Conclusion: OPD 不稳的关键在优势信号的方差与噪声而非其幅度，TV 整形使优势有界并衰减即可同时保住性能与稳定性。

papers.title: Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention enables efficient long-context inference by compressing token history into a fixed-size recurrent memory. This compression makes each update a trade-off between incorporating new information and preserving useful associations. Models such as DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, and KDA predict write strength from the current token representation, without explicitly tracking uncertainty in the stored memory. Yet this uncertainty matters: a new observation should have greater influence when the existing association is uncertain and less when it is already well supported. We introduce Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs), a family of linear-attention models that explicitly track memory uncertainty to guide each update. By formulating associative memory as a linear-Gaussian state-space model, KDNs propagate both the memory estimate and its uncertainty, using the Kalman gain to balance accumulated evidence against the reliability of new observations. This formulation also recovers standard delta-rule updates by replacing tracked covariance with a token-predicted isotropic surrogate. To support hardware-efficient training and inference, we derive Diagonal KDN and Isotropic KDN, which retain one uncertainty value per key channel and per head, respectively. Their uncertainty updates admit associative scans with logarithmic parallel depth, requiring only $O(d_k)$ and $O(1)$ auxiliary state per head. Across controlled pretraining at 750M and 1.3B parameters, both variants consistently improve perplexity and mean downstream accuracy over the evaluated state-of-the-art linear-attention baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把线性注意力的联想记忆写成线性高斯状态空间模型，用 Kalman gain 同时传播记忆估计与其不确定性来决定每次写入强度；当已有关联不确定时新观测权重更大、已充分支持时更小。该形式把追踪协方差换成 token 预测的各向同性代理即退化为标准 delta rule，并派生出 Diagonal KDN 与 Isotropic KDN 两个硬件高效变体。在 750M 与 1.3B 参数的受控预训练中，两变体的 perplexity 与下游平均准确率均一致优于所评估的 SOTA 线性注意力基线。
Motivation: DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、KDA 等线性注意力模型只用当前 token 表示预测写入强度，不追踪已存记忆的不确定性，导致新信息与既有联想的权衡无法按可靠性调节。
Method: 将联想记忆表述为线性高斯状态空间模型 (linear-Gaussian state-space model)，同时传播记忆估计与不确定性，用 Kalman gain 平衡累积证据与新观测可靠性；把追踪协方差替换为 token 预测的各向同性代理即可复原标准 delta-rule 更新。为硬件高效训练与推理派生 Diagonal KDN（每 key 通道一个不确定性值）与 Isotropic KDN（每 head 一个），其不确定性更新可用对数并行深度的 associative scan，每 head 仅需 O(d_k) 与 O(1) 辅助状态。
Result: 在 750M 与 1.3B 参数的受控预训练中，Diagonal KDN 与 Isotropic KDN 的 perplexity 与下游平均准确率均一致优于所评估的 SOTA 线性注意力基线；辅助状态开销分别为每 head O(d_k) 与 O(1)，associative scan 并行深度为对数级。
Conclusion: 显式追踪记忆不确定性并用 Kalman gain 调节写入强度，是比 token 预测写入强度更有效的线性注意力更新规则，且能以对数并行深度和 O(d_k)/O(1) 辅助状态在硬件上实现。

papers.title: Smoothed Picard Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: We develop a new low-accuracy sampler, called smoothed Picard Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, which combines Gaussian smoothing, Picard iteration, and higher-order discretization. For a log-concave target $π\propto \exp(-V)$ in dimension $d$ satisfying $0 \prec αI \preceq \nabla^2 V \preceq βI$, with condition number $κ:= β/α$, smoothed Picard HMC returns a sample with $\sqrt α\,W_2(\cdot,π) \le \varepsilon$ using $\widetilde O(κ^2 + κ^{7/6} d^{1/6}/\varepsilon^{1/3})$ gradient queries. We also prove stronger $W_q$ bounds, and then develop an algorithmic framework, the recursive warm start generator, to upgrade these $W_q$ bounds to stronger divergence guarantees. This produces a warm start for the proximal bouncy particle sampler, introduced in a companion work, leading to a high-accuracy log-concave sampler with complexity $\widetilde O((κ^{7/6} d^{1/6} + κ^{1/2} d^{1/4})\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 smoothed Picard HMC：把 Gaussian smoothing、Picard 迭代与高阶离散化组合成低精度采样器，对条件数 κ、维数 d 的 log-concave 目标 π∝exp(−V)，达到 √α·W₂(·,π)≤ε 只需 Õ(κ²+κ^{7/6}d^{1/6}/ε^{1/3}) 次梯度查询；再用 recursive warm start generator 把 W_q 界升级为更强散度保证，为 companion work 的 proximal bouncy particle sampler 提供 warm start，得到复杂度 Õ((κ^{7/6}d^{1/6}+κ^{1/2}d^{1/4})polylog(1/ε)) 的高精度 log-concave 采样器。
Motivation: log-concave 目标的高精度采样在高维、病态条件数下梯度查询代价高，需要在低精度阶段就压低复杂度，并让低精度结果能被升级为强散度意义下的 warm start。
Method: smoothed Picard HMC 组合 Gaussian smoothing、Picard iteration 与 higher-order discretization；目标满足 0≺αI≼∇²V≼βI，κ:=β/α。证明更强的 W_q 界后，用 recursive warm start generator 框架把 W_q 界升级为更强的 divergence 保证，作为 proximal bouncy particle sampler（见 companion work）的 warm start。
Result: 低精度：√α·W₂(·,π)≤ε 用 Õ(κ²+κ^{7/6}d^{1/6}/ε^{1/3}) 次梯度查询；高精度（配合 proximal bouncy particle sampler）：Õ((κ^{7/6}d^{1/6}+κ^{1/2}d^{1/4})polylog(1/ε))。另给出更强的 W_q 界；v2 注记为 sharpened some bounds。
Conclusion: 低精度采样与 warm start 升级框架配合，可以把 log-concave 目标的采样复杂度在 κ 与 d 上压到上述界，高精度部分依赖 companion work 的 proximal bouncy particle sampler。

papers.title: CST-WM: A Causally Structured World Model for Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to choose actions that keep a moving target observable at a suitable distance, and to recover it after occlusion, out-of-view drift, or distractor crossings. We cast the task as planning over future target evidence with an action-conditioned world model. In logged tracking data, however, the behavior policy's actions are correlated with where the target is, so a generic predictor can learn a shortcut: it writes the current action directly into its prediction of target evidence, instead of letting the action affect that evidence only by moving the robot and changing what it observes. We call this failure causal hallucination; the resulting rollouts look plausible but rank candidate actions for the wrong reason. We propose CST-WM, a causally structured world model whose state is split into target-evidence, robot, and observation branches. Its transition removes the same-step edge from action to target evidence but keeps the path through robot motion and the resulting views, so candidate actions are still distinguished by their predicted ego-motion. With rollout-based model-predictive control, a single model handles both steady following and re-acquisition after target loss. On EVT-Bench and Habitat 3.0, covering standard tracking, target-loss recovery, and cross-dataset transfer, CST-WM improves following, distance-range control, safety, and re-acquisition over reactive trackers and world-model baselines, and removing the action mask causes the largest drop in re-acquisition among our ablations. Offline, CST-WM has lower multi-step rollout error, and its ranking of candidate actions agrees better with the simulator's. On a Unitree Go2 quadruped, CST-WM succeeds in 20 of 30 real-world trials under occlusion, distractor crossing, and fast motion, against 14 for TrackVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CST-WM 把具身视觉跟踪建模为对未来目标证据的规划，并在世界模型的状态转移中切断 action 到 target-evidence 的同步边，只保留经机器人运动与观测视角的路径，从而消除把当前动作直接写进预测的 causal hallucination。配合基于 rollout 的 MPC，单一模型同时处理稳定跟随与目标丢失后的重捕获：在 EVT-Bench 与 Habitat 3.0 上提升跟随、距离保持、安全与重捕获，消融中去掉 action mask 对重捕获损害最大；Unitree Go2 实机遮挡/干扰/快速运动 30 次试验成功 20 次，TrackVLA 为 14 次。
Motivation: 日志跟踪数据中行为策略的动作与目标位置相关，通用预测器会学到捷径：把当前动作直接写进目标证据预测，rollout 看似合理却按错误理由给候选动作排序。
Method: CST-WM 将状态拆成 target-evidence、robot、observation 三个分支，转移函数去掉 action→target-evidence 的同步边，保留经机器人运动与所产生视角的路径；用 rollout 式模型预测控制 (MPC) 对候选动作排序与执行。

papers.title: Beyond Retraining-Free MoE Compression: A Cost-Normalized Study of Post-Compression Adjustment
papers.abstract_en: Retraining-free MoE compression reduces deployment memory by pruning or merging experts, but often treats the compressed checkpoint as the final artifact. We argue that this view is incomplete: compressed MoE checkpoints are better understood as compressed initializations that benefit from a tiny post-compression adjustment stage. Across two MoE LLM backbones, four pruning/merging methods, three expert-retention ratios, and 28 benchmarks, we compare LM fine-tuning and teacher-based KD under matched small-data budgets and measured GPU costs. Using only 3,000 C4 examples and a single epoch of adjustment, Full FT recovers 37.3% of the original-to-compressed performance gap on average. Moreover, LM fine-tuning is more cost-effective than standard token-level KD, and full-parameter adjustment gives the strongest cost--recovery trade-off among the tested scopes. These results suggest that retraining-free compression should be paired with small post-compression adjustment to recover a substantial portion of the performance lost during compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 retraining-free MoE 压缩后的 checkpoint 当作压缩初始化而非最终产物，用极小规模的 post-compression adjustment 恢复压缩损失：仅 3,000 条 C4 样本、1 个 epoch 的 Full FT 平均恢复原始到压缩性能差距的 37.3%，且比 token-level KD 更具成本效益。作者主张 retraining-free 压缩应配一个小的后压缩调整阶段。
Motivation: 剪枝或合并专家的 retraining-free MoE 压缩通常把压缩后的 checkpoint 直接当作最终模型，压缩造成的性能损失没有被回收，部署收益以质量下降为代价。
Method: 在两个 MoE LLM backbone、四种剪枝/合并方法、三种专家保留率上，以匹配的小数据预算和实测 GPU 成本对比 LM fine-tuning 与 teacher-based KD 两种调整方式，并考察不同参数调整范围（scope）的成本-恢复权衡，评测覆盖 28 个 benchmark。
Result: 仅用 3,000 条 C4 样本、1 个 epoch 的 Full FT 平均恢复原始到压缩模型性能差距的 37.3%；在匹配预算下 LM fine-tuning 比标准 token-level KD 更符合成本效益；全参数调整在所测 scope 中给出最强的成本-恢复权衡。
Conclusion: retraining-free 压缩不应止于压缩后的 checkpoint，配一个极小数据、单 epoch 的后压缩调整即可收回相当一部分压缩损失，其中全参数 LM 微调性价比最高。

papers.title: SimFuse3D: Source-Guided Target Simulation and Confidence-Guided Multi-Stage Localization Reweighting for Cross-Platform 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Changes in sensor height and viewpoint alter object-level point distributions, making cross-platform LiDAR unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) difficult. Self-training uses labeled source scans and unlabeled target scans, yet a retained prediction may provide a useful target location while enclosing sparse foreground returns, background clutter, or points inconsistent with the predicted box. We refer to this mismatch as box-point inconsistency. We introduce SimFuse3D, which preserves the target placement and repairs the associated pseudo object using measured geometry from labeled source scans. Object Memory retrieves a similar labeled source instance. Target Simulation places the retrieved source geometry at the target location, aligns its points with the target viewing geometry, and filters the aligned crop to approximate the target observation. Confidence-Guided Multi-Stage Localization Reweighting (CMLR) maps each target pseudo-object confidence score to a bounded weight shared by RPN localization and R-CNN box regression. All components operate only during adaptation, leaving the detector architecture and inference graph unchanged. Across six cross-platform transfers, SimFuse3D consistently outperforms Pi3DET-Net and achieves the best performance among the compared adaptation methods on nearly all metrics. On nuScenes-to-KITTI, it ranks first among the compared adaptation methods with both evaluated detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimFuse3D 针对跨平台 LiDAR 无监督域适应中的 box-point inconsistency（伪框位置可用但框内点稀疏或混入背景），用源域实测几何在目标位置重建伪目标：Object Memory 检索相似源实例，Target Simulation 按目标视角几何摆放并裁剪过滤，CMLR 把伪目标置信度映射为有界权重同时作用于 RPN 定位与 R-CNN 框回归。六组跨平台迁移上一致优于 Pi3DET-Net，在几乎所有指标上取得所比较方法中最佳，nuScenes→KITTI 上用两个被评估检测器均排名第一。
Motivation: 传感器高度与视角变化改变物体级点分布，使跨平台 LiDAR UDA 困难；自训练中保留下来的预测可能位置有用，但框内混杂稀疏前景、背景杂点或与预测框不一致的点（box-point inconsistency），污染伪标签。
Method: 三个组件只在适应阶段运行，不改检测器结构与推理图：Object Memory 从带标签源扫描检索相似实例；Target Simulation 把检索到的源几何放到目标位置、按目标视角几何对齐并过滤裁剪以逼近目标观测；CMLR 将每个目标伪目标置信度分数映射为有界权重，共享给 RPN localization 与 R-CNN box regression。
Result: 六组跨平台迁移上一致优于 Pi3DET-Net，在所比较的适应方法中几乎所有指标最佳；在 nuScenes-to-KITTI 上，用两个被评估的检测器均在所比较方法中排名第一。
Conclusion: 用源域实测几何在目标视角下重建伪目标、并按置信度重加权定位损失，可在不改检测器架构的前提下改善跨平台 LiDAR 无监督域适应。

papers.title: SMILE: Bridging Continuous Optimization and Discrete Symbolic Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) discovers closed-form mathematical expressions from data, offering interpretability beyond black-box models. Existing methods suffer from slow convergence in combinatorial search spaces and lack mechanisms to exploit compositional structure in the data. We introduce SMILE (Sine, Multiplication, Identity, Logarithm, Exponential), a hybrid framework that unifies continuous gradient-based optimization with discrete symbolic recovery through three stages: structural analysis of the data to identify the compositional hierarchy of the target expression, continuous optimization to learn parameters of a network that encodes the target expression using interpretable activations, and symbolic recovery through structured pruning, coefficient optimization, and rounding. This final stage distills the learned network into a compact expression with exact symbolic constants. We evaluate SMILE on SRBench across ground-truth and black-box datasets, with ablation studies validating each component. SMILE achieves the highest symbolic solution rate at the largest noise levels, demonstrating strong robustness where competing methods degrade substantially. It consistently lies on the Pareto front of accuracy versus complexity, recovering significantly simpler expressions in a fraction of the time required by the competing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMILE 把符号回归拆成三段：先做数据的结构分析找出目标表达式的组合层级，再用可解释激活的网络做连续参数优化，最后经结构化剪枝、系数优化与取整把网络蒸馏成带精确符号常数的紧凑表达式。在 SRBench 的 ground-truth 与 black-box 数据集上，它在最大噪声档取得最高的符号解率，并稳定处于精度-复杂度 Pareto 前沿，用竞争方法所需时间的一小部分恢复出显著更简单的表达式。
Motivation: 符号回归在组合搜索空间中收敛慢，且现有方法缺少利用数据组合结构的机制，导致噪声下符号解率下降、表达式冗长。
Method: 三阶段混合框架：结构分析识别目标表达式的组合层级；连续优化训练以可解释激活 (Sine, Multiplication, Identity, Logarithm, Exponential) 编码表达式的网络；符号恢复阶段用结构化剪枝、系数优化与 rounding 蒸馏出含精确符号常数的紧凑表达式，并对各组件做 ablation。
Result: 在 SRBench 的 ground-truth 与 black-box 数据集上评测：SMILE 在最大噪声档取得最高符号解率，而竞争方法在此大幅退化；始终位于 accuracy-versus-complexity 的 Pareto 前沿，恢复的表达式显著更简单，耗时仅为竞争方法的一小部分；ablation 验证了各组件的作用。
Conclusion: 连续优化加离散符号恢复的三段式路线能在高噪声下保住符号解率，同时把表达式复杂度和求解时间一起压下来。

papers.title: Is One Step Enough for Offline Policy Improvement?
papers.abstract_en: Behavior regularization in offline reinforcement learning limits the exploitation of critic errors, but strong anchoring can also restrict policy improvement. We study how policy improvement is composed through multi-step proximal policy improvement (MPI), which re-centers each proximal objective on the preceding policy. We parameterize the procedure by a nominal total horizon $T$ and $K$ stages with local horizon $T/K$, distinguishing subdivision at a fixed total horizon from additional refinement at a common local horizon. Our analysis shows that sequential re-centering can reach endpoints unavailable to any single proximal step and characterizes how subdivision reduces the leading local discretization error of ideal updates under a fixed critic. We consider TD3+BC and IQL-based policy extraction to examine how improvement composition interacts with actor objectives and policy geometry. TD3+BC experiments on D4RL locomotion suggest that subdivision can broaden the range of useful total horizons, while adding refinement stages at a fixed small local horizon can improve return. The results identify improvement composition as a design choice alongside regularization strength, with distinct effects from horizon subdivision and additional policy extraction.
papers.comment: Preprint; 22 pages. Major revision with a new title, revised analysis of horizon subdivision and re-centering, and expanded experiments and controls
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离线强化学习中把策略改进拆成 K 阶多步近端改进 (MPI)，每步以先前策略重新居中，可在固定总时域 T 下到达单步近端更新无法达到的终点。D4RL 运动任务上 TD3+BC 实验显示，细分 (subdivision) 能拓宽可用总时域范围，而在固定小局部时域上增加细化阶段可提高回报。
Motivation: 行为正则化限制了对 critic 误差的利用，但锚定过强又会限制策略改进；改进如何通过多步组合而成、以及这种组合与 actor 目标和策略几何如何交互，此前缺少刻画。
Method: 以名义总时域 T 与 K 阶（局部时域 T/K）参数化 MPI 过程，区分固定总时域下的细分与固定局部时域下的额外细化；分析给出顺序重居中可达终点以及细分如何降低固定 critic 下理想更新的主导局部离散化误差；实验用 TD3+BC 与基于 IQL 的策略提取。
Result: D4RL locomotion 上的 TD3+BC 实验表明：细分可拓宽有用总时域的范围，在固定小局部时域上增加细化阶段可提升回报。
Conclusion: 改进组合 (improvement composition) 应与正则化强度并列作为设计选择，且时域细分与额外策略提取的作用彼此不同。

papers.title: Instability Floors: Separating Bias from Noise in Fairness Audits of Clinical LLM Agents with FairMedAgent
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual fairness audits of clinical language-model agents report a flip rate: how often an action changes when only the patient's demographic descriptor changes. Part of that rate is not demographic. A stochastic agent also changes its own action when nothing changes, and a flip rate cannot be interpreted without knowing how often. We measured it. Re-running one condition ten times over sixteen synthetic vignettes at default sampling changed a clinical agent's action in 8.7 percent of replicate pairs, from 2.2 percent for intensive-care escalation to 17.9 percent for controlled-substance caution, an output given no operational criteria. Across six models from five vendors, pooled floors ranged from 2.5 to 23.7 percent; in this panel neither disclosed size, vendor, nor hosting ordered them. The floor depends on the decoding configuration: majority voting over five draws removed 39 percent of it (95 percent confidence interval (CI) 18 to 64); at temperature 0 three of four locally served models showed no disagreement, but a hosted model still did. We also show that, for a binary action, the flip rate expected under no demographic effect equals the floor and a real effect adds only its square, so a flip rate inside the floor is not evidence of fairness, and direction must be tested with a signed paired test. We give a four-step reporting procedure and release FairMedAgent, the harness, with its protocol, vignettes and analysis scripts, so any team can measure the floor for its own agent.

TL;DR: 临床 LLM agent 的反事实公平审计里，翻转率 (flip rate) 有一部分与人口属性无关：随机性 agent 在什么都不变时也会自己改动作。作者对 16 个合成病例、同一条件重复 10 次，测得基线翻转率 8.7%（ICU 升级 2.2% 到管制药物谨慎 17.9%），六个模型的合并基线在 2.5%–23.7% 之间；落在基线内的翻转率不能作为公平证据，方向必须用带符号配对检验。
Motivation: 反事实公平审计把人口描述符变化导致的动作翻转直接当作人口偏倚，但随机采样本身就会产生翻转，这部分噪声与偏倚混在一起，翻转率无法解读。

papers.title: MeshSplatBench: A Unified Benchmark for Triangle- and Mesh-Based Neural Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Triangle- and mesh-based neural rendering aims to bridge neural scene representations and existing graphics engines (\textit{e.g.}, Unity and Blender) by leveraging triangle primitives compatible with standard rasterization hardware. However, existing methods are developed and evaluated under inconsistent settings, with limited comparison and little investigation into practical graphics engine deployment. This gap significantly hinders the understanding of their real-world usability. To address this issue, we introduce MeshSplatBench, the first benchmark for systematic evaluation of triangle- and mesh-based neural rendering from native rendering to graphics engine deployment. We propose a hierarchical deployment protocol with two options: (1) Standard deployment, using a conventional opaque mesh pipeline with vertex colors and hardware Z-buffering; and (2) Dedicated deployment, incorporating method-specific engine implementations to preserve appearance and compositing properties (e.g., alpha blending). For mesh splatting, we further introduce a structural audit to evaluate the topological and geometric integrity of exported surfaces for downstream graphics applications. Extensive evaluations reveal three key findings: (1) graphics engine deployment introduces noticeable quality degradation across methods, while mesh splatting approaches achieve relatively better robustness under standard deployment; (2) dedicated deployment can preserve most rendering fidelity at the cost of approximately 6-30$\times$ slowdown; and (3) explicit connectivity and shared vertex indexing in current mesh splatting methods remain insufficient to guarantee manifoldness or global connectivity. Our benchmark demonstrates that rasterizability alone does not imply graphics readiness and highlights the importance of evaluating practical engine compatibility. The benchmark and source code will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshSplatBench 是首个系统评测三角形/网格基神经渲染从原生渲染到图形引擎部署的基准，提出含 Standard 与 Dedicated 两档的分层部署协议，并对 mesh splatting 做结构审计。评测发现引擎部署使各方法质量明显下降，Dedicated 部署可保住大部分保真度但代价是约 6–30× 减速，且现有 mesh splatting 的显式连接与共享顶点索引仍不足以保证流形性或全局连通。
Motivation: 三角形/网格基神经渲染方法的训练与评测设置不一致、缺少横向对比，也几乎没人检验能否真正部署进 Unity、Blender 这类图形引擎，导致其真实可用性难以判断。
Method: 提出分层部署协议：Standard 档用传统不透明网格管线（顶点色 + 硬件 Z-buffer），Dedicated 档为各方法实现专用引擎实现以保留外观与合成属性（如 alpha blending）；对 mesh splatting 额外引入结构审计，检查导出表面的拓扑与几何完整性。
Result: 三项发现：图形引擎部署在所有方法上都带来明显质量下降，而 mesh splatting 在 Standard 部署下相对更稳健；Dedicated 部署能保住大部分渲染保真度，代价是约 6–30× 减速；现有 mesh splatting 的显式连接与共享顶点索引仍不足以保证流形性 (manifoldness) 或全局连通。
Conclusion: 可光栅化不等于图形就绪 (graphics readiness)，神经渲染方法必须把实际引擎兼容性纳入评测；基准与源代码将公开发布。

papers.title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, but on vision-language models (VLMs) a self-reinforcing cycle holds it back. Because an autoregressive drafter pays a sequential pass for each drafted token, it must stay small and can ill afford to attend to the image at each pass. Prior work therefore compresses or hides the image, leaving the drafter weakest on the text the image determines. We present GLANCE, a one-pass block drafter that breaks this cycle on an unmodified VLM target. Its block-diffusion head drafts a whole block in one forward pass over the target's already fused vision-language states, reading the multimodal context once, however deep the draft. The target verifies a wide candidate tree in one pass and commits exactly its greedy output. In one production engine at a fixed round budget, GLANCE decodes up to 3.05 times faster than autoregressive decoding and outpaces the production EAGLE3-VL head on average and by about 11% on grounded tasks. An entropy law explains when drafting pays, predicting the longest accepted blocks on grounded tasks, where the target's next-token entropy is lowest. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLANCE 用 block-diffusion 头在目标模型已融合的视觉-语言状态上一次前向起草整块 token，起草器只读一次多模态上下文，从而打破 VLM 投机解码中“起草器小到看不了图像”的自强化循环。在生产引擎固定轮次预算下，比自回归解码最高快 3.05 倍，平均超过生产版 EAGLE3-VL 头，grounded 任务上约快 11%。
Motivation: 投机解码本不改变输出，但 VLM 中自回归起草器每起草一个 token 就要顺序过一遍，只能做小且难以逐步看图，先前工作因此压缩或隐藏图像，使起草器恰恰在图像决定的文本上最弱。
Method: GLANCE 是 one-pass block drafter，直接作用于未经修改的 VLM 目标模型：block-diffusion 头在目标已融合的视觉-语言状态上一次前向起草整块候选，无论起草深度多深都只读一次多模态上下文；目标一次验证较宽的候选树并精确提交其贪心输出。另给出一条 entropy law 解释起草何时划算。
Result: 在生产引擎、固定轮次预算下，GLANCE 解码速度最高为自回归解码的 3.05 倍；平均快于生产版 EAGLE3-VL 头，grounded 任务上约快 11%。entropy law 预测 grounded 任务上接受的块最长，因为该处目标的 next-token 熵最低。
Conclusion: 让起草器一次读取融合后的多模态状态、整块起草，可以在不改目标模型的前提下加速 VLM 解码；起草是否划算由目标 next-token 熵决定，grounded 任务熵最低因而收益最大。

papers.title: Benevolent Bias in Multi-Turn Human-Agent Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Bias in human-agent interaction can manifest not only through hostile language but also as benevolent bias, whereby unequal treatment hides behind a warm, positive tone. To make it detectable, we operationalise benevolent bias along two dimensions, tone and treatment, yielding three classes: neutral support, overt bias, and benevolent bias. Building on these definitions, we construct BENEVDIAL, a class-balanced corpus of 362,880 multi-turn support dialogues spanning user and agent demographics, roles, and generators, to support controlled evaluation. We then test two detector families on it: off-the-shelf safety detectors and prompted large language model (LLM) judges. Our findings reveal a notable detection gap: off-the-shelf detectors reliably flag overt bias yet largely fail to identify benevolent bias. LLM judges improve sensitivity when guided by explicit detection criteria, but this comes at the cost of increased misclassification of neutral supportive statements as benevolent bias, a tendency that is further exacerbated by the presence of demographic context. These findings suggest that fair monitoring of human-agent dialogue must look beyond surface cues to whether the agent's treatment is disparate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人机对话中的偏见按语气与待遇两维操作化为三类（neutral support、overt bias、benevolent bias），并构建类均衡语料 BENEVDIAL（362,880 条多轮支持对话）。现成安全检测器能可靠识别 overt bias 却基本抓不到 benevolent bias；LLM judge 在明确检测准则下敏感度提升，但代价是把中性支持误判为 benevolent bias，且加入人口统计语境后该误判更严重。
Motivation: 温暖正面语气掩盖的不平等对待（benevolent bias）在人机交互中不可见，现有偏见检测依赖表面敌意线索，无法公平监控这类隐蔽的差别待遇。
Method: 沿语气与待遇两维操作化 benevolent bias，定义三类标签；据此构建类均衡语料 BENEVDIAL，覆盖用户与智能体的人口统计属性、角色与生成器，共 362,880 条多轮支持对话；在语料上测试两类检测器：现成安全检测器与带提示的 LLM judge。
Result: 现成检测器可靠标出 overt bias，但基本无法识别 benevolent bias；LLM judge 在显式检测准则引导下敏感度提高，却增加把 neutral support 误判为 benevolent bias 的比例，且人口统计语境会进一步加剧这一误判。
Conclusion: 公平的人机对话监控必须越过表面语气线索，判断智能体的实际待遇是否存在差别；单靠现成安全检测器或无准则的 LLM judge 都不足以支撑这一判断。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The reach of a verification tool decides its value: A controlled study of verification surface, artifact quality, and cost in AI coding agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern artificial-intelligence coding agents can be equipped with tools for checking their own work e.g. a linter, a boot probe, a shell, a screenshot tool. We call this set the agent's verification surface. This study asks whether increasing only that surface, with everything else held fixed, produces a matching growth in the quality of the software the agent ships. We built a minimal coding agent whose tool list is the single controlled variable and used it to implement 1,116 web applications across six models and eight tool configurations. A condition-blind human graded every application against a frozen rubric, and automatic probes stress-tested the API-observable behaviors. Verification's cheapest benefit arrives first, which is to make sure that the application comes up. Without any tools, about one build in seven fails to launch at all and a single boot probe removes nearly all of these failures at roughly 35 percent of a full shell's token cost, while the full shell multiplies the no-tools cost by 2.35. Screenshots help most where mistakes are visible (e.g. element placement, interaction), though even there the gain over a shell is modest and does not survive correction for multiple statistical comparisons. In cases where failures can only be measured rather than seen, such as keeping scrolling smooth over a 100,000-row list, screenshots add nothing. A verification tool improves the output artifact only where its reach covers the way the application actually fails.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21961590
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受控实验表明，AI 编码 agent 的验证工具只有在其“覆盖范围”(verification surface) 命中应用真实失败方式时才提升产出质量：无工具时约七分之一的构建完全无法启动，单个 boot probe 以约为完整 shell 35% 的 token 成本消除其中几乎所有失败，而完整 shell 把无工具成本推高到 2.35 倍。截图只在肉眼可见的错误（元素排布、交互）上有小增益，且经多重比较校正后不成立；对只能测量的失败（如 10 万行列表滚动流畅度）毫无帮助。
Motivation: 给编码 agent 加验证工具被默认等同于产出变好，但工具清单是常被同时改动的众多变量之一，无法区分“工具更多”与“工具对症”哪个真正起作用。
Method: 构建一个最小编码 agent，把工具列表作为唯一受控变量，在 8 种工具配置 × 6 个模型上实现 1,116 个 web 应用；每个应用由对条件盲评的人按冻结评分表打分，并用自动探针压测 API 可观测行为。
Result: 无工具时约 1/7 的构建无法启动；单个 boot probe 消除其中几乎全部失败，成本约为完整 shell 的 35%；完整 shell 的 token 成本是无工具的 2.35 倍。截图在可见错误上增益最大但相对 shell 很小且经多重比较校正后不成立；在 100,000 行列表滚动流畅度这类只能测量的失败上，截图零增益。
Conclusion: 验证工具只在其覆盖范围与应用实际失败方式一致时才改善产出，因此按失败模式而非工具数量来配置 verification surface。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention at large token counts. We point out two common assumptions in contemporary training-free methods; attention sparsity, and context that can be leveraged, such as structure in the input or multiple similar forward passes, and show when they fail. Our proposed method utilizes a fast attention-aware recursive clustering method, and compensation of excluded clusters through their mean. The clustering method gives power-of-two cluster sizes, allowing block-sparse attention to match dense attention in GPU throughput. On TabPFN-3 arXiv:2605.13986, a model where none of the assumptions hold, ClusterAttention is to our knowledge the first method to provide a substantial speedup over the default attention, while consistently keeping over 99\% of its accuracy. On the largest dataset from the TALENT benchmark suite, it makes processing of the training dataset close to 8x faster at nearly 11x attention speedup. ClusterAttention is also competitive with domain-specific methods, while avoiding any of the domain-specific engineering. On video-generation with Wan 2.1-T2V-14B arXiv:2503.20314 it produces output closer to dense attention at a larger speedup (1.8x vs 1.4x) than SVOO arXiv:2603.18636, a leading method in this domain, with both evaluated without offline calibration.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, plus appendix. September update: Faster compensation kernel, fixed TabPFN-3 preprocessing and autocast scope (giving better accuracy and larger speedup), corrections in the error analysis and complexities, expanded comparison with similar work, revised the writing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ClusterAttention 是一种免训练的双向注意力加速方法：用注意力感知的递归聚类把 token 分成 2 的幂次大小的簇，被排除的簇用均值补偿，使块稀疏注意力达到与稠密注意力相当的 GPU 吞吐。在 TabPFN-3 上它是首个在该模型（两个常见假设均不成立）上取得实质加速且保持 99% 以上精度的方法；TALENT 最大数据集上训练集处理接近 8 倍加速、注意力约 11 倍加速；视频生成上以 1.8x 加速（对比 SVOO 的 1.4x）得到更接近稠密注意力的输出。
Motivation: 免训练注意力加速方法普遍依赖两个假设——注意力稀疏、以及可利用的输入结构或多次相似前向——而这些假设在部分模型上失效，导致现有方法拿不到加速。
Method: 采用注意力感知的递归聚类 (attention-aware recursive clustering) 将 token 划分为 2 的幂次大小的簇，配合对被排除簇的均值补偿 (compensation through their mean)；幂次簇大小使块稀疏注意力匹配稠密注意力的 GPU 吞吐。九月更新包含更快的补偿 kernel、TabPFN-3 预处理与 autocast 范围修正，以及误差分析与复杂度的更正。
Result: 在 TabPFN-3 (arXiv:2605.13986) 上保持默认注意力 99% 以上的精度并取得实质加速；在 TALENT benchmark suite 最大数据集上训练集处理接近 8x 加速、注意力约 11x 加速；在视频生成 Wan 2.1-T2V-14B 上以 1.8x 加速优于 SVOO (arXiv:2603.18636) 的 1.4x，且输出更接近稠密注意力，两者均在无离线校准下评测。
Conclusion: 不依赖注意力稀疏或可利用上下文这两个假设，也能在大 token 数下对双向注意力做免训练的实质加速并保住精度，同时与领域专用方法竞争而不做领域专用工程。

papers.title: Alignment Matters Inside and Out in Equivariant Graph Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Graphs are invariant under node permutations, motivating permutation-equivariant architectures in generative models. In flow matching, however, symmetry also affects the source-target coupling: one must choose both which graphs to pair and which node representatives to align. We study these two forms of alignment, termed outer and inner alignment, and their effect on equivariant graph flow matching. We connect inner alignment to transport on the graph quotient space, whose Euclidean quotient metric coincides with Gromov-Monge distance, and show that quotient couplings admit aligned representative lifts while symmetrization yields equivariant flow-matching minimizers, including for categorical endpoints. In practice, we compare random augmentation, permutation-blind minibatch optimal transport, approximate Gromov-Wasserstein alignment, and combinations of inner and outer alignment. Across continuous graph and molecular generation, alignment can substantially simplify trajectories and improve few-step generation, while its benefits depend on the alignment and computational budget. Our results highlight that effective graph flow matching benefits from alignment both inside and across graph pairs.
papers.comment: Gromov-Wasserstein, Optimal Transport, Flow Matching, Graph Generation, Equivariant Networks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图生成的 flow matching 中，源-目标耦合同时存在两种对齐：外对齐决定配对哪些图，内对齐决定节点代表如何对应。内对齐可对应到图商空间 (graph quotient space) 上的输运，其欧氏商度量恰为 Gromov-Monge 距离；商耦合存在对齐的代表提升，对称化后得到等变 flow-matching 极小元（含类别端点）。实验上对齐能显著简化轨迹并改善少步生成，但收益取决于对齐方式与计算预算。
Motivation: 图的节点置换不变性只约束了架构，未约束 flow matching 的源-目标耦合；随机配对与随机节点对应会引入不必要的弯曲轨迹，损害少步生成。
Method: 把对齐拆成 outer（配对哪些图）与 inner（节点代表对应）两类；将内对齐关联到图商空间输运，指出其欧氏商度量等于 Gromov-Monge 距离，并证明商耦合有对齐代表提升、对称化给出等变极小元（含 categorical 端点）。实践中比较 random augmentation、permutation-blind minibatch OT、近似 Gromov-Wasserstein 对齐及内外对齐的组合。
Result: 在连续图生成与分子生成上，对齐可显著简化生成轨迹并改善 few-step generation，且收益随对齐方式与计算预算变化；理论侧给出商耦合的对齐提升与对称化后等变极小元的存在性（含类别端点）。
Conclusion: 有效的图 flow matching 需要同时在图对之间（outer）与图对内部节点（inner）做对齐，但最优选择受计算预算制约。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires adapting to contact states that can evolve substantially within an action horizon. However, chunk-based vision-language-action models predict complete action chunks from observations collected before execution, leaving tactile conditioning stale during execution. Existing tactile-reactive approaches typically rely on separate high-frequency controllers, which increase both architectural and training complexity. In this paper, we introduce TacForcing, a streaming action-generation framework incorporating execution-time tactile feedback. TacForcing replaces the standard action expert with a streaming expert that generates action blocks sequentially while preserving intermediate states of unfinished blocks. After each block is executed, the expert resumes generation from these states using newly acquired tactile feedback. To better align tactile conditioning with action execution, we further introduce Execution-Aware Tactile Attention (EATA), which restricts direct access to each tactile update to the next block scheduled for execution. Across six UniVTAC simulation tasks and six real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks on two robot platforms, TacForcing achieves average success rates of 65% in simulation and 66% in the real world, outperforming the strongest baselines by 6 and 15 percentage points, respectively.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Revised text and expanded real-world experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TacForcing 把视觉-语言-动作模型的整块动作预测改成流式生成：streaming expert 逐块产出动作并保留未完成块的中间状态，每执行完一块就用新触觉反馈续生成，再用 Execution-Aware Tactile Attention (EATA) 把每次触觉更新限制只作用于下一块。在 6 个 UniVTAC 仿真任务与 6 个真实接触密集任务（两个机器人平台）上平均成功率分别为 65% 和 66%，比最强基线高 6 和 15 个百分点。
Motivation: 接触密集操作中接触状态会在一个动作块的执行期内大幅变化，而 chunk 式 VLA 只用执行前的观测预测整块动作，触觉条件在执行中变陈旧；现有触觉反应方案依赖独立高频控制器，抬高架构与训练复杂度。
Method: 用 streaming expert 替换标准 action expert，顺序生成动作块并保留未完成块的中间状态，每块执行后凭新触觉反馈从该状态续生成；EATA 限制每次触觉更新只被下一个待执行块直接访问，从而让触觉条件与动作执行对齐。
Result: 在 6 个 UniVTAC 仿真任务上平均成功率 65%，在两个机器人平台的 6 个真实接触密集任务上 66%，分别比最强基线高 6 和 15 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把触觉反馈推迟到执行时刻并按块续生成，比执行前一次性预测整块动作更能跟上接触状态变化，且无需独立高频控制器。

papers.title: Comparing Corrupted Constrained Learning Problems
papers.abstract_en: A key result in statistics is the data processing inequality, originally proved by Blackwell (1951) and later refined by DeGroot (1962) in terms of statistical uncertainty. The latter statement claims that the Bayes risk achieved on raw data always undercuts the Bayes risk on a processed version of the same data. This seemingly contradicts empirical findings in machine learning: pre-training, representation learning, feature learning, data augmentation are techniques used to improve performance of machine learning models. We reconcile both worlds by simply accepting that machine learning problems are constrained learning problems: the model class used does not include all measurable functions. We present counterexamples showing that the classical data processing inequality fails to hold in such a setting. Hence, we formulate a generalized data processing inequality, requiring the constrained Bayes risk of a joint distribution (with respect to a loss function and a constrained model class) to lower bound the constrained Bayes risk on the stochastically modified data distribution, regardless of the choice of distribution. We show this inequality to be equivalent to a set containment condition on a specific function set induced by the loss and model class, called the superprediction set. Finally, we exploit our characterization, derive sufficient conditions for this containment and quantify the inequality-gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出经典数据处理不等式（DeGroot 1962 版本：原始数据的 Bayes risk 总不高于其随机处理后数据）在机器学习的约束学习设定下失效，因为模型类并非所有可测函数。作者提出广义数据处理不等式：约束 Bayes risk 在联合分布上仍下界随机修改后数据分布的约束 Bayes risk，且该不等式等价于由损失与模型类诱导的 superprediction set 的集合包含条件，并给出该包含的充分条件与不等式差距的量化。
Motivation: 统计学的数据处理不等式声称处理数据只会抬高 Bayes risk，与预训练、表示学习、特征学习、数据增强等提升模型性能的经验事实表面矛盾；需要解释这一矛盾并给出在模型类受限时仍成立的替代结论。
Method: 把机器学习问题形式化为约束学习问题（模型类不含全部可测函数），构造经典数据处理不等式失效的反例；提出以约束 Bayes risk 表述的广义数据处理不等式，并证明其等价于损失与模型类诱导的 superprediction set 的集合包含条件，再推导该包含的充分条件并量化不等式差距。
Result: 给出经典数据处理不等式在约束模型类下失效的反例；证明广义数据处理不等式对任意分布成立当且仅当相应 superprediction set 满足集合包含条件；并推导该包含的充分条件与不等式差距的量化表达。
Conclusion: 数据处理不等式与表示学习、数据增强的收益并不真正冲突：只要把学习问题视为受模型类约束，Bayes risk 的下界关系可改写为 superprediction set 的包含条件并加以量化。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium Dynamics of Simple Exclusion Processes Across Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: The simple exclusion process (SEP) is a paradigmatic model for nonequilibrium transport, yet its rich dynamics over an exponentially large configuration space remain notoriously intractable. Here, we leverage variational autoregressive networks to characterize the nonequilibrium dynamics of the symmetric (SSEP), asymmetric (ASEP), and totally asymmetric (TASEP) cases in one to three dimensions at any time. We validate the approach against established finite-time 1D and long-time 2D results for the SSEP, and further provide new results on dynamical activity, density fields and nonequilibrium phase transitions for 2D and 3D cases. In 2D, we give a directional-density criterion connecting the bulk-density organization to the 1D TASEP phase diagram, and reveal how boundary and bulk rates separately control the activity and susceptibility. In 3D, we provide the first finite-time characterization of the SSEP active-inactive phase transition, and uncover scaling relations over time. Across dimensions, the critical field follows a trend $s_c\sim L^{-2}$, suggesting tuning strategies by the characteristic diffusive length scale. Overall, this work establishes a unified neural-network framework for characterizing nonequilibrium dynamics of representative transport systems.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Solving Robust POMDPs with Omega-regular Objectives via Partially Observable Stochastic Games
papers.abstract_en: Robust POMDPs (RPOMDPs) generalize classical POMDPs to the setting where exact transition probabilities are not known -- rather, they are only known to belong to some uncertainty set of values. In this work, we study the problem of solving RPOMDPs with general omega-regular objectives, which subsume a broad class of objectives such as reachability, safety, and linear temporal logic (LTL) objectives. We show that, for (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets, the problem of solving RPOMDPs under omega-regular objectives can be reduced to solving partially observable stochastic games (POSGs) under omega-regular objectives. Moreover, we show for the first time that reductions can be constructed in both directions, establishing the semantic equivalence between (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets and POSGs. This allows us to derive a range of new computational complexity results, including both upper and lower complexity bounds, on solving RPOMDPs with different omega-regular objectives. As a corollary, we also derive new computational complexity results for RMDPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 (s,a)-rectangular 且不确定集为多面体的鲁棒 POMDP (RPOMDP) 在 omega-regular 目标（可达性、安全性、LTL）下可归约为带同类目标的部分可观测随机博弈 (POSG)，且双向归约成立，二者语义等价。由此得到 RPOMDP 与 RMDP 求解复杂度的一批新上下界。
Motivation: 转移概率只知道落在某个不确定集内时，RPOMDP 在一般 omega-regular 目标下缺少与 POSG 的对应关系，复杂度上下界也未建立。
Method: 在 (s,a)-rectangular、多面体不确定集假设下构造 RPOMDP 到 POSG 的归约，并首次给出反向归约，确立二者语义等价；再由该等价推导不同 omega-regular 目标下 RPOMDP 求解的复杂度上下界。
Result: 建立双向归约与语义等价，得到 RPOMDP 在各类 omega-regular 目标下求解的新的上界与下界复杂度结果，并作为推论得到 RMDP 的新复杂度结果。
Conclusion: 在 (s,a)-rectangular 多面体不确定集下，RPOMDP 与 POSG 在 omega-regular 目标上是同一问题的两种表述，复杂度可互相转移。

papers.title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have become two widely adopted paradigms for post-training large language models. However, RLVR suffers from sparse task-level feedback, while OPD provides dense token-level guidance but ignores trajectory correctness, limiting its performance to that of the teacher. Combining them is a promising direction: OPD supplies dense supervisory signals, while RLVR provides task-level correctness. Nevertheless, existing integrations often rely on weighted combination or heuristic switching, introducing extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. We propose On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward (OPDVR), a simple yet effective method that seamlessly combines OPD and RLVR without adding any hyperparameters. We first reformulate the implicit reward of sampled-token OPD based on trajectory correctness, then apply a ReLU gating mechanism to ensure that correct trajectories receive non-negative rewards and incorrect ones receive non-positive rewards---thereby aligning the distillation signal with task success while preserving the teacher's distributional guidance. Furthermore, our modification transforms sampled-token OPD into a proper RLVR method, making it readily combinable with any policy gradient algorithm, such as GRPO. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that OPDVR consistently outperforms standard OPD. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPDVR 把 sampled-token on-policy distillation 的隐式奖励按轨迹正确性重写，再用 ReLU 门控保证正确轨迹奖励非负、错误轨迹非正，从而在不引入任何额外超参数的前提下把 OPD 与 RLVR 合成一个 proper RLVR 方法，可直接接 GRPO 等策略梯度算法。在六个推理 benchmark 上 OPDVR 一致优于标准 OPD。
Motivation: RLVR 只有稀疏的任务级反馈，OPD 有稠密的 token 级引导却忽略轨迹正确性、性能被教师上限锁死；现有拼接方式依赖加权组合或启发式切换，引入额外超参数与权衡。
Method: 先基于轨迹正确性重写 sampled-token OPD 的隐式奖励，再施加 ReLU 门控使正确轨迹得非负奖励、错误轨迹得非正奖励，保留教师分布引导的同时对齐任务成败；改造后的方法可与任意策略梯度算法（如 GRPO）组合，全程不加超参数。
Result: 在六个推理 benchmark 上，OPDVR 一致优于标准 OPD；方法被表述为可与任意 policy gradient 算法组合的 proper RLVR 方法，代码发布于 github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR。
Conclusion: 把 OPD 的隐式奖励按轨迹正确性门控化，就能在不引入加权系数或切换启发式的情况下同时拿到稠密 token 信号与任务级正确性，性能不再被教师分布锁死。
