papers.title: Unified-protocol voxel-level pulmonary embolism annotations for three public CT angiography datasets
papers.abstract_en: Reliable clot-volume quantification and subsequent risk assessment in pulmonary embolism depend on precise segmentation of emboli on computed tomography pulmonary angiography. Deep learning models for this task must be trained on accurate voxel-level labels. The three public datasets that provide such labels were annotated under different protocols, and some of their studies contain unlabeled emboli or labels that are discontinuous across slices. This Data Descriptor presents voxel-level pulmonary embolism annotations for 149 of the 166 studies in these datasets. A primary rater drew all annotations under a single protocol. A thoracic radiologist with more than 20 years of experience reviewed and revised them. Three raters at three different centers independently annotated a subset of 15 studies. The subset was selected by source dataset and embolus location. Technical validation quantifies volumetric agreement with the source annotations, changes in within-mask attenuation, and inter-rater agreement on the subset. The dataset is intended to allow segmentation models to be developed and compared under a common reference standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把三个公开 CTPA 数据集的肺栓塞体素级标注统一到单一标注协议下重做：主标注者按统一协议标注 166 例中的 149 例，由有 20 年以上经验的胸部放射科医师复核修订，并在按来源数据集与栓子位置选出的 15 例子集上做三中心独立标注。技术验证量化了与原始标注的体积一致性、掩膜内衰减变化及子集上的标注者间一致性，目标是让分割模型在同一参考标准下开发与比较。
Motivation: 肺栓塞的栓子体积量化与风险评估依赖精确的体素级分割，但三个公开数据集的标注协议不一致，部分研究存在未标注栓子或跨层不连续的标签，使模型训练与横向比较失去统一参照。
Method: 单一主标注者按统一协议对三个公开 CTPA 数据集的 166 例中的 149 例重新绘制体素级标注，胸部放射科医师（20 年以上经验）复核修订；另按来源数据集与栓子位置选出 15 例子集，由三个不同中心的三名标注者独立标注，用于技术验证。
Result: 产出 149/166 例研究的统一协议体素级肺栓塞标注；技术验证报告与原始标注的体积一致性、掩膜内衰减 (within-mask attenuation) 变化，以及 15 例子集上的标注者间一致性 (inter-rater agreement)。
Conclusion: 统一协议加资深医师复核与多中心子集复标，可为肺栓塞分割模型提供共同参考标准，用于开发与比较。

papers.title: Functional compatibility as a determinant of persistent neural learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks can acquire new capabilities while damaging existing ones, but what determines whether new learning persists remains unclear. We identify functional compatibility, the extent to which incoming learning can coexist with behaviour that must be preserved, as an experimentally manipulable causal determinant of persistence. From identical neural states, we vary compatibility while matching unrestricted learning opportunity and imposing a common retention requirement. Persistent learning increases with compatibility across independent directions, convolutional and transformer architectures, vision and text, and a ten-seed replication. Learning rules and retention constraints determine how much compatible opportunity is retained, whereas nonlinear geometry limits the matched intervention at larger update norms. Functional compatibility therefore reframes stability-plasticity from preventing forgetting to determining which new learning can coexist with existing function and persist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「功能兼容性」（functional compatibility，新学习与必须保留的既有行为能共存的程度）定义为可实验操纵的因果变量：在相同神经状态、相同无约束学习机会与相同保留要求下只改变兼容性，持续学习随兼容性升高而增加。结论是稳定性-塑性问题应从防止遗忘改写为判定哪些新学习能与既有功能共存并持续。
Motivation: 神经网络习得新能力时会损害既有能力，什么决定新学习能否持续尚不清楚；作者要把这一决定因素变成可操纵的因果变量而非描述性现象。
Method: 从相同神经状态出发做匹配干预：固定无约束学习机会并施加共同的保留要求，只改变兼容性；覆盖独立方向、卷积与 Transformer 架构、视觉与文本任务，并做十种子 (ten-seed) 复现。
Result: 持续学习随兼容性升高而增加，跨独立方向、卷积与 Transformer 架构、视觉与文本任务以及十种子复现均成立；学习规则与保留约束决定保留多少兼容机会，而非线性几何在更大更新范数 (update norm) 下限制匹配干预。
Conclusion: 功能兼容性是持续学习的因果决定因素，稳定性-塑性应重新表述为判定哪些新学习能与既有功能共存并持续，而非阻止遗忘。

papers.title: Dynamics-Aware Weighting for Deep Learning Forecasts of Chaotic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning surrogates have become powerful tools for simulating and forecasting complex dynamical systems, yet their utility remains limited by catastrophic error accumulation during long-term autoregressive rollouts. This behavior is partly tied to the nature of the underlying systems: chaotic spatiotemporal systems visit phase space unevenly, with dynamics dominated by recurrent, low-dimensional quiescent states and characterized by rare and dynamically complex regime transitions. Trained under a sample-wise uniform objective, standard neural surrogates allocate their finite capacity to the statistically more numerous low-dimensional quiescent states, systematically under-representing the transient regimes that trigger disproportionate, localized errors. Existing imbalanced-regression methods tackle this issue by reweighting samples according to target-space density. However, statistical target-space rarity does not coincide with the intrinsic dynamical rarity encoded in the recurrence geometry of the attractor. To address this, we introduce Dynamics-Aware Weighting (DAW), a data-centric objective reweighting framework. Using the local dimension $d$ from dynamical systems theory as an a priori measure of a state's dynamical complexity, DAW reshapes the loss landscape to allocate representational capacity toward the sparse, high-$d$ regimes where forecast errors are systematically large. On the chaotic KS equation, DAW consistently outperforms uniform training as well as weighting based on target-space rarity, and its randomly permuted ablation, reducing long-term autoregressive error relative to all baselines. Event-level analysis shows that DAW achieves this by suppressing the localized error amplifications incurred during sharp jumps in the local dimension $d$, which typically accompany complex physical processes such as wave-merging in the KS system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dynamics-Aware Weighting (DAW)，用动力系统理论中的局部维数 d 衡量状态的内在动力学稀有性并重塑损失，把有限表示容量分给稀疏的高 d 状态。在混沌 KS 方程上，DAW 一致优于均匀训练、基于目标空间稀有性的加权及其随机置换消融，降低长期自回归误差；事件级分析显示它抑制了局部维数 d 急剧跳变时的局部误差放大（如 KS 中的波合并）。
Motivation: 混沌时空系统长期自回归滚动中误差灾难性累积，因为样本均匀目标让神经代理把容量花在数量占优的低维静息态上，系统性低估触发局部大误差的稀有过渡态；而现有不平衡回归按目标空间密度加权，统计稀有与吸引子递归几何编码的内在动力学稀有并不重合。
Method: DAW 是数据侧的目标重加权框架：先以动力系统理论的局部维数 d 作为状态动力学复杂度的先验度量，再据此重塑损失景观，把表示容量导向稀疏的高 d 区域；对照包括均匀训练、基于目标空间稀有性的加权以及随机置换的加权消融。

papers.title: Rethinking Patch Based Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Semantic Structured Partitioning
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is a fundamental task in many real world applications. Existing patch based forecasting methods generally fall into three categories: fixed partitioning, multi-scale partitioning, and extendable partitioning. Fixed partitioning often breaks meaningful temporal boundaries, multi-scale partitioning may introduce redundant representations across scales, and extendable partitioning improves flexibility but still lacks an explicit mechanism for organizing semantic structure and modeling interactions among heterogeneous temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose SCPaT, a Transformer based framework built on semantic structured partitioning. SCPaT first decomposes input sequences into semantically consistent units through adaptive semantic unit generation, then constructs a dynamic semantic graph to model directed dependencies among these units and organize them into higher order semantic blocks. Based on these structured representations, an importance aware routing mechanism adaptively dispatches different semantic blocks to different experts for customized modeling. Extensive experiments on 12 real world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SCPaT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SCPaT：把多变量时间序列切成语义一致的单元，用动态语义图建模单元间有向依赖并组织成高阶语义块，再由重要性感知路由把不同块分派给不同专家建模。在 12 个真实数据集上验证了该框架的有效性。
Motivation: 现有 patch 类预测方法中固定划分常切断有意义的时间边界，多尺度划分带来跨尺度冗余表示，可扩展划分虽更灵活却缺少显式组织语义结构与建模异质时间模式交互的机制。
Method: SCPaT 是基于 Transformer 的框架：先用自适应语义单元生成 (adaptive semantic unit generation) 把输入序列分解为语义一致的单元，再构建动态语义图刻画单元间有向依赖并聚合成高阶语义块，最后用重要性感知路由 (importance aware routing) 将语义块自适应分派给不同专家做定制化建模。
Result: 在 12 个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明 SCPaT 有效。
Conclusion: 以语义结构化划分取代固定、多尺度或可扩展划分，配合图建模与专家路由，是多变量时间序列预测的一条可行路径。

papers.title: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning has advanced multimodal reasoning through a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a helper image is encoded into latent tokens to teach visual chain-of-thought during a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, and (2) these latent tokens are further refined with reward feedback during a reinforcement learning (RL) stage. In this paper, we identify two key limitations of this framework, one in each stage. First, the SFT stage typically relies on an off-the-shelf vision encoder to encode the helper image, yielding suboptimal latent representations that may not be well aligned with the downstream reasoning task. Second, existing RL methods treat the latent component only through deterministic regularization, which constrains policy drift but does not create alternative latent trajectories for exploration. To address these limitations, we propose Scaffolding Minds. Our approach learns a dedicated scaffolding encoder that provides an optimized target in latent space, and learns both the mean and variance of the RL sampler. We further show that these two improvements are complementary, together yielding substantial gains over strong baselines. Empirically, our method improves over the strongest latent reasoning baseline by +9.5 points on FrozenLake spatial planning, with the gain widening to +19 points on the 32x32 grids, and by +5.6 points on average across nine visual-centric reasoning benchmarks.

TL;DR: 针对多模态隐空间推理 (latent reasoning) 的两阶段训练，提出 Scaffolding Minds：训练专用 scaffolding encoder 在隐空间给出优化后的目标表示，并让 RL 采样器同时学习均值与方差。两项改进互补，在九个视觉推理基准上平均比最强隐空间推理基线高 +5.6 分，FrozenLake 空间规划高 +9.5 分，32x32 网格上差距扩大到 +19 分。
Motivation: 现有两阶段隐空间推理框架中，SFT 阶段用现成视觉编码器编码 helper image，得到的隐表示与下游推理任务不对齐；RL 阶段只用确定性正则约束隐变量，限制了策略漂移却不产生可供探索的替代隐轨迹。
Method: Scaffolding Minds 学习一个专用 scaffolding encoder，在隐空间提供优化后的目标表示（替代现成视觉编码器的输出）；同时让 RL 采样器学习隐变量的均值与方差，而非仅做确定性正则，从而产生探索用的替代隐轨迹。
Result: 相对最强隐空间推理基线：FrozenLake 空间规划 +9.5 分，32x32 网格上增益扩大到 +19 分，九个以视觉为主的推理基准平均 +5.6 分。
Conclusion: 隐空间目标表示的优化与带方差的 RL 采样是互补的，联合改进可在强基线上带来实质性提升。

papers.title: The Road Taken: The Role of Optimizers at the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: The edge of stability refers to a phenomenon in deep learning with gradient-based optimizers where the Hessian eigenvalues of the loss remain stable above a threshold that the classical descent lemma predicts to be unstable. Previous works formulate the edge of stability with respect to the maximum Hessian eigenvalue and the learning rate. However, we observe that many first-order methods, including gradient descent, significantly violate the stability bound predicted by these theories by a factor as large as $\times 21.1$. Moreover, this deviation turns out to be systematic and highly dependent on the underlying optimizer, which is not captured by previous formulations. This calls for a new formulation of the stability threshold, which we derive from the directional Hessian and the gradient-alignment score with respect to the actual update taken by the optimizer, rather than the maximum curvature mode. Our new formulation of the realized edge of stability not only removes optimizer-dependent offsets and provides more consistent predictions of the stability threshold, but also introduces new diagnostic tools that reveal the unique role of the optimizer in actively balancing between the temporal and spatial budgets in first-order optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 深度学习中 edge of stability 的经典判据用最大 Hessian 特征值与学习率预测失稳阈值，但梯度下降等一阶方法实际违反该界最多达 21.1 倍，且偏差随优化器系统性变化。作者改用实际更新方向上的 directional Hessian 与 gradient-alignment score 推导 realized edge of stability，消除优化器相关偏移并给出更一致的阈值预测。
Motivation: 以最大 Hessian 特征值和学习率表述的稳定性理论无法解释一阶方法中系统性、且依赖具体优化器的越界偏差，最大曲率模式与实际更新方向不一致。
Method: 从 directional Hessian 和相对于优化器实际更新的 gradient-alignment score 出发，重新推导稳定性阈值，取代基于最大曲率模式的表述；并据此构造诊断工具分析一阶优化中时间与空间预算的平衡。
Result: 观测到梯度下降等一阶方法对既有理论预测的稳定性界违反幅度最高达 21.1 倍，且该偏差是系统性的、强烈依赖底层优化器；新表述消除优化器相关偏移并给出更一致的阈值预测。
Conclusion: 稳定性阈值应由实际更新方向而非最大曲率模式定义，优化器在时间与空间预算之间起主动平衡作用，既有 edge of stability 公式需按优化器重写。

papers.title: From Answers to Policies: Efficient In-Context Learning System through Emulating Expert Investigation
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained large language models offer a practical foundation for learning useful behavior from few task-specific examples. We argue that current prompt and context optimization methods underuse the extensive knowledge and reasoning capabilities of trillion-parameter models. These capabilities can make adaptation more sample-efficient, more compute efficient and at no performance loss when organized around how human experts investigate failures. We formalize Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF), which makes this implicit procedure explicit for LLM agents to execute, and build its automated implementation, PIHF-MCP. Initialized from clinician feedback on rare-disease diagnosis, PIHF-MCP supplies the expert procedure, testing tools, review and persistent inquiry records to develop reusable task policies. Across general reasoning benchmarks (BIG-Bench Extra Hard, HoVer and LiveBench-Math), PIHF-MCP improved performance of the baseline model by 16.9, 22.2 and 4.7 percentage points, respectively. With a matched baseline model, development used about 1/5 of the labelled examples and 4% of the task rollouts reported by a previous SOTA in-context optimizer, making it about 9 times faster and 3 times cheaper at comparable or higher scores. In a low-data rare-disease diagnosis setting, policies developed from previous SOTA prompt optimizers trailed a previously published PIHF-developed system on every held-out cohort (on average 16 percentage points). These findings support a route to more efficient inference-time scaling: PIHF-MCP develops reusable policies from a few examples that improve performance on unseen cases and across models. Because each policy comes from an explicit, recorded investigation, the process also keeps humans in the loop and enables ownership and learning, making it well suited to high-stakes decisions.

papers.title: RAISE: Diagnosing Acquisition Collapse in Costly LLM Signals
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as costly, on-demand components in real systems, but calling them indiscriminately can waste substantial compute, latency, and serving budget. The key deployment question is therefore not only whether an LLM helps on average, but when it is worth calling. We identify a common failure mode, which we call acquisition collapse: an LLM signal can appear useful in aggregate or post hoc, yet still provide too little before-call information to support reliable selective use. We introduce RAISE (Reward-SNR Actionability in Signal Evaluation), a pre-routing diagnostic framework for testing whether available evidence supports selective use before committing to a routing strategy. We instantiate RAISE with Structured Hypothesis Embeddings (SHE), a frozen-LLM intent signal for recommendation using one LLM call per user, and evaluate it through controlled, retrospective, and fresh-cohort studies and a prospective offline pilot whose audit decisions are frozen before independent outcomes are revealed. Across these settings, predictable incremental benefit, not average lift alone, distinguishes settings with recoverable selective value; deployment additionally depends on cost and operational constraints. Seemingly strong oracle or subgroup gains can disappear under independent evaluation. More broadly, RAISE reframes costly inference as an information-acquisition problem: before paying for an expensive model, tool, sensor, or measurement, first test whether its value is predictable at decision time. This principle motivates cost-aware acquisition in settings ranging from agent tool use and stronger-model consultation to robotic sensing and clinical decision pipelines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAISE 提出 acquisition collapse 概念：LLM 信号在总体或事后看似有用，但其 call 前信息量不足以支撑可靠的按需调用。它用 Reward-SNR Actionability 框架在路由策略之前先检验证据是否支持选择性调用，实例为每次用户仅一次 LLM 调用的 Structured Hypothesis Embeddings (SHE)。受控、回顾性、fresh-cohort 与前瞻性离线试点一致表明，可预测的增量收益（而非平均提升）才区分出可回收的选择性价值，看似强的 oracle 或子群增益在独立评估下会消失。
Motivation: LLM 作为按需昂贵组件被无差别调用会浪费算力、延迟与服务预算；平均提升无法回答“何时值得调用”，信号可能在总体上有用却在 call 前缺乏足够信息。
Method: 提出 RAISE（Reward-SNR Actionability in Signal Evaluation）作为路由前诊断框架，用 Structured Hypothesis Embeddings (SHE) 这一冻结 LLM 的意图信号做推荐，每次用户一次 LLM 调用；通过受控研究、回顾性研究、fresh-cohort 研究与前瞻性离线试点评估，试点中审计决策在独立结果揭晓前冻结。
Result: 各设置下区分可回收选择性价值的是可预测的增量收益而非平均提升；看似强的 oracle 或子群增益在独立评估下会消失；部署还取决于成本与运营约束。
Conclusion: 把昂贵推理重构为信息获取问题：在为模型、工具、传感器或测量付费之前，先检验其价值在决策时点是否可预测；该原则适用于 agent 工具使用、强模型咨询、机器人传感与临床决策流程。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored. Existing approaches tie supervision to task-internal anchors such as preferences or normalized progress, none of which transfer cleanly across embodiments and data sources. We introduce RynnValue, an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces these anchors with temporal distance, the directed cost-to-go from an observation to the language-specified goal. Because temporal-distance labels can be derived directly from timestamps, RynnValue scales to over 7,000 hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips without preference or progress annotations. To make temporal-value learning reliable at scale, we combine random temporal sampling, temporal-order shuffling, and value-isolation attention, suppressing shortcuts that would leave predictions insensitive to failures and regressions. Trained without preference labels, RynnValue attains an average Kendall's $τ_a$ of 0.704 on RBM-EVAL-OOD, surpassing the fully preference-supervised state of the art (0.655) and more than doubling a progress-only counterpart (0.292), while generalizing zero-shot to unseen tasks, embodiments, and viewpoints. As a zero-shot reward model, RynnValue serves a range of downstream applications. Converted into dense rewards via potential-based shaping, it raises real-world policy success from 52.5% to 72.5% online and from 63.8% to 82.5% offline; used for data filtering, it improves multi-task behavior cloning success from 35.0% to 42.5%; and applied as inference-time value guidance, it lifts a frozen policy's success from 67.5% to 80.0%. These results establish temporal distance as a scalable supervision target and practical reward interface for generalist robot policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RynnValue 是面向机器人操作的开源价值基础模型，用「时间距离」（从观测到语言指定目标的有向 cost-to-go）替代偏好或归一化进度作为监督，标签直接由时间戳导出，因此扩到 7,000+ 小时、约 3M 条指令条件片段。在 RBM-EVAL-OOD 上平均 Kendall's τa 达 0.704，超过全偏好监督 SOTA 的 0.655，并把仅进度监督的 0.292 翻倍以上；作为零样本奖励模型，经 potential-based shaping 后真实策略成功率在线 52.5%→72.5%、离线 63.8%→82.5%。
Motivation: 通用奖励模型正成为机器人学习扩展的瓶颈，而现有监督锚点（偏好、归一化进度）绑定任务内部，无法跨本体与数据源干净迁移。
Method: 以时间距离作为价值监督目标，标签由时间戳直接生成，无需偏好或进度标注；训练时结合随机时间采样、时序打乱与 value-isolation attention，抑制对失败与回退不敏感的捷径。
Result: RBM-EVAL-OOD 平均 Kendall's τa 0.704，对比全偏好监督 SOTA 0.655 与仅进度版本 0.292；零样本泛化到未见任务、本体与视角。作为奖励经 potential-based shaping 使真实策略成功率在线 52.5%→72.5%、离线 63.8%→82.5%；数据过滤使多任务行为克隆成功率 35.0%→42.5%；推理时价值引导使冻结策略 67.5%→80.0%。
Conclusion: 时间距离可作为可扩展的监督目标与实用奖励接口，支撑通用机器人策略在无偏好标注条件下学习价值能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories, complementing reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. Its self-teacher, derived from the student's current or exponentially averaged parameters and conditioned on additional context, evolves alongside the student and its rollout context distribution. The benefit of modifying this moving target depends on how target--student probability mismatches translate into updates. We propose \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}, which constructs a normalized geometric target from the self-teacher and a frozen initial policy, then minimizes the forward Rényi divergence from this target to the student. The interpolation coefficient controls the self-teacher's contribution, while the Rényi order controls the power weighting of target-to-student probability ratios in the gradient. For fixed contexts and target components, we establish a conditional variational characterization and derive the exact token-logit gradient, revealing how anchoring and projection jointly shape the effective update target. Experiments across scientific reasoning, tool use, mathematical reasoning, and code generation demonstrate strong performance across multiple model families and scales. Ablations further show that reference anchoring can improve or degrade performance depending on the projection objective, supporting the joint design of target construction and projection geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SR-OPSD 把自蒸馏的移动自教师与冻结初始策略做归一化几何插值，再最小化到该目标的前向 Rényi 散度：插值系数控制自教师贡献，Rényi 阶数控制目标/学生概率比在梯度中的幂加权。在科学推理、工具使用、数学推理与代码生成上跨多个模型家族与规模表现强劲，消融显示参考锚定会随投影目标不同而提升或降低性能。
Motivation: on-policy 自蒸馏的自教师是随学生与 rollout 上下文分布漂移的移动目标，其收益取决于目标-学生概率失配如何转化为更新，而目标构造与投影几何此前缺少联合设计依据。
Method: 构造自教师与冻结初始策略的归一化几何目标，最小化从该目标到学生的前向 Rényi 散度；在固定上下文与目标分量下给出条件变分刻画并推导精确 token-logit 梯度，说明锚定与投影如何共同塑造有效更新目标。
Result: 在科学推理、工具使用、数学推理、代码生成四类任务上，跨多个模型家族与规模均表现强劲；消融显示参考锚定可提升也可降低性能，取决于所用投影目标。
Conclusion: 目标构造（锚定）与投影几何必须联合设计，单独改动任一侧都可能反向影响性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: In autonomous driving, World-Action Models (WAMs) have improved end-to-end planning by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but many still couple planning with future-video generation at inference, incurring substantial computational overhead. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that leverages future-video prediction solely as a training-time supervision signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing trajectory prediction without future-frame generation at inference. This design supports multiple pretrained video backbones and independent action-expert scaling within a shared attention interface, while preserving the joint learning objective. Moreover, we apply reinforcement learning to optimize a compositional driving reward beyond trajectory imitation. Experiments show that SimWAM achieves $91.9$ PDMS on NAVSIM with a favorable trade-off between accuracy and latency among world-model-based planners, while transferring zero-shot to nuScenes. It also achieves competitive planning accuracy on WOD-E2E and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles. These results position SimWAM as a plain yet solid baseline for efficient autonomous driving. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/.
papers.comment: The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimWAM 把未来视频预测降级为纯训练期监督信号，用联合 flow matching 共训预训练视频专家与轻量动作专家，并用隔离注意力掩码让动作预测不依赖未来帧，推理时无需生成未来帧。在 NAVSIM 上取得 91.9 PDMS，在世界模型类规划器中取得精度与延迟的良好折中，并零样本迁移到 nuScenes。
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型 (WAM) 在推理阶段仍把规划与未来视频生成耦合，带来可观的计算开销，制约端到端自动驾驶的部署效率。
Method: 以联合 flow matching 共训预训练视频专家与轻量动作专家，未来视频预测仅作训练期监督；隔离注意力掩码 (isolated attention mask) 使动作预测与未来帧解耦，支持多种视频骨干与动作专家独立扩展；再用强化学习优化超越轨迹模仿的组合式驾驶奖励 (compositional driving reward)。
Result: NAVSIM 上 91.9 PDMS，在基于世界模型的规划器中呈现精度与延迟的良好折中；零样本迁移到 nuScenes；在 WOD-E2E 与 PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles 上取得有竞争力的规划精度。
Conclusion: 把视频生成完全移出推理路径、只留作训练监督，即可在保留世界模型先验的同时得到高效且有竞争力的端到端驾驶规划基线。

papers.title: Active-SWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Proactive Bug Fixing without Issue Reports
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in software engineering (SWE) scenarios, capable of fixing a specific bug in large-scale codebase. However, existing SWE benchmarks typically assume that high-quality issue reports with detailed information are always available, which is easily violated in practice due to the complexity of report acquisition and curation. To address this, we introduce Active-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on proactively discovering and fixing multiple bugs without report guidance, covering 1,663 tasks across six bug categories and eight languages. Beyond shifting the focus from existing reactive bug fixing to proactive bug fixing, Active-SWE enables a more in-depth evaluation by expanding the scope from fixing a specific recorded bug to multiple-bug fixing and potential bug discovery scenarios. To construct Active-SWE, we propose a novel difficulty-aware task formulation pipeline with a dual-track evaluation framework, facilitating comprehensive evaluation of proactive bug-fixing capability. Extensive experiments reveal that most state-of-the-art coding agents struggle with proactive bug-fixing tasks, demonstrating limited performance in locating and resolving recorded bugs, handling multiple bug fixing scenarios, and discovering valid potential bugs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Active-SWE 是一个评测 coding agent 主动修 bug 能力的基准：不提供 issue report，要求 agent 自主发现并修复多个 bug，覆盖 1,663 个任务、六个 bug 类别、八种编程语言。实验显示多数 SOTA coding agent 在定位已记录 bug、处理多 bug 场景和发现潜在 bug 上表现都很有限。
Motivation: 现有 SWE 基准都假设高质量 issue report 始终可得，但实际中报告的获取与整理成本高、条件常被破坏，coding agent 的主动发现问题的能力因此无从评测。
Method: 提出难度感知的任务构建流水线 (difficulty-aware task formulation pipeline) 与双轨评测框架 (dual-track evaluation framework)，把评测范围从修复单个已记录 bug 扩展到多 bug 修复与潜在 bug 发现两类场景。
Result: 基准含 1,663 个任务、六个 bug 类别、八种语言；实验显示多数 SOTA coding agent 在定位与修复已记录 bug、多 bug 修复、发现有效潜在 bug 三方面均表现有限。
Conclusion: 主动修 bug（无 report 引导）是与反应式修 bug 显著不同的能力短板，现有 coding agent 尚未胜任。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decode-Branch Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
papers.abstract_en: As large language models serve ever more requests, cumulative inference cost is growing relative to the one-time cost of training. In typical serving, prompt prefill runs in parallel and is compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and memory-traffic-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling raises both costs together, since every added layer is evaluated in both phases and enlarges the weights read at each decode step. We instead ask whether additional learned computation can be allocated to continuation prediction while preserving prompt-wide primary computation and a single KV cache. We realize this with the Decode-Branch Transformer. Its primary path alone processes the prompt and writes the KV cache; the decode branch is omitted during prefill and activated only from the final prompt position onward, adding continuation computation without writing state or affecting the primary path. The paths share attention, MLP, and output matrices, using separate token embeddings with lightweight coupling. Grouped decode reuses loaded weight tiles and the primary KV cache across both paths, so the added arithmetic does not proportionally increase dominant memory traffic or decode latency. Across matched-token comparisons, Decode-Branch achieves lower validation loss across architectures and data settings. In MoE models, the primary and branch expert fan-outs become independent knobs for trading prompt cost, decode cost, and predictive quality. We study two expert-allocation regimes, holding prefill or decode computation fixed, and expose a prefill-decode-quality trade-off enabled by phase-specific expert allocation.

papers.title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability. The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/VISR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 在提升当前目标的同时会把后续目标的成功轨迹变得在固定 rollout 预算内几乎采不到，作者称之为 verifier-induced support reshaping。IFEval 上 Qwen3-8B-Base 经 Math-RLVR 后 pass@1 升 6.5 个百分点而 best@32 降 9.8 个百分点；变化集中在响应开头几个 token，参考策略约束、路由先验与 on-policy 蒸馏只能部分保住跨任务 support。
Motivation: on-policy RLVR 只优化当前 verifier，可能悄悄压缩其他任务的成功轨迹可达性，使端点指标改善的模型在后续训练或联合能力上不可训练。
Method: 在两个模型族上对数学推理与受限指令跟随做重复 verifier 采样与双向训练（Math-RLVR 与 IF-RLVR），并加入带相反 verifier 的顺序训练；用 token 分布分析与受控开头干预定位机制，测试参考策略约束、路由先验与 on-policy distillation 对跨任务 support 的保持。
Result: IFEval + Qwen3-8B-Base：Math-RLVR 使 pass@1 提升 6.5 个百分点，best@32 下降 9.8 个百分点，且该背离在两个模型与多个 IF 基准上复现；反向 IF-RLVR 把数学响应从分步开头推向直接作答，降低各采样预算下的 best@k，并减少后续 Math-RLVR 的 reward 方差；MathIF 与 ReasonIF 显示边际增益只有部分转化为既正确又守约束的响应。
Conclusion: RLVR 主要重排基策略已有的开头分布，而开头选择因果地影响数学搜索性，因此端点指标改善不保证 on-policy 优化下的未来可训练性或联合能力。

papers.title: C-Instrument: Automating RL Data Generation and Hillclimbing with a Constitution-Grid Instrument
papers.abstract_en: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard. Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Instrument, a constitution-grid data instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C-Instrument 用 constitution-grid 自动生成安全守卫 RL 训练数据，并以逐格可学习性分数 C-LIM 决定每格动作（prune/densify/amend/expand），在训练预算花掉前标出无效数据区。over-refusal 从 22.4% 降到 12.8%，同时 adversarial attack 上的 under-refusal 从 0.27 悄悄恶化到 0.33；187 行 untargeted 数据零收益，该区域 learning impact 由 0.733 提到 0.80。
Motivation: RL 对齐中目标冲突普遍且数据效率低：安全守卫要同时抓住真实危害与不拒绝良性 prompt，两个目标互相拉扯，坏数据往往在训练预算耗尽后才暴露。
Method: C-Instrument 是 constitution-grid 数据工具，负责生成 RL 训练数据；C-LIM 给每个 cell 打可学习性分数，并据此选择该格的移动方式：prune、densify、amend 或 expand，在训练前定位 dead-weight 数据区。
Result: over-refusal 改善 22.4% → 12.8%；under-refusal 在 adversarial attacks 上由 0.27 恶化到 0.33；187 行 untargeted 数据带来零收益，该区域 learning impact 从 0.733 提升到 0.80。
Conclusion: 用逐格可学习性分数在训练前筛数据，可以在压低 over-refusal 的同时暴露 under-refusal 的隐性代价；代码与 constitution 已开源。

papers.title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
papers.abstract_en: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAC-MAN 把控制屏障函数 (CBF) 安全约束与部署可行的机载感知耦合进强化学习，让人形机器人只用头部分割深度就完成全身躲避球。固定机载相机已足够，Link-CBF 策略零样本 (zero-shot) 上 Unitree G1 实机，95% 投掷成功并能用语义分割躲避不同球。
Motivation: 人形全身安全策略常依赖特权状态或完美球状态估计，而真实部署只有机载相机，感知可观测性不足会让 CBF 结构失效。
Method: 训练时用 CBF 对每个身体连杆的间隙提供安全引导，配合对抗性动作先验 (adversarial motion prior) 约束躲避反射；策略输入为头戴相机的分割掩码深度。评测用受控 any-link 接触基准，含固定投掷与机器人走回站位并恢复的部署循环两种体制。
Result: 在该基准上策略接近特权状态 oracle（差距仅几个百分点）；Joint-CBF 在准确球状态下表现最佳，仅作训练引导时在固定相机观测下退化，加球追踪云台或特权运行时滤波后恢复；Link-CBF 策略零样本部署到 Unitree G1 实机，95% 投掷成功。
Conclusion: 可用的屏障结构取决于感知可观测性：固定机载相机足以支撑躲避，但 CBF 形式需与感知能力匹配，轻量 Link-CBF 能容忍不完美感知并直接实机部署。

papers.title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The fundamental goal of agentic visual reasoning is to improve the success rate of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex tasks. We rethink agentic visual reasoning through two key dimensions of tool use: Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect. Mode Adaptiveness characterizes whether an MLLM recognizes when tools are necessary and invokes them accordingly, avoiding unnecessary computational overhead while improving performance on problems requiring tool assistance. Tool Effect characterizes whether tools extend the model's capabilities on problems unsolvable through tool-free reasoning without introducing errors on problems it can already solve. Our analysis quantifies these properties and reveals that existing models exhibit limited Mode Adaptiveness, while tool-use gains on hard examples are largely offset by harm on easy ones. Motivated by these observations, we propose Beacon, a novel agentic visual reasoning model trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). Its RL stage combines Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward and Hint-Guided Capability Expansion. Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward encourages tool-free solutions when they succeed while preserving full reward for successful tool use when tool-free rollouts fail. Hint-Guided Capability Expansion uses verified, answer-free expert hints to recover learning signals from all-wrong rollout groups, aiming to extend tool-use capability on the hardest problems. Across 13 benchmarks, Beacon achieves the highest average score among the evaluated open-source models and ranks first on 11 benchmarks. On five diagnostic benchmarks, it improves the average tool-available accuracy over its tool-free accuracy by 1.96 points and achieves the largest tool-gain minus tool-harm score (+3.14 points). These results show Beacon's advanced performance, Mode Adaptiveness, and the net benefit of tool use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Beacon 是一个 agentic visual reasoning 模型，用 SFT 加 RL 训练，让 MLLM 判断何时调用工具：RL 阶段的 Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward 在免工具 rollout 成功时鼓励免工具解法、失败时保留工具使用的全额奖励，Hint-Guided Capability Expansion 用已验证且不含答案的专家 hint 从全错 rollout 组里恢复学习信号。在 13 个 benchmark 上取得被评估开源模型的最高平均分并在 11 个上排名第一；五个诊断 benchmark 上工具可用准确率比免工具准确率高 1.96 点，tool-gain 减 tool-harm 得分 +3.14 点。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 的 Mode Adaptiveness 不足：该调工具时不调，且工具在难题上的收益很大程度被简单题上的损害抵消，导致工具使用的净收益为负或接近零。
Method: 提出 Beacon，先用监督微调 (SFT) 再用强化学习 (RL) 训练。RL 阶段包含两个组件：Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward，免工具 rollout 成功时鼓励免工具解法、失败时对成功的工具使用保留全额奖励；Hint-Guided Capability Expansion，用已验证的、answer-free 的专家 hint 在全错 rollout 组中恢复学习信号，以扩展最难问题上的工具使用能力。
Result: 在 13 个 benchmark 上 Beacon 取得被评估开源模型中的最高平均分，并在其中 11 个 benchmark 上排名第一。在五个诊断 benchmark 上，工具可用准确率比免工具准确率平均提高 1.96 点，tool-gain minus tool-harm 得分为 +3.14 点，为所评估中最大。
Conclusion: 把工具必要性判断直接写进奖励结构，可以让 MLLM 在需要工具的难题上获得工具收益、同时不在已能免工具解决的简单题上引入损害，从而得到净正的工具使用收益。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 Beacon，先用监督微调 (SFT) 再用强化学习 (RL) 训练。RL 阶段包含两个组件：Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward，免工具 rollout 成功时鼓励免工具解法、失败时对成功的工具使用保留全额奖励；Hint-Guided Capability Expansion，用已验证的、answer-free 的专家 hint 在全错 rollout 组中恢复学习信号，以扩展最难问题上的工具使用能力。
summary_sections.result: 在 13 个 benchmark 上 Beacon 取得被评估开源模型中的最高平均分，并在其中 11 个 benchmark 上排名第一。在五个诊断 benchmark 上，工具可用准确率比免工具准确率平均提高 1.96 点，tool-gain minus tool-harm 得分为 +3.14 点，为所评估中最大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把工具必要性判断直接写进奖励结构，可以让 MLLM 在需要工具的难题上获得工具收益、同时不在已能免工具解决的简单题上引入损害，从而得到净正的工具使用收益。

papers.title: ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something different: reasoning over noisy metrics, logs, traces, and source code, starting from ambiguous user-facing reports, often hours after the incident began. We introduce ORCA-bench, a benchmark that puts general-purpose coding agents in a production-fidelity oncall setting. ORCA-bench pairs 1,079 RCA tasks with six days of metrics, logs, and traces collected from an OpenTelemetry-instrumented microservice system under continuous simulated user load. Agents investigate this recorded history through real observability interfaces---Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana---with full access to application source code. Tasks systematically vary report specificity, time-to-detection, and co-occurring fault scenarios. Ground-truth symptoms are curated and signed off by expert SREs, and our LLM-as-judge is independently re-scored by humans (Cohen's $κ_w = 0.91$). Across five frontier agents, the best RCA Accuracy is 25.3% on Medium-difficulty tasks (the realistic-input setting) and 10.0% on Hard---a gap that remains even with Claude Fable 5. The weakest model hallucinates an implausible root cause in 40% of incident reports, and removing source-code access reduces RCA accuracy and increases the hallucination rate for every evaluated model. These results come from a curated 50 GB / six-day testbed of standalone tasks on a system whose code and instrumentation are public. Since real production systems are orders of magnitude larger, more dynamic, and more idiosyncratic, the gap we report underscores the engineering work still needed before agents can be entrusted with production reliability. We release the public set at https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/orca-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORCA-bench 把通用 coding agent 放进生产保真度的 oncall 根因分析 (RCA) 场景：1,079 个 RCA 任务配六天 OpenTelemetry 微服务系统的 metrics/logs/traces，agent 通过 Prometheus、Jaeger、OpenSearch (Grafana) 真实可观测性接口调查并可读源码。五个前沿 agent 中最好的 RCA Accuracy 在 Medium（现实输入设定）仅 25.3%、Hard 仅 10.0%，最弱模型在 40% 的事故报告中编造不成立的根因，去掉源码访问会让所有被测模型精度下降且幻觉上升。
Motivation: LLM 能写码补丁，但 oncall RCA 要从模糊的用户报告出发，在事发数小时后对嘈杂的 metrics、logs、traces 和源码做推理；现有评测缺少生产保真度的该场景基准。
Method: 构建 ORCA-bench：1,079 个 RCA 任务与六天持续模拟用户负载下 OpenTelemetry 插桩微服务系统的观测历史配对，agent 经 Prometheus、Jaeger、OpenSearch (Grafana) 接口调查并可访问源码；任务系统性变化报告具体度、time-to-detection 与并发故障组合，ground truth 由专家 SRE 审定，LLM-as-judge 经人工独立复评。
Result: 五个前沿 agent 中最佳 RCA Accuracy 为 Medium 难度 25.3%、Hard 10.0%，Claude Fable 5 也未消除该差距；最弱模型在 40% 的事故报告中幻觉出不成立的根因；对每个被测模型，移除源码访问都降低 RCA Accuracy 并提高幻觉率；judge 与人工复评一致性 Cohen's κ_w = 0.91；测试床为 50 GB / 六天的独立任务集。
Conclusion: 在 50 GB、六天、代码与插桩公开的测试床上，agent 的生产级可靠性仍远不够，真实生产系统更大更动态，把可靠性托付给 agent 前还有大量工程工作要做。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FaithEyes: Towards Faithful Tool Use via Multi-Agent Process-Image Self-Verification
papers.abstract_en: Agentic vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave textual reasoning with explicit tool calls such as cropping and code-based image manipulation, have emerged as a compelling paradigm for reliable and interpretable multi-modal reasoning. However, recent studies have revealed that such models often use tools unfaithfully. Many process images are irrelevant to the question (e.g., the crops miss the queried target), yet the tool call still receives full credit and the model still answers correctly. Such decorative or misaligned tool calls waste computation and reveal that the model does not faithfully use the evidence it retrieves. This may stem from two limitations of prevailing methods: the tool reward fails to distinguish useful from useless calls, and tool feedback carries no signal of usefulness. To this end, we introduce FaithEyes, a multi-agent self-judging framework. Concretely, we use a VLM to judge whether each process image helps answer the question. The judgement is injected into the reasoning context as part of the tool observation to help subsequent reasoning, and meanwhile is used to scale the tool reward by the helpful-tool ratio to suppress reward hacking. To keep judgement available at evaluation, we further design a multi-agent framework where the model itself serves as a subagent to judge the tool calls from the main agent, eliminating any dependence on external models at inference. Training via a two-stage SFT + RL pipeline on adapted open-source data, FaithEyes attains competitive or superior accuracy across visual perception and reasoning benchmarks, while substantially improving tool faithfulness and reducing inference cost. The homepage is at https://github.com/Mosi-AI/FaithEyes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaithEyes 用一个 VLM 子代理逐步判断每张过程图像是否真的帮助回答问题，把判断注入推理上下文并按有用工具比例缩放工具奖励，从而抑制装饰性工具调用。经两阶段 SFT + RL 训练后，在视觉感知与推理基准上达到有竞争力或更优的准确率，同时显著提升工具忠实度并降低推理成本。
Motivation: Agentic VLM 的工具调用常是装饰性的：过程图像与问题无关（如裁剪没命中目标）却仍得满分，工具奖励无法区分有用与无用调用，工具反馈也不携带任何有用性信号，导致浪费算力且模型并未忠实使用检索到的证据。
Method: FaithEyes 是多代理自评判框架：用一个 VLM 判断每张过程图像是否有助于作答，该判断作为工具观测的一部分注入推理上下文，并按 helpful-tool ratio 缩放工具奖励以抑制 reward hacking；推理时由模型自身充当子代理评判主代理的工具调用，不依赖外部模型。训练采用两阶段 SFT + RL 流程，数据来自改造的开源数据。
Result: 在视觉感知与推理基准上达到有竞争力或更优的准确率，同时大幅改进工具忠实度并降低推理成本；代码与主页见 https://github.com/Mosi-AI/FaithEyes。
Conclusion: 把「工具是否有用」的判断同时做成推理时的上下文信号和训练时的奖励缩放因子，可以让 agentic VLM 在保持准确率的同时更忠实地使用工具并省下算力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning under a Think-then-Answer paradigm. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse, dynamic user interests. We propose OneLatent, an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens, enabling Latent-Reason-then-Answer inference without generating verbose traces. OneLatent first introduces Multi-View Adaptive CoT (MV-ACoT), which creates diverse, high-quality teacher-generated supervision by exploring user interests from multiple perspectives and automatically adapting reasoning complexity to each instance. Building on pretrained FRMs, it then uses a three-stage latent-token alignment paradigm to progressively internalize CoT traces into learnable latent tokens. Finally, a multistage curriculum-based post-training strategy activates latent-token reasoning for downstream recommendation tasks. Experiments on an industrial-scale Kuaishou dataset and the public Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark show that OneLatent consistently outperforms explicit CoT-based methods and traditional baselines. Compared with the Think and No-Think variants of FRMs, OneLatent improves SID@64 by 17.44% and 9.33%, respectively, while achieving over 17x higher online inference throughput. We further develop a production serving system for scalable, real-time FRM inference. An online A/B test in Kuaishou's local-services advertising scenario shows that deploying OneLatent with this system yields an estimated 9.6% revenue lift over strong online baselines, including OneRec and OneReason.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OneLatent 把推荐大模型的显式 Chain-of-Thought 压缩成若干可学习 latent token，改为 Latent-Reason-then-Answer 推理，从而省掉冗长推理轨迹的生成开销。在工业级 Kuaishou 数据集与公开 Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark 上，SID@64 相对 Think 与 No-Think 变体分别提升 17.44% 与 9.33%，在线推理吞吐提高 17 倍以上；快手本地服务广告 A/B 测试估计带来 9.6% 收入提升。
Motivation: 显式 CoT 推荐范式要生成冗长推理轨迹、推理开销大，且依赖人工模板，难以覆盖用户兴趣的多样性与动态变化。
Method: 先用 Multi-View Adaptive CoT (MV-ACoT) 从多个视角探索用户兴趣并按样本自适应调整推理复杂度，生成多样化高质量的教师监督；再在预训练 FRM 上用三阶段 latent-token alignment 逐步把 CoT 轨迹内化为可学习 latent token；最后用多阶段课程式 post-training 激活 latent-token 推理，并配套一套生产级 serving 系统。
Result: 在工业级 Kuaishou 数据集与公开 Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark 上，OneLatent 一致优于显式 CoT 方法与传统基线：SID@64 相对 Think 变体提升 17.44%、相对 No-Think 变体提升 9.33%，在线推理吞吐高出 17 倍以上。快手本地服务广告场景的线上 A/B 测试中，配合 serving 系统部署相对 OneRec、OneReason 等强线上基线估计带来 9.6% 收入提升。
Conclusion: 把显式推理轨迹内化为少量 latent token，可以在推荐任务上同时保住甚至超过显式 CoT 的效果，并把推理吞吐拉高一个量级，足以支撑实时线上服务。

papers.title: When Do Agent Loops Mistake Stagnation for Progress? Self-Evaluation Bias and Externally Grounded Verification in Long-Running Autonomous LLM Agent Loops
papers.abstract_en: Long-running autonomous agents plan, act, and judge their own completion without human intervention. When an agent grades its own work, self-evaluation bias takes hold: plausible changes are accepted as progress while real-world outcomes stagnate or regress. We name this failure mode the progress mirage and show, with controlled measurement, that it is a question of what the evaluator is grounded in. We built a testbed that holds the agent and its tool surface fixed and manipulates only the information-channel type of the evaluator that gates the loop. A world-state oracle, unfakeable in principle, is enforced by container and network isolation and verified at every run. Across 54 cycles a frontier agent claimed improvement every time, yet 56 percent had a measured delta of zero or below. Self-report was thus uninformative, and the self-verdict gate degenerated into accept-all, eroding the best deployed state it had reached by 19 percent. Even the strongest in-band judge, reading the full artifact text, the change diff, and its own verdict history, accepted cycles of which 44 percent were real-world regressions and rejected 38 percent of real improvements; the preregistered adversarial hypothesis that a strong judge closes the gap was rejected. On a boundary task whose success specification is verifiable from the artifact itself, the same judge's mirage vanished to zero and the gap collapsed within the registered threshold, showing that the gap depends on where the success signal resides. A sign-only variant returning only the acceptance verdict kept real-world output similar to full feedback (110.0 versus 113.0), locating the benefit in the gate's grounding rather than in feedback content. For open-ended objectives whose success signal lives outside the transcript, scaling up the judge is not enough; out-of-band evaluation with real-world access is a structural requirement.
papers.comment: 23 pages. Preregistered pilot measurement study. Also deposited on Zenodo (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21594735)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自主 LLM agent 长循环中，agent 自评会把停滞误判为进展（progress mirage）：54 个循环里 agent 每次都声称改进，但 56% 实测 delta 为零或负，自评门退化为 accept-all，使已部署最优状态回退 19%。即使最强 in-band judge（读全文、diff 与自身判决历史）仍接受 44% 的真实回退、拒绝 38% 的真实改进；只有当成功信号可从 artifact 本身验证时 mirage 才归零，因此对开放目标必须用带真实世界访问的 out-of-band 评估门。
Motivation: 长时自主 agent 自己给自己打分并决定是否继续循环，当成功信号位于 transcript 之外时，看似合理的改动会被当作进展，而真实结果停滞或回退，且没有人工介入来纠正。
Method: 构建受控测量 testbed：固定 agent 与工具面，只操纵门控循环的评估者信息通道类型；用容器与网络隔离强制一个原则上不可伪造的 world-state oracle 并在每次运行验证。设置包括自评、读全文/diff/判决历史的最强 in-band judge、以及只返回接受判决的 sign-only 变体，并在成功规范可从 artifact 验证的 boundary task 上做对照，检验预注册的对抗假设（强 judge 能弥合差距）。
Result: 54 个循环中 frontier agent 每次都声称改进，56% 实测 delta 为零或负，自评门退化为 accept-all 并使已达到的最佳部署状态回退 19%；最强 in-band judge 接受的循环中 44% 是真实回退、拒绝了 38% 的真实改进，预注册的强 judge 弥合差距假设被拒绝。boundary task 上同一 judge 的 mirage 归零、差距在注册阈值内收敛；sign-only 变体的真实世界输出与全反馈接近（110.0 对 113.0）。
Conclusion: 评估门的 grounding 位置而非反馈内容决定自评是否失真：对成功信号在 transcript 之外的开放目标，放大 judge 不够，带真实世界访问的 out-of-band 评估是结构性要求。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 自主 LLM agent 长循环中，agent 自评会把停滞误判为进展（progress mirage）：54 个循环里 agent 每次都声称改进，但 56% 实测 delta 为零或负，自评门退化为 accept-all，使已部署最优状态回退 19%。即使最强 in-band judge（读全文、diff 与自身判决历史）仍接受 44% 的真实回退、拒绝 38% 的真实改进；只有当成功信号可从 artifact 本身验证时 mirage 才归零，因此对开放目标必须用带真实世界访问的 out-of-band 评估门。
summary_sections.motivation: 长时自主 agent 自己给自己打分并决定是否继续循环，当成功信号位于 transcript 之外时，看似合理的改动会被当作进展，而真实结果停滞或回退，且没有人工介入来纠正。
summary_sections.method: 构建受控测量 testbed：固定 agent 与工具面，只操纵门控循环的评估者信息通道类型；用容器与网络隔离强制一个原则上不可伪造的 world-state oracle 并在每次运行验证。设置包括自评、读全文/diff/判决历史的最强 in-band judge、以及只返回接受判决的 sign-only 变体，并在成功规范可从 artifact 验证的 boundary task 上做对照，检验预注册的对抗假设（强 judge 能弥合差距）。

summary_sections.conclusion: 评估门的 grounding 位置而非反馈内容决定自评是否失真：对成功信号在 transcript 之外的开放目标，放大 judge 不够，带真实世界访问的 out-of-band 评估是结构性要求。

papers.title: LOCKS: Page-Local Compact Key Summaries for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Serving large language models at long context is bottlenecked by the key-value (KV) cache, which is read at every decode step. We find that attention keys are approximately low-rank within pages. A single low-rank projection shared across pages can miss page-specific directions; fitting a basis to each page better identifies the pages receiving the most attention at comparable stored selector cost. LOCKS stores a rank-$r$ spectral summary per page, reconstructs its within-page logits, and selects pages by log-sum-exp mass without reading candidate keys or values. It stays within about a point of FullKV on LongBench-v1, tracks the read-every-key exact-LSE oracle on RULER down to the smallest budgets, and retains quality furthest under tight budgets on AIME26 and MATH-500. At a $2048$-token budget it matches FullKV aggregate quality beyond $100$K context while attending about $2\%$ of tokens. Across ranks $2$-$8$, summaries use $4$-$10\%$ of full-KV bytes. On GH200 with GPU-resident KV, LOCKS reduces complete decode-step time by $1.8\times$ at $512$K context. With full KV offloaded to Grace memory, it reaches $3.82$-$4.22\times$ the faster dense backend's aggregate throughput at $64$K-$256$K by serving larger batches.

TL;DR: LOCKS 为长上下文 LLM 解码的 KV cache 提出按页(page)存储的 rank-r 谱摘要：页内拟合低秩基，用 log-sum-exp 质量在不读候选 key/value 的情况下选页。2048 token 预算下在 100K 以上上下文匹配 FullKV 聚合质量且只注意约 2% token，GH200 上 512K 上下文完整解码步时间加速 1.8×。
Motivation: 长上下文服务被每步解码都要读的 KV cache 卡住，跨页共享的单一低秩投影会漏掉页特有的方向，需要在同等存储下更准地识别高注意力页。
Method: 每页存一个 rank-r 谱摘要并重建页内 logits，按 log-sum-exp 质量选页，无需读取候选 key/value；跨 rank 2–8 与 FullKV、read-every-key exact-LSE oracle 及 dense backend 对比。

papers.title: Trustworthiness Costs of Domain Adaptation in Small Language Models:A Cross-Architecture Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptation of small language models (SLMs) has emerged as a practical strategy for deploying capable NLP systems in resource-constrained, high-stakes environments including healthcare, legal services, and financial analysis. While performance gains from parameter-efficient fine-tuning are well characterised, the corresponding impact on trustworthiness (factual calibration and adversarial robustness) remains poorly understood. This paper presents the first systematic cross-domain, cross-architecture empirical study quantifying the trustworthiness cost of domain adaptation across three SLM architectures (TinyLlama 1B, Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), three domains (healthcare, legal, finance), two training-data conditions (benign and adversarially perturbed), and four fine-tuning strategies (baseline LoRA, Safety-DPO, Dark Experience Replay, and Task Arithmetic LoRA, TA-LoRA). Trustworthiness is evaluated through TruthfulQA MC2 (factual calibration) and HarmBench ASR (adversarial robustness) across all 216 experimental configurations with three random seeds. Three principal findings emerge. First, baseline QLoRA domain adaptation produces minimal TruthfulQA MC2 change across all model-domain combinations (mean |Delta TQA| < 0.02). Second, adversarially perturbed training data consistently improves domain adaptation quality (Delta loss approximately -0.040) without worsening trustworthiness benchmarks. Third, none of the three safety-preserving strategies reduced adversarial harm susceptibility: Safety-DPO was effectively neutral (mean Delta ASR < 0.001), while Dark ER and TA-LoRA increased mean HarmBench ASR by +0.171 and +0.155 respectively in safety-aligned models (Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), with individual configurations exceeding +0.45. These results challenge the assumption that replay-based and arithmetic-merge strategies transfer alignment to domain-adapted SLMs.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 tables, 2 appendices (Reproducibility Checklist; Software and Data Availability). Code, model checkpoints, and datasets publicly available at https://github.com/rbpdlf/slm-trw
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对三个 SLM 架构、三个领域、两种训练数据条件与四种微调策略共 216 组配置做交叉实证，量化领域适配的可信度代价。基线 QLoRA 几乎不动 TruthfulQA MC2（|Δ|<0.02），对抗扰动数据还能降 loss 约 -0.040 而不恶化可信度；但 Dark ER 与 TA-LoRA 反而把 HarmBench ASR 抬高 +0.171 与 +0.155，个别配置超过 +0.45。
Motivation: 参数高效微调的性能收益已被研究清楚，但其对事实校准与对抗鲁棒性的影响在跨架构、跨领域层面缺乏系统量化，而部署场景恰是医疗、法律、金融这类高风险环境。
Method: 在 TinyLlama 1B、Gemma-2 2B、Llama 3.2 1B 三个架构上，覆盖 healthcare/legal/finance 三领域、benign 与 adversarially perturbed 两种训练数据条件，比较 baseline LoRA、Safety-DPO、Dark Experience Replay、Task Arithmetic LoRA (TA-LoRA) 四种微调策略，共 216 组配置、每组三个随机种子；用 TruthfulQA MC2 评事实校准，HarmBench ASR 评对抗鲁棒性。
Result: 基线 QLoRA 领域适配在所有模型-领域组合上 TruthfulQA MC2 平均 |ΔTQA| < 0.02；对抗扰动训练数据一致改善适配质量（Δloss 约 -0.040）且不恶化可信度基准；三种保安全策略均未降低对抗危害易感性——Safety-DPO 基本中性（平均 ΔASR < 0.001），Dark ER 与 TA-LoRA 在安全对齐模型（Gemma-2 2B、Llama 3.2 1B）上分别使平均 HarmBench ASR 上升 +0.171 与 +0.155，个别配置超过 +0.45。
Conclusion: 回放类与算术合并类策略并不会把对齐能力迁移到领域适配后的 SLM，反而可能显著抬高对抗危害；领域适配的可信度代价主要来自这些保安全策略而非 QLoRA 本身。

papers.title: Local Search with Correlated Randomness
papers.abstract_en: How much does an algorithm's running-time distribution under independent randomness reveal about its behavior when independence is no longer guaranteed? We study sources satisfying $ν[w]\le DP[w]^s$ for every finite prefix $w$, where $P$ is an independent reference law, $0<s\le1$, and $D\ge1$. The constraint controls complete-prefix probabilities while allowing individual choices to be predictable, even fully determined by the past. For retry tasks, all deterministic history-dependent selectors have the same independent-source running-time law. Yet two orders have worst-case failure probabilities $1$ and $\exp[-Θ(n)]$ at the same linear deadline under the same source constraint. We identify a static priority rule that is optimal at every deadline and every $D$. For the standard local walk on a $k$-CNF with at least $r$ true literals per clause under some assignment, $k/2<r<k$, we determine the sharp source threshold $s_*$. At and above it, the expected flip count is $O_{k,r}(\min\{L^3,L/(s-s_*)\})$, where $L=h+\log D+1$, $h$ is the initial Hamming distance to that assignment, and $L/0=\infty$. The bound allows arbitrary clause overlap and history-dependent clause selection. Matching instances admit one source forcing this delay with probability one for every selector. At criticality and fixed $D$, the delay is cubic despite a linear independent-source expectation. Variable-depth prefix covers, together with classical tree max-flow/min-cut, yield an exact criterion for restoring exponential tails by restarting on the same tape. We synthesize updates and restarts for explicit finite-state processes. Under a sufficient prefix guarantee, we also obtain noisy predecessor search with error at most $η$ and expected query count polynomial in the correct leaf's depth and $\log(D/η)$, without knowing the depth or tree height.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究相关性随机源下局部搜索的运行时间：源满足前缀约束 ν[w]≤DP[w]^s 时，重试任务在任意 deadline 上存在静态优先级规则最优，而 k-CNF 局部翻转在临界 s* 处期望翻转次数为 O_{k,r}(min{L³, L/(s−s*)})，即使独立源期望是线性的。
Motivation: 独立随机性下的算法运行时间分析无法覆盖选择可被历史预测甚至完全决定的相关源；同一源约束下不同执行顺序的最坏失败概率可差 1 与 exp[−Θ(n)]。
Method: 刻画满足 ν[w]≤DP[w]^s 的源类，给出重试任务的静态优先级规则；对 k/2<r<k 的 k-CNF 局部游走确定临界阈值 s*，用变深度前缀覆盖与经典树最大流/最小割导出同带上重启恢复指数尾的精确判据，并综合更新与重启策略。
Result: 同一源约束下两种顺序在同一线性 deadline 的最坏失败概率分别为 1 与 exp[−Θ(n)]；s≥s* 时期望翻转次数 O_{k,r}(min{L³, L/(s−s*)})，L=h+log D+1，允许任意子句重叠与历史相关选择；临界且固定 D 时延迟为立方级而独立源期望为线性；匹配实例存在以概率 1 强制该延迟的源；另得误差至多 η、查询次数关于正确叶子深度与 log(D/η) 多项式的 noisy predecessor search。
Conclusion: 相关随机性可在不违反前缀约束的前提下把线性期望的局部搜索拖到立方延迟，静态优先级与同带重启是恢复可控尾部的机制。

papers.title: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) post-training is essential for improving reasoning, adaptation, and alignment. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, RL relies on coarse-grained outcome supervision, resulting in difficult credit assignment and limited capability to acquire new knowledge. OPD, meanwhile, unconditionally matches teacher logits through KL divergence, which creates a dilemma: similar teachers provide little new knowledge, while substantially different teachers often yield ineffective guidance, largely restricting OPD to within-family distillation. We propose Distilled Reinforcement Learning (Distilled RL), which integrates teacher supervision into the RL objective to provide fine-grained guidance, selectively transfer new knowledge and avoid unconditional imitation. Distilled RL contains three components: reverse importance sampling with clipping, negative sample reset, and sequence-level geometric normalization. Through a concise and interpretable case study, we demonstrate that Distilled RL can effectively transfer previously unavailable knowledge from a teacher model to a student model. Extensive experiments across both within-family and cross-family distillation settings show that Distilled RL substantially outperforms standard RL and OPD in terms of both pass@1 and pass@k. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/Distilled-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把教师监督嵌进 RL 目标的 Distilled RL：用带截断的反向重要性采样、负样本重置与序列级几何归一化，选择性迁移教师新知识而非无条件模仿。在 within-family 与 cross-family 两种蒸馏设定下，pass@1 与 pass@k 均明显优于标准 RL 与 on-policy distillation (OPD)。
Motivation: RL 后训练只有粗粒度结果监督，credit assignment 困难且难获取新知识；OPD 用 KL 无条件匹配教师 logits，相似教师给不出新知识、差异大的教师指导又失效，被限制在同族模型内蒸馏。
Method: Distilled RL 把教师监督并入 RL 目标，含三个组件：带截断的反向重要性采样 (reverse importance sampling with clipping)、负样本重置 (negative sample reset)、序列级几何归一化 (sequence-level geometric normalization)；另配一个可解释的 case study 展示知识迁移机制。
Result: 在 within-family 与 cross-family 蒸馏设定的大量实验中，pass@1 与 pass@k 均显著优于标准 RL 与 OPD；case study 显示能把教师中原本学生拿不到的知识迁移过去。
Conclusion: 把教师信号做成 RL 目标里的细粒度、可选择性监督，可以突破 OPD 只能同族蒸馏的限制，同时缓解 RL 的 credit assignment 问题。

papers.title: PhysPlan: Grounded Physical State Reasoning and Graph-Guided Optimization for Physically Plausible Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models (VDMs) synthesize photorealistic content, yet they often fail to follow the course that a physical phenomenon should take within a given scene. Recent training-free methods let a vision-language model (VLM) plan the phenomenon and guide a frozen VDM toward the plan; however, such plans are derived from the prompt and consumed as whole keyframes or trajectories, which leaves unspecified where the consequences land in the observed scene and turns incidental visual details into optimization targets. We observe that a phenomenon specified in words unfolds as sparse, local changes to the physical state of the observed scene. Building on this observation, we present PhysPlan, a training-free image-to-video framework that represents a phenomenon as a grounded state graph and uses this graph to decide what, where, and when the guidance constrains. Grounded Physical State Reasoning decomposes the phenomenon into physical deltas, each stating which objects change, to what state, and by which physical rule, and translates each delta into graph edits, verified by deterministic checks, that leave all other objects unchanged. Graph-Guided Test-Time Optimization renders a keyframe for each state, measures the denoised estimates only along the properties selected by the edits, and concentrates the update on the edited objects. On PhyGenBench and Physics-IQ, PhysPlan raises its base model from 0.52 to 0.77 and from 27.1 to 38.2, surpassing the strongest prior I2V method (0.60 and 34.6), and lowers FVD by over 20%. Project page: https://physplan.github.io
papers.comment: 25 pages (9 main + references + appendix), 5 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://physplan.github.io

TL;DR: PhysPlan 是免训练的图生视频框架，把现象拆成带物理规则的 grounded state graph，用图编辑决定约束的 what/where/when，再在测试时只对被编辑对象的属性做去噪估计更新。在 PhyGenBench 上把基座模型从 0.52 提到 0.77，Physics-IQ 从 27.1 提到 38.2，均超过最强先前 I2V 方法（0.60、34.6），FVD 降低超过 20%。
Motivation: 现有免训练方法让 VLM 规划现象并引导冻结的 VDM，但规划由 prompt 派生、以整体关键帧或轨迹消费，未指定后果落在场景何处，还把偶发视觉细节当成优化目标。

papers.title: HEDGEHOG: Hierarchical Evaluation of Drug Generators Through Rigorous Filtration
authors: (2) Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology
papers.abstract_en: Generative molecular models can support early drug discovery by proposing new candidate compounds de novo. In practice, useful candidates must balance target-relevant activity, physicochemical properties, and other multiparameter design constraints. However, standard metrics commonly used to evaluate molecular generators only weakly reflect whether the generated compounds are medicinally plausible and suitable for downstream computation. This can produce an incomplete view of model performance and inefficient use of computational resources. We introduce HEDGEHOG, a unified six-stage filtration benchmark that is constructed as a hit identification workflow: (i) preprocessing; (ii) physicochemical descriptor screening; (iii) structural alerts and graph-sanity checks; (iv) synthesis feasibility; (v) docking; and (vi) three-dimensional pose and interaction checks. We evaluated 22 generative models in a KRAS G12D case study, using three runs of 1,000 requested generation attempts per model. The models showed different patterns of attrition, and final survival ranged from 0 to 127 molecules per run. None of the standard metrics showed a significant association with final survival after correction for multiple testing. HEDGEHOG provides a reproducible benchmark for evaluating molecular generative models by measuring molecule survival through chemical filters. The framework identifies stage-wise failure modes across generator classes and provides a practical basis for developing molecular generators better aligned with early drug discovery.
papers.comment: 26 pages (including References and Appendix sections), 33 tables, 6 figures, 1 supplementary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEDGEHOG 把药物分子生成器的评测做成六阶段命中发现流程（预处理、理化描述符筛选、结构警示与图合理性、合成可行性、对接、三维构象与相互作用检查），在 KRAS G12D 案例中评测 22 个生成模型，每个模型 3 次、每次 1000 次生成请求。最终存活分子数在 0 到 127 之间，且经多重检验校正后没有任何标准指标与最终存活显著相关。
Motivation: 标准分子生成指标与化合物的药用合理性和下游计算适用性关联很弱，导致对模型性能的判断不完整、算力资源使用低效。
Method: 以命中发现工作流形式构建统一的六阶段过滤基准：预处理、理化描述符筛选、结构警示与图健全性检查、合成可行性、对接、三维姿态与相互作用检查；在 KRAS G12D 案例研究中评测 22 个生成模型，每个模型三次独立运行、每次 1000 次生成请求，统计分子逐阶段存活并检验标准指标与存活的关联。

papers.title: NeuroECG: ECGFounder-Based Deep ECG Representation for EEG-Free Neurological Prognostication After Cardiac Arrest
papers.abstract_en: Neurological prognostication after cardiac arrest commonly relies on electroencephalography (EEG). However, EEG demands high clinical resources. Bedside electrocardiography (ECG) is standard and low-cost. Yet, its value for predicting neurological outcomes remains underexplored. In this study, we propose NeuroECG, an ECGFounder-based deep representation framework for EEG-free auxiliary prognostication. NeuroECG adapts a pretrained ECG foundation model via task-specific fine-tuning. We implement a gradual unfreezing strategy on single-channel bedside monitoring ECG. Multiple ECG segments per patient are encoded into segment-level deep features. These embeddings are aggregated via quantile pooling (q = 0.24) and compressed using principal component analysis (PCA). Experiments on 412 ECG-available patients from the multicenter I-CARE database show that the adapted ECGFounder backbone achieves the best performance among ECG-only backbone baselines, with a test AUROC of 0.7333. We further combine the learned deep ECG representation with static clinical covariates. The proposed NeuroECG model achieves a test AUROC of 0.8077 and an AUPRC of 0.8970. These results support deep bedside ECG representations as a useful source of auxiliary prognostic information. Their integration with static clinical covariates improves prediction in an EEG-free setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/goddream66/NeuroECG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroECG 用预训练 ECG 基础模型 ECGFounder 做渐进解冻微调，把单导联床旁 ECG 的多段嵌入经分位数池化 (q=0.24) 与 PCA 聚合，得到免 EEG 的心脏骤停后神经预后表征。在 I-CARE 多中心 412 例患者上，ECGFounder 骨干在纯 ECG 基线中 AUROC 最高 (0.7333)，再融合静态临床协变量后测试 AUROC 达 0.8077、AUPRC 0.8970。
Motivation: 心脏骤停后神经预后常规依赖 EEG，但 EEG 资源消耗大；床旁 ECG 低成本普及，其预测神经结局的价值尚未充分挖掘。
Method: 对预训练 ECG 基础模型 ECGFounder 做任务特定微调，采用渐进解冻 (gradual unfreezing) 策略处理单导联床旁监护 ECG；每位患者多个 ECG 段编码为段级深度特征，用分位数池化 (quantile pooling, q=0.24) 聚合后经 PCA 压缩，再与静态临床协变量结合。
Result: 在 I-CARE 多中心数据库 412 名有 ECG 的患者上，适配后的 ECGFounder 骨干在纯 ECG 骨干基线中性能最好，测试 AUROC 0.7333；融合深度 ECG 表征与静态临床协变量的 NeuroECG 测试 AUROC 0.8077、AUPRC 0.8970。
Conclusion: 深度床旁 ECG 表征可作为免 EEG 场景下有用的辅助预后信息源，与静态临床协变量结合能进一步提升心脏骤停后神经结局预测。

papers.title: Weight-Adjusted Gradients Reveal Parameter Importance and Failure Modes in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Understanding which parameters are influential in Large Language Models (LLMs) is central to improving their efficiency, reliability, and interpretability. We introduce Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG), a simple yet effective approach for estimating parameter importance that explicitly captures the interaction between model weights and first-order gradient information and identifies parameters that disproportionately influence model behavior, such as those responsible for collapse phenomena in LLMs. Across a range of models and settings, we show that WAG surfaces a tiny but critical subset of parameters (< 0.5 parts per million or 0.00005% of model size) whose modification leads to dramatic degradation in performance, indicating a novel failure mode. These findings also reveal a previously underexplored interplay between weights and gradients, suggesting that parameter importance cannot be fully understood through either signal alone. We demonstrate the practical utility of WAG across several diverse applications, such as expert allocation in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, targeted unlearning, mixed-precision quantization, and layer selection for knowledge editing. In sum, WAG can serve as a unified approach for analyzing, debugging, and controlling LLMs, and opens new directions for principled parameter-level interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG)，把权重与一阶梯度信息交互结合来估计 LLM 参数重要性，定位到占比小于 0.5 ppm（0.00005% 模型规模）的极小关键参数子集，改动它们会导致性能急剧退化，揭示一种新的失效模式。WAG 还可用于 MoE 专家分配、定向遗忘、混合精度量化与知识编辑的层选择。
Motivation: LLM 中哪些参数真正影响行为长期缺乏可靠判据，单看权重或单看梯度都不足以识别导致模型崩溃的少数关键参数。
Method: WAG 显式建模权重与一阶梯度的交互来给参数打分，筛出对模型行为影响不成比例的参数子集，并在多种模型与设置上应用。
Result: WAG 找到的临界参数占比小于 0.5 ppm（0.00005% 模型规模），修改它们即造成性能急剧退化；在 MoE 专家分配、定向 unlearning、混合精度量化、知识编辑层选择等应用上展示了实用性。
Conclusion: 参数重要性无法单靠权重或梯度任一信号刻画，WAG 可作为统一的 LLM 分析、调试与控制工具。

papers.title: Reward Valuation in Large Language Models: Causal Induction of Anhedonia
papers.abstract_en: Recent frontier models mimic complex aspects of human cognition. Here we ask whether this alignment extends into reward valuation, which we assess in a mechanistic framework. Specifically, we use clinical tests that were developed to evaluate anhedonia in human subjects with major depressive disorders. Mechanistically, anhedonia is frequently associated with dysregulation in the Nucleus Accumbens (NAc) and the broader dopaminergic reward system. While neuroimaging has localized these deficits, establishing a causal link between NAc activity and specific behavioral symptoms remains a challenge. We use these ideas from neuroscience to functionally identify reward-anticipatory units in state-of-the-art AI models, and evaluate their causal involvement via targeted perturbations. We find that not only are such model units predictive of NAc brain recordings, their perturbation also induces behavioral effects mirroring human anhedonia: the model opts for low-effort, low-reward tasks in effort-based decision-making paradigms. Crucially, our results demonstrate that this represents a specific deficit in self-centered reward valuation and anticipation--rather than a loss of task capability, reward calculation, or effort avoidance. This induced vulnerability aligns with clinical measures of anhedonia and motivation in humans, such as DARS and MAP-SR, instruments that contain no reward-related vocabulary, ruling out a purely lexical account of the perturbation effect. Taken together, our results suggest reward valuation circuits in AI models that functionally mimic those in humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用人类快感缺失 (anhedonia) 临床范式在前沿 LLM 中功能定位奖赏预期单元，并做定向扰动：被扰动后模型在基于努力的决策中转向低努力低奖赏任务，而任务能力、奖赏计算与努力回避均未受损。该效应与不含奖赏词汇的临床量表 DARS、MAP-SR 对齐，说明模型存在自我中心奖赏估值与预期的特异性缺陷。
Motivation: 神经影像能把奖赏缺失定位到伏隔核 (NAc) 与多巴胺系统，但建立 NAc 活动与具体行为症状的因果链仍是难题；同时前沿模型是否在奖赏估值层面与人类对齐尚无机制性检验。
Method: 借鉴评估重度抑郁患者快感缺失的临床测试，在 SOTA AI 模型中功能定位奖赏预期单元，再用定向扰动检验其因果作用；并用 DARS、MAP-SR 这类不含奖赏词汇的临床量表对齐行为效应，以排除纯词汇解释。
Result: 模型单元可预测 NAc 脑记录；扰动后模型在 effort-based decision-making 中偏好低努力低奖赏任务，且缺陷特异于自我中心奖赏估值与预期，而非任务能力、奖赏计算或努力回避；行为效应与人类临床量表 DARS、MAP-SR 一致。
Conclusion: AI 模型中的奖赏估值回路在功能上模拟了人类相应回路，且该脆弱性可用临床快感缺失与动机量表刻画。

papers.title: Data-Driven Soft Labeling Scales DNA Read Classification to Whole-Body Cell-Type Deconvolution
papers.abstract_en: Cell-type deconvolution, the task of estimating the proportions of constituent cell types in a heterogeneous biological sample, is a core problem in computational biology. Methods that rely on epigenetic marks such as DNA methylation typically operate on aggregated methylation estimates, discarding the pattern-level information carried by individual DNA reads. Existing read-level approaches that exploit this information are scarce, and all remain restricted to few-class settings; scaling them further is an open problem because, at scale, non-discriminative reads dominate and hard labels conflict with the many-to-many mapping between methylation patterns and cell types, preventing classifier convergence. To overcome this, we propose data-driven soft labels that estimate the conditional cell-type distribution for each read, and integrate this scheme into $Syto$, a new modular framework for read-level classification-based deconvolution. On a whole-body atlas of 39 human cell types, $Syto$ reduces MSE by 3.7$\times$ over the best examined baseline, with gains transferring to an out-of-distribution dataset spanning 16 tissues. $Syto$ lays the foundation for modeling increasingly large cell-type panels, with improved applications in biology and healthcare. The proposed soft-labeling scheme is further translatable to any setting with a many-to-many signal-to-label mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Syto 用数据驱动的软标签为每条 DNA read 估计条件细胞类型分布，把 read 级甲基化分类从少类扩展到全身体 39 种细胞类型的去卷积。在该图谱上相对最佳基线 MSE 降低 3.7 倍，且增益迁移到覆盖 16 个组织的分布外数据集。软标签方案可推广到任何信号与标签多对多映射的场景。
Motivation: 基于 DNA 甲基化的细胞类型去卷积多在聚合甲基化水平上做，丢掉单条 read 的模式信息；已有 read 级方法都局限于少类设置，因为在大规模上非判别性 read 占主导，且甲基化模式与细胞类型是多对多映射，硬标签互相冲突导致分类器无法收敛。
Method: 提出数据驱动软标签 (data-driven soft labels)，为每条 read 估计条件细胞类型分布而非硬类别，并将其嵌入模块化的 read 级分类去卷积框架 Syto，以替代硬标签处理多对多映射。
Result: 在含 39 种人体细胞类型的全身体图谱上，Syto 相对所考察的最佳基线将 MSE 降低 3.7 倍；增益迁移到覆盖 16 个组织的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 数据集。
Conclusion: 软标签能化解多对多映射下的标签冲突，使 read 级分类去卷积可扩展到大规模细胞类型面板；该软标签方案可迁移到任何信号与标签多对多的场景。

papers.title: Theoretical Guarantees for SMC-Guided Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc conditioning of pretrained diffusion models can be addressed using Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods. By evolving an interacting particle system, SMC-guided diffusion samplers combine unconditional reverse-diffusion dynamics with sequential reweighting to approximate conditional distributions. Nevertheless, even in the infinite-particle limit, the implemented sampler may differ from the ideal conditional target because of errors in the diffusion model, its numerical implementation, and the guidance mechanism. We characterize how these local errors propagate through forward-smoothing kernels, which jointly account for the reverse dynamics and the remaining conditioning information. This yields non-asymptotic error bounds that capture both finite-particle fluctuations and approximation errors arising from initialization, numerical integration, score approximation, and potential design. In doing so, we extend stability guarantees for diffusion models to the conditional setting. Finally, we apply our framework to several state-of-the-art SMC-guided diffusion algorithms, providing a unified theoretical perspective on their approximation mechanisms and sources of error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对用 Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) 引导的预训练扩散模型，本文刻画局部误差如何经 forward-smoothing kernel 传播，得到同时含有限粒子涨落与初始化、数值积分、score 近似、potential design 近似误差的非渐近误差界，把扩散模型的稳定性保证推广到条件采样设定。
Motivation: SMC 引导的扩散采样器即使在无穷粒子极限下也可能偏离理想条件分布，误差来自扩散模型本身、数值实现与引导机制，缺少统一的非渐近误差刻画。
Method: 用同时编码反向动力学与剩余条件信息的 forward-smoothing kernel 分析局部误差传播，导出非渐近误差界，并把该框架套用到若干 state-of-the-art 的 SMC 引导扩散算法上，统一解释其近似机制与误差来源。
Result: 给出的误差界同时捕捉有限粒子涨落与来自初始化、数值积分、score 近似、potential design 的近似误差；框架应用于多个 SMC-guided diffusion 算法，提供统一的理论视角。
Conclusion: 扩散模型的稳定性保证可以推广到条件设定，SMC 引导扩散的误差可按来源分解并被非渐近界控制。

papers.title: Complexity of Normalized Persistence Problems for Topological Data Analysis and Local Hamiltonians
papers.abstract_en: Topological data analysis (TDA) is a machine learning technique that uses topology to extract patterns from data and has shown the potential to exhibit quantum advantage. A key concept in TDA is persistent homology, which measures the robustness of topological information at different lengthscales. In this paper, we introduce and study the problem of normalized persistence, a practically motivated and easily interpretable version of persistent homology that counts the fraction of holes that persist at different lengthscales. We prove that a variant of normalized persistence is $\mathsf{DQC}_1$-hard and contained in $\mathsf{BQP}$, giving evidence of an exponential quantum speedup for TDA under the standard assumption that $\mathsf{DQC}_1 \not\subseteq \mathsf{BPP}$. These are the first $\mathsf{DQC}_1$-hardness results for clique complexes, making them directly applicable to TDA instances. We also find a close connection between normalized persistence and the complexity of estimating spectral quantities in the low-energy subspace of local Hamiltonians. We study a family of such problems, including a low-energy normalized subtrace and spectral density. We show that these are $\mathsf{DQC}_1$-hard for $O(1)$-local Hamiltonians, strengthening previous results that required log-local interactions. We also introduce a variant of $\mathsf{DQC}_1$ with perfect completeness ($\mathsf{SDQC}_1$) to characterize the hardness of problems normalized by an exact kernel. This includes normalized persistence for $O(1)$-local Hamiltonians, which we show is $\mathsf{SDQC}_1$-hard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 normalized persistence：按不同长度尺度统计仍存留的洞的比例，作为可解释的 persistent homology 变体。证明其变体是 DQC1-hard 且属于 BQP，在 DQC1 不含于 BPP 的标准假设下给出 TDA 的指数级量子加速证据；并把该归约延伸到 O(1)-local Hamiltonian 的低能子空间谱量估计，其中 normalized persistence 是 SDQC1-hard。
Motivation: TDA 依赖 persistent homology，但其经典复杂度与量子加速证据此前缺少直接适用于 clique complex 的硬度结果；已有 local Hamiltonian 归约还要求 log-local 相互作用。
Method: 定义 normalized persistence（统计在各长度尺度上存留的洞的比例），证明其变体 DQC1-hard 且在 BQP 内，归约对象为 clique complex；研究一族低能子空间谱量问题，包括 low-energy normalized subtrace 与 spectral density，证明其对 O(1)-local Hamiltonian 是 DQC1-hard；并引入带完美完备性的变体 SDQC1 刻画按精确核归一化的问题。
Result: normalized persistence 的变体 DQC1-hard 且属于 BQP，构成首个针对 clique complex 的 DQC1-hardness 结果；low-energy normalized subtrace 与 spectral density 对 O(1)-local Hamiltonian 是 DQC1-hard，将此前需 log-local 相互作用的结果加强到常数局部；O(1)-local Hamiltonian 的 normalized persistence 是 SDQC1-hard。
Conclusion: 在 DQC1 不含于 BPP 的标准假设下，TDA 的 normalized persistence 存在指数级量子加速，且按精确核归一化的问题硬度由 SDQC1 刻画。

papers.title: NURBS Splatting: A Unified Differentiable Rendering Framework for Vector Graphics
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable rendering of planar rational splines remains largely underexplored, despite their widespread use in vector graphics and design. Existing differentiable vector renderers primarily focus on Bézier curves and rely on analytic rasterization, which can suffer from gradient instability and limited flexibility. We propose NURBS Splatting, a unified framework that represents planar rational curves as continuous Gaussian fields. By sampling Gaussians along the curve parameter domain and inside closed regions, rendering is reformulated as a smooth accumulation process with stable gradients. Our method naturally supports long splines, rational weights, non-uniform knots, and closed-region filling. We demonstrate its effectiveness in calligraphy reconstruction, vectorization frameworks, and long-spline image abstraction, showing improved stability and reconstruction quality over existing approaches.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NURBS Splatting 把平面有理样条表示为沿曲线参数域与闭合区域内部采样的连续高斯场，使渲染变成平滑累积过程，梯度稳定。该方法原生支持长样条、rational weights、非均匀节点与闭合区域填充，在书法重建、矢量化框架和长样条图像抽象中展示出比现有方法更好的稳定性与重建质量。
Motivation: 可微矢量渲染目前主要围绕 Bézier 曲线与解析光栅化构建，对平面有理样条（NURBS）支持不足，且解析光栅化易出现梯度不稳定、灵活性受限。
Method: 将平面有理曲线表示为连续 Gaussian field：沿曲线参数域以及闭合区域内部采样高斯核，把渲染重构为平滑累积过程，从而获得稳定梯度；框架直接容纳长样条、rational weights、非均匀节点与闭合区域填充。
Result: 在书法重建、矢量化框架与长样条图像抽象三类任务上展示有效性，相对已有方法在稳定性与重建质量上均有提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 用高斯场累积替代解析光栅化，是让有理样条可微渲染同时获得稳定梯度与表达灵活性的可行路径。
Relevance: 0
