papers.title: Does Anthropomorphic Language Impact Public Perceptions of AI?
papers.abstract_en: Public discourse about artificial intelligence (AI) often uses anthropomorphic language: language that attributes human capabilities and characteristics to AI systems. This practice has been criticized for setting misleading expectations, inflating claims, and fueling hype around AI, which may distort public understanding of AI and impact policy priorities. We study the effects of anthropomorphic framing by comparing changes in participants' perceptions of AI (N=815) when reading passages with and without anthropomorphic language, designed to reflect realistic public-facing AI discourse. We further examine whether these effects differ across two types of AI technologies -- large language models and recommendation systems -- and measure changes in perceptions of AI across several dimensions that are prominent in current public discourse. In a separate condition using a text that explicitly discusses the dangers of AI, we show that individuals' views of AI can shift in response to reading a text; yet in the main conditions of the experiment, where we compare anthropomorphic and non-anthropomorphic descriptions, we find that whether the text uses anthropomorphic language does not substantially affect participants' perceptions of AI. Our results indicate that any immediate effects on opinions of AI are modest, although they leave open the possibility that anthropomorphic language could have an effect in naturalistic settings, or over gradual, continued exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 一项 N=815 的受控实验比较参与者阅读含与不含拟人化语言 (anthropomorphic language) 的 AI 描述段落后对 AI 认知的变化，覆盖大语言模型与推荐系统两类技术。结果显示拟人化措辞并未实质性改变参与者的 AI 认知，而另一条件下阅读明确讨论 AI 危害的文本确实能改变观点，说明观点本身可被文本移动，只是拟人化这一具体手段的即时效应很小。
Motivation: 公共讨论中把人类能力归于 AI 的拟人化语言被批评会误导预期、放大炒作并扭曲公众理解与政策优先级，但这种框架是否真的即时改变公众认知缺乏实验证据。
Method: 受控实验：给参与者阅读反映真实公共 AI 讨论风格的段落，分为含拟人化语言与不含拟人化语言两组，比较阅读前后对 AI 认知在多个公共讨论维度上的变化；另设一个阅读明确讨论 AI 危害文本的独立条件作为观点可移动性的对照，并在 LLM 与推荐系统两类技术间比较效应差异。
Result: 主实验 N=815；在拟人化与非拟人化描述的对比中，是否使用拟人化语言并未实质性影响参与者对 AI 的认知；在单独的 AI 危害文本条件下，参与者观点确实发生了移动。
Conclusion: 拟人化语言对 AI 观点的即时影响是温和的，但作者保留其在自然情境或长期持续暴露下产生效应的可能。

papers.title: A Generalization Theory for JEPA-Based World Models
papers.abstract_en: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for world modeling by predicting future representations rather than reconstructing observations. Despite their empirical success, the theoretical understanding of JEPA-based world models remains limited. In this paper, we develop the first generalization theory for JEPA-based world models. We formulate JEPA pretraining as a conditional spectral graph learning problem and show that the JEPA objective is equivalent to a low-rank factorization of an action-conditioned co-occurrence matrix. Building on this characterization, we establish a connection between JEPA pretraining error and downstream planning regret, leading to a finite-sample generalization bound for JEPA-based world models. Our analysis reveals an approximation-sample error trade-off governed by latent dimensionality, providing insights into latent- versus input-level prediction. The theoretical trade-off motivates us to investigate a simple Multi-Depth JEPA extension that combines representations from different network depths. In validation experiments, latent-level prediction exhibits greater robustness under unpredictable observations and difficult planning tasks. Multi-depth representations further improve planning success over single-depth representations and a dimensionality-matched control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 JEPA 世界模型建立首个泛化理论：把 JEPA 预训练形式化为条件谱图学习，证明其目标等价于动作条件共现矩阵的低秩分解，进而把预训练误差与下游规划 regret 联系起来得到有限样本泛化界。界揭示由 latent 维度控制的近似-样本误差权衡，据此提出的 Multi-Depth JEPA 在规划成功率上优于单深度表示与维度匹配对照。
Motivation: JEPA 世界模型已有经验成功，但缺少理论理解：预训练误差如何传导到下游规划、latent 维度如何影响泛化，均无刻画。
Method: 将 JEPA 预训练表述为条件谱图学习问题，证明 JEPA 目标等价于动作条件共现矩阵的低秩分解；由此建立预训练误差与下游规划 regret 的联系并导出有限样本泛化界；再据权衡提出 Multi-Depth JEPA，融合不同网络深度的表示。
Result: 验证实验中，latent 级预测在不可预测观测与困难规划任务下鲁棒性更强；Multi-Depth 的多深度表示在规划成功率上超过单深度表示和维度匹配的对照 (dimensionality-matched control)。
Conclusion: JEPA 的规划能力可由预训练误差经有限样本界约束，latent 维度决定近似-样本权衡，因此 latent 级、跨深度的表示预测比输入级重建更利于规划。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A functional central limit theorem for kernel gradient flow and infinitesimal gradient boosting
papers.abstract_en: Building on the large-sample analysis of infinitesimal gradient boosting (Dombry and Duchamps, 2024), we study the fluctuations of the process around its deterministic limit and establish a functional central limit theorem: the rescaled deviations converge in distribution to a Gaussian process. The analysis is carried out in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) naturally associated with the softmax gradient tree base learner, in which the boosting process is characterized as the solution of an autonomous ordinary differential equation (ODE). The proof rests on a general stochastic perturbation analysis of ODEs in Banach spaces, which is of independent interest: whenever a sequence of vector fields converges and satisfies a central limit theorem, so does the associated ODE solution. We first illustrate this perturbation approach in the simpler setting of kernel gradient flow, where the Gaussian limit admits an explicit characterization, and then consider the more complicated tree-based gradient boosting setting.
papers.comment: 53 pages; the new version mainly corrects issues related to compactness in Banach spaces
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明无穷小梯度提升 (infinitesimal gradient boosting) 围绕其确定性极限的涨落满足泛函中心极限定理：重标度偏差依分布收敛到高斯过程。核心工具是 Banach 空间中 ODE 的随机扰动分析——向量场序列收敛且满足 CLT 则对应 ODE 解也满足 CLT——先在 kernel gradient flow 上给出显式高斯极限，再用于 softmax 梯度树基学习器对应的 RKHS 中的 boosting 自治 ODE。
Motivation: 已有大样本分析只刻画了无穷小梯度提升的确定性极限，缺少围绕该极限的涨落刻画，无法给出不确定性或置信带；同时 Banach 空间中 ODE 解对向量场扰动的 CLT 传递性本身是可复用的工具性问题。
Method: 把 boosting 过程在与 softmax 梯度树基学习器自然关联的再生核 Hilbert 空间 (RKHS) 中表示为自治 ODE 的解；证明一般性结论：若向量场序列收敛且满足中心极限定理，则相应 ODE 解亦满足 CLT。先在 kernel gradient flow 这一较简单设定中演示该扰动方法并得到显式高斯极限，再处理基于树的梯度提升设定。
Result: 重标度偏差过程依分布收敛到高斯过程（泛函中心极限定理）；kernel gradient flow 情形的高斯极限有显式刻画；所用 Banach 空间 ODE 随机扰动分析被指出具有独立价值。论文为 53 页，新版本主要修正 Banach 空间中的紧性 (compactness) 相关问题。
Conclusion: 无穷小梯度提升的涨落可用 RKHS 中自治 ODE 的 CLT 传递性来刻画，从而把确定性极限结果推进到高斯过程层面的涨落描述。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI: From Foundations to Systems
papers.abstract_en: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI is a comprehensive practitioner's reference for building autonomous AI systems, covering the full stack from first principles to production deployment. The central thesis: building great agentic systems requires understanding every layer of the pipeline, not just one. The book opens with the LLM substrate, covering transformer architecture, GPU systems, training and fine-tuning (SFT, LoRA, MoE), model compression, and inference optimization, as essential foundations. It then develops the alignment and reasoning layer: RLHF, PPO, DPO and its variants, GRPO, reward modeling, and RL for large reasoning models including chain-of-thought and test-time scaling. The second half is devoted to agentic AI proper: agentic training and trajectory-based RL, RAG and Agentic RAG, memory systems (in-context, external, episodic, and semantic), agent harness design, loop engineering, graph-based orchestration, and a taxonomy of agent design patterns covering security, red teaming, and gateway infrastructure. Inter-agent coordination is covered in depth: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent skills and tool use, the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol, and multi-agent architectures spanning centralized, decentralized, and hierarchical topologies. The book concludes with agent development frameworks, agentic UI design, evaluation methodology (non-deterministic evaluation, reasoning collapse, LLM-as-Judge), production deployment, and the regulatory environment (EU AI Act, California SB 942) as an engineering requirement. Each chapter pairs theory with implementation guidance, executable notebooks, and references to the primary literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本面向工程实践者的 agentic AI 全栈参考书，主张构建好的自主智能体系统必须打通从 LLM 底座到生产部署的每一层，而不是只精通其中一层。内容覆盖 transformer/GPU 与训练微调（SFT、LoRA、MoE）、对齐与推理（RLHF、PPO、DPO、GRPO、思维链与 test-time scaling）、智能体训练与轨迹 RL、RAG 与记忆系统、MCP/A2A 协议与多智能体拓扑，以及评估方法与 EU AI Act、California SB 942 合规。
Motivation: 自主 AI 系统的开发知识分散在模型训练、对齐、智能体编排、评估与合规等互不衔接的层次里，实践者往往只熟悉单一层级，难以把系统从原型做到生产。
Method: 按层次组织的参考书结构：先给 LLM 底座（transformer、GPU 系统、SFT/LoRA/MoE、模型压缩、推理优化），再给对齐与推理层（RLHF、PPO、DPO 及其变体、GRPO、奖励建模、RL for large reasoning models），后半部给智能体层（trajectory-based RL、Agentic RAG、记忆系统、agent harness 与 loop engineering、图编排、设计模式分类、MCP/A2A、多智能体集中式/去中心化/分层拓扑），最后是评估（non-deterministic evaluation、reasoning collapse、LLM-as-Judge）、生产部署与监管。每章配理论、实现指引、可执行 notebook 与原始文献引用。
Result: 给出覆盖全栈的章节体系与可执行 notebook，评估方法一章列出 non-deterministic evaluation、reasoning collapse 与 LLM-as-Judge，合规部分点名 EU AI Act 与 California SB 942；摘要未给出任何基准、数据集或数值对比。
Conclusion: agentic 系统的质量取决于对整条流水线各层的联合理解，因此应按从底座到部署的完整层次来组织学习与工程实践，并把合规当作工程要求而非事后附加。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Low-power analogue neural networks with trainable nonlinear connections for continuous control
papers.abstract_en: Physical neural networks promise low-power machine learning by computing directly with analogue device physics, but most architectures force nonlinear device responses to act as scalar weights. Inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, we place trainable nonlinear functions on the connections, making each physical connection a learnable computational element. Realising these functions as analogue band-pass filters on field-programmable analogue arrays, we find that the benefit is task-dependent and follows from the smoothness of the physical basis: the networks represent smooth, continuously valued targets, including robotic kinematics, continuous control, and photovoltaic maximum-power-point tracking, with far fewer nodes and connections than multilayer perceptrons, but offer no parameter-efficiency advantage on classification-like decision boundaries. Trained networks transfer to hardware across approximately 35,000 connections with quantified fidelity, and a dedicated CMOS implementation is projected to operate at approximately 30 microwatts. A memristive realisation reproduces the same behaviour in simulation, indicating that the advantage comes from placing trainable nonlinearity on connections, rather than from a particular device.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可训练非线性函数放到物理连接上（受 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络启发），在场编程模拟阵列上用带通滤波器实现，使每个物理连接成为可学习的计算单元。对平滑连续值目标（机器人运动学、连续控制、光伏最大功率点跟踪）用远少于 MLP 的节点与连接即可表示，而在分类式决策边界上无参数效率优势；约 35,000 个连接可迁移到硬件，专用 CMOS 实现预计功耗约 30 微瓦。
Motivation: 物理神经网络通常把非线性器件响应当作标量权重，限制了模拟计算的表达能力与参数效率；需要判断把非线性放到连接上是否真能带来收益、收益在什么任务上成立。
Method: 受 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络启发，将可训练非线性函数置于连接上，用场编程模拟阵列 (field-programmable analogue arrays) 上的模拟带通滤波器实现这些函数；在机器人运动学、连续控制、光伏最大功率点跟踪等连续值任务与分类式任务上训练并与 MLP 对比，另用忆阻器实现做仿真复现。
Result: 平滑连续值任务上所需节点与连接远少于 MLP，分类式决策边界上无参数效率优势；训练后网络跨约 35,000 个连接迁移到硬件并量化保真度，专用 CMOS 实现预计约 30 微瓦；忆阻器仿真复现同样行为。
Conclusion: 参数效率优势来自把可训练非线性放在连接上这一结构本身，而非特定器件；优势取决于任务，随物理基函数的平滑性而定，适用于平滑连续值目标而非分类式边界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Is Agent Code Less Maintainable Than Human Code?
papers.abstract_en: Maintainability is a core dimension of software engineering, shaping how code is written, reviewed, and developed over time. While coding agents have demonstrated strong performance on single-issue tasks, it remains unclear how maintainable their code is when future agents build on top of it, potentially leading to compounding downstream effects. We investigate how agent code compares to human code in these maintenance settings, presenting CodeThread, a framework to construct controlled experiments from repository-level coding benchmarks. Applying CodeThread to four frontier coding agents and four benchmarks, we find that agents are less effective at resolving tasks when building on agent code compared to human code, with task resolve rate drops of up to 13.1%. Regression analysis reveals that many traditional software engineering maintainability metrics do not explain this difference. Instead, the clearest signals are subtler behavioral differences in agent code, such as changes to input validation and error handling, along with differences in downstream code size and task difficulty. These findings highlight the need to evaluate these systems not only by immediate task resolution but also by code maintainability, and point to potential sources of downstream errors introduced by agent code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CodeThread 框架，从仓库级编码基准构造受控实验，比较在 agent 代码与人类代码之上继续开发时的可维护性。对四个前沿 coding agent 与四个基准的实验显示，在 agent 代码上构建任务的解决率最多下降 13.1%。
Motivation: coding agent 在单 issue 任务上表现强，但后续 agent 在其代码之上继续开发时的可维护性未知，可能产生累积的下游影响。
Method: CodeThread 框架从仓库级编码基准构造受控实验，应用于四个前沿 coding agent 和四个基准；用回归分析检验传统软件工程可维护性指标能否解释解决率差异。
Result: 在 agent 代码上构建任务的 resolve rate 最多下降 13.1%；回归分析显示传统可维护性指标无法解释该差异，最清晰的信号是 agent 代码在输入校验与错误处理上的行为差异，以及下游代码规模与任务难度的差异。
Conclusion: 评估 coding agent 不能只看即时任务解决率，还要看代码可维护性；agent 代码引入下游错误的可能来源在于输入校验、错误处理等行为差异而非传统指标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OVIG: Optimistic Verification of AI Training Integrity via Gradient Signals
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of AI has increased the demand for domain-specific models. Post-training of open-source models offers a more economical way to meet this growing demand, but the cost of accelerator infrastructure often pushes organizations to outsource the process to third-party providers. An untrusted provider may deviate from the declared training procedure to save computation or inject malicious behavior. A potential solution is to audit the training by having an independent verifier replay the training and compare the results. This faces two key challenges: benign numerical drift from floating-point computation across heterogeneous accelerators is difficult to distinguish from malicious deviations, and the checkpoints and metadata required for verification introduce substantial storage and transmission costs. Existing approaches either have security limitations or high deployment costs. We present OVIG, an optimistic verification framework that verifies training using an empirical boundary on gradient differences calibrated from honest heterogeneous replay. Gradient differences that exceed this boundary are treated as malicious deviations. OVIG further uses optimistic verification and partitions training into stride-$s$ intervals, retaining evidence only at interval endpoints to reduce storage and transmission costs. Across shortcut training attacks and adaptive targeted manipulation attacks, OVIG maintains \(0\%\) ASR on language, vision, and diffusion workloads. On Qwen3, increasing the stride from \(s=1\) to \(s=2000\) reduces off-chain storage and evidence transmission by \(1996\times\) while preserving \(0\%\) ASR and only adds \(14.3\%\) system computation overhead relative to unverified training.

papers.title: Gen2-IC: Bridging Generative Models and Image Codecs through Latent Transport
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based image compression has achieved strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates. However, existing codecs are often tied to specific backbones and specialized components, making diverse, rapidly evolving generative models difficult to reuse. This raises a natural question: Can modern generative foundation models be connected to image compression through a simple and extensible interface? Two insights guide our design: stronger generative priors make a simpler codec interface viable, and generation and compression can be intrinsically linked through latent transport. We therefore propose Gen2-IC with two stages: (1) Latent Compression maps clean image latents to entropy-constrained latents; and (2) Latent Transport refines them with one near-terminal update based on the pretrained model. Gen2-IC requires neither auxiliary conditioning signals nor task-specific backbone modifications. With lightweight adaptation and no distillation, it supports fast encoding and one-step decoding across multiple bitrates. We validate Gen2-IC on SD-2.1, SANA-1.5, FLUX.1-dev, and Qwen-Image-2512, spanning U-Net and Transformer architectures as well as diffusion and flow-matching formulations. With stronger priors, Gen2-IC delivers gains below 0.05 bpp: the Qwen variant leads diffusion-based generative codecs in reconstruction fidelity (PSNR), perceptual similarity (LPIPS and DISTS), and recognizer-based semantic fidelity (OCR CER/WER and face-ROI similarity) across four benchmarks.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and expanded version of FlowCodec, renamed Gen2-IC; generalized methodological formulation and expanded technical and evaluation details
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gen2-IC 把任意预生成模型接成图像编解码器：先将干净图像 latent 压到熵约束 latent，再用预训练模型做一次近末端 latent transport 更新，无需辅助条件信号或骨干改造。在 SD-2.1、SANA-1.5、FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-2512 上验证，Qwen 变体在 0.05 bpp 以下于四个基准的 PSNR、LPIPS、DISTS 与 OCR CER/WER、face-ROI 相似度上领先扩散类生成编解码器。
Motivation: 扩散图像压缩感知质量强，但编解码器常绑定特定骨干与专用组件，快速演进的生成基础模型难以复用；需要一个简单可扩展的接口把生成模型接到压缩上。
Method: 两阶段：Latent Compression 将干净图像 latent 映射为熵约束 latent；Latent Transport 用预训练模型做一次近末端更新进行精化。轻量适配、无蒸馏，支持多码率快速编码与一步解码，覆盖 U-Net 与 Transformer 架构以及 diffusion 与 flow-matching 形式。
Result: 在 SD-2.1、SANA-1.5、FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-2512 四个骨干、四个基准上验证；0.05 bpp 以下 Qwen 变体在重建保真度 (PSNR)、感知相似度 (LPIPS、DISTS) 与识别器语义保真度 (OCR CER/WER、face-ROI 相似度) 上领先扩散类生成编解码器。
Conclusion: 生成先验越强，编解码器接口可以越简单：generation 与 compression 可经 latent transport 内在打通，无需骨干修改或蒸馏即可复用生成基础模型。

papers.title: SoftSkill: Behavioral Compression for Contextual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language skills let agents reuse task knowledge, yet deploying a long Markdown document makes the model interpret that knowledge anew on every call. We ask whether the behavior induced by a skill can be carried by a compact, trainable context. SoftSkill initializes virtual token embeddings from a skill document and optimizes a soft skill with next-token prediction while keeping the language model frozen. The resulting conditioning sequence can occupy the skill section or another supported prompt location. On Qwen3.5-4B, a 32-token soft skill improves over no skill by 7.6, 42.1, and 1.3 points on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA. It also exceeds the optimized textual skill on SearchQA and LiveMath by 4.5 and 12.5 points, respectively, while replacing skill documents of hundreds to thousands of tokens. The same approach improves multi-step agent execution: on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, OfficeQA and ALFWorld rise by 8.2 and 14.1 points over no skill; on Qwen3.5-4B with aligned action decoding, ALFWorld success rises from 44/134 with the untrained initialization to 91/134 after training. These findings show that a skill document can serve as the starting point for a continuous control that improves both answers and actions without updating the backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoftSkill 把自然语言技能文档蒸馏成一段可训练的虚拟 token 嵌入（soft skill），冻结语言模型只用 next-token prediction 优化这段连续上下文，用 32 个 token 替代数百到数千 token 的技能文档。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上 32-token soft skill 相对无技能在 SearchQA、LiveMath、DocVQA 上分别提升 7.6、42.1、1.3 分，相对优化过的文本技能在 SearchQA 和 LiveMath 上再高 4.5 和 12.5 分；多步智能体上 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 OfficeQA、ALFWorld 分别涨 8.2 和 14.1 分，ALFWorld 成功率从 44/134 升到 91/134。
Motivation: 自然语言技能虽可复用任务知识，但每次调用都要重新解释一份长 Markdown 文档，token 开销大且行为控制不直接。
Method: 从技能文档初始化虚拟 token 嵌入，在语言模型完全冻结的条件下用 next-token prediction 优化这段 soft skill；得到的条件序列可放进 prompt 的技能段或其他受支持位置，同时支持对齐动作解码 (aligned action decoding) 的多步智能体执行。
Result: Qwen3.5-4B 上 32-token soft skill 相对无技能在 SearchQA、LiveMath、DocVQA 上分别 +7.6、+42.1、+1.3 分；相对优化过的文本技能在 SearchQA、LiveMath 上分别 +4.5、+12.5 分，而 token 数从数百至数千降到 32。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上 OfficeQA、ALFWorld 相对无技能 +8.2、+14.1 分；Qwen3.5-4B 配 aligned action decoding 时 ALFWorld 成功率从训练前初始化的 44/134 升到训练后的 91/134。
Conclusion: 技能文档可以当作连续控制的起点：优化后的 soft skill 在不更新骨干模型的前提下同时改善答案质量与多步动作执行，并把技能的 token 占用压到几十量级。

papers.title: DeepForestVisionV2: Ecology-Driven Taxonomy Expansion for Camera-Trap Monitoring in African Tropical Forests
papers.abstract_en: Camera-trap monitoring in African tropical forests increasingly extends beyond closed-canopy interiors to riverbanks, clearings, and park edges. Among available open tools for African forest camera-trap classification, DeepForestVision is the only one providing a matched offline workflow for both photographs and videos, and previous work showed that it outperformed other available baselines on a comparable benchmark. However, it was designed for closed-canopy, ground-level forest interiors and uses a 35-class prediction space that becomes too coarse when deployments encounter arboreal primates, birds, semi-aquatic taxa, or human-associated confounders such as livestock. We present DeepForestVisionV2, an ecology-driven expansion from 35 to 64 prediction classes (61 animal classes plus human, vehicle, and blank) designed to address three recurrent deployment gradients: vertical stratification, scene openness, and anthropogenic interfaces. DeepForestVisionV2 retains the same offline workflow and is trained on 1,535,010 photographs and 243,354 videos from multi-country African tropical-forest projects. Evaluation combines a cross-country cropped-photo validation set, used to assess robustness across sites and camera-trap settings, with three held-out Uganda video benchmarks spanning the targeted gradients. On the validation set, DeepForestVisionV2 reaches 0.86 accuracy, 0.82 macro-F1, and 0.81 balanced accuracy. On the deployment benchmarks, it preserves or improves baseline accuracy despite its harder classification task, while increasing the number of identified taxa from 22 to 29 in forest-interior videos and from 4 to 9 at riverbanks. In the park-edge use case, it raises accuracy from 0.62 to 0.86 and reduces false alarms from 11 to 0. These results show that DeepForestVisionV2 materially improves field utility while preserving robustness across sites, habitats, and camera-trap settings.
papers.comment: Published in Pattern Recognition. ICPR 2026 International Workshops (LNCS 17113, pp. 252-265). Please cite the published version: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-39518-4_17
papers.journal_ref: In: Sintorn, IM., Pal, U., Lu, S. (eds) Pattern Recognition. ICPR 2026 International Workshops. ICPR 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 17113. Springer, Cham
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepForestVisionV2 把非洲热带森林相机陷阱分类空间从 35 类扩到 64 类（61 动物 + 人、车辆、空白），针对垂直分层、场景开阔度、人为界面三条部署梯度。在跨国家裁剪照片验证集上 accuracy 0.86、macro-F1 0.82、balanced accuracy 0.81；公园边缘场景 accuracy 从 0.62 升到 0.86、误报从 11 降到 0，林内识别物种数 22→29、河岸 4→9。
Motivation: 原 DeepForestVision 面向闭郁林下层地面视角，35 类预测空间在遇到树栖灵长类、鸟类、半水生物种或牲畜等人为混淆物时过粗，无法覆盖河岸、林窗、公园边缘等新开阔部署场景。
Method: 生态驱动的类别体系扩展（35→64 类），保留原离线照片+视频工作流；用 1,535,010 张照片与 243,354 段视频（多国非洲热带森林项目）训练；评测由跨国家裁剪照片验证集与三个留出的 Uganda 视频基准（对应三条部署梯度）组成。
Result: 跨国家验证集 accuracy 0.86、macro-F1 0.82、balanced accuracy 0.81；部署基准上在更难的分类任务下保持或提升基线 accuracy，林内视频识别物种数 22→29、河岸 4→9，公园边缘 accuracy 0.62→0.86、误报 11→0。
Conclusion: 把类别空间按生态部署梯度扩展能在不牺牲跨站点、跨生境稳健性的前提下实质提升野外可用性，尤其是公园边缘这类人为干扰场景。

papers.title: EventVLA: Event-Driven Visual Evidence Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Memory remains a critical bottleneck for long-horizon robotic manipulation, as standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often fail when task-relevant cues become occluded or unobservable over time. While existing memory-augmented methods utilize historical context, they either suffer from severe information bottlenecks, incur high latency via decoupled dual systems, or rely on unselective buffers that accumulate massive visual redundancies. To address these limitations, we introduce EventVLA, an end-to-end framework founded on the concept of sparse visual evidence memory that comprises two core components: foundational visual anchors to retain initial and short-term contexts, and a dynamic Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) module. Specifically, KEM directly predicts future keyframe probabilities from the VLA's latent embeddings to autonomously capture and store sparse, task-critical visual events. This foresight-driven mechanism empowers the policy to dynamically evaluate the future causal utility of current observations, preserving transient visual evidence before it becomes unobservable. Furthermore, we propose RoboTwin-MeM, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate non-Markovian manipulation tasks with interactive visual evidence. Extensive evaluations show that across 17 memory-requiring simulation tasks and 4 real-world bimanual tasks, EventVLA achieves an average success rate improvement of +40% over state-of-the-art memory-augmented VLAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EventVLA 把长程操作的记忆做成稀疏视觉证据记忆：用基础视觉锚保留初始与短期上下文，再由 Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) 从 VLA 潜表示直接预测未来关键帧概率，在证据被遮挡前抢先存下任务关键画面。在 17 个需记忆的仿真任务与 4 个真实双臂任务上，平均成功率较 SOTA 记忆增强 VLA 提升 +40%。
Motivation: 长程机器人操作中任务关键线索会随时间被遮挡或变得不可观测，现有记忆增强方法要么信息瓶颈严重，要么靠解耦双系统带来高延迟，要么用无选择缓冲堆积大量视觉冗余。
Method: 端到端框架 EventVLA，含两部分：基础视觉锚 (foundational visual anchors) 保留初始与短期上下文；动态 Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) 模块从 VLA 潜嵌入直接预测未来关键帧概率，自主捕获并存储稀疏任务关键视觉事件，由前瞻性机制评估当前观测的未来因果效用。同时提出诊断基准 RoboTwin-MeM，针对带交互视觉证据的非马尔可夫操作任务。
Result: 在 17 个需记忆的仿真任务与 4 个真实双臂任务上，EventVLA 平均成功率较 SOTA 记忆增强 VLA 提升 +40%。
Conclusion: 稀疏、前瞻驱动的关键帧证据记忆可以让 VLA 在线索变得不可观测之前保住瞬时视觉证据，从而支撑长程非马尔可夫操作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Temporal Self-Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon policies trained with reinforcement learning can still achieve high return through inefficient interactions, while rare efficient behaviors discovered during training may be forgotten. We argue that temporal efficiency itself provides a source of self-supervision for reinforcement learning. We introduce Temporal Self-Imitation Learning (TSIL), a reinforcement learning framework that mines temporally efficient successful trajectories generated during learning and converts them into reusable supervision for future policy improvement. TSIL progressively refines learning using configuration-conditioned adaptive temporal targets derived from fast successful trajectories, while preserving and replaying efficient behaviors through efficiency-weighted self-imitation learning. Across 30 long-horizon tasks spanning robot manipulation and interactive navigation, TSIL consistently improves task success rates, learning efficiency, behavioral efficiency, and robustness to unstable training conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TSIL 把训练过程中挖出的时间上更高效的成功轨迹转成可复用的自监督信号：用配置条件化的自适应时间目标逐步收紧策略，并以效率加权的自模仿回放保住罕见高效行为。在覆盖机器人操作与交互导航的 30 个长时程任务上，任务成功率、学习效率、行为效率与训练不稳条件下的鲁棒性均一致提升。
Motivation: 长时程 RL 策略即使拿到高回报也可能靠低效交互达成，训练中偶然出现的高效行为会被后续更新遗忘，缺少可复用的自我监督信号。
Method: TSIL 从学习过程中生成的成功轨迹里挖掘时间效率更高的样本，构造 configuration-conditioned adaptive temporal target 做渐进式策略改进，再用 efficiency-weighted self-imitation learning 保留并回放高效行为。
Result: 在 30 个长时程任务（机器人操作 + 交互导航）上，任务成功率、学习效率、行为效率以及在不稳定训练条件下的鲁棒性均得到一致改善。
Conclusion: 时间效率本身可以充当 RL 的自监督来源：把高效成功轨迹转成自模仿目标，能在长时程任务中同时提升成功率与行为效率，并增强对训练不稳的抵抗力。

papers.title: Optimal scenario design for climate emulation
papers.abstract_en: As deep learning for physical systems continues to grow in popularity, efforts to improve generalizability have primarily focused on designing architectures that embed physical constraints. However, for machine-learning surrogate climate models (emulators), we show that the low structural diversity in existing scenarios commonly used to generate training data places a ceiling on predictive skill. Here, we examine whether training datasets themselves can be optimized to improve generalization. We introduce a method to create datasets that produce emulators capable of generalizing to new, structurally different scenarios absent from the training data. We use a differentiable Simple Climate Model (SCM) to calculate the sensitivity of emulator loss to perturbations in the training data, iteratively updating the training data to maximize emulator skill. For an SCM, training on one scenario optimized in this fashion outperforms an emulator trained on six standard ScenarioMIP pathways. We achieve this higher predictive skill despite training on a smaller dataset, finding that our emulator successfully isolates distinct physical behaviors of different climate forcing agents (e.g., greenhouse gases vs. aerosols) without single-forcing runs. We then demonstrate that scenarios optimized using an SCM, when used to drive an intermediate-complexity climate model, produce a training dataset that yields a more skillful emulator than training on ScenarioMIP outputs. Our results suggest that, in the compute-constrained environment of running full-scale climate models, generating a small number of dynamically rich scenarios provides greater marginal value for emulation and characterizing system responses than expanding the suite of traditional emissions pathways.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对气候代理模型 (emulator) 泛化受限于训练场景结构单一，提出用可微 Simple Climate Model (SCM) 计算代理损失对训练数据扰动的敏感度，迭代改写训练场景以最大化代理技能。只用一个这样优化出的场景训练，泛化到训练集外结构不同的场景时优于用六条标准 ScenarioMIP 路径训练的代理，且数据量更小；该优化场景驱动中等复杂度气候模型后，产出的训练集仍比 ScenarioMIP 输出训练的代理更有技能。
Motivation: 现有气候 emulator 的泛化改进集中在把物理约束嵌入架构，但生成训练数据的场景结构多样性低，给预测技能设了上限；在跑不动全尺度气候模式的算力约束下，需要判断训练数据本身能否被优化。
Method: 用可微 Simple Climate Model (SCM) 反传得到 emulator loss 对训练数据扰动的敏感度，迭代更新训练数据以最大化 emulator 技能；再把 SCM 上优化出的场景用于驱动一个中等复杂度气候模型，生成第二组训练数据。
Result: 在 SCM 上，单个优化场景训练的 emulator 在训练数据更小的情况下，超过用六条标准 ScenarioMIP 路径训练的 emulator；该 emulator 无需 single-forcing runs 即可区分温室气体与气溶胶等不同强迫剂的物理行为；用 SCM 优化场景驱动中等复杂度气候模型所得训练集，训练出的 emulator 也比用 ScenarioMIP 输出训练的更有技能。
Conclusion: 在算力受限、跑不动全尺度气候模式的条件下，生成少量动态丰富的场景比扩充传统排放路径集合对 emulator 和系统响应刻画的边际价值更大。

papers.title: Skill-MAS: Evolving Meta-Skill for Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has become a crucial frontier for tackling complex tasks. However, existing methods face a dilemma between model capability and experience retention. Inference-time MAS leverages frozen frontier LLMs but repeats identical searches without learning from past experience. Conversely, Training-time MAS internalizes experience via gradient updates but is constrained by the low capability ceiling of smaller models, and is hard to scale to large frontier LLMs. To bridge this gap, we propose Skill-MAS, a novel third path that decouples experience retention from parametric updates by conceptualizing the high-level orchestration capability as an evolvable Meta-Skill. Skill-MAS refines this architectural knowledge through a closed optimization loop: (1) Multi-Trajectory Rollout samples a behavioral distribution for each task under the current Meta-Skill; and (2) Selective Reflection adaptively selects priority tasks and applies hierarchical contrastive analysis to distill systemic experience into generalizable, strategy-level principles. Extensive experiments across four complex benchmarks and four distinct LLMs demonstrate that Skill-MAS not only achieves remarkable performance gains but also maintains a favorable cost-performance trade-off. Further analysis reveals that the evolved Meta-Skills are highly robust and exhibit strong transferability across unseen tasks and different LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Skill-MAS 把多智能体系统的高层编排能力抽成可进化的 Meta-Skill，用 Multi-Trajectory Rollout 采样行为分布、Selective Reflection 做分层对比反思，把系统经验蒸馏成策略级原则，从而在不更新模型参数的前提下保留经验。在四个复杂 benchmark、四种 LLM 上取得性能提升并保持成本-性能权衡，进化出的 Meta-Skill 对未见任务和不同 LLM 迁移性强。
Motivation: 推理时 MAS 用冻结的前沿 LLM 却每次重复相同搜索、不积累经验；训练时 MAS 靠梯度更新内化经验，但受限于小模型能力上限且难扩展到前沿 LLM，两者形成能力与经验保留的两难。
Method: 把高层编排能力概念化为可进化的 Meta-Skill，通过闭环优化：Multi-Trajectory Rollout 在当前 Meta-Skill 下为每个任务采样行为分布；Selective Reflection 自适应挑选优先任务，用分层对比分析 (hierarchical contrastive analysis) 把系统经验蒸馏为可泛化的策略级原则。
Result: 在四个复杂 benchmark 和四种不同 LLM 上的实验显示 Skill-MAS 取得显著性能提升并保持有利的成本-性能权衡；进一步分析表明进化出的 Meta-Skill 高度鲁棒，在未见任务与不同 LLM 间迁移性强。
Conclusion: 把经验保留与参数更新解耦、以可进化 Meta-Skill 承载编排知识，是绕开小模型能力上限的第三条路径，且学到的策略级原则可跨任务跨模型复用。

papers.title: Do Gaussian Scenes Contain Enough Structure for Intrinsic Segmentation?
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian segmentation is usually posed as transferring object knowledge from 2D foundation models into a 3D representation. This leaves a fundamental question unanswered: how much object structure is already encoded by a trained gaussian scene? We investigate this question with GS-IntSeg, an intrinsic, mask-free, and training-free method that constructs partitions using only: gaussian geometry, opacity, spherical-harmonic radiance, and deformation trajectories. On the dynamic Neu3D and HyperNeRF datasets, GS-IntSeg obtains a mean of 0.677 mIoU across multi-view and monocular scenes without masks, external features, or segmentation training. This intrinsic formulation also enables GS-IntSeg to require approximately 2.5 minutes per HyperNeRF scene on a consumer RTX 5080 to construct its partitions, over 10x faster than SAM-based methods that require mask generation, feature rendering, and other stages. These results suggest that gaussians alone can approach mask-supervised performance in gaussian scenes segmentation. While a gap remains between intrinsic and foundation model based methods, to our knowledge, GS-IntSeg is the first mask-free approach to gaussian segmentation, motivating a re-evaluation of the assumption that gaussian scene segmentation must be based on external masks and pointing toward an alternative faster, more generalizable segmentation approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GS-IntSeg 仅用高斯几何、不透明度、球谐辐射与形变轨迹对高斯场景做无掩码、免训练的内在分割，在动态 Neu3D 与 HyperNeRGB 上多视角与单目场景平均 mIoU 0.677，单个 HyperNeRGB 场景在 RTX 5080 上约 2.5 分钟，比 SAM 类方法快 10 倍以上。结果表明高斯本身已编码足够物体结构，可逼近掩码监督性能，但与基于基础模型的方法仍有差距。
Motivation: 高斯分割通常被当作把 2D 基础模型的物体知识迁移到 3D 表示的问题，回避了一个根本问题：训练好的高斯场景本身编码了多少物体结构。
Method: 提出 GS-IntSeg：一种内在、无掩码 (mask-free)、免训练的方法，仅用高斯几何、不透明度、球谐 (spherical-harmonic) 辐射与形变轨迹构建分割，不使用掩码、外部特征或分割训练。
Result: 在动态 Neu3D 与 HyperNeRGB 数据集上，多视角与单目场景平均 mIoU 0.677（无掩码、无外部特征、无分割训练）；每个 HyperNeRGB 场景在消费级 RTX 5080 上约 2.5 分钟完成划分，比需要掩码生成与特征渲染等阶段的 SAM 类方法快 10 倍以上。
Conclusion: 高斯本身足以在高斯场景分割中逼近掩码监督性能，首个无掩码高斯分割方法的结果促使重新审视「高斯分割必须依赖外部掩码」这一假设；内在方法与基于基础模型的方法之间仍存在差距。

papers.title: Non-negative Matrix Factorisation with Topological Regularisation
papers.abstract_en: Non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF) learns additive representations from data, but non-negativity alone does not ensure interpretable basis functions. We introduce Top-NMF, which guides basis learning through general topological preferences without prescribing the detailed form of the components. Observations and basis vectors are treated as non-negative functions on structured domains. Discrete topological conditions are difficult to optimise directly. Our guiding viewpoint is that persistent homology provides a stable, continuous relaxation of ordinary homological invariants: it tracks connected components and loops across thresholds, allowing structural preferences to be expressed through continuous scores suitable for optimisation. We construct such scores for connected image parts, clique-like graph structure, and periodic time-series components, and incorporate them into a common NMF objective. For graph data, we derive an exact maximum-weight-spanning-tree formula and characterise all local minimisers of the score, showing that their positive-weight edges form disjoint cliques. We establish the regularity of the scores, describe their derivatives, and analyse projected first-order optimisation. Numerical studies on synthetic and real data demonstrate how these priors guide basis learning and examine the balance between structural agreement, atom recovery, and reconstruction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Top-NMF 把持久同调 (persistent homology) 作为连续松弛的拓扑正则项加入 NMF 目标，用连通分量与环的连续分数表达结构先验，从而在不规定成分具体形式的前提下引导基向量学习。图数据上导出精确的最大权生成树公式并刻画全部局部极小，其正权边构成不相交团；数值研究检验结构一致性、原子恢复与重建精度之间的权衡。
Motivation: NMF 仅靠非负性无法保证基函数可解释，而离散拓扑条件难以直接优化，需要一种可微、可并入统一目标的结构偏好表达方式。
Method: 把观测与基向量视为结构化域上的非负函数，用持久同调在阈值上跟踪连通分量与环，构造针对图像连通区域、图中类团结构、时间序列周期成分的连续分数并入同一 NMF 目标；对图数据推导精确的最大权生成树 (maximum-weight-spanning-tree) 公式，分析分数正则性、导数与投影一阶优化。
Result: 图数据的分数局部极小被完全刻画，其正权边构成不相交团；在合成与真实数据上给出数值研究，展示这些先验如何引导基学习，并考察结构一致性、原子恢复与重建精度三者的平衡。

papers.title: ActiveSAM: Fast and Accurate Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Frozen SAM 3
papers.abstract_en: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) provides a strong frozen backbone for concept-prompted segmentation, but applying it directly to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) is inefficient: full-resolution decoding is typically run over the entire dataset vocabulary, whereas each image contains only a small active subset of classes. We introduce ActiveSAM, a training-free inference framework that turns SAM 3 into an active-vocabulary segmenter. ActiveSAM first canonicalizes and expands class prompts, then uses evidence-proportional grounding to estimate an image-conditioned active set from a low-resolution presence preview. Only retained prompts receive full-resolution mask prediction, using bucketed prompt multiplexing with the frozen SAM 3 decoder. The preview stage uses only class-presence evidence and skips unnecessary segmentation-head computation. To resolve overlapping concept responses, exclusive concept decoding compares each pixel's joint score vector with class signatures estimated once per vocabulary from unlabeled images. ActiveSAM requires no weight updates, no oracle class-presence labels and no per-dataset hyperparameter tuning. Across eight OVSS benchmarks, ActiveSAM improves the speed-accuracy tradeoff of training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, outperforming the current state-of-the-art SegEarth-OV3 by +2.1 mIoU on average while running much faster, with 7.3-12.2x speedups on large-vocabulary datasets. ActiveSAM also achieves the highest accuracy under image corruptions that simulate real-world distribution shift, making it well-suited for deployment in noisy-input domains such as autonomous driving and embodied AI. Code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/ActiveSAM
papers.comment: Preprint. Code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/ActiveSAM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActiveSAM 把冻结的 SAM 3 改造成免训练的开放词汇语义分割 (OVSS) 推理框架：先低分辨率预览估计每图活跃类别子集，只对保留的 prompt 走全分辨率解码。在八个 OVSS 基准上平均比 SegEarth-OV3 高 +2.1 mIoU，大词汇数据集提速 7.3–12.2 倍，图像损坏条件下精度最高。
Motivation: SAM 3 直接做 OVSS 时要对整个数据集词汇跑全分辨率解码，而单图只含少量类别，算力浪费严重；现有免训练方法在速度与精度上难以兼顾。
Method: 免训练推理框架：先规范化并扩展类别 prompt，用低分辨率 presence preview 做 evidence-proportional grounding 估计图像条件下的活跃类别集，仅保留的 prompt 进入冻结 SAM 3 解码器的 bucketed prompt multiplexing 全分辨率掩码预测；重叠概念用 exclusive concept decoding，将每像素联合得分向量与每词汇一次、由无标注图像估计的类别签名比较。全程无权重更新、无 oracle 类别存在标签、无逐数据集调参。
Result: 在八个 OVSS 基准上平均 mIoU 超过当前 SOTA SegEarth-OV3 +2.1，且运行快得多；在大词汇数据集上取得 7.3–12.2 倍加速；在模拟真实分布偏移的图像损坏 (image corruptions) 条件下取得最高精度。
Conclusion: 免训练的活跃词汇筛选加专属概念解码即可同时改善 OVSS 的速度-精度权衡，并在噪声输入域（自动驾驶、具身 AI）保持最强鲁棒性。

papers.title: Elastic ODYN: Differentiable Optimization for Infeasible Control and Learning in Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Robotic systems routinely encounter conflicting objectives, modeling errors, and degenerate contact conditions that render quadratic programs (QPs) infeasible. Yet most optimization solvers and differentiable QP layers assume feasibility, leading to numerical failures, unstable gradients, or solver breakdown when constraints cannot be simultaneously satisfied. We present Elastic ODYN, a primal-dual non-interior-point QP solver that handles infeasibility through smooth squared-$\ell_2$ elastic relaxations. The formulation remains well posed under ill-conditioning and degeneracy, supports warm starting, and converges to closest-to-feasible solutions, with lightweight refinement recovering physically meaningful dual variables. Building on this framework, we develop Elastic ODYNLayer, a differentiable QP layer with stable gradients under infeasibility, and Elastic OdynSQP, an SQP method that resolves inconsistent subproblems and intrinsically infeasible optimal control tasks through selective constraint elasticity. Across benchmark QPs, singular contact mechanics, differentiable parameter identification, and quadrupedal and humanoid trajectory optimization, Elastic ODYN outperforms state-of-the-art elastic QP solvers in robustness, warm-start performance, and convergence reliability, enabling optimization, simulation, control, and learning beyond standard feasibility assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Elastic ODYN 是一个用光滑平方 ℓ2 弹性松弛处理不可行性的 primal-dual 非内点 QP 求解器，并在其上构建可微 QP 层 Elastic ODYNLayer 与 SQP 方法 Elastic OdynSQP。在病态与退化下仍良定、支持 warm start 并收敛到最接近可行的解，在基准 QP、奇异接触力学、可微参数辨识以及四足与人形轨迹优化上优于 SOTA 弹性 QP 求解器的鲁棒性、warm-start 与收敛可靠性。
Motivation: 机器人中的冲突目标、建模误差与退化接触使 QP 不可行，而多数求解器与可微 QP 层假设可行，导致数值失败、梯度不稳或求解器崩溃。
Method: primal-dual 非内点 QP 求解器，用光滑平方 ℓ2 弹性松弛 (elastic relaxations) 处理不可行性，配合轻量 refinement 恢复有物理意义的对偶变量；其上构建可微层 Elastic ODYNLayer（不可行下梯度稳定）与 Elastic OdynSQP（选择性约束弹性处理不一致子问题与本征不可行的最优控制任务）。
Result: 在基准 QP、奇异接触力学、可微参数辨识、四足与人形轨迹优化上，Elastic ODYN 在鲁棒性、warm-start 性能与收敛可靠性上优于 SOTA 弹性 QP 求解器；论文为 8 页、5 图、3 表。
Conclusion: 把弹性松弛直接放进 primal-dual 非内点求解器，可让优化、仿真、控制与学习越过标准可行性假设继续工作。

papers.title: A Safety-First Gateway Architecture for Trusted Public Health Resource Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI can improve access to public health information, but public-facing healthcare applications require safeguards against inappropriate medical guidance and unsupported generation. We present a Safety-First Science Gateway for maternal and child health (MCH) resource navigation that combines large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a multi-layer safety architecture. The gateway integrates emergency handling, domain/scope screening, source attribution, anonymous session management, and operational audit logging while restricting retrieval to curated institutional resources. We describe the gateway architecture, prototype implementation, and functional verification of selected workflows. The current system provides resource provenance and safety-bounded navigation; it does not constitute a clinical decision-support system or automated claim-by-claim verification of generated health information. This work provides a reusable architectural framework for conversational navigation of curated public-health resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向母婴健康 (MCH) 资源导航的 Safety-First Science Gateway：把 LLM 与 RAG 嵌进多层安全架构，检索范围限定在人工整理的机构资源，并叠加紧急处理、领域/范围筛查、来源归因、匿名会话与审计日志。系统提供可溯源且受安全边界约束的导航，作者明确其不是临床决策支持系统，也不做逐条声明的自动核验。
Motivation: 面向公众的医疗对话应用容易给出不当医疗建议和无依据生成，而母婴健康资源导航需要在开放问答与安全边界之间找到可复用的架构方案。
Method: 组合 LLM 与 RAG，检索仅限 curated 机构资源；多层安全架构包含紧急处理、domain/scope screening、source attribution、匿名会话管理和 operational audit logging，并给出原型实现与部分工作流的功能性验证 (functional verification)。
Result: 交付了网关架构描述、原型实现以及对选定工作流的功能性验证；系统当前提供资源溯源与安全边界内的导航，不构成临床决策支持系统，也不做生成健康信息的逐条自动核验。
Conclusion: 对话式公共卫生资源导航可以靠检索范围收紧加多层安全模块做成可复用的架构框架，其定位是导航而非临床判断或事实核验。

papers.title: JointEdit3D: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Editing in a Unified Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D scene editing methods typically rely on per-scene optimization over explicit 3D representations or cascaded edit-and-reconstruct pipelines, resulting in high test-time cost, limited 3D awareness, and structural inconsistencies. To couple appearance synthesis with geometry prediction, we adapt a pretrained unified RGB-geometry latent space to feed-forward scene editing. Given a source video and an edited reference image, JointEdit3D performs asymmetric latent inpainting: it observes only the edited RGB reference latent and jointly generates the remaining RGB latents and the entire geometry latent along the source trajectory. JointEdit3D introduces a dedicated SceneAnchor Branch to inject source-scene structure without forcing direct copying, and adopts edit/background-aware losses to balance edited-region fidelity with unedited-content preservation. To address the lack of paired resources for standardized 3D scene editing evaluation, we introduce SceneEdit3D-15K, a dataset with 15K paired editing samples and renderer-provided 3D annotations, together with SceneEdit3D-Bench, a curated 100-sample benchmark. Experiments show that JointEdit3D improves edited-region quality and 3D structural completeness over prior baselines while maintaining competitive background preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JointEdit3D 把预训练的统一 RGB-几何 latent space 改造成前馈式 3D 场景编辑：给定源视频与编辑参考图，只观测编辑后 RGB 参考 latent，沿源轨迹联合生成其余 RGB latent 与全部几何 latent。配套发布含 15K 配对样本与渲染器 3D 标注的 SceneEdit3D-15K 及 100 样本的 SceneEdit3D-Bench，实验显示编辑区域质量与 3D 结构完整性优于既有基线，同时背景保持能力相当。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景编辑要么逐场景优化显式 3D 表示、要么级联编辑再重建，测试时开销大、3D 感知弱且结构不一致；同时缺少标准化的 3D 场景编辑评测资源。
Method: 将预训练统一 RGB-几何 latent space 适配到前馈编辑，采用非对称 latent inpainting：仅观测编辑 RGB 参考 latent，联合生成剩余 RGB latent 与沿源轨迹的完整几何 latent；用 SceneAnchor Branch 注入源场景结构而不强制直接复制，并以 edit/background-aware 损失平衡编辑区保真与未编辑内容保持。
Result: 构建 SceneEdit3D-15K（15K 配对编辑样本、渲染器提供的 3D 标注）与 SceneEdit3D-Bench（100 个精选样本）；实验显示编辑区域质量与 3D 结构完整性优于先前基线，同时保持有竞争力的背景保持效果。
Conclusion: 把外观合成与几何预测耦合进统一 latent 空间做前馈编辑，可绕开逐场景优化与级联重建的代价，并补齐 3D 场景编辑的配对评测资源。

papers.title: Space-sampled Value Decay: Forgetting Mechanisms for Non-stationary Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning agents deployed on physical systems must adapt continually, since degradation and shifting environment conditions change the dynamics (they \emph{drift}) over time. In the hardest version of this problem, the agent interacts with a single system that might drift at every timestep, leaving no opportunity to revisit past conditions -- a setting we call Single Environment, One-Shot Non-Stationary Reinforcement Learning (SEOS-NSRL). We argue that this setting calls for selective forgetting rather than re-learning, and introduce Space-sampled Value Decay (SsVD), which pulls value estimates of randomly chosen elements of the state space to a baseline value, so that outdated information in non visited regions is discarded. SsVD does not require resetting or change-point detection and plugs into modern off-policy algorithms; we integrate it into Soft Actor Critic and Deep Q-Networks. Across 6 non-stationary environments, SsVD improves upon its direct base algorithms and attains the best mean rank across all. The SsVD mechanism can also induce optimism which we show on hard-exploration tasks, although we investigate the connection here only briefly.
papers.comment: An earlier version (v1) was presented at EIML@ICML2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Space-sampled Value Decay (SsVD)：在单环境、每步都可能漂移且无法回访旧状态的 SEOS-NSRL 设定下，随机抽取状态空间元素把其价值估计拉回基线值，主动丢弃未访问区域的过时信息。SsVD 无需重置或变点检测，可直接嵌入 Soft Actor-Critic 与 DQN；在 6 个非平稳环境中均优于其直接基算法，并取得全体方法中最好的平均排名。
Motivation: 部署在物理系统上的 RL 智能体因设备退化与环境条件变化而动力学漂移，最难的情形是只能与单一系统交互、每步都可能漂移，没有机会回访过去条件，旧价值估计因此持续误导决策。
Method: SsVD 对状态空间中随机选取的元素施加价值衰减，把其 value estimate 拉向一个基线值，从而丢弃未被访问区域的过时信息；机制不依赖重置或变点检测，作为插件集成进 off-policy 算法 Soft Actor-Critic 与 Deep Q-Networks。
Result: 在 6 个非平稳环境上，SsVD 相对其直接基算法（SAC、DQN）均有提升，并在全部方法中取得最好的平均排名；在 hard-exploration 任务上该机制还能诱导 optimism，作者对这一联系只做了简要考察。
Conclusion: 在无法回访历史条件的持续漂移设定下，选择性遗忘（随机空间采样的价值衰减）比重学更有效，且可作为即插即用模块嫁接到现代 off-policy 算法上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: UPLOTS: A Unified Pretrained Language Model for Constrained Time-series Generation
papers.abstract_en: In time-series generation, existing approaches typically handcraft ortrain a separate model for each dataset, which hinders their scalability and fails to leverage shared temporal structures across domains. To address this fragmentation, we propose UPLOTS, a Unified, Prompt-guided Language model framework fOr constrained Time-Series Generation across diverse domains. Instead of building task-specific models, UPLOTS leverages a single pre-trained transformer backbone guided by learned constraint prompts, enabling on-demand generation with precise pattern control. One key innovation is our dynamic multi-dataset loss re-weighting and prompt-to-pattern mapping, which allows UPLOTS to internalize diverse temporal structures during training and conditionally generate them at inference. We evaluate UPLOTS on four real-world benchmarks and multiple constraint settings, including peak-period, calendar, load-level, and volatility patterns. Additional held-out constraint-combination and downstream forecasting experiments further demonstrate that UPLOTS generalizes beyond the original peak-pattern setting and improves data augmentation under scarce real-data regimes. Our code and baselines are available at github repo: https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/UPLOTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UPLOTS 用单一预训练 Transformer 主干加可学习的约束 prompt，按 prompt 到模式的映射在推理时按需生成受约束时间序列，取代逐数据集手工建模。在四个真实基准与峰值、日历、负荷水平、波动率等约束设置上验证，并在留出的约束组合与下游预报实验中显示可泛化到原峰值模式之外、并在真实数据稀缺时改善数据增强。
Motivation: 时间序列生成通常为每个数据集单独手工设计或训练模型，难以扩展，也无法跨领域共享时间结构。
Method: UPLOTS 以单一预训练 Transformer 主干配合学习得到的约束 prompt 做按需生成；核心是动态多数据集损失重加权与 prompt-to-pattern 映射，使模型在训练中内化多种时间结构、在推理时条件化生成。
Result: 在四个真实世界基准与多种约束设置（peak-period、calendar、load-level、volatility）上评估；额外的留出约束组合实验与下游预报实验显示其泛化超出原始峰值模式设置，并在真实数据稀缺情形下改善数据增强效果。
Conclusion: 跨领域的时间序列生成可以统一到一个带约束 prompt 的预训练语言模型框架里，靠损失重加权与 prompt 映射实现模式的条件控制与跨设置泛化。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Generalizing Geometry-Guided Mamba as a Plug-and-Play Context Module for CNN-based Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: CNN-based semantic segmentation networks usually rely on context heads such as ASPP, PPM, or attention modules to enlarge the receptive field. These heads are effective but may introduce heavy computation, memory cost, or boundary leakage. This paper revisits Directional Geometric Mamba (G-Mamba) from DGM-Net and studies it as a plug-and-play context aggregation module rather than a completely new segmentation architecture. The key idea is to inject geometric guidance into the selective scan process, allowing long-range feature propagation to be modulated by boundary and centripetal-flow cues. We replace the original context heads of six representative CNN segmentation models, including DeepLabV3+, DANet, CCNet, PSPNet, PSANet, and OCRNet, while keeping the ResNet-101 backbone unchanged. On CCNet, we additionally compare serial and parallel combinations of criss-cross attention and the G-Mamba block, with the parallel head performing best. Results on Cityscapes show consistent mIoU gains with only moderate extra GFLOPs at $1024\times1024$ resolution, suggesting that geometry-guided SSM modules can serve as practical alternatives or enhancements to conventional CNN context heads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 DGM-Net 的 Directional Geometric Mamba (G-Mamba) 从完整分割架构降级为即插即用的上下文聚合模块，注入几何引导到 selective scan，使长程特征传播受边界与向心流线索调制。替换 DeepLabV3+、DANet、CCNet、PSPNet、PSANet、OCRNet 六个 CNN 分割模型的原上下文头（backbone 固定为 ResNet-101）后，Cityscapes 上 mIoU 一致提升且仅增加中等 GFLOPs（1024×1024 分辨率）；CCNet 上串行与并行组合对比中并行头最优。
Motivation: CNN 语义分割依赖 ASPP、PPM 或注意力等上下文头扩大感受野，但这些头计算量与内存开销大，且存在边界泄漏问题。
Method: 将 G-Mamba 作为即插即用上下文模块替换六个 CNN 分割模型的原上下文头，ResNet-101 backbone 保持不变；在 selective scan 过程中注入几何引导，由边界与向心流 (centripetal-flow) 调制长程特征传播；在 CCNet 上额外对比 criss-cross attention 与 G-Mamba block 的串行和并行组合方式。
Result: Cityscapes 上六个模型的 mIoU 均获得一致提升，仅带来中等额外 GFLOPs（1024×1024 分辨率）；CCNet 的并行组合头表现最佳。
Conclusion: 几何引导的 SSM 模块可以作为常规 CNN 上下文头的实用替代或增强，且不必重造整套分割架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IR-SIM: A Lightweight Declarative Simulator for Navigation Learning and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Developing navigation policies requires simulation scenarios that support repeatable training and evaluation. Despite the availability of numerous simulators, constructing diverse navigation scenarios often involves writing simulator-specific code, using complex graphical interfaces, performing substantial manual configuration, or relying on resource-intensive computing platforms, making scenarios difficult to reproduce and reuse across experiments. To this end, we develop the Intelligent Robot Simulator (IR-SIM), a lightweight declarative simulator implemented as a Python library to support navigation learning and benchmarking through rapid construction of reusable and diverse scenarios and efficient execution on accessible platforms. IR-SIM represents scenarios as human-readable YAML configurations, in which necessary objects, behaviors, sensors, maps, and environment parameters can be flexibly specified and composed. This declarative representation makes IR-SIM friendly to large language model (LLM)-powered agents, enabling them to compose and modify executable navigation scenario files through the provided agent skills, instead of writing a large amount of code that is difficult to reuse. Despite its lightweight implementation, IR-SIM provides the essential components for navigation simulation, while retaining interfaces to high-fidelity simulators for downstream validation. Experiments demonstrate that IR-SIM runs up to several hundred times faster on the evaluated CPU platform, while agent skills reduce mean LLM-based scenario construction time by more than $50\%$ across both evaluated models. The experiments further show ability to support reproducible benchmarking and RL-based navigation policy learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IR-SIM 是一个轻量声明式导航仿真器，把场景写成人类可读的 YAML 配置（物体、行为、传感器、地图、环境参数可自由组合），并提供 agent skills 让 LLM 直接生成和修改可执行场景文件而非写代码。在所评测的 CPU 平台上运行速度最高达数百倍，agent skills 使两个被测模型的 LLM 场景构建平均时间缩短 50% 以上。
Motivation: 导航场景构建依赖仿真器专用代码、图形界面或大量手工配置，难以复现和跨实验复用，且常需昂贵算力平台。
Method: 以 Python 库形式实现声明式仿真器 IR-SIM：场景用 YAML 描述对象、行为、传感器、地图与环境参数；配套 LLM agent skills 用于合成与修改场景文件；保留对接高保真仿真器的接口做下游验证。
Result: 在所评测的 CPU 平台上运行速度最高达数百倍 (up to several hundred times faster)；agent skills 在两个被测模型上把 LLM 场景构建平均时间缩短 50% 以上；实验展示了对可复现基准测试与基于 RL 的导航策略学习的支持能力。
Conclusion: 声明式 YAML 场景加 LLM agent skills 足以支撑可复现的导航基准与 RL 策略学习，同时保留通向高保真仿真器的验证路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EgoPriMo: Egocentric Motion Generation for Interactive Humanoid Control
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots require whole-body motions that adapt to scene context, task requirements, and user intent. Motion tracking reproduces specified trajectories, and humanoid vision-language-action systems provide semantic interfaces, but neither offers a scalable and interactive prior for broad full-body behavior. We introduce EgoPriMo (Egocentric Motion Prior for Humanoid Robots), a unified framework that learns such priors from egocentric human demonstrations. Given egocentric observations and a text prompt, EgoPriMo reconstructs, generates, and forecasts SMPL-based full-body motion. Language is used as a high-level control signal rather than a complete motion specification. At the core of EgoPriMo is a Triple-stream DiT that jointly models body dynamics, egocentric visual context, and text; task-conditioning masks route different tasks and missing-modality data through the same checkpoint. Experiments on Nymeria and EgoExo4D show that one checkpoint improves egocentric motion generation over UniEgoMotion while supporting reconstruction and forecasting; the generated SMPL motions can also be executed by a Unitree humanoid controller. These results indicate a practical path from scalable egocentric observations to generalizable and interactive humanoid motion priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoPriMo 用一个 Triple-stream DiT 同时建模人体动力学、第一人称视觉与文本，靠任务条件掩码把重建、生成、预报三类任务和缺失模态数据路由到同一 checkpoint。在 Nymeria 与 EgoExo4D 上，单 checkpoint 的第一人称运动生成优于 UniEgoMotion，且生成的 SMPL 运动可由 Unitree 人形控制器执行。
Motivation: 运动跟踪只能复现给定轨迹，VLA 系统只提供语义接口，两者都缺少可扩展、可交互的全身运动先验，难以覆盖广谱人形行为。
Method: 输入第一人称观测与文本 prompt，重建/生成/预报基于 SMPL 的全身运动；核心是 Triple-stream DiT 联合建模身体动力学、egocentric 视觉上下文与文本，语言仅作高层控制信号而非完整运动规格，任务条件掩码 (task-conditioning masks) 负责路由不同任务与缺失模态数据。
Result: 在 Nymeria 与 EgoExo4D 上，单 checkpoint 的 egocentric motion generation 相对 UniEgoMotion 有提升，同时支持重建与预报任务；生成的 SMPL 运动可由 Unitree 人形控制器执行。
Conclusion: 从可扩展的第一人称观测学到通用且可交互的人形运动先验是可行路径，一个 checkpoint 即可覆盖多任务并驱动实体控制器。

papers.title: Hierarchical Forecast Reconciliation for Urban Rail Transit Demand Prediction under Operational Disruptions
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and coherent passenger demand forecasting is essential for Urban Rail Transit (URT) operations. Passenger demand is hierarchical: origin--destination (OD) flows aggregate to station-level inflows and outflows through conservation constraints. However, independently generated station- and OD-level forecasts may violate these constraints and limit information sharing across levels. This paper develops a hierarchical forecast reconciliation framework for joint station- and OD-level demand prediction. A neural Fully Connected Reconciler (FCR) maps incoherent base forecasts to coherent predictions with exact structural consistency by construction. We benchmark FCR against classical and machine-learning reconciliation methods using one year of Rejsekort smart-card and Banedanmark operational data from a 12-station Copenhagen S-train subnetwork, covering one-step, multi-step, and disruption forecasting. We also compare against a matched-parameter multi-task station--OD baseline with a soft consistency penalty. Reconciliation improves aggregate OD accuracy while enforcing exact coherence. Under standard conditions, FCR is competitive with statistical methods, while an oracle experiment using observed station demand reduces OD MSE by about 34\%. Under train delays and cancellations, reconciliation continues to improve OD accuracy, with FCR achieving larger reductions than MinT-Sample in disruption-affected subsets. Greater cross-level disagreement is associated with larger reconciliation gains, highlighting the value of hierarchical reconciliation under both regular and disrupted operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 城市轨道交通客流预测中，OD 流与站点进出量存在守恒约束，独立建模的分层预测会互相矛盾。神经 Fully Connected Reconciler (FCR) 把不一致的基预测映射为构造上严格一致的站点+OD 联合预测；在哥本哈根 S-train 12 站子网一年数据上，oracle 实验（用观测站点需求）使 OD MSE 降低约 34%，列车延误与取消场景下 FCR 的 OD 精度降幅大于 MinT-Sample。
Motivation: 站点级与 OD 级预测各自独立生成时会违反守恒约束、且无法跨层级共享信息；运营中断（延误、取消）下这种不一致进一步削弱客流预测可靠性。
Method: 提出神经 Fully Connected Reconciler (FCR)，将不一致的基预测映射为按构造满足结构一致性的预测；用 Rejsekort 智能卡与 Banedanmark 运营数据（哥本哈根 S-train 12 站子网、一年）做基准，覆盖单步、多步与中断预测，并与经典统计、机器学习 reconciliation 方法及参数量匹配的多任务软约束基线对比。
Result: Reconciliation 在保证严格一致性的同时提升聚合 OD 精度；标准条件下 FCR 与统计方法相当，oracle 实验（用观测站点需求）使 OD MSE 降低约 34%；列车延误与取消下 reconciliation 仍提升 OD 精度，FCR 在受中断影响子集上的降幅大于 MinT-Sample；跨层级分歧越大，reconciliation 收益越大。

papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation benefits from one controller to coordinate locomotion, arm movements, and fall recovery. These behaviors are difficult to learn together from scratch because they require different skills and objectives. We present HANDOFF, a training architecture that distills motion-tracking, locomotion, and recovery teachers into one 29-DoF policy, using context-conditioned KL losses over separate action slices and a soft mixture of experts. Commanded velocity continuously blends body supervision, while a binary recovery flag assigns the full action to the recovery teacher. The resulting controller takes a compact 10-D task-space command rather than a dense kinematic stream and does not switch policies at runtime. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and obtains the largest robust manipulation workspace in a matched adapted-interface benchmark. The same controller executes natural-language-driven, multi-stage loco-manipulation tasks in simulation and hardware experiments without further data collection or fine-tuning.

Motivation: 人形 loco-manipulation 需要同时协调移动、手臂动作与跌倒恢复，这些行为技能与目标不同，从零一起训练很难。

papers.title: Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values
papers.abstract_en: Asymptotic e-values are emerging as a powerful alternative to asymptotic p-values, particularly in post-hoc inference and multiple testing, where significance levels may be data-dependent. Existing asymptotic e-values, however, suffer from the ``missing factor,'' a scaling inefficiency resulting in overly conservative inference. Drawing on the framework of near-optimal concentration inequalities developed by Bentkus in the 2000s, we introduce Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values and prove that they successfully eliminate the missing factor. We also demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that Bentkus-type e-values consistently deliver sharper inference than existing alternatives, leading to tighter post-hoc confidence intervals and higher rejection rates in multiple testing procedures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对渐近 e-value 的“缺失因子”（missing factor）缩放低效导致推断过保守，本文借 Bentkus 近最优集中不等式框架构造 Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values，并证明其消除该因子。理论上与实证上都给出比现有替代更锐利的推断：事后置信区间更窄、多重检验拒绝率更高。
Motivation: 现有渐近 e-value 存在 missing factor 这一缩放低效，使显著性水平可数据依赖的事后推断与多重检验过于保守。
Method: 基于 Bentkus 在 2000 年代发展的近最优集中不等式 (near-optimal concentration inequalities) 框架构造 Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values，并给出消除 missing factor 的证明；同时做理论与实证两方面的比较。
Result: 证明 Bentkus-type e-values 消除 missing factor；理论与实证均显示其推断比现有替代更锐利，表现为更紧的事后置信区间与多重检验中更高的拒绝率。
Conclusion: Bentkus 型集中不等式可作为渐近 e-value 的更优缩放方案，改善数据依赖显著性水平下的事后推断与多重检验功效。

papers.title: Reproducing, Analyzing, and Detecting Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) uses an LLM-as-a-Judge (LaaJ) to score model outputs according to rubrics as rewards. However, policy models may exploit latent biases in the judge, leading to reward hacking and ineffective or unsafe training outcomes. In real-world rubric-based RL, such hacking behaviors are often subtle and entangled with multiple judge biases, making them difficult to analyze, detect, and mitigate. In this paper, we introduce CHERRL, a Controllable Hacking Environment for Rubric-based RL. By injecting known biases into LaaJ, CHERRL enables stable reproduction of reward hacking, explicit observation of reward divergence, and identification of hacking onset. This provides a clean experimental testbed for studying the mechanisms and mitigations of reward hacking in rubric-based RL. To demonstrate its utility, we analyze different judge biases from the perspectives of discoverability and exploitability, and explore an agent for automatically detecting reward hacking onset from training logs. The code and environment are publicly available at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CHERRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CHERRL：向 LLM-as-a-Judge 注入已知偏差，使 rubric-based RL 中的 reward hacking 可稳定复现、reward 分歧可观测、hacking 起点可定位。据此从 discoverability 与 exploitability 两个维度分析各类 judge 偏差，并训练一个从训练日志自动检测 hacking 起点的 agent。
Motivation: 真实 rubric-based RL 中 reward hacking 行为细微且与多种 judge 偏差纠缠，难以分析、检测和缓解，缺少可控的实验环境。
Method: CHERRL 通过向 LaaJ 注入已知偏差构造可控 hacking 环境，实现 reward hacking 的稳定复现与 hacking 起点识别；在此基础上按 discoverability 与 exploitability 分析不同 judge 偏差，并探索一个从训练日志自动检测 hacking 起点的 agent，代码与环境已公开。
Result: CHERRL 支持稳定复现 reward hacking、显式观测 reward 分歧并定位 hacking 起点；以该测试床分析了不同 judge 偏差的 discoverability 与 exploitability，并探索了基于训练日志的 hacking 起点自动检测 agent。
Conclusion: 注入已知 judge 偏差的可控测试床能把纠缠的真实 hacking 拆成可归因的机制研究，并使 hacking 起点检测成为可训练的任务。

papers.title: Beyond Missing Rates: Rethinking Incomplete Multi-View Clustering with Protocol Divergence
papers.abstract_en: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) is typically evaluated by retraining separate models under different missing-view configurations. Evaluations indexed only by nominal missing rate can overlook differences in observation structure across missing-view protocols. We show that missing-data protocols with identical nominal missing rates can induce substantially different learning regimes, differing by approximately 50-fold in the proportion of fully observed samples. We formalize this phenomenon as protocol divergence, which quantifies structural disparities among missing-view protocols beyond marginal missing rates. Furthermore, we analyze support-gated reconstruction mechanisms and show that their optimization contribution is inherently limited by the frequency of eligible observations under explicit normalization and optimization conditions. Based on these observations, we propose CRAFT (Co-occurrence-free Robust Attention-masked Fusion Transformer), a train-once framework that combines representation learning with an architecture designed to process missing-view inputs. CRAFT combines (i) per-sample forward computation using each sample's observed views and shared parameters, and (ii) mask-aware fusion over nonempty observed-view subsets. The deployment evaluation starts from training data with all views available and reuses one final checkpoint per dataset and seed across missing-view protocols without retraining. Experiments on CUB and MultiFashion show that CRAFT achieves the strongest performance in 12 out of 13 information-matched settings. Additional deployment experiments across seven benchmarks and sixteen missing configurations demonstrate substantial computational savings through checkpoint reuse while maintaining competitive clustering performance. Code and evaluation tools: https://github.com/dk23lhl/CRAFT and https://github.com/dk23lhl/imvc-audit.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 as a poster paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 不完整多视图聚类 (IMVC) 只按名义缺失率评测会掩盖观测结构差异：相同缺失率的不同缺失协议在全观测样本占比上可差约 50 倍，作者将其形式化为 protocol divergence。提出的 CRAFT 用逐样本按已观测视图前向加 mask-aware 融合，一次训练后跨协议复用同一 checkpoint，在 CUB 与 MultiFashion 的 13 个信息匹配设置中 12 个最强。
Motivation: IMVC 惯例是在不同缺失视图配置下分别重训模型评测，仅以名义缺失率为索引，会忽略观测结构差异，导致同一缺失率下的学习体制不可比。
Method: 先形式化 protocol divergence 以量化超出边际缺失率的协议结构差异，并分析 support-gated reconstruction 在显式归一化与优化条件下其优化贡献受合格观测频率限制；据此提出 CRAFT (Co-occurrence-free Robust Attention-masked Fusion Transformer)，含逐样本用各自已观测视图与共享参数前向，以及对非空已观测视图子集的 mask-aware 融合，训练数据全视图可用、每数据集每 seed 只留一个最终 checkpoint。
Result: 相同名义缺失率的协议在全观测样本占比上相差约 50 倍；CRAFT 在 CUB 与 MultiFashion 的 13 个信息匹配设置中 12 个取得最强性能；在七个基准、十六种缺失配置上的部署实验显示 checkpoint 复用带来显著计算节省，同时保持有竞争力的聚类性能。
Conclusion: IMVC 评测应按 protocol divergence 而非名义缺失率对齐，且 train-once 加 checkpoint 复用可在跨协议部署时省算力而不牺牲聚类表现。

papers.title: RobotValues: Evaluating Household Robots When Human Values Conflict
papers.abstract_en: While household robots are often evaluated based on task completion, everyday domestic environments involve value-conflicting situations where robots are expected to choose actions that prioritize diverse values such as human autonomy, efficiency, or social appropriateness. Yet, there are no benchmarks for evaluating robots' value preferences in such scenarios. We introduce RobotValues, a benchmark to evaluate household robot planners in 8K value-conflict scenarios. Each instance consists of a realistic, synthetically generated household image with multiple plausible robot actions that prioritize different human values. We construct ROBOTVALUES through LLM-assisted scenario generation, stakeholder-grounded value extraction, image generation and automatic quality control. We evaluate 10 VLMs used in robotics and find that models show default value preferences, including safety and accommodation, while underselecting privacy-prioritizing actions. When models are prompted to prioritize values that conflict with their preferences, models often fail to override the default actions, choosing incorrect actions 80% of the time on average across models. These findings highlight the need to go beyond task completion or safety evaluations and assess robots' decision-making capability when human values conflict.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RobotValues 是一个含 8K 价值冲突场景的家庭机器人规划基准，每个样本是一张合成家居图像加多个偏向不同人类价值（自主、效率、社会得体、隐私、安全）的候选动作。评测 10 个机器人常用 VLM，发现模型有默认价值偏好（安全与迁就），却少选隐私优先动作；被要求优先与其偏好冲突的价值时，平均 80% 的情况下仍选错动作。
Motivation: 家庭机器人评测长期只看任务完成或安全，缺少衡量机器人在人类价值相互冲突时如何取舍的基准，无法暴露模型价值偏好的可覆盖性。
Method: 用 LLM 辅助场景生成、stakeholder-grounded 价值抽取、图像生成与自动质量控制构建 8K 场景；每个实例给出合成家居图像与多个偏向不同价值的合理动作，再对 10 个机器人领域常用 VLM 做评测，含默认偏好与强制指定冲突价值两种提示设置。
Result: 8K 价值冲突场景，评测 10 个 VLM；模型默认偏向安全与迁就、系统性少选隐私优先动作；在被要求优先与其偏好冲突的价值时，平均跨模型 80% 的情况下仍选择错误动作。
Conclusion: 家庭机器人评测必须超出任务完成与安全，专门检验价值冲突下的决策能力，因为现有 VLM 规划器难以按指令覆盖自身默认价值偏好。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: RobotValues 是一个含 8K 价值冲突场景的家庭机器人规划基准，每个样本是一张合成家居图像加多个偏向不同人类价值（自主、效率、社会得体、隐私、安全）的候选动作。评测 10 个机器人常用 VLM，发现模型有默认价值偏好（安全与迁就），却少选隐私优先动作；被要求优先与其偏好冲突的价值时，平均 80% 的情况下仍选错动作。

papers.title: Learning to Solve, Forgetting to Retain: Correct-Set Turnover in RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the ability of large language model, yet headline accuracy gains often conceal a hidden cost: previously solved problems quietly become unsolvable as training proceeds. We frame this phenomenon as \emph{correct-set turnover}, representing the coupled dynamics of solution acquisition and regression over the mastered set. Under this view, retention becomes an explicit optimization target alongside acquisition. We analytically and empirically establish the \emph{repair-window principle}: the cost of restoring a regressed prompt grows sharply with review delay, defining a low-cost window that standard RLVR pipelines fail to exploit. To address this, we propose \textbf{\method{}}, a retention-aware review mechanism that tracks mastered prompts and periodically reintroduces them to \textbf{remind} the model of previous solutions. By utilizing pre-rollout batch replacement, \method{} incurs zero additional rollout overhead. Evaluated across 20 benchmarks spanning image-text, video, and text-only tasks with Qwen3-VL and Qwen2.5-Math, \method{} consistently improves performance over GRPO, DAPO, and replay baselines, demonstrating robust generalizability across modalities and algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 训练中已解决的题目会随训练推进重新变难，作者把这种解法获取与已掌握集回退的耦合动态定义为 correct-set turnover，并提出保留感知的复习机制：跟踪已掌握 prompt 并周期性重新引入，用 pre-rollout batch replacement 实现零额外 rollout 开销。在 20 个跨图文、视频、纯文本基准上，用 Qwen3-VL 与 Qwen2.5-Math 评测，一致优于 GRPO、DAPO 与 replay 基线。
Motivation: RLVR 的总体准确率提升掩盖了已解决题目悄悄回退的隐性代价，而标准 RLVR 流程没有把保留 (retention) 当作显式优化目标，也不利用低成本修复窗口。
Method: 把 correct-set turnover 形式化为已掌握集上获取与回退的耦合动力学，使保留与获取并列为优化目标；解析与实证确立 repair-window principle（修复回退 prompt 的成本随复习延迟急剧上升），据此提出跟踪已掌握 prompt 并周期性重引入的保留感知复习机制，借助 pre-rollout batch replacement 不增加 rollout 开销。
Result: 在覆盖图文、视频、纯文本的 20 个基准上，以 Qwen3-VL 与 Qwen2.5-Math 为模型，该方法相对 GRPO、DAPO 和 replay 基线一致提升性能，跨模态与跨算法均表现稳健；解析与实证共同确立修复成本随复习延迟急剧增长的 repair-window principle。
Conclusion: 保留应作为与获取并列的显式优化目标，在回退 prompt 的低成本窗口内及时复习即可在零额外 rollout 开销下持续提升 RLVR 性能。

papers.title: How Optimality Structures Sparse Dictionaries: Theory for Interpreting SAE Representations
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have found success parsing neural network representations into interpretable concepts, providing a basis for understanding and control. However, what exactly SAEs extract and, hence, the scientific conclusions we can draw from them are not obvious. In short, if your SAE behaves strangely, does that reflect interesting neural network behaviour or an SAE-imposed distortion? Towards answering this, we use dictionary learning identifiability results to derive constraints that optimal dictionary learning features must satisfy. For example, an optimal feature will never turn on only while another is active. We use these conditions to explain various SAE oddities - hierarchical splitting & absorption, which features can be left in the residuals, dense antipodal features, and infinite feature splitting - simply as properties imposed by the dictionary learning objective. Finally, these constraints are diagnostic: real SAEs pass when measured on the dataset on which they were trained, but increasingly fail as the test dataset becomes more `distant'. In sum, we hope to provide theoretical tools to explain puzzling SAE patterns, allowing more principled inferences about internal model behaviour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用字典学习可识别性结果推导最优字典特征必须满足的约束（例如一个特征绝不会只在另一个特征激活时才开启），据此把 SAE 的层级分裂与吸收、残差中保留的特征、稠密对跖特征、无限特征分裂等怪象解释为字典学习目标本身强加的性质。诊断性检验显示：真实 SAE 在其训练所用数据集上通过这些约束，而测试集越“远”就越不通过。
Motivation: SAE 从神经网络表示中抽出的特征未必对应真实概念，SAE 行为异常时无法区分是网络本身的有趣行为还是 SAE 自身引入的失真，从而削弱基于 SAE 得出的科学结论。
Method: 基于 dictionary learning 的可识别性 (identifiability) 结果，推导最优字典学习特征必须满足的一组约束条件；再用这些条件解释 SAE 的若干怪象，并把它们作为诊断量去测量真实 SAE 在训练集与更远测试集上的表现。
Result: 给出的约束之一是最优特征绝不会只在另一个特征激活时才开启；这些条件可解释 hierarchical splitting & absorption、残差中被留下的特征、dense antipodal features、infinite feature splitting 等 SAE 怪象。诊断结果：真实 SAE 在训练所用数据集上通过检验，随测试数据集变得更远而 increasingly fail。
Conclusion: SAE 的许多 puzzling patterns 是字典学习目标强加的性质而非网络行为，因此可用这组约束作为诊断工具，对模型内部行为做出更有依据的推断。

papers.title: Two-Fidelity Best-Action Identification for Stochastic Minimax Tree
papers.abstract_en: We study fixed-confidence best-action identification (BAI) in stochastic minimax trees. This problem is increasingly relevant in modern AI planning, where deep minimax search and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with language model long rollouts face a fundamental tradeoff: heuristic evaluations are cheap but biased, while accurate rollouts are reliable but prohibitively expensive. We propose 2FFS, a two-fidelity tree-search algorithm that brings multi-fidelity flat bandit ideas into trees. The algorithm combines minimax-style fast expansion with MCTS-style stochastic sampling, adaptively deciding when to exploit cheap biased evaluations and when to invoke expensive accurate evaluations for local certification. We prove fixed-confidence correctness, establish finite stopping for exact identification, and give a polynomial-depth cost upper bound for general-depth trees. Across numerical stochastic-tree experiments, 2FFS uses substantially fewer samples and computational operations comparing to existing BAI-MCTS baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 2FFS：把多保真 (multi-fidelity) flat bandit 思路搬进随机 minimax 树，用便宜但有偏的启发式评估做快速展开，只在需要局部认证时才调用昂贵但可靠的 rollout。证明了固定置信度正确性、精确识别的有限停止，以及一般深度树的多项式深度代价上界；数值随机树实验中相比现有 BAI-MCTS 基线显著减少样本数与计算操作数。
Motivation: AI 规划里深度 minimax 搜索与 MCTS 长 rollout 面对保真度权衡：启发式评估便宜但有偏，rollout 可靠但代价高，固定置信度 best-action identification 在树结构上缺少兼顾两者的算法。
Method: 2FFS 在树上结合 minimax 式快速展开与 MCTS 式随机采样，自适应决定何时利用便宜的有偏评估、何时调用昂贵的准确评估做局部认证 (local certification)，并给出理论保证。
Result: 证明固定置信度正确性、精确识别的有限停止 (finite stopping)，以及一般深度树的多项式深度代价上界；在数值随机树实验中，相对现有 BAI-MCTS 基线使用显著更少的样本与计算操作数。
Conclusion: 把多保真 bandit 的保真度切换机制移植到 minimax 树上，可在保持固定置信度正确识别的同时大幅压低采样与计算代价。

papers.title: Reasoning with Sampling: Cutting at Decision Points
papers.abstract_en: Frontier reasoning models are produced by post-training base language models with reinforcement learning. Recent work has challenged this by showing that sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution, a so-called power distribution, elicits comparable reasoning without additional training, curated datasets, or verifiers. However, making this method practical requires efficiently sampling from the power distribution. A sampler needs to "mix" to the power distribution, which necessitates moving between modes of the target distribution; intuitively, e.g., trying different reasoning strategies. The samplers proposed in prior works repeatedly select a "cut" position in the current reasoning trace uniformly at random and resample the suffix from that position onward. However, reasoning traces typically contain a few consequential decisions (e.g., the choice of proof strategy or algorithm), and we observe that a uniformly chosen cut tends to rewrite local details rather than revisit decision points. We introduce an algorithm (Entropy-Cut Metropolis-Hastings) that uses the base model's next-token entropy as a proxy to identify key decision points and resample from those positions. We empirically verify that entropy jumps are a useful proxy for decision points and, in a stylized model of reasoning, prove that our method's mixing time scales with the number of decisions in a trace rather than with the number of tokens, which can be much larger. Across MATH500, HumanEval, GPQA Diamond, and AIME26, our method consistently improves over baselines and RL-trained models, including best-of-N at the same token budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Entropy-Cut Metropolis-Hastings：用 base model 的 next-token 熵跳变定位推理轨迹中的关键决策点，只在这些位置重采样后缀，替代先前在轨迹上均匀随机选 cut 的做法。在 MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA Diamond、AIME26 上一致优于基线与 RL 训练模型（含同 token 预算的 best-of-N），并证明混合时间随轨迹中的决策数而非 token 数增长。
Motivation: 从 sharpened 的 power distribution 采样可免训练地激发推理，但高效采样要求跨模式混合；均匀随机选 cut 多在重写局部细节而非回到关键决策点，导致混合代价随 token 数增长。
Method: 以 base model 的 next-token 熵作为决策点代理，熵跳变处作为 cut 位置做 Metropolis-Hastings 重采样后缀；在简化的推理模型 (stylized model of reasoning) 中证明混合时间标度，并在四个推理基准上与既有采样器和 RL 模型对比。
Result: 熵跳变被实证验证为决策点的有效代理；理论上混合时间随决策数而非 token 数缩放；在 MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA Diamond、AIME26 上一致改进基线与 RL 训练模型，包括同 token 预算下的 best-of-N。
Conclusion: 把重采样位置从均匀随机改为熵标记的决策点，可在不增加训练与 token 预算的前提下提升 power-distribution 采样的推理表现，且混合代价由决策数而非轨迹长度决定。

papers.title: DeepSurvey: Agent-Oriented Automated Survey Generation with Analytical Depth and Citation Reliability
papers.abstract_en: As scientific literature grows rapidly and research increasingly involves AI agents, automated survey generation has become a key capability for both agents and human researchers. For such agents, a survey serves as a primary knowledge source of a field prior to research. Since pretrained models already encode broad knowledge of established work, these consumers benefit more from analytical depth than from breadth alone; moreover, unsupported claims, once ingested as knowledge, can propagate into downstream research. However, existing systems tend to overemphasize coverage and presentation; they suffer from limited analytical depth due to reliance on abstracts and isolated paper processing, and from unreliable citations due to imprecise retrieval and post-hoc grounding. We present DeepSurvey, an agentic generation system that addresses both limitations. To enhance depth, DeepSurvey extracts structured keynotes, models cross-paper relationships through clustering and comparative analysis, and integrates a code-agent subsystem to recover implementation-level details. To fortify reliability, it combines citation-graph expansion with hybrid filtering for topic-focused retrieval, enforces evidence-constrained analysis and writing, and deploys multi-granularity agentic refinement to validate citation--claim alignment. Experiments show that DeepSurvey achieves the highest content score (8.34/10) and citation quality (recall and precision gains of 25.3\% and 35.2\% over the strongest baseline), generalizes more robustly across domains, and is preferred by domain experts over human-written surveys (83.3\% in overall quality, 100\% in content depth). Moreover, when a coding agent uses a survey as its only literature source, the agent equipped with DeepSurvey achieves the best performance among human-written and baseline-generated surveys.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepSurvey 是面向 AI agent 的自动综述生成系统，用结构化 keynotes、跨论文聚类与比较分析、以及 code-agent 子系统补足分析深度，用引用图扩展加混合过滤检索、证据约束写作和多粒度 agent 精修保证引用可靠性。实验中其内容得分 8.34/10，引用 recall 与 precision 相对最强基线分别提升 25.3% 与 35.2%，专家在总体质量上 83.3%、内容深度上 100% 偏好它胜过人写综述。
Motivation: 现有自动综述系统偏重覆盖面与呈现，依赖摘要和逐篇孤立处理导致分析深度不足，检索不精与事后对齐又造成引用不可靠；不可靠论断被 agent 当作领域知识吸收后会传导进下游研究。
Method: 深度侧：抽取结构化 keynotes，用聚类与比较分析建模跨论文关系，并接入 code-agent 子系统恢复实现层细节。可靠性侧：引用图扩展配合混合过滤做主题聚焦检索，强制证据约束的分析与写作，再用多粒度 agent 精修校验 citation–claim 对齐。
