papers.title: Certified Adaptive Refresh: Anytime-Valid Monitoring for Federated Conformal RAG
papers.abstract_en: Question-answering services built on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), in which a language model answers from retrieved documents, are inspected continuously and upgraded repeatedly, so their reliability guarantee must survive both. We study federated conformal RAG: nodes holding private corpora score candidate answers with a shared language model and send compressed scores to a hub that returns an answer set; a miss omits the true answer. We formulate monitoring as a sequential test: alarm when misses exceed a certified bound on the miss rate (the allowance). But a conformal certificate covers one frozen configuration at one look fixed in advance, so it gives no anytime-valid alarm; a threshold calibrated for one model certifies nothing about its replacement; and re-certifying each upgrade at full error level compounds failures. We propose Anytime-FC-RAG with three auditable rules: pick each configuration before its fresh calibration, charge every certificate attempt to one trajectory-wide budget $δ_{\rm cal}$, and fix threshold, allowance and bet before each query. One betting wealth $E_t$, growing in expectation only when misses exceed the allowance, never resets across deployments. Our certified adaptive-refresh theorem shows that, with evidence budget $δ_e$, alarming when $E_t$ reaches $1/δ_e$ has false-alarm probability at most $δ_e + δ_{\rm cal}$ under a random number of history-selected, evidence-driven refreshes of model, retriever, corpus, score or threshold; $δ_{\rm cal}$ pays for wrong certificates. With an exact order-statistic certificate the bound is distribution-free, architecture-agnostic and about misses, not per-input coverage or distribution shift as such. On Qwen2.5/MMLU-Pro the alarm separated audited-harmful from benign shifts completely at a 5% budget; in a model swap, only fresh calibration kept a downgrade's miss rate in check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把联邦 conformal RAG 的可靠性监控写成序贯检验：用一个跨部署不重置的 betting wealth E_t 监测 miss 率是否超过 allowance，当 E_t 达到 1/δ_e 时报警，误报概率至多 δ_e + δ_cal。在 Qwen2.5/MMLU-Pro 上，5% 预算下报警把经审计的有害偏移与良性偏移完全分开；模型替换时只有 fresh calibration 能压住降级后的 miss 率。
Motivation: RAG 服务被持续监控并反复升级，但 conformal 证书只覆盖预先固定的一次性冻结配置：无法给出 anytime-valid 报警，旧阈值对换掉的模型不作数，每次升级都按完整错误水平重新认证又会累积失败。
Method: 提出 Anytime-FC-RAG，含三条可审计规则：每个配置在 fresh calibration 之前选定；每次证书尝试计入全轨迹预算 δ_cal；threshold、allowance 与 bet 在每次查询前固定。监控用单一 betting wealth E_t，仅在 miss 超过 allowance 时期望增长，跨部署不重置；证书用 exact order-statistic。
Result: certified adaptive-refresh 定理给出：证据预算 δ_e 下，E_t 达到 1/δ_e 时误报概率 ≤ δ_e + δ_cal，适用于模型、检索器、语料、打分或阈值被历史选择、证据驱动的随机次刷新；该界是 distribution-free、architecture-agnostic。在 Qwen2.5/MMLU-Pro 上，5% 预算下报警将 audited-harmful 与 benign 偏移完全区分；模型替换实验中仅 fresh calibration 维持了降级模型的 miss 率。
Conclusion: 把每次证书尝试计入统一预算并让 betting wealth 跨部署连续累积，可在任意次模型/检索器/语料刷新下保住误报界；证书针对 miss 而非 per-input coverage 或分布偏移本身，换模型后必须重新校准。

papers.title: Efficient Pre-Training of LLMs through Truncated SVD Representations
papers.abstract_en: LLM pretraining is extremely costly; therefore, parameter-efficient LLM architectures have recently emerged as a compelling research direction. One such promising approach is to represent the parameters as orthonormal low-rank weight matrices. However, maintaining orthonormality during training is computationally expensive, making it impractical. This paper presents the TSVD (Truncated Singular Value Decomposition) framework which efficiently maintains orthonormality through QR decomposition and caching. Furthermore, a spectral energy heuristic is introduced to select the rank of the resulting low-rank weight matrices. Empirical evaluations across model sizes show that TSVD matches or outperforms full-parameter baselines at a fraction of the compute cost. TSVD thus provides a scalable, computationally efficient foundation for LLM pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TSVD 框架，用 QR 分解加缓存在 LLM 预训练中低成本维持低秩权重矩阵的正交性，并用谱能量启发式 (spectral energy heuristic) 选择秩。跨模型规模的评测显示 TSVD 以远低于全参数基线的计算成本达到持平或更优的表现。
Motivation: LLM 预训练成本极高，参数高效架构中用正交低秩权重矩阵表示参数是可行路线，但训练中持续维持正交性计算开销大、难以落地。
Method: TSVD 框架通过 QR 分解与缓存机制高效维持低秩权重矩阵的正交性；另引入谱能量启发式来确定低秩矩阵的秩，评测覆盖多个模型规模并与全参数基线对比。
Result: 跨模型规模的经验评测中，TSVD 以远低于全参数基线的计算成本 (a fraction of the compute cost) 达到持平或更优的表现；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 正交低秩参数化在可控计算开销下可作为 LLM 预训练的可扩展基础，QR 加缓存使维持正交性变得实际可行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diversifying RLVR Rollouts via First-Token Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models without labeled trajectories, using groups of verifier-scored rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. Limited rollout diversity is a central bottleneck, typically addressed through adjustments to temperature, prefixes, or rollout selection. We identify the first token of the response as a structurally distinct target for diversification, largely overlooked in prior work. We find that the first-token distribution is sharply concentrated and only weakly related to downstream correctness, as lower-probability candidates can yield similarly accurate responses. Diversifying the first token can therefore broaden the reasoning paths explored within each rollout group with little loss in response quality. Motivated by this observation, we introduce REFT (Rollout Exploration with First-Token Diversification), a lightweight modification to RLVR. REFT samples first tokens uniformly from the policy's top-$N$ candidates and allocates rollouts evenly across the sampled tokens, leaving the rest of the pipeline unchanged. We evaluate REFT on eight models spanning multiple architectures and sizes (0.5B-14B), with mathematical reasoning and code-generation tasks under GRPO and DAPO. Across these settings, REFT consistently improves Pass@1, Pass@8, and Pass@64. It also outperforms competing diversification methods at every evaluated budget, incurring the lowest rollout cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REFT 把 RLVR 中响应首 token 从策略 top-N 候选里均匀采样，并在采样到的 token 之间均分 rollout 组，从而在几乎不损失回答质量的前提下拓宽每组探索的推理路径。在 0.5B–14B 共八个模型、数学推理与代码生成任务、GRPO 与 DAPO 设置下，Pass@1、Pass@8、Pass@64 一致提升，且在每个评估预算上超过其他多样化方法、rollout 成本最低。
Motivation: RLVR 靠 verifier 打分的 rollout 组探索不同推理路径，但 rollout 多样性不足是核心瓶颈；现有手段集中在调温度、前缀或 rollout 选择，响应首 token 这一结构性位置基本被忽略。
Method: REFT (Rollout Exploration with First-Token Diversification)：从策略的 top-N 候选中均匀采样首 token，把 rollout 均匀分配到这些 token 上，RLVR 其余流程保持不变；在 GRPO 与 DAPO 下评估。
Result: 首 token 分布高度集中且与下游正确性仅弱相关，低概率候选也能给出同样准确的回答。在八个模型（0.5B–14B，多架构）、数学推理与代码生成任务上，REFT 一致提升 Pass@1、Pass@8、Pass@64，并在每个评估预算上超过其他多样化方法，rollout 成本最低。
Conclusion: 首 token 是低成本且此前被忽视的多样化切入点：均匀采样 top-N 首 token 即可拓宽 rollout 组的推理路径，同时保住回答质量并压低 rollout 开销。

papers.title: KLineage: Recovering the Missing When of Kernel Optimization by Deoptimizing Experts
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to generate GPU kernels, but they often struggle to determine when an optimization is sound because its required code state and dependencies are implicit in expert implementations. We introduce KLineage, which learns this missing "when" knowledge from expert kernels: instead of relying on forward rollouts, KLineage walks expert implementations backward through validation-gated simplifications and reverses each accepted step into a reusable optimization skill. Each skill records not only the optimization intent, but also when to apply the optimization technique, including where it applies in code, what conditions made it valid, what effect it has, and what failures its assumptions avoid. A downstream LLM materializes these skills on new code surfaces under the same compile/correctness/profile gate. This guidance on when to apply each optimization can help downstream models to generate higher-performance kernels. On five expert workloads across two NVIDIA architectures, these lineage-derived skills serve as an effective optimization curriculum, exceeding recent memory-based LLM-kernel baselines in both final kernel quality and optimization efficiency under the same fixed budget. We also demonstrate that the KLineage framework extends beyond NVIDIA GPUs to Ascend NPUs. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ict-agent/klineage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KLineage 从专家 GPU kernel 出发做反向“去优化”：逐步用验证门控的简化回退专家实现，把每一步可逆的改写固化为带适用条件的可复用优化 skill，再由下游 LLM 在新代码上按同样的编译/正确性/性能剖析门控落地。在两种 NVIDIA 架构上的五个专家负载中，这些 lineage skill 作为优化课程，在相同固定预算下最终 kernel 质量与优化效率均超过近期基于记忆的 LLM-kernel 基线，并可扩展到 Ascend NPU。
Motivation: LLM 生成 GPU kernel 时难以判断一次优化何时成立，因为所需代码状态与依赖隐含在专家实现里，缺少显式的“when”知识。
Method: 不依赖前向 rollout，而是把专家实现反向走一遍验证门控的简化 (validation-gated simplification)，将每个被接受的步骤逆转为一条优化 skill，记录优化意图、适用代码位置、成立条件、效果及其假设所规避的失败；下游 LLM 在新代码面上物化这些 skill，同样受编译、正确性与 profile 门控约束。
Result: 在两种 NVIDIA 架构上的五个专家负载中，lineage-derived skills 作为优化课程，在相同固定预算下在最终 kernel 质量与优化效率两方面均超过近期基于记忆的 LLM-kernel 基线；框架进一步从 NVIDIA GPU 扩展到 Ascend NPU。
Conclusion: 把专家 kernel 的优化知识反向解构为带适用条件的 skill，可作为下游模型生成更高性能 kernel 的有效优化课程，且该框架不绑定 NVIDIA GPU。

papers.title: Learning to Assign Prediction Tasks to Agents with Capacity Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of learning to assign prediction tasks to one agent from a set of available agents, including human decision-makers and AI models. We focus on sequential learning of agent expertise and assignment policies where each agent is constrained to handle a fraction of tasks. We provide a general theoretical characterization of this problem in terms of agent capacities, differences in agent expertise, and task context. We then develop a framework of sequential explore-exploit policy-learning algorithms that seek to maximize overall performance. Experimental results over a variety of tabular, image, and text prediction tasks demonstrate systematic gains from our policy-learning algorithms relative to non-contextual baselines across different types of agents, including LLMs and humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在每个 agent 只能承接一部分任务的约束下，把「选谁来预测」本身当作序贯 explore-exploit 的策略学习问题，用 agent 专长、容量与任务上下文的联合刻画来分配预测任务。在表格、图像、文本三类预测任务上，所学策略相对非上下文基线在 LLM 与人类 agent 上都取得系统性增益。
Motivation: 当可用预测者（人类决策者与 AI 模型）各自容量受限时，如何按任务上下文动态指派才能整体性能最大，缺少统一的理论刻画与可学习的指派策略。
Method: 先给出以 agent 容量、专长差异和任务上下文为变量的一般性理论刻画，再提出一组序贯 explore-exploit 策略学习算法来学习指派策略，目标是最大化整体预测表现。
Result: 在表格、图像与文本预测任务上，策略学习算法相对非上下文基线取得系统性增益，覆盖包括 LLM 与人类在内的多种 agent 类型；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把任务指派当作受容量约束的序贯策略学习问题，利用任务上下文区分 agent 专长，比不看上下文的固定指派更能提升整体预测性能。

papers.title: Boosting Knowledge Graph Foundation Models via Enhanced Negative Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) have become the core backbone of numerous downstream tasks such as question answering and recommender systems. However, despite all this, KGs are often very incomplete. To perform zero-shot knowledge graph completion in unseen KGs, which have different relational vocabularies from those used for pre-training, KG foundation models (KGFMs) receive a wide range of attention. Existing KGFMs often perform training using random negative triples, which are constructed by replacing the head or tail entity of a positive triple with a random entity. However, these negative triples are often constructed with limited quality, providing weak supervision for KGFM training. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective adaptive negative sampling approach, KMAS, to enhance existing KGFMs. KMAS constructs hard negative triples through the updated relation embeddings generated from the existing KGFM's relation encoder. To further adaptively align with the evolving capability of the KGFM during the training process, KMAS adjusts the ratio of hard negative triples dynamically throughout the whole training process: after a warmup phrase, it increases the ratio linearly and then decreases linearly. Extensive experiments are conducted over 44 data sets. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed negative sampling method can enhance many SOTA KGFMs without requiring excessive additional time or memory consumption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KMAS：用 KGFM 关系编码器更新后的关系嵌入构造难负例三元组，并在 warmup 后线性升再线性降地动态调整难负例比例，以替代随机替换头尾实体的负采样。在 44 个数据集上可增强多个 SOTA KGFM，且不带来过多时间或内存开销。
Motivation: 零样本知识图谱补全依赖 KGFM，但训练普遍用随机替换头尾实体得到的负三元组，质量低、监督信号弱，限制了模型在关系词表不同的未见 KG 上的表现。
Method: KMAS 从现有 KGFM 关系编码器更新得到的关系嵌入出发构造难负例三元组；难负例比例在 warmup 阶段后线性上升、再线性下降，随训练进程自适应调整，用于增强既有 KGFM 而非替换其架构。
Result: 在 44 个数据集上的实验表明，该负采样方法能增强多个 SOTA KGFM，且不需要过多额外时间或内存消耗；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 难负例加动态比例调度是提升零样本 KG 补全训练监督质量的低成本通用插件，可叠加在现有 KGFM 之上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AdvantageFlow: Regularized Advantage-Weighted RL in Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: We present AdvantageFlow, a forward-process reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm for rectified flow models. The algorithm minimizes an advantage-weighted prediction loss, which maximizes reward, regularized by the rollout policy, which convexifies the objective and makes its optimization stable. Our objective can be viewed as fitting a local reward-improving target distribution. The rollout regularization arises as a variance reduction step. We evaluate AdvantageFlow empirically on text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and FLUX.1, and compare it to both forward- and reverse-process RL algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdvantageFlow 是面向 rectified flow 模型的前向过程强化学习算法，通过最小化优势加权预测损失来最大化奖励，并用 rollout 策略作正则项，使目标凸化、优化稳定，可视为拟合一个局部的奖励改进目标分布；正则项本身来自方差缩减步骤。在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 与 FLUX.1 的文生图任务上与前向及反向过程 RL 算法做了对比。
Motivation: rectified flow 类文生图模型的前向过程 RL 训练缺少既能最大化奖励又保持优化稳定的正则化目标，反向过程 RL 算法也未必适配前向采样结构。
Method: 在 rectified flow 的前向过程中最小化优势加权 (advantage-weighted) 预测损失以最大化奖励，并加入 rollout 策略作为正则项来凸化目标、稳定优化；该正则被解释为方差缩减步骤，整体等价于拟合局部奖励改进的目标分布。
Result: 在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 和 FLUX.1 上做文生图实证评估，并与前向过程和反向过程 RL 算法进行比较。
Conclusion: 优势加权加 rollout 正则的前向过程 RL 可作为 rectified flow 文生图的奖励优化方案，其正则项同时承担方差缩减作用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Eliciting Dynamic Memory for Out-of-Sight State Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Video world models should maintain evolving states when evidence is unobserved, yet current generators often freeze hidden states upon interruption. This is not simply a capacity problem: pretrained video diffusion transformers already possess KV-cache mechanisms capable of non-local retrieval, but they are rarely trained to use them as dynamic memory. We introduce ReMind, a framework eliciting dynamic memory behavior via memory-oriented data, event-aware training, and cache adaptation. Organized around a taxonomy of 100+ dynamic events, we build a camera-annotated training mixture combining VLM-filtered real videos, generated hard dynamics, synthetic camera loops, and memory-interruption augmentations. Each clip is converted into a frame graph with protected anchors, degraded intervals, and explicit temporal gaps. A node-structured curriculum -- including node-drop, noisy memory, frontier continuation, and reference-cache training -- forces the model to retrieve relevant past states across interruptions rather than relying solely on local continuity. PM-RoPE, an elegant camera-phase RoPE extension, unlocks spatiotemporal retrieval at a single-attention cost while preserving pretrained pathways. ReMind achieves the best overall scores on STEVO-Bench and recovery tasks. Furthermore, general image-to-video evaluations confirm this curriculum avoids catastrophic forgetting. We have released our code, data, and models on our project page \href{https://remind-applied.github.io/}{https://remind-applied.github.io/}.
papers.comment: Accepted by Neurips 2026. Project page: https://remind-applied.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReMind 通过记忆导向数据、事件感知训练与 KV-cache 适配，让预训练视频扩散 Transformer 在画面中断后仍能跨间隔检索并延续被遮挡状态，而不是冻结隐状态。在 STEVO-Bench 与恢复任务上取得最佳综合分，且通用图生视频评测显示该课程训练不会造成灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 视频世界模型在证据不可见时应维持状态演化，但现有生成器在中断后往往直接冻结隐状态；预训练视频扩散 Transformer 已具备可非局部检索的 KV-cache，却很少被训练成动态记忆使用。
Method: 围绕 100+ 动态事件分类体系构建相机标注训练混合（VLM 筛选的真实视频、生成的困难动力学、合成相机循环、记忆中断增强），每段剪辑转为含受保护锚点、退化区间与显式时间间隔的帧图；用节点结构化课程（node-drop、noisy memory、frontier continuation、reference-cache training）强制跨中断检索，并提出 PM-RoPE（camera-phase RoPE 扩展）以单次注意力开销解锁时空检索、保留预训练通路。
Result: 在 STEVO-Bench 与恢复任务上取得最佳综合分；通用 image-to-video 评测确认该课程避免灾难性遗忘；训练分类体系覆盖 100+ 动态事件，代码、数据与模型已在项目页发布。
Conclusion: 隐状态冻结不是容量问题而是训练问题：把 KV-cache 当作动态记忆来训练，配合跨中断检索课程与 PM-RoPE，可在不牺牲通用生成质量的前提下恢复被遮挡状态的演化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DemoEvolve: Demonstration-Guided Harness Evolution under Sparse Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Harness evolution enables frozen language model agents to adapt to unfamiliar tasks by modifying the external programs that govern their behavior. For long-horizon tasks, each rollout is costly, and a limited interaction budget may yield few examples of effective behavior. Sparse, delayed feedback also makes it difficult for a coding agent to diagnose failures and determine which modifications will improve performance. We present DemoEvolve, which uses human demonstrations to guide harness evolution under limited interaction budgets. The coding agent examines demonstrations alongside its own rollout history, extracts strategies and the conditions under which they apply, and turns them into reusable harness components. We compare demonstration guidance with self-rollout evolution and augmentation with retrieved textual knowledge under the same evolution procedure and agent interaction budget. On held-out seeds, DemoEvolve improves mean capped final-round progress from 16.83 to 20.00 in Balatro and mean floor reached from 18.17 to 28.83 in Slay the Spire 2, compared with the respective base harnesses. These results suggest that demonstrations can help harness evolution make better use of limited interaction experience by providing concrete guidance for diagnosis and modification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DemoEvolve 用人类示范引导冻结语言模型 agent 的 harness 演化：coding agent 同时读示范与自身 rollout 历史，提炼策略及其适用条件并转成可复用 harness 组件。在相同演化流程与交互预算下，Balatro 的 mean capped final-round progress 从 16.83 升到 20.00，Slay the Spire 2 的 mean floor reached 从 18.17 升到 28.83。
Motivation: 长程任务中每次 rollout 成本高，有限交互预算只能留下少量有效行为样本；稀疏延迟反馈又让 coding agent 难以定位失败、判断哪种修改能提升性能。
Method: 以人类示范作为演化指导：coding agent 对照示范与自身 rollout 历史，抽取策略及其生效条件，转成可复用 harness 组件；对照组为 self-rollout 演化与检索文本知识增强，三者共用同一演化流程与 agent 交互预算。
Result: 在 held-out seeds 上，相对各自 base harness，Balatro 的 mean capped final-round progress 由 16.83 提升至 20.00，Slay the Spire 2 的 mean floor reached 由 18.17 提升至 28.83。
Conclusion: 示范通过给出诊断与修改的具体指引，让 harness 演化更充分地利用有限交互经验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gaussian Mixture Copula Processes for Irregular Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Gaussian Mixture Copula Processes (GMCP), a conditional copula process for irregularly sampled multivariate time series (IMTS) that is expressive and marginalization consistent at the same time. Existing conditional copula processes achieve only one of the two. Gaussian copula processes are consistent by construction but confined to elliptical dependence, whereas attentional copulas such as TACTiS-2 are far more expressive but neither preserve the marginals they are built on nor guarantee that integrating out a target point returns the joint over the remaining ones. GMCP closes this gap by inferring the parameters of a Gaussian Mixture Copula from the context in a way that guarantees consistent marginalization. This yields a non-elliptical copula process with tractable likelihood and consistency guarantees. Our experiments show that copulas equipped with MargFlow, a normalizing-flow model for the univariate marginals fitted in isolation, outperform jointly trained baselines in probabilistic IMTS forecasting. We further provide evidence that GMCP is more expressive than Gaussian copula processes, and on par with the inconsistent TACTiS-2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gaussian Mixture Copula Processes (GMCP)，一种面向不规则采样多变量时间序列 (IMTS) 的条件 copula 过程，从上下文推断 Gaussian Mixture Copula 参数并保证边缘化一致，同时保持非椭圆依赖与可解似然。实验显示配 MargFlow（单独拟合的单变量边缘 normalizing flow）的 copula 在概率式 IMTS 预报上优于联合训练基线，表达力超过 Gaussian copula 过程、与不一致的 TACTiS-2 相当。
Motivation: 现有条件 copula 过程只能二选一：Gaussian copula 过程构造上边缘一致但局限于椭圆依赖，注意力型 copula（如 TACTiS-2）表达力强却不保留所建边缘、也不保证积分掉目标点后返回其余点的联合分布。
Method: GMCP 从上下文推断 Gaussian Mixture Copula 的参数，并以保证一致边缘化的方式构造，得到非椭圆、似然可解且有一致性保证的 copula 过程；边缘分布用单独拟合的 normalizing-flow 模型 MargFlow 提供，再与 copula 组合用于概率式 IMTS 预报。
Result: 配 MargFlow 的 copula 在概率式 IMTS 预报上优于联合训练的基线；GMCP 比 Gaussian copula 过程更具表达力，且与不保证一致性的 TACTiS-2 表现相当。
Conclusion: 表达力与边缘化一致性可以同时满足：把边缘与 copula 分开建模并显式约束边缘化，就能在不牺牲一致性的前提下达到注意力型 copula 的表达水平。
Relevance: 37

summary_sections.result: 配 MargFlow 的 copula 在概率式 IMTS 预报上优于联合训练的基线；GMCP 比 Gaussian copula 过程更具表达力，且与不保证一致性的 TACTiS-2 表现相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 表达力与边缘化一致性可以同时满足：把边缘与 copula 分开建模并显式约束边缘化，就能在不牺牲一致性的前提下达到注意力型 copula 的表达水平。

papers.title: Adaptive Mass-Segmented KV Compression for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache is a critical bottleneck in long-form LLM inference. Existing KV compression methods mitigate this by evicting tokens based on importance scores. However, we show that their reliance on global Top-k selection triggers Region Wipe-out: the severe eviction of contiguous reasoning blocks that derails logical coherence. To address this, we propose Adaptive Mass-Segmented (AMS) KV Compression, a framework that shifts the paradigm from token-level competition to region-aware quota allocation. AMS adaptively partitions the KV cache based on the spatial distribution of attention mass, ensuring structurally vital reasoning segments receive guaranteed memory quotas. To ensure stability during iterative decoding, an EMA-based smoothing mechanism is incorporated to prevent jitter in segment boundaries. Crucially, AMS is a universal plug-and-play layer that is orthogonal to existing scorers. It can be seamlessly integrated into representative methods such as TOVA, Expected Attention, KeyDiff, R-KV and TriAttention. AMS is also system-compatible with modern paged-KV serving frameworks such as vLLM, supporting efficient gather-and-compact KV execution without introducing additional steady-state attention overhead. Extensive experiments across a diverse suite of tasks, including mathematical reasoning (MATH500, AIME, GSM8K), code completion, open-domain QA, and sparse retrieval, demonstrate that AMS consistently mitigates structural fragmentation and boosts model performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMS 把 KV cache 压缩从 token 级全局 Top-k 竞争改为按注意力质量空间分布做区域配额分配，避免连续推理块被整体擦除（Region Wipe-out）。它用 EMA 平滑段边界、以即插即用层接入 TOVA、Expected Attention、KeyDiff、R-KV、TriAttention，并兼容 vLLM 分页 KV。在 MATH500、AIME、GSM8K、代码补全、开放域 QA 与稀疏检索上一致缓解结构碎片化并提升模型性能。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 线性增长是关键瓶颈；现有方法按重要性分数驱逐 token，全局 Top-k 会连续擦除整段推理块，破坏逻辑连贯性。
Method: AMS 按注意力质量（attention mass）的空间分布自适应切分 KV cache，给结构关键的推理段分配保底内存配额；用 EMA 平滑机制抑制迭代解码中的段边界抖动；作为与打分器正交的通用层接入 TOVA、Expected Attention、KeyDiff、R-KV、TriAttention，并与 vLLM 分页 KV 框架兼容，执行 gather-and-compact 且不引入额外稳态注意力开销。
Result: 在数学推理（MATH500、AIME、GSM8K）、代码补全、开放域 QA 与稀疏检索的多样任务套件上，AMS 一致缓解结构碎片化并提升模型性能。
Conclusion: 把 KV 压缩从 token 级竞争换成区域感知配额分配，可在不改动既有打分器、不增加稳态注意力开销的前提下修复长上下文推理的连贯性损失。

papers.title: Decomposing and Measuring Evaluation Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models sometimes recognize that they are under evaluation and adjust their behavior which can undermine validity of benchmark results. Yet the field studies it without a shared foundation, conflating flaws of the evaluation with capabilities of the model, and detection with behavioral response. We ground evaluation awareness in social psychology, decomposing it into an environment component and a model component that separates recognition from propensity. We operationalize the environment component through eight categorized trigger factors, such as placeholder entities and grading-style output formats, and study recognition and behavior through chain-of-thought monitoring. Across nine frontier models and four benchmarks, recognition rates depend on the specific pairing of model and benchmark. Recognition rarely associates with behavioral change, and when it does, the direction depends on the type of evaluation perceived. Models are also more sensitive to safety than capability evaluations, placing safety benchmark validity at greater risk. To study which factors each model is sensitive to and how they interact, we propose \textbf{EvalAwareBench}, a factor-controlled benchmark of 100 paired safety-capability tasks where each of the eight factors can be independently toggled, varying evaluative signals while holding the underlying request fixed. Through EvalAwareBench, we find that no single factor uniformly affects all models, but stacking factors progressively raises evaluation awareness across all of them. Our framework and EvalAwareBench provide the tools to measure, attribute, and mitigate evaluation awareness, building the foundation for future solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把评测意识 (evaluation awareness) 拆成环境触发与模型成分（识别 recognition 与行为倾向 propensity 分离），用八类触发因子和 CoT 监控在 9 个前沿模型、4 个 benchmark 上测量。识别率取决于模型与 benchmark 的具体配对，且很少伴随行为改变；安全类评测比能力类更易受影响，叠加因子会在所有模型上逐步抬高评测意识。
Motivation: 前沿模型会察觉自己在被评测并调整行为，削弱 benchmark 结果的有效性，但该领域缺少共同框架，把评测缺陷与模型能力、识别与行为反应混为一谈。
Method: 以社会心理学为理论基础，把评测意识分解为环境成分与模型成分；环境成分用八类触发因子（如占位实体、评分式输出格式）操作化，识别与行为通过 chain-of-thought 监控考察；并提出 EvalAwareBench，一个含 100 组安全-能力配对任务的因子受控 benchmark，八个因子可独立开关、只改变评测信号而保持底层请求不变。
Result: 在 9 个前沿模型与 4 个 benchmark 上，识别率取决于模型与 benchmark 的具体配对；识别很少与行为改变相关，一旦相关，方向取决于所感知的评测类型；模型对安全类评测比能力类更敏感，使安全 benchmark 的有效性风险更大。EvalAwareBench 上没有单一因子对所有模型一致生效，但因子叠加会在所有模型上逐步提升评测意识。
Conclusion: 评测意识需按识别与行为倾向分开测量，安全 benchmark 的效度风险高于能力 benchmark；缓解方案应针对因子组合而非单一触发因子。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimum Description Length based Granular-Ball Tree Regularization for Spectral Clustering
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes Minimum Description Length based Granular-Ball Tree Regularized Spectral Clustering (MDL-GBTRSC), a fixed-K method that uses granular balls as regional descriptors for sample-level affinity construction rather than as reduced graph nodes. A reciprocal-neighborhood continuity term is incorporated into an MDL-based refinement criterion to construct a granular-ball hierarchy, and the structural scales of the terminal regions are transferred to the original sample graph before spectral partitioning. Experiments on 18 real and 20 synthetic datasets, comprising 109,969 samples in total, compare MDL-GBTRSC with nine competing methods. On the 17 real datasets completed by all methods, MDL-GBTRSC achieves mean ARI and NMI values of 0.5998 and 0.6613, compared with the next-highest means of 0.5792 and 0.6285, respectively. On the 20 synthetic datasets, it achieves mean ARI and NMI values of 0.9618 and 0.9688, compared with the next-highest means of 0.7921 and 0.8306, and is best or tied on 15 datasets for both metrics. These results indicate that MDL-selected regional structure provides useful local information for affinity construction while preserving the resolution of the original spectral graph. Source code and experimental materials are available at https://github.com/AnonymousUser0816/MDL-GBTRSC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出固定 K 的谱聚类方法 MDL-GBTRSC：用 granular ball 作为区域描述子直接构造样本级亲和度（而非缩减图节点），以互近邻连续性项加入 MDL 精炼准则构建层次，并把终端区域的结构尺度传回原始样本图再做谱划分。在 18 个真实与 20 个合成数据集（共 109,969 样本）上对比九种方法，真实集平均 ARI/NMI 0.5998/0.6613（次优 0.5792/0.6285），合成集 0.9618/0.9688（次优 0.7921/0.8306），两项指标在 15 个合成集上并列最佳。
Motivation: 以 granular ball 缩减图节点的做法会损失原始谱图的分辨率，谱聚类需要在保留样本级结构的同时获得可判别的区域先验。
Method: MDL-GBTRSC 用 granular ball 做区域描述子构造样本级亲和度；在基于 MDL 的精炼准则中加入 reciprocal-neighborhood continuity 项以构建 granular-ball 层次；把终端区域的结构尺度转移回原始样本图后再做谱划分，方法为固定 K。
Result: 18 个真实与 20 个合成数据集、共 109,969 样本，对比九种方法；在全部方法完成的 17 个真实数据集上平均 ARI 0.5998、NMI 0.6613（次高均值 0.5792、0.6285）；20 个合成数据集上平均 ARI 0.9618、NMI 0.9688（次高 0.7921、0.8306），两项指标在 15 个数据集上最优或并列最优。
Conclusion: MDL 选出的区域结构既为亲和度构造提供有用的局部信息，又保留了原始谱图的分辨率；源码与实验材料已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: Guided Trajectory Optimization with Sparse Scaling for Test-Time Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) paradigm offers a promising perspective for enhancing the generation performance of diffusion models. However, current solutions largely restrict their search to predefined noise candidates or suffer from inflexible exploration across the denoising trajectory. To bridge this gap, we propose RTS, a novel Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling method to fully unlock the generative potential of diffusion models. Unlike existing methods, RTS facilitates the synthesis of refined, high-fidelity images via two core innovations: 1) a coarse-to-fine noise optimization mechanism that exploits historical search experience to actively steer the exploration toward high-reward regions and 2) a unified sparse test-time scaling framework featuring PCA-driven curvature analysis, which eliminates temporal redundancy by flexiblely allocating compute to a sparse set of key timesteps that represent critical shifts in the denoising direction. Extensive experiments across SD v3, FLUX, and Qwen-Image architectures demonstrate that RTS outperforms baselines, improving the GenEval score by 20.7%, 15.6%, and 12.2%, respectively. Notably, empirical findings indicate that these key points primarily cluster in the mid-stage of the trajectory, distinct from the structure-sensitive early phases and the late attribute refinement phases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RTS 把扩散模型的测试时扩展从固定噪声候选改为沿去噪轨迹的奖励引导搜索：用历史搜索经验做由粗到细的噪声优化，把算力稀疏分配到由 PCA 曲率分析选出的关键时间步。在 SD v3、FLUX、Qwen-Image 上 GenEval 分别提升 20.7%、15.6%、12.2%，关键点集中在轨迹中段。
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展 (TTS) 方法要么把搜索限制在预定义的噪声候选上，要么在去噪轨迹上的探索不灵活，无法充分释放扩散模型的生成潜力。
Method: RTS (Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling) 含两个核心组件：一是 coarse-to-fine 噪声优化机制，利用历史搜索经验主动把探索导向高奖励区域；二是统一的稀疏测试时扩展框架，用 PCA 驱动的曲率分析识别去噪方向的关键转折时间步，把计算灵活分配到这组稀疏关键点以消除时间冗余。
Result: 在 SD v3、FLUX、Qwen-Image 三种架构上，RTS 的 GenEval 分数相对基线分别提升 20.7%、15.6%、12.2%；经验上关键时间步主要聚在轨迹中段，区别于对结构敏感的早期阶段和做属性精修的晚期阶段。
Conclusion: 奖励引导的轨迹级稀疏测试时扩展能比固定噪声候选搜索更有效地提升扩散模型生成质量，且去噪轨迹的中段是计算最该投放的位置。

papers.title: EvoScene-VLA: Evolving Scene Beliefs Inside the Action Decoder for Chunked Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: Chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate multi-step actions from one observation and typically re-observe after executing the action chunk. Earlier actions change the scene conditions for later steps, while occlusion can compromise visual feedback. Spatial and temporal VLAs enhance geometry and memory, but their representations may become stale as actions alter object poses and contacts. We introduce EvoScene-VLA, which uses compact scene tokens to unify within-chunk scene prediction, cross-chunk state propagation, and observation-based correction. The action expert jointly denoises actions and future scene states in a single flow-matching process, allowing predicted scene changes to inform action generation. The final scene state serves as the next prior for subsequent correction. At the next control call, the vision-language model (VLM) fuses the incoming visual input with this prior. Two-level geometric anchoring applies local depth supervision to per-view scene features and global 3D feature supervision to the fused scene state; a shared geometric decoder imposes the same constraints on current and future states. Since demonstrations do not directly provide future scene states, we train a scene predictor using 3D teacher features from future images. Its predictions provide targets for the action expert's future scene states. At deployment, we remove both Scene Predictor and Geometric Anchor. EvoScene-VLA improves average success over the matched baseline by 2.4 and 2.2 percentage points on 31 RoboTwin tasks under fixed and randomized settings, respectively, and by 2.7 points on LIBERO. Across three real-robot tasks, average success rises from 37.3% to 42.0%. Ablations show that a recurrent scene state alone does not necessarily improve performance, whereas state propagation can improve control when combined with geometric and future scene supervision.
papers.comment: Updated manuscript, experiments, and preprint formatting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoScene-VLA 在动作解码器内部维护紧凑 scene token，用单个 flow-matching 过程同时去噪动作与未来场景状态，使预测的场景变化反过来指导动作生成，并把最终场景状态作为下次控制的先验。在 31 个 RoboTwin 任务上相对匹配基线平均成功率提升 2.4（固定设置）与 2.2 个百分点（随机设置），LIBERO 提升 2.7 个百分点，三个真机任务平均成功率从 37.3% 升到 42.0%。消融显示仅有循环场景状态并不必然提升性能，必须配合几何监督与未来场景监督。
Motivation: 分块 VLA 策略一次观测生成多步动作，先前动作会改变后续步骤的场景条件，遮挡又削弱视觉反馈；空间与时间 VLA 的表征会随物体位姿与接触变化而过期。
Method: 用紧凑 scene token 统一块内场景预测、跨块状态传播与基于观测的校正；动作专家在单个 flow-matching 过程中联合去噪动作与未来场景状态，最终场景状态作为下次校正的先验，由 VLM 将新观测与该先验融合。两级几何锚定对逐视图场景特征施加局部深度监督、对融合场景状态施加全局 3D 特征监督，共享几何解码器对当前与未来状态施加同一约束；因演示不含未来场景状态，另用未来图像的 3D teacher 特征训练 Scene Predictor 提供目标，部署时移除 Scene Predictor 与 Geometric Anchor。
Result: 31 个 RoboTwin 任务上平均成功率相对匹配基线提升 2.4 个百分点（固定设置）与 2.2 个百分点（随机设置），LIBERO 提升 2.7 个百分点；三个真机任务平均成功率由 37.3% 升至 42.0%。消融表明单独的循环场景状态不必然改善性能，而状态传播结合几何监督与未来场景监督时可改善控制。

papers.title: Dropout Universality: Scaling Laws and Optimal Scheduling at the Edge-of-Chaos
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether the standard treatment of dropout as a static hyperparameter is optimal, or whether its utility can be improved by letting it vary over depth. We answer this by developing a mean-field theory of dropout near the edge of chaos, identifying distinct universality classes for smooth and kinked activations, together with their scaling exponents. The resulting propagation theory, constrained by maximizing the regularization delivered by dropout, motivates concentrating dropout near the input. Experiments on vision, speech and financial time series show gains most consistently in MLPs, with smaller gains in Transformers.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 36 pages, 11 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 dropout 从静态超参数改为随深度变化的调度：在混沌边缘 (edge-of-chaos) 附近建立 dropout 的平均场理论，得到光滑激活与折点激活两类不同的普适类及标度指数。由最大化 dropout 所提供正则化的传播理论推出应把 dropout 集中在靠近输入的层；在视觉、语音和金融时间序列上，增益在 MLP 中最一致，在 Transformer 中较小。
Motivation: dropout 通常被当作全网统一的静态超参数处理，其效用是否能通过沿深度变化来提升、以及在混沌边缘附近应遵循何种标度，此前缺少理论刻画。
Method: 在混沌边缘附近推导 dropout 的平均场理论 (mean-field theory)，区分光滑激活与折点激活 (kinked activations) 的普适类并给出标度指数；再以最大化 dropout 提供的正则化为约束建立传播理论 (propagation theory)，据此导出沿深度的 dropout 分布形态。
Result: 理论给出两类普适类及其标度指数，并推出 dropout 应集中在输入侧；实验覆盖视觉、语音与金融时间序列三类数据，增益在 MLP 中最一致，在 Transformer 中较小。
Conclusion: dropout 的最优形态是随深度变化而非全网常数，且应向输入层集中；这一收益依赖架构，在 MLP 上比在 Transformer 上更明显。

papers.title: Accelerating Video Inverse Problem Solvers with Autoregressive Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide powerful priors for zero-shot video inverse problems, but their real-time deployment is hindered by two inefficiencies: high initial latency caused by holistic video restoration, and low throughput resulting from multiple VAE passes to enforce measurement consistency in pixel space. To overcome these limitations, we propose Autoregressive Video Inverse problem Solver (AVIS). The AVIS framework leverages autoregressive video diffusion models to restore videos in a streaming manner, naturally eliminating latency bottlenecks. Specifically, AVIS initializes reverse diffusion with a measurement-consistent estimate, reducing the required sampling steps. Compared to leading non-autoregressive solvers, AVIS drastically reduces initial latency from 114s to 4s and increases throughput from 0.71 to 1.18 FPS while achieving superior restoration quality. We further introduce a highly accelerated variant, dubbed AVIS Flash, that enforces measurement consistency solely on the first chunk. AVIS Flash substantially boosts throughput to 5.91 FPS on a single RTX 4090 GPU while maintaining competitive performance and achieving a favorable efficiency-performance trade-off, paving the way toward real-time deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVIS 用自回归视频扩散模型做流式零样本视频逆问题求解，并用测量一致的初值启动反向扩散以减少采样步数。初始延迟从 114s 降到 4s，吞吐从 0.71 提到 1.18 FPS 且重建质量更优；AVIS Flash 只在首个 chunk 强制测量一致性，单张 RTX 4090 上吞吐达 5.91 FPS。
Motivation: 扩散先验做零样本视频逆问题时，整体式复原造成高初始延迟，且在像素空间多次 VAE 前向以维持测量一致性导致吞吐低下，难以实时部署。
Method: AVIS 以自回归视频扩散模型流式复原视频，反向扩散用测量一致的估计初始化以减少所需采样步数；AVIS Flash 变体仅在第一个 chunk 上强制测量一致性。
Result: 相对领先的非自回归求解器，初始延迟 114s → 4s，吞吐 0.71 → 1.18 FPS，且复原质量更优；AVIS Flash 在单张 RTX 4090 上吞吐提升到 5.91 FPS，同时保持有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 自回归流式扩散加测量一致初值可把视频逆问题求解推向实时部署，AVIS Flash 以仅首 chunk 强制一致性换取更激进的效率-性能折中。

papers.title: Vision Harnessing Agent for Open Ad-hoc Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation has become easy when the concept is known, requiring retrieval of a learned visual grounding from text. It remains hard for open ad-hoc concepts, where the grounding may not exist as one learned mask and must often be constructed from image evidence through parts, relations, exclusions, and collections. We propose a Vision-guided Ad-hoc Segmentation Agent (VASA), the first vision harnessing agent for open ad-hoc segmentation. VASA is training-free and couples a VLM agent, a segmentation foundation model, and a visual harness that maintains a working mask to make visual progress persistent, inspectable, and editable. Rather than revising text prompts alone, it plans visual operations, invokes segmentation tools, inspects results, edits the mask, and recovers from errors. We construct PARS, a new benchmark that turns part-level labels into open ad-hoc concepts through long-form definition queries. We show that VASA is consistently effective across six VLMs with varying capabilities. Using Qwen3-VL 32B Thinking as the VLM, VASA outperforms various baselines on PARS, surpassing SAM3 Agent by 13.5%-25.3%. On RefCOCOm, VASA improves over SAM3 Agent by 4.8%-8.8% and over other agentic baselines by more. VASA also remains competitive with SAM3 Agent on ReasonSeg for common, named concepts. These results validate VASA's agentic visual construction for open ad-hoc segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练无关的视觉引导即席分割 agent (VASA)，把 VLM、分割基础模型与维护工作掩码的 visual harness 耦合起来，通过规划视觉操作、调用分割工具、检查结果并编辑掩码来构造开放即席概念的 grounding。在自建 PARS 基准上用 Qwen3-VL 32B Thinking 比 SAM3 Agent 高 13.5%–25.3%，在 RefCOCOm 上高 4.8%–8.8%。
Motivation: 概念已知时分割只需检索从文本学到的视觉 grounding，而开放即席概念的 grounding 不存在单一已学掩码，必须从图像证据中由部件、关系、排除与集合构造出来，仅改文本提示无法解决。
Method: VASA 为 training-free 流程：VLM agent 规划视觉操作并调用分割工具，分割基础模型出掩码，visual harness 维护一个可持久、可检查、可编辑的 working mask，支持结果检查、掩码编辑与错误恢复；同时构建 PARS 基准，把部件级标签转成长文本定义查询的开放即席概念。
Result: 在 PARS 上用 Qwen3-VL 32B Thinking 作 VLM，VASA 超过多种基线，比 SAM3 Agent 高 13.5%–25.3%；在 RefCOCOm 上比 SAM3 Agent 高 4.8%–8.8%，并优于其他 agentic 基线；在 ReasonSeg 的常见命名概念上与 SAM3 Agent 保持竞争力，且在能力各异的六个 VLM 上均一致有效。
Conclusion: 开放即席分割应靠 agent 式的视觉构造（规划、调用工具、编辑掩码）而非仅改写文本提示，且该构造方式在不同 VLM 上都稳定成立。

papers.title: Observation-Aligned Mask Priors for Learning Physical Fields from Authentic Occlusions
papers.abstract_en: Learning physical fields directly from incomplete observations is challenging because authentic occlusions are structured, sample-dependent, and often missing not at random, whereas existing methods typically rely on heuristic masking rules or predefined mask distributions. We propose Observation-Aligned Mask Priors, a framework that learns the distribution of authentic observation masks and uses it to construct context-query partitions for training from incomplete data. Specifically, we pretrain a Bayesian Flow Network (BFN) on binary observation masks to capture real occlusion topologies, then guide BFN sampling with a globally normalized cross-entropy objective to generate sample-specific masks aligned with each sparse observation. The intersection between the guided mask and the observed mask defines the context, and the remaining observed entries become query targets for a diffusion-based reconstruction model. We show that this intersection-based partitioning gives every valid observed dimension a strictly positive probability of being queried, preventing zero-query dead zones and local generative collapse. Experiments on three real-world oceanographic datasets with authentic satellite occlusions, across resolutions up to 256$\times$256, show consistent improvements over strong diffusion baselines in MSE and PSNR. These results demonstrate that learning mask priors from authentic occlusions is an effective alternative to heuristic masking for learning from incomplete physical observations without access to fully observed fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Observation-Aligned Mask Priors：用 Bayesian Flow Network (BFN) 学真实观测掩码的分布，再以全局归一化交叉熵引导采样生成与每条稀疏观测对齐的样本专属掩码，其与观测掩码的交集作为 context、其余观测项作为 query 训练扩散重建模型。交集划分保证每个有效观测维度被查询的概率严格为正，消除零 query 死区与局部生成坍缩；在三个带真实卫星遮挡的海洋数据集、分辨率最高 256×256 上，MSE 与 PSNR 一致优于强扩散基线。
Motivation: 从不完整观测直接学习物理场时，真实遮挡是结构化、样本相关且非随机缺失的，而现有方法依赖启发式掩码规则或预定义掩码分布，无法反映真实遮挡拓扑。
Method: 先在二值观测掩码上预训练 Bayesian Flow Network (BFN) 学习真实遮挡拓扑，再用全局归一化交叉熵目标引导 BFN 采样，生成与每条稀疏观测对齐的样本专属掩码；引导掩码与观测掩码的交集定义 context，其余观测项作为 query 目标送入扩散重建模型。
Result: 在三个带真实卫星遮挡的真实海洋数据集上、分辨率最高 256×256，MSE 与 PSNR 相对强扩散基线一致改进；理论上交集划分使每个有效观测维度被查询的概率严格为正，避免零 query 死区与局部生成坍缩。
Conclusion: 从真实遮挡中学习掩码先验，是在无法获得完整观测场条件下替代启发式掩码的有效途径，且交集式 context-query 划分是避免生成坍缩的关键机制。

summary_sections.conclusion: 从真实遮挡中学习掩码先验，是在无法获得完整观测场条件下替代启发式掩码的有效途径，且交集式 context-query 划分是避免生成坍缩的关键机制。

papers.title: TwinRouterBench: Fast Static and Live Dynamic Evaluation for Realistic Agentic LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: LLM routing matters most in long-horizon applications such as coding agents, deep research systems, and computer-use agents, where a single user request triggers many model calls. Routing each call to the cheapest sufficient model can cut costs without sacrificing quality, yet existing router benchmarks evaluate routers only on one-shot prompts. They never expose the router-visible prefix at an intermediate agent step, never test whether a cheaper replacement preserves downstream task success, and often rely on online LLM judges at evaluation time. We introduce TwinRouterBench, a step-level routing benchmark with two tracks. The static track provides 970 router-visible prefixes from 520 instances across SWE-bench, BFCL, mtRAG, QMSum, and PinchBench, each paired with an execution-verified target tier estimated under a released downgrade-and-cascade protocol; scoring is deterministic arithmetic over tier labels, trajectory membership, and token costs, with no online evaluator-side LLM judge. The dynamic track supplies a harness that runs routers on the full 500-case SWE-bench Verified suite; in this paper we report a 100-case held-out evaluation disjoint from the static SWE supervision split. At each LLM call the router selects a concrete model from a locked pool, and success is measured by official task resolution and realized API spend. The two tracks support fast offline iteration followed by end-to-end validation under live agent execution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CommonstackAI/TwinRouterBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TwinRouterBench 是面向智能体 (agent) 长程调用的 LLM 路由基准，含静态与动态两条赛道：静态赛道给 970 个路由器可见前缀（来自 520 个实例，覆盖 SWE-bench、BFCL、mtRAG、QMSum、PinchBench），每个前缀配一个经执行验证的目标模型档位；动态赛道在完整 500 例 SWE-bench Verified 上跑路由器，本文报告与静态监督划分不相交的 100 例留出评测。评分是确定性算术（档位标签、轨迹成员、token 成本），不依赖在线 LLM judge，成功以官方任务解决率与实际 API 花费衡量。
Motivation: 现有路由基准只在一次性 prompt 上评测，从不暴露智能体中间步骤的路由器可见前缀，也不检验更便宜的替代模型能否保住下游任务成功，且常依赖在线 LLM judge。
Method: 静态赛道用已发布的 downgrade-and-cascade 协议为每个前缀估计经执行验证的目标档位，评分对档位标签、轨迹成员与 token 成本做确定性算术；动态赛道提供 harness，让路由器在每次 LLM 调用时从锁定模型池中选具体模型，按官方任务解决率与实际 API 花费计成功。
Result: 静态赛道 970 个前缀、520 个实例，跨 SWE-bench、BFCL、mtRAG、QMSum、PinchBench 五个数据集；动态赛道覆盖完整 500 例 SWE-bench Verified，本文报告 100 例与静态 SWE 监督划分不相交的留出评测。
Conclusion: 路由评测应下沉到智能体的单次调用级别，并按“先离线快速迭代、再在真实执行下端到端验证”的两段流程来做，评分不依赖在线 LLM judge。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Edge-AI-Driven Learning-to-Rank for Decentralized Task Allocation in Circular Smart Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Task allocation in smart manufacturing systems must operate under decentralized decision-making, dynamic workloads, and shared-resource constraints. In circular manufacturing settings, these challenges are further intensified because tasks compete for reusable, capacity-constrained assets, and machine selection also might affect processing energy. Although learning-based approaches have been explored for task allocation, improvements in predictive modeling do not necessarily translate into better allocation outcomes under decentralized negotiation. This work proposes an Edge-AI-driven decentralized task-allocation framework. We develop lightweight decision intelligence deployed at the machine level. It is developed progressively: first, a resource-aware heuristic establishes the decentralized bidding structure; a regression-based Edge-AI formulation then examines learned local bid approximation, and a compact autoencoder-regularized pairwise ranking model finally provides a learned correction to the analytical bid ordering. Each machine evaluates incoming tasks by using its processing capability, queue state, energy characteristics, and a compact signal representing contention over the reusable shared production asset. The framework is assessed using discrete-event simulation in scenarios characterized by high load and dependence on shared resources. Compared to the heuristic, the proposed ranking method increases completed tasks, reduces average tardiness, and lowers the deadline-miss rate, with statistically significant paired differences. Mean energy per completed task is also reduced. The results indicate that effective learning-assisted allocation depends not only on approximating local decision quantities, but also on shaping the relative preferences that determine negotiation outcomes.
papers.journal_ref: Under review at IEEE IoT J, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向循环智能制造的去中心化任务分配，提出 Edge-AI 分层框架：资源感知启发式建立竞标结构，回归式 Edge-AI 学局部出价近似，再用紧凑的自编码器正则化成对排序模型 (autoencoder-regularized pairwise ranking) 对解析出价排序做学习修正。在高负载、依赖共享可复用资产的离散事件仿真场景中，相比启发式，完成任务数增加、平均延误与截止期违约率下降且配对差异统计显著，单位完成任务平均能耗也降低。
Motivation: 去中心化协商下，预测模型精度的提升未必转化为更好的分配结果；循环制造中任务还竞争容量受限的可复用资产，机器选择会影响加工能耗。
Method: 三层递进的机器级轻量决策智能：资源感知启发式定义去中心化竞标结构；回归式 Edge-AI 学习局部出价近似；紧凑的自编码器正则化成对排序模型对解析出价排序给出学习修正。每台机器依据处理能力、队列状态、能耗特征以及表示共享资产竞争程度的紧凑信号评估任务。
Result: 在高负载且依赖共享资源的离散事件仿真场景中，排序方法相比启发式提高完成任务数、降低平均 tardiness 与 deadline-miss rate，配对差异具统计显著性；单位完成任务的平均能耗也下降。
Conclusion: 学习辅助分配的关键不只是近似局部决策量，而是塑造决定协商结果的相对偏好（排序），即把学习放在偏好排序而非单纯出价回归上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FactorizedHMR: A Hybrid Framework for Video Human Mesh Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Human Mesh Recovery (HMR) is fundamentally ambiguous: under occlusion or weak depth cues, multiple 3D bodies can explain the same image evidence. This ambiguity is not uniform across the body, as torso pose and root structure are often relatively well constrained, whereas distal articulations such as the arms and legs are more uncertain. Building on this observation, we propose FactorizedHMR, a two-stage framework that treats these two regimes differently. A deterministic regression module first recovers a stable torso-root anchor, and a probabilistic flow-matching module then completes the remaining non-torso articulation. To make this completion reliable, we combine a composite target representation with geometry-aware supervision and feature-aware classifier-free guidance, preserving the torso-root anchor while improving single-reference recovery of ambiguity-prone articulation. We also introduce a synthetic data pipeline that provides the paired image-camera-motion supervision under diverse viewpoints. Across camera-space and world-space benchmarks, FactorizedHMR remains competitive with strong baselines, with the clearest gains in occlusion-heavy recovery and drift-sensitive world-space metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactorizedHMR 把视频人体网格恢复 (Human Mesh Recovery) 的歧义按身体部位拆开：躯干-根节点锚点用确定性回归先解，手臂腿部等远端关节再用 flow-matching 概率模块补全，并配合复合目标表示、几何感知监督与 feature-aware classifier-free guidance。在相机空间与世界空间基准上与强基线持平，优势集中在遮挡严重场景与对漂移敏感的世界空间指标。
Motivation: 遮挡或深度线索弱时多个 3D 人体都能解释同一图像证据，且这种歧义在身体上分布不均：躯干姿态与根结构相对受约束，手臂腿部等远端关节不确定性高，统一建模会浪费这一结构。
Method: 两阶段框架：确定性回归模块先恢复稳定的 torso-root anchor，概率 flow-matching 模块在此锚点条件下补全非躯干关节；监督用复合目标表示加几何感知损失，并引入 feature-aware classifier-free guidance 在保留锚点的同时改善歧义关节的单参考恢复。另提出合成数据管线，在多样视角下生成配对的 image-camera-motion 监督。
Result: 在 camera-space 与 world-space 两类基准上与强基线保持竞争力，最明显的增益出现在遮挡严重的恢复场景以及对漂移敏感的 world-space 指标上。
Conclusion: 把人体姿态歧义按躯干与远端关节分而治之——先锚定受约束部分再概率补全不确定部分——是恢复遮挡下肢体与抑制世界空间漂移的有效路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: COLLATOR: Compositional Multi-Agent Orchestration with Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible foundation for multi-agent systems, but their effectiveness and computational cost depend critically on orchestration design. Across different tasks, role design, capacity assignment, and dependency construction jointly affect both solution quality and execution efficiency. Existing approaches automate parts of this design process, yet they often optimize these decisions partially or sequentially, and rely on execution-level feedback that provides limited credit assignment for local orchestration decisions. We propose LEMON (Learning Executable Multi-Agent Orchestration via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning), an LLM-based orchestrator that learns to design efficient multi-agent orchestration. Given a task, LEMON designs a unified orchestration specification that composes customized agent duties, capacity levels, and dependency relations. To train the orchestrator, we augment the orchestration-level Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective with a localized counterfactual credit signal that edits role, capacity, or dependency fields and applies the resulting reward contrast only to the edited spans. Experiments on six reasoning and coding benchmarks, including MMLU, GSM8K, AQuA, MultiArith, SVAMP, and HumanEval, show that LEMON achieves the best average performance among evaluated multi-agent orchestration methods while improving the accuracy-token trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LEMON：用带局部反事实信用分配的 GRPO 训练 LLM 编排器，让它为任务一次性生成包含 agent 职责、容量等级与依赖关系的统一编排规范。在六个推理与编码基准上，它在被比较的多智能体编排方法中取得最佳平均性能，同时改善准确率- token 权衡。
Motivation: 多智能体系统的效果与算力开销高度依赖编排设计，而现有方法只做部分或顺序优化，且依赖执行级反馈，对角色、容量、依赖这类局部编排决策的信用分配很粗。
Method: LEMON 是基于 LLM 的编排器，输出统一编排规范（agent duties、capacity levels、dependency relations）；训练时在编排级 GRPO 目标上加入局部反事实信用信号：编辑 role/capacity/dependency 字段，只把编辑前后的 reward 差值归到被编辑的 span 上。
Result: 在六个推理与编码基准 MMLU、GSM8K、AQuA、MultiArith、SVAMP、HumanEval 上，LEMON 在所评估的多智能体编排方法中平均性能最佳，并改善了 accuracy-token 权衡。
Conclusion: 把编排决策的信用分配做成字段级反事实对比，能让编排器同时学到更高质量与更省 token 的多智能体结构。

papers.title: Are Agents Ready to Teach? A Multi-Stage Benchmark for Real-World Teaching Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Language agents are increasingly deployed in professional workflows, yet tutoring remains a high-stakes capability that existing evaluations only partially capture. Effective tutor agents require more than producing correct answers or executing accurate tool calls: they must infer a warranted teaching decision from evidence, adapt support as learner state changes, and carry an instructor's request through a learning-management system (LMS) to a completed, verified intervention. We introduce TeachArena, a source-grounded benchmark that jointly evaluates three complementary surfaces of teaching work: professional pedagogical judgment, situated multi-turn tutoring, and end-to-end LMS teaching workflows. Its 354 audited tasks are each built around a pedagogical insight, grounded in evidence, and evaluated with matched verifiers over observable turn-level responses, tutoring trajectories, and persistent artifacts or environment states. Across a comprehensive evaluation of frontier models, our findings reveal that current models are generally capable of bounded pedagogical judgment, but still fall short of professional teaching standards in situated tutoring and end-to-end teaching-workflow execution. By unifying teacher judgment, adaptive tutoring, and institutional action in one auditable benchmark, TEACHARENA provides a measurement foundation for developing tutor agents that can support realistic teaching work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TeachArena 是一个以教学证据为源、配对验证器的辅导智能体基准，354 个经审核任务联合评测三层教学能力：专业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导、端到端 LMS 教学工作流。对前沿模型的评测显示它们普遍能完成有边界的教学判断，但在情境化辅导与端到端工作流执行上仍达不到专业教学标准。
Motivation: 现有评测只部分覆盖辅导这一高风险能力：答对题目或正确调用工具不等于做出有依据的教学决策、随学习者状态调整支持、并在 LMS 中把教师指令执行成经过验证的干预。
Method: 每个任务围绕一条教学洞察构建并锚定证据，用配对验证器 (matched verifiers) 评测可观测的轮次级回答、辅导轨迹以及持久化产物或环境状态；三个评测面分别对应教学判断、情境多轮辅导与端到端 LMS 工作流，共 354 个经审核任务。
Result: 在对前沿模型的综合评测中，模型普遍具备有边界的教学判断能力，但在情境化多轮辅导和端到端教学工作流执行两面上仍达不到专业教学标准；基准规模为 354 个经审核任务。
Conclusion: 把教师判断、自适应辅导与机构层面行动放进同一个可审计基准，才能为能支撑真实教学工作的辅导智能体提供测量基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Support Realignment for Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain offline reinforcement learning learns a target policy from pre-collected source and target datasets with different dynamics. When target data are scarce, effectively compensating for their limited coverage using source data remains challenging due to the discrepancy between domains. We propose Target-aligned Coverage Expansion (TCE), which leverages source states to generatively realign and expand the limited target support while controlling the generation error induced by this expansion. We further derive a performance gap bound that characterizes the interplay between generation error and source--target dynamics gap, providing theoretical guidance for effective coverage expansion and source utilization. Across diverse cross-domain environments, TCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, while further analysis empirically supports the guidance provided by our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Target-aligned Coverage Expansion (TCE)，用源域状态生成式地重对齐并扩展稀缺目标域数据的支撑集，同时控制扩展引入的生成误差。推导的性能差上界刻画了生成误差与源-目标动力学差异的相互作用，为覆盖扩展与源数据利用给出理论指导；在多种跨域环境中持续优于最先进基线。
Motivation: 跨域离线强化学习中目标域数据稀缺时，源数据与目标域的动力学差异使源数据难以补偿目标支撑集的有限覆盖。
Method: TCE 利用源域状态对有限目标支撑做生成式重对齐与扩展，并控制扩展带来的生成误差；同时推导一个性能差上界，刻画生成误差与源-目标动力学差距的交互，指导覆盖扩展与源数据利用。
Result: 在多种跨域环境中 TCE 持续优于最先进基线；进一步分析为理论结论给出的指导提供经验证据支持。
Conclusion: 按生成误差与动力学差距的权衡来扩展目标支撑，可以在目标数据稀缺时有效利用源数据，理论指导与实证结果一致。

papers.title: UHR-Micro: Diagnosing and Mitigating the Resolution Illusion in Earth Observation VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to analyze ultra-high-resolution (UHR) Earth observation imagery, yet they face a severe scale mismatch between broad scene context and micro-scale targets. We refer to this phenomenon as a "resolution illusion": higher input resolution provides access to more visual detail, but does not necessarily translate into reliable perception of task-relevant micro-evidence. To benchmark this challenge, we introduce UHR-Micro, a benchmark comprising 11,072 instructions grounded in 1,212 UHR images, designed to evaluate VLMs on micro-scale evidence in native-resolution Earth observation imagery. UHR-Micro spans diverse target scales, task families, and visual conditions, with each sample having an objectively verifiable target. Experiments with representative high-resolution VLMs show substantial failures in localizing and interpreting task-relevant evidence, despite access to high-resolution inputs. Further analysis shows that model scaling alone is insufficient, while localized evidence substantially improves performance, pointing to evidence access as a major bottleneck. Motivated by this finding, we propose Micro-evidence Active Perception (MAP), which constructs a spatially grounded evidence state from localized observations and supplements it when the current evidence is insufficient. Across two backbone VLMs, MAP improves UHR-Micro performance by 8.65 percentage points on average. UHR-Micro and MAP provide a framework for diagnosing and improving high-resolution reasoning in Earth observation VLMs. Datasets and source code were released at https://github.com/MiliLab/UHR-Micro.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UHR-Micro 基准与 Micro-evidence Active Perception (MAP) 方法，诊断超高分辨率地球观测 VLM 的“分辨率幻觉”：输入分辨率提高并不等于能可靠感知任务相关的微尺度证据。在 11,072 条指令、1,212 张原生分辨率 UHR 图像上，代表性高分辨率 VLM 定位与解读证据失败明显，单纯扩大模型规模无效，而给定局部证据可显著提升；MAP 构建空间锚定的证据状态并在证据不足时主动补充，在两个骨干 VLM 上平均提升 8.65 个百分点。
Motivation: 超高分辨率遥感影像中，广域场景上下文与微尺度目标之间存在尺度失配：提高输入分辨率能带来更多细节，却不保证模型感知到任务相关的微证据，导致 VLM 在原生分辨率影像上定位与解读失败。
Method: 构建 UHR-Micro 基准：11,072 条指令、1,212 张 UHR 图像，覆盖不同目标尺度、任务族与视觉条件，每条样本都有客观可验证的目标。方法上提出 Micro-evidence Active Perception (MAP)：从局部观测构建空间锚定的证据状态 (spatially grounded evidence state)，当当前证据不足时主动补充证据，再在两个骨干 VLM 上检验。
Result: UHR-Micro 含 11,072 条指令与 1,212 张 UHR 图像；代表性高分辨率 VLM 即使输入高分辨率仍大量失败于定位与解读任务相关证据；分析显示仅扩大模型规模不足，而提供局部证据可显著改善性能；MAP 在两个骨干 VLM 上平均提升 8.65 个百分点。
Conclusion: 地球观测 VLM 高分辨率推理的主要瓶颈是证据获取 (evidence access) 而非模型规模，主动补充微证据是有效的改进路径；数据集与代码已在 GitHub 的 MiliLab/UHR-Micro 发布。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: On What We Can Learn from Low-Resolution Data
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence systems typically rely on large, centrally collected datasets, a premise that does not hold in many real-world domains such as healthcare and public institutions. In these settings, data sharing is often constrained by storage, privacy, or resource limitations. For example, small wearable devices may lack the bandwidth or energy capacity needed to store and transmit high-resolution data, leading to aggregation during data collection and thus a loss of information. As a result, datasets collected from different sources may consist of a mixture of high- and low-resolution samples. Despite the prevalence of this setting, it remains unclear how informative low-resolution data is when models are ultimately evaluated on high-resolution inputs. We provide a theoretical analysis based on the Kullback-Leibler divergence that characterises how the influence of a datapoint changes with resolution, and derive bounds that relate the relative contribution of high- and low-resolution observations to the information lost under downsampling. To support this analysis, we empirically demonstrate, using both a vision transformer and a convolutional neural network, that adding low-resolution data to the training set consistently improves performance when high-resolution data is scarce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高低分辨率混合训练、最终只在高分辨率输入上评测的设定下，论文用 KL 散度刻画单个数据点的影响力如何随分辨率变化，并给出高低分辨率观测相对贡献与下采样信息损失之间的界。用 ViT 与 CNN 实证：当高分辨率数据稀缺时，把低分辨率数据加入训练集能一致地提升性能。
Motivation: 医疗、公共机构与可穿戴设备等场景受存储、隐私、带宽或算力限制，只能采集或上传下采样后的数据，导致训练集是高低分辨率混合；但低分辨率样本对最终在高分辨率输入上评测的模型究竟有多大信息价值一直不清楚。
Method: 基于 Kullback-Leibler 散度做理论分析，刻画单个数据点的影响力随分辨率的变化，并推导联系高低分辨率观测相对贡献与下采样信息损失的界；再用 vision transformer (ViT) 与 convolutional neural network (CNN) 两类模型做实证检验。
Result: 理论给出随分辨率变化的影响力刻画与高低分辨率贡献、下采样信息损失之间的界；实证上，在高分辨率数据稀缺时向训练集加入低分辨率数据能一致提升性能（ViT 与 CNN 均如此）。
Conclusion: 低分辨率数据在高分辨率数据稀缺时对高分辨率评测仍有可量化的信息价值，不必因分辨率不齐而丢弃。

papers.title: Missing Old Logits in Asynchronous Agentic RL: Semantic Mismatch and Repair Methods for Off-Policy Correction
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning improves rollout throughput for large language model agents by decoupling sample generation from policy optimization, but it also introduces a critical failure mode for PPO-style off-policy correction. In heterogeneous training systems, the total importance ratio should ideally be decomposed into two semantically distinct factors: a \emph{training--inference discrepancy term} that aligns inference-side and training-side distributions at the same behavior-policy version, and a \emph{policy-staleness term} that constrains the update from the historical policy to the current policy. We show that practical asynchronous pipelines with delayed updates and partial rollouts often lose the required historical training-side logits, or old logits. This missing-old-logit problem entangles discrepancy repair with staleness correction, breaks the intended semantics of decoupled correction, and makes clipping and masking thresholds interact undesirably. To address this issue, we study both exact and approximate correction routes. We propose three exact old-logit acquisition strategies: snapshot-based version tracking, a dedicated old-logit model, and synchronization via partial rollout interruption, and compare their system trade-offs. From the perspective of approximate correction, we focus on preserving the benefits of decoupled correction through a more appropriate approximate policy when exact old logits cannot be recovered at low cost, without incurring extra system overhead. Following this analysis, we adopt a revised PPO-EWMA method, which achieves significant gains in both training speed and optimization performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 异步 agentic RL 中延迟更新与部分 rollout 会丢失历史训练侧 old logits，使重要性比无法拆成语义独立的训练-推理差异项与策略陈旧项，进而让 clipping 与 masking 阈值互相干扰。论文给出三条精确恢复 old logits 的路线（snapshot 版本追踪、专用 old-logit 模型、部分 rollout 中断同步）并比较系统开销；在无法低成本精确恢复时改用近似修正，采用修订版 PPO-EWMA，在训练速度与优化性能上均取得显著提升。
Motivation: 异步 RL 解耦采样与优化提高了 LLM agent 的 rollout 吞吐，却破坏了 PPO 式 off-policy 修正的语义：缺失 old logits 把差异修复与陈旧度修正纠缠在一起。
Method: 先把总重要性比拆成同一行为策略版本下的 training-inference discrepancy 项与历史到当前策略的 policy-staleness 项；精确路线提出 snapshot-based version tracking、专用 old-logit 模型、partial rollout interruption 同步三种 old-logit 获取策略并比较系统权衡；近似路线在无法低成本恢复时采用修订版 PPO-EWMA 保持解耦修正的收益且不引入额外系统开销。
Result: 论文系统比较了三种精确 old-logit 获取策略的 trade-off，并报告修订版 PPO-EWMA 在训练速度 (training speed) 与优化性能 (optimization performance) 两方面均取得显著提升。
Conclusion: old logits 缺失是异步 PPO 语义破损的根因：能低成本精确恢复就恢复，否则用更合适的近似策略（修订版 PPO-EWMA）保住解耦修正的收益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robust Promptable Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The performance of promptable video object segmentation (PVOS) models substantially degrades under input corruptions, which prevents PVOS deployment in safety-critical domains. This paper offers the first comprehensive study on robust PVOS (RobustPVOS). We first construct a new, comprehensive benchmark with two real-world evaluation datasets of 351 video clips and more than 2,500 object masks under real-world adverse conditions. At the same time, we generate synthetic training data by applying diverse and temporally varying corruptions to existing VOS datasets. Moreover, we present a new RobustPVOS method, dubbed Memory-object-conditioned Gated-rank Adaptation (MoGA). The key to successfully performing RobustPVOS is two-fold: effectively handling object-specific degradation and ensuring temporal consistency in predictions. MoGA leverages object-specific representations maintained in memory across frames to condition the robustification process, which allows the model to handle each tracked object differently in a temporally consistent way. Extensive experiments on our benchmark validate MoGA's efficacy, showing consistent and significant improvements across diverse corruption types on both synthetic and real-world datasets, establishing a strong baseline for future RobustPVOS research. Our benchmark is publicly available at https://sohyun-l.github.io/RobustPVOS_project_page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对提示式视频目标分割 (PVOS) 在输入损坏下性能大幅退化的问题，提出 Memory-object-conditioned Gated-rank Adaptation (MoGA)：用跨帧记忆中的目标特定表征来条件化鲁棒化过程，使每个被跟踪目标以时序一致的方式被区别处理。在含 351 段视频、2,500+ 目标掩码的真实恶劣条件基准上，MoGA 在多种损坏类型、合成与真实数据集上均取得一致且显著的提升。
Motivation: PVOS 模型在输入损坏下性能显著下降，阻碍其在安全关键场景部署；此前缺少对鲁棒 PVOS (RobustPVOS) 的系统研究与评测基准。
Method: 构建含两个真实评测数据集（351 段视频、2,500+ 目标掩码）的新基准，并对现有 VOS 数据集施加多样且随时间变化的损坏来生成合成训练数据；提出 MoGA，依赖跨帧记忆维护的目标特定表征来条件化鲁棒化，兼顾目标级退化与时序一致性。

papers.title: PRISM: A Geometric Risk Bound for Decomposing Drift into Scale, Shape, and Head
papers.abstract_en: A single base LLM now comes with dozens of post-training variants, quantized, LoRA-adapted, or distilled, and each has to be checked before release. Existing evaluations provide only a partial picture: benchmark scores and likelihood screens say that a variant has degraded, similarity scores such as CKA and SVCCA say how its features moved, and nothing connects the two. We connect them with one structural fact and one design choice: the prediction head is linear, so feature geometry reaches the loss, and we compare the two feature sets through an orthogonal map, which leaves the geometry being measured unchanged. From these we derive PRISM, a closed-form upper bound on the cross-entropy risk gap between a target model and a proxy variant, and prove that it splits exactly into three measurable axes: scale, shape, and head. Each axis names a failure mode and where to intervene: low-bit quantization distorts shape and, at the lowest bit-widths, also inflates activation scale; quantizing the output embedding inflates the head term, which dominates the bound at high bit-widths. Because the shape term is differentiable, the same geometry becomes a regularizer that curbs catastrophic forgetting more than experience replay. Across two model families and five benchmarks, PRISM ranks quantized and fine-tuned variants from a single forward pass at mean Spearman above 0.8, and eight reference sequences already recover the ranking that the risk gap itself needs over a hundred to reach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 把目标模型与代理变体（量化、LoRA、蒸馏）之间的交叉熵风险差写成闭式上界，并证明其可精确分解为 scale、shape、head 三个可测轴，各自对应一种失效模式与干预位置。低比特量化扭曲 shape 并在最低位宽抬高激活 scale，量化输出嵌入则抬高 head 项并在高位宽主导上界；shape 项可微，可直接当正则器抑制灾难性遗忘，效果强于 experience replay。在两个模型族、五个 benchmark 上，单次前向即以平均 Spearman 超过 0.8 排序量化与微调变体，8 条参考序列即可复现风险差本身需一百多条才能得到的排序。
Motivation: 一个 base LLM 衍生出几十个后训练变体，发布前都要逐一检查；benchmark 分数与似然筛查只说变体退化了，CKA、SVCCA 等相似度只说特征怎么动了，两者之间没有桥梁。
Method: 利用线性 prediction head 使特征几何直达 loss，并用正交映射比较两组特征以保持被测几何不变；据此推导目标模型与代理变体间交叉熵风险差的闭式上界 PRISM，证明其精确分解为 scale、shape、head 三轴。shape 项可微，被复用为正则器与 experience replay 对比。
Result: 在两个模型族、五个 benchmark 上，PRISM 用单次前向对量化与微调变体排序，平均 Spearman 超过 0.8；8 条参考序列即可恢复风险差本身需要一百多条序列才能得到的排序。诊断上：低比特量化扭曲 shape 并在最低位宽抬高激活 scale，量化输出嵌入抬高的 head 项在高位宽主导上界；shape 正则器比 experience replay 更能抑制灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 特征几何与基准退化可由一个闭式风险上界连起来，三轴分解同时给出失效定位与干预点，且同一几何既可做单前向排序筛查也可做抗遗忘正则。

papers.title: PowerStep: Memory-Efficient Adaptive Optimization via $\ell_p$-Norm Steepest Descent
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive optimizers such as Adam are standard for training Transformers, but storing gradient first and second moments incurs substantial memory overhead. We introduce PowerStep, a memory-efficient optimizer that achieves coordinate-wise adaptivity without storing second-moment statistics. Motivated by $\ell_p$-norm steepest descent, PowerStep applies a signed-power transform directly to one momentum buffer. We establish a finite-horizon stationarity bound for exact, unregularized updates, with an $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ term and a noise-dependent residual. Experiments on Transformers from 124M to 235B parameters show competitive validation quality while halving $\texttt{fp32}$ optimizer-state memory relative to AdamW. Combined with uniform $\texttt{int8}$ quantization, PowerStep remains numerically stable and reduces optimizer-state memory by $\sim8\times$ compared to $\texttt{fp32}$ AdamW. PowerStep thus provides a simple, memory-efficient alternative for large-scale training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PowerStep 用 ℓ_p-范数最速下降的思路，对单个动量缓冲区做带符号幂变换 (signed-power transform)，在不存二阶矩统计量的前提下拿到逐坐标自适应步长。124M 到 235B 参数的 Transformer 上验证质量与 AdamW 相当，fp32 优化器状态内存减半，叠加 int8 均匀量化后相对 fp32 AdamW 约省 8 倍。
Motivation: Adam 需要同时保存梯度一阶、二阶矩，在大规模 Transformer 训练中造成显著优化器状态内存开销，限制可训练规模。
Method: 由 ℓ_p-范数最速下降导出更新式，对单个动量缓冲区直接施加带符号幂变换以实现逐坐标自适应，不维护二阶矩；对精确无正则化更新给出有限视界平稳性界，含 O(1/√T) 项与噪声相关残差。
Result: 在 124M 至 235B 参数的 Transformer 上验证质量与 AdamW 相当，fp32 优化器状态内存相对 AdamW 减半；配合均匀 int8 量化仍数值稳定，优化器状态内存相对 fp32 AdamW 降低约 8 倍。
Conclusion: 大规模训练的逐坐标自适应不必依赖二阶矩统计量，单缓冲区的幂变换步长即可作为省内存的 AdamW 替代方案。

papers.title: Empirical Bayes 1-bit matrix completion
papers.abstract_en: The problem of predicting unobserved entries in a binary matrix, known as 1-bit matrix completion, has found diverse applications in fields such as recommendation systems. In this study, we develop an empirical Bayes method for 1-bit matrix completion motivated by the Efron--Morris estimator, a matrix generalization of the James--Stein estimator that shrinks singular values toward zero. The proposed method exploits the underlying low-rank structure of binary matrices, drawing parallels with multidimensional item response theory. Simulation studies and real-data applications demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive predictive accuracy and favorable predictive calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对二值矩阵补全 (1-bit matrix completion)，提出受 Efron–Morris 估计器启发的经验贝叶斯方法：把奇异值向零收缩，利用二值矩阵的低秩结构，并与多维项目反应理论 (multidimensional item response theory) 建立对应。模拟研究与真实数据应用显示该方法在预测精度与预测校准 (predictive calibration) 上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 二值矩阵补全（如推荐系统中预测未观测条目）需要在低秩结构下同时给出准确预测与良好不确定性校准，传统点估计难以兼顾。
Method: 以 Efron–Morris 估计器（James–Stein 估计器的矩阵推广）为动机构造经验贝叶斯方法，对奇异值施加向零收缩以利用二值矩阵低秩结构，方法与多维项目反应理论相类比。
Result: 模拟研究与真实数据应用表明该方法取得有竞争力的预测精度和良好的预测校准；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 向奇异值施加经验贝叶斯收缩可在二值矩阵补全中同时获得竞争力的预测精度与有利的预测校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EquiMem: Calibrating Shared Memory in Multi-Agent Debate via Game-Theoretic Equilibrium
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) systems increasingly rely on shared memory to support long-horizon reasoning, but this convenience opens a critical vulnerability: a single corrupted entry can contaminate the downstream memory-augmented reasoning, and debate alone fails to filter such errors. Existing safeguards filter entries via heuristics or LLM-based validation, yet they rely on AI judgments that share the same failure modes and overlook the cross-agent dynamics of MAD. We address this gap by formulating memory updating in MAD as a zero-trust memory game, in which no agent is assumed reliable and the game's equilibrium motivates a principled objective for calibrating memory influence. Guided by this objective, we propose EquiMem, an inference-time calibration mechanism that evaluates each update against the shared memory state and the memory already being used by other agents, using their existing retrieval queries and traversal paths as evidence of calibration. EquiMem instantiates this calibration for both embedding- and graph-based memory, and across diverse benchmarks, MAD frameworks, and memory architectures, it consistently outperforms existing safeguards, remains robust under adversarial agents, and incurs negligible inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多智能体辩论 (MAD) 的共享记忆更新建模为零信任记忆博弈，均衡解导出校准记忆影响力的推理时目标 EquiMem：用其他智能体已有的检索 query 与遍历路径作为证据，评估每条更新对共享记忆状态的影响。在多种 benchmark、MAD 框架与记忆架构上一致优于现有防护机制，在对抗性智能体下保持稳健，推理开销可忽略。
Motivation: 共享记忆里单条被污染的条目会污染下游记忆增强推理，而辩论本身筛不掉这类错误；现有基于启发式或 LLM 校验的防护依赖与被防护对象同失效模式的 AI 判断，且忽略 MAD 的跨智能体动态。
Method: 将记忆更新表述为零信任记忆博弈（不假设任何智能体可靠），由博弈均衡推出校准记忆影响力的原理性目标；据此提出推理时校准机制 EquiMem，每条更新同时对照共享记忆状态与其他智能体正在使用的记忆，并以这些智能体现有的 retrieval query 与 traversal path 作为校准证据，分别在 embedding-based 与 graph-based 记忆上实例化。
Result: 在多样 benchmark、MAD 框架与记忆架构上，EquiMem 一致优于现有 safeguard，在对抗性智能体下保持稳健，且推理开销可忽略（negligible inference overhead）。
Conclusion: 跨智能体的检索证据足以在推理时校准共享记忆影响力，无需依赖与被防护 LLM 同源的 AI 判断，即可同时提升鲁棒性并保持低开销。

papers.title: Relative Kinetic Utility: Calibrating Cross-Layer Credit for Global Structured LLM Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Global structured pruning requires channels from different layers to compete under a shared sparsity budget, raising two coupled challenges: identifying which channels should be retained and making their scores comparable across layers. Raw channel scores can contain block-common scale that leaves within-block ordering unchanged but distorts model-wide competition. Our experiment indicates that similar layer-wise allocations can retain substantially different FFN channels, so layer allocation alone does not determine channel identity. Motivated by this separation, we introduce Global Relative Kinetic Utility (Global RKU), a label-free criterion that separates channel importance estimation from cross-layer comparison. Global RKU measures channel participation using a final-hidden-state activation-gradient signal, then applies block-relative normalization to mitigate block-common scale while preserving within-block ordering, requires only unlabeled calibration inputs, and produces a static pruning topology in a single calibration stage. Under questions-only calibration on Qwen-2.5-7B, RKU-GISP Mean3 margins are -0.98, +3.79, and +8.61 points at 30%, 40%, and 50% sparsity, respectively (average +3.81). Additional Qwen evaluations cover non-mathematical reasoning, recovery, held-out transfer, and physical deployment. Separately, replacing Wiki16K with questions-only Q16K improves RKU's Mean3 at every tested sparsity on Qwen, Llama, and Gemma. Our ablation study shows relative-normalization gains of 14.42 and 5.53 Mean3 points at 40% and 50% sparsity, respectively; the common-seed audit is positive in all 27 seed-task comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Global RKU：用最终隐状态的激活-梯度信号估计通道重要性，再做块内相对归一化消除跨层共同尺度，使不同层通道能在统一稀疏预算下直接竞争。在 Qwen-2.5-7B questions-only 校准下，RKU-GISP Mean3 相对基线在 30%/40%/50% 稀疏度分别为 -0.98、+3.79、+8.61 点（平均 +3.81），相对归一化消融在 40% 和 50% 稀疏度分别贡献 14.42 和 5.53 点。
Motivation: 全局结构化剪枝中不同层通道要在共享稀疏预算下竞争，原始通道分数含块共同尺度，会扭曲跨层可比性；且实验显示相近的层分配可能保留完全不同的 FFN 通道，说明仅做层分配无法决定通道身份。
Method: Global RKU 将通道重要性估计与跨层比较解耦：用最终隐状态的激活-梯度信号度量通道参与度，再施加块相对归一化（block-relative normalization）消除块共同尺度同时保留块内排序；仅需无标签校准输入，单阶段校准即产出静态剪枝拓扑。
Result: Qwen-2.5-7B 上 questions-only 校准的 RKU-GISP Mean3 相对基线在 30%、40%、50% 稀疏度分别为 -0.98、+3.79、+8.61 点，平均 +3.81；用 questions-only Q16K 替换 Wiki16K 在 Qwen、Llama、Gemma 的每个测试稀疏度上都提升 RKU 的 Mean3；消融显示相对归一化在 40% 和 50% 稀疏度分别带来 14.42 和 5.53 个 Mean3 点，27 项 seed-task 对比的 common-seed audit 全部为正。
Conclusion: 跨层分数的块共同尺度是全局剪枝竞争失真的主因，块相对归一化在保留块内排序的同时能稳定转化为 Mean3 收益，且校准数据可从 Wiki16K 换成 questions-only。

papers.title: Learning Distributionally Robust First-Order Methods for Convex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose a distributionally robust approach to learning hyperparameters (e.g., step sizes and momentum coefficients) for first-order methods in convex optimization. Given a dataset of problem instances, we minimize a Wasserstein distributionally robust version of the performance estimation problem (PEP). Our framework unifies two extremes. As the robustness radius vanishes, we recover classical learning to optimize (L2O), and as it grows we recover the PEP worst-case algorithm design problem. We solve the resulting problem with stochastic gradient descent, differentiating through the solution of an inner semidefinite program at each step. We prove high-probability bounds showing that the true risk of the learned algorithm is at most the in-sample L2O optimum plus a slack that shrinks with the sample size, and is no worse than the worst-case PEP bound. On logistic regression, LASSO, and linear programming examples, our learned algorithms achieve strong out-of-sample performance with certifiable robustness, outperforming both worst-case optimal and vanilla L2O baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒版本的性能估计问题 (PEP) 学习一阶优化算法的超参数（步长、动量），鲁棒半径趋于零时退化为经典 learning to optimize (L2O)，趋于无穷时退化为 PEP 最坏情形算法设计。在 logistic regression、LASSO 和 linear programming 例子上，学到的算法取得强的样本外性能并带可认证鲁棒性，优于最坏情形最优与 vanilla L2O 两类基线。
Motivation: L2O 学到的超参数只对训练实例分布有效，而 PEP 最坏情形设计过于保守；两者分别代表分布内与最坏情形两个极端，缺少一个可用半径连续插值、并能给出泛化保证的统一框架。
Method: 对给定问题实例数据集最小化 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒版 PEP；用随机梯度下降求解，每步对内层半定规划 (SDP) 的解做微分 (differentiate through the solution)。证明高概率界：学到算法的真实风险不超过样本内 L2O 最优值加上随样本量收缩的松弛项，且不劣于最坏情形 PEP 界。
Result: 在 logistic regression、LASSO、linear programming 例子上，学到的算法样本外性能强且鲁棒性可认证，优于 worst-case optimal 与 vanilla L2O 基线；理论给出高概率风险界，松弛随样本量增大而收缩，并被最坏情形 PEP 界夹住。
Conclusion: 分布鲁棒 PEP 把 L2O 与最坏情形设计统一成一个由 Wasserstein 半径调节的连续谱系，学习超参数可以同时拿到样本外性能和可认证鲁棒性。

papers.title: ProCompNav: Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment for Ambiguous User Queries
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language instance navigation becomes challenging when the initial user request does not uniquely specify the target instance. A practical agent should reduce the user's burden by actively asking only the information needed to distinguish the target from similar distractors, rather than requiring a detailed description upfront. Existing approaches often fall short of this goal by mistaking distractors that strongly match the accumulated information about the target provided by the user. As a result, despite the dialogue, the agent may still fail to distinguish the target from distractors, leading to premature decisions and lengthy user responses. We propose Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment (ProCompNav), a two-stage framework that first constructs a candidate pool and then identifies the target through Recursive Comparative Judgment (RCJ). RCJ iteratively narrows the pool by selecting an attribute-value pair that divides the candidates, asking the user a binary question, and removing inconsistent candidates, without requiring an attribute unique to the target. On CoIN-Bench, ProCompNav outperforms the evaluated baselines in Success Rate while substantially reducing Response Length. On the non-interactive TextNav benchmark, ProCompNav achieves the highest Success Rate. Two human studies further show that participants prefer ProCompNav's interaction strategies.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Oral), Project page: https://tree-jhk.github.io/procompnav/ Code: https://github.com/tree-jhk/procompnav/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProCompNav 用两阶段框架解决歧义指令下的实例导航：先建候选池，再用递归比较判定 (RCJ) 每轮挑一个能二分候选的属性-值对向用户提二元问题并剔除不一致候选，无需目标独有属性。在 CoIN-Bench 上 Success Rate 超出所评基线且 Response Length 大幅缩短，非交互 TextNav 上取得最高 Success Rate，两项人类研究显示用户更偏好其交互策略。
Motivation: 初始请求不唯一指定目标时，现有方法会把与用户累积描述高度匹配的干扰物误当目标，导致过早决策和冗长的用户回复。
Method: 两阶段框架：先构建候选池，再由 Recursive Comparative Judgment (RCJ) 迭代收窄——选择能划分候选的属性-值对，向用户提二元问题，删除与答案不一致的候选，全程不要求存在目标独有的属性。
Result: 在 CoIN-Bench 上，ProCompNav 的 Success Rate 高于所评估基线，同时 Response Length 显著下降；在非交互 TextNav benchmark 上取得最高 Success Rate；两项人类研究中参与者更偏好其交互策略。
Conclusion: 主动用比较式二元提问区分目标与干扰物，可以在降低用户回复负担的同时提高导航成功率，且该交互策略被人类用户偏好。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Federation of Experts: Communication Efficient Distributed Inference for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture of experts has emerged as the primary mechanism for making Large Language Models (LLMs) computationally efficient. However, in distributed settings, communicating token embeddings between experts is a significant bottleneck. We present the novel Federation of Experts (FoE) architecture. FoE restructures the MoE block of a transformer layer into multiple MoE clusters. Each cluster is responsible for only one of the KV heads and expert parallelism is applied between those experts. Between clusters, a sum synchronizes the post-attention residuals, which then drives routing and dispatch for the next MoE block. In a single-node setting, FoE completely eliminates all-to-all communication as all experts within a group are contained on the same GPU. In multi-node settings, FoE confines all-to-all communication to the intra-node fabric, thus significantly reducing communication overhead. An implementation of FoE finds that on LongBench, FoE significantly improves inference throughput and latency in both single-node and multi-node settings, reducing end-to-end prefill latency by up to 5.88x, TTFT by 3.66x, and TPOT by 1.53x. It does so while achieving comparable generation quality to a mixture of experts model of the same size and training configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Federation of Experts (FoE)：把 Transformer 层的 MoE 块重组为多个 MoE cluster，每个 cluster 只负责一个 KV head 并在其间做 expert parallelism，cluster 之间用一次 sum 同步 post-attention residual 来驱动下一块的路由与分发。单节点下完全消除 all-to-all 通信，多节点下把 all-to-all 限制在节点内 fabric；在 LongBench 上端到端 prefill 延迟最多降 5.88 倍、TTFT 3.66 倍、TPOT 1.53 倍，生成质量与同规模同训练配置的 MoE 相当。
Motivation: 分布式 MoE 推理中 token embedding 在专家间通信是主要瓶颈，all-to-all 通信拖慢吞吐并抬高延迟。
Method: FoE 架构把 MoE block 拆成多个 cluster，每个 cluster 绑定一个 KV head，expert parallelism 只在 cluster 内专家之间进行；cluster 间用 sum 同步 post-attention residual，该结果再驱动下一个 MoE block 的 routing 与 dispatch。
Result: 在 LongBench 上，FoE 在单节点与多节点设置下都显著提升推理吞吐并降低延迟：端到端 prefill 延迟最多降低 5.88 倍，TTFT 降低 3.66 倍，TPOT 降低 1.53 倍；生成质量与相同规模、相同训练配置的 mixture of experts 模型相当。
Conclusion: 把 MoE 按 KV head 分簇并用 residual 求和衔接各簇，可以在不牺牲生成质量的前提下消除或大幅压缩 all-to-all 通信，从而显著降低 LLM 分布式推理的 prefill 与首 token 延迟。
