papers.title: Non-Myopic Active Feature Acquisition via Pathwise Policy Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Active feature acquisition (AFA) considers prediction problems in which features are costly to obtain and the learner adaptively decides which feature values to acquire for each instance and when to stop and predict. In this paper, we introduce a continuous relaxation of the acquisition process that enables non-myopic pathwise policy gradients (NM-PPG) through the full acquisition trajectory, avoiding the high variance of standard score-function policy gradients while allowing end-to-end optimization of the acquisition policy. To better align training with deployment, we develop a straight-through rollout that follows discrete feature acquisitions in the forward pass while backpropagating through the corresponding soft relaxation. We derive an AFA-specific average-case upper bound on the variance of this gradient estimator, which characterizes instability and motivates staged temperature sharpening. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that NM-PPG yields superior performance relative to state-of-the-art AFA baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出非近视主动特征获取 (non-myopic AFA) 方法 NM-PPG：对特征采集过程做连续松弛，使路径策略梯度 (pathwise policy gradients) 能贯穿整条采集轨迹反传，避开 score-function 估计的高方差。前向走离散采集、反向走软松弛的 straight-through rollout 让训练与部署一致；推导出 AFA 专用的平均情形梯度方差上界，据此做分阶段温度锐化 (staged temperature sharpening)，在合成与真实数据集上优于 SOTA AFA 基线。
Motivation: 主动特征获取中每个特征都有获取成本，需要逐实例决定采哪些特征、何时停止预测；标准 score-function 策略梯度方差高，且近视 (myopic) 决策与端到端训练难以对齐部署。
Method: 对采集过程做连续松弛，得到 NM-PPG，沿完整采集轨迹做路径策略梯度并端到端优化策略；前向按离散特征采集、反向对相应软松弛回传的 straight-through rollout；推导 AFA 特定的平均情形梯度估计方差上界，用其刻画不稳定性并设计分阶段温度锐化。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，NM-PPG 相对 SOTA AFA 基线取得更优性能；并给出该梯度估计器的 AFA 专用平均情形方差上界。
Conclusion: 用连续松弛加 straight-through rollout 做路径策略梯度，可以在避免 score-function 高方差的同时端到端训练非近视 AFA 策略，方差上界为温度锐化调度提供依据。

papers.title: GRIFDIR: Graph Resolution-Invariant Diffusion Models over Irregular Domains
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models in infinite-dimensional function spaces provide a mathematically principled framework for modelling function-valued data, offering key advantages such as resolution invariance and the ability to handle irregular discretisations. However, practical implementations have struggled to fully realise these benefits. Existing backbones like Fourier neural operators are often biased towards regular grids and fail to generalise to complex domain topologies. We introduce an architecture, GRIFDIR, for function-space diffusion models that represents generalised graph convolutional kernels as finite element functions, allowing the score network to operate directly on unstructured meshes over domains of arbitrary shape. We demonstrate the efficacy of our network architecture through a series of unconditional and conditional sampling experiments across diverse geometries, including non-convex and multiply-connected domains. Our results show that the proposed method maintains resolution invariance and achieves high fidelity in capturing functional distributions on non-trivial geometries.

papers.title: GRAVITY: Architecture-Agnostic Structured Anchoring for Long-Horizon Conversational Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon memory systems increasingly improve how evidence is stored and retrieved, yet the generator must still reason over fragments whose cross-session relationships are implicit. We study generation-time memory organization as a distinct design dimension and introduce GRAVITY (Generation-time Relational Anchoring Via Injected Topological MemorY), a host-independent auxiliary memory layer. GRAVITY consolidates raw dialogue into entity profiles, temporal event traces, and cross-session topic summaries, then retrieves and injects query-relevant records through the prompt interface. Across five heterogeneous memory systems on LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it improves every host--benchmark baseline under two distinct LLM configurations. Controlled analyses separate gains from organizing already available evidence and from consolidating information across the full history. Under a matched LightMem pipeline, the entity--event--topic representation reaches 83.9% on LoCoMo, 3.6% above the strongest of six alternative auxiliary representations. These results show that generation-time structure is a portable complement to existing memory retrieval, while its interaction with host evidence depends on the benchmark and host.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRAVITY 把长程对话记忆的组织从检索阶段移到生成阶段：先将原始对话固化为实体档案、时间事件轨迹与跨会话题目摘要三类记录，再经 prompt 接口注入查询相关记录，作为宿主无关的辅助记忆层。在 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 上跨五个异构记忆系统、两种 LLM 配置均提升全部宿主-基线；匹配 LightMem 管线下该三元表示在 LoCoMo 达 83.9%，高出六种替代辅助表示中最强者 3.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有长程记忆系统改进了证据的存取，但生成器仍要在碎片上推理，跨会话关系是隐式的；生成时的记忆组织作为一个独立设计维度此前未被研究。
Method: GRAVITY（Generation-time Relational Anchoring Via Injected Topological MemorY）是宿主无关的辅助记忆层：把原始对话整合成实体档案、时间事件轨迹、跨会话题目摘要三类记录，检索后经 prompt 接口注入；用受控分析分离“组织已有证据”与“跨全历史整合信息”两类增益，并在匹配的 LightMem 管线上对比六种替代辅助表示。
Result: 在 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 两个基准、五个异构记忆系统、两种 LLM 配置下，对每个宿主-基线组合都有提升；匹配 LightMem 管线下 entity-event-topic 表示在 LoCoMo 得 83.9%，比六种替代辅助表示中最强的高 3.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 生成时的结构化组织是现有记忆检索的可移植补充，但它与宿主证据的交互效果取决于具体基准与宿主系统。

papers.title: NoiseRater: Meta-Learned Noise Valuation for Diffusion Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Training a diffusion model involves two sources of randomness for each data sample: the timestep and the Gaussian noise realization. The timestep has been studied extensively through scheduling and weighting, whereas the impact of the noise realization at a given timestep is still underexplored. In this work, we examine whether different noise instances are equally informative. We introduce NoiseRater, a network that scores an individual noise instance conditioned on the data sample and timestep. The rater is learned through bilevel optimization, where its scores reweight the diffusion loss in the inner loop, and it is updated to reduce validation loss after the inner-loop updates. Using the trained rater to select training noise, we observe three properties of training noise. First, noise realizations at the same timestep are not equally useful: the rater's top-scored noise improves performance over i.i.d.\ sampling, while its bottom-scored noise degrades it. Second, this utility is contextual, depending jointly on the image, the class, and the timestep. Third, noise selection is complementary to timestep-level design, retaining most of its gain when combined with existing scheduling and weighting schemes. These findings establish instance-level noise valuation as a new axis for understanding and improving diffusion training. Code is available at https://github.com/JoeZhao527/Noise-Rater.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NoiseRater 用一个以数据样本和 timestep 为条件的网络给单个高斯噪声实例打分，通过双层优化训练：内层按分数重加权 diffusion loss，外层以降低验证损失更新打分器。用它挑选训练噪声后，同 timestep 下 top 分数噪声优于 i.i.d. 采样、bottom 分数噪声使性能变差，且该效用依赖图像、类别与 timestep 的联合上下文，并与现有 timestep 级调度/加权方案互补。
Motivation: Diffusion 训练中每个样本有 timestep 与噪声实现两层随机性，前者已被调度与加权充分研究，而给定 timestep 下不同噪声实例是否等信息量仍不清楚。
Method: 训练 NoiseRater 网络，输入数据样本与 timestep，输出该噪声实例的分数；采用双层优化，内层用分数重加权 diffusion loss，外层按内层更新后的验证损失更新打分器，再用训练好的 rater 选择训练噪声。
Result: 三条性质：同 timestep 的噪声实现不等价，top-scored 噪声相对 i.i.d. 采样提升性能、bottom-scored 噪声使其下降；效用是上下文相关的，取决于图像、类别与 timestep 的联合；噪声选择与 timestep 级设计互补，与现有调度和加权方案结合时保留其大部分增益。
Conclusion: 实例级噪声估值 (instance-level noise valuation) 是理解并改进 diffusion 训练的一条新轴，可与 timestep 级设计叠加而非替代。

papers.title: Minimum Specification Perturbation: Robustness as Distance-to-Falsification in Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Empirical causal claims depend on many analyst decisions, from selecting covariates to choosing estimators. Existing robustness tools summarize how results vary across these choices, but, to the best of our knowledge, do not answer: \textbf{How many analyst decisions must change to reach a specification, which is a set of choices, whose confidence interval (CI) contains zero?} We introduce \emph{Minimum Specification Perturbation (MSP)}, the smallest number of changes. MSP is small under the null, grows with effect strength and captures distance-to-falsification information that dispersion-based summaries cannot report; when making decisions under weak effects, an MSP-based rule yields lower false-positive rates than dispersion-based rules. We show that Fragility Index and MSP measure orthogonal vulnerabilities: fragility to influential observations need not imply fragility to specification choices. On the LaLonde benchmark, MSP = 1 implies that one decision change makes the CI contain zero. We further provide exact permutation calibration under randomization and characterize computation, showing tractable cases under additive structure and NP-hardness in general.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Minimum Specification Perturbation (MSP)，把因果推断的稳健性定义为「最少改几个分析决策，才能让置信区间覆盖零」，即到被证伪的距离。MSP 在零假设下小、随效应强度增长，且在弱效应下基于 MSP 的判定规则比基于离散度 (dispersion) 的规则假阳性更低；在 LaLonde 基准上 MSP = 1，意味着改动一个决策就足以让 CI 含零。
Motivation: 现有稳健性工具只汇总结果在协变量选择、估计量选择等分析决策变化下的离散程度，回答不了「还需改几个决策才会翻车」这一到证伪的距离问题。
Method: 定义 MSP 为使 CI 包含零所需改变的最少决策数；证明其在零假设下取值小、随效应强度增长，并给出随机化下的精确置换校准 (exact permutation calibration)；刻画计算复杂度——在加法结构下可解，一般情形 NP-hard；并与 Fragility Index 对比，说明二者度量正交的脆弱性。
Result: MSP 在零假设下小、随效应强度增长；弱效应下基于 MSP 的规则比基于离散度的规则假阳性率更低；LaLonde 基准上 MSP = 1，即一次决策改动就使 CI 含零；Fragility Index 与 MSP 度量正交脆弱性（对高影响观测的脆弱不蕴含对规格选择的脆弱）；计算上加法结构下可解、一般情形 NP-hard。
Conclusion: 稳健性应度量到证伪的最小距离而非结果离散度，MSP 与 Fragility Index 捕捉的是互补的脆弱性，且一般情形的 MSP 计算本质上是 NP-hard。

papers.title: TimeTok: Granularity-Controllable Time-Series Generation via Hierarchical Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Time-series data are inherently multiscale, spanning diverse temporal granularities from coarse trends to fine-scale dynamics. However, existing time-series generative models provide limited control over the temporal granularity of both inputs and outputs, restricting their ability to condition on user-provided coarse sketches and generate samples at a desired target granularity. To address this, we introduce TimeTok, a unified framework for Granularity-Controllable Time-Series Generation (GC-TSG), which generates time series at any target granularity from any coarser input (e.g., rough sketches) or without conditioning. At the core of TimeTok is a hierarchical tokenization strategy that maps time series into an ordered sequence of tokens, from coarse to fine temporal granularity. Our autoregressive generation process operates across these granularity levels, producing token blocks that are decoded back into continuous time series. This design naturally enables GC-TSG within a single framework, where controlling the number of token blocks provides explicit control over output detail. Experiments show that TimeTok excels at GC-TSG tasks while achieving state-of-the-art performance in standard generation. Furthermore, we showcase TimeTok's potential as a foundational tokenizer by training on multiple datasets with heterogeneous temporal granularities, verifying strong transferability that consistently outperforms models trained on individual datasets. To our knowledge, this is the first unified framework that covers the full generative spectrum for time series, offering a valuable foundation for models that benefit from diverse temporal granularities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeTok 用分层 tokenization 把时间序列映射成从粗到细的有序 token 序列，自回归地跨粒度层级生成 token block 并解码回连续序列，通过控制 token block 数量显式控制输出细节粒度。它可在单一框架内从任意粗输入（如草图）或无条件生成任意目标粒度的时间序列，在 GC-TSG 任务上表现突出，标准生成达到 state-of-the-art，且作为基础 tokenizer 在多个异质粒度数据集上训练后迁移性优于单数据集训练的模型。
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成模型对输入与输出的时间粒度控制有限，难以在用户给定的粗略草图条件下生成、也难以按期望的目标粒度输出样本。
Method: 核心是分层 tokenization 策略，将时间序列映射为从粗到细的时间粒度有序 token 序列；自回归生成过程跨这些粒度层级进行，产出 token block 再解码回连续时间序列；通过控制 token block 数量实现输出细节的显式控制。
Result: 实验显示 TimeTok 在 GC-TSG 任务上表现优异，同时在标准生成任务上达到 state-of-the-art；作为基础 tokenizer 在多个具有异质时间粒度的数据集上训练，迁移性稳定优于在单个数据集上训练的模型。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个覆盖时间序列完整生成谱（从粗到细任意粒度、含条件与无条件）的统一框架，可作为需要多粒度时间序列的下游模型的基础 tokenizer。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Single-turn emergency psychiatric triage across 15 frontier AI chatbots
papers.abstract_en: People increasingly turn to general-purpose AI chatbots for advice about emotional and mental health problems, but the ability of these systems to recognize and appropriately triage psychiatric emergencies remains under-characterized. We evaluated psychiatric triage performance in 15 frontier AI chatbots using 112 clinical vignettes spanning four urgency levels, from routine care to immediate emergency assessment. In each trial (1680 total), a chatbot received a single user message conveying all triage-relevant information from one vignette and recommended a timeframe for care. The primary outcome was emergency under-triage; secondary outcomes included triage accuracy and the direction of errors. Vignettes and user messages were generated using a clinician-verified LLM pipeline. Across 415 emergency trials, 23 were under-triaged (5.5%; 95% CI 1.8-15.9). Overall accuracy, averaged across urgency levels, ranged from 42.0% to 71.8% across chatbots and was lowest for intermediate cases (19.6%; 95% CI 11.7-28.1). Every chatbot showed a net over-triage bias; overall, 763 of 786 incorrect assignments (97.1%) were more urgent than the prespecified triage level. The error pattern was similar when predictions were assessed against clinician ratings: 35 of 430 trials involving vignettes rated as emergencies by at least 75% of clinicians were under-triaged (8.1%). AI chatbots recognized most psychiatric emergencies but still missed clinically important cases and frequently over-triaged less urgent presentations. Further evaluations should examine how triage performance changes when clinically relevant information must be elicited through conversation.

TL;DR: 对 15 个前沿 AI 聊天机器人做单轮精神科分诊测试：112 个临床情景、1680 次试验中，急诊欠分诊 23/415（5.5%，95% CI 1.8–15.9），但 786 次错误里 97.1% 属于过度分诊，且中间紧急度病例准确率最低（19.6%）。结论是聊天机器人多数能识别急诊，却系统性地把轻症往急里报，并仍漏掉部分关键病例。
Motivation: 公众越来越多地用通用聊天机器人咨询心理与精神健康问题，但这些系统识别并恰当分诊精神科急诊的能力此前缺乏刻画。
Method: 用临床医生核验的 LLM pipeline 生成 112 个覆盖四个紧急度等级的临床情景，每次试验只给聊天机器人一条含全部分诊信息的用户消息并要求给出就医时间建议；主要结局为急诊欠分诊，次要结局为分诊准确率与错误方向，共 1680 次试验，另以至少 75% 临床医生评为急诊的情景做对照评分。
Result: 415 次急诊试验中 23 次欠分诊（5.5%，95% CI 1.8–15.9）；跨紧急度平均准确率在聊天机器人间为 42.0%–71.8%，中间病例最低（19.6%，95% CI 11.7–28.1）；786 次错误中 763 次（97.1%）比预设分诊级别更急；按临床医生评分对照时，430 次试验中 35 次欠分诊（8.1%）。
Conclusion: 单轮输入下聊天机器人能识别多数精神科急诊，但会漏掉临床上重要的病例并频繁对低紧急度表现过度分诊；下一步应考察必须通过对话追问才能获得临床信息时分诊表现如何变化。

papers.title: Understanding Scattered Forest Search: A Version-Space Perspective on Multi-Turn Program Correction
papers.abstract_en: In multi-turn program correction, the state-of-the-art method Scattered Forest Search (SFS) has been proposed, employing Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with carefully crafted initial seeds and text-based optimization. However, since SFS integrates multiple components, the effects of each component on performance and the overall behavior of SFS have not been sufficiently analyzed. In this work, we theoretically analyze the refinement process of SFS from the perspective of version spaces in learning theory and clarify its behavior. First, as a basis for the theoretical analysis, we introduce a sequential self-refinement method (Line), which starts from an initial program and repeatedly refines the resulting program. Furthermore, while Line progresses the refinement process in the depth direction, we introduce Iterative Refinement of Repair Instructions (IRRI) to capture the refinement process in the width direction, which fixes initial programs and iteratively refines repair instructions. We then analyze Line and IRRI and conduct a theoretical analysis of SFS by positioning it as an intermediate method between the two. Our theoretical analysis reveals that SFS exhibits behavior closer to IRRI than to Line, and this theoretical characteristic is also confirmed experimentally. Considering computational resources and methodological simplicity, these results suggest that a simpler method, IRRI, may achieve a similar refinement process without relying on the complex correction mechanism of SFS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 version space 视角拆解多轮程序纠错方法 Scattered Forest Search (SFS)：引入只沿深度迭代的 Line 与只沿宽度迭代修复指令的 IRRI，把 SFS 定位为两者之间的中间方法。理论分析显示 SFS 的行为更接近 IRRI 而非 Line，实验也证实这一特性；据此作者主张在考虑计算资源与方法简洁性时，用更简单的 IRRI 即可实现相似的纠错过程。
Motivation: SFS 把 MCTS、精心设计的初始种子与文本优化等多个组件耦合在一起，各组件对性能的贡献与整体行为缺乏分析，难以判断复杂纠错机制是否必要。
Method: 提出两个对照性的自精炼方法：Line 从初始程序出发反复精炼产出的程序（深度方向），IRRI 固定初始程序、迭代精炼修复指令（宽度方向）；再以学习理论中的 version space 框架分析 Line 与 IRRI，并把 SFS 作为两者之间的中间方法做理论刻画，最后用实验验证该理论特性。
Result: 理论分析给出 SFS 的行为更接近 IRRI 而非 Line，这一理论特性在实验中得到确认；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: SFS 的复杂纠错机制并非必需，从计算资源与方法简洁性出发，更简单的 IRRI 可以实现与 SFS 相似的精炼过程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Utility-Aware Data Pricing: Token-Level Quality and Empirical Training Gain for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Traditional ``row-count $\times$ quality coefficient'' approaches fail to capture the nonlinear utility of data for Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities. We present a utility-aware data valuation framework that moves from static accounting toward utility-based pricing. The framework combines token-level information density and data quality, empirical training contribution estimated by influence functions, proxy models, and Data Shapley values, and cryptographic mechanisms based on hash commitments, Merkle trees, and tamper-evident training ledgers. Preliminary evaluation includes a smoke-scale multi-domain study and a synthetic duplication test. Results show that proxy-based empirical gain achieves strong ranking agreement with proxy-defined realized utility and substantially outperforms row-count and token-count baselines in the tested setting, while the prototype provides a controlled sanity check of the valuation pipeline and its sensitivity to duplication-based manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 LLM 的效用感知数据定价框架，把 token 级信息密度与数据质量、用 influence function 与 Data Shapley 估计的经验训练贡献、以及基于 hash commitment 与 Merkle tree 的防篡改训练账本组合起来定价。在 smoke 规模多领域研究与合成重复测试中，proxy-based 经验增益与 proxy 定义的 realized utility 排序高度一致，并在该设定下明显优于 row-count 与 token-count 基线。
Motivation: 传统的“行数 × 质量系数”定价方式无法刻画数据对 LLM 能力的非线性效用，导致数据定价与真实训练贡献脱节。
Method: 框架三部分：token 级信息密度与数据质量打分；用 influence function、proxy model 与 Data Shapley 估计经验训练贡献；用 hash commitment、Merkle tree 与防篡改训练账本 (tamper-evident training ledgers) 提供密码学可审计性。评估为 smoke 规模多领域研究加一个合成重复操纵测试。
Result: proxy-based 经验增益与 proxy 定义的 realized utility 达到强排序一致性，并在所测设定下大幅优于 row-count 与 token-count 基线；原型对基于重复 (duplication) 的操纵表现出可控的敏感性。评估规模为 smoke-scale 多领域研究与合成重复测试。
Conclusion: 数据定价应从静态行数核算转向以实测训练效用为准的定价，且定价管线可被密码学账本审计并对重复操纵敏感。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Read the Paper, Write the Code: Agentic Reproduction of Social-Science Results
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has used LLM agents to reproduce empirical social science results with access to both the data and code. We broaden this scope by asking: Can they reproduce results given only a paper's methods description and original data? We develop an agentic reproduction system that extracts structured methods descriptions from papers, runs reimplementations under strict information isolation -- agents never see the original code, results, or paper -- and enables deterministic, cell-level comparison of reproduced outputs to the original results. An error attribution step traces discrepancies through the system chain to identify root causes. Evaluating four agent scaffolds and four LLMs on 48 papers with human-verified reproducibility, we find that agents can largely recover published results, but performance varies substantially between models, scaffolds, and papers. Root cause analysis reveals that failures stem both from agent errors and from underspecification in the papers themselves.
papers.comment: This extended version of the paper forthcoming at EMNLP provides additional detail and discussion for a social science audience
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 agentic 复现系统：从论文方法描述中抽取结构化方法，在严格信息隔离下（agent 看不到原代码、原结果、原论文）重跑实现，并对复现输出与原结果做逐 cell 的确定性比对，再用误差归因定位根因。在 48 篇人工核验可复现性的论文上评测 4 种 agent scaffold 与 4 个 LLM，agent 大体能恢复已发表结果，但失败既来自 agent 错误，也来自论文本身的欠规范 (underspecification)。
Motivation: 既有的 LLM agent 复现工作同时拿到数据和代码，条件过宽；只给方法描述与原始数据时能否复现社会科学结果尚不清楚，而论文欠规范正是复现失败的隐性来源。
Method: 系统从论文中抽取结构化方法描述，在严格信息隔离下运行重新实现，用确定性逐 cell 比对将复现输出与原结果对照，并加入误差归因步骤沿系统链路追踪差异根因；评测覆盖 4 种 agent scaffold 与 4 个 LLM。
Result: 在 48 篇经人工核验可复现性的论文上，agent 大体能恢复已发表结果，但性能在不同模型、scaffold 与论文之间差异显著；根因分析显示失败同时源于 agent 错误与论文欠规范。
Conclusion: 仅凭方法描述与原始数据，LLM agent 已能大体复现社会科学结果，但复现可靠性取决于模型与 scaffold 的选择，且相当一部分失败应归咎于论文写作本身不够规范。

papers.title: Replay-buffer engineering for noise-aware quantum circuit optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning for quantum circuit optimization faces three bottlenecks: replay buffers that overlook temporal difference (TD) target reliability, curriculum-based architecture search requiring a full quantum-classical evaluation after every edit, and the discard of noiseless trajectories when retraining under hardware noise. We address these limitations by treating replay as a central algorithmic lever. We introduce ReaPER+, an annealed replay rule that transitions from TD-error prioritization to reliability-aware sampling as value estimates mature. ReaPER+ achieves up to 4x higher sample efficiency than fixed PER, ReaPER, and uniform replay, while matching prior on-policy solution quality with up to 32x fewer interactions At 12 qubits, fixed ReaPER reaches the lowest energy error in the fewest steps, while PER and uniform replay find more compact circuits at higher error. On tasks scaling to 20 qubits, ReaPER+ retains its advantage, demonstrating that reliability-aware annealing extends beyond small-system benchmarks. LunarLander-v3 confirms that the ReaPER+ is domain-agnostic, it improves success rates by up to 26.8% over PER and 21.8% over fixed ReaPER, with a 3% AUC gain over both. We further introduce OptCRLQAS, which amortizes quantum-classical evaluations across multiple architectural edits, reducing training wall-clock time by up to 67.5% on 12-qubit without degrading solution quality. Finally, lightweight replay-buffer transfer warm-starts noisy optimization from noiseless trajectories, without weight transfer or $ε$-greedy pretraining, reducing steps to chemical accuracy by 85-90% and final energy error by up to 90% relative to from-scratch learning. Transfer gains increase with system size. Together, these results establish experience storage, sampling, and transfer as decisive levers for sample efficient, noise-aware quantum circuit optimization.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 main track. Camera ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 replay buffer 当作核心算法杠杆来改造量子线路强化学习：提出 ReaPER+，采样权重从 TD-error 优先 anneal 到可靠性感知采样，配合 OptCRLQAS 摊销架构编辑的量子-经典评估，并用无噪声轨迹热启噪声下训练。样本效率比固定 PER、ReaPER、uniform replay 最高提升 4 倍，以最多 32 倍更少交互达到既有 on-policy 解质量；12 qubit 上把达到化学精度的步数减少 85–90%、最终能量误差最多降低 90%。
Motivation: 深度 RL 做量子线路优化有三个瓶颈：replay buffer 不区分 TD target 可靠性、curriculum 架构搜索每次编辑都要完整跑一遍量子-经典评估、以及在硬件噪声下重训时把无噪声轨迹直接丢弃，导致样本与墙钟时间开销都很大。
Method: ReaPER+ 用 annealed replay 规则，随价值估计成熟从 TD-error 优先过渡到 reliability-aware 采样；OptCRLQAS 把量子-经典评估在多次架构编辑间摊销；replay-buffer transfer 直接用无噪声轨迹热启噪声优化，不迁移权重也不做 ε-greedy 预训练。评测含 12 qubit、扩展到 20 qubit 的任务以及 LunarLander-v3。
Result: ReaPER+ 样本效率比固定 PER、ReaPER、uniform replay 最高 4 倍，用最多 32 倍更少交互匹配先前 on-policy 解质量；12 qubit 上固定 ReaPER 用最少步数达到最低能量误差，PER 与 uniform replay 换来更紧凑但误差更高的线路；20 qubit 上 ReaPER+ 优势保持。LunarLander-v3 上成功率比 PER 高 26.8%、比固定 ReaPER 高 21.8%，AUC 高 3%。OptCRLQAS 在 12 qubit 上把训练墙钟时间降低最多 67.5% 且不损解质量；transfer 把达到化学精度的步数减少 85–90%、最终能量误差最多降低 90%，且系统越大增益越大。
Conclusion: 经验的存储、采样与迁移是样本高效、噪声感知量子线路优化的决定性杠杆，reliability-aware annealing 的优势不限于小系统基准。

summary_sections.method: ReaPER+ 用 annealed replay 规则，随价值估计成熟从 TD-error 优先过渡到 reliability-aware 采样；OptCRLQAS 把量子-经典评估在多次架构编辑间摊销；replay-buffer transfer 直接用无噪声轨迹热启噪声优化，不迁移权重也不做 ε-greedy 预训练。评测含 12 qubit、扩展到 20 qubit 的任务以及 LunarLander-v3。
summary_sections.result: ReaPER+ 样本效率比固定 PER、ReaPER、uniform replay 最高 4 倍，用最多 32 倍更少交互匹配先前 on-policy 解质量；12 qubit 上固定 ReaPER 用最少步数达到最低能量误差，PER 与 uniform replay 换来更紧凑但误差更高的线路；20 qubit 上 ReaPER+ 优势保持。LunarLander-v3 上成功率比 PER 高 26.8%、比固定 ReaPER 高 21.8%，AUC 高 3%。OptCRLQAS 在 12 qubit 上把训练墙钟时间降低最多 67.5% 且不损解质量；transfer 把达到化学精度的步数减少 85–90%、最终能量误差最多降低 90%，且系统越大增益越大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 经验的存储、采样与迁移是样本高效、噪声感知量子线路优化的决定性杠杆，reliability-aware annealing 的优势不限于小系统基准。

papers.title: Scepsy: Serving Agentic Workflows Using Aggregate LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows carry out complex tasks by orchestrating multiple large language models (LLMs) and tools. Serving them at a target throughput with low latency is hard because they are written in arbitrary agentic frameworks and their execution times are unpredictable: execution branches, fans out, or recurs in data-dependent ways. Since their LLMs often outnumber the available GPUs, they also oversubscribe GPUs. We describe Scepsy, a serving system that schedules arbitrary multi-LLM agentic workflows onto a GPU cluster. Scepsy exploits the insight that, while the end-to-end latency of an agentic workflow is unpredictable, each LLM's fraction of execution time is comparatively stable across requests. Scepsy profiles each LLM under different parallelism degrees and combines the profiles with these fractions into an Aggregate LLM Pipeline, a lightweight throughput and latency predictor for allocations. To minimize latency at a target throughput, Scepsy uses the Aggregate LLM Pipeline to search over fractional GPU shares, tensor parallelism degrees, and replica counts. A hierarchical heuristic then places the chosen allocation onto the cluster, minimizing fragmentation and respecting network topology. On realistic agentic workflows, Scepsy achieves up to 2.5x higher throughput before saturation and 1.0-3.3x lower latency than systems that optimize LLMs independently or rely on user-specified allocations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Scepsy 把任意 agentic workflow 的多 LLM 调度化归为可预测问题：利用每个 LLM 占执行时间的比例跨请求稳定这一性质，构建 Aggregate LLM Pipeline 吞吐/时延预测器，再据此搜索分数级 GPU 份额、张量并行度与副本数并做分层放置。在真实 agentic workflow 上，饱和前吞吐最高提升 2.5 倍，时延比独立优化各 LLM 或依赖用户指定分配的系统低 1.0–3.3 倍。
Motivation: agentic workflow 由任意框架编写、执行分支/扇出/递归导致端到端时延不可预测，且 LLM 数常超过 GPU 数造成 oversubscription，现有按单个 LLM 独立优化或依赖用户手工分配的做法无法在目标吞吐下控住时延。
Method: Scepsy 在不同并行度下 profile 每个 LLM，将其与各 LLM 的执行时间占比结合成 Aggregate LLM Pipeline 这一轻量吞吐与时延预测器；用它搜索分数级 GPU 份额、tensor parallelism 度与副本数以在目标吞吐下最小化时延，再用分层启发式把选定分配放到集群上，最小化碎片并遵守网络拓扑。
Result: 在 realistic agentic workflows 上，饱和前吞吐最高达独立优化 LLM 或依赖用户指定分配系统的 2.5 倍，时延低 1.0–3.3 倍。
Conclusion: 端到端时延虽不可预测，但单个 LLM 的执行时间占比稳定，据此做聚合式预测与联合分配搜索即可在 GPU oversubscription 集群上同时提高吞吐、压低时延。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ControlFoley: Unified and Controllable Video-to-Audio Generation with Cross-Modal Conflict Handling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video-to-audio (V2A) generation enable high-quality audio synthesis from visual content, yet achieving robust and fine-grained controllability remains challenging. Existing methods suffer from weak textual controllability under visual-text conflict and imprecise stylistic control due to entangled temporal and timbre information in reference audio. Moreover, the lack of standardized benchmarks limits systematic evaluation. We propose ControlFoley, a unified multimodal V2A framework that enables precise control over video, text, and reference audio. We introduce a joint visual encoding paradigm that integrates CLIP with a spatio-temporal audio-visual encoder to improve alignment and textual controllability. We further propose temporal-timbre decoupling to suppress redundant temporal cues while preserving discriminative timbre features. In addition, we design a modality-robust training scheme with unified multimodal representation alignment (REPA) and random modality dropout. We also present VGGSound-TVC, a benchmark for evaluating textual controllability under varying degrees of visual-text conflict. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple V2A tasks, including text-guided, text-controlled, and audio-controlled generation. ControlFoley achieves superior controllability under cross-modal conflict while maintaining strong synchronization and audio quality, and shows competitive or better performance compared to an industrial V2A system. Code, models, datasets, and demos are available at: https://github.com/xiaomi-research/controlfoley.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ControlFoley 是一个统一的视频到音频 (V2A) 生成框架，用 CLIP 与时空音视频编码器的联合视觉编码提升文本可控性，用 temporal-timbre decoupling 压掉参考音频里冗余的时序线索、保留音色判别特征，并以 REPA 对齐与随机模态丢弃 (random modality dropout) 做模态鲁棒训练。作者同时发布 VGGSound-TVC 基准，在不同程度视觉-文本冲突下评测文本可控性；实验称在文本引导、文本控制、音频控制多类 V2A 任务上达到 SOTA，跨模态冲突下可控性更优且同步与音质保持，与一套工业级 V2A 系统相比持平或更好。
Motivation: 视觉-文本冲突时现有 V2A 方法的文本可控性弱，参考音频中时序与音色纠缠导致风格控制不精确，且缺少标准化基准，无法系统评测可控性。
Method: 联合视觉编码范式把 CLIP 与时空音视频编码器 (spatio-temporal audio-visual encoder) 结合以改善对齐与文本控制；temporal-timbre decoupling 抑制冗余时序线索同时保留音色特征；训练侧用统一多模态表征对齐 (REPA) 加随机模态丢弃；并构建 VGGSound-TVC 基准，按视觉-文本冲突程度分档评测。
Result: 实验覆盖文本引导、文本控制、音频控制三类 V2A 任务，报告跨多任务的 state-of-the-art 表现；在跨模态冲突下可控性更优，同时保持同步与音频质量；与一套工业 V2A 系统相比持平或更好。
Conclusion: 把视觉编码、音色/时序解耦与模态鲁棒训练统一到一个框架，可在视觉-文本冲突下同时拿到可控性、同步与音质；VGGSound-TVC 被作为该冲突场景的标准评测载体，代码与模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Auditable Commercial Registry Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Public commercial registries are formally open, yet their practical analysis remains difficult because relevant facts are scattered across millions of records that combine structured metadata, multilingual legal notices, temporal events, and entity aliases. This paper presents a controlled, tool-mediated agentic GraphRAG architecture for auditable natural-language analysis of such registries. The proposed pipeline transforms publications from the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce into a Neo4j knowledge graph comprising over five million nodes and 4.7 million relationships. It combines deterministic ingestion of structured registry fields, LLM-assisted extraction of latent actors from unstructured notices, and a deterministic identity-resolution layer. An analytical agent operates on this graph through intent routing, restricted graph tools, bounded reflection, and state-machine-guided response synthesis. We evaluate the system using a multi-tier protocol covering answer quality, retrieval behavior, entity resolution, and multi-turn conversational performance. The complete architecture is compared with dense, lexical, and hybrid flat-retrieval baselines and with controlled architectural ablations. On a manually curated benchmark, graph-mediated retrieval increases factual correctness from 0.26 for the strongest flat-retrieval baseline to 0.83 for the complete system, with comparable improvements in relevance and completeness. Ablation results show that bounded reflection improves answer quality while intent routing and LLM-based graph enrichment improve reliability in difficult entity resolution tasks. An exploratory dashboard displays the graph evidence and execution traces underlying each response, allowing users to inspect how answers were produced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出受控、工具中介的 agentic GraphRAG 架构，把瑞士商业公报 (Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce) 出版物建成含 500 万节点、470 万关系的 Neo4j 知识图谱，供可审计的自然语言查询。在人工整理基准上，图中介检索把事实正确性从最强 flat-retrieval 基线的 0.26 提到完整系统的 0.83。
Motivation: 公共商业登记册形式上开放，但事实散落在数百万条记录中，混合结构化元数据、多语种法律公告、时序事件与实体别名，难以做可审计的自然语言分析。
Method: 流水线含确定性结构化字段摄取、LLM 从非结构公告中抽取潜在主体、确定性 identity-resolution 层，建成 Neo4j 图（超 500 万节点、470 万关系）；分析 agent 通过 intent routing、受限图工具、bounded reflection 与状态机引导的响应合成操作图，并用多层协议评测答案质量、检索行为、实体解析与多轮对话。
Result: 在人工整理基准上，图中介检索的事实正确性从最强 flat-retrieval 基线 0.26 升至完整系统 0.83，relevance 与 completeness 有相当幅度提升；与 dense、lexical、hybrid flat-retrieval 基线及受控架构消融对比，消融显示 bounded reflection 提升答案质量，intent routing 与 LLM 图富化改善困难实体解析任务的可靠性。
Conclusion: 把检索约束在受控图工具与状态机引导的合成内，可让商业登记册问答同时拿到高事实正确性和可检查的执行轨迹，dashboard 可展示每个回答背后的图证据与执行痕迹。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PAC-CF: Calibrating Irreversible Frontier Pruning in LLM-Guided Search
papers.abstract_en: LLM-guided search explores multiple candidate trajectories, but at substantial test-time cost. Pruning low-scoring frontier candidates can control this cost, yet it also turns potentially biased evaluator scores into irreversible decisions: systematic ranking errors can persist under repeated scoring and remove useful branches. We propose Probably Approximately Correct Conformal Filtering (PAC-CF). Its fixed-frontier analysis formulates elimination as an $(\varepsilon,δ)$-PAC problem under bounded evaluator bias; its operational rule separately calibrates a score-gap threshold on held-out tasks by running the original controller without PAC-CF and using post-search verifier labels to measure the deficit of solution-preserving candidates relative to the frontier leader. Conditional on exchangeable native-controller tasks with nonempty protected exposure, conformal calibration gives finite-sample coverage for retaining at least one verifier-defined valid continuation at every protected frontier on the native trajectory. At deployment, PAC-CF removes only candidates whose gap from the highest frontier score exceeds the frozen threshold. We evaluate PAC-CF across three domains, five controllers, and four request budgets from B100 to B500. In the cross-domain/controller macro averages, the point estimates for all three workload measures are lower at every budget; the paired-bootstrap 95\% confidence interval for utility excludes zero at B100 and B200. For pruning-aware ToolTree, the full-test-set cross-domain utility difference is $+4.38$ points at each tested budget; on the natural-termination sensitivity cohort, physical requests decrease by $18.94$--$18.95\%$ and end-to-end token usage by $23.57$--$23.76\%$.
papers.comment: 26 pages. Major revision. Earlier versions circulated under the title PAC-MCTS and reported controlled proof-of-concept experiments. This version introduces native-trajectory conformal calibration, frozen-margin deployment, controller-agnostic integration, and benchmark-based multi-domain evaluation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAC-CF 把 LLM 引导搜索中的前沿剪枝写成有界评估器偏差下的 (ε,δ)-PAC 问题，在留出任务上用原生控制器轨迹与事后 verifier 标签校准分数差阈值，部署时只删除与前沿最高分差超过冻结阈值的候选。跨 3 个领域、5 个控制器、B100–B500 四档预算的评测中，三项工作负载指标的点估计在每档预算下都更低；对剪枝感知的 ToolTree，全测试集效用差为每档 +4.38 点，自然终止敏感队列上物理请求下降 18.94–18.95%、端到端 token 用量下降 23.57–23.76%。
Motivation: LLM 引导搜索要跑多条候选轨迹，测试时开销大；对低分前沿候选做剪枝会把可能有偏的评估器分数变成不可逆决策，系统性排序错误在重复打分下持续存在，可能删掉有用分支。
Method: 固定前沿分析把消去建模为有界评估器偏差下的 (ε,δ)-PAC 保留问题；操作规则在留出任务上运行不带 PAC-CF 的原生控制器，用事后 verifier 标签度量保解候选相对前沿领先者的分数亏缺，从而单独校准分数差阈值。在可交换的原生控制器任务且保护前沿非空的条件下，conformal 校准给出有限样本覆盖：原生轨迹上每个受保护前沿至少保留一条 verifier 判定的有效延续；部署时只删除与最高前沿分差超过冻结阈值的候选，且与控制器解耦。
Result: 跨 3 个领域、5 个控制器、B100 到 B500 四档请求预算评测：跨领域/控制器宏平均下三项工作负载指标的点估计在每档预算都更低，配对 bootstrap 的 95% 置信区间在 B100 与 B200 上对效用排除零。对剪枝感知的 ToolTree，全测试集跨领域效用差在每档测试预算为 +4.38 点；自然终止敏感队列上物理请求减少 18.94–18.95%，端到端 token 用量减少 23.57–23.76%。
Conclusion: 把剪枝做成带有限样本覆盖保证的 (ε,δ)-PAC 冻结阈值决策，可以在不丢掉有效延续的前提下压低 LLM 搜索的测试时开销，且该阈值校准与具体控制器无关。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ArtifactWorld: Scaling 3D Gaussian Splatting Artifact Restoration via Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) delivers high-fidelity real-time rendering but suffers from geometric and photometric degradations under sparse-view constraints. Current generative restoration approaches are often limited by insufficient temporal coherence, a lack of explicit spatial constraints, and a lack of large-scale training data, resulting in multi-view inconsistencies, erroneous geometric hallucinations, and limited generalization to diverse real-world artifact distributions. In this paper, we present ArtifactWorld, a framework that resolves 3DGS artifact repair through systematic data expansion and a homogeneous dual-model paradigm. To address the data bottleneck, we establish a fine-grained phenomenological taxonomy of 3DGS artifacts and construct a comprehensive training set of 107.5K diverse paired video clips to enhance model robustness. Architecturally, we unify the restoration process within a video diffusion backbone, utilizing an isomorphic predictor to localize structural defects via an artifact heatmap. This heatmap then guides the restoration through an Artifact-Aware Triplet Fusion mechanism, enabling precise, intensity-guided spatio-temporal repair within native self-attention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ArtifactWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in sparse novel view synthesis and robust 3D reconstruction. Code available at: https://github.com/fyting/ArtifactWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ArtifactWorld 用视频扩散骨干修复 3D Gaussian Splatting 在稀疏视角下的几何与光度退化：先由同构预测器输出 artifact heatmap 定位结构缺陷，再经 Artifact-Aware Triplet Fusion 在原生 self-attention 内做强度引导的时空修复。配套构建 107.5K 对配对视频片段训练集，实验称在稀疏新视角合成与鲁棒 3D 重建上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下 3DGS 存在几何与光度退化，现有生成式修复方法时序一致性不足、缺少显式空间约束且训练数据规模有限，导致多视图不一致、几何幻觉与真实场景泛化差。
Method: 先建立 3DGS artifact 的细粒度现象学分类并构造 107.5K 对多样配对视频片段训练集；架构上统一到视频扩散骨干，用同构预测器 (isomorphic predictor) 生成 artifact heatmap 定位结构缺陷，再由 Artifact-Aware Triplet Fusion 在 self-attention 内融合引导修复。
Result: 构建含 107.5K 对配对视频片段的训练集；实验显示 ArtifactWorld 在稀疏新视角合成 (sparse novel view synthesis) 与鲁棒 3D 重建上取得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 数据扩展加同构双模型范式（heatmap 定位 + 注意力内融合）可把 3DGS 伪影修复推到 SOTA，代码已开源。

papers.title: Query Lower Bounds for Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate samples by iteratively querying learned score estimates. A rapidly growing literature focuses on accelerating sampling by minimizing the number of score evaluations, yet the information-theoretic limits of such acceleration remain unclear. In this work, we establish the first score query lower bounds for diffusion sampling. We prove that for $d$-dimensional distributions, given access to score estimates with polynomial accuracy $\varepsilon=d^{-O(1)}$ (in any $L^p$ sense), any sampling algorithm requires $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt{d})$ adaptive score queries. In particular, our proof shows that, within any polynomial total-query budget, successful sampling requires searching over $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt{d})$ distinct noise levels, providing a formal explanation for why multiscale noise schedules are necessary in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明扩散采样的首个 score 查询下界：对 d 维分布，只要 score 估计精度为多项式级 ε=d^{-O(1)}（任意 L^p 范数），任何采样算法都需要 Ω̃(√d) 次自适应 score 查询；且在多项式总查询预算内，成功采样必须遍历 Ω̃(√d) 个不同噪声水平，从信息论上解释了实践中多尺度噪声调度 (multiscale noise schedules) 为何必要。
Motivation: 加速扩散采样的文献集中于减少 score 评估次数，但这类加速的信息论极限尚不清楚，缺少任何查询复杂度下界。
Method: 建立扩散采样的 score 查询下界证明：设定为 d 维分布、score 估计具有多项式精度 ε=d^{-O(1)}（任意 L^p 意义），下界针对自适应 (adaptive) 查询次数，并刻画多项式总查询预算下必须搜索的噪声水平数量。
Result: 任何采样算法需要 Ω̃(√d) 次自适应 score 查询；在任意多项式总查询预算内，成功采样需要搜索 Ω̃(√d) 个不同噪声水平。
Conclusion: 扩散采样的加速存在 √d 级的不可突破查询代价，多尺度噪声调度不是工程取舍而是信息论上的必需。

papers.title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
papers.abstract_en: With the advancement of interactive video generation, diffusion models have increasingly demonstrated their potential as world models. However, existing approaches still struggle to simultaneously achieve memory-enabled long-term temporal consistency and high-resolution real-time generation, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. To address this, we present Matrix-Game 3.0, a memory-augmented interactive world model designed for 720p real-time longform video generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 2.0, we introduce systematic improvements across data, model, and inference. First, we develop an upgraded industrial-scale infinite data engine that integrates Unreal Engine-based synthetic data, large-scale automated collection from AAA games, and real-world video augmentation to produce high-quality Video-Pose-Action-Prompt quadruplet data at scale. Second, we propose a training framework for long-horizon consistency: by modeling prediction residuals and re-injecting imperfect generated frames during training, the base model learns self-correction; meanwhile, camera-aware memory retrieval and injection enable the base model to achieve long horizon spatiotemporal consistency. Third, we design a multi-segment autoregressive distillation strategy based on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), combined with model quantization and VAE decoder pruning, to achieve efficient real-time inference. Experimental results show that Matrix-Game 3.0 achieves up to 40 FPS real-time generation at 720p resolution with a 5B model, while maintaining stable memory consistency over minute-long sequences. Scaling up to a 2x14B model further improves generation quality, dynamics, and generalization. Our approach provides a practical pathway toward industrial-scale deployable world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Matrix-Game 3.0 是面向 720p 实时长视频的带记忆交互式世界模型：用残差建模与训练期回灌不完美生成帧让基模型学会自我纠正，配合相机感知的记忆检索与注入维持长时序一致，再以多段自回归 DMD 蒸馏加量化和 VAE decoder 剪枝做实时推理。5B 模型在 720p 下达到最高 40 FPS，并在分钟级序列上保持稳定记忆一致性；扩到 2x14B 进一步提升生成质量、动态性与泛化。
Motivation: 现有交互式视频生成方法难以同时做到带记忆的长时序一致性和高分辨率实时生成，限制了其在真实场景中的可用性。
Method: 数据侧构建工业级无限数据引擎，融合 Unreal Engine 合成数据、3A 游戏大规模自动采集与真实视频增广，产出 Video-Pose-Action-Prompt 四元组；训练侧建模预测残差并在训练中回灌不完美生成帧以学习自我纠正，加相机感知记忆检索与注入；推理侧用基于 Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) 的多段自回归蒸馏，配合模型量化与 VAE decoder 剪枝。
Result: 5B 模型在 720p 分辨率下实现最高 40 FPS 实时生成，并在分钟级序列上保持稳定记忆一致性；扩展到 2x14B 模型进一步改善生成质量、动态性与泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为数据、长时一致训练与蒸馏量化三方面系统改进可给出通往工业级可部署世界模型的现实路径。

papers.title: Revisiting the Capacity Gap in Chain-of-Thought Distillation from a Practical Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation transfers reasoning behaviors from a strong teacher to a smaller student, but prior work reports a capacity gap: distillation may fail when the teacher-student capability mismatch is large. We revisit the capacity gap from a practical perspective by re-examining commonly used experimental settings. Notably, we find that CoT distillation often degrades performance compared to the student's pre-distillation baseline, and that some settings used in prior work, while suitable for establishing the capacity gap as a phenomenon, do not reflect realistic deployment scenarios. Complementing prior work that establishes the capacity gap, we evaluate its practical impact under more realistic settings and find that it does not consistently dominate; stronger teachers tend to be preferable when candidate teachers differ substantially in performance. Our results offer practical guidance for selecting teacher-student pairs in CoT distillation.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 6 figures; the first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 重审 CoT 蒸馏中的 capacity gap：在更贴近真实部署的设置下，蒸馏并不稳定优于学生蒸馏前基线，且当候选教师能力差距明显时应选更强的教师。
Motivation: 既有工作把 capacity gap 当作既定现象来建立，但其常用实验设置未必对应真实部署，导致对蒸馏收益的判断失真。
Method: 重新审视常用的 CoT 蒸馏实验设置，在更贴近真实部署的设置下评估 capacity gap 的实际影响，并据此比较不同候选教师的选择。
Result: 发现 CoT 蒸馏常使性能低于学生蒸馏前基线；在更现实的设置下 capacity gap 并不一致占优；当候选教师性能差距较大时，更强的教师通常更可取。
Conclusion: capacity gap 的实际影响取决于实验设置是否贴近部署，选教师-学生配对时应优先考虑能力更强的教师。

papers.title: Restless Bandits with Individual Penalty Constraints: Near-Optimal Indices and Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) framework under individual penalty constraints to address resource allocation challenges in dynamic wireless networked environments. Unlike conventional RMAB models, our model allows each user (arm) to have distinct and stringent performance constraints, such as energy limits, activation limits, or age of information minimums, enabling the capture of diverse objectives including fairness and efficiency. To find the optimal resource allocation policy, we propose a new Penalty-Optimal Whittle (POW) index policy. The POW index of an user only depends on the user's transition kernel and penalty constraints, and remains invariable to system-wide features such as the number of users present and the amount of resource available. This makes it computationally tractable to calculate the POW indices offline without any need for online adaptation. Moreover, we theoretically prove that the POW index policy is asymptotically optimal while satisfying all individual penalty constraints. We also introduce a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to efficiently learn the POW index on the fly. Simulation results across various applications and system configurations further demonstrate that the POW index policy not only has near-optimal performance but also significantly outperforms other existing policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带个体惩罚约束的 restless multi-armed bandit (RMAB) 资源分配模型中，提出 Penalty-Optimal Whittle (POW) index 策略：指数只依赖单个用户的转移核与惩罚约束，与用户数和可用资源量无关，可离线预计算。理论上证明 POW 策略渐近最优且满足全部个体惩罚约束，并给出在线学习该指数的深度强化学习算法；仿真显示其接近最优并显著优于现有策略。
Motivation: 无线网络动态资源分配中各用户有各自不同的性能约束（能耗上限、激活次数上限、Age of Information 下限），常规 RMAB 的统一约束设定无法刻画公平与效率等多样目标，且传统 Whittle index 需随系统规模在线调整。
Method: 建立带个体惩罚约束的 RMAB 模型，把约束以惩罚项形式并入目标，推导 POW index——仅由用户转移核与惩罚约束决定、对系统级特征不变；证明该 index 策略渐近最优并满足全部个体约束；另设计深度强化学习算法在线学习 POW index。
Result: 理论证明 POW index 策略渐近最优且满足所有个体惩罚约束；仿真覆盖多种应用场景与系统配置，显示 POW 策略接近最优并显著优于其他现有策略（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把个体惩罚约束编码进 index 本身，可让 RMAB 策略在保持可离线计算与系统规模无关的同时达到渐近最优，深度 RL 则补上在线学指数的路径。

summary_sections.method: 建立带个体惩罚约束的 RMAB 模型，把约束以惩罚项形式并入目标，推导 POW index——仅由用户转移核与惩罚约束决定、对系统级特征不变；证明该 index 策略渐近最优并满足全部个体约束；另设计深度强化学习算法在线学习 POW index。
summary_sections.result: 理论证明 POW index 策略渐近最优且满足所有个体惩罚约束；仿真覆盖多种应用场景与系统配置，显示 POW 策略接近最优并显著优于其他现有策略（摘要未给出具体数值）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把个体惩罚约束编码进 index 本身，可让 RMAB 策略在保持可离线计算与系统规模无关的同时达到渐近最优，深度 RL 则补上在线学指数的路径。

papers.title: FusionBERT: Multi-View Image--3D Retrieval via Cross-Attention Visual Fusion and Normal-Aware 3D Encoder
papers.abstract_en: We propose FusionBERT, a novel multi-view visual fusion framework for image--3D multimodal retrieval. Existing image--3D representation learning methods predominantly focus on feature alignment of a single object image and its 3D model, limiting their applicability in realistic scenarios where an object is typically observed and captured from multiple viewpoints. Although multi-view observations naturally provide complementary geometric and appearance cues, existing multimodal large models rarely explore how to effectively fuse such multi-view visual information for better cross-modal retrieval. To address this limitation, we introduce a multi-view image--3D retrieval framework named FusionBERT, which innovatively utilizes a cross-attention-based multi-view visual aggregator to adaptively integrate features from multi-view images of an object. The proposed multi-view visual encoder fuses inter-view complementary relationships and selectively emphasizes informative visual cues across multiple views to get a more robustly fused visual feature for better 3D model matching. Furthermore, FusionBERT proposes a normal-aware 3D model encoder that can further enhance the 3D geometric feature of an object model by jointly encoding point normals and 3D positions, enabling a more robust representation learning for textureless or color-degraded 3D models. Extensive image--3D retrieval experiments on both synthetic 3D models and real-world industrial mechanical objects demonstrate that FusionBERT achieves significantly higher retrieval accuracy than SOTA multimodal large models under both single-view and multi-view settings, establishing a strong baseline for multi-view multimodal retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FusionBERT 面向图像–3D 多模态检索，用跨注意力多视角聚合器自适应融合同一物体的多视角图像特征，并用法线感知 3D 编码器联合编码点法线与三维位置。在合成 3D 模型与真实工业机械物体的检索实验中，单视角与多视角设置下检索准确率均显著高于 SOTA 多模态大模型。
Motivation: 现有图像–3D 表征学习多只对齐单张物体图像与其 3D 模型，难以覆盖真实场景中多视角观测；而多模态大模型很少处理如何有效融合多视角视觉信息以改进跨模态检索。
Method: FusionBERT 包含跨注意力多视角视觉聚合器，自适应整合多视角图像特征、融合视角间互补关系并选择性强调有信息量的线索，得到更稳健的融合视觉特征用于 3D 模型匹配；另提出法线感知 3D 模型编码器，联合编码点法线 (point normals) 与 3D 位置以增强几何特征，面向无纹理或颜色退化的 3D 模型。
Result: 在合成 3D 模型与真实工业机械物体两类图像–3D 检索实验上，FusionBERT 在单视角与多视角设置下检索准确率均显著高于 SOTA 多模态大模型。
Conclusion: 多视角融合加法线感知的 3D 编码可为多视角多模态检索建立强基线，尤其改善无纹理或颜色退化 3D 模型的表征稳健性。

papers.title: Screening Is Enough
papers.abstract_en: We call query--key relevance absolute when its values lie on a fixed bounded scale, depend on neither competing keys nor sequence length, require no sequence-length-dependent calibration, and can all be zero. To realize this notion, we introduce screening, whose explicit threshold transforms bounded query--key similarities into relevance values, enabling exact rejection, empty selection, and direct inspection on a common scale. In a controlled comparison of 12 attention mechanisms on a matched Transformer backbone, only screening maintains both low long-context perplexity and robust retrieval beyond the training context; notably, it does so without inference-time scaling. Building on screening, we introduce Multiscreen, a language-model architecture composed of parallel gated screening tiles. Multiscreen retains these long-context gains while achieving greater parameter efficiency, stronger general zero-shot downstream performance, lower training cost at larger scales, and lower model-side time to first token than Transformer baselines. We further develop a normalization design that keeps Multiscreen training stable even at a learning rate of $1$ and show that an adapted version likewise stabilizes Transformer at the same learning rate.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 25 figures. Substantially revised version with all experiments rerun, extensive controlled attention-mechanism comparisons and architectural ablations, and corrections and minor refinements to the mathematical specification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把有界 query-key 相似度经显式阈值变成绝对相关性的注意力机制 screening，使相关性不依赖竞争 key 与序列长度、可全为零，从而支持精确拒绝与空选择。在匹配的 Transformer 骨干上对 12 种注意力机制的受控对比中，只有 screening 同时保持低长上下文困惑度与训练上下文之外的稳健检索，且不依赖推理时扩展；基于它构建的 Multiscreen 架构在参数效率、零样本下游性能、训练成本与首 token 延迟上优于 Transformer 基线。
Motivation: 现有注意力的 query-key 相关性随竞争 key 与序列长度变化，需要随长度校准，无法表达“全部不相关”，长上下文检索在外推长度上失效。
Method: screening 用显式阈值把有界相似度映射为绝对相关性，支持精确拒绝与空选择；Multiscreen 由并行的门控 screening tile 组成，并配一种使训练在学习率 1 下仍稳定的归一化设计，同一设计改造后也能稳定 Transformer。
Result: 在匹配 Transformer 骨干上受控比较 12 种注意力机制，只有 screening 同时保持低长上下文困惑度与超出训练上下文的稳健检索，且无需推理时扩展；Multiscreen 保留这些长上下文增益，并取得更高参数效率、更强的通用零样本下游性能、更大规模下更低训练成本、更低模型侧首 token 时间；归一化设计使 Multiscreen 在学习率 1 下训练稳定，改造版同样稳定 Transformer。
Conclusion: 把 query-key 相关性做成带阈值的绝对量，足以同时解决长上下文检索与空选择问题，并可进一步支撑更省参数、更省训练成本的非 Transformer 架构。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Pure and physics-guided deep learning approaches for spatio-temporal groundwater level prediction
papers.abstract_en: Groundwater represents a key element of the water cycle, yet it exhibits complex and context-dependent relationships that make its modeling challenging. Theory-based models have been the cornerstone of scientific understanding. However, their computational cost, simplifying assumptions, and calibration requirements limit their use. In recent years, data-driven models have emerged as powerful alternatives. In particular, deep learning has proven to be a promising approach for its design flexibility and ability to learn complex relationships directly from the data without requiring extensive domain information. We proposed an attention-based pure deep learning model, named STAINet, to predict weekly groundwater levels in Piedmont (Italy), leveraging both irregular groundwater time series and weather image sequences. To enhance the model's trustworthiness and generalization ability, we merged the theory and data-driven approaches by considering physics-guided strategies to inject the groundwater flow equation into the model. Firstly, we restructured the tail of the architecture to predict the three terms of the governing equation, named the autoregressive, diffusion, and residual components - we thus obtained the PSTAINet-IB. Then, we further injected physics priors by adding loss terms related to the estimated equation components, obtaining the PSTAINet-ILB model. Lastly, we developed the PSTAINet-ILRB by imposing a loss term specific to the residual component, which forces the groundwater recharge to occur within the groundwater body recharge zone, which is identified by domain experts. The models were evaluated both by feeding true lagged values as input and by iterating their own predictions (rollouts) over the whole test set. The PSTAINet-ILB model performed the best, achieving remarkable test performance, and generating equation components in line with domain experts' expectations.
papers.journal_ref: Salis, M., Sartor, G., Meo, R., Ferraris, S., and Atto, A. M. Pure and physics-guided deep learning approaches for spatio-temporal groundwater level prediction. Machine Learning: Science and Technology, 7(5):055016, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出注意力时空模型 STAINet，用不规则地下水位时间序列加天气影像序列做周尺度地下水位预测，并通过三种物理引导变体把地下水流方程注入架构：PSTAINet-IB 让输出头直接预测方程的自回归、扩散、残差三项，PSTAINet-ILB 再加对应损失项，PSTAINet-ILRB 额外约束补给只能发生在专家划定的补给区。在意大利 Piemonte 全测试集上，PSTAINet-ILB 在真值滞后输入与自回归 rollout 两种评测下表现最好，且生成的方程分量符合领域专家预期。
Motivation: 机理模型计算成本高、依赖简化假设与率定，纯数据驱动模型又缺乏可信度与泛化保证；地下水位与水文气象的关系随情境变化，需要把方程约束嵌入学习模型。
Method: STAINet 以注意力机制融合不规则地下水位时间序列与天气影像序列，输出周尺度水位；物理引导改造包括重构网络尾部以直接预测地下水流方程的自回归、扩散、残差三项（PSTAINet-IB），在损失中加入与这些分量相关的项（PSTAINet-ILB），以及对残差项施加补给须落在专家识别的补给区内的损失（PSTAINet-ILRB）。
Result: 在 Piemonte 测试集上，以真值滞后值输入和自回归 rollout 两种方式评测，PSTAINet-ILB 表现最佳，取得最好的测试性能，其生成的方程分量与领域专家预期一致。
Conclusion: 把地下水流方程的分量预测与对应损失一起注入注意力时空网络，能在保持预测性能的同时让模型输出符合水文机理，其中带分量损失的 PSTAINet-ILB 是作者选定的最优方案。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: A Skill-augmented Agentic Framework and Benchmark for Multi-Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved strong performance in single-video understanding, yet their ability to reason across multiple videos remains limited. Existing approaches typically concatenate multiple videos into a single input and perform direct inference, which introduces training-inference mismatch, information loss from frame compression, and a lack of explicit cross-video coordination. Meanwhile, current multi-video benchmarks primarily emphasize event-level comparison, leaving identity-level matching, fine-grained discrimination, and structured multi-step reasoning underexplored. To address these gaps, we introduce MVX-Bench, a Multi-Video Cross-Dimension Benchmark that reformulates 11 classical computer vision tasks into a unified multi-video question-answering framework, comprising 1,442 questions over 4,255 videos from diverse real-world datasets. We further propose SAMA, a Skill-Augmented Agentic Framework for Multi-Video Understanding, which integrates visual tools, task-specific skills, and a conflict-aware verification mechanism to enable iterative and structured reasoning. Experimental results show that SAMA outperforms strong open-source baselines and GPT on MVX-Bench, and ablations validate the effectiveness of skill design and conflict resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MVX-Bench，把 11 个经典 CV 任务改写成统一的多视频问答框架（1,442 题、4,255 个视频），并给出 SAMA 智能体框架，用视觉工具、任务专属技能与冲突感知验证机制做迭代式跨视频推理。在 MVX-Bench 上 SAMA 超过强开源基线与 GPT，消融验证技能设计与冲突消解均有效。
Motivation: 多视频推理受限于把视频拼接后直接推理带来的训练-推理不匹配、帧压缩信息损失与缺乏显式跨视频协调；现有基准偏事件级比较，身份级匹配、细粒度判别与结构化多步推理被忽视。
Method: SAMA 整合视觉工具、任务专属技能 (task-specific skills) 与冲突感知验证机制 (conflict-aware verification)，支持迭代结构化推理；MVX-Bench 将 11 个经典计算机视觉任务统一为多视频 QA 形式。
Result: MVX-Bench 含 1,442 道问题、覆盖 4,255 个来自真实世界数据集的视频；实验显示 SAMA 在其上优于强开源基线与 GPT，消融实验验证技能设计与冲突消解的有效性。
Conclusion: 把技能与冲突感知验证注入智能体框架可提升跨视频推理，且结构化基准（含身份级与多步推理维度）是检验该能力的必要载体。

papers.title: HARMONI: Aligning Human and Scene Priors for Multi-View 4D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D foundation models have enabled joint reconstruction of humans and their surrounding environments. However, combining independently trained human and scene priors often produces misalignment in scale and depth. We observe that the two priors have complementary strengths. The scene prior provides consistent depth but approximate scale, while the human prior provides fixed body scale but less reliable depth. Motivated by this observation, we present HARMONI, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs cameras, scene, and humans with identities from monocular or multi-view video without test-time optimization. We introduce bidirectional anchoring, in which scene depth guides human placement, while human keypoints calibrate the scene scale to match the human body. While most existing approaches target monocular inputs and multi-view methods rely on optimization or re-identification, our approach naturally extends to multiple views. Building on bidirectional anchoring, we introduce a multi-view fusion module that merges per-view estimates, while reducing the influence of unreliable views and visually similar individuals. Experiments show that our framework outperforms previous human-scene methods in global motion and multi-view pose estimation by up to 28% and 64%, while running 28 times faster than optimization-based approaches. Project page: https://nstar1125.github.io/harmoni.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 独立训练的人体先验与场景先验直接组合会在尺度和深度上错位：场景先验深度一致但尺度只是近似，人体先验尺度固定但深度不可靠，导致人-场景联合重建对不齐。
Method: 前馈框架，从单目或多视角视频直接重建相机、场景与带身份的人体，无需测试时优化。核心是双向锚定：场景深度引导人体放置，人体关键点标定场景尺度以匹配人体；其上的多视角融合模块合并逐视角估计，并降低不可靠视角与视觉相似个体的影响。
Result: 相比既有人体-场景方法，全局运动估计最高提升 28%，多视角姿态估计最高提升 64%；相比基于优化的方法运行速度快 28 倍。
Conclusion: 把人体与场景两个先验通过双向锚定互相校准，可以在免测试时优化的前提下同时改善人-场景重建的全局运动、多视角姿态与速度。

papers.title: Altered Thoughts, Altered Actions: Reasoning Chain as Control Surface for a Vision-Language-Action Policy
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action policies map camera images and natural-language instructions to a robot's motor actions. Some of these policies are designed to reason in text before acting, generating a reasoning chain and decoding actions conditioned on that chain. The works introducing this design offer the reasoning chain as an oversight interface: text a person can read and edit to correct the policy. What an edited reasoning chain does to the policy's motor actions, whether it repairs them or corrupts them, remains an open question. We measure both directions, repair and corruption, with our deterministic entity swap applied to the instruction the policy receives and to the reasoning chain it generates. A forty-task observed backdrop across all four LIBERO simulation suites reveals that the cost of corrupting the reasoning chain concentrates where language alone determines the goal. There, on LIBERO-Goal, we run the decisive counterfactual intervention with DeepThinkVLA, chosen because its reasoning chain is exposed as plain text. The policy receives a corrupted instruction, paired with the reasoning chain it generates when that instruction is clean. This counterfactually correct reasoning chain recovers 47.8 pp of the lost success, our pre-registered confirmatory test. Had the chain merely restated what the camera image already determines, the injection could have changed nothing. Instead, all 10 tasks move in the predicted direction. The reasoning chain is therefore a working control surface: text written into it steers the robot, repairing behaviour when the text is right and corrupting it when the text is wrong. Whether to expose such a control surface is a real deployment tradeoff, and it can now be measured.

TL;DR: VLA 策略的推理链不只是可读的监督界面，而是真正控制动作的控制面：用确定性实体替换污染指令后，在 LIBERO-Goal 上把干净指令下生成的推理链注入回去，可挽回 47.8 个百分点的成功率损失，且全部 10 个任务都朝预测方向移动。作者据此主张，是否向人暴露这条可编辑文本通道是可量化的部署权衡。
Motivation: 先推理后行动的 VLA 策略把推理链当作供人阅读和编辑的监督接口，但编辑这条链究竟修复还是破坏机器人的动作一直没有实证答案。
Method: 提出确定性实体替换 (deterministic entity swap)，同时作用于策略收到的指令和它生成的推理链，双向度量修复与污染；在 LIBERO 四个仿真套件、40 个任务的背景下，于 LIBERO-Goal 上对 DeepThinkVLA 做反事实干预：给策略污染的指令，却配以该指令干净时生成的推理链。
Result: 该反事实正确的推理链挽回了 47.8 个百分点的成功率损失（预注册验证性检验）；污染代价集中在语言单独决定目标的场景，LIBERO-Goal 上全部 10 个任务都朝预测方向移动。
Conclusion: 推理链是一个可用的控制面：写进其中的文本会操纵机器人行为，文本正确则修复、错误则破坏；是否暴露这一控制面是可测量的部署权衡。

papers.title: Reference-Guided Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a model while preserving its general utility. In vision, many approximate unlearning methods pursue this goal through degradation-based heuristics, such as loss maximization or random labeling. Yet making a model worse on forget samples is not the same as making it behave as if those examples had never been seen: these signals can be poorly conditioned, destabilize optimization, and harm generalization. We argue that approximate unlearning should instead prioritize distributional indistinguishability, aligning the model's predictive behavior on forget data with that on truly unseen data. Motivated by this principle, we propose Reference-Guided Unlearning (ReGUn), a vision unlearning framework that uses disjoint held-out data to construct a principled, class-conditioned reference distribution for distillation. Rather than explicitly degrading predictions on forget examples, ReGUn guides them toward non-member behavior through held-out supervision. Across multiple architectures, natural image datasets, and forget fractions, ReGUn achieves a competitive forgetting--utility trade-off relative to standard approximate baselines while closely matching retrain-like membership inference behavior. As one instantiation of this principle, the results suggest that simple objectives designed around indistinguishability can provide an effective alternative to complex degradation-based unlearning procedures.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at three ICLR 2026 workshops: Test-Time Updates (TTU), AI with Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), and Agents in the Wild (AIWILD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReGUn 把近似机器遗忘的目标从「在遗忘样本上把模型搞坏」改为「让模型在遗忘数据上的预测与真正未见过的数据在分布上不可区分」：用不相交的 held-out 数据构造按类别条件化的参考分布，再对模型做蒸馏，把预测推向 non-member 行为。在多种架构、自然图像数据集与遗忘比例上，该方法相对标准近似遗忘基线取得有竞争力的遗忘-效用权衡，且成员推断 (membership inference) 行为接近 retrain。
Motivation: 视觉领域的近似遗忘多依赖 loss maximization、random labeling 等 degradation 启发式，这些信号条件差、会 destabilize 优化并损害泛化；让模型在 forget 样本上变差并不等于表现得像从未见过这些样本。
Method: 提出 Reference-Guided Unlearning (ReGUn)：用 disjoint held-out 数据构造 class-conditioned 参考分布，以蒸馏方式把模型在 forget 数据上的预测对齐到该参考（即 non-member 行为），而非显式压低 forget 样本上的预测；评估覆盖多种架构、自然图像数据集与多个 forget fraction。
Result: 在多个架构、自然图像数据集和遗忘比例上，ReGUn 相对标准近似遗忘基线取得有竞争力的 forgetting–utility 权衡，并在成员推断行为上紧密贴合 retrain 的表现。
Conclusion: 围绕分布不可区分性设计的简单目标，可以作为复杂 degradation-based 遗忘流程的有效替代；近似遗忘应优先对齐 non-member 行为而非刻意劣化 forget 样本。

papers.title: ContactExplorer: Contact Coverage-Guided Exploration for General-Purpose Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning explores effectively in domains such as Atari games, navigation, and locomotion, where novelty over states or dynamics is a sufficient signal. In contrast, dexterous manipulation requires rich physical hand--object interactions, but existing methods often suffer from unstable contact-based novelty signals, inefficient distance novelty signals, or reliance on task-specific priors. We propose ContactExplorer, a general exploration method for dexterous manipulation tasks. ContactExplorer represents contact as the intersection between object surface points and hand keypoints, encouraging dexterous hands to discover diverse and novel contact patterns, namely which fingers contact which object regions. It maintains a contact counter conditioned on discretized object states obtained via learned hash codes. This counter is leveraged in two complementary ways: (1) a count-based contact coverage reward that promotes exploration of novel contact patterns, and (2) an energy-based reaching reward that guides the agent toward under-explored contact regions. We evaluate ContactExplorer on seven contact-rich manipulation tasks and five dexterous hand embodiments. Experimental results show that ContactExplorer substantially improves sample efficiency and success rates over existing exploration methods, that it reduces the need for task-specific priors, and that it remains effective across hand embodiments and transfers to the real world. Project page is https://contact-explorer.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContactExplorer 把灵巧手探索的 novelty 信号从状态/动力学换成接触模式：以物体表面点与手部关键点的交集定义接触，用学习式 hash code 离散化物体状态并维护接触计数器，同时给出计数式接触覆盖奖励与基于能量的到达奖励。在 7 个富接触操作任务、5 种灵巧手 embodiment 上，它显著提升样本效率与成功率，减少对任务先验的依赖，并可迁移到真实世界。
Motivation: 灵巧操作需要丰富的手-物交互，但现有探索方法的接触型 novelty 信号不稳、距离型 novelty 信号低效，或依赖任务特定先验，限制了通用探索。
Method: 将接触表示为物体表面点与手部关键点的交集，鼓励发现新颖的“哪根手指接触哪个物体区域”模式；用学习得到的 hash code 对物体状态离散化并维护条件接触计数器，该计数器同时驱动两项奖励：计数式接触覆盖奖励（鼓励新颖接触模式）与能量式到达奖励（引向欠探索的接触区域）。
Result: 在 7 个富接触操作任务与 5 种灵巧手 embodiment 上的实验显示，ContactExplorer 相比现有探索方法显著提升样本效率与成功率，降低对任务特定先验的需求，并跨 embodiment 有效、可迁移到真实世界。
Conclusion: 以接触模式而非状态新颖性作为探索信号，是灵巧操作中更通用且跨手型可迁移的探索路径，且不必依赖任务特定先验。

papers.title: Evaluating Generative Models via One-Dimensional Code Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Most evaluations of generative models rely on feature-distribution metrics such as FID, which operate on continuous recognition features that are explicitly trained to be invariant to appearance variations, and thus discard cues critical for perceptual quality. We instead evaluate models in the space of discrete visual tokens, where modern 1D image tokenizers compactly encode both semantic and perceptual information and quality manifests as predictable token statistics. We introduce Codebook Histogram Distance (CHD), a training-free distribution metric in token space, and Code Mixture Model Score (CMMS), a no-reference quality metric learned from synthetic degradations of token sequences. To stress-test metrics under broad distribution shifts, we further propose VisForm, a benchmark of 210K images spanning 62 visual forms and 12 generative models with expert annotations. Across AGIQA, HPDv2/3, and VisForm, our token-based metrics achieve state-of-the-art correlation with human judgments. We will release all code and datasets to facilitate future research, with the code publicly available at https://github.com/zexiJia/1d-Distance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在离散视觉 token 空间评估生成模型：提出免训练的 Codebook Histogram Distance (CHD) 与从 token 序列合成退化学习的无参考质量指标 CMMS，并构建含 210K 图像、62 种视觉形态、12 个生成模型与专家标注的 VisForm 基准。在 AGIQA、HPDv2/3 与 VisForm 上，token 级指标与人类判断的相关性达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: FID 等指标依赖连续识别特征，而这些特征被显式训练成对表观变化不变，丢掉了感知质量关键线索，导致生成质量评价与人类判断脱节。
Method: 在 1D 图像 tokenizer 的离散 token 空间操作：CHD 用码本直方图距离度量 token 分布，CMMS 从 token 序列的合成退化中学习无参考质量评分；VisForm 基准覆盖 62 种视觉形态、12 个生成模型并带专家标注，用于在广泛分布偏移下压测指标。
Result: 在 AGIQA、HPDv2/3 与 VisForm 三个评测集上，token 级指标与人类判断的相关性达到 state-of-the-art；VisForm 规模为 210K 图像、62 种视觉形态、12 个生成模型。
Conclusion: 离散视觉 token 的统计量足以承载语义与感知信息，可作为比连续识别特征更贴近人类感知的生成模型评价空间；代码与数据集将全部开源。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic escape from the proto-lunar disk and the origin of the Earth-Moon volatile dichotomy
papers.abstract_en: Volatile elements - those that vaporize at low temperatures - are depleted in lunar rocks relative to terrestrial rocks. This systematic chemical depletion is evidence for vaporization and preferential removal of vapor from proto-lunar materials during the high-temperature processes accompanying lunar origin. Despite the robustness of these observations, the physical processes by which proto-lunar vapors were removed after the giant impact are not yet well-understood. Here, we show that toward the end of post-giant impact cooling history, Earth's atmosphere was dominated by carbon species (e.g., CO) and was spatially compact, behaving as a closed system retaining Earth's volatile inventory, whereas the proto-lunar disk atmosphere was dominated by H and H2 and was spatially extended, developing into a hydrodynamic outflow analogous to the solar wind. We find that equilibrium H2 recombination (2H->H2) in a partially-dissociated disk atmosphere produces a nearly isothermal structure, a feature known to activate outflows. The expected outflow was strong enough to propel proto-lunar volatiles from a Roche-interior (r < 3RE) disk out of Earth's gravity field and to establish a cometary tail composed of volatile elements transporting proto-lunar disk volatiles into interplanetary space. The proposed model suggests that the dichotomy in volatile element abundances between the silicate Earth and Moon is a natural outcome of the hydrodynamical behavior of magma ocean atmospheres and that lunar chemical and isotopic volatile abundances are diagnostic of the radial structure of the proto-lunar disk towards the end of its condensation.

papers.title: COMiT: Learning Structured Visual Tokens through Sequential Communication
papers.abstract_en: Discrete image tokenizers provide a sequential interface for vision and multimodal models, but are typically optimized for reconstruction or compression and therefore tend to encode local appearance rather than object-level structure. We introduce COMiT, a communication-inspired framework for learning structured discrete visual representations. COMiT constructs a fixed-length latent message through sequential visual observations: at each step, a transformer processes a localized image crop and updates, refines, and reorganizes the existing token sequence. After several iterations, the resulting message conditions a flow-matching decoder that reconstructs the complete image. The encoder and decoder are implemented within a single transformer and trained end-to-end using flow-matching reconstruction and semantic representation-alignment objectives. COMiT substantially improves compositional generalization and relational reasoning over prior methods. Our experiments show that, while semantic alignment helps ground the representation, attentive sequential tokenization is critical for inducing more interpretable, object-centric token structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMiT 用通信范式学结构化离散视觉 token：transformer 逐步处理局部图像 crop，就地更新、精炼并重组一条定长 latent message，最后由 flow-matching 解码器重建整图。实验显示语义对齐有助于锚定表示，而带注意力的序列化 token 化才是产生可解释、以物体为中心的 token 结构的关键，并在组合泛化与关系推理上明显优于既有方法。
Motivation: 离散图像 tokenizer 通常按重建或压缩目标优化，倾向于编码局部外观而非物体级结构，难以支撑组合泛化与关系推理。
Method: 编码器在每步用 transformer 处理一个局部 crop，对既有 token 序列做更新、精炼与重组，迭代若干次得到定长 message；该 message 条件化 flow-matching 解码器重建完整图像。编码与解码实现在同一个 transformer 内，以 flow-matching 重建损失与语义表示对齐 (semantic representation-alignment) 目标端到端联合训练。
Result: 在组合泛化与关系推理上较既有方法有大幅提升；消融显示语义对齐帮助锚定表示，而 attentive sequential tokenization 对诱导更可解释、以物体为中心的 token 结构是关键因素。
Conclusion: 结构化离散视觉表示应通过序列通信而非单次重建压缩来获得：物体级 token 结构主要来自带注意力的逐步 token 化，语义对齐起辅助锚定作用。

papers.title: Agentic AI for Scalable and Robust Optical Systems Control
papers.abstract_en: We present AgentOptics, an agentic AI framework for high-fidelity, autonomous optical system control built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). AgentOptics interprets natural language tasks and executes protocol-compliant actions on heterogeneous optical devices through a structured tool abstraction layer. We implement 64 standardized MCP tools across 8 representative optical devices and construct a 410-task benchmark to evaluate request understanding, role-aware responses, multi-step coordination, robustness to linguistic variation, and error handling. We assess two deployment configurations--commercial online LLMs and locally hosted open-source LLMs--and compare them with LLM-based code generation baselines. AgentOptics achieves 87.7%--99.0% average task success rates, significantly outperforming code-generation approaches, which reach up to 50% success. We further demonstrate broader applicability through five case studies extending beyond device-level control to system orchestration, monitoring, and closed-loop optimization. These include DWDM link provisioning and coordinated monitoring of coherent 400 GbE and analog radio-over-fiber (ARoF) channels; autonomous characterization and bias optimization of a wideband ARoF link carrying 5G fronthaul traffic; multi-span channel provisioning with launch power optimization; closed-loop fiber polarization stabilization; and distributed acoustic sensing (DAS)-based fiber monitoring with LLM-assisted event detection. These results establish AgentOptics as a scalable, robust paradigm for autonomous control and orchestration of heterogeneous optical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentOptics 是基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的智能体框架，把自然语言任务映射为对异构光学设备的协议合规操作，用 64 个标准化 MCP 工具覆盖 8 类代表性光学器件。在 410 任务基准上平均任务成功率 87.7%–99.0%，而基于 LLM 的代码生成基线最高仅 50%。
Motivation: 光学系统控制依赖人工编写设备脚本与逐台调试，跨异构设备的多步协调、语言表述变化和错误恢复难以自动化，缺少可量化的评测基准。
Method: 通过结构化工具抽象层将自然语言任务解析为协议合规动作，实现 64 个标准化 MCP 工具与 8 类光学设备对接；构建 410 任务基准，评测请求理解、角色感知响应、多步协调、语言变体鲁棒性与错误处理，并对比商业在线 LLM、本地开源 LLM 两种部署配置与 LLM 代码生成基线。
Result: AgentOptics 平均任务成功率 87.7%–99.0%，显著高于代码生成方法（最高 50%）；另以五个案例展示设备级之外的系统编排能力：DWDM 链路配置与相干 400 GbE 及模拟 radio-over-fiber (ARoF) 协同监测、承载 5G fronthaul 的宽带 ARoF 链路自主表征与偏置优化、多跨段信道配置与入纤功率优化、闭环光纤偏振稳定、以及基于分布式声学传感 (DAS) 的光纤监测与 LLM 辅助事件检测。
Conclusion: 以 MCP 工具抽象加智能体编排的范式可扩展、稳健地控制与编排异构光学系统，任务成功率远超让 LLM 直接生成代码的路线。

papers.title: Evaluating Test-Time Scaling of General LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly expected to operate as general-purpose systems that resolve real-world user requests, yet their dynamic scaling behavior in realistic environments remains poorly understood. In this paper, we systematically investigate two principal test-time scaling axes of LLM agents: sequential scaling through extended interaction and parallel scaling through trajectory sampling. We first introduce a realistic benchmark that provides one unified framework for evaluating LLM agents across search, coding, reasoning, and tool-use domains, more faithfully reflecting the heterogeneity of real-world deployments. Evaluating ten leading LLM agents reveals substantial performance degradation when transitioning from domain-specific evaluations to this realistic setting. Building on this foundation, we progressively scale test-time compute along fine-grained increments to characterize the performance upper bound. We find that neither scaling axis can consistently yield meaningful gains from additional test-time compute in realistic environments, a phenomenon we attribute to two fundamental limitations: the scaling plateau that bottlenecks sequential scaling and the verification gap that undermines parallel scaling. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/cxcscmu/General-AgentBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在覆盖 search、coding、reasoning、tool-use 的统一真实感基准上评测十个领先 LLM agent，发现从领域专用评测切到真实设置后性能大幅下降；沿顺序扩展（延长交互）与并行扩展（轨迹采样）两条轴逐步加算力，两条轴都无法稳定换来有意义的增益，作者归因于限制顺序扩展的 scaling plateau 与破坏并行扩展的 verification gap。
Motivation: LLM agent 作为通用系统处理真实用户请求时的动态扩展行为缺乏系统认知：领域专用评测无法反映真实部署的异构性，额外测试时算力是否有效并不清楚。
Method: 提出统一评测框架 General-AgentBench，跨 search、coding、reasoning、tool-use 四域评估 LLM agent；先评十个领先 agent，再沿细粒度增量逐步扩展测试时算力以刻画性能上界，区分顺序扩展（extended interaction）与并行扩展（trajectory sampling）两条轴。
Result: 十个领先 LLM agent 从领域专用评测迁移到真实设置时出现显著性能下降；沿两条测试时扩展轴逐步加算力均无法持续获得有意义的增益，瓶颈分别为 scaling plateau 与 verification gap。
Conclusion: 在真实环境中，测试时算力的顺序与并行扩展都存在根本性上限：前者被 scaling plateau 卡住，后者被 verification gap 削弱，单纯加算力不是通用 agent 的可靠改进路径。

papers.title: Robo-Saber: Generating and Simulating Virtual Reality Players
papers.abstract_en: We present the first motion generation system for playtesting virtual reality (VR) games. Our player model generates VR headset and handheld controller movements from in-game object arrangements, guided by style exemplars and aligned to maximize simulated gameplay score. We train on the large BOXRR-23 dataset and apply our framework on the popular VR game Beat Saber. The resulting model Robo-Saber produces skilled gameplay and captures diverse player behaviors, mirroring the skill levels and movement patterns specified by input style exemplars. Robo-Saber demonstrates promise in synthesizing rich gameplay data for predictive applications and enabling a physics-based whole-body VR playtesting agent.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 15 figures. Accepted to Eurographics 2026. Project page: https://robo-saber.github.io/
papers.journal_ref: Computer Graphics Forum 45(2), e70353 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Robo-Saber 是首个用于 VR 游戏 playtesting 的动作生成系统：由游戏内物体布局生成头显与手柄控制器运动，用风格范例引导并以模拟游戏得分对齐优化。在大型数据集 BOXRR-23 上训练并应用于 Beat Saber，模型能产出熟练操作并复现输入风格范例指定的技能水平与运动模式。
Motivation: VR 游戏的自动化 playtesting 缺少能生成真实玩家动作的模型：需要从游戏内物体布局出发，产出既像真人风格、又能实际打通关的头显与手柄运动。
Method: 以游戏内物体布局为条件生成 VR 头显与手持控制器运动，用风格范例 (style exemplars) 引导行为多样性，并以最大化模拟游戏得分 (simulated gameplay score) 做对齐优化；在 BOXRR-23 数据集上训练，应用到 Beat Saber。
Result: 在 BOXRR-23 上训练的 Robo-Saber 于 Beat Saber 产出熟练 gameplay，并捕捉多样玩家行为，镜像输入风格范例指定的技能水平与运动模式；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 物理驱动的全身 VR playtesting agent 可以靠风格范例加得分对齐的动作生成来合成丰富 gameplay 数据，供预测类应用使用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FloCA: Towards Faithful and Logically Consistent Flowchart Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Flowchart-oriented dialogue (FOD) systems aim to guide users through multi-turn decision-making or operational procedures by following a domain-specific flowchart to achieve a task goal. In this work, we formalize flowchart reasoning in FOD as grounding user input to flowchart nodes at each dialogue turn while ensuring node transition is consistent with the correct flowchart path. Despite recent advances of LLMs in task-oriented dialogue systems, adapting them to FOD still faces two limitations: (1) LLMs lack an explicit mechanism to represent and reason over flowchart topology, and (2) they are prone to hallucinations, leading to unfaithful flowchart reasoning. To address these limitations, we propose FloCA, a zero-shot flowchart-oriented conversational agent. FloCA uses an LLM for intent understanding and response generation, while delegating flowchart reasoning to an external tool that performs topology-constrained graph execution, ensuring faithful and logically consistent node transitions across dialogue turns. We further introduce an evaluation framework with an LLM-based user simulator and five new metrics covering reasoning accuracy and interaction efficiency. Extensive experiments on FLODIAL and PFDial datasets highlight the bottlenecks of existing LLM/VLM-based methods and demonstrate the superiority of FloCA. The code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/Jinzi-Zou/FloCA-flowchart-reasoning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FloCA 把流程图对话 (FOD) 中的流程图推理从 LLM 中剥离，交给执行拓扑约束图遍历的外部工具，LLM 只做意图理解与回复生成，从而零样本保证节点转移与正确路径一致。在 FLODIAL 与 PFDial 上的实验配合新提出的 LLM 用户模拟器与五项指标，显示现有 LLM/VLM 方法存在推理瓶颈而 FloCA 更优。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的流程图导向对话缺少显式表示流程图拓扑的机制，且易产生幻觉，导致节点转移偏离正确路径、推理不忠实。
Method: 提出零样本对话代理 FloCA：LLM 负责意图理解与回复生成，流程图推理外包给执行拓扑约束图执行 (topology-constrained graph execution) 的外部工具；并构建含 LLM 用户模拟器的评测框架，覆盖推理准确性与交互效率共五项新指标。
Result: 在 FLODIAL 与 PFDial 两个数据集上的大量实验揭示了现有 LLM/VLM 方法的瓶颈，并展示 FloCA 的优势；评测使用新提出的五项指标，代码与数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 把流程图拓扑推理交给受约束的外部执行器而非让 LLM 自由生成，是实现忠实且逻辑一致的流程图对话的可行路径。
