papers.title: Nonmonotone subgradient methods based on a local descent lemma
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we present a nonmonotone line search subgradient algorithm tailored to upper-$\mathcal{C}^2$ functions. This is a family of nonsmooth and nonconvex functions that satisfies a nonsmooth and local version of the descent lemma, making them suitable for line searches. We prove subsequential convergence of the proposed algorithm to a stationary point of the optimization problem. Our approach allows us to cover the setting of various subgradient algorithms, including Newton and quasi-Newton methods. In addition, we propose a specification of the general scheme, named Self-adaptive Nonmonotone Subgradient Method (SNSM), which automatically updates the parameters of the line search. Particular attention is paid to the minimum sum-of-squares clustering problem, for which we provide a concrete implementation of SNSM. We conclude with some numerical experiments where we exhibit the advantages of SNSM in comparison with some known algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 upper-C² 函数的非单调线搜索次梯度算法，利用该函数族满足的非光滑局部 descent lemma 做线搜索，并证明迭代子列收敛到稳定点；其特例 SNSM 自动更新线搜索参数，在最小平方和聚类问题上给出具体实现，数值实验显示其优于若干已知算法。
Motivation: 非光滑非凸优化中，一般函数缺少可用的 descent lemma，线搜索参数需人工调，Newton/quasi-Newton 类次梯度法难以统一处理。
Method: 针对满足非光滑局部 descent lemma 的 upper-C² 函数族设计非单调线搜索次梯度框架，覆盖 Newton 与 quasi-Newton 等多种次梯度算法；再给出自动更新线搜索参数的特例 SNSM，并为最小平方和聚类问题 (minimum sum-of-squares clustering) 实现具体版本。
Result: 证明所提算法的子序列收敛到优化问题的稳定点；在最小平方和聚类问题上给出 SNSM 的具体实现，数值实验展示 SNSM 相对若干已知算法的优势（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: upper-C² 函数的局部 descent lemma 足以支撑非单调线搜索并保证收敛到稳定点，自适应参数更新的 SNSM 在聚类问题上表现出实际优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Constructive Distortion: Improving MLLMs with Attention-Guided Image Warping
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss small details and spatial relations in cluttered scenes, leading to errors in fine-grained perceptual grounding. We introduce AttWarp, a lightweight method that allocates more resolution to query-relevant content while compressing less informative areas, all while preserving global context. At test time, the approach uses an MLLM's cross-modal attention to perform rectilinear warping of the input image, reallocating spatial resolution toward regions the model deems important, without changing model weights or architecture. This attention-guided warping preserves all original image information but redistributes it non-uniformly, so small objects and subtle relationships become easier for the same model to read while the global layout remains intact. Across five benchmarks (TextVQA, GQA, DocVQA, POPE, MMMU) and four MLLMs (LLaVA, Qwen-VL, InternVL, and InstructBLIP), AttWarp consistently improves accuracy, strengthens compositional reasoning, and reduces hallucinations, outperforming four competitive baselines that manipulate raw images at test time. Together, these results show that attention-guided warping prioritizes information relevant to the query while preserving context, and that the same MLLMs perform better when given such warped inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AttWarp 在测试时用 MLLM 自身的跨模态注意力对输入图像做直线变换 (rectilinear warping)，把空间分辨率重新分配到与查询相关的区域、压缩无关部分，且不改模型权重与结构。在 TextVQA、GQA、DocVQA、POPE、MMMU 五个基准与 LLaVA、Qwen-VL、InternVL、InstructBLIP 四个 MLLM 上一致提升准确率、组合推理与抗幻觉表现，超过四个同样在测试时操作原图的基线。
Motivation: MLLM 在杂乱场景中容易漏掉小目标与细粒度空间关系，导致视觉 grounding 出错；根因是固定分辨率下查询相关区域分到的像素太少。
Method: 测试时读取 MLLM 的跨模态注意力，据此对输入图像做 rectilinear warping，非均匀重分配空间分辨率，保留全部原始信息与全局布局；不修改权重或架构，属于免训练的测试时图像操作。
Result: 在五个基准（TextVQA、GQA、DocVQA、POPE、MMMU）× 四个 MLLM（LLaVA、Qwen-VL、InternVL、InstructBLIP）上一致提升准确率，增强组合推理并减少幻觉，优于四个竞争性的测试时原图操作基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 同一 MLLM 在获得按查询定向 warp 的输入后表现更好，说明注意力引导的分辨率再分配是免训练提升细粒度感知 grounding 的有效路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Sequence Variables: A Constraint Programming Computational Domain for Routing and Sequencing
papers.abstract_en: Constraint Programming (CP) offers an intuitive, declarative framework for modeling Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP). While classical successor-based CP models can be adapted to handle optional visits or insertion-based heuristics, sequence variables provide a significantly more natural and elegant formulation for these requirements. Building upon our prior work that introduced the initial concept, the main contribution of this article is the complete semantic and operational formalization of sequence variables as a computational domain. Specifically, we formally define the sequence domain and its update operations, and detail the implementation and data structures required to integrate sequence variables into trail-based CP solvers. Furthermore, we introduce consistency levels for associated constraints on this domain alongside specialized global constraints tailored for routing problems. Finally, we demonstrate that sequence variables simplify problem modeling while achieving competitive computational performance on Pickup and Delivery Problems with and without Time Windows, the Dial-a-Ride Problem, and a Prize-Collecting Scheduling Problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 sequence variables 形式化为约束规划 (CP) 的一个计算域：给出域定义与更新操作、在 trail-based CP solver 中的实现与数据结构、配套约束的一致性级别，以及面向路径问题的专用全局约束。在带/不带时间窗的 Pickup and Delivery Problem、Dial-a-Ride Problem 和 Prize-Collecting Scheduling Problem 上，建模更简洁且计算性能有竞争力。
Motivation: 经典 successor-based CP 模型处理可选访问或插入式启发式时表达别扭，需要一个更自然的序列表述；此前只有概念提出，缺少完整的语义与操作层面的形式化。
Method: 形式定义 sequence 域及其更新操作，说明将其集成进 trail-based CP solver 所需的实现与数据结构；为该域上的约束引入一致性级别 (consistency levels)，并设计面向路径问题的专用全局约束。
Result: 在 PDP（含/不含时间窗）、Dial-a-Ride Problem 与 Prize-Collecting Scheduling Problem 上，sequence variables 简化问题建模，同时达到有竞争力的计算性能。
Conclusion: sequence variables 可作为 CP 中与 successor 表述并列的正式计算域，用更自然的建模换取不损失的求解性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning as Mutual Information Maximization
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised representation learning (SSRL) has demonstrated remarkable empirical success, yet its underlying principles remain insufficiently understood. While recent works attempt to unify SSRL methods by examining their information-theoretic objectives or summarizing their heuristics for preventing representation collapse, architectural elements like predictor networks, stop-gradient operations, and statistical regularizers are often viewed as empirically motivated additions. In this paper, we adopt a first-principles approach and investigate whether the learning objective of an SSRL algorithm dictates its possible optimization strategies and model design choices. In particular, by starting from a variational mutual information (MI) lower bound, we derive two training paradigms, namely Self-Distillation MI (SDMI) and Joint MI (JMI), each imposing distinct structural constraints and covering a set of existing SSRL algorithms. SDMI relies on alternating optimization, in which stop-gradient operations serve as a principled mechanism for realizing the alternating updates. In contrast, JMI admits joint optimization through symmetric architectures without such components. Under the proposed formulation, predictor networks in SDMI and statistical regularizers in JMI emerge as tractable surrogates for the MI objective. We show that many existing SSRL methods are specific instances or approximations of these two paradigms. This paper provides a theoretical explanation for the choices of different architectural components of existing SSRL methods, going beyond heuristic conveniences.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 09/2026. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=hlNAYdhUi6
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从变分互信息 (MI) 下界出发推导出自监督表征学习的两种训练范式：Self-Distillation MI (SDMI) 走交替优化、stop-gradient 是实现交替更新的原则性机制，Joint MI (JMI) 则用对称架构做联合优化而无需此类组件。SDMI 中的 predictor network 与 JMI 中的统计正则项分别是 MI 目标的可处理代理，许多现有 SSRL 方法是这两种范式的特例或近似。
Motivation: 自监督表征学习经验上成功但原理不清，现有统一视角只梳理信息论目标或防坍缩启发式，predictor、stop-gradient、统计正则等结构常被当作经验性附加。
Method: 从变分 MI 下界这一第一性原理出发推导，得到 SDMI 与 JMI 两种范式，各自施加不同的结构约束；再把现有 SSRL 算法归入这两类，说明其架构组件是 MI 目标的代理。
Result: 给出理论解释而非实验数字：SDMI 的交替优化使 stop-gradient 成为有原则的机制，JMI 的对称架构允许联合优化；predictor networks (SDMI) 与 statistical regularizers (JMI) 被证明是 MI 目标的 tractable surrogates，许多既有 SSRL 方法是两范式的实例或近似。
Conclusion: 现有 SSRL 方法的架构选择可由学习目标本身推导出来，是 MI 目标在不同结构约束下的必然结果，而非启发式便利。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 从变分互信息 (MI) 下界出发推导出自监督表征学习的两种训练范式：Self-Distillation MI (SDMI) 走交替优化、stop-gradient 是实现交替更新的原则性机制，Joint MI (JMI) 则用对称架构做联合优化而无需此类组件。SDMI 中的 predictor network 与 JMI 中的统计正则项分别是 MI 目标的可处理代理，许多现有 SSRL 方法是这两种范式的特例或近似。

summary_sections.method: 从变分 MI 下界这一第一性原理出发推导，得到 SDMI 与 JMI 两种范式，各自施加不同的结构约束；再把现有 SSRL 算法归入这两类，说明其架构组件是 MI 目标的代理。
summary_sections.result: 给出理论解释而非实验数字：SDMI 的交替优化使 stop-gradient 成为有原则的机制，JMI 的对称架构允许联合优化；predictor networks (SDMI) 与 statistical regularizers (JMI) 被证明是 MI 目标的 tractable surrogates，许多既有 SSRL 方法是两范式的实例或近似。
summary_sections.conclusion: 现有 SSRL 方法的架构选择可由学习目标本身推导出来，是 MI 目标在不同结构约束下的必然结果，而非启发式便利。

papers.title: CPATTA: Conformal Supervision Allocation For Active Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Active Test-Time Adaptation (ATTA) improves model robustness under domain shift by selectively querying human annotations at deployment, but existing methods use heuristic uncertainty measures and suffer from low data selection efficiency, wasting human annotation budget. We propose Conformal Prediction Active TTA (CPATTA), which first brings principled, conformal uncertainty with coverage-aware online calibration into ATTA. CPATTA employs smoothed conformal scores with a top-$K$ certainty measure, an online weight-update algorithm driven by pseudo coverage, a domain-shift detector that adapts human supervision, and a staged update scheme that balances human-labeled and model-labeled data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CPATTA consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art ATTA methods by around 5% in accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CPATTA 把带覆盖率保证的 conformal 不确定性引入主动测试时适应 (ATTA)，用平滑 conformal 分数加 top-K 确定性度量挑选查询样本，并由伪覆盖率驱动的在线权重更新、域偏移检测器和分阶段更新方案共同分配人工标注预算。在实验中其准确率比现有 SOTA ATTA 方法高约 5%。
Motivation: 现有 ATTA 依赖启发式不确定性度量，样本选择效率低，浪费部署期的人工标注预算。
Method: CPATTA 用 smoothed conformal scores 配合 top-K certainty 度量替代启发式不确定性；在线权重更新由 pseudo coverage 驱动，domain-shift detector 决定何时追加人工监督，staged update scheme 平衡人工标注与模型伪标注数据。
Result: 实验显示 CPATTA 一致优于 SOTA ATTA 方法，准确率提升约 5%。
Conclusion: 把 conformal 预测的覆盖率感知校准放进主动测试时适应，可以更省标注预算地提升域偏移下的部署期准确率。

papers.title: Hybrid Approach for Enhancing Lesion Segmentation in Fundus Images
papers.abstract_en: Choroidal nevi are common benign pigmented lesions in the eye, with a small risk of transforming into melanoma. Early detection is critical to improving survival rates, but misdiagnosis or delayed diagnosis can lead to poor outcomes. Despite advancements in AI-based image analysis, diagnosing choroidal nevi in colour fundus images remains challenging, particularly for clinicians without specialized expertise. Existing datasets often suffer from low resolution and inconsistent labelling, limiting the effectiveness of segmentation models. This paper addresses the challenge of achieving precise segmentation of fundus lesions, a critical step toward developing robust diagnostic tools. While deep learning models like U-Net have demonstrated effectiveness, their accuracy heavily depends on the quality and quantity of annotated data. Previous mathematical/clustering segmentation methods, though accurate, required extensive human input, making them impractical for medical applications. This paper proposes a novel approach that combines mathematical/clustering segmentation models with insights from U-Net, leveraging the strengths of both methods. This hybrid model improves accuracy, reduces the need for large-scale training data, and achieves significant performance gains on high-resolution fundus images. The proposed model achieves a Dice coefficient of 89.7% and an IoU of 80.01% on 1024*1024 fundus images, outperforming the Attention U-Net model, which achieved 51.3% and 34.2%, respectively. It also demonstrated better generalizability on external datasets. This work forms a part of a broader effort to develop a decision support system for choroidal nevus diagnosis, with potential applications in automated lesion annotation to enhance the speed and accuracy of diagnosis and monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把数学/聚类分割与 U-Net 结合的混合模型用于眼底彩色图像中的脉络膜痣 (choroidal nevi) 分割，在 1024×1024 分辨率上 Dice 达 89.7%、IoU 80.01%，而 Attention U-Net 基线只有 51.3% 和 34.2%，且在外部数据集上泛化更好。作者称该方法减少了对大规模标注训练数据的依赖。
Motivation: 眼底痣分割受限于数据集低分辨率与标注不一致，纯深度模型依赖标注数量与质量，而传统数学/聚类方法又需要大量人工输入，难以用于临床。
Method: 提出混合模型：将数学/聚类分割模型与 U-Net 的设计思路结合，兼顾两者的精度与数据效率，在高分辨率 (1024×1024) 彩色眼底图像上做病灶分割，并与 Attention U-Net 对比。
Result: 在 1024×1024 眼底图像上 Dice coefficient 89.7%、IoU 80.01%，对比 Attention U-Net 的 51.3% 与 34.2%；在外部数据集上展示了更好的泛化性。
Conclusion: 数学/聚类方法与 U-Net 结合可在高分辨率眼底图像上大幅提升分割精度并降低对大规模标注的依赖，是迈向脉络膜痣诊断决策支持系统的分割基础。

papers.title: Adversarial Defense in Cybersecurity: A Systematic Review of GANs for Threat Detection and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based cybersecurity systems are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, while Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) act as both powerful attack enablers and promising defenses. This survey systematically reviews GAN-based adversarial defenses in cybersecurity (2021--August 31, 2025), consolidating recent progress, identifying gaps, and outlining future directions. Using a PRISMA-compliant systematic literature review protocol, we searched five major digital libraries. From 829 initial records, 185 peer-reviewed studies were retained and synthesized through quantitative trend analysis and thematic taxonomy development. We introduce a four-dimensional taxonomy spanning defensive function, GAN architecture, cybersecurity domain, and adversarial threat model. GANs improve detection accuracy, robustness, and data utility across network intrusion detection, malware analysis, and IoT security. Notable advances include WGAN-GP for stable training, CGANs for targeted synthesis, and hybrid GAN models for improved resilience. Yet, persistent challenges remain such as instability in training, lack of standardized benchmarks, high computational cost, and limited explainability. GAN-based defenses demonstrate strong potential but require advances in stable architectures, benchmarking, transparency, and deployment. We propose a roadmap emphasizing hybrid models, unified evaluation, real-world integration, and defenses against emerging threats such as LLM-driven cyberattacks. This survey establishes the foundation for scalable, trustworthy, and adaptive GAN-powered defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇用 PRISMA 协议做的系统综述，覆盖 2021 至 2025 年 8 月 31 日的 GAN 对抗防御研究：从五个数字图书馆的 829 条记录中筛出 185 篇同行评议文献，按防御功能、GAN 架构、网络安全领域、威胁模型四个维度建立分类法。结论是 GAN 能提升入侵检测、恶意软件与 IoT 安全的检测准确率与鲁棒性，但训练不稳定、缺乏统一基准、算力开销大和可解释性差仍是落地瓶颈。
Motivation: 机器学习驱动的网络安全系统本身易受对抗攻击，而 GAN 既是攻击使能器又是防御手段，该领域进展分散、缺少统一分类与基准，需要系统梳理。
Method: 采用 PRISMA 合规的系统综述协议，检索五个主要数字图书馆，对 829 条初始记录做筛选后保留 185 篇同行评议研究，进行定量趋势分析与主题分类，构建覆盖防御功能、GAN 架构、网络安全领域、对抗威胁模型的四维分类法。
Result: 综述覆盖 2021 至 2025 年 8 月 31 日，检索 829 条记录、纳入 185 篇文献，全文 36 页含 10 个表与 4 幅图；归纳出的代表性进展包括 WGAN-GP 稳定训练、CGAN 定向合成、混合 GAN 提升韧性，指出的持续问题为训练不稳定、缺乏标准化基准、高计算成本与可解释性有限。
Conclusion: GAN 类防御在检测准确率、鲁棒性与数据效用上潜力明确，但要走向可扩展可信部署，需先在稳定架构、统一评测、透明性与真实系统集成上取得进展，作者给出的路线图强调混合模型、统一评估与针对 LLM 驱动攻击的防御。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Geometrically Constrained and Token-Based Probabilistic Spatial Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transformations such as rotation and scale obscure the morphological cues needed for accurate image classification. Careful consideration is required for reliable use in high stakes settings. A model should stay robust under such transformations, expose why a correction was applied, and signal when its input is ambiguous. While geometrically equivariant architectures provide a mathematically grounded solution, they often limit model flexibility through strict symmetry constraints and incur significant computational overhead. Spatial Transformer Networks (STNs) offer a data-driven, flexible alternative for learning pseudo-equivariances to affine transformations. However, STNs have historically been restricted to convolutional architectures and suffer from training instability. To address this, we introduce a novel STN framework. It leverages the global modeling capabilities of transformers to regress the affine transformation acting on the input. For this, we decompose affine transformations into interpretable primitives, regressed under adaptable geometric constraints, thereby preventing the training instability typically caused by degenerate transformations. By sharing weights between the localization network and the classification backbone, the framework requires minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on challenging insect biodiversity and medical imaging benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior predictive performance under diverse spatial transformations while maintaining high efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/johSchm/TokenSTN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TokenSTN：用 transformer 全局建模回归作用于输入的 affine 变换，把 affine 分解为可解释的几何基元并在可调几何约束下回归，同时让定位网络与分类 backbone 共享权重。约束阻止了退化变换导致的训练不稳定，在昆虫多样性与医学影像基准上于多种空间变换下取得更优预测性能且开销很小。
Motivation: 旋转、缩放等空间变换会掩盖图像分类所需的形态学线索；几何等变架构虽有数学保证但对称约束过严、计算开销大，传统 STN 又局限于卷积架构并有训练不稳定问题。
Method: TokenSTN 框架：用 transformer 的全局建模能力回归作用在输入上的 affine 变换，将其分解为可解释的基元，在可调几何约束 (adaptable geometric constraints) 下回归以避免退化变换引起的训练不稳定；定位网络与分类 backbone 共享权重以压低计算开销。
Result: 在具有挑战性的昆虫多样性与医学影像基准上，于多样空间变换下取得 superior predictive performance，同时保持高效率；摘要给出的定性结论为训练稳定性问题被几何约束缓解、开销极小。
Conclusion: 把 affine 变换拆成受约束的可解释基元并由 transformer 回归，可以让 STN 摆脱卷积架构限制与训练不稳定，在保持低开销的同时提升变换下的分类鲁棒性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Achieving detailed medial temporal lobe segmentation with upsampled isotropic training from implicit neural representation
papers.abstract_en: Imaging biomarkers in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are important tools for diagnosing, tracking and treating Alzheimer's disease (AD). Neurofibrillary tau pathology in AD is closely linked to neurodegeneration and generally follows a pattern of spread in the brain, with early stages involving subregions of the medial temporal lobe (MTL). Accurate segmentation of MTL subregions is needed to extract granular biomarkers of AD progression. MTL subregions are often imaged using T2-weighted (T2w) MRI scans that are highly anisotropic due to constraints of MRI physics and image acquisition, making it difficult to reliably model MTL subregions geometrically and extract morphological measures, such as thickness. In this study, we propose a segmentation framework for MTL subregions in isotropic space, in which an implicit neural representation is used to construct the isotropic training atlas from the anisotropic low-resolution T2w data, with T1w MRI as an auxiliary modality to support the INR and segmentation. In an independent test set, the morphological measures extracted using this isotropic model showed stronger effect sizes than those from models trained on anisotropic data in distinguishing participants with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) from cognitively unimpaired individuals. In the test-retest analysis, the morphological measures extracted using the isotropic model showed greater stability than those from the anisotropic segmentation. This study demonstrates improved reliability of MRI-derived MTL subregion biomarkers without additional atlas annotation effort, which may more accurately quantify and track the relationship between AD pathology and brain atrophy for monitoring disease progression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在各向同性空间做内侧颞叶 (MTL) 亚区分割的框架：用 implicit neural representation (INR) 从各向异性低分辨率 T2w 数据构建各向同性训练 atlas，并以 T1w 作辅助模态。独立测试集上，该各向同性模型提取的形态学测量区分 MCI 与认知正常者的效应量强于各向异性数据训练的模型，test-retest 稳定性也更高。
Motivation: MTL 亚区依赖 T2w MRI，而受 MRI 物理与采集限制该序列高度各向异性，难以可靠建模几何结构并提取厚度等形态学测量，而这些测量是 AD 进展的细粒度影像生物标志物。
Method: 在各向同性空间构建分割框架：以 implicit neural representation 从各向异性低分辨率 T2w 数据生成各向同性训练 atlas，T1w MRI 作为辅助模态同时支撑 INR 与分割，无需额外 atlas 标注工作。
Result: 在独立测试集上，各向同性模型提取的形态学测量在区分 mild cognitive impairment (MCI) 与认知正常个体时效应量强于各向异性数据训练的模型；test-retest 分析中其测量稳定性也高于各向异性分割结果。
Conclusion: 无需追加 atlas 标注即可提升 MRI 派生 MTL 亚区生物标志物的可靠性，从而更准确地量化与追踪 AD 病理同脑萎缩的关系，用于疾病进展监测。

papers.title: MCPTox: A Benchmark for Tool Poisoning Attack on Real-World MCP Servers
papers.abstract_en: By providing a standardized interface for LLM agents to interact with external tools, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is quickly becoming a cornerstone of the modern autonomous agent ecosystem. However, it creates novel attack surfaces due to untrusted external tools. While prior work has focused on attacks injected through external tool outputs, we investigate a more fundamental vulnerability: Tool Poisoning, where malicious instructions are embedded within a tool's metadata without execution. To date, this threat has been primarily demonstrated through isolated cases, lacking a systematic, large-scale evaluation. We introduce MCPTox, the first benchmark to systematically evaluate agent robustness against Tool Poisoning in realistic MCP settings. MCPTox is constructed upon 45 live, real-world MCP servers and 353 authentic tools. To achieve this, we design three distinct attack templates to generate a comprehensive suite of 1348 malicious test cases by few-shot learning, covering 10 categories of potential risks. Our evaluation on 20 prominent LLM agents setting reveals a widespread vulnerability to Tool Poisoning, with o1-mini, achieving an attack success rate of 72.8\%. We find that more capable models are often more susceptible, as the attack exploits their superior instruction-following abilities. Finally, the failure case analysis reveals that agents rarely refuse these attacks, with the highest refused rate (Claude-3.7-Sonnet) less than 3\%, demonstrating that existing safety alignment is ineffective against malicious actions that use legitimate tools for unauthorized operation. Our findings create a crucial empirical baseline for understanding and mitigating this widespread threat, and we release MCPTox for the development of verifiably safer AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MCPTox 是首个系统评估 LLM agent 对 MCP 工具元数据投毒 (Tool Poisoning) 鲁棒性的基准：在 45 个真实 MCP 服务器、353 个工具上，用 3 类攻击模板经 few-shot 生成 1348 条恶意用例，覆盖 10 类风险。对 20 个主流 agent 的评测显示攻击普遍成功，o1-mini 攻击成功率 72.8%，且能力越强的模型越易中招；拒绝率最高的 Claude-3.7-Sonnet 也不足 3%。
Motivation: 此前工具投毒只以孤立案例演示，缺少系统性大规模评测；而 MCP 作为 LLM agent 调用外部工具的标准接口，其不可信工具元数据带来了无需执行即可注入恶意指令的新攻击面。
Method: 基于 45 个在线真实 MCP 服务器的 353 个工具，设计 3 种不同攻击模板，通过 few-shot learning 生成 1348 条恶意测试用例，覆盖 10 类潜在风险；在 20 个知名 LLM agent 上评测并做失败案例分析。
Result: 20 个 LLM agent 普遍易受工具投毒影响，o1-mini 攻击成功率 (ASR) 达 72.8%；能力更强的模型往往更易受攻击，因为攻击利用了其更强的指令遵循能力；agent 极少拒绝此类攻击，拒绝率最高的 Claude-3.7-Sonnet 也不足 3%。
Conclusion: 现有安全对齐无法防御借合法工具做未授权操作的投毒攻击，能力越强反而越脆弱；MCPTox 作为经验基线公开发布，用于开发可验证更安全的 AI agent。

papers.title: Mitigating Cross-Image Information Leakage in Multi-Image Understanding with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong performance on single-image tasks. However, their performance degrades significantly when handling multi-image inputs. While this degradation has been observed in prior work, its nature remains poorly understood. We empirically observe visual elements from different images become entangled in the model's representations and responses. We refer to this phenomenon as cross-image information leakage. To address this issue, we propose FOCUS, a training-free and architecture-agnostic method. FOCUS masks all but one image with random noise, guiding the model to focus on the single clean image. This process is applied across the target images to obtain logits under partially masked contexts. These logits are aggregated and then refined using a noise-only reference input, which suppresses the leakage and yields more accurate outputs. FOCUS consistently improves performance on diverse multi-image benchmarks. We further show that FOCUS generalizes to video understanding, extending its applicability beyond static multi-image inputs. This demonstrates that FOCUS offers a general solution for enhancing multi-image reasoning without additional training or architectural modifications.
papers.comment: AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main. Source code is available at https://github.com/yejipark-m/FOCUS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FOCUS 用随机噪声遮蔽除一张以外的全部图像，分别在部分遮蔽上下文下取 logits，再用纯噪声参考输入做细化，抑制 LVLM 多图输入中的跨图信息泄漏 (cross-image information leakage)。该方法免训练、架构无关，在多个多图基准上一致提升性能，并可推广到视频理解。
Motivation: LVLM 单图表现强但多图输入时性能显著下降，此前工作只观察到退化现象，其成因不清楚；作者实证发现不同图像的视觉元素在表示与回答中纠缠在一起。
Method: FOCUS 是免训练、架构无关的方法：用随机噪声遮蔽除一张以外的所有图像，让模型聚焦单张干净图像；对目标图像逐一执行得到部分遮蔽上下文下的 logits，聚合后再用纯噪声参考输入细化，以抑制泄漏。
Result: 在多个不同的多图基准上一致提升性能，并可推广到视频理解；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 跨图信息泄漏是多图推理退化的一个可操作来源，通过遮蔽-聚合-细化即可在不训练、不改架构的前提下缓解，且适用范围超出静态多图、延伸到视频。

papers.title: Matrix-game 2.0: An open-source, real-time, and streaming interactive world model
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in interactive video generations have demonstrated diffusion model's potential as world models by capturing complex physical dynamics and interactive behaviors. However, existing interactive world models depend on bidirectional attention and lengthy inference steps, severely limiting real-time performance. Consequently, they are hard to simulate real-world dynamics, where outcomes must update instantaneously based on historical context and current actions. To address this, we present Matrix-Game 2.0, an interactive world model generates long videos on-the-fly via few-step auto-regressive diffusion. Our framework consists of three key components: (1) A scalable data production pipeline for Unreal Engine and GTA5 environments to effectively produce massive amounts (about 1200 hours) of video data with diverse interaction annotations; (2) An action injection module that enables frame-level mouse and keyboard inputs as interactive conditions; (3) A few-step distillation based on the casual architecture for real-time and streaming video generation. Matrix Game 2.0 can generate high-quality minute-level videos across diverse scenes at an ultra-fast speed of 25 FPS. We open-source our model weights and codebase to advance research in interactive world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Matrix-Game 2.0 用少步自回归扩散把交互式世界模型做成实时流式生成：Unreal Engine 与 GTA5 数据管线产出约 1200 小时带交互标注的视频，动作注入模块接收帧级鼠标键盘输入，基于 causal 架构的少步蒸馏支撑流式推理。模型可跨多样场景生成分钟级高质量视频，速度达 25 FPS，并开源权重与代码。
Motivation: 现有交互式世界模型依赖双向注意力与冗长推理步数，实时性受限，难以像真实世界那样根据历史上下文与当前动作即时更新结果。
Method: 三组件框架：面向 Unreal Engine 与 GTA5 环境的可扩展数据生产管线，产出约 1200 小时带多样交互标注的视频；动作注入模块把帧级鼠标键盘输入作为交互条件；在 causal 架构上做少步蒸馏 (few-step distillation) 实现实时流式视频生成。
Result: 可跨多样场景生成分钟级高质量视频，生成速度达 25 FPS；数据管线产出约 1200 小时带交互标注的视频数据；开源模型权重与代码库。
Conclusion: 少步自回归扩散加动作注入足以让交互式世界模型在保持质量的同时做到实时流式生成，作者以开源权重和代码推动交互式世界建模研究。

papers.title: LLM Serving Optimization with Variable Prefill and Decode Lengths
papers.abstract_en: We study offline scheduling for large language model (LLM) serving under a fixed KV-cache memory budget, where requests have heterogeneous prompt (prefill) and response (decode) lengths. Given a backlog of requests available at time zero, the scheduler forms mixed prefill/decode batches over time to minimize total end-to-end latency. We show that heterogeneity in prompt lengths fundamentally changes the problem: minimizing total latency is NP-hard, and standard policies that prioritize short outputs or small total sequence sizes can have unbounded approximation ratios. We propose Sorted-F, which repeatedly selects feasible batches using an F-metric that balances batch cardinality against downstream decode cost. With exact batch selection, Sorted-F achieves a constant-factor approximation guarantee in the unit-time, uninterrupted-decoding model with known output lengths; the guarantee also holds under a static peak-memory batch constraint. We develop an exact pseudopolynomial dynamic program for this static subproblem, scalable local-search and greedy heuristics, LP-guided variants, and a receding-horizon online extension. Experiments on public conversational and long-document summarization workloads show that F-metric-based scheduling substantially reduces latency relative to standard baselines and remains close to the LP relaxation lower bound on tractable instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定 KV-cache 预算、prefill/decode 长度异构的 LLM 服务离线调度中，最小化总端到端时延是 NP-hard，且短输出优先或小序列优先这类标准策略的近似比无界。提出 Sorted-F：用平衡批内基数与后续 decode 代价的 F-metric 反复选取可行批，在单位时间、已知输出长度模型下取得常数因子近似保证（静态峰值内存批约束下同样成立）。
Motivation: LLM 服务调度中 prompt 与 response 长度异构使总时延最小化变为 NP-hard 问题，而常用贪心策略近似比无界，缺少有理论保证的批调度方法。
Method: Sorted-F 用 F-metric（批基数与下游 decode 代价的平衡项）反复选择可行的 mixed prefill/decode 批；配套给出静态子问题的精确伪多项式动态规划、可扩展的局部搜索与贪心启发式、LP 引导变体，以及 receding-horizon 在线扩展。
Result: 理论上：单位时间、无中断解码、已知输出长度模型下精确批选择的 Sorted-F 有常数因子近似保证，且在静态峰值内存批约束下保持；标准策略近似比无界。实验上：在公开的对话与长文档摘要工作负载中，F-metric 调度相对标准基线显著降低时延，并在可解实例上接近 LP 松弛下界。
Conclusion: prompt 长度异构是调度难度的根源，按 F-metric 组批能在保证近似比的同时把时延压到接近 LP 下界。

papers.title: Squeeze10-LLM: Squeezing LLMs' Weights by 10 Times via a Staged Mixed-Precision Quantization Method
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) is challenging due to their massive parameters and high computational costs. Ultra low-bit quantization can significantly reduce storage and accelerate inference, but extreme compression (i.e., mean bit-width <= 2) often leads to severe performance degradation. To address this, we propose Squeeze10-LLM, effectively "squeezing" 16-bit LLMs' weights by 10 times. Specifically, Squeeze10-LLM is a staged mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) framework and achieves an average of 1.6 bits per weight by quantizing 80% of the weights to 1 bit and 20% to 4 bits. We introduce Squeeze10LLM with two key innovations: Post-Binarization Activation Robustness (PBAR) and Full Information Activation Supervision (FIAS). PBAR is a refined weight significance metric that accounts for the impact of quantization on activations, improving accuracy in low-bit settings. FIAS is a strategy that preserves full activation information during quantization to mitigate cumulative error propagation across layers. Experiments on LLaMA and LLaMA2 show that Squeeze10-LLM achieves state-of-the-art performance for sub-2bit weight-only quantization, improving average accuracy from 43% to 56% on six zero-shot classification tasks--a significant boost over existing PTQ methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Squeeze10-LLM 把 16-bit LLM 权重压缩 10 倍：80% 权重量化到 1 bit、20% 到 4 bits，平均 1.6 bits/weight，靠 PBAR 权重量化显著性度量与 FIAS 全信息激活监督缓解低比特精度崩塌。在 LLaMA 与 LLaMA2 的六项 zero-shot 分类任务上，平均精度从 43% 提到 56%，达到 sub-2bit weight-only 量化最优。
Motivation: 平均位宽 ≤2 的极端权重量化能大幅省存储、加速推理，但通常带来严重性能下降，现有 PTQ 方法在 sub-2bit 区间精度不足。
Method: 分阶段混合精度 PTQ 框架：80% 权重 1 bit、20% 权重 4 bits，平均 1.6 bits/weight。两个核心组件——Post-Binarization Activation Robustness (PBAR) 作为考虑量化对激活影响的权重量化显著性度量，Full Information Activation Supervision (FIAS) 在量化中保留完整激活信息以抑制跨层累积误差。
Result: 在 LLaMA 与 LLaMA2 的六项 zero-shot 分类任务上，平均精度从 43% 提升到 56%（提升 13 个百分点），平均 1.6 bits/weight（80% 权重 1 bit、20% 4 bits），达到 sub-2bit weight-only 量化 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 混合 1/4-bit 加上以激活鲁棒性为导向的重要性度量与激活监督，可以在 sub-2bit 权重量化下把 LLM 精度损失压到可用水平。

summary_sections.conclusion: 混合 1/4-bit 加上以激活鲁棒性为导向的重要性度量与激活监督，可以在 sub-2bit 权重量化下把 LLM 精度损失压到可用水平。

papers.title: Gondola: Grounded Vision Language Planning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promising progress in robotic manipulation. However, directly mapping visual observations and language instructions to low-level actions often results in limited interpretability and weak robustness in complex, long-horizon tasks. To address these challenges, we employ a modular manipulation framework that separates high-level planning from low-level control. At its core is Gondola, a grounded vision-language planning model that generates structured plans with explicit pixel-level object grounding before action execution. Given multi-view observations and planning history, Gondola predicts the next-step plan as interleaved textual instructions and multi-view segmentation masks corresponding to target objects and goal locations. To train Gondola, we construct synthetic datasets that provide explicit supervision for short-horizon grounded planning, multi-view referring expression, and long-horizon compositional reasoning. By coupling grounded plan generation with a 3D-based execution policy, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging GemBench benchmark. The system further demonstrates promising transfer to real robots. Ablation studies confirm that pixel-level grounding and the proposed planning-oriented supervision are critical for effective high-level reasoning. Project webpage: https://cshizhe.github.io/projects/robot_gondola.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gondola 是机器人操作的 grounded vision-language 规划模型：给定多视角观测与规划历史，输出文本指令与目标物体/目标位置的多视角分割掩码交织的下一步计划，再交给 3D 执行策略。在 GemBench 上达到 state-of-the-art，并可迁移到真实机器人。
Motivation: VLA 直接从视觉与语言映射到低层动作，可解释性差、在复杂长程任务上鲁棒性弱，需要把高层规划与低层控制解耦。
Method: 模块化框架：Gondola 生成带像素级 object grounding 的结构化计划（文本指令 + 多视角分割掩码），由 3D-based execution policy 执行；用合成数据集监督短程 grounded planning、多视角 referring expression 与长程组合推理。
Result: 在 GemBench benchmark 上达到 state-of-the-art，并展示向真实机器人的迁移；消融确认像素级 grounding 与 planning-oriented supervision 对高层推理关键。
Conclusion: 把像素级 grounding 的显式规划与 3D 执行解耦，是提升长程操作可解释性与鲁棒性的有效路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: On The Limited Cost of Consistency In Points-Based Rewards Programs
papers.abstract_en: Points-based rewards programs are a prevalent way to incentivize customer loyalty. In theory, the effective design of these programs is shaped by two important considerations. Customer heterogeneity suggests that tailoring thresholds to different customer types may yield revenue gains, while demand uncertainty creates incentives to update thresholds over time as the seller learns how customers respond to the program. In practice, however, there may be nontrivial operational and customer-facing benefits associated with maintaining consistency along both of these dimensions. Setting a single threshold across customer types can facilitate transparent communication and reduce the legal, reputational, and operational risks associated with personalization, while avoiding threshold increases prevents the devaluation of customers' previously earned points. Motivated by these considerations, this paper studies the cost of consistency in points-based rewards programs. We study this question within the context of the popular ``Buy $N$, Get One Free'' (BNGO) rewards programs. We first bound the value of personalization of these programs, proving that the revenue of the optimal single-threshold program is within a factor of $\frac{π^2}{6}$ of that of the optimal personalized strategy. We then tackle the problem of designing devaluation-free learning algorithms --- i.e., algorithms that never increase the redemption threshold --- in the presence of demand uncertainty. Toward this goal, we first design a greedy learning algorithm that incurs $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret in expectation over a horizon of length $T$; this guarantee is optimal, up to polylogarithmic factors. We then provide a devaluation-free modification of this algorithm, and show that this results in only a constant factor loss in regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Buy N, Get One Free (BNGO) 积分奖励项目中量化“一致性”的代价：单一阈值的最优收入在 π²/6 因子内逼近最优个性化策略的收入；在需求不确定下设计永不提高兑换阈值的去贬值学习算法，其期望 regret 为 Õ(√T)（除 polylog 因子外最优），去贬值化改造只带来常数因子损失。
Motivation: 个性化阈值与随学习上调阈值在理论上能增收，但会带来沟通、法律、声誉风险并贬值客户已赚积分；需要量化坚持单一且不上调阈值这一一致性约束到底损失多少收入与 regret。
Method: 在 BNGO 奖励项目框架下先界定个性化价值，证明最优单阈值项目收入与最优个性化策略收入相差至多 π²/6 因子；再构造贪心学习算法并给出其去贬值化（阈值永不增加）改造，分析长度 T 视界上的期望 regret。
Result: 最优单阈值收入在 π²/6 因子内逼近最优个性化策略收入；贪心学习算法在长度 T 视界上期望 regret 为 Õ(√T)，除 polylog 因子外最优；去贬值化改造仅造成常数因子的 regret 损失。
Conclusion: 在 BNGO 项目中坚持单阈值且不上调阈值的一致性代价有限：个性化收益有 π²/6 的常数级上界，去贬值约束只让 regret 多一个常数因子。

papers.title: MoCA-Video: Motion-Aware Concept Alignment for Consistent Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Unlike traditional video editing or inpainting, video semantic mixing fuses a reference concept with a moving target entity to produce a hybrid while preserving the source video's motion and layout. We propose MoCA-Video, a training-free framework that steers a frozen video-diffusion denoising trajectory through concept-localized reference injection. At selected low-noise steps, MoCA-Video uses concept attention to localize the target object and injects the reference latent into the localized region, where object structure has formed but appearance remains editable. A momentum-based correction carries the injected prediction across frames to encourage coherent concept integration through the sequence. We further introduce CASS, a CLIP-based metric that measures the output's directional alignment shift toward the reference and away from the source prompt. Using the denoiser's internal attention avoids an external localization model; in our A100 FP16 setup, MoCA-Video takes 3.2 seconds per output frame, excluding preprocessing. Across the evaluated baselines, MoCA-Video achieves the highest CASS, rel-CASS, and ImageReward, while LPIPS-T and FVD expose separate temporal-coherence and video-quality trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoCA-Video 是一个免训练的视频语义混合框架：在冻结的 video-diffusion 去噪轨迹上，于低噪声步用概念注意力定位目标物体并把参考 latent 注入该区域，再用基于动量的跨帧校正保持整段序列的概念一致。在被评测的基线上它取得最高 CASS、rel-CASS 与 ImageReward，A100 FP16 下每输出帧 3.2 秒（不含预处理）。
Motivation: 视频语义混合要求把参考概念融进运动中的目标实体，同时保留源视频的运动与布局；现有视频编辑或 inpainting 方法不处理这种跨帧概念一致性问题。
Method: 免训练框架，引导冻结的 video-diffusion 去噪轨迹：在选定的低噪声步用概念注意力 (concept attention) 定位目标物体并注入参考 latent（此时物体结构已成形、外观仍可编辑），再用基于动量的校正把注入后的预测跨帧传递；定位直接用去噪器内部注意力，不引入外部定位模型。同时提出 CASS——基于 CLIP 的度量，衡量输出相对参考方向的对齐偏移与远离源 prompt 的程度。
Result: 在被评测的全部基线上取得最高 CASS、rel-CASS 与 ImageReward；LPIPS-T 与 FVD 则暴露出时间一致性与视频质量之间的独立权衡。A100 FP16 配置下每输出帧耗时 3.2 秒（不含预处理）。
Conclusion: 在去噪器内部注意力上做概念局部化的参考注入，配合跨帧动量校正，可在免训练设定下实现一致的视频语义混合，但时间一致性与视频质量仍需分别权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Probability Convergence of Clipped SGD under Heavy-Tailed Noise and $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness
papers.abstract_en: Gradient clipping is widely used in language-model training to control heavy-tailed gradient noise and can improve convergence guarantees over stochastic gradient descent (SGD) under $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness. Under these joint conditions, a central challenge is to obtain high-probability guarantees without exponential dependence on $L_1R_0$, where $R_0$ bounds the initial distance to a minimizer. We resolve this challenge for convex objectives, establishing, to the best of our knowledge, the first such guarantees for standard Clip-SGD. We assume unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded central $α$-th moment, $α\in(1,2]$. Our bounds have only polylogarithmic dependence on the inverse failure probability and recover known deterministic generalized-smoothness rates when the noise vanishes, as well as the standard high-probability rate under heavy-tailed noise in the classical $L$-smooth setting. The convex rate is attained by a computable output that averages iterates whose sampled stochastic gradients are not clipped, requiring neither function values nor extra oracle calls. We establish a lower bound for Clip-SGD with any fixed stepsize and clipping level, showing that, under the stated iteration conditions, our convex stochastic rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors in the iteration budget. Our upper-bound analysis uses a directional clipping-bias bound to absorb part of the bias into the progress generated by the clipped population gradient, avoiding an exponentially large local smoothness constant. We also obtain nonconvex high-probability guarantees that recover the noiseless rate, match the classical-smooth stochastic iteration rate when $L_1=0$, and have no explicit $L_1$ dependence in the asymptotically dominant stochastic term.
papers.comment: 76 pages; v2 contains minor edits; v3 contains improved results in the convex case and a new result in the non-convex case
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 (L0,L1)-smoothness 与重尾噪声（有界 α 阶中心矩，α∈(1,2]）下，给出 Clip-SGD 的高概率收敛保证，且对 L1R0 只有多对数依赖而非指数依赖。凸情形的速率由一个可计算输出达到：只平均那些采样梯度未被裁剪的迭代点，无需函数值或额外 oracle 调用；并给出固定步长与裁剪阈值下 Clip-SGD 的下界，说明该速率在迭代预算的对数因子内最优。
Motivation: 梯度裁剪是语言模型训练中抑制重尾梯度噪声的常用手段，但在 (L0,L1)-smoothness 这一联合条件下，获得不依赖 L1R0 指数的高概率收敛保证是核心难题。
Method: 假设无偏随机梯度且中心 α 阶矩有界（α∈(1,2]）；上界分析用 directional clipping-bias bound 把部分裁剪偏差吸收进被裁剪总体梯度产生的进展中，从而避免指数级大的局部光滑常数；凸情形的输出为平均未被裁剪的迭代点，非凸情形另给高概率保证。
Result: 凸情形为标准 Clip-SGD 建立（作者所称）首个此类高概率保证，对逆失败概率仅有多对数依赖；噪声消失时恢复已知确定性 generalized-smoothness 速率，L1=0 时恢复经典 L-光滑下重尾噪声的标准高概率速率。给出固定步长与裁剪阈值下 Clip-SGD 的下界，表明凸随机速率在迭代预算的对数因子内最优。非凸保证恢复无噪声速率、在 L1=0 时匹配经典光滑随机迭代速率，且渐进主导的随机项无显式 L1 依赖。
Conclusion: 裁剪配合合适的输出平均方式，可在 (L0,L1)-smoothness 与重尾噪声下给出既实用（无需函数值与额外 oracle 调用）又（在对数因子内）最优的高概率收敛速率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DimGrow: Memory-Efficient Field-level Embedding Dimension Search
papers.abstract_en: Key feature fields need bigger embedding dimensionality, others need smaller. This demands automated dimension allocation. Existing approaches, such as pruning or Neural Architecture Search (NAS), require training a memory-intensive SuperNet that enumerates all possible dimension combinations, which is infeasible for large feature spaces. We propose DimGrow, a lightweight approach that eliminates the SuperNet requirement. Starting training model from one dimension per feature field, DimGrow can progressively expand/shrink dimensions via importance scoring. Dimensions grow only when their importance consistently exceed a threshold, ensuring memory efficiency. Experiments on three recommendation datasets verify the effectiveness of DimGrow while it reduces training memory compared to SuperNet-based methods.
papers.comment: This paper is duplicated. As the newest version of this paper is arXiv:2503.09315. In addition, this paper will prevent the newest version of paper during the review process
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DimGrow 从每个特征场 1 维起步，用重要性打分逐场扩缩嵌入维度，只有当重要性持续超过阈值才增长，从而免去 SuperNet 枚举全部维度组合。在三个推荐数据集上验证有效，且训练内存低于基于 SuperNet 的方法。
Motivation: 推荐模型中关键特征场需要更高嵌入维度、其余需要更低维度，但现有剪枝与 NAS 类方法要训练内存密集的 SuperNet 来枚举所有维度组合，对大特征空间不可行。
Method: DimGrow 不训练 SuperNet：模型从每个特征场 1 维开始，按重要性打分逐步扩张或收缩维度，且仅当重要性持续超过阈值才增长，以此保证内存效率。
Result: 在三个推荐数据集上的实验验证了 DimGrow 的有效性，同时相比基于 SuperNet 的方法降低了训练内存。
Conclusion: 逐步扩缩的维度搜索可以替代 SuperNet 枚举，在推荐系统嵌入维度分配上以更低训练内存达到有效结果。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: DimGrow 不训练 SuperNet：模型从每个特征场 1 维开始，按重要性打分逐步扩张或收缩维度，且仅当重要性持续超过阈值才增长，以此保证内存效率。
summary_sections.result: 在三个推荐数据集上的实验验证了 DimGrow 的有效性，同时相比基于 SuperNet 的方法降低了训练内存。
summary_sections.conclusion: 逐步扩缩的维度搜索可以替代 SuperNet 枚举，在推荐系统嵌入维度分配上以更低训练内存达到有效结果。

papers.title: ICNN-enhanced 2SP: Leveraging input convex neural networks for solving two-stage stochastic programming
papers.abstract_en: Two-stage stochastic programming (2SP) offers a basic framework for modelling decision-making under uncertainty, yet scalability remains a challenge due to the computational complexity of recourse function evaluation. Existing learning-based methods like Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming (Neur2SP) employ neural networks (NNs) as recourse function surrogates but rely on computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulations. We propose ICNN-enhanced 2SP, a method that leverages Input Convex Neural Networks (ICNNs) to exploit linear programming (LP) representability in convex 2SP problems. By architecturally enforcing convexity and enabling exact inference through LP, our approach eliminates the need for integer variables inherent in the conventional MIP-based formulation while retaining an exact embedding of the ICNN surrogate within the 2SP framework. This results in a more computationally efficient alternative, and we show that good solution quality can be maintained. Comprehensive experiments reveal that ICNNs incur only marginally longer training times while achieving validation accuracy on par with their standard NN counterparts. Across benchmark problems, ICNN-enhanced 2SP often exhibits considerably faster solution times than the MIP-based formulations while preserving solution quality, with these advantages becoming significantly more pronounced as problem scale increases. For the most challenging instances, the method achieves speedups of up to 100$\times$ with solution quality superior to MIP-based formulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对两阶段随机规划 (2SP) 中 recourse 函数评估的可扩展性瓶颈，提出 ICNN-enhanced 2SP：用输入凸神经网络 (Input Convex Neural Network) 替代 Neur2SP 的普通 NN surrogate，架构上强制凸性，从而把原需混合整数规划 (MIP) 的求解改写为纯线性规划 (LP) 精确推理。在基准问题上求解时间常显著快于 MIP 形式且随规模增大优势更明显，最难实例加速最高达 100×，解质量反而优于 MIP 形式。
Motivation: 2SP 是不确定性下决策的基础框架，但 recourse 函数评估的计算复杂度限制了可扩展性；现有基于学习的方法 Neur2SP 用神经网络做 surrogate，却仍依赖计算量大的 MIP 形式。
Method: 对凸 2SP 问题，用 ICNN 在架构上强制 surrogate 的凸性，利用其 LP 可表示性，将 ICNN surrogate 精确嵌入 2SP 框架并以 LP 求解，去掉传统 MIP 形式所需的整数变量；训练与标准 NN 对照。
Result: ICNN 训练时间仅略长于标准 NN，验证精度与之相当；在基准问题上 ICNN-enhanced 2SP 的求解时间常明显快于 MIP 形式且保持解质量，规模越大优势越显著；最难实例加速最高达 100×，解质量优于 MIP 形式。
Conclusion: 在凸 2SP 中用 ICNN 强制凸性并以 LP 精确推理，可在保持乃至提升解质量的同时取代 MIP 形式，规模越大收益越大。

papers.title: Causal pieces: analysing and improving spiking neural networks piece by piece
papers.abstract_en: We introduce "causal pieces", a novel concept for analysing spiking neural networks (SNNs), inspired by "linear pieces" used to study expressivity and trainability in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Causal pieces partition the input and parameter space of a feedforward SNN with single-spike coding into distinct regions where the same subnetwork causes the output spikes. For networks of current-based leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with large membrane time constants, we show that within each causal piece, output spike times are locally Lipschitz continuous with respect to inputs and network parameters. We further prove a lower bound on the approximation error that depends on the number of causal pieces. Thus, the number of causal pieces is a measure of the approximation capabilities of SNNs, which is valid despite spike-time discontinuities and applies to networks with both excitatory and inhibitory synapses. Empirically, we find that parameter initialisations yielding more causal pieces on the training set strongly correlate with SNN training success across multiple benchmarks, including Yin-Yang, Fashion-MNIST, and EuroSAT. Moreover, simulations with standard single-spike LIF neurons indicate that our findings extend beyond the theoretically analysed regime. These results establish causal pieces as a powerful and principled tool for analysing and improving the computational capabilities of SNNs.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at NeurIPS 2026. Code repository: https://github.com/dodo47/snnpiece
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 causal pieces 概念，把单脉冲编码前馈 SNN 的输入与参数空间切成若干区域，区域内由同一子网络产生输出脉冲。证明每个 causal piece 内输出脉冲时刻对输入和参数局部 Lipschitz 连续，并给出依赖 causal pieces 数目的逼近误差下界；在 Yin-Yang、Fashion-MNIST、EuroSAT 上，训练集 causal pieces 更多的初始化与训练成功强相关。
Motivation: SNN 因脉冲时刻不连续而难以刻画表达能力与可训练性，ANN 的 linear pieces 分析无法直接迁移。
Method: 针对单脉冲编码的前馈 SNN 定义 causal pieces 划分；对大膜时间常数的 current-based LIF 神经元证明 piece 内局部 Lipschitz 性与依赖 piece 数的逼近误差下界，允许兴奋与抑制突触；再在多个基准上统计初始化的 causal pieces 数与训练成功的关系。
Result: 得到 piece 内输出脉冲时刻的局部 Lipschitz 连续性与随 causal pieces 数变化的逼近误差下界；经验上训练集 causal pieces 数与 SNN 训练成功在 Yin-Yang、Fashion-MNIST、EuroSAT 等多个基准上强相关，标准单脉冲 LIF 神经元的模拟显示结论超出理论分析的适用范围。
Conclusion: causal pieces 数可作为 SNN 逼近能力的有效度量，且可作为初始化选择的判据来提升 SNN 训练成功率。

papers.title: Boosting Adversarial Robustness and Generalization with Dictionary Structure
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates a novel approach to boost adversarial robustness and generalization by incorporating structural prior into the design of deep learning models. Specifically, our study surprisingly reveals that existing dictionary learning-inspired convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are robust against random noise but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. To address this, we propose Elastic Dictionary Learning Networks (EDLNets), a novel ResNet architecture that significantly enhances adversarial robustness and generalization. Extensive and reliable experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in adversarial robustness across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and threat models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to discover and validate that dictionary structure can reliably enhance deep learning robustness under strong adaptive attacks, unveiling a promising direction for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EDLNet（Elastic Dictionary Learning Network）把字典结构先验改进为弹性字典学习的 ResNet 架构，在强自适应攻击下同时提升对抗鲁棒性与泛化；作者发现既有字典学习启发的 CNN 只抗随机噪声、对对抗攻击仍高度脆弱，而字典结构本身可可靠增强深度模型鲁棒性。
Motivation: 既有字典学习启发的 CNN 对随机噪声鲁棒，却在对抗攻击下高度脆弱，说明结构先验的设计方式不足以提供对抗鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 Elastic Dictionary Learning Networks（EDLNet），一种引入弹性字典结构先验的 ResNet 架构；在多个数据集、骨干网络与威胁模型上做实验验证。
Result: 在多个数据集、骨干架构和威胁模型上，对抗鲁棒性一致提升；发现既有字典学习启发的 CNN 抗随机噪声但对对抗攻击高度脆弱。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个发现并验证字典结构能在强自适应攻击下可靠增强深度学习鲁棒性的工作，指向一个有前景的研究方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Audiovisual Speech Processing via MUTUD: Multimodal Training and Unimodal Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Building reliable speech systems often requires combining multiple modalities, like audio and visual cues. While such multimodal solutions frequently lead to improvements in performance and may even be critical in certain cases, they come with several constraints such as increased sensory requirements, computational cost, and modality synchronization, to mention a few. These challenges constrain the direct uses of these multimodal solutions in real-world applications. In this work, we develop approaches where the learning happens with all available modalities but the deployment or inference is done with just one or reduced modalities. To do so, we propose a Multimodal Training and Unimodal Deployment (MUTUD) framework which includes a Temporally Aligned Modality feature Estimation (TAME) module that can estimate information from missing modality using modalities present during inference. This innovative approach facilitates the integration of information across different modalities, enhancing the overall inference process by leveraging the strengths of each modality to compensate for the absence of certain modalities during inference. We apply MUTUD to various audiovisual speech tasks and show that it can reduce the performance gap between the multimodal and corresponding unimodal models to a considerable extent. MUTUD can achieve this while reducing the model size and compute compared to multimodal models, in some cases by almost 80%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MUTUD（Multimodal Training and Unimodal Deployment）框架：训练阶段用全部可用模态，部署阶段只保留单模态或缩减模态，靠 TAME（Temporally Aligned Modality feature Estimation）模块在推理时从现有模态估计缺失模态信息。在多项视听语音任务上，MUTUD 明显缩小多模态与对应单模态模型的性能差距，同时模型体积与算力相比多模态模型最多减少近 80%。
Motivation: 多模态语音系统性能更好，但传感需求、计算成本与模态同步约束限制了其在真实场景的直接部署，需要在保留多模态收益的同时降低推理端开销。
Method: MUTUD 框架在训练时使用全部可用模态，推理时只用单模态或缩减模态；核心是 TAME 模块，利用推理时存在的模态对缺失模态做时间对齐的特征估计，从而跨模态整合信息补偿缺失。
Result: 在多个音频视觉语音任务上，MUTUD 大幅缩小多模态模型与对应单模态模型之间的性能差距，同时相比多模态模型降低模型大小与计算量，某些情况下减少近 80%。
Conclusion: 多模态训练加单模态部署的组合可以在推理端省下大部分模型与算力开销，同时把单模态性能拉回接近多模态的水平。

papers.title: TeD-Loc: Text Distillation for Weakly Supervised Object Localization
papers.abstract_en: Weakly supervised object localization (WSOL) models can predict both the object class and the spatial regions corresponding to the object, without requiring explicit bounding-box annotations. Given their reliance on classification objectives, traditional WSOL methods, like class activation mapping, tend to focus on the most discriminative object regions, often missing the full spatial extent. Although vision-language models like CLIP encode rich semantic priors, their global text and class-token embeddings are not explicitly aligned with local patch embeddings, limiting patch-level localization. Recent methods such as GenPrompt address this limitation, but at the cost of increased complexity, as they rely on conditional denoising and elaborate prompt-learning strategies. In this paper, we propose Text Distillation for Localization (TeD-Loc), which distills knowledge from CLIP text embeddings to patch embeddings through contrastive alignment, thereby enabling patch-level foreground/background localization. A localization-guided classification module is also introduced, which uses localization scores to aggregate foreground patch embeddings for joint classification and localization within a single model. In addition, a QR-based orthogonalization of class text embeddings is applied before distillation to improve discrimination for semantically similar classes. Extensive experiments show that TeD-Loc improves Top-1 Loc by ~5% on CUB and ILSVRC, and PxAP by ~31% on histopathology benchmarks, while achieving more efficient inference than GenPrompt.
papers.journal_ref: Pattern Recognition 183 (2027) 114994
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TeD-Loc 用对比对齐把 CLIP 文本嵌入蒸馏到 patch 嵌入，实现弱监督目标定位 (WSOL) 的前景/背景逐 patch 分割，并用定位分数聚合前景 patch 做单模型联合分类定位。在 CUB 与 ILSVRC 上 Top-1 Loc 提升约 5%，组织病理基准 PxAP 提升约 31%，推理比 GenPrompt 更高效。
Motivation: 传统 WSOL 依赖分类目标，类激活图只聚焦最具判别力的局部区域，漏掉目标完整空间范围；CLIP 的全局文本与 class token 嵌入又未与局部 patch 嵌入显式对齐，限制 patch 级定位，而 GenPrompt 用条件去噪与复杂 prompt 学习来补救却带来额外复杂度。
Method: TeD-Loc 通过对比对齐将 CLIP 文本嵌入蒸馏到 patch 嵌入，得到 patch 级前景/背景定位；引入 localization-guided classification 模块，用定位分数聚合前景 patch 嵌入，在单一模型内联合分类与定位；蒸馏前对类别文本嵌入做 QR 正交化以区分语义相近类别。
Result: 在 CUB 和 ILSVRC 上 Top-1 Loc 提升约 5%，在组织病理学基准上 PxAP 提升约 31%，推理效率高于 GenPrompt。
Conclusion: 把 CLIP 文本语义经对比蒸馏下沉到 patch 层并配合定位引导分类，可在不增加 GenPrompt 式复杂度的前提下同时改善 WSOL 的定位与分类。

papers.title: Convex Physics Informed Neural Networks for the Monge-Ampère Optimal Transport Problem
papers.abstract_en: Optimal transportation of raw material from suppliers to customers is an issue arising in logistics that is addressed here with a continuous model relying on optimal transport theory. A physics informed neural network method is advocated here for the solution of the corresponding generalized Monge-Ampère equation. Convex neural networks are advocated to enforce the convexity of the solution to the Monge-Ampère equation and obtain a suitable approximation of the optimal transport map. A particular focus is set on the enforcement of transport boundary conditions in the loss function. Numerical experiments illustrate the solution to the optimal transport problem in several configurations, and sensitivity analyses are performed.

papers.title: RecKG: Knowledge Graph for Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs have proven successful in integrating heterogeneous data across various domains. However, there remains a noticeable dearth of research on their seamless integration among heterogeneous recommender systems, despite knowledge graph-based recommender systems garnering extensive research attention. This study aims to fill this gap by proposing RecKG, a standardized knowledge graph for recommender systems. RecKG ensures the consistent representation of entities across different datasets, accommodating diverse attribute types for effective data integration. Through a meticulous examination of various recommender system datasets, we select attributes for RecKG, ensuring standardized formatting through consistent naming conventions. By these characteristics, RecKG can seamlessly integrate heterogeneous data sources, enabling the discovery of additional semantic information within the integrated knowledge graph. We apply RecKG to standardize real-world datasets, subsequently developing an application for RecKG using a graph database. Finally, we validate RecKG's achievement in interoperability through a qualitative evaluation between RecKG and other studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RecKG 提出一个面向推荐系统的标准化知识图谱 schema，用统一实体表示与一致命名规范把异构推荐数据集整合进同一图，并在图数据库上构建应用。通过与既有研究的定性对比验证其互操作性，未涉及天气或降水场景。
Motivation: 推荐系统数据集之间实体表示不一致、属性类型各异，缺少可无缝整合异构推荐数据的标准化知识图谱。
Method: 考察多个推荐系统数据集后挑选属性，规定统一命名与格式规范以保证跨数据集实体一致；用图数据库实现应用，并与既有研究做定性对比。
Result: 产出 RecKG 标准化知识图谱及其图数据库应用，通过定性评估验证其在互操作性上的达成，摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 统一实体表示与命名规范足以让异构推荐数据源在知识图谱层面互通，并从中挖掘额外语义信息。

papers.title: Segment Anything for Dendrites from Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation of cellular structures in electron microscopy (EM) images is fundamental to analyzing the morphology of neurons and glial cells in the healthy and diseased brain tissue. Current neuronal segmentation applications are based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and do not effectively capture global relationships within images. Here, we present DendriteSAM, a vision foundation model based on Segment Anything, for interactive and automatic segmentation of dendrites in EM images. The model is trained on high-resolution EM data from healthy rat hippocampus and is tested on diseased rat and human data. Our evaluation results demonstrate better mask quality compared to the original and other fine-tuned models, leveraging the features learned during training. This study introduces the first implementation of vision foundation models in dendrite segmentation, paving the path for computer-assisted diagnosis of neuronal anomalies.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2025 IEEE 6th International Conference on Image Processing, Applications and Systems (IPAS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DendriteSAM 把 Segment Anything 视觉基础模型迁移到电镜 (EM) 树突分割，支持交互式与自动两种模式，在健康大鼠海马高分辨率 EM 数据上训练，并直接测试到患病大鼠与人类数据。评估显示其 mask 质量优于原始 SAM 及其他微调模型，是树突分割上首个视觉基础模型实现。
Motivation: 现有神经元分割应用基于 CNN，无法有效捕捉图像中的全局关系，而 EM 中树突等细胞结构的分割是分析健康与病变脑组织形态的基础。
Method: 基于 Segment Anything 构建 DendriteSAM，用于 EM 树突的交互式与自动分割；在健康大鼠海马的高分辨率 EM 数据上微调训练，测试集为患病大鼠与人类 EM 数据，与原始 SAM 及其他微调模型比较 mask 质量。
Result: 评估中 DendriteSAM 的 mask 质量优于原始 SAM 和其他微调模型，且训练所得特征可迁移到患病大鼠与人类数据；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 视觉基础模型可作为树突分割的首个可行实现，其训练特征能跨物种与健康/病变状态迁移，为神经异常的计算机辅助诊断铺路。

papers.title: Multi-Task Dynamic Pricing in Credit Market with Contextual Information
papers.abstract_en: We study the dynamic pricing problem faced by a broker seeking to learn prices for a large number of credit market securities, such as corporate bonds, government bonds, loans, and other credit-related securities. A major challenge in pricing these securities stems from their infrequent trading and the lack of transparency in over-the-counter (OTC) markets, which leads to insufficient data for individual pricing. Nevertheless, many securities share structural similarities that can be exploited. Moreover, brokers often place small "probing" orders to infer competitors' pricing behavior. Leveraging these insights, we propose a multi-task dynamic pricing framework that leverages the shared structure across securities to enhance pricing accuracy. In the OTC market, a broker wins a quote by offering a more competitive price than rivals. The broker's goal is to learn winning prices while minimizing expected regret against a clairvoyant benchmark. We model each security using a $d$-dimensional feature vector and assume a linear contextual model for the competitor's pricing of the yield, with parameters unknown a priori. We propose the Two-Stage Multi-Task (TSMT) algorithm: first, an unregularized MLE over pooled data to obtain a coarse parameter estimate; second, a regularized MLE on individual securities to refine the parameters. We show that the TSMT achieves a regret bounded by $\tilde{O} ( δ_{\max} \sqrt{T M d} + M d ) $, outperforming both fully individual and fully pooled baselines, where $M$ is the number of securities and $δ_{\max}$ quantifies their heterogeneity. Finally, our empirical experiment on U.S. corporate bonds shows promising performance of our TSMT algorithm and supports the theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 OTC 信用市场中证券交易稀疏、单券数据不足的动态定价问题，提出两阶段多任务算法 TSMT：先在全部证券池化数据上做无正则 MLE 得到粗估计，再对每只证券做带正则的 MLE 精修。理论 regret 上界为 Õ(δ_max·√(TMd) + Md)，优于完全独立与完全池化两个基线；美国公司债实验表现支持该理论结论。
Motivation: 公司债、政府债、贷款等信用证券在 OTC 市场交易不频繁且缺乏透明度，单券定价数据不足，而各券之间存在可利用的结构相似性。
Method: 将每只证券表示为 d 维特征向量，对竞争对手的收益率报价假设线性 contextual 模型、参数未知；TSMT 第一阶段在池化数据上做无正则 MLE 得粗估计，第二阶段对单券做正则化 MLE 精修，目标是在对全知基准的期望 regret 下学到获胜报价。
Result: TSMT 的 regret 上界为 Õ(δ_max·√(TMd) + Md)，其中 M 为证券数量、δ_max 刻画证券间异质性，优于完全独立与完全池化两个基线；在美国公司债上的实验证验表现良好并支持理论结论。
Conclusion: 跨证券共享结构的两阶段估计能在异质性存在时同时压过独立定价与完全池化定价，是数据稀疏的 OTC 信用定价的可行路径。

papers.title: BadRAG: Identifying Vulnerabilities in Retrieval Augmented Generation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases to provide more accurate, contextually informed, and up-to-date responses. However, this reliance on external knowledge introduces significant security vulnerabilities, as many RAG systems (e.g., Google Search) rely on large and unsanitized data repositories (e.g., Reddit). In this paper, we unveil a novel threat in which attackers steer the RAG system's response by injecting malicious passages into its knowledge base. When a user's query contains attacker-specified trigger words, the RAG retrieves and refers to these malicious passages, enabling the attacker to steer the response without altering the user input or modifying the RAG weights. BadRAG operates in two phases: (i) malicious passages are optimized to be retrieved exclusively when trigger words appear in user queries; (ii) these passages are meticulously crafted to achieve adversarial generation objectives, including denial of service, sentiment manipulation, context leakage, and tool misuse. Our experiments show that injecting just 10 malicious passages (0.04\% of the external corpora) achieves a 98.2\% retrieval success rate and increases negative response rates from 0.22\% to 72\% for queries containing triggers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BadRAG 揭示 RAG 知识库注入威胁：攻击者优化恶意 passage，使其仅在用户查询含触发词时被检索，再把 passage 精心构造以达成拒绝服务、情感操纵、上下文泄露与工具滥用。仅注入 10 条恶意 passage（占外部语料 0.04%）即达 98.2% 检索成功率，含触发词查询的负面响应率从 0.22% 升到 72%。
Motivation: RAG 依赖未清洗的外部知识库（如 Google Search 检索 Reddit），使攻击者可在不改用户输入、不动模型权重的情况下操纵回答，这一威胁此前未被刻画。
Method: BadRAG 分两阶段：先优化恶意 passage，使其仅在查询含攻击者指定触发词时被检索；再精细构造这些 passage 以实现对抗生成目标，包括拒绝服务、情感操纵、上下文泄露与工具滥用。
Result: 注入 10 条恶意 passage（占外部语料 0.04%）达到 98.2% 检索成功率；含触发词查询的负面响应率从 0.22% 升至 72%。
Conclusion: RAG 的外部知识库本身可被用作攻击面：少量经优化的恶意 passage 即可在触发词命中时稳定劫持系统输出。

papers.title: On the Approximation and Convergence of Distributional Policy Gradient Algorithms for Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) is crucial for maintaining reliable performance in high-stakes applications. While traditional RL methods aim to learn a point estimate of the random cumulative cost, distributional RL seeks to estimate the entire distribution of it, leading to a unified framework for handling different risk measures. However, developing policy gradient methods for risk-sensitive distributional RL is inherently more complex as it often involves finding the gradient of a probability measure. This paper introduces a new distributional policy gradient framework for risk-sensitive RL, where we derive an analytical gradient of the probability measure of the cumulative cost. For practical implementation, we further design a categorical distributional policy gradient algorithm (CDPG) that approximates arbitrary distributions using a categorical family supported on fixed points. Using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) as the objective, we prove that the proposed CDPG converges to stationary points and establish its iteration complexities under inexact policy evaluation. Through experiments in a stochastic Cliffwalk environment, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and highlight the benefits of incorporating risk sensitivity into distributional RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向风险敏感强化学习的分布式策略梯度框架，推导累积代价概率测度的解析梯度，并给出在固定支撑点上用 categorical 分布逼近任意分布的 CDPG 算法。以 CVaR 为目标，证明 CDPG 在非精确策略评估下收敛到驻点并给出迭代复杂度；随机 Cliffwalk 实验显示算法有效，且在分布式 RL 中引入风险敏感性带来收益。
Motivation: 传统 RL 只学随机累积代价的点估计，无法统一处理不同风险度量；而为风险敏感分布式 RL 构造策略梯度常需求概率测度的梯度，本身更困难。
Method: 推导累积代价概率测度的解析梯度，构成新的分布式策略梯度框架；实现上设计 CDPG，用固定点支撑的 categorical 分布族逼近任意分布，目标函数取 CVaR，并在非精确策略评估 (inexact policy evaluation) 下做收敛性分析。
Result: 证明 CDPG 收敛到驻点并建立其在非精确策略评估下的迭代复杂度；在随机 Cliffwalk 环境的实验中展示算法有效性，并体现在分布式 RL 中加入风险敏感性的收益。
Conclusion: 概率测度的解析梯度加上 categorical 分布逼近，可把风险敏感目标（如 CVaR）纳入可收敛的分布式策略梯度算法。

summary_sections.result: 证明 CDPG 收敛到驻点并建立其在非精确策略评估下的迭代复杂度；在随机 Cliffwalk 环境的实验中展示算法有效性，并体现在分布式 RL 中加入风险敏感性的收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 概率测度的解析梯度加上 categorical 分布逼近，可把风险敏感目标（如 CVaR）纳入可收敛的分布式策略梯度算法。

papers.title: AdvMT: Adversarial Motion Transformer for Long-term Human Motion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Human motion prediction is a crucial capability for advanced robotic systems that interact with humans. In facilities with dynamic human-robot collaboration settings, robots must anticipate human movements to ensure safety, prevent collisions, and optimize cooperative tasks. Traditionally, motion forecasting is treated as a sequential modeling problem using historical pose data, but achieving long-term accuracy and physical realism remains challenging. We present Adversarial Motion Transformer (AdvMT), a novel approach that integrates a Transformer-based motion encoder with a temporal continuity discriminator to address these challenges. The Transformer captures rich spatio-temporal dependencies across human joints, while adversarial training with a continuity discriminator enforces smooth, natural motion trajectories that adhere to biomechanical constraints. Our training scheme includes a bone-length consistency term and adversarial loss to reduce common artifacts like pose freezing or unnatural transitions. In experiments on the Human3.6M motion dataset, AdvMT achieves state-of-the-art long-horizon prediction accuracy while also delivering robust short-term predictions. These improvements strengthen the prediction foundation for physical AI in manufacturing and human-robot collaboration, where anticipating human motion is a prerequisite for safe and efficient robot coordination.
papers.journal_ref: S. Idrees, S. Sohn, and J. Choi, AdvMT: Adversarial Motion Transformer for Long-term Human Motion Prediction, International Journal of Precision Engineering and Manufacturing, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdvMT 用 Transformer 运动编码器加时序连续性判别器做人运动长期预测，对抗训练配合骨长一致性项抑制姿态冻结与不自然过渡。在 Human3.6M 上取得长期预测的 state-of-the-art 精度，同时保持稳健的短期预测。
Motivation: 人机协作场景中机器人需预判人体动作以保证安全与避碰，但把运动预报当作序列建模时，长期精度与物理真实性难以兼顾。
Method: Transformer 编码器捕捉关节间时空依赖，时序连续性判别器 (temporal continuity discriminator) 做对抗训练以约束平滑、符合生物力学的轨迹；训练损失含骨长一致性项与对抗损失，用于抑制姿态冻结和不自然过渡。
Result: 在 Human3.6M 运动数据集上，AdvMT 达到长期预测精度的 state-of-the-art，同时给出稳健的短期预测（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 对抗式连续性约束加骨长一致性可同时改善长期预测精度与运动的物理真实性，为制造与人机协作中的物理 AI 提供预测基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MONOVAB : An Annotated Corpus for Bangla Multi-label Emotion Detection
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, Sentiment Analysis (SA) and Emotion Recognition (ER) have been increasingly popular in the Bangla language, which is the seventh most spoken language throughout the entire world. However, the language is structurally complicated, which makes this field arduous to extract emotions in an accurate manner. Several distinct approaches such as the extraction of positive and negative sentiments as well as multiclass emotions, have been implemented in this field of study. Nevertheless, the extraction of multiple sentiments is an almost untouched area in this language. Which involves identifying several feelings based on a single piece of text. Therefore, this study demonstrates a thorough method for constructing an annotated corpus based on scrapped data from Facebook to bridge the gaps in this subject area to overcome the challenges. To make this annotation more fruitful, the context-based approach has been used. Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), a well-known methodology of transformers, have been shown the best results of all methods implemented. Finally, a web application has been developed to demonstrate the performance of the pre-trained top-performer model (BERT) for multi-label ER in Bangla.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建孟加拉语 (Bangla) 多标签情感语料 MONOVAB：从 Facebook 抓取文本并用基于上下文 (context-based) 的方式做多标签情绪标注，训练 BERT 等模型做多标签情绪识别 (multi-label ER)，BERT 在所实现的方法中表现最佳，并封装为 web 应用演示。
Motivation: 孟加拉语已有正负情感与多类情绪抽取工作，但同一段文本识别多种情绪的多标签抽取几乎空白，且该语言结构复杂使情绪识别困难。
Method: 以 Facebook 抓取数据构建标注语料，标注采用基于上下文的方法；用 BERT 等 Transformer 模型做多标签情绪识别，并将表现最好的预训练模型部署为 web 应用。
Result: BERT 在所实现的全部方法中取得最佳结果；最终交付为可演示多标签孟加拉语情绪识别的 web 应用。
Conclusion: 上下文式标注的孟加拉语多标签情绪语料配合 BERT 可支撑该语言的多标签情绪识别，填补多情绪共现抽取的空白。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exponential Convergence of Deep Operator Networks for Elliptic Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: We construct and analyze approximation rates of deep operator networks (ONets) between infinite-dimensional spaces that emulate with an exponential rate of convergence the coefficient-to-solution map of elliptic second-order partial differential equations. In particular, we consider problems set in $d$-dimensional periodic domains, $d=1, 2, \dots$, and with analytic right-hand sides and coefficients. Our analysis covers linear, elliptic second order divergence-form PDEs as, e.g., diffusion-reaction problems, parametric diffusion equations, and elliptic systems such as linear isotropic elastostatics in heterogeneous materials. We leverage the exponential convergence of spectral collocation methods for boundary value problems whose solutions are analytic. In the present periodic and analytic setting, this follows from classical elliptic regularity. Within the ONet branch and trunk construction of [Chen and Chen, 1993] and of [Lu et al., 2021], we show the existence of deep ONets which emulate the coefficient-to-solution map to a desired accuracy in the $H^1$ norm, uniformly over the coefficient set. We prove that the neural networks in the ONet have size $\mathcal{O}(\left|\log(\varepsilon)\right|^κ)$, where $\varepsilon>0$ is the approximation accuracy, for some $κ>0$ depending on the physical space dimension.
papers.journal_ref: SIAM J. Numer. Anal.61(2023), no.3, 1513-1545
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在周期域上解析系数与解析右端的二阶椭圆 PDE，其系数到解映射可被 ONet 以指数速率逼近：H1 范数下达到精度 ε 所需网络规模为 O(|log ε|^κ)，κ 只依赖物理空间维数 d。结论是该逼近复杂度对系数集一致成立，且直接继承谱配置法对解析解的指数收敛。
Motivation: 深度算子网络对椭圆 PDE 的逼近速率此前缺少与维数、精度挂钩的严格界，无法判断 ONet 相对经典谱方法是否保住了指数收敛这一优势。
Method: 在 Chen and Chen (1993) 与 Lu et al. (2021) 的 ONet branch/trunk 分解框架下构造网络，借用解析解边值问题谱配置法的指数收敛性，结合经典椭圆正则性，证明存在 ONet 在系数集上一致逼近系数到解映射。
Result: 证明存在深度 ONet 在 H1 范数下以一致于系数集的精度 ε 逼近系数到解映射，网络规模为 O(|log(ε)|^κ)，κ>0 依赖物理空间维数 d；覆盖 d 维周期域上解析系数与解析右端的线性二阶散度型椭圆 PDE，包括扩散-反应、参数化扩散与非均匀材料线性各向同性弹性静力学。
Conclusion: 在周期且解析的设定下，ONet 能以指数速率模拟椭圆 PDE 的系数到解映射，逼近代价随精度只按对数的幂增长、维数只进入指数 κ。

papers.title: Evaluating Bounded Autonomy in Regulated Agentic AI: A Diagnostic Harness with Constitutional Rewards, Escalation Labels, and Runtime Governance
papers.abstract_en: We propose RegLLM, a diagnostic harness for bounded autonomy in regulated agentic workflows. It instruments six trustworthiness signals: citation validity, source grounding, schema compliance, escalation correctness, constitutional alignment, and unsafe-action rate. Signals are distinguished by their source of supervision: programmatic verifiers, task-level escalation labels, or AI-judge scores. A deterministic runtime supervisor blocks ungrounded answers and forces escalation, logging interventions. The same domain constitution informs evaluation, training rewards, and serving guardrails. Task-level should-escalate labels make the act-versus-defer decision a measurable training signal. We demonstrate the harness at smoke scale. An offline reference run (n=12) lifts escalation recall from 0 to 0.67 and reduces unsafe-action rate from 0.33 to 0.08 when governance is enabled. Two single-GPU Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO pilots (n=8, same seed and evaluation split) expose substantial variation: nominally identical RL-base configurations yield task success of 0.25 versus 0.12 and escalation recall of 1.0 versus 0.5. An answer-quality adapter changes recall from 1.0 to 0.5 in Run A, but from 0.5 to 1.0 in Run B. An escalation-aware variant produces no measurable change in Run B. These small pilots do not establish reliable adapter effects or production readiness. Their contribution is diagnostic: configuration variance can overwhelm apparent tuning effects on bounded-autonomy metrics, motivating larger evaluation sets and repeated runs.
papers.comment: 9 pages; ancillary evaluation artefacts. Previously submitted to NLLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RegLLM 是面向受监管 agentic 工作流的有界自主诊断框架，用六路可信度信号（引用有效性、来源接地、schema 合规、升级正确性、宪法对齐、不安全动作率）加确定性运行时监督器拦截无据回答并强制升级。开治理后 n=12 的离线参考运行把升级召回从 0 提到 0.67、不安全动作率从 0.33 降到 0.08；但两个 n=8 的 Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO 试点显示同配置任务成功率 0.25 vs 0.12、升级召回 1.0 vs 0.5，配置方差可淹没调参效果。
Motivation: 受监管领域里 agentic 模型何时该行动、何时该升级缺乏可测量的训练与评估信号，且小规模调参结果的可信度本身存疑。
Method: RegLLM 用程序验证器、任务级 should-escalate 标签、AI-judge 三类监督源区分六路信号；确定性 runtime supervisor 拦截无据回答并记录干预；同一份 domain constitution 同时驱动评估、训练奖励（LoRA/DPO）与服务端护栏。
Result: 离线参考运行 n=12：开治理后升级召回 0 → 0.67，不安全动作率 0.33 → 0.08。两个单卡 Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO 试点（n=8，同 seed 同评估集）：名义相同的 RL-base 配置任务成功率 0.25 vs 0.12、升级召回 1.0 vs 0.5；answer-quality adapter 使 Run A 召回 1.0 → 0.5、Run B 0.5 → 1.0；escalation-aware 变体在 Run B 无可测变化。
Conclusion: 作者明确这些小试点不构成 adapter 效应或生产就绪的证据，其贡献是诊断性的：配置方差可压过调参效果，因此需要更大评估集与重复运行。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: REVO: Rollout-Efficient Off-Policy Distillation via Variance-Guided Reuse
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains language models using dense token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, its reliance on frequently refreshed student rollouts often incurs substantial generation cost. We introduce REVO, an off-policy distillation framework that improves rollout efficiency by reusing each student rollout for multi-step learner updates. REVO addresses prefix-level and current-token policy mismatch through stabilized prefix weighting and one-step resampling from the current student, which enables repeated updates without regenerating full trajectories. To prioritize informative token positions within reused rollouts, REVO uses the variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio to quantify the remaining token-level learning signal and guide repeated optimization. Across multiple student-teacher scales, REVO with only 50 rollout iterations matches or exceeds OPD baselines trained for 200 iterations on both in-domain and cross-domain reasoning benchmarks.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables, code available at https://github.com/UNCSciML/REVO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REVO 把 on-policy distillation 改成可复用的 off-policy 框架：每条学生 rollout 用多步 learner 更新，靠 stabilized prefix weighting 与从当前学生一步重采样压住 prefix 与当前 token 的策略失配，再用学生-教师 log-probability 方差挑信息量大的 token 位置反复优化。只用 50 次 rollout 迭代就在 in-domain 与 cross-domain 推理基准上追平或超过训练 200 次的 OPD 基线。
Motivation: OPD 依赖频繁刷新的学生 rollout，生成开销大；每次采样只做一次更新使 token 级教师监督的计算成本居高不下。
Method: off-policy 蒸馏框架 REVO：复用每条学生 rollout 做多步更新；用 stabilized prefix weighting 处理 prefix 级失配，用从当前学生出发的 one-step resampling 处理当前 token 失配；以学生-教师 log-probability 比值的方差衡量剩余 token 级学习信号，指导重复优化时的位置选择。
Result: 在多个 student-teacher 规模上，REVO 仅 50 次 rollout 迭代即匹配或超过训练 200 次的 OPD 基线，覆盖 in-domain 与 cross-domain 推理基准。
Conclusion: rollout 可以被多次复用而不必重新生成整条轨迹，rollout 迭代数可压缩到 OPD 的四分之一而性能不降。

papers.title: Your Benchmark Is Not Saturated: Reviving Multiple-Choice Evaluation with Answer Pooling
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-choice benchmarks are cheap to grade and are running out of room, and the standard remedy, writing harder items, is slow and repeated for every benchmark. A saturated benchmark still holds a harder task. Each question's wrong options are written for that question alone, so a model can score by eliminating a few options. We propose AnswerPool: take $N$ questions that share a context, pool all their options into one list, and ask the model to assign every question its answer. No item is written and no label changes. The chance of guessing a group right falls from $10^{-3}$ to $5\times10^{-7}$ for five four-option questions, and a model that recognizes its answers keeps its multiple-choice score, so the accuracy lost to pooling measures the credit the format gave for elimination. Deleting answers from the pool makes questions unanswerable with exact ground truth, so abstention is scored in the same pass. Across eight text, image, and video benchmarks and eighteen models, pooling is harder for every model, the elimination credit is largest for the weakest models, and seven of eight open-weight models answer 87 to 100% of unanswerable questions.

TL;DR: 提出 AnswerPool：把共享同一 context 的 N 道选择题的全部选项合并成一个选项池，让模型一次性为每题指派答案，不新增题目也不改标签。五道四选项题的随机猜中概率从 10^-3 降到 5×10^-7；在八个文本/图像/视频基准、十八个模型上池化对每个模型都更难，消除式得分红利对最弱模型最大，且七个开放权重模型对不可答问题仍回答 87–100%。
Motivation: 选择题基准评分便宜但已趋饱和，常规补救是重写更难题目，慢且每个基准都要重复做；而错误选项是为单题定制的，模型靠排除法即可得分，格式本身虚增了能力信号。
Method: AnswerPool 取共享 context 的 N 道题，把所有选项汇成一个列表，要求模型为每题分配答案；不新写题目、不改标签。删除池中答案即构造出带精确 ground truth 的不可答问题，使弃答 (abstention) 在同一次前向中被打分。
Result: 五道四选项题成组的随机猜中概率由 10^-3 降至 5×10^-7；在八个文本、图像、视频基准与十八个模型上，池化对每个模型都更难，消除红利 (elimination credit) 对最弱模型最大；七个开放权重模型对不可答问题回答了 87–100%。
Conclusion: 选择题分数中有相当一部分是排除法带来的格式红利，池化后损失的准确率即该红利的度量；饱和基准仍可通过池化变成更难任务，且同一次评测即可测出模型是否会弃答。

papers.title: Attention-Scoped Guidance: Training-Free Spatial Control for Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-guided image editing should change what the instruction names and leave the rest of the image untouched. In dual classifier-free guidance (CFG), an editor combines two directions at every denoising step, one that pushes toward the instructed edit and one that pulls back toward the source image, using global weights. We introduce Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG), a sampler wrapper that makes these weights spatial. It reads a soft support map from the instruction attention that the editor already computes, then weakens text guidance where support is low and strengthens image anchoring where support is high. The wrapper requires no training, no external mask, and no additional network evaluation. On the full MagicBrush and PIE-Bench++ splits, ASG improves preservation-oriented metrics, leading three of four MagicBrush metrics and PIE-Bench++ background PSNR. A dose-matched control that removes the spatial placement loses up to 0.73 CLIP on PIE-Bench++, confirming that the spatial allocation itself carries the gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASG 把双 CFG 的全局权重改成空间化的采样器包装：读取编辑器已有的指令注意力软支撑图，在支撑低处削弱文本引导、支撑高处加强图像锚定，无需训练、外部掩码或额外网络前向。在 MagicBrush 与 PIE-Bench++ 全量划分上提升保持类指标，MagicBrush 四项指标中领先三项，并拿下 PIE-Bench++ 背景 PSNR；去掉空间放置的等剂量对照最多损失 0.73 CLIP。
Motivation: 指令引导图像编辑应只改指令点名的区域、其余保持原样，但双 CFG 用全局权重同时施加编辑方向与回拉方向，无法区分该改与不该改的空间位置。
Method: 提出 Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG)，一个免训练的采样器包装：复用编辑器在去噪每步已计算的指令注意力，导出软支撑图，据此逐像素调制文本引导与图像锚定的权重；不需要外部掩码，也不增加网络评估次数。
Result: 在 MagicBrush 与 PIE-Bench++ 全量划分上，ASG 改善保持导向指标：MagicBrush 四项指标中领先三项，取得 PIE-Bench++ 背景 PSNR；一个去除空间放置的等剂量对照 (dose-matched control) 在 PIE-Bench++ 上最多损失 0.73 CLIP。
Conclusion: 增益来自空间分配本身而非总引导剂量，把 CFG 权重按指令注意力的空间支撑做局部化即可在不训练、不加掩码的前提下提升编辑的背景保持。
