papers.title: KT-EGO: A Knowledge Transfer Assisted Efficient Global Optimization Algorithm for Solving High-Dimensional Expensive Black-Box Problems
papers.abstract_en: Many engineering problems involve optimizing a high-dimensional expensive black-box (HEB) design space. To solve such problems efficiently, we propose a knowledge transfer assisted efficient global optimization (EGO) algorithm, labeled as KT-EGO, which extends the EGO algorithm for solving problems over higher dimensions (i.e., $d>20$). Specifically, the original design space is divided into several low-dimensional subset design spaces. More importantly, in order to extract information from the subset design spaces to accelerate the progress of full optimization, we propose a surrogate-based data fusion strategy in KT-EGO. And further, a searching strategy with an adaptive variable range is devised to enhance the exploitation of promising areas. To show the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm, it is compared against the state-of-the-art algorithms over 12 benchmark functions and a 28-dimensional engineering optimization for the design of compressor blade, which fully validates the effectiveness of the KT-EGO for solving HEB problems.
papers.journal_ref: Engineering Optimization 55(12), 2015-2033 (2023)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KT-EGO 把高维昂贵黑盒 (d>20) 的设计空间切成若干低维子空间，用基于代理模型的数据融合策略把子空间信息迁移到全空间优化，再配合自适应变量范围的搜索策略加强局部开发。在 12 个基准函数和 28 维压气机叶片工程优化上与最先进算法对比，验证其求解 HEB 问题的有效性。
Motivation: 高维昂贵黑盒问题中每次评估代价高、维度超过 20，标准 EGO 难以在全空间有效采样与开发。
Method: KT-EGO 扩展 EGO：将原设计空间划分为多个低维子空间；提出基于代理模型的数据融合策略 (surrogate-based data fusion) 从子空间抽取信息加速全空间优化；并设计自适应变量范围的搜索策略增强对有希望区域的开发 (exploitation)。
Result: 在 12 个基准函数以及一个 28 维压气机叶片 (compressor blade) 设计工程优化问题上，与最先进算法对比，验证了 KT-EGO 求解 HEB 问题的有效性。
Conclusion: 通过子空间划分加知识迁移，EGO 可扩展到 d>20 的高维昂贵黑盒优化，并在基准与工程实例上得到验证。

papers.title: Commitment Hierarchies under Intent Revision: A Belief-Revision Account of Salvage in Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: When a user changes their mind partway through a task, an agent that has already split the task into sub-goals and paid for tool calls must decide, per cached sub-result, whether to keep, patch, or discard it (salvage), restarting wastes valid work and continuing unchanged answers the old question. Our main finding is that salvage quality is a matter of role design rather than model capability: a language model asked the keep/patch/discard question one node at a time is unreliable, but asked to classify the revision once, with a deterministic layer propagating the decision, it reaches the cost-optimal oracle on all three models tested, from two vendors. Modeling the plan as a commitment hierarchy and the intent change as a belief-revision operator with AGM style postulates, we prove that no policy observing only a node's local view can be both safe and cost optimal, while the single classification design is both. Across three environments the policy recovers the full achievable savings, 43% cheaper than restart, at 100% correctness.
papers.comment: Accepted in the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工具调用 agent 在用户中途改主意时，需对已缓存的子结果逐个决定保留/修补/丢弃 (salvage)。把计划建模为承诺层级 (commitment hierarchy)、把意图改写建模为 AGM 式信念修正，作者证明只看节点局部视图的策略不可能同时安全且成本最优，而让模型一次性分类整次修正、再由确定性层传播决定的设计两者兼得。在三个环境、两家厂商的三个模型上该设计都达到成本最优 oracle，比从头重启便宜 43%，正确率 100%。
Motivation: 用户中途改意图时，agent 已经拆好子目标并为工具调用付费：重启浪费有效工作，照旧继续则回答的是旧问题。逐节点询问模型该保留、修补还是丢弃并不可靠，需要一个既安全又成本最优的 salvage 机制。
Method: 把计划表示为承诺层级 (commitment hierarchy)，把意图变更表示为带 AGM 公设的信念修正算子；对比两种角色设计——逐节点询问 keep/patch/discard，与让模型一次性对整次修正做分类、再由确定性层把决定传播到各节点。并给出不可能性证明：只观察节点局部视图的策略无法同时满足安全与成本最优。
Result: 单一分类设计在测试的三个模型（来自两家厂商）上全部达到成本最优 oracle；跨三个环境，该策略回收全部可得节省，比 restart 便宜 43%，正确率 100%。逐节点询问的设计被报告为不可靠。
Conclusion: salvage 质量取决于角色设计而非模型能力：把分类交给模型一次完成、把传播交给确定性层，是同时满足安全与成本最优的构造，而任何只看局部视图的策略都做不到。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CAMEO: A Class-Activation-Mapped Equitable Overlay Framework for Fair and Robust Deep Learning-based Skin Condition Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning classifiers for dermoscopic skin lesions often reach high in-distribution accuracy while quietly relying on spurious background cues such as skin tone, device vignetting, and embedded rulers, rather than on lesion morphology. This undermines robustness and fairness across skin tones. This work asks whether Explainable AI (XAI), typically used only to audit a finished model, can instead be repurposed as an active training signal that corrects this shortcut without sacrificing diagnostic accuracy. We introduce CAMEO (Class Activation Mapped Equitable Overlay), a framework that improves skin-lesion classification by selecting stable model explanations and using them to separate lesions from their backgrounds. It then replaces the background with realistic synthetic skin while keeping the lesion unchanged. On HAM10000 and dark-skin ISIC images, CAMEO maintained accuracy while reducing background-driven errors by nearly four times. It also made the model's attention more consistent when backgrounds changed. Results across multiple tests show that reducing reliance on background information improves robustness, with Fitzpatrick-based backgrounds providing a realistic and interpretable approach. Results show that XAI-guided augmentation can make dermoscopic classifiers measurably more robust and fair at no cost to accuracy. They also clarify that it is the mechanism and not the specific tone palette that matters, and that the lasting contribution of XAI here lies in stability-screened, annotation-free lesion localisation rather than in the robustness number itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAMEO 把 XAI 从训后审计改成训练期信号：用 class activation map 稳定性筛选选出可靠解释，据此把病灶与背景分离，再用按 Fitzpatrick 肤色生成的合成皮肤替换背景、保持病灶不变。在 HAM10000 与深肤色 ISIC 图像上，该做法维持原有准确率，同时把背景驱动的错误降低近四倍，并让模型注意力在背景变化时更一致。
Motivation: 皮肤镜分类器在分布内准确率高，却依赖肤色、设备暗角、标尺等背景伪线索而非病灶形态，损害跨肤色的鲁棒性与公平性；XAI 通常只用于训后审计，未被当作纠正捷径的训练信号。
Method: CAMEO (Class Activation Mapped Equitable Overlay) 框架：先筛选稳定的模型解释（class activation map）做病灶与背景分离，再用真实感的合成皮肤替换背景、保持病灶像素不变，作为 XAI 引导的数据增强进入训练；背景肤色按 Fitzpatrick 量表生成。
Result: 在 HAM10000 与深肤色 ISIC 图像上，准确率保持不变，背景驱动错误降低近四倍；背景变化时模型注意力一致性提高。多项测试显示降低背景依赖可提升鲁棒性，且起作用的是替换机制本身而非具体色调。
Conclusion: XAI 引导的背景替换能在不牺牲诊断准确率的前提下提升皮肤镜分类的鲁棒性与公平性；作者认为 XAI 在此的持久价值是稳定性筛选、无需标注的病灶定位，而非鲁棒性数字本身。

papers.title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV
papers.abstract_en: Decision-only language models return a probability for every answer option instead of generating text, which makes them attractive as survey respondents and as judges. We audit the cultural values of one such model, TypeSafe's JEV, with the Values Survey Module 2013. We asked it the 24 items as 12 matched Saudi and 12 matched American personas and without a persona, in English and Arabic, under eight ways of formulating the request (288,000 answers). JEV's answers were highly repeatable (ICC 0.997), and without a persona they resembled those of its own American personas. When the persona was Saudi rather than American, the answers moved in the direction of the human Saudi-US difference, reproducing 87% of its size in English but 62% in Arabic, with long-term orientation reversed. A language cross shows that the smaller difference in Arabic comes from the language of the items, not from the language of the persona description. Age shifted the profiles about as much as nationality, gender shifted them more for Saudi than for American personas, and JEV was less confident in Arabic and for Saudi personas. These patterns held in every request design, although the model never generates text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 decision-only 模型 TypeSafe 的 JEV 用 Values Survey Module 2013 的 24 个题目做文化价值观审计：以沙特/美国 persona、英阿双语、8 种提问方式共 288,000 次作答。沙特 persona 使答案朝真人沙特-美国差异方向移动，英语复现该差异的 87%、阿拉伯语 62%，且长期导向 (long-term orientation) 方向反转；阿拉伯语差异变小来自题目语言而非 persona 描述语言。
Motivation: decision-only 语言模型为每个选项输出概率而非生成文本，正被当作问卷受访者与评判者使用，但其文化价值观是否随 persona 与语言系统性偏移、偏移能否对应真人跨国差异，需要实证审计。
Method: 用 Values Survey Module 2013 的 24 个题目，构造 12 个匹配沙特与 12 个匹配美国的 persona，另加无 persona 条件，在英语和阿拉伯语下、以 8 种提问表述方式询问 JEV，共得到 288,000 个答案；用语言交叉 (language cross) 分离题目语言与 persona 描述语言的作用，并以 ICC 衡量可重复性。
Result: 答案高度可重复，ICC 0.997；无 persona 时 JEV 的答案接近其自身的美国 persona。沙特 persona 相对美国 persona 使答案朝真人沙特-美国差异方向移动，英语复现其 87%、阿拉伯语 62%，长期导向反转。语言交叉显示阿拉伯语差异较小源于题目语言而非 persona 描述语言；年龄造成的画像移动约与国籍相当，性别对沙特 persona 的影响大于美国 persona；模型在阿拉伯语与沙特 persona 下置信度更低，且这些模式在全部 8 种提问设计中一致。
Conclusion: JEV 的文化价值观可被 persona 与题目语言系统性调节，且调节幅度在阿拉伯语下更弱、长期导向甚至反向；即便模型从不生成文本，这些跨设计一致的偏移依然存在。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where Should Physics Enter a Molecular Crystal Generator?
papers.abstract_en: Generative models make molecular crystal structure prediction fast, but their samples still exhibit geometric and packing violations. Physics can be introduced during training, post-training, or inference, yet these choices are rarely compared with the generator and physical signal held fixed. We introduce CrystAF, an all-atom crystal flow-map generation model, and use it with the UMA interatomic potential to systematically study where physics should enter. Post-training learns physical preferences directly into CrystAF, improving molecular validity and crystal packing while leaving sampling unchanged: physics is paid for once during training rather than repeatedly at deployment. In contrast, UMA relaxation is effective at repairing local clashes but makes generation 6--26$\times$ slower, while learning from relaxed targets provides little benefit. These routes are complementary rather than competing. Physics-informed post-training first shifts the generated distribution toward more physically reasonable structures, after which inexpensive inference-time corrections further remove clashes and restore stereochemistry that the generator cannot represent. Importantly, the same post-training strategy also improves the multi-step all-atom Clari-M and rigid-body MolCrystalFlow generators, demonstrating transfer across architectures and representations. Together, our results suggest a simple principle: learn reusable physical alignment into the generator, and reserve inference-time physics for residual constraints that are better corrected than learned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分子晶体结构生成中对比物理介入的三个时机：训练后、训练中与推理时。CrystAF 配 UMA 势的实验显示，post-training 把物理偏好直接学进生成器，一次付费即提升分子有效性与晶体堆积且不改采样；推理时 UMA 弛豫擅长修补局部冲突但使生成慢 6–26 倍，从弛豫目标学习收益甚微。作者主张先用 post-training 平移分布，再用廉价推理时修正处理残余冲突与立体化学。
Motivation: 生成式分子晶体结构预测虽快，样本仍存在几何与堆积违规；物理可在训练、训练后或推理时引入，但这些选择很少在生成器与物理信号固定的前提下被系统比较。
Method: 提出全原子晶体 flow-map 生成模型 CrystAF，配合 UMA interatomic potential，在固定生成器与物理信号下系统改变物理介入时机：post-training 直接学物理偏好、推理时 UMA 弛豫、以及从弛豫目标学习；并把同一 post-training 策略迁移到多步全原子 Clari-M 与刚体 MolCrystalFlow 生成器。
Result: Post-training 提升分子有效性与晶体堆积且采样过程不变；UMA 弛豫有效修复局部冲突但使生成慢 6–26 倍；从弛豫目标学习收益甚微；同一 post-training 策略也改善了 Clari-M 与 MolCrystalFlow，跨架构与表示可迁移。
Conclusion: 两类路线互补而非竞争：把可复用的物理对齐学进生成器，推理时物理只留给更适合修正而非学习的残余约束。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LOCO-AdaMP: Built-in LOCO Inference for Adaptive Minipatch Ensembles with Enhanced Prediction
papers.abstract_en: As black-box machine learning models become increasingly common, extracting interpretations with uncertainty quantification has become a critical challenge. One popular type of interpretation is leave-one-covariate-out (LOCO) feature importance, while prior LOCO inference methods often require data-splitting or model-refitting. A recent ensemble framework, LOCO-MP, addresses these challenges using minipatches that subsample both observations and features, but massive feature subsampling can hurt prediction in high-dimensional sparse settings. Motivated by this limitation, we consider minipatch ensembles with adaptive feature sampling guided by LOCO importance, and propose LOCO-AdaMP, which enables free LOCO inference for the resulting adaptive minipatch ensemble. We show that LOCO-AdaMP yields substantially improved predictive models while retaining asymptotically valid feature importance inference without data-splitting, despite the complex dependence between the adaptive sampling distribution and the LOCO importance statistics. Our analysis relies on a careful leave-two-out perturbation bound for the iteratively updated sampling probabilities together with the stability of LOCO scores induced by observation subsampling. Empirical results on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate advantages of LOCO-AdaMP over existing methods in predictive performance, inferential power, and stability. Overall, LOCO-AdaMP provides a flexible ensemble framework (agnostic to base models) that delivers both strong predictive performance and asymptotically valid, powerful feature importance inference for regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LOCO-AdaMP 把 LOCO 重要性反过来指导 minipatch 的特征自适应采样，使自适应集成在不做数据切分的前提下免费给出 LOCO 推断。它用 leave-two-out 扰动界处理采样概率迭代更新与 LOCO 统计量之间的依赖，在提升预测的同时保持渐近有效的特征重要性推断。
Motivation: LOCO 特征重要性的现有推断方法通常要数据切分或重拟合模型；LOCO-MP 虽用 minipatch 规避了这一点，但在高维稀疏设定下大量特征子采样会损害预测。
Method: 以 LOCO 重要性引导自适应特征采样概率，构建自适应 minipatch 集成并直接给出 LOCO 推断；理论依赖对迭代更新采样概率的 leave-two-out 扰动界，以及观测子采样诱导的 LOCO 分数稳定性，框架对基模型不敏感。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，LOCO-AdaMP 相对已有方法在预测性能、推断功效 (inferential power) 与稳定性三方面均展现优势；理论结论是预测模型显著改善且特征重要性推断渐近有效、无需数据切分。
Conclusion: 把 LOCO 重要性嵌入采样分布本身，可以在不牺牲推断有效性的前提下修复 minipatch 集成在高维稀疏场景的预测损失，为回归给出兼顾预测与特征重要性推断的通用框架。

papers.title: Reward-rate Policy Gradient for Efficient Machine Learning Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) techniques focus on maximizing expected cumulative reward, where each action assumes to take a constant unit of time. However, this assumption does not hold for agentic RL tasks such as machine learning engineering (MLE) agents, where actions involve data loading, feature engineering, and model training that take variable durations. Efficiency matters in modern agentic RL where actions are costly. To address this limitation, we adapt from continuous-time RL and Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) formulation and propose Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG), where we focus on optimizing the reward rate -- the long-term reward per unit of time. RPG estimates the reward rate from off-policy samples, then charges each action for the time it consumes at that rate. We first conduct theoretical analysis in the bandit setting to establish that RPG approximates the optimal reward rate and empirically demonstrate it outperforms baselines while avoiding enumeration over the policy space, a known issue for an existing method. We then further apply RPG on a small language model (Qwen3.5-4B) with self-improvement loops and empirically show it obtains higher rewards within a fixed time budget than vanilla RL on MLE-Bench and NanoGPT, with a 19.2% and 85.7% margin, respectively. Our method provides a practical solution for optimizing performance under wait time considerations in modern agentic RL tasks, where actions interact with external environments and cost time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对动作耗时可变的 agentic RL（如 MLE agent），提出 Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG)：从 off-policy 样本估计长期单位时间奖励率，并按该费率对每个动作消耗的时间计费。在 Qwen3.5-4B 自我改进循环中，固定时间预算下 MLE-Bench 与 NanoGPT 上分别比 vanilla RL 高 19.2% 与 85.7%。
Motivation: 传统 RL 假设每个动作耗时恒定为单位时间，但 MLE agent 的数据加载、特征工程、模型训练耗时差异大，导致在动作昂贵的 agentic RL 中无法直接优化时间预算下的表现。
Method: 从 continuous-time RL 与 Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) 出发提出 RPG，优化 reward rate（单位时间长期奖励）：用 off-policy 样本估计 reward rate，再按该费率对每个动作消耗的时间扣费；先在 bandit 设定下做理论分析，再在小语言模型 Qwen3.5-4B 上配合 self-improvement loop 应用。
Result: bandit 理论分析表明 RPG 近似最优 reward rate，且避免了已有方法对策略空间的枚举；实证上超过基线。在固定时间预算下，Qwen3.5-4B 上 RPG 相比 vanilla RL 在 MLE-Bench 高 19.2%、在 NanoGPT 高 85.7%。
Conclusion: 在动作与外部环境交互且耗时不定的 agentic RL 中，按时间计费优化 reward rate 是在等待时间约束下提升表现的可行方案。

papers.title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: In diseases where clinical guidelines are incomplete, contested, or mutually contradictory, knowledge completeness and dynamic conflict-aware synthesis are two safety-critical properties that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems do not provide. Therefore, we present \sysname, an adaptive retrieval calibration clinical question-answering agent for ME/CFS, a disease where diagnostic frameworks coexist and major guidelines actively contradict each other on treatment. ARCagent contributes three components. First, a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base with a structured inter-guideline conflict registry spanning all active ME/CFS diagnostic frameworks. Second, a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks retrieved evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. Third, a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, avoiding systematic underestimation averaging 10.1 percentage points caused by keyword matching. ARCagent achieves 95.3%, outperforming all base LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/ARCagent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 ME/CFS 这类指南互相矛盾的疾病，提出临床问答 agent ARCagent：用 1,706-chunk、10-source 知识库加跨指南冲突登记表，配合按查询焦点与冲突信号重排序的检索校准流水线。在 LLM-as-Judge 基准上达到 95.3%，超过全部基座 LLM；该基准本身避免了关键词匹配导致的 10.1 个百分点系统性低估。
Motivation: 指南不完整或彼此矛盾的疾病里，知识完整性与动态冲突感知合成是标准 RAG 给不了的安全关键属性，而关键词匹配评分还会系统性低估答案质量。
Method: 三个组件：1,706-chunk、10-source 知识库并附结构化 inter-guideline conflict registry，覆盖全部现行 ME/CFS 诊断框架；conflict-aware 检索校准流水线，用查询特定的 focus 与 conflict 信号对检索证据重排序；以 LLM-as-Judge 打分的基准。
Result: ARCagent 达到 95.3%，优于所有基座 LLM；所用基准避免关键词匹配造成的平均 10.1 个百分点系统性低估。
Conclusion: 在指南互相冲突的疾病上，把冲突登记与冲突感知重排序放进检索链路，配合 LLM-as-Judge 评分，可让临床问答达到 95.3% 并超过全部基座模型。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Receptive-field-constrained stimulus optimization for human early and intermediate visual cortex
papers.abstract_en: An ongoing challenge in sensory neuroscience is to characterize the feature dimensions encoded by cortical populations. Recent approaches probe feature selectivity in a data-driven way, by synthesizing a most-exciting-input (MEI) for a target neural population. While this approach has been successfully applied to human higher visual cortex using fMRI data, generating MEIs for early- and mid-level retinotopic visual areas requires additional modeling constraints due to small receptive field sizes. To address this challenge, we introduce two novel MEI generation frameworks, Receptive Field Diffusion for Visual Exploration (RF-DiVE) and Receptive Field Gradient Optimization (RF-GO). Both methods use a population receptive field (pRF)-constrained voxelwise encoding model; RF-DiVE combines this with a pretrained latent diffusion model, while RF-GO uses regularized gradient ascent. When applied to single voxels in retinotopically defined areas V1-hV4, using data from the Natural Scenes Dataset, we obtain MEIs that exhibit consistent structure within the pRF, suggesting selectivity for local features like contour, color, and texture. We systematically compare MEIs generated by RF-DiVE and RF-GO using two encoding backbones, performing in-silico validation of predicted responses to MEIs using independent encoding models. Across all methods and all visual areas, MEIs elicit higher model-predicted responses than the most activating natural images. We further find that the choice of generation framework and encoding backbone differentially affects MEI properties, including their visual appearance, structural interpretability, and cross-model generalizability. These results offer a new approach for performing data-driven characterization of spatial and feature selectivity across human visual cortex.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两种受感受野约束的最兴奋输入 (MEI) 生成框架 RF-DiVE 与 RF-GO，用于人类早期与中级视网膜拓扑视觉区。两者都把 pRF 约束的逐体素编码模型与生成器结合（RF-DiVE 接预训练 latent diffusion，RF-GO 用正则化梯度上升），在 Natural Scenes Dataset 的 V1–hV4 单体素上生成的 MEI 在 pRF 内呈现一致结构，且在所有方法与视觉区上都比最激活自然图像引发更高的模型预测响应。
Motivation: MEI 数据驱动探针已在人类高级视觉皮层用 fMRI 成功应用，但早期与中级视网膜拓扑区感受野很小，直接生成需要额外的建模约束。
Method: 两种框架都采用 pRF 约束的逐体素编码模型：RF-DiVE 将其与预训练 latent diffusion 模型结合，RF-GO 用正则化梯度上升。在视网膜拓扑定义的 V1–hV4 单体素上生成 MEI，数据取自 Natural Scenes Dataset，并用独立编码模型对 MEI 预测响应做 in-silico 验证，同时系统比较两种生成框架与两种编码 backbone。
Result: 生成的 MEI 在 pRF 内呈现一致结构，提示对轮廓、颜色、纹理等局部特征的选择性；在所有方法与所有视觉区上，MEI 引发的模型预测响应都高于最激活的自然图像。生成框架与编码 backbone 的选择会差异性地影响 MEI 的视觉外观、结构可解释性与跨模型泛化能力。
Conclusion: 把 pRF 约束放进 MEI 生成可以把数据驱动的特征选择性刻画扩展到人类早期与中级视觉皮层，但生成框架与编码 backbone 的选择会改变 MEI 的性质与可解释性。

papers.title: Finite-Sample Theory for Fitted Q-Iteration When Actions Are Functions
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning seeks optimal decision rules from previously collected data. In some applications, a decision can be an entire function, such as a fluence map in radiation therapy or a smooth movement trajectory in robotics. In this paper, we study the finite-sample theory for fitted Q-iteration (FQI) with functional actions in a discounted infinite-horizon setting. Three major difficulties arise in this setting: first, the absence of a Lebesgue probability density for functional actions complicates coverage descriptions; second, conventional coverage requirements can be restrictive; and third, the large functional action space makes greedy optimization in FQI challenging. To address these difficulties, we study smoothness-regularized policy search under a critic-relative coverage condition. This condition measures how well logged data distinguish relevant action-value differences without requiring an action density. Our main theorem gives finite-sample guarantees for learned-policy regret relative to the best value within a fixed smooth class of functional-action policies. The results allow trajectory lengths to be either bounded or growing and Q-functions to be fitted by either functional-input kernel ridge regression or adaptive functional neural networks. For a few examples, we can obtain polynomially decaying regret bounds in the number of logged transitions, up to logarithmic factors, with logarithmically many FQI iterations. Numerical experiments show gains of learned functional-action policies over constant-action policies and support our adoption of a critic-relative coverage condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在折扣无限时域离线强化学习中，当动作本身是函数（如放疗 fluence 图、机器人轨迹）时，提出平滑正则化策略搜索配合 critic-relative coverage 条件，给出 fitted Q-iteration (FQI) 的有限样本 regret 保证。该覆盖条件只衡量日志数据区分相关 action-value 差异的能力，不要求动作存在 Lebesgue 密度；在若干例子中 regret 随日志转移数多项式衰减（忽略对数因子），FQI 迭代只需对数次。
Motivation: 函数值动作没有 Lebesgue 概率密度，传统基于密度的覆盖条件无法使用且过于苛刻；同时函数动作空间巨大，使 FQI 中的贪心优化困难。
Method: 在平滑函数类上做平滑正则化策略搜索，用 critic-relative coverage 条件替代密度型覆盖；主定理覆盖轨迹长度有界或增长两种情形，Q 函数可用函数输入的 kernel ridge regression 或 adaptive functional neural networks 拟合。
Result: 若干例子中 learned-policy regret 相对固定平滑类内最优策略值随日志转移数多项式衰减（至多差对数因子），FQI 迭代次数为对数级；数值实验显示函数动作策略优于常数动作策略，并支持 critic-relative coverage 条件的采用。
Conclusion: 无需动作密度的 critic-relative coverage 足以支撑函数动作 FQI 的有限样本理论，平滑正则化策略搜索是处理函数值动作离线 RL 的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Persona Dosing: Calibrated Activation Steering for Graded Trait Control
papers.abstract_en: An activation-steering coefficient sets intervention strength, but requesting a particular degree of persona expression requires a behavioral scale. We study persona dosing: controlling a language model through a trait description and a requested mean intensity. PersonaDose specializes a shared, description-conditioned FLAS controller on persona responses, then calibrates its flow time against measured trait expression. Training responses are not paired with requested target intensities. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B, PersonaDose raises core-trait expression at the Persona Vectors coherence floor of 75 by 33.2, 18.3, and 17.8 points over contrastive activation addition. Calibration-selected settings retain an expression advantage on held-out questions, although the coherence floor does not hold for every trait there. Across seven trained traits, calibrated requests yield mean targeting errors of 4.7-6.2 points over 14-22 calibration-reachable targets out of 28 per model. These results separate the behavioral range learned by a controller from the accuracy of requests within that range.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PersonaDose 用人格特质描述加请求的平均强度来控制语言模型：先在 persona 回应上专门训练共享的、以描述为条件的 FLAS 控制器，再把其 flow time 对实测特质表达做校准，训练回应不配对目标强度。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-3-4B 上，Persona Vectors 一致性下限 75 处核心特质表达较 contrastive activation addition 分别高 33.2、18.3、17.8 分；七个训练特质上校准请求的平均瞄准误差为 4.7–6.2 分，覆盖每模型 28 个目标中的 14–22 个可达目标。
Motivation: 激活转向系数只设定干预强度，而用户请求的是某个具体的人格表达程度，二者之间缺少一把行为标尺，无法把「想要多强」翻译成可执行的干预参数。
Method: PersonaDose 先在 persona 回应上专门训练一个共享的、以特质描述为条件的 FLAS 控制器，再把控制器的 flow time 对测得的特质表达强度做校准；校准阶段的训练回应不与请求的目标强度配对，靠校准建立请求与干预的对应。
Result: 在 Persona Vectors 一致性下限 75 处，核心特质表达较 contrastive activation addition 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-3-4B 上分别提高 33.2、18.3、17.8 分；校准选出的设置在 held-out 问题上仍保持表达优势，但一致性下限在那里的并非每个特质都成立。七个训练特质上，校准请求的平均瞄准误差为 4.7–6.2 分，每个模型 28 个目标中有 14–22 个在可达范围内。
Conclusion: 控制器学到的行为范围与其在该范围内响应请求的精度是两回事，校准能把请求落到可达目标上，但可达范围只覆盖部分目标，且一致性下限在新问题上不保证对所有特质成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stealth Is a Relation, Not a Property: How Event Representations Create Blind Spots for Timing Attacks in Event-Based Perception
papers.abstract_en: An event camera produces an asynchronous stream, but what is visible in that stream depends on how a downstream consumer, such as a model or detector, processes time. The same timestamp change may leave a coarse temporal representation unchanged while changing the response of a model that preserves finer timing. We characterize this dependence as observer-relative stealth. For recorded event streams, retiming an event within its protected accumulation window leaves the accumulated integer tensor exactly unchanged. We use this exact blind space to construct Null, a gradient-guided timestamp-retiming attack, and define SC-ASR_A(tau) to measure attack success while bounding the change visible to observer A. On DVS Gesture at a 10% event budget, Null reaches 81.56 +/- 5.81% ASR on ConvSNN and 98.67 +/- 0.45% on a GRU while preserving the protected tensor exactly. On DailyDVS-200, a protocol-scale Multi-View Fusion Network variant reaches 99.28 +/- 0.11% exact-null ASR, compared with 9.70 +/- 1.06% for its matched control. In a five-attack comparison, Null is the only method with nonzero attack success at exact observer equality, reaching 81.4% on DVS Gesture and 87.35% on DailyDVS-200. We also search the same exact blind space with an independently implemented constrained projected-gradient optimizer, C-PGD. At matched victim-gradient evaluations, C-PGD reaches 84.50 +/- 2.89% ASR on DVS Gesture and 89.55 +/- 4.39% on DailyDVS-200, again with exact protected equality. Perturbations that are exactly hidden from the protected observer become visible under shifted, finer, overlapping, and randomized temporal views. Adding observer constraints reduces the real-valued blind-space fraction from 87.5% to 75.0% to 62.5%, while DVS ConvSNN ASR falls from 74.9% to 61.9% to 37.2%. These results show that stealth is not a property of the perturbation alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 事件相机的时间戳篡改是否隐蔽取决于下游消费者如何聚合时间，而非扰动本身。作者把受保护累积窗口内的重定时定义为精确盲空间，据此构造梯度引导攻击 Null 与指标 SC-ASR_A(τ)：DVS Gesture 10% 事件预算下 ConvSNN ASR 81.56±5.81%、GRU 98.67±0.45%，且受保护张量逐位不变；加入观察者约束后实值盲空间占比从 87.5% 降到 62.5%，ConvSNN ASR 同步从 74.9% 降到 37.2%。
Motivation: 事件流的时间篡改是否可检测取决于下游模型的时间表示粒度，粗粒度累积会把同一时间戳改动完全吞掉，形成对特定观察者不可见、对其他观察者可见的盲区，现有攻击评估缺少按观察者约束成功率的度量。
Method: 利用受保护累积窗口内重定时不改变累积整数张量这一精确不变性构造盲空间，提出梯度引导时间戳重定时攻击 Null 与度量 SC-ASR_A(τ)（在观察者 A 可见变化受限下度量成功率）；另用独立实现的约束投影梯度优化器 C-PGD 在同一盲空间搜索，并做五种攻击对比与观察者约束消融。
Result: DVS Gesture 10% 事件预算下 Null 在 ConvSNN 上 ASR 81.56±5.81%、GRU 上 98.67±0.45%，受保护张量精确不变；DailyDVS-200 上协议规模 Multi-View Fusion Network 变体 exact-null ASR 99.28±0.11%，匹配对照为 9.70±1.06%。五攻击对比中 Null 是唯一在观察者精确相等时仍有非零成功率的方法，DVS Gesture 81.4%、DailyDVS-200 87.35%；C-PGD 在等量受害梯度评估下 DVS Gesture 84.50±2.89%、DailyDVS-200 89.55±4.39%。观察者约束使实值盲空间占比 87.5%→75.0%→62.5%，DVS ConvSNN ASR 74.9%→61.9%→37.2%；对受保护观察者完全隐藏的扰动在更细、重叠、随机化的时间视图下可见。
Conclusion: 隐蔽性是扰动与观察者时间表示之间的关系而非扰动固有属性，因此事件感知的时间攻击评估必须显式绑定观察者约束；收紧观察者的时间粒度会同时压缩盲空间并压低攻击成功率。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Support-Set Target Leakage in Relational Foundation Models during In-Context Learning: Impact, Detection, and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Relational in-context learning (ICL) conditions predictions on the labeled support examples and their linked tables, creating a failure mode when the support set contains target-derived features that are unavailable for the query. We formulate this problem as support-set target leakage, distinct from leakage during dataset construction, temporal splitting, or representation learning. Here, the target-derived (leaker) columns are present only in the labeled support set during relational in-context inference, while queries remain clean. We construct 14 synthetic leaker types, corresponding to 20 columns, spanning proxies with different noise levels, coverage, modalities, semantic transparency, and relational distances. We evaluate a frozen relational encoder with an ICL head on held-out RelBench databases and use Integrated Gradients (IG) to rank and remove suspicious columns. Our results show that the effect of support-set leakage varies across tasks and relational distances. Target-table leakers cause the clearest degradation, while one- and two-hop leakers are not consistently used by the model. IG ranks target-table leakers highly across datasets and partially recovers performance in settings where leakage has the largest effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 关系型基础模型做 in-context learning 时，若标注 support set 里含有查询侧不存在的 target 派生列（leaker），模型会利用这些列造成性能下降。作者构造 14 类共 20 列合成 leaker，在 RelBench 数据库上用冻结关系编码器加 ICL 头评测，并用 Integrated Gradients (IG) 排序可疑列后移除：target-table leaker 退化最明显，IG 能在泄漏影响最大处部分恢复性能。
Motivation: 关系型 ICL 以带标签的 support 样例及其关联表为条件做预测，一旦 support set 含查询侧拿不到的 target 派生特征，就会形成一种区别于数据集构建、时间切分与表示学习阶段泄漏的新失效模式，且此前缺少刻画与检测手段。
Method: 将问题形式化为 support-set target leakage：leaker 列只出现在带标签 support set 中，query 保持干净。构造 14 类合成 leaker（共 20 列），覆盖不同噪声水平、覆盖率、模态、语义透明度与关系距离；在 held-out RelBench 数据库上评测冻结关系编码器加 ICL 头，并用 Integrated Gradients (IG) 对可疑列排序后移除。
Result: 泄漏效应随任务与关系距离变化：target-table leaker 造成最明显的性能退化，一跳与二跳 leaker 并未被模型一致利用；IG 在各数据集上都把 target-table leaker 排到前列，并在泄漏影响最大的设置中部分恢复性能。
Conclusion: support-set target leakage 是关系型 ICL 的真实失效模式，其危害集中在 target 表内的 leaker 列，基于 Integrated Gradients 的归因排序可作为检测与缓解手段。

papers.title: Suêtes: An end-to-end differentiable non-hydrostatic limited-area dynamical core
papers.abstract_en: We present Suêtes, a fully differentiable, non-hydrostatic, limited-area atmospheric dynamical core implemented in JAX. Suêtes includes both a semi-implicit semi-Lagrangian scheme and a Split-Explicit Runge-Kutta scheme with acoustic substepping, enabling applications from coarse regional simulations to convection-permitting dynamics. Its terrain-following geometry, spatial discretization, time integration, initial conditions, lateral boundary treatment, and included physical parameterizations are all compatible with reverse-mode automatic differentiation. A single reverse-mode pass can therefore compute sensitivities of forecast diagnostics to selected initial and boundary fields, physical parameters, topography, and computational geometry. We provide a series of numerical experiments---including a tracer-source inverse problem, a sensitivity analysis of a three-dimensional squall-line, adversarial perturbation construction an ERA5-driven downslope hurricane force wind event, topography optimization, and terrain-following coordinate optimization---demonstrating the versatility of Suêtes as a framework for gradient-based diagnosis and model development at regional and convection-permitting scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Suêtes 是用 JAX 实现的端到端可微非静力有限区域动力核，含半隐式半拉格朗日与 Split-Explicit Runge-Kutta（声波子步）两套时间积分，一次反向自动微分即可算出预报诊断量对初始场、侧边界场、物理参数、地形与计算几何的敏感度。数值实验覆盖示踪源反演、三维飑线敏感度、对抗扰动构造、ERA5 驱动的下坡飓风级大风事件、地形优化与地形跟随坐标优化。
Motivation: 区域与对流可分辨尺度的动力核通常不可微，无法用一次反向传播把预报诊断对初边值、物理参数和地形的梯度拿来做反演与优化。
Method: 在 JAX 中实现非静力有限区域动力核，地形跟随几何、空间离散、时间积分、初始条件、侧边界处理与物理参数化全部兼容反向模式自动微分；提供半隐式半拉格朗日与带声波子步的 Split-Explicit Runge-Kutta 两种格式，覆盖粗区域模拟到对流可分辨动力。
Result: 给出一组数值实验：示踪源反问题、三维飑线敏感度分析、对抗扰动构造、ERA5 驱动的下坡飓风级大风事件、地形优化、地形跟随坐标优化；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: Suêtes 可作为区域与对流可分辨尺度上基于梯度的诊断与模式开发框架，一次反向微分即可支撑反演、敏感度分析与优化三类任务。

papers.title: LEGO-Anything: Coding Agents for 3D Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: A 3D scene reconstructed from a single image is most useful when represented not as a rendering or a fixed 3D output, but as an explicit scene program whose execution yields a scene that can be inspected, edited, and queried. We present LEGO-Anything, an Image-to-Code framework in which a coding agent iteratively writes and executes Blender code, inspects scenes and renderings, and revises the program. To evaluate end-to-end scene recovery, we introduce LEGO-Bench, a simulator-grounded benchmark with 208 images from 104 diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. LEGO-Bench separately scores artifact validity, visible-surface geometry, and rendered appearance. Its simulator-grounded design enables extensibility and precise automatic evaluation. Among evaluated agents, GPT-6-astra achieves the strongest overall results, with 53.4% indoor and 39.6% outdoor scores, yet substantial gaps remain between delivering valid scene artifacts and faithfully recovering scene geometry and appearance. Analysis of agent construction trajectories reveals three recurring issues: weak scene initialization, regressive edits during iteration, and unreliable self-evaluation. These findings motivate LEGO-Plugin, a training-free harness plugin for more controlled iterative scene construction, which improves all six evaluated models, with relative gains of up to 62.7% in overall score. Finally, we test whether reconstructed scenes can represent natural images and support vision tasks. In LEGO-World, we derive object detections, instance masks, and relative depth as deterministic queries on scenes reconstructed by GPT-6-astra. These readouts show non-trivial performance across all three tasks but fall well short of specialized vision models, suggesting that program-constructed scenes from current coding agents are a promising but not yet sufficiently precise representation of natural images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEGO-Anything 把单图 3D 场景重建做成 Image-to-Code：coding agent 迭代编写并执行 Blender 代码、检查渲染再改程序，输出可编辑可查询的场景程序。在自建的 LEGO-Bench（208 张图、104 个室内外场景）上 GPT-6-astra 总分最高，室内 53.4%、室外 39.6%；training-free 的 LEGO-Plugin 使全部 6 个受测模型提升，总分相对增益最高 62.7%。
Motivation: 单图重建出的固定 3D 输出难以检查、编辑与查询；现有 coding agent 在迭代构建中存在场景初始化弱、编辑回退、自我评估不可靠三类问题，且有效产物与真实几何/外观恢复之间仍有明显差距。
Method: Image-to-Code 框架：coding agent 迭代写并执行 Blender 代码、检视场景与渲染后修订程序；提出 simulator-grounded 基准 LEGO-Bench，分别对 artifact 有效性、可见表面几何、渲染外观打分；再给出 training-free 的 harness 插件 LEGO-Plugin 约束迭代构建，并在 LEGO-World 中把目标检测、实例掩码、相对深度作为对重建场景的确定性查询。
Result: LEGO-Bench 含 208 张图、104 个室内外场景；GPT-6-astra 总体最强，室内 53.4%、室外 39.6%；LEGO-Plugin 改进全部 6 个受测模型，总分相对增益最高 62.7%；LEGO-World 中基于 GPT-6-astra 重建场景的三类读出（检测、掩码、相对深度）表现非平凡但明显低于专用视觉模型。
Conclusion: 程序化构建的场景是自然图像的一种有前景但精度尚不足的表示，需先解决初始化、迭代回退与自我评估三类问题才能逼近专用视觉模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantization Enables Private Dense Retrieval against Malicious Service Providers
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrieval, the key component of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieves the most relevant documents by comparing dense vector representations of queries and passages from a large corpus. In privacy-sensitive applications, the server observes the query and controls which evidence is returned, creating both confidentiality and integrity risks. We formulate private dense retrieval as providing query privacy and retrieval integrity against a malicious server, and develop a two-round cryptographic protocol that provides both guarantees. Our protocol reduces private and verifiable retrieval to multiplication of a committed matrix by an encrypted vector and uses low-bit quantization to make this computation practical. We evaluate the resulting trade-off between cryptographic cost, retrieval quality, and downstream RAG accuracy across six embedding models, four language models, and corpora of up to 2.68 million passages. Our results show that, with a clipped quantizer, three-bit quantization largely preserves retrieval quality and downstream accuracy, while a private query over a corpus the size of a clinical reference requires one to three minutes of server time. These results suggest that private dense retrieval is already practical for moderately sized, privacy-sensitive corpora when minute-scale latency is acceptable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RAG 的私密稠密检索形式化为同时对抗恶意服务端的查询隐私与检索完整性，用低比特量化把「承诺矩阵乘加密向量」这一密码学核心算子做实用化。在 6 个 embedding 模型、4 个语言模型、最多 268 万 passage 的语料上，clipped quantizer 下 3-bit 量化基本保住检索质量与下游准确率，临床规模语料的一次私密查询需 1–3 分钟服务端时间。
Motivation: RAG 中服务端能看到查询并控制返回证据，同时带来机密性与完整性风险；私密且可验证的检索原本密码学开销过大，难以在真实语料规模上运行。
Method: 提出两轮密码学协议，把私密可验证检索归约为承诺矩阵与加密向量的乘法，并用低比特量化（含 clipped quantizer）降低该计算成本；在 6 个 embedding 模型、4 个语言模型、最大 268 万 passage 的语料上评估密码学开销、检索质量与下游 RAG 准确率的三方权衡。
Result: clipped quantizer 下 3-bit 量化基本保留检索质量与下游准确率；临床参考规模语料上一次私密查询需 1–3 分钟服务端时间；评测覆盖 6 个 embedding 模型、4 个语言模型、最多 268 万 passage。
Conclusion: 只要接受分钟级延迟，私密稠密检索对中等规模、隐私敏感语料已经实用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neural Succession: A Mesoscopic Theory of Invasion, Coexistence, and Stabilization in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning is usually studied through mechanisms that preserve old knowledge. We develop Successional Learning Theory (SLT), a mesoscopic account in which the current representation is a resident community, the incoming task is an invader, forgetting is resident displacement, joint retention is coexistence, replay is resident reinforcement, and training moves from establishment toward stabilization. Its empirical coordinate is directional pre-invasion compatibility, measured on the resident model before the incoming task is learned. Across eight experiments, compatibility orders later forgetting on the 20 directed Split-CIFAR-10 transitions (three-repeat r=-0.789, incoming-task cluster 95% CI [-0.90,-0.72], every repeat alone r<=-0.67), forecasts held-out forgetting with 24% lower error than a no-information baseline, and reproduces under controlled MNIST permutations and CIFAR-10 rotations (r=-0.804, -0.718). On an 84-transition suite, compatibility separates coexistence from exclusion at every retention threshold (AUC 0.93-0.97). Replay repairs every transition with at most 325 stored examples and is most efficient where displacement is largest. Compatibility reaches |r|=0.720, while activation, representation, Jacobian, and fixed-coefficient Lotka-Volterra specializations do not. Plasticity and feature turnover fall reliably from early to late training (15/15 and 14/15 runs). We formalize a minimum habitat-modification bound, a displacement floor, a sufficient coexistence condition, an identifiability law with a range-restriction corollary, successional stabilization, and local reinforcement. The identifiability law also predicts where the coordinate loses leverage, and the prediction matches three CIFAR-100 partitions and five optimizer regimes. SLT is a pre-adaptation diagnostic that complements replay, regularization, and projection methods.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/shoaibdipu/Neural_Succession/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Successional Learning Theory (SLT)，把持续学习重写为群落生态过程：当前表示是 resident、新任务是入侵者，遗忘即 resident displacement。其核心可测坐标是学习新任务之前的 directional pre-invasion compatibility，在 20 条 Split-CIFAR-10 有向迁移上以 r=-0.789 排序后续遗忘，并以比无信息基线低 24% 的误差预报 held-out forgetting。
Motivation: 持续学习通常只从保留旧知识的机制出发，缺少在新任务训练之前就能预测谁会被挤掉的前置诊断量。
Method: SLT 用 resident/invader/coexistence/replay 对应表示、入侵任务、联合保留与回放，定义在 resident 模型上测得的 directional pre-invasion compatibility 作为坐标；共做八组实验，覆盖 Split-CIFAR-10 有向迁移、受控 MNIST 置换与 CIFAR-10 旋转、84 条迁移套件、replay 修复，并给出最小栖息地改造界、displacement floor、充分共存条件、可辨识性定律与稳定化形式化。
Result: compatibility 在 20 条 Split-CIFAR-10 有向迁移上排序遗忘 r=-0.789（incoming-task cluster 95% CI [-0.90,-0.72]，单次重复均 r<=-0.67），预报 held-out forgetting 误差比无信息基线低 24%；在 MNIST 置换与 CIFAR-10 旋转上复现 r=-0.804 与 -0.718；在 84 条迁移套件上于所有 retention 阈值区分 coexistence 与 exclusion，AUC 0.93-0.97；replay 用至多 325 个存储样本修复每条迁移，且在 displacement 最大处最有效；compatibility 达 |r|=0.720，而 activation、representation、Jacobian 与固定系数 Lotka-Volterra 特化均不达标；plasticity 与 feature turnover 从训练早期到晚期可靠下降（15/15 与 14/15 次运行）；可辨识性定律对坐标失效位置的预测与三个 CIFAR-100 划分和五种 optimizer regime 相符。
Conclusion: SLT 把 compatibility 定位为 replay、正则化与 projection 方法的前置诊断量：它能在新任务训练前预测遗忘与共存/排除，并指出该坐标在何处失去预测力。

papers.title: OTT3R: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Fast Dataset Generation at 1% Compute
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved impressive performance by scaling model and dataset size, but their cost excludes most research groups and precludes edge deployment. Additionally, generating 3D supervision without sensors still relies on slow, unreliable Structure-from-Motion, as the community lacks a COLMAP-like system for neural 3D pseudo-label generation. We present OTT3R (RGB-Only Tiny Transformer for 3D Reconstruction), a knowledge distillation framework that addresses both problems on a single workstation equipped with 2 GPUs. Distilling $π^3$ (959M parameters) into a 102M-parameter student yields 9.4$\times$ compression and up to 7$\times$ faster inference, trained at 1.6% of VGGT's training compute. An integrated pseudo-label pipeline offers a reliable, high-throughput alternative to COLMAP, generating dense per-pixel point maps and SE(3) camera poses for a 667K-image corpus in 3.5 hours on two commodity GPUs and succeeding on every sequence we tested, including those where COLMAP fails. The general student tracks the teacher on in-distribution monocular depth and, zero-shot, outperforms COLMAP on 7-Scenes and on DTU completion, but it does not replace the teacher on out-of-distribution multi-view geometry. The deployable artifact is the domain-specialized student: after specialization at 0.2% compute, it is 4$\times$ more accurate than COLMAP on 7-Scenes at 980$\times$ throughput, with near-teacher completion. Code is available at https://github.com/TheFourthKaramazov/OTT3R
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OTT3R 用知识蒸馏把 π³（959M 参数）压成 102M 学生模型，压缩 9.4×、推理提速最高 7×，训练只花 VGGT 的 1.6% 算力；配套的纯 RGB 伪标签流水线 3.5 小时内在两块消费级 GPU 上为 667K 图像语料生成逐像素点图与 SE(3) 位姿，测试序列全部成功。域内单目深度上学生追平教师，零样本在 7-Scenes 与 DTU completion 上超过 COLMAP；经 0.2% 算力特化后在 7-Scenes 上精度为 COLMAP 的 4 倍、吞吐 980×，但分布外多视角几何仍不能替代教师。
Motivation: 前馈 3D 重建靠堆模型与数据规模，成本把多数研究组挡在门外且难以边缘部署；无传感器的 3D 监督生成仍依赖慢且不可靠的 SfM，社区缺少神经 3D 伪标签版的 COLMAP 系统。
Method: 以知识蒸馏把教师 π³（959M 参数）蒸到 102M 学生 Transformer，单工作站 2 GPU 完成训练；集成伪标签流水线直接从 RGB 输出稠密逐像素点图与 SE(3) 相机位姿，替代 COLMAP/SfM 生成监督；另以 0.2% 算力做域特化得到可部署工件。
Result: 9.4× 压缩、最高 7× 推理加速，训练开销为 VGGT 的 1.6%；伪标签流水线 3.5 小时内在两块消费级 GPU 上处理 667K 图像语料，测试序列全部成功（含 COLMAP 失败的序列）。通用学生在分布内单目深度追平教师，零样本在 7-Scenes 与 DTU completion 上优于 COLMAP；域特化学生在 7-Scenes 上精度为 COLMAP 的 4 倍、吞吐 980×，completion 接近教师水平。
Conclusion: 蒸馏加神经伪标签可以在极低算力下产出可部署的 3D 重建工件并替代 COLMAP 做监督生成，但分布外多视角几何仍需教师，特化是换取精度与吞吐的前提。

papers.title: Audience-Bound Persistent Memory: Authorization Across the Memory Lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: A personal language agent that acts for its owner across private and shared conversations can learn a fact from one audience and later place it in the context it assembles for another. We study authorization before context across the whole memory lifecycle. Each memory item carries the audience present when it was recorded; derived items are partitioned by audience, receive the intersection of their sources' audiences, or are suppressed; an audience widens only by an explicit, object-specific grant; and an item enters a model attempt only when every current viewer belongs to one of its authorized audiences, with unresolved viewers failing closed to public-only. Under explicit identity, provenance and complete-mediation assumptions, this admission is sound and policy-complete on the exact assembled context, enforced by exclusion rather than by model behavior. We realize it in two independently persisted reference architectures, a flat store and a relationship graph, and, descriptively, in a native agent-memory runtime. In a prospectively frozen confirmation over 10,000 multi-party histories, no forbidden item entered any architecture's context, whereas unscoped retrieval exposed forbidden items in 82% of its contexts. Entitled recall matched policy-equivalent baselines exactly and exceeded unscoped retrieval by 0.30 Recall@5, with a Holm-confirmed advantage that grows with distractors. No architecture produced a wrong-principal substitution, but unscoped substitutions were too rare to establish the prespecified joint decision.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Includes technical appendices and an ancillary research artifact
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为个人语言 agent 的记忆生命周期提出 audience-bound 授权机制：每条记忆携带记录时的受众，派生记忆按受众交集划分或抑制，受众只能通过显式对象级授权扩大，未解析的 viewer 一律 fail-closed 到 public-only，从而在组装上下文时靠排除而非模型行为阻止越权内容。在 10,000 条多方对话历史的前瞻性冻结确认中，两个参考架构均无禁入条目进入上下文，而 unscoped retrieval 在 82% 的上下文中暴露禁入条目。
Motivation: 个人 agent 会从一个受众处学到事实，再把它放进为另一个受众组装的上下文，跨私有与共享对话的记忆复用缺少贯穿记录、派生、检索、组装全生命周期的授权约束。
Method: 每条记忆项携带记录时的受众标签；派生项按受众划分、取源受众交集或被抑制；受众扩张仅允许显式对象级 grant；条目进入模型尝试当且仅当每个当前 viewer 都属于其授权受众，未解析 viewer fail-closed 到 public-only。在明确身份、来源追溯与完全中介 (complete mediation) 假设下给出可靠性与策略完备性论证，并在扁平存储与关系图两种独立持久化参考架构及一个原生 agent-memory 运行时中实现。
Result: 在前瞻性冻结的 10,000 条多方历史确认中，两个架构的上下文均无禁入条目，unscoped retrieval 则在 82% 的上下文中暴露禁入条目；entitled recall 与策略等价基线完全一致，比 unscoped retrieval 高 0.30 Recall@5，优势经 Holm 校正确认且随干扰项增多而扩大；无架构出现错误主体替换，但 unscoped 替换过于稀少，不足以确立预设的联合判定。
Conclusion: 在身份、来源与完全中介成立时，把授权判定放在上下文组装处并靠排除执行，可以在精确组装的上下文上做到可靠且策略完备，而不依赖模型自身行为。

papers.title: LatentSift: Policy-State Filtering for Token-Efficient Verification of Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling improves software engineering agents by generating multiple candidate trajectories and selecting the best one. Verifying and selecting among these long interactions can consume as many tokens as generation itself. Existing hybrid workflows first apply an LLM-based execution-free (EF) verifier to filter candidates before running tests, which adds another model pass over every trajectory. We introduce LatentSift, a token-free and execution-free filter that replaces this first stage with hidden states the policy already produces while generating the candidates. It represents each candidate through its reasoning, observation, and function-call states, compares them with positive and negative banks of such states collected from successful and unsuccessful trajectories during policy training, and fuses the resulting distance scores with a learned linear score to retain promising candidates for the execution-based stages. On SWE-bench Verified, across three agents and two policy sizes, LatentSift cuts EF-verifier tokens by 66.6--81.0% and total verification tokens, which include test generation, by 49.1--62.1% at K=16, while hybrid Best@16 matches or improves on each agent's reference workflow, rising from 59.26% to 60.06% on DeepSWE-Preview.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentSift 用策略生成候选时已产生的 hidden states 替代执行前 (execution-free) LLM 校验器的第一道筛选，按推理、观测与函数调用状态与正负状态库的距离打分并线性融合，保留候选进入执行阶段。在 SWE-bench Verified、三个 agent、两种策略规模、K=16 下，EF 校验器 token 降 66.6–81.0%，含测试生成的总校验 token 降 49.1–62.1%，hybrid Best@16 不劣于各 agent 参考流程，DeepSWE-Preview 从 59.26% 升到 60.06%。
Motivation: Test-time scaling 靠多候选轨迹选优，但校验与筛选长交互的 token 开销可与生成相当；现有混合流程先用 LLM 做执行前校验，等于对每条轨迹再多跑一遍模型。
Method: LatentSift 是 token-free、execution-free 的过滤器：用策略生成候选时已有的 hidden states，把每条候选表示为其推理、观测与函数调用状态，与策略训练期间从成功/失败轨迹收集的正负状态库比较得到距离分数，再用一个学习到的线性分数融合，保留有希望的候选交给基于执行的阶段。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified、三个 agent 与两种策略规模上，K=16 时 EF 校验器 token 减少 66.6–81.0%，含测试生成的总校验 token 减少 49.1–62.1%；hybrid Best@16 在每个 agent 上都匹配或优于参考流程，DeepSWE-Preview 由 59.26% 升至 60.06%。
Conclusion: 候选筛选可以只靠策略已产出的隐状态完成，不必再为第一道执行前校验付出模型推理 token，同时保持甚至提升 Best@16 的解题率。

papers.title: AdaKerNet: Neural Kernel Decoding for Task-Adaptive Prediction with Multimodal Large Models
papers.abstract_en: Large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. Yet, under limited supervision, MLLMs, an important class of large foundation models, remain challenging to adapt to various downstream tasks. Adaptation typically relies either on MLLM parameter fine-tuning or on training neural-based decoders. Both approaches struggle under limited supervision, while fine-tuning additionally requires access to model parameters, which is often unavailable for closed-source models. We introduce AdaKerNet, a novel learnable task-adaptive neural kernel decoder. AdaKerNet is fully agnostic to the parameters of the underlying MLLM and operates solely on its (frozen) rich representations obtained from the diverse available modalities. AdaKerNet relies on (i) a set of learnable, Lipschitz-controlled multimodal features derived from these MLLM representations; (ii) a reference kernel that provides a soft structural prior on those features; and (iii) a lightweight nonlinear neural predictor that adaptively deforms that structure. Learning the kernel representation and the neural predictor jointly within a unified optimization framework allows AdaKerNet to capture features and geometric relationships relevant to the downstream task. Numerical tests across four MLLMs: BLIP-2, LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemini Embedding 2, and multimodal inputs spanning text, audio, images, and tabular measurements demonstrate significant and consistent improvements over direct MLP, attention-, autoencoder- and kernel-based decoders, across a range of scarce-label budgets, with average error reduction of up to 41% across baselines. These results establish AdaKerNet as an effective approach for prediction from frozen multimodal representations in the scarce label regime. Additional structural ablations highlight the complementary contributions of AdaKerNet's components.

papers.title: Cross-attention encoding models reveal dynamic spatiotemporal routing across human higher visual cortex
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how the brain parses actions and events from time-varying natural inputs is a central challenge in neuroscience. Recent work has used deep neural network (DNN) models to build stimulus-computable fMRI encoding models that predict single-voxel responses to complex natural videos. However, the majority of video-computable encoding models predict responses using simple linear mappings from model tokens, overlooking the spatiotemporal structure shared by video representations and neural responses. Recent cross-attention encoding models address this limitation for static images, enabling flexible stimulus-dependent weighting of image content across space. Here, we extend this framework to naturalistic video, using per-parcel cross-attention to dynamically route features from a self-supervised video model (V-JEPA-2) across both space and time, fitting this model to fMRI responses to short video clips. We compare joint spatiotemporal attention with factorized and selectively constrained alternatives, and find that joint routing improves predictions of brain responses to held-out videos across higher visual regions, most consistently in lateral and dorsal visual areas associated with dynamic motion perception. Moreover, our method provides interpretable, stimulus-specific attention maps that dynamically follow moving objects, revealing which locations and temporal moments contribute to each neural response. We further show that attention maps from parcels in different category-selective networks (face-, body-, scene-selective) differentially weight content in accordance with expected semantic selectivity. Together, this work provides a new computational framework for understanding how visual information is adaptively weighted by cortical populations during dynamic visual perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把静态图像的 cross-attention 编码模型扩展到自然视频：按脑区 parcel 用 cross-attention 从自监督视频模型 V-JEPA-2 的表征中沿空间和时间动态路由特征，拟合短视频片段的 fMRI 体素响应。联合时空注意力在留出视频上优于分解式与选择性约束的注意力变体，提升最稳定地出现在与动态运动知觉相关的外侧与背侧视觉区。
Motivation: 现有视频可计算的 fMRI 编码模型多用从模型 token 到体素的简单线性映射，忽略了视频表征与神经响应共享的时空结构；静态图像上的 cross-attention 编码框架尚未延伸到时变自然输入。
Method: 以 V-JEPA-2 自监督视频模型为特征源，按 parcel 做 cross-attention，沿空间与时间动态路由特征，拟合短视频片段诱发的 fMRI 单体素响应；对比联合时空注意力、分解式 (factorized) 与选择性约束 (selectively constrained) 三种注意力结构，并输出可解释的 stimulus-specific attention map。
Result: 联合时空路由在留出视频上提升高级视觉区的脑响应预测，且在与动态运动知觉相关的外侧和背侧视觉区最一致；attention map 能随移动物体动态跟踪，标出对每次神经响应有贡献的位置与时刻；face、body、scene 选择性网络的 parcel 所给出的 attention map 按各自预期的语义选择性差异化加权内容。
Conclusion: 视觉皮层群体对动态视觉信息的加权是跨时空自适应路由的，联合时空注意力比分解式结构更贴近这一机制，并给出可解释的、随刺激变化的注意力图。

papers.title: Engineering Simplicity: Simple Mechanism Interfaces Steer LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Can interaction formats and textual scaffolds help large language model (LLM) agents make better decisions, and do better decisions come with better explanations? We study these questions in auctions and matching, multi-agent environments with explicit rules and known optimal strategies. These settings let us vary how a decision problem is presented while retaining a benchmark for evaluating behavior. Drawing on human-motivated theories of simplicity, we compare interfaces that elicit a complete bid or ranking with sequential interfaces that make safe choices easier to identify. We then hold the interaction format fixed and vary reasoning scaffolds and rule descriptions. Across four model families, the ascending auction interface substantially reduces bid deviations. The matching comparison also shows why sequential responses require different error accounting from complete rankings. Laying out payoff contingencies and explaining why truth-telling is safe also improve choices, whereas prompts to plan through matching rounds or form beliefs about opponents worsen play overall. In auctions, these behavioral gains are not accompanied by corresponding improvements in measured verbal indicators of strategic understanding in the agents' short stated plans. Other prompts change those indicators without improving bids. Our findings suggest that human-motivated theories of simplicity can inform the design of decision environments for artificial agents. They also show why scaffolds should be evaluated through realized choices as well as explanations: improvements in one need not appear in the other.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在拍卖与匹配这两类有已知最优策略的多智能体环境中，比较让 LLM agent 输出完整出价/排序的接口与逐步暴露安全选择的顺序接口，并固定接口单独变换推理 scaffold。跨四个模型族，升价拍卖 (ascending auction) 接口显著缩小出价偏差；列出支付 contingencies、解释为何说真话安全能改善选择，而要求规划匹配轮次或形成对手信念的 prompt 总体反而使表现变差。行为改善并不伴随短期计划中策略理解的言语指标提升，反之亦然。
Motivation: LLM agent 的决策质量与其解释质量是否同步并不清楚；拍卖与匹配有显式规则和已知最优策略，能在改变呈现方式的同时保留评估行为的基准。
Method: 基于人类简化理论设计接口对比：完整出价/排序 vs 顺序接口（使安全选择更易识别）；随后固定接口，单独变换推理 scaffold 与规则描述（支付 contingencies、说真话安全性说明、匹配轮次规划 prompt、对手信念 prompt），在四个模型族上比较出价与短计划中的言语指标。
Result: 升价拍卖接口大幅降低出价偏差；匹配比较显示顺序响应需要与完整排序不同的误差核算；列出支付 contingencies 与解释说真话安全改善选择，而规划匹配轮次、形成对手信念的 prompt 总体使表现变差；拍卖中这些行为收益没有带来短计划中策略理解言语指标的相应提升，另一些 prompt 则只改变指标而不改善出价。
Conclusion: 人类动机的简化理论可用于为人工 agent 设计决策环境；scaffold 必须同时用实际选择和解释来评估，因为一方的改善未必出现在另一方。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Compress to Remember: Learning Compact Memory via On-Policy Distillation for Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Standard video generators do not natively compact historical context into reusable memory tokens. As generation continues, the growing history makes it increasingly difficult to retain information from earlier frames due to long-context degradation. Key-frame-based approaches address this challenge by retaining selected past frames, but can discard information needed for future generation. Rather than relying on frame selection alone, we study whether a frozen video generator can supply the supervision needed to learn a compact representation of the history. We propose Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction (PACC), which uses a learned compressor to aggregate information across past frames into compact memory tokens. We train the compressor through on-policy distillation, using the same frozen generator both as a student when conditioned on compressed memory and as a teacher when conditioned on the full history. The student generates continuations, while the teacher provides targets for the same noisy inputs at each denoising step. Only the compressor is updated to align the student's predictions with these targets. We evaluate PACC on MBench, which jointly measures memory-event coverage and consistency. PACC outperforms the strongest baseline by 6.63 points on Causal-rCM and 3.19 points on Causal Forcing. Evaluation on VBench-Long using MovieGen prompts further shows that PACC produces minute-long videos with generation quality competitive with baselines. Together, these results show that learning to compact historical context can improve long-video memory without modifying the underlying generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACC 用可学习压缩器把历史帧聚合为紧凑 memory token，通过 on-policy 蒸馏训练：同一个冻结视频生成器在压缩记忆条件下当 student、在全历史条件下当 teacher，在每个去噪步为相同噪声输入提供目标，只更新压缩器。在 MBench 上比最强基线在 Causal-rCM 高 6.63 点、Causal Forcing 高 3.19 点，VBench-Long 上用 MovieGen prompts 生成的分钟级视频质量与基线相当。
Motivation: 标准视频生成器不会把历史压成可复用的记忆 token，生成越长越难保留早期帧信息（long-context degradation）；关键帧选择又可能丢掉未来生成所需的信息。
Method: 提出 Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction (PACC)：学习型 compressor 聚合历史帧为紧凑 memory token；on-policy 蒸馏中冻结生成器既作 student（以压缩记忆为条件）又作 teacher（以全历史为条件），student 生成续写、teacher 在每个去噪步对相同噪声输入给出目标，仅更新 compressor 使 student 预测对齐这些目标。
Result: 在 MBench（联合度量 memory-event coverage 与 consistency）上比最强基线高 6.63 点（Causal-rCM）与 3.19 点（Causal Forcing）；在 VBench-Long 上用 MovieGen prompts 评测，生成的分钟级视频质量与基线相当。
Conclusion: 学习压缩历史上下文即可在不改动底层生成器的前提下改善长视频记忆，无需只依赖关键帧选择。

papers.title: Better Nearest Neighbor Graph Indices via (Efficient) LLM-Guided Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is widely used for large-scale semantic search. Its indices are constructed primarily based on geometric relationships among embeddings of an input dataset (e.g., documents or images), rather than explicitly optimizing for semantic relevance. However, when using these indices for downstream query retrieval, performance is evaluated based on the semantic relevance of the retrieved results to the query. This creates a fundamental "geometry-semantic" mismatch between how the indices are constructed and how their retrieval results are evaluated. While existing LLM-based reranking methods can partially mitigate this mismatch at query time, they leave this underlying structural problem in the graph unresolved. We therefore propose LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP), a general framework that addresses this mismatch directly by leveraging LLM reasoning to refine an existing ANN graph index itself. LGP identifies structurally "low-value" neighbors of nodes and replaces them with LLM-selected alternatives that provide useful semantic information while retaining desired geometric structures of the original graph, including sparsity and efficient navigability. Experiments on representative semantic retrieval benchmarks show that LGP consistently improves end-to-end retrieval performance over both vanilla greedy graph search and LLM-based reranking across widely used graph-based ANN indices such as DiskANN and HNSW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP)：用 LLM 推理识别 ANN 图索引中结构上低价值的邻居并替换为语义更有用的候选，同时保留原图的稀疏性与可导航性。在代表性语义检索基准上，LGP 在 DiskANN、HNSW 等图索引上端到端检索性能一致优于原始贪心图搜索与 LLM 重排序。
Motivation: 图索引按 embedding 几何关系构建，而检索效果按语义相关性评估，二者存在 geometry-semantic 错配；查询时的 LLM 重排序只能部分缓解，图结构本身的问题未被解决。
Method: LGP 框架直接改写已有 ANN 图索引：用 LLM 推理挑出节点的低价值邻居，替换为 LLM 选出的、能提供有用语义信息的替代节点，同时约束保留原图的稀疏性与高效可导航性。
Result: 在代表性语义检索基准上，LGP 在 DiskANN、HNSW 等广泛使用的图式 ANN 索引上，端到端检索性能一致优于 vanilla greedy graph search 与 LLM-based reranking。
Conclusion: geometry-semantic 错配是图索引的结构性问题，可在索引构建阶段用 LLM 引导的剪枝直接修正，而不必只在查询时重排序。

papers.title: HyperZip: Efficient Data Compression through Personalized Diffusion LLMs with Hypernetworks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for lossless data compression, but existing approaches are constrained by the high computational cost and low throughput of autoregressive decoding. We propose HyperZip, an efficient and scalable LLM-based compression framework that leverages diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) with Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) to accelerate LLM-based data compression processes. We identify a trade-off in diffusion-based compression, where increasing decoding throughput degrades the compression rate. To mitigate this trade-off, HyperZip employs a hypernetwork to generate data-specific updates from a context representation, adapting the dLLM to the target data without costly fine-tuning, resulting in a low compression rate and high throughput. Extensive experiments show that HyperZip achieves a superior trade-off between compression rate and speed compared with state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperZip 用 diffusion-based LLM (dLLM) 加 Multi-Token Prediction 替代自回归解码做无损数据压缩，并识别出扩散式压缩中解码吞吐提高会恶化压缩率的权衡。其做法是用 hypernetwork 从上下文表示生成针对目标数据的更新，免去昂贵微调，从而同时拿到低压缩率与高吞吐，在压缩率-速度权衡上超过 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: LLM 无损压缩受限于自回归解码的高计算成本与低吞吐；而扩散式解码虽提速，却存在吞吐上升即压缩率变差的固有权衡，直接换用 dLLM 并不能两全。
Method: 以 diffusion-based LLM 为压缩主体，用 Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) 加速解码；再引入 hypernetwork，从目标数据的上下文表示直接生成对该 dLLM 的个性化更新，替代对每份数据的昂贵微调，以同时优化压缩率与吞吐。
Result: 在与 SOTA 基线的对比实验中，HyperZip 在压缩率与压缩速度的权衡上取得更优结果；摘要给出的定性结论是同时实现低压缩率与高吞吐。
Conclusion: 扩散式 LLM 做无损压缩时，吞吐与压缩率的权衡可通过 hypernetwork 个性化而非逐数据微调来缓解，使 LLM 压缩在速度与压缩率上同时具备竞争力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Explainability from Training with Applications to TCR-Epitope Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have achieved strong performance in artificial intelligence for science, yet their black-box nature limits our understanding of how they learn scientific tasks. Existing methods for interpretability provide limited insight into how models organize evidence and evolve during learning. We introduce explainability from training (EFT), a model-agnostic paradigm that traces model interpretation during training to explain why models rely on specific features and how they organize these features as predictive evidence. We apply EFT to four state-of-the-art T cell receptor (TCR)-epitope prediction models, TCR-SRIM, TULIP, MixTCRpred, and NetTCR-2.2, spanning post-hoc and interpret-by-design approaches as well as transformers and CNNs. To investigate how structural information affects model explanations, we introduce a benchmark, TCR-XAI2, containing 388 unique experimentally resolved TCR-epitope structures, complemented by structures predicted using AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, TCRModel2, tFold-TCR, and OpenFold3. Using EFT with TCR-XAI2, we demonstrate that (1) CNN and transformer models exhibit distinct learning trajectories; (2) TCR $α$ and $β$ evidence can conflict during learning, limiting the benefits of jointly modeling both chains, while MHC information mitigates this; and (3) real versus predicted structural data for TCR-epitope prediction exhibits distinct TCR and peptide feature preferences as well as differing trajectories of model certainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 explainability from training (EFT)，在训练过程中追踪模型解释，说明模型为何依赖特定特征、如何把特征组织成预测证据。应用于四个 TCR-epitope 预测模型并配套 388 个实验解析结构的 TCR-XAI2 基准，发现 CNN 与 transformer 学习轨迹不同，TCR α/β 链证据在学习中会冲突、MHC 信息可缓解，真实与预测结构数据呈现不同的特征偏好与模型确定性轨迹。
Motivation: 深度学习在 AI for science 中表现强但黑箱，现有可解释性方法难以说明模型如何组织证据、证据在学习过程中如何演化。
Method: EFT 是模型无关范式，在训练期间追踪解释；应用于 TCR-SRIM、TULIP、MixTCRpred、NetTCR-2.2 四个 SOTA TCR-epitope 模型（涵盖 post-hoc 与 interpret-by-design、transformer 与 CNN），并引入 TCR-XAI2 基准，含 388 个实验解析结构，辅以 AlphaFold3、Boltz-2、TCRModel2、tFold-TCR、OpenFold3 预测结构。
Result: 三项发现：CNN 与 transformer 学习轨迹不同；TCR α 与 β 链证据在学习中会冲突、限制联合建模两条链的收益，而 MHC 信息可缓解；真实与预测结构数据在 TCR 与 peptide 特征偏好及模型确定性轨迹上均不同。
Conclusion: 模型对特征的依赖是在训练中逐步组织出来的，且受结构数据来源（真实 vs 预测）影响，因此解释应从训练过程而非仅从最终模型读取。

papers.title: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform well on shorter-horizon manipulation tasks but still struggle with long-horizon tasks that require multiple dependent manipulations from a single command. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies through environment interaction, yet many existing methods provide reward only after the complete task succeeds. However, such terminal supervision is sparse and does not distinguish early failures from rollouts that make substantial partial progress. We propose StructRL, an online RL framework that constructs structured intermediate supervision from verifiable subtask completions. StructRL decomposes each task into verifiable subtasks, grants intermediate rewards only after the prerequisite subtasks have been completed, and scales each reward according to completion pace. Across RoboCasa365 and LIBERO-Long with GR00T-N1.5 and pi 0.5, StructRL consistently outperforms evaluated online RL baselines. These results show that verifiable, structured intermediate rewards improve long-horizon VLA post-training. Code is available at https://github.com/amazon-science/StructRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StructRL 为长时程视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 任务构造结构化中间奖励：把任务拆成可验证子任务，只有前置子任务完成后才发放该步奖励，并按完成节奏缩放奖励大小。在 RoboCasa365 与 LIBERO-Long 上配合 GR00T-N1.5 和 pi0.5，其在线 RL 后训练稳定优于所评测的在线 RL 基线。
Motivation: 长时程操作任务需要单条指令串起多次依赖动作，而现有在线 RL 多在整任务成功后才给终局奖励，稀疏信号无法区分早期失败与已取得大量部分进展的 rollout。
Method: StructRL 是在线 RL 框架：将每个任务分解为可验证 (verifiable) 子任务，仅在前置子任务完成后发放该步中间奖励，并按完成节奏 (completion pace) 缩放奖励幅度，用于 VLA 模型后训练。
Result: 在 RoboCasa365 与 LIBERO-Long 上，配合 GR00T-N1.5 与 pi0.5 两个 VLA 模型，StructRL 一致优于所评测的在线 RL 基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 可验证的结构化中间奖励能改善长时程 VLA 后训练，其关键在于按子任务前置关系与完成节奏发放而非只看终局成败。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Representation by Design in Generation: Cross-View Class-Token Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Generative and representation learning remain asymmetrically connected: semantic representations are used to improve diffusion generation, whereas the models' own representations are often treated as a by-product of synthesis. We ask whether diffusion models can instead be trained to learn substantially stronger semantic representations without sacrificing generation quality. SelfFlow takes a step in this direction by introducing self-supervised patch alignment into flow matching, but its main gains remain in faster convergence and improved generation. Inspired by DINO and iBOT, we extend this framework with cross-view class-token alignment to further strengthen semantic representations. Specifically, we form two independently noised, dual-timestep observations of each image and align each student class-token representation with the stop-gradient EMA-teacher target from the other observation. This objective is optimized jointly with the inherited flow-matching and local patch objectives. Notably, although the additional objective acts only on the class token, it strengthens both class-token and patch representations. Compared with a matched two-view baseline, ImageNet linear-probing accuracy improves by 9.4\% using the class token and 10.1\% using mean-pooled patch tokens, while frozen-backbone VOC2012 segmentation improves by 3.6 mIoU. These representation gains are achieved while maintaining comparable ImageNet generation FID. In text-to-image training, the same objective also improves generation FID, reducing it from 2.52 to 2.37 at matched checkpoints. Our results show that representation need not remain a by-product of generation or merely a tool for improving it: it can be directly optimized as a first-class capability of diffusion pretraining alongside generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 diffusion Transformer 预训练中把语义表征当作一等目标直接优化：在 flow matching 之上加入跨视角 class-token 对齐，用 EMA-teacher 的 stop-gradient 目标对齐同一图像两个独立加噪视图的 class token。ImageNet linear probing 用 class token 提升 9.4%、mean-pooled patch token 提升 10.1%，冻结骨干的 VOC2012 分割提升 3.6 mIoU，同时 ImageNet 生成 FID 持平；文生图训练中 FID 从 2.52 降到 2.37。
Motivation: 生成与表征学习不对称：语义表征被用来改善扩散生成，而模型自身的表征只是合成的副产品。问题在于能否在不牺牲生成质量的前提下，让扩散模型学到明显更强的语义表征。
Method: 在 SelfFlow（把自监督 patch 对齐引入 flow matching）基础上，借鉴 DINO 与 iBOT 加入跨视角 class-token 对齐：对每张图构造两个独立加噪、双 timestep 的观测，把学生 class-token 表征与另一观测经 stop-gradient EMA-teacher 得到的目标对齐，该目标与继承的 flow-matching 目标及 local patch 目标联合优化。
Result: 相对 matched two-view 基线：ImageNet linear-probing 准确率用 class token 提高 9.4%，用 mean-pooled patch token 提高 10.1%；冻结骨干的 VOC2012 分割提高 3.6 mIoU；ImageNet 生成 FID 保持相当。文生图训练中同一目标还改善生成 FID，在 matched checkpoints 上从 2.52 降到 2.37。
Conclusion: 表征不必只是生成的副产品或改善生成的工具，可以在扩散预训练中与生成并列作为一等能力直接优化；只作用于 class token 的额外目标同时增强 class-token 与 patch 表征，且不牺牲生成质量。

papers.title: ThuRunel: Dynamic Decoupling for Structured Advisory Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: High-stakes advisory domains such as medical aesthetics, legal consultation, and educational planning exhibit a two-phase structure. The early phase requires empathetic elicitation and emotional support, and the late phase requires authoritative specialist judgment. Neither fully automated agents nor human junior consultants adequately address this structure at scale. We formalize the core design challenge as dynamic decoupling, asking how an AI advisory agent should decide what to ask, when to stop, what to resolve autonomously, and what to forward to the specialist. We present ThuRunel, an advisory agent combining a finite-state belief management framework, a chain-of-thought teacher synthesis protocol, and learned generation adapters. Against eleven baselines, ThuRunel achieves consistent improvements in elicitation completeness and specialist brief quality. ThuRunel is publicly deployed as a bilingual web application in which the same decoupling decisions operate from the client's side, grounded in a curated knowledge base that cites its sources in every answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThuRunel 把高风险咨询（医美、法律、教育规划）的两阶段结构形式化为动态解耦 (dynamic decoupling)：由有限状态信念管理框架决定问什么、何时停、什么自行处理、什么转交专家。对十一个基线取得引出完整性与专家简报质量的一致提升，并以双语 Web 应用公开部署，每条回答引用其知识库来源。
Motivation: 医美、法律咨询、教育规划这类高风险场景前段需要共情式信息引出、后段需要权威专家判断，全自动 agent 与人类初级顾问都无法在规模化时兼顾这两段。
Method: ThuRunel 结合有限状态信念管理框架 (finite-state belief management)、chain-of-thought 教师合成协议 (teacher synthesis protocol) 与学习式生成适配器 (generation adapters)，并以人工整理、逐条引用来源的知识库支撑回答。
Result: 对十一个基线 (eleven baselines) 取得引出完整性 (elicitation completeness) 与专家简报质量 (specialist brief quality) 的一致提升；论文含 22 幅图、8 张表，共 14 页。
Conclusion: 动态解耦决策可同时服务客户端与转交专家两侧，让咨询 agent 在两阶段高风险对话中规模化给出可溯源的回答。

papers.title: Adapting Linear-Time Architectures for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models achieve strong performance by conditioning on labelled examples in context, but softmax attention limits their use on large datasets. Existing linear-time alternatives, however, are mostly causal, and their potential for tabular in-context learning (ICL) remains underexplored. To address this, we (1) revisit causal training setups, (2) compare linear sequence mixers, and (3) investigate their ICL generalisation beyond the pretraining context length. First, we show that the best training setup for causal models resembles next-token prediction. Then, perhaps surprisingly, the most promising linear sequence mixer is causal: DeltaNet outperforms even non-causal linear attention. However, it degrades beyond $2$-$4\times$ the pretraining context length, and existing mitigation strategies such as bidirectionality defer the problem at best. A hidden-state oracle shows that this is not a capacity problem. Instead, our analysis points to an instability in the recurrent state, which drifts in deeper layers of causal models. Since DeltaNet's learned write rates overfit to the pretraining regime, we modulate them with a time-dependent decay schedule intervention to stabilise length generalisation. Finally, re-introducing non-causality by reading out from the final state allows us to closely match a controlled softmax attention baseline on OpenML-CC18 and TabArena.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/schnurrd/ICL-Architectures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表格 in-context learning (ICL) 中，因果线性序列混合器 DeltaNet 表现超过非因果线性注意力，但外推到预训练上下文长度的 2–4 倍后性能退化；作者定位为递归状态漂移而非容量不足，并用时间相关衰减调度调制 DeltaNet 的写入率来稳定长度泛化，最后从最终状态读出恢复非因果性，在 OpenML-CC18 与 TabArena 上接近 softmax attention 基线。
Motivation: 表格基础模型靠上下文中的标注样本取得强性能，但 softmax attention 限制了在大数据集上的使用；现有线性时间替代方案多为因果式，其在表格 ICL 中的潜力尚未充分探索。
Method: 三步：重新审视因果模型的训练配置（发现最优配置类似 next-token prediction），比较多种线性序列混合器，并研究超出预训练上下文长度的 ICL 泛化；用 hidden-state oracle 区分容量问题与递归状态不稳定性，再以时间相关衰减调度 (time-dependent decay schedule) 干预调制 DeltaNet 学到的写入率，并从最终状态读出以重新引入非因果性。
Result: 最优因果训练配置类似 next-token prediction；DeltaNet 是最有前景的线性序列混合器并超过非因果线性注意力，但在超过预训练上下文长度 2–4 倍后退化，bidirectionality 等既有缓解策略至多推迟该问题；hidden-state oracle 表明这不是容量问题，分析指向深层因果模型中递归状态漂移导致的不稳定性；恢复非因果读出后在 OpenML-CC18 与 TabArena 上接近受控的 softmax attention 基线。
Conclusion: 因果性本身不是表格 ICL 长度泛化的障碍，真正的瓶颈是 DeltaNet 写入率对预训练长度的过拟合引发的递归状态漂移，可通过衰减调度干预加最终状态读出来稳定并追平 softmax 基线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models rely on representation geometry for planning, yet regularizing the latent marginal alone does not determine the state-to-state relationships used for action selection. We show that this can cause planning-relevant novelty structure to be weakened as representations are transformed into the final latent used by the planner. We introduce Aligned Transport of Latent Structure (ATLAS), a training objective that explicitly preserves relational geometry while calibrating the global latent distribution. ATLAS transfers normalized pairwise structure from an informative encoder representation to the planning latent and uses Wasserstein embedding matching (WEMReg) to calibrate its marginal through one-dimensional Wasserstein-2 transport. Our analysis shows that relational preservation and marginal calibration impose non-redundant constraints, and connects finite-candidate planning stability to relational distortion, latent-scale mismatch, and prediction error. Instantiated in LeWM, ATLAS improves mean goal-reaching success across PushT, TwoRoom, and OGBench-Cube on both lower- and higher-novelty evaluation subsets, with the largest gain on higher-novelty TwoRoom episodes. Representation and rollout diagnostics further show stronger novelty-related structure in the planning latent, improved marginal calibration, and lower multi-step prediction error. Together, these results highlight preservation of planning-relevant latent geometry as an important ingredient for reliable world-model planning. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atlas-world-model-72C4/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATLAS 通过在训练目标中显式保持状态间关系几何来提升世界模型规划的可靠性：把编码器表示上的归一化成对结构迁移到规划 latent，并用一维 Wasserstein-2 传输的 WEMReg 校准其边缘分布。在 LeWM 中于 PushT、TwoRoom、OGBench-Cube 上提高平均到达目标成功率，高新颖度 TwoRoom 回合增益最大。
Motivation: 只正则 latent 边缘分布无法决定动作选择所依赖的状态间关系，表示在被变换为规划器最终使用的过程中，与规划相关的新颖度结构会被削弱。
Method: ATLAS 训练目标包含两部分：从信息量更大的编码器表示向规划 latent 迁移归一化成对结构 (normalized pairwise structure)，以及用 Wasserstein embedding matching (WEMReg) 通过一维 Wasserstein-2 传输校准边缘分布；分析把有限候选规划稳定性与关系失真、latent 尺度失配和预测误差联系起来，并在 LeWM 中实例化。
Result: 在 PushT、TwoRoom、OGBench-Cube 上，低新颖度与高新颖度评测子集的平均到达目标成功率均提升，最大增益出现在高新颖度 TwoRoom 回合；表示与 rollout 诊断显示规划 latent 中新颖度相关结构更强、边缘校准改善、多步预测误差更低。
Conclusion: 关系保持与边缘校准施加的是非冗余约束，保持与规划相关的 latent 几何是可靠世界模型规划的关键成分。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Calibrating One-Round Membership Inference with Neighbors
papers.abstract_en: The state-of-the-art Membership Inference (MI) methods calibrate their signal separately for each example using reference models, auxiliary models trained to exclude the target. This paradigm scales poorly to modern large models, however, whose training is too expensive to replicate. This has motivated one-round settings, where only a single trained model is available; but without reference models the per-example calibration that drives the strongest attacks can no longer be estimated, leaving the membership signal weak. We ask whether neighbors of the target point can recover this calibration without training any additional model. Our key observation is that reference models serve only to reveal how an example behaves under models not trained on it, and that querying the target model on nearby samples yields the same information. We propose two complementary ways to obtain such neighbors, and show that querying them against an early training checkpoint further sharpens the signal. We evaluate across three image classification datasets and three training setups, showing that neighbors yield strong membership signals and competitive attack performance at no additional training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只允许访问单个已训练模型的 one-round 成员推断 (membership inference) 设定下，用目标点的邻居查询替代 reference model 来恢复逐样本校准：对邻居查询目标模型、并结合早期训练 checkpoint 查询可进一步锐化成员信号。在三个图像分类数据集与三种训练设定上，邻居方法给出强成员信号和有竞争力的攻击性能，且不额外训练任何模型。
Motivation: SOTA 成员推断依赖 reference model（排除目标样本训练的辅助模型）做逐样本校准，但现代大模型训练成本太高无法复制，one-round 设定下没有 reference model 就无法估计校准，成员信号变弱。
Method: 核心观察是 reference model 只用于揭示样本在未见过它的模型下的行为，而对目标点附近样本查询目标模型可获得同等信息。据此提出两种互补的邻居获取方式，并把邻居查询对齐到早期训练 checkpoint 以进一步锐化信号，全程不训练额外模型。
Result: 在三个图像分类数据集和三种训练设定上的评估显示：邻居查询能产生强成员信号与有竞争力的攻击性能，且无额外训练成本。
Conclusion: 邻居查询可以在 one-round 设定下替代 reference model 的逐样本校准，以零额外训练代价恢复强成员推断信号。
