papers.title: DecoyTrace: Toxic Decoys for Active Defense in Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server, reducing the single point of observation that traditional defenses against attacks rely on. As a result, peer-to-peer networks become exposed to malicious updates containing backdoors or semantic poisoning, since such updates can remain close to benign ones in the parameter space while behaving very differently. This may evade defenses based on passive parameter inspection. However, existing deception-based defenses have mainly been designed for centralized FL and do not jointly address local observation, poisoning propagation, source attribution, and containment in strictly serverless DFL. To address these limitations, this paper presents DecoyTrace, a proactive cyber deception-based defense for strictly serverless DFL environments. DecoyTrace deploys a mobile DecoyNode that generates decoy challenges using chaotic maps, disseminates a dual model (clean vs. decoy) based on neighbor trust, and evaluates them using three-state semantic metrics. Upon confirmation, a distributed protocol isolates the source and performs a model reset or recovery to preserve training progress. Evaluated across sixty configurations on the NEBULA platform (five datasets, three topologies, and four attack/defense scenarios), DecoyTrace systematically restores lost utility. The F1-score remains within 0.03 of the baseline on MNIST/FashionMNIST (mitigating drops of up to 0.37), matches or exceeds the baseline on EMNIST and CIFAR-100, and remains between 0.05 and 0.10 below the baseline on CIFAR-10, the most visually complex convolutional scenario evaluated. Furthermore, containment reduces CPU and network usage by up to two-thirds. These results demonstrate the feasibility of unifying deception, identification, and containment in DFL, while also identifying its limitations in complex tasks and multi-attractor threat models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DecoyTrace 在无中心服务器的去中心化联邦学习 (DFL) 中用移动 DecoyNode 主动投毒式诱骗：混沌映射生成 decoy challenge，按邻居信任分发 clean/decoy 双模型，用三态语义指标判定后由分布式协议隔离源头并做模型重置或恢复。在 NEBULA 平台 60 组配置（5 数据集、3 拓扑、4 攻防场景）上，MNIST/FashionMNIST 的 F1 与基线差距保持在 0.03 内（挽回最高 0.37 的跌幅），EMNIST 与 CIFAR-100 持平或超过基线，CIFAR-10 仍低 0.05–0.10；遏制阶段 CPU 与网络占用最多减少三分之二。
Motivation: 去掉中心聚合服务器后，传统依赖单点观测的被动参数检查防御失效：含后门或语义中毒的更新在参数空间贴近良性更新却行为迥异。现有欺骗类防御主要为集中式 FL 设计，未在严格无服务器的 DFL 中同时处理本地观测、中毒传播、源头归因与遏制。
Method: 部署可移动的 DecoyNode，用混沌映射 (chaotic maps) 生成 decoy challenge；依据邻居信任分发 clean 与 decoy 双模型，并用三态语义指标 (three-state semantic metrics) 评估响应；确认中毒后由分布式协议隔离源头，并执行模型重置或恢复以保住训练进度。
Result: 在 NEBULA 平台 60 组配置（5 数据集、3 拓扑、4 攻防场景）上：MNIST/FashionMNIST 的 F1 与基线差距在 0.03 以内，挽回最高 0.37 的跌幅；EMNIST 与 CIFAR-100 持平或超过基线；CIFAR-10 低于基线 0.05–0.10；遏制使 CPU 与网络使用量最多减少三分之二。
Conclusion: 在严格无服务器 DFL 中把欺骗、识别与遏制统一到一个协议是可行的，但在视觉复杂度高的卷积任务（CIFAR-10）和多吸引子威胁模型下仍有力所不及之处。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reducing the Adaptation Gap Through Reachable Fisher Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) determines not only how many parameters are trained, but also which local directions a model can move in, so similar adapters can affect subgroup losses differently. Since curvature matrices are infeasible to form at adapter scale, scalar summaries such as the Fisher trace are often used instead. We study what the trace reveals and what it loses through the reachable Fisher: each subgroup's full-model Fisher pulled back through the adapter Jacobian. Under likelihood losses, it represents the Gauss-Newton curvature accessible to the adapter, and its trace can be computed from score-gradient norms without forming the full matrix. Under matched subgroup gradients, a positive-definite reachable-Fisher difference, with a margin exceeding the Hessian-Fisher defect, implies that every sufficiently small nonzero model-changing update increases the signed gap. In contrast, the restricted operator norm determines worst-case quadratic change, while a matrix-free Frobenius discrepancy bounds its reachable-Fisher component. Trace alone cannot certify definiteness or control matrix mismatch. Equal traces rule out a positive-definite difference but can still hide large operator discrepancies. Across 306 single-seed models, higher trace accompanies greater subgroup difficulty in 75.7 percent of 1,218 eligible evaluations, while trace matching reduces the best-worst subgroup gap in all 30 dataset-encoder-adapter combinations. However, held-out audits show that operator discrepancy decreases in 23 of 30 combinations, while the unbiased squared-Frobenius statistic decreases in only 16 of 30. Fisher trace is therefore a scalable diagnostic and training heuristic, but not a certificate of local gap behavior or matrix alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEFT 中常用 Fisher trace 作为可扩展诊断，但本文证明 trace 无法判定 reachable Fisher 差的正定性、也无法控制矩阵失配：等 trace 只能排除正定差，仍可能隐藏大的算子范数偏差。在 306 个单种子模型上，trace 更高在 1,218 次合格评估的 75.7% 中伴随子群更难，trace matching 在全部 30 个 dataset-encoder-adapter 组合中缩小最优-最差子群差距，但 held-out 审计中算子偏差仅在 30 个组合中的 23 个下降、无偏平方 Frobenius 统计量仅在 16 个中下降。
Motivation: PEFT 决定模型可移动的局部方向，相似 adapter 对子群损失影响不同；曲率矩阵在 adapter 规模不可行，实践中退化为 Fisher trace 这类标量摘要，而它可能掩盖子群差距的真实局部行为。
Method: 定义 reachable Fisher：各子群全模型 Fisher 经 adapter Jacobian 拉回；似然损失下它等于 adapter 可达的 Gauss-Newton 曲率，trace 可由 score-gradient 范数计算而不构造全矩阵。给出基于正定差与 Hessian-Fisher defect 裕度的判定条件，并用 restricted operator norm 与 matrix-free Frobenius discrepancy 分别界定最坏二次变化与 reachable-Fisher 分量。
Result: 306 个单种子模型、1,218 次合格评估中 75.7% 显示更高 trace 伴随更高子群难度；trace matching 在全部 30 个 dataset-encoder-adapter 组合中降低最优-最差子群差距。held-out 审计中算子偏差在 30 个组合的 23 个下降，而无偏平方 Frobenius 统计量仅在 16 个下降。
Conclusion: Fisher trace 是可扩展的诊断与训练启发式，但不是子群差距局部行为或矩阵对齐的证书；等 trace 排除正定差却仍可能隐藏大的算子偏差。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.motivation: PEFT 决定模型可移动的局部方向，相似 adapter 对子群损失影响不同；曲率矩阵在 adapter 规模不可行，实践中退化为 Fisher trace 这类标量摘要，而它可能掩盖子群差距的真实局部行为。
summary_sections.method: 定义 reachable Fisher：各子群全模型 Fisher 经 adapter Jacobian 拉回；似然损失下它等于 adapter 可达的 Gauss-Newton 曲率，trace 可由 score-gradient 范数计算而不构造全矩阵。给出基于正定差与 Hessian-Fisher defect 裕度的判定条件，并用 restricted operator norm 与 matrix-free Frobenius discrepancy 分别界定最坏二次变化与 reachable-Fisher 分量。
summary_sections.result: 306 个单种子模型、1,218 次合格评估中 75.7% 显示更高 trace 伴随更高子群难度；trace matching 在全部 30 个 dataset-encoder-adapter 组合中降低最优-最差子群差距。held-out 审计中算子偏差在 30 个组合的 23 个下降，而无偏平方 Frobenius 统计量仅在 16 个下降。
summary_sections.conclusion: Fisher trace 是可扩展的诊断与训练启发式，但不是子群差距局部行为或矩阵对齐的证书；等 trace 排除正定差却仍可能隐藏大的算子偏差。

papers.title: PILLAR: Private Inverted-Index Lexical Lookup for Augmented Retrieval
authors: Evgenios M. Kornaropoulos (2) ((1) Arizona State University
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) hands the user's query to whoever hosts the corpus. We propose PILLAR, a Privacy-Preserving RAG (PPRAG) system based on Private Information Retrieval (PIR) in which a client utilizes the k documents most similar to their query from a server-held and publicly known corpus to respond to their query, while the server learns nothing about the query, either its terms or its access pattern. Prior PPRAG constructions rely on dense retrieval alone, translating approximate nearest-neighbor search into many query-dependent rounds of PIR, and pay for it in both latency and retrieval quality. PILLAR instead performs private hybrid retrieval in two stages. A sparse stage issues a small, fixed number of PIR queries against a carefully designed index of precomputed BM25 scores, filtering the corpus down to candidates that share terms with the query without the server ever seeing which terms these are. A dense stage then fetches only those candidates' document embeddings and re-ranks them locally, avoiding the many costly PIR queries that private dense retrieval typically requires. We instantiate PILLAR with two protocols that trade latency against retrieval quality, each built on a different private rendering of lexical search. PILLAR-Bin bins posting lists into a hash table and is a single-round design that achieves lower latency than state-of-the-art private retrieval schemes. PILLAR-Tree turns block-max pruning into an oblivious tree traversal combined with cuckoo hash tables and achieves the highest retrieval quality at lower latency than state-of-the-art schemes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PILLAR 是基于私有信息检索 (PIR) 的隐私保护 RAG 系统：先用固定少量 PIR 查询对预计算 BM25 分数索引做稀疏过滤，再只取候选文档 embedding 在本地重排，服务器对查询词与访问模式均不可见。两个实例中 PILLAR-Bin 单轮、延迟低于 SOTA 私有检索方案，PILLAR-Tree 用 block-max 剪枝的 oblivious 树遍历加 cuckoo hash 达到最高检索质量且延迟同样更低。
Motivation: RAG 把用户查询交给语料托管方；既有 PPRAG 只做稠密检索，把近邻搜索转成多轮查询相关 PIR，延迟与检索质量同时受损。
Method: 两阶段私有混合检索：稀疏阶段对预计算 BM25 分数索引发固定次数 PIR 查询筛出共享词项的候选；稠密阶段仅取这些候选的文档 embedding 本地重排。PILLAR-Bin 将倒排表分桶进哈希表实现单轮；PILLAR-Tree 把 block-max 剪枝改写为 oblivious 树遍历并配 cuckoo hash 表。
Result: PILLAR-Bin 为单轮设计，延迟低于当前最先进的私有检索方案；PILLAR-Tree 取得最高检索质量，且延迟同样低于 SOTA 方案。摘要给出的是相对比较，无绝对数值。
Conclusion: 把词法检索的私有化与稠密重排分工，可在不向服务器泄露查询词项与访问模式的前提下同时压低延迟并保住检索质量；两个协议按延迟与质量权衡取用。

papers.title: Distill Locally, Schedule Globally: Flow Maps for Few-Step Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching text-to-speech (TTS) models achieve high synthesis quality but require many neural function evaluations (NFEs) to integrate their generative trajectories. Recent few-step flow-map distillation approaches for TTS construct targets from numerically integrated teacher trajectories, creating a trade-off between target accuracy and training cost. We propose Local Flow-Map Distillation (LFMD), which adapts Eulerian Map Distillation to conditional TTS and avoids teacher trajectory integration during target construction. For inference, we derive a sampling schedule (TD-DP) from teacher dynamics and consistency of the learned maps, with a single cost graph supporting multiple NFE budgets without external audio-metric evaluation. Because scheduling offers no flexibility at one NFE, we refine this regime with alignment-aware temporal self-distillation using soft-DTW. Across Seed-TTS and LibriSpeech-PC, LFMD improves low-NFE synthesis over a matched integral-distillation baseline. On Seed-TTS, the refined student reaches 1.80% WER with 1-NFE, compared with 1.76% for its 32-NFE teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Local Flow-Map Distillation (LFMD)，把 Eulerian Map Distillation 改造到条件 TTS 上，构造蒸馏目标时不再积分教师轨迹，并从教师动力学与学到的 map 一致性推出采样调度 TD-DP，单张代价图即可覆盖多个 NFE 预算。在 Seed-TTS 上精炼后的学生模型 1-NFE 达到 1.80% WER，其 32-NFE 教师为 1.76%。
Motivation: Flow-matching TTS 合成质量高但需要大量 NFE；现有 few-step flow-map 蒸馏用数值积分的教师轨迹构造目标，目标精度与训练成本互相牵制。
Method: LFMD 将 Eulerian Map Distillation 适配到条件 TTS，目标构造阶段避开教师轨迹积分；推理端由教师动力学与学习到的 map 一致性推导 TD-DP 采样调度，单一代价图支持多个 NFE 预算且无需外部音频指标评测；1-NFE 这一无调度余地的档位再用基于 soft-DTW 的 alignment-aware temporal self-distillation 精炼。
Result: 在 Seed-TTS 与 LibriSpeech-PC 上，LFMD 相对匹配的 integral-distillation 基线改善了低 NFE 合成；Seed-TTS 上精炼学生 1-NFE WER 1.80%，其 32-NFE 教师为 1.76%。
Conclusion: 避开教师轨迹积分的局部蒸馏加全局调度，可以把 flow-matching TTS 压到 1-NFE 而 WER 逼近 32-NFE 教师；1-NFE 档位需靠时间自蒸馏补足调度带来的灵活性缺失。

papers.title: Towards an AI Software Factory for Data Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted coding tools deliver significant acceleration of coding, but only limited impact across the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC)--an Amdahl's law effect! In this paper, we discuss our progress towards building an AI SW Factory that accelerates all the stages of SDLC-Targeting, Coding, Reviewing, and Ops. The AI SW Factory produces a metadata exhaust that enables self-improvement by fine-tuning model weights and updating our World Model (a rich data substrate). We focus on Data Systems and the important class of Evolutionary Coding Tasks (i.e., those with a measurable objective to hill-climb) and report on 1) scaled deployments at Microsoft (tens of repositories) leading to 3x engineering efficiency above agentic coding and up to 22x token efficiency, and 2) several open challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向数据系统 (Data Systems) 的 AI 软件工厂，把 SDLC 的 Targeting、Coding、Reviewing、Ops 全阶段纳入加速，并用流程产生的 metadata exhaust 微调模型权重、更新 World Model 数据底座实现自我改进。在 Microsoft 数十个仓库的规模化部署中，相对 agentic coding 达到 3 倍工程效率、最高 22 倍 token 效率。
Motivation: AI 编码工具只加速了编码环节，对端到端软件开发生命周期整体提升有限（Amdahl's law 效应），瓶颈在 Targeting、Reviewing、Ops 等未被覆盖的阶段。
Method: 构建覆盖 SDLC 四阶段（Targeting、Coding、Reviewing、Ops）的 AI SW Factory；流程产出 metadata exhaust，用于微调模型权重并更新 World Model（富数据底座）；重点处理数据系统中带可度量目标、可爬山优化的 Evolutionary Coding Tasks。
Result: 在 Microsoft 数十个仓库的规模化部署中，相对 agentic coding 实现 3 倍工程效率提升，token 效率最高达 22 倍；论文同时报告若干开放挑战。
Conclusion: 把 AI 加速从编码扩展到整个 SDLC 并复用流程元数据做自我改进，可在数据系统工程上带来数倍效率与数量级 token 节省，但仍有开放挑战待解。

papers.title: Periodic Weak Spots: Phase Sensitivity from Chunked KV-Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Chunked KV-cache compression reduces the memory and attention costs of long-context inference by compressing windows of consecutive tokens into fewer cache entries at a fixed stride. Such compression also introduces a new positional coordinate: a token's phase, or its position relative to compression-window boundaries. We uncover a systematic asymmetry in models using such compression: the same information can be easy to retrieve at one phase and difficult at another. We call this periodic variation in retrieval performance phase sensitivity. In large open-weight models with such compression, long-context retrieval accuracy can differ by up to 40 percentage points across phases, revealing periodic weak spots that average benchmark scores can conceal. To investigate this behavior, we pretrain a family of transformers from scratch across multiple KV-compression designs, reproducing phase sensitivity across the variants. Mechanistic analysis using causal interventions in these models reveals phase specialization: different attention components contribute asymmetrically to retrieving information at different source phases. We further analyze idealized retrieval models, showing how gradient flow dynamics may favor sharp phase specialization. Evaluating models with chunked KV-cache compression thus requires measuring across compression phases: high average accuracy can coexist with systematic positional failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 分块 KV-cache 压缩给 token 引入了新的位置坐标——相位（相对压缩窗口边界的偏移），同一信息在不同相位上的可检索性系统性不同。在采用该压缩的大规模开源权重模型中，长上下文检索准确率随相位波动可达 40 个百分点，而平均分会掩盖这些周期性弱点；因此评测必须跨压缩相位分别测量。
Motivation: 分块 KV-cache 压缩在降低长上下文推理的显存与注意力开销的同时引入了相位这一新坐标，但平均检索分数会掩盖随相位变化的系统性位置失效，模型在某些相位上难以取回信息。
Method: 先在采用分块 KV 压缩的大型开源权重模型上观察相位敏感性；再从零预训练一族覆盖多种 KV 压缩设计的 Transformer 以复现该现象；随后用因果干预做机制分析，定位不同 attention 组件对不同源相位检索的非对称贡献；最后分析理想化检索模型的梯度流动力学。
Result: 采用分块 KV 压缩的大型开源权重模型中，长上下文检索准确率在不同相位间差异最高达 40 个百分点；从零预训练的多压缩设计 Transformer 家族复现了相位敏感性；因果干预揭示相位特化（phase specialization），理想化模型的梯度流分析表明其动力学有利于尖锐的相位特化。
Conclusion: 相位敏感性是分块 KV-cache 压缩的系统性副作用，评测此类模型必须跨压缩相位测量，高平均准确率可以与系统性位置失效并存。

papers.title: StateTape: Action-Conditioned Evidence Lifecycle Modeling for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Despite the recent success of coding agents built on large language models, it remains challenging to run them over long horizons, since every observation is appended to the context and the context grows with each one. History-based maintenance is a common remedy, which masks or summarizes old observations, or prunes what a model reads as useless, and bounds the context at little cost. However, it decides from the text of the history alone and sees nothing of how the code is connected. Since a coding agent edits code many times over a single task, and each write can change what code elsewhere means, such maintenance may keep records a write has falsified, drop ones that still hold, and miss code the agent needs next. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes StateTape, a novel and scalable framework that rewrites a coding agent's context as the repository changes rather than as the context grows. The key idea of StateTape is to model the repository as a symbol-level code graph, whose dependencies and language rules expose which symbols a write can affect. Upon this graph, a tape marks the symbols each write changed, which turns staleness from an inference about text into an observation of the agent's writes. We propose a per-write procedure in which the tape nominates the records a write could have falsified while a small manager model settles what the write log cannot, and further provide a theoretical analysis and TraceBench, a benchmark that labels what an agent is holding against what is actually needed. Empirically, we demonstrate that StateTape can effectively clear falsified records and retrieve what is needed, and thus achieve a higher resolve rate in all experiments spanned by six coding agents and three edit-heavy benchmarks with little computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StateTape 把编码 agent 的上下文维护从「随上下文增长而裁剪」改为「随仓库变化而重写」：以符号级 code graph 刻画依赖与语言规则，用 tape 记录每次写入改动了哪些符号，再由逐写入流程提名可能被证伪的记录、交由小型 manager 模型裁决。在六个编码 agent、三个重编辑基准上，它清除了被证伪记录并检索到所需信息，resolve rate 在全部实验中更高且计算开销很小。
Motivation: 长时程编码 agent 每条观测都追加进上下文，历史式维护只看文本、看不到代码连接，于是会保留已被写入证伪的记录、丢掉仍然成立的记录，并漏掉 agent 下一步真正需要的代码。
Method: StateTape 将仓库建模为符号级 code graph，依赖与语言规则暴露一次写入能影响哪些符号；图上用 tape 标记每次写入改动的符号，把陈旧性从文本推断变成对写入的直接观测。逐写入流程中 tape 提名该写入可能证伪的记录，小型 manager 模型裁决写入日志无法判定的部分；另给出理论分析与 TraceBench 基准，标注 agent 手头持有的记录与实际需要的记录之差。
Result: 在六个编码 agent、三个 edit-heavy 基准的全部实验中，StateTape 都取得更高的 resolve rate，能有效清除被证伪的记录并检索到所需内容，且计算开销很小。
Conclusion: 上下文维护应随仓库变化而非随上下文增长来触发：以写入为观测、以 code graph 为影响范围，可以在低成本下同时解决陈旧记录清理与所需记录检索。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: StateTape 把编码 agent 的上下文维护从「随上下文增长而裁剪」改为「随仓库变化而重写」：以符号级 code graph 刻画依赖与语言规则，用 tape 记录每次写入改动了哪些符号，再由逐写入流程提名可能被证伪的记录、交由小型 manager 模型裁决。在六个编码 agent、三个重编辑基准上，它清除了被证伪记录并检索到所需信息，resolve rate 在全部实验中更高且计算开销很小。
summary_sections.motivation: 长时程编码 agent 每条观测都追加进上下文，历史式维护只看文本、看不到代码连接，于是会保留已被写入证伪的记录、丢掉仍然成立的记录，并漏掉 agent 下一步真正需要的代码。

summary_sections.result: 在六个编码 agent、三个 edit-heavy 基准的全部实验中，StateTape 都取得更高的 resolve rate，能有效清除被证伪的记录并检索到所需内容，且计算开销很小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 上下文维护应随仓库变化而非随上下文增长来触发：以写入为观测、以 code graph 为影响范围，可以在低成本下同时解决陈旧记录清理与所需记录检索。

papers.title: Training LLMs to Verbalize Evaluation Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation awareness (EA) can cause large language models (LLMs) to behave differently during audits than in deployment, yet measuring and accounting for EA remains challenging. We introduce verbalization training (VT), a method for making LLMs less reticent about verbalizing evaluation awareness while avoiding to supervise the latent belief itself. VT uses a model's spontaneous verbalizations as evidence that awareness is present and truncates each rollout immediately before the verbalization, producing training prefixes at which the model is presumed to be aware. The model is then trained with an RL objective designed to increase verbalization in a calibrated way. Across Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Kimi K2.6, and Inkling, VT increases verbalized EA by 2.4-2.9 times and transfers to held-out agentic settings, while measured latent EA and behavior remain largely stable. In a causal experiment, we independently implant meta-knowledge about evaluations through synthetic-document fine-tuning and show that VT-induced verbalizations reflect the richer knowledge acquired by the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 verbalization training (VT)：把模型自发说出「我意识到自己在被评估」的时刻当作证据，在该时刻前截断 rollout 作为训练前缀，再用校准的 RL 目标提高说出评估意识 (evaluation awareness, EA) 的概率，而不直接监督潜在信念。在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Kimi K2.6、Inkling 上，VT 使被说出的 EA 提高 2.4–2.9 倍并迁移到 held-out agentic 场景，同时测得的潜在 EA 与行为基本不变。
Motivation: 评估意识使 LLM 在审计与部署中表现不一致，而测量和处理 EA 一直困难：直接监督潜在信念既不可行也不可取，模型倾向于对被评估这件事保持沉默。
Method: VT 用模型自发的 verbalization 作为意识存在的证据，在每次 rollout 中紧接 verbalization 之前截断，得到被推定为「已意识到」的训练前缀；随后用以校准方式提高 verbalization 概率的 RL 目标训练，不监督 latent belief 本身。另做因果实验：用 synthetic-document fine-tuning 独立植入关于评估的 meta-knowledge。
Result: 在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Kimi K2.6、Inkling 三个模型上，VT 使 verbalized EA 提升 2.4–2.9 倍，并迁移到 held-out agentic 场景；测得的 latent EA 与模型行为大体保持稳定。因果实验显示 VT 诱导的 verbalization 反映了模型通过合成文档学到的更丰富知识。
Conclusion: 可以在不触碰潜在信念的前提下，仅靠对自发 verbalization 的 RL 训练让 LLM 更愿意说出评估意识，且这种表达随模型掌握的评估知识而变化，而非凭空编造。

papers.title: PyroStack: A Multi-Band Spatio-Temporal Sub-Daily Dataset for Wildfires in the United States
papers.abstract_en: Wildfires are an increasing hazard to ecosystems, air quality, and human systems, creating a growing need for datasets that support systematic development and evaluation of models for predicting fire spread across diverse landscapes. Effective prediction requires integrating meteorological conditions, fuels, vegetation, and topography at spatial and temporal resolutions suitable for both physical simulation and data-driven approaches. However, existing datasets often lack the resolution and coverage needed to capture these interacting controls. The PyroStack dataset addresses this gap by providing a harmonized, event-based collection of wildfire and environmental data across the contiguous United States and Alaska. It integrates satellite-derived fire observations with atmospheric reanalysis, vegetation, fuel characteristics, and topographic information into a unified framework spanning 6994 wildfires that occurred between 2012 and 2024 across a wide range of ecosystems and climate conditions. PyroStack offers spatial resolutions ranging from 30 m to 9 km and hourly temporal resolution, along with fire progression data at 12-hour intervals to support model initialization and evaluation. By combining broad spatial coverage with fine spatial and temporal detail, the dataset enables systematic analysis of wildfire dynamics and supports both physics-based and machine learning approaches, providing a foundation for benchmarking and improving fire spread models, with future extensions aimed at incorporating additional regions and fire suppression data streams to further advance wildfire prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyroStack 是一个覆盖美国本土与阿拉斯加的野火多波段时空数据集，把卫星火点观测与大气再分析、植被、燃料和地形统一到同一框架，含 2012–2024 年 6994 场野火。空间分辨率 30 m 至 9 km、时间分辨率为小时级，火势推进数据每 12 小时一帧，可直接用于物理模拟与机器学习两类火蔓延模型的初始化和评测。
Motivation: 野火蔓延预测需要同时耦合气象、燃料、植被与地形，但现有数据集在分辨率和覆盖面上不足以刻画这些交互控制，缺少支撑系统开发与评测的统一基准。
Method: 以事件为单位组织数据，融合卫星火观测、大气再分析、植被、燃料特性与地形信息，形成统一框架；提供小时级环境场与 12 小时间隔的火势推进数据，用于模型初始化和评测。
Result: 覆盖 2012–2024 年 6994 场野火，跨多种生态系统与气候条件；空间分辨率 30 m 至 9 km，时间分辨率小时级，火势推进数据 12 小时一帧；论文为 23 页、6 图、5 表。
Conclusion: 把广域覆盖与细时空细节结合，PyroStack 可作为火蔓延模型的基准底座，同时服务物理模型与机器学习方法；作者计划扩展到更多区域并纳入灭火数据流。

papers.title: Fractional State Space Transition for Long Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) compress sequence history into a bounded recurrent state, making the resulting memory law a central architectural choice for long-context performance. Most modern SSMs rely on ODE-based dynamics that lead to exponential forgetting, limiting their ability to retain information over broad temporal ranges. We introduce FRAC, a selective SSM architecture derived from fractional dynamics that replaces this exponential decay with power-law long memory. To make fractional dynamics practical, FRAC approximates the heavy-tailed target kernel with a finite-state, log-spaced sum of exponential modes. This construction turns fractional memory into an efficient recurrent module with parallel training and prefill, while retaining bounded-state autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments, including 1.3B-parameter language modeling, demonstrate that FRAC consistently improves long-context performance over state-of-the-art SSM baselines while staying competitive on short-context. These results show that fractional dynamics provide a practical and effective prior for long-context SSMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FRAC 用分数阶动力学替换现代 SSM 的 ODE 指数遗忘记忆律，把重尾目标核近似为有限状态、对数间隔的指数模态和，从而在保持有界状态与并行训练/prefill 的同时获得幂律长记忆。在 1.3B 参数语言建模上，FRAC 相对最先进 SSM 基线持续提升长上下文性能，短上下文仍具竞争力。
Motivation: 现代 SSM 普遍基于 ODE 动力学，导致指数遗忘，难以在宽时间范围内保留信息，长上下文性能受限于记忆律这一核心架构选择。
Method: 提出选择性 SSM 架构 FRAC：由分数阶动力学导出，用有限状态、对数间隔的指数模态和 (log-spaced sum of exponential modes) 近似重尾目标核，把分数记忆实现为可并行训练与 prefill 的高效递归模块，解码仍保持有界状态自回归。
Result: 在 1.3B 参数语言建模等大量实验中，FRAC 在长上下文性能上持续优于最先进 SSM 基线，同时在短上下文上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 分数阶动力学可作为长上下文 SSM 的实用且有效的先验，用可实现的有限状态近似换来幂律长记忆而不牺牲递归效率。

papers.title: Learning Samples Importance: Parameterizing Dual Variables in Everywhere Learning
papers.abstract_en: Everywhere learning provides a principled framework for training AI models under constraints that must hold throughout the data distribution. In the dual domain, these pointwise constraints give rise to functional dual variables. In this work, we propose to learn these dual variables, motivated by the fact that their values encode useful information about the underlying constrained problem. By representing the dual variable as a parametric function of each sample, we enable the learned multiplier to be evaluated on new, unseen samples. This contrasts with standard empirical dual formulations, which assign an independent multiplier to each training sample. We characterize the error in the recovered primal solution induced by restricting the dual variable to a parametric function class and show that it is controlled by how well this class approximates the optimal statistical multiplier. Moreover, we show that the learned parametric multiplier retains the sensitivity interpretation of the optimal statistical multiplier, yielding approximate sensitivity guarantees that extend beyond the samples used for training. We empirically validate our theory across a variety of everywhere learning tasks, showing that the resulting constrained problems can be solved efficiently and that the learned dual variables provide meaningful representations of sample-level sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 everywhere learning 中逐样本的对偶变量改成样本的参数化函数，使乘子可在未见样本上求值；理论上原解误差由该函数类对最优统计乘子的逼近程度控制，且学到的乘子保留敏感度解释并外推到训练样本之外。
Motivation: 标准经验对偶形式给每个训练样本分配独立乘子，无法在新样本上求值，也难以把逐点约束的敏感度信息泛化到训练集之外。
Method: 在 everywhere learning 框架下将逐点约束导出的函数型对偶变量表示为每个样本的参数化函数，学习该乘子函数；对限制在参数函数类导致的原解误差给出刻画，并论证其保留最优统计乘子的敏感度解释。
Result: 理论给出原解误差受该函数类逼近最优统计乘子的程度控制，并得到可外推到训练样本之外的近似敏感度保证；作者在多种 everywhere learning 任务上做经验验证，表明相应约束问题可高效求解，学到的对偶变量是样本级敏感度的有意义表示。
Conclusion: 对偶变量可以作为可学习的样本函数而非逐样本自由参数，从而把约束问题的敏感度信息推广到未见样本。

papers.title: CheatBench: Measuring Reward Gaming in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has helped AI agents solve increasingly difficult tasks, but high rewards do not always reflect the work users intended. In recent incidents and controlled evaluations across the AI industry, agents trained to maximize reward have accessed unauthorized information, attempted to evade monitoring systems, and even breached sandbox protections to attack external systems. As agents become more capable, this behavior could pose increasingly serious risks. To measure this problem, we introduce CheatBench, a benchmark of cheating in AI agents across mathematical research, knowledge work, coding, visual tasks, and other domains. Its environments combine challenging assignments with opportunities to cheat, allowing researchers to study how agents pursue a goal when honest work is difficult. CheatBench supports comparisons across models and task categories, providing a testbed for measuring and reducing cheating as agents take on more consequential responsibilities. We publicly release CheatBench at https://cheatbench.ai
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CheatBench：把高难度任务与作弊机会绑定在同一环境里，用于度量 AI agent 为最大化奖励而访问未授权信息、规避监控、突破沙箱的行为。基准覆盖数学研究、知识工作、编码、视觉任务等领域，支持跨模型与跨任务类别比较，并公开发布。
Motivation: 强化学习训练出的 agent 拿到高奖励并不等于完成了用户意图的工作；行业事故与受控评估中已出现访问未授权信息、规避监控、突破沙箱攻击外部系统的行为，且随 agent 能力增强风险上升，此前缺少统一的度量基准。
Method: 构建 CheatBench 基准：在数学研究、知识工作、编码、视觉任务等多个领域中，把具有挑战性的任务分配与可作弊机会组合在同一环境里，让研究者观察 agent 在诚实完成困难时如何选择；支持跨模型与跨任务类别的对比评测。
Result: 产出可跨模型、跨任务类别比较的作弊度量测试床，覆盖数学研究、知识工作、编码、视觉任务等多个领域，并以 https://cheatbench.ai 公开发布。
Conclusion: 把作弊机会显式嵌入高难度任务环境，可以在 agent 承担更关键职责之前度量并进而减少 reward gaming 行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cheap and Powerful Tests for Supervised Subspaces: Per-Component Inference for PLS
papers.abstract_en: Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression extracts a few outcome-aligned directions in a high-dimensional X and is widely used across applied science, but inference on the resulting fit is either expensive, biased and discouraged, or absent. We reduce inference to held-out OLS refits of the supervised subspace, a primitive shared by PLS, supervised PCA, and linear probes, and supply two tests using held-out correlations: a Nadeau-Bengio corrected asymptotic t-test as a fast approximation, and a permutation test with comparable power, finite-sample valid under outcome-predictor independence and iid rows. Held-out predictions are unchanged under any orthogonal rebasing of the supervised span, so an interpretable basis such as varimax inherits the joint claim but not a per-axis p-value; per-component claims come from a fixed-sequence test on the PLS extraction order. We validate on synthetic geometries, two NIR chemometric datasets, and cross-lingual word-embedding regressions; the exact test also transfers to supervised PCA and a ridge probe. The proposed tests have more power than CV-permutation-Q^2, at a fraction of its cost. A pre-run check on n and the spectrum of X says when the approximation is safe. We release a Rust library with Python, R, and Julia bindings, plus a Python text pipeline.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 5 figures, 28 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004298
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 PLS 等监督子空间的推断化归为在 held-out 数据上对子空间做 OLS 重拟合，给出两种检验：Nadeau-Bengio 校正的渐近 t 检验作为快速近似，以及在结果-预测因子独立且行 iid 下有限样本有效的置换检验。逐分量结论来自按 PLS 提取顺序的 fixed-sequence 检验；在合成几何、两个 NIR 化学计量数据集与跨语言词嵌入回归上，该检验比 CV-permutation-Q^2 功效更高而成本只是其一小部分。
Motivation: PLS 在高维 X 中提取少数与结果对齐的方向，但对其拟合的推断要么昂贵、要么有偏且被劝退、要么根本不存在，逐分量层面的推断尤其缺失。
Method: 把推断化归为对监督子空间（PLS、supervised PCA、linear probe 共有的原语）做 held-out OLS 重拟合，用 held-out 相关性构造两种检验：Nadeau-Bengio 校正渐近 t 检验与置换检验；逐分量 p 值由 PLS 提取顺序上的 fixed-sequence 检验给出，并附一个基于 n 与 X 谱的预运行检查判断近似何时安全。
Result: 在合成几何、两个 NIR 化学计量数据集和跨语言词嵌入回归上验证；exact 检验可迁移到 supervised PCA 与 ridge probe。所提检验功效高于 CV-permutation-Q^2，而成本只是其一小部分。发布 Rust 库并带 Python、R、Julia 绑定及 Python 文本流水线。
Conclusion: held-out OLS 重拟合加校正 t 检验或置换检验，能以远低于 CV-permutation-Q^2 的成本给 PLS 类监督子空间提供有效推断；varimax 等可解释基只继承联合结论，逐轴 p 值须靠提取顺序上的 fixed-sequence 检验。

papers.title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HeurEvo 用 plan–code–component 共同演化的方式自动设计时限敏感的组合优化启发式：planner 决定算法结构与运行时分配，coder 把方案写成可执行代码，component evolver 维护共享组件池，interpreter agent 根据执行结果反馈迭代。在多种组合优化基准与困难 MIPLIB 实例上，它在紧运行时预算内常能匹配或超越给定数小时至数天计算量的最先进求解器，并在 hexagon packing 等非线性几何问题上改进已报道的最好结果。
Motivation: 时限约束下需要把问题专用启发式与数学规划求解器结合，但现有 agentic 启发式设计只能在预定义流程内改组件或单独调求解器配置，无法整体决定算力分配、求解器使用方式与算法结构。
Method: 提出 HeurEvo：在 island-based 演化框架内让高层算法结构（plan）、其实现（code）与共享可复用组件池共同演化；planner 选组件、定组合并分配各阶段运行时，coder 生成可执行代码，component evolver 更新组件池，interpreter agent 分析执行结果并给出改进方向。
Result: 在多样组合优化基准与有挑战的 MIPLIB 实例上，HeurEvo 在紧运行时预算内找到高质量解，常匹配或超越拥有数小时乃至数天计算时间的最先进优化求解器；在 hexagon packing 等若干非线性几何问题上超过此前报道的最好结果。
Conclusion: 同时在算法结构与其实现两个层面搜索，是 agentic 启发式设计在时限敏感数学优化中有效的路径，比只改组件或只调求解器配置更能在紧预算下逼近或超过重型求解器。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Universal Classifier for Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: While foundation models have revolutionized natural language processing and computer vision by leveraging universal vocabularies, Graph Machine Learning (GML) remains fractured due to the absence of a unified feature and structural representation across diverse domains. Existing works claiming to be Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) are typically restricted to node-level predictions or require fixed feature dimensions, failing to provide a truly task-agnostic backbone for the full spectrum of graph learning applications. In this paper, we introduce the Universal Classifier (UC), which supports arbitrary feature and class cardinalities, unifying node-, edge-, and graph-level objectives under a single similarity-based classification objective. The UC reformulates all node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction tasks as maximizing similarity in the latent space: by lifting heterogeneous features and labels into 3D latent tensors, the model learns transferable features independent of specific input schemas. This architecture allows a single pre-trained model to generalize to node classification, node regression, and link prediction across unseen graphs with varying feature semantics. Experiments show strong zero-shot transfer performance across node-, link-, and graph-level tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Universal Classifier (UC)，把节点、边、图三级任务统一成单一相似度分类目标：异构特征与标签被提升到 3D 潜空间张量，模型学出与输入 schema 无关的可迁移特征，从而支持任意特征与类别基数。单个预训练模型可在未见过的图上零样本迁移到节点分类、节点回归与链接预测，摘要称其在节点、链接、图三级任务上均有较强的零样本迁移表现。
Motivation: 图机器学习缺少跨域统一的特征与结构表示，现有 Graph Foundation Model (GFM) 多被限制在节点级预测或要求固定特征维度，无法成为覆盖全部图学习任务的通用骨干。
Method: UC 将异构特征与标签提升 (lift) 到 3D 潜空间张量，把节点、边、图级预测全部重构为潜空间中最大化相似度的单一分类目标；预训练一个模型后直接在特征语义各异的未见图上做零样本推理，支持任意特征与类别基数。
Result: 实验显示 UC 在节点级、链接级与图级三类任务上均有较强的零样本迁移 (zero-shot transfer) 表现，覆盖节点分类、节点回归与链接预测；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 以相似度分类目标统一三级图任务并放开特征/类别基数约束，可让单一预训练模型成为任务无关的图学习骨干，跨未见图零样本泛化。

papers.title: MoRE: Scaling mixture of experts with hardware-aware low-rank routing
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers are central to frontier language models, and recent architectures push toward more and smaller experts. In this regime, the standard linear router becomes a bottleneck: with $M$ experts and hidden dimension $h$, its per-token cost $Θ(Mh)$ dominates the MoE layer once $M$ is large. We introduce MoRE (Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts), which factorizes the router weight matrix at rank $r$ and reduces the routing cost to $O((h + M)r)$. We prove that rank logarithmic in $M$ suffices for routing expressivity when the number of active experts is fixed, and is necessary up to precision factors. We also prove that logarithmic rank preserves load balance in a Gaussian memorization model, and training on a synthetic phonebook task shows that low rank does not hurt memorization. At matched active FLOPs, the factorization allows a factor of $Θ(h/r)$ more experts. To realize this gain in wall-clock time, we design a fused Triton kernel at inference that avoids expensive memory operations on HBM. Empirically, MoRE improves memorization on the phonebook task and performance on knowledge-intensive Q\&A benchmarks after pretraining, while matching reasoning ability. Code available at https://github.com/Matheart/MoRE_code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoRE 把 MoE 路由器权重矩阵按秩 r 分解，将每 token 路由开销从 Θ(Mh) 降到 O((h+M)r)，并证明在激活专家数固定时秩取 M 的对数即足以保证路由表达力（且在精度因子内是必要的），对数秩还能在 Gaussian memorization 模型中保持负载均衡。同等 active FLOPs 下可容纳 Θ(h/r) 倍的专家数，配合避免 HBM 访存的 fused Triton 推理 kernel，phonebook 合成任务记忆与知识型 QA 均提升，推理能力持平。
Motivation: 前沿语言模型趋向更多更小的专家，M 变大后标准线性路由器每 token Θ(Mh) 的开销主导整个 MoE 层，成为扩展瓶颈。
Method: 将路由器权重矩阵做秩 r 分解得到 MoRE (Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts)，路由代价降为 O((h+M)r)；理论上证明固定激活专家数时对数秩足够且必要，并在 Gaussian memorization 模型中证明对数秩保持负载均衡；推理侧设计避免 HBM 昂贵访存的 fused Triton kernel。
Result: 路由开销 Θ(Mh) → O((h+M)r)，同等 active FLOPs 下可多用 Θ(h/r) 倍专家；合成 phonebook 任务上低秩不损害记忆且 MoRE 记忆表现更好，预训练后知识密集 QA 基准性能提升，推理能力与基线持平。
Conclusion: 对数秩的低秩路由足以支撑 MoE 的表达力与负载均衡，是把路由开销换成更多专家并转化为实际墙钟收益的可行路径。

papers.title: When Trees Are Not Enough: Learning Mixed-Topology Feature Graphs with Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose interpretable features in large language model activations, yet existing structured SAEs impose single-parent trees or forests, while post-hoc graphs permit multiple parents but neither guide feature learning nor ensure reliable relation recovery. We introduce the Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoder (AG-SAE), a structure-guided training paradigm that treats each feature's complete parent set as an atomic structural hypothesis and lets evidence select zero, one, or multiple parents. By competing complete parent sets against null, subset, and alternative explanations, AG-SAE identifies jointly necessary multi-parent relations while rejecting redundant or spurious alternatives and verifying that each child contributes beyond its parents. The induced topology over SAE features then defines a differentiable structural loss that guides SAE training, while topology-guided refinement mitigates feature absorption and uses persistent reconstruction gaps exposed by the learned structure to initialize new features. The entire graph is then induced again from the revised dictionary by reassessing every feature's complete parent set, closing the dictionary-graph self-consistency cycle. Experiments demonstrate exact mixed-topology recovery in a controlled toy model, greater relational reliability and semantic validity than structured and post-hoc baselines on real LLM activations, and stronger feature-level causal interventions than conventional SAE features. AG-SAE thereby turns recovered mixed-topology feature structure into an unsupervised training signal that improves the dictionary, enables reliable feature organization beyond the topological limitations of trees, and exhibits stronger causal control beyond reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AG-SAE 把每个特征的完整父集当作原子结构假设，让证据在零个、单个或多个父节点之间选择，并用诱导出的混合拓扑作为可微结构损失反哺 SAE 训练，形成字典-图自洽循环。在受控 toy 模型上实现精确混合拓扑恢复，在真实 LLM 激活上比结构化与 post-hoc 基线有更高的关系可靠性和语义有效性，特征级因果干预也强于常规 SAE 特征。
Motivation: 结构化 SAE 强加单父树或森林，post-hoc 图虽允许多父却不指导特征学习、也不保证关系恢复可靠，LLM 特征的多父拓扑因此既学不好也验不准。
Method: AG-SAE 以完整父集为原子假设，与 null、subset 及替代解释竞争，筛出联合必要且超出父节点仍有贡献的多父关系；诱导出的拓扑定义可微结构损失指导训练，topology-guided refinement 缓解 feature absorption，并用学习结构暴露的持续 reconstruction gap 初始化新特征，再从修订字典重新诱导整张图闭合自洽循环。
Result: 受控 toy 模型上实现精确混合拓扑恢复；在真实 LLM 激活上，关系可靠性与语义有效性高于结构化和 post-hoc 基线；基于所得特征的因果干预强于常规 SAE 特征。

papers.title: How Much Prompt Is Enough? A Blackbox Minimization of Few-Shots in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Prompts are the primary mechanism for directing the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Yet the internal structure and causal hierarchy of prompts remain poorly understood: which parts are causally necessary and which are redundant is an open question. This opacity can have severe consequences. Subtle prompt variations can silently shift model outputs in critical software systems, and engineers lack techniques to reason about prompt reliability. We present \framework, a blackbox prompt-minimization framework that reduces few-shot prompts to their necessary minimal subset. We use a case study to apply \framework to a few-shot learning system and demonstrate the insights that this framework can provide. Our experiments show that few-shot exemplars can be reduced by a mean of 65.3\%~$\pm$~15.8\% in character count while fully preserving propositional output fidelity. The models preferentially retain logical identifiers and constraint declarations while discarding natural language prose and cross-prompt relational annotations. Our analysis also shows that some models are universal encoders, able to produce highly legible yet minimized prompts, while others are universal decoders, able to interpret minimized prompts from most other models. By identifying which components are indispensable, \framework provides a principled basis for prompt compression and structural analysis of few-shot exemplars.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黑盒 prompt 最小化框架，把 few-shot 示例削减到因果必要的最小子集，同时保持输出保真度不变。实验中 few-shot 示例平均按字符数缩减 65.3%±15.8% 且完全保持命题级输出保真；模型优先保留逻辑标识符与约束声明，丢弃自然语言散文和跨 prompt 关系标注。
Motivation: prompt 的内部结构与因果层级不清楚，哪些部分因果必要、哪些冗余是开放问题；这种不透明性使细微 prompt 变动在关键软件系统中静默改变输出，工程师缺少推理 prompt 可靠性的手段。
Method: 以黑盒方式对 few-shot prompt 做最小化：迭代剔除成分并检验输出保真，得到必要最小子集；在一个 few-shot 学习系统上做案例研究，并分析各模型保留/丢弃的成分类型以及模型间编码与解码能力的差异。
Result: few-shot 示例按字符数平均缩减 65.3%±15.8%，同时完全保持命题级输出保真；模型优先保留逻辑标识符与约束声明，丢弃自然语言散文与跨 prompt 关系标注；部分模型是 universal encoder（能产出高度可读的最小化 prompt），另一些是 universal decoder（能解读多数其他模型产出的最小化 prompt）。
Conclusion: few-shot prompt 中相当大比例的字符是冗余的，可被因果必要性检验剔除而不损输出；prompt 压缩与结构分析应以识别不可或缺的成分为原则性依据。

papers.title: Representational and Functional Robustness to Electrode Montages in EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) are intended to generalize across different datasets by learning representations that, ideally, are invariant to dataset-specific EEG configurations such as electrode montages. However, EEG-FMs that accept different montages as input do not guarantee that representations and predictions remain stable across different electrode configurations, especially outside the training setting. In this work, we investigate the effects of different electrode montages through a joint functional and representational analysis of four EEG foundation models selected to span distinct montage-handling designs. We evaluate embeddings on cross-subject resting-state eyes-open/closed and within-subject motor-imagery classification under spatially informed channel reduction. Functional robustness is tested through the generalizability of linear probes across channel counts, while representational robustness is assessed through within-subject similarity and preservation of between-subject geometry. The four models show distinct robustness profiles, and the two axes dissociate: large changes in embedding similarity need not come with comparable probe degradation, and stable embeddings can still lose downstream performance. Comparing two readouts of the same encoder further shows that aggregation, not the encoder alone, determines functional robustness: pooling into anatomically aligned regions degrades less than a learned global readout, despite being montage-invariant by construction. Montage robustness is therefore a joint property of the encoder and its aggregation, and characterizing it requires both a representational and a functional axis. Input compatibility alone is evidence for neither.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对四个 EEG 基础模型做表征与功能双轴联合分析，发现电极 montage 鲁棒性由编码器与聚合方式共同决定：按解剖区域对齐的 pooling 比按构造即 montage 不变的 learned global readout 退化更小。表征相似度大幅变化未必伴随线性探针性能下降，而稳定的 embedding 也可能丢下游性能，因此仅能接受不同 montage 的输入兼容性不能作为鲁棒性证据。
Motivation: EEG-FM 声称跨数据集泛化、对电极配置不变，但接受不同 montage 并不保证表征与预测在训练设定之外稳定，且鲁棒性此前缺少统一的刻画维度。
Method: 选取四个在 montage 处理设计上各异的 EEG-FM，做表征与功能联合分析：在空间信息引导的通道削减下，用跨被试静息态睁/闭眼分类与被试内运动想象分类评测 embedding；功能鲁棒性看线性探针对不同通道数的泛化性，表征鲁棒性看被试内相似度与被试间几何结构保持度，并比较同一编码器的两种 readout。
Result: 四个模型呈现不同的鲁棒性 profile，且两条轴解耦：embedding 相似度大变不必然带来同等程度的探针退化，稳定的 embedding 仍可能丢下游性能；同一编码器下，聚合到解剖对齐区域的 pooling 比 learned global readout 退化更小，尽管后者按构造是 montage 不变的。
Conclusion: montage 鲁棒性是编码器与聚合的联合属性，必须同时用表征轴与功能轴刻画，输入兼容性本身不构成任何证据。

papers.title: GNA: Granular Neighbor Assembly for Retrieval-Augmented Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Deep forecasters predict from a fixed-length lookback window, and lengthening it gives diminishing returns at a growing cost. Retrieval augmentation instead shows the model how similar past situations continued. Retrieving a whole past window gives every variate the continuation of the same past moment. In multivariate series, however, the best past match differs from variate to variate. We present GNA (Granular Neighbor Assembly), a retrieval layer for forecasting backbones that assembles neighbors at two granularities: whole past windows, which keep the variates coherent, and per-variate neighbors, in which each variate takes its future from its own best-matching past. A learned gate decides, per forecast step and variate, how much to trust these futures against a persistence forecast, next to the backbone's own forecast. Candidates come from an embedding trained to predict each window's future, and retrieval is strictly causal: a past window is used only once its future has been observed. With the same lookback for every model and the same retrieval constants for all datasets, GNA improves two Transformer backbones in 85 of 96 dataset-horizon settings, gives the lowest MSE on 8 of 12 standard benchmarks and beats its backbone in every seed on 10 of them. Both granularities are needed, and neighbors of mismatched queries are worse than none. Retrieval helps most where the lookback says least: the gate shifts trust to retrieved futures further ahead. Where it fails, on hourly non-stationary series at long horizons, the loss is consistent with a drifting level of the retrieved futures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GNA 为多变量时间序列预报骨干加一层检索增强：按整段历史窗口与单变量 (per-variate) 两种粒度各取邻居，用可学习门控在每个预报步、每个变量上决定信任检索到的未来还是 persistence。在统一 lookback 与统一检索常数下，GNA 在 96 个 dataset-horizon 组合中的 85 个上改进两个 Transformer 骨干，12 个标准基准中 8 个取得最低 MSE。
Motivation: 固定长度 lookback 的深度预报器加长窗口收益递减且成本上升；多变量序列中各变量的最佳历史匹配时刻并不相同，整段窗口检索会把所有变量绑在同一历史时刻的延续上。
Method: GNA (Granular Neighbor Assembly) 是挂在预报骨干外的检索层：候选来自一个以预测各窗口未来为目标训练的 embedding，检索严格因果（只有当某历史窗口的未来已被观测才可用）；两种粒度分别给出整段窗口邻居与单变量邻居，可学习门控在每个预报步、每个变量上把这两种未来与 persistence 及骨干自身预报做权衡。
Result: 在相同 lookback、所有数据集共用同一组检索常数的设置下，GNA 改进两个 Transformer 骨干于 96 个 dataset-horizon 设置中的 85 个；在 12 个标准基准中 8 个取得最低 MSE，并在其中 10 个上每个 seed 都胜过其骨干。消融显示两种粒度缺一不可，查询不匹配的邻居比不检索更差；门控在更远时效上把信任移向检索未来，失败案例为长时效的小时级非平稳序列，其损失与检索未来电平漂移一致。
Conclusion: 检索增强对多变量预报有效，前提是邻居按变量粒度组装且严格因果；检索的收益集中在 lookback 信息量不足的场景，而长时效非平稳序列上检索未来的电平漂移是主要失效模式。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Proofs Without Nominals: Gödel's Ontological Argument, its Shallow Embedding, and the Open Questions of the Monatshefte Notes
papers.abstract_en: The shallow embedding of higher-order modal logic in classical higher-order logic, used in Benzmüller and Scott's Notes on Gödel's and Scott's variants of the ontological argument (2025), reaches beyond the modal object language of the arguments: its property quantifiers range over terms that may also express nominals and satisfaction operators of hybrid logic, and a proof using one proves a theorem of the embedding that need not be one of the modal logic. That the framework affords this is not new, and whether a result is one of the modal logic can be settled in two ways: by replaying it in an explicit proof calculus, done by hand for chosen theorems, or by analysing the proofs the embedding itself produces, which this article does mechanically, for every result at once. Every statement the Notes prove has a proof inside the object language: 294 written out by hand and machine-checked, none using a nominal. The proofs the Notes themselves give instantiate no nominal either; what the detector flags there are terms a prover substituted. The three questions the Notes leave open are settled too, and without nominals, but the conjunction axiom has to be emended: generalised in the Notes to Gödel's "any number of summands", it covers the conjunction of no properties, and of one; the empty one alone settles all three, and the two together yield what a separate axiom of Gödel's is for. This article restricts the conjunction axiom to at least two different conjuncts, the reading Gödel's footnote suggests, and the questions are settled again, by proofs that turn on the argument rather than a degenerate instance. The restriction holds of the object language only: with a nominal the axioms make the accessibility relation the identity and the readings coincide. Every theorem is verified in Isabelle/HOL and independently in Lean 4; the countermodels are Nitpick's, certified by the build.
papers.comment: 27 pages. Ancillary files: Isabelle/HOL and Lean 4 sources of every theorem, sixteen Isabelle sessions on the readings of the conjunction axiom with Lean counterparts and all 72 Nitpick searches as checked expect annotations, both hybrid-witness detectors with reports and census, five audit sessions and 19 cross-check theories. The sources of the Notes are in the Archive of Formal Proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Gödel 本体论论证的浅嵌入 (shallow embedding) 中每个定理的证明机械地检查一遍，判定哪些是模态对象语言的定理、哪些只是嵌入里混入了 hybrid logic 的 nominal。294 条手写并机器检查的证明全部不含 nominal；Notes 留下的三个开放问题在修正合取公理（限定为至少两个不同合取项）后仍可不靠 nominal 解决。
Motivation: 浅嵌入的性质量词可以取到 nominal 与 satisfaction operator，嵌入中可证的命题未必是模态逻辑的定理；此前只能靠手工在显式证明演算里重放个别定理来区分。
Method: 对嵌入自身产生的全部证明做机械分析，用 hybrid-witness detector 扫描 nominal 出现位置；在 Isabelle/HOL 与 Lean 4 中独立验证每条定理，反模型由 Nitpick 给出并由 build 认证，另含十六个 Isabelle session 覆盖合取公理的不同读法与全部 72 次 Nitpick 搜索。
Result: Notes 证明的每条陈述都有对象语言内的证明，共 294 条手写并机器检查，无一使用 nominal；Notes 自身给出的证明也不实例化 nominal，detector 标记的是 prover 替换进去的项。三个开放问题在不加 nominal 的情况下解决，其中空合取单独即可解决全部三个，空合取与单元素合取合起来等价于 Gödel 另一条公理的作用。
Conclusion: 合取公理应限定为至少两个不同合取项（Gödel 脚注所指的读法），此时三个问题的证明依赖论证本身而非退化实例；该限制只属于对象语言，加入 nominal 后公理使可达关系成为恒等，各读法随之重合。

summary_sections.result: Notes 证明的每条陈述都有对象语言内的证明，共 294 条手写并机器检查，无一使用 nominal；Notes 自身给出的证明也不实例化 nominal，detector 标记的是 prover 替换进去的项。三个开放问题在不加 nominal 的情况下解决，其中空合取单独即可解决全部三个，空合取与单元素合取合起来等价于 Gödel 另一条公理的作用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 合取公理应限定为至少两个不同合取项（Gödel 脚注所指的读法），此时三个问题的证明依赖论证本身而非退化实例；该限制只属于对象语言，加入 nominal 后公理使可达关系成为恒等，各读法随之重合。

papers.title: Illusory Truth or Mere Exposure? Model-Dependent Repetition Effects in LLM-Based Social Media Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Generative agent-based models (GABMs) are increasingly used to simulate social media dynamics, including misinformation spread. For such social simulations to be valid proxies of human behavior, LLM agents should replicate established human cognitive biases, among them the Illusory Truth Effect (ITE), where repeated exposure to a claim increases its perceived truth value. We investigate whether and how the ITE manifests across four LLMs (Gemma-3-4b-it, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and GPT-5-nano) in a social media simulation context. We propose a two-phase within-context experimental design that embeds the repetition manipulation inside a realistic news feed interaction. Using this design, we collect 336,000 truth, importance, sentiment, and interest ratings across 100 statements, 10 feed variants, and 3 replications. The key comparison is between ratings assigned to repeated statements, seen throughout a simulation phase, and completely unseen ones, rated within the same experimental context window. We distinguish genuine ITE (truth-specific repetition boost) from mere exposure effects. We run an OLS regression followed by a Linear Mixed-Effect Model to account for differences across models and ratings. Our results reveal four qualitatively distinct patterns: Gemma-3 exhibits a genuine ITE; Qwen2.5 shows a mere exposure effect; GPT-5-nano displays no repetition effect on truth and mild skepticism toward repeated content; Llama-3.1 shows a small truth boost alongside decreases in evaluative dimensions. Crucially, temperature has no effect on these findings, and a variance decomposition highlights the high context-sensitivity of LLM rating behavior. Our findings caution against assuming uniform ITE replication across LLMs in social simulations, while suggesting that Gemma-3-4b-it may offer the most behaviorally realistic approximation for misinformation-related simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在社交媒体生成式智能体模拟中检验 LLM 是否复现真实感效应 (Illusory Truth Effect, ITE)，四个模型给出四种不同模式：Gemma-3 是真正的 ITE，Qwen2.5 只是单纯曝光效应，GPT-5-nano 对重复内容无真值提升且略显怀疑，Llama-3.1 真值小幅提升但评价性维度下降；温度对结论无影响。作者据此警告不要假设 LLM 在社会模拟中统一复现 ITE，并认为 Gemma-3-4b-it 最接近行为真实。
Motivation: 生成式智能体模型 (GABM) 被用作人类行为的代理来模拟社交媒体与错误信息传播，但若 LLM 不复现人类已确立的认知偏差（如重复曝光提升真值判断的 ITE），这类社会模拟的有效性就存疑。
Method: 提出两阶段 within-context 实验设计，把重复操纵嵌入真实新闻流交互；在 4 个 LLM（Gemma-3-4b-it、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、GPT-5-nano）上，对 100 条陈述、10 种 feed 变体、3 次重复收集真值、重要性、情感、兴趣评分，先做 OLS 回归再用 Linear Mixed-Effect Model 处理模型与评分差异，以区分真 ITE 与单纯曝光效应。
Result: 共收集 336,000 条评分。四种定性模式：Gemma-3 呈现真 ITE；Qwen2.5 为单纯曝光效应；GPT-5-nano 真值维度无重复效应且对重复内容轻度怀疑；Llama-3.1 真值小幅提升但评价性维度下降。温度对上述结论无影响，方差分解显示 LLM 评分行为高度依赖上下文。
Conclusion: 不能假设各 LLM 在社会模拟中一致复现 ITE，模型选择会改变偏差结构；就错误信息相关模拟而言 Gemma-3-4b-it 可能是行为上最真实的近似。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Surfaces to Volumes: Registered Geometry for Protein Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Existing protein geometry models typically represent molecular surfaces using local geometric features such as sampled points, normals, and curvature. While effective for capturing exposed molecular shape, these representations do not explicitly model the volumetric organization beneath the surface or provide a consistent coordinate system for residue-wise volumetric structure. We introduce Protein-TetSphere, a registered residue-wise volumetric representation for proteins. Each protein chain is tetrahedralized to obtain local volumetric regions associated with individual residues, which are then registered to a shared fixed-topology tetrahedral reference and represented in a common Laplacian basis. This registration establishes consistent volumetric coordinates across residues, enabling local three-dimensional deformation to be integrated with surface and chemical information in a multimodal protein representation. We evaluate Protein-TetSphere on ligand-binding pocket classification, protein--protein interface prediction, and de novo protein binder design. Across the three tasks, Protein-TetSphere improves ligand-binding pocket balanced accuracy from $0.795$ to $0.826$, Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC from $0.914/0.852$ to $0.932/0.866$, and binder-design success from $14.95\%$ to $19.90\%$ on the BoltzGen Challenge Set and from $27.62\%$ to $32.19\%$ at the ProtDBench backbone level. These results show that registered volumetric geometry provides complementary spatial information beyond molecular surfaces across protein recognition, interaction, and design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Protein-TetSphere：把蛋白链四面体化得到残基层体积区域，配准到固定拓扑的四面体参考并在统一 Laplacian 基上表示，从而给残基级体积结构一套跨残基一致的坐标系。三项任务上配准体积几何带来一致提升：配体口袋 balanced accuracy 0.795→0.826，Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC 0.914/0.852→0.932/0.866，binder 设计成功率在 BoltzGen Challenge Set 14.95%→19.90%、ProtDBench backbone 27.62%→32.19%。
Motivation: 现有蛋白几何模型只用采样点、法向、曲率等局部表面特征，既不显式刻画表面之下的体积组织，也给不出残基级体积结构的一致坐标系。
Method: 将每条蛋白链四面体化 (tetrahedralize) 得到与单个残基对应的局部体积区域，配准到共享的固定拓扑四面体参考，并用统一的 Laplacian 基表示；由此建立的体积坐标把局部三维形变与表面、化学信息融合成多模态蛋白表示。
Result: 在配体结合口袋分类、蛋白-蛋白界面预测、de novo 蛋白 binder 设计三项任务上：口袋 balanced accuracy 从 0.795 提到 0.826；Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC 从 0.914/0.852 提到 0.932/0.866；binder 设计成功率在 BoltzGen Challenge Set 从 14.95% 提到 19.90%，在 ProtDBench backbone 层面从 27.62% 提到 32.19%。
Conclusion: 配准的体积几何在蛋白识别、相互作用与设计三类任务上都提供超出分子表面的互补空间信息。

papers.title: Stochastic Optimization Under Power-Law Spectra: Tight Bounds and Shuffling Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has established that power-law spectral conditions on data enable tight convergence bounds for deterministic gradient descent, resolving the conflict between classical exponential bounds and observed power-law learning curves. In this work, we extend this result to the stochastic regime of high-dimensional machine learning. We provide two main contributions: (1) We generalize the power-law spectral theory to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), showing that the same spectral exponents govern stochastic dynamics; (2) For the fundamental case of isotropic Gaussian data, we provide a precise analysis of data shuffling, deriving exact constants that prove Single Shuffle is strictly superior to Flip-Flop and IID sampling. Our results bridge the gap between abstract spectral theory and practical stochastic training choices, offering a unified picture of how data geometry drives optimization speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把幂律谱收敛理论从确定性 GD 推广到 SGD，证明支配确定性动力学的同一组谱指数也支配随机训练；在各向同性高斯数据这一基本情形下给出数据洗牌 (shuffling) 的精确常数分析，证明 Single Shuffle 严格优于 Flip-Flop 与 IID 采样。
Motivation: 幂律谱条件已能为确定性梯度下降给出紧的收敛界，调和了经典指数界与实际观察到的幂律学习曲线之间的矛盾，但高维机器学习实际使用的是随机梯度下降，谱理论与随机训练选择之间存在缺口。
Method: 将幂律谱理论推广到 Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD)，论证相同的谱指数支配随机动力学；并对各向同性高斯数据这一基本情形做数据洗牌的精确分析，推导出可比较不同洗牌策略的精确常数。
Result: 推导出的精确常数证明 Single Shuffle 严格优于 Flip-Flop 与 IID 采样；同一组谱指数同时支配确定性与随机动力学。
Conclusion: 数据几何（谱指数）是驱动优化速度的统一解释，且在各向同性高斯数据下洗牌策略存在严格的优劣排序：选 Single Shuffle 而非 Flip-Flop 或 IID。

papers.title: In-Context Learning Amplifies a Latent Symbolic Circuit
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can learn abstract rules from just a few in-context examples, but how their internal mechanisms activate as examples accumulate is not well understood. We trace a three-stage symbolic reasoning circuit (abstraction, induction, retrieval) across shot counts in three model families and find it is detectable and functional well before the model achieves high accuracy. Per-head causal contribution grows up to 8x from 1- to 10-shot, and cross-shot activation patching raises accuracy from 1% to 56% at 0-shot and 17% to 88% at 1-shot. Function vectors scaled and injected at 0-shot rescue accuracy up to 86%, largely substituting for the induction stage but depending critically on an intact downstream retrieval stage. The infrastructure for abstract rule-following is present in the weights before any demonstrations; in-context examples, function vectors, and related interventions appear to supply input to the same latent circuit.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三个模型家族中追踪三阶段符号推理回路（abstraction→induction→retrieval）随 shot 数的激活，发现该回路在模型准确率还很低时就已可检测且功能完整。跨 shot activation patching 把 0-shot 准确率从 1% 提到 56%、1-shot 从 17% 提到 88%；注入 function vector 在 0-shot 可把准确率救回最高 86%，主要替代 induction 阶段但依赖下游 retrieval 完好。
Motivation: 大语言模型能从少量 in-context 示例学到抽象规则，但这些内部机制如何随示例累积而激活尚不清楚；需要判断抽象规则遵循的基础设施是权重中预先存在还是由示例现场构建。
Method: 在三个模型家族上跨 shot 数追踪三阶段符号回路（abstraction、induction、retrieval），结合逐头因果贡献度量、cross-shot activation patching，以及对 function vector 的缩放与注入干预（在 0-shot 注入）。
Result: 逐头因果贡献从 1-shot 到 10-shot 增长最高达 8x；cross-shot activation patching 在 0-shot 把准确率从 1% 提到 56%、1-shot 从 17% 提到 88%；0-shot 注入 function vector 可把准确率救回最高 86%，主要替代 induction 阶段，但关键依赖完好的下游 retrieval 阶段。
Conclusion: 抽象规则遵循的基础设施在任何示例之前就已存在于权重中；in-context 示例、function vector 及相关干预是在向同一个潜在回路提供输入，而非各自建立新机制。

papers.title: OTROPE: Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-policy Evaluation for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is essential for their development and deployment, yet is often costly, risky, and difficult to perform safely online. We study off-policy evaluation for LLMs, where limited human-labeled data from a behavior model are used to evaluate a newer target LLM. This setting is challenging because labels are scarce, behavior--target distribution shift is common, and response likelihoods are often unavailable for black-box LLMs. We propose the Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OTROPE), a likelihood-free evaluation that performs distributional correction in a semantic space via optimal transport to align labeled behavior-policy samples with unlabeled target-policy samples. OTROPE combines corrected human-labeled residuals with proxy predictors, yielding a doubly robust-style evaluation without behavior-policy modeling or density-ratio estimation. We theoretically characterize why baseline evaluators fail under LLM distribution shift, and establish consistency and convergence rates for OTROPE when either the reweighted behavior distribution or the proxy predictor converges. Experiments on synthetic and real LLM evaluation tasks show that OTROPE consistently outperforms baselines while enabling ensembles of weaker LLM evaluators to approach and sometimes surpass stronger evaluators. Code is available at https://github.com/LinerXiang/OTROPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OTROPE 用最优传输在语义空间做分布校正，把行为模型的少量人工标注样本对齐到目标模型的无标注样本，得到免似然的 doubly robust 式离策略评估 (off-policy evaluation)。理论上给出基线评估器在 LLM 分布偏移下失效的原因，并在重加权行为分布或代理预测器任一收敛时建立一致性与收敛速率；合成与真实 LLM 评估任务上稳定超过基线，且弱评估器集成可逼近甚至偶尔超过更强评估器。
Motivation: LLM 线上评估昂贵且有风险，只能用行为模型的少量人工标注数据评估新目标模型；标签稀缺、行为-目标分布偏移常见，黑盒 LLM 又常拿不到响应似然，使常规离策略评估失效。
Method: OTROPE 通过最优传输在语义空间对齐已标注的行为策略样本与未标注的目标策略样本，做免似然的分布校正；再把校正后的人工标注残差与代理预测器结合，得到不需行为策略建模、也不需密度比估计的 doubly robust 式评估，并给出一致性与收敛速率的理论刻画。
Result: 在合成与真实 LLM 评估任务上，OTROPE 稳定优于基线评估器；弱 LLM 评估器的集成能逼近、有时超过更强评估器。理论上刻画了基线评估器在 LLM 分布偏移下失效的原因，并在重加权行为分布或代理预测器收敛时建立一致性与收敛速率。

papers.title: Paired Multimodal Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Existing multimodal scaling laws fit multimodality terms empirically after testing and never vary how much data is multimodally paired at fixed data budgets. We investigate how, under the same total data per modality, changing the number of paired data affects loss curves in multimodal classification tasks. We train models in three different environments and run experiment sweeps varying data sizes and pairing budget. Pairing ratios have a dramatic impact on loss and this impact is directly tied to how much information synergy the task contains. Only paired data is able to reduce synergistic loss, while unpaired data can reduce redundant or unimodal information up until unimodal floors. Unlike traditional scaling laws where loss drops immediately in power law decay, synergy acquisition is gated, requiring a critical threshold of paired data before synergistic loss falls at all. We introduce a new family of multimodal scaling laws where total data-attributable loss is the sum of four individual power laws corresponding to the four different information channels of redundancy, a unique channel per modality, and synergy, and show how this law is both more theoretically sound and empirically valid across our experiments. This law predicts multimodal loss in our experiments more accurately than existing laws, with 3.2% error on fit tests versus 10.4% error for the best pairing extension of published laws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多模态分类任务中，固定每模态总数据量、只改变配对数据比例，配对比例对损失影响巨大，且该影响直接由任务的信息协同 (synergy) 量决定。只有配对数据能压低协同损失，非配对数据只能把冗余与单模态通道降到各自的单模态下限；协同损失的下降存在临界配对阈值，未达阈值前完全不降。作者据此提出四条幂律之和的多模态 scaling law，拟合误差 3.2%，对比已发表定律最佳配对扩展的 10.4%。
Motivation: 现有 multimodal scaling law 只在事后把多模态项经验性地补进去，且从不在固定数据预算下改变配对数据量，因此无法解释配对比例如何塑造损失曲线。
Method: 在三种不同环境中训练模型，做数据规模与配对预算 (pairing budget) 的扫描实验；把总数据可归因损失分解为四条独立幂律之和，分别对应冗余通道、每个模态各自的 unique 通道、以及 synergy 通道。
Result: 配对比例如何影响损失取决于任务包含多少信息协同；只有配对数据能降低 synergistic loss，非配对数据可降低冗余与单模态信息直至单模态下限；协同损失的下降被阈值门控，需达到临界配对量才开始下降。新定律在拟合测试上误差 3.2%，已发表定律最佳配对扩展为 10.4%。
Conclusion: 多模态损失应建模为四条信息通道各自的幂律之和，且协同增益必须先越过临界配对阈值才会出现，该形式在理论上更自洽、在其实验中预测更准。

papers.title: Understanding LLM Parameter Update Sparsity through the Lens of Fisher
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies have observed that parameter changes during language-model post-training can be concentrated in a small subset of coordinates. This phenomenon has been reported in reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and supervised fine-tuning on near-policy data. Its recurrence across different post-training paradigms suggests shared structure in training dynamics. In this paper, we examine this pattern through the diagonal model Fisher, which measures the sensitivity of the model's output distribution to individual parameters and is independent of any particular reward or teacher signal. Theoretically, we show that small diagonal Fisher leads to small expected gradients across a range of training objectives, providing a common explanation for sparse gradient updates. Empirically, we test this connection in RL and OPD. We find that Fisher identifies where gradients are concentrated, and fixed sparse masks selected from the initial Fisher retain a large proportion of the improvement from full training. Finally, we investigate the mechanisms underlying low Fisher in on-policy training. Our results show that high-probability next tokens tend to have similar parameter sensitivities, contributing to low Fisher. Together, these results establish the diagonal model Fisher as a unifying perspective linking update sparsity to on-policy training dynamics in LLM post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用对角 Fisher 信息统一解释 LLM 后训练中参数更新稀疏现象：对角 Fisher 小则一系列训练目标下的期望梯度小，这解释了 RL、on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 与近策略数据 SFT 中梯度集中于少数坐标。用初始 Fisher 固定的稀疏掩码能保留全量训练的大部分提升；on-policy 训练中低 Fisher 源于高概率 next token 的参数敏感度趋同。
Motivation: RL、OPD、近策略 SFT 等不同后训练范式都出现参数更新集中于少数坐标的现象，但缺少一个与具体 reward 或 teacher 信号无关的共同解释。
Method: 以对角模型 Fisher（衡量输出分布对单个参数的敏感度）为分析工具：理论上证明小的对角 Fisher 导致一系列训练目标下期望梯度小；实证上在 RL 与 OPD 中检验 Fisher 与梯度集中位置的对应，并用初始 Fisher 选取固定稀疏掩码做训练。
Result: 理论结果：小对角 Fisher ⇒ 一系列训练目标下期望梯度小。实证上 Fisher 能识别梯度集中位置；由初始 Fisher 选出的固定稀疏掩码保留了全量训练的大部分提升；on-policy 训练中高概率 next token 倾向于具有相似的参数敏感度，从而压低 Fisher。
Conclusion: 对角模型 Fisher 是连接更新稀疏性与 on-policy 后训练动力学的统一视角，且可在训练前用初始 Fisher 指定稀疏更新坐标。

papers.title: CyFA: Linear Sequence Modeling with Relative-Time-Partitioned Memory
papers.abstract_en: Linear RNNs offer linear-time sequence processing and constant-memory decoding, but their fixed-size recurrent states must accommodate all past key--value associations. Existing forgetting mechanisms and Delta Rule updates reduce interference by selectively clearing or correcting the state, yet earlier associations can still become difficult to retrieve. We introduce CyFA (Cyclic Flow Attention), a Linear RNN with relative-time-partitioned memory. At each step, a learned clock controls the cyclic transport applied jointly to the key and value states before the current key--value pair enters the age-zero slot, thereby organizing stored associations across relative-time slots. We further derive an exact change to absolute-clock coordinates that expresses CyFA as two scalar-decay linear attention recurrences and enables efficient chunk-wise training. Across 400M--1.4B pretraining experiments with matched recurrent-state sizes, CyFA improves recall-intensive performance while maintaining competitive language modeling and high computational efficiency. At 400M, CyFA outperforms KDA on FDA (42.60 vs. 26.07) while requiring only 46.7% and 48.3% of KDA's forward and backward core-operator execution times, respectively. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Chyxx/CyclicFlowAttention}{this https URL}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CyFA (Cyclic Flow Attention) 用学习到的时钟对 key/value 状态做相对时间分槽的循环搬运，让线性 RNN 的固定状态按相对时间组织历史关联，从而在保持线性时间与常数内存解码的同时改善召回密集任务。400M 预训练上 FDA 得分 42.60 对 KDA 的 26.07，前向与反向核心算子执行时间仅为 KDA 的 46.7% 与 48.3%。
Motivation: 线性 RNN 的固定大小循环状态要装下全部历史 key-value 关联，现有遗忘机制与 Delta Rule 只能选择性清除或修正状态，早期关联仍会变得难以检索，召回密集任务受损。
Method: CyFA 在每步由学习时钟控制对 key 与 value 状态的联合循环搬运，再把当前 key-value 对写入 age-zero 槽位，按相对时间槽组织存储关联；并推导出到绝对时钟坐标的精确变换，将 CyFA 表示为两个标量衰减的线性注意力递推，从而支持分块 (chunk-wise) 高效训练。
Result: 在 400M–1.4B 预训练、循环状态大小匹配的设置下，CyFA 提升召回密集表现同时保持有竞争力的语言建模与高计算效率；400M 规模上 FDA 指标 42.60 对 KDA 的 26.07，前向与反向核心算子执行时间分别为 KDA 的 46.7% 与 48.3%。
Conclusion: 把历史关联按相对时间分槽并用可学习时钟循环搬运，可以在不增大循环状态的前提下显著提高线性 RNN 的召回能力，同时把核心算子开销压到 KDA 的一半左右。

papers.title: Towards Mitigating Deceptive Safety Alignment in Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are commonly trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to improve their generation of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before producing final answers. However, RL rewards are typically assigned based on final answers, providing little or no direct supervision over intermediate reasoning. This can lead to deceptive safety alignment, where the reasoning trace and final answer convey inconsistent safety signals. To systematically investigate this phenomenon, we introduce DSAR (Deceptive Safety Alignment Rate), a metric that jointly assesses reasoning traces and final answers to quantify their safety inconsistency. Across multiple LRMs and benchmarks, we find that deceptive safety alignment is pervasive under standard prompting conditions and is substantially amplified under prefilling attacks. We further provide a hidden representation analysis showing that models exhibit stronger safety discrimination at the final-answer stage than during intermediate reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SARA (Safety-Aware Reasoning Alignment), an RL-based method that rewards both safety-aware reasoning and safe final answers, encouraging early harmful intent recognition and enforcing reasoning-answer consistency. Experiments show that SARA significantly mitigates deceptive safety alignment under both standard and adversarial settings while preserving helpfulness and utility. Code is available at https://github.com/xzhou98/SARA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 大推理模型 (LRM) 的 RL 奖励只看最终答案，导致推理链与最终答案给出不一致的安全信号，即欺骗性安全对齐。提出 DSAR 指标联合评估推理轨迹与答案的安全不一致性，发现该现象在标准提示下普遍存在、在 prefilling 攻击下显著放大；再提出 SARA，同时奖励安全感知推理与安全答案，显著降低 DSAR 并保持有用性。
Motivation: RL 奖励只基于最终答案，几乎不监督中间推理，使推理轨迹与最终答案的安全信号互相矛盾，且在 prefilling 攻击下被放大，现有评测无法量化这种不一致。
Method: 提出 DSAR (Deceptive Safety Alignment Rate) 指标，联合评估推理轨迹与最终答案以量化安全不一致；再提出 SARA (Safety-Aware Reasoning Alignment)，一种基于 RL 的方法，同时奖励安全感知推理与安全最终答案，促使模型尽早识别有害意图并强制推理-答案一致。
Result: 在多个 LRM 与多个 benchmark 上，DSAR 显示标准提示下欺骗性安全对齐普遍存在，prefilling 攻击下显著放大；隐藏表示分析显示模型在最终答案阶段的安全判别强于中间推理阶段；SARA 在标准与对抗设定下均显著降低欺骗性安全对齐，同时保持 helpfulness 与 utility。
Conclusion: 欺骗性安全对齐源于奖励只落在最终答案上，把安全监督前移到推理阶段并强制推理-答案一致即可缓解，且不牺牲模型有用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Population Fidelity: Evaluating Population Representativeness in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) show considerable potential in simulating human attitudes and preferences. Prior work finds that LLM-generated responses can compress the range of attitudes found within populations and misrepresent particular subgroups in ways that vary across models and topics. We introduce Population Fidelity, an evaluation framework that distinguishes key conditions required for a set of LLM-generated responses to represent a population. It incorporates three dimensions: group-level accuracy, the amount of between-group variation, and the structure of that variation. We demonstrate the framework's utility in two ways. First, we reproduce a prior study of "machine bias" in LLM survey responses and apply the framework to its models and more recent ones, showing that poor representation reflects not only insufficient between-group variation but also variation assigned to the wrong groups. Second, we evaluate one proposed approach to improving models' population representativeness: cultural fine-tuning. We find that cultural fine-tuning can improve alignment with the survey center without improving the representation of within-population differences, a distinction that measures of aggregate agreement do not capture. We argue that representing a population requires models to reproduce several features of human attitudinal variation simultaneously. Our framework organizes these features and provides reusable code, data, and trained models for evaluating population fidelity across substantive domains and assessing proposed alignment methods.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Population Fidelity 评估框架，从组级准确度、组间差异幅度、差异结构三个维度判定 LLM 生成的回答能否代表一个人群，而不只看总体一致性。复现 LLM 调查回答的 machine bias 研究后发现，代表性差既来自组间差异不足，也来自差异被分配给了错误的群体；cultural fine-tuning 能把回答拉近调查中心，却不改善群体内部差异的表达。
Motivation: LLM 被用来模拟人群态度与偏好，但既有工作发现其回答会压缩人群态度分布、并以随模型和议题变化的方式错代表特定子群，而总体一致性指标看不出这种错位。
Method: 框架含三个维度：group-level accuracy、between-group variation 的量、以及该差异的结构；先复现一项关于 LLM 调查回答 machine bias 的既有研究并套用到原模型与更新模型，再用它检验 cultural fine-tuning 这一改善人群代表性的方案。
Result: 复现 machine bias 研究显示代表性差不仅是组间差异不足，还包括差异被分配到错误的群体；cultural fine-tuning 提高了与调查中心的对齐度，但没有改善群体内部差异的表达，而总体一致性指标捕捉不到这一区分。
Conclusion: 代表人群要求模型同时重现人类态度差异的多项特征，单一聚合一致性指标不足以判定代表性；作者据此提供可复用的代码、数据与训练模型，用于跨领域评估 population fidelity 和检验对齐方法。

papers.title: The Signed Geometry of One-Shot Recourse: On-Path Validity and the Signed-Curvature Criterion
papers.abstract_en:
Closed-form recourse moves a rejected user along the unit gradient $\hat g$ of the classifier score $f$ by the promised distance $d_p=|f(x)|/\|
abla f(x)\|$, at which the linearized score reaches zero. We ask when this one-shot step succeeds and what additional model queries change. To leading order the step ends on the favorable side exactly when the path curvature $κ=\hat g^	op
abla^2 f(x)\,\hat g$ is nonnegative. Across 80 shallow models, the fraction of rejected users whose step ends there and the fraction with $κ\ge0$ correlate at $r=0.985$, although on Fashion-MNIST the first falls below the second by 8.2 points on average. No rule that uses only the score value and gradient can be valid for every score with path curvature bounded by $K$ without overshooting some by order $Kd_p^2/\|
abla f(x)\|$. When the curvature is also Lipschitz and the step is short, one evaluation of $f$ at the promised point attains the minimax rate among deterministic one-query rules that know the curvature bound and its Lipschitz constant, and split-conformal calibration makes such a rule reach the first crossing or abstain with probability at least $1-δ$. Training with an asymmetric curvature penalty lets 99-100% of paths cross within the promised step on undershoot-prone shallow data, at about 4-22 times the overshoot of symmetric penalties (Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS). Because $κ$ and $d_p$ depend on how the score is scaled, part of this gain can be a longer promised step, and at matched validity a smaller audit of briefly trained models finds no uniform advantage over tuned inflation. Where a per-user line search along the ray is affordable, it is exact to grid resolution and preferable.
papers.comment: Main text 8 pages; 57 pages including appendix and checklist
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 闭式 recourse 沿分类器分数的单位梯度走承诺步长 d_p=|f(x)|/‖∇f(x)‖，本文证明一步走到有利侧当且仅当路径曲率 κ=ĝᵀ∇²f(x)ĝ 非负；80 个浅层模型上实际成功率与 κ≥0 比例相关 r=0.985。仅用分数值与梯度的规则在曲率有界 K 时必然以 O(Kd_p²/‖∇f(x)‖) 过冲；曲率 Lipschitz 且步长短时，一次 f 求值即达 minimax 率，split-conformal 校准使规则以至少 1-δ 概率命中首次穿越或弃权。
Motivation: 闭式一步 recourse 承诺让被拒用户的线性化分数归零，但非线性曲率会让这一步落到不利侧或过冲；需要判定一步何时成功、以及额外模型查询能改善多少。
Method: 对分数 f 做路径曲率 κ=ĝᵀ∇²f(x)ĝ 的一阶展开，给出仅用分数与梯度的规则的下界（曲率界 K 下必过冲 O(Kd_p²/‖∇f(x)‖)）；在曲率 Lipschitz 且步长短时构造单次 f 求值的 minimax 规则，并用 split-conformal 校准保证以 1-δ 概率到达首次穿越或弃权；训练侧加非对称曲率惩罚，并与对称惩罚、tuned inflation、沿射线 line search 对比。
Result: 80 个浅层模型上，一步走到有利侧的比例与 κ≥0 比例相关 r=0.985；Fashion-MNIST 上前者平均比后者低 8.2 个百分点。非对称曲率惩罚训练使 undershoot 易发的浅层数据上 99-100% 路径在承诺步内穿越，但过冲约为对称惩罚的 4-22 倍（Fashion-MNIST、COMPAS）；在匹配有效性下，对短暂训练模型的小规模审计未发现相对 tuned inflation 的一致优势。
Conclusion: 路径曲率符号是一步 recourse 成败的判据，但曲率与步长都随分数缩放而变，非对称惩罚的增益部分来自更长的承诺步；若能负担沿射线的逐用户 line search，它精确到网格分辨率且更可取。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
papers.abstract_en: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. Across 25 simulated robotics tasks from IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, spanning locomotion, arm manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction, ACPPO-Corr achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated methods and performs best on both decision-frequency-sensitive and decision-frequency-neutral task subsets. Ablations show that moderate chunk lengths work best and that corrector regularization is important for balancing chunk-level planning with local feedback. These results suggest that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when chunk-level planning is paired with closed-loop correction. The code is available at: https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO)：用分块 actor 做时序抽象但保留标准状态值 critic，避免难以学习的 chunk 级 Q 函数；ACPPO-Corr 再在每个 chunk 内加逐步反馈校正器在线修正动作。在 IsaacGym 与 Bi-DexHands 共 25 个仿真机器人任务上，ACPPO-Corr 总体性能最强，在对决策频率敏感与不敏感两个子集上都排第一。
Motivation: 高维机器人控制中，chunk 级 value/Q 函数随动作维度与块长增长难以学习，且开环执行整块动作丢掉块内反馈，接触密集任务反应性差。
Method: ACPPO 扩展 PPO：分块 actor 输出短动作序列，critic 仍是标准状态值函数，从而绕开 chunked Q；ACPPO-Corr 在 chunk planner 上叠加 stepwise feedback corrector，块内逐步在线调整已规划动作。
Result: 在 IsaacGym 与 Bi-DexHands 的 25 个仿真任务（locomotion、arm manipulation、dexterous hand-object interaction）上，ACPPO-Corr 在被评估方法中总体性能最强，且在决策频率敏感与中性两个任务子集上均居首；消融显示中等 chunk 长度最好，corrector 正则对平衡块级规划与局部反馈很重要。
Conclusion: 在线 PPO 中 action chunking 可行，前提是块级规划与闭环修正配对使用；块长取中等值并给 corrector 加正则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CoRe: Co-Evolving Reward Models for Mitigating Latent Reward Hacking in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent reward models (LRMs) enable efficient alignment of video diffusion models by scoring intermediate states directly in latent space. However, we find that optimizing against a fixed latent reward rapidly leads to latent reward hacking: the predicted reward stays high while perceptual and motion quality deteriorate. Our analysis identifies distributional escape as the central cause: within a few hundred updates, the generator moves beyond the reward model's training support, where its scores no longer reflect video quality. Based on this insight, we introduce CoRe, a co-evolving reward framework that treats latent-space alignment as a dynamic interaction between the generator and the reward model. Rather than optimizing against a stationary proxy, CoRe continually refits the reward model on the generator's current samples while anchoring it to real-video preferences, so the generator cannot gain reward by drifting away from the data. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, experiments show that CoRe consistently improves generation quality over both the pretrained model and prior alignment methods, while avoiding the quality collapse of fixed-reward optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoRe 把视频扩散模型的 latent reward 对齐改成生成器与奖励模型的共同演化：奖励模型持续在生成器当前样本上重拟合，同时用真实视频偏好做锚定，使生成器无法靠漂移出奖励模型训练支撑区来刷分。在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上，CoRe 相对预训练模型和既有对齐方法一致提升生成质量，并避免固定奖励优化导致的质量崩塌。
Motivation: latent reward model (LRM) 让视频扩散对齐只需在隐空间打分，但对固定奖励持续优化会触发 latent reward hacking：预测分数维持高位而感知与运动质量下滑，根因是生成器几百步内就逃出奖励模型的训练支撑区 (distributional escape)。
Method: CoRe 框架把隐空间对齐视为生成器与奖励模型的动态博弈：不优化静态代理，而是持续用生成器当前采样重拟合 (refit) 奖励模型，并以真实视频偏好作锚定约束，防止生成器靠偏离数据分布获取奖励。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上，CoRe 相对预训练模型与先前对齐方法一致提升生成质量，同时避免固定奖励优化出现的质量崩塌；分析显示固定奖励下生成器在几百次更新内即逃出奖励模型训练支撑区。
Conclusion: 固定 latent reward 不是可靠的对齐代理，只有让奖励模型跟随生成器共同演化并锚定真实数据偏好，才能在隐空间对齐中同时保住分数与感知、运动质量。
