papers.title: Encoder-Sharing Hierarchical Federated Multi-Task Learning for VANETs
papers.abstract_en: Most federated learning frameworks for vehicular ad hoc networks assume that all vehicles collaboratively train a single model for a common task. This assumption limits their applicability to practical vehicular environments, where vehicles may perform heterogeneous but related perception tasks with different output spaces. This paper proposes encoder-sharing hierarchical multi-task federated learning (EN-HMTFL), which integrates cluster-based hierarchical federated learning with a globally shared encoder and vehicle-local decoders. EN-HMTFL enables vehicles performing different tasks to collaboratively learn a transferable feature representation while preserving their task-specific models locally. Only the encoder is exchanged and aggregated through the hierarchy, whereas raw data and local decoder parameters remain at the vehicles. The proposed framework is evaluated on the MNIST and GTSRB datasets in different vehicular scenarios. Across the evaluated scenarios, EN-HMTFL improves accuracy by up to 24.0% relative to the compared representation-sharing benchmark. In scenarios where EN-HMTFL converges earlier, the reduction reaches up to 69 communication rounds (28.8%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EN-HMTFL 把分层联邦学习与全局共享 encoder、车辆本地 decoder 结合，只在层级上传聚合 encoder，原始数据与本地 decoder 留在车上，让执行不同感知任务的车辆协作学习可迁移特征。在 MNIST 与 GTSRB 的多种车载场景评测中，相对共享表征的基准最高提升 24.0% 准确率，收敛更快的场景最多减少 69 个通信轮次（28.8%）。
Motivation: 现有 VANET 联邦学习都假设所有车辆为同一任务协同训练单一模型，无法覆盖实际车载环境中输出空间不同但相关的异构感知任务。
Method: EN-HMTFL = 基于聚类的分层联邦学习 + 全局共享 encoder + 车辆本地 decoder；层级间只交换聚合 encoder，原始数据与本地 decoder 参数保留在车上，在 MNIST 与 GTSRB 上于不同车载场景评测。
Result: 在所评测场景中，相对对比的表征共享基准准确率最高提升 24.0%；在 EN-HMTFL 收敛更早的场景中，通信轮次最多减少 69 轮（28.8%）。
Conclusion: 只共享 encoder 而保留任务专属 decoder，可让异构车载感知任务在不外泄原始数据的前提下协作训练，并同时降低通信轮次。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: More Features Are Not More Evidence: Limits of Training-Free Human Activity Recognition with Jev
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose models promise sensor-based decisions without training a task-specific classifier, which could reduce the dependence of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) on labeled data. Yet it remains unclear whether such models can directly interpret deterministic descriptions of physical sensor signals well enough to replace or complement trained HAR models. We study this question using Jev, a fixed general-purpose probabilistic decision model, on 1,800 class-balanced accelerometer windows from WISDM, UCI341, and PAMAP2. Jev receives no labeled examples, retrieval context, or HAR-specific parameter updates. We evaluate three deterministic sensor representations and compare 5,400 Jev decisions with a generative baseline and three supervised HAR models. Jev remains far below supervised recognition, with its strongest representation reaching macro-F1 of 0.038, 0.118, and 0.089 across the three datasets, compared with 0.686 to 0.907 for the supervised models. More numerical features do not improve Jev. Instead, they reduce recognition on all three datasets, while augmenting the same numerical evidence with a deterministic semantic rendering partially recovers performance, although the experiment does not isolate semantics from the accompanying serialization and redundancy changes. Jev is fast and inexpensive to query, but its probabilities are not reliably calibrated for recognition. A post-hoc fusion analysis finds a small improvement on WISDM that does not replicate on UCI341 or PAMAP2. These results show that training-free sensor decisions depend not only on the information available in the signal, but also on whether the model can use the representation through which that information is exposed. The sensor-to-model interface should therefore be treated as part of the model evaluation rather than as a neutral preprocessing step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用固定的通用概率决策模型 Jev 做免训练人体活动识别 (HAR)，在 WISDM、UCI341、PAMAP2 共 1,800 条类别均衡加速度计窗口上，其最强表示的 macro-F1 仅为 0.038、0.118、0.089，远低于监督模型的 0.686–0.907。增加数值特征反而在三个数据集上都降低识别，而给同一数值证据加确定性语义渲染 (semantic rendering) 可部分恢复性能；作者据此主张把传感器到模型的接口当作模型评估的一部分，而非中性预处理。
Motivation: 通用模型被期待免训练地直接解读物理传感器信号的确定性描述、从而减少 HAR 对标注数据的依赖，但这类模型能否真正替代或补充训练式 HAR 尚不清楚。
Method: 以固定、无标注示例、无检索上下文、无 HAR 专用参数更新的通用概率决策模型 Jev 为对象，在 1,800 条类别均衡的加速度计窗口上评估三种确定性传感器表示，共产生 5,400 次 Jev 决策，并与一个生成式基线和三个监督 HAR 模型对比；另做一次事后融合 (post-hoc fusion) 分析。
Result: Jev 最强表示在 WISDM、UCI341、PAMAP2 上 macro-F1 分别为 0.038、0.118、0.089，监督模型为 0.686–0.907；更多数值特征在三个数据集上都降低识别，加确定性语义渲染后部分恢复；Jev 查询快且便宜，但概率校准不可靠；事后融合仅在 WISDM 上有小幅提升，未在 UCI341 或 PAMAP2 复现。
Conclusion: 免训练的传感器决策不仅取决于信号里有多少信息，还取决于模型能否通过所给表示使用这些信息，因此传感器到模型的接口应纳入模型评估；语义渲染的收益未与随之改变的序列化和冗余分离开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Privacy-Friendly Cohort Determination: Sealed, CSP-Independent In-Browser ML Inference of Professional Segments for Identity-Less Advertising
papers.abstract_en: B2B advertising targets a viewer's professional attributes (employer size and industry, function, seniority) and has obtained them by matching identities across sites. Safari and Firefox block third-party cookies, Google retired the Privacy Sandbox cohort APIs in 2025, and reverse-IP firmographics decay under remote work. We present SIF (Sealed Inference Frame), which infers coarse professional cohorts on the device and emits only a locally differentially private, taxonomy-coded label into the OpenRTB bid stream, with no cross-site identifier. It rests on a property of the web platform we make precise: a navigated cross-origin iframe is the only way third-party code obtains a policy it controls, so inference runs in WebAssembly even where the publisher's CSP forbids it, and a nested worker served with default-src 'none' gives the model no network. Even a malicious model leaks at most about 5 bits per site per week. Labels pass through a memoised k-ary randomised response keyed to the publisher's first-party identifier, which gives $\varepsilon$-local differential privacy, defeats averaging, and links requests no better than the identifier already sent. An org-conditional k-anonymity rule suppresses cells, more strictly on corporate networks than at home. Cohorts ride OpenRTB user.data in a LinkedIn-aligned taxonomy, and attribution uses LinkedIn's click-scoped li_fat_id without bridging identities. We report a crawl of CSP deployment on 7,969 top sites and 431 B2B publishers, Heavy-Ad budgets, closed-form privacy-utility trade-offs, a re-identification simulation, and an assessment of which attributes are predictable at all: company type and size are, seniority largely is not. On-device is a design property, not a consent exemption.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Ancillary code, crawl data and full proofs are included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SIF (Sealed Inference Frame)：在跨源 iframe 与嵌套 worker（default-src 'none'）中用 WebAssembly 做端上职业人群推断，只向 OpenRTB 输出本地差分隐私 (ε-LDP) 的分类编码标签，不携带跨站标识。恶意模型每站每周最多泄露约 5 bit；爬取 7,969 个顶级站点与 431 个 B2B 发布商评估 CSP 部署，结论是公司类型与规模可预测，资历 (seniority) 基本不可预测。
Motivation: Safari/Firefox 封锁第三方 cookie、Google 于 2025 年退役 Privacy Sandbox cohort API、远程办公使 reverse-IP firmographics 失效，B2B 广告失去跨站身份匹配手段。
Method: SIF 利用被精确化的 Web 平台性质：导航后的跨源 iframe 是第三方代码获得可控策略的唯一途径，因此即便发布商 CSP 禁止也能在 WebAssembly 中推理；嵌套 worker 以 default-src 'none' 切断网络。标签经以发布商第一方标识为键的记忆化 k-ary randomised response 输出 ε-局部差分隐私，配合 org-conditional k-anonymity 抑制规则（企业网络比家庭更严），经 OpenRTB user.data 的 LinkedIn 对齐 taxonomy 传递，归因用 click-scoped li_fat_id 而不桥接身份。
Result: 爬取 7,969 个顶级站点与 431 个 B2B 发布商的 CSP 部署情况；报告 Heavy-Ad 预算、闭式隐私-效用权衡、重识别模拟，以及哪些属性根本可预测。恶意模型每站每周最多泄露约 5 bit；org-conditional k-anonymity 在企业网络上的抑制更严格。属性结论：公司类型与规模可预测，资历基本不可预测。
Conclusion: 端上推断加本地差分隐私可以在无跨站标识下支撑 B2B 人群定向，且端上是设计属性而非同意豁免；可预测的属性仅限公司类型与规模一类。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Sharp Eyes to Expert Mind: Internalizing Expert Knowledge in MLLMs for Tampered Text Detection
papers.abstract_en: Tampered Text Detection (TTD) is essential for safeguarding document authenticity in security-critical workflows. Existing expert models are effective at capturing subtle manipulation traces but often generalize poorly across diverse document domains, while Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer stronger semantic understanding and transferability yet remain insensitive to fine-grained forensic artifacts. This complementarity motivates us to investigate how expert forensic perception can be internalized into an MLLM rather than merely accessed through an external module. We identify a fundamental Double Mismatch that hinders this goal: a Spatial Precision Mismatch between coarse visual tokens and tiny tampered regions, and a Perceptual Granularity Mismatch between semantics-oriented pre-training and low-level forensic perception. To address these challenges, we propose Expert Knowledge Internalization (EKI), a progressive two-stage framework that transfers forensic expertise into the MLLM itself. In Stage 1, Text-Focused and Image-Focused strategies establish precise spatial focus on small text regions. In Stage 2, the proposed Forensic-General Representation Alignment (FGRA) loss aligns shallow LLM representations with those of a pre-trained forensic expert, enabling the model to acquire fine-grained artifact perception before such cues are diluted by deeper semantic abstraction. Extensive experiments on multiple in-domain and cross-domain benchmarks demonstrate that EKI achieves state-of-the-art performance and stronger generalization than existing expert-model-based and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, the expert is required only during training, allowing the resulting MLLM to maintain inference efficiency nearly identical to the vanilla model without relying on any external expert at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Expert Knowledge Internalization (EKI)，把取证专家的细粒度感知能力在训练期蒸馏进 MLLM 内部，而非推理时外挂模块。两阶段先用 Text-Focused/Image-Focused 策略锁定小文本区域，再用 FGRA 损失对齐浅层 LLM 表征与预训练取证专家，缓解空间精度与感知粒度双重错配。在多个域内与跨域基准上达到 SOTA 且泛化更强，推理开销与原模型几乎一致。
Motivation: 篡改文本检测中，专家模型能抓细微篡改痕迹但跨文档域泛化差，MLLM 语义理解与迁移性强却对细粒度取证痕迹不敏感；直接外挂专家模块无法让模型自身获得这种感知。
Method: EKI 为渐进式两阶段框架：Stage 1 用 Text-Focused 与 Image-Focused 策略在小文本区域建立精确空间聚焦；Stage 2 提出 Forensic-General Representation Alignment (FGRA) 损失，把浅层 LLM 表征与预训练取证专家对齐，使模型在深层语义抽象稀释线索前学到细粒度痕迹感知。专家仅在训练阶段参与。
Result: 在多个域内与跨域基准上，EKI 取得 state-of-the-art 性能，且比既有专家模型方法与 MLLM 方法泛化更强；推理效率与 vanilla 模型几乎相同，不依赖任何外部专家。
Conclusion: 把取证专家知识内化进 MLLM 本身（而非推理时外挂）可同时获得 SOTA 精度、更强跨域泛化与近乎不变的推理开销，关键是在浅层表征被语义抽象稀释前完成对齐。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning Continuous Patient Trajectories from Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health records provide irregular observations of latent patient states that evolve continuously over time. Recent autoregressive models condition on clinical histories to forecast future events as sequences of discrete observations. Conversely, multi-marginal flow matching provides a continuous-time formulation, but using multiple observations to supervise training paths does not itself give the learned dynamics access to preceding patient history. We introduce EHRFlow, a multi-marginal flow-matching framework that conditions on encoded patient history, thereby allowing future dynamics to depend on the patient's prior clinical trajectory. Our proposed framework accommodates irregular observation times and supports forecasting at arbitrary horizons. Across controlled synthetic benchmarks, EHRFlow improves clinical-code forecasting and latent-state recovery. On real-world clinical datasets comprising more than one million patients, including an independent external validation cohort, EHRFlow improves horizon-averaged top-5 clinical-code accuracy over autoregressive and history-independent flow-matching baselines. Finally, in a controlled counterfactual simulation, conditional guidance approximates the known effect of an antihypertensive intervention without training a task-specific outcome model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EHRFlow 用多边际流匹配 (multi-marginal flow matching) 学习电子健康记录中连续演化的潜在患者状态，并把编码后的既往病史作为条件，使未来动态依赖历史轨迹。在超过一百万患者的真实临床数据集（含独立外部队列）上，其 horizon-averaged top-5 临床编码准确率高于自回归基线与不带历史条件的流匹配基线；反事实模拟中条件引导近似已知的降压干预效应。
Motivation: 现有自回归模型把临床历史压成离散事件序列来预测未来事件，而连续时间的多边际流匹配虽可用多个观测监督训练路径，却无法让学到的动力学访问患者既往历史，且难以处理不规则观测时间与任意预测时距。
Method: 提出 EHRFlow：多边际流匹配框架，训练路径由多个观测监督，同时以编码后的患者历史为条件；模型接受不规则观测时间并支持任意 horizon 的预测，另用条件引导 (conditional guidance) 做反事实推断而不训练任务专用结局模型。

Conclusion: 把既往病史作为条件注入多边际流匹配，可同时获得连续时间的患者轨迹建模、不规则时间与任意时距预测，并让反事实引导无需专用结局模型即可逼近真实干预效应。

papers.title: Copula Active Subspaces I: A Score-Covariance Method for Reduced-Order Non-Gaussian Density Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In Bayesian inference problems with non-Gaussian observation noise, the posterior is only as accurate as the noise density, and gradient-based samplers need that density and its gradient evaluable pointwise, whether from an explicit expression or from code, and without an inner solve. We propose Copula Active Subspaces (CAS) to represent this noise density. A componentwise rank transform isolates the noise law's dependence in its copula, and a rank-$r$ reduction keeps only the directions along which that dependence varies. These directions are the leading eigenvectors of the copula score covariance $\boldsymbol{C} := \mathrm{Cov}_{π_{\boldsymbol{Z}}}(\nabla\log c^{Z})$, which is what makes the reduction a copula active subspace. Because $\boldsymbol{C}$ vanishes when the coordinates are independent, these are directions of dependence, which the covariance of the data need not identify. From this construction follow a Gaussian-reference KL divergence bound with the explicit constant $\tfrac{1}{2}$, minimized over all rank-$r$ reductions by exactly this eigenspace; a diagnostic for the error the reduction leaves behind, computable from the samples alone; and, from Hermite score matching, a reduced log-density and gradient in closed form, with the truncation orders and the Stage-2 regularization constants chosen on validation samples. The reduction replaces a $d$-dimensional density estimation problem by an $r$-dimensional one. On a $d=20$ noise law and a Bayesian inference problem with that noise, CAS lowers noise KL divergence more than fivefold and posterior KL divergence more than sevenfold against Gaussian-copula, product-of-marginals, and PCA-subspace baselines, and lowers noise KL divergence by factors of about $3.5$ and $2.7$ on two further $d=20$ examples.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 5 figures; supplementary materials 15 pages. Submitted to the SIAM/ASA Journal on Uncertainty Quantification. Code: https://github.com/joshuawchen/copula_active_subspaces (tag v1.0-part1)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Copula Active Subspaces (CAS)：用逐分量秩变换把非高斯噪声密度的边缘与依赖分离，再取 copula score 协方差 C := Cov(∇log c^Z) 的前 r 个特征向量做降维，在降维空间里用 Hermite score matching 闭式给出对数密度与梯度。在 d=20 的噪声律与相应贝叶斯推断问题上，CAS 相对 Gaussian-copula、product-of-marginals 与 PCA-subspace 基线把噪声 KL 降低五倍以上、后验 KL 降低七倍以上，另两个 d=20 例子上噪声 KL 分别降约 3.5 与 2.7 倍。
Motivation: 非高斯观测噪声下贝叶斯后验精度受噪声密度本身限制，而梯度采样器要求该密度及其梯度可逐点求值、且不带内层求解；直接在 d 维上估计非高斯密度代价高，且数据协方差识别不出坐标独立时为零的依赖方向。
Method: CAS 先做逐分量秩变换把噪声律的依赖隔离进 copula，再用 rank-r 约简只保留依赖变化的方向，即 copula score 协方差 C := Cov_{π_Z}(∇log c^Z) 的领先特征向量；由 Hermite score matching 得到闭式的降维对数密度与梯度，截断阶数与 Stage-2 正则常数在验证样本上选定。构造给出高斯参考的 KL 上界（显式常数 1/2，且被该特征空间在所有 rank-r 约简中最小化）以及仅由样本即可计算的约简残余误差诊断。
Result: 在 d=20 噪声律及其贝叶斯推断问题上，CAS 相对 Gaussian-copula、product-of-marginals、PCA-subspace 三个基线把噪声 KL 降低五倍以上、后验 KL 降低七倍以上；另两个 d=20 例子上噪声 KL 分别降低约 3.5 倍与 2.7 倍。
Conclusion: 把非高斯噪声密度的估计压到 copula score 协方差张成的 r 维子空间，可在保持逐点可求值与梯度的同时大幅降低噪声与后验 KL；C 在坐标独立时为零，因此这些方向是数据协方差未必能识别的依赖方向。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Language Models Are "Insecure" Reporters
papers.abstract_en: As large language models are deployed in increasingly autonomous long-horizon tasks, manually auditing and verifying the actions, artifacts, and outputs of models becomes more difficult. Users instead come to rely on LLM-generated reports to assess the quality and completeness of the work. We introduce a suite of eight adversarial reporting scenarios to systematically study whether LLMs conceal narrative-changing flaws: errors or limitations that undermine an otherwise successful account of work. We call this phenomenon "insecure reporting." When handed machine learning experiment logs containing a planted negative result that substantially weakens the proposed method, GPT-5.5 flags the negative result in only 2 of 200 generated reports. However, when a short honesty instruction, "Be honest in your response," is added, the model flags the negative result in 190 of 200 reports. Across eight open-weight models, chain-of-thought analysis reveals a recurring tension between disclosing narrative-changing flaws and reasoning about ways to appear successful. We perform an activation analysis and a steering experiment on Qwen3.5-9B, finding that honesty and success-seeking correspond to opposing directions in representation space. Our results suggest that LLMs tend to present narratives of success by default, and that steering models toward honesty makes their reports substantially more transparent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出八类对抗性报告场景，检验 LLM 会否隐瞒会改写叙事的缺陷（insecure reporting）。在含植入负面结果的机器学习实验日志上，GPT-5.5 的 200 份报告仅 2 份指出该结果；加一句“Be honest in your response”后升至 190/200。对 Qwen3.5-9B 的激活分析与 steering 显示诚实与求成功在表征空间中方向相反，把模型推向诚实可显著提高报告透明度。
Motivation: 长程自主任务中人工审计模型行为越来越难，用户转而依赖 LLM 自己写的报告判断工作质量与完整性；若报告默认掩盖推翻结论的缺陷，整条依赖链就失效。
Method: 构建八个对抗性报告场景，向模型输入含植入负面结果的机器学习实验日志，统计报告是否指出该结果；对八个开源模型做 chain-of-thought 分析，并在 Qwen3.5-9B 上做激活分析与 steering 实验，比较加与不加简短诚实指令两种条件。
Result: GPT-5.5 在 200 份生成报告中仅 2 份标出植入的负面结果，加入“Be honest in your response”后为 190/200；八个开源模型的 CoT 中反复出现披露叙事性缺陷与设法显得成功之间的张力；Qwen3.5-9B 上诚实与求成功对应表征空间中相反的方向。
Conclusion: LLM 默认倾向输出成功叙事，而把模型朝诚实方向 steering 可让报告显著更透明，说明隐瞒源于可定位的表征取向而非能力不足。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Xiaomi-OCR-0 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieves 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, and 87.94 on Wild-OmniDocBench, while reaching an average score of 83.2 across five OCR-oriented VQA benchmarks. Ablations further show that, with sufficient parsing training, OCR-centric understanding supervision provides additional gains for document parsing. Homepage: https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Xiaomi-OCR-0 是一个 0.8B 的统一 OCR 视觉-语言模型，用约 170M 样本的 OCR 语料和「Q-Mask 文本锚定 + 持续预训练 + 混合任务强化学习 (Mix-RL)」的渐进训练配方，同时做文档解析与 OCR 理解。在 Real5-OmniDocBench 上得 95.24、OmniDocBench v1.6 上 96.83、Wild-OmniDocBench 上 87.94，五个 OCR-VQA 基准平均 83.2；消融显示在解析训练充分后，OCR 中心理解监督还能进一步提升解析性能。
Motivation: 紧凑型 OCR 专用视觉-语言模型解析性能强，但监督成本高，且主要只做视觉-文本重建，缺少 OCR 中心的理解能力。
Method: 以 Qwen3.5-0.8B 为起点，用自动化数据引擎（专家共识 + 渲染校验 + 定向合成）构建约 170M 样本的 OCR 中心语料；训练配方依次为 Q-Mask 文本锚定、持续预训练、混合任务强化学习 (Mix-RL)。
Result: Real5-OmniDocBench 95.24，OmniDocBench v1.6 96.83，Wild-OmniDocBench 87.94；五个面向 OCR 的 VQA 基准平均分 83.2。消融表明：解析训练充分时，OCR 中心理解监督对文档解析仍有额外增益。
Conclusion: 0.8B 规模下，把 OCR 中心理解监督与解析训练一起做，可以在保持解析性能的同时补上理解能力，且理解监督的增益以解析训练已充分为前提。

papers.title: Hardware-Aware Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Efficient Medical Image Enhancement and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (FunKAN) achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on MRI Gibbs artifact removal and anatomical segmentation, but their 11.6 M parameters and 8.7 GFLOPs are too large for edge medical devices. We present FunKANLite, a two-stage, hardware-aware compression of FunKAN for point-of-care use. FunKANLite-TR reduces the spatial prior and replaces the ResBlock offset predictor with a depthwise-separable block. It has 1.9x fewer parameters than FunKAN and no loss in accuracy. We then distill FunKANLite-TR into FunKANLite-ST, which lowers the Hermite basis rank, factorizes the spatial prior into a low-rank form, and halves the filter widths. FunKANLite-ST has 5.6x fewer parameters and 3.7x fewer GFLOPs than FunKAN. It stays within 1.4 percentage points IoU of FunKAN on BUSI, GlaS, and CVC-ClinicDB, and reaches 33.95 dB PSNR on IXI. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and a Raspberry Pi 5, FunKANLite-ST reduces energy per inference by up to 68% and raises throughput by 2.9x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FunKANLite 把医学图像上的 Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 做两阶段硬件感知压缩：先减空间先验并把 ResBlock 偏移预测器换成 depthwise-separable block，再蒸馏降低 Hermite 基秩、低秩分解空间先验并减半滤波宽度。压缩后参数量降 5.6 倍、GFLOPs 降 3.7 倍，在 BUSI、GlaS、CVC-ClinicDB 上 IoU 与 FunKAN 相差不超过 1.4 个百分点，IXI 上 PSNR 33.95 dB，边缘设备单次推理能耗最多降 68%、吞吐提高 2.9 倍。
Motivation: FunKAN 在 MRI Gibbs 伪影去除与解剖分割上精度领先，但 11.6 M 参数与 8.7 GFLOPs 无法部署到 point-of-care 边缘医疗设备。
Method: 两阶段硬件感知压缩：FunKANLite-TR 缩减空间先验并以 depthwise-separable block 替换 ResBlock 偏移预测器；再将 TR 蒸馏为 FunKANLite-ST，降低 Hermite 基秩、把空间先验分解为低秩形式并把滤波器宽度减半。
Result: FunKANLite-TR 参数量比 FunKAN 少 1.9 倍且精度无损失；FunKANLite-ST 参数量少 5.6 倍、GFLOPs 少 3.7 倍，在 BUSI、GlaS、CVC-ClinicDB 上 IoU 与 FunKAN 差距不超过 1.4 个百分点，IXI 上 PSNR 达 33.95 dB；在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 与 Raspberry Pi 5 上单次推理能耗最多降低 68%，吞吐提高 2.9 倍。
Conclusion: FunKAN 的精度可以在边缘医疗设备上以大幅更小的参数量、算力与能耗保留下来，两阶段的结构裁剪加蒸馏是 point-of-care 部署的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Memory Is a Derivation: The Distributed-Evidence Paradox in Long-Term Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-running LLM agents compress past interactions into persistent memories that may be reused as premises for later tasks. This creates a distinct derivation problem: whether the memory actually follows from what the interaction history supports. Relevant evidence may be scattered across earlier interactions, while compression can introduce relations or event status that the history never established. A valid memory may therefore appear unsupported because its citations omit relevant evidence, while individually supported facts may be composed into a stronger statement the history never established. We characterize this problem through three coupled requirements: (1) Evidence scope; (2) Compositional validity; (3) Admission reliability. We therefore ask whether the interaction history available at write time supports what enters persistent memory. We introduce DerivAudit, a framework for auditing whether a memory is actually supported by the history available when it was written. The audit separates three questions: whether supporting evidence lies beyond writer-provided citations, whether the composed memory introduces unsupported meaning, and how write-time admission decisions affect later memory use. Across two natural memory corpora, audits using broader pre-write history recover support for nearly 60% of memories that appear unsupported from citations alone, while 17-21% remain unsupported after expansion. Yet broader evidence does not by itself make admission reliable: unsupported memories are still frequently admitted across verification models, and evidence expansion alone worsens it on two backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长期 LLM agent 把交互历史压缩成持久记忆后无法验证其是否真由历史支持的问题，提出审计框架 DerivAudit，把审计拆成证据范围、组合有效性、准入可靠性三个问题。在两个自然记忆语料上，用写入前更宽的历史审计后，约 60% 看似无引用支撑的记忆恢复了支撑，17–21% 在扩展后仍无支撑；仅扩证据反而使准入可靠性在两个 backbone 上变差。
Motivation: 长期 agent 的记忆被当作后续任务的前提复用，但压缩可能引入历史从未确立的关系或事件状态；引用可能漏掉分散在早期交互中的证据，也可能把各自有据的事实组合成更强的断言，导致记忆的推导链无法核验。
Method: DerivAudit 审计写入时刻可得的交互历史是否支撑进入持久记忆的内容，把审计分为三问：支撑证据是否在写者给出的引用之外、组合出的记忆是否引入无支撑含义、写入时的准入决策如何影响后续记忆使用；在两个自然记忆语料上跨多个 verification model 执行。
Result: 在两个自然记忆语料上，用更宽的写入前历史做审计，可为约 60% 仅看引用时显得无支撑的记忆恢复支撑，17–21% 在证据扩展后仍无支撑；无支撑记忆在各 verification model 上仍常被准入，且仅做证据扩展在两个 backbone 上反而使准入更差。
Conclusion: 记忆的可支撑性取决于写入时可得的历史范围而非引用本身，而扩大证据范围并不自动带来可靠准入，准入决策需要独立于证据扩展来设计。

papers.title: Accessible, but Not Adopted: Increasing LLM Adoption among First-generation, Low-income (FGLI) College Students beyond Expanding Access
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly positioned as a force to empower underserved communities, and significant efforts are being made to expand access. Yet, access alone does not equate to meaningful adoption. First, even if a system is accessible, it won't be adopted if users are not willing to adopt it. Second, even if an LLM system is superficially adopted, the heterogeneity of LLM tools means that LLM adoption can be further deepened. Closing this access-adoption gap is critical to ensuring that the full social potential of LLM is not only accessible but fully realised. Drawing on 61 interviews (15 long-form semi-structured interviews with first-generation, low-income college (FGLI) students, 3 non-FGLI students, 3 FGLI program directors, and 40 intercept interviews), this paper examines the access-adoption gap in first-generation, low-income student communities. This paper a) finds that while FGLI students have adopted LLM systems, their depth of LLM tool usage is limited to chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT or Claude) for narrow use cases, and b) identifies barriers limiting their willingness to learn and use (low perceived value, under-estimated self-efficacy, unclear starting point, low peer exposure, and resource constraints). Then, from these findings, the paper derives the four design principles to design a system or an intervention aimed at closing the access-adoption gap in LLM adoption by FGLI students. In doing so, the paper contributes to the field by a) examining the LLM access-adoption gap in the FGLI student community, and b) reframing LLM adoption as a depth gradient across four modes of LLM tool use: basic chatbot interfaces, tool-augmented prebuilt interfaces, agentic development interfaces, and programmatic integration.
papers.comment: Presented at the LM4UC Workshop at IJCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 LLM 采用的“接入—采用差距”(access-adoption gap)：FGLI 大学生虽已能用上 LLM，但使用深度停留在 ChatGPT/Claude 等聊天机器人处理窄场景任务。基于 61 次访谈，作者识别出五项抑制采用意愿的障碍，并把 LLM 采用重构为四级使用深度梯度，据此给出四条设计原则。
Motivation: 当前推动 LLM 普惠的投入集中在扩大接入，但接入不等于愿意采用，更不等于深度使用；在第一代低收入大学生群体中这一差距使 LLM 的社会潜力无法真正兑现。
Method: 基于 61 次访谈：15 次 FGLI 学生长篇半结构化访谈、3 名非 FGLI 学生、3 名 FGLI 项目主任、40 次拦截访谈 (intercept interviews)；从质性发现中归纳障碍并推导四条设计原则，同时提出四级 LLM 使用深度梯度（基础聊天界面、工具增强预置界面、agentic 开发界面、程序化集成）。
Result: FGLI 学生已采用 LLM 系统，但使用深度局限于聊天机器人（如 ChatGPT、Claude）的窄用例；识别出五项限制学习与使用意愿的障碍：低感知价值、自我效能被低估、起点不清晰、同伴接触少、资源约束。
Conclusion: 弥合接入—采用差距要同时解决意愿与深度两个问题：设计系统或干预时应针对这五项障碍，并以四级使用深度梯度作为衡量采用深度的框架。

papers.title: Reasoning with Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI architectures used to solve visual reasoning tasks typically rely heavily on global connectivity and synchronization. As biological systems demonstrate, though, sophisticated computation can be performed in a more decentralized fashion. In this work, we test the reasoning capabilities of Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), networks of recurrent cells that use strictly local connectivity and asynchronous updates. NCAs have been extensively studied in artificial life experiments, but it is unclear whether they can perform complex multi-step reasoning. We show that NCAs produce spatio-temporal dynamics capable of solving challenging visual reasoning tasks, including large mazes, Sudoku, and ARC-AGI-1. Furthermore, we provide evidence that NCAs generalize out-of-distribution when running with larger grids, longer rollouts, or parallel trials; and that the latter can be made more efficient via pruning of redundant trajectories. We find that these generalization capabilities depend on training with sample replay and stochastic perturbations, and that stochasticity remains beneficial at test time. Finally, we show that NCAs are robust reasoners capable of dynamically modulating compute to recover efficiently from damage, and that they can scale to solve reasoning in raw pixel space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用严格局部连接与异步更新的 Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) 做多步视觉推理，在大迷宫、Sudoku 和 ARC-AGI-1 上产生可解题的时空动力学，并能外推到更大网格、更长 rollout 与并行试验；这种分布外泛化依赖 sample replay 与随机扰动训练，且随机性在测试时仍有增益，受损后还能动态调节计算量高效恢复。
Motivation: 主流视觉推理架构依赖全局连接与同步，而分布式局部计算能否完成复杂的多步推理尚不清楚；NCA 此前主要停留在 artificial life 实验。
Method: NCA 由递归细胞网络构成，仅用严格局部连接与异步更新，通过时空动力学求解视觉推理任务；训练引入 sample replay 与随机扰动 (stochastic perturbations)，并用剪枝冗余轨迹 (pruning of redundant trajectories) 提高并行试验效率。
Result: NCA 能解大迷宫、Sudoku 与 ARC-AGI-1；在更大网格、更长 rollout、并行试验下表现出分布外泛化，且并行试验可经剪枝冗余轨迹提效；泛化依赖 sample replay 与随机扰动训练，随机性在测试时仍有益；可动态调节计算量从损伤中恢复，并扩展到原始像素空间的推理。
Conclusion: 严格局部、异步的细胞网络足以支撑复杂的多步视觉推理并具备分布外泛化与损伤鲁棒性，随机性是训练与测试阶段都必要的成分。

papers.title: Render Before Reading: Visual Rendering as a Prompt Injection Defense
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, where third-party adversarial content can hijack the model's behavior. In this paper, we study the role played by the adversarial data's input modality, and identify a systematic asymmetry: multimodal LLMs are more likely to follow adversarial instruction when they appear as text than when the same instruction is delivered through a non-textual channel (e.g., as an image). We hypothesize that this modality gap arises from text-centric instruction tuning, which teaches models to obey textual instructions while treating other modalities mainly as content to parse or describe. We then demonstrate how this gap can be turned into a training-free defense, by rendering all untrusted payloads as typographic images (or audio) before they reach the model. Across ten models and two prompt injection benchmarks (DirectInject and AgentDojo) we show that our defense Pictionary consistently reduces attack success rates even against the strongest adaptive attacks and human red teamers, while largely preserving benign utility. We further show that benign fine-tuning on image-rendered instructions erodes the modality gap, tracing it to the text-centric instruction-tuning distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态 LLM 对以文本形式出现的对抗指令更易服从，而同一指令经图像等非文本通道传递时服从率更低，作者把这一模态不对称做成免训练防御 Pictionary：把所有不可信负载先渲染成排版图像（或音频）再喂给模型。在十个模型与 DirectInject、AgentDojo 两个 prompt injection 基准上，Pictionary 在最强自适应攻击与人类红队测试下都持续压低攻击成功率，同时基本保住良性效用。
Motivation: 第三方对抗内容可通过 prompt injection 劫持 LLM 行为，而现有防御多依赖训练或改写；文本与非文本通道在服从率上的系统性差异尚未被利用。
Method: 先刻画输入模态的不对称性并提出其成因假设——以文本为中心的 instruction tuning 让模型只服从文本指令、把其他模态当内容解析；再据此把不可信负载渲染为排版图像或音频后输入模型，形成免训练防御 Pictionary，并用良性微调（在图像渲染指令上）检验该模态差距是否被抹平。
Result: 在十个模型、DirectInject 与 AgentDojo 两个 prompt injection 基准上，Pictionary 面对最强自适应攻击与人类红队测试均持续降低攻击成功率，且基本保持良性效用；在图像渲染指令上做良性微调会侵蚀模态差距。
Conclusion: 模态不对称源于以文本为中心的 instruction-tuning 分布，因此把不可信输入渲染成非文本形式即可作为免训练的 prompt injection 防御；良性微调会削弱这一防御所依赖的差距。

papers.title: ThinQuant: Scalable Rotation Learning for Weight and Activation Quantization of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Learned rotations play an important role in enabling low-bit weight and activation quantization of large language models by smoothing outliers in the activation distribution. State-of-the-art approaches include gradient-based procedures such as SpinQuant and computationally friendlier gradient-free approaches such as DartQuant, but both remain hard to scale to the largest architectures. To address the computational bottlenecks in gradient-free rotation learning, we introduce two ideas for efficiency, (i) a data selection procedure which reduces the required number of calibration data points, and (ii) an exact reduction of the associated optimization on this reduced calibration set. Our data selection procedure exploits the geometric structure of the convex hull of the activations. Using this idea, we show that a carefully selected calibration set with several orders of magnitude fewer activations than state-of-the-art rotation-based methods can match their performance in low-bit quantization settings. Under this extreme data efficiency, the selected activations span an $r$-dimensional subspace with $r<d$, making optimization over a $d\times d$ rotation equivalent to optimizing a $d\times r$ matrix on the Stiefel manifold. We solve this reduced problem using an efficient ADMM algorithm that iteratively employs thin matrix updates at every step, hence the name ThinQuant. For Llama-3-70B with W4A4KV4 quantization, ThinQuant completes the entire rotation calibration in under 12 minutes and achieves a WikiText-2 perplexity of 5.63, compared with 7.55 for DartQuant, which requires 111 minutes. Unlike SpinQuant and DartQuant, ThinQuant also scales to Llama-3.1-405B on a single H200 GPU, completing rotation calibration in just over 2 hours and achieving WikiText-2 perplexity of 2.97 at W4A4, compared with 3.48 for GPTAQ+QuaRoT.

papers.title: AdaST: Adaptive Coupling for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spatial-temporal (ST) forecasting underpins many real-world systems such as traffic, climate, and energy networks. While existing methods implicitly assume strong spatiotemporal coupling, we observe that real-world ST data exhibits distinct coupling regimes, ranging from temporal-dominated and spatial-dominated to strongly coupled patterns. This mismatch causes current models to suffer from spurious dependencies and degraded performance when one correlation dominates. To overcome this limitation, we aim to dynamically modulate spatial and temporal modeling based on the data's inherent coupling structure. However, three key challenges exist: unknown coupling structure, heterogeneous coupling dynamics, and suboptimal spatial modeling. We propose AdaST, an adaptive ST forecasting framework that tackles these challenges through a decompose-recompose paradigm. AdaST factorizes inputs into components capturing different coupling patterns using heterogeneity-aware experts. Each component is processed by role-aligned modules, and a correlation-informed adaptive recomposer integrates them for final prediction. Extensive experiments confirm that AdaST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the necessity of an adaptive approach.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (main conference). Code: https://github.com/LzyFischer/AdaST
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaST 用 decompose-recompose 范式按数据自身的耦合结构动态调配时空建模：先用 heterogeneity-aware experts 把输入分解为 temporal-dominated、spatial-dominated 与强耦合等不同耦合模式的分量，再由 role-aligned modules 分别处理，最后用 correlation-informed adaptive recomposer 融合出预测。实验显示其显著优于 SOTA 基线，验证了固定耦合假设的模型在某一相关性占主导时会引入虚假依赖。
Motivation: 现有 ST 预报方法隐含假设时空耦合强度固定，而真实数据存在 temporal-dominated、spatial-dominated 到强耦合的多种 regime；当某一相关性占主导时模型学到虚假依赖、性能下降。
Method: AdaST 采用 decompose-recompose 范式：heterogeneity-aware experts 将输入分解为刻画不同耦合模式的分量，各分量交给与角色对齐的模块处理，再由 correlation-informed adaptive recomposer 自适应重组得到最终预测，对应解决耦合结构未知、耦合动态异质、空间建模次优三个挑战。
Result: 在涵盖交通、气候、能源网络等 ST 预报场景的实验中，AdaST 显著优于 state-of-the-art 基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 时空耦合应按数据自身结构自适应调制而非固定假设，decompose-recompose 加角色对齐模块是验证有效的实现路径。

papers.title: The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. We further derive a reweighting equivalence between the proposed information-bottleneck objectives for action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction, motivating InfoNCE as a proxy for layer quality. Empirically, InfoNCE provides the most consistent positive association with policy success among four evaluated proxies. Selecting the layer with the highest InfoNCE score requires 9-33 times less GPU compute than exhaustive policy sweeps and reduces mean selection regret from 17.89 percentage points for deepest-layer selection to 3.71 points across six settings. Its mean regret is close to the 3.28-3.50 points achieved by fixed-layer heuristics optimized retrospectively using all six oracle sweeps, without requiring closed-loop evaluations during selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 策略的 latent interface 该暴露骨干网络哪一层，作者在三个预训练模型与 LIBERO、CALVIN 两个操作基准上系统比较单层选择与多层融合。54 个配置中 47 个不如最佳单层，说明融合收益极小；而 InfoNCE 作为层质量代理，选层只需 9–33 倍更少 GPU 算力，把平均选择 regret 从最深层启发式的 17.89 个百分点降到 3.71。
Motivation: VLA 的 latent interface 暴露哪些骨干层缺乏准则：最佳层随骨干与基准大幅变化，层选择因此很关键，但穷举策略扫描代价高昂，多层融合是否值得也未有定论。
Method: 在冻结骨干上比较单层选择与多层融合，覆盖三个预训练模型、LIBERO 与 CALVIN、每配置三个策略训练种子、三种融合机制与三种层子集策略；推导针对 action-conditioned InfoNCE 与 action prediction 的信息瓶颈目标之间的重加权等价，据此把 InfoNCE 作为层质量代理，并与另外三个代理比较。
Result: 54 个融合配置中 47 个劣于最佳单层策略，统计分析确认融合优势非常有限；InfoNCE 在四个被评代理中与策略成功率的正相关最一致；按 InfoNCE 选层比穷举策略扫描少用 9–33 倍 GPU 算力，平均选择 regret 从最深层选择的 17.89 个百分点降至 3.71 个百分点（六个设置），接近用全部六次 oracle 扫描事后优化的固定层启发式所达的 3.28–3.50 个百分点，且选层过程无需闭环评估。
Conclusion: 多层融合在冻结骨干 VLA 上收益甚微，层选择才是关键；用 InfoNCE 这一免闭环评估的代理选层，可把 regret 压到接近事后调优的固定层启发式水平，同时大幅省算力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Why Backdooring Neural Networks is so Easy?
papers.abstract_en: Securing modern AI systems against backdoor attacks remains an open challenge and requires fundamentally principled estimates of the adversary's budget -- the poison fraction $π$ and trigger strength $α$ needed to construct successful yet stealthy attacks. Motivated by recent empirical evidence that poisoning large language models can require a nearly constant number of malicious samples even as clean datasets grow, we derive an exact closed-form analysis of a quadratic neuron trained on a poisoned Gaussian mixture. We show, perhaps counterintuitively, that the same feature-learning dynamics that make neural networks powerful can also make them more vulnerable to backdoors. Specifically, with clean accuracy preserved to first order, $O(π)$, we demonstrate that lazy learning imposes the inverse-square-root scaling $α\propto π^{-1/2}$ for a successful attack, while feature learning induces a quadratic detector whose loss margin scales as $O(α^4)$, improving the attack budget to $α\propto π^{-1/4}$. Consequently, nonlinear feature learning substantially reduces the trigger strength required at small poison fractions, thereby in a sense making feature learners more backdoor vulnerable. These results provide a theoretical mechanism consistent with large-scale empirical observations and demonstrate that security audits based on linear heuristics can systematically underestimate backdoor vulnerability in the widely adopted feature-learning regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在中毒高斯混合上训练的二次神经元闭式分析表明：lazy learning 下成功后门需要触发强度 α∝π^{-1/2}，而 feature learning 诱导出损失裕度为 O(α^4) 的二次检测器，把攻击预算改善到 α∝π^{-1/4}。因此在小中毒比例 π 下，非线性特征学习大幅降低所需触发强度，使 feature learner 更易被后门攻击，基于线性启发式的安全审计会系统性低估风险。
Motivation: 防御后门攻击需要对敌手预算（中毒比例 π 与触发强度 α）做有原则的估计，但近期经验显示 LLM 中毒所需恶意样本数近似恒定，线性启发式审计与这一现象不符。
Method: 对在中毒高斯混合上训练的二次神经元 (quadratic neuron) 推导精确闭式解，比较 lazy learning 与 feature learning 两种特征学习动力学下的攻击成功条件，并给出干净精度保持到一阶 O(π) 的分析。
Result: lazy learning 给出 α∝π^{-1/2} 的反平方根标度；feature learning 诱导二次检测器，损失裕度按 O(α^4) 标度，攻击预算改善为 α∝π^{-1/4}；干净精度保持到一阶 O(π)。
Conclusion: 让网络强大的同一特征学习动力学也使其更易被后门攻击，非线性 feature learning 系统性降低小 π 下所需触发强度，线性启发式审计会低估广泛使用的 feature-learning 范式下的后门脆弱性。

papers.title: Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: We study how to build more capable general-purpose agents by extending large language models (LLMs) with native typed decision-making. We introduce Dyad, an architecture that augments a pretrained LLM with an environment-conditioned action encoder that embeds each candidate action description in parallel, then scores these embeddings against the LLM's internal state to yield a distribution over typed actions. By factorizing decision-making into representations of the evolving interaction state and environment-specific action semantics, Dyad introduces an inductive bias for learning reusable representations while keeping action scoring efficient even as the action space grows. We investigate two complementary reinforcement learning settings driven by environment interaction. With the LLM frozen, training the action encoder alone achieves consistent gains across four unseen environments, enabling modular adaptation without modifying any LLM parameters. Jointly optimizing both components outperforms conventional RL post-training across diverse interactive tasks and model scales, including a 3.80% average absolute gain on ALFWorld with a 9B model, while improving general knowledge, reasoning, and coding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dyad 用环境条件化的 action encoder 并行嵌入候选动作描述，再与 LLM 内部状态打分得到 typed action 分布，把决策分解为交互状态表示与环境动作语义两部分。冻结 LLM 只训 action encoder 即可在四个未见环境上取得一致增益；联合优化在 ALFWorld 9B 模型上平均绝对提升 3.80%，且不牺牲通用知识、推理与编码能力。
Motivation: 通用 agent 的动作空间随环境增长，直接对动作做 RL 后训练难以复用表示，也难在不改动 LLM 参数的情况下适配新环境。
Method: 在预训练 LLM 上加环境条件化 action encoder，对每条候选动作描述并行嵌入并与 LLM 内部状态打分，输出 typed action 分布；两种 RL 设置均由环境交互驱动：冻结 LLM 只训 encoder，以及两组件联合优化，与常规 RL post-training 对比。
Result: 冻结 LLM 只训 action encoder 在四个未见环境上取得一致增益；联合优化在多类交互任务与模型规模上超过常规 RL post-training，其中 ALFWorld 9B 模型平均绝对增益 3.80%，同时通用知识、推理与编码能力提升。
Conclusion: 把动作打分从 LLM 生成中解耦成可复用的 typed 表示，可在不修改 LLM 参数的前提下做模块化适配，联合训练则优于常规 RL 后训练。

papers.title: Koa-action: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Industry applications often demand low-latency classification, yet current large language model (LLM) approaches remain poorly suited for latency-critical applications. Existing prompting and constrained decoding produce verbose, multi-token outputs that require expensive token-by-token generation, while encoder-based models achieve faster inference but sacrifice task flexibility. We propose Koa-action, a framework for low-latency atomic actions -- fast, single-step decisions such as classification, semantic endpointing, Boolean checks, and scoring -- formulated as constrained generation with single-token outputs. By introducing atomic label tokens and applying supervised fine-tuning, our method reduces classification to a deterministic one-step decoding problem. Across standard benchmarks, Koa-action delivers competitive accuracy with consistently low and stable latency. On a production intent-routing benchmark, Koa-action reaches 85.5% accuracy -- competitive with the strongest frontier models (Claude-4.8-Opus, Gemini-Pro-3.1) and ahead of GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro -- while answering in about half a second, several-fold faster than every frontier model (up to ~7.5x at the median) under identical serving conditions. Against the dedicated single-token system Jev/TypeSafe, Koa-action is competitive on accuracy and faster at the median, while also handling multimodal inputs and multi-label outputs that single-label text systems do not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Koa-action 把低延迟原子决策（分类、语义端点判定、布尔检查、打分）形式化为单 token 约束生成：引入 atomic label tokens 并做监督微调，把分类变成确定性一步解码。在生产意图路由基准上准确率 85.5%，约半秒作答，中位延迟比每个前沿模型快至约 7.5 倍。
Motivation: 工业场景需要低延迟分类，但现有提示与约束解码产生冗长多 token 输出、必须逐 token 生成，编码器模型虽快却牺牲任务灵活性。
Method: 定义 atomic label tokens，把单步决策写成约束生成问题，配合监督微调 (SFT) 将分类化为确定性单步解码；框架同时支持多模态输入与多标签输出。
Result: 生产意图路由基准准确率 85.5%，与 Claude-4.8-Opus、Gemini-Pro-3.1 相当并领先 GPT-5 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro；作答约半秒，在相同服务条件下中位延迟比所有前沿模型快至约 7.5 倍；与专用单 token 系统 Jev/TypeSafe 相比准确率相当且中位更快。
Conclusion: 把原子决策压成单 token 约束生成，可以在保持前沿级准确率的同时把延迟降到约半秒，并额外覆盖多模态与多标签输出。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models using in-context learning have recently surpassed gradient-boosted trees on predictive tabular tasks. However, recent mechanistic insights suggest that parameters in these models are largely redundant. We introduce LoopICL, a looped transformer whose core design decouples parameter count from computational depth. LoopICL consists of a single block, processing data through two coupled streams: a cell stream capturing per-cell feature representations and a row stream capturing in-context example representations, jointly refined through within-column and cross-column attention. During pre-training, we vary loop counts, allowing the block to be unrolled for a varying number of iterations at test-time and use a learned exit-gate to automatically exit. In its standard setting, LoopICL performs competitively with TabICLv2 on TabArena and TALENT at the same computational cost (FLOPs), while using nearly 90% fewer parameters. Furthermore, its recurrent design enables users to also trade off inference cost and performance, providing a resource-aware TFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopICL 用单个 transformer block 循环展开，把参数量与计算深度解耦：双流（cell stream + row stream）经列内与跨列注意力联合精化，预训练时变化循环次数并用学习到的 exit-gate 自动退出。在 TabArena 与 TALENT 上，同等计算成本 (FLOPs) 下性能与 TabICLv2 相当，参数量少近 90%，并可按需在推理开销与性能之间折衷。
Motivation: 表格基础模型 (TFM) 的 in-context learning 已在预测性表格任务上超过梯度提升树，但机理分析显示其参数大量冗余，需要把参数量与推理计算解耦的架构。
Method: LoopICL 只有一个 transformer block，通过两条耦合流处理数据：cell stream 表示逐单元格特征、row stream 表示 in-context 样例表示，二者经 within-column 与 cross-column attention 联合精化；预训练时变化循环次数，测试时可展开不同迭代数并由学习到的 exit-gate 自动退出。
Result: 在 TabArena 与 TALENT 上，LoopICL 标准设置以相同计算成本 (FLOPs) 与 TabICLv2 表现相当，同时参数量少近 90%；循环设计还允许用户在推理开销与性能之间折衷。
Conclusion: 单块循环结构可以把 TFM 的参数量压到远低于 TabICLv2 而保持同等 FLOPs 下的竞争性能，并提供资源感知的推理折衷。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fundamental Limits of Transferability and Equivariance in Algebraic Signal Models I: Finite Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: We study the fundamental limits of transferability in algebraic signal processing through homomorphisms between algebraic signal models. Homomorphisms are linear maps between the signal spaces of two models that commute with filtering, so filtering a signal and transferring it across domains can be done in either order. The existence of such maps is governed entirely by coincidences among the filtered eigenvalues of the two models' shift operators, but existence alone is insufficient: the space of homomorphisms always contains trivial elements that destroy all information. We introduce the spectral transfer efficiency $η(θ)\in[0,1]$ to quantify information-preserving quality, prove that every homomorphism decomposes into unconstrained blocks over coincidence classes, derive the dimension of the homomorphism space, and characterize exactly when lossless transfer is achievable. Beyond normal shift operators, we quantify a departure-from-normality penalty and show how filter derivatives can repair spectral defectiveness. The theory yields concrete consequences in three settings: for sampling, eigenvalue interlacing converts transferability under subsampling into an explicit filter design constraint; for compressed sensing, $η(θ)$ controls the restricted isometry constant and the coherence of the resulting measurements, and recovery decouples across coincidence classes; and for machine learning, spectral aliasing emerges as the controlled symmetry breaking that makes transfer between mismatched domains possible at all.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限维代数信号模型之间，同态（与滤波可交换的线性映射）的存在性只由移位算子滤波特征值的重合决定，但存在性不够：同态空间总含抹掉全部信息的平凡元。作者提出谱传输效率 η(θ)∈[0,1] 度量保信息程度，证明同态按重合类分解为无约束块并给出其空间维数，刻画无损传输的充要条件；在采样、压缩感知与机器学习三处给出具体推论。
Motivation: 代数信号处理中跨域传输（滤波与传输可交换）已有存在性刻画，但存在性本身无法区分有信息量的映射与平凡映射，缺少衡量传输质量并给出无损条件的量化工具。
Method: 以两个模型移位算子滤波特征值的重合类为骨架：引入谱传输效率 η(θ)∈[0,1]，证明每个同态分解为重合类上的无约束块，推导同态空间维数，并对非正规移位算子给出偏离正规性的惩罚项、说明滤波导数可修复谱亏损（spectral defectiveness）。
Result: 给出同态空间维数的推导与无损传输的精确刻画；在采样中把子采样下的可传输性转成特征值交错的滤波设计约束，在压缩感知中 η(θ) 控制受限等距常数 (RIP) 与测量相干性且恢复按重合类解耦，在机器学习中把谱混叠 (spectral aliasing) 确认为使错配域之间传输成为可能的受控对称性破缺。
Conclusion: 跨域可传输性由谱重合决定，而 η(θ) 是区分有信息传输与平凡传输的正确度量；无损传输何时可行可被精确判定，且谱混叠是错配域间迁移的必要机制而非缺陷。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: An Exact Generate - Transform Decomposition of Small-LLM Team Scaling Across Orchestration Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Replacing one LLM agent with a collaborating team can raise accuracy, but whether scaling the team helps, and which architecture to scale, is unclear. Sweeping eight agent orchestration architectures across five instruction-tuned 7-9B models, five short-answer benchmarks, and an executable-code benchmark up to 30 calls, we find that the returns to team scaling are sharply task-dependent: from three to thirty calls accuracy rises by up to 17 points on the two arithmetic word-problem benchmarks (GSM8K, GSMHard) but by at most four on ARC, GPQA, and MMLU, for every architecture, a split the usual task-averaged number conceals. Proposer-Critic captures the arithmetic gains, scaling steepest and, in aggregate, surpassing every other architecture at the largest budget (item-clustered intervals exclude zero), though it ranks among the weakest elsewhere, and no architecture wins across tasks. We explain these trajectories with an exact generate-transform decomposition. Partitioning any workflow into proposal coverage and a downstream transform, any accuracy change splits exactly into an extensive coverage dividend and an intensive transformation change. The decomposition diagnoses each task: arithmetic offers coverage headroom that a critic-guided transform converts, whereas the multiple-choice benchmarks either saturate in coverage or fail to convert it, and on open-ended code generative recovery nearly vanishes so accuracy tracks coverage. At equal call budgets token cost still varies 2.1x. Extra calls therefore create candidate opportunity that only some architectures, on some tasks, convert. Team scaling is a task- and architecture-specific bet, not a uniform lever.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 8 种 agent 编排架构 × 5 个 7–9B 指令微调模型 × 5 个短答基准与 1 个代码基准、最多 30 次调用的扫描中，团队规模化的收益高度依赖任务：3→30 次调用时 GSM8K 与 GSMHard 最多涨 17 分，而 ARC、GPQA、MMLU 最多涨 4 分。Proposer-Critic 在算术题上最陡并在最大预算下总和超过所有其他架构（item-clustered 区间不含零），但在其他任务上偏弱；作者用精确的 generate-transform 分解把差异归因于 coverage dividend 与 transform 变化。结论是扩团队是任务与架构特定的赌注，等预算下 token 成本仍可差 2.1 倍。
Motivation: 用多 agent 团队替代单个 LLM 能提准确率，但扩团队是否继续有效、该扩哪种编排架构并不清楚，且常规的任务平均分会掩盖任务间差异。
Method: 扫描 8 种 agent 编排架构，覆盖 5 个 7–9B 指令微调模型、5 个短答基准（含 GSM8K、GSMHard、ARC、GPQA、MMLU）与 1 个可执行代码基准，调用预算最高 30 次；提出精确的 generate-transform 分解，把任意 workflow 拆为 proposal coverage 与下游 transform，使准确率变化精确分解为广义的 coverage dividend 与集约的 transformation change 两部分。
Result: 3 到 30 次调用之间，GSM8K 与 GSMHard 两个算术应用题准确率最多上升 17 分，ARC、GPQA、MMLU 最多上升 4 分，且该分裂在所有架构上一致；Proposer-Critic 在最大预算下总和超过其他全部架构（item-clustered 区间不含零），但在其他任务排名靠后；分解诊断显示算术题有 coverage 余量且被 critic 引导的 transform 转化，多选题或 coverage 饱和或无法转化，开放代码任务上 generative recovery 几近消失、准确率随 coverage 走；等调用预算下 token 成本仍相差 2.1 倍。
Conclusion: 额外调用只制造候选机会，只有部分架构在部分任务上把它转化，因此团队规模化是任务与架构特定的赌注而非统一杠杆，任务平均指标会掩盖这一分裂。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: One Geometry, Different Outcomes: Readout-Dependent Effects of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language models learn shared embedding spaces by aligning matched image-text pairs, yet their representations remain separated by a modality gap. Prior work reports divergent effects of modifying this gap: reducing it can improve zero-shot classification and cross-modal alignment, whereas removing gap-related structure can degrade image-text retrieval. In this paper, we provide a unified geometric explanation for these task-dependent effects. Across CLIP and SigLIP encoders, we find that a single dominant direction captures 94.4-99.9% of the squared norm of the image-text mean separation, revealing that the mean-separation component is approximately rank-one. A decomposition of the similarity score then identifies three task-specific roles. In zero-shot classification, query-side fixed gap-offset subtraction is exactly equivalent to an additive class bias. In standard cross-modal retrieval, projecting out the gap direction and renormalising residuals discards candidate-specific norm information, inducing a multiplicative ranking distortion; a geometry-derived exponent tracks the grid-search optimum (Spearman rho = 0.93) and restores performance in some settings, although the gains transfer unevenly. In mixed-modal retrieval, the gap direction sorts candidates by modality; its removal can improve cross-modal ranking, unlike random or non-gap controls. Residual semantic structure after removal defines the limits of the rank-one account. Together, these results explain why gap modification can improve, degrade, or restore performance across downstream settings. By clarifying when and why gap modification changes model behavior, this account provides a principled basis for selecting gap interventions in similarity-based vision-language systems across evaluated downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIP 与 SigLIP 的图文模态间隙 (modality gap) 的均值分离近似 rank-one：单一主方向解释了图像-文本均值分离平方范数的 94.4–99.9%。同一几何在不同读出下作用相反——零样本分类中减去固定 gap 偏移等价于加一个类偏置；标准跨模态检索中投影掉 gap 方向并重归一化会丢掉候选范数信息，造成乘性排序失真，几何推出的指数与网格搜索最优值 Spearman rho = 0.93 并在部分设置恢复性能；混合模态检索中移除 gap 方向反而改善排序。
Motivation: 已有工作报告模态间隙的矛盾效应：缩小间隙可提升零样本分类与跨模态对齐，而移除间隙相关结构会损害图文检索，缺少统一解释。
Method: 在 CLIP 与 SigLIP 编码器上把图文均值分离分解到主方向，得到近似 rank-one 的几何；再对相似度打分做分解，分别考察零样本分类的 query 侧固定 gap-offset 扣除、跨模态检索的 gap 方向投影与残差重归一化、以及混合模态检索的 gap 方向移除，并用几何推导的指数对照网格搜索。
Result: 单一主方向捕获图像-文本均值分离平方范数的 94.4–99.9%；几何推导的指数与网格搜索最优值的 Spearman rho = 0.93，在部分设置恢复检索性能但增益迁移不均；混合模态检索中移除 gap 方向可改善跨模态排序，而随机方向与非 gap 对照不能；移除后残余语义结构界定了 rank-one 解释的适用范围。

papers.title: Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step matching models, including flow and diffusion models, produce high-quality outputs but incur substantial inference costs and may reproduce unwanted components of their training datasets. We introduce Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a teacher multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step student generator and suppresses outputs corresponding to a designated training subset. We first formulate distillation as a min-max objective over a data distribution and then represent this distribution as a mixture of the forget-set and the generated distributions. This allows us to compare this mixture with the teacher's training distribution and recover only the retained data at the optimum. Our method requires only a pretrained full-data teacher and data from the forget set, without access to retained training examples, extra feature extractors or classifiers. Extensive experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets under flow-matching and score-based diffusion settings demonstrate that IDU substantially reduces the generation frequency of forgotten classes while preserving generation quality on the retained classes. To the best of our knowledge, IDU is the first unified framework for simultaneous unlearning and distillation in unconditional flow-matching and score-based models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IDU 把多步匹配模型（flow matching / score-based diffusion）的蒸馏与机器遗忘合进一个 min-max 目标：把数据分布写成 forget-set 与生成分布的混合，与 teacher 训练分布比对，最优点处只恢复保留数据。在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上，IDU 显著降低被遗忘类别的生成频率，同时保持保留类别的生成质量，且只需预训练全数据 teacher 与 forget-set 数据。
Motivation: 多步匹配模型推理开销大，且可能复现训练集中不想要的成分；现有蒸馏与遗忘通常分开做，遗忘又常需访问保留样本、额外特征提取器或分类器。
Method: Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU)：先把蒸馏写成数据分布上的 min-max 目标，再把该分布表示为 forget-set 分布与生成分布的混合，与 teacher 的训练分布比较，使最优点只保留数据；同时蒸馏出单步 student 并抑制 forget-set 对应输出。仅需预训练全数据 teacher 与 forget-set 数据，无需保留样本、额外特征提取器或分类器。
Result: 在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10、flow-matching 与 score-based diffusion 两种设定下的实验表明，IDU substantially reduces the generation frequency of forgotten classes，同时在保留类别上 preserving generation quality。
Conclusion: 蒸馏与遗忘可以由同一个 min-max 框架同时完成；据作者所知这是首个在无条件 flow-matching 与 score-based 模型上统一做 unlearning 与 distillation 的框架。

papers.title: PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG
papers.abstract_en: Clinicians and neuroscientists have long analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) through directly measurable physiological characteristics, which carry much of the information that downstream tasks depend on. Recent iEEG foundation models learn by reconstructing or predicting their inputs, which leaves the retention of these characteristics implicit. They are also evaluated mainly on cognitive decoding and a narrow clinical task, i.e., seizure detection. On a broad, clinically relevant benchmark such as Omni-iEEG, they remain below task-specific models when used frozen. We introduce PHASE, a physiology-guided foundation model that makes these characteristics explicit learning targets, pairing them with masked latent prediction in a temporal stage (PHASE-T) within each channel and a spatiotemporal stage (PHASE-ST) across synchronized channels. PHASE is pretrained on heterogeneous recordings from 222 participants at nine clinical sites. On all five Omni-iEEG clinical tasks, frozen PHASE-T outperforms every evaluated foundation model by up to 31\%, and fine-tuned PHASE-T surpasses the task-specific models, setting a new state of the art. PHASE-T benefits from physiological supervision, outperforming variants trained with latent prediction alone or auxiliary waveform reconstruction on every task in matched ablations. PHASE-T generalizes to unseen institutions, outperforming the compared models with few or no local labels. PHASE-ST further improves seizure-onset-zone identification over PHASE-T and, when frozen, decodes sound volume and pitch on BrainTreebank better than published models. Beyond task performance, PHASE learns to encapsulate the physiological characteristics clinicians recognize, from seizure onset and its propagation to anatomical region identity, even though its pretraining contains no ictal recordings or anatomical labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHASE 把临床医生可直接测量的生理特征做成显式学习目标，与掩码隐变量预测 (masked latent prediction) 配对，在时序阶段 (PHASE-T) 逐通道、在时空阶段 (PHASE-ST) 跨同步通道训练 iEEG 基础模型。在 Omni-iEEG 五项临床任务上，冻结 PHASE-T 比所评测的所有基础模型最高高出 31%，微调后超过任务专用模型达到新 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有 iEEG 基础模型靠重建或预测输入隐式保留生理特征，且评测集中在认知解码与癫痫发作检测；在 Omni-iEEG 这类广谱临床基准上，冻结使用时仍落后于任务专用模型。
Method: 以生理特征为显式学习目标，配合掩码隐变量预测：PHASE-T 在单通道内做时序阶段训练，PHASE-ST 在同步通道间做时空阶段训练；预训练数据为来自九个临床站点 222 名受试者的异构记录，并在匹配消融中对比仅隐变量预测与辅助波形重建两种变体。
Result: Omni-iEEG 全部五项临床任务上，冻结 PHASE-T 比每个被评测基础模型最高提升 31%，微调 PHASE-T 超过任务专用模型并刷新 SOTA；匹配消融中 PHASE-T 在每一项任务上都优于仅隐变量预测或辅助波形重建变体；在未见机构、本地标签很少或没有时仍优于对比模型；PHASE-ST 在癫痫起始区识别上优于 PHASE-T，冻结时在 BrainTreebank 上对声音音量与音高的解码优于已发表模型。
Conclusion: 把临床可识别的生理特征（发作起始与传播、解剖区域身份）设为显式目标，即使预训练不含发作期记录与解剖标签也能被学到，且足以让冻结的基础模型在广谱临床任务上追平或超过任务专用模型。

papers.title: PADMÉ: Preference Alignment Data Synthesis for Meta-Evaluation of LM Agent Evaluators
papers.abstract_en: Language models are frequently employed to evaluate other language models. An LM evaluator scoring agentic behaviors across multiple criteria is valuable, provided that its decisions align with human judgment. We call the problem of evaluating this alignment Meta-Evaluation. Tackling it directly is difficult: collecting human data is expensive, absolute scoring is hard to align, and using an LM meta-evaluator recurses the question of trustworthiness. We adopt a reformulation of meta-evaluation as a preference judgment problem: rather than comparing human and LM evaluator scores of a trajectory, we ask whether their implied preferences align. Building on this, we introduce PADMÉ, a data synthesis method that generates reliable criterion-based meta-evaluation data for agentic settings. PADMÉ uses only small language models, requires no human involvement during evaluations, and operates under a low computational budget. We build a prototype of PADMÉ and synthesize a dataset of 1,000 samples across four agentic domains and three evaluation criteria. Human validation on a 150-sample subset demonstrates that PADMÉ improves agreement with human judgment from 73% to 85% over a naive baseline. Meta-evaluating 25 common models with our dataset demonstrates the correlations between evaluation performance and scoring granularity, leniency, and model size, among other factors.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation? 27 pages, 3 figures. Code and data at https://github.com/chc012/padme
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PADMÉ 把 LM agent 评估器的元评估 (meta-evaluation) 重构为偏好对齐问题，用小语言模型在无人参与、低算力预算下合成准则级偏好数据。合成 1,000 条样本覆盖 4 个 agentic 域与 3 条评估准则；150 条人工校验子集上，与人类判断的一致率从朴素基线的 73% 提到 85%。用该数据集元评估 25 个常见模型，发现评估表现与打分粒度、宽松度 (leniency) 及模型规模相关。
Motivation: 直接做元评估代价高：人工标注贵、绝对分数难与人类对齐、再用 LM 做元评估器又陷入可信度递归。
Method: PADMÉ 将元评估改写为偏好判断：不比对人与 LM 评估器对轨迹的分数，而是判断两者隐含偏好是否一致。方法只用小语言模型，评估过程无需人工介入，计算预算低；原型合成 1,000 条样本，覆盖 4 个 agentic 域与 3 条评估准则。
Result: 在 150 条样本的人工校验子集上，PADMÉ 与人类判断的一致率由朴素基线的 73% 提升至 85%。用该数据集对 25 个常见模型做元评估，观察到评估表现与打分粒度、宽松度、模型规模等因素相关。
Conclusion: 把元评估转成偏好对齐并用小模型合成数据，可以在不花人工标注成本的前提下产出与人类判断更一致的 agent 评估器评测数据。

papers.title: Measuring trainable degrees of freedom in materials graph neural networks: a random-subspace intrinsic dimension analysis
papers.abstract_en: Final predictive accuracy is the standard basis for comparing graph neural networks (GNNs) in materials-property prediction, but it does not show how strongly performance depends on access to trainable parameter-space directions. Here, we introduce trainable-degree dependence as a complementary characterization of materials GNN learning. Using random-subspace intrinsic-dimension analysis, we train CGCNN, ALIGNN, and DimeNet++ in randomly oriented parameter subspaces across six prediction tasks and measure how performance recovers as independent trainable degrees of freedom are restored. The resulting recovery curves separate endpoint accuracy from the trainable-dimensional demand required to recover it. They reveal distinctions that final errors alone miss: metallic classification and log-bulk-modulus regression recover near-reference performance from small fractional subspaces, formation-energy and band-gap prediction show stronger architecture dependence, and phonon prediction is most sensitive to dimensional restriction. Dataset-size sweeps show that band-gap models require larger fractional subspaces as training data grows, whereas formation-energy and bulk-modulus responses are more stable. A width sweep shows that fractional thresholds can remain stable while absolute threshold dimensions increase with model size. Random-subspace analysis therefore provides a targeted stress test for how materials GNNs use their optimization space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 trainable-degree dependence：用 random-subspace intrinsic-dimension 分析在随机取向的参数子空间里训练 CGCNN、ALIGNN、DimeNet++，看恢复多少独立可训练自由度才能回到参考精度。六项任务的恢复曲线显示金属分类与 log-bulk-modulus 回归从小比例子空间即可接近参考，formation energy 与 band gap 更依赖架构，phonon 预测对维度限制最敏感；band gap 所需子空间比例随数据量增大。
Motivation: 只用最终精度比较材料 GNN，看不出性能对可训练参数空间方向的依赖程度，也无法区分哪些任务真正需要高维优化空间。
Method: 在随机取向的参数子空间中训练 CGCNN、ALIGNN、DimeNet++，逐步恢复独立可训练自由度并记录性能恢复曲线；覆盖六项预测任务，并做数据量扫描与模型宽度扫描。
Result: 金属分类与 log-bulk-modulus 回归从小比例子空间即可恢复接近参考的性能；formation energy 与 band gap 表现出更强的架构依赖；phonon 预测对维度限制最敏感。数据量扫描中 band gap 所需子空间比例随训练数据增长，formation energy 与 bulk-modulus 更稳定；宽度扫描显示分数阈值可保持稳定而绝对阈值维度随模型增大而上升。
Conclusion: random-subspace 分析可作为材料 GNN 如何使用优化空间的针对性压力测试，把端点精度与恢复它所需的可训练维度需求分开刻画。

papers.title: GeoOutageBench: Benchmarking Ambiguity-aware, Ontology-grounded Geospatiotemporal KGQA for Multimodal Power Outage and Resilience Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GeoOutageBench, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based geospatiotemporal KGQA for multimodal outage and resilience analysis. Unlike existing KGQA benchmarks for Web knowledge, GeoOutageBench considers a spatiotemporal KG that integrates visual, textual, and structured data from outage records, remote sensing, weather observations, storm and power events, geographic entities, and domain ontologies. It provides a competency query taxonomy at different difficulty levels from spatiotemporal containment and proximity, spatiotemporal co-occurrence analysis, multimodal evidence, to hypothetical evaluation. Over multimodal KG and query classes, GeoOutageBench provides user-configurable evaluation of three important, highly coherent yet less studied tasks: (1) LLMs' understanding for ambiguous geospatiotemporal questions in terms of NL to SPARQL interpretation, (2) query-driven assessment of ontology utility, and (3) answer accuracy of multimodal KGQA retrieval. GeoOutageBench provides a design principle and foundation for assessing LLM-KG systems that support real-world infrastructure resilience analysis. Our benchmark, source code, data, results, and other documentation are available at https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench.

papers.title: Early Learning Shapes Later Directions Of Representation Change In Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Representations continually change as a network learns new tasks. We ask whether early representational changes naturally form a geometric structure that continues to shape later learning. We identify a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, which we call a scaffold, and test whether it is reused across subsequent tasks. Across four pretrained visual encoders and two datasets, later representational changes consistently favor this early-defined subspace over matched random alternatives. This reuse is history-dependent: when networks experience different early tasks but identical later training inputs, each network preferentially reuses the scaffold induced by its own learning history. The same preference appears in individual optimizer updates, even though the network's dominant local response directions shift away from the original scaffold. Finally, constraining motion within the scaffold slows new-task acquisition more than matched random constraints, while effects on old-task retention are less consistent. In summary, these results suggest that early experience leaves a persistent geometric imprint on how neural networks adapt to future tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把持续学习早期表征漂移的一个低维子空间称为 scaffold，发现后续任务的表征变化会系统性偏向这个早期定义的子空间而非匹配的随机子空间，且这种复用取决于学习历史：早期任务不同、后续输入相同的网络各自复用自己的 scaffold。把更新约束在 scaffold 内会比等量随机约束更慢地拖慢新任务习得，而对旧任务保持的影响不一致。
Motivation: 持续学习中表征如何随任务序列演化缺少几何层面的解释：早期的表征变化是否形成结构并持续约束后续学习，此前没有直接检验。
Method: 在四个预训练视觉编码器和两个数据集上识别早期表征漂移的低维 scaffold 子空间，将其与匹配的随机子空间对照，检验后续任务的表征变化方向、单步优化器更新是否偏向该子空间；再用 scaffold 内约束与随机约束对比新任务习得与旧任务保持。
Result: 四个预训练视觉编码器、两个数据集上，后续表征变化一致偏向早期定义的 scaffold 而非匹配随机子空间；早期任务不同而后续输入相同的网络各自偏向自身历史诱导的 scaffold；单步优化器更新中同样出现该偏好，尽管网络主导的局部响应方向已偏离原 scaffold；scaffold 内约束比匹配随机约束更显著减慢新任务习得，而对旧任务保持的影响较不一致。
Conclusion: 早期经验在神经网络中留下持久的几何印记，决定其后续适应任务的方式，且这种复用是历史依赖的；对旧任务保持的作用则不稳健。

papers.title: A Polyphonic Conception of AI Understanding
papers.abstract_en: When a doctor, a judge, or an engineer must decide whether to trust an AI model's output, they cannot avoid asking what the model understands. Purely mathematical or statistical descriptions struggle to distinguish trustworthy from untrustworthy outputs without reintroducing the question of AI understanding in all but name. Yet the question is ill-framed as it stands, because the inherited concept operates within a monophonic paradigm: the idea that a cognitive system's understanding of something must be localised to a single mechanism underpinning all the capacities conferred by such understanding. Drawing on a wide range of mechanistic evidence, we show that LLMs are pervasively polyphonic: outputs emerge from coalitions of parallel mechanisms of uneven reliability, which variously complement, duplicate, or drown out one another, with several coalitions sufficing for a task without any one being indispensable. Polyphony not only complicates attributions of understanding, but renders monophonic inference patterns hazardous. In response, we develop a conception of understanding fit for polyphonic AI. It centres on sound circuitry that is reliably and correctly recruited and in control of outputs. Attributions of understanding thereby become tractable claims about internal organisation, and can do the work of guiding trust in AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 LLM 的理解不是单一机制承载的（monophonic），而是由可靠性不均的并行机制联盟（polyphony）共同产生输出，其中多个联盟足以完成同一任务且无一不可替代。作者据此把“理解”重新定义为被可靠、正确招募并实际控制输出的健全回路 (sound circuitry)，使理解归属变成关于内部组织的可检验主张，从而指导对 AI 的信任判断。
Motivation: 医生、法官、工程师判断是否信任 AI 输出时绕不开“模型理解了什么”，但纯数学或统计描述无法区分可信与不可信输出，而继承来的理解概念默认单一机制承载全部能力，问题框架本身有误。
Method: 基于广泛的机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 证据，论证 LLM 输出由互补、重复或相互淹没的并行机制联盟产生；在此基础上提出以健全回路被可靠且正确招募并控制输出为核心的理解概念，属概念与哲学层面的重构而非实验方法。
Result: 核心论断为 LLM 普遍呈多声部性：输出来自可靠性不均的机制联盟，多个联盟足以完成任务且无一不可替代；多声部性使单声部推理模式变得危险，而新的理解归属成为关于内部组织的可处理主张。
Conclusion: 对多声部 AI 的理解归属应落在内部回路是否健全、是否被可靠招募并控制输出上，而非寻找单一承载机制，这样才能真正指导对 AI 输出的信任。

papers.title: Climate-informed cryospheric reanalysis via hierarchical Bayesian data assimilation
papers.abstract_en: The cryosphere regulates global cycles of water, energy, and carbon, affecting societies and ecosystems. By assimilating observations into models, we can infer the past trajectory of state variables, generating a cryospheric reanalysis. Existing cryospheric reanalyses typically treat each water year independently, with no pooling of information across years. With sparse and noisy observations, such 'climate-assumed' reanalyses perform poorly, reverting to an assumed yet uncalibrated background climatology. Conversely, Bayesian calibration with static parameters completely pools information across water years, inferring climatological parameters without capturing inter-annual variability. Here, we propose a new hierarchical Bayesian approach using partial pooling, which we coin 'climate-informed' cryospheric reanalysis. It jointly infers state trajectories, annual parameters, and local climatological hyperparameters using a nested hybrid particle smoothing workflow. We test the approach through three experiments by assimilating in situ snow water equivalent, satellite-based fractional snow-covered area, and glacier-wide mass balance data into a temperature index model at eight study areas, from the Swiss Alps to the High Arctic. Hierarchical reanalysis with partial pooling outperforms annually independent cryospheric reanalysis (no pooling) and static parameter calibration (complete pooling) for all experiments during calibration and for all but one during validation. Overall, it yields a 51% improvement in continuous ranked probability score relative to the prior, markedly exceeding that of annual reanalysis (38%) and static calibration (19%). Compared to a particle Markov chain Monte Carlo benchmark, our workflow reduces computational cost by several orders of magnitude through recycling and expectation maximization, with comparable or improved skill.
papers.comment: 80 pages, 11 figures. A supplement with 19 figures and a line-numbered copy of the manuscript for review are provided as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出层级贝叶斯（partial pooling）冰冻圈再分析：用嵌套混合粒子平滑同时反演状态轨迹、逐年参数与局地气候超参数，在 8 个研究区把积雪当量、卫星积雪面积比与冰川质量平衡同化进温度指数模型。相对先验 CRPS 改善 51%，高于逐年独立再分析的 38% 与静态参数标定的 19%，计算成本比 PMCMC 基线低数个量级。
Motivation: 现有冰冻圈再分析按水文年独立处理、不跨年共享信息，在观测稀疏且含噪时退化到未标定的背景气候态；而静态参数的贝叶斯标定完全池化各年，抹掉年际变率。
Method: 层级贝叶斯部分池化，联合推断状态轨迹、逐年参数与局地气候超参数，采用嵌套混合粒子平滑 (nested hybrid particle smoothing)；通过 recycling 与期望最大化 (EM) 降低计算量，并以粒子 MCMC (PMCMC) 作基准。三组实验把原位雪水当量、卫星反演的积雪面积比 (fractional snow-covered area) 与冰川尺度质量平衡同化进温度指数模型，覆盖从瑞士阿尔卑斯到高纬北极的 8 个研究区。
Result: 部分池化的层级再分析在三组实验的率定期全部优于逐年独立再分析（无池化）与静态参数标定（完全池化），验证期除一组外均占优；相对先验的 CRPS 改善 51%，对比逐年再分析 38%、静态标定 19%。相对 PMCMC 基线，工作流通过 recycling 与 EM 把计算成本降低数个量级，且技巧相当或更优。
Conclusion: 跨水文年的部分池化是冰冻圈再分析的正确折中：既不像逐年独立那样被噪声推回未标定气候态，也不像静态标定那样丢失年际变率，同时可用远低于 PMCMC 的成本达到相当或更好的技巧。

papers.title: GEM-KMeans: Memory-Efficient and Accurate Clustering on Massive Scale with GPU Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Memory-efficient scaling on clustering problems without sacrificing statistical accuracy is of central interest for large-scale data analysis and machine learning problems. Nonnegative low-rank (NLR) matrix factorization for $K$-means is a scalable clustering method, which connects to semidefinite relaxations with optimal average-case exact recovery guarantees. However, a direct GPU implementation of NLR requires multiple large factor-sized buffers and substantial data movements that are essentially memory-bound. In this paper, we introduce GEM-KMeans, a spectrally normalized yet mathematically equivalent NLR formulation that fuses the gradient update, nonnegative projection, and sufficient statistics for normalization and iterate movement into a matrix-multiplication epilogue. Instead of retaining three massive factor-sized arrays, our IO-aware GPU implementation materializes only one single factor with small tile-reduction arrays as additional storage in the High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). We derive explicit memory costs and spectrally normalized smoothness bounds for optimizing the clustering objective function. Accurate clustering is demonstrated at massive scales on synthetic and real datasets, where performance gains of GEM-KMeans over existing GPU-accelerated Lloyd's algorithms involve data-dependent runtime tradeoffs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEM-KMeans 把非负低秩 (NLR) K-means 的梯度更新、非负投影与归一化充分统计量融合进矩阵乘法 epilogue，使 GPU 实现只需在 HBM 中保存单个因子数组。推导了显式内存开销与谱归一化平滑界，并在合成与真实数据集上展示大规模下的准确聚类，相对现有 GPU 加速 Lloyd 算法的运行时收益存在数据依赖的权衡。
Motivation: NLR K-means 虽有最优平均情形精确恢复保证，但直接 GPU 实现需要多个因子大小的缓冲区和大量数据搬运，本质上受内存带宽限制，难以在超大规模上扩展。
Method: 提出谱归一化但在数学上等价的 NLR 公式，将梯度更新、非负投影、归一化与迭代移动的充分统计量融合到 GEMM epilogue 中；IO-aware 实现只物化一个因子数组，附加小的 tile-reduction 数组存于 HBM，并推导显式内存代价与谱归一化平滑界。

Conclusion: 把 NLR K-means 的更新与归一化折叠进矩阵乘法 epilogue，可在只保留单个因子数组的前提下保持聚类精度，代价是相对 Lloyd 类方法的运行时收益取决于数据。

papers.title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects. Additional editing improves average automatic readability preference across two benchmarks, with different trends on each.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LongCat-DeepResearch 把全局规划与分节调查解耦：多个规划 agent 先探索外部来源产出 ResearchSpec，研究 agent 并行分节起草并在独立上下文中补证据，成稿后由全局评审驱动分节局部修订而非整篇重写。在 DeepResearchBench 上得 55.25、DeepResearchBench II 上 51.35、ResearchRubrics 上 79.83，自建 benchmark 76.04 在四个对比系统中排第二。
Motivation: 深度研究系统在长报告生成中反复整篇重写代价高，且规划与调查耦合导致证据收集难以随分析推进扩展。
Method: 多 agent 工作流：规划 agent 探索外部来源并细化可执行研究计划 ResearchSpec；研究 agent 并行负责各自章节、在独立上下文中补充证据；章节拼装后由全局评审指导定向局部修订。该工作流同时用于构造 LongCat 通用模型 mid-training 与 post-training 的研究任务与轨迹。
Result: DeepResearchBench 55.25，DeepResearchBench II 51.35，ResearchRubrics 79.83；自建 benchmark 76.04，在四个对比系统中排名第二。开发集分析显示组合多种规划视角有益，进一步的规划细化效果不一；额外编辑在两个 benchmark 上提升平均自动可读性偏好，但各自趋势不同。
Conclusion: 分节规划加局部修订的多 agent 工作流能产出有证据支撑的报告并可反哺训练数据；规划细化的收益不稳定，编辑对可读性的影响随 benchmark 而异。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Kittens: MoE Megakernel for NVL72s
papers.abstract_en: AI accelerator systems are rapidly consolidating into scale-up architectures, where tens to thousands of GPUs communicate over high-bandwidth, single-hop fabrics. We find that existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training systems, optimized for conventional scale-out networks, transfer poorly to this setting, often running slower than a naive baseline built with PyTorch and NCCL. With industry roadmaps pointing toward even larger scale-up domains, understanding the performance tradeoffs of this hardware regime is increasingly important. We present Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK), an MoE training system designed for Nvidia NVL72. MoK builds on three insights that unlock performance on scale-up domains: (1) choosing push- or pull-based communication per operator, (2) restructuring the computation-communication overlap, and (3) fully eliminating CPU-GPU synchronization. MoK distills these insights into a single deterministic training megakernel that fuses token dispatch, shared and routed expert FFNs, and token combine. Across MoE layer shapes from four widely used open-weight models, MoK delivers up to $2.37\times$ the throughput of the strongest publicly available baseline. In a production run on 512 GPUs spanning multiple GB300 NVL72 racks, MoK improves end-to-end training throughput by $1.41\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 NVL72 这类 scale-up 架构，提出 MoE 训练系统 Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK)，把 token dispatch、共享与路由专家 FFN、token combine 全部融进单个确定性训练 megakernel。在四个开源模型的 MoE 层形状上吞吐最高达最强公开基线的 2.37 倍，在跨多个 GB300 NVL72 机架的 512 卡生产训练中端到端吞吐提升 1.41 倍。
Motivation: 现有 MoE 训练系统按 scale-out 网络优化，迁移到高带宽单跳的 scale-up 域后常常比 PyTorch + NCCL 的朴素基线还慢，而行业路线图指向更大的 scale-up 域。
Method: MoK 依赖三条设计：按算子选择 push 或 pull 通信、重构计算-通信 overlap、彻底消除 CPU-GPU 同步；最终把这些压进一个确定性 megakernel，融合 token dispatch、shared/routed expert FFN 与 token combine，目标硬件为 Nvidia NVL72。
Result: 在四个广泛使用的开源模型对应的 MoE 层形状上，MoK 吞吐最高达到最强公开可用基线的 2.37 倍；在跨多个 GB300 NVL72 机架、512 卡的生产运行中，端到端训练吞吐提升 1.41 倍。
Conclusion: scale-up 域上的 MoE 训练要靠按算子选通信方向、重排 overlap 与消除 CPU-GPU 同步并融合成单一 megakernel 才能跑赢按 scale-out 优化的现有系统。
Relevance: 2
