papers.title: The Uneven Decline of Collective Knowledge Production: Evidence from Stack Overflow After Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (Gen AI) is reshaping how individuals learn and work, but its consequences for collective knowledge, the shared body of knowledge that online communities produce together, remain poorly understood. Prior work has documented an aggregate decline in participation on knowledge-sharing platforms, but it remains unclear which specific kinds of knowledge are being lost first. We study this question using Stack Overflow, one of the largest online communities for software engineering, treating the release of ChatGPT-3.5 as a natural shock. Analyzing over two million questions posted between 2020 and 2025, we track how two dimensions of collective knowledge, difficulty and data availability, change following Gen AI's release. Using diverse methods and robust checks, we find consistent patterns. Easy questions decline sharply while difficult questions become more common, a pattern corroborated by rising code complexity. Data-rich topics and tags lose share of questions, while data-scarce ones gain ground. The two dimensions also interact: the decline in easy questions is concentrated specifically within data-rich domains, while difficult questions increase regardless of data availability. This pattern extends beyond Python across programming languages, with more prevalent languages showing sharper shifts. Together, our findings reveal that Gen AI's impact on collective knowledge is uneven, eroding easy, accessible knowledge first while more complex, less common knowledge persists.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 ChatGPT-3.5 发布为自然冲击，分析 Stack Overflow 2020–2025 年超两百万个问题，发现生成式 AI 对集体知识的侵蚀是不均匀的：简单问题锐减、难题占比上升，数据丰富的主题与标签份额流失，且简单问题的下降集中在数据丰富领域，难题则无论数据可得性都增加。
Motivation: 已有研究记录了知识分享平台参与度的整体下滑，但尚不清楚哪些具体类型的知识最先流失，生成式 AI 对集体知识的影响缺乏细粒度证据。
Method: 以 ChatGPT-3.5 发布作为自然实验冲击，分析 Stack Overflow 上 2020 至 2025 年发布的超过两百万个问题，沿难度与数据可得性两个维度追踪集体知识变化，并用多种方法与稳健性检验交叉验证，同时考察代码复杂度与编程语言分布作为佐证。
Result: 简单问题显著减少而难题占比上升，代码复杂度上升佐证该趋势；数据丰富的主题与标签失去问题份额、数据稀缺的获得份额；简单问题的下降集中于数据丰富领域，难题的增加与数据可得性无关；该模式跨越 Python 延伸到其他编程语言，普及度越高的语言转变越剧烈。
Conclusion: 生成式 AI 对集体知识的影响是不均匀的：先侵蚀简单、易得的知识，而更复杂、更小众的知识得以保留。

papers.title: AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search
papers.abstract_en: Open-world aerial object-goal search is a foundational yet challenging task, requiring aerial agents to autonomously explore large-scale, unstructured three-dimensional environments and reach target objects specified by semantic descriptions or reference images, rather than following route-specific instructions. However, research in this task remains at a nascent stage and relies on small, environment-specific benchmarks with heterogeneous action spaces and data formats. These limitations hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation, constraining the scalability and generalizability of aerial agents. To address this problem, we propose AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, with 3 times as many scenes and 18.7 times as many task instances as the largest existing benchmark for this task. Specifically, we construct 42 simulation scenes spanning four scene families and 21 scene types, including 18 urban, 12 natural, six infrastructure, and six disaster scenes. To ensure data quality, 12 annotators spent two months manually annotating 109 landmarks, 2099 target objects, and 2099 object anchors across these scenes. We further construct 205,732 task instances, comprising over 100K semantic-goal and over 100K image-goal instances across Base, Standard, and Long-Horizon settings. Each task instance includes a collision-free reference trajectory and corresponding multi-view video recordings. We also develop a unified evaluation framework with a scene partition comprising 21 in-distribution scenes and 21 out-of-distribution scenes. Finally, our evaluation of five open-source and four closed-source multimodal large language models reveals that there is still a long way to go toward achieving general-purpose aerial agents. All can be found at https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AerialDojo-200K 是面向开放世界空中 object-goal search 的大规模基准套件：42 个仿真场景、205,732 个任务实例（各含无碰撞参考轨迹与多视角视频），场景按 21 个分布内/21 个分布外划分评测。对 5 个开源与 4 个闭源多模态大模型的评测显示，通用空中智能体距离实用仍有很长的路要走。
Motivation: 该任务研究尚处早期，依赖规模小、环境特定的基准，动作空间与数据格式异构，阻碍大规模训练与跨基准评测，限制空中智能体的可扩展性与泛化能力。
Method: 构建 42 个仿真场景（18 urban、12 natural、6 infrastructure、6 disaster，覆盖 4 个场景族、21 种场景类型），由 12 名标注者耗时两个月人工标注 109 个 landmark、2099 个目标物体与 2099 个 object anchor；生成 205,732 个任务实例，含超过 100K 语义目标与超过 100K 图像目标，分 Base、Standard、Long-Horizon 三档，每个实例附无碰撞参考轨迹与多视角视频；配套统一评测框架与 21/21 的 in-distribution/out-of-distribution 场景划分。
Result: 场景数为现有最大同类基准的 3 倍，任务实例数为其 18.7 倍；共 205,732 个任务实例（>100K 语义目标、>100K 图像目标）。对 5 个开源与 4 个闭源多模态大模型的评测显示，所有模型距离通用空中智能体都还有很长的路要走。
Conclusion: 统一动作空间与数据格式的大规模基准是训练和跨基准评测空中 object-goal search 智能体的前提，而现有 MLLM 在该任务上普遍远未达到通用可用水平。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FLOORA: A Human-Aligned Domain-Specific Language Model for Architectural Design
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are powerful generators, but many engineering domains require structured representations that general-purpose systems handle poorly. We introduce FLOORA (Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment), a family of small domain-specific language (DSL) models for architectural layout generation. With specialized data and alignment, our 0.6B model outperforms much larger frontier models, achieving VLM judge win rates up to 92.0% on out-of-distribution real-world buildings and 96.0% on synthetic buildings. Human evaluations further corroborate these results, with FLOORA selected as the best model in 89.3% of evaluations. FLOORA combines a token-efficient DSL, custom tokenization, domain-specific pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) with learned human-preference and verifiable rewards. This pipeline improves architectural and geometric validity, supported by extensive empirical evaluation and ablation studies. Although focused on architecture, our results suggest that similar domain-specific recipes may be useful in other engineering domains with structured, verifiable outputs. Datasets, models, and inference code are available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/floora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLOORA 是面向建筑平面布局生成的小型领域专用语言模型（0.6B），用专用 DSL、自定义分词、领域预训练、SFT 与带人类偏好和可验证奖励的 RL 对齐。在分布外真实建筑上 VLM judge 胜率达 92.0%、合成建筑 96.0%，人类评测中 89.3% 的评审选它为最佳，超过体量大得多的前沿通用模型。
Motivation: 通用基础模型难以生成工程领域所需的结构化表示，建筑平面布局这类几何与建筑约束严格的任务尤其如此。
Method: FLOORA（Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment）组合 token 高效的专用 DSL、custom tokenization、领域专用预训练、监督微调 (SFT)，以及带 learned human-preference 与 verifiable rewards 的强化学习 (RL)，并配合消融研究检验各组件。
Result: 0.6B 模型在分布外真实建筑上 VLM judge 胜率最高 92.0%，合成建筑上 96.0%；人类评测中 FLOORA 在 89.3% 的评审里被选为最佳模型；该流程提升建筑与几何有效性 (architectural and geometric validity)。
Conclusion: 小模型配专用数据与对齐即可在结构化、可验证输出的工程任务上超过更大的前沿模型，这套领域专用配方可迁移到其他工程领域。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Understanding Decision-Making Mechanisms in Neural Routing Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) has achieved strong empirical success, yet the internal mechanisms driving model decisions remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate three representative autoregressive NCO models spanning two encoder-decoder configurations: AM and POMO (heavy-encoder, light-decoder), and LEHD (light-encoder, heavy-decoder). Through behavioral analyses, representation probing, and causal interventions, we examine how these models construct solutions and use internal representations during decoding. Our results suggest that AM and POMO predominantly follow a persistent geometric pattern throughout solution construction, whereas LEHD contains linearly accessible information about multiple future actions. Causal experiments further provide evidence for the role of future-node representations in LEHD's decision-making. We also observe that LEHD relies strongly on the current-node representation for immediate local decisions, while the start-node representation plays a broader navigational role over the subsequent route. Cross-instance alignment analyses additionally indicate that LEHD maps current-node representations into a relatively shared latent region, which may provide a stable reference for evaluating subsequent decisions. Across the Traveling Salesman Problem and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, these results reveal distinct decision-making patterns across these architecturally distinct solvers and provide a foundation for more interpretable analyses of NCO solvers. Code and additional visualizations are provided in the https://github.com/NCO-Interpretability/NCO-Interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对三个自回归神经组合优化 (NCO) 求解器 AM、POMO、LEHD 做行为分析、表示探针与因果干预，发现 AM/POMO 在解构造全程依赖持续的几何模式，而 LEHD 的线性可解码表示含有多步未来动作信息，因果实验支持未来节点表示参与其决策。跨 TSP 与 CVR P，结论是架构差异（重编码器-轻解码器 vs 轻编码器-重解码器）决定了求解器是靠几何先验还是靠前瞻表示做决策。
Motivation: NCO 求解器经验效果强，但驱动模型决策的内部机制基本未被探索，缺少可解释的分析基础。
Method: 选取两种编码器-解码器配置的三个模型：AM 与 POMO（heavy-encoder, light-decoder）、LEHD（light-encoder, heavy-decoder）；结合行为分析、表示探针 (representation probing)、因果干预 (causal interventions) 与跨实例对齐分析，考察解构造过程中内部表示的使用方式。
Result: AM 与 POMO 在解构造全程主要遵循持续的几何模式；LEHD 含有线性可访问的多未来动作信息，因果实验为其未来节点表示在决策中的作用提供证据；LEHD 强依赖当前节点表示做即时局部决策，起始节点表示对后续路线起更广的导航作用；跨实例对齐显示 LEHD 把当前节点表示映射到相对共享的潜在区域。上述发现在 Traveling Salesman Problem 与 Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem 上一致出现。
Conclusion: 架构不同的 NCO 求解器采用本质不同的决策模式：LEHD 借前瞻表示与共享潜在参考区做决策，因而更可解释；这些结果为 NCO 求解器的可解释分析奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SMat-Attention: Structured Long-Context Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Long-context sequence models face a fundamental tradeoff: softmax attention uses flexible token-level interactions at quadratic cost, whereas linear attention obtains linear-time training and constant-time decoding by compressing history into a fixed-size state. In this work, we ask whether we can connect these regimes through a tunable notion of structure. To this end, we introduce Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention) via a family of causal masks with structured long-range routing whose row supports have VC-dimension $d$. In our construction, $d=1$ recovers the standard causal mask, and increasing $d$ permits richer subset-routing patterns. We give chunkwise forward and backward algorithms to enable hardware-efficiency. For sequences of length $T$, the hard-routing construction takes $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$ work, despite the mask being dense, for our prescribed family. In fixed-horizon streaming, decoding after the distant prefix takes constant time per token using $O(T^{1-1/d})$ cached states. SMat-Attention therefore makes VC-dimension an explicit knob governing access-pattern complexity, prefill cost, and decoding memory. Empirically, subset-routing and rule-assisted multi-key retrieval experiments illustrate the masks' routing expressiveness. Extensions to Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet using learned routing with top-$k$ query reads retain subquadratic prefill, improve recall accuracy over the backbones in several settings, and achieve comparable small-scale language-modeling performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention)：一族行支撑 VC 维为 d 的因果掩码，把访问模式复杂度、prefill 成本与解码内存做成可调旋钮，d=1 退化为标准因果掩码。硬路由在长度 T 上耗时 O(T^{2-3/d}+T)，定长流式解码每 token 常数时间、缓存 O(T^{1-1/d}) 个状态；扩展到 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet 后在若干设定上提升召回率且小规模语言建模性能相当。
Motivation: 长上下文序列模型卡在两极：softmax attention 交互灵活但训练是二次代价，linear attention 线性训练、常数解码却要把历史压进定长状态，缺少一个在两者之间可调的结构化中间态。
Method: 构造行支撑 VC 维为 d 的因果掩码族，d=1 即标准因果掩码、d 增大允许更丰富的 subset-routing；给出 chunkwise 前向与反向算法以适配硬件。再把该掩码扩展到 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet，用可学习路由加 top-k query reads。
Result: 硬路由构造在序列长度 T 上工作量 O(T^{2-3/d}+T)，尽管掩码本身是稠密的；定长流式设定中越过远前缀后每 token 解码常数时间，缓存 O(T^{1-1/d}) 个状态。子集路由与 rule-assisted multi-key retrieval 实验展示掩码的路由表达力；扩展版在若干设定上相对 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet 骨干提升 recall accuracy，并达到可比的小规模语言建模性能。
Conclusion: VC 维可以作为显式旋钮，统一控制注意力掩码的访问模式复杂度、prefill 成本与解码内存，并在保持次二次 prefill 的前提下给状态空间骨干带来召回率提升。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Introducing the CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions
papers.abstract_en: In quantitative finance, standard regression losses are misaligned with the economics of return prediction. As the conditional mean of financial log-returns is close to zero, symmetric losses such as the mean squared and mean absolute errors make the constant zero forecast a near-optimal solution, penalizing models with genuine but noisy directional skill. This applies both during training, where predictions shrink toward zero, and during evaluation, where trivial forecasters can lead loss-based rankings. Under a Gaussian linear prediction model, we show that all symmetric monotonic losses share a universal breakeven directional accuracy against the zero predictor, which rises sharply and becomes unobtainable as the prediction noise approaches the standard deviation of the returns. We introduce the CZAR (Composite Zero-Agnostic Return) loss function, a piecewise quadratic loss built around five key requirements: convexity in the prediction, asymmetry with true return direction that vanishes at zero, near-linear penalization of undershoots and wrong-direction predictions, divergence for large errors, and an adaptive loss floor for evaluation. CZAR is provably convex in the prediction at fixed true value, has closed-form gradient and Hessian suitable for custom objectives in gradient-boosted libraries, and its four hyperparameters reduce to a single choice through correlated defaults. In idealized tests, the minimum directional accuracy required for a CZAR-evaluated forecaster to outperform the zero predictor under mean log loss remains near the 50% chance level, whereas the corresponding threshold for symmetric losses rises sharply with prediction noise. This advantage persists under heavy-tailed return distributions. In a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC log-returns, CZAR-trained models reduce the `zero-returns bias' and improve directional accuracy on large-magnitude returns.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables; appeared in ADI (September 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 金融对数收益条件均值近零，MSE/MAE 这类对称损失让常数零预测近乎最优，把有真实但含噪方向技巧的模型压向零。论文证明在高斯线性模型下所有对称单调损失共享一个普适盈亏平衡方向准确率，且随预测噪声接近收益标准差而急剧上升直至不可达；据此提出分段二次的 CZAR (Composite Zero-Agnostic Return) 损失，其评估下限使所需方向准确率保持在 50% 附近。
Motivation: 对称回归损失与收益预测的经济学错配：训练时预测被收缩到零，评估时平凡预测者可凭损失排名领先，压制有真实方向技巧的模型。
Method: CZAR 是围绕五条要求构造的分段二次损失：对预测凸、随真实收益方向不对称且在零处消失、对欠射与反向预测近线性惩罚、大误差发散、评估用自适应损失下限；给出闭式梯度与 Hessian 以便接入梯度提升库的 custom objective，四个超参数经相关默认值归并为单一选择。
Result: 高斯线性模型下证明所有对称单调损失共享普适盈亏平衡方向准确率，预测噪声接近收益标准差时急剧上升并变得不可得；理想化测试中，CZAR 评估下均值对数损失下击败零预测者所需方向准确率保持在 50% 附近，而对称损失的阈值随噪声急剧上升，且该优势在重尾收益分布下保持。LightGBM 在 BTC 日内对数收益上的实验中，CZAR 训练的模型降低 zero-returns bias 并提升大幅度收益的方向准确率。
Conclusion: 收益预测的损失必须对真实方向不对称并带自适应评估下限，否则含噪方向技巧会被对称损失系统性惩罚；CZAR 以凸的分段二次形式实现这一点并可直接接入梯度提升库。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory lets an LLM assistant use a history it can no longer reread, and most memory systems build it by rewriting conversations into facts, graphs or typed memories at write time. We argue that the work of memory divides, as thinking does, into two systems. Most of it is fast System 1 work: many small, independent yes/no judgments about records, such as whether a record is needed or no longer current, which a decision model makes by the dozen in a third of a second. Only a little is slow System 2 work: writing a few search queries, naming what the reply needs and composing the answer, which an LLM does well but slowly. We present Mnemon, a memory agent built on this division. It keeps conversations as raw, dated records; an LLM (System 2) plans searches over them, a decision model, Jev (System 1), judges what the searches return, and rules with explicit budgets turn the judgments into a small View for an unchanged answering model. A background pass consolidates each record once into topic timelines, value histories and standing instructions linked to the records, so that questions about a whole conversation reach evidence their own searches miss. Because nothing is decided about a record when it is written, the same agent can read any store that returns dated records. With gpt-4.1-mini answering, as in a public re-evaluation of 14 systems, Mnemon scores 91.7% on LoCoMo, the highest among them, and 83.8% on LongMemEval-S, from under 4k tokens of context per question, with the lowest effective cost index on LoCoMo. With a reasoning model answering, it reaches 92.2% on LoCoMo and 94.4% on LongMemEval-S, the latter on par with the best published results. From 100K to 10M tokens of history on BEAM, its cost per question grows by a factor of 1.11. On the same records, Jev separates gold evidence better than two LLMs and is 3-11 times faster.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code, prompts and run records: https://github.com/Grivn/mnemon-memory-agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mnemon 把 LLM 长期记忆拆成快慢两套系统：原始带日期记录不预先改写，System 2 的 LLM 只规划查询，System 1 判别模型 Jev 批量判断检索结果，规则按预算压成小 View 再交给不变的答题模型。在 gpt-4.1-mini 答题下 LoCoMo 得 91.7%（14 系统公开复评中最高）、LongMemEval-S 83.8%，每题上下文低于 4k tokens；换推理模型后分别到 92.2% 与 94.4%。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统在写入时就把对话重写成事实、图或类型化记忆，代价高且一旦写入即固化；同时大量记忆维护工作其实是成批的小是/否判断，交给慢的 LLM 做既浪费又昂贵。
Method: 对话以原始带日期记录保存；System 2（LLM）规划搜索并命名所需内容，System 1 判别模型 Jev 对搜索返回逐条做小判断，显式预算规则把判断收敛成小 View 供不变的答题模型使用；后台一遍 consolidation 把每条记录汇成 topic timelines、value histories 与挂靠记录的 standing instructions。

papers.title: ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE). Finally, we combine ABC with DAE into a single actor-critic algorithm and evaluate it in an offline-to-online RLVR setting, where the critic is first trained on previously collected trajectories and adapted during online learning. On mathematical reasoning tasks, ABC achieves performance competitive with GRPO using substantially fewer online optimization steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC)：从轨迹级 control variate 出发重写 advantage-value 形式，揭示其协方差结构与 Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) 的回报分解一致，并把 ABC 与 DAE 合成单一 actor-critic 算法。在离线转在线的 RLVR 设定下，数学推理任务上 ABC 以显著更少的在线优化步数达到与 GRPO 竞争的性能。
Motivation: GRPO 等 critic-free 方法简单有效，而 actor-critic 依赖学习到的价值函数，其近似误差会通过 TD 类 advantage 估计器引入偏差，需要一种既能保留 critic 又能控制该偏差的方案。
Method: 重访轨迹级 control variate 并写成 advantage-value 形式（ABC），指出其协方差结构与 DAE 的回报分解密切相关；再将 ABC 与 DAE 合并为一个 actor-critic 算法，critic 先在既有轨迹上离线训练、在线学习中继续适应（offline-to-online RLVR）。
Result: 在数学推理任务的 offline-to-online RLVR 设定下，ABC 用显著更少的在线优化步数取得与 GRPO 竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 用轨迹级 control variate 构造的 advantage 估计可以把 actor-critic 的 critic 偏差压到接近 critic-free 的水平，同时在样本效率上占优。

papers.title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
papers.abstract_en: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mirror-Score 是面向异手性 D-peptide/L-蛋白复合物的校准式、仅推理打分框架，并公开 31 个晶体复合物基准（四个靶标家族，其中 18 个有文献验证亲和力）。原始 ProteinMPNN NLL 不能作为亲和力排序器：与亲和力的合并 Spearman 仅 0.19，且在 MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) 与 gp41 (-0.70) 之间方向反转；改用 Boltz-2 镜像空间 cofolding 置信度后，病毒入侵家族 7 个结构的界面 pLDDT 留一 Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006)，三个肽亲和力排序全对，而 NLL 仅 rho = 0.18。作者主张按家族内校准部署，跨家族校准在当前样本量下不迁移。
Motivation: Mirror-Peptidizer 的镜像筛选管线用 ProteinMPNN 原始 NLL 排序，但从未对实测亲和力验证，9 个 MDM2 设计中仅 4 个可检测结合，D-peptide 结合体的计算设计因此仍不成熟。
Method: 构建 31 个晶体复合物、跨四个靶标家族的公开基准（18 个带文献验证亲和力），在镜像空间用 Boltz-2 cofolding 置信度（界面 pLDDT）打分，并与 ProteinMPNN NLL 对比；采用结构级 leave-one-out Spearman 评估，另给出针对 Pseudomonas aeruginosa 的 LasR 与 LecB 抗菌耐药靶标的前瞻性设计协议，含镜像结构、配体导出 hotspot 图、diffusion-model-ready 输入与 Mirror-Score 排序。
Result: 原始 ProteinMPNN NLL 与亲和力的合并 Spearman 为 0.19，家族间方向反转：MDM2/CHIP +0.62、gp41 -0.70；病毒入侵家族 7 个结构（代表 3 个肽）上界面 pLDDT 结构级留一 Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006)，三个肽亲和力排序全对，NLL 同设置仅 rho = 0.18。基准含 31 个晶体复合物、四个靶标家族、18 个有文献验证亲和力；Mirror-Peptidizer 原 9 个 MDM2 设计中仅 4 个可检测结合。

papers.title: GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning
papers.abstract_en: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 31 pages. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/GeoWind2Plan/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoWind2Plan 在任务时间内从背景风矢量与建筑几何预测任务相关 3D 城市风场并直接优化 UAV 路径与速度剖面：几何先变换到参考风坐标系，用局部几何条件神经算子预测风 patch 再拼成可查询风场，最后用物理能量模型规划。在 CFD 评估下，相对无风规划在顺风、逆风、侧风任务分别节能 6.9%、12.7%、4.5%，回收 CFD 参考节省的 87.9%、85.7%、75.0%，走廊定位推理约 3 秒而 CFD 约 8 小时。
Motivation: 城市建筑把环境风改造成空间变化的 3D 流场，UAV 能耗同时取决于局部风暴露与路径长度；但任务规划时通常没有建筑分辨的风信息，CFD 每次模拟绑定固定入流条件且耗时数小时到数天，与分钟到几十分钟的城市任务不匹配。
Method: 给定背景风矢量、3D 建筑几何与起终点对，先把几何变换到参考风坐标系 (reference-wind frame)，用局部几何条件神经算子 (localized geometry-conditioned neural operator) 预测任务相关 3D 风 patch，拼接成可查询的局部风场，再用物理驱动的 UAV 能量模型联合优化可行 3D 路径与速度剖面；定位为 decision-useful wind prediction 而非 CFD 级重建，规划用预测风、评估用高保真 CFD 风。
Result: 在留出的城市域、风速与任务风向工况上，走廊定位风推理约 3 秒，CFD 约 8 小时。CFD 评估下，相对无风规划的轨迹在顺风、逆风、侧风任务分别节能 6.9%、12.7%、4.5%，回收 CFD 参考节省的 87.9%、85.7%、75.0%。
Conclusion: 快速的走廊定位 3D 城市风预测足以让风感知 UAV 能耗规划在任务时间内可用，无需追求 CFD 级风场重建。

papers.title: What if automating AI R&D triggers an intelligence explosion?
papers.abstract_en: In contrast to even a year ago, AI systems now write most of the code inside the companies that build them. As more of the AI research and development (R&D) pipeline is automated, could AI progress radically accelerate in an "intelligence explosion," where years of advances are compressed into months or less? Preliminary evidence suggests that it could. In this work, we assess this evidence, analyze an intelligence explosion's potential impacts, and propose policy responses. AI systems are on track to automate most AI R\&D work within a few years, and possibly all of it. If this triggers an intelligence explosion, it could dramatically bring forward AI's benefits, but also pose extreme risks: capabilities growth could accelerate far beyond what society can keep up with, humanity could lose control over superhuman AI systems, and checks on power within and between states, companies, and branches of government could be severely eroded. Although there remains much uncertainty about these possibilities, the high stakes warrant serious further attention. Policymakers should urgently obtain more visibility into the automation of AI R&D, develop ways to steer and constrain an intelligence explosion, and prepare society to adapt to an intelligence explosion's impacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文评估 AI 自动化自身研发是否会在几年内触发智能爆炸 (intelligence explosion)，把数年进展压缩到数月，并给出政策应对。作者判断 AI 系统有望在数年内自动化大部分乃至全部 AI R&D 工作；若由此触发智能爆炸，收益可能大幅提前，但能力增长可能远超社会跟进速度、人类可能失去对超人类 AI 系统的控制，国家与公司内部及之间的权力制衡可能被严重侵蚀。作者建议政策制定者紧急提高对 AI R&D 自动化的可见度，开发引导与约束智能爆炸的手段，并让社会为冲击做准备。
Motivation: AI 系统如今已编写其开发公司内部的大部分代码，AI R&D 管线正被加速自动化，但这一趋势是否会引发智能爆炸、其影响与政策缺口尚缺系统评估。
Method: 工作分三步：评估 AI 自动化 AI R&D 的初步证据，分析智能爆炸的潜在影响（能力增长失控、超人类系统失控、权力制衡被侵蚀），并据此提出政策回应方案。
Result: 判断 AI 系统有望在数年内自动化大部分 AI R&D 工作，甚至全部；若触发智能爆炸，可把数年进展压缩到数月或更短，收益大幅提前，同时带来能力增长远超社会跟进速度、人类失去对超人类 AI 系统控制、以及国家/公司/政府分支间权力制衡被严重侵蚀的极端风险。

papers.title: PowerZooJax: A JAX-based Power System Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Power system operation is a safety-critical sequential decision-making problem, making it a natural testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing RL environments for power systems are often narrow in scope and computationally limited by CPU-based simulation workflows, making large-scale evaluation difficult. We introduce PowerZooJax, a JAX-based benchmark suite for RL in power system operation. It provides five constrained Markov decision process tasks spanning generation, transmission, distribution, distributed energy resources, and data center microgrid. By rewriting power flow, economic dispatch, market clearing, and device dynamics as JAX computation graphs, PowerZooJax keeps the entire training and evaluation loop on the GPU. Experiments show substantial speedups over CPU-based simulations and demonstrate standardized evaluation of policy returns, safety violations, and out-of-distribution stress conditions. Our open-source benchmark is available at: https://github.com/powerzoojax/PowerZooJax.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PowerZooJax 把电力系统运行的五个约束 MDP 任务（发电、输电、配电、分布式能源、数据中心微电网）的潮流、经济调度、市场出清与设备动态全部改写为 JAX 计算图，使训练与评估整环留在 GPU 上。实验显示相对基于 CPU 的仿真有大幅加速，并支持对策略回报、安全违规与分布外 (OOD) 压力条件的标准化评估。
Motivation: 现有电力系统 RL 环境覆盖面窄，且受 CPU 仿真流程限制，难以做大规模评估。
Method: 提出 JAX 基准套件 PowerZooJax：提供五个约束 MDP 任务，覆盖发电、输电、配电、分布式能源与数据中心微电网；将潮流 (power flow)、经济调度 (economic dispatch)、市场出清 (market clearing) 与设备动态重写为 JAX 计算图，训练与评估全程在 GPU 上运行。
Result: 实验显示相对基于 CPU 的仿真有大幅加速 (substantial speedups)，并演示了对策略回报、安全违规与分布外压力条件的标准化评估；开源地址 github.com/powerzoojax/PowerZooJax。
Conclusion: 把电力系统仿真改写为 JAX 计算图可让 RL 训练与评估整环留在 GPU，从而支撑大规模、标准化的电力系统策略评测。

papers.title: Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors
papers.abstract_en: Worker-monitor setups are a promising approach to AI oversight, but training workers against fixed monitors can incentivize monitor evasion. We study whether this failure mode can be avoided by co-training the monitor alongside the worker, and explore both supervised and self-supervised approaches. In the supervised setting, we prove a characterization: monitoring is possible with vanishing error and query rates exactly when the class of possible monitor functions has finite Littlestone dimension. This connects worker monitoring with an established literature on adversarial online learning. For self-supervision, we propose a co-training procedure based on test-time distillation: the monitor uses additional test-time compute to generate training labels, then trains its standard-compute policy on those labels. For majority-vote labels, we give a finite-sample sharpening guarantee under adaptive worker distributions with action coverage, that shows that the monitor's verdicts converge to its initial modal verdicts. We stress-test the former in code-security settings where the worker is trained adversarially to fool the monitor. Our results suggest that adaptive monitors are better at keeping pace with evolving worker strategies, while fixed monitors are more vulnerable to evasion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 worker-monitor 监督场景下固定 monitor 被规避的问题：监督设定下证明 monitor 函数类 Littlestone 维数有限当且仅当监控可实现误差与查询率趋零；自监督提出基于 test-time distillation 的协同训练，用额外测试时算力生成标签再训练标准算力策略。在代码安全对抗设定中压力测试，结果支持自适应 monitor 比固定 monitor 更能跟上 worker 策略演化。
Motivation: 对 worker 用固定 monitor 训练会激励 monitor evasion，使可扩展监督 (scalable oversight) 失效；需要判断协同训练能否避免这一失效模式。
Method: 监督设定给出充要刻画，将 worker 监控与对抗在线学习 (adversarial online learning) 联系起来；自监督提出 test-time distillation 协同训练：monitor 用额外测试时算力生成训练标签，再训练其标准算力策略；对多数投票标签在带 action coverage 的自适应 worker 分布下给出有限样本收紧保证，并在代码安全设定中让 worker 对抗训练以欺骗 monitor 做压力测试。
Result: 监督刻画：监控误差与查询率趋零当且仅当可能的 monitor 函数类具有有限 Littlestone 维数。多数投票标签下证明有限样本收紧保证，monitor 判决收敛到其初始众数判决。代码安全压力测试定性显示自适应 monitor 更能跟上演化中的 worker 策略，固定 monitor 更易被规避。
Conclusion: 协同训练的自适应 monitor 比固定 monitor 更能保持对 worker 策略演化的跟进，monitor evasion 是固定 monitor 训练的固有风险。

papers.title: Neural networks for spectral optimization
papers.abstract_en: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues. We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. The second is a model that takes the landscape function, the indicator function and the gradient of the landscape function. A Gram-Schmidt process produces orthogonal eigenfunctions as output of the model along with the associated eigenvalues. The landscape model reaches 1\% mean relative error on the first ten eigenvalues, compared with 4\% for an FNO model. Replacing the landscape by an SDF worsened both prediction and optimization errors. The trained model also generalizes from synthetic shapes to domains given as classical image dataset. The resulting surrogates of both approaches recover classical spectral optima such as the disk for the first eigenvalue or the conjectured minima of higher eigenvalues. This confirms that our models produce accurate differentiable estimates of eigenvalues, which can be used in shape optimization problems involving spectral quantities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两种直接从几何预测微分算子谱的神经代理模型，替代昂贵的 PDE 求解器来做谱形状优化：Fourier 系数加轻量 MLP（星形域精度 0.2%），以及输入 landscape 函数、指示函数与梯度、经 Gram-Schmidt 输出正交本征函数的模型（前十个本征值平均相对误差 1%，FNO 基线 4%）。代理模型能复现第一本征值的圆盘等经典谱最优解，可用于含谱量的形状优化。
Motivation: 依赖微分算子谱的泛函优化通常要反复调用 PDE 求解器，计算代价高；需要能直接从几何预测本征值且可微的代理。
Method: 模型一：以 Fourier 系数编码域、轻量 MLP 回归谱，系数重缩放满足本征值标度律，并对旋转反射取输出平均诱导不变性。模型二：输入 landscape 函数、指示函数及其梯度，用 Gram-Schmidt 过程输出正交本征函数与对应本征值；另试用 SDF 替换 landscape。
Result: Fourier-MLP 在星形几何上精度 0.2%；landscape 模型前十个本征值平均相对误差 1%，FNO 为 4%；用 SDF 替换 landscape 使预测与优化误差均变差；模型可从合成形状泛化到经典图像数据集给出的域。
Conclusion: 两种代理给出精确且可微的本征值估计，足以在谱形状优化中替代 PDE 求解，并复现圆盘与高阶本征值的猜想极小形。

papers.title: Graph-Split Bayesian Causal Forest for Spatial Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In spatial observational studies, treatment assignment and outcomes often exhibit spatial dependence patterns, and treatment effects may vary across space and subpopulations due to both measured and unmeasured spatially structured confounders. Accounting for spatial dependence while estimating heterogeneous treatment effects (HTEs) is a central task in spatial causal inference. Causal Bayesian additive regression tree methods are popular nonparametric methods for modeling and estimating HTEs. Despite their flexibility and uncertainty quantification, the axis-aligned split rules often adopted in these models are not suitable for modeling spatial structures. We propose a spatial structure-aware Bayesian nonparametric method, called Graph-Split Bayesian Causal Forest (GSBCF), that integrates graph-split Bayesian additive regression trees (GS-BART) with the Bayesian causal forest propensity-score regression framework for spatial heterogeneous causal inference. Spatial confounding is accommodated through graph-guided split rules in modeling decision trees of the prognostic and HTE functions. We develop an efficient informed proposal sampling algorithm for posterior computation, enabling full Bayesian inference of the spatial conditional average treatment effect function. Simulations and a real data study demonstrate substantially improved estimation accuracy and uncertainty quantification over existing causal BART methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Graph-Split Bayesian Causal Forest (GSBCF)，把图分割 BART (GS-BART) 的图引导分裂规则嵌入 Bayesian causal forest 的倾向得分回归框架，用以估计空间异质性处理效应 (HTE)。图引导分裂规则取代轴对齐分裂来刻画空间结构并容纳空间混杂，配一个 informed proposal sampling 算法做后验计算，实现空间条件平均处理效应 (CATE) 函数的全贝叶斯推断；模拟与真实数据研究显示估计精度与不确定性量化较现有 causal BART 方法有大幅提升。
Motivation: 空间观测研究中处理分配与结果都带空间依赖，已测与未测的空间结构化混杂使处理效应随空间和子群变化；而 causal BART 常用的轴对齐分裂规则不适合刻画空间结构。
Method: GSBCF 融合 GS-BART 与 Bayesian causal forest 的倾向得分回归框架：预后函数与 HTE 函数的决策树都采用图引导分裂规则 (graph-guided split rules) 来处理空间混杂；后验计算用一个高效的 informed proposal sampling 算法，输出空间 CATE 函数的全贝叶斯推断。
Result: 模拟研究与一项真实数据研究显示，GSBCF 在估计精度和不确定性量化上较现有 causal BART 方法有大幅提升 (substantially improved)。
Conclusion: 把图结构信息写进树的分裂规则，是让贝叶斯非参数因果模型适配空间混杂与空间 HTE 的有效路径，且能给出完整的贝叶斯不确定性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Hybrid Neural Simulation-Based Inference for Robust Applications and Limited-Budget Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: We develop two hybrid techniques that approach the performance of neural simulation-based inference (NSBI) analyses while substantially reducing the computational cost of inference and preserving some or all of the reliability guarantees of parametric methods. The first approach is broadly applicable, while the second is tailored to a class of particle physics analyses that admit a semi-parametric NSBI formulation. With only a modest compromise in raw sensitivity, these methods represent an important step toward computationally efficient NSBI in offline analyses and also open the door to the exploration of trigger-level applications in the future. Based on our comparison studies, we recommend the use of our first approach, Latent Categories, for robust and efficient inference.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, code available at https://github.com/benevedes/hybrid-nsbi
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两种混合神经仿真推断 (hybrid NSBI) 方法，在接近纯 NSBI 性能的同时大幅降低推断计算成本，并保留部分乃至全部参数化方法的可靠性保证。对比研究后作者推荐第一种方法 Latent Categories，用于稳健且高效的推断；第二种方法面向可半参数化 NSBI 表述的粒子物理分析。
Motivation: 纯神经仿真推断 (NSBI) 计算成本高，且缺少参数化方法的可靠性保证，限制了其在离线分析乃至未来触发级 (trigger-level) 场景中的应用。
Method: 提出两种混合技术：第一种通用（Latent Categories），第二种针对可采用半参数化 NSBI 表述的一类粒子物理分析；两者在性能上逼近 NSBI，同时保留参数化方法的部分或全部可靠性保证，并通过对比研究 (comparison studies) 选型。
Result: 在仅有适度原始灵敏度 (raw sensitivity) 折损的前提下，两种方法大幅降低推断计算成本并保留可靠性保证；对比研究推荐第一种方法 Latent Categories。
Conclusion: Latent Categories 是稳健高效推断的推荐选择，混合路线使 NSBI 可用于离线分析并为触发级应用打开可能。

papers.title: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly self-evolve by editing a persistent skill document that encodes their workflow, tool-use rules, and decision logic. This loop has two steps, an optimizer that proposes a candidate edit and a gate that accepts or rejects it. Prior work has concentrated on the optimizer, while the gate still follows a naive rule that keeps any edit which improves an aggregate validation score. We show that this rule fails in two ways. First, it admits permanent regressions, since an edit can raise the average while breaking items the skill already solves. Second, it is vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse, since the best observed score on a finite and noisy validation set is upward biased. To solve the above two limitations, we propose a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents (SAGE). Compared with previous work, SAGE has two contributions. First, SAGE proposes a per-item paired comparison that evaluates the current skill and the edited skill on identical validation items, which exposes regressions that an aggregate score hides and penalizes them asymmetrically. Second, SAGE also employs a one-sided paired test that commits an edit only when its wins are statistically reliable against its losses, and it abstains otherwise. SAGE is a conservative refinement of the standard gate that recovers the baseline exactly at a boundary setting. It commits only a subset of the baseline's edits, filtering out those whose gains are unreliable or purchased by breaking already-solved items. Across five benchmarks and four backbone LLMs under an equal-budget protocol, SAGE lowers the regression rate in 19 of 20 settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one, for example from 36.5% to 0% on LiveMath and from 42.8% to 0% on OfficeQA with DeepSeek-V4. SAGE also attains the highest final score in all 20 settings, raising LiveMath from 34.15 to 48.78.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 用逐项配对比较加单侧配对检验替换自进化 agent 的聚合分数接受门：只有当编辑的胜出项相对损失项统计可靠时才提交，否则弃权，并对破坏已解题目的编辑非对称惩罚。在 5 个 benchmark、4 个 backbone LLM、等预算协议的 20 个设置中，回归率在 19 个设置下降（LiveMath 36.5%→0%，OfficeQA 42.8%→0%，DeepSeek-V4），其余 1 个持平，且 20 个设置全部取得最高最终分数，LiveMath 从 34.15 升到 48.78。

Result: 在 5 个 benchmark、4 个 backbone LLM、等预算协议的 20 个设置中，回归率在 19 个设置下降、剩余 1 个与基线持平：LiveMath 从 36.5% 降到 0%，OfficeQA 从 42.8% 降到 0%（DeepSeek-V4）。20 个设置的最终分数全部最高，LiveMath 从 34.15 提到 48.78。

papers.title: Multi-Class, Multi-Tier Network Intrusion Detection: A Comprehensive and Reproducible Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have dominated Intrusion Detection System (IDS) research in recent years. Unfortunately, many existing studies have produced inflated results and unreliable benchmarks due to critical oversights and mistakes in the ML and DL pipeline, from data collection and labeling to feature engineering and model training and evaluation. CIC-IDS2017 is a standard benchmark for network intrusion detection. Still, many published results on this dataset are difficult to compare due to labeling errors, inconsistent flow extraction, potential leakage, and performance evaluation metrics dominated by benign traffic. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark with corrected PCAP-level labeling and a complete evaluation pipeline with diverse ML models. We evaluate eleven tabular classifiers at three nested levels: binary attack detection, nine-class attack-family attribution, and fifteen-class fine-grained classification. A soft-voting ensemble of Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM obtains the best fine-tier macro-F1 of 0.955, with coarse and binary macro-F1 scores of 0.980 and 0.999, respectively. We further conducted a feature selection study based on an analysis of feature importance. This comprehensive benchmark pipeline is configurable and open-source, enabling new feature extraction and model plugins for new datasets. Future work should use this pipeline as a reference point for richer features, rare-class analysis, and model generalization towards new datasets and attack classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 CIC-IDS2017 上标签错误、流提取不一致、数据泄漏与被良性流量主导的指标问题，提出修正 PCAP 级标注的可复现基准流水线，并在二分类、九类攻击家族、十五类细粒度三个嵌套层级上评测十一个表格分类器。Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM 的 soft-voting 集成取得最佳细粒度 macro-F1 0.955，粗层级 0.980、二分类 0.999。
Motivation: CIC-IDS2017 是网络入侵检测标准基准，但已有结果因标注错误、流提取不一致、潜在泄漏和被良性流量主导的评价指标而难以比较，ML/DL 流水线中的疏漏导致结果虚高。
Method: 给出修正的 PCAP 级标注与完整评测流水线，评测十一个表格分类器，按三个嵌套层级评估：二分类攻击检测、九类攻击家族归因、十五类细粒度分类；并基于特征重要性分析做特征选择研究。流水线可配置、开源，支持新数据集的新特征提取与模型插件。
Result: Random Forest + XGBoost + LightGBM 的 soft-voting 集成在细粒度层级取得 macro-F1 0.955，粗层级 macro-F1 0.980，二分类 macro-F1 0.999；共评测十一个表格分类器、三个嵌套层级（二分类、九类、十五类）。
Conclusion: 修正标注与统一评测口径后，表格集成模型在 CIC-IDS2017 三个层级上都能达到高 macro-F1，该流水线可作为后续更丰富特征、稀有类分析与跨数据集泛化的参照基线。

papers.title: Dual-Anchor Acceleration Is Near-Optimal for Stochastic Monotone Root-Finding
papers.abstract_en: Among distinct optimal acceleration mechanisms for deterministic monotone root-finding problems and fixed-point problems, dual-anchoring has recently been shown to admit a more robust direct stochastic extension than standard anchor acceleration. However, without additional strong monotonicity, the existing stochastic dual-anchoring guarantee has two limitations: first, it requires cocoercivity in expectation, and second, it attains only $O(ε^{-3})$ oracle complexity, leaving a gap to the near-optimal $\tilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ complexity achieved by other methods. In this work, we address both of these limitations by combining dual-anchoring with stochastic resolvent approximation and optimized variance control. For unbiased stochastic oracles with variance bounded by $σ^2$, where sample operators are monotone and uniformly $L$-Lipschitz, our algorithm finds a point with $ε$-residual with a near-optimal oracle complexity of $O ( (LD / ε) \ell + (σ^2 / ε^2) \ell^2)$, where $\ell = \log (1 + LD / ε)$ and $D$ is the initial distance to a solution. This result improves the best known oracle complexity in the noise-dominated regime under these samplewise assumptions, reducing the poly-logarithmic factor from cubic to quadratic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 dual-anchoring 与随机 resolvent 近似及优化的方差控制结合，得到无需期望 cocoercivity 的随机单调求根算法，在无偏、方差 σ²、样本算子单调且一致 L-Lipschitz 的假设下达到近最优 oracle 复杂度 O((LD/ε)ℓ + (σ²/ε²)ℓ²)，ℓ = log(1+LD/ε)。噪声主导区间内这是已知最好结果，多对数因子由三次降为二次。
Motivation: 随机 dual-anchoring 现有保证有两个缺口：要求期望 cocoercivity，且复杂度只有 O(ε⁻³)，与其它方法的近最优 Õ(ε⁻²) 相差一个量级。
Method: 将 dual-anchoring 与 stochastic resolvent approximation 结合，并加入优化的方差控制 (optimized variance control)；假设随机 oracle 无偏、方差上界 σ²，样本算子单调且一致 L-Lipschitz，D 为到解的初始距离。
Result: 求得 ε-residual 点的 oracle 复杂度为 O((LD/ε)ℓ + (σ²/ε²)ℓ²)，ℓ = log(1+LD/ε)；在噪声主导区间改进已知最好复杂度，多对数因子从三次降为二次，逼近 Õ(ε⁻²)。
Conclusion: 在逐样本单调加一致 Lipschitz 这类较弱假设下，dual-anchoring 配上 resolvent 近似与方差控制即可去掉期望 cocoercivity 要求并逼近最优复杂度。

papers.title: TORQUE: Optimizing What (not) to Quantize Before and After Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Uniform random rotations are an effective preprocessing step for quantization: they make normalized coordinate distributions approximately Gaussian, enabling the use of codebooks optimized offline. We introduce TORQUE, a framework that improves on previous quantization works that use random rotations by jointly optimizing how many and which coordinates to preserve at high precision both before and after rotation, under a fixed overall expected bit budget. Intuitively, before rotation, preserving large input coordinates at high precision can reduce overall error by preventing the rotation from spreading their values across many coordinates. Likewise, after rotation, preserving a small fraction of the largest-magnitude coordinates at high precision allows the remaining values to be quantized more accurately using codebooks optimized offline for the resulting truncated Gaussian distribution. We derive a quantization error upper bound and prove that top-$k$ pre-rotation retention minimizes it for each $k$. This reduces the search over coordinate subsets to an optimization over $k$, enabling a fast optimizer that uses offline codebooks and parallel parameter selection for practical implementation. We demonstrate an improved tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and storage cost through numerical evaluation under the Gaussian model and experiments on nearest-neighbor retrieval, KV-cache compression, and activation compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TORQUE 在固定比特预算下联合决定旋转前后各保留多少、哪些坐标走高精度：旋转前保留大坐标可避免其被旋转摊到多个坐标上，旋转后只留少量最大幅值坐标，其余交给离线优化的码本。推导出量化误差上界并证明对每个 k，旋转前 top-k 保留使该上界最小，把子集搜索降为对 k 的一维优化；数值评估与最近邻检索、KV-cache 压缩、激活压缩实验显示重建精度与存储开销的折中更优。
Motivation: 均匀随机旋转虽能把归一化坐标分布变成近高斯、便于用离线码本，但旋转前后哪些坐标该以高精度保留仍是未被优化的自由度，直接决定固定比特预算下的量化误差。
Method: 在固定整体期望比特预算下联合优化旋转前与旋转后高精度保留的坐标数量与选择；推导量化误差上界并证明 top-k 旋转前保留对每个 k 最小化该上界，从而把子集搜索化为对 k 的优化，配合离线码本与并行参数选择实现快速优化器。
Result: 在 Gaussian 模型下的数值评估，以及最近邻检索、KV-cache 压缩、激活压缩三类实验中，重建精度与存储成本的折中得到改进；理论结果为对每个 k 的旋转前 top-k 保留最小化量化误差上界。
Conclusion: 旋转前后的坐标保留应按幅度做 top-k 而非任意选择，这把组合搜索压成一维的 k 优化，即可在固定比特预算下取得更好的精度-存储折中。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight
papers.abstract_en: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, to appear at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明偏好压缩 (preferent compression) 的当前最优样本压缩界是紧的：用均匀分布与顺序统计量给出显式构造，使界在极限意义下被取到。同时给出一个只用初等计数论证、无需无穷维对偶的更短证明。
Motivation: 基于样本压缩的安全与性能证书是部署学习型方法的关键工具，偏好性质（即学习理论中的 stability）下的压缩界已在 Scenario Approach、Pick-to-Learn、Support Vector 等方法中直接使用，但该界是否紧一直是公开问题。
Method: 构造基于均匀分布与顺序统计量 (order statistics) 的显式例子，在极限下取到 state-of-the-art 的偏好压缩界；并给出替代原证明的更短论证，仅需初等计数，不依赖无穷维对偶 (infinite-dimensional duality)。
Result: 证明偏好压缩的当前最优界是 provably tight，显式构造在极限下达到该界；并给出更短、更易读的证明，只需初等计数论证。
Conclusion: 偏好压缩的 state-of-the-art 界不可再改进，其紧性由显式构造确立；证书类界本身是可依赖的，且可用更初等的方法重新证明。

papers.title: CoDimRecon: Agentic Reconstruction of Sim-Ready 3D Scenes with Deformable Curves, Surfaces, and Volumes
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing simulation-ready 3D scenes from real-world observations enables robotics, gaming, and immersive applications, yet existing methods largely assume rigid objects. This leaves an important gap for deformables, whose simulation-ready geometry depends on dimensionality (curves, surfaces, or volumes) and whose behavior may require models beyond elasticity. We present CoDimRecon, an agentic framework that reconstructs editable scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB observations. Scene-level geometric priors ground scale and layout, while object-level generated meshes guide the agent toward detailed, compact geometry; articulated rigid objects are decomposed into movable parts with explicit joints. For deformables, category-wise agent sessions reconstruct curves as centerlines with radii, surfaces as manifold shells with thickness, and volumes as watertight solids for volumetric meshing. Reusable simulator skills initialize compatible physical models and parameters, while agent-guided behavioral tests expose mismatches and trigger targeted revisions of motion, geometry, numerics, or material modeling. On evaluated Replica and ScanNet++ scenes, CoDimRecon achieves competitive compositional reconstruction accuracy while additionally producing deformable assets for rod, shell, and solid simulation. We further demonstrate robot interactions across all three representations, including a controlled paper-folding case in which behavioral testing motivates plastic bending.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDimRecon 用 agentic 流程从多视角 RGB 重建可编辑、仿真就绪的混合场景：刚体、铰接体与可变形体分别按维度处理——曲线取中心线加半径、曲面取带厚度的 manifold shell、体积取 watertight 实体，并用可复用的 simulator skills 初始化物理模型与参数，再由 agent 驱动的行为测试暴露失配并触发针对性修订。在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 场景上取得有竞争力的组合式重建精度，同时产出 rod/shell/solid 三类仿真资产并演示机器人交互，其中纸张折叠案例由行为测试判定需要塑性弯曲 (plastic bending)。
Motivation: 现有重建方法基本假设刚体，可变形体的仿真就绪几何取决于维度（曲线/曲面/体积），且其行为可能需要弹性之外的本构模型，这一缺口阻碍了机器人、游戏与沉浸式应用的仿真就绪场景构建。
Method: Agentic 框架 CoDimRecon：场景级几何先验确定尺度与布局，物体级生成网格引导 agent 得到细致紧凑的几何；铰接刚体分解为带显式关节的可动部件；可变形体按类别分 session 重建曲线（中心线+半径）、曲面（manifold shell+厚度）与体积（watertight solid 用于体网格划分）。可复用 simulator skills 初始化相容的物理模型与参数，agent 引导的行为测试发现失配后定向修订运动、几何、数值或材料建模。
Result: 在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 场景上取得有竞争力的组合式重建精度，并额外产出可用于 rod、shell、solid 仿真的可变形资产；演示覆盖三种表示的机器人交互，包括一个由行为测试推动判定塑性弯曲的受控纸张折叠案例。
Conclusion: 把可变形体按维度分通道重建、再用行为测试闭环校正物理模型，可以一次产出刚体、铰接体与可变形体混合的仿真就绪场景，且本构选择（如塑性弯曲）可由测试结果反推。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Persistence Forcing: Exploiting Feature Specialization in Pixel-Space Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-space diffusion Transformers (DiTs) directly operate on high-dimensional visual data, yet their hidden representations typically undergo uniform refinement across depth. Natural images, however, are inherently organized at different levels of granularity. Global structure can often be represented compactly, whereas local textures and fine details require richer representations. Motivated by this, we introduce heterogeneous refinement in pixel-space DiTs, assigning different feature groups distinct refinement budgets across depth. Consequently, an ordered feature specialization emerges: sparsely refined features predominantly encode global visual structure, whereas more frequently refined features increasingly specialize toward localized, high-frequency details. We refer to these two groups as persistent and active features, respectively. Building on this emergent specialization, we introduce Persistence Forcing (PerF), which explicitly exploits this persistent--active feature organization for pixel-space image generation. This enables persistent features to continuously condition actively refined features, allowing stable global information to guide the ongoing refinement of finer visual details. During generative sampling, this interaction further induces a meaningful guidance direction that promotes coherent global structure and naturally complements classifier-free guidance. On ImageNet $256\times256$, PerF-L achieves FID of $1.91$, approaching $1.86$ of JiT-H with only half the parameters, while PerF-H further achieves FID of $1.63$ and $1.76$ on ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在像素空间 DiT 中引入跨深度的异质细化预算，让稀疏细化的 persistent 特征专司全局结构、频繁细化的 active 特征专司高频细节，再用 PerF 让前者持续条件化后者并诱导出与 classifier-free guidance 互补的引导方向。ImageNet 256×256 上 PerF-L FID 1.91，接近 JiT-H 的 1.86 但参数量只有一半；PerF-H 在 256×256 与 512×512 上分别取得 FID 1.63 与 1.76。
Motivation: 像素空间 DiT 的隐表示在深度上被均匀细化，而自然图像本身具有不同粒度层级：全局结构可紧凑表示，局部纹理与细节需要更丰富的表示，均匀预算浪费了这种不对称。
Method: 对不同特征组分配不同的跨深度细化预算（heterogeneous refinement），自然涌现出 persistent 与 active 两组特征；PerF 显式利用该组织，让 persistent 特征持续条件化被反复细化的 active 特征，并在采样阶段诱导出促进全局一致性的引导方向，与 classifier-free guidance 互补。
Result: ImageNet 256×256：PerF-L FID 1.91，对比 JiT-H 的 1.86 且参数量为其一半；PerF-H FID 1.63（256×256）与 1.76（512×512）。
Conclusion: 按粒度不对称分配细化预算并让稳定特征持续引导细节细化，可在像素空间图像生成上以约一半参数逼近更大模型的 FID。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making context useful. Across manipulation and navigation, we examine how these mechanisms preserve taught requirements as objects, environments, and execution conditions change. This analysis links method design to evaluation practices that distinguish responsiveness to teaching, physical transfer, and benefits from retained experience. The resulting agenda connects compositional task acquisition and faithful transfer with physical recursive self-improvement, in which experience improves the ability to learn subsequent tasks.
papers.comment: 100 pages, 26 figures, 25 tables. Project page: https://jethrojames.github.io/awesome-robots-icl/ ; Code and literature: https://github.com/JethroJames/awesome-robots-icl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇机器人上下文学习 (in-context learning, ICL) 综述，把演示与交互在神经参数冻结条件下引导机器人执行的机制按四类接口组织：context-conditioned policies、geometric demonstration transfer、world-model-based control、skill- and agent-based execution。核心论断是这四类接口的差别在于迁移假设，以及 training、correspondence、memory 各自在把上下文变有用时的角色，并据此区分衡量教学响应性、物理迁移与保留经验收益的评估实践。
Motivation: 通用机器人需从演示与交互中推断新任务要求并转成物理动作，但现有方法的迁移假设与评估口径分散，难以比较上下文证据如何在物体、环境与执行条件变化时保住被教的要求。
Method: 综述按上下文到执行的接口分四族进行组织与比较：context-conditioned policies、geometric demonstration transfer、world-model-based control、skill- and agent-based execution；覆盖 manipulation 与 navigation，横向对照各族的 transfer 假设以及 training、correspondence、memory 的作用，并把方法设计与评估实践对应起来。
Result: 给出四族接口的分类框架与跨 manipulation、navigation 的机制比较，产出连接方法设计与评估实践的分析，并提出以 compositional task acquisition、faithful transfer 与 physical recursive self-improvement（经验提升后续任务学习能力）为内容的研究议程；全文 100 页、26 图、25 表。
Conclusion: 上下文是否有用取决于接口的迁移假设以及 training、correspondence、memory 的分工，评估应分别检验教学响应性、物理迁移与保留经验的收益；后续方向是把组合式任务获取与忠实迁移接到物理递归自我改进上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Infrared Subtraction with Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We present AI-developed local infrared subtraction, building on projection to Born and EFT matching. The framework separates an integrable radiation term from a finite contribution at Born kinematics, referred to as the Born contact. The contact is determined using the EFT singular distribution in a resolution observable such as N-jettiness $τ_N$. Under human physics guidance, an LLM develops two implementations. One uses a neural network for phase space projection and fits the contact by matching to EFT cumulants. The other uses an analytic construction that keeps the Born momenta fixed while integrating over radiation. It combines the EFT $δ(τ_N)$ coefficient with finite 4-dimensional radiation integrals to calculate the contact term directly. This gives a local subtraction formula without a slicing parameter, while reusing existing lower-order radiation calculations and EFT singular predictions. As a demonstration, we reconstruct the full NLO correction for massless 3- and 4-jet production in electron-positron annihilation. The attempt to the NNLO dijet production is also made by recursively using the NLO P2B construction with the LLM designing machine-learning controls to reduce the variance of the contact integral. The tested predictions are in good agreement with EERAD3. The numerical calculation and projection-network training use a 2020 Apple M1 MacBook, without GPU acceleration, illustrating the feasibility of the construction with modest computing resources. The appendices develop an extension of the local subtraction to 3-jet NNLO, giving explicit radiation maps and a proposed contact formula. We also show how to integrate over NNLO radiation while keeping the Born momenta fixed, for any number of massless final-state jets. Our results demonstrate how AI can help higher-order calculations by constructing infrared subtraction and improving its numerical integration.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 11 figures. Prompts and pseudocode for LLM-based agents to reproduce the figures are available in the Ancillary files section
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在投影到 Born (projection to Born) 与 EFT matching 框架上，用 LLM 在人类物理指导下开发两种局域红外相减 (local infrared subtraction) 实现：神经网络做相空间投影并按 EFT cumulant 拟合 contact，或解析地固定 Born 动量、把 EFT δ(τ_N) 系数与四维辐射积分结合直接算 contact，从而得到无 slicing 参数的相减公式。在 e+e− 湮灭的无质量 3、4-jet NLO 重建中预测与 EERAD3 一致，NNLO dijet 尝试也用递归 NLO P2B 加 ML 降方差控制完成，全程只用 2020 年 Apple M1 MacBook、无 GPU。
Motivation: 高阶微扰计算的红外相减通常依赖 slicing 参数并需人工推导，数值积分方差大、算力门槛高，阻碍 NNLO 级预测的常规化。
Method: 框架把可积辐射项与 Born 运动学处的有限项（Born contact）分离，contact 由分辨可观测量 N-jettiness τ_N 上的 EFT 奇异分布确定。两种 LLM 开发的实现：一是神经网络做相空间投影、匹配 EFT cumulant 拟合 contact；二是固定 Born 动量、对辐射积分，用 EFT δ(τ_N) 系数加有限四维辐射积分直接计算 contact，复用已有低阶辐射计算与 EFT 奇异预测。
Result: 重建了 e+e− 湮灭中无质量 3-jet 与 4-jet 产生 的完整 NLO 修正；对 NNLO dijet 用递归 NLO P2B 构造并由 LLM 设计机器学习控制降低 contact 积分方差作出尝试。测试预测与 EERAD3 良好一致；数值计算与投影网络训练在 2020 Apple M1 MacBook 上完成、无 GPU 加速。附录给出向 3-jet NNLO 的推广，含显式辐射映射与拟议 contact 公式。
Conclusion: 无 slicing 参数的局域红外相减可由 AI 辅助构造并在 modest 算力下数值实现，AI 能帮助高阶计算并改进数值积分；该构造可推广到任意多无质量末态 jet 的 NNLO 辐射积分。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 框架把可积辐射项与 Born 运动学处的有限项（Born contact）分离，contact 由分辨可观测量 N-jettiness τ_N 上的 EFT 奇异分布确定。两种 LLM 开发的实现：一是神经网络做相空间投影、匹配 EFT cumulant 拟合 contact；二是固定 Born 动量、对辐射积分，用 EFT δ(τ_N) 系数加有限四维辐射积分直接计算 contact，复用已有低阶辐射计算与 EFT 奇异预测。
summary_sections.result: 重建了 e+e− 湮灭中无质量 3-jet 与 4-jet 产生 的完整 NLO 修正；对 NNLO dijet 用递归 NLO P2B 构造并由 LLM 设计机器学习控制降低 contact 积分方差作出尝试。测试预测与 EERAD3 良好一致；数值计算与投影网络训练在 2020 Apple M1 MacBook 上完成、无 GPU 加速。附录给出向 3-jet NNLO 的推广，含显式辐射映射与拟议 contact 公式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 无 slicing 参数的局域红外相减可由 AI 辅助构造并在 modest 算力下数值实现，AI 能帮助高阶计算并改进数值积分；该构造可推广到任意多无质量末态 jet 的 NNLO 辐射积分。

papers.title: Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) in healthcare remains challenging, as the overhead of rebuilding governance guarantees for every collaboration stops most projects at the proof-of-concept stage. Here we present FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform that makes FL training and evaluation repeatable. FLIP implements common FL workflows as a set of composable services: cohort queries against per-site structured databases, on-demand DICOM retrieval from institutional PACS, per-site project approval, and reusable FL job types. To demonstrate FLIP, we ran two distinct use cases, federated fine-tuning and federated evaluation, on synthetic chest X-ray cohorts across two client nodes based in the United Kingdom (UK) and Thailand. In FLIP, each institution independently approves its participation in each project and operates its own node under local IT security processes. This study makes an operational rather than an algorithmic claim. It does not compare federated with centralised training; for that question, we refer the reader to existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses. The central result is evidence that such platforms enable international FL collaboration and improve repeatability, auditability, and site-specific governance. We also present a comprehensive comparison of existing platforms to help researchers and operators choose the right platform for their use case.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/londonaicentre/FLIP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLIP 把联邦学习的治理与数据接入流程拆成可组合服务（队列查询、按需 DICOM 调取、逐站点审批、可复用 FL 任务类型），使跨国医疗 FL 训练与评估可重复。在英国与泰国两个节点的合成胸片队列上完成联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例，各机构独立审批并按本地 IT 安全流程运行节点。作者明确这是操作性而非算法性结论：平台使国际 FL 协作可重复、可审计、可按站点治理。
Motivation: 医疗联邦学习中每次合作都要重建治理保证，开销过大，多数项目停在概念验证阶段，缺少让跨国 FL 训练与评估可重复的平台层方案。
Method: FLIP 以可组合服务实现常见 FL 工作流：对各站点结构化数据库做队列查询、从机构 PACS 按需检索 DICOM、逐项目逐站点审批、提供可复用的 FL job 类型；演示用例为合成胸片队列上的联邦微调与联邦评估，部署在英国与泰国两个客户端节点。
Result: 在 FLIP 上完成两个用例（联邦微调、联邦评估），跨 UK 与 Thailand 两个节点的合成胸片队列运行；各机构独立审批参与并按本地 IT 安全流程运营自己的节点；另给出既有 FL 平台的综合对比。摘要明确不比较联邦与集中式训练。
Conclusion: 这类平台能支撑国际 FL 协作并提升可重复性、可审计性与站点级治理；作者的主张限定在操作层面而非算法性能，并附平台对比供研究者与运维者选型。

papers.title: Causal and Interpretable Structures in LLM Compositional Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are able to solve tasks whose answers depend on not only individual input tokens, but also on relations among them. How is such relational information represented and processed across transformer layers? We study activations from ensembles of prompts that require inferring relationships between three tokens corresponding to a cyclic concept (months, hours, weekdays, and musical notes) to correctly predict the next token. Across model families (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral) and cyclic concepts, we find a consistent layerwise progression in how the joint dependence among the tokens is geometrically organized and causally used: intermediate layers use a joint representation based on the inferred relationship between two tokens, while later layers use a joint representation associated with all three tokens to correctly complete the task. We also find other relationships between tokens that are geometrically structured but remain causally inert in the next-token prediction. Crucially, when taken together, these geometric and causal investigations reveal the representation-level mechanism that progressively organizes and composes the relational information to form the answer. More surprisingly, restricting the models to such causally relevant joint representations improves next-token prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Llama、Qwen、Gemma、Mistral 上研究三 token 循环关系（月份、小时、星期、音符）的下一 token 预测，发现中间层用两 token 推断关系的联合表示，末层改用覆盖三 token 的联合表示来完成任务；把模型限制在这些因果相关的联合表示上反而提高预测准确率。
Motivation: LLM 能解依赖 token 间关系的组合任务，但这种关系信息在 transformer 各层如何被几何组织并因果使用尚不清楚。
Method: 对需要推断三个循环概念 token 关系的 prompt 集合分析激活，结合几何表示分析与因果干预，跨四个模型家族和多种循环概念追踪逐层演化。
Result: 跨模型家族与循环概念一致观察到分层进程：中间层依赖两 token 关系的联合表示，末层依赖三 token 联合表示；另存在几何结构化但对下一 token 预测因果惰性的关系；限制模型只用因果相关联合表示可提高下一 token 预测准确率。
Conclusion: 几何与因果分析共同揭示了 LLM 逐步组织并组合关系信息形成答案的表示层机制，且筛除因果惰性表示可反哺预测性能。

papers.title: SIFARI: Self-Supervised Interferometric Fitting for Astronomical Radio Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Radio-interferometric images are reconstructed from sparsely sampled visibilities, and CLEAN-based imaging can struggle with spatial filtering, complex morphologies, and uncertainty quantification. Alternative methods that fit visibilities directly can address some of these limitations but often require manual choices of image priors and model hyperparameters. We present SIFARI (Self-Supervised Interferometric Fitting for Astronomical Radio Imaging), a self-supervised neural network workflow that represents sky brightness as a continuous function of position and fits measured visibilities without an external image training set or explicit spatial regularizer. An empirical rule sets the Fourier feature scale from the visibilities before training, controlling how readily the network fits fine structure. Sampling network weights with Stochastic Weight Averaging-Gaussian (SWAG) gives approximate brightness uncertainty estimates, which we combine with a thermal-noise floor to construct spatially resolved signal-to-noise maps. In synthetic ALMA tests, SIFARI yields an effective point-source response about eight times narrower than the natural-weighting CLEAN restoring beam and recovers more extended flux than CLEAN when short baselines are missing. It also achieves higher image fidelity than the restored CLEAN images in all three morphology benchmarks. Applied to ALMA observations of PDS 70, SIFARI recovers the bright outer ring together with faint compact emission in the central cavity. For long-baseline-only WISPIT 2 data, SIFARI supplies a sky model for phase self-calibration where the CLEAN model is inadequate. The restored, self-calibrated SIFARI image has approximately 30% lower RMS noise than the CLEAN image made from the original visibilities without self-calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIFARI 用自监督神经网络把天空亮度表示为位置的连续函数，直接拟合干涉仪可见度，无需外部图像训练集或显式空间正则。在合成 ALMA 测试中其有效点源响应比 natural-weighting CLEAN 恢复波束窄约 8 倍，三个形态基准的图像保真度全部高于恢复后的 CLEAN 图像；用于 WISPIT 2 长基线数据时，自校准后的 SIFARI 图像 RMS 噪声比未自校准的 CLEAN 图像低约 30%。
Motivation: 射电干涉成像从稀疏采样的可见度重建图像，CLEAN 在空间滤波、复杂形态和不确定性量化上受限；直接拟合可见度的方法又需人工挑选图像先验与模型超参数。
Method: SIFARI 以连续位置函数表示天空亮度，自监督地直接拟合实测可见度，不依赖外部图像训练集或显式空间正则；用一条经验规则在训练前由可见度设定 Fourier feature 尺度，控制网络拟合精细结构的程度；用 Stochastic Weight Averaging-Gaussian (SWAG) 对网络权重采样得到近似亮度不确定性，再与热噪声底合成空间分辨的信噪比图。
Result: 合成 ALMA 测试中，SIFARI 的有效点源响应比 natural-weighting CLEAN 恢复波束窄约 8 倍；短基线缺失时比 CLEAN 恢复出更多展宽流量；在全部三个形态基准上图像保真度高于恢复后的 CLEAN 图像。应用于 ALMA 的 PDS 70 观测，恢复出外亮环与中央空腔内的暗弱致密发射。对仅有长基线的 WISPIT 2 数据，SIFARI 为相位自校准提供天空模型而 CLEAN 模型不足，其自校准恢复图像的 RMS 噪声比原始可见度直接成像的未自校准 CLEAN 图像低约 30%。
Conclusion: 不依赖图像先验与显式正则的自监督可见度拟合，配合 SWAG 不确定性，可在分辨率、展宽流量恢复、自校准天空模型上超过 CLEAN，并直接产出带空间分辨信噪比的图像。

papers.title: Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation: Formulation, Benchmark, and Method
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has largely focused on a single agent following a single instruction, yet many real-world applications require teams of robots to tackle tasks beyond the capabilities of any individual agent. We present Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation, providing, to our knowledge, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent VLN as a constrained coordination problem: each mission consists of subtasks carrying dependency and resource constraints (presence locks and holding chains). A verified four-stage crafting pipeline instantiates the task as MAVLN, comprising 11,724 episodes across 145 scenes with teams of up to four agents under three instruction regimes, accompanied by tailored constraint-aware metrics. We further present TRISS, a coordination-ready navigation system coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler, a shared topological memory that turns each agent's exploration into team knowledge, and a conflict-aware execution mechanism that realizes simultaneous intentions as collision-free routes. Extensive experiments establish TRISS as a comprehensive baseline and reveal substantial room for improvement across scheduling, planning, and execution, highlighting the challenges of coordinating under MAVLN task constraints. Project page: https://xyz9911.github.io/mavln.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多机器人视觉-语言导航 (multi-agent VLN) 形式化为带依赖与资源约束的协调问题，并构建 MAVLN 基准（11,724 个 episode、145 个场景、最多四智能体、三种指令体制）与协调系统 TRISS。实验显示 TRISS 可作为综合基线，但在调度、规划与执行三方面仍有很大提升空间。
Motivation: 现有 VLN 几乎只研究单智能体执行单条指令，而真实场景需要多机器人团队完成超出单体能力的任务，且缺少把依赖约束与资源约束（presence locks、holding chains）纳入的形式化与基准。
Method: 提出 MAVLN：经四阶段可验证构建流程实例化任务，含 11,724 个 episode、145 个场景、最多四智能体、三种指令体制，并配套约束感知指标；方法 TRISS 由 LLM 子任务调度器、共享拓扑记忆（把单个智能体探索转为团队知识）与冲突感知执行机制（将并发意图落实为无碰撞路径）组成。
Result: MAVLN 含 11,724 个 episode、145 个场景、最多四智能体、三种指令体制；大量实验确立 TRISS 为综合基线，并显示其在调度、规划、执行上均有显著改进空间。
Conclusion: 多智能体 VLN 可被系统化为受约束协调问题并配有可复现基准，而现有协调方法在 MAVLN 约束下仍远未解决该问题。

papers.title: Solver Agent: an Agentic AI Framework for Theoretical Physics Computations Applied to F-theory Uplifts of O3-planes and S-folds
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Solver Agent, an AI framework based on large language models for calculations and proofs in mathematics and theoretical physics. The solution process is tracked through a persistent ledger that records assumptions, derivations, and computations. A central agent delegates tasks to specialized sub-agents, while independent agents verify both intermediate steps and the final result. This setup improves the traceability, reproducibility, and verification of computer-assisted calculations. Applying Solver Agent, we study global F-theory uplifts of Type IIB orientifolds and their S-fold generalizations. We establish sufficient conditions for Weierstrass models over projective threefolds with terminal $\mathbb{Z}_k$ quotient singularities ($k\in\{2,3,4,6\}$) to give $\mathbb{Q}$-factorial projective elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau fourfolds with isolated Gorenstein terminal quotient singularities. These geometries realize O3-planes and S-folds, where local D3-brane probes of the latter yield four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=3$ superconformal field theories. Using stringy invariants, we derive fixed-point contributions to Hodge data and Euler characteristics, and show that these Euler corrections determine the localized D3-brane charges required for tadpole cancellation. We illustrate these results using toric hypersurface constructions, where a single three-dimensional polytope determines both the Type IIB Calabi-Yau threefold and the F-theory base; here, the orientifold double cover naturally forms a bisection of an alternative genus-one-fibered uplift with discrete $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge symmetry. Finally, we provide methods for toric computations and four-form flux analysis in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ compactifications with non-abelian gauge sectors.

papers.title: HEIR: Learning Human-Entity Interactions with Functional Roles
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human-entity interactions requires recovering each person-action event's participants, roles, and shared identities. This structure can support embodied agents by clarifying who acts on which entities and how, informing anticipation and coordination in shared environments. Standard HOI metrics score individual links, leaving complete event composition undermeasured. We introduce HEIR (Human-Entity Interactions with Functional Roles), an image benchmark for complete grounded participant-role sets across object, interpersonal, and self-directed interactions. It contains 18,730 images, six roles, 105 actions, and 437 nouns, with shared entities, role changes, and repeated fillers; 51.6% of images contain multiple actors and 62.1% contain multiple actions. HEIR pairs relation AP with complete-set AP and structural evaluation. We also introduce CoRISP (Compositional Role-aware Interaction Set Prediction), which uses shared entity identities to combine role-conditioned evidence and predict normalized participant-role sets. Cardinality and role-multiplicity potentials couple assignments through event size and role composition, with exact per-event normalization. Across 16 baselines, relation and complete-event rankings diverge even after aligning action weights. CoRISP leads the evaluated systems on repeated-role events and shared-participant images in HEIR by 2.87 and 3.82 Set mAP points, respectively. On V-COCO, CoRISP achieves 73.72/76.23 role AP and 61.06/68.59 complete-set AP on two-slot actions under Scenarios 1/2. These results show the value of learning and evaluating event composition alongside individual relations. The code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HEIR.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 4 figures. Code and dataset: https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HEIR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEIR 是一个图像基准，用于评测完整的人-实体交互事件（参与者、功能角色、共享身份），并提出 CoRISP 用共享实体身份组合角色条件证据来预测归一化参与者-角色集合。在 16 个基线上，关系级与完整事件级排名即使对齐动作权重后仍不一致；CoRISP 在 HEIR 的重复角色事件与共享参与者图像上分别领先 2.87 和 3.82 个 Set mAP 点。
Motivation: 标准 HOI 指标只逐条打分人-物链接，完整事件的组合（谁对哪个实体做什么、角色如何分配）被系统性低估，无法支撑具身智能体在共享环境中的预判与协调。
Method: 发布 HEIR 图像基准（18,730 张图、6 种角色、105 个动作、437 个名词，含共享实体、角色变化与重复填充者），配 relation AP 与 complete-set AP 及结构化评测；提出 CoRISP（Compositional Role-aware Interaction Set Prediction），用共享实体身份融合角色条件证据，以 cardinality 与 role-multiplicity 势函数通过事件规模与角色组成耦合分配，并做逐事件精确归一化。
Result: HEIR 中 51.6% 图像含多行动者、62.1% 含多动作；16 个基线上关系级与完整事件级排名在对齐动作权重后仍分歧。CoRISP 在重复角色事件与共享参与者图像上分别领先 2.87 与 3.82 个 Set mAP 点；在 V-COCO 两槽动作上 Scenarios 1/2 的 role AP 为 73.72/76.23，complete-set AP 为 61.06/68.59。
Conclusion: 事件组合必须与单条关系一起学习和评测，因为两者排名会分歧；用共享实体身份约束集合预测能在重复角色与共享参与者场景下提升完整事件指标。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and software engineering. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ROSS improves the six-benchmark MOPD average from 58.40% to 62.20% and SWE-bench Verified from 64.20% to 68.40%. These results show that self-rollout training leaves behind reusable behavioral experience that can yield further gains through offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), without additional policy rollouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROSS 把历史自生成 rollout 当作可复用经验：保留整条轨迹作上下文，只对其中被选中的模型生成续段施加损失，用离线 SFT 继续提升已推进的策略。在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，六 benchmark MOPD 平均从 58.40% 提到 62.20%，SWE-bench Verified 从 64.20% 提到 68.40%，且无需额外策略 rollout。
Motivation: LLM 后训练中，RL 与 on-policy distillation 产生的自生成 rollout 一旦策略前进就被当作过期数据丢弃；但其中既有仍与新策略兼容、且保留了策略已不再稳定表达的行为，也混有错误、废弃尝试和冗余动作，需要更细粒度的取舍。
Method: ROSS（Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision）保留完整历史轨迹作为上下文，只对筛选出的模型生成续段计算损失，以离线 SFT 方式回炉；应用于 domain-specific RL、multi-teacher on-policy distillation 与 agentic RL 三类后训练场景。
Result: 在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，六 benchmark MOPD 平均 58.40% → 62.20%，SWE-bench Verified 64.20% → 68.40%；在数学、代码生成、指令遵循与软件工程上一致提升上游 checkpoint 并优于基线，覆盖 domain-specific RL、multi-teacher on-policy distillation 与 agentic RL。
Conclusion: 自 rollout 训练留下的历史经验是可复用的行为资产，通过选择性监督的离线 SFT 就能继续榨出增益，无需再跑新的策略 rollout。

papers.title: Right Words, Wrong Moment: A Clinician-Grounded Analysis of Distress in 19,930 Conversations between Young People and ChatGPT
papers.abstract_en: Young people increasingly turn to General-Purpose Conversational Agents (GPCAs), such as ChatGPT, in moments of distress. We examine young adults' (ages 18-25) experiences using ChatGPT. We first collected 19,930 ChatGPT conversations and survey data from 158 young adults. We then selected five example conversations reflecting user distress. Finally, we asked ten clinicians to review those five conversations. We found distressed participants reported greater emotional engagement with ChatGPT and greater behavioral change from using it than their peers. When they turned to ChatGPT in moments of acute distress, ChatGPT was quick to give overly dramatic responses and excessive action-oriented suggestions. Clinicians endorsed ChatGPT's availability and much of its wording, but identified seven process failures, such as prematurely jumping to solutions. We translated clinicians' feedback into design guidelines following three stages: 1) asking about safety, 2) de-escalating intensity to restore emotional regulation, and 3) exploring concerns without agreeing with them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 19,930 段 18–25 岁用户与 ChatGPT 的对话加问卷与临床医生审阅，发现处于痛苦中的用户对 ChatGPT 情绪卷入更深、行为改变更大，而 ChatGPT 在急性痛苦时刻会迅速给出过度戏剧化的回应和过量行动导向建议。十位临床医生认可其可用性与大部分措辞，但指出七类过程性失败（如过早跳到解决方案），并据此给出三阶段设计指南：先问安全、再降温以恢复情绪调节、最后在不认同的前提下探讨顾虑。
Motivation: 年轻人在痛苦时刻越来越多地向通用对话代理 (GPCA) 求助，但急性痛苦场景下 ChatGPT 的回应方式是否恰当缺少临床视角的检验。
Method: 三步设计：收集 19,930 段 ChatGPT 对话与 158 位 18–25 岁年轻人的问卷数据；从中选出五段反映用户痛苦的示例对话；请十位临床医生审阅这五段对话，并把其反馈按三个阶段（询问安全、降温强度、探讨而不认同顾虑）转化为设计指南。
Result: 痛苦组自报对 ChatGPT 的情绪投入与行为改变均高于同龄对照；临床医生指出七类过程性失败，其中包括过早跳到解决方案；ChatGPT 在急性痛苦时反应过快、过于戏剧化且行动建议过量。
Conclusion: 对话代理在急性痛苦时刻的默认策略应改为先确认安全、再降温、最后探讨顾虑，而不是直接给出行动方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HEAR: Real Voices, Real Bias: A Large-Scale Human-Recorded, Demographically Diverse Benchmark for Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce HEAR (Human-recorded Evaluation of Audio-LLM bias by Real speakers), a large-scale, ecologically valid benchmark comprising 87k real human audio samples from 843 demographically diverse participants. HEAR enables comprehensive evaluation through Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) and open-ended long-form tasks. To our knowledge, this is the first large-scale voice benchmark grounded entirely in authentic human speech. We evaluate model behavior across both real-time speech-to-speech and speech-to-text architectures. Our results reveal that voice-conditioned bias is a model-specific property. Furthermore, we demonstrate that personalization instructions consistently exacerbate demographic disparities. Our findings establish that voice bias is a controllable model characteristic, providing a foundational framework for future bias mitigation and evaluation in Audio-LLM development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEAR 用 87k 条真实人声、843 位不同人口背景参与者的录音构建音频大模型 (Audio-LLM) 偏差基准，覆盖 MCQA 与开放式长回答两类任务，并同时测实时 speech-to-speech 与 speech-to-text 架构。结果显示语音条件偏差是模型特有的属性，而个性化指令 (personalization instructions) 会一致加剧人口统计学差异。
Motivation: 现有音频大模型评测多依赖合成或单一来源语音，无法刻画真实说话人口音、性别、年龄等人口属性引发的偏差，也缺少可复用的大规模真实人声评测集。
Method: 构建 HEAR 基准：87k 条真实人类录音、843 位人口背景多样的参与者，任务形式为 Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) 与开放式长回答；在实时 speech-to-speech 和 speech-to-text 两类架构上评测模型行为，并对比加入个性化指令前后的表现。
Result: 基准规模为 87k 条真实人声样本、843 位参与者；评测揭示 voice-conditioned bias 是模型特有 (model-specific) 的属性，且个性化指令在各模型上一致加剧人口统计学差异。
