papers.title: A neural network-based Universal Thermal Climate Index for reliable global thermal-stress classification across extreme weather
papers.abstract_en: Extreme temperatures are the leading cause of climate-related mortality world-wide. Climate-health research and operational weather forecasting require accurate estimates of human thermal stress. The Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI) is among the most sophisticated and widely used feels-like temperature metrics. However, its ubiquitous polynomial approximation does not generalize well to extreme weather conditions. Here, we introduce Neural-UTCI, a neural network that calculates UTCI with substantially higher accuracy across global conditions at a lower computational cost for operational use. Neural-UTCI reduces the polynomial approximation RMSE from 2.78°C to 0.36 °C, an 87% improvement, and lowers thermal stress misclassification rates from 5.3% to 1.7%, with consistent performance across resampling experiments. These differences affect thermal exposure metrics. For example, during the 2003 European heatwave summer in Rome, Italy, the number of very strong heat stress days increases from 15 to 35 days when using Neural-UTCI compared to operational products like ERA5-HEAT. Simultaneously, Neural-UTCI reliably classifies extreme cold stress conditions, allowing continuous global application. By improving UTCI accuracy, Neural-UTCI can strengthen climate-health risk assessments and public weather warning systems, especially as global warming increases the incidence of extreme events.

TL;DR: Neural-UTCI 用神经网络替代 UTCI 的多项式近似，在全球条件下把 RMSE 从 2.78°C 降到 0.36°C（改善 87%），热应激误分类率从 5.3% 降到 1.7%，且在极端冷应激下也能可靠分类，可连续全球应用。2003 年欧洲热浪夏季罗马的极强热应激日数因此从 15 天升到 35 天（对比 ERA5-HEAT 等业务产品），说明多项式近似会系统性低估极端天气下的热暴露。
Motivation: 气候健康研究与业务天气预报需要准确的人体热应激估计，但 UTCI 通用的多项式近似在极端天气条件下泛化差，导致热暴露指标与预警失真。
Method: 提出 Neural-UTCI：一个直接计算 UTCI 的神经网络，替代原有多项式近似，在全球条件范围内训练/拟合以覆盖极端高温与极端冷应激，并做重采样实验检验稳定性；同时以 2003 年欧洲热浪罗马个例对照 ERA5-HEAT 等业务产品。
Result: RMSE 从 2.78°C 降至 0.36°C（改善 87%）；热应激误分类率从 5.3% 降至 1.7%；重采样实验中表现一致。2003 年欧洲热浪夏季罗马极强热应激日数从 15 天增至 35 天（Neural-UTCI vs ERA5-HEAT 等业务产品）。
Conclusion: 神经网络版 UTCI 在精度与计算成本上都优于多项式近似，可支撑连续全球热应激分类，从而改进气候-健康风险评估与公共天气预警系统。

papers.title: Intrinsic Associative Memory on Riemannian Manifolds: Curvature, Capacity, and Emergent Modes
papers.abstract_en: Geometry does more than constrain an associative memory: curvature determines what it remembers and which states it creates. We develop intrinsic dense associative memories on Riemannian manifolds by casting memory as Epanechnikov kernel-density mode seeking. We compare geodesic and volume-corrected energies and show that curvature separates their behavior. We prove that geodesic memory always retains an isolated pattern, while corrected memory obeys a sharp Ricci-curvature threshold: positive curvature can erase memories in high dimensions, while negative curvature reinforces them. We derive geodesic capacity scalings of $q_β^{-1/2}$ for retaining every pattern and $q_β^{-1}$ for a typical one, where $q_β$ is the pairwise kernel-overlap probability. We show how overlap \emph{creates} novel memories: designed $N$-pattern configurations realize all $2^N-1$ subset modes, but random data at the storage threshold yield only a Poisson number. We establish exact one-step recall using Riemannian mean shift. In simulations, we recover the predicted curvature transition and every designed mode. On WordNet's full noun hierarchy, we demonstrate that volume correction improves low-capacity retrieval. Together, our work shows that curvature is a design variable for associative memory, not merely a property of the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把联想记忆写成 Riemannian 流形上的 Epanechnikov 核密度众数搜索，证明测地线记忆总保留孤立模式，而体积修正记忆存在尖锐 Ricci 曲率阈值：高维正曲率会抹掉记忆、负曲率则强化记忆。容量标度为保留全部模式 q_β^{-1/2}、保留典型模式 q_β^{-1}；设计的 N 模式配置可实现全部 2^N-1 个子集众数，随机数据在存储阈值处只得到 Poisson 个。
Motivation: 稠密联想记忆的容量与回忆行为通常在欧氏空间讨论，而流形曲率如何决定记忆被保留还是被抹除、能存多少模式，缺少刻画。
Method: 将记忆建模为 Epanechnikov 核密度的众数搜索，比较测地线能量与体积修正能量；推导容量标度与 Ricci 曲率阈值，用 Riemannian mean shift 实现一步精确回忆，并在模拟与 WordNet 完整名词层级上检验。
Result: 测地线容量标度 q_β^{-1/2}（保留全部模式）与 q_β^{-1}（典型模式）；设计的 N 模式配置实现全部 2^N-1 个子集众数，随机数据在存储阈值只产生 Poisson 个众数；模拟中复现预测的曲率转变并找回每一个设计众数；在 WordNet 完整名词层级上体积修正改善低容量检索。
Conclusion: 曲率是联想记忆的设计变量而非数据的附带属性：正曲率在高维可擦除记忆、负曲率强化记忆，体积修正在低容量检索中更有效。

papers.title: FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FluxLite 是面向离散扩散模型的免训练推理期提议控制框架：在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上，任何稀疏跳率扰动都可被 Feynman-Kac 势中的 q_t 加权图散度项精确补偿，从而保持目标路径不变、让残余重加权方差变成局部凸问题。由此实例化 HEU 单跳局部再分配与 D-VCG 小型非负二次规划两种采样器；在解析可解有限状态 CTMC 基准上终端 KL 相对标准 Feynman-Kac SMC 基线最多改善两个数量级，2D Ising 采样的行相关 MSE 几何平均降 5–7 倍、峰值最多降 55 倍。
Motivation: 预训练离散扩散与扩散语言模型的许多推理期任务可归结为从倾斜 (tilted) 分布采样，Feynman-Kac SMC 原则上精确，但当提议动力学与倾斜失配时权重会退化，粒子数再多也无法提升效果。
Method: 在预训练反向速率构成的稀疏有向图上，用 q_t 加权的图散度项精确补偿任意稀疏跳率扰动，使残余重加权方差成为局部凸目标；据此给出两种采样器：单跳局部再分配规则 HEU，以及在预训练速率基上求解小型非负二次规划的 D-VCG。另在标准 score-entropy 训练损失下证明总体稳定性，识别出决定对 score 误差鲁棒性的倾斜路径覆盖因子，并给出固定受控 Feynman-Kac 递推的有限粒子收敛性。
Result: 在解析可解的有限状态 CTMC 基准上，FluxLite 相对标准 Feynman-Kac SMC 基线的终端 KL 改善最多两个数量级；在 2D Ising 采样上行相关 MSE 几何平均降低 5–7 倍、峰值最高降低 55 倍。
Conclusion: 把提议速率的稀疏扰动用图散度项在势中精确抵消，可在不改目标路径的前提下把重加权方差变成可解的局部凸问题，从而突破 Feynman-Kac SMC 的权重退化瓶颈。

papers.title: EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnJoi 提出基于 score 的集合联合滤波 (Ensemble Joint Score Filter)：把过去与未来状态的联合分布学出来，再用改造版 En4DVar 依据集合协方差动态平衡对当前状态与新观测的信任。在流体与交通流仿真上重建性能提升，观测稀疏且非均匀时改善最明显。
Motivation: 用 score-based 生成模型做数据同化时，自回归扩散模型只以前一状态为条件，不携带对自身历史预测不确定性的估计，因而在观测稀疏、非均匀时难以平衡状态先验与观测。
Method: 训练自回归扩散模型时条件于前一状态，并学习包含过去与未来状态的联合分布；在此基础上套用改造版 En4DVar，用粒子集合的协方差动态加权当前状态置信度与新观测。
Result: 在流体 (fluid) 与交通流 (traffic flow) 仿真上，重建性能优于对照设定，且在观测稀疏、非均匀的条件下改善尤其明显。
Conclusion: 让生成模型输出联合状态分布、再交给依赖集合协方差的经典 DA 算法，可以在观测不全时更稳地恢复动力系统完整状态。

papers.title: HERO: Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models trained on large pathology image corpora now provide strong, transferable representations for computational pathology. Over the past few years a series of such models has been released, each trained on more slides than the last; on standard classification and segmentation benchmarks, the leading models are now separated by small margins. In clinical use, however, the foundation model is applied to images from hospitals, scanners, and staining protocols outside its training data. Encoders generally embed these acquisition factors alongside biological information, which may introduce downstream errors and hinder safe clinical adoption. A pathology foundation model should therefore be robust to acquisition shift without giving up representation quality, yet robustness is seldom the axis along which models are compared. In this report, we introduce HERO (Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology), a ViT-G/14 pathology foundation model trained with the DINO and iBOT objectives and refined with high-resolution Gram anchoring on a morphology-balanced corpus of 500 million tiles from approximately 575,000 clinical whole-slide images. Across the evaluated public benchmarks, HERO shows the strongest robustness to center, scanner, and stain variation among the compared state-of-the-art foundation models, performs comparably on tile-level classification, segmentation, and gene-expression prediction, ranks first on average across 39 evaluated slide-level clinical tasks, and, under an equal-weighted framework-level analysis, has the best average rank across the six benchmark frameworks.

TL;DR: HERO 是一个 ViT-G/14 病理基础模型，用 DINO 与 iBOT 目标在 575,000 张临床全切片的 5 亿 tile 语料上训练，再以高分辨率 Gram anchoring 精修，把中心、扫描仪、染色这类采集偏移从表征中剥离。在所评测的公开基准上，它在对比的 SOTA 基础模型中对中心/扫描仪/染色变化鲁棒性最强，tile 级分类、分割与基因表达预测表现相当，39 项切片级临床任务平均排名第一，六个基准框架的等权框架级分析中平均排名最佳。
Motivation: 病理基础模型的榜单差距已很小，但临床部署时会遇到训练数据之外的医院、扫描仪与染色协议；编码器通常把采集因素与生物学信息一起嵌入，带来下游误差并阻碍安全的临床采用，而鲁棒性很少是比较轴。
Method: ViT-G/14 架构，训练用 DINO 与 iBOT 目标，语料为形态学均衡的约 575,000 张临床 WSI、5 亿个 tile；随后用高分辨率 Gram anchoring 精修，使表征对采集变化不变。评测覆盖 tile 级分类、分割、基因表达预测与 39 项切片级临床任务，并做六个基准框架的等权框架级排名分析。
Result: 在所评测的公开基准上，HERO 在对比的 SOTA 基础模型中对 center、scanner、stain 变化的鲁棒性最强；tile 级分类、分割、基因表达预测表现相当（comparable）；在 39 项切片级临床任务上平均排名第一；等权框架级分析中在六个基准框架上平均排名最佳。
Conclusion: 病理基础模型可以在不牺牲表征质量的前提下对采集偏移更鲁棒，鲁棒性应作为与精度并列的比较轴，而非只比 benchmark 分数。

papers.title: KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KernelOnet 把核函数显式写进神经算子架构，用核替换 DeepONet 的 trunk 网络，使算子结构与边界型核展开方法一致，并给出数据驱动可学习核、物理信息核、混合核三种形式。在三个基准与一个浅水波导工程问题上达到高精度，在可与 DeepONet 对比处用更少可学习参数取得更高精度，无监督配置不需内部解标签，单次查询推理代价远低于逐实例求解器。
Motivation: DeepONet 等传统神经算子靠深度网络隐式学基函数，结构与边界型核展开方法不对应，且在无界外域声传播这类通用神经算子难以处理的问题上受限。
Method: 以显式核替换 trunk 网络：数据驱动核用神经网络参数化径向基函数（常系数线性问题中可视作非奇异基本解）；物理信息核嵌入解析基本解，使展开自动满足控制方程，仅用边界条件即可无监督训练；混合核按控制方程线性主部把解拆成解析基本解张成的齐次部分与低秩学习修正核承载的源项部分。
Result: 在三个基准和一个浅水波导工程问题上达到高精度；在可与 DeepONet 对比处以更少可学习参数获得更高精度；无监督配置不需要内部解标签；单次查询推理代价远低于逐实例求解器。
Conclusion: 把核展开结构显式植入神经算子，可在无界外域声传播问题上以更少参数和更低查询代价换取高精度，物理先验与数据拟合可按方程主部在齐次解与源项之间分工。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: PrivacySkills: How Privacy Guidance Shapes Source Selection in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: While prior work has documented privacy failures in LLM agents, it remains unclear how the presentation of privacy guidance influences their choice of information sources. We introduce PrivacySkills, a controlled framework for evaluating how agents choose among acquisition pathways that provide the same task-relevant value: consulting publicly available personal information, accessing confidential sources, or interacting with the user. The evaluation framework comprises 55 synthetic tasks spanning 11 categories of personal information, with 169 associated skills that describe the available acquisition pathways. We consider privacy guidance through system-level instructions, skill-level metadata labels, or both. Separately, we vary user availability and urgency framing. With users available and no privacy guidance, agents access confidential sources in 30% of valid runs on average across five open-weight models, despite sufficient alternatives. This rate increases to 45% when users are unavailable, whereas urgency framing has no detectable effect. System-level privacy instructions alone have limited effects on confidential access, while skill-level intrusiveness labels produce a modest reduction (24% on average), but combining the two roughly halves confidential access. Our findings motivate incorporating privacy annotations into skill specifications and evaluating their effectiveness alongside system-level instructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrivacySkills 用 55 个合成任务、169 个 skill 构造同一任务价值下的三条信息获取路径（公开个人信息、机密源、询问用户），测 LLM agent 在不同隐私指引下的机密源访问率。用户可用且无指引时五个开源模型平均 30% 的有效运行仍访问机密源，用户不可用升到 45%，紧迫性措辞无可检测影响；仅系统级指令效果有限，仅 skill 级侵入性标签降到 24%，两者结合约减半。
Motivation: 已知 LLM agent 存在隐私失败，但隐私指引的呈现方式（系统指令 vs skill 元数据标签）如何改变其信息源选择尚不清楚，且用户可用性与紧迫性框架是否放大该行为未被分离。
Method: 受控评测框架：55 个合成任务覆盖 11 类个人信息，配 169 个描述获取路径的 skill；隐私指引分别设为系统级指令、skill 级侵入性标签或两者兼有，并独立变化用户可用性与紧迫性措辞，在五个开源模型上运行。
Result: 用户可用且无隐私指引时，五个开源模型平均 30% 的有效运行访问机密源（尽管存在足够替代）；用户不可用时升至 45%，紧迫性措辞无可检测影响。仅系统级指令对机密访问影响有限，仅 skill 级侵入性标签平均降到 24%，两者结合约使机密访问减半。
Conclusion: 隐私标注应写进 skill 规范并与系统级指令一起评测，因为单独的系统指令不足以压住机密源访问，而用户不可用会显著抬高这一比例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Embodied Semantic Communication for Collective Autonomous Agents: A Tutorial on Representation, Wireless Delivery, and Closed-Loop Coordination
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous systems and embodied intelligence enter the dynamic physical world, multi-agent collaboration calls for a paradigm shift in communication design. However, existing communication paradigms overlook that agents form action understanding from their own states, environmental observations, and collaboration relations through a process that evolves as a task unfolds. Consequently, reliable bit delivery, general semantic recovery, or single-task utility optimization alone cannot ensure that heterogeneous agents form coordinated actions compatible with their own conditions from shared information during task execution. To address this gap, this paper proposes embodied semantic communication (ESC) as a paradigm that transforms information transmission into action-oriented semantic interaction. Specifically, ESC characterizes how an explicit communication link can encapsulate multimodal perceptual states, intrinsic hardware capabilities, and collaborative intents into unified actionable semantic representations, thereby enabling heterogeneous receiving agents to parse, align, and ground them in local motor control. This paper clarifies the conceptual boundary, system characteristics, and environment-constrained technical pathways of ESC. It maps the underlying mathematical tools, including semantic information theory, world models, and multi-agent decision theory. Finally, this paper summarizes key open challenges, including measurable semantic reliability, ambiguity-triggered interaction under dynamic environments and tasks, and bandwidth-adaptive semantic transmission, outlining a roadmap for collective embodied networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出具身语义通信 (embodied semantic Communication, ESC) 范式，把多智能体间的信息传输改写为面向动作的语义交互：把多模态感知状态、自身硬件能力与协作意图封装成统一的可执行语义表征，使异构接收方能在本地电机控制中解析、对齐并落地。论文给出概念边界、环境约束下的技术路径与开放挑战路线图，属于教程性综述而非实验工作。
Motivation: 现有通信范式只保证比特可靠送达、通用语义恢复或单任务效用优化，忽略了智能体的动作理解来自自身状态、环境观测与协作关系且随任务推进演化，因而异构智能体无法从共享信息形成与自身条件兼容的协同动作。
Method: 以教程形式界定 ESC 的概念边界与系统特征，给出环境约束下的技术路径，并映射底层数学工具：语义信息论、world model、多智能体决策理论；最后梳理可度量语义可靠性、动态环境与任务下由歧义触发的交互、带宽自适应语义传输三项开放挑战。
Result: 论文为教程/综述性质，给出概念框架、数学工具映射与开放挑战清单（可度量语义可靠性、歧义触发交互、带宽自适应语义传输），并输出集体具身网络路线图。
Conclusion: 可靠比特、通用语义恢复或单任务效用都不足以支撑异构智能体协同，通信设计必须转向以动作为导向的语义交互，并优先解决语义可靠性的可度量性与带宽自适应传输。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets
papers.abstract_en: Sensor networks and radars can deliver signals as organized sets, e.g. ordered signals, signals describing range cells within a grid or signals perceived as graph nodes. Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. The encoding and embeddings discrimination experiments conducted rely exclusively on synthetic complex-valued radiofrequency signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向组织化信号集的图神经网络编码器，把异构采样参数下的信号集投影到固定维度向量空间，使嵌入对采样差异不变并保留拓扑。在纯合成复值射频信号上评估嵌入的区分潜力，重点是波形分离。
Motivation: 传感器网络与雷达产生的信号集内各信号采样参数各异，常规编码难以在消除采样差异的同时保留拓扑结构，限制了后续任意拓扑感知处理。
Method: 用图神经网络编码器将异构采样的组织化信号集（有序信号、网格距离单元、图节点）映射到任意固定维度向量空间，设计目标是抑制采样参数影响并去除信号处理约束；评估方式为信号集区分潜力，聚焦波形分离。
Result: 编码与嵌入区分实验全部基于合成复值射频信号，评估指标为信号集的区分潜力与波形分离表现；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 采样不变的嵌入表示可让组织化信号集在统一向量空间中做拓扑感知处理，其有效性以波形分离的区分潜力来衡量。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.method: 用图神经网络编码器将异构采样的组织化信号集（有序信号、网格距离单元、图节点）映射到任意固定维度向量空间，设计目标是抑制采样参数影响并去除信号处理约束；评估方式为信号集区分潜力，聚焦波形分离。
summary_sections.result: 编码与嵌入区分实验全部基于合成复值射频信号，评估指标为信号集的区分潜力与波形分离表现；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
summary_sections.conclusion: 采样不变的嵌入表示可让组织化信号集在统一向量空间中做拓扑感知处理，其有效性以波形分离的区分潜力来衡量。

papers.title: Same Bytes, Different Authority: Reserved-Token Representations in Chat-Template Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection against LLM agents becomes much stronger when the injected instruction is wrapped in the model's own chat template. A forged template marker such as <|im_start|> can reach the model either as a single reserved control token or as a sequence of ordinary subword tokens. The two decode to exactly the same text, and because tokenization runs on the server, the defender rather than the attacker decides which one the model receives. We use this to measure how much of the injected instruction's authority comes from the reserved token's learned representation. Encoding the forged markers as subwords, with the text held fixed and a control for the extra tokens this adds, lowers attack success on the InjecAgent benchmark by 39 to 66 percentage points on three of four open-weight families, and the gap carries over to multi-turn agent tasks in AgentDojo. On Qwen3-8B the gap is 8 points, because without reserved ids the model still recognises the forged turn from its text by reasoning; suppressing the reasoning block widens the gap to 50. The authority sits in the single learned vector at the marker position: the mean of the marker's subword vectors does not reproduce it, the vector of the nearest ordinary token restores the attack on Llama-3.1, and an adaptive attacker who searches for non-reserved markers finds such embedding neighbours on three of four families. In every base and instruction-tuned pair we test, instruction tuning strengthens the model's preference for reserved markers. The standard mitigation, a tokenizer option that encodes special tokens as ordinary subwords, applies only to tokens a configuration declares special, so in 33 of 67 distinct tokenizer configurations, covering 255 of the 400 most-downloaded chat models on Hugging Face, it leaves intact the tool-protocol tokens through which agents read untrusted tool output, and the gap persists on that channel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一段伪造 chat template 文本，若以单个 reserved control token 而非等价 subword 序列进入模型，注入指令的权威性显著更高：在 InjecAgent 上把标记改编码为 subwords 可让攻击成功率下降 39 到 66 个百分点（四个开源权重家族中的三个），差距延续到 AgentDojo 多轮 agent 任务。权威性集中在标记位置那一个学习到的 embedding 向量上，且标准缓解手段（tokenizer 把 special token 编码为普通 subword）在 67 个 tokenizer 配置中有 33 个覆盖不到工具协议 token。
Motivation: chat-template prompt injection 的威力被普遍归因于文本内容，但同一文本可被 tokenizer 解码为 reserved token 或 subword 序列，且 tokenization 在服务端执行，防御方实际控制这一选择；此前缺少对 reserved token 表征本身贡献多少攻击权威性的隔离测量。
Method: 固定注入文本不变，只把伪造标记（如 ）从单个 reserved token 改编码为等价 subword 序列，并对新增 token 数量做对照；在 InjecAgent 与 AgentDojo 多轮 agent 任务上测攻击成功率，比较四个开源权重家族及其 base/instruction-tuned 配对。再做表征消融：取标记 subword 向量的均值、用最近普通 token 的向量替换，以及让自适应攻击者搜索非 reserved 的 embedding 邻居；在 Qwen3-8B 上抑制 reasoning block 以分离文本推理通道。
Result: subword 编码使 InjecAgent 攻击成功率下降 39 到 66 个百分点（四个家族中三个），差距延续到 AgentDojo；Qwen3-8B 上差距仅 8 点，抑制 reasoning block 后扩大到 50 点。标记 subword 向量的均值无法复现该效果，用最近普通 token 的向量可恢复攻击（Llama-3.1），自适应攻击者在四个家族中三个找到此类 embedding 邻居。所有测试的 base/instruction-tuned 配对中，instruction tuning 都强化了模型对 reserved 标记的偏好。标准 tokenizer 缓解选项在 67 个不同配置中有 33 个失效，覆盖 Hugging Face 下载量前 400 聊天模型中的 255 个，工具协议 token 通道上的差距持续存在。
Conclusion: 注入权威性来自标记位置那一个学习到的向量而非文本本身，因此防御必须在服务端 tokenization 层面处理，且仅靠声明 special token 的 tokenizer 选项不足以覆盖 agent 读取不可信工具输出的通道。

papers.title: Bregman Consensus
papers.abstract_en: Consider a community of agents who are seeking consensus on a set of parameters. The agents agree to use the same Bregman-type divergence to quantify disagreement between their individual estimates of the parameters but have varying confidence in each other's abilities. Each agent is happy to revise their estimate by moving to the weighted barycenter of all individual estimates with higher weights applied to more trusted agents. We show that such revisions naturally lead to an iterative algorithm which converges to a unique consensus estimate of the parameters. Furthermore, since the consensus estimate is itself a barycenter with computable weights, the group emerges as a collective super-agent with a well-formed opinion regarding the ability of each individual agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体用同一个 Bregman 散度度量参数分歧、并按对彼此能力的信任度加权，把各自估计更新为加权重心 (weighted barycenter)，该迭代收敛到唯一共识估计；且共识本身仍是重心，其权重可反推出群体对每个个体能力的评价，群体因此涌现出一个对成员能力有明确判断的超级智能体。
Motivation: 分布式估计中各智能体对彼此能力的信任度不同，缺少一种机制让带异质信任的迭代更新既收敛到唯一共识、又同时产出对个体能力的评价。
Method: 以 Bregman 型散度定义分歧，每个智能体把自身估计更新为全体估计的加权重心，权重反映对相应智能体能力的信任；由此导出迭代算法，并利用共识估计本身可写成权重可计算的重心这一结构。
Result: 证明该迭代收敛到唯一的参数共识估计；共识估计作为重心带有可计算权重，群体由此形成对每个个体能力的明确意见。
Conclusion: 带异质信任的 Bregman 重心迭代能同时给出唯一共识与可解释的个体能力权重，使群体成为一个意见完备的集体超级智能体。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts. In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data. Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark evaluation scripts available at https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADENCE 用双专家架构做时间序列分类 (TSC)：Convolutional Linear Expert 把 10,000 个确定性膨胀特征接到闭式 L2 正则 Woodbury ridge 分类器，Distributional Interval Expert 用 Hydra 膨胀核加 Cornish-Fisher 矩近似（跨信号运动学与 FFT 频带）接 ExtraTrees，再由带稀有类保护的验证 meta-router 在纯路由与置信度加权软融合间选择并全量重训。在 UCR Archive 全部 109 个等长数据集、30 次重采样共 3,270 次运行上，grand mean accuracy 0.8864，排名 #2，与 HIVE-COTE 2.0 的 0.8895 差 0.31 个百分点且无显著差异 (p_Holm = 0.295)，平均每数据集仅 17.53 秒（双核 CPU）。
Motivation: TSC 存在精度与算力的尖锐取舍：HIVE-COTE 2.0 精度最高但算力开销大，MiniRocket、Hydra 等超快随机卷积变换秒级完成却在相位无关分布、信号运动学和大类数下的决策树碎片化上表现不佳。
Method: CPU 原生双专家架构：Convolutional Linear Expert 用 10,000 个确定性膨胀特征配闭式 L2 正则 Woodbury ridge 分类；Distributional Interval Expert 用 Hydra 竞争膨胀核，对信号运动学与 FFT 频带做 dyadic Cornish-Fisher 矩近似，由 ExtraTrees 拟合。内部验证 meta-router 带稀有类保护，在纯专家路由与置信度加权软融合间动态选择，最后用 100% 训练数据全量重训。
Result: 在 UCR Archive 全部 109 个等长数据集、30 次重采样（共 3,270 次运行）上，CADENCE grand mean accuracy 0.8864，全档案排名 #2，仅次于 HIVE-COTE 2.0 的 0.8895（p_Holm = 0.295，无统计显著差异）；高于 Hydra+MultiRocket 0.8818、MultiRocket 0.8797、HIVE-COTE 1.0 0.8786（p_Holm = 0.048）。与 HIVE-COTE 2.0 的差距缩到 0.31 个百分点，平均每数据集耗时 17.53 秒（双核 CPU）。
Conclusion: 双专家分工加置信度自适应路由，可以在 CPU 上把 TSC 精度推到与 HIVE-COTE 2.0 统计上不可区分的水平，同时把每数据集耗时压到秒级量级。

papers.title: Prompted Identity Degrades Cooperation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly mix models from several providers, yet exposing each agent's underlying model identity to its peers significantly impairs cooperation. We show that when agents are aware of each other's model family, the group splits into clusters, where agents prefer interacting with others carrying their same label, although nothing in the task rewards or asks for such a split. We argue that the label itself causes this split, which we define as $\textit{factionalism}$. We show and measure this phenomenon in two cooperative games and on a reasoning benchmark, with nine to twenty-five agents drawn from up to five open-weight model families. We further show that when the announced families are shuffled, or replaced by arbitrary labels, the factions still follow this information; when the label is removed, this behavior disappears. In strictly cooperative tasks, labeled groups spend on average $30\%$ more rounds and $55\%$ more tokens to reach a decision, and their success rate drops from $96\%$ to $81\%$. The effect replicates across tasks, group sizes and model families. Withholding identity labels from the agents is simple and effective mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多智能体 LLM 系统中向 agent 公布彼此的模型家族标签会诱发派系化 (factionalism)：agent 偏向与同标签同伴交互，而任务本身并不奖励这种分裂。在两个合作博弈与一个推理基准上，带标签组达成决策平均多花 30% 轮次、55% token，成功率从 96% 降到 81%；去掉标签即可消除该行为。
Motivation: 多 provider 混合的多智能体 LLM 系统中，模型身份信息被默认暴露给同伴，但这种标签是否会破坏合作此前没有被量化。
Method: 在两个合作博弈和一个推理基准上做对照实验，规模为 9 至 25 个 agent、最多 5 个开源模型家族；通过打乱公布家族、替换为任意标签、以及移除标签三种干预来检验标签本身是否为原因。
Result: 严格合作任务中带标签组平均多用 30% 轮次和 55% token 达成决策，成功率由 96% 降至 81%；标签打乱或换成任意标签时派系仍跟随该信息，移除标签后行为消失；效应在不同任务、群体规模与模型家族上复现。
Conclusion: 派系化由身份标签本身而非任务激励引起，因此对 agent 隐去身份标签是简单且有效的缓解手段。

papers.title: Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized historical trajectory of the network's parameter values. By integrating this trajectory-based preconditioning directly into the gradient update, we actively shield historically critical parameter directions without relying on additive penalties. Empirical evaluations on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the loss barrier between consecutive tasks.

papers.title: Grab a Coffee: Future-Aware Guidance for Discrete Diffusion with Compiled Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by iteratively resolving multiple tokens in parallel, offering a flexible alternative to left-to-right generation. However, guiding this process with a sequence-level objective is difficult because the value of one unresolved token depends on the other tokens with which it can form a high-reward sequence. Enumerating all such completions makes the whole guidance computation grow exponentially with the number of unresolved positions. We introduce COFFEE, a plug-and-play framework that avoids this enumeration by separating sequence dependence from the objective. At each diffusion step, a target-free carrier absorbs the marginal token distributions predicted by the denoiser to construct a joint model over the unresolved tokens, while a compiled finite-state model records how their combinations affect the sequence-level preference. Pairing their states allows COFFEE to transfer global preferences to unresolved positions and sample a clean reconstruction without retraining the diffusion model. The same framework supports explicit hard constraints and learned soft objectives. We evaluate COFFEE across multiple symbolic, language, and biological benchmarks, where it achieves strong control results with task-dependent quality and diversity trade-offs. By making objectives available to inference rather than only evaluation, COFFEE brings joint conditioning, completion-weighted guidance, and optimization-based constraints into pretrained neural generation, showing the potential of neural-symbolic methods in diffusion guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COFFEE 把序列级目标与序列依赖解耦：用 target-free carrier 吸收去噪器的边缘 token 分布构造未决 token 的联合模型，再用编译出的有限状态模型记录组合对序列级偏好的贡献，配对两者状态即可在不重训扩散模型的前提下把全局偏好传到未决位置并采样干净重建。在符号、语言与生物多类基准上取得强控制结果，质量与多样性按任务取舍。
Motivation: 离散扩散并行解码时，单个未决 token 的价值取决于它与哪些 token 组成高回报序列，枚举全部补全使引导计算随未决位置数指数增长，序列级目标难以用于推理阶段。
Method: COFFEE 是即插即用框架：每步扩散中 target-free carrier 吸收去噪器预测的边缘 token 分布，构造未决 token 的联合模型；编译好的有限状态模型记录其组合如何影响序列级偏好；配对两者状态完成引导并采样重建，无需重训扩散模型。同一框架同时支持显式硬约束与学习到的软目标。
Result: 在符号、语言与生物多类基准上取得强控制结果，控制质量与多样性呈任务相关的取舍；摘要给出的是定性结论而非具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把目标从仅用于评估变为推理时可用，即可在预训练神经生成中引入联合条件、按补全加权的引导与基于优化的约束，体现 neural-symbolic 方法在扩散引导中的潜力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Almost Human, Except When It Matters: VoxParity and the Decisions a Voice Should Change
papers.abstract_en: A voice agent can handle almost every call on the words alone and still fail the few its sector's rules were written for. Emergency-call standards, fraud guidance, radio phraseology and vulnerability rules recognise that how a caller sounds, or what else is audible, can change the right action. VoxParity tests whether agents act on it. In 183 scenarios from 14 sectors, one transcript stays fixed while the audio changes (a coaching voice, a medical monitor beeping, a mayday under a radio check, noise over a drug name, a child's voice placing a bet, a frightened whisper), and with it the correct typed tool call. A words-only null test credits a system only if hearing the call moves its actions more than it moves a pipeline that only reads the words. Only 11 of the 23 systems that can also be run on the transcript pass. Descriptively, errors run toward the words: when the audio calls for protection, all 28 systems carry out the routine request more often than they over-react on clean calls (41% against 12% pooled; the words-only pipeline, 58% against 15%). Exploratory analyses place most of the leading systems' misses on cues they heard; systems beat the null almost entirely on items that state the rule; the leading systems overrule heard resignation or confusion far more often than acute alarm; and, in the models tested, describing the voice and stating the rule each recover part of the shortfall, leaving a gap on emotion.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Code, scorer and development-split data at https://github.com/bhavik-mangla/voxparity-bench and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23008159
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VoxParity 用 183 个场景、14 个行业测试语音 agent 是否真的依据听觉线索改变行动：固定转写、只改音频与正确工具调用。23 个可跑转写的系统中仅 11 个通过 words-only null 检验；当音频要求保护时，28 个系统执行常规请求的比例高于在干净通话上的过度反应（41% 对 12%，words-only 管线 58% 对 15%），说明多数失败偏向按字面行事。
Motivation: 语音 agent 常在纯文本上表现良好，却在行业规则依赖声音或背景音的少数通话上失效；现有评测无法区分系统是真听了音频还是只读了转写。
Method: 构建 VoxParity bench：183 个场景覆盖 14 个行业，转写固定而音频变化（指导语气、医疗监护仪声、mayday、噪声盖住药名、儿童声音下注、恐惧耳语），对应正确 typed tool call；用 words-only null 检验，只有当听音频带来的行动变化大于纯读字管线的变化才记为通过，并做探索性归因分析。
Result: 23 个可同时在转写上运行的系统中仅 11 个通过 null 检验；音频要求保护时，全部 28 个系统执行常规请求多于在干净通话上过度反应（41% 对 12%，合并口径；words-only 管线 58% 对 15%）。探索性分析显示多数领先系统的失误落在其听到的线索上；系统几乎只在明写规则的条目上胜过 null；领先系统对听到的 resignation 或 confusion 的否决远多于对 acute alarm；在受测模型中，描述声音与陈述规则各能补回部分缺口，情绪上仍有差距。
Conclusion: 语音 agent 的关键失败是偏向字面而非听觉线索，通过 null 检验的不到一半；描述声音和陈述规则可部分弥补，但情绪线索的缺口仍在。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Evaluating Name-Only Directory Routing for One-Shot Code Search
papers.abstract_en: Finding the right files is an early challenge for coding agents. We test whether a language model can follow directory and file names to find annotated code files missed by fixed lexical queries. Across 82 audited issues from 11 repositories at pinned pre-fix commits, name-only directory routing recovered 0.465 of gold files within eight candidates, compared with 0.352 for FTS5 and 0.245 for a fixed full-issue rg query. The paired gain over FTS5 was 0.113 (95% repository-cluster bootstrap interval, 0.053 to 0.168). Under a shared 16K-token context budget, routing delivered 0.443 of annotated lines versus 0.246 for FTS5 on 55 cases with fully aligned annotations. At the same eight-file limit, combining routing with FTS5 reached 0.491 file recall, but its gain over routing alone was uncertain. An exploratory flat path control reached 0.572 recall while using 24.6 model calls per issue, compared with 8.9 for routing. Routing averaged 8.9 seconds per issue; FTS5 took 7 milliseconds per query after a 0.9-second build. On this cohort, directory routing added relevant file candidates to one-shot lexical search, but the study cannot attribute the gain to hierarchy or show that it improves issue resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 11 个仓库、82 个已审计 issue 的 pre-fix commit 上测试：让语言模型只看目录与文件名做 one-shot 代码检索，8 个候选内找回 0.465 的 gold 文件，高于 FTS5 的 0.352 与固定全文 rg 查询的 0.245。同为 8 文件上限时与 FTS5 组合达 0.491，但相对单独 routing 的增益不确定；作者明确指出该增益无法归因于目录层级，也未证明能改善 issue 解决。
Motivation: 编码 agent 找对文件是早期瓶颈，固定词法查询会漏掉带注释的目标文件；需要检验按名字走目录能否在一次调用内补回这些文件。
Method: 在 11 个仓库的 82 个 issue、锁定在修复前 commit 上做配对评测；基线为 FTS5 与固定全文 rg 查询，指标为 8 候选内的 gold 文件召回与 16K token 共享上下文下的注释行覆盖；增益用按仓库聚类的 bootstrap 给区间，并设 flat path 对照与 routing+FTS5 组合。
Result: 8 候选内文件召回：routing 0.465、FTS5 0.352、rg 0.245；相对 FTS5 配对增益 0.113（95% 仓库聚类 bootstrap 区间 0.053–0.168）。16K token 预算下注释行覆盖 0.443 对 FTS5 0.246（55 个标注完全对齐的 case）。组合 routing+FTS5 达 0.491，但超出 routing 单独的增益不确定。flat path 对照召回 0.572，每 issue 用 24.6 次模型调用，routing 为 8.9 次；routing 平均 8.9 秒/issue，FTS5 查询 7 毫秒（构建 0.9 秒）。
Conclusion: 目录名路由能在一次调用内为词法检索补上相关候选文件，代价是每 issue 8.9 次模型调用与秒级延迟；该研究不能把增益归因于目录层级，也未证明其改善 issue 解决。

papers.title: Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. At matched history depth our model is statistically indistinguishable from that baseline ($-0.90$ points, $p=0.61$), and the reference architecture loses to it on 18 of 18 held-out windows ($-17.37$, $p<10^{-6}$). Sweeping the baseline's lookback horizon shows it spans 22.71% to 83.94% accuracy on that variable alone, and that every published figure in this line of work is matched by the baseline at a horizon of one to five years. We argue that the apparent margin of graph networks over historical baselines in this task is substantially an artefact of the short horizons those baselines were computed over, and recommend horizon-matched baselines and multi-seed reporting as minimum practice.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/Maurya1112-sudo/greyspot
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 复现一项道路级事故预测的 GNN 工作时发现，其十一项设计决策只有四项能在第二个伦敦 borough 上复现，四项效应甚至变号；多随机种子下参考架构的 per-borough 种子离散度最高达 35.7 点，而本文方法为 4 点。与按历史累计事故数排序的无参数基线在匹配回看深度后比较，本文模型与其统计不可区分（-0.90 点，p=0.61），参考架构在 18/18 个留出窗口上输给该基线（-17.37，p<10^-6）；作者建议把 horizon-matched 基线与多种子报告作为最低标准。
Motivation: 道路级事故预测中 GNN 的增益稳定性少有人检验：短回看窗口下的历史基线可能被系统性低估，使图网络的表面优势成为假象。
Method: 独立重建一个近期 uncertainty-aware 模型的数据管线，在伦敦三个 borough 上用 expanding-window 协议评估其十一项设计决策；做多随机种子评测，并引入按累计历史事故数排序的无参数基线，扫描其 lookback horizon（1–5 年）与两个网络对比。
Result: 十一项设计决策中四项在第二个 borough 上复现，七项不复现，其中四项效应变号而非衰减；一项效应在同一 borough 内随随机种子变号。参考架构 per-borough 种子离散度最高 35.7 点，本文方法为 4 点。匹配回看深度下本文模型与无参数基线统计不可区分（-0.90 点，p=0.61），参考架构在 18/18 个留出窗口上输给它（-17.37，p<10^-6）。该基线仅凭回看窗口在该变量上横跨 22.71% 到 83.94% 的准确率，且此方向已发表的每个数字都能被 1–5 年回看窗口的基线追平。

papers.title: VehicleArena: A Realistic Urban Environment for Multi-Agent Driving
papers.abstract_en: Real-world embodied agents often pursue independent objectives within a shared physical environment, where their actions can alter the conditions faced by others. Existing benchmarks, however, typically assume shared goals or explicitly prescribed interaction protocols, leaving such emergent physical coupling underexplored. We introduce VehicleArena, a 3D urban-driving benchmark for studying independently operating agents in a dynamic shared world. In VehicleArena, LLM-controlled agents must fulfill evolving passenger requests while navigating complex traffic, and each agent's driving decisions can reshape traffic flow, delays, risks, and subsequent observations for surrounding agents. The benchmark provides 112 evaluation tasks spanning single-agent and multi-agent driving. Across nine evaluated models, the highest arrival rates reach only 65.0% on single-agent tasks and 65.6% on multi-agent tasks, while strong passenger-request or cabin scores do not reliably translate into successful trip completion. Moreover, in matched multi-agent runs, every tested focal policy reduces the arrival rate of surrounding vehicles relative to the simulator's native traffic controller, revealing measurable externalities beyond the focal vehicle itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VehicleArena 是一个 3D 城市驾驶多智能体基准：LLM 控制的车辆各自服务不断变化的乘客请求，其驾驶决策会改变周围车辆的车流、延误与风险。在 112 项任务、9 个受测模型上，单智能体最高到达率仅 65.0%、多智能体 65.6%，且匹配多智能体实验中每个受测策略都比模拟器原生交通控制器更降低周围车辆到达率，说明存在可测量的外部性。
Motivation: 现有具身智能基准大多假设共享目标或显式规定交互协议，多个独立目标的智能体在同一物理环境中相互改变对方处境这种涌现式物理耦合被忽视。
Method: 构建 3D 城市驾驶基准，含 112 项单智能体与多智能体任务；LLM 智能体需在复杂交通中完成演化中的乘客请求，并在匹配的多智能体运行中把受测策略与模拟器原生交通控制器对照，考察对周围车辆的影响。
Result: 9 个受测模型中，单智能体任务最高到达率 65.0%，多智能体 65.6%；乘客请求或车内评分高并不可靠转化为成功完成行程；匹配多智能体运行里，每个受测焦点策略都比原生交通控制器更降低周围车辆到达率。
Conclusion: 现有 LLM 驾驶策略在动态共享环境中既难以可靠完成行程，也对周围车辆产生可测的负外部性，因此多智能体基准必须度量焦点车辆之外的溢出效应。

papers.title: Agentic Federated Learning: Rule-Based Client and Server Agents for Adaptive Training
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive applications such as healthcare, finance, and edge intelligence. However, conventional FL approaches rely on static client participation and fixed aggregation strategies, which limits their effectiveness under non-IID data distributions, heterogeneous client behavior, and noisy or unreliable updates. To overcome these issuess, this paper proposes an Agentic Federated Learning (AFL) framework that integrates lightweight rule-based autonomous agents at both client and server levels. The proposed framework introduces a Client-Side Agent (CSA) that dynamically adapts local training parameters, controls participa- tion, and evaluates update reliability, while a Server-Side Orchestrator Agent (SSOA) performs quality-aware client selection and adaptive aggregation. Unlike traditional FL methods, AFL enables context-aware decision-making during the training process, improving adaptability and robustness in dynamic distributed environments. Extensive experiments conducted on the CIFAR-10 dataset under IID, non-IID, and noisy-client settings demonstrate that AFL consistently outperforms standard base- lines including FedAvg and FedProx. Experimental results show improvements in classification accuracy, convergence speed, robustness against corrupted updates, and communication efficiency. Ablation studies further confirm the complementary contributions of CSA and SSOA, while statistical analysis validates the significance of the observed gains. The proposed AFL framework demonstrates that incorporating autonomous agentic reasoning into federated learning provides an effective and practical solution for intelligent, adaptive, and robust distributed learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Agentic Federated Learning (AFL)，在客户端与服务器各放一个轻量规则型智能体：Client-Side Agent 动态调本地训练参数、控制参与并评估更新可靠性，Server-Side Orchestrator Agent 做质量感知选客户端与自适应聚合。在 CIFAR-10 的 IID、non-IID 与含噪客户端设定下，AFL 在分类精度、收敛速度、抗损坏更新与通信效率上持续优于 FedAvg 与 FedProx，消融确认 CSA 与 SSOA 互补。
Motivation: 传统联邦学习用固定参与策略与固定聚合规则，在 non-IID 数据、客户端异构与含噪/不可靠更新下适应性和鲁棒性受限。
Method: AFL 框架在客户端部署 Client-Side Agent (CSA) 动态调整本地训练参数、控制参与、评估更新可靠性，在服务器部署 Server-Side Orchestrator Agent (SSOA) 做质量感知客户端选择与自适应聚合，训练过程中做上下文感知决策；实验在 CIFAR-10 上按 IID、non-IID、含噪客户端三种设定进行，并做消融与统计显著性分析。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 的 IID、non-IID 与 noisy-client 设定下，AFL 在分类精度、收敛速度、抗损坏更新鲁棒性和通信效率上持续优于 FedAvg 与 FedProx 等标准基线；消融研究确认 CSA 与 SSOA 的贡献互补，统计分析验证了增益的显著性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把自主智能体推理嵌入联邦学习，可在动态分布式环境中同时提升适应性与鲁棒性，是分布式学习系统实用且有效的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UNBIND: UNlearning By INference-time Directional Steering for Code LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Code large language models acquire programming capabilities from large code corpora, but can also memorize implementations that later require removal. Code unlearning is needed to control their continued reproduction when copyright or security concerns arise. However, targeted and retained code share computational patterns, creating a tension between forgetting specific implementations and preserving general programming ability. We propose \textbf{UNBIND}, a code unlearning framework that separately considers which hidden states correspond to the target code and how to suppress its reproduction. By constructing separate directions for these objectives, UNBIND achieves selective unlearning at inference time while keeping model weights fixed. Our evaluation covers fourteen baselines across two code models and two corpora. UNBIND achieves the highest joint forgetting and utility score in every setting. It reduces target code reproduction by 97.3\% to 99.1\% as measured by F-BLEU, with at most two fewer HumanEval+ and six fewer MBPP+ problems solved than the original models. In repeated extraction tests under a fixed budget, the number of targets yielding exact spans of at least 50 tokens falls from 188--262 to 0--2 out of 300 per setting. No extracted span reaches 100 tokens, and the mean best recovery ratio ranges from 0.43\% to 6.45\%. Multilingual and related-code evaluations further show effective forgetting with limited impact on useful programming capabilities, supporting UNBIND as a practical approach to selective code unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UNBIND 在推理时用两个独立的隐状态方向分别定位目标代码并抑制其复现，权重不动即可实现选择性代码遗忘。在两个代码模型、两个语料、14 个基线上，目标代码复现按 F-BLEU 降低 97.3%–99.1%，HumanEval+ 与 MBPP+ 最多各少解 2 道和 6 道题。
Motivation: 代码 LLM 记忆了因版权或安全需要移除的具体实现，但目标代码与保留代码共享计算模式，遗忘特定实现与保住通用编程能力之间存在张力。
Method: UNBIND 把「哪些隐状态对应目标代码」与「如何抑制其复现」拆成两个目标，构造各自的方向，在推理时做方向引导 (directional steering)，模型权重保持固定；评测覆盖两个代码模型、两个语料和 14 个基线。
Result: 在全部设定中取得最高的遗忘-效用联合分；F-BLEU 口径的目标代码复现下降 97.3%–99.1%，HumanEval+ 与 MBPP+ 相比原模型最多各少解 2 道和 6 道题。固定预算的重复抽取中，产出 ≥50 token 精确片段的目标数从 188–262 降到 0–2（每设定 300 个），无片段达到 100 token，平均最佳恢复率 0.43%–6.45%。
Conclusion: 把定位与抑制分成两个推理时方向，可以在权重不动的前提下同时压住目标代码复现并保住大部分编程能力，作者据此把 UNBIND 视为实用的选择性代码遗忘方案。

papers.title: MMSkillRisk: Can Agents Stay Safe When Multimodal Skills Become Traps?
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are shareable packages of procedural instructions, tools, and examples. Multimodal skills additionally include visual references that agents retrieve and inspect during execution. Because these images guide actions, attackers can disguise malicious instructions as ordinary visual guidance within otherwise legitimate skills. Existing skill-security research primarily examines text-carried attacks or scanner detection, leaving the runtime effects of image-borne attacks insufficiently evaluated. We introduce MMSkillRisk, to our knowledge the first publicly available benchmark dedicated to end-to-end safety evaluation of image-borne attacks in multimodal skills. To instantiate this attack surface, we design Native-Context Visual Attack (NCVA), which disguises malicious instructions as native components of teaching images, such as annotations and interface labels. The accompanying SKILL.md provides auxiliary guidance toward relevant visual regions without explicitly stating the malicious operation. Built from 28 curated clean skills, MMSkillRisk contains 36 attack packages and 108 executable cases spanning five attack objectives, with separate checks for attack success and legitimate-task completion. Across nine model-harness configurations evaluated in isolated sandboxes, NCVA induces unauthorized operations in every configuration. Its pooled attack success rate (ASR) reaches 43.1%, exceeding the matched text-carrier baseline by 16.4 percentage points, with higher ASR in all nine configurations. Attack success and legitimate-task completion co-occur in 36.5% of cases, reaching 72.2% for GPT-5.6-sol with Codex. These results show that skill-bundled images can induce unauthorized actions even as agents complete legitimate tasks, so task success alone does not establish safe skill use. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/kaill-jlq/MMSkillRisk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMSkillRisk 是首个面向多模态 skill 中图像携带攻击的端到端安全基准，配套提出 Native-Context Visual Attack (NCVA)，把恶意指令伪装成教学图里的标注与界面标签。在九种模型-框架配置的隔离沙箱中 NCVA 全部诱发未授权操作，合并攻击成功率 43.1%，比匹配的文本载体基线高 16.4 个百分点。攻击成功与合法任务完成同时发生的比例为 36.5%，GPT-5.6-sol 配 Codex 时达 72.2%，说明任务成功不能证明 skill 使用安全。
Motivation: 现有 skill 安全研究主要覆盖文本载体攻击与扫描器检测，图像载体攻击在 agent 运行期的实际效果缺乏评估，而图像恰恰直接引导 agent 行动。
Method: 构建基准 MMSkillRisk：由 28 个清洗后的干净 skill 派生 36 个攻击包与 108 个可执行用例，覆盖五类攻击目标，分别检查攻击成功与合法任务完成；攻击手法 NCVA 将恶意指令伪装为教学图的原生组件，配套 SKILL.md 只给出指向相关视觉区域的辅助提示而不明说恶意操作；在九种模型-框架配置的隔离沙箱中评测。
Result: 九种配置全部被 NCVA 诱发未授权操作，合并攻击成功率 (ASR) 43.1%，比匹配的文本载体基线高 16.4 个百分点，且九种配置的 ASR 均更高；攻击成功与合法任务完成共现于 36.5% 的用例，GPT-5.6-sol 配 Codex 时达 72.2%。
Conclusion: skill 自带图像足以在 agent 完成合法任务的同时诱发未授权操作，因此任务成功率不能作为 skill 使用安全的判据。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 九种配置全部被 NCVA 诱发未授权操作，合并攻击成功率 (ASR) 43.1%，比匹配的文本载体基线高 16.4 个百分点，且九种配置的 ASR 均更高；攻击成功与合法任务完成共现于 36.5% 的用例，GPT-5.6-sol 配 Codex 时达 72.2%。
summary_sections.conclusion: skill 自带图像足以在 agent 完成合法任务的同时诱发未授权操作，因此任务成功率不能作为 skill 使用安全的判据。

papers.title: Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. It turns informative transitions into hypotheses that can guide the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reuse across episodes. Their predicted effects are checked against subsequent observations outside the source episodes, and only sufficiently supported hypotheses become available for persistent guidance. This process updates external knowledge while keeping all model parameters fixed. Over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld, StepLearn achieves average success rates of 59.9% and 84.0% with GPT-5-mini, and 57.8% and 88.1% with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, respectively. It outperforms EvoTest, the strongest baseline, by 2.2-12.7 percentage points across the four settings. Learning dynamics further shows that these gains are not restricted to the final repetition, with advantages already present on first task attempts in most settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StepLearn 把 LLM agent 部署中的测试时学习拆成「立即使用」与「持久信任」两层：从单个 transition 生成假设供下一步立即调用，再用源 episode 之外的后续观测做前瞻验证，只有获支持的假设才进入跨 episode 的持久知识库，全程模型参数固定。在 WebArena-Lite 与 ALFWorld 上五轮实验中，GPT-5-mini 平均成功率 59.9% 与 84.0%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 为 57.8% 与 88.1%，在四种设置上比最强基线 EvoTest 高 2.2–12.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有测试时学习方法只能从已完成 episode 中提炼经验，进行中交互的反馈来不及指导下一个决策；而按 transition 粒度学习又会让单 episode 内有效的规则被直接复用到未来 episode，传播偶然或错误归因的指导。
Method: StepLearn 是非参数框架：把信息量高的 transition 转成假设，先用于指导下一步；再用源 episode 之外的后续观测核对其预测效应，只有获得充分支持的假设才升级为持久指导，整个过程不更新任何模型参数。
Result: 五轮实验中，GPT-5-mini 在 WebArena-Lite 与 ALFWorld 平均成功率分别为 59.9% 与 84.0%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 分别为 57.8% 与 88.1%；四种设置上均超过最强基线 EvoTest 2.2–12.7 个百分点。学习动态显示多数设置下优势在首次任务尝试时就已出现，而非只在最后一轮重复时体现。
Conclusion: 把「立即使用」与「跨 episode 持久信任」分开、并用外部观测做前瞻验证，能在参数完全冻结下持续提升 LLM agent 的成功率，且收益不依赖多轮重复。

papers.title: The Decision Value of Perception Compute
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 感知升级未必改善下游决策：本文定义「感知计算的决策价值」为把输入从廉价模式升到昂贵模式所引起的下游损失变化，并指出该值可为负。在 KITTI、nuScenes 与 nuPlan 上，34–54% 改变下游损失的升级反而使决策变差；按感知增益而非决策价值选择信号，平均使实测决策增益减少全廉价损失的 7.4%。
Motivation: 自适应感知通常假设更准的感知输出必然带来更好的下游决策，但当感知服务于决策系统时这一假设会失效，导致算力预算被浪费在有害的升级上。
Method: 提出 DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception) 基准，用预算约束的决策 oracle 作为对照（均匀全保真推理仅作基线而非上界），在选择、延迟与能量预算下给分配器打分并计入其自身计算开销；实验用部署态单目几何在 KITTI 与 nuScenes 上进行，nuPlan 上对 PDM-Closed 规划器做开环评估并引入真实检测器输出。
Result: 在改变下游损失的升级中 34–54% 使其变差，已发布的 PDM-Closed 规划器上也出现有害升级；nuScenes 上感知层增益与决策价值常符号相反；按感知增益而非决策价值在固定可部署信号间选择，平均使实测测试决策增益降低全廉价损失的 7.4%；学习型分配器找回部分 oracle 价值但选中的有害升级接近随机水平，计入自身计算后在 20% 延迟预算下只有约占完整检测器一遍 3.5% 的轻量 router 仍胜过随机。
Conclusion: 感知计算的分配应以预算约束决策 oracle 为评判标准，感知层增益不能作为决策价值的代理；只有开销足够低的轻量 router 才能在计入自身算力后稳定优于随机。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Cheap to Hypothesize, Costly to Verify: The Defense Surface of Agentic Vulnerability Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents turn vulnerability discovery into a repository-scale search: they generate many vulnerability hypotheses but can verify only a subset under a finite budget. We show that autonomous vulnerability discovery exhibits a hypothesis-verification asymmetry, where verifying a candidate hypothesis through reachability analysis, execution, and proof-of-concept construction is substantially more expensive than forming it. Under a finite resource budget, this makes autonomous discovery a resource-bounded selective-verification process, further exposing verification effort as a unique defense surface. We present RedHerring, which inserts certifiably safe decoys that divert verification effort from real vulnerabilities. Each decoy combines a CVE-derived vulnerability chain that attracts verification with a false bridge that keeps its dangerous sink unreachable. A private certificate lets the defender verify this property efficiently, while establishing the same fact from the released repository requires solving a computationally hard problem. RedHerring further adapts each decoy to the target repository so that it reads as ordinary program logic. Across 33 OSS-Fuzz projects, 70 evaluation instances, and five models under matched budgets, RedHerring reduces real vulnerabilities discovered by 38.7-60.4%. Trajectory analysis shows that agents spend 30.6-51.5% of completion tokens and an estimated 32.5-49.9% of runtime verifying decoys, showing that RedHerring redirects a substantial fraction of the fixed search budget toward decoys. When explicitly informed that decoys may be present, the agent adapts its search strategy, yet RedHerring still reduces vulnerabilities discovered by 37.2% relative to an informed Baseline, showing that its effectiveness does not depend on decoy secrecy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RedHerring 在目标仓库中插入带私有安全证书的诱饵漏洞链（CVE 派生、危险 sink 不可达），把自主 LLM agent 的验证预算从真实漏洞上引开。在 33 个 OSS-Fuzz 项目、70 个评估实例、5 个模型的匹配预算下，真实漏洞发现数下降 38.7–60.4%；即使明确告知 agent 存在诱饵，仍下降 37.2%。
Motivation: 自主漏洞发现中形成假设便宜、验证昂贵，有限预算下 agent 只能选择性验证，验证环节因此成为可被防御方利用的新攻击面，此前缺少针对该面的主动防御手段。
Method: RedHerring 为每个诱饵组合一条吸引验证的 CVE 派生漏洞链与一条使危险 sink 不可达的 false bridge，并附带私有证书让防御者高效证明安全性，而外部从发布仓库建立同一事实需解计算困难问题；诱饵还会按目标仓库改写成普通程序逻辑。
Result: 在 33 个 OSS-Fuzz 项目、70 个评估实例、5 个模型、匹配预算下，真实漏洞发现减少 38.7–60.4%；轨迹分析显示 agent 将 30.6–51.5% 的完成 token 与估计 32.5–49.9% 的运行时用于验证诱饵；明确告知 agent 可能存在诱饵后，相对知情 baseline 仍减少 37.2%。
Conclusion: 验证预算本身就是可操纵的防御面：把选择性验证重定向到带证书的安全诱饵即可显著压低自主漏洞发现产出，且效果不依赖诱饵保密。

papers.title: Similarity Is Not Validity: Defending LLM Semantic Caches Against Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Semantic caches reduce LLM serving costs by reusing previously generated answers for semantically similar queries. However, retrieval is based solely on embedding similarity between the incoming query and cached queries. This design enables cache poisoning: an attacker can cache a malicious response under a query with high cosine similarity to benign requests. The vulnerability stems from a gap between retrieval similarity and answer validity. From an information-bottleneck perspective, query embeddings can lose information needed to distinguish valid from invalid cache hits, which limits any matching algorithm that uses only these embeddings. We propose a novel defense that recovers this necessary information from the raw text of the cache key. Across poisoning attacks, adversarial queries share a rewrite-residual structure: they pair a rewrite of the target query with residual content. The rewrite maintains high similarity, while the residual elicits the malicious response. Deleting the residual makes the remaining rewrite more similar to the incoming query. We exploit this structure using Deletion Gain to search shortened variants of the cached query for similarity gains, and an Answer Check to test whether the removed text contributes to the stored answer. We prove that Deletion Gain stays positive when a deletion leaves text close enough to the rewrite, and we search for such deletions with a sliding window. Across three poisoning attack classes, our defense blocks 82.0% to 98.2% of poisoned entries at a 5% false-positive rate, with negligible serving overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 语义缓存只按 embedding 余弦相似度检索，攻击者可用「目标查询的改写 + 残留恶意内容」在高相似度下缓存恶意回答。防御用 Deletion Gain 在缓存键原文上滑窗搜索删除片段，配合 Answer Check 判断被删文本是否贡献了存储答案；在三类投毒攻击上以 5% 误报率拦截 82.0%–98.2% 的投毒条目，服务开销可忽略。
Motivation: 语义缓存的检索相似度与回答有效性之间存在鸿沟：query embedding 丢失了区分有效与无效命中的信息（信息瓶颈视角），任何只依赖这些 embedding 的匹配算法都受限，从而可被缓存投毒。
Method: 从缓存键原文中恢复判别信息：识别投毒查询的「改写 + 残留」结构，用 Deletion Gain 搜索使剩余文本与来查询相似度上升的缩短变体，并用 Answer Check 检验被删文本是否对存储答案有贡献；证明当删除后文本仍足够接近改写时 Deletion Gain 保持为正，并用 sliding window 搜索此类删除。
Result: 在三类投毒攻击 (poisoning attack classes) 上，以 5% 误报率拦截 82.0% 到 98.2% 的投毒条目，服务开销 (serving overhead) 可忽略。
Conclusion: 相似度不等于有效性：仅靠 embedding 相似度无法防御缓存投毒，从缓存键原文中检验删除增益与答案贡献即可在低误报率下挡住大部分投毒条目。

papers.title: Reconstructing Implicit Scientific Knowledge: Evaluating LLM Agents through End-to-End Reproduction of Astronomy
papers.abstract_en: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into scientific workflows is accelerating, yet their ability to reconstruct the reasoning underlying published research remains unexplored. Papers specify explicit procedures while leaving many methodological dependencies-data selection, calibration corrections, priors, and domain assumptions-implicit. This ambiguity complicates the evaluation of LLM-based agents, since a failure to reproduce a result may reflect either limitations of the agent or underspecification in the source. We present a framework that evaluates agents through end-to-end reproduction, separating execution from verification and computational failure from methodological ambiguity. We apply it to fourteen astronomy studies: a case study from The Astrophysical Journal and thirteen papers published in Nature. Eleven of the thirteen contained an ambiguity preventing a uniquely specified reproduction path. In a controlled case study, twelve predefined paths, a 3x2x2 sensitivity analysis over sample definition, sky masking, and parallax zero-point treatment-gave estimates from 2.16 to 3.53 kpc for the same quantity, with only one recovering the published value (about 2.70 kpc). The published value was never used as an optimization target, selection criterion, or stopping condition; the matching path was found only after all twelve had run. Crucially, the decisive information (a +0.02 mas parallax zero-point correction) was already in the paper, but the agents did not recognize its causal relevance until the analysis made the effect visible. Matching a published outcome therefore does not validate reconstruction of the underlying reasoning, and the bottleneck is as often a failure to connect relevant information as to retrieve it. End-to-end reproduction thus serves both as a test of reproducibility and as a framework for evaluating implicit scientific knowledge in AI systems.

papers.title: Toward a Culturally Adapted Chinese Language Agent: A Wizard-of-Oz Study of Nonverbal Behavior in Chinese-German Intercultural Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Successful intercultural communication requires more than grammatical competence. It demands sensitivity to culturally embedded social norms whose violation triggers subtle but meaningful nonverbal responses. For German learners of Mandarin Chinese, acquiring this sensitivity is critical yet poorly supported by existing language-learning agents. We present a Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) study design and supporting real-time system for collecting multimodal behavioral data from native Chinese speakers reacting to social norm violations by German learners. The system features a photorealistic MetaHuman avatar driven by Live Link face capture and MediaPipe upper-body tracking, a wizard console for real-time behavior selection, and synchronized multimodal logging across agent and learner streams. A layered annotation framework, based on psychological theory and covering non-observable socioemotional reactions, norm interpretation, verbal, and observable behavior thereof, and future supervision targets enables the corpus to support training of future automated cultural interpretation and behavior generation models. Four ecologically valid interaction scenarios, developed with cultural and pedagogical experts, provide the methodological and technical foundation for a culturally adapted conversational agent for Chinese language learning.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICMI Companion '26. 7 pages, 4 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套 Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) 实时系统与分层标注框架，采集母语中文者对德国学习者违反社会规范时的多模态非言语反应语料，为面向中文学习的文化适配对话智能体提供训练目标。系统用 MetaHuman 虚拟形象、Live Link 面部捕捉与 MediaPipe 上肢追踪驱动，配 wizard 控制台实时选行为并同步记录双方数据流。
Motivation: 跨文化交际需要对文化内嵌社会规范的敏感度，违反规范会引发细微但有意义的非言语反应；面向德语母语者的中文学习智能体缺乏这类多模态行为数据支撑。
Method: WoZ 研究设计加实时系统：photorealistic MetaHuman avatar 由 Live Link 面部捕捉与 MediaPipe 上肢追踪驱动，wizard console 实时选择行为，agent 与 learner 两侧流做同步多模态日志；分层标注框架基于心理学理论，覆盖不可观察的社会情绪反应、规范解读、言语与可观察行为，并预留未来监督目标；四个由文化与教学专家共同设计的生态有效交互场景。
Result: 产出四个与文化、教学专家协作开发的生态有效交互场景，以及配套的实时采集系统与分层标注语料，用于训练未来的自动文化解读与行为生成模型。
Conclusion: WoZ 采集加分层标注可为中文学习的文化适配对话智能体提供方法与技术基础，语料定位在支撑后续自动文化解读与行为生成模型的训练。

papers.title: Online Learning via Learned Latent Bayesian Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Online learning in non-stationary environments requires models to adapt rapidly from streaming data under strict computational constraints. A principled approach casts online learning as Bayesian state tracking, where model parameters are updated sequentially via Bayesian filtering. However, applying Bayesian filters directly to modern deep models is computationally prohibitive due to the high dimensionality of parameter space, forcing existing methods to rely on restrictive approximations or manually designed low-dimensional subspaces. In this work, we identify the absence of a suitable low-dimensional dynamical representation as the core bottleneck in Bayesian filtering-based online learning. Accordingly, we propose Adaptive Update through Representation Adaptation (AURA), a meta-learning framework that learns offline a low-dimensional latent state-space model governing the evolution of optimal model parameters under distribution shift. Online adaptation is then performed via extended Kalman filtering in this learned latent space followed by reconstruction of the full model parameters through a learned lifting map, enabling efficient single-step online adaptation while preserving model expressiveness. Evaluated on online adaptation of neural wireless receivers under time-varying channels and on non-stationary image classification, AURA shows substantial improvements in adaptation speed, accuracy, and computational efficiency over existing online learning and Bayesian filtering baselines, demonstrating that an adaptation-aware latent geometry is beneficial for effective Bayesian online learning in high-dimensional models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AURA 把在线学习重写为贝叶斯状态跟踪，用元学习离线学出最优模型参数在分布漂移下的低维潜空间状态空间模型，在线在该潜空间做 extended Kalman filtering，再经 learned lifting map 还原全量参数，实现单步在线适配。在时变信道下的神经无线接收机在线适配与非平稳图像分类两类任务上，适配速度、准确率与计算效率相对现有在线学习和贝叶斯滤波基线均有显著提升。
Motivation: 把贝叶斯滤波直接套到深度模型上因参数维度太高而算不动，现有方法只能依赖受限近似或手工设计的低维子空间；作者把缺少合适的低维动力学表示认定为核心瓶颈。
Method: 提出元学习框架 Adaptive Update through Representation Adaptation (AURA)：离线学习一个刻画最优模型参数在分布漂移下演化的低维潜空间状态空间模型，在线用 extended Kalman filtering 在该潜空间更新，再由 learned lifting map 重建完整模型参数，从而在保持模型表达力的同时做单步适配。
Result: 在时变信道下的神经无线接收机在线适配与非平稳图像分类两个设置上，AURA 相对现有在线学习与贝叶斯滤波基线在适配速度、准确率和计算效率上均取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 适配感知的潜空间几何 (adaptation-aware latent geometry) 是高维模型上有效做贝叶斯在线学习的关键，学习得到的低维动力学表示可替代手工子空间与受限近似。

papers.title: Cheap, open agents make LLM pollution harder to mitigate
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) pollution occurs when synthetic responses contaminate data intended to capture human behavior. High deployment costs have so far limited the risk posed by autonomous survey agents. However, open-weight models paired with open-source agentic frameworks may have removed this barrier. We compared the performance and detectability of nine agent configurations, ranging from fully open variants to closed commercial ones. Each agent autonomously completed a survey containing multiple response types yielding various detection checks. Fully open agents ran locally without usage fees and performed competitively with commercial alternatives. Open and commercial agents failed different sets of checks, and no single check reliably detected all agents, but open-text responses discriminated best between agents and humans. These findings identify fully open agents as a distinct risk for LLM pollution and support multilayered detection strategies emphasizing open-text analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开源权重模型加开源 agent 框架让自主填问卷的 agent 无使用费本地运行，性能已可比商业方案，使 LLM 污染（合成回答混入人类行为数据）更难拦截。九种 agent 配置中，开源与商业 agent 失败的检测项不同、没有任何单一检测项能识别全部 agent，只有开放文本回答最能区分 agent 与人类，因此检测必须多层叠加并以开放文本分析为主。
Motivation: 高部署成本此前限制了自主调查 agent 对行为数据的污染风险，而开源权重模型与开源 agentic 框架可能已消除这一成本壁垒，使污染更难缓解。
Method: 比较九种 agent 配置（从全开源到闭源商业）的表现与可检测性：每个 agent 自主完成一份含多种回答类型的问卷，产生多项检测判据，并据此比较 agent 与人类回答。
Result: 全开源 agent 可本地运行、无使用费，表现与商业替代方案相当；开源与商业 agent 失败的检测项集合不同，没有单一检测项能可靠识别所有 agent；开放文本回答在区分 agent 与人类上效果最好。
Conclusion: 全开源 agent 构成 LLM 污染的独立风险，检测策略需多层化并强调开放文本分析。

papers.title: XPhysICS: Cross-Physical-Domain Threat Grounding for Industrial Control Systems Security
papers.abstract_en: Industrial control system attacks are usually documented in terms of the plant where they occurred: its sensors, actuators, process stages, and control logic. Yet many attacks express a more general physical pattern--such as suppressing flow, corrupting chemical dosing, or driving a vessel toward overflow--that may also matter in a different plant. The challenge is deciding when such a threat remains meaningful on a new system rather than relying on similar component names or broad semantic labels. We present XPhysICS, a methodology for grounding documented cyber-physical threats onto a specific target system. XPhysICS converts source evidence into a provenance-linked description of what is manipulated, what physical consequence is expected, and what observations the evidence calls for. Once this analyst-guided abstraction, its vocabulary and schema version, and a target contract are fixed, XPhysICS applies deterministic grounding checks. An accepted result can be represented as a validation slice that records the mapped roles, signals, dependencies, and context intended to support later evaluation. We study 83 threat abstractions across continuous-process and manufacturing sources using separate evaluation denominators. The continuous-process study evaluates 78 abstractions against target contracts spanning water treatment, water distribution, hydropower, and chemical processes. Selected cases are exercised through controlled perturbations of simulator-role signals. We also test compatibility with several analysis styles, including the released upstream GeCo implementation, and conduct a three-objective, one-target realizability study using a paper-derived search reproduction. Across these evaluated settings, the results support treating explicit target checks and traceable evidence as separate from semantic similarity alone.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables; revised abstract, overview figure, method description, and appendix layout
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XPhysICS 把已记录的工控威胁抽象成带溯源的「操纵什么、预期什么物理后果、需要什么观测」描述，再对目标系统契约做确定性落地检查，而非依赖组件名或语义相似度。在 83 个威胁抽象中，78 个连续过程抽象被对照水处理、配水、水电与化工目标契约评估，另有制造侧研究与仿真角色信号扰动案例。
Motivation: 工控攻击按发生厂站记录，但同一物理模式（抑制流量、错误加药、容器溢出）可能在另一厂站同样成立；靠组件名相似或宽泛语义标签无法判定威胁在新系统上是否仍然成立。
Method: XPhysICS 先把源证据转成带 provenance 的抽象（操纵对象、预期物理后果、证据要求的观测），固定该抽象的词表与 schema 版本及目标契约后执行确定性落地检查，通过结果表示为记录映射角色、信号、依赖与上下文的 validation slice；并测试与上游 GeCo 实现及论文衍生搜索复现的兼容性。
Result: 共研究 83 个威胁抽象（连续过程与制造来源分开计分）；其中 78 个连续过程抽象对照覆盖水处理、配水、水电、化工的目标契约评估，选定案例通过仿真角色信号的受控扰动演练；另做三目标、单目标的可实现性研究（paper-derived search reproduction）。
Conclusion: 显式的目标检查与可追溯证据应与语义相似度分开处理，才能判断一个威胁在新系统上是否仍然成立。

summary_sections.result: 共研究 83 个威胁抽象（连续过程与制造来源分开计分）；其中 78 个连续过程抽象对照覆盖水处理、配水、水电、化工的目标契约评估，选定案例通过仿真角色信号的受控扰动演练；另做三目标、单目标的可实现性研究（paper-derived search reproduction）。

papers.title: Audio LLMs Know When They Can't Hear You
papers.abstract_en: Audio large language models allow users to interact with the model through speech. When an input recording is too degraded, the model may misinterpret the user's query and respond based on an incorrect transcription. In this paper, we study model-conditional transcription reliability: whether an Audio LLM can recognize when its own transcription is unreliable. We first prompt the Audio LLM to assess whether its own transcription would be reliable, and find that the model is a poor judge of its own transcription reliability: in most cases, it predicts that its transcription will be reliable. We find that existing approaches, including speech quality predictors, audio LLM generation uncertainty, and transcript-conditioned WER estimation, provide limited signals for detecting transcription failures. In contrast, we discover that transcription reliability is strongly represented in the model's audio-encoder representations. Based on this observation, we devise a lightweight reliability predictor that operates on representations extracted by the frozen audio encoder and predicts the reliability class before generation. The reliability predictor can trigger a clarification request from the user when their voice query is predicted to be unreliable, while allowing reliable queries to proceed without modifying the underlying Audio LLM. Our predictor achieves 81.10% in-domain and 78.09% cross-domain macro-F1 scores, outperforming the strongest baselines by 10.33 and 11.93 points, respectively. Finally, we show that reliability labels can transfer across Audio LLM families, and that transfer performance is closely related to the alignment of their model-specific reliability boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Audio LLM 无法自行判断转写是否可靠：直接让模型自评时，多数情况下它都预测自己的转写可靠。可靠性信息其实编码在冻结 audio encoder 的表征里，据此在生成前训练一个轻量可靠性预测器，触发澄清请求而不改动原模型，in-domain macro-F1 81.10%、cross-domain 78.09%，分别超出最强基线 10.33 和 11.93 个百分点。
Motivation: 输入录音严重退化时，Audio LLM 会基于错误转写作答，而模型自身与现有信号（speech quality predictor、生成不确定性、transcript-conditioned WER 估计）都难以发现这种失败，用户得不到澄清机会。
Method: 先让 Audio LLM 自评转写可靠性并检验其判别能力；再比较 speech quality predictor、audio LLM generation uncertainty、transcript-conditioned WER estimation 三类已有信号；最后在冻结 audio encoder 的表征上训练一个轻量可靠性预测器，在生成前输出可靠性类别，不可靠时触发向用户发起澄清请求，底层 Audio LLM 保持不变。
Result: 可靠性预测器 in-domain macro-F1 81.10%，cross-domain 78.09%，分别比最强基线高 10.33 和 11.93 个百分点；模型自评在多数情况下都预测自己的转写可靠；已有三类信号对检测转写失败作用有限；可靠性标签可在不同 Audio LLM 家族间迁移，迁移效果与各模型可靠性边界的对齐程度密切相关。
Conclusion: Audio LLM 的转写可靠性可由其冻结 audio encoder 的表征在生成前预测，因此可以在不修改原模型的前提下按预测结果发起澄清；可靠性标签跨模型家族迁移是否有效，取决于双方可靠性边界是否对齐。

papers.title: Pretrained ASR Pseudo-labeling for Noisy Police Audio
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained ASR systems perform poorly on noisy Broadcast Police Communication (BPC), hindering efforts to understand police decision-making. Pseudo-labeling offers an unsupervised path to improve ASR without expensive human labels, but the efficacy of this approach on very noisy domains is not known. In this work, we systematically assess the opportunities and limits of pseudo-labeling to adapt foundation ASR models (Whisper and Qwen3-ASR) to noisy BPC domain corpora from Baltimore and Chicago. We demonstrate that existing internal confidence metrics (log-probabilities and STAR scores) fail to distinguish between high and low quality BPC pseudo-labels, and we introduce an external LLM-as-a-judge filtering paradigm that leverages parametric knowledge to discard contextually implausible transcripts. Our LLM-judging filters more aggressively than internal metrics and significantly reduces WER of the pseudo-labeled training sets across the Baltimore and Chicago BPC corpora, though a substantial gap remains relative to an oracle filter. We also introduce a new cross-model pseudo-labeling paradigm where one model is finetuned with pseudo-labels from the other, and we identify this method as a promising direction for future pseudo-labeling work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在极噪的警务广播语音 (BPC) 上，用 LLM-as-a-judge 依据上下文合理性过滤 Whisper 与 Qwen3-ASR 的伪标签，比模型内部置信度指标（log-probability、STAR score）过滤更激进，显著降低 Baltimore 与 Chicago 语料伪标签训练集的 WER，但仍与 oracle 过滤有较大差距；跨模型伪标签（一个模型用另一个模型的伪标签微调）被指为有前景的方向。
Motivation: 预训练 ASR 在极噪的 Broadcast Police Communication 上表现差，人工标注昂贵，而伪标签在如此嘈杂领域是否有效尚不清楚。
Method: 系统评估用 Whisper 与 Qwen3-ASR 对 Baltimore、Chicago BPC 语料做伪标签适配；对比内部置信度指标（log-probabilities、STAR scores）与新提出的 LLM-as-a-judge 过滤范式，后者利用参数化知识丢弃上下文上不可信的转写；另提出跨模型伪标签范式，即用另一模型产出的伪标签微调本模型。
Result: 内部置信度指标无法区分高、低质量 BPC 伪标签；LLM-judge 过滤比内部指标更激进，并在 Baltimore 与 Chicago 两个 BPC 语料上显著降低伪标签训练集的 WER，但相对 oracle 过滤仍存在较大差距。
Conclusion: 在极噪领域，基于外部 LLM 判别上下文合理性的过滤优于模型内部置信度，跨模型伪标签是有前景的后续方向，但与 oracle 过滤的差距说明伪标签质量仍是瓶颈。

papers.title: Hapi: A Multivariable Land-Surface Transformer for Medium-Range Hydrological Forecasting at Continental Scale
papers.abstract_en: Accurate flood forecasts several days in advance are essential for flood control, water-resource management, and emergency response. A central challenge is to produce high-resolution forecasts across continental domains where hydrological behavior varies widely from place to place. We developed Hapi, a U-Net Swin Transformer that uses fine three-dimensional patches and hierarchical shifted-window attention to forecast river discharge, surface runoff, snow water equivalent, and soil wetness index across the contiguous United States. The model produces medium-range forecasts (24--72~h) at $0.05^{\circ}$ resolution with adaptive task weighting and required only 0.11 seconds for a four-variable 72-h CONUS forecast on one A100 GPU. In a held-out 2024 potential-skill evaluation with ERA5-Land inputs prescribed over the forecast horizon, Hapi achieved the highest F1-score for floods in 20 of 21 comparisons across seven GloFAS return periods and three forecast leads. Independent validation against observed daily discharge at 3{,}881 U.S. Geological Survey gauges showed that Hapi achieved the highest median Nash--Sutcliffe efficiency at every lead, supported by regional-cluster bootstrap intervals. In a matched 24-h comparison of loss formulations, adaptive task balancing produced the lowest discharge errors and the highest F1-score for floods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hapi 是一个 U-Net Swin Transformer，用三维细 patch 与分层滑窗注意力，在 CONUS 上以 0.05° 分辨率同时预报流量、地表径流、雪水当量和土壤湿度指数，覆盖 24–72 小时中期时段。在 2024 年留出集的 potential-skill 评估中，它在 7 个 GloFAS 重现期 × 3 个预报时效的 21 组对比里有 20 组洪水 F1 最高；对 3,881 个 USGS 站点的日流量独立验证中，各时效的中位 Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency 均为最高。
Motivation: 大陆尺度上水文行为空间差异极大，要在数天提前量上给出高分辨率洪水与流量预报，同时兼顾径流、雪、土壤湿度多个变量，是防洪与应急响应的核心难题。
Method: 模型为 U-Net Swin Transformer，采用细三维 patch 与分层 shifted-window attention，配合 adaptive task weighting 联合预报四个变量；输入在预报时段内由 ERA5-Land  prescribe，损失函数形式做了 24 小时匹配对比。
Result: 单块 A100 上四变量 72 小时 CONUS 预报耗时 0.11 秒；2024 留出 potential-skill 评估中，21 组对比（7 个 GloFAS 重现期 × 3 个时效）有 20 组洪水 F1 最高；3,881 个 USGS 站点日流量验证中各时效中位 NSE 均最高（含区域聚类 bootstrap 区间）；24 小时匹配对比中 adaptive task balancing 的流量误差最低、洪水 F1 最高。
Conclusion: 多变量自适应任务加权的 Swin-U-Net 能在大陆尺度上以极低算力产出 24–72 小时高分辨率水文预报，且在洪水 F1 与流量 NSE 两个指标上均领先所比较的方案。
