papers.title: What Must Survive? Exact Task-Information--State Frontiers Under Partial Task Revelation
papers.abstract_en: A state may need to be compressed before its exact downstream task is known. For a finite family of linear task operators $\{T_u\}_{u\in\U}$, we characterize exactly how much state must survive when only one of $K$ coarse task messages is available at compression time: $$p^*(K)= \min_{\substack{\Pcal\text{ partition of }\U\\|\Pcal|\le K}} \max_{C\in\Pcal}\rank(T_C),$$ where $T_C$ stacks the tasks that remain unresolved within cell $C$. Thus task information reduces retained state precisely by separating tasks whose joint task-visible subspace is expensive. We derive the dual bit frontier, an irreducible common-core floor, and a sharp singular-value characterization for nonzero tolerance. For overlapping task families, a cumulative overlap deficit places the exact frontier within an additive $Δ$ of weighted load balancing. Optimal partitioning is strongly NP-hard, yet direct-sum families admit classical approximation guarantees and a PTAS. We stress-test the theory on learned task operators from CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST, SVHN, and Burgers observables. For Burgers with $K=2$ and $\eps=0.35$, a constructive partition attains $p=4$, while balanced random partitions require median $p=6$, with held-out worst standardized RMSE $0.0368$. The results distinguish uniform task sufficiency from distributional and decision-level performance.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Substantially expanded version: added sharp approximate bounds, overlap-deficit theory, approximation guarantees, and empirical stress tests on learned representations and Burgers observables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对有限族线性任务算子，给出压缩时只拿到 K 个粗任务消息之一时必须保留的状态维数精确刻画 p*(K)=min_{|P|≤K} max_{C∈P} rank(T_C)，并证明最优分划强 NP-hard、直和族有 PTAS。在 Burgers observables 上 K=2、ε=0.35 时构造分划达到 p=4，而平衡随机分划中位数 p=6，留出集最差标准化 RMSE 为 0.0368。
Motivation: 状态压缩常在下游任务尚未确定时进行，已有充分性刻画多针对单一或完全已知任务，缺少部分任务揭示 (partial task revelation) 下必须保留多少状态的精确边界。
Method: 以任务族分划定义 p*(K)，导出对偶比特边界、不可约公共核下界与非零容差下的奇异值刻画；对重叠任务族引入累计重叠亏缺，把精确边界夹到加权负载平衡的加性 Δ 内；证明最优分划强 NP-hard，直和族给出经典近似保证与 PTAS，并在 CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST、SVHN 的学习任务算子与 Burgers observables 上做压力测试。
Result: Burgers 上 K=2、ε=0.35 时构造分划 p=4，平衡随机分划中位数 p=6，留出集最差标准化 RMSE 0.0368；理论侧给出 p*(K) 精确式、对偶比特边界、公共核下界、重叠亏缺的加性 Δ 界，以及强 NP-hard 性与直和族的 PTAS。
Conclusion: 任务信息通过分离联合任务可见子空间代价高的任务来精确减少保留状态维数，且均匀任务充分性与分布级、决策级表现是两回事。

papers.title: 4DGS-Fixer: Generative Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting with Iterative Refinement Guided by Video Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenges of dynamic scene synthesis from sparse-view videos. Existing methods employ geometric priors, adaptive optimization, or density-control strategies to improve 4D Gaussian modeling under sparse observations. However, they cannot fundamentally resolve the ill-posed problem caused by insufficient observations and missing scene information. Moreover, sparse-view 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) often suffers from poor geometric initialization: with only a few input views, COLMAP typically reconstructs sparse and incomplete point clouds, leaving large scene regions without sufficient Gaussian support and making them difficult to recover through subsequent optimization. To address these limitations, we propose a novel iterative refinement framework based on a video diffusion model to improve the completeness and consistency of dynamic 4D scenes. Specifically, we first estimate multi-view depth maps and fuse them into dense point clouds to provide more complete geometric initialization for a dynamic 4DGS representation. We then employ a pretrained video restoration model to refine sequences rendered along novel camera trajectories at different time steps. The restored sequences serve as pseudo-supervision to regularize and iteratively refine the 4DGS representation. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing baselines, achieving nearly a 2 dB PSNR improvement over the previous best-performing method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4DGS-Fixer 用视频扩散先验迭代修补稀疏视角动态 4D Gaussian Splatting 的欠定问题：先多视角深度估计融合成稠密点云改善几何初始化，再用预训练视频修复模型沿新视角轨迹渲染序列作伪监督，反复正则化 4DGS 表示。在广泛使用的基准数据集上比此前最佳方法 PSNR 提升近 2 dB。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下观测不足、场景信息缺失使 4DGS 呈本质欠定，且 COLMAP 只能重建稀疏不完整点云，大片区域缺少 Gaussian 支撑，后续优化难以恢复。
Method: 先估计多视角深度图并融合为稠密点云，为动态 4DGS 提供更完整的几何初始化；再用预训练视频修复模型（video restoration）精修沿新相机轨迹、在不同时间步渲染出的序列，这些恢复序列作为伪监督 (pseudo-supervision) 正则并迭代精修 4DGS 表示，整体是基于 video diffusion model 的迭代精修框架。
Result: 在广泛使用的基准数据集上大幅超越现有基线，PSNR 较此前最佳方法提升近 2 dB。
Conclusion: 几何初始化补全加视频扩散先验的伪监督迭代精修，能实质缓解稀疏视角动态 4DGS 的欠定与初始化缺陷。

papers.title: Exact Regret Frontiers and Externality Scheduling in Centralized Serial-Dictatorship Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Exploration in centralized serial-dictatorship matching bandits must use complete matchings, so learning one player-arm pair can impose regret on others. We study this externality under a known common priority order and Gaussian rewards with unit variance. We show that the matching-level Graves-Lai constraints reduce to finitely many pairwise exploration quotas and, at top-choice-separated instances, yield a polynomial-size marginal linear program. At these instances, the exact attainable set of expected logarithmic regret coefficients is $G(θ)\mathcal{X}(θ)$, where $\mathcal{X}$ is the feasible matching-allocation set and $G$ maps allocations to player regret. The usual upper-closed Graves-Lai region can be strictly larger despite having the same Pareto-minimal boundary. We further show that identical exploration quotas can induce very different regret through their scheduling. Finally, we construct estimate-solve-track policies, uniformly good on the full row-strict class, that attain every fixed positively weighted optimum without assuming optimizer uniqueness. Every Pareto-minimal point is pointwise attainable, possibly through an instance-calibrated target.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在已知共同优先序、单位方差高斯奖励的集中式串行独裁匹配 bandit 中，匹配级 Graves-Lai 约束可化为有限个成对探索配额，在 top-choice-separated 实例上给出多项式规模的边际线性规划；可达的期望对数遗憾系数集合恰为 G(θ)X(θ)。相同的探索配额因调度不同可产生差异很大的遗憾，作者构造的 estimate-solve-track 策略在全 row-strict 类上一致良好，逐点可达每个 Pareto 最小点。
Motivation: 集中式匹配 bandit 中探索一个 player-arm 对会把遗憾外部性强加给其他参与者，而常规上闭的 Graves-Lai 区域可能严格大于真实可达集，配额本身也不足以决定遗憾。
Method: 在已知共同优先序与单位方差高斯奖励设定下，把匹配级 Graves-Lai 约束约化为有限个成对探索配额；在 top-choice-separated 实例上构造多项式规模边际线性规划，刻画可达集 G(θ)X(θ)（X 为可行匹配分配集，G 将分配映射为各玩家遗憾），并设计 estimate-solve-track 策略。
Result: 可达的期望对数遗憾系数集合恰为 G(θ)X(θ)；通常的上闭 Graves-Lai 区域可严格更大，但两者共享同一 Pareto 最小边界；相同探索配额经不同调度可诱导差异很大的遗憾；estimate-solve-track 策略在全 row-strict 类上一致良好，无需假设优化器唯一即可达到每个固定正权最优，且每个 Pareto 最小点都逐点可达（可能需实例校准的目标）。
Conclusion: 匹配 bandit 的探索代价应按配额调度而非仅按配额大小刻画，且 Pareto 最小遗憾点在 row-strict 类上可逐点实现。

papers.title: The Complexity Kink: A Prompt-Side Structural Complexity Index for Code-Generation Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Complexity measured from generated code is failure-dependent: a difficult prompt can yield a short failing program and be assigned low output complexity. We introduce a six-dimension prompt-side structural-complexity index scored before generation and kept separate from correctness. We select 5,000 Python prompts across six bands of a preliminary single-rater rubric. Four out-of-panel LLM raters rescore the locked prompts, giving 19,997 score rows; composite inter-rater reliability is ICC = 0.872 on the 4,998 prompts with all four ratings. We evaluate 21 models per prompt, yielding 105,000 generations. In the unadjusted mean-pooled analysis, pass rate has a nonmonotone breakpoint at composite 13.75, with 79.9% at or below and 87.6% above. This is not a universal failure cutoff. Task-type fixed effects shift the breakpoint to 10.75 and cut the regime gap from 7.6 to 2.1 points. A construction-frame control shifts it to 8.50 with a raw gap of -3.5 points, and neither frame alone reproduces the pooled +7.6-point change. Model-specific fits include 16 upward and five downward changes. A 365-prompt audit-clean extension matches the original five-model estimates at bins 15 and 16 but adds only 14 prompts above bin 16. Among zero-pass generations with computable Lizard complexity, 28.5% pair a prompt composite above 8 with output complexity at most 10. Human agreement is moderate and rater-dependent on a disagreement-enriched calibration set; paraphrase and cross-language rescoring preserve score ordering. Overidentification tests reject the joint restrictions on the six dimensions, so we treat the composite as an index and make no causal interpretation of the 2SLS estimates. The contribution is a pre-generation measurement framework and a bounded observational analysis of reliability regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出生成前打分的六维 prompt 侧结构复杂度指数，把提示难度与生成代码的正确性解耦；在 5,000 个 Python prompt、21 个模型共 105,000 次生成上，pass rate 在综合分 13.75 处出现非单调断点，断点以上通过率高 7.6 个百分点，但任务类型固定效应会把断点移到 10.75 并把差距压到 2.1 点，说明这不是通用失败阈值。
Motivation: 用生成代码本身度量复杂度会被失败污染：难题可能产出短小的错误程序而被判为低复杂度，导致代码生成可靠性分析在生成前无法区分提示难度与模型能力。
Method: 构建六维 prompt 侧结构复杂度指数，在生成前打分并与正确性分离；从初步单评分量表的六个区间选 5,000 个 Python prompt，由 4 位面板外 LLM 评分者重评得到 19,997 条评分（ICC = 0.872，覆盖 4,998 个四评齐全的 prompt），每 prompt 评测 21 个模型共 105,000 次生成，并用任务类型与 construction-frame 固定效应、2SLS 估计和过度识别检验做有界观测分析。
Result: 未调整的均值池化分析中 pass rate 在综合分 13.75 处有非单调断点：≤13.75 为 79.9%，>13.75 为 87.6%（差 7.6 点）；任务类型固定效应把断点移到 10.75、差距降到 2.1 点，construction-frame 控制移到 8.50 且原始差距为 -3.5 点，任一框架单独都无法复现池化的 +7.6 点；模型级拟合含 16 个上升与 5 个下降变化；365-prompt 审计清洗扩展在 bin 15、16 与原五模型估计一致但 bin 16 以上仅增 14 个 prompt；零通过且可算 Lizard 复杂度的生成中 28.5% 属于综合分 >8 而输出复杂度 ≤10；改写与跨语言重评保持分数排序，过度识别检验拒绝六维联合约束。
Conclusion: 作者把综合分当作 index 而非因果量，对 2SLS 估计不做因果解释；贡献是生成前的测量框架与有界的可靠性区间观测分析，13.75 断点不是通用失败阈值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudolabels as rewards and optimizes only ~100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy with Qwen2.5-7B, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 label-free 的 bias-only TTRL：用多数投票伪标签当奖励，只优化约 100K 个 bias 参数、冻结预训练 backbone。在 MATH-500 上 Qwen2.5-7B 达到 76.67% 准确率，略超作者自己的有标签 bias-steering 复现，参数量比全参数 TTRL 少 76,000 倍。
Motivation: 现有 TTRL 通常更新很大一部分模型参数；作者追问在奖励信号与优化空间都被严重限制时，有效的测试时适应能否出现。
Method: 多数投票伪标签作为奖励，仅优化约 100K bias 参数并冻结 backbone；进一步分析多数投票可靠性随 rollout 共识提升，以及可访问梯度能量更大的 bias 子空间具有更强下游可训练性。
Result: MATH-500 上 Qwen2.5-7B 达 76.67% 准确率，略高于作者的有标签 bias-steering 复现，参数量比全参数 TTRL 少 76,000 倍；同一训练过程在 MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista、MMAU 等视觉-语言与音频推理任务上均有提升；学到的 steering vectors 可迁移到 4,500 个 held-out MATH 问题。
Conclusion: 完全无标签的奖励加上极小的 bias-only 子空间就足以产生可观的测试时适应，且适应不限于测试时优化所用的问题。

papers.title: Root-Cause Attribution Is a Search Problem: Continual Search for Long-Horizon Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: The increasing deployment of AI agents in long-horizon tasks yields massive execution logs. Diagnosing failures within these records is crucial for reliability, as it transforms outcome-level signals into actionable interventions. The sheer scale of the data renders human review impractical, driving the need for automated root-cause attribution (RCA). However, automated RCA methods using LLMs suffer from low diagnostic accuracy, especially as execution traces grow larger. They struggle because relevant information is often sparse, distributed across distant actions, and disconnected from the visible failure, reducing root-cause attribution to a massive search problem. Existing RCA methods typically rely on one-shot LLM judgments to diagnose failures from execution traces. While effective for shorter trajectories, these judges tend to settle on a plausible diagnosis early, leaving critical evidence in longer traces unexamined. We introduce Continual Search, an iterative framework that nudges the judge, over successive turns, to keep searching for unresolved diagnostic evidence. We evaluate Continual Search across four existing RCA benchmarks. Recognizing the lack of massive execution traces in current benchmarks, we introduce MegaRCA-Mix to evaluate RCA at scale. MegaRCA-Mix provides a challenging testbed of 50 human-annotated failure trials spanning long-horizon, execution-heavy tasks. Across multiple benchmark suites and model families, Continual Search consistently improves attribution performance. On MegaRCA-Mix, for example, it improves Opus-4.8's F1 score by 29\%, from $0.471$ to $0.608$. More interestingly, within the same model family, lower-tier models can even surpass their higher-tier counterparts, demonstrating that effective search supersedes raw model scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把长程 agent 失败的根因归因 (RCA) 视为搜索问题，提出迭代框架 Continual Search，让 LLM judge 在多轮中持续寻找尚未解释的诊断证据，而不是一次性给出结论。在新构建的 MegaRCA-Mix（50 条人工标注失败试验）上，Opus-4.8 的 F1 从 0.471 提升到 0.608（+29%），且同系列低档模型可反超高档模型。
Motivation: 长程 agent 产生海量执行日志，人工审查不可行；现有 LLM RCA 多为一次性判断，在长轨迹上过早锁定貌似合理的诊断，关键证据被跳过，导致诊断准确率随轨迹变长而下降。
Method: Continual Search 在连续多轮中推动 judge 继续搜索未解决的诊断证据；在四个已有 RCA benchmark 上评测，并新增 MegaRCA-Mix——50 条人工标注的失败试验，覆盖长程、执行密集型任务。
Result: 在 MegaRCA-Mix 上 Continual Search 将 Opus-4.8 的 F1 从 0.471 提到 0.608，提升 29%；跨多个 benchmark 套件与模型家族均一致改善归因表现；同一系列中低档模型可超过高档模型。
Conclusion: 根因归因的瓶颈在于搜索是否充分而非模型规模：持续搜索带来的收益可让低档模型反超同系列高档模型。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: Continual Search 在连续多轮中推动 judge 继续搜索未解决的诊断证据；在四个已有 RCA benchmark 上评测，并新增 MegaRCA-Mix——50 条人工标注的失败试验，覆盖长程、执行密集型任务。
summary_sections.result: 在 MegaRCA-Mix 上 Continual Search 将 Opus-4.8 的 F1 从 0.471 提到 0.608，提升 29%；跨多个 benchmark 套件与模型家族均一致改善归因表现；同一系列中低档模型可超过高档模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 根因归因的瓶颈在于搜索是否充分而非模型规模：持续搜索带来的收益可让低档模型反超同系列高档模型。

papers.title: Processing and classifying bird songs using wavelet techniques and supervised learning
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes an integrated framework for the processing and classification of invasive bird species vocalizations within natural soundscapes, characterized by high levels of environmental noise. We address the challenge of signal degradation by employing a Bayesian wavelet shrinkage methodology based on the Epanechnikov kernel prior, which offers a closed form decision rule and high computational efficiency for processing large bioacoustic datasets. The methodology was applied to recordings of three species obtained from the iNaturalist platform: Euphonia violacea, Leiothrix lutea, and Passer domesticus. After signal denoising, we extracted a comprehensive set of features, including Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) and spectral indices such as entropy and zero-crossing rate. Several supervised learning models: Random Forest, Multinomial Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine (SVM) were evaluated across different feature dimensionalities. Our results demonstrate that the proposed wavelet based preprocessing significantly enhances classification performance, with the SVM model achieving the highest accuracy (up to 0.9398) under a 10-dimensional MFCC configuration. This research provides a robust statistical tool for automated ecological monitoring and the management of biological invasions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对高环境噪声自然声景中的入侵鸟种鸣声，用基于 Epanechnikov 核先验的贝叶斯小波收缩 (Bayesian wavelet shrinkage) 去噪，再以 MFCC 与谱指数特征训练监督分类器。小波预处理显著提升分类性能，SVM 在 10 维 MFCC 配置下取得最高准确率 0.9398。
Motivation: 自然声景录音信噪比低、信号退化严重，直接做物种声学分类准确率受限，需要一种闭式判决规则且计算高效、能处理大规模生物声学数据的去噪手段。
Method: 先用 Epanechnikov 核先验的贝叶斯小波收缩对录音去噪（闭式判决规则），再提取 MFCC 及熵、过零率等谱指数特征，评估 Random Forest、Multinomial Logistic Regression 与 SVM 在不同特征维度下的分类表现；数据为 iNaturalist 平台的三个物种录音：Euphonia violacea、Leiothrix lutea、Passer domesticus。
Result: 小波去噪预处理显著提升分类性能；SVM 在 10 维 MFCC 配置下准确率最高，达 0.9398。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯小波收缩配合 MFCC+SVM 是高噪声生物声景中入侵鸟种自动识别的有效统计工具，可用于生态监测与生物入侵管理。

papers.title: Online Surrogate Repair: Decoupling High-Fidelity Feedback from Search Length in Closed-Loop Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. We propose \emph{online surrogate repair} (OSR), a closed-loop algorithm that uses sparse high-fidelity evaluations to update the surrogate throughout a longer agent search conducted primarily with inexpensive surrogate feedback. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes. Across controlled synthetic environments, we demonstrate that improving global surrogate fit does not necessarily reduce maximum regret, whereas Q90-UCB and expected improvement (EI) substantially reduce regret by directing evaluations toward regions that determine the optimizer's decisions. On MADE, controls receiving high-fidelity feedback after every episode require $6.36$--$7.23\times$ more oracle queries to match Online EI under two LLM orchestrators and $10.27\times$ more under the non-LLM Chemeleon+MLIP workflow. Online surrogate repair introduces a novel third feedback regime between fixed-surrogate operation and high-fidelity feedback after every episode, separating the frequency of high-fidelity evaluation from the duration of the agent's search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在线代理修复 (online surrogate repair, OSR)：在长程闭环 AI scientist 搜索中主要用廉价代理反馈，靠采集规则 (Q90-UCB、EI) 挑选少量设计做高保真评估并回写代理，把高保真评估频率与搜索长度解耦。在 MADE 上，每 episode 都给高保真反馈的对照要多用 6.36–7.23 倍 oracle 查询才能追平 Online EI（两种 LLM orchestrator），非 LLM 的 Chemeleon+MLIP 流程下为 10.27 倍。
Motivation: 闭环 AI scientist 生成候选的边际成本极低，但可靠反馈依赖湿实验或高保真计算；用固定代理替代新实验会留下持久模型误差并被优化放大，而实验室自动化改造基础设施密集且昂贵。
Method: OSR 是闭环算法：agent 在主要由廉价代理反馈驱动的更长搜索中累积候选提案，采集规则 (Q90-UCB、expected improvement) 决定哪些设计送高保真评估，得到的标签在后续 episode 更新代理；在受控合成环境与 MADE 上与固定代理、每 episode 高保真反馈两种反馈机制对照。
Result: 受控合成环境中，改善代理的全局拟合并不必然降低最大 regret，而 Q90-UCB 与 EI 通过把评估导向决定优化器决策的区域显著降低 regret。MADE 上，每 episode 高保真反馈的对照在两种 LLM orchestrator 下需 6.36–7.23 倍更多 oracle 查询才能匹配 Online EI，在非 LLM 的 Chemeleon+MLIP 工作流下需 10.27 倍。
Conclusion: 高保真反馈的价值在于导向优化器决策所在的区域而非全局拟合精度；OSR 提供介于固定代理与逐 episode 高保真反馈之间的第三种反馈机制，把高保真评估频率与 agent 搜索时长分开。

papers.title: Fast PAC Global Optimization via Restarted Langevin: Exploration, Exploitation, and Degenerate Cooling
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses a fundamental question in non-convex optimization: \textit{How should a stochastic optimizer allocate computation between global exploration and local exploitation?} We study this question in continuous time, using Langevin dynamics for global exploration and deterministic gradient flow for local exploitation. The simplest algorithm in this class is the best-state Langevin--gradient method: several Langevin trajectories explore the objective landscape, the best state encountered is retained, and a single gradient trajectory then refines this state to high terminal accuracy. Our main objective is to characterize the computational work required to achieve a prescribed accuracy with prescribed confidence. We develop low-temperature approximations for this probably approximately correct (PAC) work--accuracy tradeoff, both for the best-state method and for related Langevin schemes. Global exploration is governed by energy barriers, through spectral-gap and Eyring--Kramers asymptotics. The resulting approximations expose the competing effects of temperature, computational budget, and the number of exploratory trajectories, and quantify their dependence on the confidence parameter. In contrast, terminal accuracy is largely separated from global exploration: once a suitable region of attraction has been reached, gradient flow requires only $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ additional work to reach accuracy at least $\varepsilon$. Numerical experiments on challenging objectives serve to compare algorithms and to test the quantitative predictions of the asymptotic theory. They identify regimes in which the low-temperature approximations provide useful guidance, as well as regimes exhibiting substantial temperature sensitivity and potentially significant high-dimensional limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在连续时间框架下用 Langevin 动力学做全局探索、确定性梯度流做局部开发，刻画达到给定精度与置信度所需的 PAC 计算量。全局探索由能量势垒（谱隙与 Eyring--Kramers 渐近）决定，而一旦进入合适吸引域，梯度流只需 O(log(1/ε)) 额外工作量即可达到精度 ε；低温近似同时暴露温度、计算预算与探索轨迹条数的竞争效应。
Motivation: 非凸优化中随机优化器如何在全局探索与局部开发之间分配计算量缺乏定量刻画，尤其是达到给定精度与置信度（PAC）所需工作量与温度、轨迹数、置信参数的关系。
Method: 提出 best-state Langevin--gradient 方法：并行跑多条 Langevin 轨迹探索目标地形，保留遇到的最佳状态，再用单条梯度轨迹精修到高终端精度；在低温区间为该方法及相关 Langevin 方案推导 PAC 工作量-精度权衡近似，全局探索部分用谱隙与 Eyring--Kramers 渐近，终端精度部分由梯度流吸引域刻画。
Result: 终端精度与全局探索基本解耦：进入合适吸引域后，梯度流只需 O(log(1/ε)) 额外工作量达到精度至少 ε。低温近似给出温度、计算预算、探索轨迹条数与置信参数之间的竞争关系；在具有挑战性的目标函数上做数值实验比较算法并检验渐近理论的定量预测，识别出低温近似有指导作用的区域，以及对温度敏感、高维下可能有显著局限的区域。
Conclusion: 探索成本由能量势垒主导、开发成本按 O(log(1/ε)) 缩放，二者可分离刻画；低温近似在部分区域给出有用指导，但在高维与温度敏感区域存在潜在局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Spectrally Optimised Mesh-Free Discretisations
papers.abstract_en: Numerical methods for partial differential equations (PDEs) discretise differential operators, ideally reproducing the action of the continuous operators across all wavenumbers permitted by a given discretisation. Spectral-type methods approach this ideal, but rely on structured grids or high-order meshes that are hard to generate for complex geometries. In contrast, mesh-free methods are geometrically flexible, yet how faithfully they reproduce the operator across resolved scales is strongly influenced by a heuristically chosen kernel, which selects one of many weight sets satisfying the same consistency conditions without regard to the resulting spectral response. To address this, we introduce Spectrally optimised Neural Discretisations (SpeND), a framework that learns the map from local stencil geometry to discretisation weights on unstructured point clouds. A projection layer constrains every predicted stencil to the affine set defined by the discrete moment conditions, so polynomial consistency, and hence formal order of accuracy, holds exactly. Since consistency is enforced by the architecture, the weights can additionally be optimised for accuracy on a prescribed function space. Herein, we use Fourier modes and target the exact differentiation response over a chosen wavenumber band, so training is unsupervised. The loss function is a design interface: changing how it weights wavenumbers yields operators with distinct accuracy profiles. The trained discrete differential operators are PDE-agnostic and are applied without retraining to the Poisson, Burgers and Navier--Stokes equations, to near-boundary stencils, and across resolutions. At the same order and resolution, SpeND matches or improves on established mesh-free discretisations, and has been shown to reduce the wall-clock time between $3-20\times$ to achieve equivalent error as the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SpeND：用神经网络从非结构点云的局部模板几何直接学习无网格微分算子权重，并用投影层把预测强制约束在满足离散矩条件的仿射集上，使多项式相容性与形式精度阶严格成立。相容性由架构保证后，损失函数即可自由地按 Fourier 模态在指定波数带上优化微分响应，训练完全无监督。算子与 PDE 无关，免重训直接用于 Poisson、Burgers 与 Navier–Stokes 方程及近边界模板，在同等精度阶与分辨率下匹配或改进既有无网格格式，并把达到同等误差的墙钟时间缩短 3–20 倍。
Motivation: 无网格方法几何灵活，但精度强依赖启发式选取的 kernel：它只是众多满足同一相容条件的权重之一，完全不考虑谱响应；而谱型方法精度理想却依赖结构网格或高阶网格，复杂几何难以生成。
Method: SpeND 学习从局部模板几何到离散权重的映射，投影层将每个预测模板约束到离散矩条件定义的仿射集，保证多项式相容性与形式精度阶精确成立；随后以 Fourier 模态为目标，在指定波数带上匹配精确微分响应，属无监督训练，损失函数通过调整波数权重充当精度剖面的设计接口。
Result: 训练好的微分算子与 PDE 无关，无需重训即应用于 Poisson、Burgers、Navier–Stokes 方程、近边界模板与不同分辨率；在相同精度阶与分辨率下匹配或改进既有无网格离散，并将达到同等误差所需的墙钟时间缩短 3–20 倍。
Conclusion: 把相容性硬编码进架构、把谱精度留给损失函数，可以在不牺牲几何灵活性的前提下让无网格算子获得接近谱型方法的波数响应，且一次训练可跨方程与分辨率复用。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Hydra: A Navigation World Action Model with Discrete Latent Planning and Continuous Flow-Matching Execution
papers.abstract_en: World models let robots imagine possible futures, but exploiting this capability for real-time planning is bottlenecked by a representation misalignment: generative models and planners operate on decoupled manifolds, requiring computationally expensive decoding of every candidate back to the high-dimensional observation space for evaluation. In this paper, we present Hydra, a discrete World Action Model that tackles this by establishing a unified latent manifold over visual states, physical poses, and control actions. By compressing this manifold through modality-specific Vector-Quantized bottlenecks, Hydra yields discrete vocabularies of kinodynamic intents and visual states. This enables Discrete Latent Planning (DLP), where candidates are sampled directly from the shared manifold and ranked by a Kinematic-Perceptual Cost within the discrete latent space. To bridge discrete planning with the continuous commands required for physical actuation, Hydra pairs DLP with conditional Flow Matching to map selected intents to smooth execution trajectories. Evaluated on two physical robotic platforms, Hydra outperforms state-of-the-art navigation world models in goal-directed planning, while matching or exceeding the closed-loop execution capabilities of leading reactive navigation policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hydra 把视觉状态、物理位姿和控制动作统一到一个离散隐空间，用模态各自的 Vector-Quantized 瓶颈压缩出运动学意图与视觉状态词表，在隐空间内直接采样候选并用 Kinematic-Perceptual Cost 排序，再由条件 Flow Matching 把选中意图映射为连续执行轨迹。在两个实体机器人平台上，其目标导向规划超过当前导航 world model，闭环执行达到或超过领先的反应式导航策略。
Motivation: 生成式模型与规划器工作在解耦的流形上，每个候选都要解码回高维观测空间才能评估，实时规划因此被计算开销卡住。
Method: 以模态特定的 Vector-Quantized 瓶颈压缩统一隐流形，得到运动学意图与视觉状态的离散词表；在其上做 Discrete Latent Planning（DLP），候选直接从共享流形采样并按 Kinematic-Perceptual Cost 排序；再用条件 Flow Matching 将离散意图转为连续平滑执行轨迹。
Result: 在两个实体机器人平台上评测：目标导向规划优于 state-of-the-art 导航 world model，闭环执行能力达到或超过领先的反应式导航策略。
Conclusion: 把规划与执行统一到同一离散隐流形，可绕开逐候选解码回观测空间的开销，同时保住实时闭环导航能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Performative Privacy: When Differential Privacy Maximizes Utility
papers.abstract_en: Privacy-preserving learning is often motivated by the idea that protecting users' data can preserve trust and thus participation, improving utility in the long term. However, this claim has not been formalized so far. In parallel, performative learning provides a framework for studying learning systems whose deployment affects the data they later observe. In this work, we bring these two perspectives together and introduce performative privacy, where data leakage reduces future participation. We study a simple model where agents repeatedly contribute data for mean estimation but may leave the system when their data is leaked. Privacy is implemented through differentially private mechanisms, creating a trade-off between estimation noise and future participation. We show, through a theoretical study of the dynamics and numerical experiments, that a finite privacy budget can outperform non-private estimation in the long term when the feedback loop between leakage and participation is sufficiently strong. This provides first evidence that differential privacy can be optimal not only as a protection mechanism, but also from the perspective of long-term utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 performative privacy：把数据泄露直接建模为未来参与率下降，研究均值估计中差分隐私 (DP) 噪声与长期参与之间的反馈回路。理论分析与数值实验表明，当泄露—参与反馈足够强时，有限隐私预算在长期效用上反而优于非私有估计。
Motivation: “保护数据能维持信任与参与、从而长期提升效用”这一常见动机此前未被形式化；performative learning 提供了部署影响后续数据的框架，但未与隐私结合。
Method: 在 performative privacy 框架下设定一个简单模型：agent 反复为均值估计贡献数据，一旦数据泄露即可能退出；隐私通过差分隐私机制实现，产生估计噪声与未来参与之间的权衡。对系统动力学做理论分析并辅以数值实验。
Result: 理论与数值实验共同显示：当泄露与参与之间的反馈回路足够强时，有限的隐私预算在长期效用上可超过非私有估计。
Conclusion: 差分隐私不仅值得作为保护机制，从长期效用角度看也可能是最优选择——这是该论点的首个证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TraceML: What Auto-Research Agents Miss in Long-Horizon ML Development
papers.abstract_en: Auto-research agents now run machine-learning development unattended for hours, revising data pipelines, models, and validation from their own feedback, yet on most competitions they still finish below strong human competitors. Outcome-based benchmarks record this gap but not its cause, because they grade the final submission and discard the development process behind it. We introduce TraceML, which pairs human and agent work on the same competitions under one version-level schema: 4{,}465 human Kaggle trajectories across 134 competitions, seven of which are also worked by two agent scaffolds, giving 430 paired human and 207 agent trajectories. Every code version carries its score, its timestamp, and labels for the action taken, its intent, the edit size, and the score effect. Read this way, the gap becomes concrete. Experts alternate data work, validation, model changes, and ensembling, and return to approaches they had set aside. Each agent scaffold instead collapses into a narrow loop: Codex spends its steps re-weighting ensembles and tuning submissions, MLEvolve mutates its model in place, and neither pivots at the human rate nor reopens abandoned work. A short planning prompt distilled from human practice moves the behaviors it names toward the human profile and lifts scores, but the effort profile stays agent-shaped: instruction closes only the part of the gap that reduces to instructions. We release the corpus, the schema, and the labeling models, together with an open-source toolkit that turns a run from any command-line agent into a TraceML trajectory and reads it against the human cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceML 用统一版本级 schema 把 4,465 条人类 Kaggle 轨迹与 430 条配对人类、207 条 agent 轨迹并排对齐，逐版本记录分数、时间戳、动作类型、意图、编辑规模与分数效应，从而定位自动研究 agent 长程开发落后的成因。读出的结论是：专家在数据、验证、模型改动与集成之间交替并会重启搁置方案，而 Codex 与 MLEvolve 各自塌缩成窄循环（前者反复重调集成权重与提交、后者就地变异模型），转向与重启频率都低于人类；一段从人类实践蒸馏的简短规划提示能把它点名的行为拉向人类画像并抬升分数，但努力分布仍是 agent 形状——指令只能关掉可归约为指令的那部分差距。
Motivation: 基于结果的 benchmark 只给最终提交打分、丢弃开发过程，因此能记录 agent 与强人类选手的差距却无法解释成因；无人值守跑数小时的自动研究 agent 在多数竞赛上仍低于强人类。
Method: 提出 TraceML：以统一版本级 schema 对齐同一竞赛上的人类与 agent 工作，语料含 134 个竞赛的 4,465 条人类 Kaggle 轨迹，其中 7 个竞赛由两个 agent scaffold 参与，形成 430 条配对人类轨迹与 207 条 agent 轨迹；每个代码版本标注分数、时间戳、动作类型、意图、编辑规模与分数效应。发布语料、schema、标注模型，以及把任意命令行 agent 的运行转成 TraceML 轨迹并与人类 cohort 对读的开源工具包。
Result: 数据规模为 134 个竞赛、4,465 条人类轨迹、430 条配对人类轨迹与 207 条 agent 轨迹（7 个竞赛由两个 agent scaffold 参与）。定性发现：专家交替数据工作、验证、模型改动与集成并重启搁置方案；Codex 把步数花在重调集成权重与调提交上，MLEvolve 就地变异模型，两者转向与重启频率均低于人类。从人类实践蒸馏的简短规划提示使被点名行为向人类画像靠拢并提升分数，但努力分布仍保持 agent 形状。
Conclusion: 长程 ML 开发的差距可从过程轨迹中读出成因：agent 的问题在于塌缩成窄循环而非缺少指令，指令只能弥补可归约为指令的那部分差距。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Homo-RAG: Homology-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Cross-Species Gene Function Prediction
papers.abstract_en: The functional annotation of genes in non-model organisms remains a significant challenge in computational biology, with 20-70% of sequenced genes lacking characterized functions. Traditional homology-based methods are often costly and strongly dependent on high sequence similarity. This study presents Homo-RAG, a framework for large language model-based gene function prediction that integrates homology-guided multi-hop retrieval with evidence-aware ranking. The framework exploits biological relationships between zebrafish and human orthologs to guide evidence acquisition from ZFIN, UniProt, and PubMed through hybrid dense and lexical retrieval. An Evidence Confidence Score (ECS) integrates semantic relevance, entity matching, orthology information, source reliability, and literature association signals to refine the ranking of retrieved evidence. Extensive evaluation across 150 queries and 7,200 retrieved documents shows that evidence weighting parameter of lambda=0.50 improves NDCG@10 to 0.9879 and MRR to 0.99, while retrieving relevant evidence for 99.33% of queries. Furthermore, 80% of the retrieved documents are query-exclusive, indicating that evidence quality complements rather than replaces retrieval relevance. These findings establish Homo-RAG as a practical and robust framework for reliable, evidence-grounded gene function prediction in understudied organisms. The study addresses important limitations of conventional annotation pipelines while identifying opportunities for future improvements in evidence features and attribution mechanisms.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Homo-RAG 用斑马鱼-人类直系同源关系引导多跳检索，从 ZFIN、UniProt、PubMed 取证据并用 Evidence Confidence Score (ECS) 重排，做非模式生物基因功能预测。在 150 条查询、7,200 篇检索文档上，证据权重 lambda=0.50 使 NDCG@10 达 0.9879、MRR 达 0.99，99.33% 的查询检索到相关证据。
Motivation: 非模式生物中 20–70% 的已测序基因缺乏功能注释，传统同源比对方法成本高且强依赖高序列相似度。
Method: 以斑马鱼与人类直系同源关系引导多跳检索，混合 dense 与 lexical 检索从 ZFIN、UniProt、PubMed 获取证据；Evidence Confidence Score (ECS) 综合语义相关性、实体匹配、直系同源信息、来源可靠性与文献关联信号做证据感知重排。
Result: 在 150 条查询、7,200 篇检索文档的评测中，证据权重 lambda=0.50 将 NDCG@10 提升到 0.9879、MRR 提升到 0.99，99.33% 的查询检索到相关证据；80% 的检索文档为 query-exclusive。
Conclusion: 证据加权与检索相关性互补而非替代，Homo-RAG 可作为非模式生物中证据可溯的基因功能预测框架；作者指出证据特征与归因机制仍有改进空间。

papers.title: Recirculation
papers.abstract_en: We describe an inference-time architectural enhancement for off-the-shelf foundation models that systematically reduces perplexity and boosts accuracy across generation and reasoning tasks. Our approach incurs essentially no additional latency during generation, though it requires serial processing in the prefill phase. Motivated by the fundamental limitation that state updates in feedforward transformers are bounded by model depth, our technique, recirculation, introduces a specific form of recurrence that allows the model to act as a dynamical system and track belief states. We distinguish this technique from chain-of-thought computation---which is better reserved for complex inferences rather than basic state tracking---as well as from popular depth-recurrence techniques (looping) and the costly training of recurrent transformers. We also propose and evaluate an adaptive variant of recirculation which requires only light tuning of hyperparameters while freezing the original model weights. Relative to the off-the-shelf baseline, adaptive recirculation achieves surprising gains on the Gemma3 family, including a consistent reduction in perplexity on a suite of datasets, a 21% increase in relative accuracy on GSM8k, and reliable improvements in accuracy on other downstream tasks. Our training-free approach succeeds by leveraging the model itself to inform architectural modifications, suggesting a route to architectural evolution guided by a trained network's properties rather than forced, arbitrary design choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出推理期架构增强 recirculation：给现成 Transformer 注入特定形式的循环，使模型表现为动力学系统并跟踪 belief state，从而突破前馈状态更新受深度限制的问题。自适应变体只调超参、冻结原权重，在 Gemma3 系列上一致降低困惑度，GSM8k 相对准确率提升 21%。
Motivation: 前馈 Transformer 的状态更新受限于模型深度，基础模型在生成与推理任务上困惑度与准确率仍有损失；链式思维 (chain-of-thought) 又更适合复杂推理而非基本状态跟踪。
Method: recirculation 在推理期注入特定循环结构，让模型作为动力学系统跟踪 belief state；prefill 阶段串行处理，生成期几乎不增加延迟。另提出自适应变体，仅轻调超参并冻结原模型权重，无需训练。
Result: 相对 off-the-shelf 基线，自适应 recirculation 在 Gemma3 系列上一致降低一组数据集的困惑度，GSM8k 相对准确率提升 21%，其他下游任务准确率也有可靠提升；生成期额外延迟基本为零，prefill 需串行。
Conclusion: 训练-free 的架构修改可由模型自身性质引导，代表一条由已训练网络属性驱动架构演化的路径，而非任意人工设计；该方法与 looping、循环 Transformer 训练相区分。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) increasingly master individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising pathway freezes the VLA and puts an LLM coding agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Yet applied to long horizons, this recipe breaks twice. (1) Its competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is exponential in the number of stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs on the order of T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, and a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON to address both failures. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each subtask is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Exploration cost becomes linear (KT), and each failure is attributed to one stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is invoked only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. On the RoboMemArena benchmark, BATON improves task success by 37.7% and cumulative success by 29.7% over the SoTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BATON 把长程机器人操作的探索单元从整任务拆成子任务，使探索代价从 T^K 降到线性 KT，且每次失败可归因到单个阶段；再用 transition-aware memory 管理子任务内 VLA 调用、跨子任务交接与前瞻选择。在 RoboMemArena 上任务成功率较 SoTA 提升 37.7%，累计成功率提升 29.7%。
Motivation: 冻结 VLA、由 LLM coding agent 编排的方案在长时程上失败两次：整任务测试时探索代价随阶段数指数增长（K 阶段约 T^K），且失败无法定位到具体阶段；同时缺少对状态转移的表示，子任务可能以继任者无法使用的形式成功。
Method: 以子任务为探索单元，在短时程内廉价探索并把解存入记忆，长程轨迹由这些解组合而成；transition-aware memory 含三类转移：子任务内由 verifier agent 在腕部视角确认场景就绪后才调用 VLA，跨子任务用 handoff 恢复被前驱残留扰动的进入状态，lookahead 选择继任者可继承结果的策略。
Result: 探索代价由整任务的 T^K 量级降为线性 KT，失败可归因到单个阶段；在 RoboMemArena benchmark 上，任务成功率较 SoTA 提升 37.7%，累计成功率提升 29.7%。
Conclusion: 把子任务作为探索与记忆的基本单元、并显式建模调用与交接转移，是让冻结 VLA + LLM 编排方案在长时程接触密集任务上成立的路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Tight Nonasymptotic Local Convergence of Sinkhorn-Knopp
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) algorithm for the matrix scaling problem. Despite extensive literature on the global convergence of SK and its variants, its local linear convergence behavior remains less understood. We address this gap by providing the first nonasymptotic local analysis of SK that matches the rate obtained from existing asymptotic Jacobian-based arguments. We show that under certain connectivity conditions, SK is a polynomial-time algorithm for doubly stochastic matrix scaling. With the developed tools, we showcase the local suboptimality of SK and provide accelerated variants. Finally, for dense matrices, we improve the complexity of existing first-order matrix scaling algorithms from $O(\tfrac{n^{7/3}}{\varepsilon^{2/3}})$ to $O(\tfrac{n^{9/4}}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}})$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) 矩阵缩放给出首个非渐近局部收敛分析，匹配既有基于 Jacobian 的渐近线性收敛速率；在一定连通性条件下证明 SK 是双重随机矩阵缩放的多项式时间算法，并据此构造加速变体。对稠密矩阵，把现有一阶矩阵缩放算法复杂度从 O(n^{7/3}/ε^{2/3}) 改进到 O(n^{9/4}/√ε)。
Motivation: SK 及其变体的全局收敛已有大量文献，但局部线性收敛行为仍不清楚，缺少与渐近 Jacobian 分析同速率的非渐近局部刻画。
Method: 给出首个非渐近局部收敛分析以匹配渐近 Jacobian 论证的速率；在连通性条件下证明 SK 的多项式时间性；用所开发的工具展示 SK 的局部次优性 (local suboptimality) 并构造加速变体；对稠密矩阵改进一阶矩阵缩放算法的复杂度。
Result: 非渐近局部分析达到既有渐近 Jacobian 论证的收敛速率；在一定连通性条件下 SK 为双重随机矩阵缩放的多项式时间算法；稠密矩阵下一阶矩阵缩放算法复杂度由 O(n^{7/3}/ε^{2/3}) 改进至 O(n^{9/4}/√ε)。
Conclusion: SK 的局部线性收敛可被非渐近地刻画到与渐近分析相同的速率，且其局部次优性可被量化并用加速变体改进；稠密情形的最优复杂度界被进一步压低。

papers.title: XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) maps the sender's original context tokens to the receiver's vocabulary, providing discrete entity anchors. A Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) lets the receiver query the sender's hidden states for contextual enrichment. The entity anchors ground the bridge's contextual signals to specific entities through the receiver's own self-attention. Across three model families (Llama, Qwen, and Mistral), seven benchmarks, and both communication directions, XBRIDGE outperforms text-based communication on all seven tasks for each model pair while achieving 11x lower latency, and in a same-architecture setting it also exceeds a KV-sharing baseline on six of seven tasks. LEB requires only 264M trainable parameters (3.8% of the receiver), is trained on a small balanced sample set, and adds negligible inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XBRIDGE 提出免解码 (decode-free) 的跨架构 LLM 潜空间通信协议：用 Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) 把发送方原始上下文词元映射到接收方词表提供离散实体锚，再用 Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) 让接收方查询发送方 hidden states。在 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 三个模型族、七个基准上，它对全部七个任务都优于文本通信且延迟低 11 倍，同架构下在七个任务中六个超过 KV-sharing 基线。
Motivation: 异构多智能体 LLM 系统能靠减少冗余推理模式胜过同构配置，但现有通信要么走文本、丢掉发送方内部表示，要么要求架构同构才能做潜层传输；跨架构 cross-attention bridge 还会因 rare-token compression collapse 丢失实体身份。
Method: 两个机制：Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) 将发送方原始上下文词元映射到接收方词表，给出离散实体锚；Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) 让接收方查询发送方 hidden states 做上下文增益，实体锚再经接收方自身 self-attention 把桥接信号锚定到具体实体。LEB 仅 2644 万可训练参数（占接收方 3.8%），在小规模均衡样本集上训练。
Result: 纯 bridge-only 的实体 F1 约 30%，暴露 rare-token compression collapse。跨 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 三个模型族、七个基准、双向通信，XBRIDGE 在每个模型对的全部七个任务上都优于文本通信，延迟低 11 倍；同架构设定下在七个任务中六个超过 KV-sharing 基线。LEB 只需 264M 可训练参数（接收方的 3.8%），推理开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 跨架构潜空间通信的瓶颈是实体身份而非表示带宽：用离散词元锚定再让接收方自注意力建立上下文联系，可在不解码的情况下同时拿到文本通信的实体保真与潜层传输的低延迟。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection for Pathology Transformer Attentions
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models are increasingly used for whole-slide image analysis in computational pathology. Yet, WSIs differ fundamentally from natural images: neighbouring patches often contain highly similar tissue type, stain, texture, and cellular composition. We identify this local spatial redundancy as a pathology-specific failure mode of self-attention, where dominant neighbourhood features can be repeatedly mixed into patch-tokens and weaken subtle diagnostic or prognostic deviations. We propose Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection (Gated SRP), a lightweight drop-in correction module for self-attention layers. For each patch token and attention head, Gated SRP estimates a local redundancy axis from neighbouring value vectors, projects the attention output onto this axis, and applies a learned signed gate to correct the redundancy-aligned component geometrically. Across five TCGA survival cohorts, Gated SRP obtains the highest mean C-index among the compared attention variants in all cohorts, with an average improvement over the base attention, while adding only +0.02% parameters. Across five slide-level classification datasets, it improves the base attention on 12 of 16 reported metrics and achieves the best AUC on three datasets. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/GatedSRP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 病理全切片图像 (WSI) 中相邻 patch 高度冗余，会把邻域特征反复混入 patch token、压掉细微诊断或预后偏差。Gated SRP 在每个 patch token 与注意力头上从邻域 value 向量估计局部冗余轴，把注意力输出投影到该轴并用可学习符号门几何地校正冗余分量；在 5 个 TCGA 生存队列上平均 C-index 均为所比注意力变体中最高，参数仅 +0.02%。
Motivation: WSI 与自然图像不同，邻域 patch 在染色、纹理、细胞组成上高度相似，这种局部空间冗余是 self-attention 的病理特有失效模式：主导的邻域特征被反复混入 patch token，削弱细微的诊断或预后偏差。
Method: 提出 Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection (Gated SRP)，一个可即插即用的轻量 self-attention 修正模块：对每个 patch token 和注意力头，从邻域 value 向量估计局部冗余轴，将注意力输出投影到该轴，再用可学习的符号门 (signed gate) 几何地校正冗余对齐分量。
Result: 在 5 个 TCGA 生存队列上，Gated SRP 在全部队列中都取得所比较注意力变体里最高的平均 C-index，相对 base attention 平均有提升，参数量仅增加 +0.02%；在 5 个 slide 级分类数据集上，16 项报告指标中有 12 项优于 base attention，并在 3 个数据集上取得最佳 AUC。
Conclusion: 针对 WSI 局部空间冗余做几何校正，可以在几乎不增加参数的前提下同时改善生存分析的 C-index 与 slide 级分类指标，说明冗余是 self-attention 在病理上的可修正失效模式。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Belief-Guided Decision Making with Uncertainty Gating in the Game of Go
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Computer Go, driven by AlphaZero and MuZero, rely heavily on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to correct the errors of the neural network policy. While effective on massive computational clusters, this dependence creates a critical bottleneck on consumer-grade hardware, where the computational cost of tree management severely limits inference rates. Furthermore, without deep search, these models suffer from hallucination, proposing moves with high confidence that are strategically fatal. This paper introduces a novel Belief-Guided architecture that disentangles the Policy head from a distinct Belief head. Unlike traditional value functions, the Belief head acts as an internal simulator and independent critic, modeling epistemic uncertainty and strategic stability. By integrating memory mechanisms (Transformer/GRU) to handle long-term dependencies and the Ko rule, and utilizing a gating mechanism to filter overconfident policy errors, our model shifts the burden of intelligence from runtime search to parametric "intuition." Experimental results demonstrate that this approach significantly improves search-free win rates and reduces hallucination, enabling professional-level play on limited hardware where massive MCTS is infeasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在围棋上把策略头与独立的 Belief 头解耦，Belief 头作为内部模拟器与独立评判者建模认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 和战略稳定性，再用门控机制过滤过度自信的策略错误，把智能从运行时 MCTS 搜索转移到参数化直觉。结果是免搜索胜率显著提升、幻觉减少，在大规模 MCTS 不可行的有限硬件上达到职业级对弈水平。
Motivation: AlphaZero/MuZero 类模型依赖 MCTS 纠正策略网络错误，在消费级硬件上树管理开销严重压低推理速度；而缺少深搜索时模型会以高置信度提出致命着法（幻觉）。
Method: 提出 Belief-Guided 架构：将 Policy head 与独立的 Belief head 解耦，Belief head 不同于传统 value function，负责建模认知不确定性与战略稳定性；用 Transformer/GRU 记忆机制处理长程依赖与 Ko 规则，并以 gating 机制过滤过度自信的策略错误，把负担从运行时搜索移到参数化直觉。
Result: 实验结果显示免搜索胜率显著提高、幻觉减少，使模型在大规模 MCTS 不可行的有限硬件上达到职业级水平（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 在消费级硬件上，用独立的不确定性建模与门控替代大规模 MCTS 搜索，是可行的免搜索对弈路径。

papers.title: Importance-Aware OBS Pruning for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose importance-aware pruning for diffusion models, a training-free framework that prioritizes preserving parameters critical to semantically salient image regions. To do so, we incorporate spatial importance maps -- derived from conditioning signals or model attention -- into the pruning objective. This produces parameter rankings aligned with perceptual relevance rather than uniform reconstruction error. On MS-COCO dataset, our proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and structural correctness at high compression ratios where conventional pruning causes visible degradation. These results demonstrate that content-aware objectives are key to perceptually faithful compression of generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向扩散模型的重要性感知 OBS 剪枝 (importance-aware OBS pruning)：把由条件信号或模型注意力导出的空间重要性图并入剪枝目标，使参数排序对齐感知显著区域而非均匀重建误差。在 MS-COCO 上，该方法在高压缩比下持续保持主体保真与结构正确，而常规剪枝出现可见退化。
Motivation: 扩散模型的训练免式剪枝通常按均匀重建误差排序参数，忽视图像中语义显著区域，导致高压缩比下主体与结构可见退化。
Method: 训练免式框架：从条件信号或模型注意力生成空间重要性图，将其并入 OBS 剪枝目标，得到按感知相关性而非均匀重建误差的参数排序。
Result: 在 MS-COCO 数据集上，高压缩比下持续保持主体保真与结构正确性，而常规剪枝造成可见退化；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 内容感知的剪枝目标是生成模型感知保真压缩的关键，参数取舍应按感知显著性而非均匀误差分配。

papers.title: From Pixels to Pairs: A Comprehensive Benchmark of LLM-Driven Key-Value Extraction in Noisy Document Settings
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in document key-value pair (KVP) extraction, yet controlled evaluations of their robustness to optical character recognition (OCR) output remain limited. This leaves an important gap in understanding their reliability in real-world OCR-to-LLM pipelines. Unlike end-to-end Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which jointly perform visual perception and semantic extraction, modular pipelines allow these stages and their errors to be isolated and audited. We introduce a controlled benchmark that distinguishes downstream LLM extraction behavior from upstream OCR degradation. It evaluates 136 experimental configurations and 17,688 document-level inferences generated with deterministic decoding across five instruction-tuned open-weight LLMs (2B-8B parameters), three datasets, and four text-quality conditions. The evaluation combines a full zero-shot comparison, targeted one- to three-shot experiments, and a sensitivity analysis of 40 configurations across 20 frozen demonstration sets. By separating Key Recall (annotated-field recovery) from Exact Match and Value F1 (exact and partial value recovery, respectively), we test whether OCR degradation affects field identification and value reproduction differently across models. Our findings challenge three practical assumptions: (1) clean-text performance reliably predicts real-world robustness, (2) model rankings remain consistent across annotation-derived Gold and OCR-derived text, and (3) additional few-shot demonstrations monotonically improve extraction accuracy. The observed model-ranking reversals and unstable few-shot gains expose important reliability risks under noisy document conditions. We release the benchmarking framework, dataset splits, and evaluation scripts to support reproducible research.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Revised experiments, results, and analysis; author list and contact information updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文构建一个受控基准，把下游 LLM 抽取行为与上游 OCR 退化解耦，在 5 个 2B–8B 指令微调开源 LLM、3 个数据集、4 种文本质量条件下跑 136 个配置、17,688 次文档级推理。发现干净文本表现不能预测真实 OCR 管线鲁棒性，模型排名在 Gold 与 OCR 文本间会反转，且增加 few-shot 示例并不单调提升抽取精度。
Motivation: OCR-to-LLM 管线中 LLM 对 OCR 输出的鲁棒性缺少受控评测，无法区分错误来自上游 OCR 还是下游抽取，导致真实场景可靠性判断失准。
Method: 提出区分 Key Recall（标注字段恢复）与 Exact Match、Value F1（精确与部分值恢复）的评测框架；组合全零样本对比、1–3 shot 定向实验，以及跨 20 个冻结示例集的 40 配置敏感性分析，采用确定性解码。
Result: 共 136 个实验配置、17,688 次文档级推理，覆盖 5 个 2B–8B 指令微调开源 LLM、3 个数据集、4 种文本质量条件；敏感性分析含 40 个配置与 20 个冻结 demonstration 集。三项假设被推翻：干净文本表现不能预测真实鲁棒性、模型排名在 Gold 与 OCR 文本间不一致、更多 few-shot 示例不单调提升准确率；观察到排名反转与不稳定的 few-shot 增益。
Conclusion: 在噪声文档条件下，用干净文本基准选出的模型与 few-shot 策略都不可靠，评测必须把 OCR 退化与 LLM 抽取分开审计；作者公开基准框架、数据划分与评测脚本以支持复现。

papers.title: Orthogonality of coastal trapped waves
papers.abstract_en: Coastal trapped wave modes are shown to be orthogonal in the sense that they make independent contributions to the energy of the wave field. The hydrostatic Boussinesq dynamics on an $f$-plane, linearized around a state of rest, are formulated as a (generalized) Schrödinger equation, which exposes the Hermitian structure of the wave operator that implies the orthogonality of eigenmodes. This formulation, which becomes particularly simple in weak form, is parlayed into a finite-element discretization that preserves the symmetries of the original problem and therefore the energy conservation and orthogonality of modes. The geostrophic momentum approximation, under which the orthogonality of modes has been recognized previously, is reprised and discussed in the present context to emphasize that low-frequency coastal trapped waves are edge waves. Their dynamics are governed by boundary potential-vorticity anomalies, both Bretherton-type contributions familiar from the quasi-geostrophic equations and lateral contributions that are important for steep slopes and coastal walls.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Physical Oceanography 56 (2026), 2391-2403
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 f 平面上线性化的静力 Boussinesq 海岸陷波 (coastal trapped waves) 写成广义 Schrödinger 方程，从波算子的 Hermitian 结构直接推出各模态对波场能量正交、彼此独立贡献；弱形式进一步导出保持该对称性与能量守恒的有限元离散。结论是低频海岸陷波本质为 edge wave，其动力学由边界位涡异常（Bretherton 型项与陡坡、海岸壁上的侧向项）控制。
Motivation: 海岸陷波模态此前只在地转动量近似下被认识到正交，缺少从原始静力 Boussinesq 动力学出发的普适论证，也缺少能保持这种正交与能量守恒的数值离散。
Method: 将 f 平面、静止态线性化的静力 Boussinesq 动力学表述为广义 Schrödinger 方程，暴露波算子的 Hermitian 结构以保证本征模正交；该表述在弱形式下最简，并据此构造保持原问题对称性的有限元离散；同时在该框架下重审地转动量近似。
Result: 证明各海岸陷波模态对波场能量正交、贡献相互独立；给出保持能量守恒与模态正交的有限元离散；指出低频海岸陷波为 edge wave，由 Bretherton 型边界位涡异常及陡坡和海岸壁上重要的侧向位涡异常共同支配。
Conclusion: 海岸陷波的正交性源于波算子的 Hermitian 结构而非近似技巧，因此可直接落到保对称性的数值格式；低频极限下这类波应按 edge wave 与边界位涡动力学理解。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Large Audio-Visual Retrieval models
papers.abstract_en: Weak supervision sets a practical regime for audio-visual sound source localization as dense spatial annotations are costly to obtain at scale. The task, however, remains challenging, as models must locate sound sources from temporally aligned audio-visual data without pixel-level supervision. Recent large-scale audio-visual retrieval models, trained at unprecedented scale, encode rich multimodal structure. We show their latent representations, though optimized for global alignment, can nonetheless enable fine-grained spatial grounding. While spatial detail is progressively lost in the upper layers of retrieval backbones due to global pooling, intermediate visual tokens retain highly structured spatial information. To exploit this, we introduce LAIP (\emph{Localization via Audio-Informed Pooling}), a framework that employs a lightweight \emph{Audio-informed Spatial Pooling} (AiSP) to replace the standard global aggregation module. By querying intermediate visual tokens with audio aligned at the frame level, LAIP recovers localized spatial information that is otherwise discarded by the retrieval pipeline, with the largest gains observed for PE-AV, a stack with underlying temporal aggregation. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on AVSBench and AVATAR, nearly doubling previous results on the latter, improving average CIoU from 13.21 to 26.22.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAIP 用音频引导的空间池化 (Audio-informed Spatial Pooling, AiSP) 替换大规模音视频检索骨干的全局聚合模块，以帧级对齐的音频查询中间层视觉 token，把被全局池化丢掉的空间信息重新取出。在 AVSBench 与 AVATAR 上达到 state-of-the-art，AVATAR 上平均 CIoU 从 13.21 提到 26.22，接近翻倍。
Motivation: 弱监督下声源定位缺少像素级标注，而大规模音视频检索模型为全局对齐训练、上层经全局池化丢失空间细节，细粒度空间 grounding 一直做不好。
Method: 提出 LAIP (Localization via Audio-Informed Pooling)：用轻量的 AiSP 取代检索骨干的标准全局聚合模块，以帧级对齐的音频查询中间层视觉 token，恢复被检索流程丢弃的局部空间信息；对含底层时间聚合的 PE-AV 组合收益最大。
Result: 在 AVSBench 与 AVATAR 上取得 state-of-the-art；AVATAR 上平均 CIoU 从 13.21 提升到 26.22，接近翻倍，此前结果约为其一半。
Conclusion: 检索骨干中间层仍保留可用的空间结构，用音频条件化的池化替换全局聚合即可在无像素监督下解锁细粒度空间 grounding。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mirage: a Clean-Label Backdoor against LiDAR 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural network-based LiDAR 3D object detection serves as a critical perception component in safety-critical autonomous systems. However, recent studies have revealed its vulnerability to backdoor attacks. Existing attacks typically require white-box access or label modification and focus on geometric attacks such as object disappearance or bounding-box manipulation. In this paper, we present Mirage, a black-box and clean-label backdoor attack against deep neural network-based LiDAR 3DOD. Mirage injects a small number of label-consistent poisoning samples into the training set, causing the model to learn a malicious association between a trigger pattern and an attacker-chosen target class while preserving normal training semantics. As a result, the compromised model behaves normally on benign inputs yet systematically misclassifies triggered objects as the target class during deployment. We evaluate Mirage on multiple state-of-the-art LiDAR 3DOD models and benchmark datasets. Experimental results show that Mirage achieves a 73% misclassification success rate with a poisoning rate of only 0.5%, while maintaining detection performance close to that of benign models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mirage 是针对 LiDAR 3D 目标检测的黑盒、clean-label 后门攻击：向训练集注入少量标签一致的投毒样本，让模型学到触发图案与攻击者指定目标类的恶意关联。在多个 SOTA 3DOD 模型与基准数据集上，仅 0.5% 投毒率即达 73% 误分类成功率，同时良性输入上的检测性能接近未投毒模型。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 3DOD 后门攻击多需白盒访问或改标签，且集中在物体消失、边界框操纵等几何攻击，缺少黑盒、标签不变的隐蔽攻击手段。
Method: Mirage 注入少量标签一致 (clean-label) 的投毒样本，使模型在保持正常训练语义的前提下学习触发图案到攻击者选定目标类的关联；攻击为黑盒设定，部署时触发对象被系统性误分类为目标类。
Result: 在多个 SOTA LiDAR 3DOD 模型与基准数据集上，投毒率 0.5% 时误分类成功率达 73%，且检测性能保持在良性模型水平附近。

papers.title: Fisher-Guided Progressive Parameter Selection for Adaptive Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning often selects trainable parameters before adaptation using architectural heuristics, without accounting for their varying importance during training. We introduce \textbf{FisherAdapTune}, which progressively selects parameter groups based on temporal drift in their Fisher information. Under a local Gaussian approximation, we bound the divergence between the fine-tuned posterior and pretrained prior by accumulated Fisher-weighted update costs, motivating curvature-aware selection. FisherAdapTune measures Jensen-Shannon distance between successive Fisher-value distributions and uses an adaptive threshold to freeze stabilized groups. Across VTAB-1k classification tasks, it achieves the highest macro Top-1 accuracy among the compared methods with a smaller average trainable set than full fine-tuning. Across four segmentation backbones, it maintains competitive in-distribution performance and improves zero-shot transfer in several settings. Its selections reveal architecture-dependent patterns where input, output, and normalization parameters can remain trainable as attention and MLP groups freeze at different rates. The results support Fisher structural drift as a task-dependent signal for allocating updates during adaptation. We release our \href{https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/FisherAdapTune}{code} publicly to enable further application of our proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FisherAdapTune 在微调过程中按 Fisher 信息的时间漂移逐步筛选可训练参数组：用局部高斯近似把微调后验与预训练先验的散度上界为累积的 Fisher 加权更新代价，再用相邻 Fisher 值分布间的 Jensen-Shannon 距离加自适应阈值冻结已稳定的参数组。在 VTAB-1k 分类任务上取得所比较方法中最高的 macro Top-1 精度，且平均可训练参数集小于全量微调。
Motivation: 参数高效微调 (PEFT) 通常在适配前用架构启发式一次性选定可训练参数，忽略了各参数组在训练过程中的重要性会随时间变化，导致选择与实际需求脱节。
Method: 在局部高斯近似下，把微调后验与预训练先验的散度上界为累积 Fisher 加权更新代价，据此做曲率感知选择；逐轮测量相邻 Fisher 值分布间的 Jensen-Shannon 距离，用自适应阈值冻结已稳定的参数组，实现渐进式参数组筛选。
Result: 在 VTAB-1k 分类任务上，macro Top-1 精度在所比较方法中最高，且平均可训练参数集小于全量微调；在四个分割 (segmentation) backbone 上保持有竞争力的 in-distribution 性能，并在多个设置中提升 zero-shot transfer；参数组冻结呈现架构相关模式——input、output、normalization 参数可保持可训练，而 attention 与 MLP 组以不同速率冻结。
Conclusion: Fisher 结构漂移可作为任务相关的信号来分配微调中的更新预算，据此渐进筛选参数组优于训练前一次性启发式选择；代码已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: Adaptive Order Policies for Masked Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models have seen great success in capturing data distributions over discrete sequences in domains such as text and proteins. These models generate data by iteratively unmasking tokens starting from a fully masked sequence, with the unmasking order typically chosen at random or using a heuristic based on denoiser probabilities. In this work, we propose a scheme for learning the unmasking order using an additional lightweight policy network on top of a diffusion model. Our proposed loss reweights terms in the masked diffusion loss according to policy probabilities, and results in a policy that prefers positions where the denoiser is more likely to be correct. We study this loss in two settings: (i) training solely the policy while using a frozen pre-trained denoiser, and (ii) training the policy and denoiser jointly with the weighted loss to allow for mutual adaptation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms common heuristics on problems that are sensitive to token ordering, such as combinatorial problems, proteins as well as various coding and language tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在掩码扩散 (masked diffusion) 模型上加一个轻量策略网络学习解掩码顺序，用按策略概率重加权的损失训练，使策略偏向去噪器更可能预测正确的位置。在顺序敏感的任务（组合优化问题、蛋白质、代码与语言任务）上超过随机与基于去噪器概率的常见启发式顺序。
Motivation: 掩码扩散的解掩码顺序通常随机选或用去噪器概率启发式，而生成质量对 token 顺序敏感的任务里这种顺序并非最优。
Method: 在扩散模型之上加一个轻量 policy network，提出按策略概率重加权掩码扩散损失的训练方案；两种训练设置：(i) 冻结预训练去噪器只训策略，(ii) 策略与去噪器用加权损失联合训练以相互适配。
Result: 在对 token 顺序敏感的问题上优于常见启发式，涵盖组合问题 (combinatorial problems)、蛋白质以及多种代码与语言任务；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 解掩码顺序可以学出来，且学得的顺序在顺序敏感任务上比随机与概率启发式更有效；联合训练允许策略与去噪器相互适配。

papers.title: Do Proactive Agents Need an LLM to Decide When to Act?
papers.abstract_en: Proactive assistants continuously decide when to intervene and what context should support the intervention. Large language model (LLM) pipelines repeatedly interpret activity histories to make these decisions, paying an inference cost even when the assistant remains silent. We show that a small graph model can handle both decisions and improve the language agents it controls. Our key insight is that user activity has a native graph structure: events involve persistent entities whose recurrence connects interactions over time. Triggering and context selection map directly to predictions on event and entity nodes. We introduce a temporal-graph-learning (TGL) controller that learns these predictions jointly and supplies both outputs in one forward pass. The downstream language agent generates suggestions on triggered events using the activity history and scored entities. At 11.13 ms per event on a GPU server, TGL achieves the highest AUCs among nine trigger architectures and gives approximately $4$--$7\times$ trigger-stage speedups over the two single-forward LLM triggers. A shared TGL model improves F1 across all 14 downstream backbones by a mean of 16.7 points. The controller also runs at 13.99 ms on a consumer laptop with an approximately 220 MiB BF16 resident footprint, bringing effective proactive control to on-device deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 主动助手的触发时机与上下文选择可由小型时序图模型 (TGL) 一次前向完成，无需 LLM 反复解读活动历史。在 9 种触发架构中 TGL 取得最高 AUC，触发阶段比两个单前向 LLM 触发器快约 4–7 倍（11.13 ms/event），共享 TGL 使全部 14 个下游 backbone 的 F1 平均提升 16.7 点。
Motivation: LLM 管线为决定何时介入而反复解析活动历史，即使助手保持沉默也付出推理成本；触发与上下文选择两个决策被割裂处理。
Method: 把用户活动建模为原生图结构（事件涉及持久实体，实体复现把交互跨时间连起来），将触发与上下文选择映射为事件节点与实体节点上的预测，由 TGL 联合学习并在一次前向中同时输出；下游语言 agent 再基于触发事件、活动历史与打分实体生成建议。
Result: 11.13 ms/event（GPU server），在 9 种触发架构中 AUC 最高，比两个单前向 LLM 触发器快约 4–7 倍；共享 TGL 使 14 个下游 backbone 的 F1 全部提升，平均 +16.7 点；消费级笔记本上 13.99 ms，BF16 常驻内存约 220 MiB。
Conclusion: 触发与上下文选择这类时机决策可交给小型图模型，把 LLM 留给真正生成建议的环节，从而实现端侧 (on-device) 主动控制部署。

papers.title: Scalable Heterogeneous Graph Foundation Models for Data-Driven Optimal Power Flow in Smart Grids
papers.abstract_en: Fast and reliable optimal power flow (OPF) approximation is important for power system operation, yet heterogeneous OPF graph models are often evaluated either with architecture-specific implementations or on limited training corpora. This paper presents a large-scale heterogeneous graph-learning workflow, built on HydraGNN, for data-driven OPF surrogate modeling and graph foundation-model (GFM) development. The workflow preserves buses, generators, loads, shunts, alternating-current (AC) lines, transformers, and device-to-bus relations and provides a common implementation for distributed preprocessing, multi-graphics-processing-unit (GPU) training, hyperparameter optimization (HPO), and downstream adaptation. Using approximately three million heterogeneous graphs from ten Power Grid Library for Benchmarking AC Optimal Power Flow Algorithms (PGLib-OPF) cases spanning 14 to 13,659 buses, we compare six heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) families under a common HPO campaign on Frontier, resulting in two compact HeteroSAGE and HeteroHEAT models (~1.6-1.7 million parameters) that achieve the lowest observed validation MSE. Strong and weak scaling using up to 1,024 Frontier nodes show that 256 nodes (corresponding to 1,024 AMD MI250X GPUs) provides the best time-to-solution balance for the measured workload. Two downstream tasks evaluate task adaptation on the IEEE 118-bus case: a classification task to distinguish nominal operating conditions from artificially generated extreme-overload conditions and N-1 single-component-outage regression to predict bus voltage magnitude and phase angle. Partial fine-tuning provides the strongest balance between predictive performance and computational requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Frontier 上用 HydraGNN 搭起异构电网图的大规模训练流水线，约三百万张异构图上统一 HPO 比较六类异构 GNN，得到验证 MSE 最低的紧凑 HeteroSAGE 与 HeteroHEAT（约 160–170 万参数）。弱/强扩展显示 256 节点（1024 块 AMD MI250X）时间-解最优；IEEE 118-bus 上下游任务中 partial fine-tuning 在预测性能与算力开销之间最平衡。
Motivation: 异构 OPF 图模型多用架构专属实现或在有限语料上评测，缺少统一的分布式预处理、多 GPU 训练与超参搜索工作流，难以支撑图基础模型 (GFM) 的规模化开发与下游适配。
Method: 基于 HydraGNN 构建保留母线、发电机、负荷、并联、交流线路、变压器及设备-母线关系的异构图工作流，覆盖分布式预处理、多 GPU 训练、HPO 与下游适配；在 Frontier 上对六类异构 GNN 做统一 HPO campaign，用约三百万张来自 PGLib-OPF 十个算例（14 至 13,659 母线）的图训练。
Result: 得到 HeteroSAGE 与 HeteroHEAT 两个约 1.6–1.7 百万参数的模型，取得最低验证 MSE；扩展实验用到 1,024 个 Frontier 节点，256 节点（1,024 块 AMD MI250X GPU）时间-解最优；IEEE 118-bus 上游任务为区分正常与人工极端过载的分类、以及预测母线电压幅值与相角的 N-1 单元件停运回归，partial fine-tuning 表现与算力开销最平衡。
Conclusion: 统一的异构图工作流加共同 HPO 能在大规模语料上产出紧凑且验证 MSE 最低的 OPF 代理模型，且下游适配以 partial fine-tuning 为最佳折中。

papers.title: Lost in Tokenization: Fundamental Trade-offs in Graph Tokenization for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have become a central architecture for graph learning, but their application to graphs requires first choosing a tokenization: a graph-to-token map that determines which structural information is exposed at the input. In this work, we show that this choice is a fundamental component of transformer expressivity. We examine three tokenizations that serve as building blocks for many existing graph tokenizations: spectral, random-walk, and adjacency tokenizations. We prove that different tokenizations induce distinct depth regimes: the same graph computation may be realizable by a shallow transformer under one tokenization, while requiring substantially larger depth under another. For example, we prove that random-walk tokenization is lossy for any walk length, making it impossible in general to recover the graph from it, and that while spectral tokenization is lossless, it is ill-conditioned for local tasks. We further show that although both random-walk and spectral tokenizations are derived from adjacency information, it is impossible for a limited-depth transformer to convert between tokenization families in general. In particular, we establish lower bounds and impossibility results showing that unfavorable tokenizations may preclude the efficient recovery of more suitable structural representations. Finally, we complement our theory with controlled experiments on synthetic and real-world tasks, validating the predicted separations and showing that different tasks favor different structural views, and combining complementary tokenizations allows the transformer to leverage distinct signals from each representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图 Transformer 的表达力取决于 graph-to-token 的 tokenization 选择：随机游走 tokenization 对任意 walk 长度都是有损的、一般无法还原原图，谱 tokenization 无损但对局部任务病态，且有限深度 Transformer 无法在 tokenization 家族之间互相转换。合成与真实任务上的受控实验验证了理论预测的深度分离，并显示组合互补 tokenization 能让模型同时利用不同表示的信号。
Motivation: 图 Transformer 需要先选 tokenization，但这一选择如何决定表达力与所需深度缺少理论刻画，导致不同任务该用哪种结构视图无从判断。
Method: 以 spectral、random-walk、adjacency 三类 tokenization 为构建块，证明它们诱导不同深度区间，给出随机游走有损性、谱表示对局部任务的病态性，以及有限深度下跨 tokenization 家族转换的下界与不可能性结果，并用合成与真实任务的受控实验验证。
Result: 证明 random-walk tokenization 对任意 walk 长度有损、一般无法恢复原图；spectral tokenization 无损但对局部任务 ill-conditioned；同一图计算在一种 tokenization 下浅层可实现、另一种需要显著更大深度；有限深度 Transformer 一般无法在 tokenization 家族间转换。受控实验验证了这些预测的分离，并显示不同任务偏好不同结构视图、组合互补 tokenization 可利用各自信号。

papers.title: Leveraging Latent Visual Reasoning in Silence
papers.abstract_en: Latent visual reasoning involves visual evidence more directly in multimodal reasoning by inserting continuous latent tokens before textual generation. However, the necessity of these latent tokens at inference remains ambiguous. We show that replacing latent tokens with random noise or removing them completely causes little performance degradation across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Reinforcement learning further diminishes the latent generation behavior after post-training. These observations raise a central question: \textit{Is latent visual reasoning still meaningful}? We argue that its value should be measured by how effectively latent tokens guide learning, rather than whether they persist as an inference-time format. Our analysis shows that latent reasoning is unevenly favorable across question types, yet hard task-level routing for applying latent generation is brittle. Motivated by these findings, we propose an attention-based reward that encourages generated latent tokens to interact with later text tokens during RL. This reward promotes latent utilization when the latent mode is activated while preserving the flexibility to use pure-text reasoning. Experiments show that our method improves performance across perception and visual reasoning benchmarks, even when latent tokens are rarely generated after post-training. Our results highlight that, without explicit expression at inference, latent visual reasoning can shape better visual grounding and more accurate textual reasoning \textbf{in silence}. Code \& model: \href{https://github.com/ddydyd32/silent-lvr/tree/master}{\faGithub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态推理中的隐空间视觉推理 (latent visual reasoning) 在推理期其实可有可无：把 latent token 换成随机噪声或直接删掉，各空间推理基准性能几乎不掉，RL 后训练还会进一步压制 latent 生成行为。作者据此提出一种 attention-based reward，在 RL 中鼓励已生成的 latent token 与后续文本 token 交互，使模型在感知与视觉推理基准上提升，即便后训练后 latent token 几乎不再生成。
Motivation: 在文本生成前插入连续 latent token 的做法是否真的必要并不清楚：若推理期可被噪声替换或删除而不掉点，latent 推理的价值就需要新的衡量方式。
Method: 先做消融诊断（latent token 替换为随机噪声、完全移除、RL 后训练后的生成行为），再提出 attention-based reward，在强化学习中促使生成的 latent token 与后续文本 token 交互，同时保留纯文本推理的灵活性；latent 模式按需激活，不做硬的任务级路由（作者指出其脆弱）。
Result: 替换 latent token 为随机噪声或完全移除，在各空间推理基准上仅造成很小的性能下降；RL 后训练进一步减少 latent 生成行为；latent 推理的收益随题型不均，而任务级硬路由脆弱；加入 attention-based reward 后，方法在感知与视觉推理基准上均有提升，即使后训练后 latent token 很少被生成。
Conclusion: latent 视觉推理的价值在于它如何引导学习、而非是否在推理期显式存在：即使推理时不显式表达，它仍能塑造更好的视觉 grounding 与更准确的文本推理（in silence）。

papers.title: Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs
papers.abstract_en: Equipping LLM agents with reusable skills derived from past experience has become a popular and successful approach for tackling complex and long-horizon tasks. However, such lessons are often encoded as textual guidance that remains largely advisory, lacking explicit mechanisms for when and how to intervene in the agent loop. To bridge the gap, we introduce HASP(Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs), a new framework that upgrades skills into executable Program Functions (PFs). Rather than offering passive advice, PFs act as executable guardrails that activate on failure-prone states and modify the next action or inject corrective context. HASP is highly modular: it can be applied at inference time for direct agent-loop intervention, during post-training to provide structured supervision, or for self-improvement by evolving validated, teacher-reviewed PFs. Empirically, HASP drives substantial gains compared to both training-free and training-based methods on web-search, math reasoning, and coding tasks. For example, on web-search reasoning, inference-time PFs alone improve the average performance by 25% compared to (multi-loop) ReAct Agent, while post-training and controlled evolution achieve a 30.4% gain over Search-R1. To provide deeper insights into HASP, our mechanism analysis reveals how PFs trigger and intervene, how skills are internalized, and the requirement for stable skill library evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HASP 把 LLM agent 从过往经验中学到的技能从文本建议升级为可执行的 Program Functions (PFs)，在易失败状态上触发并改写下一步动作或注入纠正上下文。web-search 推理任务上，仅推理期 PFs 相对 (multi-loop) ReAct Agent 平均提升 25%，post-training 与受控演化相对 Search-R1 提升 30.4%。
Motivation: 现有 agent 技能以文本形式编码，只停留在建议层面，缺少何时、如何介入 agent loop 的显式机制，复杂长程任务上难以稳定复用经验。
Method: HASP 将技能升级为可执行的 Program Functions，作为在失败倾向状态触发的 guardrail，修改下一动作或注入纠正上下文；框架支持三种接入方式：推理期直接干预 agent loop、post-training 提供结构化监督、以及由 teacher 审核后的 PF 演化实现自我改进。
Result: 在 web-search 推理任务上，仅推理期 PFs 相对 (multi-loop) ReAct Agent 平均性能提升 25%；post-training 与受控演化 (controlled evolution) 相对 Search-R1 提升 30.4%；在 web-search、数学推理与 coding 三类任务上相对 training-free 与 training-based 方法均有显著增益。
Conclusion: 把经验技能做成可执行、可触发的 guardrail 而非文本建议，能在推理期、post-training 和自我演化三个环节同时带来收益；机制分析指出 PF 的触发与介入方式、技能内化过程，以及技能库稳定演化的前提。

papers.title: SCAMP: Sparse-anchor Control is One Small Projection
papers.abstract_en: Authoring with a text-to-motion generator needs sparse anchors: chosen joints, at chosen frames, at given positions. Meeting them currently costs a conditioning branch trained for the task, or hundreds of per-clip optimisation steps in the architecture's native variables. In any generator that decodes a continuous state through a frozen differentiable decoder, the anchors ask for little and leave most of the state free: a few hundred numbers against a state of tens of thousands. Every control method is a choice among the states that satisfy them, and the choices differ along the directions the anchors cannot see and the motion can. SCAMP makes the choice that moves none of them: damped Gauss-Newton in the space of the anchors, through the frozen decoder alone, training-free, with one dimensionless damping constant. Every increment is a combination of the rows of the anchors' Jacobian, so the correction is orthogonal to everything the anchors never see, and the system solved is the size of the request rather than of the state. Applied unchanged to seven published generators spanning diffusion, token and latent designs, it matches or exceeds in anchor error every released control method it is measured against, and closes the anchors on hosts that ship none. Confined to those rows, a correction can only take the shapes the decoder admits, so what it costs belongs to the decoder, and holding the solver fixed makes that cost measurable: it divides by decoder family, windowed decoders staying within a small multiple of the unconstrained generator's foot skating where analytic recoveries multiply it several times over. Built to that criterion, our own generator reaches 0.083 m anchor error at FID 0.102 in 0.50 s per clip. The decoder's temporal support is a design criterion for controllable motion generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCAMP 用锚点空间的阻尼 Gauss-Newton、只经冻结解码器做免训练优化，把文本到动作生成器的稀疏锚点（指定关节、指定帧、指定位姿）闭合；增量是锚点 Jacobian 行的组合，因此修正对锚点看不见的方向正交。在七个已发布生成器（扩散、token、latent 设计）上，其锚点误差匹配或优于所对比的已发布控制方法，并在无控制接口的宿主上闭合锚点。
Motivation: 文本到动作生成器的稀疏锚点控制目前要么需要为任务训练条件分支，要么需要在架构原生变量上做每段几百步优化；锚点只约束状态中极少数维度，其余自由度的选择方式决定了结果差异。
Method: 在锚点空间做阻尼 Gauss-Newton，仅通过冻结的可微解码器前向，免训练，只有一个无量纲阻尼常数；每次增量取锚点 Jacobian 行的线性组合，求解系统规模等于请求规模而非状态规模。方法原样套用到七个已发布生成器，并以固定求解器测量解码器带来的 foot skating 代价。
Result: 在七个已发布生成器（覆盖 diffusion、token、latent 设计）上，锚点误差匹配或优于所对比的每个已发布控制方法，并能在不附带控制功能的宿主上闭合锚点；按解码器族划分代价，windowed decoder 的 foot skating 保持在无约束生成器的小倍数内，而解析恢复方法使其放大数倍。作者自建生成器达到 0.083 m 锚点误差、FID 0.102、每段 0.50 s。
Conclusion: 解码器的时间感受野（temporal support）应作为可控运动生成的设计准则：修正被限制在锚点 Jacobian 行内时，代价只来自解码器，windowed decoder 明显优于解析恢复式控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ottilie: A Socially Intelligent Virtual Host for Sales-Driven Live Commerce
papers.abstract_en: A skilled live-commerce host is not merely a narrator, but a sales agent who converts viewer curiosity into purchase intent through expert product knowledge, emotionally intelligent response tactics, and entertainment that serves as a vehicle for product exposure. Yet no existing AI system replicates this. Conversational recommenders treat recommendation as a terminal act, while general-purpose LLMs hallucinate product claims and default to generic promotional templates that fail to engage or persuade. We present Ottilie, a sales-conversion-oriented virtual host for Chinese beauty live commerce that grounds product responses in a verified knowledge base, adapts discourse strategy to viewer intent through empathetic amplification, evidence-backed rebuttal, and humor-mediated deflection, and supervises all four output fields simultaneously within a structured generation framework. Experiments demonstrate gains of 14% on informativeness and 5% on factual correctness, with consistent advantages in tactfulness and viewer engagement. Ottilie has been deployed as an autonomous English-language host on Twitch, where the same fine-tuned model runs unattended on a single commodity GPU and promotes the company's own product; we report how the system adapted to a new language, market, and product without retraining, and what the deployment revealed about latency and adversarial chat.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. An earlier version, titled "VerbalValue: A Socially Intelligent Virtual Host for Sales-Driven Live Commerce", was accepted to the CVPR 2026 HiGen Workshop (non-archival). This version extends it with a deployment study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ottilie 是面向中文美妆直播带货的销售转化型虚拟主播：用已验证知识库约束产品回答，按观众意图切换共情放大、有据反驳与幽默化解三种话术策略，并在结构化生成框架里同时监督四个输出字段。实验中信息性提升 14%、事实正确性提升 5%，机智度与观众参与度也一致占优；同一微调模型在 Twitch 上单卡无人值守运行，跨语言、市场与产品零再训练部署。
Motivation: 对话式推荐系统把推荐当作终止动作，通用 LLM 则会编造产品宣称、只会套用通用促销模板，无法像真人主播那样把观众好奇转成购买意愿。
Method: Ottilie 由三部分组成：已验证知识库为产品回答提供事实锚点；话术策略模块按观众意图在共情放大 (empathetic amplification)、有据反驳 (evidence-backed rebuttal)、幽默化解 (humor-mediated deflection) 之间选择；结构化生成框架对四个输出字段做联合监督。系统在中文美妆直播场景上微调。
Result: 实验显示信息性 (informativeness) 提升 14%，事实正确性 (factual correctness) 提升 5%，机智度 (tactfulness) 与观众参与度 (viewer engagement) 上保持一致优势。部署侧：同一微调模型在 Twitch 上以英文自主运行，单块消费级 GPU 无人值守，无需再训练即适配新语言、新市场与新产品，并暴露了延迟与对抗性弹幕问题。
Conclusion: 把产品回答锚定在验证过的知识库并按意图调度话术，能让虚拟主播在带货对话中同时守住事实性与说服力；跨语言零再训练的 Twitch 部署说明这套监督框架可迁移到新市场。
Relevance: 1
