summary_sections.result: 实验显示信息性 (informativeness) 提升 14%，事实正确性 (factual correctness) 提升 5%，机智度 (tactfulness) 与观众参与度 (viewer engagement) 上保持一致优势。部署侧：同一微调模型在 Twitch 上以英文自主运行，单块消费级 GPU 无人值守，无需再训练即适配新语言、新市场与新产品，并暴露了延迟与对抗性弹幕问题。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把产品回答锚定在验证过的知识库并按意图调度话术，能让虚拟主播在带货对话中同时守住事实性与说服力；跨语言零再训练的 Twitch 部署说明这套监督框架可迁移到新市场。

papers.title: Optimization Risk Bounds for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks Trained by DP-SGD with Correlated Noise
papers.abstract_en: The theoretical understanding of differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) with temporally correlated noise remains limited, particularly for non-convex neural network training. As a first step, we study two-layer Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), a recently introduced architecture with learnable spline-based edge functions. We establish the first optimization risk bounds for clipped mini-batch DP-SGD with correlated noise in this setting, with explicit dependence on temporal correlation, clipping, mini-batch sampling, and network width. Existing arguments fail for three reasons: temporal dependence breaks the conditional-centering step; projection obstructs the cross-iteration cancellation of correlated perturbations; and active clipping breaks the empirical-gradient structure. We address these issues through shifted and auxiliary dynamics, a weighted empirical loss, and a high-probability localization argument. Our bound shows that temporal correlation reduces the leading noise terms, the clipping threshold enters essentially through an effective step size, and private training admits an explicit network width range. Experiments on synthetic data and MNIST support the predicted optimization effect of temporal correlation. As an application, we derive population risk guarantees via algorithmic stability. Our framework recovers non-private mini-batch SGD, independent-noise DP-SGD, and their full-batch counterparts as special cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出两层 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 上带时间相关噪声的 clipped mini-batch DP-SGD 的首个优化风险界，显式依赖时间相关性、裁剪阈值、mini-batch 采样与网络宽度。界表明时间相关性压低主导噪声项、裁剪阈值基本通过有效步长进入、私有训练存在显式网络宽度范围；合成数据与 MNIST 实验支持时间相关性带来的优化效应。
Motivation: 带时间相关噪声的 DP-SGD 在非凸神经网络训练上缺乏理论理解，现有论证因时间依赖破坏条件中心化、投影阻碍相关扰动的跨迭代抵消、主动裁剪破坏经验梯度结构而失效。
Method: 以两层 KAN（可学习 spline 边函数）为对象，用 shifted 与 auxiliary dynamics、加权经验损失和高概率 localization 论证建立 clipped mini-batch DP-SGD 的优化风险界；再经算法稳定性导出 population risk 保证，框架把非私有 mini-batch SGD、独立噪声 DP-SGD 及其全批量版本作为特例回收。
Result: 界显式含时间相关、裁剪、mini-batch 采样与网络宽度：时间相关性降低主导噪声项，裁剪阈值基本通过有效步长进入，并给出显式网络宽度范围；合成数据与 MNIST 实验支持时间相关性的预测优化效应。
Conclusion: 时间相关噪声在 KAN 的 DP-SGD 中是可利用的优化资源（压低噪声项并保留显式宽度范围），且该框架统一覆盖私有与非私有、相关与独立噪声的多个特例。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: JUMP: Efficient Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) test whether a candidate example was used to train a language model. Existing attacks on fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) often aggregate reconstruction signals across many mask configurations, requiring repeated model evaluations. We propose Joint Uncertainty Guided Mask Probing (JUMP), an efficient MIA that exploits the ability of dLLMs to predict masked tokens in parallel. Using the pre-fine-tuning checkpoint as a reference, JUMP selects low-confidence positions, masks them jointly, and aggregates clipped target-reference reconstruction gaps. This focuses the attack on positions that reveal stronger membership signals from fine-tuning. After mask selection, all selected tokens are evaluated with one scoring query per model. Across six MIMIR domains, JUMP improves mean ROC-AUC over a prior multi-mask attack from 0.819 to 0.902 on LLaDA and from 0.851 to 0.942 on Dream. Including mask selection, it requires only three forward passes per example, compared with 32 for the baseline. We further extend JUMP to the target-only setting by replacing target-reference scoring with relative token preference, which compares the observed token with alternative predictions at the same masked position. Target-Only JUMP achieves mean ROC-AUCs of 0.609 and 0.638 on LLaDA and Dream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JUMP 用微调前 checkpoint 作参考，挑出低置信度位置联合掩码，聚合裁剪后的 target-reference 重建差距，一次打分查询完成成员推断 (MIA)。在 MIMIR 六个域上，LLaDA 平均 ROC-AUC 从 0.819 升到 0.902、Dream 从 0.851 升到 0.942，每样本只需 3 次前向（基线 32 次）。
Motivation: 对微调离散扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 的现有成员推断攻击要在大量掩码配置上反复聚合重建信号，模型评估次数多、代价高。
Method: JUMP (Joint Uncertainty Guided Mask Probing)：以微调前 checkpoint 为参考，选择低置信度位置并联合掩码，聚合裁剪后的 target-reference 重建差距；掩码选定后每个模型只需一次打分查询。另提出 Target-Only 变体，用同一掩码位置上观测 token 与备选预测的相对偏好替代 target-reference 打分。
Result: MIMIR 六域平均 ROC-AUC：LLaDA 0.819 → 0.902，Dream 0.851 → 0.942（对比先前 multi-mask 攻击）；含掩码选择在内每样本仅 3 次前向，基线为 32 次。Target-Only JUMP 在 LLaDA 与 Dream 上平均 ROC-AUC 分别为 0.609 与 0.638。
Conclusion: 把攻击集中在微调前后重建差距最强的低置信度位置，可在大幅减少前向次数的同时提高 dLLM 成员推断的 ROC-AUC；失去参考 checkpoint 后改用相对 token 偏好，判别力明显下降。

papers.title: Dataset Watermarking with Provable Black-Box Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are often pre-trained and post-trained on vast amounts of loosely curated data, and potentially have been trained on proprietary datasets or the benchmarks used for evaluation. This motivates dataset watermarking: designing datasets such that training on them leaves detectable signatures in the resulting model. Existing approaches embed watermarks by either injecting artificial content or paraphrasing full examples under token-level generation control, and many require model access beyond generated outputs for detection. Our method embeds a dataset-level watermark by increasing the co-occurrence of randomly selected word pairs through meaning-preserving local edits, and detects it from generated text alone with provable false positive control. We conduct evaluation on four base models and three datasets and show that it reliably detects the watermark ($p <0.01$) in the fine-tuning stage, outperforming existing black-box baselines. Our method remains effective under substantial dilution where watermarked data is less than 5% of fine-tuning tokens. Moreover, our method better preserves benchmark utility and semantic integrity than existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数据集水印方法：通过保持语义的局部编辑提高随机词对的共现频率，把水印写进训练数据，检测时只用生成文本即可判定并保证假阳性可控。在四个基线模型与三个数据集上，微调阶段以 p<0.01 可靠检出，优于已有黑盒基线；当水印数据占微调 token 不足 5% 时仍有效，且比基线更好地保留基准效用与语义完整性。
Motivation: LLM 预训练与后训练数据来源混杂，可能混入私有数据或评测基准，需要在只能拿到生成输出的黑盒条件下证明性地检出数据来源，而现有方法多依赖人工注入内容、整例改写或超出输出的模型访问。
Method: 数据集级水印：对样本做保持语义的局部编辑，提高随机选定词对的共现频率；检测阶段仅从生成文本估计该共现信号，并给出假阳性率的可证明控制。
Result: 在四个 base model 和三个数据集上，微调阶段以 p<0.01 可靠检出水印，优于已有黑盒基线；水印数据占微调 token 不足 5% 的稀释条件下仍保持有效；在基准效用与语义完整性保持上优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 把水印做成数据层面的词对共现偏置，可在纯黑盒、强稀释的微调场景下实现带假阳性保证的检测，同时少损害模型效用。

papers.title: Process Matters more than Output for Distinguishing Humans from Machines
papers.abstract_en: Reliable human-machine discrimination is becoming increasingly important as Large Language Models and autonomous agents are deployed in online settings. Existing approaches evaluate whether a system can produce responses indistinguishable from those of a human. This approach follows the focus on the output of a machine, as suggested by Alan Turing. Cognitive science provides an alternative approach: considering the process by which that behavior is produced. To evaluate whether processes can reliably distinguish humans from machines, we introduce a process-based framework, the Process Turing Test, and evaluate it across a battery of cognitive tasks spanning decision-making, working memory, and planning. These tasks, such as mental rotation and sequence prediction, yield process-level measures complementing conventional measures of overall task performance. We also include multiple CAPTCHA tasks in the battery. Across the battery, process-level features provide substantially stronger discriminative signal than performance metrics alone, reliably distinguishing humans from agents even when task performance is matched (process-based classifier AUC = 0.88). We also conducted a controlled red-teaming study comparing off-the-shelf frontier agents (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro), Centaur (LLM fine-tuned on 10.7M human decisions), and two task-specific fine-tuning methods: action-level supervised fine-tuning (A-SFT) and process-level fine-tuning (P-SFT), which directly optimizes process features. We find that broad fine-tuning on human choices makes task processes more human-like relative to off-the-shelf frontier agents, and task-specific P-SFT further improves human-like behavioral mimicry, though this advantage largely disappears under cross-task transfer. These results highlight process specification as a central bottleneck in achieving human-like cognitive processes in machines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Process Turing Test：不看输出是否像人，而看产生行为的过程特征，在决策、工作记忆、规划与 CAPTCHA 任务组上区分人与机器。过程级特征比单纯绩效指标判别力强得多，在任务绩效已匹配时过程分类器 AUC 仍达 0.88；任务内 P-SFT 能进一步模仿人类过程，但跨任务迁移时该优势基本消失。
Motivation: 在线场景中 LLM 与自主智能体需要与人区分，但沿用 Turing 思路只比较输出，绩效一旦匹配就失效；认知科学提示应比较产生行为的过程。
Method: 构建 Process Turing Test 框架，在含心理旋转、序列预测与多项 CAPTCHA 的认知任务组上提取过程级特征（补充总体绩效指标），训练过程分类器；红队实验对比 Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、在 10.7M 人类决策上微调的 Centaur，以及动作级 A-SFT 与直接优化过程特征的 P-SFT 两种任务内微调。
Result: 过程级特征的判别信号显著强于仅用绩效指标，在任务绩效匹配时仍可靠区分人与智能体，过程分类器 AUC = 0.88；在人类选择上广泛微调使任务过程比现成前沿智能体更像人，任务内 P-SFT 进一步提升人类式行为模仿，但该优势在跨任务迁移时基本消失。
Conclusion: 区分人与机器的关键在过程而非输出，过程设定 (process specification) 是让机器获得人类式认知过程的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Cumulative-Goodness Free-Riding in Forward-Forward Networks: Real, Repairable, but Not Accuracy-Dominant
papers.abstract_en: Forward-Forward (FF) training lets each layer learn from a local goodness criterion. In cumulative-goodness variants, later layers can inherit a task that earlier layers have partly separated. We formalize this as layer free-riding: under the softplus FF criterion, the class-discrimination gradient reaching block $d$ decays exponentially with the positive margin accumulated by earlier blocks (Theorem 3.1); a squared-hinge barrier reproduces the pathology. History-free and hardness-gated repairs raise deeper-layer separation by up to $5\times$ on CIFAR-100 and $45\times$ in an 8-block CIFAR-10 model, yet these and a depth-scaled auxiliary term move accuracy by under one percentage point among non-degenerate variants; on Tiny ImageNet, a harder cross-dataset check of the selected configuration, layer health likewise does not track accuracy. A theory-derived attenuation-compensated objective raises deepest-block separation $5.9\times$ at a consistent cost in the FF classifier's own accuracy that a probe trained on the frozen features recovers; in a smaller CIFAR-10 control, most of its separation gain comes from dropping the depth-scaled auxiliary term it replaces. Accuracy invariance is a property of the deployed sum-based scoring rule under redistribution (Proposition 3.2) and, empirically, of the structured trained readouts we test, not of what the network learns: retrained variants disagree on 13-26% of test predictions. Architecture and augmentation matter far more than the non-degenerate training rules studied. Cumulative free-riding is therefore a real and repairable pathology, but for the softplus and squared-hinge objectives, architectures, and datasets we study, it is not the dominant factor limiting accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Camera-ready version: 65 pages (10 pages main text), 24 figures, 45 tables. Code: https://github.com/amirhossein-yousefi/ff-free-riding ; checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/Amirhossein75/ff-free-riding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 Forward-Forward 网络中累积 goodness 的搭便车现象形式化为 layer free-riding：定理 3.1 证明在 softplus FF 准则下，到达第 d 块的类判别梯度随前面各块累积的正 margin 指数衰减，squared-hinge barrier 可复现该病理。history-free 与 hardness-gated 修复把深层分离度最多提升 5×（CIFAR-100）与 45×（8-block CIFAR-10），但非退化变体间准确率变化不足 1 个百分点；作者结论是该病理真实且可修复，却不是限制准确率的主导因素。
Motivation: cumulative-goodness 变体中后层可从前层已部分分离的任务中搭便车，导致深层梯度与分离度塌缩；需要判定这是否真的损害最终准确率，还是只影响层内健康度。
Method: 先形式化 layer free-riding 并给出定理 3.1（softplus 准则下类判别梯度随正 margin 指数衰减）与 squared-hinge barrier 复现；再提出 history-free、hardness-gated 修复以及理论导出的 attenuation-compensated objective，并以 Proposition 3.2 分析部署时 sum-based scoring 在重分配下的准确率不变性，配合 frozen-feature probe 与重训练变体对照。
Result: history-free 与 hardness-gated 修复使深层分离度在 CIFAR-100 上提升最多 5×、在 8-block CIFAR-10 上提升 45×；这些修复与 depth-scaled auxiliary 项在非退化变体间带来的准确率变化不足 1 个百分点。attenuation-compensated objective 把最深块分离度提高 5.9×，但以 FF 分类器自身准确率为代价，该损失可由 frozen features 上训练的 probe 找回；在较小的 CIFAR-10 对照中，其分离度增益主要来自去掉它所替代的 depth-scaled auxiliary 项。Tiny ImageNet 上 layer health 同样不随准确率变化；重训练变体在 13–26% 的测试预测上不一致。
Conclusion: 累积 free-riding 是真实且可修复的病理，但在所研究的 softplus 与 squared-hinge 目标、架构与数据集上并非限制准确率的主导因素——架构与数据增强的影响远大于非退化训练规则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Trojan Hippo Bench: A Dynamic Benchmark for Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems enable otherwise stateless LLM agents to persist user information across sessions, but also introduce a new attack surface. The Trojan Hippo attack is a class of persistent memory attacks that operates under a more realistic threat model than prior memory poisoning work. The attacker plants a dormant payload into an agent's long-term memory via a single untrusted tool call (e.g., a crafted email), which activates only when the user later discusses sensitive topics such as finance, health, or identity, and exfiltrates high-value personal data to the attacker. While anecdotal demonstrations of such attacks have appeared against deployed systems, no prior work systematically evaluates them across heterogeneous memory architectures and defenses. We introduce Trojan Hippo Bench, a dynamic evaluation framework for persistent memory attacks and memory-layer defenses, comprising two components, (1) an OpenEvolve-based adaptive red-teaming benchmark that stress-tests defenses and memory backends against continuously refined attacks, and (2) a capability-aware security-utility analysis for persistent memory systems, enabling principled reasoning about defense deployment across different usage profiles. Instantiated on an email assistant across four memory backends (explicit tool memory, agentic memory, RAG, and sliding-window context), the undefended Trojan Hippo attack achieves up to 85-100% attack success rate (ASR) against current frontier models from OpenAI and Google, with planted memories successfully activating even after 100 benign sessions. We evaluate four memory-system defenses inspired by basic security principles; they reduce attack success to as low as 0-5%, but at utility costs that vary widely with the task mix. Effective real-world deployment thus remains an open challenge that Trojan Hippo Bench is built to study; we release it to support reuse and extension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Trojan Hippo Bench 是针对 LLM agent 持久记忆攻击的动态评测框架：攻击者用一次不可信工具调用（如伪造邮件）植入休眠 payload，仅在用户谈及金融、健康、身份等敏感话题时激活并外泄数据。在邮件助手场景、四种记忆后端上，未防御的 Trojan Hippo 攻击对 OpenAI 与 Google 前沿模型的攻击成功率 (ASR) 高达 85–100%，植入记忆在 100 个良性会话后仍能激活；四种记忆层防御可把 ASR 压到 0–5%，但效用代价随任务组合差异很大。
Motivation: 已有记忆投毒工作威胁模型不现实，且缺少跨异构记忆架构与防御的系统评测；已部署系统上虽有零星演示，但无法比较不同记忆后端与防御的攻防效果。
Method: 框架含两部分：基于 OpenEvolve 的自适应红队基准，用持续精化的攻击压测防御与记忆后端；以及能力感知的安全-效用分析，用于按使用画像权衡防御部署。在邮件助手上实例化，覆盖 explicit tool memory、agentic memory、RAG、sliding-window context 四种记忆后端，并评测四种源自基本安全原则的记忆系统防御。
Result: 未防御的 Trojan Hippo 攻击对 OpenAI 与 Google 当前前沿模型的 ASR 最高达 85–100%，植入记忆在 100 个良性会话后仍成功激活；四种防御把 ASR 降到最低 0–5%，但效用代价随任务组合差异很大。
Conclusion: 持久记忆攻击在现实威胁模型下对前沿模型高度有效，安全原则驱动的防御能大幅压低 ASR，但效用代价随任务组合波动，真实部署仍是开放挑战；作者开源该基准以支持复用与扩展。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Global Optimality for Constrained Exploration via Penalty Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Efficient exploration is a central problem in reinforcement learning and is often formalized as maximizing the entropy of the state-action occupancy measure. While unconstrained maximum-entropy exploration is relatively well understood, real-world exploration is often constrained by safety, resource, or imitation requirements. This constrained setting is particularly challenging because entropy maximization lacks additive structure, rendering Bellman-equation-based methods inapplicable. Moreover, scalable approaches require policy parameterization, inducing non-convexity in both the objective and the constraints. To our knowledge, the only prior model-free policy-gradient approach for this setting under general policy parameterization is due to Ying et al. (2025). Unfortunately, their guarantees are limited to weak regret and ergodic averages, which do not imply that the final output is a single deployable policy that is near-optimal and nearly feasible. In this work we take a different approach to this problem, and propose Policy Gradient Penalty (PGP) method, a single-loop policy-space method that enforces general convex occupancy-measure constraints via quadratic-penalty regularization. PGP constructs pseudo-rewards that yield gradient estimates of the penalized objective, subsequently exploiting the classical Policy Gradient Theorem. We further establish the regularity of the penalized objective, providing the smoothness properties needed to justify the convergence of PGP. Leveraging hidden convexity and strong duality, we then establish global last-iterate convergence guarantees, attaining an $ε$-optimal constrained entropy value with $ε$-bounded constraint violation despite policy-induced non-convexity. We validate PGP through ablations on a grid-world benchmark and further demonstrate scalability on two challenging continuous-control tasks.
papers.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Policy Gradient Penalty (PGP)：用二次罚函数正则化把状态-动作占用测度的凸约束塞进最大熵探索目标，构造伪奖励得到罚目标梯度估计，再套经典 Policy Gradient Theorem 做单循环策略空间优化。借助 hidden convexity 与 strong duality，得到全局 last-iterate 收敛保证，在策略诱导的非凸性下仍达到 ε-最优约束熵值且约束违反 ≤ ε。
Motivation: 带安全、资源或模仿约束的最大熵探索中，熵最大化缺少可加结构使 Bellman 类方法失效，而策略参数化又让目标与约束都非凸；已有模型-free 策略梯度方法 (Ying et al., 2025) 只能给弱 regret 与遍历平均保证，无法保证最终输出是单个近优且近可行的可部署策略。
Method: PGP 是单循环的策略空间方法：以二次罚正则强制一般凸占用测度约束，构造伪奖励来给出罚目标的梯度估计，随后调用经典 Policy Gradient Theorem；作者证明罚目标的正则性（光滑性）以支撑收敛分析，再用 hidden convexity 与 strong duality 建立全局 last-iterate 收敛保证。
Result: 理论结果：在策略诱导的非凸性下达到 ε-最优约束熵值且约束违反为 ε-界。实验部分为 grid-world 基准上的 ablation，以及两个有挑战的连续控制任务上展示可扩展性。
Conclusion: 罚正则化加 hidden convexity/strong duality 可以绕过策略参数化带来的非凸性，把约束最大熵探索的保证从弱平均量提升为单个近优近可行的最终策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Amortized Optimal Transport from Sliced Potentials
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel amortized optimization method for predicting optimal transport (OT) plans across multiple pairs of measures by leveraging Kantorovich potentials derived from sliced OT. We introduce two amortization strategies: regression-based amortization (RA-OT) and objective-based amortization (OA-OT). In RA-OT, we formulate a functional regression model that treats Kantorovich potentials from the original OT problem as responses and those obtained from sliced OT as predictors, and estimate these models via least-squares methods. In OA-OT, we estimate the parameters of the functional model by optimizing the Kantorovich dual objective. In both approaches, the predicted OT plan is subsequently recovered from the estimated potentials. As amortized OT methods, both RA-OT and OA-OT enable efficient solutions to repeated OT problems across different measure pairs by reusing information learned from prior instances to rapidly approximate new solutions. Moreover, by exploiting the structure provided by sliced OT, the proposed models are more parsimonious, independent of specific structures of the measures, such as the number of atoms in the discrete case, while achieving high accuracy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approaches on tasks including MNIST digit transport, color transfer, supply-demand transportation on spherical data, and mini-batch OT conditional flow matching.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, 25 pages, 11 figures, 10 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 sliced OT 的 Kantorovich 势函数的摊销最优传输 (amortized OT) 预测方法，把 sliced OT 得到的势当作预测量、原 OT 势当作响应，从而跨多对测度快速近似新的 OT plan。RA-OT 用最小二乘拟合函数回归模型，OA-OT 直接优化 Kantorovich 对偶目标，两者恢复出的 OT plan 与测度原子数无关且保持高精度。
Motivation: 重复求解不同测度对之间的 OT 问题代价高，需要复用先前实例学到的信息来快速近似新解；同时希望模型不依赖测度的具体结构（如离散情形的原子数）。
Method: 两种摊销策略：RA-OT 将原 OT 问题的 Kantorovich 势作为响应、sliced OT 得到的势作为预测量，构建函数回归模型并用最小二乘估计；OA-OT 通过优化 Kantorovich 对偶目标来估计函数模型参数；两者都从估计出的势恢复预测的 OT plan。
Result: 在 MNIST 数字传输、颜色迁移、球面数据上的供需运输 (supply-demand transportation on spherical data)，以及 mini-batch OT 条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 等任务上展示了方法有效性；模型更简约、独立于测度结构（离散情形下与原子数无关）并达到高精度。
Conclusion: 利用 sliced OT 提供的结构做摊销，可以在不绑定测度具体结构的前提下高效、准确地求解重复出现的 OT 问题。

papers.title: Rater State Bias in RLHF Preference Data: An Audit Framework
papers.abstract_en: We identify a structured confound in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). Pairwise preference labels are intended to reflect the compared outputs, but they may also reflect the rater's state during annotation. Under sustained stressful or distressing conditions, raters' preferences may shift over time, so that preference data encode rater state alongside judgments about response quality. We argue that, if present, such shifts would differ from ordinary disagreement or random label noise. They would be state dependent, could be shared across annotators under similar conditions, and would not necessarily cancel during aggregation, reward modeling, and policy optimization. We propose rater state shift as a plausible and testable source of structured bias in RLHF preference data. This paper develops a hypothesis and an audit framework for studying this source of bias. We define rater state shift, rater state confound, and correlated rater state bias. We also propose survival level emotional authenticity as a candidate output signature, defined by lexical, pragmatic, discourse, and safety features whose reliability and validity remain to be demonstrated. We show that systematic rater state bias can survive aggregation and may enter the learned reward signal. We state five testable predictions, together with effect size thresholds for an initial audit, and note which require proprietary data. Finally, we present an audit protocol and pilot study plan that can be applied to publicly available instruction tuned models. We do not infer the training history of any specific deployed model.
papers.comment: v3: Refined the mathematical analysis of bias propagation and policy optimization. Extended the discussion to model judges and the possible transmission of preference bias across models. Minor revisions throughout
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出 RLHF 成对偏好标签可能混入标注者在持续压力下的状态偏移 (rater state shift)，这类偏移是状态依赖的、可在相似条件的标注者间共享，且在聚合、奖励建模与策略优化中不会自动抵消，从而进入学到的奖励信号。论文给出 rater state shift / rater state confound / correlated rater state bias 的定义、五条可检验预测及带效应量阈值的审计协议，并提出 survival level emotional authenticity 作为候选输出特征签名。
Motivation: RLHF 偏好数据通常把标注者分歧当作随机噪声处理，但持续压力下的状态依赖偏移是结构化混淆，可能在聚合后残留并污染奖励模型，现有流程缺少识别这类偏移的框架。
Method: 提出一个假设加审计框架：形式化定义 rater state shift、rater state confound、correlated rater state bias，分析偏移如何经聚合与策略优化传播；提出 survival level emotional authenticity（基于词汇、语用、篇章、安全特征）作为候选签名，并给出五条带效应量阈值的预测与可应用于公开 instruction-tuned 模型的审计协议和试点研究方案。
Result: 论证系统性 rater state bias 可在聚合后存活并进入学到的奖励信号；给出五条可检验预测及初始审计用的效应量阈值，其中部分预测需要专有数据；提出可在公开 instruction-tuned 模型上执行的审计协议与试点方案。
Conclusion: 标注者状态偏移是 RLHF 中一种可检验的结构化偏差来源，应作为独立于随机噪声的审计对象；候选签名的信效度仍待验证，且论文不推断任何具体已部署模型的训练历史。

papers.title: Collective Opinion Dynamics in Structured LLM Populations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed as interacting agents in settings such as online platforms, recommendation systems, and multi-agent applications. Understanding the collective behaviors that emerge from their interactions is therefore increasingly crucial, especially as these behaviors may shape public opinion and contribute to polarization. In this work, we investigate how network structure and group composition shape the evolution of opinions in populations of LLM agents engaged in multi-round debates. We generate networks with controlled levels of homophily and varying group sizes, and perform ten independent runs per configuration. The results show that LLM agents exhibit patterns that are highly sensitive to network structure, relative group sizes, and to the model itself. We highlight that even within LLM populations, low homophily facilitates convergence by increasing opportunities for cross-group interaction, whereas higher homophily limits cross-group exposure and can preserve distinct opinion states, consistent with previous research. We further show that the choice of LLM substantially affects the resulting dynamics, with different models exhibiting different patterns of opinion updating under comparable network conditions. At the individual level, providing agents with information about their local neighborhood further modulates opinion transitions, revealing substantial differences between models in their sensitivity to local social context. Overall, our findings show that the collective dynamics of LLM populations arise from interactions among model-specific behavior, network structure, population composition, and local social information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多轮辩论的 LLM 群体中，低同质性 (homophily) 因增加跨组接触而促进观点收敛，高同质性则限制跨组暴露、可保留多个不同观点状态；观点演化对网络结构、群体规模、所用 LLM 模型以及是否提供局部邻域信息都高度敏感。选模型时要把它当作观点动力学的一个自变量，而非可互换的载体。
Motivation: LLM 正被部署为在线平台与多智能体系统中的交互智能体，其集体行为可能塑造舆论并加剧极化，但网络结构与群体构成如何影响 LLM 群体的观点演化尚不清楚。
Method: 构造具有受控同质性水平与不同群体规模的网络，让 LLM 智能体进行多轮辩论，每个配置做 10 次独立运行；并比较不同 LLM 在相同网络条件下的观点更新模式，以及向智能体提供其局部邻域信息这一干预。
Result: LLM 智能体的观点模式对网络结构、相对群体规模和模型本身高度敏感：低同质性促进收敛，高同质性可保留不同观点状态；不同 LLM 在可比网络条件下呈现不同的观点更新模式；提供局部邻域信息会进一步调节观点转移，且各模型对局部社会情境的敏感度差异明显。
Conclusion: LLM 群体的集体动力学由模型特异行为、网络结构、群体构成与局部社会信息共同决定，因此同质性对收敛的作用在 LLM 群体中依然成立，但效应大小随所选模型而变。

papers.title: OntoTKGE: Ontology-Enhanced Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) extrapolation is an important task that aims to predict future facts through historical interaction information within KG snapshots. A key challenge for most existing TKG extrapolation models is handling entities with sparse historical interaction. The ontological knowledge is beneficial for alleviating this sparsity issue by enabling these entities to inherit behavioral patterns from other entities with the same concept, which is ignored by previous studies. In this paper, we propose a novel encoder-decoder framework OntoTKGE that leverages the ontological knowledge from the ontology-view KG (i.e., a KG modeling hierarchical relations among abstract concepts as well as the connections between concepts and entities) to guide the TKG extrapolation model's learning process through the effective integration of the ontological and temporal knowledge, thereby enhancing entity embeddings. OntoTKGE is flexible enough to adapt to many TKG extrapolation models. Extensive experiments on five data sets demonstrate that OntoTKGE not only significantly improves the performance of many TKG extrapolation models but also surpasses many state-of-the-art(SOTA) baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OntoTKGE 用本体视图 KG（ontology-view KG）中的概念层级与概念-实体连接，让稀疏历史交互的实体从同概念实体继承行为模式，从而增强实体嵌入并指导时序知识图谱 (TKG) 外推的编码器-解码器学习。在五个数据集上，它显著提升多种 TKG 外推模型并超过多个 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 多数 TKG 外推模型难以处理历史交互稀疏的实体，而以往研究忽略了本体知识可让这些实体继承同概念实体的行为模式这一途径。
Method: 提出编码器-解码器框架 OntoTKGE，把本体视图 KG（抽象概念间层级关系及概念与实体的连接）中的本体知识与时间知识有效融合，以此增强实体嵌入并引导 TKG 外推模型学习；框架设计为可适配多种现有 TKG 外推模型。
Result: 在五个数据集上的大量实验表明，OntoTKGE 显著提升多种 TKG 外推模型的性能，并超过多个 SOTA 基线方法。
Conclusion: 引入本体知识缓解稀疏实体问题，是可移植到多种 TKG 外推模型并带来一致性能提升的通用增强手段。

papers.title: Suppression Is Not Forgetting: Residual Recoverability in Visual Concept Unlearning for VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) may need to forget visual concepts after deployment because of privacy, copyright, licensing, safety, or policy changes. Conventional machine unlearning modifies model parameters, which may be costly or inaccessible for API-only models. Prompt-based suppression offers a training-free alternative, but does it make a concept inaccessible or merely change the model's answer? We investigate this question in off-the-shelf VLMs. Our visually grounded, multi-probe evaluation first verifies that a model recognizes each concept from the image, then tests its recoverability through multiple-choice, short-answer, and indirect queries. Across objects, scenes, and identities, prompt suppression reduces short-answer recall for some concepts while leaving multiple-choice and indirect performance largely unchanged. Explicitly listing the concepts to suppress often increases short-answer recall, suggesting that the list itself cues the answer. Beyond prompting, decoding constraints, representation editing, and parameter updates can suppress particular responses while the same concept remains detectable through other queries. A model may stop naming a visual concept yet still identify or use it when queried differently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VLM 的提示词式概念遗忘 (prompt-based suppression)，用视觉锚定的多探针评测检验被抑制概念是真不可达还是仅被改写答案：先确认模型仍从图像识别该概念，再用多选、简答、间接三类查询测其可恢复性。结果是提示抑制只降低部分概念的简答召回，多选与间接查询性能基本不变，且显式列出待抑制概念反而常提高简答召回。
Motivation: 部署后的 VLM 因隐私、版权、许可、安全或政策变化需要遗忘视觉概念，而改参数的机器遗忘对仅 API 可用的模型代价高或不可行；提示抑制作为免训练替代，其是否真让概念不可访问尚不清楚。
Method: 在现成 (off-the-shelf) VLM 上提出视觉锚定的多探针评测：先验证模型能从图像识别每个概念，再通过多选题、简答题、间接查询三类探针测概念可恢复性，覆盖物体、场景与身份三类概念；并对照解码约束、表示编辑、参数更新等抑制手段。
Result: 提示抑制在部分概念上降低简答召回，但多选与间接查询性能大体不变；显式列出待抑制概念清单常反而提高简答召回，说明清单本身提示了答案；解码约束、表示编辑与参数更新同样能压住特定回答而概念仍可被其他查询检出。
Conclusion: 模型可以不再说出某个视觉概念，却在换一种问法时仍能识别或使用它，即抑制不等于遗忘；判断遗忘必须用多探针而非单一问答口径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Recorrupt: Noise Distribution Agnostic Self-Supervised Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised image denoising methods have traditionally relied on architectural constraints, pseudo-pair constructions, or specialized loss functions to avoid the trivial identity mapping. Among these, approaches such as Noisier2Noise or R2R create training pairs by adding synthetic noise to noisy images. While effective, these recorruption-based approaches require precise knowledge of the noise distribution, which is often unavailable. We present Learning to Recorrupt (L2R), a self-supervised framework that does not require exact knowledge of the noise distribution. Our method introduces a learnable recorruptor jointly optimized with the denoiser through a min--max saddle-point objective. The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods without prior knowledge of the noise distribution across unconventional and heavy-tailed noise distributions, such as log-gamma and Laplace, as well as spatially correlated noise, while obtaining competitive results on real-world denoising benchmarks characterized by signal-dependent noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Learning to Recorrupt (L2R)：把 recorrupter 作为可学习模块，与去噪网络用 min–max 鞍点目标联合优化，从而在不掌握精确噪声分布的前提下替代 Noisier2Noise / R2R 这类依赖噪声先验的自监督去噪。在 log-gamma、Laplace 等非常规重尾噪声、空间相关噪声上达到
Motivation: Noisier2Noise、R2R 等 recorruption 自监督方法靠给含噪图再加合成噪声构造训练对，但必须精确知道噪声分布，而实际中该分布常不可得。
Method: L2R 引入一个可学习的 recorruptor，与去噪器通过 min–max 鞍点目标联合优化，不再依赖精确噪声分布先验，替代依赖架构约束、伪配对或专用损失的自监督方案。
Result: 在无噪声分布先验的方法中达到 state-of-the-art，覆盖 log-gamma、Laplace 等非常规重尾噪声与空间相关噪声；在以信号依赖噪声为特征的真实去噪基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: 把 recorruption 的加噪过程本身学出来，可以在缺少噪声分布知识时仍保持自监督去噪的有效性，并在重尾与相关噪声下领先同类方法。

papers.title: TabKD: Tabular Knowledge Distillation through Interaction Diversity of Learned Feature Bins
papers.abstract_en: Data-free knowledge distillation enables model compression without original training data, critical for privacy-sensitive tabular domains. However, existing methods does not perform well on tabular data because they do not explicitly address feature interactions, the fundamental way tabular models encode predictive knowledge. We identify interaction diversity, systematic coverage of feature combinations, as an essential requirement for effective tabular distillation. To operationalize this insight, we propose TabKD, which learns adaptive feature bins aligned with teacher decision boundaries, then generates synthetic queries that maximize pairwise interaction coverage. Across 4 benchmark datasets and 4 teacher architectures, TabKD achieves highest student-teacher agreement in 14 out of 16 configurations, outperforming 5 state-of-the-art baselines. We further show that interaction coverage strongly correlates with distillation quality, validating our core hypothesis. Our work establishes interaction-focused exploration as a principled framework for tabular model extraction.
papers.comment: Accepted in 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence IJCAI 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Thirty-Fifth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence 2026 Main Track. Pages 4723-4731
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabKD 在无原始训练数据的表格知识蒸馏中，把「特征交互多样性」作为核心要求：先学习与教师决策边界对齐的自适应特征分箱 (adaptive feature bins)，再生成使成对特征交互覆盖最大化的合成查询。在 4 个基准数据集 × 4 种教师架构共 16 个配置中，TabKD 有 14 个取得最高的学生-教师一致性，超过 5 个 SOTA 基线，且交互覆盖度与蒸馏质量强相关。
Motivation: 隐私敏感的表格场景需要 data-free 知识蒸馏，但现有方法不显式处理特征交互——而这正是表格模型编码预测知识的根本方式，导致无数据蒸馏效果差。
Method: TabKD 分两步：学习与教师决策边界对齐的自适应特征分箱，再基于分箱生成能最大化 pairwise interaction coverage 的合成查询去查询教师；并检验交互覆盖度与蒸馏质量的相关性以验证核心假设。
Result: 在 4 个基准数据集和 4 种教师架构构成的 16 个配置中，TabKD 在 14 个上取得最高的 student-teacher agreement，优于 5 个 state-of-the-art 基线；交互覆盖度与蒸馏质量呈强相关。
Conclusion: 以交互覆盖为导向的合成查询探索是表格模型抽取 (tabular model extraction) 的一个有原则的框架，交互多样性是有效表格蒸馏的必要条件。

papers.title: CIRCLE: A Framework for Evaluating AI from a Real-World Lens
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes CIRCLE, a six-stage, lifecycle-based framework to bridge the reality gap between model-centric performance metrics and AI system outcomes in deployment. Current approaches such as MLOps frameworks and AI model benchmarks offer detailed insights into system stability and model capabilities, but they do not provide decision makers outside the AI stack with systematic evidence of how these systems actually behave in real world contexts or affect their organizations over time. CIRCLE operationalizes the Validation phase of TEVV (Test, Evaluation, Verification, and Validation) by translating priorities of stakeholders outside the stack into measurable signals. Unlike participatory design which often remains localized, or algorithmic audits which are often retrospective, CIRCLE provides a structured, prospective protocol for linking context sensitive qualitative insights to scalable quantitative metrics. By integrating methods such as field testing, red teaming, and longitudinal studies into a coordinated pipeline, CIRCLE produces systematic knowledge; evidence that is comparable across sites yet sensitive to local context. This can enable governance based on materialized downstream effects rather than theoretical capabilities.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Intelligent Systems Conference 2026. In: K. Arai and P. Lorenz (eds.), Intelligent Systems and Applications, LNNS 2075, pp. 737-756, Springer, Cham (2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIRCLE 是一个六阶段、基于生命周期的 AI 评估框架，把 AI 系统在部署中的实际表现与模型中心指标之间的落差补齐：将 AI 栈之外的利益相关者优先事项转成可测量信号，串联 field testing、red teaming、longitudinal studies 形成统一管线，产出跨站点可比但对本地语境敏感的证据，使治理依据落地的下游影响而非理论能力。
Motivation: MLOps 框架与 AI 模型基准只反映系统稳定性与模型能力，栈外决策者拿不到这些系统在真实场景中如何行为、随时间如何影响组织的系统性证据。参与式设计常局限于局部，算法审计多为回溯性，缺少前瞻性的协议把定性洞见与可扩展的定量指标连起来。
Method: CIRCLE 分六个阶段、按 AI 生命周期组织，操作化 TEVV（Test, Evaluation, Verification, and Validation）的 Validation 环节：先翻译栈外利益相关者的优先事项为可测量信号，再把 field testing、red teaming、longitudinal studies 整合进一条协调管线，将语境敏感的定性洞见与可扩展的定量指标对接。
Result: 提出的是框架本身：一个结构化的前瞻性协议，产出跨站点可比、同时对本地语境敏感的系统性证据；摘要给出的量化要素为六阶段生命周期结构与 TEVV Validation 的操作化，未列出实验指标或数据集。
Conclusion: AI 评估应从模型中心指标转向基于部署中物化的下游影响的治理，CIRCLE 提供了把栈外利益相关者关切转成可比证据的前瞻性流程。

papers.title: Vision Wormhole: Latent-Space Communication in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous multi-agent systems combine models with different capabilities through a common communication interface. Exchanging internal states directly requires translating between model-specific representations and controlling intermediate computation. We introduce the Vision Wormhole, which repurposes the visual input interface of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for continuous communication between frozen heterogeneous agents. A Universal Visual Codec encodes each sender's latent rollout into a fixed-size message, maps it through a shared reference space, and decodes received messages into the receiver's image-token span. Per-model codecs and affine reference maps form a hub-and-spoke architecture with $O(N)$ components for $N$ models. Each model learns its codec independently through self-distillation on anchor texts, and shared-anchor alignment enables reuse across communication partners. Across four VLM families, six team configurations, and nine reasoning benchmarks, Vision Wormhole improves accuracy by 6.0 percentage points on average over text-mediated MAS and achieves a 1.69$\times$ geometric-mean speedup in batch-normalized end-to-end runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vision Wormhole 把 VLM 的视觉输入接口改造成异构多智能体的连续隐空间通道：Universal Visual Codec 将发送方 latent rollout 编码为定长消息，经共享参考空间映射后解码进接收方的 image-token span，各模型独立自蒸馏训练。在四个 VLM 家族、六种团队配置、九个推理基准上，相对文本中介的 MAS 平均提升 6.0 个百分点准确率，端到端运行时几何平均加速 1.69×。
Motivation: 异构多智能体要交换内部状态，就得在模型专属表示之间做翻译并控制中间计算；直接传隐状态缺乏通用接口，走文本中介又损失信息并拖慢运行时。
Method: 复用冻结 VLM 的视觉输入接口：Universal Visual Codec 把发送方 latent rollout 压成定长消息，经共享参考空间映射后解码为接收方 image-token span；每个模型配独立 codec 与 affine 参考映射，构成对 N 个模型只需 O(N) 组件的 hub-and-spoke 结构，各 codec 在 anchor texts 上自蒸馏独立学习，shared-anchor alignment 让同一模型可复用于不同通信伙伴。
Result: 在四个 VLM 家族、六种团队配置、九个推理基准上，相对文本中介 MAS 平均准确率提升 6.0 个百分点，批归一化端到端运行时几何平均加速 1.69×。
Conclusion: 冻结的异构 agent 之间可以靠视觉接口做连续隐空间通信，用 O(N) 的 codec 与 affine 映射同时换来准确率与运行时收益，而不必逐对翻译内部表示。

papers.title: Cross-Fitting-Free Debiased Machine Learning with Multiway Dependence
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops an asymptotic theory for two-step debiased machine learning (DML) estimators in generalised method of moments (GMM) models with general multiway clustered dependence, without relying on cross-fitting. While cross-fitting is commonly employed, it can be statistically inefficient and computationally burdensome when first-stage learners are complex and the effective sample size is governed by the number of independent clusters. We show that valid inference can be achieved without sample splitting by combining orthogonal moments with a localisation-based empirical process approach, allowing for an arbitrary number of clustering dimensions. The resulting debiased GMM estimators are shown to be asymptotically linear and asymptotically normal under multiway clustered dependence. A central technical contribution of the paper is the derivation of novel global and local maximal inequalities for empirical processes indexed by general classes of functions for separately exchangeable arrays, which underpin our theoretical arguments and are of independent interest. Python and R packages are available for implementing the proposed procedures.
papers.comment: This paper supersedes the earlier manuscript "Maximal inequalities for separately exchangeable empirical processes" (arXiv:2502.11432)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多维聚类相关结构下的 GMM 两步 DML 估计中，去掉 cross-fitting 仍可得到有效推断：用正交矩条件加基于 localisation 的经验过程方法，允许任意多个聚类维度，估计量渐近线性且渐近正态。核心技术贡献是为 separately exchangeable arrays 上的函数类推导新的全局与局部 maximal inequalities。
Motivation: cross-fitting 在一阶段学习器复杂、有效样本量由独立簇数决定时统计低效且计算负担重；多维聚类依赖下缺少不依赖样本分割的渐近理论。
Method: 在 GMM 模型中结合正交矩条件 (orthogonal moments) 与 localisation-based 经验过程方法，不作 sample splitting，处理任意维数的 multiway clustered dependence；理论建立在为 separately exchangeable arrays 推导的全局与局部 maximal inequalities 之上，并提供 Python 与 R 实现包。
Result: 所得 debiased GMM 估计量在多维聚类依赖下渐近线性且渐近正态，推断有效且无需样本分割；聚类维度数可任意。
Conclusion: 不依赖 cross-fitting 的 DML/GMM 推断在多维聚类依赖下可行，且 separately exchangeable 经验过程的 maximal inequalities 具有独立价值。

papers.title: From Seeds to Semantics: Measuring Semantic Accessibility in Deterministic Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate samples through a sequence of learned denoising steps, and recent work has studied how semantic structure appears along this sampling process. We study this question in deterministic samplers by measuring semantic accessibility: how much information about a final semantic property, such as an image class label or attribute, can be extracted from the seed and intermediate states along the trajectory that produces the sample. Using DDIM sampling, for which each initial noise seed determines a unique trajectory and final image, we train separate classifiers (probes) at several points along the trajectory to predict a semantic property of the final image. We measure how well such a property can be predicted from the state at a given point using top-1 accuracy and normalized mutual information. Across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CelebA, class labels and image attributes can be predicted above chance from the initial noise seed, and along DDIM trajectories, this accessibility exceeds matched-noise forward baselines. We find that semantic accessibility is substantially higher along the trajectories whose final images are classified with high confidence than along those classified with low confidence. These measurements provide a quantitative view of when semantic properties can be recovered during deterministic generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DDIM 确定性采样轨迹上量化语义可及性 (semantic accessibility)：用探针分类器从初始噪声种子与中间状态预测最终图像的类别或属性，发现标签可高于随机水平预测，且沿轨迹的可及性超过匹配噪声的 forward 基线；最终图像被高置信度分类的轨迹，其语义可及性显著高于低置信度轨迹。
Motivation: 已有工作关注语义结构如何在扩散采样过程中出现，但缺少对确定性采样器中「从种子和中间状态能恢复多少最终语义信息」的定量刻画。
Method: 基于 DDIM 采样（每个初始噪声种子唯一确定一条轨迹与最终图像），在轨迹多个时间点分别训练探针分类器预测最终图像的类别标签或属性，用 top-1 accuracy 与 normalized mutual information 度量可及性，并与 matched-noise forward 基线对比。
Result: 在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CelebA 上，类别标签与图像属性均可从初始噪声种子高于随机水平预测；沿 DDIM 轨迹的可及性超过 matched-noise forward 基线；最终图像高置信度分类的轨迹语义可及性显著高于低置信度轨迹。
Conclusion: 确定性扩散生成中语义属性可在采样过程的早期就被恢复，且可及性强弱与最终样本的分类置信度相关，为「何时能恢复语义」提供了定量视角。

papers.title: Zero Sum SVD: Balancing Loss Sensitivity for Low Rank LLM Compression
papers.abstract_en: Advances in large language models have driven strong performance across many tasks, but their memory and compute costs still hinder deployment. SVD-based compression reduces storage and can speed up inference via low-rank factors, yet performance depends on how rank is allocated under a global compression ratio. Prior methods often use homogeneous ranks for similarly sized matrices, despite large differences in loss sensitivity, or rely on expensive iterative pre-truncation optimization to determine per matrix ranks. We propose Zero Sum SVD (ZS-SVD), a post-training method that performs global singular component selection using activation whitening and first-order calibration loss estimates in whitened coordinates. ZS-SVD prunes components across the whole model with a zero sum rule that keeps the cumulative predicted loss change near zero, automatically yielding heterogeneous ranks without solving a rank allocation optimization. Motivated by evidence that gradients near pretrained solutions exhibit low rank structure, we also introduce an optional lightweight correction that applies a single projected gradient update after truncation, followed by re-truncation. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM architectures show consistent gains across diverse benchmarks and compression ratios. Code is available at https://github.com/mint-vu/Zero-Sum-SVD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zero Sum SVD (ZS-SVD) 用激活白化加一阶校准损失估计，在白化坐标下对整个 LLM 做全局奇异成分选择，并按零和规则让累计预测损失变化接近零，从而在不做秩分配优化的情况下自动得到异质秩。在多种 LLM 架构与压缩比上，该方法在各 benchmark 上取得一致增益。
Motivation: SVD 低秩压缩的性能取决于全局压缩比下各矩阵的秩分配，但既有方法对规模相近的矩阵给同质秩、忽略损失敏感度差异，或依赖昂贵的迭代预截断优化。
Method: ZS-SVD 是训练后 (post-training) 方法：用激活白化与一阶校准损失估计在白化坐标下打分奇异成分，再以零和规则 (zero sum rule) 跨全模型剪枝，使累计预测损失变化近零；另可选一个轻量校正——截断后做一次投影梯度更新再重新截断，依据是预训练解附近梯度呈低秩结构。
Result: 在多种 LLM 架构、多个 benchmark 与多种压缩比上取得一致增益；代码发布于 github.com/mint-vu/Zero-Sum-SVD。
Conclusion: 秩分配可以由零和规则自动产生异质秩，无需解显式的秩分配优化，且训练后截断加一次投影梯度校正是可行的补充。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Persistent Tri-State Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: In stochastic message passing, an edge's sampled role changes the node states used to compute adaptive weights at later layers. Weight averaging therefore depends on whether edge roles persist across layers or are resampled at each layer. We study this dependence in Persistent Tri-State Message Passing (P3MP), which combines persistent additive, subtractive, and inactive roles with weights computed from each sample's endpoint states. For two layers, we separate target-state feedback from weight-source covariance and derive the condition under which local and shared weights reverse their preactivation ordering. Shared weights retain a $1/K$ fraction of the feedback for $K$ samples. The interaction is zero for a source-only scorer. Permuting complete weight vectors between samples quantifies the same role-state dependence while preserving their empirical distribution. Exact enumeration and feature-only checkpoint measurements agree with the analytical predictions. Across independently trained feature-only models, local weights yield higher accuracy and lower negative log-likelihood under persistence, while shared weights yield higher accuracy and lower loss under layerwise resampling. The same accuracy ordering holds on deduplicated Chameleon and Squirrel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究随机消息传递中边角色（additive/subtractive/inactive）是否跨层持续对权重平均的影响：P3MP 让边角色持久化、权重由每个样本端点状态计算。两层情形下解析推导出局部权重与共享权重 preactivation 排序反转的条件，共享权重对 K 个样本只保留 1/K 的反馈；持久化时局部权重准确率更高、NLL 更低，逐层重采样时共享权重更优，该排序在去重后的 Chameleon 与 Squirrel 上同样成立。
Motivation: 随机消息传递中边的采样角色会改变后续层计算自适应权重所用的节点状态，因此权重平均的效果取决于角色是跨层持续还是每层重采样，这一依赖此前缺少解析刻画。
Method: 提出 Persistent Tri-State Message Passing (P3MP)，结合持久的加、减、不活跃三种边角色与基于每个样本端点状态的权重；对两层情形把目标状态反馈与权重来源协方差分离，推导局部权重与共享权重 preactivation 排序反转的条件，并用完整权重向量在样本间置换来量化同一角色-状态依赖，同时保持经验分布；以精确枚举和 feature-only checkpoint 测量验证解析预测。
Result: 共享权重对 K 个样本只保留 1/K 的反馈，source-only scorer 下该交互为零；精确枚举与 feature-only checkpoint 测量同解析预测一致；在独立训练的 feature-only 模型上，角色持久化时局部权重准确率更高、负对数似然 (NLL) 更低，逐层重采样时共享权重准确率更高、损失更低；同一准确率排序在去重后的 Chameleon 与 Squirrel 数据集上成立。
Conclusion: 权重平均的优劣由边角色是否跨层持续决定：持久化选局部权重，逐层重采样选共享权重，且这一排序可迁移到去重后的图分类基准。

papers.title: Fooling Algorithms in Non-Stationary Bandits using Belief Inertia
papers.abstract_en: We study worst-case dynamic regret of specific multi-armed bandit algorithms on piecewise-stationary instances with at most one breakpoint. Our constructions exploit belief inertia: observations collected before a change can make an algorithm slow to revise the empirical ordering on which its decisions are based. We first illustrate this mechanism for Explore-Then-Commit, $ε$-greedy, and UCB, for which deterministic one-breakpoint instances can produce linear regret. Our principal result concerns standard sliding-window UCB (SW-UCB), which was designed to forget outdated observations. For every $K\geq 2$ and every window $K\leqτ\leq T$, we prove the finite gap-free lower bound $\frac{1}{20}\min\{T,(K\ln T)^{1/3}T^{2/3}\}$ on its worst-case regret. The proof combines two deterministic obstructions: a stationary small-gap instance that makes repeated forgetting costly, and a one-breakpoint instance that creates a strict post-change index lock. This yields an algorithmic separation. The class with at most one breakpoint admits regret $O(\sqrt{KT\ln(KT)})$, whereas SW-UCB necessarily incurs $Ω((K\ln T)^{1/3}T^{2/3})$ until the linear cap becomes active, regardless of how its window is tuned. Thus, with respect to the horizon, the class admits essentially $T^{1/2}$ regret while SW-UCB necessarily incurs $T^{2/3}$ regret. This shows that the $T^{2/3}$ behavior appearing in gap-free analyses of forgetting policies is not merely an artifact of an upper-bound proof for SW-UCB. The comparison does not resolve the different dependence on $K$ or the logarithmic factors. All constants are explicit, and the SW-UCB proof permits arbitrary non-anticipating randomized tie-breaking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在至多含一个变点的分段平稳多臂老虎机上，用“信念惯性”构造证明滑动窗口 UCB (SW-UCB) 的最坏情形 regret 必然达到 Ω((K ln T)^{1/3}T^{2/3})，而该变点类本身存在 O(√(KT ln(KT))) 的算法，即时域标度上 T^{1/2} 与 T^{2/3} 的分离。
Motivation: 遗忘型策略的 gap-free 分析中出现的 T^{2/3} 上界，究竟是证明技巧的产物还是 SW-UCB 的真实下界，此前没有判定；Explore-Then-Commit、ε-greedy、UCB 在单变点实例上已可产生线性 regret。
Method: 以信念惯性构造确定性实例：一个平稳小间隙实例使反复遗忘付出代价，另一个单变点实例造成变点后严格的 index lock；对 SW-UCB 证明有限的 gap-free 下界，且证明允许任意不预知未来的随机 tie-breaking。
Result: 对任意 K≥2 与 K≤τ≤T，SW-UCB 最坏 regret 下界为 (1/20)·min{T,(K ln T)^{1/3}T^{2/3}}；至多一个变点的类可实现 O(√(KT ln(KT)))，故时域上为 T^{1/2} 对 T^{2/3}；Explore-Then-Commit、ε-greedy、UCB 在确定性单变点实例上可产生线性 regret。
Conclusion: T^{2/3} 不是 SW-UCB 上界证明的伪影，而是遗忘策略的固有代价，且与窗口如何调节无关；该比较不解决 K 的依赖与对数因子的差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data-Efficient Time-Dependent PDE Surrogates: Graph Neural Simulators vs. Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Developing accurate, data-efficient surrogate models is central to advancing AI for Science. Neural operators (NOs), which approximate mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces using conventional neural architectures, have gained popularity as surrogates for systems driven by partial differential equations (PDEs). However, their reliance on large datasets and limited ability to generalize in low-data regimes hinder their practical utility. We argue that these limitations arise from their global processing of data, which fails to exploit the local, discretized structure of physical systems. To address this, we propose Graph Neural Simulators (GNS) as a principled surrogate modeling paradigm for time-dependent PDEs. GNS leverages message-passing combined with numerical time-stepping schemes to learn PDE dynamics by modeling the instantaneous time derivatives. This design mimics traditional numerical solvers, enabling stable long-horizon rollouts and strong inductive biases that enhance generalization. We rigorously evaluate GNS on five canonical PDE systems: (1) 2D scalar Burgers', (2) 2D coupled Burgers', (3) 2D Allen-Cahn, (4) 2D nonlinear shallow water equations, and (5) 2D flow past a cylinder, comparing against SOTA NOs including DeepONet, FNO, and GINO. Results demonstrate that GNS is markedly more data-efficient, achieving less than 1% relative L2 error using only 3% of available trajectories, and exhibits dramatically reduced error accumulation over time (82.5% lower autoregressive error than FNO, 99.9% lower than DeepONet). To choose the training data, we introduce a PCA combined with KMeans trajectory selection strategy. These findings provide compelling evidence that GNS, with its graph-based locality and solver-inspired design, is the most suitable and scalable surrogate modeling framework for AI-driven scientific discovery.
papers.comment: 37 pages including references. Supplementary Information provided
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Graph Neural Simulator (GNS) 作为时变 PDE 代理模型：消息传递学习瞬时时间导数，再接数值时间步进方案推进，模仿传统求解器。在五个二维 PDE 系统上，GNS 只用 3% 轨迹就达到相对 L2 误差低于 1%，自回归误差比 FNO 低 82.5%、比 DeepONet 低 99.9%。
Motivation: 神经算子 (NO) 依赖大数据集且在低数据 regime 泛化差，作者归因于其对数据的全局处理方式，无法利用物理系统局部的离散结构。
Method: GNS 用消息传递结合数值时间步进方案建模瞬时时间导数，从而获得稳定长时程 rollout 与强归纳偏置；训练数据用 PCA 加 KMeans 的轨迹选择策略挑选；对比 DeepONet、FNO、GINO 等 SOTA NO。
Result: 在 2D scalar Burgers'、2D coupled Burgers'、2D Allen-Cahn、2D nonlinear shallow water equations、2D flow past a cylinder 五个系统上，GNS 仅用 3% 可用轨迹即达到相对 L2 误差 <1%；自回归误差比 FNO 低 82.5%、比 DeepONet 低 99.9%。
Conclusion: 基于图的局部性加求解器式设计使 GNS 在数据效率与长时程 rollout 稳定性上优于全局处理的神经算子，作者据此主张其为 AI 驱动科学发现最可扩展的代理建模框架。

papers.title: Cryo-EM as a Stochastic Inverse Problem
papers.abstract_en: Cryo-electron microscopy (Cryo-EM) enables high-resolution imaging of biomolecules, but structural heterogeneity remains a major challenge in 3D reconstruction. Traditional methods assume a discrete set of conformations, limiting their ability to recover continuous structural variability. In this work, we formulate cryo-EM reconstruction as a stochastic inverse problem (SIP) over probability measures, where the observed images are modeled as the push-forward of an unknown distribution over molecular structures via a random forward operator. We pose the reconstruction problem as the minimization of a variational discrepancy between observed and simulated image distributions, using statistical distances such as the KL divergence and the Maximum Mean Discrepancy. The resulting optimization is performed over the space of probability measures via a Wasserstein gradient flow, which we numerically solve using particles to represent and evolve conformational ensembles. We validate our approach using synthetic examples, including a realistic protein model, which demonstrates its ability to recover continuous distributions over structural states. We analyze the connection between our formulation and Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) approaches, which can be interpreted as instances of the discretize-then-optimize (DTO) framework. We further provide a consistency analysis, establishing conditions under which DTO methods, such as MAP estimation, converge to the solution of the underlying infinite-dimensional continuous problem. Beyond cryo-EM, the framework provides a general methodology for solving SIPs involving random forward operators.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 13 figures; supplementary material: 12 pages, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 cryo-EM 三维重构写成概率测度空间上的随机逆问题 (stochastic inverse problem, SIP)：观测图像是未知结构分布经随机前向算子的 push-forward，通过最小化观测与模拟图像分布间的统计距离来恢复连续构象分布。用粒子表示构象系综、以 Wasserstein gradient flow 数值求解，在含真实蛋白模型的合成例子上恢复出连续结构状态分布；并给出 MAP 等 discretize-then-optimize 方法收敛到无穷维连续解的条件。
Motivation: cryo-EM 结构异质性是 3D 重构的主要难题，传统方法假设离散构象集合，无法恢复连续结构变异。
Method: 将重构表述为概率测度上的 SIP，观测建模为未知结构分布经随机前向算子的 push-forward；以 KL divergence、Maximum Mean Discrepancy 等统计距离最小化观测与模拟图像分布的变分差异，在测度空间上用 Wasserstein gradient flow 求解，数值上用粒子表示并演化构象系综；另分析该表述与 MAP 的关系（属 discretize-then-optimize 框架）并给出 DTO 收敛到无穷维连续解的条件。
Result: 在合成例子（含一个真实蛋白模型）上验证方法能够恢复结构状态上的连续分布；给出 DTO/MAP 类方法收敛到无穷维连续问题解的条件的理论分析。
Conclusion: cryo-EM 异质重构可作为测度空间上的 SIP 用分布层面的变分距离求解，且 MAP 等 DTO 方法在给定条件下与连续无穷维解一致；该框架可推广到含随机前向算子的其他 SIP。

papers.title: Implementing Cumulative Functions with Generalized Cumulative Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Modeling scheduling problems with conditional time intervals and cumulative functions has become a common approach when using modern commercial constraint programming solvers. This paradigm enables the modeling of a wide range of scheduling problems, including those involving producers and consumers. However, it is unavailable in existing open-source solvers and practical implementation details remain undocumented. In this work, we present an implementation of this modeling approach using a single, generic global constraint called the Generalized Cumulative. We also introduce a novel timetabling filtering algorithm specifically designed to handle tasks defined on conditional time-intervals. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach, combined with the new filtering algorithm, performs competitively with existing solvers enabling the modeling of producer and consumer scheduling problems and effectively scales to large-scale problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把商业求解器里的条件时间区间与累积函数 (cumulative functions) 建模范式移植到开源约束规划求解器，用单个通用全局约束 Generalized Cumulative 实现，并配套提出一个专为条件时间区间上任务设计的新 timetabling 过滤算法。实验显示该实现与现有支持生产者-消费者调度建模的求解器表现相当，并能扩展到大规模问题。
Motivation: 含生产者与消费者的调度问题普遍依赖条件时间区间加累积函数的建模方式，但这一范式在现有开源求解器中不可用，且实现细节缺乏文档记录。
Method: 以单个通用全局约束 Generalized Cumulative 承载条件时间区间上的累积函数语义，并设计一个针对条件时间区间任务的新 timetabling 过滤算法，二者结合构成完整实现。
Result: 实验结果表明，该实现加新过滤算法在生产者-消费者调度问题上与现有支持此类建模的求解器表现相当 (performs competitively)，并能有效扩展到大规模问题；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 开源求解器可以用一个通用全局约束加专用过滤算法复现商业求解器的条件区间累积建模能力，且在规模上具备实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Geometry of Data
papers.abstract_en: We demonstrate how Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML) encodes data as quantum geometry. In QCML, features of the data are represented by learned Hermitian matrices, and data points are mapped to states in Hilbert space. The quantum geometry description endows the dataset with rich geometric and topological structure---including intrinsic dimension, quantum metric, and Berry curvature---derived directly from the data. QCML captures global properties of data, while avoiding the curse of dimensionality inherent in local methods. The present work provides the first full exposition of QCML as a framework for \emph{matrix geometry}, establishing its mathematical foundation and demonstrating how operator-level tools from quantum geometry can be directly applied to data. We introduce the matrix Laplacian and its eigenmaps as a geometry-preserving alternative to graph-based embeddings, and we show how topological invariants such as Chern numbers can be extracted from data for the first time. An important practical outcome is the efficiency of the representation: high-dimensional datasets can be faithfully modeled with Hilbert spaces of size as small as $N \sim 10$, revealing global structures that are hard to capture with linear methods such as PCA. We illustrate these results on a number of synthetic and real-world examples, including the Wisconsin Breast Cancer dataset, where QCML uncovers geometric separability between benign and malignant samples and yields an interpretable decomposition of feature relevance. The emphasis of this work is on a new geometric representation of data rather than on algorithmic benchmarking, establishing a foundation for extracting global geometric and topological structure from high-dimensional datasets.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 16 figures. Compared to the version 1, expanded analyses and comparisons, particularly for the Wisconsin Breast Cancer dataset; added computational-scaling, stability, and reproducibility results and released supporting data, trained models, and analysis code; clarified the scope of the claims
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QCML 把数据特征学成 Hermitian 矩阵、数据点映射为 Hilbert 空间状态，从而直接从数据导出内禀维数、quantum metric 与 Berry curvature 等几何/拓扑结构。高维数据集只需 N≈10 维的 Hilbert 空间即可忠实建模，并首次从数据中提取 Chern 数等拓扑不变量；在 Wisconsin Breast Cancer 数据集上发现良恶性样本的几何可分性与可解释的特征相关性分解。
Motivation: 局部流形方法受维数灾难限制，难以刻画高维数据的全局几何与拓扑性质；线性方法如 PCA 也难以捕捉这类全局结构。
Method: 提出 Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML) 框架：特征由学习得到的 Hermitian 矩阵表示，数据点映射为 Hilbert 空间状态；引入 matrix Laplacian 及其 eigenmaps 作为保几何的图嵌入替代方案，并从数据中提取 Chern 数等拓扑不变量。在合成数据与真实数据（含 Wisconsin Breast Cancer 数据集）上演示。
Result: 高维数据集可用小至 N≈10 的 Hilbert 空间忠实建模，捕捉线性方法（PCA）难以得到的全局结构；在 Wisconsin Breast Cancer 数据集上发现良恶性样本间的几何可分性，并给出可解释的特征相关性分解；首次从数据中提取 Chern 数等拓扑不变量。
Conclusion: 作者强调本工作核心是新的数据几何表示而非算法基准测试，为从高维数据中提取全局几何与拓扑结构奠定基础；v2 补充了计算扩展性、稳定性与可复现性结果并公开了数据、模型与代码。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Moving Object Detection from Moving Camera Using Focus of Expansion Likelihood and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Separating moving and static objects from a moving camera viewpoint is essential for 3D reconstruction, autonomous navigation, and scene understanding in robotics. Existing approaches often rely primarily on optical flow, which struggle to detect moving objects in complex, structured scenes involving camera motion. To address this limitation, we propose Focus of Expansion Likelihood and Segmentation (FoELS), a method based on the core idea of integrating both optical flow and texture information. FoELS computes the focus of expansion (FoE) from optical flow and derives an initial motion likelihood from the outliers of the FoE computation. This likelihood is then fused with a segmentation-based prior to estimate the final moving probability. The method effectively handles challenges including complex structured scenes, rotational camera motion, and parallel motion. Comprehensive evaluations on the DAVIS 2016 and FBMS-59 datasets, along with real-world traffic videos including parallel, cross-direction, opposite-direction, and crowded scenes, demonstrate its effectiveness and state-of-the-art performance.
papers.comment: 11 pages. Accepted manuscript of the article published in the International Journal of Automation Technology (IJAT), Vol. 20, No. 5, pp. 491-502, 2026
papers.journal_ref: Int. J. Automation Technol., Vol. 20, No. 5, pp. 491-502, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FoELS：由光流计算扩展焦点 (Focus of Expansion)，把 FoE 计算的离群点转成初始运动似然，再与分割先验融合得到最终运动概率，从而在旋转、平行运动和复杂结构场景中分离动/静物体。在 DAVIS 2016、FBMS-59 及真实交通视频上达到 state-of-the-art 表现。
Motivation: 动相机下的动/静物体分离是 3D 重建与自主导航的前提，但现有方法主要依赖光流，在相机运动的复杂结构场景中难以检出运动物体。
Method: FoELS 融合光流与纹理信息：从光流求 FoE，以 FoE 计算的离群点导出初始运动似然，再与基于分割的先验融合估计最终运动概率。
Result: 在 DAVIS 2016 与 FBMS-59 数据集，以及含平行、交叉、对向和拥挤场景的真实交通视频上评测，展示了有效性与 state-of-the-art 表现；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 FoE 离群似然与分割先验结合，可在旋转、平行运动和复杂结构场景下更可靠地分离动/静物体，优于主要依赖光流的既有做法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning Task Mixtures from Task Affinities: A Probabilistic Graphical Model for Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning performance for large language models depends strongly on how training budget is distributed across a heterogeneous set of tasks. In practice, mixtures are often fixed using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant sources. We introduce TaskPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures via an energy-based model over tasks. Tasks form the nodes of a Markov random field: unary potentials capture per-task utility, and pairwise potentials encode inter-task relationships using behavioral divergences computed from predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models (e.g., Jensen--Shannon divergence and pointwise mutual information). Optimizing this objective yields mixtures that balance coverage against redundancy. We show that the resulting set function is weakly submodular under budget constraints, enabling approximation guarantees for discrete selection variants. Across multiple model families (LLaMA-7B, Qwen2-7B) and evaluation suites (BIG-Bench Hard), TaskPGM improves over standard mixing strategies and provides interpretable structure over task interactions.
papers.comment: Some newer results and theoretical analysis changed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaskPGM 用任务间亲和度学连续任务混合比例：把任务当作 Markov random field 的节点，一元势刻画单任务效用，成对势用单任务微调模型预测分布的行为散度（Jensen–Shannon 散度、点互信息）编码任务关系，在预算约束下优化得到兼顾覆盖与冗余的混合。该集合函数被证明在预算约束下弱次模 (weakly submodular)，可为离散选择变体给出近似保证；在 LLaMA-7B、Qwen2-7B 与 BIG-Bench Hard 上优于常规混合策略。
Motivation: LLM 监督微调 (SFT) 的性能强烈依赖训练预算在异构任务间的分配，而实践中常用均匀或按数据量成比例的启发式混合，忽略任务间相互作用，既损害迁移又把预算浪费在冗余任务上。
Method: 提出 TaskPGM：以任务为节点构建 Markov random field 的能量模型，一元势取单任务效用，成对势由单任务微调模型的预测分布计算行为散度（Jensen–Shannon 散度与点互信息）得到；在预算约束下优化该目标学习连续任务混合，使覆盖与冗余平衡，并对离散选择变体给出近似保证。
Result: 在 LLaMA-7B 与 Qwen2-7B 两个模型家族、BIG-Bench Hard 评测集上，TaskPGM 优于标准任务混合策略；理论上证明所得集合函数在预算约束下弱次模，从而对离散选择变体给出近似保证，并给出可解释的任务交互结构。
Conclusion: 用任务间行为散度建模的图模型来学任务混合，比均匀或按规模成比例的启发式更能把微调预算分配到互补而非冗余的任务上，且弱次模性质让离散版本有可证明的近似界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meta-SecAlign: Training LLMs against Prompt Injection for Robust Agents
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection attacks, where untrusted data contains an injected prompt to manipulate the system, have been listed as the top security threat to AI agents. By fine-tuning on simulated prompt injections, SecAlign, a leading open defense, reports LLMs with good test-time robustness and negligible benign utility drop. By scaling up training and evaluations, however, we find that SecAlign actually suffers from significant utility degradation, especially in agentic tasks where the threat of prompt injection is prominent. Motivated by this, we propose Meta-SecAlign for utility-preserving defense by (1) randomized injection position during training to avoid shortcut learning and (2) self-generated responses as high-quality in-distribution training labels. Across general knowledge, instruction following, and agentic workflows (on tool-calling and web-navigation), Meta-SecAlign maintains almost all the undefended LLM's utility while achieving better overall security than SecAlign against various static and GCG adaptive attacks. Experiments use Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Llama-4-Scout, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3.6-27B on 6 prompt injection benchmarks including AgentDojo, InjecAgent, WASP, and SEP. Below are links for the code (https://github.com/facebookresearch/Meta_SecAlign), Meta-SecAlign-70B (https://huggingface.co/facebook/Meta-SecAlign-70B), and Meta-SecAlign-8B (https://huggingface.co/facebook/Meta-SecAlign-8B) models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Meta-SecAlign 用训练时随机化注入位置加自生成回复标签来微调 LLM，使防御在保持未防御模型几乎所有效用的同时，在静态与 GCG 自适应攻击下整体安全性优于 SecAlign。作者发现放大训练与评测后，SecAlign 在 agentic 任务上效用显著下降。
Motivation: SecAlign 作为领先的开放防御，报告测试时鲁棒且良性效用损失可忽略，但放大训练与评测后发现其在 prompt injection 威胁突出的 agentic 任务上效用显著退化。
Method: Meta-SecAlign 在模拟 prompt injection 上微调，采用两项改动：训练时随机化注入位置以避免 shortcut learning，以及用自生成回复作为高质量 in-distribution 训练标签。评测覆盖通用知识、指令遵循与 agentic workflow（tool-calling、web-navigation）。
Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Llama-4-Scout、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3.6-27B 上，于 6 个 prompt injection benchmark（含 AgentDojo、InjecAgent、WASP、SEP）评测：Meta-SecAlign 保持了未防御 LLM 几乎全部效用，且在静态与 GCG 自适应攻击下整体安全性优于 SecAlign；放大规模后 SecAlign 在 agentic 任务上效用显著退化。
Conclusion: 随机化注入位置与自生成标签能把 prompt injection 防御的效用损失压到接近未防御模型，同时安全性超过 SecAlign；SecAlign 的“可忽略效用下降”在放大训练与评测后不成立。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Responsiveness Verification: Will Predictions Change? How Much? How Often?
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are often used in applications where their inputs change due to routine interactions, strategic manipulation, or noise. In such settings, models can undermine safety as these changes can lead them to predict over regions of the input space they have not seen. We propose to address these safety risks by measuring responsiveness---the probability that a model output attains a target prediction under feasible interactions defined by the interaction model. We develop algorithms to estimate responsiveness for any machine learning model, and a framework to specify broad classes of interaction models. We pair these algorithms with statistical guarantees that support practical validation. We demonstrate how our tools can promote safety and reliability across domains by detecting preclusion in recidivism prediction, estimating the cost of gaming in content moderation, and testing the robustness of benchmarks for LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 responsiveness 度量：在给定可行交互模型下，模型输出达到目标预测的概率，并给出适用于任意模型的估计算法与配套统计保证。工具在三个场景落地：检测累犯预测中的 preclusion、估计内容审核中被 gaming 的代价、检验 LLM benchmark 的稳健性。
Motivation: 模型输入会因常规交互、策略性操纵或噪声而变化，使模型在训练未见过的输入区域上做预测，从而损害安全性；现有实践缺少对这种变化下输出改变概率的量化手段。
Method: 定义 responsiveness 为在交互模型定义的可行交互下模型输出达到目标预测的概率；开发面向任意机器学习模型的估计算法，并给出一个可指定广泛交互模型类别的框架，配套支持实际验证的统计保证。
Result: 在累犯预测中用该工具检测 preclusion，在内容审核中估计 gaming 的成本，在 LLM benchmark 上检验其稳健性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把输入变化下的输出响应概率化并配以统计保证，可以在多个应用领域支撑安全性和可靠性的检验。

papers.title: From Laboratory to Real World: A New Benchmark Towards Privacy-Preserved Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Aiming to match pedestrian images captured under varying lighting conditions, visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) has drawn intensive research attention and achieved promising results. However, in real-world surveillance contexts, data is distributed across multiple devices/entities, raising privacy and ownership concerns that make existing centralized training impractical for VI-ReID. To tackle these challenges, we propose L2RW, a benchmark that brings VI-ReID closer to real-world applications. The rationale of L2RW is that integrating decentralized training into VI-ReID can address privacy concerns in scenarios with limited data-sharing regulation. Specifically, we design protocols and corresponding algorithms for different privacy sensitivity levels. In our new benchmark, we ensure the model training is done in the conditions that: 1) data from each camera remains completely isolated, or 2) different data entities (e.g., data controllers of a certain region) can selectively share the data. In this way, we simulate scenarios with strict privacy constraints which is closer to real-world conditions. Intensive experiments with various server-side federated algorithms are conducted, showing the feasibility of decentralized VI-ReID training. Notably, when evaluated in unseen domains (i.e., new data entities), our L2RW, trained with isolated data (privacy-preserved), achieves performance comparable to SOTAs trained with shared data (privacy-unrestricted). We hope this work offers a novel research entry for deploying VI-ReID that fits real-world scenarios and can benefit the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: L2RW 把可见光-红外行人重识别 (VI-ReID) 从集中式训练改成联邦式去中心化训练，按隐私敏感度设计两档协议：各摄像头数据完全隔离，或不同数据实体选择性共享。在未见域（新数据实体）上，仅用隔离数据训练的 L2RW 达到与共享数据训练的 SOTA 相当的性能，说明隐私受限条件下去中心化 VI-ReID 可行。
Motivation: 真实监控数据分散在多设备/多实体，隐私与数据归属限制使集中式训练在 VI-ReID 中不可行，而现有方法都假设数据可集中共享。
Method: 提出 L2RW 基准：设计针对不同隐私敏感度的协议与对应算法，规定训练在各摄像头数据完全隔离、或数据实体可选择性共享两种条件下进行；训练时采用多种 server-side 联邦算法 (federated algorithms)。
Result: 多种 server-side 联邦算法的实验表明去中心化 VI-ReID 训练可行；在未见域（新数据实体）评测中，仅用隔离数据（隐私保护）训练的 L2RW 性能与用共享数据（无隐私限制）训练的 SOTA 相当。
Conclusion: 在严格隐私约束下，去中心化的 VI-ReID 训练可以逼近集中式 SOTA，为真实场景部署 VI-ReID 提供可行路径。

papers.title: Bias-variance decompositions: the exclusive privilege of Bregman divergences
papers.abstract_en: Bias-variance decompositions are widely used to understand the generalization performance of machine learning models. While the squared error loss permits a straightforward decomposition, other loss functions - such as zero-one loss or $L_1$ loss - either fail to sum bias and variance to the expected loss or rely on definitions that lack the essential properties of meaningful bias and variance. Recent research has shown that clean decompositions can be achieved for the broader class of Bregman divergences, with the cross-entropy loss as a special case. However, the necessary and sufficient conditions for these decompositions remain an open question. In this paper, we address this question by studying continuous, nonnegative loss functions that satisfy the identity of indiscernibles (zero loss if and only if the two arguments are identical), under mild regularity conditions. We prove that so-called $g$-Bregman or rho-tau divergences are the only such loss functions that have a clean bias-variance decomposition. A $g$-Bregman divergence can be transformed into a standard Bregman divergence through an invertible change of variables. This makes the squared Mahalanobis distance, up to such a variable transformation, the only symmetric loss function with a clean bias-variance decomposition. Consequently, common metrics such as zero-one and $L_1$ losses cannot admit a clean bias-variance decomposition, explaining why previous attempts have failed. We also examine the impact of relaxing the restrictions on the loss functions and how this affects our results.
papers.comment: v5: Corrected boundary and dual-space convexity assumptions in Section 4 (Theorems 8, 9, Corollary 10, Lemma 11) and updated Acknowledgments

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在连续、非负且满足同一性公理的损失函数中，只有 g-Bregman（rho-tau）散度具备干净的偏差-方差分解，且经可逆变量变换即标准 Bregman 散度；由此平方 Mahalanobis 距离是唯一具此性质的对称损失，0-1 与 L1 损失不可能有干净分解。
Motivation: 平方误差之外的损失（0-1、L1）要么偏差与方差加不回期望损失，要么定义缺乏良定义偏差方差的必要性质；此前只有 Bregman 散度可分解的充分性结果，充要条件是公开问题。
Method: 在温和正则条件下研究连续、非负、满足同一性公理的损失函数，证明 g-Bregman / rho-tau 散度是唯一具干净偏差-方差分解者，并考察放松损失函数限制对结论的影响；v5 修正了第 4 节的边界与对偶空间凸性假设（Theorems 8, 9, Corollary 10, Lemma 11）。
Result: 给出充要条件的刻画性定理：g-Bregman 散度是唯一具干净分解的此类损失，经可逆变量变换等价于标准 Bregman 散度，从而平方 Mahalanobis 距离是唯一对称的此类损失；0-1 与 L1 损失被排除，解释了以往失败尝试。
Conclusion: 干净的偏差-方差分解是 Bregman 型散度的排他性质，选损失函数时若要可加分解就只能落在这一类里。

papers.title: Learning Nonlinear Finite Element Solution Operators using Multilayer Perceptrons and Energy Minimization
papers.abstract_en: We develop and evaluate a method for learning solution operators to nonlinear problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). The approach is based on a finite element discretization and aims at representing the solution operator by a multilayer perceptron (MLP) that takes problem data variables as input and gives a prediction of the finite element solution as output. The variables will typically correspond to parameters in a parametrization of input data such as boundary conditions, coefficients, and right-hand sides. The output will be an approximation of the corresponding finite element solution, thus enabling support and enhancement by the standard finite element method (FEM) both theoretically and practically. We focus on using the corresponding energy functional to a PDE as the loss function since this allows us formulate efficient parallelizable training algorithms based on assembling the energy locally on each element. For large problems, the learning process can thus be made more efficient by using only a small fraction of randomly chosen elements in the mesh in each iteration. The method is evaluated on several relevant test cases, where learning the finite element solution operator turns out to be beneficial, both in its own right but also by combination with standard FEM theory and software.
papers.comment: Author's Accepted Manuscript (AAM) of article published in SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing. 30 pages, 11 figures (26 subfigures in total)
papers.journal_ref: M. G. Larson, C. Lundholm, and A. Persson, Learning Nonlinear Finite Element Solution Operators Using Multilayer Perceptrons and Energy Minimization, SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing, 48 (2026), C1192-C1219
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 MLP 学习非线性 PDE 的有限元解算子：以 PDE 对应的能量泛函作损失，按单元局部组装，训练时每次只随机取网格的一小部分单元，使大规模问题的训练可并行且更省。在多个测试算例上，学习到的有限元解算子单独使用以及与标准 FEM 理论和软件结合都显示出收益。
Motivation: 非线性 PDE 的解算子难以显式写出，逐次求解有限元问题代价高；需要一种以问题数据（边界条件、系数、右端项）为输入、直接给出有限元解的可学习表示，并能与现有 FEM 框架衔接。
Method: 在有限元离散基础上训练一个 MLP：输入为参数化的数据变量（边界条件、系数、右端项），输出为有限元解的近似。损失函数取 PDE 对应的能量泛函，按单元在每个网格单元上局部组装，从而得到可并行的训练算法；大规模问题每次迭代只使用网格中随机选取的一小部分单元。
Result: 在若干相关测试算例上评估该方法，学习有限元解算子被证明是有益的——既可单独使用，也可与标准 FEM 理论和软件结合使用；摘要未给出具体误差或加速数值。
Conclusion: 以能量泛函为损失、按单元局部组装并随机抽样单元训练 MLP，可以学到可用于替代或增强标准 FEM 的非线性 PDE 解算子。

papers.title: Estimating the Causal Effects of T Cell Receptors
papers.abstract_en: A central question in human immunology is how a patient's T cell receptors impacts disease. Here, we introduce a method to infer the causal effects of T cell receptor (TCR) sequences on patient outcomes using observational TCR sequencing data and clinical outcomes data. Our approach corrects for unobserved confounders, such as a patient's environment and life history, using the patient's pre-selection TCR repertoire. This pre-selection repertoire is generated by a programmed stochastic recombination process, V(D)J recombination, which provides a natural experiment. We first derive a causal identification result that leverages biological theory to semiparametrically constrain a hierarchical causal model, enabling causal inference. We then develop a causal estimation strategy that uses permutation invariant neural networks and representation learning to scale to millions of sequences from hundreds of patients. Given sequence data, our method produces an estimate of the effect of interventions that add a specific TCR sequence to patient repertoires. On semisynthetic data, we demonstrate that our method can correct for unobserved confounding. We use it to analyze the effects of TCRs on COVID-19 severity, uncovering potentially therapeutic TCRs that are (1) observed in patients, (2) bind SARS-CoV-2 antigens in vitro and (3) have strong positive effects on clinical outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从观察性 TCR 测序与临床结局数据推断 TCR 序列对患者结局因果效应的方法：用患者 V(D)J 重排产生的 pre-selection repertoire 作为自然实验，纠正环境与生活史等未观测混杂。在半合成数据上该方法能纠正未观测混杂，并用于分析 TCR 对 COVID-19 严重程度的效应，找出同时满足在患者中被观测到、体外结合 SARS-CoV-2 抗原、且对临床结局有强正效应的潜在治疗性 TCR。
Motivation: 人类免疫学的核心问题是 TCR 序列如何影响患者疾病，但观察性 TCR 测序数据中患者环境与生活史等未观测混杂使因果效应无法直接识别。
Method: 利用 V(D)J 程控随机重联生成的 pre-selection repertoire 作为自然实验，先结合生物学理论对层级因果模型做半参数约束以得到因果识别结果，再用置换不变神经网络与表示学习构建因果估计策略，扩展到数百名患者的数百万条序列。
Result: 在半合成数据上证明该方法能纠正未观测混杂；应用于 COVID-19 严重程度分析，得到加入特定 TCR 序列到患者 repertoire 的干预效应估计，并找出三条件同时满足的潜在治疗性 TCR：在患者中被观测、体外结合 SARS-CoV-2 抗原、对临床结局有强正效应。
Conclusion: 借助 V(D)J 重排这一天然实验可以对 TCR 序列的因果效应做半参数识别与规模化估计，从而从观察性数据中筛出有治疗潜力的 TCR。

papers.title: Hybrid Feature Learning for Handwriting Verification
papers.abstract_en: We propose an effective Hybrid Deep Learning (HDL) architecture for the task of determining the probability that a questioned handwritten word has been written by a known writer. HDL is an amalgamation of Auto-Learned Features (ALF) and Human-Engineered Features (HEF). To extract auto-learned features we use two methods: First, Two Channel Convolutional Neural Network (TC-CNN); Second, Two Channel Autoencoder (TC-AE). Furthermore, human-engineered features are extracted by using two methods: First, Gradient Structural Concavity (GSC); Second, Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT). Experiments are performed by complementing one of the HEF methods with one ALF method on 150000 pairs of samples of the word "AND" cropped from handwritten notes written by 1500 writers. Our results indicate that HDL architecture with AE-GSC achieves 99.7% accuracy on seen writer dataset and 92.16% accuracy on shuffled writer dataset which out performs CEDAR-FOX, as for unseen writer dataset, AE-SIFT performs comparable to this sophisticated handwriting comparison tool.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented in International Conference on Frontiers in Handwriting Recognition (ICFHR) 2018
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合深度学习 (HDL) 架构做笔迹验证：判定被检手写词出自已知书写者的概率，把自动学习特征 (ALF：TC-CNN、TC-AE) 与人工设计特征 (HEF：GSC、SIFT) 两两组合。在 1500 位书写者手写笔记中裁出的 150000 对单词 "AND" 样本上，AE-GSC 在 seen writer 上达 99.7% 准确率、shuffled writer 上 92.16%，超过 CEDAR-FOX；unseen writer 上 AE-SIFT 与该工具相当。
Motivation: 手写笔迹验证需要在书写者未见过的情况下判定词是否出自同一人，纯自动特征或纯人工特征都难以同时覆盖 seen、shuffled、unseen 三种书写者场景。
Method: HDL 把一种 HEF 方法与一种 ALF 方法拼接：ALF 侧用 Two Channel CNN (TC-CNN) 或 Two Channel Autoencoder (TC-AE) 自动提取特征，HEF 侧用 Gradient Structural Concavity (GSC) 或 SIFT；实验在 150000 对裁自 1500 位书写者笔记的 "AND" 单词样本上进行。
Result: AE-GSC 在 seen writer 数据集上准确率 99.7%，在 shuffled writer 数据集上 92.16%，均超过 CEDAR-FOX；在 unseen writer 数据集上 AE-SIFT 表现与 CEDAR-FOX 相当。
Conclusion: 自动学习特征与人工设计特征的混合在笔迹验证上有效，AE-GSC 适合 seen 与 shuffled 书写者场景，unseen 书写者则由 AE-SIFT 更接近专业笔迹比对工具的水平。
Relevance: 1
