papers.title: Risk-Controlled Selective LLM Answering by Pricing Label-Free Checks
papers.abstract_en: Serving an answer from a large language model requires deciding when to abstain, yet a verifier's ranking accuracy alone does not determine the error rate among served answers. We introduce PriceCheck, which builds a compact family of decision rules from label-free checks such as re-solving a problem. Each check has a price: its agreement rates on correct and incorrect answers and its cost per run. Prices fitted on a small, class-enriched labelled set compose into predictions of a schedule's coverage and cost, guiding which checks to run and when to stop. A calibration test then selects a schedule at a stated selective-risk target. In mathematics, the selected schedules serve 76.1% of answers on average and keep held-out selective risk below 1.5% on all 15 splits. Under the shared testing protocol, PriceCheck serves more answers at that target than reward models, a prompted judge, the generator's confidence and a trained correctness classifier. At matched coverage, it keeps the fewest wrong answers among these scorers. Across 118 diagnostic schedules, price-based coverage predictions have a rank correlation of 0.97 with observed coverage. These results show that choosing how checks are combined and stopped matters alongside how well a verifier ranks answers. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PriceCheck.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. Dongyub Jude Lee and Jungseob Lee contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PriceCheck：把「重新解题」等无标签检查按其在正确/错误答案上的同意率与单次成本定价，在小规模类别增强的有标签集上拟合出覆盖-成本预测，再用校准检验在给定 selective-risk 目标下选出检查调度。数学任务上所选调度平均服务 76.1% 的答案，15 个 split 上留出 selective risk 全部低于 1.5%，且在同目标下比 reward model、prompted judge、生成器置信度和训练的正确性分类器服务更多答案。
Motivation: LLM 服务中何时弃答取决于被服务答案的错误率，而 verifier 的排序准确率本身并不决定该错误率；缺少把检查的收益与成本一起纳入的调度选择方法。
Method: PriceCheck 从无标签检查（如重新解题）构造一族紧凑决策规则，每项检查有价格：在正确与错误答案上的同意率、单次运行成本；在小规模类别增强的有标签集上拟合价格，组合预测某调度的覆盖率与成本，再由校准检验在给定 selective-risk 目标下选出调度，决定跑哪些检查、何时停止。
Result: 数学任务中所选调度平均服务 76.1% 的答案，15 个 split 的留出 selective risk 全部低于 1.5%；在共享测试协议下，同目标比 reward models、prompted judge、生成器置信度与训练的正确性分类器服务更多答案，同覆盖率下错答最少；118 个诊断调度上，价格预测覆盖率与实测覆盖率的秩相关为 0.97。
Conclusion: 如何组合并停止检查与 verifier 排序能力同等重要：按价格组合检查即可在给定风险目标下改善服务覆盖率与错答数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FORUM: Frozen Outputs Reconciled Using Model Agreement for Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now solve standard referring expression comprehension with a single prompted call, yet on adversarial benchmarks with same-category distractors and negation, even the largest models are confidently wrong, and resampling repeats the error. Models built from different data and architectures rarely fall for the same confounder, so their agreement is a strong label-free signal of the correct target. We present FORUM, a training-free test-time fusion of frozen MLLMs guided by two fixed geometric rules: agreement-based selection keeps the region supported by the most distinct models, and medoid localization returns an actual member box instead of a coordinate average, so one loose prediction cannot shift the answer. Fusing three open MLLMs, FORUM surpasses the 397B-parameter published reference by a relative 5% in mean accuracy on the adversarial Ref-Adv-s benchmark, and a plain averaging ensemble by 15%. The gains transfer to standard RefCOCO+, and a balanced lineup with no dominant member still surpasses the 397B model by 5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FORUM 用两条固定几何规则在测试时融合三个冻结 MLLM 的框预测：按支持模型数选区域、取 medoid 框而非坐标平均。在对抗性 Ref-Adv-s 上平均准确率相对 397B 参考模型高 5%、比普通平均集成高 15%，且无主导成员的均衡阵容仍高 5%。
Motivation: 在含同类别干扰物与否定表达的对抗性指代表达理解 (referring expression comprehension) 上，即便最大的冻结 MLLM 也会自信答错，且重采样会重复同一错误；不同数据与架构的模型很少被同一混淆项骗到。
Method: 训练无关的测试时融合 (training-free test-time fusion)：agreement-based selection 保留被最多不同模型支持的区域，medoid localization 返回真实成员框而非坐标平均，避免单个松散预测拉偏答案；融合三个开源 MLLM。
Result: 在对抗性 Ref-Adv-s 上平均准确率相对已发表的 397B 参数参考模型提升 5%，相对普通平均集成提升 15%；增益迁移到标准 RefCOCO+；无主导成员的均衡阵容仍比 397B 模型高 5%。
Conclusion: 冻结 MLLM 之间的模型间一致性是无需标签的正确目标信号，用几何规则做测试时融合即可超过单个 397B 级模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching for Precipitation Nowcasting
papers.abstract_en: Precipitation nowcasting, generating future radar fields from past observations, is critical for flood warning and disaster response. It is also a demanding benchmark for spatiotemporal generative modeling, with chaotic dynamics, heavy-tailed intensities, and rare high-intensity structures that matter most. Deterministic models minimize a pixel loss and are driven toward the conditional mean, which blurs exactly those structures, while generative models that add a stochastic residual on top of a deterministic backbone inherit the same blur. We propose Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM), a conditional flow-map model that decouples predictable advection from uncertain small-scale detail. A frozen Lagrangian advection prior transports the radar field and supplies an explicit motion forecast, and a flow-map generative head, conditioned on the past frames and the prior rollout rather than summed onto it, produces sharp stochastic detail in four sampling steps. The prior serves only as guidance, so the head replaces blurred structure instead of inheriting it. Extensive experiments on four radar benchmarks show that PG-FMM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on 18 of 24 metrics, with the largest gains at heavy-rain thresholds, where the critical success index improves by up to 58.9%. The project page can be found at https://neurogica.github.io/PG-FMM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM)：用冻结的 Lagrangian 平流先验给出显式运动预报，flow-map 生成头以过去帧和先验 rollout 为条件生成随机细节，而非在其上叠加残差，从而避免确定性模型的条件均值模糊。在四个雷达基准上，24 项指标中 18 项超过 SOTA，强降水阈值上 CSI 最高提升 58.9%。
Motivation: 降水临近预报中确定性模型最小化像素损失被拉向条件均值，模糊了最关键的稀有强降水结构；在确定性骨干上加随机残差的生成模型继承同样的模糊。
Method: PG-FMM 是条件 flow-map 模型，将可预报平流与不确定小尺度细节解耦：冻结的 Lagrangian advection prior 输运雷达场并给出显式运动预报，flow-map 生成头以过去帧和先验 rollout 为条件（而非叠加），四步采样生成锐利随机细节；先验仅作引导，头部替换模糊结构。
Result: 在四个雷达基准上，PG-FMM 在 24 项指标中的 18 项优于 SOTA 方法，最大增益出现在强降水阈值，critical success index (CSI) 最高提升 58.9%。
Conclusion: 把平流先验作为引导而非叠加基底，可让生成头替换模糊结构，从而在强降水阈值上显著改善降水临近预报的锐度与命中率。
Relevance: 94

papers.title: PoE-Fuse: Precision-Weighted Expert Fusion for Bi-Temporal Change Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Bi-temporal change understanding, which localizes and characterizes what changed between two satellite images, is central to disaster response and environmental monitoring, spanning change detection, building localization, and damage assessment. Strong vision-language models address these tasks, but adapting them typically requires full fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, which is costly and unstable. We propose PoE-Fuse, a parameter-efficient framework that instead composes frozen foundation experts for geometry, grounding, and language, resampling their features onto a shared spatial grid and training only a lightweight fusion trunk. PoE-Fuse treats the aligned features as Gaussian observations of a latent scene state and fuses them by learned per-cell precision. This product-of-experts estimator strictly generalizes uniform summation and scalar gating, and extends to change fields by composing the precisions of the two timestamps. A single shared trunk solves the three tasks at once, reaching a mean F1 of 59.2%, compared with 40.7% for an instruction-tuned temporal vision-language assistant, and surpassing dedicated change-detection models retrained under the same protocol and training budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PoE-Fuse 把冻结的几何、grounding、语言三个基础模型的特征重采样到共享空间网格，按每像元学得的 precision（高斯观测的精度权重）做 product-of-experts 融合，只训练一个轻量 fusion trunk。两个时相的 precision 直接相乘即可扩展到变化场，单个共享 trunk 同时解 change detection、building localization、damage assessment 三个任务，mean F1 达 59.2%，而指令微调的时序 vision-language 助手为 40.7%。
Motivation: 用 VLM 做双时相变化理解通常要全量微调或强化学习，成本高且训练不稳定；三个任务往往还要各训一个模型。
Method: 冻结 geometry、grounding、language 三个 foundation expert，把各自特征重采样到共享空间网格；将对齐后的特征视为潜在场景状态的高斯观测，用学习到的 per-cell precision 做 product-of-experts 估计，双时相情形下组合两个时间戳的 precision；仅训练一个轻量 fusion trunk，三个任务共享同一 trunk。
Result: 单个共享 trunk 在三个任务上 mean F1 59.2%，对比指令微调的时序 vision-language 助手 40.7%；在同一训练协议与训练预算下重训练的专用 change-detection 模型也被超过。
Conclusion: 按 per-cell precision 组合冻结专家严格推广了均匀求和与标量 gating，使参数高效融合足以同时覆盖三类双时相变化任务，无需全量微调或 RL。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: A probability used for a decision should refer to the same event across equivalent requests. We introduce probability contracts, a benchmark connecting exact finite-world posteriors, validated event transformations, and failure-aware decision evaluation. Four model-interface configurations are evaluated on 1,000 worlds. Their assessments differ across accuracy, coherence, and decision loss: Kev has lower aggregate canonical posterior error than Jev, but larger complement and coarsening residuals, with accuracy ordering varying by stratum. Jev's Event and Choice interfaces induce different binary actions on 32.8% of valid pairs at defer cost 0.10. A post-hoc analysis finds that disagreement certifies only 11-52% of mean binary pair error across configurations. An elementary action-region characterization explains when averaging changes decision loss relative to randomly selecting one interface. Although averaging cannot worsen that baseline's expected Brier score, its decision effect depends on the cost and crossed boundaries; the observed same-baseline penalties occur in configurations already worse than always deferring. The benchmark makes these distinctions measurable without treating consistency as accuracy or a score improvement as a decision guarantee.
papers.comment: Research preprint; includes proofs and supplementary analyses
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出概率契约 (probability contracts) 基准，把有限世界精确后验、经验证的事件变换与失败感知决策评估绑在一起，衡量 LLM 接口输出的概率是否指向同一事件。在 1,000 个世界上评测四种模型-接口配置：Kev 的整体规范后验误差低于 Jev，但补与粗化残差更大；Jev 的 Event 与 Choice 接口在 32.8% 有效配对上给出不同二元动作（defer 代价 0.10）。事后分析显示分歧只能认证平均二元配对误差的 11–52%。
Motivation: 同一请求的等价改写应得到指向同一事件的概率，但 LLM 接口在准确性、一致性与决策损失上互相矛盾，且一致性常被误当作准确性或决策保证。
Method: 基准连接三部分：有限世界的精确后验、经验证的事件变换 (validated event transformations)、失败感知决策评估；评测四种模型-接口配置，含 Kev/Jev 规范后验与 Event/Choice 接口，并给出动作区域刻画解释接口平均相对随机选一接口的决策损失变化。
Result: 在 1,000 个世界、四种配置上：Kev 整体规范后验误差低于 Jev，但补与粗化残差更大，准确率排序随分层变化；Jev 的 Event 与 Choice 接口在 32.8% 有效配对上诱导不同二元动作（defer 代价 0.10）；事后分析中分歧仅认证平均二元配对误差的 11–52%；平均不会恶化该基线的期望 Brier 分数，但决策效应取决于代价与跨越的边界，同基线惩罚只出现在本就差于始终 defer 的配置。
Conclusion: 一致性不等于准确性，分数提升也不等于决策保证；接口平均的决策效果由代价与动作边界决定，只有在已劣于始终 defer 的配置中才出现同基线惩罚。

papers.title: Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence: Detecting Evidence Gaps Before Generation in RAG
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external sources, but retrieved passages often name the right entities without providing the facts needed to answer. Even when instructed to abstain, 12 generators answer 40.0-99.3% of insufficient-evidence questions. Training generators to abstain ties the decision to model weights, may reward answers recalled from parametric knowledge, and still requires a full generator call. Can sufficiency be judged from the question and evidence alone, before any answer exists? We identify pitfalls in constructing insufficient-evidence tests: removing relevant evidence or pairing evidence with unrelated questions can reveal labels through lexical overlap or evidence position. We build a paired benchmark using substitution, deletion, and question-swap constructions that vary answer support while controlling selected surface features, such as word use. Sufficiency can be judged without generating an answer, but no single signal works across all datasets. We introduce RINSE (Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence), which combines three signals: whether every part of the question is covered, whether any passage offers an answer, and whether a small language model reading the passages together judges them sufficient. Across six datasets, RINSE ranks sufficient above insufficient evidence with a score of 0.837 (chance 0.5), exceeding the best of 10 prior methods (0.746) and a frontier model queried through an API (0.784). Its weakest dataset scores higher than any other method's weakest (0.684 vs. 0.676). RINSE runs locally before generation, taking 36.5 ms per question on a single GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RINSE 在 RAG 生成前只用问题与检索证据判断证据是否充分，组合三个信号：问题各部分是否被覆盖、是否有段落给出答案、小模型通读段落后的充分性判断。在六个数据集的配对基准上排序得分 0.837（随机 0.5），超过 10 个既有方法中最好的 0.746 与经 API 查询的前沿模型 0.784，单 GPU 每问题 36.5 ms。
Motivation: 检索段落常命中正确实体却缺回答所需事实，12 个生成器在证据不足问题上仍有 40.0-99.3% 直接作答；靠训练让生成器弃答把决定绑在权重上、可能奖励参数记忆、且仍需完整生成调用。
Method: 用替换、删除、问题交换三种构造配对基准，在控制词面特征的同时改变答案支撑；RINSE 融合三个信号——问题逐部分覆盖、任一段落是否提供答案、小语言模型通读段落后的充分性判断，在生成前本地判定。
Result: 六个数据集上 RINSE 排序得分 0.837（chance 0.5），高于最优既有方法 0.746 与前沿模型 API 查询 0.784；最弱数据集 0.684，高于其他方法最弱值 0.676；单 GPU 每问题 36.5 ms。12 个生成器在证据不足问题上作答率 40.0-99.3%。
Conclusion: 证据充分性可在答案生成前仅凭问题与证据判定，但没有单一信号在所有数据集上通用，因此需要多信号组合；判定在生成前本地完成，无需完整生成调用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Event-Only Wingbeat Counting under Camera Motion: A Controlled MuJoCo Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Counting completed wingbeats requires identifying individual cycles, including during frequency changes and pauses; estimating a dominant frequency alone is insufficient. Camera motion further mixes target and background brightness changes in event observations. We present a controlled MuJoCo benchmark that separates motion training from event-only image translation compensation. The acquisition contains 324 streams from 24 independent scenes, three flapping geometries, two distances (1.5 and 3.0 m), and static, moderate-motion and stronger-motion views. Fifteen scenes are used for fitting, three for validation and six for held-out testing. A fixed causal temporal convolutional network is evaluated in a matched 2 x 2 ablation with three initialization seeds and compared with ridge, Fourier, autocorrelation and an adapted EEPPR baseline. Under moderate motion, paired motion training reduces count mean absolute error from 31.130 to 3.185 cycles at 1.5 m and from 42.019 to 5.444 at 3.0 m. Adding the tested compensation increases these errors to 4.630 and 10.185, respectively. A Fourier baseline achieves 0.944 cycles at 1.5 m under moderate motion, showing that the neural model is not uniformly best. We report exact-count accuracy and temporally matched cycle F1 alongside count error. These findings support motion-aware training in this small synthetic benchmark, while exposing limits of simple event-background stabilization. They do not establish real-sensor performance, aerodynamic flight, or generalization to unseen vehicle types.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Controlled simulation study with an ideal contrast-event sensor. Follow-up to arXiv:2609.17308 using new event-only acquisitions and a motion ablation protocol
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MuJoCo 受控仿真中做仅事件相机 (event-only) 的振翅计数，发现配对运动训练把中等运动下的计数 MAE 从 31.130 降到 3.185 周期（1.5 m）、从 42.019 降到 5.444（3.0 m），而叠加所测的事件背景补偿反而把误差抬到 4.630 与 10.185。结论是小规模合成基准上应做 motion-aware 训练而非依赖简单事件背景稳定化，且 Fourier 基线在 1.5 m 中等运动下 0.944 周期优于神经模型。
Motivation: 振翅计数需要识别单个周期而非仅估主频，而相机运动把目标与背景亮度变化混进事件观测；缺少能分离运动训练与事件图像平移补偿的受控评测。
Method: 构建 MuJoCo 受控基准：324 条流、24 个独立场景、三种扑翼几何、1.5 与 3.0 m 两个距离、静止/中等/较强运动视角，15 场景训练、3 验证、6 留出测试；用固定因果 TCN 在配对 2×2 消融、三个初始化种子下评测，对比 ridge、Fourier、autocorrelation 与改造的 EEPPR。
Result: 中等运动下配对运动训练使计数 MAE 由 31.130 降至 3.185 周期（1.5 m）、由 42.019 降至 5.444（3.0 m）；加入所测补偿后误差升至 4.630 与 10.185；Fourier 基线在 1.5 m 中等运动下为 0.944 周期，优于神经模型；同时报告 exact-count accuracy 与 temporally matched cycle F1。
Conclusion: 在该小合成基准上支持 motion-aware 训练并暴露简单事件背景稳定化的极限；结果不建立真实传感器性能、气动飞行或对未见机型的泛化。

papers.title: Engineering Efficient Self-Play Chess: Search, Replay, and Throughput Under Limited Compute
papers.abstract_en: How strong can an AlphaZero-style chess system become under limited training compute when its entire learning loop is engineered for efficiency? We train from random initialization through searched self-play on a single eight-GPU node for 2.5 days. The resulting 6.32-million-parameter model reaches 3,251 benchmark Elo [3,206, 3,297] at 100,000 searches per move (estimated at under five seconds of thinking time) against a fixed-node Stockfish 13 ladder. The run ingests 3.25 million completed games, involves an estimated 100 billion search simulations, and makes 836.6 million training presentations. We investigate search allocation, replay and restart-state selection, policy representation, progressive model sizing, quantized inference, and throughput engineering. Alongside the retained design, we document plausible alternatives that failed to improve the complete learning loop or did not justify their cost. The reported strength is a result of the integrated system, not an isolated Elo gain attributable to any single choice.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 17 figures, including appendices. Code and experimental evidence: https://github.com/BertilBraun/Advanced-Techniques-in-Chess-Engines ; model artifacts: https://huggingface.co/BertilBraun/alphazero-chess ; interactive demo: https://chess.bertil-braun.de/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单机八卡、2.5 天训练预算下，把 AlphaZero 式国际象棋自博弈整条学习回路按吞吐优化后，从随机初始化训练出的 632 万参数模型在每步 10 万次搜索（估计思考时间低于 5 秒）时对固定节点 Stockfish 13 梯度达到 3,251 Elo [3,206, 3,297]。作者强调该强度来自搜索分配、回放与重启状态选择、策略表示、渐进式模型扩容、量化推理和吞吐工程的整体集成，而非任何单一改动的孤立增益。
Motivation: 在有限训练算力下，AlphaZero 式系统的强度取决于整条学习回路的工程效率，而单点改进往往无法转化为端到端 Elo，需要在固定预算内系统性取舍。
Method: 在单个八 GPU 节点上从随机初始化做搜索驱动的自博弈训练，系统研究搜索分配、replay 与 restart-state 选择、policy 表示、渐进式模型扩容 (progressive model sizing)、量化推理 (quantized inference) 与吞吐工程，并同时记录未能改善完整学习回路或成本不划算的备选方案。
Result: 训练 2.5 天，产出 632 万参数模型；在每步 100,000 次搜索（估计思考时间低于 5 秒）下对固定节点 Stockfish 13 梯度达到 3,251 Elo，置信区间 [3,206, 3,297]；全程摄入 325 万盘完整对局，估计 1000 亿次搜索模拟，完成 8.366 亿次训练样本呈现 (training presentations)。
Conclusion: 受限算力下的 AlphaZero 式国际象棋强度是集成系统的产物，任何单一设计选择都不应被单独归因；被保留的设计与被否决的备选方案同等构成结论。

papers.title: Wasserstein Causal Forests for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF) for settings in which each unit's outcome is itself a probability distribution. This study also defines finite-grid transformed average and conditional average treatment effects, including a reference-distance contrast that asks whether treatment moves unit-level distributions toward a prespecified benchmark. Simulations cover null effects, location and shape changes, limited overlap, equal-mean but different laws, heterogeneous effects, multimodality, and structural zeros. WCF is most accurate on the conditional-law metric in most reported designs and sharply improves reference-effect estimation in the principal location-and-shape settings, but it is less accurate than the forest baselines for multimodal settings. WCF is applied to the famous Project STAR \citep{word1990state}, revealing that small classes alter more than the mean: they raise within-grade mathematics achievement by $0.161$ standard deviations on average (SE $0.028$); but the gain is not a uniform location shift, it is larger in the upper part of the classroom score distribution ($+0.179$ at the ninetieth percentile versus $+0.091$ at the tenth) and, in descriptive stratum estimates, largest in the schools serving the most economically disadvantaged students (highest free-lunch quartile, $+0.262$, versus $+0.092$ to $+0.164$ elsewhere), while overall dispersion is essentially unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF)，用于个体结局本身是概率分布的因果效应估计，定义有限网格上的 transformed average/conditional average treatment effect 与参考距离对比。在多数模拟设计中 WCF 的 conditional-law 指标最准，并在位置-形状主设定中显著改进 reference-effect 估计，但多峰设定不如森林基线。
Motivation: 当每个个体的结局是一个分布而非标量时，传统因果森林无法直接估计处理对分布形状的影响，也缺少检验处理是否把分布推向预设基准的对比量。
Method: 提出 Wasserstein Causal Forests，基于 Wasserstein 距离处理分布结局；定义有限网格 transformed average treatment effect 与 conditional average treatment effect，并引入 reference-distance contrast；模拟覆盖零效应、位置与形状变化、有限重叠、等均值不同分布、异质效应、多峰与结构性零。
Result: 多数报告设计中 WCF 在 conditional-law 指标上最准确，并在主要位置-形状设定中显著改进 reference-effect 估计，但多峰设定下不如森林基线。Project STAR 应用：小班使年级内数学成绩平均提高 0.161 个标准差（SE 0.028），分布上端增幅更大（第九十分位 +0.179 对第一十分位 +0.091），最高免费午餐四分位学校 +0.262 对其他 0.092–0.164，整体离散度基本不变。
Conclusion: 小班教学的收益不仅是均值提升，而是偏向成绩分布上端、且在最贫困学校最强的非均匀分布效应；WCF 能捕捉这类分布层面的异质性，但在多峰结局上仍不如森林基线。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF)，用于个体结局本身是概率分布的因果效应估计，定义有限网格上的 transformed average/conditional average treatment effect 与参考距离对比。在多数模拟设计中 WCF 的 conditional-law 指标最准，并在位置-形状主设定中显著改进 reference-effect 估计，但多峰设定不如森林基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 当每个个体的结局是一个分布而非标量时，传统因果森林无法直接估计处理对分布形状的影响，也缺少检验处理是否把分布推向预设基准的对比量。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Wasserstein Causal Forests，基于 Wasserstein 距离处理分布结局；定义有限网格 transformed average treatment effect 与 conditional average treatment effect，并引入 reference-distance contrast；模拟覆盖零效应、位置与形状变化、有限重叠、等均值不同分布、异质效应、多峰与结构性零。

papers.title: Self-discovering RL in the Era of Experience: Is Learning History an Asset or a Burden?
authors: Haomin Luo (1 and 2) ((1) University of Cambridge
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of recursive self-improvement (RSI) toward general intelligence is divided between macro-level language model scaling and the interaction-driven principles of "Era of Experience". Yet, any self-improving architecture ultimately rests upon its underlying optimization engine: if general intelligence requires learning from grounded interaction, the reinforcement learning (RL) update rule itself must be capable of cumulative adaptation. While algorithm self-discovery has produced Disco103 that surpassed PPO to achieve SOTA benchmark performance -- its internal update machinery remains an uninspected black box. We present the first causal mechanistic audit of a self-discovered RL rule, structured directly around the five pillars of the Era of Experience: extended horizon, grounded reward scales, continuing streams, within-lifetime change, and exploration depth. By surgically pinning, freezing, and transplanting recurrent states while holding meta-parameters fixed, we test when learning history acts as an asset or a burden. Three findings organize the audit: (1) Recurrent history actively expands usable reward scales, sustaining a six-decade window versus three under zero-pinning. (2) Decoupling historical content from its maintenance reveals that the penalty of mismatched history stems from perpetual clamping; allowing imported state to evolve naturally attenuates this burden. (3) Under environmental change, controlling replay retention reverses the apparent adaptation advantage over DQN, demonstrating that external data turnover can confound internal plasticity. Validated through capability thresholds and ported to a second rule (OPEN), this work grounds macro-RSI ambitions in micro-level learning dynamics, establishing a foundational audit standard for next-generation, self-evolving RL algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对自发现 RL 规则 Disco103 做因果机制审计，通过钉死、冻结、移植循环网络状态来判定学习历史何时是资产何时是负担。循环历史把可用奖励尺度窗口从 3 个数量级扩到 6 个数量级；错配历史的惩罚来自持续钳制而非内容本身，让移植状态自然演化可减轻该负担；控制回放保留率后，相对 DQN 的适应优势反转。
Motivation: 自发现 RL 规则（如超越 PPO 的 Disco103）内部更新机制是黑箱，而 Era of Experience 要求 RL 更新规则具备累积适应能力，缺少机制层面的因果审计无法判断其是否支撑递归自我改进 (RSI)。
Method: 围绕 Era of Experience 五支柱（extended horizon、grounded reward scales、continuing streams、within-lifetime change、exploration depth）组织审计，固定 meta-parameters，对循环状态做 pinning、freezing、transplanting 三类外科式干预；用 capability thresholds 验证，并把结论移植到第二条规则 OPEN。
Result: 循环历史把可用奖励尺度窗口维持在六个数量级 (six-decade window)，zero-pinning 下只有三个；解耦历史内容与维护成本后，错配历史的惩罚源于 perpetual clamping，允许移植状态自然演化可衰减该负担；在环境变化下控制 replay retention 会反转相对 DQN 的表面适应优势，说明外部数据更替会混淆内部可塑性 (plasticity)。
Conclusion: 学习历史的资产/负担取决于状态维护方式与外部数据更替，而非历史内容本身；宏观 RSI 目标应建立在微观学习动态的机制审计之上，并为自演化 RL 算法确立审计标准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Representational Simplicity and Circuit Size Dissociate in a Threshold-Dependent Way: A Controlled Test via Adversarial Training
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-autoencoder decomposability and concentrated feature attribution are increasingly treated as evidence that a model's computation is easier to reverse-engineer. Whether this representational and attributional cleanliness actually predicts a smaller or more tractable causal circuit remains an open question. We test this directly using adversarial training as a controlled instrument: it reliably reshapes internal representations, but this alone does not constitute a test of circuit size. We investigate this question through reverse-engineering complexity: the causal structure required to recover a model's behavior at a fixed level of faithfulness. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled empirical test of whether representational or attributional simplicity translates into causal simplicity at the circuit level. Starting from the same pretrained GPT-2 Small checkpoint, we apply matched standard and adversarial continual training, requiring both conditions to retain competence on indirect object identification and pass independent robustness verification before comparing mechanisms. We then compare the models along three complementary axes: sparse-autoencoder decomposability, SAE feature engagement in task attribution, and the size of faithful circuits recovered from the raw computational graph. The robust model is more SAE-decomposable and engages fewer SAE features in task attribution. Circuit size is regime-dependent: on competence-matched IOI, standard leads or ties below 85% faithfulness, but robust needs substantially fewer edges at high faithfulness (90%, 95%), a pattern established on the primary pair while representational trends generalize across a seven-point sweep and a second corpus.
papers.comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. 21 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用对抗训练作为受控工具，从同一 GPT-2 Small checkpoint 出发做匹配的持续训练，检验表征简洁（SAE 可分解性、归因集中）是否真的对应更小的因果电路。鲁棒模型更可 SAE 分解、任务归因涉及的 SAE 特征更少，但电路规模随 faithfulness 阈值反转：IOI 上低于 85% faithfulness 时标准模型更小或持平，而在 90%、95% 高 faithfulness 下鲁棒模型所需边数显著更少。
Motivation: SAE 可分解性与集中式特征归因常被当作模型计算更易逆向工程的证据，但表征/归因层面的简洁是否真的对应更小或更易处理的因果电路仍是开放问题。
Method: 从同一预训练 GPT-2 Small checkpoint 出发做匹配的 standard 与 adversarial 持续训练，两组都须在 indirect object identification (IOI) 上保持能力并通过独立鲁棒性验证；再沿三条轴比较：SAE 可分解性、任务归因中的 SAE 特征参与度、从原始计算图恢复的 faithful circuit 规模（faithfulness 扫描为七点）。
Result: 鲁棒模型 SAE 可分解性更高、任务归因中参与的 SAE 特征更少；电路规模呈 regime-dependent：在能力对齐的 IOI 上，faithfulness 低于 85% 时 standard 领先或持平，而在 90% 与 95% 高 faithfulness 下 robust 需要明显更少的边。该模式在主模型对上建立，表征趋势在七点 faithfulness 扫描与第二个语料上均可泛化。
Conclusion: 表征与归因的简洁并不单调转化为电路层面的因果简洁：结论取决于所要求的 faithfulness 阈值，高 faithfulness 下鲁棒模型的电路反而更小。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SINGED: Correct Outputs Do Not Certify Safe Execution in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents select and execute third-party artifacts. Different implementations can return the requested output while producing hidden execution effects that task-, attack-, or choice-based evaluations may miss. We study functional counterfeits: implementations that match benign alternatives on the requested output but add an effect forbidden by the task contract. We introduce SINGED (Source Integrity and the Nonidentifiability Gap in Execution Decisions for LLM Agents), a controlled benchmark covering five primary and two held-out task families. It varies displayed rank, evidence depth, decision policy, model release, and agent configuration, while task and process oracles verify the artifact and execution path. Across 7,549 audited trials, the randomized-rank study finds counterfeit execution in 45% (27/60) of rank-one trials and none at later ranks. Cross-candidate comparison eliminates shallow failures and reduces layered failures from 15.7% to 4.2%, but leaves dependency failures; its benefit is uncertain on unseen effects and public-package structures. Moreover, seven releases with no counterfeit executions when benign alternatives are available execute the counterfeit in 55/175 single-source cells after alternatives are removed. SINGED thus exposes a rank-, evidence-, and choice-sensitive outcome-to-execution gap: evaluation must connect correct outputs to execution paths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SINGED 是一个受控基准，用来检验工具型 LLM agent 在输出正确时是否仍执行了任务契约禁止的隐藏副作用（functional counterfeit）。7,549 次审计试验中，随机排序研究发现 45%（27/60）的 rank-one 试验执行了伪造实现，后续排名为零；跨候选比较把分层失败从 15.7% 降到 4.2% 但留下依赖失败；七个在有良性替代时零伪造的版本，在移除替代后于 157/175 单源格中执行伪造（55/175）。结论是评测必须把正确输出与执行路径绑定，仅看输出无法认证安全执行。
Motivation: 工具型 agent 选择并执行第三方构件，不同实现可以返回相同请求输出却带来隐藏执行效应；任务、攻击或选择式评测可能漏掉这类 functional counterfeit，输出正确并不等于执行安全。
Method: 提出 SINGED（Source Integrity and the Nonidentifiability Gap in Execution Decisions for LLM Agents），覆盖五个主任务族与两个 held-out 任务族，系统变化展示排序、证据深度、决策策略、模型发布与 agent 配置，并用 task oracle 与 process oracle 同时校验构件和执行路径；共 7,549 次审计试验，含随机排序研究与跨候选比较两种评测策略。
Result: 7,549 次审计试验中，rank-one 试验 45%（27/60）执行伪造，后续排名为零；跨候选比较消除浅层失败并把分层失败从 15.7% 降到 4.2%，但保留依赖失败，且在未见效应与公共包结构上收益不确定；七个在有良性替代时零伪造的发布版本，在移除替代后于 55/175 个单源格中执行伪造。
Conclusion: 存在一个随排序、证据与选择敏感的 outcome-to-execution gap：输出正确不能认证执行安全，评测必须把正确输出与执行路径关联起来。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agentic Commerce Bench: Measuring Fraud Detection for Agents That Spend Money
papers.abstract_en: AI agents now hold spend authority and settle payments without per-action human confirmation. The resulting loss is often not a security failure: a counterparty with the correct domain, the correct settlement address and a genuinely delivered service can charge more than it should, and no check keyed on identity will see it. We present three artefacts for measuring and reducing that loss. First, a taxonomy of agentic commerce fraud that separates five observation levels (agent reasoning, wire, settlement rail, counterparty, principal) from the request-level and history-level evidence available at each, and records which levels can observe which attacks. Second, Agentic Commerce Bench (ACB), a benchmark of twenty fraud classes generated from production aggregates, 1,647 catalogued service operations and 1,068 settlements, of which six involve a counterparty that is exactly who it claims to be. Third, gordonguard, an open-source detector stack and offline harness with which an operator can audit an agent configuration, replay hostile counterparties without an account, and run the same detectors inline. Calibrating to a stated false-positive budget on clean training traffic gives a 6.5% clean flag rate, replicated across three independent generations, and leaves eight of twenty classes no better than chance. On the four classes a reasoning layer can observe, a widely used agent security scanner run over its jailbreak-detection panel scores zero on all four, while correctly scoring 1.0 on a jailbreak supplied as a control. A measured median payment of $0.007 places a hard constraint on deployment: one human review costs 143 times the value of the payment it examines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出智能体商务欺诈的三层测量体系：五观测层分类法、含 20 类欺诈的基准 ACB、开源检测栈 gordonguard。按误报预算校准后干净流量误标率 6.5%，但 20 类中 8 类检测不优于随机；中位支付额 $0.007 使一次人工审核成本达被审支付价值的 143 倍，构成部署硬约束。
Motivation: 具备支出权限的 AI 智能体不经逐次人工确认即完成结算，损失常来自身份完全正确的对手方超额收费，任何基于身份的检查都看不到这类损失。
Method: 三层构件：区分五个观测层（agent reasoning、wire、settlement rail、counterparty、principal）并标注各层可见攻击的分类法；基于生产聚合数据、1,647 个服务操作与 1,068 笔结算生成 20 类欺诈的基准 ACB（其中 6 类对手方身份完全真实）；开源检测栈与离线 harness gordonguard，支持审计配置、离线重放敌意对手方并以内联方式运行同一检测器。
Result: 在干净训练流量上按给定误报预算校准得 6.5% 干净误标率，三次独立生成结果一致，20 类中 8 类检测不优于随机。在推理层可观测的 4 类上，某广泛使用的智能体安全扫描器的 jailbreak 检测面板 4 类全得 0，而作为对照提供的 jailbreak 得 1.0。中位支付额 $0.007，一次人工审核成本为被审支付价值的 143 倍。
Conclusion: 现有智能体安全扫描器对推理层可观测的商务欺诈类攻击完全失效，且在极低支付额下人工审核在经济上不可行，检测必须依赖可观测层与误报预算的匹配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning. We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation. Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection. Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对无散场算子学习中冗余参数化（如 Neural Conservation Law 势）导致的多对一映射，提出把 D 维无散向量场编码为同域上 (D-1) 分量的横小子空间极小表示：在 Fourier 空间用 Householder 正交变换直接构造缩减坐标，周期与封闭不可穿透情形下变换可逆、等距且保角，开放非周期流用 Fourier extension 构造兼容周期场并以最小能量规则选出唯一表示。神经算子完全在缩减空间内学时间演化，推理时直接解码回物理无散场，无需预测环境场或事后投影；实验显示冗余利于静态拟合优化，而唯一可逆坐标为时间动力学提供良定义状态，该表述取得更低预测误差与更强鲁棒性，且散度自由由构造保证。
Motivation: 冗余参数化把多个辅助表示映到同一物理场，虽能靠扩大等价解集合降低静态拟合误差，却给算子学习的状态带来多对一、非唯一的问题，时间演化缺少良定义的起始状态。

Result: 静态拟合与时间预测实验揭示任务依赖的权衡：冗余降低静态表示拟合误差但不给唯一状态，唯一可逆坐标则为时间动力学提供良定义状态；所提表述取得更低预测误差与更强鲁棒性，并由构造保持散度自由。
Conclusion: 把无散场状态压到 (D-1) 分量的唯一可逆横子空间表示，可去掉学习状态空间中不受约束的纵向或零方向，从而在保持散度自由的同时改善时间预测；冗余只在静态优化阶段有利。

papers.title: CipherGenome: Homomorphic Inference for Genomic Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Genome foundation models are growing into sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks whose expert weights no longer fit on the machines that hold the sequences, yet sending a private genome to rented accelerators exposes it: we show that a single server hosting one expert recovers the input nucleotides with 99.8% top-1 accuracy. We present CipherGenome, a protocol that keeps the embedding, attention and router of a 15.1B-parameter MoE genome model on a trusted thin client and outsources every expert projection, 95.8% of the parameters, to untrusted and possibly colluding GPU servers under module-LWE encryption. The design exploits three structural facts: expert layers are linear between two SwiGLU gates, expert weights are public, and GPU integer tensor cores can evaluate a ciphertext-weight product exactly modulo $2^{48}$ in a single GEMM. The client evaluates the nonlinearity exactly and re-encrypts with fresh secrets, so no polynomial approximation or bootstrapping is ever needed. On 72 windows from 12 bacterial genomes, encryption adds $2.54 \times 10^{-4}$ nats per token of KL divergence (95% CI upper bound $3.95 \times 10^{-4}$), below a pre-registered non-inferiority margin and indistinguishable from bf16 inference, while the same inversion attack falls to chance level. A reusable public hint cuts end-to-end latency by 3.54 times, wire compression reduces traffic 6.8 times, per-layer padding reduces routing leakage from 54.9% to 8.9% accuracy, and HE-compatible int4 experts remain non-inferior to their plaintext counterparts. Per expert and token, the server-side cost is more than six orders of magnitude below a CKKS baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CipherGenome 把 15.1B 参数基因组 MoE 的 embedding、attention 与 router 留在可信瘦客户端，只把占参数 95.8% 的 expert 投影在 module-LWE 加密下外包给不可信 GPU 服务器，利用 expert 层在两个 SwiGLU 门之间为线性、expert 权重公开、整数张量核可精确计算模 2^48 的密文-权重 GEMM，从而完全不需要多项式近似或 bootstrapping。在 12 个细菌基因组的 72 个窗口上，加密相对明文只增加 2.54×10^-4 nats/token 的 KL 散度（95% CI 上界 3.95×10^-4），低于预注册的非劣效界，而原本 99.8% top-1 恢复核苷酸的反演攻击降到随机水平。
Motivation: 基因组基础模型转向稀疏 MoE 后 expert 权重放不进持有序列的机器，把私有基因组发给租来的加速器会泄露：单服务器托管一个 expert 就能以 99.8% top-1 准确率恢复输入核苷酸。
Method: 客户端保留 embedding、attention 与 router，把全部 expert 投影（95.8% 参数）在 module-LWE 加密下外包给可能串通的 GPU 服务器；利用 expert 层在两个 SwiGLU 门之间为线性、expert 权重公开、整数张量核单次 GEMM 精确计算模 2^48 的密文-权重积；客户端精确计算非线性并用新密钥重加密，无需多项式近似与 bootstrapping；辅以可复用 public hint、wire compression 与 per-layer padding。
Result: 在 12 个细菌基因组的 72 个窗口上，加密引入 2.54×10^-4 nats/token 的 KL 散度（95% CI 上界 3.95×10^-4），低于预注册非劣效界，与 bf16 推理不可区分，反演攻击降至随机水平；可复用 public hint 使端到端延迟降低 3.54 倍，wire compression 使流量减少 6.8 倍，per-layer padding 把路由泄露从 54.9% 降到 8.9% 准确率，HE 兼容 int4 expert 相对明文仍非劣效；每 expert 每 token 的服务器端开销比 CKKS 基线低六个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 把非线性留在明文客户端、只加密线性 expert 投影，就能在可信瘦客户端上跑 15.1B 基因组 MoE，同时挡住反演攻击并把开销压到 CKKS 基线的百万分之一以下。

papers.title: GenomeOcean Anywhere: Private WebGPU Inference for Genome MoEs
papers.abstract_en: Genome foundation models are most useful where sequences are generated, yet the largest models need datacenter accelerators and a place to send private DNA. We ask whether a 15-billion-parameter genome mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can instead run on volunteers' web browsers, with the experts spread across many untrusted devices, without changing its predictions and without revealing the sequence to any single device. We build a system in which a trusted coordinator runs attention and routing while browser workers run every expert feed-forward network through hand-written WebGPU kernels, and we protect the expert inputs with real-valued Lagrange coded computing: each worker receives only a Gaussian-padded share, computes the expert's linear maps, and the coordinator decodes from any two of three workers. On GenomeOcean-MoE (8 experts, top-2 routing, 24 layers), the browser path matches native llama.cpp at every quantization level, the distributed path stays at the BF16 numerical noise floor (KL 0.0036 nats per token), and an unfitted latency model predicts decode time within 0.74% (median) under emulated wide-area links. We first show that plaintext expert inputs are not private: a probe recovers the token from a single vector at every depth, and one worker can identify the source genome from 300 unordered tokens with 92% accuracy. With coded experts, an adaptive attacker trained on shares falls to the most-frequent-token baseline, one worker's information about each token is bounded below one bit per forward pass, and the fidelity cost stays below the BF16 noise floor; in Chrome, coded decoding runs at 220 to 376 ms per token, depending on how much of the routing is hidden, and continues without replicas when a worker fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 150 亿参数的基因组 MoE（GenomeOcean-MoE，8 专家、top-2 路由、24 层）搬到志愿者浏览器里跑：可信协调器负责 attention 与路由，浏览器 worker 用 WebGPU 手写 kernel 执行专家 FFN，专家输入用实值 Lagrange 编码计算保护，任意两个 worker 即可解码。浏览器路径在各量化级别与原生 llama.cpp 一致，分布式路径停在 BF16 数值噪声底（KL 0.0036 nats/token）；明文专家输入会被探针从单个向量恢复 token，而编码后自适应攻击退化到最频繁 token 基线，单 worker 每次前向的信息量低于 1 bit。
Motivation: 基因组基础模型要在有序列生成的地方才最有用，但最大模型需要数据中心加速器，还得把私有 DNA 送出去；明文专家输入本身不私密——探针能在每个深度从单个向量恢复 token，一个 worker 能用 300 个无序 token 以 92% 准确率识别来源基因组。
Method: 可信协调器运行 attention 与 top-2 路由，浏览器 worker 通过手写 WebGPU kernel 执行每个专家的前馈网络；专家输入用实值 Lagrange coded computing 保护，每个 worker 只拿到高斯填充的 share 并计算专家线性映射，协调器从三个 worker 中任意两个解码。延迟模型未拟合（unfitted），在模拟广域链路上预测解码时间。
Result: 浏览器路径在每个量化级别都与原生 llama.cpp 匹配；分布式路径保持在 BF16 数值噪声底，KL 为 0.0036 nats per token；未拟合的延迟模型在模拟广域链路下预测解码时间中位误差 0.74%。明文专家输入下，单个向量即可在每个深度恢复 token，一个 worker 从 300 个无序 token 识别来源基因组准确率 92%；编码专家下，基于 share 训练的自适应攻击退化到最频繁 token 基线，单 worker 每次前向关于每个 token 的信息量低于 1 bit，保真代价低于 BF16 噪声底；Chrome 中编码解码为每 token 220 至 376 ms（取决于隐藏多少路由），worker 失败时无需副本即可继续。
Conclusion: 在不改变预测、也不向任何单一设备暴露序列的前提下，15B 基因组 MoE 可以在志愿者浏览器上以编码计算方式私密推理；代价是每 token 220–376 ms 的解码延迟，且该延迟随隐藏路由的程度变化。

papers.title: GenoTrace: Inheritable Watermarks for Genome Foundation Model Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Can a genome model retain a detectable record of the synthetic sequences used to train it? We study watermark inheritance through distillation with GenoTrace, a codon-aware extension of green-list watermarking. Two token-level factors modulate the teacher's generation bias using codon position and organism-specific codon usage. The resulting sequences train a smaller student, whose outputs are audited without an active watermark processor. In a three-seed GenomeOcean-500M-to-100M experiment, the joint configuration achieves a mean audit score of 17.88 and 94.5% detection at a fixed threshold. It retains 49.0% detection after key-aware token substitution, compared with 0% for the available single-seed plain-watermark comparator, and 47.0% after combined mechanism-targeted nucleotide edits. Additional experiments establish inherited signal across five organism-conditioned datasets and teacher-student size ratios up to 40. Component ablations and computational sequence-quality assays reveal distinct operating points for detection strength and coding coverage. GenoTrace provides a practical token-level construction and an empirical account of how genomic structure shapes inherited watermark signals. The findings concern shared-tokenizer distillation and the tested editing procedures, with calibration and biological utility treated as separate evaluation requirements.

papers.title: GeoSET: Generalist Foundation Model for SAR-to-EO Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Paired synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery is increasingly available across sensors, resolutions, and geographic regions. Yet existing SAR-to-EO image translation (SET) methods are typically trained on a single, limited-scale dataset, producing models specialized to particular sensing conditions. We introduce GeoSET, the first generalist model for SET, built around a single pretrained parent that is adapted to downstream datasets under a common protocol. We curate over 3 million high-quality SAR--EO pairs from a collection of more than 10 million SAR observations, spanning diverse sensors, spatial resolutions, and ground sampling distances. To bridge the modality gap between SAR observations and a pretrained image generator, we develop a speckle-robust SAR encoder and pretrain the conditional generator on this heterogeneous corpus. The resulting parent supports efficient adaptation across downstream datasets through low-rank adaptation (LoRA), updating only 0.60% of the generator parameters and requiring approximately one hour per dataset. Across six downstream benchmarks, GeoSET achieves state-of-the-art results in FID and DISTS with full fine-tuning or LoRA, demonstrating effective transfer across heterogeneous SAR-EO domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoSET 是首个 SAR-to-EO 图像翻译 (SET) 通用模型：用抗斑点 SAR 编码器在 300 万对异构 SAR–EO 数据上预训练条件生成器，再以 LoRA 只更新 0.60% 参数、约每数据集一小时完成适配。在六个下游基准上，全量微调与 LoRA 两种方式的 FID 与 DISTS 均达到 state-of-the-art，证明跨传感器、分辨率域的迁移有效。
Motivation: 现有 SET 方法只在单一、规模有限的数据集上训练，模型专属于特定传感条件，无法跨传感器、分辨率与地理区域复用。
Method: 从超过 1000 万景 SAR 观测中整理出 300 万以上高质量 SAR–EO 配对；设计抗斑点 (speckle-robust) SAR 编码器弥合 SAR 与预训练图像生成器的模态差距；在该异构语料上预训练条件生成器作为 parent，下游用 LoRA 适配，仅更新 0.60% 生成器参数。
Result: 在六个下游基准上，全量微调或 LoRA 适配的 FID 与 DISTS 均取得 state-of-the-art；LoRA 每个数据集适配约需一小时，只更新 0.60% 参数；语料规模为 300 万以上 SAR–EO 对、源自 1000 万以上 SAR 观测。
Conclusion: 单一预训练 parent 加统一 LoRA 适配协议足以覆盖异构 SAR–EO 域，无需为每个传感条件单独训练专用 SET 模型。

papers.title: MotionMaestro: Masked Tokenization for Unified Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Human motion generation plays an important role in applications such as character animation, virtual environments, and embodied interaction. While existing approaches have achieved remarkable progress, many of them are developed for individual tasks, including text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, and trajectory control. Although these tasks involve different types of conditions, a unified framework capable of handling them within a common representation would greatly simplify motion generation systems. We observe that diverse motion conditions can be naturally formulated as different observation patterns over motion sequences, where each task corresponds to a specific masking strategy. Based on this insight, we introduce MotionMaestro, a unified motion generation framework that learns a shared representation for complete motions and heterogeneous partial observations through masked motion tokenization. MotionMaestro employs a three-stage training strategy that first learns a masked motion tokenizer, then refines its reconstruction ability on clean motions, and finally trains a conditional flow-matching generator in the learned latent space. Furthermore, we introduce an observation map and an observation loss to explicitly preserve provided motion conditions during generation. With this unified representation and conditioning mechanism, MotionMaestro supports text-guided and unconditional synthesis, pose conditioning and partial completion, temporal interpolation, trajectory control, and motion continuation. Experiments on the large-scale RoMo and MotionMillion datasets show state-of-the-art performance across diverse motion generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotionMaestro 把文本到动作、姿态条件生成、轨迹控制等不同条件统一成动作序列上的不同观测模式（masking strategy），用掩码动作 tokenizer 学共享表示，再在 latent 空间用 flow matching 生成。在 RoMo 与 MotionMillion 上覆盖文本引导、无条件合成、姿态条件与补全、时间插值、轨迹控制、动作续写等任务，达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有动作生成方法多为单任务设计，文本到动作、姿态条件、轨迹控制各自条件形式不同，系统难以在统一表示下处理。
Method: 三阶段训练：先学 masked motion tokenizer，再在干净动作上微调重建能力，最后在学到的 latent 空间训练条件 flow-matching 生成器；另引入 observation map 与 observation loss 显式保留给定条件。
Result: 在大规模 RoMo 与 MotionMillion 数据集上，跨多种动作生成任务（文本引导与无条件合成、姿态条件与部分补全、时间插值、轨迹控制、动作续写）报告 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 多样动作条件可统一表述为动作序列上的观测模式，共享的掩码 token 化表示加显式条件保持机制足以支撑多任务动作生成。

papers.title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
papers.abstract_en: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把普通单目行走视频直接转成策略状态空间里的闭环社交导航训练环境：静态场景压成度量可通行图并随反事实机器人运动刚体变换，行人轨迹从视频恢复后原样回放，从而在状态空间直接定义前向动力学、无需重建或渲染逼真观测。所得策略在独立 Arena benchmark 上成功率 81.2%（最强基线 75.0%），真实机器人 20 次试验成功 19 次且不做策略微调。
Motivation: 社交导航策略训练依赖场景布局、地形与行人运动多样的仿真器，而搭建这类环境并指定行人行为成本高昂。
Method: 流水线将单目行走视频转为策略状态空间的闭环训练环境：静态场景表示为度量可通行图 (metric traversability map)，可在反事实机器人运动下刚体变换；行人轨迹从视频中随时间恢复并直接回放；由此在策略状态空间直接定义前向动力学，高效模拟反事实机器人状态，不重建也不渲染逼真观测。
Result: 在独立 Arena benchmark 上策略成功率 81.2%，最强基线为 75.0%；真实机器人试验 20 次成功 19 次，且未做策略微调。
Conclusion: 局部社交导航只需可通行性与邻近行人运动两类信息，用视频恢复的这两项抽象即可替代昂贵仿真器，训练出可直接零微调上真机的策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Boundary-State Control for Tool-Using Language-Model Agents: Commit-Time Consistency under State Drift
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents can decide that an action is permissible and execute it only after security-relevant state has changed. We study this proposal-to-commit gap and introduce BSC-R, a deterministic effect-boundary mechanism that binds a single-use commit authorization to the exact action and to a semantic projection of the authorization state that justified it. On 2,847 attacked AgentDojo episodes, the boundary kernel preserves the unprotected agent's behavior exactly (80.576% utility; 1.616% attack success). On 10,302 frozen proposals, it accepts every unchanged commit and rejects every instance of ten prospectively specified changed or replayed classes. In an independently generated boundary-drift experiment, full joint binding commits 0/4,403 invalid contexts while retaining 5,899/5,899 valid contexts. A prospective external evaluation on the 3,460-scenario CONTINUITY suite retains all 700 benign cases, prevents 1,200/1,200 represented non-replay invalid effects, handles 160/160 replay lifecycles correctly, and withholds 200/200 ambiguous no-release cases. The broader external suite also exposes the method's limit: across all 2,560 attacks, BSC-R has a 25% invalid-effect commit rate versus 0% for CONTINUITY. The result is therefore a scoped commit-time consistency mechanism, not a universal agent-safety claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BSC-R：把一次性提交授权绑定到具体动作与当初授权该动作的语义状态投影上，使工具型 agent 只能在安全相关状态未变时执行。在 2,847 个被攻击的 AgentDojo 回合上保持原行为（utility 80.576%，攻击成功率 1.616%），10,302 条冻结提案全部接受未变提交、全部拒绝十类变更或重放；但在 2,560 次攻击的外部套件上无效效果提交率达 25%，作者据此把它定位为有作用域的提交时一致性机制而非通用安全保证。
Motivation: 工具型 agent 在提议与提交之间存在 proposal-to-commit gap：安全相关状态可能在决策后被改变或重放，使原本被判定为允许的动作在提交时已不再合法。
Method: BSC-R 是确定性的 effect-boundary 机制，用 boundary kernel 把单次提交授权绑定到确切动作以及证明该动作合理的授权状态的语义投影；评估覆盖 AgentDojo 攻击回合、冻结提案集、独立生成的 boundary-drift 实验与 CONTINUITY 外部套件。
Result: 在 2,847 个被攻击的 AgentDojo 回合上完全保持未保护 agent 的行为：utility 80.576%，攻击成功率 1.616%；10,302 条冻结提案上接受全部未变提交并拒绝十类前瞻指定的变更/重放；boundary-drift 实验中全联合绑定提交 0/4,403 个无效上下文、保留 5,899/5,899 个有效上下文；CONTINUITY 套件（3,460 场景）保留全部 700 个良性案例、阻止 1,200/1,200 个非重放无效效果、正确处理 160/160 个重放生命周期、扣留 200/200 个歧义不释放案例；但在全部 2,560 次攻击上 BSC-R 的无效效果提交率为 25%，CONTINUITY 为 0%。
Conclusion: 提交时一致性可以做到不改变正常行为且拒绝前瞻指定的状态漂移与重放，但其有效性依赖于边界类别的覆盖范围，跨套件暴露的 25% 无效提交率说明这是有作用域的机制而非通用 agent 安全主张。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Authority Before Utility: Non-Compensatory Control for Persistent LLM Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory creates a control problem that retrieval relevance alone does not solve: a memory can remain highly useful after an update, deletion, or revocation makes it inadmissible for the current answer. We formalize this as a separation between utility and authority. A fixed finite penalty applied to an unnormalized utility score cannot guarantee exclusion under arbitrary positive-affine reparameterization of that score; by contrast, rank-normalized compensation is scale-invariant and therefore forms a stronger empirical comparator. Our prospectively frozen TIDE/LongMemEval primary was quarantined before a valid HELDOUT comparison because the materialized TIDE adapter conflated historical age with query-relative inadmissibility and the aligned LongMemEval split left no DEV set for the predeclared penalty selection. We therefore report a post-primary replacement diagnostic on Memora Remembering, where update/delete operations provide item-level forgetting state. On Qwen3-8B, DEV selected lambda = 0.6 from a ten-point normalized SOFT family. Across 185 HELDOUT units in 28 dependency clusters, HARD exclusion yields 4.04% balanced construct error versus 19.66% for locked SOFT, a paired difference of 15.61 points with a 20,000-replicate cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of [13.07, 18.76]. The effect is driven primarily by forgotten-value leakage while current-value recall is preserved. This is same-Q operator-comparison evidence, not a universal claim that scalar control fails, not an evaluation of learned authority inference, and not an independent downstream-harm endpoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 持久记忆中“有用但已失效”的条目，提出 utility 与 authority 分离的非补偿控制：固定有限惩罚在效用分数任意正仿射重参数化下无法保证排除，而 HARD 排除在 Memora Remembering 上把 balanced construct error 从锁定 SOFT 的 19.66% 降到 4.04%。作者建议对 update/delete 后的失效记忆用秩归一化的硬排除而非标量惩罚。
Motivation: 检索相关性无法处理已更新、删除或撤销的记忆：条目仍可能高度有用，却对当前回答不可采信，需要在控制层面保证排除。
Method: 将 utility 与 authority 形式化分离，证明固定有限惩罚对未归一化效用分数的正仿射重参数化不具排除保证，改用秩归一化补偿；在 Qwen3-8B 上由 DEV 从十点归一化 SOFT 族选定 lambda = 0.6，主实验 TIDE/LongMemEval 因 adapter 混淆历史年龄与查询相对不可采信、且无 DEV 集而被隔离，改用 Memora Remembering 的 update/delete 项级遗忘状态做替换诊断。
Result: 在 185 个 HELDOUT 单元、28 个依赖簇上，HARD 排除的 balanced construct error 为 4.04%，锁定 SOFT 为 19.66%，配对差 15.61 个百分点，20,000 次簇 bootstrap 的 95% 区间为 [13.07, 18.76]；效应主要来自 forgotten-value 泄漏下降，同时 current-value recall 保持。
Conclusion: 在同-Q 算子比较范围内，非补偿的 HARD 排除比标量惩罚更能阻止失效记忆泄漏且不损当前回忆；作者明确限定这不是“标量控制普遍失败”、不是学习式 authority 推断的评估，也不是独立下游危害终点。

papers.title: Backdoor in the Loop: Compromising Agentic Search via Malicious Retrievers
papers.abstract_en: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) interleaves reasoning with repeated retrieval, giving the retriever influence over both the evidence an agent observes and its subsequent search decisions. We study retriever backdoors that exploit this feedback loop and repurpose weak backdoor purification to conceal their presence. An attacker supplies a compromised retriever checkpoint while leaving the search agent and deployment corpus unchanged. Without corpus write access, the attacker can still suppress useful evidence, persistently retrieve a selected existing document, or steer the agent toward prolonged search, inflating retrieval, context, and latency cost. To conceal these behaviors from detection, we propose leveraging a controlled inject-and-remove cycle: deliberately inject a weaker backdoor and then unlearn it. This process weakens detector-visible signatures and fools the backdoor detectors with an illusion of purification while preserving the malicious retrieval behavior. These findings expose a systematic vulnerability in RAG systems in which a weak defense becomes an attacker's concealment tool for a backdoored retriever, even when the underlying corpus remains trustworthy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 agentic RAG 的检索-推理闭环中，攻击者只替换 retriever checkpoint、不动搜索 agent 与语料库，即可压制有用证据、持续召回指定文档或诱导 agent 长时间搜索以抬高检索、上下文与延迟开销。其用受控的 inject-and-remove 循环：先注入较弱后门再将其 unlearn，削弱检测器可见的签名，制造已被净化的假象，同时保留恶意检索行为。
Motivation: agentic RAG 中 retriever 同时影响 agent 观察到的证据与后续搜索决策，反馈闭环放大了单点被控 checkpoint 的破坏力；而现有弱后门净化手段反而可被攻击者用来掩盖后门。
Method: 攻击者提供被控的 retriever checkpoint，保持 search agent 与部署语料不变、无需语料写权限；再利用受控 inject-and-remove 循环，先注入较弱后门随后 unlearn，以削弱检测器可见签名并欺骗后门检测器。
Result: 在该攻击设置下可实现三类行为：抑制有用证据、持续召回某条既有文档、把 agent 引向长时间搜索从而抬高 retrieval、context 与 latency 成本；inject-and-remove 循环在保留恶意检索行为的同时让后门检测器误判为已净化。
Conclusion: RAG 存在系统性脆弱面：即使底层语料可信，弱防御也会变成攻击者藏匿被控 retriever 后门的工具。

papers.title: VeriWeave Govern: Evidence-Gated Deterministic Runtime Governance for Enterprise AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise artificial-intelligence agents increasingly call tools, modify infrastructure, and process protected data, creating a need to separate action generation from action authorization. This article presents VeriWeave Govern, a deterministic runtime governance layer that evaluates structured agent actions against versioned policies, validates typed evidence, applies fixed deny > review > allow precedence, routes consequential actions to accountable human review, and records replayable tamper-evident audit state. GovernBench evaluates the design over 30 independent seeds and 60,000 oracle-labelled cases spanning five enterprise domains, adversarial evidence, out-of-distribution actions, and temporal policy evolution. VeriWeave achieves 0.9888 mean accuracy, 0.9836 macro-F1, zero observed aggregate false allows, and zero observed Governance Attack Success Rate on the evaluated cases. Six ablations show that evidence gating, deny precedence, out-of-distribution fail-safe behavior, human review, contradiction handling, and temporal replay contribute complementary safety. The deployed API additionally passes 12/12 end-to-end scenarios and a 40,040-request concurrency matrix with zero failures. A separate 150-case EU/Austria regulation-grounded evaluation uses frozen predictions and two independent blinded human annotators, who agree on all decisions. On this set, deterministic engines remain conservative, while a Gemma 4 31B comparator aligns more closely with the human consensus. The results expose a measurable safety--utility trade-off and motivate evidence-aware, replayable governance as an independent control plane for enterprise agent execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriWeave Govern 是企业 AI agent 的确定性运行时治理层，把动作生成与动作授权分离：对结构化动作按版本化策略求值、校验证据类型、执行固定的 deny > review > allow 优先级，并把高后果动作路由到人工复核与可重放的防篡改审计状态。在 GovernBench 的 30 个随机种子、60,000 条 oracle 标注用例上平均准确率 0.9888、macro-F1 0.9836，聚合层面零 false allow、零 Governance Attack Success Rate。
Motivation: 企业 agent 开始调用工具、修改基础设施并处理受保护数据，动作生成与动作授权耦合在一起，缺少一个可重放、可审计的独立控制面。
Method: 确定性治理层对结构化 agent 动作按版本化策略求值，校验 typed evidence，套用固定 deny > review > allow 优先级，把高后果动作送人工复核，并记录可重放、防篡改的审计状态；用 GovernBench 评测，覆盖五个企业域、对抗性证据、分布外 (OOD) 动作与策略的时间演化，另做六项消融。
Result: GovernBench 上 30 个独立种子、60,000 条 oracle 标注用例：平均准确率 0.9888，macro-F1 0.9836，聚合层面零 false allow，零 Governance Attack Success Rate；六项消融（evidence gating、deny 优先级、OOD fail-safe、人工复核、矛盾处理、时间重放）显示各自贡献互补的安全性。部署 API 通过 12/12 端到端场景与 40,040 请求并发矩阵，零失败。另有 150 例基于 EU/Austria 法规的评测，用冻结预测与两名独立盲评标注者，两人对全部决策一致；该集合上确定性引擎偏保守，而 Gemma 4 31B 对照模型与人类共识更接近。
Conclusion: 证据门控、可重放的确定性治理可以作为企业 agent 执行的独立控制面，但结果同时暴露出可度量的 safety–utility 权衡：确定性引擎在法规对齐集合上更保守，Gemma 4 31B 更贴近人类共识。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Governing the Edge: Automating Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance Underwriting via a Hybrid Local-Cloud Multi-Agent Framework
papers.abstract_en: Underwriters in commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance spend 30 to 40% of their time on administrative work rather than risk judgment, and a single submission takes about 40 minutes by hand. We present Governing the Edge, a multi-agent framework for that layer, organized around a data-residency constraint: sensitive submission data must not leave the perimeter. Eleven agents and two deterministic control nodes, one a human-escalation interrupt, form a 13-node LangGraph workflow across two tiers. Agents touching raw submissions run locally on Gemma 2, each bound through a tool interface logging every invocation (synthetic stubs in the current prototype); only anonymized scores and non-identifying fields cross to Claude Sonnet in the cloud. Compliance rules are encoded as conditions on graph edges, so a non-compliant submission never reaches pricing. We walk through one full scenario end to end, a commercial auto submission whose principal driver carries serious violations, showing every agent call, every tool invocation, and the resulting routing decision. The framework processes a 40-minute manual submission in a few minutes on a single edge device, dominated by serialized on-device inference. On the hard-stop violation tier the framework enforces every rule correctly and reproducibly, since hard stops are deterministic predicates over fields extracted at temperature 0; overall compliance accuracy across the 20-scenario benchmark is 70%, with the remaining gap concentrated in softer, judgment-based tiers. It keeps a complete audit trail and respects the privacy boundary throughout. We release all code, compliance rules, tool stubs, and synthetic datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted at AIxB 2026. 6 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Data and Code in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/governing-the-edge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Governing the Edge 把商业财产险核保的行政层做成 13 节点 LangGraph 多智能体工作流：11 个 agent 加 2 个确定性控制节点分两层部署，接触原始投保数据的 agent 跑在本地 Gemma 2 上，只有匿名化分数进入云端 Claude Sonnet。合规规则写成图边上的条件，硬性违规档位全部被确定性拦截，20 场景基准上总体合规准确率为 70%，缺口集中在偏判断的软性档位。
Motivation: 商业 P&C 核保人 30%–40% 的时间花在行政事务而非风险判断，单份投保件手工处理约 40 分钟；同时敏感投保数据受数据驻留约束，不能离开本地边界，云端大模型无法直接接触原始材料。
Method: 以 LangGraph 构建 13 节点工作流（11 个 agent + 2 个确定性控制节点，其一为人工升级中断），分本地/云两层：接触原始提交的 agent 绑定 Gemma 2，每次调用经工具接口记录（当前原型为 synthetic stubs）；合规规则编码为图边条件，硬停规则是在 temperature 0 抽取字段上的确定性谓词；仅匿名化分数与非标识字段传给云端 Claude Sonnet。
Result: 单台边缘设备上把 40 分钟的手工投保件压缩到几分钟，耗时主要来自串行的端侧推理；硬性违规档位上规则全部正确且可复现地执行；20 场景基准的总体合规准确率为 70%，剩余误差集中在更软、依赖判断的档位；端到端走通一个商业车险场景（主驾驶员有严重违规），展示每次 agent 调用、工具调用与路由决策。
Conclusion: 数据驻留约束下，把确定性合规拦截放在本地图边、只让匿名分数出边界是可行的核保自动化路径，但判断型软档位的准确率仍是短板（70%）。

papers.title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

Result: 这是一篇立场论文，其核心论断为：在策略会经在线交互继续更新的设定下，离线 RL 目标应从静态部署扩展为保留记忆、探索与自我纠错能力的自适应先验；摘要给出的是概念区分（AORL 与 offline-to-online RL）与研究方向，而非实验数字。

papers.title: CruxBench: A Benchmark of Information Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) typically evaluate the accuracy of answers against fixed reference labels. But a central step in many complex real-world tasks is identifying which questions are worth asking in the first place: decomposing a difficult problem into subquestions -- which we call cruxes -- whose answers provide key steps on the path toward solving the target problem. To evaluate this capability of information discovery, we introduce CruxBench, a benchmark that grades LLM-generated questions by their Value of Information (VOI): how much a model-proposed crux updates beliefs about a target forecasting question. CruxBench enjoys a rare combination of three key properties: it is (1) contamination-resistant by construction, since ground truth is generated by future world events; (2) open-ended, admitting unbounded and complex text-based submissions rather than one correct numeric answer; and (3) grounded, with informativeness measured against quantified changes in real-world beliefs. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models on 293 target forecasting questions and find that VOI correlates highly with independent measures of model capability (r=0.90) and captures cruxes' usefulness for answering target questions. However, information discovery remains challenging even for frontier LLMs, which only narrowly outperform a random-timing baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CruxBench 用信息价值 (Value of Information, VOI) 给 LLM 生成的子问题打分：把难题拆成若干 crux，按其答案对目标预测问题信念的更新量衡量提问质量。在 293 个目标预测问题上评测八个模型，VOI 与独立能力指标高度相关 (r=0.90)，但前沿 LLM 仅略优于随机时机基线，说明信息发现仍是难题。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 基准只对照固定参考标签判答案对错，而复杂真实任务的第一步是判断哪些问题值得问；提问/信息发现能力缺少可评测、抗污染的度量。
Method: 将目标问题分解为 crux 子问题，用模型提出的问题对目标预测问题信念的更新量作为 VOI 打分；基准以未来真实世界事件生成 ground truth，从而构造上抗污染，并接受开放式文本提交，信息量以真实信念的量化变化衡量。
Result: 在 293 个目标预测问题上评测八个模型：VOI 与独立模型能力度量相关系数 r=0.90，且能捕捉 crux 对回答目标问题的用处；前沿 LLM 仅小幅超过随机时机 (random-timing) 基线。
Conclusion: VOI 可作为抗污染、开放式且有现实锚定的信息发现评测指标，但前沿 LLM 在该能力上仍接近随机基线。

papers.title: BarcodeMAE+: Rethinking Masked Pretraining and Global Representations for DNA Barcode Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Many DNA foundation models are pretrained by masking parts of a sequence and asking the model to reconstruct them. Standard masked pretraining exposes the encoder to special [MASK] tokens that are absent at inference, creating a mismatch between training and downstream use. The role of an explicit global sequence representation such as a [CLS] token and how it should be trained also remain poorly understood for DNA barcodes. We introduce BarcodeMAE+ and study model architecture, global [CLS] representation, and auxiliary pretraining objectives across arthropod COI (BIOSCAN-5M) and fungal ITS (UNITE+INSD) barcodes. Across both barcode regions, the encoder-decoder MAE-LM architecture outperforms its matched encoder-only counterpart in nearly all evaluated configurations, supporting MAE-LM as an effective architectural design for DNA barcode foundation models. A trained global [CLS] representation provides substantial additional gains: on BIOSCAN-5M, [CLS] accuracy increases from 47.53% without an auxiliary objective to 80.65% with cross-entropy genus classification. The best auxiliary objective is region-dependent: cross-entropy performs best on BIOSCAN-5M, whereas pairwise same-genus classification performs best on UNITE+INSD, reaching 73.19% on Yeast and 63.07% on Filamentous Fungi. BarcodeMAE+ outperforms published DNA foundation model baselines on BIOSCAN-5M and achieves the highest Yeast accuracy among the evaluated UNITE+INSD baselines using frozen encoder representations. Similarity-weighted softmax KNN voting further stabilizes accuracy as neighbourhood size increases. Overall, encoder-decoder masked pretraining and an explicitly trained global representation are strong design choices for DNA barcode foundation models, while the optimal objective for learning that representation depends on the biological domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BarcodeMAE+ 重做 DNA 条形码基础模型的掩码预训练设计：编码器-解码器 MAE-LM 架构加显式训练的全局 [CLS] 表示，在 arthropod COI (BIOSCAN-5M) 与 fungal ITS (UNITE+INSD) 上几乎全面优于匹配的纯编码器版本。[CLS] 加交叉熵属级分类后准确率从 47.53% 升到 80.65%；最优辅助目标随生物域变化——BIOSCAN-5M 上交叉熵最好，UNITE+INSD 上 pairwise same-genus 分类最好（Yeast 73.19%、Filamentous Fungi 63.07%）。
Motivation: DNA 掩码预训练把推理时不存在的 [MASK] token 喂给编码器，造成训练与下游使用不匹配；而 [CLS] 这类全局序列表示在 DNA 条形码上如何训练也缺乏理解。
Method: 对比模型架构（编码器-解码器 MAE-LM vs 匹配的纯编码器）、全局 [CLS] 表示的训练方式，以及辅助预训练目标（交叉熵属级分类、pairwise same-genus 分类），在 BIOSCAN-5M（arthropod COI）与 UNITE+INSD（fungal ITS）两个条形码区域上系统评测；下游用冻结编码器表示加 similarity-weighted softmax KNN voting。
Result: MAE-LM 在两个条形码区域的几乎所有评测配置中优于匹配的纯编码器；[CLS] 准确率在 BIOSCAN-5M 上从无辅助目标的 47.53% 提升到交叉熵属级分类的 80.65%；UNITE+INSD 上 pairwise same-genus 分类最优，Yeast 73.19%、Filamentous Fungi 63.07%；在 BIOSCAN-5M 上超过已发表 DNA 基础模型基线，并在 UNITE+INSD 评测基线中用冻结编码器取得最高 Yeast 准确率；KNN voting 随邻域增大稳定准确率。
Conclusion: 编码器-解码器掩码预训练加显式训练的全局表示是 DNA 条形码基础模型的强设计选择，而学习该表示的最优辅助目标取决于生物域。

papers.title: Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 EEG 的癫痫发作预报混合集成：5 个深度模型 + 3 个经典机器学习模型由 logistic regression stacking 元学习器融合，配合概率校准与临床导向后处理。在 CHB-MIT 的严格 Leave-One-Patient-Out 下，过滤后队列达到 74.2% 发作级敏感度、1.24 次/小时误报、平均预警提前 16.9 分钟；作者强调敏感度必须与实际误报率一起报告。
Motivation: 癫痫发作预报需要在发作前给出可用预警，但患者无关泛化与误报控制仍是主要瓶颈：跨患者性能常因个体差异崩塌，且只报敏感度会掩盖真实误报代价。
Method: 流水线包含信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准与临床动机的后处理；5 个深度模型与 3 个经典 ML 模型的输出由 logistic regression stacking 元学习器融合。在 CHB-MIT 上用严格 Leave-One-Patient-Out 交叉验证，阈值与后处理参数只在留出的 meta 数据上选择。
Result: 在过滤队列（剔除发作前比率低于 1% 或高于 15% 的患者）上：发作级敏感度 74.2%，误报 1.24 次/小时，平均预警时间 16.9 分钟。受目标误报预算约束的 test-tuned oracle 达到 60.9% 敏感度、0.951 次/小时。
Conclusion: 敏感度必须与实际实现的误报率一起报告，否则会高估临床可用性；混合 stacking 集成在患者无关设定下可把误报控制在每小时约 1 次的量级。

papers.title: Beyond Symmetric Agents: Cognitive Diversity and Multi-Agent Debate in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) reportedly improves reasoning and factuality over single-model inference, but prior work treats agents as symmetric peers, leaving open what drives the gains. We test the hypothesis that cognitive diversity among agents is the driver, in the setting where the question is still measurable: small open-weight models with benchmark headroom. Across 23 models from eleven vendor families, five tasks, and 5,500+ debate and control runs, we vary diversity along three axes - personas, sampling temperature, and model identity - pairing every debate configuration with a generation-budget-matched majority-vote control. The hypothesis is rejected on every axis. Debate beats single-agent inference (3--7 points where tasks have headroom) but at matched budget conditions it ties or even loses to self-consistency sampling at 1.6$\times$ the wall-clock and 3.4$\times$ the token cost. Persona prompting reduces accuracy and a dose-response experiment over each model's full combinatorial persona space shows the cost is a persona tax, not a diversity tax: redundant personas hurt most, while maximally-diverse teams recover part of the loss. Furthermore, mixed-model teams lose to majority votes over their own rosters, with accuracy tracking member capability rather than heterogeneity, and nearly all of debate's benefit comes from the first exchange of answers. We further identify a pervasive measurement hazard in which debate transcripts silently overflow serving context windows, whose correction alone moves our debate-versus-sampling comparison from $-1.8$ points to parity. Our results recast reported MAD gains as an ensemble-sampling effect and provide the budget-matched, contamination-checked baseline bar that future debate mechanisms should be required to clear.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 23 个小模型、5 个任务、5500+ 次辩论与对照运行中，认知多样性作为多智能体辩论 (MAD) 增益驱动的假设在 persona、采样温度、模型身份三条轴上全部被否决。辩论虽比单智能体高 3–7 分，但在等预算下与 self-consistency 打平甚至更差（1.6× 墙钟、3.4× token 成本）；纠正上下文溢出后，辩论对采样从 −1.8 分变为持平。
Motivation: 既有多智能体辩论工作把参与者当作对称同质体，无法解释增益来源；且缺少等生成预算、经污染检查的基线，导致辩论收益可能被高估。
Method: 在 11 个厂商家族的 23 个开源小模型、5 个任务上做 5500+ 次辩论与对照运行，沿 persona、采样温度、模型身份三条轴操纵多样性，每个辩论配置都配一个生成预算匹配的多数投票对照；另对每个模型的完整 persona 组合空间做剂量-反应实验，并检查 serving 上下文窗口溢出这一测量隐患。
Result: 辩论在有提升空间的任务上比单智能体高 3–7 分，但等预算下与 self-consistency 打平或更差（1.6× 墙钟时间、3.4× token 成本）；persona 提示降低准确率，冗余 persona 损失最大、最大多样性团队只能挽回部分损失；混合模型团队输给其成员名单上的多数投票，准确率随成员能力而非异质性变化；辩论收益几乎全部来自第一轮交换；纠正上下文溢出后，辩论对采样比较从 −1.8 分变为持平。
Conclusion: 作者把已报道的 MAD 增益重新解释为集成采样效应 (ensemble-sampling effect)，并给出未来辩论机制必须跨越的等预算、经污染检查的基线标准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Risk-Averse Online POMDP Planning via CVaR of the Immediate Cost with Performance Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Online POMDP planners optimize the expected cumulative cost, which can mask dangerous states when the belief places significant mass on high-cost states. Existing risk-averse methods apply static or dynamic Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) to the value function, capturing trajectory-level risk, but share two gaps: (i) by retaining the immediate cost as an expectation of a state-dependent cost over the belief, the risk \emph{within} the belief is left unaddressed; and (ii) by modifying the value function, they require new tailored algorithms rather than reusing existing expectation-based planners. We instead apply CVaR to the immediate cost over the belief at each step, directly targeting per-step uncertainty about the current state. The standard expected cumulative return is retained as the objective, so the resulting problem has a standard MDP structure: any expectation-based POMDP planner can be made risk-sensitive by changing only the cost computation. We inherit finite-time guarantees for policy evaluation and sparse sampling---with estimation error independent of the risk level---and, as our central theoretical result, prove a finite-time bound on the gap between the particle belief MDP surrogate and the original POMDP, which together yield an end-to-end guarantee from the true POMDP value to the algorithmic estimate. In the risk-neutral limit, the formulation recovers standard expectation-based planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 CVaR 从价值函数移到每步的即时代价上：在 belief 上对当前状态的代价取 CVaR，而目标仍是标准期望累积回报，因此问题保持标准 MDP 结构，任何期望型 POMDP planner 只改代价计算即可变风险规避。由此继承策略评估与 sparse sampling 的有限时保证（估计误差与风险水平无关），并证明 particle belief MDP 代理与原 POMDP 之间差距的有限时界，形成从真实 POMDP 值到算法估计的端到端保证；风险中性极限退化为标准期望规划。
Motivation: 在线 POMDP 规划优化期望累积代价，会在 belief 对高代价状态赋予较大质量时掩盖危险状态；已有静态/动态 CVaR 作用于价值函数，只刻画轨迹级风险，belief 内部的即时风险未处理，且必须为每个风险目标重写专用算法。
Method: 在每一步对即时代价关于 belief 取 CVaR，直接针对当前状态的逐步不确定性；保留标准期望累积回报作为目标，使问题仍具标准 MDP 结构，从而可复用现有期望型 POMDP planner，仅替换代价计算。理论部分给出策略评估与 sparse sampling 的有限时保证，并证明 particle belief MDP 代理与原 POMDP 之间的有限时差距界。
Result: 策略评估与 sparse sampling 的有限时保证中估计误差与风险水平无关；中心理论结果是 particle belief MDP 代理与原 POMDP 之间差距的有限时界，与前者合起来给出从真实 POMDP 值到算法估计的端到端保证；风险中性极限下退化为标准期望规划。
Conclusion: 风险规避不必通过改造价值函数实现：对 belief 上的即时代价取 CVaR 即可让任意期望型 POMDP planner 变得风险敏感，同时保留有限时与端到端理论保证。

papers.title: More Programs or More Rolls? Separating Coverage from Specialization in LLM Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Automated generation of LLM harnesses promises to improve inference through task specialization. Yet additional answer coverage can arise from repeated execution of the same program, making specialization difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation that separates answer coverage, repeatable task advantages, and gains from pre-execution selection. On 386 MATH-500 tasks, we compare eight generated harnesses plus a baseline with nine byte-identical baseline copies, using three executions per member. Identical programs yield 2.16 percentage points of repeat-averaged oracle headroom. Generated programs exhibit substantially more repeatable score patterns, but these chiefly reveal persistent weaknesses: losses relative to the baseline persist across all three repeats on 100 tasks, while persistent wins occur on only one task and are sensitive to answer extraction. The frozen selector gains 0.00 percentage points, and both populations reach 98.70% oracle coverage at 27 harness executions. Stable complementarity remains unresolved at three repeats. Supporting BIRD traces locate failures in mechanism implementation, activation, and output validity. Together, these findings establish why coverage and repeatability alone cannot justify claims of useful specialization. They motivate an evaluation standard for harness diversity: task advantages should persist across executions, guide usable decisions, and improve on additional fixed-program executions under matched inference budgets.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, including references and appendices. Under review at ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/StatXzy7/harness-eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MATH-500 的 386 道题上，把 LLM harness 的答案覆盖度与可复用的任务优势拆开评测：同一程序重复执行本身就能带来 2.16 个百分点的 repeat-averaged oracle headroom，而生成的 harness 表现出的可重复分数模式主要反映持续性弱点——相对基线的损失在 100 道题上三次重复全输，持续获胜的仅 1 道题且对答案抽取敏感。冻结选择器 (frozen selector) 增益为 0.00 个百分点，两组在 27 次 harness 执行时都达到 98.70% oracle 覆盖。
Motivation: 自动合成的 LLM harness 被宣称能通过任务特化提升推理，但额外的覆盖度可能只是同一程序反复执行带来的，特化因此难以辨识，缺少能区分覆盖与真实任务优势的受控评测。
Method: 受控评测把答案覆盖、可重复任务优势、执行前选择 (pre-execution selection) 三者分离：比较 8 个生成 harness 加一个基线，基线含 9 份字节相同副本，每个成员执行 3 次；用冻结选择器做执行前选择，并以 BIRD traces 定位失败机制。
Result: 在 386 道 MATH-500 任务上，字节相同程序带来 2.16 个百分点的 repeat-averaged oracle headroom；生成程序的分数模式更可重复，但相对基线的损失在 100 道题上跨全部 3 次重复持续存在，持续获胜仅 1 道题且对答案抽取敏感；frozen selector 增益 0.00 个百分点；两组在 27 次 harness 执行时均达 98.70% oracle 覆盖。
Conclusion: 覆盖度与可重复性本身不足以支撑“有用特化”的主张：任务优势必须跨执行持续、能指导可用决策，并在匹配推理预算下胜过追加的固定程序执行；三次重复下稳定互补性仍未解决。

papers.title: The Price of Token Boundaries: Compression Certificates and Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Pre-tokenisation restricts which text fragments can become prediction units, but its compression cost is obscured when tokenisers are compared only under the same boundaries. We measure this cost by bounding the minimum token count from both sides, with and without a regular-expression boundary rule. Nonnegative prices on token occurrences yield a lower bound through shortest paths and vocabulary-budget selection; maximising over all prices recovers the linear programming relaxation, and an independent integer checker certifies the reported values. On English Wikipedia, boundaries increase the optimal token count by 28.3--36.8\%. Byte pair encoding lies 2.1\% above the constrained lower bound, but 10.9\% above the unrestricted bound. Compression and prediction favour different dictionaries: at 85M non-embedding parameters and matched training-token budgets, unrestricted fitting yields higher mean held-out bits per byte under a common unrestricted decoder in all 12 languages in the paired study and 11 of 12 under independent tuning and evaluation. To study intermediate boundary policies, we introduce boundary licences, which limit the vocabulary entries permitted to cross cuts and admit the same form of certificate. On separate English and Chinese fitting corpora, licensing 10\% of the vocabulary budget recovers 85.2\% and 100.0\% of the achieved token-count reduction from removing all cuts. These results quantify the compression cost of boundaries while separating it from the prediction quality of the resulting token units.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预分词边界 (pre-tokenisation) 的压缩代价可以被证书化度量：在 English Wikipedia 上，边界使最优 token 数上升 28.3–36.8%，BPE 比受约束下界高 2.1%、比无约束下界高 10.9%。压缩与预测偏好不同词表——85M 非嵌入参数、匹配训练 token 预算下，无约束拟合在 12 语言配对研究中全部 12 个语言取得更低的 held-out bits per byte。引入 boundary licence 后，只放开 10% 词表预算即可在英/中语料上分别收回 85.2% 和 100.0% 的去边界 token 数缩减。
Motivation: 只在同一边界下比较 tokenizer 会掩盖预分词本身的压缩成本，且压缩质量与预测质量被混在一起，无法区分词表选择到底影响哪一项。
Method: 用非负 token 出现价格经最短路与词表预算选择给出下界，最大化价格恢复线性规划松弛，并用独立整数校验器 (integer checker) 认证数值；再提出 boundary licence 限制允许跨切分的词表条目，沿用同一证书形式，以 85M 非嵌入参数、匹配训练 token 预算做 12 语言拟合比较。
Result: English Wikipedia 上边界使最优 token 数增加 28.3–36.8%；BPE 高于受约束下界 2.1%、高于无约束下界 10.9%。85M 非嵌入参数与匹配 token 预算下，无约束拟合在共同无约束解码器下 12/12 语言 held-out bits per byte 更低，独立调参评估下为 11/12。英/中独立拟合语料上，许可 10% 词表预算分别收回 85.2% 与 100.0% 的 token 数缩减。
Conclusion: 边界对压缩的代价可被严格上下界量化并与预测质量分离；放开少量词表预算即可回收大部分去边界带来的压缩收益，且压缩最优的词表并不等于预测最优的词表。
