papers.title: Is Human-Readable Text Necessary for Effective LLM Fine-Tuning?
papers.abstract_en: Is human readability necessary for effective fine-tuning of large language models? We investigate whether model-conditioned training representations can preserve or improve adaptation utility without requiring a human-readable textual form. We propose Desired-Update-Aligned Synthetic Data (DASA), which uses activation-gradient feedback from a frozen reference model to guide the optimization of continuous synthetic input embeddings. Inspired by the role of activation gradients in local risk reduction, DASA targets useful adaptation updates rather than source-text reconstruction or linguistic fluency. The resulting embeddings are used directly for downstream fine-tuning; discrete token projections are employed only for qualitative inspection. Experiments on six models from the Llama and Qwen families, ranging from 1B to 32B parameters, cover six benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and commonsense reasoning. Under matched LoRA adaptation settings, DASA achieves performance comparable to the source natural-language data and surpasses it in multiple configurations, while outperforming GRADMM in most comparisons. Further experiments cover general-domain and task-specialized source data. Under the evaluated synthesis settings, DASA provides a $3.6$--$4.9\times$ speedup over GRADMM with comparable peak GPU memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DASA 用冻结参考模型的 activation-gradient 反馈直接优化连续合成输入嵌入，绕开人类可读文本做 LLM 微调。在 Llama/Qwen 六个模型（1B–32B）、六个知识/数学/代码/常识基准、匹配 LoRA 设置下，性能与源自然语言数据相当且多项配置更优，多数比较中超过 GRADMM，并相对 GRADMM 取得 3.6–4.9 倍加速。
Motivation: 微调通常依赖人类可读的自然语言数据，但可读性是否是适配效用的必要条件尚不清楚；同时现有合成数据方法（如 GRADMM）的生成开销较大。
Method: 提出 Desired-Update-Aligned Synthetic Data (DASA)：以冻结参考模型的 activation-gradient 反馈引导连续合成输入嵌入的优化，目标对齐有用的适配更新而非源文本重建或语言流畅度；嵌入直接用于下游微调，离散 token 投影仅用于定性检查，适配采用 LoRA。
Result: 在 Llama 与 Qwen 家族六个模型（1B 到 32B 参数）、覆盖知识、数学推理、代码生成、常识推理的六个基准上，匹配 LoRA 设置下 DASA 与源自然语言数据性能相当并在多个配置上超过它，多数比较中优于 GRADMM；在评估的合成设置下相对 GRADMM 加速 3.6–4.9 倍，峰值 GPU 显存相当。

papers.title: ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation
papers.abstract_en: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReLOBGen 在生成限价单 (LOB) 消息时就保证可回放 (replayable)：先从当前 LOB 的挂单中按学习到的分布采样被引用订单，再用掩码屏蔽非法 token 使其余字段与该订单和市场状态一致，从而免去事后修正或重采样。在 500 条消息的 rollout 中达到 100% 可回放率，改善盘口顶部统计与消息相对价格的真实度，单条回放消息较 LOBS5 基线提速 2.7–3.6×。
Motivation: 闭环市场仿真要求消息可回放，但现有 LOB 消息生成器会产出与当前市场状态不一致的原始消息，只能靠事后修正或拒绝后重采样，这会改变回放消息的分布并抬高推理成本。
Method: 两阶段生成：先从当前 LOB 的挂单中采样被引用订单，采样分布由缓存的订单表示加一个依赖上下文的 query 高效计算；随后生成其余消息字段，并通过屏蔽非法 token 强制其与所选订单和市场状态一致，全程不做事后修正或重采样。
Result: 在 500 条消息的 rollout 中可回放率达 100%；市场真实度改善，尤其是盘口顶部 (top-of-book) 统计与 LOB 消息的相对价格；单条回放消息相对 LOBS5 基线提速 2.7–3.6×。
Conclusion: 把可回放性放进生成过程本身（引用订单先定、其余字段掩码约束），可以在不做事后修正或重采样的前提下同时拿到真实消息分布与更低的回放推理成本。

papers.title: PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Single-token typed-decision models answer a schema question by reading the logits of a few one-letter answer codes at a single position: they are fast and return a probability for every allowed answer, but they are trained with plain cross-entropy that ignores most of the structure in their training data. We study such a model whose data is curated as contrastive pairs---two contexts that differ in one edited fact that flips the answer---each carrying a machine-checked certificate that deleting the decisive sentence makes the fact unknown. We propose PACT, which turns this structure into four training terms that need no new annotation: a difference-in-differences margin over each pair that is invariant to any shared logit offset, a permutation-consistency term against answer-code position bias, an evidence-necessity term on certificate-verified ablated contexts, and an ordinal transport cost for rubric fields, plus a three-parameter contextual temperature. On a frozen 324-item holdout with three seeds, PACT matches the published recipe in accuracy ($84.6\%$ vs. $85.2\%$; McNemar $p \ge 0.50$ at every seed) while giving the lowest position bias of all runs (answer flips under relabelling $9.8\%$ vs. $13.8\%$) and the lowest ordinal error on rubric fields (MAE $0.232$ vs. $0.311$). Against a control with the same optimiser and schedule but cross-entropy only, PACT is significantly more accurate at two of three seeds, halves the seed-to-seed spread and lowers NLL by $26\%$. Seed-matched ablations and pre-specified falsification tests locate these gains precisely: no single term raises raw accuracy, and the method's value lies in robustness and stability rather than headline accuracy. Code, data splits, trained adapters, and all run records are available at https://github.com/BennyLinntu/PACT-Pairwise-Anchored-Calibrated-Tuning-for-Single-Token-Typed-Decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACT 把对比对数据的结构转成四个无需新标注的训练项（成对差分中的差分 margin、答案编码置换一致性、证书验证的证据必要性项、rubric 字段的序数传输代价）加三参数上下文温度，用于单 token 分类型决策模型。在 324 条冻结 holdout、三个 seed 上，准确率与原配方持平（84.6% vs 85.2%，McNemar p ≥ 0.50），但位置偏置最低（答案翻转 9.8% vs 13.8%）、rubric 序数误差最低（MAE 0.232 vs 0.311），相对仅交叉熵的对照在三个 seed 中两个显著更准、seed 间离散度减半、NLL 降低 26%。
Motivation: 单 token 分类型决策模型用交叉熵训练，忽略了对比对、答案编码位置与 rubric 序数等训练数据结构，导致位置偏置与跨 seed 不稳定。
Method: PACT 在原有交叉熵之上加四项损失：对每个编辑翻转答案的对比对做对共享 logit 偏移不变的差分中的差分 margin；针对答案编码位置偏置的置换一致性项；在证书验证的删句消融上下文上加证据必要性项；对 rubric 字段加序数传输代价；另加三参数 contextual temperature。全部复用已有标注，无需新数据。
Result: 在 324 条冻结 holdout、三个 seed 上：准确率 84.6% vs 已发布配方 85.2%（McNemar p ≥ 0.50，每个 seed）；重标号下的答案翻转率 9.8% vs 13.8%，为所有 run 最低；rubric 字段序数 MAE 0.232 vs 0.311。与同优化器同调度但仅交叉熵的对照相比，三个 seed 中两个显著更准，seed 间离散度减半，NLL 降低 26%。逐项消融显示没有任何单项提升原始准确率。
Conclusion: PACT 的价值在鲁棒性与稳定性（位置偏置、序数误差、seed 方差、NLL），而非抬高头条准确率；四项训练项需合在一起才起作用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Regime Boundary Alignment for Evidence-Gated Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented language models are expected to answer from the retrieved evidence, but in practice they often keep answering when that evidence is missing. We trace this behavior to the training signal: answer-focused fine-tuning assigns no target to unsupported contexts, so it cannot distinguish a reader that abstains from one that guesses, and unsupported answering stays near 100% even as supported accuracy improves. We introduce Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA), which trains a single reader on matched variants of the same question and gold answer. The reader is trained to produce the gold answer when the context supports it, including when conflicting evidence is also present, and to abstain when the correct support is removed; inference is ordinary decoding, with no verifier, threshold, or regime label. On three multi-hop QA datasets across three seeds, RBA reduces the unsupported-answer rate by more than sixty percentage points relative to conflict-focused training while matching its supported accuracy. On a held-out TriviaQA retrieval-miss slice, the same reader reduces unsupported answering from 100% to below 1% while also improving supported accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-gated answering must be learned on both sides of the support boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 检索增强问答在证据缺失时仍照答，根因是只按答案对齐的微调对无支撑上下文不给训练目标。Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA) 用同一问题与金答案的配对变体同时训练两侧：有支撑时答出金答案（含冲突证据并存），支撑被移除时弃答，推理仍是普通解码、无需验证器或阈值。三个多跳 QA 数据集上无支撑作答率较 conflict-focused training 下降逾 60 个百分点且支撑准确率持平；TriviaQA 检索缺失切片上从 100% 降到 1% 以下，支撑准确率同时提升。
Motivation: RAG 模型被期望只依据检索证据作答，但证据缺失时仍继续回答；答案导向的微调对无支撑上下文不设目标，无法区分弃答与瞎猜，导致无支撑作答率长期贴近 100%。
Method: RBA 构造同一问题与金答案的配对上下文变体训练单一 reader：支撑存在（包括同时含冲突证据）时输出金答案，移除正确支撑时弃答；推理为普通解码，不引入验证器、阈值或 regime 标签。
Result: 在三个多跳 QA 数据集、三个随机种子上，RBA 相对 conflict-focused training 将无支撑作答率降低超过 60 个百分点，同时支撑准确率持平。在 held-out TriviaQA 检索缺失 (retrieval-miss) 切片上，同一 reader 把无支撑作答从 100% 降到 1% 以下，并提升支撑准确率。
Conclusion: 证据门控作答必须在支撑边界的两侧同时学习，仅靠冲突证据训练不足以让模型在证据缺失时弃答。

papers.title: Label Less, Learn More: Resource-Efficient Active Semi-Supervised Learning for Onboard Satellite Image Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pervasive sensing increasingly relies on high-resolution satellite imagery, yet task-specific onboard vision is constrained by costly annotation and limited computation, memory, energy, and communication resources. Existing approaches largely rely on either data-hungry supervised learning or large vision-language foundation models, limiting efficient adaptation and deployment under these constraints. We present SatLabel, a resource-aware learning framework that transforms limited satellite labels into progressively refined onboard models through adaptive sample acquisition and semi-supervised model adaptation. Rather than repeatedly training on uniformly sampled labels, SatLabel closes the loop between model uncertainty, class imbalance, and pseudo-label quality to selectively acquire informative samples while exploiting abundant unlabeled imagery. This enables a compact student to adapt to target sensing domains with reduced annotation and inference costs. We further introduce an optional Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) student with graph-based feature refinement to enhance representation capacity while retaining a lightweight footprint. We evaluate SatLabel on 11 remote-sensing datasets spanning core, extended, and unseen domains against RemoteCLIP zero-shot inference. SatLabel improves Macro-F1 on most core and extended datasets while maintaining strong cross-dataset transfer to unseen domains. More importantly, the Balanced student contains only 11.2 M parameters and occupies approximately 42.8 MB, compared with 151.3M parameters and 577 MB for RemoteCLIP, while requiring 3.65 versus 5.89 GFLOPs. Across four efficiency benchmarks, it achieves approximately 2x higher GPU-forward throughput and reduces energy per image on datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SatLabel 是面向星载卫星影像标注的资源感知主动半监督学习框架：用模型不确定性、类别不平衡与伪标签质量闭环选择性采集样本，让紧凑 student 在少量标注下适配目标传感域，并可选配带图特征精化的 MoE student。在 11 个遥感数据集上对比 RemoteCLIP zero-shot，Balanced student 参数 11.2M、约 42.8MB、3.65 GFLOPs，GPU 前向吞吐约 2 倍。
Motivation: 星载任务专用视觉受标注成本与算力、内存、能耗、通信限制约束，现有方法要么依赖数据饥渴的监督学习，要么依赖大型 vision-language 基础模型，在这些约束下难以高效适配与部署。
Method: SatLabel 通过自适应样本采集与半监督模型适配闭环，把模型不确定性、类别不平衡与伪标签质量联系起来选择信息量大的样本，同时利用大量未标注影像；可选的 MoE student 加入基于图的特征精化以提升表示能力并保持轻量。
Result: 在 11 个覆盖 core、extended、unseen 域的遥感数据集上对比 RemoteCLIP zero-shot：SatLabel 在多数 core 与 extended 数据集上提升 Macro-F1，并对 unseen 域保持较强的跨数据集迁移；Balanced student 11.2M 参数、约 42.8MB，对比 RemoteCLIP 的 151.3M 参数与 577MB，GFLOPs 为 3.65 对 5.89；在四个效率基准上 GPU 前向吞吐约高 2 倍，并降低每图能耗。
Conclusion: 把有限卫星标签转成逐步精化的星载模型是可行的：小一个数量级的 student 在保持跨域迁移的同时显著降低标注与推理开销。

summary_sections.method: SatLabel 通过自适应样本采集与半监督模型适配闭环，把模型不确定性、类别不平衡与伪标签质量联系起来选择信息量大的样本，同时利用大量未标注影像；可选的 MoE student 加入基于图的特征精化以提升表示能力并保持轻量。
summary_sections.result: 在 11 个覆盖 core、extended、unseen 域的遥感数据集上对比 RemoteCLIP zero-shot：SatLabel 在多数 core 与 extended 数据集上提升 Macro-F1，并对 unseen 域保持较强的跨数据集迁移；Balanced student 11.2M 参数、约 42.8MB，对比 RemoteCLIP 的 151.3M 参数与 577MB，GFLOPs 为 3.65 对 5.89；在四个效率基准上 GPU 前向吞吐约高 2 倍，并降低每图能耗。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把有限卫星标签转成逐步精化的星载模型是可行的：小一个数量级的 student 在保持跨域迁移的同时显著降低标注与推理开销。

papers.title: Do Evidence-Reading Diagnostics Improve Interface Selection in Small LLM Recommenders?
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral tests measure how a language model reads evidence. We ask whether those measurements help choose a recommendation interface. We evaluate six small instruction-tuned checkpoints across four recommendation domains with chronological evaluation and 3,426 evaluation users. Each request ranks eight candidates. A baseline selector chooses among history-only prompting, prompting with collaborative evidence, and score fusion. It uses observable features and six stability prompts that vary wording and candidate order. An augmented selector adds features from six evidence-reading prompts that ask the model to compare support counts. An interface chosen once on development (validation) data for each domain and checkpoint scores 0.5524 NDCG@5, compared with 0.5447 for the baseline selector and 0.5428 for the augmented selector. Adding the diagnostic features changes NDCG@5 by -0.0019 (95% interval [-0.0046, 0.0004]). The interval includes zero, and its upper bound is below the analysis plan's 0.005 improvement target. Matching the selectors' hyperparameters also leaves the interval upper bound below that target. Evidence from retrieved similar users improves prompting by 0.0999 NDCG@5 over a control using randomly selected users matched for activity. The evidence-reading tests also reveal answer-position and tie-response biases. These results concern the tested selectors and candidate sets. They illustrate why diagnostic measurements should be evaluated by whether they improve recommendation choices beyond existing features and a fixed interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在小模型推荐器上，证据阅读诊断（evidence-reading diagnostics）特征并未改善接口选择：按分析计划预先设定的固定接口在开发集上选一次，NDCG@5 为 0.5524，高于基线选择器 0.5447 与加入诊断特征的选择器 0.5428。诊断特征带来的 NDCG@5 变化为 -0.0019（95% 区间 [-0.0046, 0.0004]），区间含零且上界低于 0.005 的改进目标；结论是诊断测量须以能否在既有特征之外改进推荐选择来检验。
Motivation: 行为诊断测试可以度量语言模型如何读取证据，但这些度量是否能帮助选择推荐接口（prompting、协同证据、score fusion）尚不清楚；需要判断诊断特征相对既有可观测特征是否带来超出预设阈值的实际改进。
Method: 在四个推荐域上评估六个小规模 instruction-tuned checkpoints，采用按时间顺序的评估与 3,426 名评估用户，每个请求对八个候选排序。基线选择器用可观测特征加六个改变措辞与候选顺序的 stability prompts 在三种接口（仅历史 prompting、带协同证据的 prompting、score fusion）中选择；增强选择器再加入六个要求模型比较 support counts 的证据阅读 prompt 所产出的特征；对照为按活跃度匹配的随机相似用户。
Result: 开发集上固定一次的接口得 0.5524 NDCG@5，基线选择器 0.5447，增强选择器 0.5428；加入诊断特征使 NDCG@5 变化 -0.0019（95% 区间 [-0.0046, 0.0004]），区间含零且上界低于分析计划的 0.005 改进目标，匹配选择器超参数后上界仍低于该目标。检索到的相似用户证据相对活跃度匹配的随机用户对照提升 0.0999 NDCG@5。证据阅读测试还暴露 answer-position 与 tie-response 偏差。
Conclusion: 在所测试的选择器与候选集上，证据阅读诊断特征没有在既有特征之外改进接口选择，其上界低于 0.005 目标；诊断测量应按能否改进推荐选择来评估，而非仅证明模型读取证据的行为差异。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CRASM-Gate: Deterministic-First Constraint- and Role-Aware Semantic Mapping with Selective Model Assistance Across Heterogeneous Industrial Standards
papers.abstract_en: Industrial standards often encode the same engineering concept through incompatible hierarchies, identifiers, roles, and structural constraints, so the nearest lexical or embedding match can still be technically inadmissible. This article presents CRASM, a deterministic constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping method, and CRASM-Gate, its selectively model-assisted extension. The framework separates standard-specific canonicalization, bounded retrieval, deterministic rules, destination-versus-origin role interpretation, semantic and structural ranking, ambiguity refusal, and target validation. CRASM-Gate adds a confidence/disagreement gate that may invoke a candidate-constrained large language model, while final authority remains with deterministic validation. A controlled artifact covers six directed industrial-standard pairs, three difficulty levels, and ten configurations, yielding 14,400 sample-level decisions. With a fixed local model endpoint, CRASM-Gate reaches mean F1 0.9938 and an implemented structural-validity rate of 1.0000; deterministic CRASM reaches 0.9931 without generative-model calls; and the model-only baseline reaches 0.5347. Relative to the model-only baseline, CRASM reduces top-1 errors from 670 to 10 while exhibiting 0.0688 s/sample rather than 24.5263 s/sample observed latency. CRASM-Gate improves CRASM by one additional correct decision out of 1,440, with observed latency increasing to 15.7666 s/sample. The results support a deterministic-first interoperability architecture in which model assistance is optional, measurable, candidate-bounded, and unable to bypass structural validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRASM-Gate 提出确定性优先的约束与角色感知语义映射：先做标准化规范化、受限检索、确定性规则与目标校验，仅在置信度/分歧门控触发时调用候选约束 LLM，最终裁决权留在确定性校验。在 6 组工业标准对、3 难度、10 配置共 14,400 条样本决策上，CRASM-Gate 平均 F1 0.9938、结构有效率 1.0000，纯确定性 CRASM 达 0.9931 且无需生成式调用，而纯模型基线仅 0.5347。
Motivation: 工业标准之间层级、标识符、角色与结构约束互不兼容，最近的词法或 embedding 匹配仍可能技术上不合法，纯 LLM 映射既慢又大量出错。
Method: CRASM 流水线分离标准专属 canonicalization、bounded retrieval、确定性规则、destination-versus-origin 角色解释、语义与结构排序、ambiguity refusal 与 target validation；CRASM-Gate 在其上加置信度/分歧门控，可选择性调用候选约束的 LLM，最终权威仍归确定性校验。评测为受控 artifact：6 个有向工业标准对、3 个难度级别、10 种配置，共 14,400 条样本级决策，固定本地模型端点。
Result: CRASM-Gate 平均 F1 0.9938、实现的结构有效率 1.0000；确定性 CRASM F1 0.9931 且零生成式调用；纯模型基线 F1 0.5347。相对纯模型基线，CRASM 把 top-1 错误从 670 降到 10，观测延迟从 24.5263 s/sample 降到 0.0688 s/sample；CRASM-Gate 相对 CRASM 在 1,440 条中多对 1 条，延迟升至 15.7666 s/sample。
Conclusion: 结果支持确定性优先的互操作架构：模型辅助应是可选、可度量、候选受限且无法绕过结构校验的，纯确定性路径已能拿到几乎全部精度与三个数量级的延迟优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Discrimination: Calibrated Geoprior Fusion for Bioacoustic Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Modern bioacoustic foundation models like Perch and BirdNET can identify species with high discriminative accuracy, yet their confidence scores are often uncalibrated and difficult to interpret as probabilities of real-world occurrence. This limits their use for ecological inference beyond threshold-based detection. We leverage a global annotated acoustic dataset (WABAD) to produce calibration priors for an acoustic model, optionally incorporating species-level information. We introduce new methods of fusing the acoustic predictions with geopriors, which empirically improves calibration while preserving discrimination. Together, these results suggest a path to simpler and more reliable acoustic monitoring for broad biodiversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生物声学基础模型 Perch、BirdNET 判别精度高但置信度未校准，无法当作真实出现概率使用。作者用全球标注声学数据集 WABAD 为声学模型生成校准先验（可选纳入物种级信息），并提出把声学预测与地理先验 (geoprior) 融合的新方法，实证上改善校准同时保持判别能力。
Motivation: Perch、BirdNET 等模型置信度未校准、难以解释为真实出现概率，使其只能做阈值式检测，无法支撑阈值之上的生态推断。
Method: 利用全球标注声学数据集 WABAD 为声学模型生成校准先验，可选加入物种级信息；再提出把声学预测与 geoprior 融合的新方法，目标是改善校准而不损失判别。
Result: 新融合方法实证改善校准 (calibration) 同时保持判别性能 (discrimination)，基于 WABAD 数据集；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把地理先验与声学预测做校准式融合，是通向更简单、更可靠的广域生物多样性声学监测的一条路径。

papers.title: The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Sampling based consistency is widely used for hallucination detection, yet aggregate performance can conceal systematic differences in which errors are detectable. This work studies that heterogeneity across four language models and three factual question answering datasets. Partitioning hallucinations by answer agreement reveals high agreement (Ghost) and low agreement (Flickering) regimes with an apparent detectability gap of $0.35$ to $0.46$ AUC. Because the statistics used to define the regimes and measure this gap are strongly coupled ($|ρ|\approx0.94$ to $1.00$), the raw result is treated as a property of agreement based detection rather than independent evidence. After freezing regime assignments, lexical and semantic response dispersion preserve the asymmetry, with bootstrap $95\%$ intervals excluding zero in all $12$ model and dataset settings. A stricter test using individual diffusion trajectories and no cross seed information preserves the asymmetry across all three LLaDA datasets ($p<0.005$) and directionally across all three Dream datasets, with one reaching significance. The hard regime varies substantially in prevalence across models ($16\%$ to $77\%$), and matched prompts frequently change regimes between models. These findings show that aggregate detection metrics conceal persistent, model dependent heterogeneity in language model failures and motivate regime conditioned evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于采样一致性的幻觉检测在聚合 AUC 下掩盖了系统性差异：按答案一致性把幻觉切成高一致 (Ghost) 与低一致 (Flickering) 两档后，可检测性差距达 0.35–0.46 AUC。冻结档位划分后，词面与语义响应离散度仍保持该不对称，12 个模型×数据集设置的 bootstrap 95% 区间均不含零；作者据此主张按 regime 分层评估检测器。
Motivation: 聚合检测指标把不同可检测性的错误平均在一起，掩盖了语言模型失败的模型依赖异质性，导致对幻觉检测器的评估失真。
Method: 在 4 个语言模型与 3 个事实问答数据集上，用采样一致性按答案一致性划分 Ghost/Flickering 两档；先处理统计量耦合（|ρ|≈0.94–1.00）带来的循环性，再冻结档位，改用词面与语义响应离散度并做 bootstrap；最后用单条 diffusion 轨迹、不跨 seed 的更严格检验，覆盖 LLaDA 与 Dream 模型。
Result: 表观可检测性差距 0.35–0.46 AUC；定义档位与度量差距的统计量强耦合（|ρ|≈0.94–1.00）；冻结划分后 12 个模型-数据集设置的 bootstrap 95% 区间均不含零；单轨迹无跨 seed 检验在全部 3 个 LLaDA 数据集上 p<0.005，在 3 个 Dream 数据集上方向一致、其中 1 个显著；难档占比随模型在 16% 到 77% 之间变化，同一批 prompt 常在不同模型间换档。
Conclusion: 聚合检测指标会掩盖持续且依赖模型的异质性，幻觉检测评估应按 regime 分层报告，而不是只报总体 AUC。

papers.title: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
papers.abstract_en: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mara Chain 把 propose-evaluate-select 中被丢弃的候选保留下来，用历次尝试累积的证据在固定深度的链上迭代精修，并用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 限制候选池。在 AppWorld 技能优化、TerminalBench 2.1 harness 优化与 MuSiQue 检索管线优化上，它以更少 rollout 取得更大任务性能增益：AppWorld 相对性能最高超 GEPA/ACE/SkillOpt-Lite 达 20.5%，达到目标分所需 rollout 比 GEPA 少 65.5%。
Motivation: 对已部署 AI 系统的优化对象已从权重转向 prompt、skill、harness 与代码，而现有 propose-evaluate-select 流程直接丢弃未过验收线的候选，导致后续提案反复回到同样的失败模式。
Method: Mara Chain 是一条精修流程：不丢弃被拒候选，而是保留它并用此前尝试累积的证据迭代精修；每条精修链限制固定深度，并以 Pareto-filtered Top-N 选择约束候选池规模。评测对象为 AppWorld 技能优化、TerminalBench 2.1 harness 优化、MuSiQue 检索管线优化。
Result: AppWorld 上相对性能最高比 GEPA、ACE、SkillOpt-Lite 高 20.5%，达到目标分所需 rollout 比 GEPA 少 65.5%；TerminalBench 2.1 上 pass rate 分别比 AHE 与 Meta-Harness 高 20.2 和 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上相对手写检索管线 test nDCG@10 与 Recall@10 分别提升 0.104 与 0.131。
Conclusion: 被拒候选本身携带对后续优化关键的信息，沿链精修而非丢弃，可以在更少 rollout 下取得更大的任务性能增益。

papers.title: Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility
papers.abstract_en: In the field of Machine Learning, many papers contain empirical results supporting claimed statements or illustrating the performance of a proposed method. However, most practitioners know that (1) results are generally hard to reproduce, and increasingly so, (2) code is not often available to do so, and (3) it hinders the development of research. In this position paper, we analyze and quantify these issues, and make concrete proposals to improve result checkability, if not reproducibility. Code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track 的立场论文：ML 论文的经验结果越来越难复现、代码常不公开，阻碍研究推进。作者对这些问题做了分析与量化，并提出以可验证性 (verifiability) 补足无法强制的可复现性 (reproducibility) 的具体改进建议，配套代码与材料已开源。
Motivation: ML 论文中支撑论断的经验结果普遍难以复现且趋势在恶化，代码又常常不提供，直接拖慢研究进展；强制可复现性不可行，需要一个可操作的替代目标。
Method: 对结果复现困难、代码缺失及其对研究的阻碍进行分析与量化，并在此基础上给出提升结果可检查性 (checkability) 的具体提案；配套代码与支持材料发布在 GitHub 仓库 position-enforce-verifiability。
Result: 论文声称分析并量化了复现困难、代码不可得与研究受阻这三类问题，并给出具体提案；摘要中未列出任何数值、数据集或基线对比。
Conclusion: 在无法强制可复现性的情况下，应转而强化可验证性，用可检查性作为提升 ML 经验结果可信度的抓手。

papers.title: A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields
papers.abstract_en: Pooled statistics of Transformer weights obscure how magnitude is distributed across functional channels, while individual weights are too numerous to compare directly. We study the mesoscopic level between them: row and column scale fields, the median-centred log-RMS profiles of a weight matrix over its channels, which together with a global scale and a full balanced core represent the matrix exactly. Across public Pythia checkpoints at four sizes and controlled runs from three initialization families, balancing reveals similar measured core magnitude profiles. A mixture bridge, with its form fixed before the analysis and its coefficients fitted, predicts the pooled-shape departure from field width on held-out runs and data arms of the controlled grid. The indexed fields retain further structure: they align across projections that share a functional channel, and query/key profiles follow reassigned RoPE frequencies rather than fixed matrix coordinates. Training trajectories show early field formation followed by component-dependent broadening or recession. Extending the channel-based analysis to AdamW's second moment reveals related functional organization in its log-space row and column factors. Finally, edits of a frozen checkpoint separate reciprocal scale balance, which preserves the forward computation, from relative channel gain: flattening the gain increases in-distribution loss while preserving matrix norms and the balanced core. Row and column scale fields thus connect pooled magnitude statistics to channel organization and provide coordinates for tracking and testing trained weight structure.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public (directory scale_field, tag p5-scale-field-v1)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Transformer 权重矩阵的行/列通道统计成 median-centred log-RMS 的 scale field，与全局 scale 和 balanced core 一起精确重构矩阵，从而在池化统计与单权重之间给出介观视图。在 Pythia 四个尺寸与三类初始化的受控运行中，balancing 后 core 幅度剖面相似，mixture bridge 能在留出运行上预测 pooled-shape 偏离 field width；冻结检查点上压平 relative channel gain 会抬高 in-distribution loss，同时矩阵范数与 balanced core 不变。
Motivation: 池化权重统计抹掉了功能通道上的幅度分布，而逐权重比较规模又太大；需要一个介于两者之间、能对齐通道功能并可追踪训练演化的表示。
Method: 定义行/列 scale field（通道上 median-centred log-RMS 剖面），与全局 scale 和 full balanced core 构成矩阵的精确分解；用形式先固定、系数再拟合的 mixture bridge 在留出运行与受控网格的数据臂上预测 pooled-shape；把同一分析扩展到 AdamW 二阶矩的 log 空间行列因子，并对冻结检查点做编辑实验区分 reciprocal scale balance 与 relative channel gain。
Result: 在 Pythia 四个尺寸的公开检查点与三类初始化的受控运行上，balancing 后测得的 core 幅度剖面相似；mixture bridge 在留出运行和受控网格的数据臂上预测 field width 引起的 pooled-shape 偏离；索引后的 field 在共享功能通道的 projection 间对齐，query/key 剖面跟随重新分配的 RoPE 频率而非固定矩阵坐标；训练轨迹呈早期 field 形成、随后随组件展宽或回缩；冻结检查点上压平 relative channel gain 提高 in-distribution loss，同时保持矩阵范数与 balanced core 不变。
Conclusion: 行/列 scale field 把池化幅度统计与通道组织连起来，可作为追踪和检验已训练权重结构的坐标；幅度平衡本身保持前向计算，起作用的是通道间的相对增益。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learned Compression of SAR Phase-History Data: A Rate-Honest Feasibility Study on GOTCHA
papers.abstract_en: On-board compression of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) phase history is bandwidth-critical, and block-adaptive quantization (BAQ) remains the operational standard. We test whether a small convolutional autoencoder, with its encoder on the sensor, can compete with BAQ on complex phase-history patches from the AFRL GOTCHA collection. Every method is charged for all transmitted bits, rates are reported in bits per complex sample (b/cs), and detection is scored by one-to-one matching of CA-CFAR detections. The autoencoder (28,656 encoder parameters) loses at every rate. At 16 b/cs it reaches -2.87 dB NMSE, against -35.5 dB for 8-bit BAQ with $\pm 3σ$ clipping and -41.0 dB with a tuned clipping range. It also loses to a $16 \times 16$ block Karhunen-Loève transform (KLT), a local linear coder with a tenth of its encoder cost (-5.39 dB). Running the network in a companded Fourier domain helps, but its detection F1 remains bounded at 33%. The evidence points to this model, its normalization, and its objective, not to a fundamental limit of learned coding. Per patch, the data have modest lag-1 coherence ($|ρ| \approx 0.3$) and patch-specific spectral concentration. Two findings concern evaluation itself. First, 97% of CFAR crossings on raw $64 \times 64$ patches are border artifacts of the zero-padded detector. Second, on interior cells BAQ's clipping range decides detection: 8-bit BAQ keeps 69% F1 with tuned clipping but 17% at $\pm 3σ$, and at 8 b/cs or less adaptive FFT thresholding preserves more detections than BAQ. We close with an evaluation protocol for learned radar compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AFRL GOTCHA 相位历史数据上做速率诚实 (rate-honest) 的星上 SAR 压缩可行性研究：小型卷积自编码器（编码器 28,656 参数）在所有码率上都输给 BAQ 与 16×16 KLT。16 b/cs 时自编码器 NMSE 为 -2.87 dB，而 8-bit BAQ（±3σ 截断）为 -35.5 dB、调优截断为 -41.0 dB；作者把失败归因于模型、归一化与目标函数，而非学习编码的根本极限。
Motivation: SAR 相位历史的星上压缩直接决定下行带宽，BAQ 仍是业务标准，但学习式压缩的对比常因未计入全部传输比特或检测评分方式不当而失真，需要一次速率对齐、以检测为终点的诚实评估。
Method: 用小型卷积自编码器（编码器置于传感器端，28,656 参数）压缩 GOTCHA 复数相位历史图块，所有方法按传输比特计费并以 b/cs 报告码率；检测用 CA-CFAR 一对一匹配打分，另测试 companded Fourier 域运行网络，并与 BAQ、16×16 块 KLT、局部线性编码器及自适应 FFT 阈值对比。
Result: 自编码器在每个码率都落后：16 b/cs 时 NMSE -2.87 dB，对比 8-bit BAQ ±3σ 截断 -35.5 dB、调优截断 -41.0 dB，也输给编码器成本仅十分之一的 16×16 KLT（-5.39 dB）；companded Fourier 域改善重建但检测 F1 仍封顶在 33%。评估方面：原始 64×64 图块上 97% 的 CFAR 过阈是零填充检测器的边界伪影；内部单元上 BAQ 检测由截断范围决定，调优截断保 69% F1、±3σ 仅 17%；8 b/cs 及以下自适应 FFT 阈值比 BAQ 保留更多检测。图块 lag-1 相干性约 |ρ|≈0.3，具图块特异的谱集中。
Conclusion: 学习式压缩在该设置下输给 BAQ 与 KLT 是模型、归一化和目标的问题而非根本极限；雷达学习压缩的评测必须计全传输比特、剔除零填充边界伪影，并把截断范围与 CFAR 检测一起报告，作者据此给出一套评测协议。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 学习式压缩在该设置下输给 BAQ 与 KLT 是模型、归一化和目标的问题而非根本极限；雷达学习压缩的评测必须计全传输比特、剔除零填充边界伪影，并把截断范围与 CFAR 检测一起报告，作者据此给出一套评测协议。

papers.title: Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis: Mapping Technological Diffusion across Academic Preprints, Patent Signals, and Compute Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Macroeconomic productivity metrics, such as Total Factor Productivity, register technological breakthroughs with multi-year reporting lags due to administrative survey intervals and national accounting conventions. This paper introduces Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis (HSTA), an unsupervised quantitative methodology that tracks technology diffusion directly from unstructured scientific and commercial text streams. We analyze 30,000 filtered document records spanning academic preprints from arXiv and patent application records from the USPTO. By projecting high-dimensional Transformer sentence embeddings onto unit hyperspheres using Spherical K-Means clustering across eight primary sub-topics and UMAP manifold reductions, HSTA formalizes two quantitative metrics: (1) Semantic Centroid Vector Drift, which tracks vocabulary shifts between temporal sub-corpora to identify structural paradigm transformations; and (2) Commercialization Offset, which evaluates cross-corpus peak density alignments between scientific discovery and intellectual property filings. Linking quarterly topic volume velocity with physical hardware metrics from the Epoch AI database, Vector Autoregressive F-tests demonstrate that quarterly paper volume velocity alone does not Granger-cause frontier compute allocation surges at conventional statistical significance levels, highlighting the necessity of conditioning textual signals on physical capital constraints. Empirical results reveal that sub-topics covering Large Language Models (with a drift metric of 0.332) and Artificial Intelligence Systems (with a drift metric of 0.234) undergo the highest rate of semantic evolution, offering an objective, real-time mechanism to complement traditional economic statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无监督的超球语义轨迹分析 (HSTA)，把 arXiv 预印本与 USPTO 专利文本的 Transformer 句嵌入投影到单位超球面，用语义质心漂移与商业化偏移两个指标追踪技术扩散。30,000 条文档记录上，LLM 子主题漂移 0.332、AI Systems 0.234 最高；向量自回归 F 检验显示论文季度流量速度单独并不 Granger-cause 前沿算力配置激增。
Motivation: 全要素生产率等宏观生产率指标因行政调查间隔与国民核算惯例存在数年报告滞后，难以实时捕捉技术突破；需要直接从非结构化科研与商业文本流中客观追踪技术扩散。
Method: 对 30,000 条过滤文档记录（arXiv 预印本 + USPTO 专利申请）做 Transformer 句嵌入，用 Spherical K-Means 在八个主要子主题上聚合并以 UMAP 降维；形式化 Semantic Centroid Vector Drift（跨时间子语料的词汇漂移）与 Commercialization Offset（科学发现与专利提交的跨语料峰值密度对齐），再把季度主题流量速度与 Epoch AI 硬件指标做向量自回归 F 检验。
Result: LLM 子主题漂移指标 0.332、AI Systems 0.234，为语义演化最快的两个子主题；向量自回归 F 检验显示论文季度流量速度在常规显著性水平下并不 Granger-cause 前沿算力配置激增。
Conclusion: 文本语义信号需与物理资本约束条件化结合才有解释力，HSTA 可作为传统经济统计的实时客观补充机制。

papers.title: Beyond Rule-Based Mutation Testing: Test-Aware Mutant Generation Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mutation testing evaluates test-suite adequacy by injecting synthetic faults into program code. However, traditional rule-based tools often generate large numbers of trivial, redundant, or equivalent mutants that limit their practical use for identifying gaps in a test suite. While recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches generate more realistic faults, most remain test-blind: The model sees only the source code and cannot reason about what existing tests already cover. We propose test-aware mutant generation, in which an LLM receives the problem statement, canonical solution and base tests in a single prompt, and must generate a nontrivial mutant that passes the base unit tests. We evaluate this approach across a set of five LLMs -- Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT 5.1 Codex Mini, GPT 4.1 Mini, Qwen3-32B -- on the HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks. The extended EvalPlus test suites serve as an automated oracle to verify whether surviving mutants represent genuine bugs. Test-aware prompting yields verified fault rates of 87.7% (HumanEval) and 79.1% (MBPP), meaning these mutants pass all base tests but are caught by the oracle. This vastly outperforms the matched test-blind prompting (which yields only 12.2% and 23.0%, respectively) and the traditional rule-based tool mutmut (4.4% and 5.7%). While fault subtlety (the fraction of extended tests a mutant fails) remains comparable across all three methods, test-awareness minimizes the computational cost per verified fault, compared to test-blind prompting. Exposing an LLM to existing unit tests shifts mutant generation from untargeted bug injection toward effective discovery of weaknesses in an existing test suite. Our work establishes a concrete foundation for future research to scale test-aware mutant generation to production-level environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 test-aware 变异体生成：把题目描述、标准解和基础测试放进同一个 prompt，让 LLM 生成能通过基础测试的非平凡变异体。在 HumanEval 与 MBPP 上用 EvalPlus 扩展测试做 oracle，验证故障率 87.7% 与 79.1%，远高于 test-blind prompt 的 12.2%/23.0% 和 mutmut 的 4.4%/5.7%。
Motivation: 规则式变异测试工具产生大量平凡、冗余或等价变异体，难以定位测试套件缺口；已有 LLM 变异方法多为 test-blind，模型只看源码，无法推理现有测试覆盖了什么。
Method: 单条 prompt 输入问题描述、canonical solution 与 base tests，要求生成能通过基础单元测试的非平凡变异体；在五个 LLM（Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 3 Flash、GPT 5.1 Codex Mini、GPT 4.1 Mini、Qwen3-32B）上于 HumanEval 与 MBPP 评测，用扩展 EvalPlus 测试套件作为自动 oracle 判定存活变异体是否为真实缺陷。
Result: 验证故障率：test-aware 87.7%（HumanEval）、79.1%（MBPP）；匹配的 test-blind prompt 为 12.2% 与 23.0%；规则式工具 mutmut 为 4.4% 与 5.7%。三种方法的 fault subtlety（变异体失败的扩展测试占比）相当，而 test-aware 在每个验证故障上的计算成本低于 test-blind prompt。
Conclusion: 让 LLM 看到现有单元测试，可把变异生成从无目标注入缺陷转向有效发现测试套件弱点，并降低单位验证故障的计算成本；作者认为这为把 test-aware 变异生成扩展到生产级环境奠定基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Estimation of Room Impulse Responses from Handclaps
papers.abstract_en: Handclaps provide an equipment-free excitation for room acoustics, but their unknown and variable source waveform makes room impulse response (RIR) estimation challenging. In this work, we investigate whether RIRs can be estimated directly from handclaps. To this end, we introduce an anechoic handclap dataset containing 2,540 claps from 17 participants, designed to capture variability across natural claps and different hand configurations. We first establish the performance attainable when the excitation clap is known using regularized deconvolution, and show that approximating the unknown excitation by windowing the direct sound from the reverberant recording is insufficient. To estimate the RIR without a known excitation, we propose using the anechoic handclap recordings to train a deep neural network with a supervised regression objective. Evaluated on a controlled synthetic benchmark, the proposed neural regressor significantly outperforms windowing-based baselines across all instrumental metrics. Furthermore, we test the proposed method on handclap recordings measured in real acoustic spaces, showing that the inferred RIR spectra are consistent across different handclap measurements taken in the same room location. These results showcase the feasibility of directly estimating RIRs from natural handclaps without requiring knowledge of the excitation signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 拍手作为免设备的房间脉冲响应 (RIR) 激励源，其未知且多变的波形使反卷积困难；作者用 2,540 条无回声拍手录音训练深度回归网络直接从自然拍手估计 RIR。在受控合成基准上该神经回归器在全部指标上显著优于基于直接声加窗的基线，真实房间录音推得的 RIR 频谱在同一位置不同拍手间保持一致。
Motivation: 拍手是零设备的房间声学激励，但源波形未知且每次不同，直接反卷积不可行；用加窗近似未知激励效果不足，需要不依赖已知激励的 RIR 估计手段。
Method: 构建含 17 名参与者、2,540 条拍手的无回声 (anechoic) 数据集，覆盖自然拍手与不同手部构型的变异；先用已知激励的正则化反卷积给出性能上界，再以无回声录音为输入、以监督回归目标训练深度神经网络直接输出 RIR。
Result: 在受控合成基准上，所提神经回归器在全部指标上显著优于加窗类基线；在真实声学空间实测拍手上，同一房间位置不同拍手推得的 RIR 频谱一致。已知激励时正则化反卷积可建立可达性能，而对混响录音直接声加窗近似未知激励并不充分。
Conclusion: 无需知道激励信号即可直接从自然拍手估计 RIR，拍手可作为免设备的房间声学测量激励；加窗近似未知激励这条路走不通。

papers.title: Amadeus: When Models of People Meet
papers.abstract_en: With the sheer constant advancements raining down in the field of Artificial Intelligence, one particular possibility that may cross our mind is whether it is possible to model agents after humans and, in turn, use these agents to carry out synthetic interactions that predict their real counterparts, or even interactions at a larger scale such as groups or societies. In this paper, we test a more controlled version of this question through chess. We use 8 elite chess players, seal their direct pairwise games, learn each player independently using different methods, and then compose the resulting models on the withheld dyads. To evaluate the generated interactions, we use two measurements: opening-family total variation distance and win-draw-loss (WDL) total variation distance. M1 reduces WDL-TV while leaving opening-family TV largely unchanged, whereas M2 substantially reduces opening-family TV while having little effect on WDL-TV. An additional post-hoc method combining components of the other two retains improvements across both measurements. These results suggest that independently learned models can recover aspects of previously unseen interactions, and that recovery across different behavioural aspects need not be mutually exclusive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 8 名国际象棋精英选手的成对对局做留出检验：各自独立学出选手模型，再在被封存的两两对局 (dyad) 上组合生成交互。M1 降低胜负平总变差距离 (WDL-TV) 而开局族 TV 基本不变，M2 大幅降低开局族 TV 而对 WDL-TV 影响很小，事后组合方法在两个指标上同时保留改进。
Motivation: 能否用按人建模的 agent 合成交互来预测真实对手及更大规模的群体行为，是一个开放问题；需要在可控设定下检验独立学习的模型能否复原从未见过的交互。
Method: 取 8 名精英棋手，封存其直接两两对局，用不同方法分别独立学习每位棋手的模型，再把模型组合到留出的 dyad 上生成交互；用开局族总变差距离与胜负平 (WDL) 总变差距离两个指标评估。
Result: M1 降低 WDL-TV 而开局族 TV 基本不变；M2 显著降低开局族 TV 而对 WDL-TV 影响很小；结合前两者分量的事后方法在两个指标上都保持改进。
Conclusion: 独立学习的模型可以复原未见交互的某些方面，且不同行为维度上的复原不必互相排斥。

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Routing for Reliable Reasoning on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Running a language model on edge hardware provides private and low-latency reasoning without a network connection, and yet the small models that fit on such devices are unreliable on the tasks computers are expected to handle well, such as arithmetic, algebra, and formal logic problems. We argue that much of this unreliability is avoidable. Many queries appearing to demand reasoning are in fact structurally deterministic and permit fast and exact symbolic solutions. Therefore, forcing a probabilistic model to approximate them sacrifices accuracy and energy for little benefit. We present a neurosymbolic router that classifies each incoming query and dispatches it to the cheapest correct solver, sending structured tasks to deterministic engines and reserving the small language model (SLM) for open-ended word problems. Instead of hand-coding the routing logic, we learn a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) with the L* grammatical inference algorithm, using the SLM as a membership oracle and labeled data as an equivalence oracle. On a Raspberry Pi 4B (8 GB RAM, no GPU), evaluated on 100 untested prompts from DeepMind Mathematics, GSM8K, and RuleTaker, learned routing attains 100% routing accuracy and 98.3% overall accuracy with a 512-token reasoning budget (93.3% on word problems), compared with 72.0% for the strongest agent baseline, Program-of-Thought, and 58.7% for a tool-calling agent given the same solvers. Since formatted queries never reach the model, the router answers them in 1-11 ms and, in its 30-token configuration, runs 8.8x faster and 2.8x more energy-efficient than Program-of-Thought.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在树莓派 4B 上用 L* 文法推断学出的 DFA 路由器把查询分派给最便宜的正确求解器：结构化任务走确定性引擎，只有开放式应用题留给 SLM。100 条未测 prompt 上路由准确率 100%、总体 98.3%（512 token 预算），对比 Program-of-Thought 的 72.0%；格式化查询 1–11 ms 内答完，30-token 配置下比 PoT 快 8.8 倍、能效高 2.8 倍。
Motivation: 边缘设备上的小模型在算术、代数、形式逻辑等任务上不可靠，而这些查询其实结构确定、可由符号引擎精确求解，强行让概率模型近似既费精度又费能耗。
Method: 神经符号路由器对每条查询分类并分派：结构化任务交给确定性引擎，开放式应用题交给 SLM。路由逻辑不用手写，而是用 L* 文法推断学一个 DFA，以 SLM 作 membership oracle、标注数据作 equivalence oracle；在 Raspberry Pi 4B（8 GB RAM、无 GPU）上以 512-token 与 30-token 推理预算评测。
Result: 在 DeepMind Mathematics、GSM8K、RuleTaker 的 100 条未测 prompt 上：路由准确率 100%，总体准确率 98.3%（512-token 预算），应用题 93.3%；最强 agent 基线 Program-of-Thought 为 72.0%，同求解器配置的 tool-calling agent 为 58.7%。格式化查询 1–11 ms 内由路由器直接回答；30-token 配置下比 PoT 快 8.8 倍、能效高 2.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把结构确定的查询从概率模型手里拿走、用学到的 DFA 路由到确定性求解器，可在无 GPU 的边缘设备上同时拿到接近满值的准确率和数量级的延迟与能耗收益。

papers.title: Bringing Agentic Search to Earth Observation Data Discovery
papers.abstract_en: NASA and its data centers hold thousands of geoscience datasets and tools like Worldview, Giovanni, the Science Discovery Engine, and Harmony. Finding the right one is hard even for domain experts. We present an agentic search framework for geoscience data discovery that takes a natural-language research query and returns matching datasets and tools. We demonstrate that, in the era of large language models, the latent value of knowledge graphs (KGs) can be substantially amplified through agentic search. From the NASA Earth Observation Knowledge Graph (NASA EO-KG) we derive NASA-EO-Bench, an open benchmark of 47k query-dataset pairs (21k task-based queries). A neural scorer fine-tuned on NASA-EO-Bench beats cosine and BM25 baselines. Further combining it with BM25 via score fusion raises both Recall@10 (R@10) and MRR to over 5x the unadapted cosine baseline. On top of this supervised pipeline, a zero-shot reranking stage lifts MRR by 16%, significant under a paired bootstrap, with no additional training, and autonomous web and arXiv tool use adds a further gain, showing that LLM reasoning is complementary to supervised retrieval.
papers.comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 (full research paper). v2: camera-ready version; LLM rerank model sweep extended from N=200 to N=600 test queries with paired-bootstrap significance tests; adds a fine-tuned cross-encoder (bge-reranker-v2-m3) as a supervised reranking baseline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向地球科学数据发现的 agentic search 框架：把自然语言研究查询映射到 NASA 数据集与工具，并从 NASA EO-KG 构建开放基准 NASA-EO-Bench（47k query-dataset 对，21k 任务型查询）。神经打分器微调后与 BM25 分数融合，Recall@10 与 MRR 达到未适配余弦基线的 5 倍以上；其上叠加零样本 reranking 再把 MRR 提升 16%（paired bootstrap 显著），自主 web 与 arXiv 工具调用继续增益，说明 LLM 推理与有监督检索互补。
Motivation: NASA 及其数据中心有数千个地学数据集与 Worldview、Giovanni、Science Discovery Engine、Harmony 等工具，即便领域专家也难以定位合适资源；知识图谱的潜在价值在 LLM 时代尚未被充分释放。
Method: 从 NASA EO-KG 派生 NASA-EO-Bench 基准，训练在该基准上微调的神经打分器，与 BM25 做 score fusion；其上叠加零样本 LLM reranking 阶段，并接入自主 web 与 arXiv 工具调用。camera-ready 版把 rerank 模型扫描从 N=200 扩到 N=600 测试查询并做 paired-bootstrap 显著性检验，另加入微调 cross-encoder bge-reranker-v2-m3 作为有监督 reranking 基线。
Result: NASA-EO-Bench 含 47k query-dataset 对、其中 21k 任务型查询；微调神经打分器胜过余弦与 BM25 基线，与 BM25 分数融合后 Recall@10 与 MRR 均超过未适配余弦基线的 5 倍；零样本 reranking 在无额外训练下把 MRR 提升 16%（paired bootstrap 显著），自主 web 与 arXiv 工具使用再增益。
Conclusion: 知识图谱经 agentic search 可被显著放大：有监督检索打底、零样本 LLM rerank 与工具调用逐层叠加，LLM 推理与监督检索互补而非替代。

papers.title: When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic self-correction asks a language model to revise its own answer without receiving new external evidence. A second pass can recover mistakes, but it can also overturn answers that were already correct. We study this trade-off across 29 open-weight LLMs on BoolQ, GSM8K, and Corr2Cause by tracking correctness transitions between initial and revised answers. Aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behavior: for example, Llama-3.1-8B improves by 25.5 percentage points on GSM8K, while refinement changes 19.1% of initially correct answers into wrong ones. A controlled BoolQ study further shows that refinement prompts shift the balance between recovery and harm. We then compare three runtime choices: keeping the initial answer, always accepting the revision, and selectively invoking revision using signals available after the initial response. The comparison identifies settings where learned gating is useful and others where a simpler unconditional policy performs better. These results suggest treating intrinsic self-correction as a revision policy rather than as a uniformly beneficial second pass, and evaluating it through both the corrections it recovers and the errors it introduces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 29 个开源 LLM 上追踪 BoolQ、GSM8K、Corr2Cause 初始答案与修订答案的正确性转移，证明 intrinsic self-correction 不是普适有益的第二遍，而是需要按恢复收益与致错代价权衡的修订策略 (revision policy)。Llama-3.1-8B 在 GSM8K 上提升 25.5 个百分点，同时把 19.1% 原本正确的答案改错；learned gating 只在部分设置下优于无条件接受修订。
Motivation: intrinsic self-correction 的聚合准确率会掩盖两种相反的转移：既可能救回错误，也可能推翻已正确的答案，导致无法判断何时该让模型改自己的答案。
Method: 在 29 个开源 LLM 上于 BoolQ、GSM8K、Corr2Cause 追踪初始与修订答案之间的正确性转移；用受控 BoolQ 实验改变 refinement prompt 以观察恢复与致错的平衡；再比较三种运行时策略——保留初始答案、总是接受修订、用初始回答后可得信号选择性触发修订（含 learned gating）。
Result: Llama-3.1-8B 在 GSM8K 上聚合准确率提升 25.5 个百分点，同时 refinement 把 19.1% 初始正确的答案改成错误；受控 BoolQ 实验显示 refinement prompt 会移动恢复与致错的平衡；三种运行时策略的比较识别出 learned gating 有用的设置，也存在更简单的无条件策略表现更好的设置。
Conclusion: intrinsic self-correction 应被当作可选的修订策略而非一律有益的第二遍，并且要用它救回的错误和它引入的错误两方面共同评估。

papers.title: Meta-learning accelerates detector design optimization
papers.abstract_en: The quality of a detector design is ultimately determined by the quality of the inference it enables, that is, by the accuracy with which the quantities of interest are reconstructed from the raw detector response. For complex detectors, the inference is performed by machine learning models, and the relation between the design and the attainable inference performance is, in general, non-trivial. In this work, we consider the optimization of the inference performance with respect to the detector design. The conventional approach prescribes retraining the inference model at every candidate design, thus, treating the evaluations as independent tasks and discarding the shared structure of the optimal inference algorithms at different designs. We propose the meta-learned objective estimate (MLOE): instead of solving the inference problem anew at every candidate design, a single meta-inference model, conditioned on the design and trained continually along the optimization path, is shared across all of them. We test MLOE on three families of optimization problems, the last of which comprises two design spaces of the Spectrometer Straw Tracker of the Search for Hidden Particles (SHiP) experiment; under matched budgets of simulation calls, the meta-inference model evaluates a candidate design using fewer simulation calls than the baseline strategies and holds the better rank over the convergence curve in all examined cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出元学习目标估计 (MLOE)：不再为每个候选探测器设计重训推理模型，而是用一个以设计为条件、沿优化路径持续训练的元推理模型共享所有设计点。在三类优化问题（含 SHiP 实验 Spectrometer Straw Tracker 的两个设计空间）上，同等仿真调用预算下 MLOE 用更少的仿真调用评估候选设计，且在全部考察案例的收敛曲线上保持更优排名。
Motivation: 复杂探测器的设计质量取决于从原始响应重建物理量的推理精度，而设计与可达推理性能的关系非平凡；常规做法在每个候选设计上重训推理模型，把各次评估当独立任务，丢弃了不同设计间最优推理算法的共享结构。
Method: MLOE 用单一元推理模型替代逐设计重训：模型以探测器设计为条件，并沿优化路径持续训练，从而在所有候选设计间共享；在三类优化问题上测试，其中最后一类包含 SHiP 实验 Spectrometer Straw Tracker 的两个设计空间。
Result: 在匹配的仿真调用预算下，MLOE 的元推理模型比基线策略用更少的仿真调用评估一个候选设计，并在所有考察案例的收敛曲线上保持更好的排名。
Conclusion: 把逐设计重训改为沿优化路径持续训练的条件化元推理模型，可在固定仿真预算内更快收敛到更优的探测器设计。

papers.title: CoVLM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Cooperative Driving Question Answering and Planning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in autonomous driving, but their success has primarily been studied in ego-centric scenes. Infrastructure-side observations provide views beyond the ego vehicle's field of view, yet conventional cooperative-driving systems typically transform them into geometric representations for downstream perception and planning. Directly incorporating these views into VLMs offers an opportunity to improve cooperative scene understanding and trajectory planning. However, question answering and trajectory planning have not been jointly evaluated on the same real-world vehicle-infrastructure scenes. We present CoVLM-Bench, a benchmark for cooperative driving question answering (CDQA) and cooperative planning (CP) on vehicle-infrastructure paired scenes. CoVLM-Bench provides scene-grounded CDQA annotations, three-part rationales as auxiliary supervision, and future trajectory targets derived from recorded ego motion. It contains 2,196 paired frames with 35,136 CDQA annotations, while CP predicts six waypoints over a three-second horizon. The annotations combine model-assisted drafting, record-based computation, and human verification. Built upon CoVLM-Bench, we introduce CoVLM-Drive, a unified VLM baseline that directly uses paired views for both CDQA and CP. Experiments show that CDQA adaptation improves answer accuracy and that CoVLM-Drive reaches a lower FDE than the compared V2X planners; QA initialization and rationale supervision each reduce planning error. Together, CoVLM-Bench and CoVLM-Drive support the training and comparison of VLMs for cooperative scene understanding and planning.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Main text 9 pages; appendices from page 17
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoVLM-Bench 把车-路配对场景上的协同驾驶问答 (CDQA) 与协同规划 (CP) 放进同一真实基准：2,196 对帧、35,136 条 CDQA 标注，CP 预测 3 秒视界内 6 个路径点。基于它提出的统一 VLM 基线 CoVLM-Drive 直接吃配对视角做两任务，CDQA 适配提升答案准确率，且相对对比的 V2X 规划器 FDE 更低，QA 初始化与 rationale 监督各自进一步降低规划误差。
Motivation: VLM 在自动驾驶的进展基本停留在以自车为中心的场景；路侧视角通常被转成几何表征再喂给下游，问答与轨迹规划从未在同一组真实车-路配对场景上被联合评测。
Method: 构建 CoVLM-Bench：场景落地的 CDQA 标注、作为辅助监督的三段式 rationale、由记录自车运动导出的未来轨迹目标，标注由模型起草 + 记录计算 + 人工核验合成；再提出 CoVLM-Drive，一个直接使用配对视角同时做 CDQA 与 CP 的统一 VLM 基线。
Result: 基准含 2,196 对帧与 35,136 条 CDQA 标注，CP 预测 3 秒视界内 6 个 waypoints。实验显示 CDQA 适配提高答案准确率；CoVLM-Drive 的 FDE 低于所对比的 V2X 规划器；QA 初始化与 rationale 监督各自降低规划误差。
Conclusion: 把路侧视角直接接入 VLM 并用同一基准联合训练问答与规划是可行路径：问答侧的适配与监督能直接转化为更低的规划误差。

summary_sections.result: 基准含 2,196 对帧与 35,136 条 CDQA 标注，CP 预测 3 秒视界内 6 个 waypoints。实验显示 CDQA 适配提高答案准确率；CoVLM-Drive 的 FDE 低于所对比的 V2X 规划器；QA 初始化与 rationale 监督各自降低规划误差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把路侧视角直接接入 VLM 并用同一基准联合训练问答与规划是可行路径：问答侧的适配与监督能直接转化为更低的规划误差。

papers.title: The Illusion of Replacement: Rethinking Specialized Machine Learning Models in the Foundation Model Era
papers.abstract_en: Specialized machine learning architectures encode structural assumptions (equivariance, permutation invariance, relational structure) that language-based foundation models lack by design. This review asks whether such assumptions can instead be acquired through language, drawing on a corpus of 186 papers published between 2016 and 2026 across nine modalities: tabular data, graphs, time series, vision, chemistry, code, knowledge graphs, point clouds, and protein structure. Methods are organized into eight representational regimes, ranging from language-only prompting to fully specialized architectures, and are assessed not only on predictive accuracy but on whether structural information is preserved by the representation and computed by the model. Language-mediated models prove competitive in extreme few-shot prediction, discretized symbolic tasks, and textually annotated knowledge graphs. No evidence of general replacement survives once structure itself is evaluated: where direct tests exist, apparent parity is traceable to information asymmetry, benchmark contamination, or computation performed outside the language model. Across independent research communities, missing structural inductive biases are reintroduced through graph modules, structure-aware tokens, or specialized attention, indicating that specialization is relocated rather than eliminated. The review closes by specifying a falsifiable controlled experiment that would measure the remaining gap directly. The derived data supporting the findings of this review are openly available in the repository at https://github.com/kiyan-rezaee/language-vs-structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述 2016–2026 年 186 篇论文、覆盖九种模态，把方法归入八种表征体制，判定语言基础模型能否通过语言习得等变性、置换不变性等结构假设。结论是：在极端少样本、离散符号任务和带文本标注的知识图谱上语言中介模型有竞争力，但一旦直接评测结构本身，表面持平都可归因于信息不对称、基准污染或模型外计算，结构归纳偏置以图模块、结构感知 token 或专用注意力的形式被重新引入，即专业化被迁移而非消除。
Motivation: 专用架构靠结构性假设（等变性、置换不变性、关系结构）获得能力，而语言基础模型按设计缺少这些假设；学界默认基础模型终将取代专用模型，但该假设从未在结构是否被保留与计算的口径下被检验。
Method: 以 2016–2026 年 186 篇论文为语料，覆盖表格、图、时间序列、视觉、化学、代码、知识图谱、点云、蛋白质结构九种模态；把方法组织为八种表征体制（从纯语言提示到完全专用架构），并按两条标准评估：预测精度之外，还看表征是否保留结构信息、模型是否在内部计算该结构。
Result: 语言中介模型在极端少样本预测、离散符号任务、带文本标注的知识图谱上具备竞争力；在存在直接测试的地方，没有一条通用取代的证据能成立，表面持平可追溯到信息不对称、基准污染或在语言模型之外完成的计算。跨独立研究社区，缺失的结构归纳偏置通过图模块、结构感知 token 或专用注意力被重新引入。综述为 75 页、11 张表、6 张图，并给出一个可证伪的受控实验设计以直接测量剩余差距，衍生数据开源在 GitHub 仓库。
Conclusion: 结构归纳偏置无法靠语言习得而被消除，只会从架构层迁移到模块、token 或注意力设计中；要判定取代是否真实，必须直接评测结构本身，并按文末给出的受控实验去测剩余差距。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models
papers.abstract_en: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用因果中介分析 (causal mediation analysis) 定位语言模型谄媚式赞同 (sycophantic agreement) 的机制：显式陈述的观点在提示最后一个 token 的残差流中很早被写入并偏置后续答案检索，由一小组早期注意力头承载；消融这些头显著降低谄媚且基本保持事实准确率。对于“你确定吗？”这类无内容施压 (content-free pushback)，则由另一组头抑制模型原本正确的答案、促成修改后的答案。
Motivation: 谄媚式赞同被普遍视为对齐失败，但其内部机制不清楚，导致干预手段缺少针对性。
Method: 以因果中介分析追踪观点信号在残差流与注意力头中的传播：定位承载显式观点的早期注意力头并做消融 (ablation)，再对无内容施压情形单独识别另一组头。
Result: 消融承载显式观点的早期注意力头显著减少谄媚，同时事实准确率基本保持不变；同一组头对显式观点的承载不随措辞改变；无内容施压触发一组不同的头，抑制原正确答案以促成修改答案。
Conclusion: 谄媚可分解为两条可分离的机制通路（显式观点写入与无内容施压抑制），因此对齐干预可以按头做定点处理而非整体微调。

papers.title: $τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages
papers.abstract_en: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: τ-Multilingual 把语音智能体基准 τ-Voice 扩展到西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，经母语者审校并对生成文本与语音输出分别评分。在 4,500 通全双工通话、五种语音配置下，西/葡/印地语任务完成率距英语不超过 3.2 个百分点，韩语与普通话分别掉 14.7 和 8.4 个百分点；韩语漏答更多、普通话打断更多，两者都在工具调用与实体处理上出错。
Motivation: 只用英语的基准只能看到语音智能体行为的一个窄切面，多语言下的任务完成、交互质量与生成质量差异无从暴露。
Method: 扩展 τ-Voice 覆盖五种语言，配母语者审校，评测生成的语言内容与口语输出；在 4,500 通全双工通话、五种语音配置上分别报告任务、交互、生成三类指标，并发布 language packs、validated judges 与工具。
Result: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语、印地语任务完成率距英语 3.2 个百分点以内；韩语下降 14.7 个百分点，普通话下降 8.4 个百分点。韩语系统漏答更多，普通话系统打断更频繁，两者在工具与实体上都吃力；Grok 任务完成率最高但生成质量得分最低。
Conclusion: 任务、交互与生成质量必须分开报告：任务完成领先者可能生成质量垫底，多语言语音智能体评测应由社区用开放的语言包与判分器共建。

papers.title: Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable
papers.abstract_en: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LUDI 指出均匀扩散语言模型 (UDLM) 难以扩展的根源是过均匀的训练目标与采样时的条件-目标混淆，提出 less uniform loss 把每个反向转移直接引向干净 token，并加入 per-token time embeddings 提供 token 级损坏提示以支持基于置信度的少步采样。把 7B 自回归模型继续训练成 LUDI-7B 后可做复杂推理，达到相对 AR 解码 3 token/step 的加速，性能与 masked diffusion 基线相当。
Motivation: 均匀扩散语言模型被视为有前景的扩散范式，但过均匀的训练目标和采样时的条件-目标混淆使其难以扩展，且复杂生成潜力尚未兑现。
Method: 提出 Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI) 框架：一是 less uniform loss，使每个反向转移指向干净 token，提供更干净的监督；二是给模型加 per-token time embeddings，注入 token 级损坏提示，从而支持基于置信度的少步采样 (confidence-based few-step sampling)。
Result: 跨规模实验显示 LUDI 改善了少步生成；将 7B 自回归模型继续训练得到 LUDI-7B，可进行复杂推理，相对 AR 解码取得 3 token/step 的加速，性能与 masked diffusion 基线相当。
Conclusion: UDLM 的瓶颈来自训练目标过均匀与采样混淆，放松均匀性后其在复杂生成上的全部潜力仍有待挖掘。

papers.title: PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrimeSeeker 用「latent anchor reasoning」把深检索拆成可监督的原子检索单元：从描述性规格中解出未命名的检索锚点，再把锚点转移到后续信息需求上，据此构造 web-grounded 锚点结构并联合生成问题与参考证据骨架。骨架在监督微调前被剥离、在强化学习阶段复用来审计 reference-step 覆盖，最终造出 9,221 条专家轨迹训练 30B 检索智能体，在五个深检索基准上表现强劲，且固定预算下用远少于长程系统的工具调用达到强解覆盖。
Motivation: 用更大证据图、更多跳数、更长轨迹这类全局属性来提升合成问题难度，只是局部检索能力的间接代理，与搜索时真正需要的检索能力不匹配。
Method: 定义 latent anchor reasoning（从描述性规格解出未命名检索锚点，再把恢复的锚点转移到后续信息需求），围绕锚点解析与关系转移组织出题，不预设唯一搜索路径；PrimeSeeker 据此构造 web-grounded 锚点结构并联合导出问题与参考证据骨架，骨架以当前工具观测的抽取式高亮引导专家生成，SFT 前删除高亮，之后复用于审计 reference-step 覆盖以支撑 RL 奖励。

papers.title: How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats
papers.abstract_en: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM judge 打分直接做统计检验会推高假阳性，且在人机一致性接近 almost perfect 时假阳性风险反而达到峰值。作者用 prediction-powered inference (PPI) 实现九个假设检验（含四个秩检验的首个 PPI 校正），并以 bootstrap-adaptive power tuning 稳住小规模人工标注校准集下的 PPI++ 权重，最终打包为 evalstats 自动选择校准方法。
Motivation: 学术界越来越多地基于 LLM judge 分数和小样本 AI 评测下显著性结论，但缺少校准良好的置信区间、假设检验与 judge 偏差校正，这类结论并不可靠。
Method: 针对混合人机评审设计给出统计分析指南与工具，用 prediction-powered inference (PPI) 实现九个假设检验，含 Wilcoxon signed-rank、Mann-Whitney U 及其 omnibus 变体的首个已知 PPI 校正；提出 bootstrap-adaptive power tuning，把估计权重向由标注数据得到的目标收缩并计入该权重自身的抽样方差；通过 Monte Carlo 模拟推导 N<100 小样本评测的 CI、p 值与 FWER 校正选择建议，封装为开源 Python 包 evalstats。
Result: Monte Carlo 模拟给出 N<100 小样本 AI 评测该用哪种 CI、p 值与 FWER 校正的推荐，并警告不要用 bootstrap CI；在三个演示场景中，一个真实 LLM judge 已达 substantial agreement 的案例本会让研究者发表虚假发现；共实现九个 PPI 假设检验，其中四个为秩检验的首个 PPI 校正。
Conclusion: 对原始 LLM judge 分数直接做统计会推高假阳性，且假阳性风险在 almost perfect 人机一致性处最高；小样本评测应改用 evalstats 自动选择的校准方法而非 bootstrap CI。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions
papers.abstract_en: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at www.breakingweb.app.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BreakingWeb 把浏览器使用任务的难度变成可编程的环境属性：对 agent 已能解出的基线任务施加受控干预，保持指令、隐含目标与后端成功判据不变，只改 web 栈不同层的环境。519 组 clean/intervention 任务对上，六个强 browser-use agent 平均 pass rate 掉 22.9%、近一半原本做对的任务被翻转，而人类首次只掉 10.0%、熟悉一次后掉 5.7%；75% 的 agent 失败以宣称成功但目标从未改变收场（belief failure）。
Motivation: 浏览器 agent 基准靠不断收集新任务、新网站来追难度，成本高且多个变量同时变化，无法判断究竟是什么让任务变难。
Method: 为每个基线任务配一个干预条件，保持用户指令、latent target 与后端成功判据不变，只在 web 栈不同层改变环境；每个干预确定、可检测、可恢复，并标注其主要加载的认知原语 (cognitive primitive)。评测六个强 browser-use agent、三个只看截图的 GUI-only agent 与人类，全部按结果 (outcome) 打分。
Result: 基准含 519 组 clean/intervention 任务对、七个自托管网站、29 个干预族。干预使 agent 平均 pass rate 下降 22.9%，并翻转每个 agent 干净解出任务的近一半；人类首次尝试只下降 10.0%，熟悉一次后下降 5.7%。六个 agent 的失败中 75% 以声明成功但所需变更从未发生结束。
Conclusion: 难度可以由环境干预确定性地注入而不改任务本身，且 agent 的主导失效模式是 belief failure 而非人类式的操作困难；代码、数据与环境在 www.breakingweb.app 公开。

papers.title: Local Predictability and Collective Fidelity in LLM-Agent Societies
papers.abstract_en: Compact surrogates could reduce the cost of simulating large language model societies, but must reproduce collective behavior. We compare individual predictions and collective forecasts using 9,455 published trajectories and new experiments on opinion dynamics. Neighbor information improves individual prediction in all 16 public-data settings and pooled collective forecasts on held-out questions, although collective gains depend on transfer conditions. Tests on 24 new statements do not confirm earlier contrasting history effects in forecasts from the initial state. Qwen benefits from history after three observed rounds. These findings motivate direct collective validation, explicit limits on available observations, and comparisons with simple baselines.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 7 figures. Standalone empirical companion to arXiv:2608.11215
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 9,455 条已发布 LLM-Agent 社会轨迹加新的观点动力学实验，检验个体预测与集体预测的可预测性：邻居信息在全部 16 个公开数据设置中都改善个体预测，并在留出问题上改善汇总后的集体预测，但集体收益依赖迁移条件。24 条新陈述的测试未复现早期从初始状态出发的相反历史效应，Qwen 在观察三轮之后才从历史中获益。
Motivation: 用紧凑代理替代大规模 LLM 社会仿真需要先证明其能复现集体行为，而个体预测准确并不自动保证集体预测准确，且历史信息的作用此前结论相互矛盾。
Method: 在 9,455 条已发布轨迹上比较个体预测与集体预测，并新增观点动力学 (opinion dynamics) 实验；检验邻居信息在 16 个公开数据设置中的作用，用 24 条新陈述测试历史效应，并考察 Qwen 在多轮观察下的历史利用。
Result: 邻居信息在全部 16 个公开数据设置中改善个体预测，并在留出问题上改善汇总集体预测，但集体收益依赖迁移条件；24 条新陈述的测试未确认早期从初始状态出发的相反历史效应；Qwen 在观察三轮后从历史中获益。
Conclusion: 集体层面的预测能力必须直接验证，并显式限定可用观测量的范围，同时与简单基线对比，不能由个体预测表现推断集体保真度。

papers.title: Lookahead-R: Budget-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution-Centric Planning
papers.abstract_en: Tool retrieval is a critical bottleneck for LLM-based agents operating over large, heterogeneous API ecosystems. Existing approaches face an inherent trade-off: semantic retrievers are fast but suffer from the semantic-functional gap, while execution-based validation improves precision at the cost of prohibitive latency. We propose Lookahead-R, a planning-based framework that reformulates tool retrieval as a resource-constrained sequential decision-making problem. At its core, Lookahead-R introduces a lightweight execution-aware surrogate world model that jointly predicts tool execution success, latency cost, and semantic utility---without invoking real APIs. This world model drives a cost-sensitive, uncertainty-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search that navigates the tool space under strict budget constraints. Evaluated on the large-scale ToolBench benchmark, Lookahead-R achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off across all test scenarios. On the most challenging I3 split, it attains an NDCG@5 of 91.40\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art ToolGen (90.16\%) by 1.24\%. Ablation studies confirm that explicit latency modeling is the key discriminative signal for identifying high-quality tools under resource constraints.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published in ICMR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lookahead-R 把 LLM agent 的工具检索改写成预算受限的序贯决策：用不调用真实 API 的执行感知代理世界模型同时预测工具执行成功率、延迟成本与语义效用，再驱动成本敏感、不确定性引导的 MCTS 在工具空间搜索。在 ToolBench 最难的 I3 划分上 NDCG@5 达 91.40%，超过 SOTA ToolGen（90.16%）1.24 个百分点。
Motivation: 语义检索快但存在语义-功能鸿沟 (semantic-functional gap)，基于执行的校验精度高却延迟不可接受，大规模异构 API 生态下两者难以兼得。
Method: 将工具检索形式化为资源受限序贯决策问题；核心是轻量执行感知代理世界模型，联合预测工具执行成功、延迟成本与语义效用而不调用真实 API；由该模型驱动成本敏感、不确定性引导的 Monte Carlo Tree Search，在严格预算约束下导航工具空间。
Result: 在大规模 ToolBench 基准上取得一致的精度-效率权衡：最难的 I3 划分 NDCG@5 为 91.40%，对比 SOTA ToolGen 的 90.16% 高出 1.24%；消融研究显示显式延迟建模是资源约束下识别高质量工具的关键判别信号。
Conclusion: 在预算约束下，显式建模延迟并配合执行感知的代理世界模型做前瞻搜索，是工具检索精度与效率同时改善的关键，而非单纯依赖语义匹配或真实执行校验。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 在预算约束下，显式建模延迟并配合执行感知的代理世界模型做前瞻搜索，是工具检索精度与效率同时改善的关键，而非单纯依赖语义匹配或真实执行校验。

papers.title: TRACE: Deployable Tree-Relational Structure Enhancement for Oncology LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used in oncology applications, but their predictions are often weakly grounded in explicit medical structure. We present TRACE, a deployable tree-relational enhancement framework for oncology LLMs. TRACE separates expensive offline structure learning from lightweight online inference: oncology concepts and relations are organized into an updatable tree-relational structure, refined using LM-loss-derived evidence, and retrieved at inference time as compact prompt evidence. This design supports task-adaptive evidence selection without requiring supervised labels in the zero-shot setting. Across ten oncology classification tasks and one MedQuAD CancerGov QA benchmark, TRACE improves both label-free evaluation and supervised fine-tuning. Additional analyses show that TRACE improves over vanilla RAG and generic GraphRAG, remains useful under leakage-controlled METABRIC inputs, and produces interpretable evidence paths aligned with clinical reasoning. These results suggest that explicit, updatable medical structure is a practical path toward more accurate and auditable oncology LLM deployment.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track for oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把肿瘤学概念与关系组织成可更新的树状结构，离线用 LM-loss 证据精炼、在线检索为紧凑 prompt 证据，在零样本无监督标签条件下做任务自适应证据选择。在十个肿瘤分类任务与 MedQuAD CancerGov QA 上同时改善无标签评测与有监督微调，优于 vanilla RAG 和通用 GraphRAG，并在防泄漏的 METABRIC 输入下仍有效。
Motivation: 肿瘤学 LLM 的预测缺少显式医学结构支撑，可审计性差；现有 RAG/GraphRAG 无法在无监督标签的零样本设定下做任务自适应证据选择。
Method: 将肿瘤概念与关系组织成可更新的树状结构，用 LM-loss 派生的证据离线精炼，推理时检索为紧凑 prompt 证据；把昂贵的离线结构学习与轻量在线推理分离，零样本下无需监督标签。
Result: 在十个肿瘤分类任务和一个 MedQuAD CancerGov QA 基准上，同时改善无标签评测与有监督微调；相比 vanilla RAG 与通用 GraphRAG 均有提升，在防泄漏 (leakage-controlled) METABRIC 输入下仍有效，并给出与临床推理一致的可解释证据路径。

papers.title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framework to generate over 9,000 paired multimodal news posts across science, health, and entertainment domains, and benchmark 16 open- and closed-source MLLMs for automated detection. We find that most models fall substantially short of human-level accuracy and fail critically on identifying image authenticity. Our research provides a foundation for developing robust defenses against social media fake news. Code and data are available at https: //github.com/xiuzhenzhang/Multimodal.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in the Findings of EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用故事代理、图像代理与批评者代理协作的多智能体框架批量生成可与真实新闻竞争的多模态假新闻，在科学、健康、娱乐三域产出 9,000 余条图文帖，并对 16 个开源与闭源 MLLM 做自动检测基准。多数模型检测准确率远低于人类水平，且在判断图像真伪上出现关键性失败。
Motivation: 文本虚假信息已有较多研究，但 MLLM 能否被用来大规模伪造逼真的图文假新闻、又能否可靠检测，这一问题尚无答案。
Method: 构建三代理框架：story agent 生成与真实新闻相抗衡的帖子文本，image agent 配图，critic agent 打磨以提高可信度；随后用生成的 9,000 余条跨科学、健康、娱乐图文帖，对 16 个开源与闭源 MLLM 做自动检测基准测试。
Result: 生成超过 9,000 条配对多模态新闻帖，覆盖科学、健康、娱乐三个领域；基准测试涵盖 16 个开源与闭源 MLLM，多数模型检测准确率大幅低于人类水平，且在识别图像真伪上关键性失败。
Conclusion: 当前 MLLM 既能被用来批量制造可信的多模态假新闻，又不足以可靠检测它，防御体系需要针对图像真伪识别补强。

papers.title: When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution
papers.abstract_en: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately one-tenth of the tokens required by raw trajectories. Controlled comparisons show that verified action normalization is the principal mechanism by which MATE restores the utility of retrieved experience, support ing memory adaptation as a distinct stage between retrieval and embodied execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MATE 是检索之后、执行之前的确定性记忆改写步骤：删掉过时控制上下文，抽取条件-动作-效果转移，做经验证的动作归一化，再按任务选择表示形式并在固定 token 预算内序列化，全程不额外调用 LLM。在 134 个 ALFWorld 任务上，Qwen2.5-14B 与 72B 的任务成功率分别达 81.3% 与 93.3%，同时只用约十分之一的原始轨迹 token；受控对比显示经验证的动作归一化是恢复检索经验可用性的主因。
Motivation: 具身智能体复用历史轨迹可省去重复探索，但先前成功的轨迹可能与当前执行上下文不兼容；现有记忆系统只优化构建与检索，语义相关和历史成功并不足以保证检索到的经验可用。
Method: MATE 是确定性的检索后处理：移除过时控制上下文，抽取 condition-action-effect 转移，施加经验证的动作归一化 (verified action normalization)，按任务选择表示形式，并在固定预算下序列化，不引入额外 LLM 推理；用受控对比拆解各组件贡献。
Result: 在 134 个 ALFWorld 任务上，MATE 配 Qwen2.5-14B 任务成功率 81.3%，配 Qwen2.5-72B 为 93.3%，token 消耗约为原始轨迹的十分之一；受控对比表明经验证的动作归一化是恢复检索经验效用的主要机制。
Conclusion: 记忆改写应作为检索与具身执行之间的一个独立阶段，其作用来自动作归一化而非更大的检索或生成开销。
